reviewText: Red Door puts Poison & Giorgio to shame. One spray will do or it will announce your arrival before you. It opens with honey-drenched white florals. Morphs into a rose, just a bit soapy, eventually a bit powdery. Takes a long time to dry down. Pleasant & wearable for me ... in about 2 hours. If you like extravagant florals, this one might be for you. I'm glad I opened the red door but I doubt that I'll do it again. I'm gonna keep this red door closed. However, I love this version: Red Door Velvet By Elizabeth Arden For Women, Eau De Parfum Spray, 3.3-Ounce Bottle

My mother has been wearing Red Door for years.  Decades?  Anyway, to me, the smell of Red Door reminds me of my mother and all of the good things that go along with that.  This is one of those fabulous scents that can become a part of the fabric of your life.  I associate the smell with holidays, birthdays and maybe even a night out at the casino.  It's demure, it's soft, but it also has an underlying allure that is sure to please.

As a retired military spouse, my mother has been buying the 3.3 ounce eau de toilette at the BX (Base Exchange) for around $30, and I understand that was often a good value for this fragrance in that volume.  What a coup it seemed to find it here on Amazon for just over $23.00 and eligible for Prime shipping!  I was able to purchase a bottle as a last minute birthday gift for my mother and have it on her doorstep within 2 business days.

What makes this such an outstanding deal is the ability to get free shipping.  Because Amazon ships it from their warehouse it can be combined with Super Saver Shipping, though you'll need to add something else to your order to get to the $25 minimum threshold. If you're a Prime member you don't have to worry about reaching a minimum and you'll enjoy the fast & free 2 day UPS shipping.

This is an item that will stay on our list of favorites and we'll turn to Amazon again and again whenever we need it.
summary: Mom is delighted by the price & I'm delighted it's Prime eligible!

reviewText:
Probably this is good for women but definitely not for men.
This is not for men, that's for sure

Perfume is one of those hard things to review.  Not every scent is for everyone.  This perfume in particular is a very deep scent.  Some people prefer more light and floral, or fruity scent, but this is much heavier.  I enjoy it as I enjoy a variety of scents.

One ounce of a rustic, earthy smelling perfume that lingers through the day.

This is a quality fragrance that's appealing in small amounts.  It's not sweet or flowery, more of a cologne strength.  Perfume is very personal, and my wife likes this one in very light qunatities.  I agree.  Good for an evening event or dinner.

Small spray bottle.

Calvin Klein Obsession is a darker, musky scent. When first applied it is a tad overwhelming but mellows out quickly into something more pleasant. The scent lasts for awhile and there's no need to reapply.

I just find that this particular scent reads a bit older. My sister and mom both felt the same way. Men seem to like it though.

Although it's not really to my specific tastes, it's a quality product.
summary: Lasting scent; reads a little old

reviewText: I guess it would be silly to say I am obsessed with this Parfum. I love the amber, musk undertones that make it more earthy than floral. I could smell this scent all day.

The smell is an ok smell, not too overpowering if you spray just a little. The hints of scent mentioned in the description are somewhat noticeable, but it smells mostly like a mild musky scent. At first the alcohol smell is super strong, but that dwindled over time. It is a decent perfume, but probably not one I would get again.

It's just not for me. I have respect for the iconic scents, but I have to come clean... I'm simple. Dita Von Teese talks about how "woman" scents are dark, spicy and complex- while "girl" ones are more sweet. She's flawless so I've tried to lean that way while I creepily hunt down her beauty tips, but I love Very Valentino and Philosophy Loveswept-- with Obsession specifically the chemistry is so bad on my skin that it actually makes me feel slightly nauseous.

I'd definitely get a sample if you do like spicier scents, but if you're like me with lighter, sweeter scents... this probably isn't for you.
summary: Scents are just so personal and varying...

reviewText:
No idea why amazon wanted this product reviewed but I jumped on it because its a classic and one that everyone in my house loves. This seemed authentic, with the heavy vanilla at first and seductive musky lingering smell. You will probably find the best price on amazon. But you must try it on first. While this smelled good on multiple women who I had sample it, it smelled different on each one. On some it was more vanilla, on others more citrus, and a guy I tried it on for kicks it smelled borderline bad. Mostly all woody with very little vanilla or floral. So keep in mind everyones body chemistry is different and you need to know whether you like the way it smells on you. One of the women it was tried on hated it, even though everyone else thought it was good. Its such a personal thing.

If you like vanilla with a hint of floral and a lingering woodsy musk you'll enjoy this.

This is an old name in perfume, but I hadn't tried it before.  It takes just a small spritz to last a long time and provide all the scent I want.  (PSA:  A little scent is nice, a lot is not nicer - go easy with whatever scent you want to use.  Especially if you are in an office or work area where others have no choice but to inhale your perfume.)

My first impression of Obsession is that is is a spicy, rich scent, relatively heavy but not overpowering.  It is not a light floral.  For my tastes, it is more suited to winter or special evenings out than sunny summer days.  It has a woodsy scent to it in addition to the spicy tones.  According to the product page, there are lots of different ingredients that add up to a very nice blend.  It is also supposed to be musky, but that is not strong, which is good for me.  I don't like overly musky scents.

My husband really likes this on me, and the scent lasts on my skin.  Which brings up an important point - if you have not tried the scent before, I suggest buying a small size to see how much you like it on YOU.  You can't really judge until you've put it on your skin and see how it reacts.  Also, the smaller bottles let you replace it more often so it stays fresh.  Old perfume is not a good thing.  Unless you use the same perfume daily, you'll save money in the long run at the smaller, more-expensive-per-ounce bottles.

I'm not a "signature scent" kind of gal - I like variety.  While I will wear this more during cooler weather, it earns a place in my perfume arsenal.

Obsession has been around since the 80's, and it smells like it too. That's not a bad thing, I rather enjoyed most of the powerhouse fragrances like this, be it for men or women. Obsession is one of those fragrances marketed for women, but men can easily wear this one too. The scent is one that sticks with you like an old friend, and it is a unique, memorable one. The longevity and strength of this doesn't seem quite the same as it was in the 80's though. I'm afraid this one seems to have seen some reformulation sometime, though I can't prove it. It just doesn't quite have the same vibe it did back then. It's still a great fragrance though.

I remember when Obsession first came out back in 1985.  The commercials were so scandalous for the time, and, as a high schooler, I remember smelling it for the first time shortly after it came out, and thinking that it smelled so "adult."  It's been years and years since I first wore Obsession, and so it was nostalgic to receive a new bottle of it through the Vine program.

Obsession falls into the category of oriental perfumes, and it gives off a musky scent whose main notes are Mandarin, Bergamot, Vanillin, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Coriander, Tagette, Amber, and Oakmoss.

It goes on strong, but after about an hour, it sinks into your skin more and just gives off a soft, sultry scent.

This is also really concentrated; one squirt is enough to provide enough scent on me so as to not be overpowering.

I love scents with darker notes like Paris, Jo Malone Blue Cacao and Agave, Black Opium, and Angel, and this fits right in with those other mysterious scents.

Certain scents are just classics, and Obession is one of them.  Even after thirty years, it feels modern and sexy.
summary: A sexy, intense oriental that doesn't feel dated at all -- even after thirty years!

reviewText: I have had this perfume for only a few days and I can confidently say this is my favorite perfume as of now. At first, I was thinking that this is just another overpriced perfume with a designer's name on it. I remember the commercials which put a smile on my face as I sprayed it on.  The first thing that hit me was the orange blossom. I never had any perfume that had an orange fragrance that was so noticeable. I also loved the musky smell that is typically reserved for men's cologne. I smelled a sweet almost vanilla smell, bergamot, and amber. The combination of these potent ingredients makes this an amazing perfume. I have received so many compliments on it. Since you do not have to spray a lot on, I think the 1fl. oz will last me a while.  If you have never tried this perfume, you have to because it has such a broad spectrum of delicious, sweet, and spicy fragrances that will appeal to many women.

This is by no means a light, frothy scent, neither is it excessively heavy or overpowering as long as it's applied sparingly.  I find it delightfully spicy, intriguing and complex.  Because it can be assertive, I've had the most satisfactory results spraying the air and walking into the mist rather than spraying myself directly.  Even with that indirect method, the fragrance lingers all day and doesn't really fade for hours.

After reading a list of the scents (mandarin, bergamot, vanillin, jasmine, orange blossom, oakmoss, musk and amber) of which it's comprised, I was fairly sure that I would find Obsession appealing and I was certainly not disappointed.  What did surprise me, however, was how much my husband liked it.  I can't recall his ever complimenting any of the fragrances I wear, yet he made a few mentions of how much he liked this one.  So for both of us, Obsession is a keeper.

I was feeling nostalgic when I ordered my bottle of Calvin Klein Obsession.  I used to LOVE the scent and wanted to throw it into my perfume mix again.  I was so excited to open the package, so I sprayed it on my wrists immediately!  I took a huge whiff and was quite surprised.  It still has that incredible dreamy smell of Obsession, but it also had an alcohol and chemical smell.  At first I wondered what I was thinking when I was younger that I would wear this.  Then I read some reviews and discovered that the formula had been sold.  I understand companies try to find cheaper ways to make products so they can make more money.  However, I wonder if they took into account the amount of customers they would lose because of this change?!?!!?  How disappointing!!!!

This has a warm, woodsy scent that would be great on a cool evening. I really liked it. But after spraying it on my wrist, I sneezed violently more than 20 times, which is totally uncommon, so I wonder if it was the parfum? But that's just me. If it happens again. I will update this review, but I do like the scent.
This is definitely not my favorite. I feel this scent is way too heavy for work. I don't know if this is the original obsession or  what because it doesn't smell like I remember.

I'm a big fragrance connoisseur as I have over 20 bottles in my fragrance cabinet ranging from Nautical, Versace, Lacoste, to my personal favorite, Gucci.  I'm very particular about my scents and was not a big fan of CK as I felt as though they were the JC Penny of fragrances.  However, Obsession has given me pause as I find it's rich and elegant scents to be rather complimenting.  I like to categorize my fragrances into sections such as sport, fresh, executive, etc. and I find Obsession to fall into the executive category as it feels like a mature scent without reeking of "old man" like Old English Leather.

Obsession starts out very potent and smells cheapy but, after a few minutes, mellows out and leaves a very mature scent behind that lasts for much of the day.  I work in retail during my days and I found that three sprays (arms and neck) lingers pleasantly for an entire 8-hour shift (including lunch) to the point where my fianc notices the scent when I get home from work.

While I still prefer other scents such as Nautica Voyage and Armani Code, CK's Obsession is a great addition to any fragrance connoisseur's collection as it superbly blends mature scents without coming across as old.
summary: Rich, Executive, Potent, and Long Lasting For Men

reviewText: Beautiful fragrance, very sexy and alluring and I've noticed that most men love this fragrance.  It's also very long lasting,  I sprayed a little on my jacket and could still smell it the next day when I opened the closet.  Perfumes usually smell a little different depending on the wearer but to me this one smells very sweet and spicy along with a hint of musk.
This my sisters favorite perfume so it was a gift.
Love it. would not be without it.

Obsession is a big spicy oriental that is similar to Opium & Cinnabar in my mind. However, Obsession seems so much better to me because it's still current, relevant, & wearable. Although gorgeous, Opium & Cinnabar seem dated by comparison. That is usually how I think of Obsession - as a me-too spicy oriental that has aged better than her big sisters.
summary: Spicy oriental stuck in time, but better than her sisters.

reviewText:
Calvin Klein's Obsession was one of the earliest releases in the designer fragrance craze, and it has since become a classic.  Obsession is a warm, earthy, sensual scent.  There is no floral or sweetness to it; rather, it has a musky, almost masculine quality with a bit of a vanilla note.  The scent is gently seductive--alluring enough for romance, but also subtle enough for everyday wear.  In has excellent staying power, as it lingers on the skin all day long.

Although Obession has all of the qualities I usually like in a fragrance--I definitely prefer musky, spicy scents to more floral ones--for some reason, Obsession is not one of my favorites; although I do enjoy wearing it on occasion, I actually prefer stealing some of my husband's Obession for Men to wear for myself!  Overall, however, Obsession for women is a classic fragrance that I would definitely recommend.
summary: The fragrance that started it all!

reviewText: Item is as described and arrived promptly.
L'Occitane has wonderful products.  Love the scene of this one.
Great scent!
Peculiar that I bought  Verbena Cleansing Hand Wash. If this didn't work Id return it without doubt.
Best shave cream ever!!!

It works about as well as anything else I've ever tried to get my razor burn under control. I'm sure this is great for most people who use it, to me is worked about as well as the No. 7 Shave Gel. Good shave cream, just nothing particularly "wowed" me.

This is a very good shave cream as long as you can get it out of the container.

This shave cream is thick, smells nice, and is super slippery. It rinses cleanly and does not leave your face feeling overly dry. I feel like I get a closer shave when using this shaving cream vs other lower end brands. My skin is more on the sensitive side and I have had no reaction to this face wash. A small dab goes a long way, which means this bottle will last a long time.

My one gripe with most of Billy's products is the packaging. These white bottles are too stiff for a thicker product like this. You really need to work to get this product out of the container and its worse as the container gets more empty. Down near the bottom it is almost impossible to get the rest. I contemplated cutting it in half and just scooping it out, but I shave in the shower and that may present a problem. This could deter me from buying this product in the future.

For me this is part of my regular shave routine:

Steps
1) Billy Jealousy Liquidsand
2) Billy Jealousy Hot Towel
3) Billy Jealousy Super Slick Shave Cream
4) Billy Jealousy Shaved Ice

I have sensitive skin and get razor burn and until I tried the Billy Jealousy line I dreaded shaving, but this works wonders for me.

Sometimes the hot towel interferes and this is the least important of all the shave line if you ask me.

I will say this, if you have regular access to Menscience Face Scrub, that's actually the best for Step 1. Problem is it's about 2-3 times more and is more for just pre-shave than whereas Liquidsand can be used all the time.

My esthetician recmnded this & she was right! It keeps a low profile so it's easier to see what you're doing but still makes the skin just slick enough to help with smooth shaving. There's no slipping around.
Freshly shaved skin shows no signs redness or irritation. I can maneuver around the knees and ankles with no nicks.
It is a little pricey but so concentrated the price ends up being about the same as drug store brands.
Best save cream I've ever used! Billy Jealousy products are the best, and reasonably priced. Always a close, smooth shave, leaves your face moisturized, not greasy nor oily afterwards.
summary: Billy Jealousy Hydroplane Shave Cream, 8-Ounce Bottle

reviewText: I have settled on the jack black line as I think overall it's superior to billy jealousy- but nothing I've ever tried is better than this shave cream. It does everything they advertise it to do. I have super sensitive skin, and after shaving, no red marks or irritation at all. And it has a very nice clean scent.

This hydroplane shave cream is good but there are better brands out there (proraso, taylor of old bond st). It is also lighter/thinner than most creams and doesn't leave any residue on your face. The best thing about it is that it rinses off very easily from my razor and from the sink too- doesn't gum everything up. I imagine it'd be great with an electric razor but I use a safety razor so I need something thicker. Price is high but I spend this much on 3 beers at happy hour and the bottle lasts a few months lol.

SHAVING- let me save you years of trial and error: take a warm shower & wash your face with billy jealousy exfoliating facial cleanser, shave afterwards with a $50 Merkur safety razor handle with good blades (save $100's on mach 3 refills!), use a $20 Tweezerman badger hair shaving brush to apply taylor of old street bond (or proraso) shaving cream (you can let it set in a minute), shave WITH the grain DOWN, SLOWLY, SOFTLY (don't press hard- let the weight of the handle and sharp blade do the cutting), lastly rub on a fingertip of proraso pre/post shave cream while your face is still wet and let it dry! Say goodbye to razor bumps and ingrown hairs FOREVER! Trust me- I've tried dozens of pricey face washes, shaving creams, and after shaves over the last 4 years. If you don't want to commit so much money yet- order the pre/post shave proraso cream online, buy proraso shave cream online or at bath and body works (under their C.O. Bigelow label) then get the cheap single blade disposables (mach 3's are too aggressive) at a grocery store and you'll notice a difference overnight.
summary: Works good- rinses off razor and sink awesomely!

reviewText:
Made by a company out of dallas - Billy Jealousy "Hydroplane Super-Slick shave Gel" has had excellent reviews over the years, well for the most part anyway.

It comes in a white 8 oz tube with a big gold sticker announcing it won first place in the Esquire Mens Grooming competition for the best shave you can get. And to that I have to agree - but with some reservations.

It's an opalescent white gel that becomes opaque on the scalp immediately. The scent is a little odd but not off putting. Kind of a mix of citrus and plastic. It's a non issue though as it's so faint and vague you have to make it a point to notice it. The product is made of all natural ingredients, cruelty free and alcohol free which I like.

The "secret" ingredient is "Dimethicone" which is an organic micro silicone that delivers a frictionless shave.

The first time I used it the blades on my Sensor and HeadBlade were about a week old so the fact that I didn't get a single nick and got such a smooth shave with a single pass is impressive. I shave both face and head with either a straight edge razer (cut throats) or an electric. If you have a wet/dry electric such as the Panasonic 5 foil Linear line - you'll get a 100% barber shop smooth shave using Hydroplane.

Hydroplane is at the mid range level for quality shave creams at $20 for an 8 oz tube -  you definitely need to use more then the dime size they reccomend.

For dry shaving out of the shower You'll need to splash water on from time to time to keep the super slickness going or else the gel gets sticky and you can feel the drag from the razor. For those looking for the closest and most comfortable shave they can get in this price range - you can't find a better shave gel.

Here's a list of the ingredients:

Purified Water, Stearic Acid, Triethanolamine, Glycereth 7, Cocamide DEA, C12 15 Alkyl Benzoate, PEG/PPG 14/14 Dimethicone, Behentrimonium, Methosulfate, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Cetearyl Alcohol, Mentha Piperita Oil (Peppermint), Citrus Grandis Oil (Grapefruit), Citrus Aurantium Dulcis Oil (Orange), Methylparaben, Citrus Aurantifolia Oil (Lime), Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Oil (Bergamot), Propylparaben, Zingiber Officinale Oil (Ginger), Diazolidinyl Urea

They also have a post shave lotion called "Shaved Ice" which is excellent and feels wonderfully chilly.

I got a sample of this stuff with an order of Derby Extra blades.  I normally use Art of Shaving pre-shave oil along with AOS shaving cream or Proraso Cream.  The Billy Jealousy, by itself, does a nice job of lubricating your skin and providing comfort while shaving while providing a close shave.  My face, however, feels better with my regular battery of shaving paraphernalia.  Even after putting on my normal after shave balm, my skin felt a bit dry with the Billy Jealousy.  That being said, I'm going to order a bottle for travel and for those times I need to shave again in the evening.  It's really hassle-free to use and requires no brush and very little prep.

It won't be my primary shave cream, but I plan to use it fairly frequently especially when I'm in a hurry.

For me this is part of my regular shave routine:

Steps
1) Billy Jealousy Liquidsand
2) Billy Jealousy Hot Towel
3) Billy Jealousy Super Slick Shave Cream
4) Billy Jealousy Shaved Ice

I have sensitive skin and get razor burn and until I tried the Billy Jealousy line I dreaded shaving, but this works wonders for me.

Of all the shave products without a doubt this is the best for me. I've had major neck and face irritation for decades and tried everything and finally this worked. Cools my face and hydrates ... this is the best of the shave products Billy Jealousy makes hands down and I couldn't do without it.

I will say this, if you have regular access to Menscience Face Scrub, that's actually the best for Step 1. Problem is it's about 2-3 times more and is more for just pre-shave than whereas Liquidsand can be used all the time.

Billy Jealousy has a "bad boy" reputation. That must mean, "Boy, this stuff hurts badly."

Shaved Ice contains some good stuff -- aloe and oils -- but it burned my face. I was tired of going to work with the dry, burning sensation that B.J.S.I causes, so I discarded the remaining 60 percent left in my bottle.

It clearly is a well-regarded product line, but it is no good for my sensitive skin. I'll look elsewhere for a good after-shave balm.

Good brand but the main thing I didn't like about this is the long-lastingness or thickness of it. It has an ok smell and dries nicely but 24 hours later you can still taste it around your lips- gross! Get the Proraso pre/post shave cream and it has a better smell and gives your skin a smooth tightness and it heals nicks better.

SHAVING- let me save you years of trial and error: take a warm shower & wash your face with billy jealousy exfoliating facial cleanser, shave afterwards with a $50 Merkur safety razor handle with good blades (save $100's on mach 3 refills!), use a $20 Tweezerman badger hair shaving brush to apply taylor of old street bond (or proraso) shaving cream (you can let it set in a minute), shave WITH the grain DOWN, SLOWLY, SOFTLY (don't press hard- let the weight of the handle and sharp blade do the cutting), lastly rub on a fingertip of proraso pre/post shave cream while your face is still wet and let it dry! Say goodbye to razor bumps and ingrown hairs FOREVER! Trust me- I've tried dozens of pricey face washes, shaving creams, and after shaves over the last 4 years. If you don't want to commit so much money yet- order the pre/post shave proraso cream online, buy proraso shave cream online or at bath and body works (under their C.O. Bigelow label) then get the cheap single blade disposables (mach 3's are too aggressive) at a grocery store and you'll notice a difference overnight.
summary: Works pretty good but Proraso pre/post shave cream is #1

reviewText:
I used a different skin care line for years, and recently tried just the hydroplane shave cream, and now I use the full Billy Jealousy line. Trust me, this is great stuff. I have super sensitive skin, and after I shave- no nicks,cuts, or irritation. If it works for me, I'm sure it would probably work for you.
And not to stray from the point, but Gillette fusion pro glide is the best razor there is- trust me again, I've tried them all.
And no, I don't get a commission if you buy that razor- LOL

I've used the Billy Jealousy "Shaved Ice After Shave Balm" a few times so far. It's a clear gel that feels great. The name couldn't be more appropriate because it really does cool your skin down. It doesn't contain menthol (which for me is a plus) so I have no clue how they get the cooling effect.

After I'm done shaving and walk back into air conditioning with this product on my face and head it feels wonderfully icy cold. It's refreshing, with a very light citrus scent that comes from the ingredients as the product is fragrance free. Like their "Hydroplane Slick Shave" Shaved Ice is in my opinion over priced especially for 3.5 oz. The packaging is the same as the Hydroplane shave gel so why the company didn't just put out an 8 oz at the same price point as a companion product is beyond me.

To it's credit you really do only have to use a tiny bit to cover your entire head - so a little goes a long way. Shaved Ice does an excellent job soothing your skin and the chill factor is unique to say the least.
summary: Refreshing For Face And Head Shavers

reviewText: Just started using this product again. Have used this in the past and it works wonders. My skin feels tighter and has a smoother appearance after 1 bottle. I have used 3x 5x and 10x strength and I recommend starting at a lower concentration and working your way up. If you do not have sensitive skin you may want to start at 5x. This is a great product and you only have to apply it at nighttime. The smell is quite pleasant also in my opinion.
I use it daily, great stuff. I'm outside all day long. It's amazing.

I love this Replenix Retinol Plus Smoothing serum. I use it daily and am noticing the wrinkles are looking much finer!!

I love this Replenix Trans-Retinol Smoothing Serum!! I use it every morning as the last thing I apply before my make up. It's a great source of Retinol and not drying in any way. It is a great way to get the much needed retinol for wrinkle control without any dry or flaking results afterwards. Great product that I love!!
I USED THIS until my face started peeling like crazy! Start out with the 3x then work up. It smells and feels great! Now using it with Vichy serum

I absolutely love this flat iron.  I just started using a flat iron for curling in the last six months or so, and the one I started with was an HSI, which was was very difficult to use.  I was happily surprised to find how easy and effective the Babyliss is to use.  Highly recommend!

This is the best flat iron I ever purchased.  I have thick bone straight Asian hair and this thing curls it in record time.  I used to have to spray a ton of products on and leave my hair for extra time to get it even close to curling but this iron does its job within 5 seconds! Fantastic iron!
Great product. I like that its thin and not too wide. Easy to use, heats incredibly fast, can use for curls, waves, or straight.
amazing! i live by this iron, I've had it already for so many years and it is amazing. gives you shiny super straight hair, it heats up really fast which makes it useful for days you are in a rush.

This dryer is really heavy and normally I would say it is too heavy. However, I have been working out my guns lately and seem to handle the weight better than I would have in the past. I have now used my dryer twice with the smoothing nozzle on it. I have fine hair, but a lot of it. It is also naturally curly and I use the dryer to straighten my locks. My hair dried pretty quickly, but what really surprised me was how much smoother my hair looked and felt with this dryer versus my cheapie ceramic drier. My hair is noticeably smoother,  and I love that this has a cold setting rather than just a cold shot button. It makes cooling the strands and setting the style so much easier!

If only is was 1/2 the weight I would have given 5 stars.  Hopefully it will last as long as my cheapie dryers. It seems every time I splurge on something higher end, it burns out in a couple months- while the cheap $20 dryers last me a year or 2. That's why I went wit this one. It wasn't too expensive, but seemed like a step up. Hopefully it is well made.
Love, love, love this flat iron it get the job done, I'm able to straighten large sections of my hair at one time!!!
I love the ceramic hair dryer.  The only reason I didn't give 5 stars, it is heavy.  It doesn't bother me though but may some.
summary: I love the ceramic hair dryer

reviewText:
The BaByliss that I previously had was so much smaller but it threw so much heat and air. I loved it. The cord was a good 10 feet long, which made using it awesome, I could stand in my hall way to make sure the dogs were not getting into trouble.

This BaByliss is so much heavier, I can barely hold it away from my head. I get tired holding it in one hand. I can barely dry one hair strand before having to switch sides. I have to keep going back and forth to dry.

The rubberized grip is so slippery. After getting out of the shower and using lotion or hair products, holding this super heavy hair dryer is so hard. It keeps wanting to slip out of my grip and I'm nervous I'll drop it.

It definitely has enough air flow. It really blows out and it seems to get my hair dry faster than my old BaByliss. The heaviness and worrying is too stressful.

I love the BaByliss but this one is not the right one for me.

I'll caveat this review by saying I'm not a hair stylist and no nothing as in zip, zilch, nada about the tools used in that profession. However my better half has been a stylist for twenty years and serves as Creative Director for one of the top ten Day Spas in the United States - he knows his scissors and then some.

Based on his feedback BaByliss Tools are a top choice for professionals for a couple of reasons:

* They hold up to heavy commercial use

* Superior build quality

* Solid Warrantee

* Comfortable grip and easy to work with

As for sizing the one inch is the most popular and any hair stylist worth their salt can straighten any size curl or wave with the one inch diameter plate. The price on Amazon was the best - beating out even the closed to the general public beauty supply houses that cater only to professionals.

Over the years I've found this to be true with virtually all his tools of trade and recently bought him a pair of $700 Kamisori shears for $265 with free shipping to boot. As for the flat iron it arrived in it's sealed retail packaging and again with a Prime membership you get free two day shipping to boot.
summary: Top Of The Line Unit At Less Than Half Price

reviewText: This is the straight iron you want if your naturaly hair is thick and curly. I have other BaByliss Pro irons and they are OK, but I'm truly impressed with the performance of this one. The enclosed directions give guidelines to heat settings based upon your hair type, and they seem fairly accurate. The directions also advise ironing as close to your scalp as possible (*not too close or you'll burn it...), and taking small sections at a time and letting them cool prior to combing or brushing your hair. There's an on/off switch and manual dial adjustment for the heat setting. The cord is on a swivel and it's of a generous length. The 1" porcelain plates are smooth, and will remain that way with care. I found that using TRESemme Thermal Creations Heat Tamer Protective Spray 8 fl oz (236 ml) as I dry my hair, and then again as I am using this iron, gives me excellent results! Soft, straight, smooth and shiny, without any stiffness or stickiness. A great combination of heat protection and performance. I highly recommend this iron for all hair types, but especially for those with thick wavy or curly hair who want a smooth option.

BaBylissPRO has a lot of blowing power. I love it! I use it to dry my hair & my body. It outperforms my old dryer Conair Babinkw5548 White Babyliss Pro Ionic Hair Dryer 2000w, and that dryer now seems like a gentle breeze compared to this powerhouse.

It did trip a circuit breaker when this was operating along with too many other electric devices, so I make sure that my curlers aren't heating up at the same time.
summary: This dryer blows away the competition.

reviewText: It was a good flat iron while it lasted. It probably would have died quicker if I used it more often. I may have used it a couple times a week, if that. I only used it to tame fly away hair so probably had it on for 5 min a use. It worked great each time - until I turned it on today. It got comfortably warm to the touch and than it cooled down. Done. Kaput. Tried it again this evening just to make sure. Didn't even get warm.
summary: I purchased it March 2011. It just died

reviewText: When this arrived, the dryer smelled pretty bad. I hadn't even turned it on yet but I kept picking up an electrical/burning scent. It filled my bathroom when I put it in there, so I was skeptical to turn it on and use it. The first few times I used the dryer, it smelled, but gradually declined. My thought was maybe it just needed to be broken in. Although it wasn't a good impression (having read previous reviews w/ electrical problems), I am loving it now. It's very soft to the touch, easy to use and dries my hair pretty quickly. I was using an old conair dryer that finally died, so I was happy to upgrade. There are 3 temperature settings which I like, and I don't think the "Hot" gets so hot that it burns your head, hair and leaves you seeing smoke. It is a little heavy as previous reviews have mentioned, but I don't find that it is difficult to hold for the couple minutes I am using it. I never had a problem w/ frizz, so I can't speak to that. I don't notice any additional damage to my hair, and that's all that matters to me. I am just enjoying the couple minutes my long hair takes to dry using this, versus several minutes with other dryers. It's also quieter than my last dryer as well. Overall, I am liking this dryer a lot and would purchase again.
summary: A fast dryer at a great price

reviewText: I can save lots of time drying my hair. It works great!

Really good power, good heat at high or medium, and I appreciate the cool shot button to 'set' a curl on the brush. Gets the job done quickly in the morning.  It's a little clunky, and noisy, but they mostly are.  The sliding buttons on the shaft for volume and heat control are a little hard to move with thumb while holding the dryer, I usually have to stop and get a really good grip with my nail in the lower button.

reviewerName: Lover of Life, Sunsets, Cats and Cooking
reviewText:
I have a lot of hair and drying it is a chore. This hairdryer works better than any other that I have tried and is much more quiet as well.

I love the black matte look and feel of it - it provides a bit of non-slip protection and hasn't fallen out of my hands yet.

I do find the switches to be a little hard to operate with even slightly damp hands, but other than that, I am entirely happy with this purchase.

I bought a universal diffuser to work with this hairdryer and would make both purchases over again.
summary: Great hairdryer for thick, hard to dry hair.

reviewText: BEST hair dryer I have ever owned. Dries my thick, long hair in minutes and leaves it smooth and silky.
summary: BEST hair dryer I have ever owned

reviewText: Love it! So far, so good. This super powerful and blow hot. Speeds up a blow dry for sure.

Wonderful!  I have medium to long hair and it dried it so fast!  It's described perfectly and I will order again if I need too.  The pros are fast heat or low heat even cool air if you need it.  It blows a lot of air so be prepared but it dries my hair super fast!!
Excellent blowdryer. Very quiet and powerful but it is a bit heavy as others said in their reviews. Doesn't bother me, it takes so much less time to dry my hair that it is worth the extra weight.
summary: Excellent blowdryer. Very quiet and powerful but it is ...

reviewText: Good overall but is fairly heavy compared to my previous blow dryers

Wow! just wow. Outside of having my hair blown out after getting it done at the salon, I have never used an ionic hair dryer on myself. I have hectic, chaotic, insane mornings and I have to get ready in about 15 minutes from the time I get out of the shower if I want to avoid traffic (and I do).  In the summer, I've just been leaving my hair wet but then i get to my office and it's freezing in there. I didn't want to keep having to take the time or create the damage of blow drying it everyday. With fall in winter around the corner in the north east, I needed a plan. I had heard about these dryers and figured I'd give this try after reading the reviews. I'm so glad I did! I only had time for a half-a**ed dry this morning but I could tell there is a totally amazing quality to this hair dryer. I love the warm/cool settings, I don't feel like I'm damaging my hair PLUS my hair came out straighter and without frizz. I can't wait to see what this bad boy does when I actually have the time. Great, high quality hair dryer IMO. I would definitely recommend.

Really did feel relief from dry itchy scalp due to frequent hair coloring.  This was my 2nd bottle.  Will continue to purchase so
I'll always have it on hand when needed.  Package arrived promptly and product arrived in excellent condition.
This is the best dandruff shampoo.  It does not dry out scalp.  It smells good.  It is worth the extra money as it really works and leaves the hair in good condition.

I suffered for years with dandruff. I've tried every thing from T-Gel to Tea Tree and so on. Nothing could get rid of my dandruff except for the the Philip B Anti-Flake. It doesn't smell as pretty as the other Philip B products, in fact it smells like tar and potting soil. However, use it as directed with a balancing shampoo like the Scent of Santa Fe or with a moisturizing shampoo like the Nordic Wood in order to give your hair better body.

I like the way this smells, I don't like the way most of the other anti-flake shampoos smell. My girlfriend, however, doesn't like the smell. To each their own.

Apart from that, it keeps the flakes away. I use it a couple times a week in my regular rotation and it works great. I guess as long as I'm not noticing anything on my black shirt, then it's doing it's job. Don't need to use a lot of it either, a little goes a long way. As you've come to expect, Philip B delivers another solid product. Amazon also has the best prices, especially if you watch it for a while and see how the price fluctuates - you can really get it pretty cheap.
This truly is an amazing product for the price!  It makes your scalp feel amazing and you honestly do feel and see a difference in your hairline.

I previously was using a $25 ConAir hairdryer that was 1750, and I don't notice much of a difference between the results of that dryer andt this one.  Plus the BaByliss is much heavier!!

It's a fine dryer, but the $25 ConAir delivers the same results.

After reading many reviews and trying out 2 other highly reviewed and value-priced hairdryers, I settled on this BaByliss. The other dryers just didn't get hot enough. This dryer is very quiet but has a stong air flow and the high heat temperature is hot, but not so much that it burns the scalp (I use the concentrator nozzle).  I was worried about the weight, since so many others said it was too heavy. Yes, its heavier than most dryers at this price point, but I haven't had a problem with my arms getting tired even after the 20-25 minutes it takes to dry my hair (I do exercise with weights regularly though). I actually weighed it out of curiosity and it's only 1 lb 11 oz. For those looking to spend less than $35 on a hairdryer with a salon-level high heat temperature, this BaByliss what you need!

This is one powerful hair dryer; maybe a little too powerful.  My mom is a hairdresser & this feels like the dryers she uses.  It is quite heavy so if you have hand mobility issues this may not be the one for you.

It can really heat up on the high heat & high air setting so much so that I normally use it on the medium heat, low air.  I find the highest air setting blows too much for styling.  When I use it on high air, I make sure to turn down the heat or use the cold air button.

The dryer has a unique finish; kind of "rubbery".  I like it because it is not slippery like my old dryer.

I really have to giggle at the claim that this dries hair from the inside out.  How can it do that?  And the current product dimensions says 2.6 ounces.  That is an error.  It weighs over 2 pounds.

Now for the good stuff.  It isn't quiet, but it's quieter than other blow dryers I've owned.  There isn't anything amazing or magical about it except the design.  It's a bit more compact than my old dryer, and the handle is great.  This dryer is so easy to hold and aim.  All the other blow dryers I've owned felt clunky.  This feels like an extension of my arm.  You know how sometimes you have those days when you go to spray your hair, and you wind up spraying the bathroom door?  It's like that with blow dryers, too, let's face it.  I don't have that problem with this baby.  I actually *don't mind* having to dry my hair!  Since I can really get it pointed in the right direction, I can get my hair dry faster.  I noticed this difference in the grip as soon as I took it out of the box.  Also, my arms don't get as tired with my BaByliss.

The cool shot really is a cool shot.  Takes a second or two vs fifteen for it to get really cool.

Ceramic heat?  Who really cares about that?  It's a great blow dryer.  Period.

I would definitely recommend this to a friend.  I may even buy one for my hairdresser :)

My skin is combination skin, and in the spring/summer, especially, the T-zone on my face is perpetually oily and shiny.  No type of makeup or powder helps with this problem.  Since the other parts of my skin are dry, I use this product only on my T-zone, and have noticed, after just a few uses, a definite improvement in shine, oil, and what I call "makeup override" which is when oil overpowers and makes the makeup on my face disappear in those oily areas.  My nose/forehead still gets oily looking later in the day, but this is a big improvement overall.

I received a tester.
One thing that I noted was that there are artificial colors in this mask when it is pretty much just white anyway.  It seems like those are just unnecessary to me.  There's also some fragrance components that could cause some people problems, though the scent itself is just very light and not at all strong.  The clay is Kaolin.

It comes out as a thick white lotion that I spread over my face.  I received a tester and there were no instructions.  I used it like I would any other mask, applying it to my face and letting it dry before rinsing it well.

I picked this out to try because my skin is normally dry, but during big temperature changes like we have in the South during the spring, it gets very, very oily, and that's been a problem lately.  This has some menthol it in that felt slightly cooling on my skin.  I read while it dried and found it pleasant to have on.  It rinsed off easily.  I felt like it took every bit of oil, dirt, sweat- everything, out of my skin.  My skin felt vacuumed out.  My skin looked a bit rosy and felt a bit dry and tight.  I put some moisturizer on and my skin just sucked it up, much more than normal.  24 hours later and my skin still didn't feel oily, only normal.

I would say that this is going to be a product that people should figure out for themselves how often to use.  I would reserve use of it for myself for times during seasonal changes when my skin gets very oily.  I would avoid this normally when my skin was dry, because this mask is very drying to me.  I do really appreciate that it is good at decreasing oiliness and cleansing and tightening pores.

I would recommend this for people with oily skin.  It does have some ingredients that could be a problem or very sensitive skin though, and it could cause a bit of breakout at first- it has willow bark in it and ingredients that often will 'uncover' breakouts about to happen anyway, though they should be less serious than usual and descrease quickly.  This seems like it would be a great mask for teen guys and men with very oily skin too.
summary: Decreases oil, cleans & tightens pores VERY well, but it is drying, and is probably best for oily skin that's not too sensitive

reviewText: Per the wife:  I don't have acne. I am 55 years old.  But I do have large pores and I am always looking for products that will help reduce the size.  Plus I have oily skin. I love this mask. I wear heavy makeup during the day, and this mask takes it all off.  When I use a toner after using this mask, there is no makeup left on my face.  It also has a very pleasant scent. I like to put it on in the bathtub after I wash my face, let it dry and then wash it off. It feels very luxurious and does a great job. It reduced my pore size. My skin is tight the next morning and looks great.  The product size is large so you get a lot out of the container.  Overall, highly recommended.
summary: Reduce Pores Size; Gets off all of your makeup.

reviewText: Some masks are difficult to spread because they're too thick or firm. Not this one: this is a white cream that is easily smoothed over your entire face in just a minute. It dries quickly and is easy to remove afterward with a warm damp washcloth. Afterward, my face feels smooth and clean (and I follow with a serum and moisturizer). Note that if you apply nothing after the mask, there's a little bit of a satin-like sheen to your skin that remains after mask removal. The dispenser works well and there is a pleasing scent that is acceptable for both men and women. I have had no irritation or redness following every other day use. Highly recommend.
summary: Easy to apply, quick drying, cleansing mask for both men and women. Follow with serum and moisturizer.

reviewText: I have used this eye cream for 4 years now and I am very happy with it.  It does a good job of smoothing fine lines and absorbs well. I also have sensitive eyes and this product does not bother them. I highly recommend the PCA line.

I will write another review on my third or fourth month.

UPDATE I am a big fan of PCA skin products and I had to update this review because I really believe I was sold an expired toner and other PCA products. I stopped buying PCA products on amazon after comparing them to the ones I bought with my dermatologist or @skinstore.com. I noticed that while everything was the same the expiration dates on the products I bought on amazon where different and where able to come off. Sadly I can't remember the vendor but there must be a reason why they are cheaper here when other sites like dermstore.com or skinstore.com will not even give a small discount on PCA products (PCA products are always excluded from promotions).
The A&C serum I bought came in the old container that had a defective pump if you buy this serum on other skin care sites they have  the newer (better quality) container which is a bit taller and has a better pump.
With that said choose the vendor carefully.
summary: Have not seen any changes UPDATE**I think I was sold an expired products

Like "Gone Gonzo," "Fresh Frog of Belair" is a clear polish with green microglitter and large silver glitter in it. It took SEVEN coats of this polish to cover my nails, and the coverage is still not good. It looks like a cheap drugstore polish and does not cover the edges of my nail or the tips. I had to use two coats of Seche Vite topcoat to make the polish smooth enough not to catch on denim, and these NINE layers of polish will take a full thirty minutes to remove, even when using pure acetone.

The color of the microglitter is a bright, leafy green. The glitter is the same color that you can get in the cheap glitter for arts and crafts that you buy at the grocery store. It is not a deep green, has a yellow undertone, and the silver glitter all but disappears and looks like clear spots in the polish. My boyfriend was not impressed.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText: I will compare Euphoria to Endless Euphoria, as they are quite different and each good in its own way.  Endless Euphoria, also by Calvin Klein, is a very pleasant floral fragrance, with a light set of overtones.  It compares well to Estee Lauder Pleasures.  And it lasts most of the day.  My wife prefers the Endless to the regular Euphoria because it is lighter and lasts longer.  However, Euphoria is one that I like more.  It is also floral, but it is bolder in its overtones.  My wife says it does not seem to last as long, but I wonder if that is because its intensity diminishes not the entire fragrance itself.  I think that the Euphoria perfume compares well to Beyond Paradise.  Both of these perfumes by Calvin Klein are very good, and I don't think you can go wrong by them.
summary: Euphoria a nice companion (though stronger and less long-lasting) to Endless Euphoria by Calvin Klein

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
Maybe it's me, but I seem to like different types of fragrances based on the season. I like fruity, floral-y things for spring and summer, and more spicy/musky things when it gets colder. Sort of like how I pick food! (ok, not musky food! ha ha!!)

This has some fruity top notes, like pomegranate and persimmon, so you think it might be a sweet light fruity scent, but as time goes on, the low notes start to blossom...they are more vanilla, musk and patchouli. I was sorta hoping that the fruit plus musk/vanilla might hint at the original Dior Poison (which I loved), but it isn't like that...but in the same sort of family, if that makes any sense.  So it is more of a deep luscious scent, not a light flirty one.

I do like it very much, but I think I will save it for autumn and winter. My body seems to react better to these type of scents when its cool. Some people can wear these scents in any season and they seem right. If you do buy it and maybe aren't sure if you like it, try it in a different season and see if it changes.
summary: I like it...wonderful fall/winter type scent

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText: People say it a lot but it really is on target-- "Euphoria" is the perfect name for this perfume. It's somewhat light but still very evocative and sensual in its own way. The bottle is very distinctive as well and a good match for the perfume. Very intoxicating scent.
summary: "Euphoria" is the perfect name for this perfume

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText: If you are looking for a soft floral or soft fruity sweet fragrance, this is not for you. It has a bold sophisticated floral fragrance that in my opinion that is anything but soft. I love this fragrance! It definitely has a scent which makes you feel put together, sexy, and in control. I would say it is a women's fragrance rather than a girls. I generally purchase light scented fragrances, but this one is a nice change of pace. Personally two squirts do the job for me and the scent is not overwhelmingly strong. After around 5 minutes I don't even notice it, but if I check for it, it is still present. The scent lasts well on the skin throughout the workday. Overall, a great quality fragrance!

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText: What a beautiful fragrance!! My special friend wears this perfume from Calvin Klein and she smells like an angel. Everywhere we go people constantly ask her "what are you wearing?" It really goes well with the chemistry of her skin. It is a fresh smell that has a mysterious undertone. It smells a bit citrus-y when she first puts it on, but after a few minutes it morphs into a darker, sensual smelling perfume. It's really hard to explain, but that makes it all the more interesting. I plan on buying this perfume for all the graduates on my list this June. I think it is perfect for both daytime or nighttime use. A little goes a long way so use sparingly. Euphoria by Calvin Klein is one of the most refreshing and innovative fragrances that has come on the market in recent history. Suitable for all ages. It would smell just as lovely and appropriate on a teenage girl as it would on a mature woman.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
I gave this as a gift to my wife. She is very fussy about which perfumes she likes and will wear. Bottom line, and good news for me, she loves it! The bottle is unique and elegant in itself. Presentation in perfume is important! The overall impression of the scent is floral, but not hit-you-in-the-face strong. However, it does have a full bodied range of scent as well, with mid-and low-notes that round it out. The write-up itself sounds delicious and sensual, with "exotic fruits and seductive florals" and then, deeper notes of "black orchid, liquid amber and even mahogany." For a quality perfume, the price is reasonable as well.

Recommended!

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText: Euphoria is a very soft floral scented perfume.  If you (or your partner) do not like overpowering perfumes... or have an allergy, asthma reaction or sensitivity to fragrances... then this perfume would definitely be something to consider.  The scent has a delicacy and lightness of being that is both attractive, pleasurable and relaxing all at once.
summary: Delicate floral scent that is a good choice for the modest woman or sensitive sniffer

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
I tend to like fragrances in the Calvin Klein line, as I generally find them to be very high quality and long-lasting.  I was excited to have the opportunity to try a full bottle of Euphoria, a scent I had only sampled in the past but had liked very much.

Euphoria is one of my favorite CK fragrances.  It is VERY sweet, so those who don't enjoy sweeter-style perfumes may not like it.  However, I find it to be sweet not in a young or girly way but in a manner that is quite feminine and sophisticated.  The fragrance description lists Euphoria as having "exotic fruits," and I'm not sure that I get that from this scent; black orchid is also listed, which seems more likely to me (although I don't know that I've ever smelled black orchid!).  I would also agree with the "rich, creamy" part, as there is definitely a richness to Euphoria that lasts all day.  In fact, one of the things I love about Euphoria is its staying power--the fragrance remains potent for hours and hours, often still being detectable the next day!

So why only four stars?  As mentioned in my subject line, I absolute HATE the bottle--so much so that I was tempted to take off more than just one star for that!  Apparently, the bottle is "a piece of art" designed by Fabien Baron.  Yes, it is pretty to look at, but as far as using it goes, it is extremely non-functional.  First, I'm not surprised that the designer is male--does he think women have a single perfume bottle that we display as an art piece?  No, we put the bottles together in drawers, on bathroom shelves, etc.  Not only is this bottle an awkward shape and size but also it does not stand flat on its own--that's right, it ROCKS!  I could actual live with that issue if the atomizer part worked correctly.  Unfortunately, just under the spray nozzle, there is a very cheap plastic piece (I will try to add a photo of this later), I think which is supposed to hold the cap on snugly.  Well, this piece does not work properly, as it is loose and leaks.  If I try to push the cap all the way back on as designed, it makes things worse.  Very frustrating!

Again, I do love this scent and would recommend it.  I would suggest either buying the smaller (.33 oz) size, which comes in a simple, purse-sized spray bottle, on be prepared to decant the larger size if needed.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText: Well I passed this on to my wife and she has tried.  I like the smell and, unlike many scents, it does not make me sneeze.  It has a feminine floral scent that lasts a long time.  It is fairly strong - so you don't want to spray too much.  Definitely not a scent for old ladies.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
I'm not a huge perfume wearer. The most alluring thing about this perfume is the bottle, very fun but elegant. Spraying it on, it isn't too over powering, and the scent does calm down during the day--but doesn't fade completely.

I put it on with a jacket, and the scent is still on the jacket days later.

As someone who doesn't normally wear scents, this one does a pretty good job of staying pleasant to me. (I often get really annoyed with smelling perfume during the course of my day.) That being said, it isn't a scent that is revolutionary, it smells pretty similar to a lot of other things that are out there.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText: I love the packaging for Euphoria.  Its in a space age type bottle and the contents are lavender.  The bottle is indented on both sides providing a handy place for your thumbs to hold on to.  I often get serious headaches from scents but that was not the case with Euphoria.  I cant say I love the overly sweet smell however.  Its not overpowering but even a little spritz lasts a long time.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
I think this makes a better cologne that a perfume, but maybe that's just me. It had a subtle sophistication to it that begs to be discovered as you inhale the scent. I suppose that's probably part of the appeal.

It smells like grapes mixed with ecstasy. It's something you won't want to stop smelling, though you probably shouldn't spray too much of it given the cost. This is perfect for going out as your date will be drawn to the smell, but probably won't be able to discover that it's you right off the bat. Upon discovering that you're the source of the scent, I assume euphoria will ensue.

This is a very high quality scent. I like the bottle, but it's probably not necessary when you think about how good the scent is. A must buy.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText: While I love refreshing scents for every day use, Euphoria is a fragrance that is distinctly for "date night" or something special. It's not too heavy, yet longlasting. It has a mature connotation- to be used by women, not "girls" or someone who prefers the sickly sweet and flowery. It's the kind of scent that heralds a woman's presence and lingers in the room after she's left. Very alluring.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
The bottle is quite unique and beautiful. It doesn't look like a traditional bottle, which I love.  I like putting it out as a bit of art on my dresser.

The scent is a bit too much for everyday wear, but it's nice for a night out. It's a pleasant blend that seems vaguely familiar. I like that it's not too sweet - I can't stand perfume that make me smell like a bouquet. This one has some musky notes, but still has a feminine feel.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
I will admit that I am fairly picky about the scents I wear and I tend to prefer for them to be subtle.  This scent is anything but subtle.  I give it high marks for being a scent that lasts - just the smallest amount hangs on all day - but that also means one must be careful in application since the scent is very powerful.

Given the marketing, I would have thought this would have had a distinctly feminine smell, but I found it to be more unisex.  It will not be in my daily rotation, but I will use it - lightly - when I think the occasion calls for it.
summary: Strong scent, more unisex than feminine.

style.Style Name:: Calvin Klein euphoria Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
This perfume has a heavenly, sweet scent.  I receive compliments from my co-workers when I wear this fragrance.
In the summer it becomes especially fragrant from body heat.  The fragrance lasts until I wash it off. It has become a standard in my daily wear.

A few days later I tried a bigger coin-sized glob and massaged it across my entire face with the same results. Sticky, tacky feeling all day! reviewText: I like this oil as it does leave my skin softened after a shower without being greasy.  I don't mind the scent either; most ladies probably adore plumeria or tropical smells and this oil smells like the tropics during the summer.  It isn't a unisex smell; it is pure female.  Meow.

I am an oil junkie. I love face oils, hair oils, and body oils. Typically I tend to go for single 100% oils, but Nuxe is my favorite good for everything oil. It's not greasy, and it's so luxurious.
Mainly, it's the smell. It's incredible, (which with single blend oils you don't get any scent really). And it is equally amazing on any part of my body, be it hair, face, legs or torso.
It's on the pricier side, yes, but honestly worth every penny. It lasts a long time, since a little goes a long way. And did I mention the scent? It's incredible.
Highly recommend. Love love love!

I received a sample as a gift and I've been buying this dry oil via Amazon ever since.  My skin feels and looks amazing (43 years old), and given that I have sensitive skin and it has never caused a blemish, I highly recommend it. I use it every morning along with the Nuxe Creme Fraiche. The oil is dry and it smells like roses.  I've been using this now for two years. In the winter months when my skin gets even more dry from electric heat, I will sometimes pat a bit on my face.  Totally freshens me up.
summary: Won't Start My Day Without It

reviewText: Smells wonderful. However it irritated my hands , arms, chest, neck . Everywhere I put this thing on gave me pimples . Do not waste your money.
summary: NOT SURE WHAT THE FUSS IS ABOUT .

reviewText:
This would be a fantastic oil for your face if it wasn't so heavily scented (or if it was fragrance free). When I tried to use it on my sensitive facial skin, I had a slight reaction (a burning sensation followed by redness) and had to wash it off. However, when I used it on my body, it was just fine. I enjoyed very soft, supple skin. It absorbs almost immediately, so you don't have to wait long to get dressed.  I have also used just a few drops on my hair ends to help manage fly-aways and prevent split ends. The fragrance itself isn't bad (it is a tropical floral with hints of neroli), it's just a bit too heavy for my taste. Wish it came in a lightly scented version.

It is a really nice dry oil, but if you do suffer from sensitive skin (as I do), keep in mind that the fragrance might cause a reaction, particularly on your face.
summary: Great for use on body and hair, but fragrance made my face turn red/splotchy

reviewText: I absolutely love this oil.  It goes silky soft without being greasy and has a lovely soft scent.  I'm thinking this would be a great gift for Mother's Day!

The scent is light and nice, vanilla I think. The conditioner is very thick and sticks to the spatula like frosting. I used it on my dry hair, covered it with a shower cap and a towel for heat. After 20 minutes I rinsed, my hair was detangled, clean and soft. It is not greasy and does not leave any heavy deposits on my hair  to weigh it down. My hair is colored, fine and partially greying. The directions state it can be used on wet hair and even as a leave in conditioner. When I rubbed a small amount of the conditioner between my fingers it disappeared like moisturizer without any greasy residue. It is definitely a luxury beauty item and has the price that goes with it.

I have waist length very fine hair, moderately thick. It is about 50% white. It tends to frizz and flyaway although on the flip side is very prone to over conditioning. I have never used this product before. It isn't advertised specifically for my hair issues but I thought I'd give it a try.

I followed the directions ( wash hair, towel dry, apply product, comb through, let sit 5-10 minutes, rinse). I do not use any heat on my hair, allowing it to air dry. The results were shinier and better controlled hair than I have had in years. My hair looks healthier and prettier. It is far more sleek looking without being flat. It even feels better in my hands.

I'd note for other long hair users that this application process is sort of a pain. Combing a product through waist length hair and letting it sit is sort of challenging and messy. However I think the results are worth it. I am sold, excellent outcome for me.
summary: Lovely boost in shine and control to my long fine hair

reviewText: This is a truly unique hair conditioner!  What we have done is to sort of not follow this product's directions.  What we have done is to run it...or rather smooth it...into dry hair and just leave it on for a while...often much longer than the 10 to 15 minutes suggested.  Then we step into the shower and shampoo it out.  The result is shiny healthy feeling hair.  I am really loving this stuff! It's a relatively pure product that seems to have a ton of good substances in it.

I have only been using this product and have no qualms with there. Put it on after washing you hair and wait.  The effects eventually, after some time begin begun to show shin.  Will update with shine notes with you after

This is an insanely luxurious hair masque, it smells so yummy, leaves a lovely scent in my hair for a few days. My hair feels stronger, like it has had a protein drink. I was concerned that this masque might be too 'heavy' for my hair and weight it down but it was quite the opposite. My coarse, dry hair drank up the product without leaving a film or coating on my hair that typically attracts dirt/oil. My hair is soft, shiny, and still has enough volume without being 'crazy hair' that I'm normally blessed with during humid weather. I had to use quite a bit (my hair is like a sponge when it's wet) after I colored my hair, not quite as much for a normal washing. This product rinses out clean, and does work better if my hair is combed in the shower with a wide tooth comb.

So far, this is my favorite hair masque that I've tried, I have tried so many (!) that don't end up working in the long run. The scent is absolutely lovely, my husband kept sniffing my hair, lol. 5 stars, highly recommended!

This product comes in an elegant, easy-to-open, jar. A spoon comes with it, in order to easily remove the product from the jar.

The masque, itself, is a thick cream having the consistency of paste. It is not greasy. It has a light, somewhat floral scent.  The masque goes on easily. I found that I didn't have to use a lot of the product either. Because of its consistency, it is easy to apply. I divided my very long hair into sections to make it easier.. Each strand needs to be covered, and using a thick-toothed comb to distribute it evenly is helpful.

Now, for the results. It did tame the frizzies, but it didn't get rid of them all together. It did improve the quality of my hair. It felt softer, stronger, easier to manage. It seemed to be hydrated without feeling greasy.

The product contains essential fatty acids, jojoba oil and vitamin e, all ingredients that are vital for healthy hair.

This masque is for very dry, thick or frizzy hair.  Several month ago, a bad dye job ruined my hair, and I hoped this would tame my hair until it could grow out enough for me to remove the damaged parts.  Upon opening the jar, I immediately noticed a delightful aroma.  This masque is very thick (almost solid), so I didn't need much for my hair.  You can use it for daily conditioning (leave on hair for 5 minutes) or intense conditioning (20 minutes).  I chose the intense conditioning.  The first use didn't make my hair silky or shiny, but it did leave it manageable and frizz free.  Even more amazing, my hair was still manageable and soft after a second shampooing.  Each time I use this, my hair looks better.

Because of the price, I'll only be using this for a weekly intense conditioning.  It does its job, and it does it very well.

Ummm, if this was a six buck product I would give it the benefit of the doubt.  It is rather expensive for zero results.  I read the instructions, after shampoo, rinse, put conditioner on, comb it through and wait five minutes.  Or you can put the conditioner on damp or dry hair 20 minutes earlier, then wash hair and follow up with the five minute rinse.  This conditioning treatment has proteins in it, and it is my understanding that you can overdue proteins in your hair.

 My hair has been horribly dry this winter.  I tried hydrating myself with more fluid intake, I thought it was a vitamin C deficiency, so I increased my vitamin C intake.  I thought I was not getting my hair cut frequently enough.  So I went more often.  I thought it was my shampoo and conditioner, so I spent oodles on conditioners.  I decided I needed to try this mask.

My hair is fine.  It has not been color treated in over a year.  My hair has about 1% gray. My hair is just below shoulder length.  I do not style my hair with products. I do not blow dry my hair.  I traditionally use only products that I can read all the ingredients and understand them (for personal care products).

My hair has been tangling a bit at the ends.  It is drier than normal.  I Dampened my hair and put a small palm sized amount of product in my hair and combed it through to the ends.  I clipped the hair up and waited 15 minutes.  I took my shower and washed the conditioning treatment out.  My hair was already fairly clean, prior to application, so I had no need to re wash it.  I used lukewarm water for my hair rinse.  The smell was pleasant enough.  The conditioner is a dry thick cream, almost the consistency of night cream.  There is a very generous amount of product in this container.  The little scoop is nice to keep your product free of dirt and what have yous.  When I combed through my hair in the shower, it certainly did not feel any easier to get through.  In fact, I tangled up a bit at the ends, and I had precombed my hair before putting the product in.  Once the product was rinsed, I didn't feel that slip to the hair like you do when you condition.  I got out of the shower, and had to recomb my hair, as I was already tangled again.  I let my hair air dry in the house while I finished straightening up.  When I went to see how it looked in the mirror, I was not impressed, I had massive flyaways on top my head, my hair was pretty lifeless at the ends, it smelled good, it was shiny, but to the touch, it was still extremely dry.

At this price point - I would expect a miracle in a bottle.  This did, almost nothing.  I had shine and I had fragrance.  Neither one is high on my list of needs.

I'm in love with this Leonor Greyl Paris Masque for hair. Everything about it screams luxury. The packaging, the container, the luscious fragrance, and even the tool to get it out of the tub. Very well thought out, easy to get the masque out of the tub without getting water into the container. The masque itself goes on thin and I wasn't sure I was rinsing it out well enough after using it but when I styled my hair it looked wonderful. This helped my hair look and feel great all day long (and I was even outside in the wind). This is a great product. A nice way to pamper yourself.

The Leonor Greyl Masque comes in luxe packaging with its own plastic scraper so that one doesn't reach in with one's fingers for the conditioning mask and to make it easier to scrape out every bit of the conditioning mask.  The Orchid version is supposed to help thick and damaged/chemically treated hair become softer and better nourished.  I have thick, straight black hair mixed with white hair.  This worked similar to the deep conditioning masks I've used in the past and it rinsed out easily.  It left my hair feeling soft. It works well but is quite pricey at $65.

I have long, naturally curly hair that tends to dry out on the ends.  I got okay results from this product but not impressive results.  The results weren't anything better than my average conditioner leaves my hair.  The scent is pleasant enough and not too strong or overpowering.  It is thick and doesn't take a lot to coat my hair entirely.  I like that it is not greasy and rinses out well.
The best it worked for me was when I applied it on my dry combed out hair and covered my hair for 20 minutes before shampooing and then I used just a little bit again after shampooing and combed it through and left it on about 5 minutes more.  My hair was softer when I used it that way.
The best face buff out there.

Not only do I love this stuff my wife does as well.  It is a perfect grit to use about every 3 days, does a great job cleaning my face and has gotten rid of my black heads on my nose.  After I use it I usually let it sit on my face for 1-3 minutes in the shower and then rinse.
