Super great product! Really does work if use other recommended product like hydration complex with it!

The oil free foaming face wash is enriched with rosehip extract, milk thistle, passionflower, and chamomile. The foaming wash left my skin feeling soft and clean without stripping skin. The wash smells heavenly and was a treat to use.
summary: The oil free foaming face wash is enriched with rosehip ...

reviewText: I've been using this Bliss Fabulous Face Wash for years and noticed that compared to my cream face washes, this is relatively strong. I have stopped using it during the dry, winter months but use it regularly during the summer.  It bubbles and has a slight scent.  It exfoliates and leaves my skin feeling clean. I find that the bottle lasts for a long time, I rarely need a full pump to wash my face.
summary: A little goes a long way

reviewText: This was not for me... i ended up using it as shaving cream.

This doesn't foam all that dramatically, but it does work up a good lather.  I know it's just psychological, but the lather really helps me feel like my face is getting clean.  And this does a really good job of getting rid of excess oil, makeup, and the like.  The exfoliation is gentle but you can definitely feel it.  (I'm unsure which ingredient is responsible for the exfoliation, though the Bliss site says "synthetic spheres" which probably means polyethylene microbeads.)  This has been non-drying and the scent is light, pleasant, and non-irritating (also it doesn't linger after you rinse your face).  It is easy to rinse this off and it leaves no residue.

Here are the ingredients since I didn't see them on the product page:

Water (Aqua/Eau), Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Triethanolamine , Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Polyethylene, Methylparaben, Fragrance (Parfum), Propylparaben, Methylisothiazolinone, PEG-12 Glyceryl Distearate, Blue 1 (CI 42090), Matricaria Leaf Extract, Citric Acid, Glucosamine, Passiflora Incarnata Extract, Pentylene Glycol, Rosa Canina Leaf Extract, Silybum Marianum Seed Extract, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8.

So this does have some ingredients that people typically avoid (fragrances, artificial colors, parabens, and sulfates).  I really don't have a problem with parabens (they keep bacteria from growing in your cleansers...) or sulfates (really good for lathering/foaming, and without SLS, this probably wouldn't foam).  So far, the fragrance and dye have not irritated my skin.  For what it's worth, this is probably not vegan because most glucosamine used in industry comes from animal sources.  This paragraph is not intended to warn anyone away who was thinking of trying this, because you need to make up your own mind about what ingredients you will use.  I was just trying to provide the details needed for you to make the right (informed) decision for yourself.

That being said, this appears to contain plastic microbeads (polyethylene from the ingredients list).  These are damaging to natural water systems and aquatic life and are difficult to remove during water treatment procedures (they are small here, but they have a tendency to aggregate in nature).  Several states are already implementing bans of these beads.  I received this in a beauty bag purchase and I will use it up since I already have it and since it is a good cleanser, but I wouldn't buy it again.
summary: works well but contains plastic microbeads

reviewText: Keeps my skin clear. In the winter I cannot use it without following up with moisturizer but that could also be my sensitive skin type.
summary: Keeps my skin clear. In the winter I cannot ...

reviewText: I've used quite a range of face washes from drug store brands to specialty products and what always sticks out about this product from Bliss is the smell.  It smells invigorating and fresh and is a nice treat first thing in the morning.  It also makes my skin feel great.  For context, my skin is dry, sensitive and acne prone. I find that this works well with my skin type.  The exfoliation is the perfect compromise of being effective enough to slough off dry and dead skin, yet gentle enough that I can use it regularly without aggravating my skin.  I also like that it washes off clean leaving no residue or skin tightness behind.
This product works great

I like bliss products, and when I needed some facial cleanser I decided to try Fabulous Foaming Face Wash.  I like it, but...

First of all with "Foaming" right there in the name, I expected, well...foam.  I washed my face.  No foam.  Next day I washed and added more water.  Still no foam.  Next day I went at it with a washcloth.  Still.  No.  Foam.  While I love a foamy face wash, but am also equally happy with a non-foamy face wash, I was just disappointed that this didn't live up to it's name.

Second...I only read the name before I bought it, I skipped the subtitle.  Wow!  I was surprised at my first cleansing session.  This wash has beads in it!  Oh, if you look past the name and down to the smaller print you'll see "2 in 1 cleanser and exfoliator".  Okay, so the weekly scrub will be shelved for a while.

Now that we're past the surprises...

I do really like the face wash.  It leaves my skin feeling clean and soft.  It doesn't leave my combination face feeling dry.  And it has this bubblegum-citrus scent going on that I enjoy.

I kind of wish that it didn't have the exfoliator beads in it.  I prefer a stronger weekly scrub to a gentle daily one, but hey, the world isn't perfect.

This is a nice face wash.

...and doesn't really deliver the foamy lather I was expecting and hoping for. Still, just a small amount of product cleans my face very well, leaving it smooth and soft. I'd still prefer more actual foam, but all things considered, this is a good cleanser.

There's something exceedingly sexy about the ritual of old-school shaving - the attention to detail, the commitment to spend more than the time it takes to swipe an electric shaver over your chin and cheeks.  It conjures up a hero from a Jane Austen novel, knife-sharp cheekbones, long sideburns, a snowy white cravat.  Sigh.

I ordered this kit for my own Mr. Darcy.  I was supremely satisfied with the kit.  It arrived in a sturdy decorative box, suitable for gifting.  The brush is well made, with soft but durable bristles.  The lotions have a light, pleasant lavender scent.  It is not over-powering or over-floral. My husband said the shaving lotion had a good lather, but he really liked the shaving oil.  I thought he balm left his face smooth and kissable.

My only negative comment would be that the portions were a little small considering the price.

Nonetheless, I would buy more Art of Shaving items in the future.
summary: A shaving kit fit for Mr. Darcy

reviewText:
My husband has a thick, tough beard combined with very sensitive skin. He allowed his beard to get pretty long before trying out The Art of Shaving Full Size Kit. He has never used a full kit like this before. The only conditioning he had done previously was to put a warm washcloth on his skin. It was with some anticipation that he used the lavender oil to help condition his skin prior to shaving. It felt very different from anything that he had done before. It smelled good and made his face oily. Then he dipped the brush into the cream and applied it generously all over his face and began to shave with his regular disposable razor. It shaved closer than anything he had experienced before. Not one nick or cut. No razor burn. Putting the aftershave lotion on his face kept his skin from drying out and gave him no discomfort whatsoever. He usually shies away from any lotion or aftershave because it exacerbates his sensitive skin but this went on comfortably and didn't irritate his skin. It was the best shave of his life.

He highly recommends (and will get) a higher quality razor. He went through two of the disposable razors because of the thickness of the cream. The cream is so much higher quality and thicker than the common foams for which cheap disposable razors are made.

His kids were impressed with the softness and smoothness of his shave and even let him kiss them since they didn't have to worry about scratchy stubble. I definitely benefited from his smooth shave.

I received this in exchange for a review.  This is a total score for me as I already use the Art of Shaving products.
The first thing you should ask yourself is....is it worth it?  Do you want a great shave, do you need a badger brush and do you want to smell nice?
The next is can you afford it and if you answer yes than you need to pull the trigger.
I currently use a twezzerman badger brush its nice but I lose bristles every time it is used.  The art of shaving brush takes a beating and does not lose a hair.  Even tried to pull out a bristle and they are packed in tight.
The cream will last you at least 4 months of regular use.  Its really a case of a little goes a long way.  You will lather up better than you ever have.
The aftershave makes you feel nice and smell nice.  My wife loves it after I shave.
Shaving with these products will produce the best shave of your life (as long as  you have a nice blade).  You will also smell nice.
I prefer the Lemon scent over Lavender but that is a matter of choice.
Is it worth it...yes.  Its cheaper to buy the pack than to buy each item individually.
The product is top notch and sold at plenty of high end stores in fact Art of Shaving even has their own store in Las Vegas.
summary: Worth the Money and Makes a Great Gift For Any Man.

reviewText:
I'd like to start by mentioning that the older reviews are for a sample size kit, not the full size kit that is currently offered. I'm not sure why the two share the same space, but the older comments may not be accurate.

This set comes in a nice gift box, and the products are securely locked into place. It took a bit of effort to get them out. The brush is very nice, made with natural badger hair. It's soft, but holds up well under a hefty load of shaving cream. The shaving cream lathers well, and it feels different - it feels cleaner. It also goes on well without the brush, but the brush makes it a more luxurious experience.

The products smell nice, but are not overpowering. We tried the lavender scent and it's fresh and masculine without being too floral or harsh. Sometimes lavender can smell medicinal, but thankfully this one didn't. The 4 step process results in an amazingly close shave and soft skin! It takes a little longer to do it this way, but the results are worth the extra time.

It's a pricey set, but a little goes a long way. This should last a while. Still, we think it's probably not going to be an everyday routine. It's good for pampering, and it might also be great for someone with sensitive skin that can't use inexpensive drug store products. The quality is very good.
summary: Smells and feels great, long lasting kit

reviewText: Very nice products in an elegant presentation.  I don't know how many guys would buy this set for themselves, but I bet most non-electric aficionados would enjoy it as a gift.  The lavender scent is not overwhelming, very soothing.

Update:  I've finally used up this set. If you're not over lathering, you should get 2.5 months of daily use out of the shave lotion concentrate.  The oil ran out a little faster because it is easy to over apply, and the after shave is still going strong (but I don't always use it). I expect the brush to last for years.

Overview:
This is a good set of full-sized products to buy or give as a gift.  If you're used to shaving every other day with regular shaving cream only, this set of products should make it possible to shave every day, comfortably.  The only downside is that some of the products have to be literally pried out of the packaging with a butter knife.

Packaging:
Certainly good-enough quality and nice-enough looking to give as a gift, and the packaging is frustration-free.  The products are packed in a clamshell box with a magnetic closure and held shut with a paper sleeve with marketing information.  The box itself is blue, and unmarked.  There isn't any plastic wrap around the box.  Removing the glass bottles from the box is very difficult.  I had to pry them out with a butter knife.  Once out of the box, the products and shaving brush present very well.  The pre-shave oil and after-shave lotion are both packed in high-quality glass bottles, and the shaving brush is a good quality, badger-hair brush with a plastic handle.  The shaving cream is packed in a plastic screw-top tub that is easy to handle.

Product usage impressions:

The pre-shave oil is thicker than I would have guessed, about the same viscosity as 60 weight gear oil.  It does smell nice (lavender and some kind of spice).  The oil goes on well if you spread a nickel-sized blob onto your hands and then onto your beard.

I was a little concerned about the amount of shaving cream included in the kit, but I shouldnt have been.  A little goes a very long ways.  I probably could have shaved a half-dozen times with the amount of product that I used the first time.  Ive found that the best way is to run the brush over the top of the cream once one way and then the other, and then lather my beard.  The shaving cream combined with the pre-shave oil delivers a very smooth shave, much better than shaving soap or cream alone.

The set that I have included a badger hair brush that was well stuffed, and hasn't shed any hairs in the time that Ive been using it.  You shouldnt be disappointed with this brush unless you're expecting a more exotic handle material than the black plastic in this set.

The after-shave lotion also works well, but make sure that your face is dry before applying it as the instructions recommend.

Overall impressions:

1.  I experience significantly less razor burn with this combination of products than Im used to, and can now shave every day without burning my beard.

2.  My wife likes the way that the products smell on me, which is certainly worth mentioning.
summary: Goodbye razor burn, wife likes the smell, long lasting

reviewText:
There are some thinks I really like about the Art of Shaving kit, but there are also some things I really don't care for.

I do like the pre-shave oil. Stepping out of the shower, I rub the pre-shave oil on my face, let it soak in for about a minute or so, then I add the shaving cream. The oil seems to provide a great base for the shaving cream, and it provides a much smoother shave.

 I like the shaving cream provided in the kit as well, but I will say it takes a few applications to get it right. The first time I tried it, I used too much, and the excess shave lotion combined with the oil had the consistency of toothpaste, and it gummed up my razor. That was my fault though, not something I blame on the product. I'm used to shaving with canned lotion, this lotion is much thicker and it will take a few times to get the application down.

The after-shave lotion is okay, but I still prefer my standard Old Spice after shave. Maybe it's because of the thicker shaving lotion, or the pre shave oil, but when I use the Art of Shaving after shave, my face feels oily. I feel like I have to rub down with a towel after using it.

The brush is kind of useless, I tried using it several times, but it never did as good a job as just spreading the lotion around with my hand.

The final thing is the overall scent. I'm not a big fan of lavender. I would prefer something a little more masculine or at least a bit more traditional. The lavender scent is kind of cloying, and after using three separate lotions and oils, you will smell like lavender regardless of whatever else you may try to cover it with.
summary: Decent Product, But May Take A Few Applications To Get it Right

reviewText:
Overall this is a luxurious shaving kit that's OK but not perfect on sensitive skin. My husband has super-sensitive skin and finds that this is better than most shaving options, but less good than Edge "extra sensitive" shaving gel (though if I'm honest, that has SUCH a slippery feel it almost feels like a petroleum-based lubricant... but apparently it's better for his face).

PROS
* Smell (lavender) is pleasant and not too strong
* Brush is quite soft. If you tap it directly onto your face it feels almost sharp, but as long as you hold it at an angle, it's quite pleasant (my husband complained until I showed him the right way to use it)

CONS
* The brush does smell funky the first few times you get it wet (like a wet badger), but this fades. This is because the brush actually IS made of badger "hair"/fur (and to that point, I personally haven't researched whether it's humanely harvested or not, though I can't imagine they shave the badgers and send them back out into the wild)
* This doesn't affect my rating, but it's REALLY hard to get the items out of the packaging--you have to really grip and pull. My husband actually used a metal dental pick to get the last item out, and it bent the pick(!)

NEUTRAL
* Lathers up quite nicely--better than most drugstore-brand shaving creams, but not quite as slick/slippery as my husband's favorite
* Other reviews said a little goes a long way, but my husband ended up using about a quarter-sized amount of oil when he didn't have enough after using just a dime-sized amount
* If you're looking for instructions, they're not on the packaging or the bottles--they're on an O-shaped cardboard thing that goes _around_ the packaging. I almost threw it away before realizing it contained the instructions (which weren't that helpful, but I personally was curious whether the oil went on first or last)
summary: luxurious; good for sensitive skin, but Edge "extra sensitive" gel is better

reviewText:
My husband loves this shaving kit. Would he or I ever actually pay for it? No.

$120.00 is a hefty price to pay for such a set. You get:
1) Shaving brush (super soft)
2) Pre-shave oil (the size of about 1/3 of a cup)
3) Shaving cream (about a cup)
4) After-shave balm (1/2 a cup)
I estimate, if you use these products every day, the set will probably last you about 2 months, especially shaving cream which fills up the biggest just but is very fluffly and light and will surely be used up very quickly.

Granted, all these products of a great quality. My husband loves the feel of his soft and smooth skin after his shaves. The scent (lavender) is very sophisticated, light and soothing (no AXE and Old Spice-like fragrance overload hear). He overall enjoys the whole shaving experience, even though it does take extra time over his usual routine.

This would definitely be an extra special gift for a man. If you can and want to afford it.

Update: after just a few uses the brush started to lose hairs. I expected it to have a better quality than this.
summary: A great product (if you can afford it)

reviewText: This is my first experience with this particular company and their products. After reading the other reviews, I was excited to see how these premium products made my shaving experience SO much better than the "cheap" stuff I currently use. Let me start off by describing my "cheap" stuff. It was the Van Der Hagen Premium Shave Set (2.5 oz. Soap, Bowl, Brush). It cost me $9 and came with the badger brush, a bowl, and a bar of soap. Then I bought the The Art of Shaving Brush Stand Black. It was a novel idea, but it quickly got old and left it lying around in my medicine cabinet for years. Overall, the $9 set proved to be just as useful as this $120 set. If you are a shaving snob, I suggest you stop here and give me a negative rating review, because you're just going to get more pissed off farther down. This shave kit is VERY small, what I would consider sample sizes for all of the items. The sandalwood smells good and works about as good as anything (soap, shampoo, lotion, whatever), but you only get about 2 weeks of shaves worth out of this if you use it the way you're supposed to (as described on the page w/ the video and descriptions). The pre shave oil spreads nicely, but is not much different or better than the Gillette pre-shave balm I normally use, also from the dollar store. The shave cream is thick and very luxurious, I've yet to find an equal for that stuff (hence the second star that I awarded to this product!). The after shave lotion does make my skin feel smooth, I guess, but no moreso than my Nivea lotion that I got at the dollar store. For this price, I was hoping that they would at least include the stainless steel razor and stand that the dude on the product pictures uses. But no, apparently that's a premium. To me, this is not a "kit", it is some stuff you can put on your face, and a brush to put on your face with. This is only step one of the shaving process - they don't provide you the tools necessary to complete step 2: SHAVE!! Thus, to me, it should not be labeled a 'kit'. *Conclusion: I got this for free through Amazon Vine. I would NEVER pay $120 for this product. I have a $79 electric razor that I use on a daily basis that I haven't changed the blades in 3 years. I am cheap, and not the demographic that the Art of Shaving was reaching for when pricing this product. This company is likely targeting to the types of people that pay $200 on a pair of designer jeans or upwards of $5000 on a designer summer dress. I'm the type of dude that trolls Goodwill for deals on used underwear. You know what I can get for $120 dollars!!? I can go to a shave shop and have an old-timey dude give me a hot shave with steaming lather while one of his daughters gives me a neck massage and his son shines my shoes for $40 bucks, and that would still leave enough left over for lunch and a happy ending!! If you're DYING to throw away some $$ and try this anyway b/c you want to feel like a semi-smooth faced chump, I found that you could actually buy the elements (less the cheap/low quality brush-which isn't worth more than $10-$15 anyway!) for about $80-$100 total. So, FOR SURE skip the kit,(and I would say these products altogether). It made my skin feel nice, but not incredible or $100+ of a hit to my wallet.
summary: SUPER Small set, Not worth the $$ -- geared towards Shaving Snobs

reviewText: this and mascara are the only makeup products I use. I love the color of this balance and brighten shade. I normally put it all over my face and then go back and contour. it eliminates having to buy blush plus I have rosacea and blush usually makes it worse. This works two ways as an all over makeup and a great contour using the number three method. I would definitely recommend this product.

I am 41 years old with fair/medium skin tone.  I bought this product after watching a demonstration on one of the Home Shopping networks.  I have never used Laura Geller products before, but the demo on TV was so impressive, I figured, why not?

This is a compact powder that is a mix of different colors.  You use a small compact brush (it does not come with this product - you have to order it separately) in order to apply it.  The intention is that you can use this by itself (instead of foundation).  Or, you can use it on top of your foundation to "set it" to last longer.

I tried to use it both ways, and found that the coverage is average - it's heavier than most of the pressed powder that I have tried in the past.  But, I can still see my freckles through it.  The heavier that you apply it, the more "cakey" it looks so you can't get more coverage that way.  As far as how long it lasts, it lasted about 3 hours which is average for any other kind of powder that I have tried.

As far as the color, I agree with one of the other reviewers that it is darker than you might expect for a "Fair" color - it's closer to what I would describe as Medium color.

In summary, I can't say that it's worth the extra cost and do not plan to purchase it again.

I am over 60 and have a lot of redness in my face.  This is a very good cover for daily wear.  It helps neutralize the redness (not 100 percent, but well).  It is light and does not cake.  The "marble" mixture of colors works well, does not look yellow, and can be worn alone or with blush, etc.

If you can't find a bronzer that doesn't look dark and muddy on you, this may do the trick. Most of the bronzers I've tried are too orange or dark for me. I have fair skin, medium fair and cool-neutral toned.

This also goes on light; you can build it up if you have to but the first swipe on with a brush is not too heavy and it does go on subtly enough to not have a stripe of orange or brown on your cheek. There are other colors: this is the fair version of bronzer but there is also a medium for darker complexions.
summary: Great for cool toned fair skin

reviewText: I live in the mountains where dry winter skin can be a real health issue, not just an inconvenience. Cracked skin provides an entry for bacteria which can turn to infection very quickly. So, keeping my skin moisturized is important. I go through a LOT of lotion in the winter months. This is not as emollient as some other lotions I have tried, but it is advertised as being for "normal" skin which, in my particular case, may be a bit too light to fully provide the moisture my skin needs. That said, it is a good lotion, in that it absorbs nicely and leaves skin feeling soft but not greasy. It has no detectable fragrance and dispenses easily from the pump. For my purposes, I feel that this is probably a better daily summer lotion than winter lotion.
summary: Good Lotion But Maybe Not For Very Dry Winter Skin

style.Style:: Body Lotion for Normal to Dry Skin

reviewText:
La Roche-Posay Lipikar Body Lotion Daily Repair Moisturizing 400 ml - 13.52 fl. oz, spreads smoothly, gets absorbed quickly, moisturizes well, and is not greasy. The best, most effective applications are taking it: after shower/bath, on daily basis before sleeping, for deep moisturizing especially in dry environments (dry climate, winter, or air-conditioned/heated rooms/spaces/quarters), and against dry skin in general. After the use, the dry skin hydration increases resulting in a visible improvement in the skin smoothness and softness. Nevertheless, the wrinkles somewhat lost their depth and pronunciation without any doubts. However, the lotion made the skin more delicate that might have been an unavoidable byproduct of its increased softness. For the same reason, the skin became min. more sensitive to touch and prone to scratch, but - at the same time - faster healing for its increased moist, as under a Band-Aid. It is mid-priced.

Obviously, it does not contain triclosan, which finally was found toxic (see: "5 Things to Know About Triclosan - FDA") and a candidate for a ban by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the USA (see: "Toxic Triclosan Banned From Soap but Lingers in Consumer Products").

style.Style:: Body Lotion for Normal to Dry Skin

reviewText: This La Roche-Posay body lotion is on the runnier side compared to the Aveeno that we usually have in the house, but I like how it also goes on and dries very quickly.  Once it dries, my hands feel normal again, but I don't feel any sort of lotion residue or scent, which is perfect for me.  The only reason that I'm docking one star is that it is really expensive, but it might be worth the cost for me.
summary: Great lotion that doesn't leave any scent or residue

style.Style:: Body Lotion for Normal to Dry Skin

reviewText:
I live in the Midwest and it gets very cold and dry during the cold winter months. So I'm always on the lookout for lotion that will keep my skin moisturized and soft. Overall, I really like this lotion. It goes on easily and sets into my skin. There is absolutely no greasy feeling after and you will notice a difference almost immediately. I use it at least once a day to help in keeping my skin. It's also a big plus that this is a fragrance free lotion. Sometimes lotions can work well but you don't want to use it because the scent is too overwhelming. Not with this lotion. A great lotion for those who are allergic or super sensitive to scented lotions.

I definitely plan on using this lotion all winter long.

reviewText: This is a nice lotion with little to no scent. It is not heavy. reviewText: I started to use this for my chapped, winter hands. It has a light scent. My skin gets very dry in the winter and I have to use a good moisturizer or risk my skin cracking -- very painful! This helps, but other moisturizers help more (especially Shikai brand). I used it a couple of times a day and right before bed. It's thick but not greasy, and it absorbs quickly. It was helpful for dry hands, cuticles, heels, elbows, shins, etc. Price is very reasonable from this brand, but it does contain BHT and one or two other chemicals that are not ideal. I think it was just okay. If your skin gets very dry, you might need something more moisturizing than this.

style.Style:: Body Lotion for Normal to Dry Skin

reviewText: I like that it does not have a scent.  Too many body lotions have a strong scent and the scent can be over powering.  To me the lotion is a bit greasy but not terrible.  The lotion works well, as expected, but I do think the price is too high.  Not sure it is good enough to justify the price that is being charged.  Amazon needs to package the bottle better. style.Style:: Body Lotion for Normal to Dry Skin

reviewText:

I was very happy to try this product.  I love it and heres why:
* It works. My skin feels smoother after only a few uses.

* It rubs in quickly and isn't greasy.  It is thick and takes a little bit of rubbing in, but then again, it keeps my skin moisturized for a while.

So if you are looking for a product to help your dry skin, this may just be the thing for you.

By day 3, rosacea pustules popped up (I haven't had any in 3 years).  I decided maybe it needed to get worse before better and stuck it out, but instead it just got worse and worse.  I ended up with several huge pustules and redness like never before. The good news is that it was prime and therefore easy to return to Amazon for a full refund. Moisturizing

After several hours, I get a little oily in the T zone but this lotion doesn't make the oiliness more pronounced.  All in all, I'm satisfied with my purchase.  I only wish it came in a bigger tube. I recently gave Toleriane Fluid to a friend who suffers from redness and burning sensations as well as occasional adult acne. Out of fear that a moisturizer would mess up her face even further, she hadn't used any in years. It took some convincing to get her to apply it to her face but frankly, her skin was so miserable-looking (blotchy red) that I just made her do it. A minor miracle happened - her face not only tolerated the cream but she called me a few weeks later and told me that the Fluid had made her skin calm down and the red flareups were all but gone. This is now the no. 1 item on her wishlist for birthdays and Christmases. I myself have drier skin and use Toleriane in a different formulation, La Roche-Posay Toleriane Soothing Protective Skincare, Normal to Combination Intolerant Skin 1.35 fl but had the same positive experience. One time I used a moisturizer sample my skin reacted badly to, and the only cream that stopped the resulting burning was Toleriane. I don't use Toleriane all the time because during the winter I prefer a thicker cream, but for the summer and in skin "emergency situations" this is definitely my go-to cream.

Like many of the other reviews I have oily, acne-prone skin and pores that get congested really easily. Most moisturizers I've tried manage to make my skin oily while still leaving dry patches on my face and cause my skin to break out. I started using the La Roche-Posay brand to help treat my acne (I used La Roche-Posay Effaclar Purifying Foaming Gel, 6.76-Ounce Tube and the La Roche-Posay Effaclar Duo) and decided to give this product a try since I was having great results from the brand. The moisturizer is super light-weight with a thin consistency, but it's incredibly effective. When I first started using it I had some dry patches on my skin and within a few days they disappeared completely. My skin feels hydrated and soft, but without being oily or congested.

In the extreme sense of the words "oil free" it'll certainly do that. It'll take the oils off your hands in the shower when you wash with it. Now, my skin needs are not so extreme that I need this level of drying it out, but I can see where some might. It does as promised, though it just wasn't right for me, it'll dry out the skin. If you have combination skin like I do or seasonal (during the summer) excess oily, this isn't the product for you. This is something one with serious oil issues uses.

reviewText: I have dry and sensitive skin and this cleanser works beautifully!
Gentle, great cleanser. Especially for irritated skin. Highly recommended

I have sensitive skin that is also oily and subject to hormonal acne. I've been using the La Roche-Posay Effaclar Deep Cleansing Foaming Cream (125ml) 4.2 Fluid Ounce Tube for a few years and really like it, but when I need a quick wash in the morning or on a day when I haven't been wearing makeup, the Effaclar is a bit much. It goes on as a milky cream, and you only need a small amount, so this bottle should last a really long time. It rinses off easily, but since it doesn't seem to clean foundation very well, I use another cleanser beforehand on days when I wear makeup, and then this afterwards, in the Japanese "double cleansing" model. I'm impressed with La Roche-Posay's products, and this is another nice one!

I always thought that I needed a cleanser that was more astringent for my combo skin. This gentle cleanser makes my skin feel smooth and silky. No break-outs or oily patches. Redness is gone in only a month.

I was a loyal Cetaphil user for 15 years. I never thought that I would find a product I like better. But I did. I switched to Toleriane after seeing it recommended for rosacea sufferers.

Cetaphil left my skin feeling neutral, which I thought was good. I hated the cleansers that left my face feeling dry. But this leaves my skin feeling moisturized without feeling greasy. And, as a bonus, it is Paraben Free! I even use it to remove my make up, which I think is doubly important since I suspect I might be developing ocular rosacea.

Love it, love it, love it.

I recently received a sample vial of the iS Clinical Hydra Cool serum and am very, very impressed with it.

While the price seems very high, I noticed that the tiny sample vial with just 0.125 fl. oz lasted about one week for me, at one application per day. A little goes an extremely long way. While I don't suffer from acne, my skin is rather dry on the cheeks. It was amazing how after only a few applications my cheeks were smooth, supple, the skin just looked a lot more even and healthier than before.

When it comes to cosmetics, nearly all products promise great results but hardly ever does one deliver. This one did for me. I really love this serum. Finally something that does make a difference. Very happy with it.

This serum worked ok. I didn't find it to be cooling at all. Serums are popular and I've used various brands that are much less expensive, with great results. I didn't feel that this product was anything out of the ordinary.

I have rosacea, which is why I was interested in trying this product.  It did seem to lessen my redness a little, although not hugely.  What I didn't like about it was how runny and thin it was.  It came with an eyedropper dispenser, and however I tried putting it on my face, directly, with cotton, on my hands first, I felt like I lost a lot of it by it running off.  With a priceline as high as this has, that would be an issue.  It also seemed to make my face a bit dry, although it's not supposed to.  There is no real scent, just a very, very mild medicine-y smell.  It didn't irritate my face at all, as many products do.  I got this to test, but I don't think I would buy it.  I'd be looking for something more use-able and more noticeable in its results if I were going to buy it.
summary: Helped with redness a little, but very runny and a bit drying for me

reviewText: I received a small sample bottle of this serum for testing. The results I had were mainly positive, I get scratchy skin on occasion and when I put it on the spot I was itching the relief was immediate and lasted. I don't notice any strong scent (a plus for me), and it goes on easily and fairly little is needed for a full application. It feels like on my skin and not heavy like some other skin products can be. Why only three stars? While I do like this product a lot, at $90 that's a breaking point for me, but your mileage may vary.
summary: Nice product, but can't rate higher at current listed price.

reviewText:
This is an okay anti-aging product that is much more expensive than products I normally use. Is it significantly better? No.

I will stick with my other products because they work fine and are much less expensive. I also don't like the scent. The product smells like chemicals, and though the scent fades, the initial smell puts me off.

While some might find the product beneficial, I prefer reasonably priced products that work just as well.
summary: I Prefer Other Less Expensive Anti-Aging Products

reviewText: I like this serum, a few drops and it smooths evenly over my whole face.  I haven't noticed a cooling sensation when applying, but it does absorb quickly and leaves my skin soft.  I have skin that is prone to breaking out, so I pick products carefully that are for sensitive skin.  This serum didn't cause any break outs while using it, and may have kept the pimples at bay.  I didn't notice a fragrance in the serum, it smelled faintly of medicine. It is a light blue color, but it wasn't noticeable after blending in my skin.  All in all I like how this serum makes my skin feel soft.

Even sensitive, irritated, acne prone skin needs moisture. This gentle serum is made with skin supporting ingredients. Among the active ingredients is hyaluronic acid, a moisture magnet. Vitamin B-5 soothes and relieves itching while mushroom extract evens pigment and smoothes. Centella asiatica is both anti-bacterial and anti-inflammatory and believed to promote healing. Pump a sparing amount of the serum and apply to clean dry skin in the morning and evening.

I found the serum refreshing, with a touch of coolness. It absorbed quickly and left my skin feeling soft and smooth. The serum is dyed blue and has an odd medicinal aroma. I would have preferred it without the color or the fragrance. a clear serum in a blue bottle would have been a healthier combination. The fragrance does not linger but I prefer products that are fragrance free. That being said, this product does work. It would be excellent as a light moisturizer in the summer or as an extra layer of protection when applied under a heavier moisturizer. It is gentle and did not irritate my sensitive skin.

This serum does a good job moisturizing.  It has excellent coverage - two drops from the dropper are enough to completely treat my face, with a bit left over for my hands.  It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave an oily residue - very clean application.  It seems to have a slight effect on acne.  I have a chronic blemish that comes up on the side of my nose where my glasses rest, and after using this for a few days that has reduced considerably (its not gone, but the reduction is heartening!)  Over all its a decent product.

This is a very nice product that goes on nice and smooth and is absorbed quickly. It did seem to moisturize and soothe dry skin well. I found that just a little bit covers a fairly wide area of skin. After several days of wearing this product, my skin, which is mostly on the dry side, did feel smooth and soft. It does have  astrange smell - sort of sweet, but not exactly - which disappears pretty quicky after the product is applied.

My reservations about this product are the price and the fact that it has some kind of blue coloring. REcommended to those who are okay with both.

I love IS Clinical serums. I've tried several in the past, my favorites are Pro Heal, Vit C+E and 20% vit C. They truly make a difference in skin appearance.
This serum has a hyaluronic acid (hydrating, plumping) and antioxidants plus mushroom extract. It is tightening and feels good on the skin. A little goes long way.
If your skin is dehydrated definitely it will help to use it under good occlusive moisturizer (after cleanser and toner) that will prevent loosing hydration from epidermis.
Every skin can benefit from this serum as most of us has dehydrated dermis and epidermis. If you need stronger anti aging properties or have a pigment issue or acne you can combine 2 serums or use one in the morning and another at night.

First, fellow Viners. That "teeny tiny sample bottle"  is .12 oz. while the real product here is 1 oz for $90. (Thank you for the person below who corrected me. Those numbers are very tiny!  I can understand $90--kind of--for a 1 oz bottle. Not for a .12 oz one!)

I definitely liked various things about IS-Clinical, most of all that it feels very good on my skin, and is easy to apply (I squeezed the e dropper on a finger then to my cheek--there are no directions. I just put a small dab, and it covered a lot more area than I expected (about two cheeks' worth). It went on smooth and felt good, no stinging.

On the "minus" side, it's obviously very, very expensive. And, while it felt good, for me, it didn't perform any miracle. Unless money's no object, I'd think twice. Also, it's tinted light blue. For something on your skin, a lotion at this price, I would want to not have dyes and parfums. Maybe it wouldn't look impressive if it were clear, but I know I would like it better.
summary: Feels good,spreads well, but its expensive and tinted

reviewText:
I tried of small sample of this item, so I can't really say anything about the bottle size/design, but I was pleased with the sample that I tried. Since it has a higher price point, I have higher expectations of it than I would have for a lower-priced drug store brand. So far, I've been reasonably pleased with it.

It does feel very good when applied. It's a liquid serum (almost like a very watered down gel in texture). A little goes a long way. Just a couple drops was sufficient to cover my face. It felt very soothing - I typically have very dry, sensitive skin and this serum felt refreshing. This didn't irritate my skin at all and actually felt really nice when on.

I can't really speak to the long-term benefits, but as far as the short-term goes. It feels nice on my face and a little goes a long way, so I would imagine the full-sized bottle would last for quite a while.
summary: A little goes a long way

reviewText:
May 2017 Update:  So, I've decided this is really not worth it and lowered my rating accordingly.  It just doesn't perform the touted benefits and isn't worth the premium price tag.  I tried using it on extremely dry skin and it only provided temporary relief.  An hour later, the skin was dry and flaky again.  Even long term use did not provide any improvement over much cheaper products and it actually performed worse than many of them.  There may be other benefits or ingredients that some may find desirable or beneficial but as far as strictly moisturizing, there are much cheaper options that moisturize just as good or better.

I tried a small sample vial of this serum.  I have very dry skin. I use several different hydrating creams with varying results but I'm always open to trying new products. I tested this on one side against Moisture Therapy intensive care cream from Avon on the other. The iS serum rubbed in nicely, was fast absorbing and made my skin feel smooth after application.  iS touts Hyaluronic Acid as "nature's most powerful hydrator".  The Avon side applied, felt and looked every bit as good as the iS side.  It also held up as long as the iS side.  Gotta admit, I expected a much more pronounced difference pitting a $2 product against a $90 product.  One thing I'm not particularly fond of with the iS serum is the scent. It smells like a rubber gym ball.  At least the scent wears off in a relatively short amount of time.  Another thing I question is why it contains dye.  For an expensive serum like this, the last thing I expect are unnecessary ingredients that have a potential to irritate, such as dyes.  I've tried expensive dermatologist office sold products like iS before.  I honestly find them overpriced for what you get.  Some may swear by them but if I don't see fifty times the difference, I can't justify spending fifty times the price.
summary: Too expensive for what you get

reviewText: I am really impressed with this product.  After shaving I have tried a variety of creams and hydrations. IS Clinical gives a unique smoothness to the skin that also seems to soften. For me IS Cllinical is one of the feel good to the skin, is good for the skin products.
