Don't get the wrong idea with this Jack Black thickening shampoo.  It's not a miracle product and won't thicken your natural hair.  What it will do, however, is add volume to your hair.  So on the days you use this, your hair will appear thicker and have more volume.

I have fine, thin hair, and have been impressed by the results of this shampoo.  In terms of providing volume, it does as good a job as my current daily shampoo (Aveda Rosemary Mint).

The scent is light, and the bottle will last a while since you only need a small amount.  So it's a solid value for the price.  Color me impressed.  Now I just wish it came in travel size bottles.
summary: Effective at providing volume to thin hair.

reviewText: With most thickening shampoos I expect a bit of tingle to help stimulate the scalp that was missing from this shampoo.  Nice fragrance, cleans hair well but didn't really notice much of a difference in the hair after a week of use.  After trying Aveda's Invati, this product, Billy Jealousy and probably some others the Aveda gave the healthiest-looking results and will probably be the one we return to.
summary: decent shampoo for cleansing but lacks that stimulating tingle

reviewText:
My experience with Jack Black products over the years has been quite favorable, and that holds true for this shampoo, which I've used before.  The shampoo itself is, for the most part, colorless and its scent both interesting and muted.  Made with "basil & white lupine" (white wolf?), the smell is unique and not objectionable, though I much prefer a shampoo that smells like coconut or mint.

The label claims that "expansion technology" helps to make your hair thicker and fuller, but no one's commented on my hair looking thicker and fuller . . . and I haven't noticed much of a difference.  However, that being said, my scalp remains healthy and dander free.

I have always had baby fine hair, so have tried loads of products over the years that promised to give me thicker, fuller hair. I wasn't expecting much when I tried Jack Black True Volume shampoo, but I've been pleasantly surprised.

It's a clear, thick liquid that lathers nicely - a little goes a long way. The smell is fresh - I can identify the tea tree oil  and grapefruit. It's completely appropriate for either gender (and doesn't linger in the hair anyway).

After a couple of weeks of use, I really can tell a difference in my hair. Some "thickening" shampoos leave a build-up that makes the hair feel thicker but leaves fine hair looking lank. This product does not have that problem. It's not a miracle-worker, but it's given my hair enough extra body that I've been able to change the way I style it. I can honestly say this is the happiest I've ever been with a hair product that promised body and volume. I'll definitely buy more.
summary: Works great for my fine hair

reviewText: This is really nice shampoo.  It lathers up well and feels good on the hair.  The bottle is fairly large.  It smells really good, with a light, fresh scent.  The scent reminds me of something I'd smell in a spa- sort of citrus and herbs, but not too heavy.  It's a scent that will work equally well for men and women, and isn't particularly masculine or feminine.  This shampoo left my hair clean and bouncy.  I would definitely buy it again.

I've enjoyed using Jack Black True Volume Thickening Shampoo.  It smells nice - sorta fruity and sorta minty at the same time.  It's a clear formula, so there's no worries about dyes if that's a concern for you.  It's thick and it lathers really well.  It doesn't leave my hair feeling like straw, neither does it leave my hair feeling greasy.  When dry, my hair does look and feel full.  I can't testify about it keeping the scalp from flaking since I don't have that problem.  I like the fact that the shampoo is made with natural ingredients so I don't have to scrutinize the label for cancer causing "ates" and "ites".  I just don't know that the shampoo is worth the price.  It's definitely worth a try, though.
summary: Good Shampoo, but may not be worth the price

reviewText: My husband really needs to take care of the hair he has left.  And he needs to make the most it as well.  So anything that can give a fuller look, clean with quality ingredients and not give him dandelion head is a real find.  To that end, this Jack Black shampoo is the best shampoo he has ever used.  Not only is the smell is terrific but it really does give his hair a thicker look without the fly away dangers involved with really clean but thinning hair.  He absolutely loves it.
summary: Just the best for thinning hair.

reviewText: Ok, I'm usually a whatever is cheapest shampoo guy; I wash my hair at least once per day and I just want something that gets it squeaky clean.  If I want a little extra body or hold, I will generally use just a little bit of a very light gel to get the results I want. I've used the Jack Black 4 mornings in a row now and the difference is noticeable.  First of all, it smells great, and works up a nice lather with only about a quarter-sized amount applied to your hair.  The best part, however, is how full, shiny, and easy to manage my hair is after I've shampooed.  It holds really well without any gel or spray and looks great.  I highly recommend this.

We love the Jack Black line. My husband normally uses the All Over wash on his hair and happily agreed to try this. It is similar in affect, in that it leaves his hair clean, freshly scented and moisturized, which he needs since he doesn't use conditioner. He washes his hair at least 5 X's a week and this does not dry out his hair. I do believe it is largely due to the removal of sulfates. The tea tree is a nice addition, promoting hair health/growth. It's hard to comment on how well this thickens since my hubby has short hair, however his hair does look great. This would be a product that he probably wouldn't buy for himself, but I would buy for him during holidays.
summary: We love the Jack Black line

reviewText:
I tried this and thought it was a great shampoo, but was pretty shocked by how expensive it was for so little shampoo.

From my husband's perspective since it is a shampoo for the Men:
Although a bit pricy, the shampoo itself is worth every penny.  It doesn't have a very strong pungent smell that is overwhelming like some shampoos.  I usually use Garnier Fructis that can sometimes leave the hair stringy and leave you smelling like a tropical fruit all day.  The jack black shampoo does seem to make your hair fuller and cleaner than most shampoos that I have tried that have promised the same results.  I am 35 years of age and have a full head of hair and according to my family history won't lose it anytime soon,  so I can not explain how the shampoo does on thinning hair, but with the results I got from it just using a quarter sized amount to wash my hair and beard, I would be shocked if it didn't do what it advertises for those with thinning hair.  Even though it is $19 for 12 ounces,  I will be buying this product from now on.
summary: The Man of the House Loves It

reviewText: As I have gotten older I have found that you can't just get by with $3 health and beauty products, whether it's moisturizers, hand creams, soaps, or shampoos.  There is a reason the cost is so low.  Yes, it is sometimes hard for someone frugal like me to splurge on something like this, but I always forget that it really does last a long time for the price.  I already have think hair but I suspect that this will help maintain that fullness and body.  Can I really evaluate it's true thickening potential, probably not, but it is still a great shampoo.  I'm a hair gel guy and some shampoos have a hard time getting that "feel" out of my hair.  JB has no problem.  I recommend the standard lather, rinse, repeat.  This shampoo has a pleasing scent that is both clean and masculine.  A little dab will do the trick.  After washing my hair feels great.
summary: Sometimes you just have to pamper yourself

reviewText: I have been using Jack Black shampoo now for over a year.  I switched to Jack Black when Nordstrom switched from Anthony line of products to the Jack Black line.  Best switch I ever made.  First off my hair is thick (I am 43 with a full set of hair) but always felt somewhat dry.  Also, I am embarrassed to admit that I would get flakes during the hot summer months.  Since I went to Jack Black my hair is shinier and feels softer and no flakes at all this summer.  Smells great and it is easy to get a nice lather.  Will continue to keep buying Jack Black as I am the age where keeping all of my hair intact and looking nice is important.
summary: Prefer the Jack Black Shampoo over its rival Anthony's shampoo

reviewText:
Jack Black's Thickening Shampoo is supposed to be unscented but it does have a mild scent of basil and citrus. The scent isn't something that I noticed immediately, I had to pause to try to identify the components.  Overall, it's subtler than most shampoos for men and it's an expensive tasteful scent.

The shampoo itself is thick, clear, and quick to lather. It was strong enough that I felt that my hair was well cleaned but it didn't leave me with the squeakiness that sometimes comes with the very strong shampoos (those that need to be followed by a conditioner).  I didn't need to use a conditioner after the thickening shampoo, which indicated to me that it was nicely balanced.

I haven't noticed a thickening of my hair volume as yet, but I've just been using the shampoo for a week. Overall, I'm pleased with the JB Thickening Shampoo but I'm still debating whether it's worth the steep price tag.

This shampoo is expensive, but I think it will become a daily staple for me, along with the matching conditioner. I've been impressed every day with this shampoo. It definitely cleans well, has a nice, light smell, and definitely improves the look of my hair throughout the day. It's quite expensive compared to regular shampoos, but a little bit of this stuff goes a long way. It should last a good while. Outside of the price, this really is the ideal shampoo. If you don't mind treating yourself, this is a good daily shampoo, and will become a staple in my daily life.

First in 2010, we didn't like the way our 65 year old, short hair, felt after using, enough so that we didn't finish the bottle. Then in 2012, but didn't like that it seemed to leave our 67 year old hair dull and brittle, enough so that we didn't finish the bottle. 3rd time was a winner, love the scent and the way it leaves the 69 year old hair. Not sure about the thickening claim after one month.
summary: Our family has tried this a few times

reviewText: As I've mentioned in some of my other JB reviews, I am doing this review from the stand point of someone with thinning hair, short cut hair.  The positives about this shampoo is this bottle will last me a long time.  I've used it for over a month now and I would say I'm about a fifth of the way through the bottle.  I imagine, someone with thicker, longer hair will run through the bottle more quickly.  It is very light weight, and washes through easily and leaves my hair feeling clean.  The negative on this (and this is purely subjective), is the scent.  It has a citrus smell, specifically lemon.  I question the decision on this particular scent because it reminds me of lemon scented dish washing soap.  It even has the same texture.  Curious.  I didn't give it 5 stars because of that, but would have given it more of a 4.5 if I had the option.  Price is a little high, but most "designer" shampoos are running about the same.  The chances are if you are looking at JB products, the price isn't a deal breaker for you.  Where I don't believe my hair appears thicker, that is the fault of genetics, not this product.  My hair is definitely clean and manageable.
summary: A review for those who have thinning hair

reviewText: I have very sensitive skin and this shampoo does not bother my hair or scalp . I don't use a very large amount of the shampoo itself since I have short hair. A little bit goes along way.  It lathers up good.  I like the fact that it lacks many of the synthetic ingredients. Keeps my hair looking great and clean.
Not convinced of the thickening claim, but it seems to clean well. The smell is a bit muted, but I follow with the Jack Black conditioner anyway, which in my opinion has a much more appealing smell.
summary: It's good, but not as good as the other Jack Black products I've used

reviewText:
Though I can't vouch for the price of $129.99 price listed here. I am extremely sensitive to chemical smells including just about every fragrance mix in every brand of shampoo. It's hard to find hair care products that don't contain fragrance. I have medium-fine hair and my husband has thick wavy hair. This shampoo works great for both of us. My husband uses conditioner with it to control his waves and I use only the shampoo because I want more volume.

Dandruff Control: A side benefit to using the Jack Black shampoo & conditioner is that my husband gets itchy dandruff and with the Jack Black shampoo and conditioner he never needs to use dandruff shampoo (which tends to be heavily scented). He used to use a variety of strong anti-dandruff shampoos, but had to stop when I developed sensitivity to chemicals because they all left his hair quite fragrant.

I hope the current price listed is a typo that Amazon can fix; in the meantime I'll be purchasing directly from the manufacturer's website.
summary: Great Shampoo for People with Chemical Sensitivity & Controls Dandruff Too!

reviewText: A must for shavers with sensitive skin.  A little bit goes a long way.  This is all I use for shaving when I use a blade.
summary: A must for sensitive skin and everyday shaving.

reviewText: Husband loves it for beard and shaving his head.  A very thin coating does the trick, so a little goes a long way.  Slippery lube quality.
summary: Very effective, a little goes a very long way.

reviewText: Fantastic Shave.

I've tried many varieties of shave creams and foams from the drugstore variety to high-end creams. Many creams aren't thick enough and drip down your face as you shave, or they fail to protect your skin from getting irritated. Jack Black's Supreme Cream is amazing. It's thick and can be applied perfectly with your fingers. It sticks to your face without risk of running down your neck. Most importantly, it provides enough glide for your blade and enough cushion to avoid irritation. I've been looking for a shave cream like this for many years.
Love  it!

This has to be the best shaving cream on the market! I can not use anything else to shave my skin with anymore. I am totally spoiled! It prepares the skin after leaving it on for at least 30 sec before shaving. It makes the shave very close, doesnt clog the razor, and i don't get razor burn. I highly, highly recommend this shave cream to everyone! Just try it, Your skin doesnt feel dried out or itchy after shaving either, which i used to hate shaving because I suffered chronically from that.
summary: This has to be the best shaving cream on the market

reviewText: good product!!! I'm a DE safety razor wet shaver and wear a full beard. I like this product, because its clear when applied, so that you can view beard while shaving. End result a barber quality shave with zero irratation.
Nice but not my favorite.
Grear will buy again

I have been using Proraso shave cream for a few years and love it, but thought I'd try something different for change. Reviews at shaving sites for this product were good. First impression is that the consistency is not as creamy as the Proraso - it seems to have more air in it. I had hoped for a luxury type of lather but was disappointed in the volume and lack of density. It does have a very clean manly scent but does not produce as much lather as I would like. The tube of Proraso is chock full with cream - the Jack Black is not, reminding me of an air filled, inflated bag of chips. For the money I am disappointed in the quality and quantity of the lather as well as in the amount of cream. Going back to the Proraso.

Tried this after becoming very disappointed with the AOS (art of shaving) shaving cream line. This wasn't the solution. Ingredient list has all the right stuff, but I find the lather to be extremely weak. Very very small layer of protection even when I use a generous amount of cream. Can't even use my badger brush and a bowl to bring a healthy lather, just won't work. Experimented with proper amounts of water several times to see if I could find the right consistency, but could never find it. I would amount this to being the shaving cream. I will continue my search as this product just wasn't for me. The art of shaving provides a better leather, but is very drying. This product makes canned gillette creams look like the "cream of the crop".

I love most of Jack Black's products but I feel like this one is a miss for me.  They call it a lather but it hardly lathers at all.  For the price, I want superior protection which I feel it did not provide so it looks like I'm going back to gels.

When you're getting old, and you have contact allergies and celiac - you start looking carefully at everything you put in and on your body.  I've used a lot of highly regarded skin care products that made my skin worse because of the ingredients.

Jack Black products do not seem to aggravate my celiac, don't try out my scalp and my bad hair days aren't nearly as awful as they usually were.  This stuff lasts forever.
summary: I've used a lot of highly regarded skin care products that made my skin worse because of the ingredients

reviewText: GREAT STUFF!!
love it, no more words needed.

It's definitely a really good conditioner and it leaves your hair feeling very soft especially if you leave it in, but there are definitely cheaper products out there that do just as good of a job for less. I wish there was a little bit of a menthol effect like you have with some other shampoos. I like having matched products though and I'm a big fan of the Jack Black shampoo so I'll probably just continue to use this anyways as the rest of their product line is amazing.
summary: Not as good as the shampoo, but not bad!

reviewText: Thank goodness for Jack Black hair products. I apologize for bragging, but my hair looks great and it doesn't smell like icky perfume. I get terrible headaches from most hair products (mostly from the synthetic fragrances that are added) and it's been challenging to find shampoo and conditioner that works well without the stinky additives. I know this product line is marketed toward men, but it works great for men's and women's hair.
summary: Great brand for people who are sensitive to chemical fragrances!

reviewText: Definitely a good value ! Very satisfied with how my hair feels after using !
summary: Definitely a good value! Very satisfied with how my hair feels ...

reviewText: great product
Have been using it for years and I like the volume it gives my hair.

I've been using this in conjunction with the Jack Black True Volume Thickening shampoo.  First of all, I have had thinning hair since I was about 26, going on ten years now.  I've tried all kinds of products to try and magically make my hair appear thicker and fuller, but I have finally come to the acceptance that there is no miracle product.  With that said, I believe this is a great conditioner.  It is relatively light, has pleasant citrus smell (smell is subjective), and it leave my hair very soft and manageable.  I'm not going to say one way or the other whether this has made my hair appear thicker... if it has, it's barely noticeable.  But since I keep my hair relatively short, it has made it much more manageable.  I will buy this product again.
summary: A realistic review on a great product for those of us who have thinning hair

reviewText: Good conditioner, works good in my curly hair, plumps it up a little bit with volume too.  Smells nice, and leaves no residue.

Very thick conditioner with fantastic mint/menthol smell. The smell is more herbal than the shampoo and pairs nicely with the Jack Black body wash. Leave your hair feeling smooth, and tames some of the wiry hair that I have. Expensive, but worth it.
summary: Great results, and smells good too

reviewText: highly recommend. moderate scent. great results. does it actually revitalize hair? i'm willing to claim that my hair does -- for a while -- have an improved vital quality.

I am a woman who suffers from skin issues from
shaving my bikini line. I've tried a ton of OTC and prescription products to resolve my ingrown hairs and post-shaving bumps without much success. I tried this product and have been using it for several weeks.
First, if you've nicked yourself shaving, do not apply this to freshly-cut skin, because it stings terribly (from the acids in the product)! This does apply beautifully--it smooths on easily and absorbs quickly. I have been applying immediately post-shave and then again once nightly. I can't say that all my shaving-related skin issues have been resolved thanks to this product, but they are reduced noticeably. I hope over time to see even greater benefit.
Repeat buyer of this stuff - I was skeptical at first, but this stuff really helps with preventing ingrown hairs after shaving.
summary: Repeat buyer of this stuff - I was skeptical at ...

reviewText: By far the best treatment for ingrown hair I have ever used. Not just for the face, it works quickly and easily. I have never found something that truly gets to the root of the problem and heals, but this definitely does. Recommend 100%.
summary: By far the best treatment for ingrown hair I have ever used

reviewText: Awesome product for those of us that are prone to ingrown hairs.  After shaving, my sensitive neck area used to always get ingrown hair and breakouts.  Using this product in combination with the Anthony Shaving cream has eliminated ingrown hairs completely.  my skin is soft and smooth!
summary: must have for ingrown hair prone skin

reviewText: I always have ingrown hair on my neck which usually leads to razor rash. I wasn't exactly sure how to apply this product, but it was just as simple as putting it on after the shave. My neck feels so much better after applying it, and somehow it really helps with the ingrown hair issues between shaves. Who would have thought?!?!  Well played, Anthony!
summary: This feels so good on my neck!

reviewText: My husband has the MOST sensitive skin in the world - the poor guy has been suffering from ingrowns for years - sometimes the ingrowns are worse than other times (and this is mostly to the fact of what skin products he uses).  After some research we stumbled upon Anthony Ingrown Hair Treatment and even though he is not 'cured' of ingrowns, the amount of ingrown hairs he gets has reduced drastically and this is just in the 3 weeks he has been using it.  We believe that with using it over time it will get better and better.  (Also, for the ladies if you get ingrowns in the bikini area this helps amazingly as well!  *wink* *wink*)
summary: ... the MOST sensitive skin in the world - the poor guy has been suffering from ingrowns for years - ...

reviewText: Was really thick like old Chapstick.  Probably won't buy anymore since you get like three sticks with the kit. Not moist

This is nice.  It does impart nice shine and it does detangle.  I've tried about a dozen Philip B products through Amazon over the past couple of
years and like them all.  Yes I'd buy this product again.
Smells to vinegary for me when spraying.  I'll try again since I have the bottle.  I do love Philip B.

I got this in July's Glossybox and I was almost afraid to try it.  I'd heard a lot of people complaining about the smell.  But, I gave it a chance, and I'm glad I did.

This contains apple cider vinegar, so it *does* smell like vinegar when you first apply it.  The smell doesn't linger, though, more than a few minutes.  It's been less than an hour since I used it and I can't smell it at all any more.  So it's perfectly OK to use in the morning before work!

This is an EXCELLENT detangler.  I don't know if I've ever used any product that made it easier to get rid of tangles, actually.  I spray it all over wet hair and then use a detangling brush to work this through my hair.  It's SO easy to do.  (I have waist-length hair and I get a LOT of tangles.)

My hair is so soft after using this, too.  I do notice less frizz, as well.  Going to have to bite the bullet and buy a full-sized bottle when my sample is out, because this has been working so well for me.
summary: super-effective detangler (and the smell doesn't last very long)

reviewText:
I have baby fine hair, I was looking for something that would not weigh my hair done.  This works well to detangle
I recommend
This truly is an amazing product for the price!  It makes your scalp feel amazing and you honestly do feel and see a difference in your hairline.
Love the peppermint. There is a small tingley sensation that you would expect from mint but you get clean, well-conditioned hair.

Whoa!  I love it!  Nicely invorgorating!  Very cleansing.  Scalp and hair feels great after using this.  I follow it with Philip B.'s light
weight conditioner.  Love the conditioner too!
summary: Philip B. Peppermint and Avacado Shampoo

reviewText: you have to use a lot if you have thick hair and for the price point it's not worth it. the peppermint essential oils in this are too concentrated and will burn your eyes
summary: you have to use a lot if you have thick ...

reviewText: This is an effective deep cleansing shampoo. With this shampoo I would really recommend that you first wash your hair with a cheaper shampoo then follow with this. I have found that on the first round of shampoo this does not lather well, so you'll end up using more than you need if you want a rich lather. So if you use a cheaper shampoo first to remove the surface dirt on your hair and scalp, and then you use this shampoo, the bottle will last a lot longer and you will get more of the scalp deep cleansing.

Soooooo clean without stripping ! The warning about not getting it in your eyes is a pertinent one. I use this 3 times a week. I've been looking for a clarifying shampoo since Fekkai DC'd theirs and found a far better one
This is a very classic shampoo which does a good job cleaning your hair. It does leave a shine. It smells really good.  It is worth the extra money.

Great shampoo that leaves your hair smelling great and your scalp stimulated with the cool relaxing feel and smell of peppermint. This shampoo gives you an experience that is both mentally and physically satisfying.

I'm a shampoo junkie. Philip B's Peppermint & Avocado Shampoo is a tried and true favorite. You won't find me without it. I even have a tiny travel bottle. I wish I could rate this 6 stars!

It smells amazing, leaves your scalp tingly, and your hair feels nice 'n clean.

Best of all, it's cheaper to buy on amazon!
Works well but VERY woody scented
summary: Awesome just be sure the scents for you

reviewText: This is my second purchase of this product and won't be my last.  It smells like Christmas and my hair feels smooth but still had body.  Love it.
summary: It smells like Christmas and my hair feels smooth but still had ...

reviewText: Nice smelling product.  I don't think it is worth the price.
My hair looks and feels terrific

The smell of this shampoo (and body wash) is intoxicating; woodsy and masculine (I'm a lady and love it). I dislike the sickening sweet smell of fruit and flowers from most other shampoos.  This product smells like a dense forest.
summary: My Hair Smells Like A Forest - Philip B. Nordic Wood

reviewText: Great shampoo and body wash that leaves your hair and skin feeling moisturized with the unique pleasant smell of Nordic Wood that helps you escape away.

I'm a guy, and I love this stuff. Bonus points for being able to use it as a shampoo and body wash. It really makes you feel awake and refreshed when you use it, like a fresh pine forest - but not a gross taxi cab air freshener. After all, this is Philip B; it's legit. Amazon has the best prices too, so no need to keep shopping. Big bottle will last you a while too.
summary: Like a pine forest of refreshing awesomeness!

reviewText: A very nice facial moisturizer but a little on the heavy side. I should have bought the oil free admittedly, but its still a good moisturizer that lasts all day. Cheap moisturizers usually dry out mid day, this doesn't.

I keep ordering this over and over and over...

The BEST facial moisturizer I've EVER tried -- and I've tried many...
Really nice to use and leave on over night.
I don't think this is any better than the other oil treatments that I have purchased.  I'd save the money.
summary: Not sure it's worth the price

reviewText: This truly is an amazing product for the price!  It makes your scalp feel amazing and you honestly do feel and see a difference in your hairline.

I was looking for a cheaper alternative than JOSIE MARAN ARGAN OIL and took a risk on this. It smells divine ... like a combination of flowers and nuts. The consistency is good too. Only negative is it contains BHT = preservative I try to avoid.

UPDATE: After using entire bottle ... the scent became too much for me. Will not purchase again
summary: beautiful scent ... so happy I bought this

reviewText: I originally bought this about 20 yrs ago from QVC (after an article appeared in a magazine and it completely sold out at Nordstrom's). I remember paying about $25-30 for it, back then. I almost bought it from HSN (for about $30) recently, but found it here and I was soooo happy!!!! I love the natural, floral, botanical scent. I usually put it on, comb through, blow dry to get it penetrated and leave it on all nite. Then in the morning add a tiny bit of water and a handful of shampoo and "dry shampoo" it out, it usually takes a second shampooing after rinsing out the first. My hair ends up looking and feeling very soft, healthy, yet not limp, stray gray hairs somehow seem to blend in and it looks like I just had a haircut. I really love this product, am very happy to find it again and at such a great price, too.
The best ever. Took care of the problem completely. Our dandruff was over the top are falling from the top constantly. Now, there is none. Use three times per week.
summary: The best ever. Took care of the problem completely

reviewText: I really like this thickening spray.  It adds body and texture without weighing my hair down.  It also adds some heft to individual strands making them look thicker and more voluminous.  I've started layering this spray with a styling spray (Suave) because my hair is really hard to hold and I found that I needed some extra support in order for my finished style to last a couple of days.  The two products work well together and there's no stiffness or crunchiness at all. But you don't have to do this because this spray works well all by itself.  I have a layered long bob (a lob) and I wanted something that would define the layers while adding some heft to my tresses.  This spray gives me incredible body and my hair is light and bouncy and responds really well to styling.  I let my hair air dry overnight and use a curling iron in the a.m. to create beachy waves.  This spray is definitely activated by heat and the volume increases as heat is applied but if you just want texture, you don't have to use heat at all. I really like this spray and its thickening properties and its ability to give my hair loads of swingy body.  It was a good purchase for me.  Amazon has the best price on this product btw.  My local Ulta sells this spray for $16 and I think I paid $10ish on Amazon Prime.  I definitely recommend this spray, especially for fine hair.  If you want more thickness, body and texture, give this product a whirl.
summary: Definitely adds thickness, body and texture.

reviewText: GREAT
Does a good job to make my hair appear thicker and with volume.  Easy to apply...sprays neatly and feels clean.

I LOVE this product! I use it so I don't have to dye my hair every month to keep it red, and it definitely works. I feel like I just dyed my hair every time I use it. The reason I say to use cautiously is because it WILL make your hair fall out if you leave it in longer than 5 minutes. reviewText: Its not fun being on the search, once you find it, stick close.
No one knows what the future holds, mine is now set up nicely.

I hate the messy spray dry shampoos.  I've tried about 6 different ones, high end and drugstore, and all of them have left a disturbing grayish cast in my dark blond hair.  But this dry shampoo is a sprinkle in powder that works incredibly well. I use the tiniest amount of this powder and it soaks up oil really well but it does take a few minutes to work.  At first the scent is strong but it soon disappears so if you're fragrance sensitive, you'll definitely be able to use Pronto.  It makes my hair look and feel much cleaner and it doesn't give me that flat matte finish like so many dry shampoos.  The small size is deceiving because it takes very little powder to do the job and I'll bet there's not much actual powder in the sprays and that all the room in the can is taken up by nasty propellant.  So this product is not expensive to use at all.  I've had the 1 ounce size for several months, even though I use it a couple of times a week.  It also comes in a larger size, which is more economical.  I know that Ulta carries Pronto and if you buy it there, you can return it if you don't like it.  However, I'm willing to bet that you'll like it as much as I do.  I definitely prefer the sprinkle in powder form over the sprays.  Today, for example, I used Pronto and after 20 minutes there was no residue left.  I just worked it in like regular shampoo and POOF!, 20 minutes later it had disappeared.  I had some nice volume and my hair still had shine.  I really like everything about this product and will keep it stocked from now on.  It's by far the best dry shampoo I've tried and I see no need to keep looking.  If you want cleaner looking hair without having to shampoo, I suggest you try this product.  I definitely recommend it.

Although I hated Oscar Blandi's Lacca hairspray, I happen to really like this dry shampoo powder.  I find spray dry shampoo to be very messy and the white residue always leaves a grayish cast even on my dark blond hair.  However, I try to wash my color treated hair as little as possible and I can usually get away with two days without using anything but on the 3rd day, dry shampoo comes in very handy.  I very much prefer this form of dry shampoo.  I sprinkle the powder on the roots every 1/2 inch or so from ear to ear and a little bit in the back.  I wait about 20 minutes while I do my makeup, making sure I work the powder into the roots as if it were regular shampoo.  After waiting the required minutes, I brush out whatever residue remains with a 100% boar bristle brush (plastic bristles do not work for this maneuver).  Most of the residue disappears as the oil is absorbed so this dry shampoo doesn't leave a grayish cast at all.  It has a very subtle scent (that dissipates quickly however) and also adds some nice volume that lasts all day and can be easily reinflated with a fluff of the fingers.  It definitely makes my hair feel cleaner and when I use it, I can wear my hair down an extra day.  This powder also washes out easily, leaving no residue whatsoever.  Yes, this product is rather expensive.  I get the 2.5 ounce size and it does last for a couple of months, even though I use it a couple of times a week.  It takes very little powder to do the job so the small size is somewhat deceptive. Amazon has the 1 ounce size of Pronto, which is like a trial or travel size and if you're looking for a really good dry shampoo product, I urge you to give it a try.

I prefer this dry shampoo over the Oscar Blandi spray versionof the dry shampoo. It can be placed precisely where needed, and with practice doesn't leave any tell tale residue in the hair.  Nobody seems to carry the 2.5 oz version anymore, so I'll have to make do with the 1 oz size and purchase it more frequently until it's no longer available -- in fact, I just purchased 3.

It is a little pricey but for me it is well worth it, I NEVERRRR thought I would be able to go a day or 2 without washing my hair and looking disgusting and was so jealous of all my friends who were able to do that but now I can! I've tried a handful of lower end spray dry shampoos. I haven't gotten a chance to try the more expensive kind, but I don't know if I want to when I have this powder. I actually like the applicator. I never apply the applicator directly to my scalp, rather I put some into the palm of my hand and then sort of sprinkle it over areas of my scalp.  Okay, yes this is messier than a spray, but imo, it allows for more precision and this powder has a lot less residue than any spray I know of.  I think it's a lot easier to control the amount when you apply with your hands. With the sprays.. spray for half a second too long and now your hair is gross and covered in too much dry shampoo. No good. I hardly have that issue with the powder.

More tips on application: like straightening or curling, you need to apply a little bit to sections of your hair. So I'll section off a part around my crown, sprinkle in the powder and really pat it around with my fingers. Do that with the next section. Sometimes I do get overzealous and put on too much. Either way, I use a brush at the end to better distribute the powder.  Sometimes I do this so carefully and it takes enough time that I wonder why I didn't just wash my hair.. but it's still worth it. Oh and I cannot stress that this is minimal residue! That's my favorite part about it.

Other positive: while I haven't used it consistently or on a weekly basis, my medium sized bottle has lasted over three years. A little truly does go a long way and you really get your money's worth.

This doesn't get a five star rating because sometimes application can be messy. Don't wear black while you're doing this. I'm also looking for the perfect spray but as far as I know, it doesn't exist.

Do not apply from the bottle directly to your head. Instead pour a bit out and apply with your fingers. It seems too little powder to do anything but it works! Very light scent and does not irritate. I've been told it's because I wash my hair every day, so I went looking for dry shampoo alternatives. It takes three separate squeezes for my hair, but again, that's because my hair is greasy the day after I wash it. The end result is wonderful. It's not like actually washing my hair, of course, but it really dries up the grease and gives my hair body. I can easily go an extra day between washes now, which is going to make a huge difference in how my color holds over time.

Thanks to all the reviewers here who took the time to write about the product, and to the manufacturer for making such a great product. I'm now an every-other-day hair washer!

LOVE THIS STUFF

I just used this stuff- I took a steamy shower, washed my face and then followed the instructions stating to get the cotton ball REALLY wet when applying Silver Powder- then I laid flat and let it dry. Next I used a pore strip and as I pulled it off, I literally did not have a black head in sight. I have battled blackheads my entire teenage and adult life. This product is INCREDIBLE... I seriously cried. I am going to use it weekly and can afford to do so, it's a reasonable price. Try this if your blackheads give you grief.

I have been using this foundation for about a year and would not consider switching to anything else.  Along with my Tarte airbrush brush, it creates almost flawless base.  I have slight melasma and it covers most of the discoloration.  It never cakes (if applied with the tarte brush) and it is pretty good at controlling oil production.  My one suggestion is to go into a store that sells this product to get color matched because their color palette is off. Love this product!  Covers well lasts all day. Always looks fresh from morning to night also easy to travel with!
Love this stuff What a difference! And I got it pretty quickly
Didn't do anything for me - didn't change the appearance of my pores at all.

This product is simply okay. I bought this to clear up my acne and blackheads. I applied it using a flat headed foundation brush. I would remove the cap and fill it with apple cider vinegar, dip the brush into the vinegar, then dip the brush into the powder and apply it to my face.  I would leave it on for about half an hour, then use a cotton ball woth apple cider vinegar to rub off the powder. This method left my skin dry so I always followed with moisturizer. I recommend the Aztec Healing Clay Mask, which is much more cost effective compared to this and works for pretty much everyone - it's a miracle!  It will absorb oil and clear your skin.

I have never found a foundation no matter what that I was pleased with but I am on my third replacement and have wondered how I lived without it. I don't like make up . This is very natural. Love the concept behind Jane Iredale products as well.

Silver Powder Review

its a great powder, I never look to made up with this powder, also love it having sun screen in it.

It can crease/build up over the day if you put too much on and as it is mineral and not absorbed by the skin it can rub off on phone screens and other items that may come in contact with your face.

AMAZING! I have been looking for the EXACT shade for over 22 yrs and I have found it in golden glow! I am mixed and have a more yellowish undertone and VERY hard to find any kind of makeup with more yellow in it. Usually I get a beige muddy look (almost ruddy) and/or a pinkish undertone. reviewText: Very nice gel?

I read about this product in a recent issue of _Lucky_ magazine, where it was touted as an excellent weekly mask.  I used it for the first time today, and it left my skin incredibly soft and silky.  My pores were also noticeably smaller.

I have very sensitive skin, and this didn't burn or irritate it at all.  There was also no redness after using it, and no stinging while it was on.

Even though this is called "Detox Face Mask," it is very hydrating.

I applied a thick coat and let it work its magic for about five minutes, before rinsing it off.  It "oxygenates" and the thick cream turns into little bubbles on your face as it goes to work.

According to the instructions, you can use this daily, depending on your skin type and the amount of it you apply.  I'll probably use this a few times a week, and will be sure to report back on how I like it as I use it more.

A great product!

UPDATE ON 1-12-13:  I've been using this mask for about a year, and still continue to love it! I don't use it as often as I'd like to, but it works so well to hydrate and add a glow to your skin.

reviewText: This is the 2nd room spray that I purchased in the last week, only because the first one was defective. This time I bought the Antica rose, orris, and oud which works well and smells very nice - it's a warm floral and not too sweet. Also it isn't overpowering or strong and I would like it even more if it lasted longer than it does. I do spray it more than I should just to be able to smell it in the rooms and hallways - for this reason this bottle won't last long for me. It says that it can be used for linens but I am reluctant to spray it on my sheets for fear it might get them stained from the ingredients like any other room spray. There are many different fragrances Antica has to choose from depending on preference and at this price I would recommend giving it a try. The first one I ordered was the lavender and lime and because it didn't work properly I didn't comment on it favorably - I did say it smelled nice though! I have one last remark about this spray - when I press the top down to spray not a lot goes into the air and I have to do it quite a few times to get enough into the room unlike some other ones that I've used (Diptyque which costs more than double the price of these).

I bought this in the lavender and lime which has a nice smell. However I'm not too sure if it's me or the spray bottle but I find it difficult to spray in a room without the liquid dripping from the hole and into my hand, fingers and onto the bottle. This has me wondering how much spray is going into the room. Prior to purchasing this I had been using Diptyque room sprays which are more than double the price of these but had a similar experience with some of them as well. This spray has a rather light smell and it needs more spray to scent the rooms it's being used in. I don't mean to be critical of this product and have just ordered another one in a different fragrance. I don't plan on returning this one as 'defective' or 'doesn't work' as I do believe the issue with the spray is probably mine. I would recommend giving this brand of room spray a try - there are many different fragrances to choose from depending on a particular preference. The lavender and lime that I based this review on is for my upstairs where the bedrooms and bathrooms are located and where I prefer a soft fragrance.

reviewText:
I was hoping that Oxygen Infusion Night Cream would be more nourishing and hydrating than Skyn Icelands Cloud Cream, which is a decent moisturizer but inadequate for dry skin. I was disappointed. I have very sensitive skin almost completely lacking in barrier. Without my regular concoction of serums, my skin is painfully dry in the winter. I was hopeful that Oxygen Infusion Night Cream would help maintain some hydration in my skin, but it doesnt do much in that department. Its not for dry skin. It doesnt add any value to my serums. This cream is lighter and fluffier than Cloud Cream. It either contains more water or more air. It goes on with almost no drag. But it stings and even burns if my skin is broken. I attribute this to the fragrance, which is floral and perfumey.

So Oxygen Infusion Night Cream is not for sensitive skin. Among its active ingredients in Gosulin Agave. Skyn Iceland does not use silicone in its products. This is the primary reason that Ive been trying their products, as I cannot stand silicone on my skin, and its difficult to find a moisturizer without it. Gosulin Agave is a polysaccharide extracted from the Blue Agave plant. It is an alternative to silicone, as it mattifies and creates a velvety surface on the skin. The texture is more natural than silicone; it doesnt feel like plastic. But I find that the retexturizing agent (probably gosulin agave mixed with oils and sugars in the formula) balls up and leaves bits on the skin when applied. Cloud Cream contains a retexturizer, but its not gosulin agave and doesnt have this problem.

Neither Cloud Cream nor Oxygen Infusion Night Cream have appreciable moisturizing properties. Theyre for normal skin, not for someone who badly needs hydration. Cloud Cream is thicker and has much more drag. But, once theyve been applied, its difficult to tell them apart or it would be, if the Oxygen Infusion Night Cream were not shedding little bits of retexturizer- because they both leave a retexturized skin surface. They feel the same. Silky smooth skin and no way to tell if it is desiccated beneath the surface. This is one of the many reasons that I dislike the trend to put retexturizers in so many skin care products. Its impossible to discern the effects of the product. But I am surprised that a moisturizer at this price point is so irritating and sheds bits of itself.

The ingredient list currently posted on Amazon is incorrect. There was a formula change. This product no longer contains retinol or dimethicone (silicone). Cloud Cream contains retinol.

Ingredients: Water (Aqua), Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Butylene Glycol, Glyceryl Stearate, Hydrogenated Ethylhexyl Olivate, Squalane, Peg-100 Stearate, Phenoxyethanol, Saccharomyces Lysate Extract, Imperata Cylindrica Root Extract, Spiraea Ulmaria Extract, Buddleja Davidii Extract, Thymus Vulgaris (Thyme) Flower/Leaf Extract, Salix Alba (Willow) Bark Extract, Agave Tequilana Leaf Extract, Saponaria Pumila Callus Culture Extract**, Angelica Archangelica Root Water*, Oxycoccus Palustris (Cranberry) Seed Oil, Rubus Chamaemorus (Artic Cloudberry) Seed Oil, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Hydrolyzed Rice Bran Protein, Pantheol, Sucrose Palmitate, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Ceramide Np, Glycerin, Maltose, Isomalt, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Hydroxide, Sodium Phytate, Stearyl Alcohol, Isostearic Acid, Pentylene Glycol, Hydrogenated Olive Oil, Unsaponifiables, Perfluorodecalin, Triethyl Citrate, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Fruit Extract, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Flower/Leaf/Stem Extract, Pyrus Malus (Apple) Fruit Extractrose Extract, Alcohol, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Extract, Olea Europaea (Olive) Leaf Extract, Santalum Album (Sandalwood) Wood Extract, Zingiber Officinale (Ginger) Root Extract, Carbomer, Caprylyl Glycol, Rose Extract, Lecithin**, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate.  (*Component Of Icelandic Glacial Water **Contains Soy)

reviewText: My husband really likes this soap.  It smells great and lasts forever.
summary: It smells great and lasts forever

reviewText:
This product is old school masculine.  First, it does the job.  The soap does a great job of cleaning and for a small bar doesn't dissolve quickly.  The scent is a cross between old time barbershops and my grandfather's pipe.  I love it.

Interesting side note:  I bought this soap in December.  After I bought it Amazon said the soap would be delivered to me around Jan. 20th.  To my shock it came on exactly Jan. 20th!  I also found out why...It shipped from Europe.
Very clean, masculine scent. Compliments the shaving cream and after shave well.

Not worth the money. Just like any other bar soap I've used. Also the smell reminded me of a laundry soap used back in my home country. It cleans well but it is not worth the money at all. Dial soap is actually better for my skin.

Wonderful soap. Lather is luxurious and delightful. It seems odd to me that people don't talk more about the scent. It is quite different than any other soap I've ever encountered. I will tell you that I love the scent, but it is not for everybody. In point of fact it smells like the spice cumin. It has a very pleasant, light curry smell that doesn't linger too long - just enough to enjoy. The quality of the soap is excellent and I am very keen to try some of their other scents.
This is the perfect moisturizer, I love it and the somme system. I wish it was a little more moisturizing during cold dry months.

Delivered as promised, new-in-box. This is a fairly non-irritating exfoliant; my skin is very sensitive and I use it only every other day. I can't imagine using it twice daily unless your skin is extremely oily. If you use the pads that go along with this (and I do) get them from Nordstrom; you can get double the amount for the same price you would pay anywhere else. Otherwise the prices here for Somme products are the best. I've ordered the serum and the cleanser but so far they have not arrived.

I've also reviewed the shampoo companion to this conditioner...and I hated the way it smells. But I will say that the conditioner is a much more toned down version of the fake Jasmine smell, so that is good. The product does what it says it will do. My hair is smoother and it feels silkier. So I only took away one star for the bad use of the Jasmine fragrance that is somewhat pain straight in the eyeball headache causing...but dissipates. The conditioner is very light and does its smoothing job without weighing down my very fine and frizzy prone curly hair. And as I said in the review of the shampoo, if it does the job, I'll use it until it is gone. But hey, if you like really fragranced products and you have fine and frizzy hair, I say go for it. The serum is great too!
