reviewText:
I have never tried any Laura Biagiotti products before but am happy with this. It has a strong smell when coming out of the bottle but after showering it is more subtle.  It is hard to describe the scent.  It has a bit of a sweet smell tempered by a more masculine smell.  I use this when I go out on a date or out with friends.

This is comes in a classy looking bottle.  I can smell the fragrance even with the bottle closed. The smell is strong when coming out of the bottle but becomes more subtle after a shower. It does have a sweet smell but that is tempered by a more masculine smell.

When I am using a shower gel, deodorant, or cologne I want something that smells nice but does not smell like a perfume. This is a nice smelling shower gel that is made for a man. It is not something I would wear to work but is perfect when I am going out on a date or going out with friends.

My main peeve about shower gels in general is that you have to use so much. This shower gel is great and a little goes a long way. The scent is strong but wears off quickly. I feel clean after using it, but even better, I do not feel like my skin is dry. It washes off easily and does not leave a film or residue. I have finally found a shower gel that I will use regularly. The only negative I can see with this is if you are sensitive to the scent. Like I said, in the shower, it is strong. Once I am dressed, it does not seem overwhelming. The tube is large and since you don't have to use much, it should last, which makes it a great value. If you shave in the shower, use this first. I used it after and it stung a little.

I've been a shower gel user for more than 15 years, much of the time using AXE Kilo, but a couple of years ago my wife bought me a gift set of Calvin Klein Obsession for Men that included a tube of shower gel. I loved it, but I've used it up and it's ridiculously expensive to replace, so I decided to give Laura Biagiotti Roma Uoma Shower and Bath Gel a try.
It compares quite favorably to the Obsession for Men, and I think I like the Roma Uomo better because it has a more masculine note with a hint of woodsmoke.
My wife likes it better too.
summary: A masculine scent, superior in many ways to more expensive gels, at a very reasonable price

reviewText: This is a good product. It does help whiten your teeth. Is it better than the $6 whitening mouthwash at the grocery store? Not really.
summary: This is a good product. It does help whiten your teeth

reviewText: This entire line rocks. Love my white teeth1
Fabulous rinse. Not only helps whiten but cleans mouth and breath. All adults in household have adopted my Super Smile Rinse. Rest of system is ordinary but rinse is terrific.

This works. It helps remove some food stains. I love tea and coffee and berries and I have older teeth. I notice a difference when I use this. I don't always rinse. I sometimes pour a bit on the toothbrush itself and brush it on. And then pour a bit on top of the toothpaste. Either ways--rinsing, using on brush--has a lightening effect. Be careful or your gums might end up pale/with white spots for a spell. Don't overuse.
Too expensive. Works good but not for the price.
summary: Works good but not for the price

reviewText: I really like this stuff.  I use it every morning, every night.  It's expensive, compare to other brands, but I honestly think it keeps me from having morning breath when I use it instead of other mouthwashes.  That's worth the price.  Am reordering.  I wasn't as impressed with the rest of the line.  I can do as well if not better with other whiteners.

I purchased the rinse and the toothpaste and accelerator.  I've been using it for 6 or 7 months.  I do NOT see any change in the color of my teeth.  I've gone through three bottles of the rinse and two each of the 8 oz. toothpaste and accelerator.  I will NOT purchase any more Supersmile products.

I liked the way this works because my sensitive teeth didn't hurt after using it.  Also, the color of white my teeth obtained was natural instead of the super blinding white you see coming from a dental office.  If you like the natural look you'll love this product when used with the toothpaste set.
summary: Used with the tooth paste this system really does work

reviewText: ii have bought this to work with the toothpaste whitening kit.  i have used the toothpaste with the past without the rinse and thought this would aide in getting better results.  i have to say i saw no difference, using this in addition.  it also made my teeth sensitive.  i will use it until it's gone, but won't buy again.  i will say if you have very stained teeth, this definitely may help.  i will continue to buy the toothpaste!
Best face wash, hands down!

This was my go-to for a long time. And the product is nice, and works well for my dry skin (particularly during Chicago winters). But I've since switched to Cerave at fraction of the cost, and which I like even more. I do not spare expense when it comes to skin care. But there is no need to pay more unnecessarily either. This product is simply overpriced for what it is.
summary: Works, but it's overpriced and you can get better for less

reviewText: This is a nice light lotion.  I have sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate it at all.  I love this lotion!

This is definitely made for dry, irritated, very spiteful skin, and it does a very good job of correcting that. My face gets somewhat red (as it usually does) when I apply it, but the redness goes away and it NEVER stings. A little goes a very long way, especially with how thick the cream is. Will definitely buy again.
I've been buying this brand  and this cream for a decade, always works, doesn't irritates your skin and moisturizes enough even during the winter.
summary: I've been buying this brand and this cream for a ...

reviewText: Didn't seem to help my mild rosacea (at all) plus it caused me to break out on my nose. We are talking full on bulbous pink-white eruptions, the likes of which I haven't seen since 8th grade. For reference, I am now 42. When you have rosacea, the last thing you want to see is more pink marks on your face, no matter what their clinical description might be!  It is a decent moisturizer so I now use it as a hand cream. My hands and nails are in great condition,now, so at least this purchase wasn't a complete cash loss.
summary: Better as a hand cream than face cream; didn't help my rosacea

reviewText: great product

Best hair oil I've ever used. I use this on towel dried hair and it leaves my hair soft, shiny and nourished. I have super long hair and when I use this oil, I never have any split ends or dry ends to my hair. A little goes a long way too, so with a bottle this size, I get about 6 months use out of it.
summary: Best hair oil I've ever used.

reviewText: good product!
Love this product its really helps my hair can't go with out it. Just buy some and try it once you do you will be hooked. I have long fine naturally curly hair and I used three pumps after shower.
Love it, I used it when I finish to blow dry my hair, is the best!!!
With my hair turning white I use this oil on the ends after washing it.  No split ends and no flyaway hair.  The Best..
summary: Oil up your hair for the Winter

reviewText: the best hair treatment!

I used this treatment on damp hair after shampooing.  Just a few drops is all that's needed for my below shoulder length hair.  It defrizzes and acts as a heat protectant because it contains a lot of silicone.  I then use my regular styling products on top of it.  I didn't get any frizz, even in the Florida humidity.  It worked like a charm.  I'm impressed with this product and may decide to make it a regular part of my routine.  I definitely recommend it.
This is great stuff.  I love it in my hair and the feel is very silky a little goes a long way.
summary: This is great stuff. I love it in my hair and ...

reviewText: ok

I used this EXACTLY as directed with NO noticeable difference in my hair!  I was advised numerous times by my hair stylist how well this works to give my hair some shine as well as tame the frizzies.  Nadda!  This is a very high-price item to give no noticeable results.  Please save your hard-earned money.  There are plenty of other more reasonably priced products out there that do a good job. I do not recommend this product.
This oil is exactly what my aging hair needs. Only use a tiny amount. Worth every dime.
I like it - I  wish the others who claim to be 100% M oil were really like this $$$ one.

I've been using this product for almost one year. I discovered Moracconoil when my hairdresser used it on my hair, and I loved the way it smelled and how soft it made my hair. I bought some to use at home because I have very dry hair in the winter (static, brittle ends, everything). That was last winter. At first it worked great and I noticed a big improvement in my hair. This summer, I noticed that my hair was feeling really dry again but I kept using the Moracconoil. I recently read a review of Moracconoil on a beauty blog that explains why it has stopped working. Moracconoil is full of silicone, which coats your hair, preventing moisture from reaching your hair and making your hair drier. If you want to use this product regularly, you need to use a clarifying shampoo.
summary: Good at First, then Not so Much

reviewText: i love it . it save my dry hair . i use it everyday. but without hair conditioner and mask it makes little sense. definitely will buy it again and again.

I was searching for a product that would help control the frizz of my naturally curly hair as well as protect from blow-drying.  My hair dresser recommended Moroccan Oil and I love it!  It truly works!  The best part is that you don't have to use a lot per application, so it lasts a long time.
summary: Great for controlling the frizz and for blow-drying straight hair

reviewText: Great product for softening my hair and it smells terrific.  I even use it on my skin from time to time.

I always love buying Moroccan Oil from Amazon. I find when I don't use it my hair becomes dull and damaged. Don't know if it does wonders frizz, but I have curly hair and it's all I use to keep a natural effortless curly (messy) look. Love it! My hair smells great too!
summary: Always a good buy for me..

reviewText: This is seriously my favorite hair product. It nourishes your hair without making it greasy at all. It protects it from the heat, and makes hair soft and shiny, without weighing it down. It keeps my hair from getting dry or split ends. I recommend this for oily or dry hair! It soaks quickly into the hair without leaving residue. It is honestly the best, I'll keep buying it for years to come. I recommended this to my mom and now she loves it too. I have nothing but good things to say!! It even smells good! I'm really excited, can you tell? :) It is a little pricey, but I think it's worth every penny. I also use this as moisturizer for my skin too, and it soaks in leaving skin so soft, no residue, and supposedly fights fine lines and wrinkles. I love this!
summary: The #1 best hair product, worth every penny!

reviewText: I love the smell and I believe this product works very well, I recommend it for someone who has dry hair.

love love the smell of this, makes your hair more manageable, as well as adding shine, and protecting your hair. Used daily, this will improve the health of your hair, and look. I becomes soft, manageable and shiny. It smooths the hair strands as well.

I love this product.  I have fine hair and it does not weigh it down. It makes it soft and bouncy.  I even have added it to my dry hair with great results. What I'm going to try next is to add a little to my hair before I color it.  It's supposed to help the color absorb into the hair shaft better. I highly recommend this product!
summary: Not Greasy. Does not weigh hair down.

reviewText: This is perfect for one's hair, smells great and two or three drops is all it takes.  The sales success of this Moroccan Oil for hair (made in Israel) is well justified.  Our whole household uses it and it lasts because you don't use much per application.
summary: Everybody said this was some kind of miracle stuff.  They were right

reviewText: What great about this oil is when you apply it to your hair it will absorb fast and you see an immediate difference. I usually use this after blow drying.

i have very curly (read: frizzy) hair...it is also very dry hair...
and now that i use this product, i just get out of the shower, put a bit in my hand while my hair is damp, and my hair seems to be getting healthier...
(please don't misunderstand--i still need to use my other "control" products--this mainly feeds and moisturizes my hair)
anyway...
i also let my friend with wavy hair borrow it after she got done blow-drying her clean hair, which was way fly-away...one teeny bit got her hair picture perfect and shiny and glamorous for her date...with NO other products.
so, perhaps straight haired people get a better deal...but i still love it!
i highly recommend this product...
wish it were cheaper and easier to get, though.

I've had my eye on this product for a while now but I was trying to finish up some of my other hair products before getting yet another thing that would add to my large collection of cosmetics and potions. My mom was sweet enough to give this to me as a gift so of course I had to use is asap, there was no way I was going to wait while it sat on my shelf! This turned out to be such a great surprise, this really works wonders. Let me say right away that men and women can both use it, its not something that only half of us can enjoy, I think my friend Danny who's also a hair product fanatic will really like this!

Rich in vitamin E, carotene, phenolic acid and essential fatty acids, argan oil is one of the rarest but most valuable cosmetic ingredients. This turns hair into silk, few small drops is all I need in the morning on freshly washed hair that's still wet or damp, and it vanished instantly, never making my hair greasy or heavy. When I wash it the next day I can still feel the extra softness but it's so marvelous that I tend to use it every day. So far in my life I haven't used an oil based product that vanishes so well, this really leaves no greasy residue whatsoever and the hair feels like spun silk, even my damaged ends feel more light and wispy, sometimes I feel like I cant stop touching my hair, to someone who doesn't know how well this works I might appear to have a disorder where my arm flies up to my hair all the time....

- Kasia S.
summary: For hair as soft as a bunny's tail

reviewText:
First of all, know this is not Argan oil.  This is some kind of silicone hair product.  it is not an oil.

Morrocan oil works very well to smooth and soften my wild frizzy hair.  A little bit goes a long way.  it makes my hair straight, soft and sleek (with a little help from an iron) without heaviness and even a little resistant to humidity frizz. People think I'm a straight haired girl.  It smells nice.

FYI --You might want to read the list of ingredients -- the argan oil is listed as about the 4th ingredient in the bottle.... so I don't think it's the argan oil that is doing the trick out of this bottle.

Also, this stuff is ridiculously expensive but it is very popular because it works so well.  I have found that sellers and retailers charge all kinds of crazy prices ripping customers off and a lot of reviewers say they receive fake product.  I just bought a bottle from Ricky's and they charged me $49 before taxes-- which is 10% more than what the Moroccan oil website charges.  So Ricky's is ripping people off on an already expensive product.  (FYI Ricky's is a big beauty store in NYC)

So -- I recommend you go to the Moroccan Oil website and order from them directly.  That way you are sure you are getting the real product for the real price.
summary: read the ingredients just so you know

reviewText:
I have long hair (almost waist length)that is foil wrapped (highlighted) every 6 weeks and my hair texture is baby fine but lots of it so blow drying without frying it can be a challenge. I've used other "tamer" type products in the past but they seem geared only towards those with naturally curly, coarse type hair or something and weigh my baby locks down. This product gives me shine without weight and the very best thing, especially in winter, is that I'm not left with TONS of static cling in my hair after blow drying. It also seems to protect my hair from the heat of the blow dryer.

This has worked for me even in the most humid weather. Another good thing is this product is so light that after using, I can curl my normally straight hair and it WILL curl and the curls last just as if I didn't use the product and I cannot say that about any other "tamer" type product I've ever used.

The only downside to this product is that it is somewhat expensive but I've found that even though I do have lots of hair, a little less than a dime sized amount is plenty to get the results I want so the bottle does last a long time for me. Just pour a small amount in your hand, rub your palms together and apply to your hair. I do my ends first and work my way up to the crown, then blow dry as normal.
summary: Light and Shiny - Even for Baby Fine Hair + No STATIC

reviewText: great shampoo
Great quality good price

I've tried every Davines shampoo and conditioner and hated them all. This was the last one I had to try before writing off the whole line as worthless. First, I loved the scent - very clean and fresh. Second and more importantly, this left my hair so soft and shiny! I'm thrilled with the results!
My only beef is they don't fill the containers all the way up.

As stated in a previous review of the MoMo Conditioner ...they are both exceptional products used together. I have acute allergies to many fragrances and the MoMo has the least amount of perfume base in their Shampoo's and Conditioners. Have been using both of them together for several years and they are luxurious, non-dehyrdrating, and a fantastic line. They make all different products which I have tried at my hair salon, some where too strong, but with that being said, their entire line is 5 star. It all depends on your hair texture and what fragrance suits you. Recommend this entire line to anyone looking for a quality product. Thanks Amazon.

This is wonderful shampoo for dry hair - leaves hair feeling soft, not stripped.
Would highly recommend to others with relaxed hair.

his serum is packed with good stuff, and makes my skin smooth and clear. I don't see it as a very effective pimple fighter, more as a prevention with delicate exfoliation (salicylic and glycolic acids are in low concentrations). It tightens the skins and minimize pores. Is very light and can be used under night cream or treatment.

I just finished the whole bottle. I can't really say I hate it, but can't fall in love with it either. It is a thick, heavy serum. Once applied on the face, it takes some time for it to sink in (or dry up), and it leaves a sticky feeling on the face. I was using a face oil when started this serum, and had to give up the oil to try out the serum. However, this product is somewhat picky to use with other moisturizers because of its sticky texture (maybe because it's made with real juice as how the label claims!!)

The best thing about it was that it didn't make my face worse than how it was, but my acne problem wasn't clearly improved. So if anyone can forgo the stickiness that this serum leaves on the skin, it can be an ok choice as it doesnt dry out the skin.
summary: Thick, sticky serum, hard to pair with other moisturizer

reviewText: It works! I have older skin that still breaks out. This is part of my non toxic clear skin arsenal.

I have been in the process of switching to all natural and organic beauty products and needed something to help with occasional breakouts.  I liked what the Juice Beauty description had to say so I decided to try it out.

I like that the serum is thick and stays where you put it.  I have to say that I was surprised at how moisturizing it was when most blemish creams leave skin dry and peeling.  The description also says that you can use this kind of like a lotion, but I don't know if I would like that since it doesn't really seem to get absorbed by your skin, just kind of sits on top of it.

While I like that it has natural and organic ingredients I didn't have such good luck with it treating my blemishes (which mostly occur at that time of the month).  It didn't really seem to reduce the redness, puffiness, or the longevity like I hoped it would. After reading another review that it helped with Rosacea, I am going to pass this along to my mother to see if it will help her with that skin problem...as for me, I am going to go back to using Tea Tree oil.  It's a lot cheaper, also natural, and seems to work better for me without drying out my skin.

Also good to note:  I had my sister try this as well and she had similar results.  She ended up giving it back (for our mother to try) and went back to using Burt's Bees Herbal Blemish stick which she likes (and also contains Tea Tree oil).
summary: Doesn't dry your skin out, but didn't really heal either.

reviewText:
Skin type: sensitive with slight rosacea
age: 57

Comes in a fairly large clear bottle with a "dropper-style" application. Slight medicinal scent but not unpleasant at all. Consistency like a serum - not too thick clear product.

This clearing serum came just in time. Even at my age, I am occasionally prone to breakouts, so I wanted to try this product. But coincidentally Juice Beauty Blemish Clearing Serum arrived right at the worst break out I've had since I was a teenager (many many years ago - dang!). Stress, too much travel to too many different places, not taking my probiotic or vitamins regularly, eating poorly, not exercising as often as I usually do -- all these contributed to a bad complexion episode.

I applied the serum for several days over my entire face but concentrating on the areas that were broken out. After the first application that night, I woke the next morning to a change--I really was astonished that this serum worked that quickly to begin drying up the mess on my face! After about three to four applications (morning and night), my blemishes were almost gone.

This serum takes out the redness, yes, but also works to heal/dry up the blemishes. It really did work, yáll.

Since I have sensitive skin and a bit of rosacea, my face felt a little warm after the first few applications, and there was a slight redness, but this went away and was well worth it to have my face clear again. I would use this product maybe twice a week just to keep any blemishes away that may decide to erupt.

Usually, I applied the serum, waited about five minutes, and then applied my regular serum or moisturizer -- that helped so that my face didn't feel too dry.

A good product that's organic, as well!

I don't notice any difference after using this product. When I applied it as necessary the blemishes remained. I didn't feel or look any different.

And, I have to agree with other reviewers complaining about the text on the bottle. It's tiny, black print, against a frosted, dark orange glass.

It just felt like I was applying this serum in vain, and I love Juice Beauty products, too.
summary: Juice Beauty Blemish Clearing Serum, 2 fl. oz.

reviewText: I got this serum for my teenage daughters and they have been happy with it. It does help to prevent breakouts and clear up the ones they have. The one thing they don't like is the very strong, unpleasant smell. Also, be sure to use moisturizer after applying the serum (as directed) as it is very drying otherwise.

I liked this serum, though I think "serum" my be a misnomer.
I have sensitive, thin skin and am prone to a few of those deep pimples you can feel coming before you see them... This worked like a charm on one of those - the pimple never broke. I do not have problem skin in the sense of acne, but I'm cautious about anything I add to the mix.

Pros:
Non-drying and didn't feel heavy
No strong scents or perfumes
Worked well as a spot treatment on a developing pimple
Helped smooth larger area of skin prone to bumps but not pimples (unclogged the pores!)
A little bit was all that I needed to make a difference

Cons:
The print on the bottle is microscopic.
If I apply too much, especially over a larger area (not just a pimple spot), it feels a little like a very thin layer of white glue drying (remember grade school?) - this improved when I started massaging it in with my fingertips

Over all? Not a bad product. It worked for what I hoped it would do.

I was looking forward to trying the Juice Beauty Blemish Clearing Serum, but it isn't for me.  First of all, this is the first product that I have tried from this brand so I can't comment on how good it is in conjunction with the other products that they recommend that you use with this.  I wash my skin with Aveeno Clear Complexion foaming cleanser.  I used this afterwards.

Warning!  The instructions are printed so tiny that you will need a magnifying glass to read them!  I was extremely annoyed to have to look up the instructions online before using this.

Then I found out that there are two different versions of instructions.  The instructions on Amazon tell the user to pump the cleanser onto dry hands and massage into dry skin. Wet fingertips and massage to form an emulsion then rinse.  The instructions on the Juice Beauty website say to apply this treatment serum to entire face or just to blemished areas and then apply moisturizer.  There is no mention of forming an emulsion and rinsing it off.  Unfortunately I couldn't read the instructions on the package, so I cannot comment on what they say.  I think that this is two very different ways to use a product and one has to be wrong.

I tried the instructions from the Juice Beauty website first and I found that leaving the serum on my face made me itch.  Then I tried only applying the serum to blemishes and it had the same effect.  I then tried using the instructions from this site and rinsing it off after applying.  My skin didn't feel as itchy, but the blemishes didn't go away either.

I think that I might have a sensitivity to some ingredient in it, so my daughter is going to try it out.

The eye dropper dispenser makes you feel like your applying some kind of magical potion or industrial compound. It's a kind of imprecise application tool.

I do like that the liquid is a little viscous so it stays where you put it and you can rub it in. It's the consistency of thick syrup.

It has a nice subtly citrusy scent that is pleasant light. As for the effectiveness...it seems ok. Definitely seems to reduce redness and inflammation, but not sure that it ultimately heals blemishes in much faster time. But I will definitely keep using it as it lasts and I approve of the effort to make it organic.

I like to look my best and use facial moisturizers and creams. I get the occasional breakout so I wanted to try this product. Its organic and includes CoQ10 and Vitamin C, both of which are great vitamins for the face. It is supposed to not only reduce blemishes but hydrate the skin. This is all really positive.

Its definitely on the thick side, but it is a serum. I applied it to my entire face and it seemed like it took awhile to truly absorb. My face certainly felt fresher in the applied areas. Since I haven't had a blemish since Ive owned it and used it, I can only say it does moisturize well and I haven't had a breakout in any way.

However, it is rather expensive given what it does and the small amount. But, on the plus side it doesnt have any noticeable smell.

Overall, if you have blemishes youll need to try it yourself. It seems to do a good job of keeping my face clean and unclogged, but its a little expensive as a breakout preventative.

I was skeptical.  I am 64 years old and still have adolescent skin.  The only product that has ever helped is Glycolic Acid MD Skin Peel 70% (which I highly recommend and which you can buy on Amazon, but not in any stores I have ever identified).  Much to my amazement, this Juice Beauty Blemish Clearing Serum actually works!  I have been using it for several weeks now and have seen pretty astonishing results.  So, two thumbs up + a blemish free smile for this product.  Give it a try.  If you have seemingly intractable skin issues, this may be the solution you have been looking for.

I have never used any kind of blemish clearing serum before. I never needed one before either. When I saw this offered in my Vine que, I thought I'd try it especially since I have been dealing with some blemishes due to the weather changing, age and stress. I didn't have a lot of blemishes, but the few that I did have cleared up right away and my face actually felt better than it has in weeks.

I have sensitive skin, with the occasional reddening and this works like a charm. It didn't leave my skin dried out. It cleared up the blemishes and tightened my pores even. I really enjoyed it and am willing to pay the price for it too.

I am not much for facial cleanser since I feel that they promise results that are not usually backed up by facts. This one though has changed my mind and will definitely check out the rest of this collection. I do like how it feels on my face and it also leaves my face feeling clean. I don't get that feeling with a lot of products.
summary: Effective For A First Time Buyer

reviewText:
This serum promises to clear blemishes, hydrate, and reduce redness/inflammation.

According to the directions, you apply it to your whole face or just the blemishes after cleanser but before moisturizer.  I wasn't sure how to apply it with a dropper, so I just applied a few drops to a cotton ball and wiped it on.  While the bottle is tiny, you don't need much serum for each application (at least if you restrict yourself to the actual blemishes).

I've been applying this product for a week and it has made no change.  The few blemishes I have were as red as always and seem to be going away at the same rate they would without acne medication.

I have, at least, seen no negative results.  This works for other people, but I have seen no results.

Salicylic Acid has always been an effective treatment for my adult acne and I was pleased to find a product that not only has .75% SA, but also has some natural ingredients that help control acne, like white tea  leaf extract and lemon juice. It also contains aloe juice which is good for calming skin.  This serum won't make existing blemishes disappear overnight, but does aid in preventing blemishes and keeping current ones under control.  It has been fairly gentle on my skin and doesn't over-dry with normal use.  I'm only using it on current blemishes and blemish-prone areas and am happy with the results so far.

This bottle contains 2 fl. oz and a dropper which lets you dispense a small amount.  If you're going to use it all over your skin, the bottle won't last long (and you may risk over-drying).  If you're just using it as a spot treatment, 2 oz will go a long way.

This serum comes in a glass bottle, and has an 'eyedropper' dispenser, the design is very nice, and works well for getting small amounts of the product without waste.

BUT...something seriously needs to be done with the labeling.  For the life of me I could not read the tiny print on the back of the bottle.  I looked on the box, but no instructions were written on the box, got out my reading glasses and nothing seemed to work...I went with 'instinct' when using for the first time because I was tired and didn't want to dig out my computer to figure out directions.

The serum does not have any noticeable scent, which is very nice, it is a bit sticky, but leaves my skin feeling very soft and smooth.  I have a bit of adult acne from time to time, sores that stay under the skin and the serum tends to make them not look so harsh.  I have yet to see if they clear up more quickly with the serum, but in the mean-time my skin feels and looks much nicer.

A part from the labeling I like this product, a bit spendy, but you really do not need to use a whole lot of the product.

This serum worked out better than I expected. To be honest, I was terrified of putting fruit on my face. Fruit, organic or not, is high in sugar and that's the last thing you want on your face. Ingredients literally include "sugar cane juice" and "apple juice". Eeek!  As it turns out, though, I believe the 'Juice Beauty' concept is just marketing hoopla aimed to tap into our craving for all things organic. The real blemish-fighting ingredients is the same old stand-by that is in every regimen: Salicylic Acid. There's also a good mix of vitamins that do contribute to skin health, such as C, B5, and E. Willow Bark and Algae Extract is also in there, for fun.

I used the treatment every night for about a week and a half and was glad to see that I didn't experience any mass breakouts. I did not use it during the day because it makes my skin red for about an hour and feels sticky. I did not get the sense that my pores were any less clogged and did not notice a reduction in minor skin blemishes. I would say it works about as good as any other Salicylic Acid moisturizer, except that it doesn't really moisturize, feels stickier than most products, and makes my skin temporarily red.

OVERALL: Every dermatologist will tell you that it's a BAD idea to be putting apple juice and sugar cane juice on your face. While it would be wonderful to pluck skin care treatment from the bosom of Mother Nature, the only reason this serum doesn't make your face break out is because it has salicylic acid in it. Some of the vitamins might help as well. While I can't COMPLAIN about it, I definitely can't rave about it either. I'm more enthusiastic about the face wash, notably because the sugar fruit juice is washed off and will not linger on your face. The fruit juice in the leave-on serum makes me nervous. It's also an overpriced bottle of salicylic acid.

This product is promoted for either whole face or localized application on blemishes. My wife found this particular product was not strong enough for correcting blemishes or occasional breakouts that she experiences on her chin. The active ingredient in this product is Salicylic acid, which cleanses pores without excessive skin drying. It stops bacteria from reproducing (bacteriostatic), and doesn't clog pores (comodogenic)  but doesn't kill existing bacteria. So it works well for her as a preventative, but did not show any visible improvement for the chin breakouts/blemishes. Products with benzoyl peroxide work better and faster for her, for occasional breakouts.

She also found this didn't absorb well in her skin, but stayed in a gel-like layer after application--then after allowing some time for absorption, she rubbed it in further before it fully absorbed. Most serums absorb much more quickly and easily. On the plus side, its a very natural product without harsh chemicals, and did a good job of hydrating the skin. While this particular product didn't work for her needs, she is a fan of Juice Beauty products and has liked their other products, and would try them again.
summary: Better as preventative than emergency blemish treatment

reviewText: I never thought of using juice as a blemish treatment but Juice Beauty Blemish Clearing Serum changed my mind.  I had planned to use this strictly on my face when I got blemishes.  That plan changed when I had breakout blemishes on my upper chest area that showed when wearing a dress or shirt that was open at the neck revealing 'break out'!  I then used Juice Beauty for about ten days and this blemish breakout was gone.  I very much like the dropper that allows dispensing of the product without mess. On the one hand, it sounds like it's for acne (which I'm too old to have) but on the other it claims to also unclog pores, even skin tone and hydrate and have "age defy results" - which are issues I do face. So I've tried it a few nights and if I'm going to be honest my face feels too dry, not hydrated and itchy. I've tried to compensate by applying a rich face cream over it but the itch doesn't go away. The bottom line for me is that I believe this may be good for younger people with acne as it has a list of ingredients suited for acne and it's balanced with some ingredients so as to not over dry, but I just don't like it for my mature skin for the reasons stated and it just doesn't provide adequate hydration for me. This is better for my teen with acne. We applied it to his skin which does have acne and it tingles but feels ok to him.
