I like Shea Butter products and even some cheap ones work fairly well. This hand cream is the bomb of them all. With very little effort I massaged this into my hands and they felt better almost immediately. Followed this practice 3 times per day and by Day 3 my hands looked great and the general texture was much improved.
I'm not suggesting that this cream needs to be used 3 times per day, but once my hands got manageable using this product once before bedtime with white cotton gloves was alI I needed to reap the obvious benefits of Shea Butter.
Great product for dry, itchy hands.

This is the best hand cream in the world. As a nurse I was always washing my hands, or using sanitizer, and my hands hurt. This product soothed my skin like no other cream. The scent is lovely, and it makes your skin feel great.

I like shea butter for times when skin really needs extra protection & moisturizing.  This shea butter hand cream is really good and not terribly greasy.  A little goes a long way.  Even my husband who hates greasy lotions, likes this one.  It has a light unisex fragrance - almond & slight coconut.

I like the packaging in a tube because it makes it easy to travel/carry in your purse or briefcase.  And you can squish it down as you use it up.
summary: Super Moisturizing Hand Cream For Women & Men

reviewText: Excellent product worth the experience

This is a review of the 5.2oz L'Occitane Shea Butter Hand Cream. Shea Butter is one ingredient I always look for when buying hand creams. My wife swears by it and so do I. But you need more than just a small smidgen of shea butter in the ingredients list to be effective. This L'Occitane hand cream contains 20% Shea Butter plus Almond and Honey extracts in addition to Coconut Oil. What a great combination. Enough Shea Butter to provide superior performance but not so much to leave your hands feeling like you just slathered them in Crisco. Together these ingredients provide a long lasting, mostly non-greasy protection and moisturization for dry, chapped hands. It has a pleasant fragrance. A little bit goes a long way unlike the cheap thin and runny hand lotions that you can buy. With those you seem to need to squirt it on your hands much more frequently. It's no wonder because many of them have water as a primary ingredient. This is an excellent hand cream that although is more expensive than many other hand creams has far superior qualities than most. Highly recommended.
summary: Rich hand cream that does not leave your hands overly greasy

reviewText: Used before and liked it but found I could get the same results purchasing a much less expensive product.

I always have a big tube of the Shea Butter hand cream on my bedside table.  I've experimented with the other scents, but I always come back to this one.  It has a nice clean scent that is noticeable without being over powering.  And the consistency is nice and thick and creamy, not at all greasy.  It absorbs well and leaves my hands and cuticles nice and baby soft, even living in a high desert.

Based on a friend's recommendation, I tried this hand cream and I'm delighted with it.  The price is a real "bummer" as is the fact that it doesn't come in a smaller tube so that I could put it in my purse.  It does make my hands smooth and soft and the scent is quite pleasant so I'll no doubt buy it again.
good
Love this stuff. Premium hand cream, lovely scent.

I have dry hands throughout the year, and they are really bad in the winter. I've tried various creams from Aveeno, Kiss My Face, Burts Bees, Kiehls, and now LOccitane.

I'd say this is the best balance of moisturizing qualities with fast absorption. I've never used a cream that absorbs instantly, but some leave your hands feeling like they are drenched in cooking oil (the Burts Bees products tend to be greasy).

I purchased 2 of the large sizes: 1 for office, 1 for at home. I plan on purchasing again once I run out.
summary: Best hand moisturizer I've tried so far

reviewText: excellent moisturizing hand cream.

I love L'Occitane Shea Butter hand cream! What a great product! Very rich but absorbs well into my skin! Works wonders for my hands, elbows, or anywhere the skin is super dry!  I will be buying it again along with other products from their company!

This is the best hand cream I've ever used, and I'm in my late sixties so I've used a lot of hand cream.  It's thick and soaks right in, not leaving your hands greasy, but soft and supple.  When I give it as a gift, my friends are always delighted because it's a bit pricey and they'd think twice before buying it for themselves.  But every time I give it to someone who's never used it before, I get rave reviews.  All of us old ladies love this stuff!

The Shea Butter L'Occitane hand cream is the best hands down, or hands up. It Is enriched with 20% Shea Butter, and the creamy balm penetrates quickly to protect, nourish and moisturize the skin. Honey, almond and coconut oil are blended with Shea Butter to create this effective moisturizer.

I found this hand cream via a friend a few years ago, and I have not been without it since that time. I wash my hands frequently and need to moisturize my hands often. This small tube lasts a long time because you need very little amount each time. That little amount you use will moisturize your hands so well that you can go through few hand washings and the cream stays on. I cannot say enough about the quality of this hand cream. This stays in my purse at all times. This is the best hand cream I have ever tried and I have tried multiple kind from 99 cents to expensive kinds.

Recommended. prisrob 12-31-13

This is one of the most effective hand creams I have found. I'm a professional landscaper, and my hands get thrashed. But nobody knows that, because each night I exfoliate and moisturize heavily so that I can still have nice hands.

This is a wonderful cream because it sinks in, doesn't sting cracked skin, and really provides long-lasting protection and healing. One tube lasts forever, in fact I usually get the gift set of small tubes of L'Occitane hand creams just for some variety, and I find that the three small tubes easily last me the year.

The two things I dislike are the scent, which smells a bit like old-lady cold cream - not unpleasant, but a bit more perfumey than I like, and the cap, which is fiddly and hard to get back on once you've moisturized your hands.

Other than that, this is a highly effective cream that works great for healing hands that have been in the dirt.
summary: Cream works great on gardener's hands, but smell is a bit commercial for me

reviewText: Thank goodness for "Nia 24 Skin Strengthening Complex"!  It replenished the moisture in my facial skin after I used Nia 24's facial cleanser.  The "Nia 24 Skin Strengthening Complex" was light, did not leave a greasy or oily sheen on my skin and made it feel soft and supple.  I used the complex at night and my face was as soft in the morning as it was after I applied "Nia 24 Skin Strengthening Complex"  Regardless of your skin type or your age, this is a fine product.
summary: An Excellent Moisturizing Complex That Will Make Your Skin Feel Soft and Supple ...

reviewText:
It  is a great moisturizer for the face. I just received this cream this morning. It goes on easy and spreads a lot. My face feel well moisturized after about a half hour. I looked up niacin cream and found that there are studies by dermatologists that show that cream with niacin or Vitamin B3 in it is great for moisturizing, that is better than Vaseline. Also that after eight weeks use, it does reduce wrinkles. I am 71 years old and have good genes so I do not have many wrinkles, but I will use if for 8 weeks and see if there is an improvement. In the studies, they found that it  may be a good product to use to help prevent skin cancer but more studies are needed to verify this. I do have a lot of precancer spots that I have had frozen off so I am hoping that this can be proven.

The only thing that i don't like is the price, so I am hoping that my tube lasts a very long time.
summary: Great Facial Moisturizer, Hoping For The Other Benefits

reviewText: As a Vine reviewer I've had the opportunity of using a lot of skin creams, many of them exquisite including one outrageous one with caviar.  The NIA24 is one of the best I've tested over the years. Although my primary use of skin creams is after shaving I still appreciate the texture, smoothness, moisturizing quality and other aspects of what I fine cream is supposed to do.  This has it all.  My wife, who is a skin cream afficionado agrees with me that this cream, though a little pricey, is worth it.  If you've got the bucks give it a shot.

I like everything but the price.

I am 53 and have light Caucasian skin.  I don't know about strengthening the skin barrier, so you can read the rest on the box that Amazon has featured in the pictures.

I used this after my shower for a week.  It is more of a night cream because, I feel, that it is a little heavy for under make-up.  I also has not SPF that a day cream should have.  When I washed my face in the morning, I did not feel like I was washing off a mask like most creams do.  My neck does feel tighter and doesn't have that roughness I get.  The price needs to be more reasonable at $52 bucks for 1.7 fluid ounces.
summary: I like everything but the price.

reviewText: Kudos to  "Nia 24 Skin Strengthening Complex"! It  really does replenish skin moisture in my face and hands.  I like the way it felt when I applied it.  Fortunately it has no strong odor and it leaves no sticky residue.  Putting it on at night gives it a chance to be absorbed into the skin and leaves the skin feeling fresh and refreshed and baby soft upon awakening.

I've had some skin surgeries for cancer cells around my face and this helped with some of the areas that were cut and the skin stretched over.  It also seems to have improved the wrinkles on the back of my hands.  It's funny how you first notice getting old, I was only in my late teens or maybe it was early 20's when I noticed the tips of my fingers started to have some lines in them.  It really disturbed me at the time seeing even moderate aging.  I can relate to how some women and men take drastic steps to retain their youth.  As a man, I'm not to vain about most things, graying hair, glasses, not able to do the physical things I could 30 years ago.  Having something that helps your skin and save it from premature aging is a good thing.  I've seen pictures of and in person those sun worshiper types, that look haggard and saggy from sun damage and dry skin.  Some even in their 30's look downright awful.

This works with a combination of nutrition, vitamins, oils and other things to strengthen the skin and keep it moist.  I can't complain about any of the contents and they appear to have done a good job blending them together in one effective compound.  It is expensive, a small tube costs a lot of money, but many of the things that work are.  I decided to let my sister have some of this stuff, and she posted a picture on FB, which I've attached here.  FYI, my sister turns 61 in June, so she was quite pleased with the result, I think she's going to save up for more, for her this is probably a five star product!
summary: Expensive, but it seems to work well doing what it's designed for, helping the skin and smoothing out wrinkles.

reviewText:
This skin cream has light texture and is non-greasy and noncomedogenic (doesn't block the pores). It has a pleasant scent, though burns lightly when I apply it to my face.

I found that it absorbs well, and leaves the skin feeling softer and nicer. The tube is very small though (only 1.76 ounces), so you have to stay thrifty with it. Overall, if you can tolerate the hefty price tag and the small tube, this is a high-quality skin cream.

My wife has been using NIA 24 for a few weeks now and she is very satisfied with the results.  She has oily skin, large pores and has issues with skin firmness.  This product leaves her skin looking less oily and firmer.  It seems to be fading a few of her dark spots and has improved the texture of her skin. She is hoping that results will be even more pronounced as she uses the product longer.  It has also improved the tautness of her neck and reduced fine lines on her face and neck.  She has used many products in diverse price ranges and this product is excellent even at this price point.

I have only been using this a week but have noticed how soft my skin feels. It feels so hydrated throughout the day. My make up goes on smoother too.

I have very sensitive skin and Nia 24 did not break me out into a rash or cause my face to become red or to burn. You don't need a whole lot to cover your face. This has never felt greasy but absorbs quickly into the skin.
summary: Great for those with sensitive skin

reviewText:
Two years or so ago, NIA24 was a dermatologists boutique office product. The docs were recommending it. The botox masters were talking about it for outbreaking pigment spots. It wasn't an Rx but it was too expensive then to try it.

This seems like half the price for like twice the amount. Ive been thinking about this product since I ran across it. Its a premium product that Ive been applying every day. The noticeable effect so far is improved skin quality. My face is noticeably softer. I have high expectations for dark spot pigment. It's likely the very best moisturizer I've ever used.

This smells so fresh. Much better than the other Burberry women's perfumes.

This smells light with a hint of floral, and lasts a long time.

I LOVE this beautiful scent! It's very light, great for every day wear.  I was a little hesitant to try this since I'd tried Marc Jacobs' Daisy and it really did not blend well with my chemistry and a different reviewer had mentioned that Brit is similar to Daisy. For some reason, Brit really works for me.  I don't wear perfume often and when I do, it varies from Elizabeth and James Nirvana Black to Philosphy's Amazing Grace.  The latter was my go-to ordinary occasion perfume.  However, I will now incorporate Brit into my rotation as it's truly delightful and not remotely overpowering. It also seems to last for at least half a day without a touch up, which I consider a bonus as well.

My girlfriend has been a fan of Burberry's Brit for many years now.  She's pretty loyal to the scent, but was curious to try out Burberry Brit Sheer.  We both first thought the scent too sweet, but the sweetness wears off during the day and leaves a refreshing floral scent. It's not overpowering, which is a plus for both of us.  The scent reminds her a little bit of Estee Lauder's Pleasures, with an additional warm woodsy scent.  She still finds Burberry Brit more unique and refreshing, but if you're looking for a more feminine alternative, Burberry Brit Sheer is your answer.
summary: A feminine version of Burberry's Brit

reviewText: I love this Burberry scent. It's very light with a little twinge of citrus and floral (in my opinion).  It's a huge bottle and one spray is quite strong, so it will last a long time. The bottle is so pretty and feminine. Love it!

I've been around perfumes, etc. a lot in my life, but this has a truly expensive essence.  It is powerful enough so that you can apply it very sparingly and it lasts a long time.  I can imagine it could be over-applied, but that would be sad.  Just a tiny dab here and there and you're going to be noticed close up, but not from a distance.  My nose is not refined enough to describe the scent but I will always recognize it from here on.

A lavish gift for a verrrry special person.

This Burberry Brit Sheer is simply amazing.  It is light but has a woody undertone.  Not too floral but not heavy either.  It has a very "expensive" aroma that works well for party wear a s well as business. The perfume itself is clear so it will not likely stain white clothes. The only downside is that this wonderful scent is rather expensive and the bottle is somewhat plain looking compared to many of the other fragrances on the market.  Other than that this is a great scent.
summary: Excellent Scent In A Somewhat Plain Bottle

reviewText:
I'm not a huge wearer of fragrance. The last time I bought perfume was way back when Cherry Vanilla was popular about 15 years ago and I still have some left. And it smells just as good today as it did the day I bought it. I am very sensitive to fragrances. Especially cloyingly sweet or musky fragrances. If I am near someone wearing a strong musky fragrance, I have to move away or I will get nausea and a headache. I really hate when you can smell someone whi is a good 10 feet away from you and they smell like they have not showered byt instead layered perfume on them layer over layer over layer. Yuck. Not all fragrances bother me, though. I like light citrusy scents. And a light floral scent as long as it isn't too heavy.

I decided to try this because it is Eau de Toilette, which is usually lighter than Eau de Parfum, so I thought I'd give it a shot. I'm glad I did.

This Burberry Brit Sheer has a light floral fragrance that isn't at all overpowering and I find that I can wear it without any ill effects. The scent is floral, yet fruity, but not cloyingly sweet or musky. I very much enjoy the fragrance and wore it to my allergy doctor appointment today and was complimented on it.

As I said, I rarely have occasion to wear fragrance, so this bottle should last me another 15 years or so. It's a very nice fragrance and I'm glad I decided to try it.
summary: Lovely light fragrance that isn't overpowering.

reviewText: This is a beautiful citrus-y, summery scent; very light and youthful. I really love this. It goes on light and bright, and has good staying power. I think as the afternoon wore on it mellowed into a slightly more mature scent, but nothing heavy or overly sexy. It reminds me of the Colors by Benneton scent, but a little brighter.  The bottle is classy and stable, and my one caveat was that it arrived to me from Amazon with a dented box. It was obviously just tossed in a cardboard box where it had room to slide around and get dented. Since perfume is often given as a gift, I thought I would bring that up, since it doesn't look as great for gift-giving as it would if you bought it from a brick-and-mortar store where it would presumably be more carefully handled. Still, a lovely scent and great product. I would wear this and give it as a gift.

Very light and crisp fragrance that lasts a long time. My only complaint is about the bottle itself. It's a thick, angular, glass bottle that awkward to hold with one hand while pressing the atomizer. I almost dropped it twice trying to apply the cologne. Maybe in making the women's fragrance bottle mimic the man's they didn't take into account that ladies have smaller hands? I'm not petite by any means, but I find the bottle hard to handle. I end up using two hands to apply it. Awkward, but it works. The bottom line is it smells great and unlike many cheaper fragrances that seem to shift smell over the course of a day, this one remains true to it's original scent.
summary: bottle is hard to handle; scent is great

reviewText:
I am not a big fan of perfumes or body sprays as sometimes, they can be overpowering and I can get nasty headaches from smelling it. My husband is not a fan of fragrances at all, especially anything that has a cinnamon scent to it. This Burberry, which I have never smelled before, is really nice. I like the pleasant scent. It lingers but not too strongly. It definitely has a feminine smell to it ... light, pleasant and floral. (Even better, my husband did not sneeze when I sprayed it on and neither of us got a headache from it.)

I don't normally buy perfume this expensive, but the 3.3 fl oz bottle is a lot bigger than I expected, so for this price, it will last a really long time. It is perfect for the every day usage as well. It will make a wonderful gift for the special lady in your life. It's not "too old" like a lot of perfumes are and yet, it's not too young either. It's a right scent for women of all ages.

It is packaged very well too. The box that it came in is very nice. The bottle is a lovely shade of pink. It definitely looks like it's a "sheer" perfume and honestly, I cannot find anything wrong with this perfume. It is now my favorite in my small collection of fine fragrances.

I have never been a big fan of my wife or others wearing perfume because it was usually too strong. I also was not that fond of the scents that were too sweet and floral. I remember that while I was teaching, a certain perfume was being used by quite a few high school girls as well as my wife for a time. After a short time the scent would change. It took on the scent of stale beer. Needless to say I mentioned to my wife who then threw it out. I always got a chuckle when I smelled stale beer in my classroom as a student walked by.
I decided to order the Burberry Brit Sheer since my wife likes to wear perfume and I figured she could try it. I have found that it is a scent that I actually like. It is not just an overpowering floral scent, but has the fragrance of citrus as well as floral. This was an interesting scent for a wearable fragrance. No scent of stale beer.

This is a lovely, delicate fragrance.  Many floral perfumes I find to be a bit sweet, but this has a nice soft balance.  It is called "sheer" and it really is.  If you like a bold fragrance or want a sexy nightime fragrance, this is not it.  This is a very soft sort of clean smell when you just want the slightest hint of fragrance.  I even like to wear it to bed for something not overpowering but just a nice smell to sleep with
summary: Many floral perfumes I find to be a bit sweet, but this has a nice soft balance

reviewText: I was excited to try this "fresh and youthful scent." I like light fragrances, not anything heavy and overpowering.  This was... awful. Like a big jar of cheap, old lady perfume. Very sweet, but not young at all. The bottle is pretty, though!
Light, refreshing, slightly tart.  I think of it as a spring and summer scent.
I really like this product. It makes your face feel very soft.
Makes a difference!
Always love this product. very nice Have been using this products for over 12 years!!!
I love this product.  It really helps hold moisture in your skin

I have this product in my purse at all times just when you think your skin is drying I put a small drop in hand and put on my face and is safe for around eyes as well.  I have been using this product for well over 10 years and would recommend for normal to dry skin and great for sensitive skin.
I've used Bioelements for years and highly recommend it for dry skin. Everybody thinks I'm 20 years younger than I am!

I have used the probiotic product before and will continue to .it makes my skin sift and helps to soften fine lines .i am 48 with dry skin and spend a lot of time outdoors so this product is a keeper for me . I use it morning and night it dries fast and has a pleasant smell.
Love it !!!!
CAN'T BE WITHOUT THIS PRODUCT GREAT FOR AGING SKIN.
Anything by BioElements is a great product.  I just don't use it all that much lately.  I switch to different products frequently.  This smells lovely.  Nice and clean.
This is a really nice hair and body wash that is a great consistency and smells GREAT!  My son wanted this but my husband won out. He is happy with it and so am I!
Nice scent. Loads of lather. Clean feeling when rinsed.

This has a wonderful masculine fragrance. It lathers well and rinses easily. Great for the body from head to toe. My husband loves products that are good for more than just one thing and the fact that this is for hair and body makes him very happy. The fact that he smells great after using it makes me very happy.
summary: Vichy Homme Body and Hair Shower Gel

reviewText:
Smells good. I like the masculine fragrance.
Cleans squeaky clean.
Flip top caps are my favorite. Easy to open and close. Keeps the gel at the bottom and tea to dispense.
Leaves my skin feeling clean.
Lathers bubbles and suds. Plentiful and rich.
I like the multi use all in one ability.

Vichy Homme Body and Hair Shower Gel, 6.76 Fl.

This is marketed to men but I like the male scented products, too. It is a fine body gel for showering and a little goes a long way. I wouldn't use it on my hair--but I am a woman. I know men who use an all-in-one product and their hair being short--or not there any longer--doesn't mind a non-specialized product.
It's convenient in the shower...being a tube. Takes up less room because it fits behind the shower/hand bar.
I plan to buy for my nephew for Christmas--I like to stick some useful stuff in with fun stuff.

Although far from using organic ingredients, Vichy makes up for it in nice quality, awesome fragrance and very good value since a little goes a long way. This nice sized body and hair shower gel is rich but doesn't leave skin sticky or feeling like a film. Just clean with a nice fragrance. The smell is clean and refreshing - not heavy or floral. Very nice product.

This moisturizer is a deliciously rich cream for your face.  It sinks in quickly though, so it doesn't feel like you're wearing a mask.  I have to have this in the winter...I have dry skin and most moisturizers don't quite do the trick!
summary: It's like giving your face a hug.

reviewText: I love the way this feels on my skin - moisturizing, but not oily at all. Absorbs really quickly. Makes your skin look radiant afterwards. I haven't gotten any acne using it.

I applied this as a night cream.  It is thick and at first feels heavy but through the night it sinks in and makes my skin soft.  When I shower in the morning my skin is super smooth.  This is a really good dry skin moisturizer.  I would not wear this during the day.  The smell isn't bad but it's not great.  It seems to have a hint of a depilatory cream smell.

This has been quite a wicked start to the fall/winter season, and I've been very impressed with this Juice Beauty Nutrient Moisturizer. Throughout the year, moisturizing is a twice a day standard in my routine. I always put on Bobbi Brown's eye moisturizer, and Aveeno's Daily Moisturizer with SPF under my foundation. However, I also now find that I've needed to up my moisturizer for the brutally drying winter months, and this organic moisturizer has already done several things very well.

It's has soothed, plumped, and softened my skin, it's worked well as a base for my liquid foundation, and it has evened-out my skin tone. My face is noticeably more radiant and healthy looking, and feels wonderfully soft, and smooth. In addition, this bright white creamy moisturizer goes on easily with great coverage using a small amount, and it isn't greasy (no breakouts). It sinks in very well on my face, and doesn't creep down into my eyes. It works well on my neck as well (very soothing).  The light citrus-woodsy scent is very nice.

I've also used Juice Beauty's Green Apple Age Defy Moisturizer, and it had the added benefit of minimizing the pores around my nose; however I feel this Nutrient Moisturizer formula works best, with wonderful radiant results.
summary: Added to My Daily Moisturizing Routine

reviewText:
I'm always hesitant about trying new facial moisturizers because I break out very easily.  The good news is that this moisturizer did not make me break out any more than what I normally do.  This is an overall good moisturizer and I've only been using it at night.  My only qualms with the moisturizer:

1) the directions tell you to warm the moisturizer in your palms before applying. I feel this wastes a lot of the moisturizer as your palms absorb some of the cream. I ignored this step and applied directly to my face

2) the cream feels a little tacky/sticky on your face initially.  Fortunately it doesn't last long.

My face feels really smooth in the morning, but I don't see myself liking this product enough to buy it again in the future.

This Juice Beauty moisturizer is light, has a delicate scent, and is keeping my skin well hydrated with the cold weather. I like that the ingredients are plant-based as well as organic. This cream applies to the skin easily but does take a few minutes to be adequately absorbed; until then, it will be slightly tacky to the touch. I had no trouble with skin irritation or redness but do keep it away from your eyes. I rubbed too closely to my eye causing it to water.

The only drawback concerning this product, a personal budgetary problem only, is the price. At $36 for 2 ounces I am having difficulty deciding whether or not to buy more--2 ounces doesn't last long. If this fits your budget, it is a good product that I recommend.

I have to say that so far, Juice Beauty Nutrient Moisturizer has proven to be quite excellent. Firstly, there is no irritation -- as a matter of fact, it seemed quite soothing to my skin. I use it right after a shower and exfoliating, with nice results. The product seems to sink right into my skin. I use it in moderation, as I am not looking for a build-up of moisturizer on my skin, I just want enough to keep it feeling soft. This eliminated the patches of winter dryness. Under cosmetics, I rarely use moisturizer. However, I did try using the slightest bit, and my foundation went on very nicely without getting an oily look as the day went on.

I'm glad that I gave Juice Beauty Nutrient Moisturizer a try because it offers excellent results. I'd happily recommend it to friends.

When I first tried this Moisturizer it felt thick and heavy.  I thought I was going to have a greasy feeling face for a long time.  However, I was pleasantly surprised that my skin quickly absorbed it, leaving a soft clean feeling behind.  It says it is "odor free" but to me, it had a nice, light citrusy scent.  It was very nice and not at all overwhelming.
summary: Quickly absorbed with a fresh citrus scent.

reviewText: Im turning 40, but I don't have the time or the inclination to spend hours on my face. I only wear makeup for special occasions. The extent of my facial routine is moisturizer. I am currently using Olay Regenerist. The Juice is made with certified organic ingredients. Now, this means that a portion of the ingredients are certified organic. Not all of the ingredients are certified organic, which to me makes the organic claim a little questionable. The cream itself is thicker than Im used to in a moisturizer, but it goes on smoothly and evenly. It can feel a bit greasy if you apply too much, so use sparingly until you find the amount that is right for you. If you are used to using products with shea butter, you will immediately recognize the feel of this moisturizer. As for the scent, I have trouble placing it. Sometimes Im sure it smells like a musty chamomile, other times I find it smells like black licorice, which I assume is the sodium anisate (I guess this is a form an anise?). I find it moisturizes well; my skin definitely doesnt feel dry but it does feel coated. It doesnt leave behind an oily or greasy feel, but you can tell that something has been applied.

Initially hesitant of the rich texture, this product has won me over by completely delivering on the promise to hydrate and soothe my skin.  I just got over a terrible cold and instead of having a red, flaky nose as a souvenir, my face looks great with no redness or flakiness.  That's because this moisturizer truly works!  Excited to have found this product before the winter months that typically dry out my sensitive, combination skin.

Application tips:  The "suggested use" is to warm up the product in your palms before applying, but I found that technique wasted too much product.  Instead try putting small dots of the cream on your face and rubbing in gently using your fingertips in a circular motion.  It is also "suggested" to use morning and evening, but for me this is strictly an evening cream.  The rich formula takes a while to absorb and leaves your face with a matte finish that didn't play well with my make-up.  Plus there isn't any SPF.
summary: Nighttime moisturizer that soothes and hydrates

reviewText: I absolutely love when my wife's skin is soft and silky.  Lately though, she has been using products that don't last long and with the dry air, her skin gets rough and flaky.  When given the opportunity to try the Juice Beauty Nutrient Moisturizer, I thought, what the hay, it cant make things much worse.  So, the day we received the product, she tried it and what a difference.  Her skin radiated with softness for a real long time.  She said that with as dry as her skin was, it sucked right in but the next application stayed for a while.  She also said that a little of this product can go a long way which is good because it isn't cheap.  Anyway, I know that some of the reviews said that it made a heavy feel but my wife hasn't complained of that yet and I'm okay with it.  I will be getting this product again as long as she is willing to use it.

First, I love the fact that this moisturizer is made with certified organic ingredients. Considering the fact that so many cosmetics are made with harmful chemicals, it's good to know that Juice Beauty provides a viable alternative. While their products may not fit my skin type completely, I'm glad that their high quality ingredients ensures that they won't do too much harm, either.

I really wanted to like this moisturizer, but unfortunately it feels just too thick and pasty for my taste. It comes in a nice frosted glass jar and has a consistency not unlike sour cream. Because it feels so thick, I used it sparingly on my face and neck. Fortunately, my skin absorbed it quickly and it doesn't leave too much of a residue. The fragrance is so mild as to be almost not there, which I don't mind (I shy away from anything too strong-smelling).

It's OK but I have many different types of moisturizer and nothing about this one stood out. Yes, my skin was a little softer, but no better or worse than other products I've used, like Neutrogena, Aveda, Burt's Bees and L'Occitane.  I think this product would be best for those who are have highly sensitive skin and break out often to the use of artificial ingredients.

The price is a little high, and given its OK but not outstanding performance, I'll stick to my current AHAVA Dead Sea moisturizer. It would also help if it had some SPF built-in - that would influence me to use it more. As it is, I will use it mainly at night and on rainy days when a high SPF isn't necessary.
summary: Thick, Creamy Moisturizer - A Little Goes a Long Way But Wish It Had SPF

reviewText:
This moisturizer reminds me a lot of Philosophy's Hope in a Jar, which used to me my holy grail moisturizer.  It has a sweet but subtle lemon scent that I loved, and even though it is thicker than most moisturizers, it blended into my skin easily .  It did leave my skin feeling slightly tacky to the touch for about an hour after applying it. That wasn't a problem under my liquid foundation (L'Oreal True Match LUMI), but I wasn't willing to try it with my Bare Minerals loose foundation since I could tell it would 'stick' in patches, so I'll be sticking with my Bare Minerals Purely Nourishing Moisturizer when I wear mineral foundation.

As a nighttime moisturizer, it didn't leave my oily/combination skin as hydrated as I'm used to with my Josie Maran's 100% Pure Argan Oil (which is magic--I'm in my thirties and I have zero wrinkles or crows feet). I did try the Juice Beauty Green Apple Age Defy Moisturizer overnight and found that it left my skin feeling almost as soft and hydrated as the argan oil, and since it's less expensive than the argan oil--depending on usage--I might try it again when I run out.

Final verdict: Great daytime moisturizer unless you wear powder foundation. Maybe not the most hydrating nighttime moisturizer unless you have very oily skin. But give the Juice Beauty Green Apple Age Defy Moisturizer a try if you have drier skin
summary: Great daytime moisturizer; not as hydrating for nighttime

reviewText:
First off, when you open the jar, the smell of this moisturizer is succulent - it's lemony and dewy, very appealing to the senses.

I love the organic ingredient list.  You have your nutrient-rich organic shea and jojoba - both very smooth and rich on my skin [with proper care before you apply].  Also aloe and algae - those may not sound so appealing, but I'm sure great on skin.

Juice asks to take a small amount and warm in your fingers before smoothing over your cleansed face and neck.  I think it's an important step.  This moisturizer is not smooth and creamy out of the jar, that's why some of the reviews are not 5 stars - but they should be.  I really take my time now, because the first time I used it - I did not - and my sensitive skin really looked a little red.  I then re-read all the instructions and next time the cream and my skin were super-silky.

This moisturizer is pretty good, I am in love with the juicy fragrance. I don't usually put anything with a strong smell on my face but decided to at least give this product a try for a week. Even though it smells good I have not seen a huge change as opposed to my previous moisturizer.
This cream feels a bit thick but once applied it absorbs quickly and leaves no residue. I don't know about it leaving me with a "glow" but my skin defiantly feels very soft and moisturized after using this. I can tell that using the whole product line together will give you better results. This jar is small...2oz but a little goes a long way!

This is a moisturizer for use at night and in the morning.  The jar it comes in is nice and hefty, but still annoying.  It's harder to get product out of jars and the ingredients degrade every time you open it.

Putting the cream on is fairly easy.  Warm it up in your hands and then smooth on.  It does feel heavy and unpleasant at first, but absorbs fairly quickly.  It smells like Fruit Loops.  I know the ingredients are organic, but the smell just seems overly sweet.  Luckily, it fades fast.

I have not broken out or had any other adverse effects.  My face is nicely moisturized, although I've had the same results with cheaper brands.

My main dislike is that this moisturizer doesn't include SPF.  That's fine for night application, but it requires an extra step and product in the morning.  I like this moisturizer well enough, but I'm not wowed.  I won't be changing preferred brands based on this product.

This moisturizer has a very thick and creamy consistency, which makes it great for colder months when indoor heating and harsh outdoor temperatures can dry out skin. (Warm it up on your fingertips before applying -- this helps it spread easily.)

The scent is clean and light, and fades very quickly. Though the instructions say it may be used morning and night, I prefer it as a night cream because it DOES NOT CONTAIN SUNSCREEN, which we need, even in colder months/winter. I also use it at night because it sinks in (partially), but does leave a SLIGHT residue on the skin surface (this does not mean greasy, just that you can feel it on your skin). I find it gentle enough to use around and under the eye area.

What I like best are the "natural juices" and oils it is made from, which include: white grape juice, aloe juice, shea butter, etc. I also like the fact that it does not contain parabens, petroleum, silicones, and other un-pronounceable ingredients.

After using it at night, my skin in the morning looks smooth and feels silky. Fine lines are less noticeable.

I'll continue to use this product throughout the winter months.

I have very dry skin and I'm always trying creams to keep it hydrated. So when I saw the chance of trying the Juice Beauty Nutrient Moisturizer, I took it. But first, I had to go to the manufacturer's website to see the list of all the ingredients, it would be great if they'd listed them on the Product Description as well.  Among its many ingredients are organic shea butter, jojoba, aloe  and algae. This is my experience with it, it's a nice moisturizer that is great for my face,  and also for my hands. After I applied it to my face and neck, I got the idea of massaging into my cuticles, fingernails and hands, and it hydrates them all very well. The cream is thick but it penetrates fast and it has a mild and pleasant aroma.  It's all natural, without chemicals, or artificial fragrance or dyes. And it doesn't have any soy components, either.  I recommend this products both for women and men.
summary: Great for my face,  and also for my hands

reviewText:
Juice Beauty is known for their organic and more natural products. They have fewer additives than most cosmetics but are also pricier.

This nutrient moisutrizer has the main ingredients organic white grape juice (hence Juice beauty!), organic aloe juice, organic shea butter, vegetable glycerin, carnauba wax, jojoba seed oil, evening primrose oil, linseed oil and some other seed oils and flower extracts such as marigold flower extract, chammomile leaf extract, and some algaes and ylang ylang etc. So as you can see the list is exhaustive, they have almost every oil that softens the skin and gives it a glow as well as repairs wrinkles (such as Vitamin E/tocopherol).

The cream itself has a semi-soft solid consistency and absorbs well in the skin. It leaves the skin feeling supple and gives it a glow. If you gently cleanse and moisturize your skin every night - you're half way there anyway. Creams like this just help the process. When I had more time I would mix up stuff like this in the kitchen, my mom would give me the pure aloe vera from the plants she grew and I would mix in the essential oils and raw shea butter. Now with all the products available it's more convenient to purchase, and this cream seems to have more than the typical amount of natural ingredients.

Will keep using for a month and report back on the longer term results. This cream is fairly expensive, so only if the results are amazing will I keep purchasing it.

Update after 2.5 months:
This moisturizer is working really well for my skin in winter. It does not have a heavy and sticky feel yet it is creamy enough to keep my skin moisturized and saves it from redness. I am using it every morning and night in the winter, and I find it much better than liquid moisturizers for this season. Maybe in the summer it may feel too heavy, and I will switch to using it in the night after cleansing. It's expensive but it can last 4 months with once a day use so probably still worth it.
summary: Juice Beauty moisturizer is based on fruit juice, essential oils, plant ingredients - makes my skin glow.

reviewText:
This is exactly what I look for in a face moisturizer. It's thick, heavy, dense, but as soon as melts into the skin, it leaves it soft and not greasy in an way. Lots of face creams say they don't leave skin greasy, but I find many of them still do. And my skin doesn't do so well with creams that make it greasy. It tends to clog up my skin and then the oils naturally in my skin build up into the moisturizer and my whole face ends up feeling like I used butter on my face or something. But if I don't use any moisturizer on my skin in the cold months, it tends to get dry and my makeup doesn't look as good.

This Juice Beauty skin cream is just what my face needed. It's so thick and rich, but leaves skin soft and not greasy at all. The smell is good. I've certainly had face creams with fragrances I've disliked, and this one isn't one of those. I can't quite put my finger on what the fragrance is. At first I thought maybe there were notes of lime or green tea, but I can't say for certain. It's a bright fragrance and works well as my morning moisturizer, and the cream even works well under makeup. Very nice!
summary: Dense, rich, but doesn't leave my face greasy at all

reviewText:
Before I review this, I should state that I am 50 years old, have generally good skin (no blemishes, age spots, or acne), and that I have regularly moisturized my face with a narrow range of products in the past decade or so. I also swim and find the chemicals dry my skin even more than usual. Lately, I had just taken to using Lubriderm on my face as well as my body, but in the past, I have used speical facial creams with hyaluranic acid as the main active ingredient. Those creams were actually superior to using consumer-level body moisturizer, but I purchased them abroad and could no longer find the same brands after returning to the U.S.

This moisturizer is very different from anything that I have used before. It goes on quite dry and feels more like applying cosmetic foundation to your face. This is not a bad thing, especially if you don't like the shiny, sometimes greasy feeling that you get from some face creams. If you are in a partnership in which you want to moisturize at night, but don't want to go to bed with a film on your face, this is a great choice. If you need something that feels creamy (or you like to slather a lot of product on your face), then this may not be a great option.

The moisturizer does appear to do a good job of keeping skin in better condition. I have fine lines on my forehead and around my eyes and a good moisturizer will minimize them (at least temporarily). This did that job admirably, though not as well as products designed specifically to "tighten" older skin (like some Oil of Olay products). However, it was better than any of the other products that I have used regularly before (aforementioned body lotions and hyaluronic acid creams). Note that I used this twice a day (as the jar recommends) in very spare amounts. An application in the morning and at night seemed to do me well.

I don't know if topical nutrient application helps with cellular regeneration (as the cream's maker seems to claim). I come from the school of thought that good skin is largely driven by what you put in your mouth (lots of water, fruit, vegetables) than what you slather on your face. That being said, the bottom line is that regardless of the nutrients in the cream, this seems to work quite well. The only thing that I did not like much about it was the scent as it seemed rather "medicinal" to me. That being said, it's not a strong scent and I strongly prefer it to any sort of perfume-like creams.
summary: good quality moisturizing, goes on dry

reviewText: I don't like to spend a lot of time on a skin care management routine. Nia24 is simple: Cleanser and this wonderful Skin Strengthening Complex lotion. However, I keep coming back to this skin creme for my moisturizer, so that says a lot about how much confidence I have in this product. It's excellent.

reviewText: I love Prorasos products-  but this version the white sensitive skin version is not my favorite.  It is hard and difficult to lather up- with my brush and ceramic cup. I would and will order Proraso again- just not this kind.

reviewText: First of all, let me say that Proraso is good quality stuff.  I gave this 3 stars because IMHO, it doesn't work as well as the shave creams that come in the tubes.  I have a tube of Proraso, but wanted to try this, and the razor glides much better with the cream and I get a much better shave.  Also, from reading all the reviews and tips on how to use this soap, a lot of users are saying to swirl the brush directly in the container to start a lather, and then transfer to another bowl to complete the lather.  I did this and it does work well, but that makes it a 2-step process which I don't want to do.  I'd rather squeeze cream out of a tube directly on the brush, then do the lather in a shaving bowl.  And for those asking if this is a hard puck or a cream, it's kind of in-between.  It's not as hard as a traditional bar of soap, but it's definitely not a cream.  It's definitely solid enough that you can take the product out of the bowl and hold it in your hand, put it back in the bowl, and you wouldn't need to wipe any residue off your hand.
summary: The cream in the tubes has done much better for me.

reviewText: I have been using the Proraso shave cream with great success.  I purchased this "Soap in the Bowl" to support a recent vacation as I did not want to travel with my ceramic bowl.  This product provided a very comparable lather and since it was the same ingredients as the cream in the tube, I did not experience any break-outs as a result.  This is a must have for travel or for anyone not wanting to mess with the separates.

I was looking for a relatively inexpensive soap for ever day shaves. I like to save my artisan stock for special occasions and I am not made of money ya know. As a mass produced soap it's actually really nice. It loads well, though I will say it loads better on stiffer brushes than softer ones. The scent is nice and has some staying power. The slickness is about average I would say and it provides decent cushion. Is this the best soap in the world? Nope. Is this soap a decent proformer at a great price point? Absolutely. One of the advantages of this soap over the cream in a tube is that it has a better post shave. Not sure why but it is definitely more moisturizing and has a better finish than the tube creams from Proraso. This is their sensitive skin formula (and I have some sensitive skin.) Let me just say a preshave is a must. I use an oil but you could use theirs as well. A good preshave and prep will make this soap preform better. without a preshave treatment this soap is still to drying for me but it does have some good anti-inflammatory properties.
summary: A relatively inexpensive soap for ever day shaves

reviewText:
I've tried everything from premium designer stuff to the value stuff.  When it comes down to it, it's really just shaving soap.  This stuff is no different.  Proraso is a very good shaving product.  It doesn't have the variety of scents that other soaps/creams have, but for the price, it's a good low-frills product.  The soap is just hard enough to load my brush on it, but soft enough to get a really good load without too much effort.  It really whips up a great rich lather that is very slick.  It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and it works great with the Nivea aftershave balm.  The only gripe I have is the scent.  I don't particularly care for the soapy scent.  It's not bad, I just wouldn't wear it as a cologne.  Of course, smell is completely subjective.  Like most all soaps, the scent doesn't linger for more than a few minutes anyway.

Overall, the soap performs great.  There's plenty of product in there to last more than a couple of months.  It performs as well as TOBS, but 25% less expensive.

I don't have sensitive skin, but opted for this over the green or red thinking that a sensitive skin product would feel all the better. I just completed my first shave and came away loving it. The thick/stiff cream in the container loaded up very easily into my brush after squeezing out excess water. A little goes a long way, I loaded the tip and was able to get coverage 3 times over my face and neck with a single load. A nice slick lather was produced - I have never felt a razor glide so effortlessly over my skin. After shaving i noticed that my skin started to tingle. It felt like menthol. This might bother some but I loved it.

Over all, 5 stars for value, ease of use, and quality of shave.

The product lasts a very long time and does not have an overwhelming scent.  This was good for me as I also don't do well with perfumes or lotions that have smells. This definitely smells better than the green. It still has menthol but its not as strong as the green. The first time I tried green my eyes watered.

I had previously tried the Red Sandalwood soap and preshave, as well as the Green soap and preshave. I have used this white variety in conjunction with the green preshave (menthol and eucalyptus), as well as by itself. I found that it loads the shaving brush with lather as quickly as the other Proraso soaps, which is to say that you'll have all the soap you need in the brush within 30 seconds. Note that you will have to soak your shaving brush for a few minutes to make this happen. The Proraso white seems to have a thicker lather than the other varieties. It gives very good protection and nice skin feel after rinsing off. To me, it smells like tea tree oil. A somewhat sharp, almost citrus smell that is quite subdued and won't negatively interact with any other fragrance you wish to use as an aftershave. I have gotten the best performance with using this soap in conjunction with the Proraso Green pre-shave. I apply the pre-shave in a small quantity while the brush is soaking (just a few minutes), then lather the soap directly on top without rinsing. You may need to add a bit of water to the suds to get the right consistency as you go, but this stuff, when properly hydrated, is slick. All but the most aggressive shaving implements should work well with this stuff. I was able to do my first few straight razor shaves without cutting myself. With a safety razor and a good blade, the stubble comes off almost like magic. I was just able to perform my closest-ever shave with this tactic. Highly recommended.

Associated gear: Parker 99R safety razor; Boker Tree Brand straight razor; Escali Badger Hair brush; Proraso Green pre-shave.
Been using Proraso shaving soaps for many years.  Still - very good product.
excellent

Good Stuff!
When I first got into DE shaving I tried all kinds of Esoteric shave creams, soap etc. After the dust settled and my wallet was empty I found the Proraso Shave Soaps. I find with a good badger brush and possibly a drop of shave oil this soap is all one needs for the PERFECT close shave! I like the green Proraso sometimes a bit better than this white and sometimes I prefer this white so I keep both on hand and alternate.
I find the value of this product is simply incredible.  With a badger brush I get fantastic, PERFECT lather and this product last many months before I need to order more. I find using one drop of Shave Secret oil in my mix is preferred but not required to get that perfect shave!
I like the built in cup as I shave in the shower and with this plastic (unbreakable) cup  I can whip up a good later in no time.
summary: BEST value shave soap / cream I have found. I love all things Proraso!

reviewText:
04/06/2016 UPDATE - almost 3 years now, the original jar is still about 40% full. I've since tried Proraso Green and Proraso Red, also love them. You can get them really cheap at Italian Barber website.

12/14/2015 UPDATE - Just a little observation: I've heard it before and then experienced it myself: this soap only works well in soft water. For a while my water softener was not working (due to a "salt bridge", resolved now) and I couldn't even use Proraso - it deflated after applying to face and was no good by second pass. I found that the Tabac stick works best for that. But after my soft water returned I tried it again yesterday and it was great. BTW, if you have hard water, you can just try using distilled water to lather your soap, that should work, can't get any softer than distilled :) Also need to make sure there's not too much water in the lather.

I switched from the cheap "can spray" foam, so I haven't tried many other high end shaving soaps and other products, but I am very pleased with Proraso (also had a bottle of aftershave lotion, but it was glass and I dropped it and it broke). The smell is exquisite, makes you feel like you're in a different income bracket ;) It tends to stay with you during the day, if you don't mask it with other fragrances, which is great!

So far I had a few friends try it and they were hooked.

Please don't cheat yourself and get a nice brush.

I used it with straight edge and more recently with double edge safety razor, but it's great even with cartridge razors (but please do yourself, your face and your budget a favor and switch to DE or straight edge).
summary: Like you're in a higher income bracket :) Great with straight edge, DE safety or cartridge razors.

reviewText: I recently started wet shaving. I came away from the cans of foam and now use saving soaps, brush and a straight razor. Those that straight shave or DE shave know what prep and the right soap is all about. After many hours of research and lots of time on Badger and Blade and SRP forum it has been decided the Italians and the Turks are make the best soaps (and the Brits). Poraso is the best of the lot and I love the Green Tea and Oats. Using this I have cut back on irritation and cuts.  It loads on my brush and makes cream like a nothing I have ever seen, except for wool fat.  Smells great and is a welcome addition to my other soaps.  I will buy this until I die.
summary: Thank God for the Italian Soap makers

reviewText: Smells great

Outstanding shave soap that face-lathers effortlessly. Just a simple fresh scent which is great; much more subtle than the menthol blast you get from the Proraso green (also a stellar soap). This soap seems to really condition your skin. I've often finished my shaves with a wet alum block followed by a cold water rinse and I was good to go. No need for a after shave balm...it's that good.
summary: Great soap that conditions your skin

reviewText: Great Product.  I use this as well as the Poraso Liquid after shave cream.  I have very sensitive skin and I do not do well using anything with a heavy scent.  The Poraso products have a light and pleasant scent that disappears within an hour after use.  I also switched to a DE razor.  Since I have started using this product I have had zero irritation after daily shaves.  I couoldn't be happier with the purchase.

I've tried several of the Proraso shave soaps and have been happy with the consistencey of all othe them.  I tried this one because it said sensitive skin. I didn't really notice a difference, but I've never had a irritablity problem with any Proraso soap.  There isn't much scent to this one, but like the others it makes a rich, creamy foam that never goes flat.

Lots of subjectivity in wet shaving preferences. A certain blade works great for one, but just will not work on another gent's face. Same goes for soap and creams. Keep in mind your mileage may vary. I love this soap. Lathers easily and is very, very slick. More slick than Proraso Green (which is a glorious product) making for an easier shave. Light, pleasant, clean scent. This soap really conditions your skin, too. Your skin feels soft all day. The Proraso Green is great, but sometimes you need a break from the menthol-blast-barbershop scent. I like to finish my shave with a wet alum block, cold water rinse, and a healthy handful of Clubman Original or Bay Rum aftershave splash. Enjoy!
I tried other Proraso Products and like them all, This one seems to work great on sensitive skin. Whips into a good lather.

I actually enjoy shaving, and the key to shaving is good shaving oil (Pacific Brand) a good brush made of Badger, and good shaving cream, this is soap, which whips up nice with a brush, but I did not find it as gentle on my sensitive skin as Black Jack Shave Cream, it maybe that I am not used to soap, as I am used to cream, but the cream whips up better for me with the brush, using this soap is sooo much cheaper the aerosol cans like Gillette or Barbosal, This lasts forever. Just whips up in its own little container. .
summary: This is Shaving Soap Not Cream- foams up nice with good brush, lasts forever.

reviewText:
OK IF YOU HATE SHAVING?!?! Get this , then go to YouTube look up how to use shaving soap. Watch several videos. Then break out your soap/cream and play around with it practice and then give it a try! If you do not find this to be thee best shave ever keep practicing cause your missing a step or have not gotten it down yet.

I hated shaving! My skin always got irritated and burned after! Then I tried this stuff after watching hours of videos, I broke down and gave it a whack. Now mind you I'm in a wheel chair so it is harder for me to shave and I get worn out in my chair quickly!!!! After using this I look forward to shaving I can't wait for the stubble at 5pm or 5am to show up cause I'm going to shave... I will spend the extra 10 min to get outta  bed to go through the procedure to shave ! My skin comes out so smooth and irritation free!!!!!! And the girlfriend really noticed a difference! Spend the money, spend the time to learn , spend the time to treat your self to something fun and comforting !!!

I have pretty sensitive skin and wanted a good shave soap so I would not break out while wet shaving. As I am new to this type of shaving, I bought this based on previous reviews and am glad that I did. This soap lathers up real nice and provides a great, close shave. I usually have to do 2 or 3 passes to get my face really smooth, but it is fun to shave now (not like with cartridge razors). The only complaint I have of this soap is the smell. It is not a bad smell, just not one that I really like. The original Proraso shaving soap (in green jar) has an awesome smell and it works fine on my sensitive skin, so I would buy that version next time. Still like this product though.

I love the Proraso smell! I love the smell of all the Proraso products so much that I wish they made mens cologne!
I am new to DE shaving and have already found another brand that will give me a closer shave and leathers better but at 3x the price! I do think this soap will last a very long time. Nice product!

I wouldn't say this is ultra sensitive.  My proraso red and green are just as good on my sensitive skin.  It's still a good soap, but you'll need a really wet brush to get an acceptable lather from this.
The green smells better too... ESP the one in the tube.. It's still pretty good shave soap tho.. Long lasting
summary: I like the green proraso better

reviewText:
I grew up with my dad using a double-sided safety razor (he had a brush and used real shaving soap). Then when it came time for me to shave the double-blade Schick razors appeared. And spray-can foam. And then 3 blades. And now 5. Ever since I started shaving I thought that we had it made. Also, shaving was always a chore - I never really enjoyed it and only did it because I hate wearing a beard more.

Lately I decided to try straight edge razor shaving. And discovered these old school soaps and other accessories. I must say that now I look forward to shaving. And even though I am still learning to use the real razor, so I still have to use my 5-blade Gillette, I enjoy using homemade lather and the smell of this Proraso soap is fantastic. I seem to get a closer shave (even with the same old Gillette) and I enjoy the process. I love making the lather in a mug with my brush. Surprised how little of this soap you need - you can make a cupful of lather with about a dime-size amount of Proraso soap.

Only when I smelled and used this soap did I realize how cheap and ordinary the chemicals from the spray cans are. I'm talking about Gillette, Schick, just about any spray can I've tried - LAME. This soap is it, even if you are using modern razors. It gives you a "respect yourself in the morning" feel instead of "oh, I gotta shave" feel.

UPDATE: it's been about 2 years now and I have yet to use up half of this first jar! I also made a complete switch to double-edge safety razors (when I don't have time to be careful with my straight edge) - I ain't EVER buying another cartridge :) This makes you feel like you're in a higher income bracket - I've managed to get a few of my friends on this product and the proper razors as well :)

UPDATE 2: I have since tried a few other shaving soaps: 2 other Proraso tubs (menthol/eucalyptus and sandalwood), Tabac stick, Palmolive stick, Williams Mug Shaving soap and a couple of DIY soaps friends gave me. So far this white Proraso is my favorite scent - the only one I've purchased again to give to friends. Great for any weather.
summary: from a chore shaving turns into an indulgence!

reviewText: It's a personal preference so YMMV, and if I'm staying with Proraso creams, I prefer their Eucalyptus & Menthol formulation. I feel I do have sensitive skin (particularly my neck) and neither of the two seem any better or worse than the other. Otherwise, there are some great UK options out there!

I was always getting art of shaving products and it was $25.00 each for shaving cream jar. I liked it a lot but recently tried this item and I am sold! $15.00 cheaper than art of shaving. I am not sure if I should keep this product in the jar it came in or put it in a different mug. I also want a double edge razor but I have no idea which one is good. I use Fusion razors now and heard double edge are better. Proraso Shave soap is great and will continue to buy and use!

Like the smell and like most soaps it does not stick around. Its a larger amount than I expected. Ive been wet shaving for about two years and still find myself experimenting with different soaps. They last a long time so its not like you have a lot of them. This one is very pleasant, very nice shave, lathers easily (I have heard water but on a hardness scale of 1-5 its a 2-1/2) and Im looking forward to keeping it in my rotation. I have a tough beard that grows in many directions and I would definitely recommend this soap.
summary: more product than expected very nice soap

reviewText:
This stuff is kind thin and doesn't seem to give as smooth a shave as the regular proraso cream. The lighter smell is ok but it just doesn't lather well. I have sensitive skin and love Proraso's regular line of products but this white label "sensitive skin" line is too sensitive for me. I'll stick to the regular proraso line.

SHAVING- let me save you years of trial and error: take a warm shower & wash your face with billy jealousy exfoliating facial cleanser, shave afterwards with a $50 Merkur safety razor handle with good blades (save $100's on mach 3 refills!), use a $20 Tweezerman badger hair shaving brush to apply taylor of old street bond (or proraso) shaving cream (you can let it set in a minute), shave WITH the grain DOWN, SLOWLY, SOFTLY (don't press hard- let the weight of the handle and sharp blade do the cutting), lastly rub on a fingertip of proraso pre/post shave cream while your face is still wet and let it dry! Say goodbye to razor bumps and ingrown hairs FOREVER! Trust me- I've tried dozens of pricey face washes, shaving creams, and after shaves over the last 4 years. If you don't want to commit so much money yet- order the pre/post shave proraso cream online, buy proraso shave cream online or at bath and body works (under their C.O. Bigelow label) then get the cheap single blade disposables (mach 3's are too aggressive) at a grocery store and you'll notice a difference overnight.
summary: Lighter texture and smell than regular Proraso but rougher shave

reviewText: I tried Proraso and Col. Conk shaving soap side by side.  I prefer Proraso.  It lathers very well, the lather makes shaving effortless, and proraso has a nice cooling effect.  It is quite a bit more expensive than Col. Conk, but I think it is worth it.
smells great!! works well

I love this soap. The only problem I had was that it's arrived unsealed, so I am not sure if it was used and returned by someone else. The reason is that it is not clear if it had a seal, and the top surface of soap had concentric circles with not very sharp edges. Could be the way it was manufactured, or it someone could have used it at least once: after I used it a couple of times, it still looked the same. Otherwise great sensation, great foam, great scent.
This just have that clean pleasant scent that's not overpowering. I've been using this since 2013.

I love this perfume so much but it's not what it used to be. I received this as a gift (hence, no AVP badge) but it was purchased from Amazon. The last bottle I bought from Birchbox and it seemed to be stronger, although not by much. This stuff doesn't even last a few hours which is almost a crime since it costs nearly as much as most designer fragrances.

Everyone else in my family loves the way this smells too - they all say the same thing, it's so light and clean, which is why I like it in the first place. I haven't found anything else that has such an unprocessed smell to it or I'd buy it instead. This just isn't a good enough value anymore, I have to find something else.
summary: Same fabulous scent, too expensive for its short wear

reviewText:
I'm not a fan of woody perfumes, but I also love to try new things--even when I think I won't like them.  I'm glad I tried CLEAN White Woods because I really love this fragrance.

CLEAN White Woods is a lovely fresh scent that isn't overpowering.  It's only lightly woodsy, which is why I like it so much.

White Woods has this fragrance profile:
top notes: bergamot, black pepper, and mandarin
mid notes: magnolia, calla lily, and vanilla orchid
base notes: sandalwood, pralines musks, and amber wood

None of these really stand out to me.  They just blend together beautifully.

I think this fragrance would work for anyone who enjoys something light with a hint of a walk through the woods.

This "Clean Eau De Parfum, Warm Cotton", has the scent of freshly washed laundry or pleasantly scented body soaps. My wife says it smells like sun-dried clothes washed with Tide Laundry detergent, but its not a "bad" soapy or laundry smell. The scent is slightly sweet, slightly spicy, and with detectable notes of jasmine. It seems like a casual, springtime fragrance.
summary: Really does smell clean...but no substitute for hygiene ;)

reviewText: I had high hopes, but this just smells like a cotton scented candle; like laundry detergent. I will continue to wear it every few weeks to see if I change my mind. I'm thinking it will smell better in the spring and summer. I was hoping the amber and musk notes would be more prominent. Very strong! Not much is needed when wearing this. I will update this review in a few months.

Terrific!  Smells like you just got out of the shower and wrapped yourself in a just-laundered towel. I've never smelled a perfume as crisp and clean smelling. The fragrance doesn't last all day, but what a great way to start the morning.

I'll admit, when I first sprayed this I wasn't expecting to overly like it. It didn't smell bad, but rather like some rather strong Febreeze, a scent that isn't bad on clothing and furniture, but not really something I'd necessarily wear as a perfume. It was also a little stronger than what I normally wear, as scents tend to be amplified on my body. I'm like a miniature incense burner with some perfumes, and not in a good way. I'd only sprayed a little mist on each wrist, about what I'd normally put on with all but a very few scents, so this initially concerned me.

I was pleasantly surprised when about a half hour later the scent actually mellowed out into a pleasant fresh laundry scent that is neither overpowering nor overwhelmingly reminds me of Febreeze. It's very basic and clean, so it's a scent that I would feel comfortable wearing in most environments without fear of it knocking someone in the face. Now when I say that it mellowed, don't take this to mean that the scent disappears. It's still very much present and I can smell it on my wrists. It's definitely something I enjoy smelling and something I'd actually use quite a bit for everyday use at work and home. It's definitely not something I'd wear during a fancy event, but then I suppose that might also depend on the person. It's not the best cotton scent I've ever smelled and I'd have to reserve that 5 star rating for a now retired cotton scent from Bath & Body Works from years back. They have a similar scent, but it's not really the same.

However it's definitely good enough to where I'd recommend it if you like cotton scents or want something nice and basic. If you're worried about your body chemistry, I'd say that you can use this relatively free of worry. Everyone is different, but I usually do not do well with perfumes and it smelled fine on myself.
summary: Really like this, nice and clean scent

reviewText:
This is a unique and lovely scent.  I'm a guy and I tried it on for evaluation purposes, but I kept smelling my wrist over and over.  While the fresh laundry comparisons are accurate, you won't smell like those dryer fresheners.  It's quite nice.

Very different and a highly appealing scent.  Big 5 stars for this product.

I tend to like perfume that isn't so bold as to overpower. Here we have an attractively designed contemporary bottle, well manufactured for this price range, and a perfume that has a pleasant jasmine and musk scent which, lightly applied, does indeed smell like laundry that I've washed in Tide + Febreze. Over the course of the day, the scent decays smoothly leaving the freshness intact. Very nice.
summary: There's a clean and fresh scent akin to laundry washed in Tide/Febreze.

reviewText:
very clean scent, like a fresh lines.. what is odd is that it is masculine and feminine. I believe a guy or gal can wear this. its also a nice touch up to just freshen the air or a piece of clothing. little goes a long way.
very nice scent that works for woman or men.

This is a clean and strong scent.  Smells like a big ole' bubble bath and the scent lasts forever.  Might be a bit much for some, but always subjective.  If you like a powerful soapy scent this is the one.  My daughter thought it smelled like carpet fresh.
summary: Scent smells like a big ole' bubble bath.

reviewText: Love this perfume. I have Skin by Clean and I love it too. This smells floral and powdery but it is not overwhelming. Only issue is that the staying power is poor. I would suggest reapplying it throughout the day.
Very refreshing and different. Not too sweet or overly floral. The overall packaging is very attractive.
summary: Not too sweet or overly floral

reviewText:
CLEAN Warm Cotton smells like freshly laundered towels.  Yes, that's right, freshly laundered towels.

I have a few requirements in a perfume.  It can't enter a room before me or stay behind when I leave, and it has to have a pleasant scent.

CLEAN Warm Cotton is a light fragrance that sticks close to me, so it wins on that count.  It also does smell nice.  I love the smell of a clean towel coming out of the dryer as much as the next crazy person who enjoys smelling their laundry.

But I'm not sure that I want to walk around smelling like laundry.  It's a nice fragrance.  But personally I'd rather smell like a spring garden than fresh laundry.
summary: Smell Like a Freshly Laundered Towel!

reviewText: I enjoy a number of the Clean scents, but not so much this one.  This perfume smells mostly like flowers and musk.  I'm not sure which flowers, it's hard to tell.  Both the florals and the musk are definitely noticeable.  It didn't smell much like clean skin to me.  The Clean perfumes aren't supposed to smell like traditional perfume, they're supposed to just smell good.  I felt like this one fell short of that.  It smells like perfume.  That's not in and of itself a bad thing (I mean, I LOVE perfume), but this is not a perfume I would select. I'm not a big fan of obvious musks, and this one has a pretty obvious musk note to it.
One of my favorite summer fragrances. There are few scents that mix with the summer heat better than this one does.

I mean.. literally. This smells like the Clinique fragrance called "Happy." If you like that fragrance you'll love this. Having worked in a salon for over 34 years I can honestly say I can "detect" any perfume and its name quickly.

I got a mini version if this a while ago and I finally got around to purchasing the full version. This is my favorite scent from the Clean line. It smells warm and fresh, like pulling your favorite T-shirt straight from the dryer. I wish everything smelled like this fragrance.

I'm VERY sensitive to scents. I like light clean scents not heavy florial or anything else, this is the one and only perfume I can wear without getting a headache or sick of it. Smells just like fresh clothes, clean and light, great for summer!!! If you hate perfume like I pretty much do, TRY this one, this might be the one and only for you too!
summary: Only perfume I'll wear!!!! SMELLS soo good, clean and light!

reviewText: Very emollient, especially in the winter here in the dry plains. Feels cool on my red cheeks.
Am I to see a difference in wrinkles or elasticity? If so, I do not. Been using it for 2 weeks now. going to stop
summary: Am I to see a difference in wrinkles or elasticity ...

reviewText:
I am new to this line of skincare and am absolutely hooked!  Every product I've purchased is gentle and seemingly effective--with a great price!  I've begun to switch to this line as my other products run out.  I'm a very happy customer.

This product is wonderful for my sometimes-dry skin.
I love Avenue night cream it's so light and fluffy!! It's just the right weight for a light night cream!! Great seller easy & quick to get!!

reviewText: One of my all time favorite brands/products. Definitely try this. You'll love it

Enjoying this rich, gentle cream very much. I use it as a night cream with their Skin Recovery Cream as a day cream. I'm not wild about the jar design, makes it hard to scoop it out, but the product is excellent so that won't deter me buying it again. It's thick but absorbs completely and quickly. No stinging, etc. I'm sold.

I'm obsessed with this stuff. It's very inexpensive and works great! It's the most hydrating cream I've come across for my winter skin! What I like about it is that it is very hydrating but isn't too greasy feeling; it goes on light and your skin can still breathe, so to speak. Has a light, pleasant scent. Wonderful. I also should say that I have very sensitive skin and have tried everything from Erno Laszlo and Chanel (both brands I LOVE), to CeraVe (also good, but this is better!) This is probably more hydrating than $80 Solution 10 de Chanel and $110 pHelityl Night Cream. Really awesome. I only wish it came in a larger jar!

I was super disappointed with this cream because it is so heavily scented. It says its for sensitive skin--but I cannot use it because its too perfumey. I will not buy again, but I use it around hair line and neck and on hands because I have it, and I cannot use on actual face.
summary: I was super disappointed with this cream because it is so heavily ...

reviewText: Great for my neck and around my eyes at night.  It's non irritating.  I love it.

PCA Skin is a good skincare brand and I wanted to give this lip treatment a try. I live in a Denver where its super dry, especially in wintertime, so my lips are constantly cracked and peeling and dry. This lip treatment feels a lot like Vaseline going on with a nice minty flavor. It doesnt last very long even without eating or drinking. It is moisturizing but because it doesnt really last the effect is very temporary. Not worth the cost IMO.
Great lip moisturizer and exfoliator!  Love this product!  Wear daily with gloss or under lipstick!  Use nightly as well!
LOVE IT!!!!!
I love this stuff. I use it at least twice a day - and it has made a wonderful difference in my dry, aging lips. Will continue to purchase!

My facialist uses this on me so i thought i would buy some for my self. It works well, but so does burts beeswax for much cheaper. I used it during the winter (i live in southern texas so it doesnt get that cold) and it kept my lips from getting cracked, and i have so big ol' lips. I think this would be great in the winter, especially in colder climates.
