really creates a great shine  a wonderful shampoo
Excellent product,

Nice bath time set that is suitable as a gift. The set I received looks different from the image (in terms of placement of the products, the items are exactly the same) so do take note of that. The items are useful for new parents and the micellar water (no rinse solution) is the perfect product for newborns. It is useful for using as a freshen-up after a poopy diaper (I use a cotton pad and saturate it with the water and wipe the area) and is also very useful for the milk gunk that builds up in the folds of the neck and underarm region. Just a few ways you can use it. However compared to the other newborn gift set I feel the latter is more useful as it includes the foaming shampoo which is heaven sent for cradle cap and parents who are noobs to bathing their newborn. I have and use a lot of mustela products and have been using them since my 3.5 year old was a newborn himself (and with my current 6 month old since he was a newborn) so I am extremely familiar with almost every single one of their products. They work well and despite the smell (which some might find strong) are very gentle/effective even with my firstborn who has eczema. I highly trust the brand and its ethics.

My daughters skin seems to be more sensitive of late. So even though she is now a child, Im now in search of gentler products to use on her skin.

Each of the bottles is sealed so that you don't have to worry about a baby or child getting into it. All of the products have a nice smelleven the microcellular water. Its a light, clean fragrance. The microcellular water is effective for a quick clean up.

A small amount of the lotion goes a long way. Its not thick. It smells good.

The 2-in-1 cleanser creates a moderate lather when used with a cloth.

The bubble bath creates a nice amount of bubblescertainly enough for a small baby tub. Its a pretty blue when it comes out but that may or may not be evident depending on how much water you run. They last for a while, too.

5 STARS: I would have been very happy to have received this when my daughter was a baby.

This set is an obvious gift for newborns, but it is just as usable for older siblings. This is what you get with these plant-based products: No-Rinse Cleansing Water: You might think that this bottle won't contain enough, but you don't need much (especially on a small baby, obviously). Like it says you use it to cleanno need to rinse off afterward. The scent is pleasant and didn't bother my wife who is extreme sensitive to smell. 2-in-1 Cleansing Gel: This is called two-in-one because it's a cleaner and a moisturizer. Multi-Sensory Bubble Bath: This bubble additive is blue in color and quite thick, so don't use too much or you will have a ton of bubbles. Hydra Bébé Body Lotion: This is a very nice moisturizer that works super great, even on my dry hands. Like all theses products, the scent is pleasing without being overpowering.

All of this comes in a reusable box that will make this an excellent choice for gift giving. Overall a nicely packaged premium product that actually works well.

I first became familiar with Mustela through my husband, who suffers from seasonal eczema.  He uses the lotion formulated specifically for his outbreaks.  It's an excellent lotion but it's hard to find.  Amazon is the one place he can find it.  It was thus a no-brainer to try this lovely gift pack.  The gentle formula is ideal not just for babies, but for anyone with sensitive skin.

We have two grandsons, 8 and 2.5 years old, with #3 due in a month.  The older boys have used Mustela baby shampoo with great results.  This gift box offers regular-sized tubes of foam shampoo, cleansing gel, lotions and diaper rash creams. I don't find the scent either strong or offensive.  What I do know is that no one in our family has allergies to this brand.

This is a nice introductory set for a new parent.
summary: Nice introductory set for new parent

reviewText:
This would make a wonderful gift for newborns.  It comes in a heavy box with a magnet closure.  I tested each product on myself, one at a time, and only one product each day -- because I have ultra sensitive skin, if there was a reaction I wanted to know which of the products caused it.  My impression of each item is as follows:

* No-Rinse Cleansing Water:  Let me start off by admitting that I'm allergic to my own sweat.  I have to shower immediately after a strenuous workout or I get a horrible itchy rash.  To test the cleansing water, I used it on myself after a *very* strenuous workout class.  Using it on my entire body (plus my hair), it removed the sweaty odor and left me feeling fresh and clean.  The real test, though, was the next morning.  I woke up feeling great.  No rash, no itching, and no yucky smell returned.  If it works that good on an adult after a sweaty workout, just think how well it will work on a baby who does nothing more than kick and coo at her mom.  Naturally, using this to clean a baby won't require near product as much as I needed to clean myself.

A note about the cleansing water...  There was a slight problem with the packaging -- the bottle was solidly glued in with double-backed tape (and almost impossible to remove).  I finally got the cleansing water out, but rather than removing the double-back tape from the bottle, the tape pulled off the shrink-wrap that had the instructions.  This could cause frustration for the new mom.  This was the reason I deducted a star.

* 2-in-1 Cleansing Gel:  It did a good job of cleaning the daily grime from my body, and I experienced no allergic reaction.  However, before 24 hours had passed, I started feeling sticky, almost as though it was holding my sweat in (which is not normal for me).  I suspect that a baby wouldn't experience this, as they do very little that would cause sweating.

* Multi-Sensory Bubble Bath:  The first thing I noticed was the bright blue color.  I don't know why Mustela would use coloring for a baby product, but whatever they used to color it is suitable for very sensitive skin.  I didn't experience any reaction at all, even after soaking in the tub for an hour.  You don't need a lot of this bubble bath to make a ton of bubbles, even in an oversized garden tub.  This is very thick, so make sure you swish it thoroughly through the bath water to make sure it mixes in.

* Hydra Bébé Body Lotion:  This does a good job of moisturizing my mature (very dry) skin.  It smells amazing and was gentle on my sensitive skin.

Most baby products (even those claiming to be suitable for sensitive skin) cause an allergic reaction on whichever body part I use them, but none of these products caused any reaction at all.  I expect that it would be great for babies with even the most sensitive skin.

Although this is geared towards newborns, I am using it with my 2 1/2 year old granddaughter. This stuff is amazing - starting with the packaging. It comes in a sturdy box that is perfect for gift giving.

Next, it has such a pleasant smell. Not a traditional baby smell, yet very appropriate for a baby - and it's mild, not over powering. The lotions and creams are thick so a little dab will do ya, so it will last a good while. We have been using daily for over a week and can hardly tell any has been used.

This is a great baby gift set.

This is a great set for a new baby as it includes four great products for bathtime. Mustela is a great brand I trust and love that they came out with four plant-based skincare products for sensitive baby skin. They also emphasis that you can use the box as a keepsake box but honestly I wouldn't have a use for it and would just recycle it. The bottles are full-size and since you only need a little they should last awhile. You get a bath wash, bubble bath, no-rinse cleansing water (perfect for in-between bathtimes freshness) and a body lotion. The scent is clean and light.

I did notice an expiration date on my bottles but they were almost two years out.

This was beautifully packaged in a very high quality box. This would make a lovely gift option. This covers all the basics, plus, for baby's bath time. My only concerns were over a few of the product ingredients. They are gentle but still chemical based. They aren't quite as bad as the conventional options out there but, I know brands like Earth Mama Baby Angel, California Baby and Burt's Bees make 'cleaner' options.
summary: Nice presentation for a baby gift

reviewText:
Mustela is my absolute favorite product to use on sensitive baby skin.  I used it on my girls as they were growing up and now my daughter is using it for her babies.

It's the only baby product that I trust 100%.  This is the only thing that has been reliable in keeping the skin clean, soft, smooth, smelling fresh and rash free.  The scent is very reminiscent of what you would expect a clean baby to smell like!  Soft, subtle baby powder fresh.

This gift set is a perfect baby shower/new baby gift.  Can't go wrong!

Highly Recommend
summary: My all time favorite baby skin care line!

reviewText:
This Mustela Mathtime Essentials is a good combination and nicely packaged gift set for baby shower or similar occasions. The ingredients are plant base and safe for soft baby skins.  It has four baby bath essentials, from a fun bubble bath to after bath lotion.

I recommend it!
summary: A Nice Selection and Well Pakaged Gift Set

reviewText: Wow, this is great stuff! I was going to try and still give part of it as a gift, but hey, we're keeping it. I've used the 2 and 1 shampoo and cleanser. That is so mild but also very thick. You don't need to use much to wash your whole body. My only negative about this stuff is that it doesn't have the traditional baby scent. I love that scent. But the scent isn't bad -- very mild and goes away. The waterless cleanser stuff is fantastic. Cleans with no water. I even tried it on my son's hair (he's 17 years old -- yes I said a teenager) and it worked great. It didn't say it was for hair but it worked for him. I haven't yet tried the bubble bath -- it says it is sensory. This is really great stuff. High quality and would make a great gift.

This is a great bathtime set that is perfect for my little ones gentle skin. Each item has a fresh scent to it. I really like the baby lotion, as its light and doesn't leave your skin feeling oily. I've been using the lotion on my very dry hands, and it's really helped  soften them up. The hair and body wash is very gentle against my daughters skin and hair, and a little bit goes a long way. You don't need a lot when using the bubble bath either. This is our first time using Mustela products and we're very impressed with this set. Makes for a great for a baby shower gift too, as this comes neatly packed with full sized bottles.

This set makes a nice gift especially if match up with a bath tub and towels.  I love the baby scent after they bath, this set does not disappoint in that area....love, love, love the scent.  I will not list everything as it is listed on the Amazon page but the blue bubble bath for bath time fun  and micellar water for cleaning on the go were my personal favorites.  All natural and gentle for baby skin...you can't go wrong.
summary: All natural set for baby. My favorites are the blue bubble bath for bath time fun and micellar water for on the go clean

reviewText: The Mustela Bathtime Essentials Gift Set was ordered for our new grandson. The gift set has for plant-based skincare products to keep our grandson clean and moisturized. They live in Colorado which is very dry and practically everyone uses moisturizers. The gift set is in a box that includes 2 in 1 Cleansing Gel, Multi-Sensory Bubble Bath, Body Lotion, and No Rinse cleansing Water to keep baby clean with touch-ups while on the go. Their products are formulated with Avocado Perseose, a patented natural ingredient to help protect and hydrate your baby's delicate skin. I've always remembered how I loved smelling my son when he was a baby after his bath time. So I wanted to give my grandson's parents something special for bath time for them to remember how much they loved smelling him after a bath. Precious.
summary: Clean & Natural Avocado Perseose Cleanser & Lotion for Baby

reviewText: The Mustela gift set comes in an attractive box, each item is carefully sealed so the liquids can't spill while in shipment.  The bubble bath and the 2-in-1 Cleansing Gel (shampoo and body soap)  has a lovely, lilac scent.  My favorite item in the set is the micellar water which works as a mild no rinse cleanser that can be used on the face as well as the body.  The items all work well with sensitive skin without stripping it of hydration.
summary: Gentle cleansing and a lovely scent

reviewText: This is a large gift set that would make a nice present at a baby shower or to give to a new Mom. It includes a 2-in-1 cleanser, a bubble bath, a no-rinse cleanser gel and a bottle of lotion with a pump. All of it is made to be gentle on a baby's skin and can also be used by adults with sensitive skin as well. They are lighly scented as to avoid triggering anyone's allergies and each bottle is easy to open. Best of all, the box can be reused as it is thick with a window, so you could use it as a photo box or to store other items. This is a lovely set and my only small criticism is that I hope the boxes come in different colors, as the blue color is usually associated with boys, though most people today think of most things as gender neutral.
summary: Set of Bathtime Gels and Lotions Made for Baby's Skin, Packaged in a Big, Reusable Box

reviewText: There is no denying the time tested cuddle factor of baby scented perfume, and this set will bring that urge to any one with a heart. This comes in a gift box and once the outer package is off and bottles out the remaining flip cover box is a nice catch all or photo box. The bottles themselves are a flip top blue colored scented bubble bath that does bubble, the scent is not to over powering. A two in one gel hair and skin cleaner that is white thick pearl lotion formula. Rinses away easily. A no rinse cleaner that is clear liquid, similar to micro water, for on the go clean up. Then a baby scented lotion white in color and in a handy pump bottle, that with a twist of the dispenser can be locked to not dispense so you can throw it in your bag if needed. Over all a nice starter set that comes in full sized bottles.
summary: Baby scent cuddle factor, nice gift set.

reviewText: This is a very nice set.  It has items in it that go in your diaper bag, to use for in between bath time messes, as well as bubble bath that is very "fluffy" making bath time lots of fun! My little one has sensitive skin, but all of these products worked very well to cleanse and moisturize her skin without drying it out too much.  It has a nice, subtle, neutral scent that is very nice.  The gift set itself would make a lovely gift as well. Overall, very nice skin care set.

I never would have tried the Bioderma products before they came up in Vine, I'd never actually heard of them outside of MakeupAlley reviews. My fallback body lotion has been CeraVe and Cetaphil. I recently had a body-wide skin flareup of unreal proportions, scaly dry and itchy on my arms, legs, face. The CeraVe and Cetaphil old faithfuls weren't cutting it, they felt waxy and like they stayed on the surface of my skin. I'd still feel itchy tight and dry 'underneath'. It was driving me nuts. I even broke out the shea butter and coconut oil straight, no dice. Castor oil, nope. Benadryl in several forms---nope. The Bioderma stuff arrived within a few days of each other and as I started using them I finally, finally got some relief from the tight dry feeling and the red scaly itching started to subside. I compared this to my 'last ditch CeraVe body cream' and found it to be comparable in price. There's no reason I won't be reordering this wonderful body cream!!! Just one pump does both my arms and I get an instant cooling, soothing feeling. My skin stays feeling comforted and moisturized. I'm sold on not only this body lotion but a few other of their products as well. I'd been suffering this flareup for over a week and within two days my skin started to calm down and the redness was subsiding. SOLD SOLD SOLD.
summary: I'll never go back to CeraVe or Cetaphil body lotion ever again.

reviewText: This really is a different type of cream.  My husband and I used this on various areas of itchy, cracked skin and also some small patches of wounds.  It has a different texture and consistency from any cream I've used.  It's not greasy, yet thick and moist.  I'm not sure if it 'cures" anything, but there is some relief now and hope to discover significant results after a few months.

I have very difficult dry skin due to a health issue & genetics and also have eczema on occasion. My skin really loves this lotion, it sinks in a bit deeper and leaves less residue than other body lotions I've used. I also love that it's fragrance free, I work outdoors and sometimes fragrance can attract insects, which is a real pain! Nothing like being attacked by no seeums because you happen to smell like a big flower, boy they love perfume. My skin needs a better quality lotion than I can find OTC, and this one competes well with those I've purchased from spas. In fact, I believe Bioderma is a product that's carried in spas, but I'm not entirely sure.

I like to give a good exfoliation to my skin before using ANY product because it just wouldn't be fair to review it any other way with a thick layer of dead skin preventing decent absorption. I also like to shave my legs, etc. because my skin tends to resist any appliaction of lotion if I have 'stubble'. Doing both of these preps makes a big difference, and I noticed that my freshly scrubbed and shaven skin doesn't sting after applying this lotion, so it's gentle. That's an important point since my skin can stay irritated for hours and days once it gets started down that path. I also don't notice any ingrown hair(s) which can happen to me quite readily the day after shaving if a product clogs my pores. So far that hasn't happened so I'm very pleased.

The spots where I have eczema (right now an elbow and knee) do seem softer and less red and irritated. This is a more occlusive lotion that keeps water from evaporating from the surface of the skin and doesn't depend on a lot of oils to moisturize. However, it does contain mineral oil so people with acne on the body might have an issue with this ingredient. I'd do a patch test if this is the case just to be on the safe side. Otherwise, this product really works well for my dehydrated skin and I love that it isn't sticky (won't stain my clothing in hot weather) and does a great job of absorbing well into my skin.

I love this lotion/cream!  I have used so many lotions over the years from Eucerine (which is too heavy & sticky for me) to Aveeno oatmeal to straight olive oil which is just messy.  I have very sensitive eczema prone skin and am always looking for something that will hydrate and nourish.

Well, so far I am IN LOVE with Bioderma Atoderm Cream.  I use it straight out of the shower and my skin has NEVER been so hydrated.  It isn't too thick but it isn't super thin.  It is kind of like Eucerine but on the lighter side and non greasy.  My skin literally soaked this up and feels SO SOFT and ZERO irritation. I will definitely be keeping this one around. What a rare find!  Love it!
summary: GENTLE my Eczema prone skin LOVES this cream

reviewText: This is a very nice, non-greasy skin cream for head to toe use. It is absolutely fragrance free. It goes on easily to wet or dry skin. It definitely promotes a smooth and hydrated skin. I keep this in my work locker for after shower use and it is just ideal for sensitive skin as well as for anyone avoiding fragrance filled products. I am new to this brand but have been very impressed with the quality of the products.
summary: Excellent head to toe skin care, no fragrance.

reviewText:
Im a older wonen and the skin on my legs lately has looked and felt lawfully  dry. I have So many body lotions, and Body butters etc. but
The bioderma has worked the best. I have to say, Im amazed!
I also have Lichen Planus , which is itchy little spots on my legs, and a little on my arms, and neck.
So far my legs do not look scaley, dry, and Biodema has cut down on The itchiness! Im thrilled.
My hands also look and feel smoother, and not dry.
I have not put this on my face, as my face is oily, and I have other creams for my face.

5 star
summary: Legs are not dry & scaley, Lichen planus less itchy.

reviewText:
I tore into this as soon as it arrived. I have had the worst itchy skin this year. Bioderma is a thick cream, no scent, It goes on smoothly and absorbs well. My skin felt soft all day. When I shower, there is a film washing off--that's some thick lotion.
I recommend for dry skin sufferers.

No complaints here. Used on pretty dry skin, provided moisture for the rest of the day.

NOTE:
Goes on thick, but not overly greasy. blends in just fine.
Smells "Clinical" upon initial application, but this doesn't last but a moment. After that, it is basically odorless.

So, I love Bioderma products.  Simply love them.  And this cream is no exception.

This is luxurious, super soft cream that leaves your skin perfectly moisturized.

It's scent free and paraben free and it smooths into your skin wonderfully.  Especially good for winter skin and dry elbows/knees.

While terrific after bath, you can even use it daily on face and neck with wonderful results.

This has quickly become my go to.

And according to their website, the cream is even appropriate for children and babies!

Love this!
summary: Good for Kids and Babies Too!

reviewText: Once I hit my sixties, my skin really dried out. Since then Ive been on an elusive search looking for products that actually work well and are non-comedogenic. So far, Bioderma products rate very high on my list. Atoderm crme is an especially nice all-purpose lotion. Its consistency is lightweight and creamy, and Im happy with end resultsmy arms and legs aren't itchy anymore and when applied immediately after a shower, my body stays hydrated and comfortable throughout the day. It truly is fragrance-freetoo often other brands make that claim, but a scent can still be detected. This crme clashes with nothing and doesnt offend sensitive skin or noses. My face is a bit more troublesome though being outdoors dries it out even more, and frequently reacts to creams by breaking out. Ive had good luck using Bioderma Hydrabio Moisturizing Face Cream for Dry Skin 1.67 fl. oz.. Both are excellent products for specific target areas, and theyve completely taken care of my middle-age dry skin problem.
summary: Takes Care Of Middle-Age Dry Skin

reviewText:
This is an excellent NONSCENTED lotion.  It's a generously sized bottle too.  The pump dispenser pumps enough for both hands, or one arm.  It is a white lotion that is easy to dispense and apply. On my sin, which is soft but dry, it just absorbs right in.  It feels a bit greasy but that only lasts a couple of minutes, then my skin feels hydrated, soft, and smooth.

My husband's skin is like leather though- when he put some on, it began to look more like oil than lotion for a minute as his skin resisted absorbing it initially, which was quite different from my experience.  He had to work a bit harder to get it applied, but with a bit of massage, his skin began to absorb it and he commented on how good it felt.  Normally he doesn't like lotion, or sunscreen, but he's always working outside- hence the leathery skin.  He really liked that it wasn't scented, and that it felt soothing to him.

The effects lasts for hours, so it's not one that you put on, and then you need more in 30 minutes. It softened my sandpaper elbows up in 2 applications.
summary: Unscented lotion that is very emollient and works for hours

reviewText: Fragrance free and extremely effective when it comes to moisturizing dry skin. Spring is always a time when my super dry winter skin begins to heal a bit, due to changes in the weather. This spring refuses to come, and so my winter skin dryness is hanging around. I have never even heard of this product line before trying it now. This Bioderma Cream is a bit heavier than what I usually use and possibly because of that, it keeps working longer. I don't find it to be sticky or impossible to absorb, but it seems to take a minute or so to soak in.  Once a day application will keep my skin smooth all day long. I love that it is fragrance free.

After one application of bioderma lotion my skin was less dry than its been all winter, and I have used a variety of other well regarded products. This is, by far, the best lotion for dry skin I have ever used. The good news is a little goes a long way.
Naturally, when you find something that really clears up your dry skin it also prevents any itchiness that might be occurring at the same time.
I know people say its fantastic for your face but I have only tried it on my body and its just been amazing.
summary: Probably the best remedy for dry skin I have ever used.

reviewText:
I like this and the other Bioderma products I've used. Bioderma has an enormous line of skincare products, color coded for one's skin type. This one is from the Atoderm line.

One applies this cream right after cleaning skin. It's fragrance free. There's a separate scented version too. For me this is a reliable long-term skincare cream. It works for me.

Instead of this 500 ml pump bottle, one can go with Bioderma's 200 ml tubes.
summary: Reliably protects skin from dehydration and provides a measure of relief from atopic dermatitis.

reviewText: great
Good
Very pretty color, fast shipping, what more could you ask for.
Super pretty! So close in color to the Too Faced Love Hangover shade, but cheaper! Plus you get more product!
summary: Super pretty! So close in color to the Too ...

reviewText:
Remember the old Bain de Soliel commercials - with the uber-thin, rich looking woman plunging into a turquoise pool somewhere in the French Riviera?  Those commercials always made me want to buy Bain de Soliel, because I wanted that Saint Tropez tan.  Hell, I wanted that woman's lifestyle.

This sunscreen feels and smells the way I imagine sunscreen used by the Rich and Famous feels and smells.

I know that sounds ridiculous, but this sunscreen has a satiny feel and just smells rich.  It comes out oily but as you rub it into your skin, it transforms to a satiny, almost matte consistency.

I did find that I had to apply the product more frequently than other sunscreens I have used, but frankly I don't care. I like the whole Saint Tropez fantasy this product inspires!

This product smells good, but in this day and age is 15 SPF really enough?  It depends on you the customer.  I can see some people really liking this product because the way it smells makes you think of sunny tropical days and an age when we didn't know how harmful the sun can be.  We thought SPF 15 was actually a high protection.  Those days of innocence are over.  Now a days for most people SPF 15 would not be enough. However, for those that are trying to get a serious tan or don't plan to be out long in the sun, this may be the perfect product.

The only critism is the container.  I had problems opening it the first time.  I had to take a dinner knife and force the top off because it had somehow stuck to the bottle's spritzer.  Then, some leaked a little as I was dpoing all this.  Finally I got it all to work and never had a problem since.

Living in Central NY with all the rain it took me awhile before I was able to try this product. Finally got a nice stretch of weather and I've tried the Hampton Sun Tanning Gel a couple of times now. I spray it on and sit in the sun for about an hour. I have noticed that I get nice color, without burning, in that hour. The gel feels nice...if you like the feel of tanning oil this feels about the same. I already had some base color before I started using this product. I think if you have lighter color skin you might burn using this product if you don't already have a base tan. The gel smells nice also. While overall I'm happy with this product, I would not pay the money they are asking for it as there are cheaper products that pretty much work the same.

I am sort of a redhead, though along with my not-quite-carrottop hair, I have not-entirely-pale skin, and I tan just a bit. I should wear sunscreen a lot more than I do, but I really really really really hate sunscreen. This product is a win for me because it smells nice and is pleasant like a moisturizer instead of gloppy like most sunscreens. I know it's only SPF15, but that is way better than nothing. So I have been really glad to stumble onto this product. Pros: 1. Smells pleasant. Still with a whiff of "suntan lotion", but it doesn't scream this. 2. Goes on well and absorbs well, and seems like it's happy-making for moisturizing my skin. Cons: 1. Pricey, but the advantages do help compensate. Since I won't use most sunscreens, this is a win for me, and I'm happy to discover it. I notice that there is an SPF 30 version: Hampton Sun SPF 30 Tanning Lotion, 4.0 Ounce, and I will try that next.
summary: A win for me, who can't stand sunscreen

reviewText:
This is, of course, not a sunscreen but a tanning gel, with just a minimum of UVA/UVB protection, and "vitamins A through E". You definitely want to have a base tan before using this product.

It's easy to apply. Just spray on and rub it in. It feels a little oily when you first put it on, but it is absorbed quickly. I like using it on my arms and legs, but I prefer stronger protection for my face. I've had no unpleasant skin reactions from using this product. The fragrance is nice, and not too overwhelming. If you put your skin right up to your nose, you can almost smell something like bug repellent, but when you're not up that close the smell is pleasant.

A "healthy tan" is a little bit of an oxymoron. Coloring  often gives the skin a more vivid, alive and healthy  appearance. But a tan is really the skin detecting it is under attract by something potentially harmful,  sending melanin, the skin's coloring agent, to the surface to darken the skin to help protect it against the radiation from the sun's rays. The same radiation that's triggers the skin darkening reaction is also subtly doing damage to skin cell DNA which can lead to premature aging and far worse, evident often only years later.  Before we knew better it was standard practice to slather on oils before laying out in the sun which essentially is the same recipe for frying a steak. The current medical advise is usually to do everything to protect the skin from the harmful UV rays with a substantial SPF rating along with limiting exposure and reapplying often. This product offers a mixture of ingredients that combine a more modest SPF rating of 15 for current thinking protection, with oils that intensify the sun's effect on the skin, old school thinking. The product is applied via a spray pump. It goes on evenly and feels very light on the skin,,offering a light pleasant fragrance as well. There are ingredients also purported to be beneficial  for the skin though these are in very small amounts. The product will help achieve a deeper tan so I gave it four out of five stars because it accomplishes its stated purpose. One star was withheld because of the seemingly high price in relation to it's competitors. If it is used to cover the entire body and is reapplied as is recommended, it would seem like the product might be exhausted after not many sessions. The current advise is that one application should use about a whiskey shot glass quantity of a product. Having any SPF rating at all might also give a person a false sense of protection. The directions specifically say it should be used if a base tan already exists, further indicating it's protection component is not very strong. In all, this seems to be a quality product whose ingredients will help produce a desired tan. Be aware, though, that it probably should be used only for limited sun exposure times.  If you want your skin to remain youthful and healthy in the long run, it would be wise to consider a product with a higher SPF rating for greater peace of mind.

reviewText: It's taken some time to write this review because the sun has been in short supply, but in the 2 times I've used the product , I really like it. It is advertised as a tanning gel, but it is more of a very light weight dry oil. The tanning oil absorbs into the skin immediately leaving a very pleasant fragrance on the skin. There is no heavy, oily feeling to this product. The product is advertised as an SPF 15, but I would definitely reapply liberally, if spending any length of time in the sun. I love the product, just need some sun to use it.

Yes, it is that time for sunscreen again, but note this product does not promote itself as a serious sun protection gel, rather it calls itself an SPF 15 Tanning Gel.  That should alert you right there, this has pretty minimal protection.  I liked the idea of it as I often get too lazy to slap thick white sunscreen on when I go outside, but figured I would be more likely to spray this light gel on before going out.  It smells good and doesn't leave you feeling like you just put car oil all over your body, but I was hoping it would be a lot more natural.  It's 3 main "protecting" ingredients are Octinoxate, Octisalate and Oxybenzone.  Octinoxate and Oxybenzone block UVA rays by reflecting them, but they are also penetration enhancers that allow other chemicals to penetrate into your skin better. Oh yippee for that.  I read that they are linked to developmental and reproductive toxicity, and oxybenzone has been linked to cancer and harming the immune system.[...]  I don't necessarily believe everything I read, but I am also not comfortable spreading penetrating chemicals over my body anymore.

I guess it depends what you want to believe is good or bad for you these days.  It is easy enough to do research on the computer and make your own decisions.  This product clearly states what it is and what is in it.  I think it is clear that it is not for fair skinned folk or people who think it will protect them all day out in the sun.  Why complain it doesn't work like an SPF 30 when it doesn't claim it will?  I like the way is smells and goes on, but I will keep looking for a more natural but effective product.

When I first sprayed on this gel formula, I thought it felt a bit on the oily side, which is why I usually go for a cream in my tanning products. I was pleasantly surprised to see that it absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving a nice, silky finish. The spray-on feature makes for easy application to all areas of the body, although I didn't NOT use it on my face.

Containing ingredients such as Oxybenzone are crucial to blocking out the rays that will cause burning and also cancer, so I knew this product would give me great protection. I already had a slight base tan, and I do recommend that anyone using it do as well.  Even though it is an spf 15, it is not a complete BLOCK and you will still get some of the sun's rays-just not the harmful ones.

It has a very pleasant smell to it, which I liked as well as the  slight shimmer it left on my skin.

I would stress again, that only people with a base tan that want to increase their skin tone and not have a complete block use this product.

I saw the Hampton Sun SPF 15 Tanning Gel and decided to try it on my face and arms. I spent the last two or so weeks in 112 temps in Las Vegas. Typically I would have put on the Bull Frog and gotten very lightly tanned. I used this on my face and arms when I was out for 30 minutes or less since it has an SPF of only 15. It is designed for the serious tanner! One of the things I really liked about it was it didn't feel heavy and greasy when put on. It absorbed well and as an added bonus smelled good. I did have to reapply it more frequently than the Bullfrog, but expected this. I ended up after two weeks with a nice tan on my upper body. I probably will continue to use this on my face and since my skin is now the shade I would like it to be--use the Bullfrog on my arms and legs!

In my cabinet, I have two types of sunblock or sunscreen: the heavy-duty type for swimming or for instances where I expect to sweat heavily, and the type that I use for everyday, brief sun exposures, when I walk to my office and back, and perhaps get some sun during my lunch hour.

Despite its luxurious look and name, this product belongs in the latter category. It's not made for the beach, despite its name and SPF. The lotion is light and absorbs easily, but it isn't water resistant, perhaps because its formulation allows you to get a nice tan while protecting you from the sun.

As someone who doesn't like to tan and would have been happy with more resistant sunblock, I found this a little annoying, as the item wasn't openly branded as such. The price is pretty high, so you're paying more for the cachet of using a brand that looks upscale and hence, popular among those who tan and see it as a status symbol.

I didn't mind the scent, but I wouldn't order this again because of its limited usefulness for my sunblock needs.

reviewText:
It is a bit challenging to get overly excited about any particular lotion, including one with an alleged boatload of benefits.  This lotion goes on well, has the minimum recommended SPF, and, if you like that sort of thing, a decent odor.  On the negative side, the cost is quite high relative to lotions that are purely sun blocks.

The lotion goes on smoothly and easily.  The odor seems relatively mild when outside where the breeze tends to blow the smell away.  We can see situations where people with a sensitive nose could find the odor overpowering, particularly when used on large areas of skin.  The color, which is light, tends to disappear as the lotion is spread on the skin.

The lotion allegedly has antioxidants and aloe extracts.  We are unsure how beneficial such are given the application on the skin.  Aloe allegedly has healing benefits, but we suspect that the term antioxidants is thrown about even without a defined or measurable benefit.

The lotion is supposed to be put on about a half hour before sun exposure.  We are unsure of the reason for the wait.  By the time a half hour has passed, the water in the lotion has pretty much evaporated, leaving the sun block and whatever solids remain, presumably including the antioxidants and aloe extract.

One downside to this lotion is that it is relatively fragile.  The lotion comes off in water and a towel rubs it off easily.  Presume that it will need to be reapplied regularly when outside for long periods.

Frankly, while the lotion seems fine and may have the alleged benefits, we just do not value the benefits enough for the price.  There are many sunscreen or sunblock lotions available at a substantially lower price, including those that are water resistant.  Those other lotions may not have the antioxidants and magic foo foo dust of this lotion, but we have to wonder whether the benefits of the magic dust are such that this lotion is worth the asking price.  We tend to think not.

Good luck!
summary: Generally a fine lotion, but we think the price is high

reviewText: I tried out Hampton Sun SPF 30 Lotion during an afternoon at the pool with my boys.  It smells and feels like a luxury suntan lotion with what I found to be a pleasant perfumed scent.  Unfortunately, prior to use, I failed to read the super-tiny fine print on the back of the bottle, Use a water resistant sunscreen if swimming or sweating.  This leaves me questioning the point of this suntan lotion, especially as someone living in south Texas.  If I go out in the sun, Im going to sweat, and if I take my boys to the pool, Im going to want to get in the water.  Even not using this sunscreen as directed, I tanned rather than burned during the couple of hours spent at the pool, in and out of the water, but that could be attributed to my genetics more than this lotion.  Its really more for sunbathing somewhere where you aren't going to sweat.  Im still sort of scratching my head at that one, but if you are a sunbather, sunbathing somewhere you aren't going to sweat or hop in the pool, this is a nicely perfumed suntan lotion that feels good on your skin.  If you are actually going to do more than bask in the suns golden glow, Im thinking a waterproof sunscreen is more the way to go.
summary: Only for Sunbathing, Not Sweating or Swimming

reviewText:
Remember in the 80s how people would apply tanning *oil* instead of sunscreen, to *increase* the effects of the sun on their body? This lotion does a bit of that, by including oils along with the sunscreen, so the effects may well counteract each other a bit. Overall it actually seems like a fairly average sun protector--it smells like most sunscreens you're familiar with (no heavy coconut smell, but it does have the typical chemical smell you'll notice if you're more used to natural sunscreens like Blue Lizard), so nothing particularly special apart from "less heavily scented." The price strikes me as a bit outrageous, and for something luxury I'd expect a bit more than nice packaging plus added oil.

On the plus side, if you do decide to indulge, there's a pump at the top that puts out a single dime-sized amount at a time, so you're unlikely to use the entire bottle in one sitting (though you may go through the whole thing in a couple of days at the beach with family). The downside of that is that you may end up using less than you truly need, resulting in even more... sun on your skin.

So although I'm a fan of luxury items, I'd recommend indulging elsewhere.
summary: not worth the price; includes tanning *oil* with the sunscreen

As for the actual lotion, the smell is very offputting for me, a combination of chemicals, fruity fragrances, and it actually makes me nauseous.  This has a SPF of 30, but it is really not a sunscreen, just a layer between your skin and the sun that is water soluble, so if you perspire or swim, it will wash off of the body.  The bottle has a warning to use a waterproof sunscreen if you will be getting wet and it also warns to not keep this bottle in the sun or heat.  In other words, be sure to keep this in your cooler if you take it outside with you.  I was unfamiliar with Hampton Sun products and cannot recommend this particular product to people who want to protect their skin from cancer or aging.  For those who are not sensitive to fragrances and are keen on getting a tan, perhaps this will work for you.  I will continue to use this on my legs, but I cannot apply it to other body parts because I really dislike the smell.
