reviewText:
I've been told that I look younger than my real age and that's not by a sycophantic nephew hoping to inherit the billions I've accumulated during my years as a teacher.  However, the closer you get to me, the more the eyes tell another story.  (And, of course, the mouth wrinkles, but that's a tale for another day because the product under review is for eyes.)

You young whippersnappers in your 30s, 40s, and 50s don't really know yet what tired eyes look like.  Past the 60 mark, even a good night's sleep doesn't help much.  That's why I'm always looking for good eye creams or serums.  I'm happy to report that this is one of them.

This has many things going for it that make it appealing:  1) The ingredients are touted to be organic.  2)  The stem cell ingredients here are not the ones conservatives object to.  They're *fruit* stem cells.  3)  No parabens, propylene or butylene glycols, petroleum sulfates, PEGs, TEA, DEA, GMO, phthalates, silicones, pesticides, artificial dyes or fragrances.

So what are the ingredients?  There are really too many to name here but, just to name a few, there are fruit stem cells and fruit juices;  aloe;  oils such as jojoba seed, sunflower seed, primrose, linseed, borage seed;  shea butter;  Vitamins C, E and B5;  hyaluronic acid;  and there are a few multisyllabic products that appear to be preservatives and emulsifiers but of the relatively harmless variety.

What are the benefits to expect?  1)  Firming effect with improved skin tone and elasticity.  2)  Hydration.  3)  Reduced puffiness.  4)  Reduced dark circles.  5)  Reduction in fine lines and wrinkles.

I have to say that all the hype for this product may be on the money.  It works for me.  Using this, I'm at optimal eye  "beauty" (less puffiness, reduction in dark circles, and smoother skin around the eyes).  I think it's the best I can look without plastic surgery.  Just don't put me next to a 20- or 30-something, please.  That's not a fair comparison.  Everything in life is relative.
summary: Works on my 68-yr-old eyes.  Just imagine what it can do for yours.

reviewText:
Wow -- this eye serum is fantastic.  From the very first application, it works well to tighten the skin around my eyes and give it a silky texture.  Even better, my extremely sensitive skin tolerates it well enough for me to use it every day.

The applicator takes a few tries to get used to, mostly because it needs to be primed.  You also must pull on the trigger and then sweep the wand over your skin.  (At first, I tried to expel the eye treatment by pressing it against my skin.  Ouch.)  The serum glides on effortlessly.  You can feel the tingle within seconds.

I like that Juice Beauty uses organic and natural ingredients to improve the look of the delicate skin around the eye.  It's soothing, brightening, and tightening, all without irritation.

-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann
summary: Starts Working From the First Application!

reviewText: This product has a very cool applicator, once you have it primed you just barely pump it and it will slide onto the skin under your eyes very easily and the wand will smooth it on for you.  No wasted product on your hands!  I noticed a difference in skin tone after the first application and by the 3rd I did notice my circles under my eyes were looking better.  That's some pretty quick work in my opinion.  Product does not burn or tingle, just feels cool like a cream would.  If this product continues to perform this way, it will be worth the money to get rid of my under eye circles.  Will update after a month or so of use and see if the results are lasting, but so far so good!

So far, so good! I like that the ingredient list is made with natural products. I am not one for jump on the bandwagon for every serum or lotion that promises to get rid of my imperfections but I thought, hey, I'll give this a try. I had not previously been using any eye cream or serum so this is from a newbie of this sort of product. I have dark circles and the beginnings of slight lines around my eyes. I found this product made the area around my eye a bit softer and thus making it easier to apply eye liner and concealer. I have sensitive skin which is why I usually only use coconut oil on my skin but this didn't irritate. The applicator is odd and so you end up using your finger to apply but that's ok by me. I'm anxious to see the results after more time.
summary: so good! I like that the ingredient list is made ...

reviewText:
I've only been using this for about five days so I can't yet speak to the long-term effects of using this, but I'll be sure to update my review as I use it more.  For now, I really like this product and it de-puffs the undereye area really quickly.

As a 43-year-old who suffers from seasonal allergies and deals with dry undereye skin, I'm always on the lookout for moisturizing products that soothe the delicate area around my eyes.  This eye treatment does so beautifully.  You pump out a small amount by pushing down on the applicator, and then use the applicator to gently massage the serum into your skin.

The consistency really is more like a serum than a cream; it sinks right in, and doesn't leave your skin feeling sticky or tight in any way.  In fact, a few minutes after applying it, I can't even feel it on my skin -- which makes it perfect to use in the morning before applying makeup.  I apply this and my regular face creams and let them sink before I apply my body lotion, and then by the time I'm ready to do my makeup, this has sunk in.  It doesn't cause your undereye concealer to pill or ball up.

I also love the fact that Juice Beauty products rank low on the EWG list, and that they don't contain parabens, petroleum products, sodium lauryl sulfates (which act like detergents on the skin, stripping away its moisture barrier), pesticides, phthalates, or artificial fragrances.  Their products are also never tested on animals.

Again, I'll be sure to update my review as I use this more, but, for now, I love how soothing it feels and how quickly it works to plump and soothe the delicate undereye area.
summary: Helps with undereye puffiness and easy to apply makeup over it

reviewText: So far I'm impressed.  I not only had circles and bags around and under my eyes, I had red circles around my eyes.  This product stung a little the first time or two I used it, but that is no longer a problem.  It is light and absorbs well; it doesn't show under make up.  No scent that I can tell.  It's expensive, but if you are bothered by bags or circles it may be worth it to you to give it a try.  I gave it four stars because I think it really needs a longer trial to be absolutely sure how good it works.

Creamy and long lasting but light and readily absorbed, this eye area moisturizer has a pleasant smell and is a joy to use. By the end of the day my skin still feels soft, not tight.

The slim tube it comes in fits easily into a purse or bag and it has a unique applicator tip that can be used directly on the skin if you'd rather not get your fingers involved.

I prefer to use natural beauty products and Juice Beauty Cellular Repair Eye Treatment has a stellar list of ingredients that make it almost sound edible. In the past I've had trouble with moisturizers that have irritated my eyes or skin, but I've had no problems with this. Lovely product.
summary: Creamy, light, readily absorbed, long lasting

reviewText: I love the consistency of Juice Beauty, it's a gel that stays put and doesn't end up IN my eyes like many eye products do. That's important for me since I wear contact lenses at times. It stays put under makeup and doesn't cause my eye makeup to "migrate" (resulting in raccoon eyes) the way other eye products do. It has a lovely light gel feeling that seems to firm up the skin under the eyes, diffusing fine lines and wrinkles. The thing I REALLY love about this product is that it's fragrance free. I can never understand why cosmetic companies feel the need to put fragrance in a product that's being applied around the eyes but many do! This one doesn't, it is very appropriate for sensitive skin, and has wonderful "clean" ingredient list as well. I am new to Juice Beauty, but I plan on investing in more of their products when I need to replenish my kit. Highly & enthusiastically recommended!

I have very sensitive skin, and I am happy to report that this eye treatment did not irritate my skin at all. It is not a miracle product, and it did not make me look 20 years younger overnight, but I do see some improvement. My skin around eyes looks smoother and more even.
I do not like the applicator, the pump works inconsistently - sometimes I need to push on it several times, and then too much product comes out, but sometimes it works just fine. You can use the round tip to apply it around your eyes, but I like it better to use my finger.
In about 2-3 seconds after application, the area starts to feel heat, and it lasts for a few minutes, then it feels cold for a few more minutes. It is quite puzzling, but I kind of started to like it. It does not make eye area red and just feels warm and then cool. It absorbs very well, and does not feel greasy or sticky afterwards.

The application piece is really cool. You don't need to touch your eyes with your finger. But when you squirt it out it doesn't stay on the applicator. I put this on before going to bed and my eyes were very puffy in the morning, I suggest using this in the morning. I have been using it for awhile and have noticed very little difference in my dark circles or bags. I love eye products because I have a family history of very saggy, puffy shrinking eyes with age. I will keep using this and update if there is any change.

After 20 minutes of battling with this container, I STILL could not get anything to come out.  It has a weird applicator.  And unlike other creams, there's no way that I can figure out to remove the strange applicator to actually get to the product, because the pump thing that's supposed to apply it clearly doesn't work.

My fingers hurt from trying to pump the thing for so long, and I think I would have to actually break it to get inside of it.  I don't even want to use it now, it's infuriating.
summary: Won't even come out of the stupidly designed container!

reviewText: Now that I am in my twenties, I have began using products to prevent fine lines and aging. The Stem Cellular Eye Treatment is great to reduce lines if you already have then and prevent them if you don't. Non irritating and it smells nice too! Great product with great ingredients.
summary: I have began using products to prevent fine lines and aging

reviewText: Love this moisturizer

While I'm not a great fan of Juice's CC cream, this stuff is actually pretty nifty. It's a solid moisturizer with a pleasant scent that fades quickly - and doesn't make me break out. Can't honestly say I've noticed any real difference in my skin's condition (I've been using it for several weeks) but honestly, I've found that nothing lives up to that kind of hype - so it's not like I'm disappointed.
summary: While I'm not a great fan of Juice's CC cream

reviewText: No difference between this and the cheap stuff. I like that it's organic...but for the price, no way.

I'll start the review by saying that I recognize the value of using a daily moisturizer and SPF cream for your face.
Overall I'd say that I can see the benefits now of using one daily for many years. Generally, my skin looks better than most my age. Not a boast, just my anecdotal evidence that it pays to start a regular routine of SPF and moisturizer when you are  young.

That being said I am particular about moisturizers, especially at this price point and above unless they meet every one of my criteria.  And if they miss on a specific attribute then I find one that has all of the things I want.

So, here we have just such a situation.  I was very pleased by the high quality packaging and design.  Clearly the company spent a lot of time and attention to the packaging and it shows.
The jar itself has a very unique dispenser that I still enjoy using.

Now to the lotion itself.  I love the citrus scent and enjoy how long it lingers. It smells mostly like lemons but other citrus notes are clearly present. Very refreshing but not overbearing.

The texture is nice but thick. The thickness helps it spread evenly and broadly. A little goes a long way here.
The bad news is that the thick cream had me sweating the moment I walked outside.  I've used other creams this thick with similar results.  Typically I can't use them any longer because it becomes so uncomfortable.
In the humidity of Florida its something to consider. Fortunately, we are heading into fall so it was only bad for a couple of weeks.

I haven't had any issues with breaking out which often results from such a heavy cream combined with the sweating.  I did break out on my neck in two places but not sure this was the result of the cream.
The other issue I have is that there is no SPF in the cream so for me that's a deal breaker for use during the day.
Considering the weight and the lack of SPF this is probably better suited as a night moisturizer.

After using it for a little over a month now I still like the product overall but I couldn't buy it again based on how thick it is.  However, if you have unusually dry skin and/or live in a less humid environment this may not be a factor for you at all.
I like the way my skin feels from using it and can tell when I have forgotten to apply it.  But that is common to most products I use.
I can't say that I notice any difference or improvement in firmness or wrinkle reduction as they claim. And I doubt anyone really can over the short term.  But as I said it really pays off in the long term. So use something...

All in, I like this product and it delivers on most of its promises.  But I likely wouldn't repurchase it based on the thickness, lack of SPF and the price point.

Pros
Beautiful packaging worthy of the price
Fantastic smell
Creamy feel
All day benefit
Not greasy considering weight

Cons
Weight causes sweating
no SPF
No noticeable results in the short term

Update 02.10.15: I have used this daily since I received it and still have product left. It seems like it is dispensing less so I am probably getting to the end but still not out.  So, going on three months and still have product to use.
summary: Very nice moisturizer with a couple of minor drawbacks

reviewText:
This product has many of the "in" ingredients for the skin - and at least some are not just "in", but also proven effective.

It was kind of a surprise when I took the top off to find out that it is a pump container. Liked this over the usual jar.

When I got some of the product out, I noticed it smelled a little like grapes juice maybe - it does have some grape derived ingredient I think. In any case, it was a refreshing kind of scent. A bit heavier than what I'd prefer, but not over the top.

It went on an into my skin easily and made it look and feel a lot smoother than it had been. Stayed that way a while.

The current amazon price is $65 for 1.7 oz. That is a lot of money, but if the product works very well, it may be worth it. Will have to try this out longer term and report back. I'll give it four stars for now - subject to upgrade later.

After using this my skin feels great. The smell is actually really nice as well which is a surprise. I'm used to pretty terrible smelling products for my skin. I've had skin issues my whole life: eczema, intense acne, etc. so I'm used to some really smelly products so I appreciate that especially.

My face feels more firm and I just feel like I'm wearing a more youthful me. It's a really nice product, highly recommend it.

I have been using this cream for two weeks, and there are several reasons that I love it:

1. It has a fresh, bright citrusy fragrance

2. It feels very light and absorbs quickly, making it easy to wear an spf on top during the day

3. It seems to improve the texture of my skin

How effective it is at treating signs of aging will be determined over the next few weeks of use, but I think I have already started seeing a difference already. I like this much better than the other department store brands I have been using; it feels cleaner and more natural.

I feel this product falls short of its promises.  While it may be organic certified and contain ingredients such as organic apple and white grape juice as well as organic oils, the name suggests "Stem Cell" which has other scientific connotations.  I do believe this is misleading.  While the moisturizer goes on without feeling greasy, I did not notice any cell turnover that you might see with other products containing Retin A or Glycolic acid.  I really did not notice any huge difference.  What probably I disliked the most about this product is the smell, very citrus, but not in a good way, more like an Old English lemon polish.

The first thing you will notice about this moisturizer is the unique pump. It works fine so far but , at this cost , you will want to get the last tiny little drop of the cream and I don't see a way to remove the cover/pump. Although the contents are clearly listed as 1.7 fl oz, the size of the jar gives the impression that you're getting much more product.

The ingredients are not listed on the jar and the printing on the box is so tiny you probably won't be able to read it so click on the thumbnail pictures to the left of the product page to read the ingredients. There is no sunscreen in the moisturizer which is an important consideration for me.

 I expected a citrus scent, considering the ingredients, but it smells sort of like lemon pledge or orange-glo cleaner. Not bad, just not what one would expect from a moisturizer. Really, who wants to smell like a coffee table?

As for results....the moisturizer goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. I like the way my face feels but, to be honest, I really can't tell that my skin looks any better than it does with another moisturizer I use which is about a third of the price for 1.7 oz and contains a sunscreen.
summary: I like it but no visible change in my skin

reviewText: Love this cream.  My skin does not feel greasy when I use it so i can use it during the day under makeup and at night, too. After a couple of weeks the tiny dark spots on my skin (sun related) are barely noticeable.  I like the lemon scent -- and like that it fades quickly so it doesn't fight with my perfume. I don't love the packaging - the press pump lid either delivers too much or too little and I have no idea how much is left.

When I first opened my shipment I was impressed with the unique design of the pump.  There is a button on the side that when you press, the perfect amount of moisturizer appears for you to apply.  I have never seen a pump like this before and hope that there is a way to make sure that I can get every drop of the formula out of the container as I use it.

I have used competitive moisturizers for several years now and I have to honestly say that I like the fresh scent of this product and the effects after using it for a couple of weeks have been noticeable.  The only reason I did not give the Juice Beauty Stem Cellular Moisturizer five stars was because I thought it was a little expensive for the amount you received and that I did not like the name.  When you first look at the product I can't help but wonder what kind of stem cells are being applied.  I read the list of ingredients and found that the formula is made up primarily of essential oil and organic fruit juices, the combinations seems to work for me.  I enjoy the pleasant citrus scent of the product and would continue using it if it were not so expensive for the amount that you get.  I'm not sure how long my 1.7 fl. oz. is going to stretch....

Benefits:
Fights free radical skin damage and firms skin with a proprietary blend of apple, grape & lemon fruit stem cells infused into organic resveratrol-rich grapeseed.

Hydrates and moisturizes skin with organic antioxidant-rich jojoba and shea.

Increases cellular turnover and improves skin luminosity with Vitamin C.

In clinical trials 100% reported improved hydration; 87.5% reported reduction in fine lines and wrinkles around eye area; 87.5% reported improved skin tone and luminosity; and 75% reported improved elasticity of the skin- I also noticed that my pores seemed to decrease in size.

I am extremely particular about my lotions and moisturizers.  Smell, bottle, feel and effectiveness must all be perfect for me to put it on my face.  Here's how Juice Beauty did:

Scent: Bright, fresh citrus! A real "wake me up" scent with no old-people-floral smell. So refreshing. A complete win for me.  The scent isn't detectable by my nose after a minute or so which is nice.

Bottle:  I HATE non-pump bottles.  Sticking my finger in a jar to scoop out lotion is equivalent to a bacteria-ridden-petri-dish in my mind.  While this product looks like a jar, it actually is a super cool pump.  Great design and the pump works very well.

Feel: Completely non-greasy and smoothly goes over my face and soaks right into the skin.  I adore the way this moisturizer makes my skin feel.

Effectiveness:  I have seen a reduction in my "beginning" wrinkles, my skin feels incredibly fresh and not at all dry after a long day at the beach.  I haven't broken out from this moisturizer (not true for every brand I've tried).

I have incorporated this into my beauty routine and will continue to do so. The fact that it is an organic product makes me feel so much better about slathering it on my face and the fact that it hasn't clogged my pores makes it a keeper.

It's hard to tell right away just what this will do for you. It's a moisturizer so at a minimum it meets that expectation. As with any beauty item I don't think it's a miracle worker.

For the size of the container you don't get near the amount of treatment that it would appear to have which makes this incredibly expensive. And not sure you really get enough in one container to tell if it will really work for you. My wife has tried it and it feels good to her but she was already beautiful so I can't tell if it did anything :)
summary: Expensive and so little in such a big container

reviewText:
This actually does a good job as a moisturizer.  I have fairly dry sun damage marks on my arms, legs and a couple on my face.  I moisturize my face daily, so it's difficult to notice a big difference on how this product works there.  But unfortunately I'm not nearly as diligent with my arms and legs.  So picked a few dried out spots on those areas and applied it once.  One application and those areas and wow, immediate difference and it lasted for days.  I never noticed a difference like this when applying body moisturizer.

After using it for about 10 days (twice a day for 2 days and once a day since), I can't say that I see a difference with the fine lines around my eyes.  The two spots on my face do appear to be somewhat lighter-looking in color.  My face also has a natural redness to it which also seems to have lightened somewhat.

I can't claim to like the smell which is like lemon scented cleaner.  It was more of an issue for me the first few days, but now if I don't think about the scent when applying it, I don't notice it anymore.

Amended 10/18:  The day after posting this review it suddenly became difficult to pump out any more product.  The jar itself still feels bottom heavy, but apparently I'm about out of product.  So if I'd used this as described, twice a day, this might have lasted only about 1 week.  There are benefits to using this product, but the majority of consumers won't be able to afford it.
summary: Does well as a moisturizer, but...

reviewText: This Juice Beauty stem cellular repair moisturizer was great: it dispensed well (from a bit of an odd pump on top), went on smooth, my skin just soaked it right in, and it left my face and neck feeling smooth and healthy. It smells strongly of fresh lemon, more overpowering than I would have expected, but not unpleasant. It definitely reminds one of organic and healthy...although I can't really vouch yet for any stem cell repair: I don't have any hugely visible difference yet after a few days. It seemed to cause kind of a mild acne outbreak though, which seemed to indicate that it was making my sensitive, normal-dry skin (with oily spots) to clear and begin repairs: this I actually liked because I can see where it's likely trending to improvements. Not sure yet if the overall improvements will be worth the price on a regular basis...but overall I really like the changes I'm beginning to see, so would recommend!
summary: Strong lemon, goes on great and face feels great after use!

reviewText:
11/13/2014:  Much to my disappointment as this really is a rich and delightfully scented cream, I found a week or so into its use that it was making my eyes water, as in wash away eye makeup water.  I am unable to continue using it!

First impression review: Let me state right up front that this cream is fabulous.  It has a delightful fruity smell which, unfortunately, does not linger long after application.  No need to rub this rich formulation across your skin--it literally glides on and a little goes a long way which is good considering the cost.  I have only used it for a few days so I can't speak to whether or not it  has favorable effects on skin appearance, but I assume other reviewers speaking favorably on the subject are pleased with their own experience.

That said, I'm wondering about this" proprietary fruit stem cell blend infused into a Vitamin C, resveratrol-rich grapeseed formula" business.  My understanding is that Vitamin C serum on your face is good, and resveratrol is a worthy anti-oxidant.  It took me awhile and a little creative searching on pubmed.com to tap into the botanicals-as-skin protectants research world after a "fruit stem cell" search on Google resulted in little but cosmetic industry nonsense.  There is a lot of research supporting the DNA reparative qualities of plant derivatives, particularly those from green tea, grapeseeds, lilacs, and Swiss apples all of which, apparently, are rich sources of polyphenols and proanthocyanidins . A lot of genetically twiddled mice bred to never grow hair spent a lot of time drinking green tea in their water bottles or having it slathered on their wrinkled, pink, hairless hides before exposure to UV light to prove that green tea is a super-duper protectant and repairer of sun-damaged DNA.  And the application of lilac leaf stem cell derivatives to sun-bathing colonies of human skin cells growing in petri dishes modulated UV damage to their DNA in a satisfying sort of way.  Human trials sunbathing with their hides still in place?  Well...there aren't any.

My conclusion?  Botanicals are good, but buying a luscious expensive cream filled with fruity goodness of uncertain strength and unsupported benefits is a luxury that I probably won't pursue on a regular basis.  I will, however, continue to drink a matcha green tea suspension, creepy green in color and faintly tasting of grass clippings based on an enormous amount of research evidence that green tea polyphenols are good for my skin and all the rest of me too.  Maybe I'll even spring for a $14 DIY instruction manual on making one's own antioxidant skin cream.

This is a very creamy and very moisturizing cream that will leave your skin feeling wonderfully soft.  While I haven't used it long enough to determine if the reported results will happen, my skin is left feeling very nice after I use this product.  I love the dispenser.  Some feel jars make product have a shorter shelf life because you are continually dipping into the product.

For me the major drawback of the product is the overwhelming scent.  Someone else described it as lemon pledge, I think that is a very close assessment of the product.  It is very strong.  I would consider not using this product due to the heavy scent.  Well packaged, creamy and moisturizing, but the overwhelming scent is too much for me.
summary: Will leave your skin soft, but with a heavy fragrance

reviewText:
While I've only been using this about 2 weeks, I do think that my skin looks good, especially considering we're fast approaching winter here and heaters tend to dry me out. Specifically, I notice that my foundation tends to go on a little more smoothly and my skin feels softer. My t-zone is also noticeably less oily, but I'm not sure if that is a result of this or a different powder I started using. A downside is that this isn't to go near the eyes, which is where most of my fine lines actually are, so this product cannot help that.

As for the application itself, it goes on fairly well, but seems a tiny bit tacky at first; fortunately, it soaks in quickly and becomes unnoticeable. I don't find it so moisturizing that I can skip facial lotion...which considering this doesn't have SPF, I would need to put that on, anyway.

The product itself smells very gingery with a slight trace of citrus, though it dissipates quickly. I find the scent pleasant, and I'm highly sensitive to perfumes, which makes me pretty sure the fragrance here is from essential oils, not chemically produced scents.

The packaging is both awesome and frustrating, and a major reason for the 4-star rating. You take off the lid and it has a large button for the pump on one side and a well where the product shoots up on the other. One push is about the perfect amount for me and I love that there is no waste and no nozzles to clog up...it's a really neat system. My concern is that I'm not sure if I can get the top off once product runs low. I tend to be thrifty and use up ALL of a product before moving on. This one costs a small fortune, so I would want every last drop. The best I can tell, I will probably have to destroy the package to make that happen.

My other (small) issue is the naming; I find "stem cellular" a bit misleading. I'm not sure what it means in the context of this product, but I'm pretty sure I'm not smearing plant stem cells on my face and making new skin. Of course, this is an issue with pretty much all beauty/skincare stuff, so it's par for the course. Still, annoying, though.

Still, overall, I've been pleased with this moisturizer and, depending on how long this jar lasts, I will likely repurchase in the future.

I never want to run out of this moisturizer because my skin has never looked better after using it.

My face feels great. My skin just drinks in the Juice Beauty Stem Cellular Repair Moisturizer. It isn't a heavy cream texture and doesn't leave my skin shiny at all. I am not as sensitive to skin-care fragrance as some, so I found the lemon-lime fragrance to be invigorating. The fragrance goes away fairly quickly, leaving soft, clean-feeling skin ready for make-up or just to leave as it is.

There are days when I like to give my skin a rest from make-up, but I think moisturizer is very wise.  Make-up goes on well and my skin still feels the refreshing effects of the moisturizer, even after my make-up is on. The make-up went on much smoother than it has been.

After about one week, things started visibly improving.  I have oily skin, but didn't realize how many whiteheads I had, until this product started bringing them out and then getting rid of them. My skin feels healthier.  Now, 3 weeks after starting using it, dark circles under my eyes and other dark spots are getting lighter. This product is much less painful and less expensive than surgery, which I have no intention of doing anyway, so it is definitely a keeper for me. Another dramatic improvement in my skin is that my pores appear smaller as it removes pore-enlarging dead cells, which is why I am ordering more of it today. I don't want to run out. This is much easier and cheaper than a spa, doctor's appointment or surgery. As one more benefit, my face feels refreshed all day long - almost cooling like an astringent, and has the most delightful fragrance, which I enjoy.

I love the pump, which makes it easy not to use too much. When I finally ran out of moisturizer though, I was determined to get every last drop, so I got tools and got into it. That pump is amazing. It had already pumped every tiny bit of the moisturizer. There was nothing left for me to get. The jar was dry. I used the moisturizer lavishly, and it lasted about a month. I'm using the second jar more carefully, mainly because I don't feel like I need so much of it now that my skin has improved. The second jar should last longer. Also, I've bought several other Juice Beauty products because I love the ingredients and the results.
summary: Loved it from Day 1. After Week 3, my skin is visibly healthier, dark spots are lighter, whiteheads & blackheads are gone.

reviewText: I have been on a search for organic face cream that actually works & I have to say that so far, this cream might finally be what I've been looking for! It goes on smooth, is not tacky & has a very pleasant lemony citrus smell that eventually fades. I run an organic family farm so my skin is exposed to the outdoor elements year round, from the harsh sun to the icy dry winds in winter. On top of that we heat our home with a wood stove. Needless to say, my mature skin needs serious TLC! I have tried so many natural organic brands over the years & the only brand that has been decent for my aging skin has been the Weleda line. The problem with Weleda is it tends to be greasy, but it is very moisturizing. For a while MyChelle Deep Repair Cream seemed to be doing a decent job but I believe they changed their formula which led me to once again be on the search for a good cream. I found Essence Certified Organic Olive Essence Gold Antioxidant Dmae & was pretty happy with it until I ordered it again & a nasty smelling sticky mess arrived that I had to return. 100% Pure Organic Acai Berry Facial Cream left my skin both greasy & dry. It is not a brand I'd recommend. Nourish - Organic Ultra-Hydrating Face Cream Argan + Pomegranate is the brand I was most recently using right before getting Juice Beauty. While using Nourish my skin became flaky & very dry. Nourish goes on very wet & dries tight. It is a horrible feeling. I have tried the Nourish line of body wash & body cream & cannot recommend the Nourish brand as I have had a bad experience with all of their products, this is unfortunate because I was thrilled to find a certified organic line of beauty products. When I first applied Juice Beauty my skin burned. I believe this was due to how extremely dry my skin had become the short time I was using the Nourish cream (I would have ordered a new brand if I didn't already have the Juice Beauty being shipped to me because the Nourish cream was so bad). By the second day or 3rd application of Juice Beauty my skin stopped burning & was already healing. My skin is now softer & more supple. It no longer feels tight nor does it hurt/burn/itch or feel greasy like it does with my second favorite beauty brand Weleda. Because I've already listed so many natural brands I've tried I figure I'll continue as it only further supports my high opinion of Juice Beauty. My third favorite brand right now is Acure Night Cream. Acure is not as greasy as Weleda which is a plus but it also is not as moisturizing aside from that it is a very good cream. John Masters Organics Day Cream is a very nice moisturizer for that can be reapplied often without it getting nasty but it is not moisturizing enough for my skin during the winter months. A great all purpose treatment is Argan Oil Organic. I use it to remove my eye makeup, as an eye treatment & use it under creams that are not moisturizing enough or alone in the hot & humid summer months. Argan oil is an excellent intimate lubricant as well! So there you have it! I've tried many more than the few brands I've taken the time out to list here in this review. We all have different skin & I am hoping to help you make the right purchasing decision. Juice Beauty is as of the time of this review very expensive, but for me very effective. If it continues to treat my skin this good, I will buy it when this runs out as it will be well worth it.

This moisturizer comes in a jar with a very strange dispenser.  You unscrew the lid and on top of the jar is a section you press down on and the cream comes up through a small opening in the middle. I think they be trying to be innovative and cool with this, but frankly, I just find it annoying.
The fragrance of this cream is a very strong lemon scent. I like lemon, but I don't like this scent.  It smells just like lemon-scented furniture polish (like Pledge).
The cream itself is thick. It goes on smoothly. It does an adequate job of moisturizing. At this price point, however, I expect more from a face cream, and after using it for a while, despite the smell, I did not feel I was getting anything else out of it. It would have to do something really amazing for me to tolerate the smell and the price. (Fortunately, I received a review sample so I did not have to pay $65)

When I saw the price of this I knew it would either be worth every penny or not worth a dime.  I have only used this for 7 days and my face looks amazingly brighter and softer and just lovely.  I'm blessed genetically but this stuff really made a difference. I love the container.  You simply press down and just the right amount of product is dispensed and you're not contaminating the entire jar of moisturizer.  I detect no scent.  This does not leave my face greasy either.  I have combination skin and it works very well on every type of skin on my face.  I adore this stuff.  Will continue to buy, even though it's pricey, because paying for crap products that do nothing is far more costly than just getting the good stuff.

Love it.

Good moisturizer. It contains vitamin C which is great during the day to fight free radicals and brighten complexion. Skin really is hydrated and no more dry spots from retinol (which I use in the evening).
Great ingredients, despite the price this is bigger jar,most of moisturizers are 1 oz.

But I'm not fond of the smell, very citrusy, like a dishwasher liquid. And it doesn't give me the finish I like (glowy, healthy looking skin).

I love how this cream feels on my face and the fact that it sinks in and doesn't make my skin shiny.  The dispenser is easy to use.  It takes a few pumps to get it primed but after it is primed you just push the button and there is the perfect amount of cream.  The price however, seems pretty high for what you get.  I will have to update my review when I see how long it lasts.

After having used this for a week I still love the cream but dispenser was a good idea that doesn't work right.  I have to push it several times each use to get anything out.  It would be much better if it stayed primed.
summary: Very Nice Cream but the Price Seems High

reviewText: The cream of the crop! No bathroom medicine cabinet should be without this moisturizer. I have been using it for over a month now and can tell a huge difference in my skin. The effect is immediate-- my skin feels so much more plump, fresh, and glowing in the morning after I use the moisturizer. Would recommend this product to ALL skin types.

My new favorite.  I always like to try new skincare products, but I don't want to try anything else after using this.  It's the perfect texture of creamy, but not too think that it feels like it never sinks into your skin.  The smell is subtly amazing.  She's a keeper.
summary: My new favorite. I always like to try new skincare products

reviewText:
PROS: This moisturizer absorbs into the skin better than any moisturizer I have ever tried. I have dry skin that is prone to looking shiny/oily on the surface. Some moisturizers make it worse if they just sit on top of the skin. Even later in the day, my skin felt moisturized but did not get shiny after applying this in the morning.

CONS: It smells exactly like lemon Pledge. While not entirely unpleasant, I would not *choose* to smell like a coffee table. The container it comes in is annoying. You have no idea how much is left and you have to crowbar it open to get the last bit out. Lastly, $65.00/month is way more than I want to pay for moisturizer. I got a deal on it the first time but couldn't find it cheaper after that so I had to stop using it.
GREAT!
I love this product and have used it for years.

I read reviews on this product before purchasing it at Costco and many people have nice things to say about it.  However, one review I read was from a dermatologist, who just made the comment that creams that work on stretch marks and wrinkles are different.  Anti Wrinkle creams need to relax the skin and stretch mark creams need to tighten the skin, so it's believable that it would do one, but not both.

That said, I decided to go ahead and give it a shot.  To start, it's a nice smelling moisturizer.  But the first week, it caused me to break out (I have sensitive skin).  Still, I persisted.  The breakouts eventually went away, but I used it for about two months and saw no noticeable difference in my fine lines on my face.  I have returned to my old standby moisturizers and my face feels much better for it.

I have not used it on stretch marks, but since I have quite a bit left, that it what it is relegated to now.  If I notice a difference in stretch marks, I will update my review, but for now it is not worth the cost.  You can get much better for less.
Works great!

This is what luxury feels like. I love this scrub. You can't imagine the difference between this scrub, and the cheap sugar and salt scrubs; no comparison. This L'Occitane body scrub is not greasy, and it leaves your skin feeling soft, silky, and polished. This scrub is amazing. The scrub also has a very lovely soft clean scent. I haven't found a product yet from L'Occitane that I haven't loved. This body scrub with shea butter is really worth the extra money.

This is one of the best body scrubs I've ever found. It's not your typical sugar/oil scrub. Its a rich cream that really helps exfoliate your skin, without clogging your shower or leaving a greasy/gritty residue in your bath tub. It smells amazing & you only need to use a small amount to get your whole body.

This stuff is amazing. It is especially wonderful in the winter time. This and the ultra rich cream are both amazing. I have super sensitive skin and this product does not harm my skin at all. It is incredible and smells wonderful.

I cancelled my order after realizing that the sellers here are selling UNBOXED product.  There is no way to tell expiration without the box.  Why else would they be 70% off?  My wife loves this product and I'll be looking for other options.  Having worked in retail for a number of years, a good rule of thumb is that anything over 60% off the MSRP starts to raise red flags for me.

The Art of Shaving takes old school saving style and methods and modernizes them with better ingredients and clever marketing.  Is my shaving experience better because of it?  Yes, but with some drawbacks.

Using The Art of Shaving's 4 Step process (pre-oil, cream, shave, moisturized) does make my skin feel healthier and softer, with less nicks and cuts.  My skin is prone to nicks, however, because my skin is naturally softer and my facial hair less course.  The pre-oil will help to create a smooth surface, while also softening the hairs to be cut.  The razor will then slide over the skin more effectively, reducing nicks and cuts.  The shaving cream, I feel, works as good as any other cream.  The lemon scent smells nice, but other than that, I don't notice much.  The moisturizer at the end does help reduce the irritation post-shave and leave my skin feeling soft.

Using this 4-step process took my usual 5-10 minutes shave and extended it to 15-20 minutes.  Most days I don't have the time or desire to shave a full 20 minutes.  Yes, I could rush and reduce my time back closer to 10 minutes, but then the quality of my shave be less and the risk of nicks and cuts would be greater.

Will this kit give me a cleaner and closer shave?  Definitely not.  The closeness of a shave depends on the razor and blade being used - not the cream.  Using hot water to rinse the face before applying the oil and cream will open the skin pores, helping the hair be cut easier and closer to the skin.  Using cool to cold water at the end to wash off the cream will tighten the skin and close the pores, helping to seal the cut hairs back in the face.

Compared to a modern day double, triple or quadruple blade razor (Gillette-style), you won't get as close a shave with a traditional saftey razor (the ones that use razor blades).  This is because safety razors don't "lift and cut" pulling the hair out of the pore.  It is well known that "lift and cut" razors cause ingrown hairs because they cut the hair below the skin surface.  This is then how the hair gets stuck inside the pore.  With a traditional saftey razor, the hair is cut flush with the skin, so the likelihood of ingrown hairs is much, much less.  If you suffer from ingrown hairs, get a better razor.  Different creams and oils, won't do much here.

After using this kit for a week, I still prefer my simpler, less timely and less expensive set up.  I use Giovanni Shave Cream, Fragrance-Free and Aloe ($9), a Merkur Model 180 Long Handled Safety Razor.($30), and 100 Astra Superior Premium Platinum Double Edge Safety Razor Blades ($10).  For traveling, I use a Parker A1R - 4 Piece Travel Safety Razor & Leather Case ($30), but I like the weight and angle of the Merkur Model 180 better for home use.  I have tried different pre-shave oils and no longer feel they are necessary because this Giovanni Shave Cream is more like a mixture of oil and cream - rather than a foaming cream.  I clearly feel that the Giovanni Shave Cream is superior to any other pre-oil and cream that I've used.  I have tried most flavors/scents of Giovannia and can say that all of them work the same.  Just pick the smell you like.

Cost is an important factor to me.  This $120 The Art of Shaving Full Kit uses very small bottles for the price, I feel.  I buy a large Giovannai shave cream container for $9 compared and it will last me about 6 months of daily shaving.  This $120 kit lasts me 2 months.  And that extra $55 each month to shave is definitely not worth it for me.  My shave looks no better.  Yes my skin feels softer with this kit, but any $15 nightly moisturizer would give me that same result.

Ultimately I feel that The Art of Shaving company charges to high a price for what you get.  The cost is likely due to those high commercial rent costs in all those shopping malls across the country.  I'll personally stick to my $9 bottle of shave cream and Astra blades.
summary: Recreates the traditional barber style shave, but my results are not worth the time and money.  Better recommendations given.

reviewText: First off, I ordered this as a gift for my son who is fast approaching shaving age so my review is not from a user point of view.  These products smell wonderful.  Very fresh.  One of the other reviewers said this sells for $25 elsewhere but I looked on the internet and the price at other vendors seems to be the same as this so not sure where he's looking.  The products are pretty small bottles for the price.  I would not normally pay this much for this type of product but it will be a wonderful gift for the occasion.  The 3 stars are for price vs. quantity.  The quality seems fine.

The Art of Shaving Full Size Kit in Lemon says it provides the elements of a perfect shave.  The kit includes a 2 ounce bottle of pre-shave oil, a 5 ounce tub of shave cream, a badger brush, and a 3.3 ounce bottle of post-shave balm.

The pre-shave oil is the first step in the shaving process- according to the information, putting the oil on the face softens the beard and provides protection against razor burn and irritation.  The oil is thin, and the top needs to be ridged as the smooth cap gets slippery when you have oil on your hands.  The bottle also would benefit from a euro-dropper or orifice dropper top, since it would be fairly simple to spill this oil, as the top is completely open.

The second step is lathering up the face using the badger brush and the tub of shave cream.  The cream is similar to other products, light, fluffy, and easy to lather.  The brush is a low end badger brush, that took almost a week to soften up to provide a good lather.  That said, it is superior to a boar bristle brush.  Once softened, the brush and cream provide a good shave, with a good razor and blade, of course.

The final step, after rinsing off excess lather, is the post-shave balm to moisturise the skin.  The product comes in a bottle with a pump top that dispenses a pea-sized amount of balm.  According to my husband, two or three pumps is sufficient for most people's faces.

The best part, for me, is the scent.  These products smell like my favorite lemon cake, or a lemon pie.  Yum!  The smell is strong in the cream, but does not linger heavily after finishing the shave.  The oil and the balm have a lighter, but still lemony, scent that provides a bit of freshness immediately post-shave.  This is NOT a long-lasting scent.  Not a bad product, and an opportunity to gift someone all the products without having to source them individually.  I cannot attest to the value of the set, but the products should last a relatively long time if used properly.

This is a great gift for any guy who likes to take care of himself.  There aren't a lot of ways a man can pamper himself but this is definitely one.  My husband loved the smell  He said it was an amazing lemony smell and that this feels awesome on his face. He said it feels like a non greasy silk on the skin.  He said it's a fantastic pre shave, shave and post shave.  Afterwards, he said he felt like he had been to a spa.  The only thing I would change is the presentation in the box.  It should be a little more high end packaging for something at this price point.  It seems a little overpriced and yet, the portions are very generous and should last a long time.  Very nice products.
summary: Generous Sizes, Smells Amazing, Silk on Your Face

reviewText:
I made the switch to safety razor shaving about two years ago.  It's one of the best things I've ever done for myself.  Not only do I get a better shave, it's significantly less expensive than buying disposables.  It's really not even close.  If you've not already done so, or you're contemplating the change, go for it.  I don't think you'll regret it.

I was excited to try out The Art of Shaving Full Size Kit.  I've never used their products before, but they enjoy a fine reputation.  Overall, this kit is perfectly fine.  The badger brush feels comparable in quality to the badger brush I've been using.  The only difference is that the brush has a plastic handle.  I much prefer the chrome handle - not only is it more attractive, in my opinion, but the added weight gives it a nice balance.

The included shaving cream compares favorably with The Taylor of Old Bond Street that I've been using for quite some time.  The lemon scent is nice and not at all overwhelming.  It smells like authentic lemon and not "lemon scent."  The pre-shave oil is nice, as is the after shave balm.  I have trouble with after shave splashes because of the high alcohol content.  The balm, while it does contain some alcohol, does a far better job of moisturizing.  It's very cooling and soothing.

The only issue with the set is the price.  It's a nice very nice set, but the cost isn't justified.  Perhaps if it came with safety razor it'd be worth the price, but it doesn't.  A chrome badger brush will run you $65, a plastic-handled brush $40.  A tub of shaving cream should run $12.  The after shave and pre-shave oil should run about $15 a piece, if that.  Add it all up and it comes in under $85.  If you have money to burn, by all means.  However, I think you're better off buying the individual components.
summary: An attractive, high quality product, but way overpriced.

reviewText: Not good for stretch marks , I use a lot of it on stomach, butt and breasts because Im prone to get some in those areas so the big tube doesnt last long enough for me to see results, I use twice daily so I ran out very fast and for the price I wish I had a chance to have seen more results but I don't want to risk again another 100+$ on this bc Im scared .
Fabulous product. Worth the high price
I like the product but this is a very small amount of product.  A lot of it stick to the insides of the tube.  Have to cut the tube open and scoop it out!
I don't think I've used this long enough to see real results yet but from what I have seen it's working so I'll continue to buy until I'm satisfied with how my skin looks
summary: ... it's working so I'll continue to buy until I'm satisfied with how my skin

reviewText: A friend I worked with who was in her 40's told me about StriVectin a couple years ago and I did give it a try but don't remember why I stopped using it. I bought the eye cream and the matching face cream recently because I just turned 31 and noticed my skin looking dull and older and wrinkles starting to appear around my eyes. I've got to say, I really like both products. The eye cream goes on smoothly and absorbs into the skin really quickly. I've noticed a big change in the feel and look of my skin since using these products and will continue to use them. No decrease in wrinkles yet but I'm really just hoping to increase the quality of my skin so I look better as I age.
This product compares itself to botox...this product doesn't do anything even close to botox...it is a complete SHAM!
summary: Better Than Botox?...LOL! That's a Joke because it doesn't do anything even similar! Terrible greasy product!

reviewText: its a good all around basic moisturizer. I like it .

Arrived fast with prime shipping. However, I was super disappointed by the small size of the tube. If you remember the original strivectin that came out several years ago, the tube was big. Anyway this was too small for me to justify keeping. The scent is minty and clean which I really like, but the product is tacky and hard to smooth on, you would also not be able to use makeup over this as it remains "sticky". Too bad they couldn't just leave the original strivectin alone. I'm returning it

I got this as a sample with a store purchase and I decided to try it... So I started using it on the corner of each eyes and on my lid and the bottom because I started having fine lines ..But I see that using this redefined those line and made them a non factor ..So i had to get another sample to keep the magic going..

After using this for a few weeks, here are my observations:

- There has been some lightening of stretch marks. They didn't magically disappear, but they ARE lighter. I always placed this under lotion.
- I can see where my wrinkles are going to be, usually at the end of a hot day where I was sweating. I started applying this to those areas (still applying moisturizer) and it helped smooth out those fine lines that "temporarily" appear when my skin is too dry.

It's not a easy solve product, but I think we're getting closer and closer to seeing products with real advantages with topical application.

I've been using this StriVectin SD for about one month now.  I wish I could say at this point I look 10 years younger but none of these types of creams have done that for me or magically turned me into George Clooney.  But, this StriVectin SD does feel good when I wear it on my face - goes on smooth, it feels light and comfortable, it doesn't make my face greasy, and I have no strange skin reactions thus far.  My skin hasn't shown any miraculous improvements but in fairness I've been using these types of products for years (various brands) and my skin has improved over that time and I like to think I look good for my 40-ish age (plus my mom tells me so thus it must be true).

But in my opinion the most important thing a person can do to preserve a youthful look is to protect your facial skin from the damaging rays from the sun...and this StriVectin SD has no SPF in it.  So, I don't wear it during the day - only at night.  This is almost a deal killer for me - these days when I buy nice face creams I look for versions with SPF.

So in conclusion - I've been using this cream at night and its been fine for me, no SPF is a big negative for me, $139 price is too high for me relative to some other nice skin creams I purchase and use.  So overall 3 star rating from me in consideration of price/value.
summary: Feels good, wish it had some SPF

reviewText:
I suppose my review needs to be taken contextually. To meet the standards of the Vine program, I had to review this in 30 days. That's a little less than what should be expected for full, noticeable results, but I certainly did use this as advised to some positive results.

This product does work. It reduces wrinkles and stretch marks gradually. I felt that massaging the cream onto my skin really made a difference. It took about two weeks before I noticed any changes, but they were there.

This product is pricey and probably varies in effectiveness depending on skin tone. But the question you're probably asking yourself right now is whether or not this works. The simple answer is yes. It's excellent at getting undesirable marks to fade. I was very pleased with the results.

Per the description on this anti-wrinkle cream it works on stretch marks and "significantly diminishes the number, length and depth of lines and wrinkles. Targets youth collagen and elastin for healthy, younger looking skin. Hydrates and visibly enhances skin texture."  I didn't use it on stretch marks but I used it for nearly 30 days on my face and neck for wrinkles and lines. It is very creamy and I used a dime sized amount on my entire face and neck. The deeper lines by my mouth (smile lines) were noticeably reduced and my forehead lines were diminished too. It didn't help a great deal around my eye wrinkles. I love the fresh minty scent and I would recommend this to improve your lines and wrinkles but it didn't help with dark spots or moisturizing.
summary: Love the overall improvement of my laugh lines and forehead lines

reviewText:
The StriVectin intensive concentrate claims that results will show in about a week and it actually seems like it has reduced the appearance of my winkles and stretch marks. I have very little wrinkles and stretch marks, but I can still notice my stretch marks if I look really close. This cream make it even less noticeable, but it was not very noticeable to begin with.

I use it twice a day, in the morning and at night, but it feels heavy under my makeup. Sometimes I forgo my moisturizer and just use this and a primer underneath my makeup because my makeup still ha SPF. It's fine at night since I use this and a moisturizer and even if it still feels a bit heavy, I don't mind since I'm sleeping anyways.

I'm a bit concerned about the ingredient list on this product because I always check the ingredient list on my makeup, face and body products. I avoid products that use parabens for sure and I look up every ingredient to judge the toxicity of the ingredient. Some of the ingredients here seem questionable, but I think it all depends on your perception of what is toxic. For example, a lot of makeup products contain paraben and mica, especially some powder foundations, and although the amount used is a small amount, I don't want to take any risk, so I choose to purchase products that have a less toxic ingredient list. There are a lot of hair products out and a lot of the popular name-brand products boast no sulfates, no parabens, and no phthalates. So it is completely up to you if you believe that the ingredients used in a product is actually a significant amount enough to actually be toxic.

So even though this products appear to work, I don't think I would purchase again. It is expensive for 4.5 fl oz and I don't feel comfortable with the ingredient list, so I will search for other products to combat wrinkles and stretch marks. If I can't find one, I can deal with wrinkles and stretch marks and try to prevent it with a good skin care routine.

This moisturizer is good stuff, but I am not sure I have the kind of wrinkles that it is meant to work on the best. I have some frown line wrinkles on my forehead and between my eyebrows that are probably beyond all moisturizing.  I did not see any difference in them.  But this feels nice on my face and it does not have a chemical smell or any noficeable fragrance so I will keep using it to see if it changes my skin at all.
summary: Nice moisturizer but I still have my wrinkles

reviewText:
I've been going full blazes with high end anti-aging and wrinkle creams this year. I've used various StriVectin products before, namely the advanced wrinkle reducer. It was OK - not the best and not the worst, but definitely something I wouldn't pay a ton of money for. The StriVectin SD is different than the previous wrinkle reducer. This one specifically names stretch marks as one of its targets, leading me rightly to believe it is stronger than products made specifically for the face.

Good thing my skin is tough, so to speak. I don't easily break out or react badly to products that might bring on a rash or worse in someone with more sensitive skin. I tried the SD concentrate on my neck for those ring-like lines you get when you hit your 30s (my mother used to say it was like counting the rings on a tree trunk to tell its age!)

I was pleasantly surprised. The SD concentrate DID make a difference. The lines, after several weeks of use, are definitely less noticeable. But having said that, I'd also warn the sensitive of skin to be careful with this product. I didn't use it on my face (I'm full to the gills with anti-aging and wrinkle creams and serums!), but I did notice a slight flush on my neck where I used the StriVectin. The color disappeared after several days, but it was noticeable. I'd fear what this cream would do to the facial complexion, it IS that strong.

If you have deep furrows, or any other part of your body beside your face is showing its age, this cream should be one you consider for real results. Just beware that it IS strong and may be a bit more than your face can handle.
summary: Great for those ring marks on the neck (but be careful with your face!)

reviewText: While it is unclear whether or not this is worth the hefty price tag, the cream does smooth and soothe dry skin without irritating it. Maybe it is from outside reasons like stress, but I did break out a little on my face, so I will have to try it again when things calm down and see if it still causes the same issue.
summary: very pricey, good moisturizing, maybe causes some irritation on the face...

reviewText: Intense is the word. StriVectin SD Advanced Intensive is not fooling around.  You will definitely feel the impact right away in the the form of more moisture and supple skin. For me, I cannot use it on my face during the day - maybe it is too heavy for my face, but I did see the beginning of some whiteheads which I rarely get.  Of course it is super humid these days, so clogging my pores with anything is not great during the day.  I will recommend StriVectin for another use besides facial wrinkles. If you are losing weight and don't want the stretch marks you get after the fact this stuff is awesome.  Worked like a charm on my winter weight to summer body transition.

I've only been using this cream for about a month, so it's too soon to tell if it's doing anything to make me look younger. For me it may be a case of locking the barn door after the horse has been stolen, but I'll keep trying. If nothing else maybe it will prevent further deterioration.

What I can say so far is that I have had no adverse effects on my skin from this product. My skin tends to be more sensitive than most, so I was careful when I first started using it. I started by putting it only on one side of my face to see what would happen. There was definitely a slight burning/tingling sensation where I had put the cream, but no redness or itching. The next day I felt safe enough to use it all over my face, except near my eyes, which they warn against doing. I've been using it regularly ever since, with no problems. I still get the slight burning feeling after applying it, but no bad reactions, so I don't worry about it. The smell is pleasant, sort of minty, and I like the way it makes my skin feel after applying.
My wife had an allergic reaction to it and could not complete the tube.  I would not recommend if you are prone to rash or have sensitive skin.

This is a very good moisturizer for my fifty-five year old skin.  I have problems with rosacea/adult acne that many similar products seem to flair and blessedly this leaves my face refreshed and blemish free.  The product does have a bit of a medicinal odor that I can almost taste and is reminiscent of acne medicine prescribed by my dermatologist back in the 1980s.  A small minus of this cream is it does not provide sunscreen.  A larger minus is the big price tag especially as I can not attest to its efficacy in preventing wrinkles and stretch marks that the manufacturer claims.

I usually think that cremes for wrinkes are kind of useless-that they just moisturize. This might actually be worth the money. My face looked clearer and tighter after using it for 3 days. I shared it with my mother (in her 70s) and HER face looked better. I tried it on my thighs and they looked better too-smoother. (Now for the price I'm not sure I'd use it on my thighs that often-I use glytone to help with the 'chicken bumps and, while it's not cheap, it does a great job). I used StriVectrin products before and I didn't see as much difference on my skin as I did with this one. It didn't irritate, it didn't burn, it just made my face look firmer and smooth.

So far so good. I'm using this cream for last 3 weeks and it has a slight tightening effect. I don't have any adverse reaction and breakouts so that's good. I use it only for my face. It's not greasy, gives nice glow and great under make up (and under sunscreen first).
It seems expensive as a face cream but the tube is big, 4 oz and most creams are only 1 oz.

Holy moisture!  Living in Colorado's dry climate, I find that I really need moisture - especially in the winter.  This StriVectin SD Advanced Intensive Concentrate is just that MOISTURE!  Major moisture!  I've been using this cream for well over 2 weeks and have been pleasantly surprised with the results.  Skin feels softer, dryness has been greatly depreciated and the overall tone of my skin has evened out.  Price tag is hefty but once I started using this, I haven't purchased the 2 bottles of cream I was using (day/night) prior.  So overall this is a must for dry skin (can't speak to someone with more oily skin)!

Have been using StriVectin  SD Advanced Concentrate for Wrinkles and Stretch Marks  for a few weeks now and scrutinizing my complexion each time I go to the mirror.

Application directions are for twice each day...morning and evening.

I do not have many lines or wrinkles as I have tried to care for my skin and protect it from the sun for the most part.  I do use different products that afford enhancement and protection to my complexion.  I do not have any stretch marks so I cannot attest to that factor.

After approximately two weeks I noticed one area to be definitively smoother and another area that seemed better a week or two later.  With the application of makeup those areas looked even smoother.

I continued to scrutinize and was wondering whether I wanted to believe the results as opposed to...did the StriVectin do anything?

After using the product for about four weeks now, I noticed some photos taken at family events and yes there was a difference!

I have been applying it twice daily on those areas on my face, neck and décolletage.

Note this product has no sunscreen.  Ensure that you get that protection for daytime use.

Also, make certain that you wash your hands after application of the StriVectin before applying any other product to your skin to avoid irritation.

For now...five stars!
summary: There are no miracles out there but this product did make a difference re lines & wrinkles...will continue to use and monitor...

reviewText:
After TWO weeks use: Very moisturizing, bordering on oily and a little sticky and has a slight fragrance that dissipates quickly. Don't fret, a pea size amount can cover face and neck. After waiting a few moments you can apply foundation without a primer and get decent coverage and glide. At night I wait a few minutes after applying it before going to bed, so my pillowcase doesn't get the no-wrinkle benefits I'd like my face to have :)

All that being said, I can only attest to the moisturizing, skin softening and skin plumping that comes from applying this after washing. Wrinkles and creases between my eyebrows are softened and diminished, as are the age rings on my neck. I do expect to see additional benefits with continued use.

I've always been skeptical of the price ranges that StriVectin products come in. I was interested in trying out this cream to see if it really was worth the price tag and the hype.

Week one was really quite pathetic. I normally use a glycolic cream at night, eye cream and a moisturizer with sun protection. Discontinued all of those to use only a Clinique face wash and this cream morning and night. I saw no impact on wrinkles or stretch marks but I did see an increase in oiliness around the T zone. Also had some mild breakout on the forehead but figured that could be the summer heat as well.

Week two saw the oiliness gone and the bumps as well. I started to notice some improvement in an even skin tone.

At the beginning of week three I can really see that the cream works - at least with my skin. The tone is better, the wrinkles are not as deep and it does an excellent job hydrating the skin and keeping it supple.

So, is it worth the price tag? For me, it could be since it replaces three other creams that add up to well over the price for this much larger tube. I do wish it came with a little SPF in it but I suppose no cream is perfect.

The very long ingredient list is an interesting mixed bag of natural extracts and some chemicals. On the one hand it has Shea Butter, Aloe, Ginger root extract, Green Bean seed extract and Resveratrol.  On the other hand it also has BHT and the beautifully vaguely defined 'Parfum'. If you are steering clear of any chemicals in particular you may want to have a good look at the ingredient list. Nothing jumped out on my radar as unsafe but all of us have different standards.

On the whole, it is a product that seems worth the investment and I plan on replacing my previous products with this one.

Update: Week 3 and 4 saw a continued improvement to skin texture. Old scars are shallower and dark spots are lighter too! I would recommend applying this to the neck as well since it improves firmness very quickly. I am so thrilled to have tried this product!
summary: Hefty price tag and it takes time but it works on wrinkles, stretch marks and dark spots!

reviewText:

It's only been two weeks, so I would like to update this at a later date, but here's what I have noticed so far:

1. It goes on thinly, so I only use a small drop to cover most of my face.

3. It's a bit greasy feeling and leaves a shine on my face--which is OK as I have dryish combination skin. For someone with oily or real combination skin, the sheen may be a problem until it soaks in (if it does for you).
4. The scent is pleasant, not too strong but not 100% odorless.
5. 4.5 ounces is actually a good size bottle and I have barely put a dent in the contents.

As for the wrinkles, I honestly think it's too short a time span to notice a big change. I like the moisturizing effect, esp. under foundation, but I do not see an impact on wrinkles. I have not tried this product on stretch marks.

Amazon has the best price I've found so far.  I purchased mine at Ulta where the price was about $15 more.  Target also carries it but I haven't checked the store to see if it's in stock yet.  This will last me quite a while I think.  I even use it in the summer, although I use much less during the hot Florida weather.  All in all, it's proven to be a great choice for me. 8/28/2015

reviewText: This balm is the best! My lips are painfully dry. This is the only product that has helped. I just ordered a second jar to keep with me. Yes, it is thick but it does stay put. It is not shiny or greasy or sticky. I also use it as a lip primer by applying a thin layer prior to applying lipstick. It keeps my lips comfortable all day and it seems to increase the wear time of my lipstick. For those that do not like the taste or smell of honey, it has a light citrus taste and smell.

Okay. This smells like lemon floor cleaner (I expected it to smell neutral or like honey... I mean, there is nothing about "citrus" in the name). The texture is weird. It's thick and yet slides right off my lips. It doesn't absorb. All of the citrus ingredients aren't really good for the delicate skin on your lips... they are acidic. I got this anticipating dry winter lips, yet not actually having them. I left this on as an overnight treatment the night I got it, and I woke up with dried-out lips. WTF.
Not only that, it was ridic expensive. If someone gave this to me and told me it was from, like, Bath and Body works, not only would I believe them, but I would likely throw it away. As it is I will try to give it to someone, because this was way too much bank to trash. The hype is not real. This is just the emperor's newest suit, like so many other cosmetic products with a high price tag and that "luxe" buzz. Don't buy into it. It is not worth the money and the time waiting for it to reach you (it took more than two weeks from the seller I bought from).

Here are products I WOULD recommend:
-Lucas' PawPaw ointment. Now, if you want an actual "overnight" lip treatment for chapping, this is it. It's also a little pricey but you get a lot more quantity and good quality. It also has that "buzz" around it to some degree if that attracts you. Packaging is cute. It can be used on cuts to help them heal as well, and that's legit...
-Egyptian Magic or its cheaper dupe, Sweet Bee Magic. I prefer the former because its consistency is less greasy and smeary, but both work very well for dry skin of all kinds, to include lips. Packaging on Egyptian Magic is very cute. I use it everywhere on my body not prone to breakouts, to include lips and undereyes.
-Dr. Hauschka makes a lip balm with a very slight orange-y tint, which is all-natural and very effective.
-Weleda Everon lip balm is the one I always come back to, which is surprising as it's the most affordable of these. It has an herbal smell a bit like roses and tastes neutral and good. It does the of moisturizing very well although it is not as thick as Lucas' or E. Magic. You'll have to reapply more, and it's more for the day than for a treatment.
-Finally, Lush's Honey Trap is great. This has a thick texture, a bit gritty almost, stays on forever, and smells and tastes divine--- it's made with white chocolate!! It's very moisturizing and can be used during the day or with a thicker hand as an overnight leave-on. My choice if you're going to be doing some making-out, as your lips will taste like really awesome honeysucklely chocolatey candy, but not in a weird Bonne Bell way.
-Finally, when I have legit chapping or cold sores, I cannot beat Blistex's medicated balm in the blue pot. It tastes medicinal but it really works.
Hope this was helpful!
summary: I wish I had my money back

reviewText: Oh I love, love this stuff! I was using straight vit E and still I would wake up with dry lips. This lip balm does go a long way, so I don't see the price as a problem. I have seen reviews that say its gritty, but I have not experienced this and I've ordered this lip balm several times. I would say it's mostly a "night time" product, but I live in pretty dry part of the country, so on days I don't wear lipstick (because I'm not wearing makeup), I will put this on.

This has saved my lips during a cold Canadian winter.  While I like my lipstick-type balms for the summer and for carrying in my purse (Nuxe and Caudalie), this is pretty fantastic at night.  It's very thick, almost pasty, with a honey-lemon aroma that is quite pleasant.  When you first use it, you don't get the full effect if you don't dig down past the superficial thin film on top.  It's much moister underneath and more emollient.  This has no Vaseline-feel or the wax-fell of a chapstick balm.  Completely unique.

I bought this balm on a recent ski trip and it became my to go healing potion for chapped lips. It is a creamy balm, almost too creamy so apply lightly and layer of if you want. It has real staying power and it doesn't feel like you have a chunk of wax on your lips, at the end of the day your lips feel awesome.

I've been a huge fan of this lip balm since it was mentioned in the newly started Lucky magazine and sold at Sephora. (Yes, that long ago!) It's texture is rich, thick and gives my lips a very cushiony feeling. I love that it's very matte, no shine at all and that it works equally well on its own or under lip color. The scent is not that of honey, but a light citrus that is so nice, not overpowering, not yucky or artificial.
I barely have to touch this balm with my fingertip to get the perfect lip amount, its that soft and creamy. (Seriously, don't slide your finger over it, I made that mistake the first time I used it, all that will do is pick up way too much and put a dent in the middle!) Plus, the transfer of product from fingertip to lip is amazingly neat and tidy. No extra product I have to wipe off!
The balm lasts for a long time, even with me constantly pressing my lips together to see if it's still there. I actually look forward to applying more and am a little bummed because it doesn't need it that often! :)
The price is high making it a bit of a splurge for sure. But, it works, it lasts, and it is amazingly worth it.

I love how moisturizing this balm makes my lips feel and it leaves a matte finish too. Love this stuff. The jar is a generous 15 grams of products too. Between this and my Jack Black lip balms, my lips have not been in better condition.

I was prepared for the grainy texture of this since I had read the reviews that described it.  It's true that you need to massage it into your lips for a few seconds to break down the granules and turn it into a waxier state.  Once you do, it's got a nice, thick texture that is very moisturizing and that stays put.  It's a bit too thick for me for during the day (I need a lighter lip balm to wear under lipsticks), but for night time use, it's perfect!  Apply it and wake up to nicely hydrated lips!
summary: Nice and thick -- and stays on!
