Shellac is like miracle nail polish.  For best results, it should be applied by a professional.  It has to cure under a UV light and needs to be removed with acetone soaked cotton balls.  BUT, it's absolutely worth it.  I've worn it continuously for nearly two years and my nails are as strong as ever and not the least bit yellowed.  This polish lasts an easy two weeks and I've worn it as long as three when I just couldn't get in to the salon. The only problem at that point was seeing the out growth at the cuticle.  The polish itself was totally in tact...even the tips.  And it stays shiny the entire time.  No chipping at all.  And of equal importance is that fact that there is literally NO drying time once you're out from under the UV light.  You can dig in your purse for your car keys without worrying about smudging your new manicure.  It's a fabulous product.  CND, the manufacturer has about 100 colors to choose from.  Probably easier to find a salon that carries their line rather than buying your own but I bought a few because the salon I go to didn't have some of the colors I like.
summary: CND Shellac Polish is the very best

CND is one of the best brand of gel shellac that I have used. It will cure using an LED light or a UV light. I have used both.  I have tried some of the less expensive brands, but they have caused nail damage, especially the ones that claim not to need a base coat. As long as I soak off the CND gel thoroughly with pure acetone, there have been no issues. Do not scrape residuals off. Let the acetone do the work. Make sure all layers are removed. If your nail looks shiny, the base coat has not been completely removed. Then soak longer. When applying the gel, be sure to apply one coat of the base, 2 coats of shellac, one top coat, and cure according to the directions between each coat. Be sure to seal the edges of each coat or you may get water between the coats and your nail, which may result in a nail fungus. If applied properly, it will last 2 weeks. I would not advise keeping it on longer than this due to the breakdown of the shellac, and nail exposure to water infiltration. Love this brand. Well worth the money.

******Updated Review******
I have used this product multiple times since receiving my UV lamp. The color indicated on the bottle is very close to the color within it. I was not shocked there was a slight difference. There is a learning curve when switching from regular nail polish to the gel color system. The objective of the gel color system is to make each layer as thin as possible. If you fail to do that, you will notice wrinkling and puckering when you begin to cure the color. Another trick that you will want to use is to get as close the the cuticle as possible without letting the product actually touch the cuticle. It takes some time to perfect it, but after a couple of tries you will get the hang of it. I watched a lot of YouTube video on the best ways to go about it. The color looks great and will go perfectly with even the most professional work environment. I am now a believer and supporter of the gel color system. The color truly last for 14 days, I can even where the color longer if my nails didn't grow so fast. I consider myself an educated consumer, and thoroughly researched each system before I purchased anything. This is definitely a GREAT buy!!! You can't go wrong. I'm looking forward to my next purchase.

It is opaque as I find the non-opaque shellacs impossible to apply without streaks even after 3 coats.
The color is very calming and delicate. It is kind of like somewhat dirty pink. Looks professional and isn't loud to wear to work.

CND Shellac is by far the best quality gel polish. I have never had a quality issue and I've tried at least a dozen shades over the last year.

The Vexed Violette is hands-down my favorite shade of purple in the CND line. I describe it as sort of a dignified frosted grape. In certain lights it can look like iron. It has a nice shimmer and it covers well.

If you love purple, you will enjoy this color.  It's not flashy at all. It's a great color for all ages, but it's one of the few purples that older women can wear very well.

LOVE CND products, and this color is fine if you can handle bright turquoise nails until your next manicure. Great for maybe a specific outfit, but it is a very bright, bold color with a shimmer. I much prefer any of the CND shades of purple.
summary: Same Great Quality, Not the Best Color

Shellac is a great product overall.. Nothing bad about it.  This color is one you need to be careful when applying for consistent coverage. A chalky color but very nice for summer!!  Looks great with a tan!

It's not sheer, you really have to look closely after two coats to see any sheerness.  I did 1 coat on the outer tip then full coverage on coats 2 and 3 and achieved 100% solid without it being bulky at the cuticle.  Barely sparkles to perfection.  LOVELY

The color matches what you see on the bottle. It does have some orange hue in the red. It is a bit translucent in outdoor light. This does not mean it's sheer. Very bright and perky color, looks great for summer.

Although true Shellac snobs would say use Shellac as a system for best results, I used it with LED lamp and it cured fine. I cured base coat for 30 secs, color coats for 60 secs each, top coat for 60 secs (as opposed to 2 mins under UV lamp).

Shellac does not require a primer and the polish bonds to nails without peeling. Removing is also easy, Shellac will soak off in 10 mins with very light scraping (if that). Compared to Sensationail (sold at drug stores), without a primer it peeled after 2 days, with a primer it took me about an hour to remove (including ~20 mins soak time) with a lot of hard scraping.

reviewText: I'm usually not a huge fan of pink polish, but this one is really pretty.  Very pale, chalky pink. The spring line seems pretty thin, but I got good coverage with 2 coats.  Also tried with a layer of neglige as a final coat before top coat and was very pretty.

LOVE this color!  Lilac Longing is the perfect Easter egg shade of lilac. I received lots of compliments on it this Spring, and I'll definitely wear it again. I've tried about half of the CND Shellac colors and this is in my Top 5 favorites.

I have found that all CND Shellac purples are classy, refined shades, not brash or tacky. My favorite purple shade is Vexed Violette, sort of a lightly frosted grape. My favorite shade overall is Asphalt. Enjoy!

I have used about half of the CND Shellac colors. Although I'm disappointed in the Spring 2013 "collection" (if you can call 4 colors and a glitter a collection), I decided to order LIMEADE and Lilac Longing. The Lilac I LOVED. It is the perfect Easter egg shade of lilac - I can't say enough good things about it.

But this LIMEADE is an altogether different story. It is SO neon and SO annoying to the eye, like radioactive neon, that I could not wait 10 days until my next mani - I had to get it removed within a week.  If your skin is iffy with neon green, I'd stay away.

My friends are amused with my variety of color changes every 9-10 days, and usually I get compliments, but LIMEADE got "2 thumbs down" across the board. I'm now wearing CND Gotcha, a bold medium matte pink, a definite winner. I have started requesting 3 thin coats for the best coverage.
This color looks great with my warm toned, fair skin. It is a perfectly feminine sheer color that is not "too much". I'll repurchase!

This is a light grey.  Goes on opaque with 2 coats.  Tip wear isn't as noticiable as with darker colors.  Product needs a UV lamp to cure.
I have been using CND for a year now and truely love it. Very fast service and will order more. my favorite color
I have been usinf CND for a year now and truely love it. Very fast service and will order more
fast service. good product! Always love CND nail shellac. Have been using it for a year now. I am very satisfied

This seems to be the color for spring, so decided to purchase this as its bright, colorful and happens to match many of my clothing pieces for the spring!

Purchased here on Amazon, shipping was quick and easy, great price, all around happy!

I had been a little concerned prior to purchase that the color might be hard to apply both consistently and in terms of getting enough color coverage but I had no such issues!

Began with my Shellac base coat then applied two coats of this: first time allowed a 2 minute curing time, then applied the next coat with a 3 minute curing time, followed up by Shellac top coat. The color was remarkably similar to the shade you see in the bottle, a vibrant and colorful lilac shade. The color was even, and the shade deep with no sheer areas! Color stayed in place for almost 2 weeks and was a perfect hue for Spring.

I was pleasantly surprised, and for those that like to match their toes with a regular polish (removing Shellac from toes is never the easiest process) I found a very similar color from Revlon:  Number 220 Enchanting from  their regular polish line!

I would certainly purchase this shade again and plan to return to select more shades from this Spring 2013 line now I have gained confidence with this color!
summary: Great spring shade, easy application, great color hue!

I am disappointed in this color.  I was so excited for the new spring colors!  I like pastels and I thought this "grapefruit sparkle" was going to be a nice shimmery light lavender color based on the one photo they had available in this product page.  I was assuming the picture was accurate since there were no previous reviews and there was no description of the polish I had no reason to doubt it...

Then a few days later my shellac arrived; and when I first opened the amazon box, I thought they shipped me the wrong polish by mistake because what I saw was a very, very light pink polish bottle that said "sheer" on the packaging.  The last thing I wanted was another clear pink polish. The first coat was barely detectable apart from a light shimmer effect.  It literally took 5 coats of color before I couldn't see the white of my own nails showing through since the polish was so sheer.

This item is non-returnable so now I am stuck with another polish that may as well be the same color as the other half dozen pale pink totally sheer polishes shellac sells, just with a different name on the label.  Everyone knows the thicker your gel polish is, the more quickly it starts to peel off.  Now I will use it up twice as fast (5 coats for each manicure instead of my normal 2-3 with non-sheer colors) and it will peel and need to be re-done in half the time (I'm on day 3 and it is starting to lift on the tips of my nails already despite my "wrapping the color around the tips.")

To summarize: Unless you are looking for a French manicure style, very sheer, hardly noticeable pale pink polish, don't get this one.  I will try to upload 2 pictures for you.  One of the how it looked with just one coat and a 2nd picture of the color after coat 5.
summary: This is a very SHEER polish, required 5 coats before I couldn't see through it anymore :(

reviewText: This is a wonderful color! Chalky pink that is perfect for spring or summer.  Can be used with a glitter over top for a different look. Very pleased with this color, looks great with any skin tone!

This color (Midnight Swim) is so dark it is almost black.  I was expecting more of a blue.  In bright light you can see the blue better and also see the sparkles.  Any other time, it looks black.  It is a UV Shellac that requires the use of a UV light to cure.  Holds up well to daily wear.
I like this color it is exactly as pictured. an opaque cool pink.  I used two coats for even coverage.

FInally, a Shellac color that combines the perfect amount of subtle, neutral, pale pink color with a fine (as opposed to coarse) shimmer.  CND Shellac's Romantique has been my go-to color for over a year now:  two coats of that, plus one coat of Shellac Zillionaire, but with the new Shellac Grapefruit Sparkle, I will be able to use two or three coats of it and skip the Zillionaire.  Side-by-side, Grapefruit Sparkle has a bit more color density, is a wee bit pinker than Romantique, which make it perfect.  I find if I use a pale neutral, I can get my DIY manicure to last 21-22 days.  More of the natural nail shows as it grows out if you use darker shades, but with pale colors like Grapefruit Sparkle, no one can really tell you've had your polish on for 3 weeks.
summary: Perfect combo of color and shimmer

reviewText: A shimmery pink.  Went on well and didn't show the tip wear as much as darker colors.  Please be aware that this polish must be dried with a UV lamp--it is not a traditional polish.  Also requires the CND Shellac top and base coats.  If you are looking to DIY, the system can be purchased on Amazon and there are multiple videos on-line with instructions.  Although it is advertised as a 2 week manicure, I usually only get a little over a week due to tip wear (I type a lot).  Works great for me since normal polish only holds up for a day at most.

I needed to use 3 coats to get good coverage but the color is very nice once you have 3 coats.  Two coats was too sheer and streaky.  A greyish purple with shimmer.  For those looking to try this polish please be aware that it requires a UV lamp to dry as well as the base coat and top coat from CND Shellac--it is NOT a traditional polish.  Although the advertising says two weeks of wear, I usually only get a little over a week due to tip wear (I type a lot).  This works fine for me because normal polish only lasts a day if I'm lucky.  Since I am doing my own nails with this system, the price is just right for a week's wear.  If I was going to the salon to have it done, it would cost a fortune.  I absolutely love that once the process is complete, my nails are totally dry and ready to go.  No more accidentally smudging them before they are  dry.  It took a couple of tries to learn the exact way to complete the process but there are plenty of videos on-line for tips on the best way to use this system.

reviewText: Love this color, finally a deep dark red! Applies like traditional nail polish and doesn't ruin my nails. Mi have been using CND shellac for over two years and don't use anything else!

Who would have thought that something so nearly black could be so useful?  I have this color and Dark Pool which is totally black and another "must own".  What's great about uber dark colors is that you can layer on top of them for a totally different look.  The first week I started off with this as a regular SOG manicure.  It's so very dark to the point of looking black.  Two coats is all you need BTW.  Then I layered two coats of a regular nail polish top coat of Spectraflair that I found off of Ebay.  WOW.  Let it dry.  (I mean let it dry for hours!!!) then put CND's UV top coat on and marched forward another few days with another new look which was more gray/silver.  Then I put overly onyx on the tips and added black glitter for another new look.  It will stay this way for a few more days until I soak the whole thing off.  What fun!
summary: Everyone needs dark nail polish in their lives

reviewText: The color Fadora is fabulous. It's more of a brown with a hint of red. Love it. It's my new favorite color. If you like dark colors but don't want to go to black you'll love this color.

I started off with Gelish and have worked my way through the various gel products.
Here is a thorough review--with tips---if you are on the fence about what to buy!
http://www.amazon.com/review/R3VWRFDI073BON/ref=cm_cr_pr_viewpnt#R3VWRFDI073BON

Strawberry Smoothie was my first Shellac purchase. I thought it would be a solid pink, so when it arrived and I saw how sheer it really was, I was at first disappointed. But!! After using it, it made THE perfect go-with-anything neutral nail. I have very pink nail beds anyway, so this looked like I'd gotten a clear polish  manicure and just have naturally pretty nail beds. I used Lomasi top and base coats because that is what I have (and like). This works just fine with the Lomasi brand. I also use an LED light and 30 seconds for each color coat. The Shellac smells like regular polish until cured, which was amusing to me. Definitely stinkier than Gelish or other brands.

I have to say that Shellac and Lomasi rank RIGHT UP THERE for me, in so many areas. The brushes in them are great! They are easy to use, and they make the tiny window of time I have to do my nails, worthwhile. The Shellac seems to cure thicker, harder, and have a more durable finish than Gelish or Red Carpet. I am very pleased at how my nails look when I've used this product and will be buying more Shellac colors.

I couldn't be happier with my gel nail experience, using the Shellac products. I have ZERO complaints about them, which is pretty amazing if you have read my Gelish review and see how much I gripe about the various products. I felt that the Shellac product was a professional quality item, and I wouldn't hesitate to buy other Shellac items nor would I hesitate to recommend them to anyone! They are worth the price, for the total satisfaction they deliver. When you figure that your TIME is valuable, this really factors into the value of this product.
summary: Top quality! Shellac or Gelish? Read for more....

reviewText: I used this color today to do my first ever at-home Shellac manicure.  I'm not a professional, but prefer doing my own nails, so I recently purchased the CND 6-bottle starter kit, a UV lamp, and an assortment of polish colors.  This color is so pretty!  I had to use 3 coats to get the coverage I wanted, but it turned out awesome.  It's a deep purplish-silver shimmer color.  I'm sure this will definately be one of my top 5 favorite colors.
I love shellac so trying out the different colors is fun for me. This is a good going out on the town color.

Midnight Swim is a standout for fall.  It goes on almost black but it is a deep dark blue.  This was my first step into the darker colors and I'm loving it.  It has the same attributes of other CND colors.  As another reviewer mentioned be careful and take your time when applying the dark colors.  Mistakes show up more.  Have your alcohol handy for cleanup to make ti look crisp and neat.  The magic happens when light hits this color.  Highly recommended.

Love this new color. Just got it in the mail today and already had to try it out. It is a deep, dark navy with silver shimmer. Indoor, it almost looks black, but in the sunlight, it is like a deep sapphire. It goes on easy and thin. One coat gives even coverage (I find some, like "romantic", need two coats to look even), but I did two color coats for a darker navy. I have been waiting for a color like this from CND. I am a Shellac addict and buy a new color every month or so, and this was my first of the new Fall 2012 line. I am not disappointed. I actually combined it with Black Pool tips for a must have black on navy french manicure. I can't wait to try some of the other fall colors! One hint - with the darker colors, make sure you have a small touch-up brush and some isopropyl alcohol to clean up around the edges, because they must be extra crisp to look good.
A great fall color.  It is navy with light blue specks, it's gorgeous!  Same quality, durability and lasting power of all the other CND Shellac colors.  A great addition to my growing collection.

Normally when I do the Shellac process I use Negligee for my nails.  It is not clear but translucent.  I was looking for something that might be closer to clear and in reading the reviews thought this might actually be it.  And so it is.

While it does have a slight pink tinge to it going on, I find that when dried under the UV light it is quite clear with no pink tinge at all.  It is perfect for what I wanted but if you are wanting it to show up pink you might be disappointed.  I also believe that the coloration and texture of an individuals nails might make this show up more pink.  In my case, it is totally clear.
summary: Clearly pink is really quite clear.

reviewText:
For those of you doing the CND Shellac nail process I hope you will consider this an option worth adding to your collection.  In fact, this was one of the first colors I tried and is usually my first choice.  This color goes on almost clear the first coat but then the second coat really brings out a pearl tint to your nails.  It is the only color that seems to become more opaque as the days go by.

This color goes on smoothly and does not leave any streaks.  It blends flawlessly with the base and top coats.  It is not totally clear but adds just that little punch of class to otherwise clear nail polish.

It really accentuates those colorful sparkles in CND Zillionaire for another alternative!

I also find that this is a very easy color to touch up in case you don't  have time for a full redo on the shellac.  I just reapply a quick base coat, then a coat of negligee and then a top coat right over my old coat.  Freshens the manicure right up and it will last a few more days.

I purchased the CND Shellac system and light for my daughter and sent this color as one of the polishes.  She told me she loves it as well and it is her most used color as well.

Personally, I think this is exceptional for everyday wear.
Hot, hot, hot!  We used Tropix as the tip color for our French manicures. It worked great. Hint - The color is very close to OPI's Cajun Shrimp, which we used for our pedicures!
At our end of summer slumber party, we did French manicures using Iced Cappuccino on the tips. The look was really glam!
We had a back to school slumber party and created a French manicure using this product on the tips. It was a big hit!

Its silver girls....It reminds me of flat silver paint for toy models. I expected depth and demension from this silver but nope it was just a silver. Maybe I'll add neglige as a top coat and I beat it would really pop!
Its the king of bright red- like a fire engine red.. My favorite of the classic red nails. It's CND so you get a nice application.

This is definitely my favorite as far a great color that can stand alone or as a top coat or in French manicure. The color is a very light opalescent pink. I great so many compliments. As a top cop it adds dimension and extra shimmer. In French manicure it's a very beautiful pink.
Its a dark rich burgundy great for the fall or a night out. It has really beautiful lights to it/depth. Once again can apply thin does not streak.
It's like a medium brown. Coffee with a little cream. I believe it would look great on any skin tone. It's a good color for thin application, no streaking. I love CND!!

I love that I can purchase CND Shellac products on Amazon. Note that you need a UV light to cure them, which is a fairly expensive initial cost, but has significant savings in the long run from doing your own manicures. I like the CND branded one better than the cheaper ones out there, I think it works better because of the higher wattage bulbs. You also need all the steps- base coat, color, and top coat. I am proficient at painting my own nails, and if you watch youtube instructional videos you should be able to recreate the salon results without the bubbling/wrinkling of the polish upon curing that I have heard many negative reviews about (thin layers, finish the edges, full coverage). The manicure can last 2-3 weeks, if you take care of your nails (for example- not using your nails as prybars, and using gloves when cleaning and doing dishes- a good habit for nice looking hands anyway). Removal is easy, and requires cotton balls, acetone, and foil for best results- also the youtube videos are helpful for this also. I even do my friends/family's nails sometimes too. I love this product- this is a true red, not pink at all, that I purchased to do my 49er manicure- it came out perfect.

Bought this in conjunction with the rest of the required items to do an at home shellac manicure. This is a great value, you will def save money doing these at home yourself. I did my first one tonight & it turned out awesome. So easy to use. I def recommend. :)

I LOVE this color.  It's definitely my new favorite color.  I've been wearing it even in the summer! Couldn't wait til colder weather to try it out.  It's dark and dreamy with a good gleam of shimmer.  Very pretty.

Bought this color because I saw it used in a number of different layering images with other colors.  I haven't yet done any layering but this is a nice shimmery pink.

This is a UV cured 'gel' polish.  Done properly, a CND Shellac will last 1-3 weeks.

I have softer flexible nails - My nails need polish to keep from breaking and get longer.  Acrylic kills my nails and if a salon does a generic 'off brand' gel polish, they often file my nails making them really damaged and weak so I decided to buy the CND kit & do it myself (also saving me $ in the long run.)  Before Shellac I gave up on polishing my nails unless for a special event because it would peel off in a day. What a waste to spend all that time painting and drying for it to peel away the next day.  I type a lot at work as well as boxing and packing stuff so I am tough on my hands.  Shellac is the best system because it stays on but comes off easy WITHOUT any filing.  It lasts me about 7-10 days on dark colors, because I chose to take it off when I can see growth at the cuticle.  On many others, it will easily last 2 + weeks

This is a UV cured 'gel' polish.  And by far my FAVORITE color so far.  I wear a lot of earthy colors especially going into fall and winter and RUBBLE is a warm taupe brown that just goes with everything.  It will dress up beautifully with one or two layers of gold VIP layered over it.  Done properly, a CND Shellac will last 1-3 weeks.

 I have softer flexible nails - My nails need polish to keep from breaking and get longer.  Acrylic kills my nails and if a salon does a generic 'off brand' gel polish, they often file my nails making them really damaged and weak.  Before Shellac I gave up on polishing my nails unless for a special event because it would peel off in a day.  I type a lot at work as well as boxing and packing stuff so I am tough on my hands.  Shellac is the best system because it stays on but comes off easy WITHOUT any filing.  It lasts me about 7-10 days on dark colors, because I chose to take it off when I can see growth at the cuticle.
Amazing color! So much depth and intensity. If you own any color of CND that would be the one. It's a good primary color and an amazing accent color.

I was not expecting this color to be so different from the bottle color. It took 3 to 4 coats to not be see through, because of this, it takes longer to do my nails since it is a thinner polish than other shellac colors I have. I was expecting a bright orange-red, but this is closer to neon orange. No shimmer, just flat plain carrot/traffic cone. I put a single coat over two coats of hot pop pink and got the nice orangy pink I was hoping for though, so not a total loss. Overall it is fun for summer, but not a color I will wear very often.
summary: This is really bight orange, like a traffic cone.

reviewText: Goes on smoothly. Always remember to do a 2 thin coats, and last 3 weeks. Don't regret investing in the shellac line

Nice color, not my favorite.  I use this with other shellac colors, as mentioned on Youtube (Nail Art).  My mother wears this color alone.  I do wear this color with white tips...like a French styling.  As all shellac products, it lasts at least two weeks!  Love shellac products!!

I like the color. As others have said, it's a true red.

Mine was delivered on a hot day, so a bit too warm when I got it. Not sure how that will affect the product. But on first use, I like the liquidy-ness of the polish. It applied nicely and easily. There is a little bit of shrinkage, but nothing too major.

If anyone knows how to address the shrinkage issue, please share! I go back over the tips before curing, but it always seems to draw up to the end of the nail and not cap the end. I feel like this leads to premature peeling of the polish. My manicure lasts on 7-9 days, not the two weeks many others report and as advertised. And I often lose one or two nails in the interim. It does look fantastic while it's on. And traditional polish only last about a day before it starts to chip on me, so I'm still happy.
Again the CND Shellac system is amazing and I will reccomend it to anyone!  It is so easy and nails turn out perfect every time.

I have been performing the CND Shellac process on my nails at home for approximately six months.  I have been using this color on my nails for most of that time.  When I chose to send the entire CND process to my daughter as a gift, this is the color I chose because it was such a lovely color.  She is loving it also.  I would categorize this color more as a pink/orange rather than a true orange color as the photo indicates.  I have found it to be long-wearing as are all the Shellac colors.

Personally, I like to have a matching regular nail polish to use for touch-ups just in case I get a flaw in the shellac process before I have time to redo my nails.  I have found the Sally Hanson Diamond Strength #340 "Something New" to work quite well with the Tropix color.

As an added note:  I have read where lots of women are purchasing other brands of gel uv colors to mix and match with the CND Shellac process. However, I recently read where the CND Shellac products actually have tiny tunnels in the polishes after curing that allow the Solar Oil to penetrate to the nail for nourishment.  Other brands do not have this process.  I had considered other brands to have some variety in the color choices but have decided to stick with the entire process being the CND brand.

Also, six new colors are coming out for Fall 2012 and those colors can be viewed on several blogs by doing a search for them.

I just can't decide on this color...it almost looks like dirty white out on your nails at first, but in the sun it almost looks like a light blue grey color.  It is not the most forgiving color either, like some shellac colors.  If you accidentally get it on the cuticle and cure it, it is REALLY noticeable, which I realize is my fault.  I've tried layering it over another dark shellac color to get a different result but one coat streaks and two coats completely covers the other.  I'll keep playing with it because of the cost and the great, long lasting, shiny results you get with all shellac products; but it isn't my favorite color by any means.

This is a very pretty color.  It doesn't match the bottle 100% but it's close enough for me.  It's a very bright, shimmery teal blue.  Very stunning especially in the sun light.  Application is very smooth and two coats covers perfectly.  It's the perfect color for summer!

I love the shellac system as a whole and this polish is no exception.  Depending on the lighting sometimes it looks like a light grey'ish purple, other times a great taupe color.  I have fair skin and the color is perfect.  I've also just tried layering it over the dark lava and it makes a great dark grey/purple.  Like other reviewers said, you do need two coats of this but I've found that with most of the shellac color's.

I agree with the other reviewers who state this is thick and not as good as other CND Shellac polishes.  Where I'm a huge fan of the whole Shellac system, this color is really thick, hard to apply thinly and shows the brush strokes after curing.  It still holds the great shine and long lasting benefits of Shellac but I'm just not a fan.  Also, the color doesn't seem to suit my skin tone very well.  I'm pretty fair and the color seems to blend into my skin, so it looks kinda funky.  I'll be giving this to a friend...

First off, I LOVE the CND Shellac polish.  I love having my nails look great all the time with minimal effort.  If I go to the salon for a Shellac manicure it lasts about 10 days, only about 7 if I do it myself.  I think the problem I have is I make the 2 coats of color too thick, but I'm getting better at that.  The entire color starts to lift and then I end up peeling it off, which is horrible for the nail bed.  I've started just removing it the correct way after one week to avoid have the color lift like that.

This color is amazing though, I have gotten more compliments on this color then anything I have tried before.  It is the perfect deep red wine/raisin color and stays wonderfully shiny until I remove it.
summary: I get so many compliments on this color

reviewText: I love the CND Shellac system and this color is beautiful! It really looks wonderful and shiny and I just can't say enough about how easy the whole sysem is and it lasts so long.  The only down side is that it doesn't come off easily.  You have to soak it off or peal it off.  Other than that it is fantastic...

super disappinted with this one. love the color. sadly i just can't get it to apply nicely. once i finally got it looking nice, as soon as i put it under the lamp, it withered up. it looked like when you get a fingerprint on tacky polish -- but nothing had touched it. boo! no idea what caused this. i had read others mention "shrinking" - maybe that's what it is. i also notice a little bit of clumpiness during application.

am presently soaking off hence no caps as i am irritably typing one handed.

UPDATE-- applied Hollywood after. It worked like a charm. No idea what the story is with the Fedora, but I hope they fix it, because I love the color. As expected, the color's similiar to OPI My Private Jet. Please fix it CND!!
summary: will not use again - applies horribly!

reviewText: I like the color, wish it was darker.  Rubble is probably the color for me.  This is very light, a hint from white/lavender. . . .not too thrilled.  Great service from this vendor.
Love Fedora. . .dark brown, flat color.  No sparkles.  My first shellac color!  The Shellac system is great and easy to do at home!

I work at a drugstore and we have hundreds  of choices of nail color to choose from.  Getting use to the limited color choices of CND Shellac and the high cost has made me very selective in ordering their polish.  This was surely a winner.  It is so hard to judge from the online photos but CND website has a little screen that shows all the various colors side by side for comparison.  This is a bright summery coral that has some pink undertones.  It is not neon and really matches with most everything I have worn.  I love how CND Shellac smoothes out the ridges and makes your toes look so pretty.

I never liked the dark colors on my nail, but this one changed my whole idea of nail colors.
I originally intended to use this under iced coral for mixed tone effects but I'll definately enjoy this as it is alone.
I can't wait for the fall.

This color is very true to the picture of the bottle, but the color isn't strong enough to stop at the normal 2 coats. I noticed thin looking coverage around the edges of my nails after 2 coats but after a third the coverage was sufficient. This polish is generally thinner than the other colors I've tried from shellac.
summary: This is a nice bright color but I recommend using 3 coats.

reviewText: This gel nail polish stays put for three weeks, or more when used with base and top coat. I have kept it on without changing for three weeks. I changed only then because my nails needed filing and new growth was visible. You also need to set polish with uv light sold here at Amazon. I love it. No chips at all. This stuff is indestructible. I wash my hands numerous times daily in addition to using hand sanitizer multiple times. Nothing breaks this stuff down. Nails look the same the 21st day as the 1st day. Only takes a total of 30 minutes per manicure. Salons charge $40 or more for gel nails. For $100 for everything you have enough manicures to last more than a year. Check out CND Nail website for colors and tutorial.
This is a great product and offers good coverage with great shine. I like this product on my acrylic nails and I am able to go longer between fills.
This is a perfect color for spring!  You need at least 2 coats if not 3 to bring it up to it's richest color.  Very eye catching, fun color.

First time using Shellac. Have had it on for a week now and it's still on. :0)
Since my nails are short right now I like having a light color on them. This is
a very nice color.

I really like these shellac nails. I find they do not last 3 weeks, it really depends I think on what you do with your hands. When I am working in the dirt, or anything that puts nails at risk they will chip as other polishes do. But I have an allergy to acrylic so these are a dream come true for me to have. My nails tend to be very thin and break easily, however, it is not rare that my nail polish will last near 2 weeks at a time if I take it easy on the hands. Love the color, you use this as a base for a french manicure and it works well. Very natural color.

This is a great summer or vacation color.  Easy to apply, bright and cheerful, it's perfect with summer clothing or maybe even a pick-me-up in the winter.  I'm going to try it on my toes for next vacation.  Great color for your Shellac collection.

Granted, I'm not a professional manicurist and a rather new Shellac do-it-yourselfer, but I found this color hard to apply.  It gave a streaky finish and didn't seem to cure as nicely as some of the matte colors.  I didn't feel so bad when I was at the salon recently and a woman had this color applied by a professional.  She came back into the salon after getting into her car and experiencing immediate peeling of this color.  So even the pros have problems with it.  When I try again, I'll add extra curing time.

THese light cure gel systems are such a great remedy for keeping nice looking nails on active hands. Shellac is an excellent 1. Just make sure you read the quick start instrucs for the entire system. I learned a lot from Amazon reviews & a referral to some great UTUBE videos by someone like "nail fixer" or "nail problem solver." Anyway, you can find her fairly easily & learn everything you need to know to do a truly pro looking mani/pedi.
This product came on time and was in perfect condition. This color is great and can be worn any time of the year even though it is bright!
This product came on time and was in perfect condition. This color is great and can be worn any time of the year!

I like soft pinks and found that this is too hot pink for me.  One of the reviews thought it wasn't pink enough.  I like more subtal tones, so this was not for me, even using one coat.  I will never use it again.  The one I love so far is Negligee.  Althought the bottle is acually white, the color is a classic, beautiful solf pink, see through slightly.  Very classy.  I would never wear hot pinks, blues or crazy colors.  I am going to try some reds for the holidays, I ordered Decadance.  I like the color of it in the bottle, but haven't tried it yet.

This color is lovely!  As the title indicates, it is a warm dark chocolate color.  It looks just okay on my super pale skin, but is absolutely stunning on a darker complexion.  Like all Shellac products, it's super shiny, chip-resistant and lasts forever!
This is an absolutely perfect classic red color, and like all Shellac products, super shiny, no chips and long lasting...Love!

I have been wearing this color on my nails for almost 3 weeks now because I love it so much! It has a nice metallic quality to it when you see it in bright light, and has no blue tones to it like so many purples I've tried in the past. It is a very nice "grape" type of purple that does not look black or gothic. I have been using the shellac system at home for months now and I think it is the best polish you can buy.

As I have stated with another review for Shellac I think this is worth pointing out to potential buyers that this is a UV polish - it requires curing via a UV light and is used with Shellac UV base and top coats!

Having purchased a bunch of pinks and reds, I decided on something a bit different and this certainly fit the bill! Its a beautiful color, really unique and perfect as we go into Fall!

The color may best be described as a deep purple! It is a deep inky color. I cured the base coat for about 2 minutes, as I find this works better than the time suggested on the bottle which is in seconds, then applied 2 coats curing each for 2 minutes! It needs the 2 coats as the color is a little faint and washed out with just one application! Then followed with a generous coat of the Shellac top coat!

The result: pretty and shiny nails, I have been wearing this color for 10 days and still no peeling or chipping! It looks as shiny as the first day I applied it and the color is still vibrant!  It is really a cool modern color and will look great for Fall  / Winter and a great party idea for Halloween! It is pretty dark so worth noting!

To remove I find the easiest thing is to get a small bowl, fill with some acetone and soak for about 6-10 minutes, it simply melts off with no problem!
summary: Amazing color with great staying power!

reviewText: I'm a beginner when it comes to applying my own Shellac.  I've purchased 5 colors so far:  Hollywood, Red Baroness, Tropix, Iced Cappuccino, and Iced Coral.  I've found the Iced colors are much more difficult to use and haven't gotten good results with either color.  The matte colors are much easier to apply thinly and smoothly.  I haven't given up on the iced colors, but think I need more experience before I can get good results.  Fingernailfixer.com is a great website for videos and tips.  She has a great video on trouble shooting and mentions that the iced colors are difficult.  My Iced Cappuccino application ended up streaky and blobby so I removed it immediately.

Love, love the Hot Chilies.  As with many other shellac colors, the bottle isn't true to color.  It has a nice sheen and has more red/orange tones than the color on the bottle.

As with all shellac product, you'll need base and top coat, and a UV light.  It is sooo worth buying the system, it's great not having to worry about your nails until you are ready to take it off due to nail growth.  I don't have the time, patience, or money to go to a salon every two weeks.
summary: My favorite shellac color so far

reviewText: I was expecting an orangey-coral as the bottle shows, but this was more pinky-coral.  The color doesn't have much sheen, and it is bright.  Personally, I like Hot Chilies better - it has the sheen to it and is more reddish/orangish than pink.  Although I wasn't thrilled with this color at first, it grew on me.  A week and a half later, I was sad to see it go.  I will definitely shellac my nails in this color again, but only in summer when I'm feeling young and flirty.  As others posted, you'll need a UV light and base & top coats with this polish.

Love the whole Shellac experience! It is unbelievable how beautiful my nails look and the fact that the manicure lasts for 2 weeks is absolutely supreme. I have one less thing to stress about, chipped nails be gone!  This color is bright and summery.  I have really enjoyed all the compliments I have gotten on my fingernails and toenails!
summary: Beautiful color with nice summery pop!

reviewText: I do wish there was a way to tell when there is sparkle in a product. This does have a little sparkle in it, but is a pretty color.

I purchased the shellac system to use at home.  (base coat, color, top coat and lamp).  I love this color.  It is a classic red: no metallic or pearl to it.  It stays shiny for a long time, too.  I find that some of the colors stay on longer then others for whatever reason and this one is one of the longer lasting ones.  It's my favorite red out of both shellac generations of colors.

I am a huge CND Shellac fan and one of my biggest complaints is that you cannot tell what color you are going to get until you use the actual polish.  I agree with the other reviewer that the bottle is misleading...but it is probably because the bottle must be made of UV protected opaque material to keep it from curing.
This color is very clear and has the slightest bit of pink that is barely noticeable.  I think it will look good with a french manicure.

I love this color.  The CND Shellac technology is great.  And yes, you must 'cure' this type of nail color/polish with a UV light. But it is totally worth the added cost and effort.  It does not chip and it stays shiny (with the required top coat). It takes about 5 minutes to remove and does not damage the nail.

This color is a very dark brown with a hint of maroon.  I use it on my fingernails and it 'matches' enough with Essie's "Wicked" color.  It is a fab color for the winter months.  I think it may be a bit too much for summer and spring.

This is the hot shade in fashion now and it delivers.  With short groomed nails it is just great and I love wearing it.  It lasts perfectly for the two weeks.  No chips at all!  Best idea was the Shallac polish for natural nail girls out there.

This is a classic red.  I loved wearing it for the two weeks you can keep the Shellac polish on.  I felt very professional at work and it looked good with everything (except orange of course!).  I will keep on loving this color.  I only wish Shellac would come out with new colors...

This color is similar to a bubble gum sparkle pink.  It looked like it would be a creamy beige to me or at least I hoped it would be.  Looking for a nice neutral shade.  It was anything but.  This one will be tossed.

I had ordered the Shellac Negligee but did not receive the order. I noticed that it had been shipped, but somehow got lost in the mail. When I contacted the shipper, I was assured that I would receive a replacement immediately, and I did. There was no hassle, nothing, just a new shipment. I am so happy to have done business with this company. Thank you. Now on the note about the shellac. It is easy to use and stays put for three to four weeks. It's easy to apply and actually easy to take off with some acetone.

Love this shade!

Buyers, if you are contemplating this product - it is a UV polish. Quite different to traditional polish - you will need the Shellac UV base coat, top coat, a color like this....and a UV lamp. It is essentially baked on or 'cured' with a UV light and will not dry on its own

I really got fed up of polishing my nails only to have it chip and peel within a day so I tried the OPI UV and loved the look  - polish stays on for 2 weeks , no chipping but it came with a price tag - locally for me $40 - plus it you had to wait half an hour to soak off or chip off and ruin your nails!

Reviews suggested this works much the same as OPI but does not take as long to remove so I purchased two shades, a UV top coat, base coat and UV lamp - my total out of pocket was $180, but I figured going to a salon costs $40 plus tip so this will pay for itself in 4 uses!

It is so simple, if you can polish your mails with regular nail polish then you can do this, only once done, you have beautiful color, amazing shine and it stays on for at least 2 weeks  - the whole time looking like you just stepped out of a salon!

Great product and lovely color!
summary: Lovely color with pretty sheen (and buyers - you need a UV lamp with this product)

reviewText: Never ever again ...in couple days of using this product my skin burning and red and I am in pain..
summary: Never ever again... in couple days of ...

reviewText: Still waiting for results promised. Way over priced for your basic moisturizer.

This is a nice, rich, lightly scented white cream. It feels like it's going to be greasy but it isn't at all after application. You don't need much.  It seems to have a nice effect on my skin, overall -- except for the part where I got a bunch of very unusual pimples right after I started using it. This is obviously not ideal, and maybe it wasn't this product, but the timing sure matched.

So, I'm continuing to use it, but cautious. That last pimple on the tip of my nose was kind of a bummer. :) Other than that, I look great, though!

I generally like Vichy products, and this is another good addition to the lineup.

I have finicky sink in that sometimes my face is fine with whatever I toss on it but the next day the same things can make it angry.  So this review is going to be wack from the get-go, I apologize.

The first thing I noticed was the citrus scent which for a supposed sensitive skin friendly cream was intriguing because they're usually unscented.

While I didn't notice a dramatic change with the few fine lines I have, I did notice that the skin appeared to be a bit smoother.  The pores seemed to be a bit smaller as well.

The cream is rather thick so a little bit goes a long way which is good for this product since it's not the cheapest one out there.

There was a bit of redness after using for about a week so I discontinued it for now to see if my skin was just getting angry from the cream or something else so I'm taking a bit of a break.
summary: Overall nice, unsure if I'd use every day

reviewText:
Full disclosure: I've been using Vichy a long time. Long before I was able to get this Vine sample.  I've always liked their brand.  Several reasons, one of which is that they are honest with packaging. The bottle you see is the size you get. No false bottoms that fill up half the bottle so you get less.  No big boxes containing a tiny product inside.  So many luxe brands do that.  You reach the bottom of the pot and it looks like it could still hold another ounce.  That's a big deal to me: Vichy shows you what you get.

The other thing is I have sensitive skin AND eyes. Before bed, some products end up rolling on to my pillow and later into my eyes.  The pain is excruciating.  Vichy never makes my rosacea act up or feels sensitive in any way, even if I have a blemish or a rash.  It's soft and soothing. Plus, I can tell it works because in the morning, when I wash my face lightly, I can still feel it on my skin.

With this bottle, they are promoting a new plumping feature.  I wish plumping was fashionable on my hips. Sadly, no. But it does help with wrinkles and I'm pleased with the look around my nose and crow's feet which look more like crow's footprints on the sand when I use this.

Vichy rules!

This is a great moisturizer that has been working well on my combination skin this winter.  The texture of this moisturizer is quite thick and stiff, like a butter, but it quickly melts into the skin.  It moisturizes well without being too greasy or heavy.  The scent is light and pleasant, a sort of herbal scent.  As mentioned, I have combination skin, and I need a moisturizer that can handle the dry parts without overwhelming the greasier parts.  In the winter the needs of the drier parts of my skin are more intense.  This moisturizer handles all of the parts of my face well, and I would not hesitate to purchase another pot of it when I run out of this one.  While 1.7 oz doesn't sound very big, in reality this is a generous-sized pot that will last for quite some time.  I'm interested in trying other Vichy skincare products now.

I love the way my skin looks after using this, and I have 60+ year old skin. As far as lessening the deep wrinkles on my upper cheeks (under my eyes) and the crows feet between my eyebrows -- it's hard to tell. Perhaps it has helped a tiny amount and perhaps it's because those wrinkles are moisturized and "nourished," and moisturized skin looks better than dry skin. But I will say that my skin and the texture of my pores look absolutely fantastic without any makeup. I am thrilled with the way this gives my face a healthy looking glow.

This has a very slight fragrance -- I like it.

After water and glycerin, RHAMNOSE is the third ingredient. The box states, "For the first time RHAMNOSE an anti-wrinkle ingredient at 5% concentration has been shown to stimulate this source of young skin.*** "

The three *** refer to text further down on the box: "EFFICACY: Proven efficacy on wrinkles - forehead and neck wrinkles as well as crow's feet. Lasting lifting effect.*** "

You can research rhamnose on the web and come up with this result from the incredibly popular online "W" encyclopedia: "Rhamnose (Rham) is a naturally occurring deoxy sugar. It can be classified as either a methyl-pentose or a 6-deoxy-hexose. Rhamnose is commonly bound to other sugars in nature. It is a common glycone component of glycosides from many plants. Rhamnose is also a component of the outer cell membrane of acid-fast bacteria . . . "

From a recent article in the New York Times (by Courtney Rubin) that you might be able to find if you search using the author's name plus the words "chemists reformulate," and/or "hyaluronic acid," I am going to deduce (rightly or wrongly) that science is on the brink of a significant skin rejuvenation revolution. Why? Because they now know that it is the size of the molecules ("six different weights") that are necessary in skin care products that are most effective, have the longest lasting results, and stimulate collagen growth. From that article: "Lower weight molecules make their way into the skin and larger molecules are better at moisturizing, hence the need for both."

In addition to rhamnose, this VICHY V LIFTACTIV NIGHT has MANY ingredients, some of which I am thinking are acids and all of which I have no idea of their molecular weight. For instance, they list glyceryl stearate which is a glycerol ester of stearic acid.
summary: I Love This V VICHY LIFTACTIV For Nourishing Texture

reviewText:
It works as advertised. It is a thick, creamy texture that melts immediately into my skin, leaving a soft, smooth finish. It is non-sticky and non-greasy. I love the feel, the not fragranced smell, and the jar itself is very elegant.

I use it at night and in the morning before applying a foundation.

For my 50+ year old tough New England skin, which used to be sensitive, its very nice. I wish I had taken a before and after photo, it seems to help make my skin smoother and firm up minor wrinkles that are appearing, but I cant tell and there are multiple products at work here.

I recommend it and will continue to use it.  The price is well within the ballpark for equivalent products from others lines I've used.

For a $50 cream I expected something better. The box says the cream was tested for sensitive skin, but there is no way this product is a sensitive skin-friendly. It is not extremely irritating, but after just a couple of uses I noticed the familiar itchiness. I am pretty sure I won't be using it again as I expect a few more uses will deliver enough chemicals into my skin for a full breakout.

Sad. I wanted to like it. Looks very luxurious and candy.

I have been using this cream for 2 weeks now and while I don't see a huge difference in fine lines, my skin does seem firmer and for some reason the redness around my nose and cheeks is less prominent.
While the cream is 50.00, you use very little.  It is very dense and creamy and you don't need a lot to cover your face.  It has a nice, light citrus scent that I really like .
The cream has also earned the Good Housekeeping seal of approval.
I would highly recommend this cream to anyone looking for a super rich, not crazy expensive alternative to a higher end brand.
summary: Thick, rich and creamy night cream

reviewText: I started using the Vichy LiftActiv the first night I received it.  I like the product's non greasy feel on my face and neck, the clean fresh scent is also very nice.  I like everything about this product and the way it leaves my skin feeling...the only problem is the price is a bit high for my budget.  My jar of Vichy came from Amazon which probably has the best price going so if you want a good night cream this is where I would start.

This rich night cream is not greasy or heavy, but it is very soothing. I have to admit that it would probably work faster and better on younger faces. This one has seen a decade or two too many, but, after using this potion every night for a week, I do think some of my finer grooves and gouges seem a little less prominent. This is a long-term project, though. There is enough in this very pretty jar for more than a month, and I may see more dramatic results by the time it is empty. For now, I can say that it has not irritated my very sensitive skin, has moisturized, smoothed, and softened the skin on my face, and is making a start at making my wrinkles a little less wrinkly.

Ugh. Phenoxyethanol! A neurotoxin, skin irritant, and potential carcinogen, why can't we stop using this in our products? Because it's a preservative to extend shelf life and people are already wise to the evils of parabens, that's why. I didn't know it was in this product before I agreed to try it, and when I saw that it was way down the list of ingredients I thought that a tiny schmear of it wouldn't matter. But it did. Despite the nice light fragrance and smooth hydrating feel, my skin became more irritated after each use. (Yes, I'm ridiculously sensitive.) Too bad. The packaging is beautiful, with a mirror on the top of the jar, and all. But I'm back to using a few drops of a pure lite olive oil applied with a swatch of paper towel before bed. My skin eats it up, it has no smell, and my face is moist and radiant the next day. It was Sophia Loren's secret, olive oil. Not nearly as chic as this Vichy product, but a lot healthier at present. Maybe L'Oreal will find a way to remove the bad chemicals while keeping the chic!
summary: Keep the Chic, Lose the Phenoxyethanol

reviewText: This cream is extremely thick.  You just need to barely touch your finger to the surface to get enough to smooth over your entire face.  Even using such a small amount, this started clogging my pores my the next morning.  By the next day, I could see little whiteheads all over my forehead.  Since I'm age 50+ and have dry skin, I haven't dealt with whiteheads in years.  I won't be using this any more.

I have tried other Vichy creams and like them.  This cream has Rhamnose in it which is supposed to be an anti aging ingredient.  This cream has a thick consistency but does not leave my skin greasy.  I have just started using it and will return to update this when the jar is empty.  This cream is more expensive than the creams I usually buy so I will need to see results before purchasing this.  So far I do like it though.

The only drawback is that the jar is a little hard for my wife to open. She believes it to be a design flaw in the jar's design.
She is extremely happy with the product: a nice light scent; easily applied; not greasy; absorbs very well and quickly; noticeable improvement to skin over night, less definitive wrinkles, and a smoother feel to one's skin; and the texture/density of the crme in jar means the cream should last longer than normal.
I, however, had no problem with opening or closing the jar.

Time will tell on just how well the product performs overall, in improving the users skin.
If the overnight improvement is a telltale sign; it's a good bet for the long run as well.
summary: Nice Light Scent/Not Greasy/Absorbs Very Well and Quickly/Observable Overnight Improvement/ But...

reviewText: Vichy is a newer brand for me. I've never heard of them until last year when I tried Vichy LiftActiv Serum 10. I used that for three days before I noticed a discernible difference in my skin's hydration. I used this last night and I am not joking--there is a lot of difference around the lines around my mouth. The scent is not as strong as the serum and the cream is very thick so apply lightly. Absorption is almost immediate. My husband tried this around his crow's feet but there was no difference this morning. We'll keep applying and update accordingly. The price is on par with Clarins or Shiseido. I do wish it be available at local retail stores but happily I'm able to get this from Amazon

The LiftActiv, which is made and manufactured in France, has a pleasant consistency and scent. I found that this product does in fact have a firming effect upon the skin, and the effect was not due to any sort of irritation or ill reaction to the cream. While the jury is still out on the small line removal, the claim of firming action does appear to be factual. The glass jar comes in a mirror finish cardboard box.

I love this night cream, not only because it instantly softens without a greasy feel, but the scent is positively divine!
It has that slight sea salt/mineral element that is the freshness in so many 'beachy' perfumes. It isn't strong, and it does dissipate quickly, but every time I put it on, I feel as relaxed as a day at a seaside spa.
Perfect way to feel at night.
Skin still feels soft in the morning.

Because you need just a dab or two, this is actually a great value for a high end product.

This is a night-time facial cream which has a plant-based sugar (rhamnose) as its active solution. This solution is supposed to, over time, thicken skin that is thinning with age and clinical studies have supposedly proven the effects of it in terms of promoting collagen in the skin. Since I can't speak to its scientific effects, I can only talk about how it felt and changed things for me, but the research did look promising. At 51, I also felt I was a good candidate for it.

In terms of the product itself, the consistency is quite thick. It goes on slightly dryer than some night creams, but not like a dry foundation. Mainly, it gives smooth coverage without being greasy or heavy. It feels very smooth and a small amount will do you. I would say be careful not to scoop out more with your fingertip than you need so as not to waste it as a thicker coat isn't going to provide more benefit and this is not cheap.

It's very hard to be objective about the appearance of your skin on a day-to-day basis, even with long-term use of a product, since appearance changes based on things like amount of sleep, diet, and hormone cycles. I also regularly use a night-time moisturizer, but I did feel this product was a cut above the usual. It's important to keep in mind what it can and can't do though. Sagging skin that is the result of gravity is not really impacted. Fine lines that come from dry, thinning, aging skin seem to be diminished, however. Skin tone and plumpness seem to be improved. Whether or not this has value to you depends on age and your particular issues. It does not turn the clock back, but it does improve an aggregate of issues related to aging that make your skin look better overall.
summary: works on fine lines and wrinkles

reviewText: Really love this.  It is a white whipped cream the consistency of Noxema.  Very generous jar this is no sampler size!  Has a light, very fresh clean scent, barely there.  Goes on silky smooth with leaving a healthy glow, not a greasy shiny look.  Gives a very slight tingly fresh feeling to your face and neck that lasts a very long time. Does not pull or tighten.  Softens lines and gives your face a healthy clean feeling and sheen.  I'm not expecting a face-lift, at age 55 I just want my wrinkles to relax and soften and to help my dry skin.  This product absolutely performs!
summary: Really love this.  It is a white whipped cream the consistency of Noxema.  Very generous jar this is no sampler size!

reviewText: I think this is probably the richest, thickest, creamiest face cream I've ever had the pleasure of smearing on my face.  My face feels super soft and my fine lines are less obvious.  My skin looks dewy and feels moisturized even the next morning.  Now, I have mature skin so if you are on the oily side, then this might not be the cream for you.  As for any lifting or firming action, I sadly cannot see any evidence of that.
summary: So soft and creamy I wish I could bathe in it

reviewText:
I am not usually a fan of too many night creams because they're usually heavy/greasy and it grosses me out to think of something like that on my face all night trapped on my skin between the pillow. There are very few that I have ever liked and that felt light enough and absorbed enough for me to tolerate. This is one of them.

I apply just enough to cover my face and lightly moisturize and I don't end up with a heavy or greasy feeling. I also do not wake up with a slimy greasy fave in the morning. Other night creams I have tried have made me look and feel like an oily mess jn the morning. I love that this one is not like that.

My skin looks and feels so soft and smooth when I wake up. It does give a very youthful look and feel to the skin. No, you won't look like you've had plastic surgery, of course, but you can definitely see an imorovement. Fine lines are plumped out a bit so that they are less noticeable. My only deep line runs across my forehead and I've noticed that one looks better too.

This is a nice size jar and when combined with using a light hand during application and the fact that it is a thick, rich cream means you don't need a lot when you use it and  also means it will last quite awhile so the price is very reasonable.

There is a light scent. I think it smells good and is not very noticeable at all.

If you ever accidentally get to much product out, it is lovely on the back of your hands to use up the excess and not waste it. It really softens them and makes all the teeny tiny lines disappear.
summary: No oily face in the morning

reviewText: I couldn't see that it did anything for the lines around my mouth.  They are supposed to be smoker's lines although I do not smoke and it's been 15 years since I did, I noticed nothing when I applied it above my upper lip.  I was hopeful but I saw nothing.
summary: Didn't seem to do anything for me

reviewText: This cream is a little tingly and works great to take care of the delicate eye area. I have seen some improvement only using it for a little over a week. The skin around my eyes was too dry and puffy and this cream took care of it. I didn't have a lot of wrinkles but this will be part of my skin care so that I keep the wrinkles away. I put a small amount in my finger and dabbed it around the eye area, didn't really like using the metal part mainly because I was hard to control how much cream came out. The metal feels cold and soothing on your skin so if you'd like that sensation use it to massage in the cream. It is a white cream that is not greasy at all and it didn't disrupt the rest of my eye care or makeup application, it absorbs quickly and cleanly into the skin.

Most eye creams don't address the 3 major aging issues: wrinkles, dark circles and puffiness.  This cream has plumped up my skin and made my crow's feet less noticeable.  It's faded the deep dark cicles under my eyes.  And perhaps most shocking, it's deflated the puffy bags under my eyes.  Even after eating Chinese food, which has enough sodium to make me look like I glued tiny pillows under my eyes, I woke up with almost zero puffiness.  The smooth metal tip might have something to do with it.  The cool metal feels very soothing, makes application a breeze and helps constrict the blood vessels to help get rid of puffiness
summary: Took care of even my most annoying issue: big puffy bags

reviewText:
I like this cream as it definitely softened and enhanced the look of my under eye area. I didn't notice as much difference around the lips.

In my early 60s, I guess I don't care enough about reducing the signs of aging to spend almost $50 for this small tube or make little circles with the cream under my eyes or around my mouth...too time consuming.

As the years continue to sink me into decrepitude, I am far better off spending my money on books on Wabi-sabi that extol the beauty of imperfection and natural aging than on vain attempts at stemming the inevitable tide.

This product is geared towards treatment of delicate eye and lip area.  I used Neovadiol based product from Vichy that was facial oil (day treatment) and found that this eye and lip cream complements the other beautifully).  I liked the packaging.  Tip of the tube has metal end and if used directly on the skin provides nice, cooling effect.  I also like the fact tat cream is used on lip and eye area.  Often times we hear that eyes thin skin is the first one to show sign of of aging, but we used lips all the time too, so treating that area of the face is just as important as the eyes.

main ingredients include: shea butter, stearic, citric and palmitic acid.  I love that product is paraben-free.  There are two other advanced ingredients in this product that I am not familiar with: ProXylane and Proteic Gf.  I will have to do some additional research on these ingredients separately.  Also, all Vichy products use special thermal water from France, which is what makes them unique.  Loreal company manufacture s these products and they are available in major drugstores like Walgreens and CVS.  their price is reasonable too.  This product comes in 0/.5 oz size so it will not take much space in your bathroom (or in your purse should you decide to carry it.

Last time I received Vichy product (talk skin refinisher) the box packaging had Russian descriptions on one side.  This time, I was amused that there was Greek writing on one side of the packaging and English on the other.  This cream is thick but it spreads quickly and easily on the skin.  It also has cooling, tightening and smoothing effect on the skin (especially eye area).  It does not have strong fragrance for anyone who is concerned about sensitive skin and allergies.
summary: Lip and eye cream geared towards menopausal women.

reviewText: This is a nice cream that spreads out over my skin so only a tiny bit is needed.  It is softening and smoothing but does not make a visible difference in wrinkles.  My skin feels very soft from the but I can't see a difference.  It has a pleasant mild scent.
summary: Softening, smoothing, a dab goes a long way

reviewText:
Have used Vichy products before and really like this one too. I have been using it for about a week and while I notice a lot of improvement around the eyes, the lips have been helped to a minimal degree. But every little bit helps; at my age, I'll take all the help I can get.

This is a great product, if a bit on expensive side. Well worth the extra expense, in my opinion.

Highly recommended, but the sooner you start using it the better.

Reviewed by Betty Dravis, January 23, 2016
Author of "The Search for Bobby McGee"
summary: Worth the extra expense! My eyes look much better, while lips are slightly better...

reviewText: This is a very nice moisturizer for your eyes and lips, but I don't feel it's anything special. I have used the product for over a week, and  I see no significant improvement in lines, or firming. It did reduce some puffiness around my eyes. I think the product is over priced for what it can really do.

I am a skeptic when it comes to eye creams and other products that are suppose to make wrinkles disappear, yet, thanks to Amazon I try the creams/products anyway in the hope that maybe, just maybe, one will actually work.

Vichy's Neovadiol Gf Eye & Lip cream seems to work temporarily on my fine eye creases. I put it around my eyes after washing my face each morning and evening. It does not change my eye puffiness, which is genetic. It also doesn't help deeper creases (laugh lines). I do not have lip issues, so did not test this facial area.

The applicator is a nice, angled dispenser that is easy to use and dispenses regular, even amounts of cream. Not much cream is used during the application process, so the product may last for awhile if you don't squeeze vigorously on the tube. The cream absorbs quickly into my skin. I do follow with my regular face cream as well as use sunscreen under makeup daily.

Upshot is that the product seems to work temporarily on fine lines, but not deeper lines. Whether the price is worth the use is up to the user.
summary: Temporary Fix for Fine Eye Lines, but Not for Deeper Lines or Puffiness

reviewText:
This is a product that is supposed to smooth wrinkles. It does moisturize the skin and I like that it is not over-fragranced like many products are. Unfortunately it still has a slight odor, slightly medicinal, which makes it unpleasant to use near my nose. Since the wrinkles on my face tend to be within a few inches of my nose, I really don't want to place it on the wrinkles. Thus I cannot judge how well it treats wrinkles, so I apologize for that.  I also felt that the light fumes from the product were a bit irritating to my eyes so I didn't want to use it near my eyes.

You may not have these reactions at all. I happen to be very sensitive and there are very few products that I tolerate. This one, at least, did not make my skin break out like some products do. Since it an effective moisturizer I will probably use it on my hands or elbows or something.
summary: Good for Adding Moisture to Skin

reviewText:
Vichy Neovadiol Gf Eye and Lip Contours is intelligently packaged. The tube will keep the ingredients from deteriorating over time. The well-shaped, metal applicator end is smooth and cool. Just the feel of its luxurious, soothing curves as I apply the cream to my undereye area makes me feel refreshed. And immediately after application there seems to be a plumping and illuminating effect that causes wrinkles to fade slightly. But after an hour or less, the plumping effect disappears and my skin returns to the way it looked before. So, the effects for me are immediate, but so far not long lasting. Ive only been using the cream for a couple of weeks and even Vichy indicates it takes longer than that for more significant results. On Vichys website, they claim this Neovadiol will produce visible results within 4 weeks. They specifically state that users saw the following reductions--
In 1 month:
  22.4% reduction in crows feet
  23.3% reduction of under eye wrinkles
  16.7% reduction in under eye bags
  33.7% reduction in upper lip lines
*clinical scores after 4 weeks of twice daily use

Since its pleasant to use, Ill keep using it, but I am highly unlikely to reorder. The ingredients are good, but not remarkable. The sixth ingredient is denatured alcohol, which is probably in there to make the cream absorb deeper. But Paula Begouns Beautypedia has a very convincing, long article about the dangers of denatured alcohol that concerns me.

INGREDIENTS as listed on the box I received:
AQUA / WATER  GLYCERIN  HYDROGENATED POLYISOBUTENE  BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII BUTTER / SHEA BUTTER  PROPYLENE GLYCOL  ALCOHOL DENAT.  PENTAERYTHRITYL TETRAETHYLHEXANOATE  DIMETHICONE  POLY C10-30 ALKYL ACRYLATE  SILICA  SUCROSE STEARATE  SILICA (NANO)  CI 42090 / BLUE 1  CI 77891 / TITANIUM DIOXIDE  STEARIC ACID  CERA ALBA / BEESWAX  MICA  DIMETHICONE/VINYL DIMETHICONE CROSSPOLYMER  SODIUM POLYACRYLATE  SODIUM COCOYL GLUTAMATE  PALMITIC ACID  PHENOXYETHANOL  ADENOSINE  VIGNA ACONITIFOLIA / VIGNA ACONITIFOLIA SEED EXTRACT  AMMONIUM ACRYLOYLDIMETHYLTAURATE / STEARETH-25 METHACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER  DISODIUM EDTA  HYDROXYPROPYL TETRAHYDROPYRANTRIOL  CAPRYLYL GLYCOL  CITRIC ACID  EPERUA FALCATA BARK EXTRACT  DEXTRIN
summary: INGREDIENTS list for this beautifully packaged, soothing cream

reviewText:
I'm 50 years old. I don't have lines around my lips but I am starting to get fine lines around my eyes
This product has some basic well known moisturizers like pro-xylane and she's butter.
It feels vey rich and creamy.
A little goes a long way
The tube has a metallic applicator meant to be used to massage around the peri orbital  and oral area.
I'm not sure how hygienic it is to use around lips and then use around the eye as well!
I have only been using it around my eyes.
It feels nice.
No long term results so far, but I would not expect that from just a simple moisturizer - I think a retinol containing product is the only proven way to minimize these lines.
I think it is very expensive for just a basic nice eye cream.

Stars: 0
Claims to reduce fine lines by plumping, tightening & cooling the skin.  I noticed a wee bit of a tight feeling that passed quickly.  It is very cool feeling but that could be due to the super smooth metal applicator tip.  The applicator tip is a nice way to apply the product without tugging or scratching the delicate skin around the eyes (not so important around the lips, but even so, it feels nice).  Fine lines were not reduced.  Not one bit.  There they sat as evident as they ever are. Day after day.  And yes, they are fine lines.  I hate them & hoped that by some miracle this would give me the temporary illusion of younger skin.  For product claims this gets zero stars as it does not perform as advertised.
Stars: 5
This cream is ultra thick.  If you suffer from dry skin, this stuff is amazing.  I heat my home with a wood stove so I am really appreciating the intense richness of this cream.  For moisturizing capabilities I give it five stars.  On the downside this will be way too heavy in the summer.  There are no weird smells & I don't feel like I'm wearing perfume on my face.
To sum it up:
Stars: 3
If you are looking at this product to reduce your fine lines, move along.  If you need extreme moisturizing, look no further.
summary: Does Not Improve Signs Of Aging, Does Provide Incredible Moisturizing

reviewText:
Although some face creams and lotions take awhile to work, this product is designed to have an immediate effect on your eyes and lips -- and it really does work!  When I wake up in the morning, I have puffy eyes due to allergies, and the metal applicator tip on this soothes them right away.  It immediately plumps up the undereye and lip area, and smooths out those little lines that those of us who are past our mid-30's (I'm 44) start getting.

My package didn't come with an insert about how to use this, so these are the instructions that Vichy has given:

--"Lip Contours: Spread a small amount of cream around the lips. Upper lip - massage delicately using circular movements. Lower lip - smooth in a backwards and forwards movement to the corners of the lips. Slide the applicator under the lower lip from right to left, and repeat the movement from left to right.

--Eye contours: Spread a small amount of cream around the eye. Place the tip of the applicator at the inner corner of the eye and smooth it outwards. Perform small circular movements in this area. At the outside corner, make a few rotations clockwise."

I've found that this also plays well with my other lotions and makeup, and it doesn't pill or ball up.  Since it works so well to de-puff morning eyes, though, I tend to use this right when I wake up, right after washing my face, which also gives it time to sink in before I apply makeup.

I'm really impressed with all the Vichy products I've tried so far!
summary: Works really well to de-puff your eyes

reviewerName: Keleigh Crigler Hadley, author of Revenge Inc.
reviewText: It's hard to write a review on a non-performing product. I smeared the cream in the contours of my eyes and onto my lips. I waited. I did the same thing in the evening. I waited. Next day, same thing. I waited. Nothing. No difference.

I really like this product so far. It's rich and creamy, yet absorbs well.  While it's too early to see long-term benefits, it makes my eye area look very moisturized and fresh.  I'm also using it around my mouth at night, although I don't have any issues with that area. So although I'm not seeing any changes, I didn't expect to.
