reviewText:
It's astonishing that with all the skincare products and lines I've tried, I never got anything Ahava. And it's a shame, since this is a very nice moisturizer. The scent is among the lightest of any I've ever tried (good for you gals who don't like a lot conflicting nose candy), and it goes on very well. Very silky texture, and melts into the skin super fast.

After reading some of the reviews, I feel the need to point out this is a FACIAL moisturizer. Of course you can use it on your hands, but why would you when it's formulated in a lighter, more absorbent texture for your face? A little goes a long way, and this small tube will last much longer if you use it where it's meant to go!

I'd also point out what a deal the mini is of this. Not only can you get a lot more by buying multiple minis than you can by buying the jar, but because you are only using these as you need them, they stay sanitary and sealed. Just a tip for you bargain hunters (me!) out there who like premium skincare at the best price. :)
summary: Super nice moisturizer, and the mini is a bargain!

reviewText: No good!
Lovely to use, light and rich at the same time

I have to admit that I was prepared to not like this. I have very pale skin and most concealers and foundations are too dark for me. I received the light Magnum and just happens to be perfect for my skin tone so I am glad I got a chance to try it. When I ordered this concealer, I actually didn't know that it was designed specifically for men. That doesn't mean the ladies can't use it, though, and I fully intend to. It comes in a tube similar to chapstick so you can throw it in your purse, or put it in your pocket where you can have it available throughout the day for emergency touch ups.
I would definitely buy this again.
summary: Very nice concealer for him or her.

reviewText:
As soon as I saw this, I wondered if it would work on my sons scars.  He has a scar along his neck that looks a little like Frankensteins neck.  (Not that I would ever tell him that.  I always say its looking better.)  Because it is still red and angry-looking, even months later, I was hoping that this would tone it down a little.  This scar was too much for Menajis abilities.  It would probably work better a year from now.

The other problem was the application.  It looks and feels a little like chap stick so if you are trying to put it on to cover blemishes, you are going to want to put it on your fingers first, because it is a little hard.  A little warmth helps.

Although I think concealer should be a gender-less product because we all occasionally need it, currently most are found in the cosmetic department next to mascara. This is an excellent concealer designed for men but good for all. The product is packaged in a large lip balm-style stick.

The other adult in residence occasionally has a blemish or other irritation, and although he is willing to tough-it-out there is really no reason not to discretely try to lessen the appearance. But, if an equal amount of attention is drawn to a glob of badly applied concealer, the exercise is a failure.

So, after a bit of arm twisting I showed him what I do with my concealer. First, fingers or using the stick directly on skin may transfer oil and/or bacteria to the product contaminating it. So to extend the life use an applicator. Facial sponges are good but unless trying to cover a large area are really not small enough for a skillful application. A simple cotton swab works well.

Less is more  it takes very little to cover a blemish. More can always be added but if the approach is to mute the appearance of the problem rather than layer on a heavy coat, the result will be more natural and not conspicuous. A little on a swab lightly dabbed on the spot feathering the edges out into the skin will obtain the least noticeable application. With a little practice a blemish or dark spot will disappear.

This light shade was a perfect match for fair skin. The other adult is pleased with the product and from my perspective it is excellent. The texture is perfect  not too thick or thin and it went on with a dry smoothness that blended well.

It wore well during the day but whether additional applications are needed will be determined by the level of oiliness, exertion or inadvertent skin touching. It is small, as are cotton swabs, so it can be easily transported, if needed.

My husband tried this but found that it was simply too pale a tone for him and was more noticeable than the spots he was trying to conceal.  It might work for someone with exactly the right skin tone but this was wrong for him.
summary: Cover spots but was more noticeable than the area my husband was trying to conceal

reviewText: This is my first time using a concealer and so far I'm really impressed with it. It does a fairly good job of hiding the razor burn that I got yesterday. It comes in a large chapstick tube container and appears like clay to me. It looks darker in the tube than it does on the skin. I used my finger to dab a bit of it and rub it on my razor burn spots. It takes a bit of time to get absorbed and blend in evenly. That said, it does mask the redness from razor burn fairly well but not the bumps or swelling. When I look close enough in the mirror, I can also see what appears to be a makeup on my face although it is very light. Anyway, it is not very obvious in normal social distance and completely unnoticeable at night. Overall, it does what it says fairly well and makes the redness from razor burn largely disappear. Good product.
summary: Works fairly well to hide redness and small blemishes

reviewText:
The Menaji CAMO concealer is a good a general use concealer in a very convenient, easy to carry packaging. Having said that, the concealer is of a ticker mud-ish consistency which (depending on your skin tone) might require quite a bit of blending to not be obvious. While not specifically listed as non comedogenic, the concealer did not feel heavy or blocking when applied (although I wouldn't call it "light" either). If you have serious issues with breakouts due to pore blockage, you may want to find something specifically listed as non comedogenic instead of risking it. It is listed as hypoallergenic - I don't have sensitive skin, but I did not notice any reaction from use.

I received the "Light" coloring and I would say that the description is pretty accurate. I generally have a light/medium skin tone and the concealer, once blended in, is a decent match. While not perfect, it's not painfully obvious that I'm wearing concealer either.  At the time of this review, this product was priced in the mid-twenties, making it a low-to-mid-ranged price for most concealers. When compared to similar brands, there are some really good names out there that - while not specifically marketed towards men - are awesome products. Personally I think I'd pick up a Nars, Make Up Forever, or Urban Decay instead. However this concealer performed decently well (but I'd still keep my Nars close at hand).
summary: A decent concealer in a great carry-along packaging

reviewText:
This concealer is marketed to men. The scent is not heavy although it is detectable. The container is like you get for Chapstick. I got the Magnum Light shade but it was not very light.

The description said it is "infused with vitamins and SPF 8 protection." I don't know why that would matter for something you use only for small areas of skin. Of course, SPF 8 is not much sun protection.

The texture reminds me of liquid clay. While this covers okay on smooth skin, it does not cover bumps well. Even on smooth skin it takes some effort to get it to look even. It does not look totally natural to me. On the plus side, it does not seem to be irritating to skin and the scent is not objectionable.
summary: Not Great but not Too Fragrant and the Container is Handy to Use

reviewText:
I've never tried a concealer before.  Truth be told, I have an aversion to men wearing make-up unless they are doing some sort of performance.  Even when it comes to women, I think the more subtle the make-up is applied, the better.  So with that point of view, I wasn't sure I would like this product but given that I'm am fair skinned and have various issues (freckles, various keratoses which I have removed by my dermatologist when possible, etc), I figured that it would be interesting to see if I could cover up some of these blemishes without the make-up being obvious.

When you first apply this concealer, it's definitely noticeable.  It's not supposed to be just applied to one's skin like lip balm to one's lips, though; it's designed to be rubbed in.  Once the product is lightly rubbed in, it does a very good job at blending in with my complexion.  It subtly masks my skin's blemishes but does not entirely hide them.  I think that if it did entirely hide blemishes as dark as freckles, the product would appear more obvious one one's skin.

The product has some sun protection built in, but I honestly cannot imagine applying so much of this product that it would substitute for my normal sunscreen.  Besides, it's only SPF 8.
summary: Subtly diminishes appearance of various blemishes, but does not entirely conceal them

reviewText:
I'm not a guy, but I have several skin issues that plague many men like excess oiliness. Plus, I really don't like to look like I am wearing make-up, so I had high hopes for this. First the pro: It's easy to apply. The big chapstick-like tube is really hand to stash in even the smallest purse. However, this doesn't outweight the cons which are numerous.

The cons:This is very chalky and much lighter than I expected. Also, and this is the biggest drawback, it doesn't cover that well. I had only mild undereye circles and had to reapply it 3 times to get proper coverage, and it still wasn't enough. I can't see most people wearing this but especially not most guys since this is more obvious than most.

My advice: save your money and head to Maybelline, L'oreal, or e.l.f. All three of these lines have far better concealers that are a lot cheaper.

I dragged my husband out to a local high end cosmetic store that caters to both sexes to try this male concealer out. My husband has fairly even skin with the exception of a few sun spots. Having the help of a makeup professional really helped because it gave both of us an idea of how to apply this product and what the end results could be.
Application is fairly easy. The product comes in an applicator that reminds me of my chap stick or lip gloss. It comes in three shades and I am surmising that the shade used would be determined by a person's ethniticity. In my husband's case he is an ash blond and has fair yet a somewhat weathered complection. Using the tube you dab this on the imperfection and then feather it outward as you blend it in. It topically conceals the spot sort of subtlely and appears to be somewhat impervious to sweat as long as you don't rub your face.
Being a somewhat strange dame I gave this a try on a birth mark on my face near my eye. I used the same technique with the exception of some matte face powder. I thought this worked as well as my female concealer, but it seemed less greasy/moisturizing when compared to most of the concealers I've tried.
I thought this worked well, was easy to apply and did a good overall job while managing to conceal problem spots for several hours before needing a touch up. I could see using this myself. My husband would no doubt use this as well.

I had never expected to try a product like this until it popped up in Vine. Then, I thought, why not? It is very easy to apply, goes on pretty smoothly. It does a pretty job concealing. I'm still not sure if I'm using enough or not, but it blends into the skin very easily. Overall, it does a pretty good job and is easy to apply. It does seem pretty pricey, which is about my only knock on it.

This product is only OK.  I can see the usefulness of this product, but I think it takes a special kind of guy to actually wear it.  My husband would use it, but I would say he isn't the norm.  Most men just don't seem to care that much what they look like, or things like dark circles, acne, razor bumps, etc.  I do think though, if you are a man with severe issues that are constant, like the ones mentioned, that this would make for a great product.  I am sure my husband would only use it for special occassions and maybe for family photos or something like that. It does cover pretty well, it appeared a different formula from my concealer, but maybe that is because mens skin is different.

I picked this up for my husband (and wasn't sure if he would use it!), but he's used it a few times so far, and likes it.  Not only is it good for covering pimples, but it's also good for covering red razor burn bumps, without burning or stinging those areas.

The color matching is pretty spot-on (pun intended :-) ).  I bought the light color for his fair skin, and it looks really natural.

The size of this also makes it easy to put in a briefcase or backpack; it's about the size of a large lip balm.
summary: Does a nice job of covering razor bumps and pimples

reviewText:
My husband and I were scheduled to get photos done and I thought we'd try this on some red areas on his face. He only grudgingly agreed and it did work nicely. Photos came out great. However he has refused to consider further use.

His loss is my gain. I have been using this as a concealer and it works perfectly well for age spots and under eye darkness. I am pale and this product in Light works just fine for me. I do feather it out with a makeup sponge. It isn't drying or cake-y. Easy to carry in a purse or pocket.
summary: Got this for my husband but I'll end up using it

reviewText:
The online representations of these colors, vs. what they look like in person (and on your eyes), have very little in common!
I was pretty hesitant to select Cassis as it looked too teen-purple, but thought what the heck, I can use it as eyeliner if it's too bright.
Bright?!?! No! Gorgeous, deep, amazing, YES! I am pasty white and purple tends to make me look bruised. This went on so softly and smoothly, no fallout anywhere, and it stayed true all day. It looked so pretty on my hazel eyes! I just couldn't believe how pretty this shadow was when it was on. It is not the "grape Kool Aid" color that it appears in online photos!

If you have any concerns about creasing, use Urban Decay Primer Potion on your eyelids (I also dab a little underneath my lower eyelash line) and your eye shadow will stick like glue. Stila eye shadows seem to really love the UDPP. I get all-day wear from them.
summary: Online photos do not do this color justice

reviewText: The only eyeshadow that can ever be worth 18$ alone!

I was so disappointed in this shade. I love Stila shadows, and this is their iconic shade. I'd heard about "kitten" forever.

But I'm 47, and I have aging eyes. I had no idea that Kitten had so much sparkle to it. Not so much glitter but definite sparkle. I used UD shadow primer and then kitten, and my eyes looked bogged down and tired.  It was quite nasty. The sparkle aged me by at least a decade.  If you're eyes are hooded at all from age, run away from this.  It just accents the wrinkles and the puffiness.

Best eyeshadoW EVER! If Stila ever discontinues Kitten eyeshadow I'll die! Well I won't die but you bet I would be stocking up for sure. But than again that's just crazy talk they wouldn't discontinue this because it's so amazing! It's sooooo soft and buttery, gives a great pop of color. It will last FOREVER! The size is generous and its a little expensive but trust me soooooo worth every penny.

Stila makes a great eye shadow...I've been using this color "Eden" for years! It's a great "neutral" that is natural in a color and can be be intensified for evening by adding a darker shade to the outer corner of the eye. Glad they stila make it!

This is a very pretty color (represented very well in the picture, too).  This eye shadow goes on smoothly with good coverage without having to "refill" the makeup brush over and over.  It lasts a long time without requiring reapplication which makes the original rather high price worth it.  It LOOKS GOOD for a long time.  I recommend it.
summary: Good coverage that lasts a long time.

reviewText: This is one of the most beautiful colors I own. I would think it would look good on any skin color.

This shampoo is sulfate free- very important to me as I don't like shampoos with chemicals that dry out my hair just so I can get that lathering effect. The shampoo cleans very well. The other reviewer who expected their hair to feel soft overnight needs to realize that its a cleaning shampoo. If you have oily hair it will make it soft. If you have color treated hair/ coarse hair, this shampoo is not for you. This is an everyday shampoo perfect for girls like me who do not color treat their hair. LOVE IT!! on my 3rd bottle.

This is the best shampoo ever! There is a reason why it's pricey, but it's definitely worth the money. It doesn't leave my scalp flakey or dry, and is super gentle on my hair overall. It's sulfate free and great for if you've had a Brazilian Blowout.
summary: This is the best shampoo ever

reviewText: I wash my hair everyday and it was suggested to me by stylist that I give this a try. I do like that this is a gentle  Shampoo and doesn't suds as much as the regular kinds,Sometimes like the saying goes less is more and now I do believe that especially since my colored hair is being stripped every time I wash but with this I'm hoping  for a longer length  of time in between coloring my hair. I am using other Oribe products also such as Shampoo Conditioner and sprays etc I love them This has been good so far has not weighed  my hair down and I have noticed it has helped my hair not to be so dry . I find it hard to choose between the best Oribe product because I have had great hair days since using the ones I have overall I'm pleased with this Shampoo.
Love how my hair looks & smells. Great product !
I am a huge fan of Oribe products, and this shampoo is no different.  The smell is intoxicating and I love this shampoo because it doesn't strip my red hair of color.

This product is like spraying water on your hair. I don't see any difference! It seems to smell like oribe so i'm assuming authentic product is in the bottle. I can name so many other products that work better! this is a rip off, and I wish I could ship it back, but this particular product is nonreturnable :(
I got one compliment after I used this product, but I feel like it drys out my hair because it's made of alcohol.
summary: but I feel like it drys out my hair because it's made of ...

reviewText: Oribe products have changed my hair and my life. They're that good. Mic drop.

Wow!! I'm very impressed and it really takes a lot to impress me! I'm a hair product junkie and I've tried everything!!! This stuff is amazing!! You get great volume and it makes my hair shiny and perfect!! Wherever i spray it, my hair cooperates and it looks shiny and voluminous!! My hair feels touchable and like nothing is in it! Other volume products make my hair feel grimey and dirty and don't much if any volume but this is different! And it smells amazing too!! Best hair product ever and the volume lasts for 3 days!! Can't go wrong with this!!
I love all Oribe products and this one in particular.  I have fine hair and it really helps increase the volume and hold.
summary: I love all Oribe products and this one in particular

reviewText: This is a must for thin hair! I have used many hair products and none canbe compared to this in my personal opinion,  a few sprays and a blow dryer is all it takes to achieve  fuller looking hair. The price is good for the great results I have gotten  from this and would recommend.

This spray did appear to coat my hair and give me more volume without weighing my hair down or making it look greasy. But it did have a crunchy, hairspray feel.  I much prefer the dry, texturizing spray in this line, which you spray onto dry hair aiming up the hair shaft from the ends to the rooms, separating the layers.  It's amazing.  I'm not sure this is worth the money.  The texturizing one also comes in a travel size, if you'd like to try it first.
This is an awesome product. I love the smell, it isn't sticky and it is easy to work with.  I use to use SACHAJUAN products, but find I like most of Orbie products better.

I didn't think I'd ever rate an Oribe product a one star, but sorry Oribe, you dropped the ball on this one. This stuff is absolutely awful! For as wonderful as the Oribe shampoos have been, this product is worse than dippity do..for those of you old enough to remember. It makes my hair stiff and heavy and sticky, like I've used a ton of hair spray. In fact..hair spray works better if you flip your hair over your head and lightly spray the underside, it will give more volume, and far less heavy stickiness. I don't apply a lot of product to my hair, but this stuff, it seems that ANY is too much! I had to wash it out of my hair the next day because I couldn't stand the way it felt. If you want your hair to feel like your wearing a helmet, then this is for you! Otherwise, steer clear. It is one of the absolute worst products I've ever used. So, if you want your hair looking and feeling like a bird's nest, then go ahead and spend all that money on this stuff, but I sure won't buy it again!

I think there are better products for less money. I don't like the way it makes my hair feel. I don't wash my hair everyday so the second day my hair feels a little rough and the texture seems to almost separate strands of my hair.

I have very fine, thinning hair.  Mainly, at the moment, due to medications I am on.  However, this spray does seem to add body.  I use it after applying a mousse product and that seems to help.  There is no magic bullet for those of us who experience thinning hair and hair loss, but there are enough products out there, along with a good hair dresser who can give you a good cut and great advice, to help you live with the problem.  I just added another star (6/29/13) I was using this and getting great results and didn't know how great the results were until I went back to another product I was using.  This product definitely makes a difference.

I just recently discovered the Oribe line through my stylist at the hair salon. He reccomended these products, as well as used them to style my hair after my most recent visit. This particular product works good, however needs to be used sparingly.  The first couple times I used it I sprayed on from root tip just as the directions indicated, I have very fine hair that is also naturally curley, which I straighten.  My hair felt stiff and noticeably more dirty feeling after 2 days of no washing (I do not wash my hair daily) which I did not care for. This product definitely added volume - but I didn't really care for the feel of my hair (brittle feeling). In any case I drastically reduced the amount I used on my hair and only spray a small amount and then brush it through my wet hair before blow drying.  Focusing mostly on the ends and back roots.  This seems to work better for me and I don't get that brittle feel on my hair. I do have to agree with another reviewer that this stuff smells like alcohol (hence the 4 stars) which is kind of annoying given all the other Oribe products that I use smell delightful. I don't think it matters who you buy it from (I bought my bottle directly from a high end salon) that's how it smells.  So save yourself some money and buy from Amazon if your interested in this product.

I am a new fan of Ahava products and this foot cream is wonderful! My feet were in pretty bad shape until I began using this product every evening after taking a shower and now they're in great condition in less than a couple of weeks time. Before I bought this cream my feet were dry, calloused and I couldn't get rid of the dead skin without going for spa pedicures every 10-14 days. Even with the pedis my feet were still not as good as they are now. This cream doesn't have a greasy feel or a strong smell to it as some creams do nor does it stain my sheets during the night when I don't wear socks to bed if it's a cold night. I would definitely recommend this foot cream for anyone who wants nice feet as well as other Ahava products. They are effective and decently priced.

This is my favorite. Every so often, I am lured away by a lower priced brand and then I return. Not the cheapest by a long shot. A tube lasts awhile because a little goes a long way. Not perfumey either (nice if you have allergies). Once you rub it in, there is no greasy feeling afterwards. I use it right after my shower. I really like it in the winter - good cure for 'winter feet' (ashy, dry and cracked - yuck). If you are not sure because of the price, look around for the 'travel' sizes in hand and foot creme that Ahava sometimes puts on the market.
summary: This is my favorite. Every so often

reviewText: Love their hand cream so I bought the foot cream. Love it. Best product I have tried for my terribly dry skin. Do not let the price hold you back. Worth it.
Buy an alternative!
Good moisturization with no greasiness, but the scent is overwhelming. I prefer to not smell like I bathed in old lady perfume.

This cream was expensive and it does nothing special for your skin. My hands and legs a very dry and that's even after applying the cream right after a shower. I also find the fragrance very overwhelming. I wouldn't recommend this cream because it does nothing.

This is an excellent hand cream and I would definitely recommend this product for long lasting benefits for dry hands. It's not the cheapest product but it's also not the most expensive that I've tried and the results are just as good, if not better. I don't usually wear gloves in the cold winter months so my hands do get dry and chapped - they also get dry from my frequent hand washing throughout the year (I'm a little OCD). When I put this cream on before going to bed at night I awaken the next morning and my hands are still smooth. The cream doesn't wear off quickly like some of the others do and it's not greasy either. I actually bought this product after trying Ahava's body wash, body lotion and foot cream and am a fan of them all. The hand cream doesn't have a strong fragrance so it would be good for men as well as women. Also, a very small amount is needed as this cream is quite thick making it cost efficient.
I did like it, but it was quite pricey for what it was.

The right size for a purse or back pack. I love the smell and the nongreasy feel. Have been a fan of AHAVA for years. The products just keep getting better. This one is my favorite for my hands. A little goes a long way and stays put.
This is such a great lotion. It is so good I didn't even buy the large size because it fixed my cracked hands after 1 use. I love it!
summary: This is such a great lotion. It is so good I didn't even ...

reviewText: This hand cream really is great... but so is the foot cream, and they're fairly interchangeable. Currently on Amazon this hand cream costs $23 for 3.4 oz, while the foot cream is $24 for 5.1 ounces (or $11 plus $6 shipping, so only $17 total from a third-party merchant)... so it's roughly half the cost for comparable quality. (It's a good product regardless of price, but I personally find it helpful to know about the alternative!)
summary: fantastic... but use the foot cream instead and pay less than 1/2 as much

reviewText: The texture and feel of this lotion is very nice. The name is so familiar, I can't recall if maybe I've ever used this in another, older form. I like the way it feels on, and I've been keeping it in my handbag to use on the go. The only thing I'm not terribly fond of it the smell. It has a bit of the old lady smell. Otherwise, it's a good hand cream - not too thick, but doesn't easily wash off when your hands get wet.

I can't decide if I like the fragrance of this or not. The first dab kind of reminds me of grandma but I think as it sits there it seems to start smelling better. Maybe more flowery.

I also kind of feel like it leaves my hands a little greasy in the beginning but then it feels almost silky as the time goes on. I've never been more wish-washy about a product before.

I'm not 100% sold on this product. Although I enjoy the silky smooth feel I'm not sure I really enjoy the fragrance. So I'm on the fence.

This hand lotion does a good moisturizing job. It's not greasy and it does do a good job at moisturizing. I live in a semi-dry climate and I work with lots of boxes every day so dry hands are part of my life. Cons were the smell. It does have a mineral like smell. I mean, I know it's a sea water mineral lotion but the scent is a big too strong for me. It clashes with perfumes, etc. The only other issue is the cost for this size. I got to try this out for free but I would never repurchase at $7 for a tiny trial size tube of lotion. For that cost, I can get 2 or 3 tubes of lesser cost/equally good hand lotion.
summary: Does a good job but has a strong scent and a bit on the pricey side

reviewText:
AHAVA Dead Sea Water Mineral Hand Cream is made in Israel using the key ingredient of Dead Sea water along with witch hazel, aloe vera, and Allantoin. Allantoin is an interesting component as described by Wikipedia, Allantoin has "a moisturizing and keratolytic effect, increasing the water content of the extracellular matrix and enhancing the desquamation (come off in scales or flakes) of upper layers of dead skin cells, increasing the smoothness of the skin; promoting cell proliferation and wound healing; and a soothing, anti-irritant, and skin protectant effect by forming complexes with irritant and sensitizing agents.

All of these ingredients work beautifully to provide a wonderfully refreshing and revitalizing hand cream. I love the fragrance because it reminds me of a fresh breezy day on a Hawaiian beach. My hands take a beating as a teacher with the constant hand washing, computer work, and paper checking. AHAVA calms, smooths, and has repaired my hands and nail cuticles. I'm sold on the benefits of Dead Sea Water and going to explore the exfoliating Dead Sea plants next as I heavily use exfoliators during the summer months to keep my skin fresh & rejuvenated.

This hand cream didn't feel too greasy and it did make my hands feel softer and smoother.  It is late enough in the spring that it didn't get the true test of winter alligator hands, but I thought it was a nice hand cream.

It didn't have as much fragrance as some products I have tried but it had enough that I noticed it.  For people without a fragrance issue, this will seem like a lightly scented product with a nice smell.  I did enjoy the scent but wish it had been even less because I noticed the fragrance all day.
summary: A little perfume-y but a nice hand cream

reviewText:
This is a really nice - but expensive - hand cream.  I loved the moisturizing qualities of this cream because it left my hand feeling soft and moist but not greasy.  The scent is distinctive and I liked it but I can see where some people may not enjoy it.  I didn't feel like the scent lingered a particularly long time like some other reviewers.

Overall, a good product but I will probably stick to a cheaper drug store brand that I love.

I use lotion on a daily basis for my face at night and in the morning, as well as on my entire body. I was surprised at how tiny the bottle of AHAVA MINERAL HAND CREAM is for the money. The travel size is handy for sticking in your purse to have on hand. Though the scent is not strong when smelling from the tube, its like having perfume on once applied to your skin with a unique, delicate fragrance. I was surprised at how tick it felt going on. I haven't determined if thats good or not. However, it does make it a little harder to apply.

Moisturizerizes without leaving hand greasy or tacky
Nice size for keeping in your purse or on the go

I work with paper a lot, and this tends to leave my hands really dry. I've used many different kinds of lotions and hand creams. Some of them feel oily, some have a scent that is too strong for my allergies. This hand cream is very nice. It leaves my hands nice and soft. It does have a scent, but in my opinion, it's not overpowering or offensive, though other may feel differently on that account. It also contains Aloe Vera extract to soothe and moisturize and Allantoin which heals and is an anti-irritant.

It's travel size, so would be convenient in your purse, car, or to take on vacation.

It may be more expensive than other hand creams and moisturizers, but as far as Dead Sea Water Mineral products, it is fairly priced.

I recommend this if you have chapped, cracked, and/or dry skin and don't mind paying the extra for Dead Sea products

This hand cream reminds me a lot of the "silk" Bath and Body works lotions they used to sell. It leaves that super smooth and silky feel to your hands.  But it is much thicker; and only a small dot will handle both top and bottom of your hands.  The scent is HEAVENLY... but that's because I love the smell of lilacs, roses and hyacinth. I can't decide which one it smells like, but the smell itself I would buy this stuff for!

Content is decent; I still wish it would keep the alcohols and other drying contents out of it... especially for the price of it.  Overall I am super happy and will definitely be milking this TINY bottle along for a while!  Thankfully you don't use much of it because the bottle is only 3" high and NOT full!
summary: Strong Lilac smell... makes hands super silky... only need a tiny amount

reviewText:
In fairness, some people may like this product more than I did.

The scent was a little heavy for a hand cream if you ask me. I didn't really like the scent, in any case. It's not horrible. Just didn't appeal to me. Might appeal to women more than men.

It isn't greasy and did  smooth out my skin pretty well. But, it felt like it mostly stayed on the surface of my skin. This might be a false impression, since I tend to use similar products that have some oilyness and am used to how that feels.

The product has Dead Sea water and minerals, but I'm not sure of how important that really is.

The tube is small (40 ml/1.3 oz) and is $7 on amazon. This seemed on the high side to me.

This is not something I would buy, but these things are a little subjective. Some people may really like the product - I'm just not one of them.

I want to like this hand lotion more than I do, but I can't be very excited about it enough to want to purchase it. What's good about it is it's a thick, emollient hand lotion that when applied softens my hands--but so do many other hand lotions for half the price and at a better scent. What makes it not exciting is that for the price at this size (see photo), it doesn't live up to that price standard. I think the marketers/creators of this hand lotion should give it an exotic spicy scent, or something citrus, or woodsy, so that, like another well-known brand sold in hair salons, there is that feeling of decadence or a "spa-like" experience. This lotion's scent is like grandma (and I'm a grandmother, but I don't want to smell like MY grandmother). There is also an almost "chemical" scent to the "grandma flowery" scent. As well, it takes a while for the lotion to soak into my skin, so if I'm at my computer working on a novel, I have to wait a while--it's a little greasy--yet, that wouldn't be so bad since when it does soak in, my hands do feel great.

So, in general, give this lotion an "exotic" or citrus'y scent and/or give a little bit more for the money, and I'd be more inclined to purchase it. Honestly, just changing the scent would do a lot to pique my interest in this product.
Would not buy!!!!
Outstanding hand cream! If you wash your hands a lot as I do then you will love Ahava hand cream.  Really nice scent, not greasy, and leaves hands moisturized.  This size (5.1 fl oz) is a great buy.

Like my review of the hand cream, I really don't care for this cream. It's expensive and it does nothing for my skin. I apply it to my damp to dry skin after shower and ten minutes later I feel my skin tight and looks ashy. The fragrance I find very unpleasant to. Really can't recommend this product.

It just arrived today. It was sealed in plastic and then inside a bubble wrapped envelope. Stay away

summary: The lotion is not as rich as I was hoping ...

reviewText:
I got a generous-sized sample of this lotion in a subscription box and now I am trying to justify to myself the expense of purchasing more, because it's a wonderful product and I'm almost out of it.

I didn't see the ingredients on the product page, so here they are:

Aqua (Mineral Spring Water), Ceteareth-30 & Cetearyl Alcohol, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Cetyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Sodium Cetearyl Sulfate, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Propanediol(Corn derived Glycol), Caprylyl Glycol & Chlorphenesin & Phenoxyethanol, Maris Sal (Dead Sea Water), Dimethicone, Parfum (Fragrance), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Flower Water, Alpha Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Salicylate, Butylphenyl Methylpropional, Citronellol, Coumarin, Geraniol, Hexyl Cinnamal, Hydroxyisohexyl 3-Cyclohexene Carboxaldehyde, Isoeugenol, Linalool.

For what it's worth, a lot of these last ones (from "citronellol" on) are compounds produced by plants and found in plant extracts.  This doesn't contain parabens, which is great.

I like that this does not include any dyes (please note that it does have added fragrance).  It has a perfect texture for a body lotion -- not too thick and not too thin.  I've only been using it on my lower legs  -- to make it last longer, and to get an idea of its effects over time.  But the skin on my lower legs is super smooth.  This is great to use after shaving your legs, and even though I have sensitive skin, I found it completely non-irritating.

The smell took a little getting used to.  It's not bad, but it's unusual for a body lotion.  The perfume level is not heavy at all, though.

All-in-all, this is a really nice lotion and I definitely recommend it.

I got this for my husband who needs to wear a high SPF sunscreen. We both prefer the mineral type but in high levels, it leaves a white "mask" effect.  This does, too, but not to the degree other brands we've tried.  It's also not too greasy and absorbs well after a 10-15 minutes.  At that point, if you blend it in some more, the white cast is almost invisible.

The Anthelios 50 Mineral is a great high SPF sunscreen with a good formulation, like most La Roche-Posay sunscreens, but the tint doesn't work for me.
The formula is indeed lightweight, sinks quickly into the skin and has a dry touch finish. It works well both alone and under make-up, offering me good protection under the California sun. It's somewhat sweat resistant (for runs and long hikes), I don't swim so I can't say if it's really water resistant. The finish is matte on my combination skin.
While I really loved the formula, I don't like the tint. For my light medium complexion is neither too dark or light, it provides almost no coverage, but leaves a grey/ashy tint that looks unhealthy on me.
summary: Great sunscreen formula, but the tint doesn't work for me

reviewText:
This is my third mineral sunscreen.  I've tried Bare Minerals Prep Step (not good if you use Tretinoin), Shiseido Senka Aging Care UV Sunscreen (which is NOT a mineral sunscreen but does go on smooth and makes the skin look o.k.) and Alba Botanica Very Emollient sunscreen (this is amazing stuff but does leave a white cast)

One dime sized amount of the Alba and one dime sized amount of the La Roche-Posay and my skin looks amazing. Not drying and it gives me glowy skin.  I don't know if it's a good sunscreen because it's winter time and the sun is barely existent but I have high hopes.

reviewText: I love the facial sunscreen but this left little white "beads" all over my face. No matter how much I shook the bottle or blended it it there was this little white "bead residue" all over my face that would not soak in or blend. Im so disappointed in this product as it was not inexpensive and I was hoping to use it on my upcoming tropical getaway, just purchase their facial sunscreen and use Neutrogena tinted makeup instead. Total waste. so bummed

This stuff is freaking incredible. I love all of LRP's products and their Effaclar line is my holy grail skincare. I have very fair skin and I'm prone to freckling which was cute when I was younger but now I just see it as sun damage. My derm recommended this to me back in the day but when I finally gave it a shot I was blown away. Yes, it's pretty pricey but it absorbs so quickly, is incredibly lightweight, leaves no white cast or greasy oil slick and has a very non-offensive smell, none of which can be said about most sunscreens I've tried in recent years. One bottle lasted me for ages and I will definitely repurchase once I decide to drag myself back out into the sun.

There are only two sunscreens on this planet that I will put on my sensitive, breakout prone combination skin: Bior UV Aqua Rich, and THIS, the La Roche Posay Anthelios Mineral Tinted sunscreen.
This stuff is seriously incredible.
The first time I tried this particular product I was a bit dubious when it came to the fact that it's tinted, even though it claimed it was a universal tint. Tinted anything other than foundations typically give my NC20 skin an unflattering orange or pink tint. Amazingly, this is not the case with this product AT ALL! At first it seemed like it would be too dark when searching it in my wrist, but when applying to my face for the first time I noticed how the tint seemed to just disappear into my skin, blending and melding with my skin tone to create a sheer and even coverage that makes my skin look like my skin, but better! It's absolutely beautiful! It's perfect for the days you don't want to wear makeup but need SPF and want your skin to look even.

This product is so light and non greasy, you don't even feel like you have anything on your skin. It also does not disrupt the makeup application process, nor does it make makeup applied on top heavier, cakey or blotchy. It almost acts like a primer/moisturizer/BB cream, but almost in that it's even lighter than any primer, moisturizer or BB cream that I've ever used under makeup.
It's not drying, nor does the tint look like makeup even when you have dry patches that would normally cause a product to cling or look flakey. It's truly beautiful on.

The liquid itself is quite runny so you have to use some precaution dispensing from the bottle. I use the back of my hand as the surface to dispense the product onto. After shaking up really well, I'll usually use about to dime size squirts or product to evenly distribute and spread into my face and neck. After it sets and absorbs, that's when it becomes transfer proof and that's when I begin my normal foundation application (if I'm doing it at all).
This product doesn't leave you matte, but it doesn't leave you shiny either. It's somewhere in between the two.

This SPF is also effective. I live in TX and since using this sunscreen, I have not once been burned or even gotten slightly pink while out an about. Granted, it's full on summer here so I'm typically not outdoors for hours on end. It's waterproof which is great for sweating in this humidity, and my skin looks fab all day long, with or without makeup. Sometimes I just use this and maybe spot conceal and use a touch of powder on top to mattify.

It is a bit in the pricey side, especially for the size, however I feel like the price is completely reflective of its quality and performance and is ultimately completely worth it. It has never caused me to break out and finding something that doesn't is a miracle in itself much less a sunscreen!

I can definitely see where this tint could be considered universal but if you're concerned about how it will actually look on your skin you might want to go seek out a La Roche Posay display and try the tester before purchasing. I will say though that testing it on your hand or wrist is very different than actually putting it on your face and the result is a bit different. I can't really explain it but when I first swatches it it looked a bit dark for my skin, but upon applying it to my face...it was perfect.

I highly highly recommend this product. I love La Roche Posay's products and this sunscreen has just been everything I've come to expect from this brand.
I Love the tint and high spf. It lasts a long time. Feels nice, not greasy. Didn't break me out or burn.
Have not used yet.  Waiting for previous bottle to be empty.  Good product and leaves less "yellow" around the neck of my tops.

This stuff is great! It's a mineral sunscreen so once it goes on, it feels very matte. It doesn't seem like it will feel matte because it's very thin and watery but it is matte within a few seconds! reviewText: I did not like this sunscreen at all, it made me look like a ghost.
Not good leaves face white, not happy with this mineralized sunscreen the regular one is the best!

This sunscreen is wonderful. I bought it to wear over my morning moisturizer everyday. I have used other facial sunscreens that make my skin oily, so I decided to spend a little more than I usually would and try this. It goes on very light and leaves the skin matte, soft feeling, and most importantly like I didn't just apply sunscreen. The tint is several shades darker than my skin tone when I pour a bit into the back of my hand to put on my face, but it sheers out and isn't noticeable. The tint gives no coverage to any dark spots or acne. I apply my makeup as usual after using this and it doesn't affect my makeup at all.

 What's most impressive about this product is it's performance in the sun. One would think that such a light product that feels nonexistent on the skin would fail to protect you from the sun, but that's the farthest from the truth. I have used this one days of hiking, boating, swimming, and more, and I have never once burned. I once used this before going boating all day and when I got home I saw that I had burned on the tip of my nose and the top of my forehead where I forgot to apply the product, but nowhere else. On days in the sun I apply sunscreen all over my body every few hours, but one application of this product in the morning leaves my face ready for a day without requiring anymore sunscreen touch ups. This product is expensive, but if you have experienced frustration trying to find a facial sunscreen that works and doesn't make you feel like an oil slick, this is for you.

The tint is a little dark for my fair skin, but in the summer it just looks like I got a little color. Like that it dried matte and feels like nothing. However, sometimes it leaves my skin too dry, so I can not use it all the time anymore.
don't like both the texture (too thin) and color (too orange), Elta MD Lightly Tinted for Extra-Sensitive Skin is far superior sunscreen

Love it! It's weightless and once it dried Matte. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin and the slight white cast from the mineral compliments my fair skin. It may cast too much of a white hue on tanner skin tones. They should try the tinted version.
Love all products from la Roche. I buy the tinted for me and the regular for my 10 year old and husband.

I love this sunscreen. I never get sunburned on my face when I wear this and I spend a lot of time on the water or at the beach.

reviewText: The glass bottle has a plastic "crystal-like" top which pops straight off revealing a pump spray. A single push of the spray releases a tad too much of the clear pale blue liquid onto the wrist. The initial smell is somewhat woodsy, not overly perfumed, and will successfully provide cover after a long day. Heat of the skin gradually alters the scent into a mature pleasant smell which is at once powdery and somewhat reminiscent of the first floor of a department store while surrounded by various perfume manufacturers. I wasn't able to detect an identifiable feature that would separate this scent from all the rest. That's not necessarily a bad thing, but this will not be your signature scent - rather, it will simply be a nice addition to a variety of choices that you might have.

reviewText: The Rochas Eau de Rochas Frache Eau de Toilette is an extremely strong fragrance. It has a odd licorice scent/dried flowers scent. Not my type of perfume by any stretch however it does last for hours and will only take a small amount anymore than one spray and it will be overbearing.

reviewText: Initially I was super excited to review this bottle of perfume.  I figured if I didn't like the fragrance, I'd at least have a nice bottle to display in my bathroom.  Well I lost out on both accounts.  The perfume smells like an old lady (musty and dingy) and the bottle is super cheap looking/feeling.  Nothing about this product is worth the $50+ they are charging.  If you're even considering this perfume I suggest you stop into the store and take a wiff of it first!!!!

You know when you go to family reunions and there is that one woman that you try to avoid because once she hugs you, you are going to smell like her for the rest of your life? You know exactly what room she has been in, but you can't tell if it was 1 minute ago, or lingering from the last family reunion 5 years ago. Well, this is the perfume she uses.

I took one whiff of this perfume and decided it was not for me. Or really for anyone under the age of 85.
It is pungent, flowery, but most of all smells like old lady.

Buy it for that relative you dislike so you always know where she is.

This is a difficult product for me to review, given that perfume is a very personal thing. I thought I would enjoy this given the description (top notes of bergamot and fresh water, middle notes of white flowers and liatris, and base notes of musk and oak moss), but it really didn't work well for me. I guess I was hoping for a more delicate blend of notes, but this really hits you over the head and is *very* strong. It smells like a very strong florally bug spray, which is not the scent I was looking for.

I also found the bottle to be a bit cheap looking. The top knob is even made of plastic and not glass, and the whole thing has a very drugstore perfume look about it. Just thought I would mention is since I know some people like to display bottles on a vanity table. I don't, but that's because I don't have a vanity to tempt me! :)

However, I will give some stars to this perfume because even though it's not my personal preference, it will be for some, and they should rest assured that this has a lot of sillage and lasting power. Also, the price point is pretty decent for the size. Bottom line - it's not for me, but I know there are people out there who would enjoy it!

I received this through Amazon Vine, but I try extremely hard to write my review as if I had paid the full purchase price, for I believe that is only fair for those who read and rely on reviews.

Let's start with the appearance of this fragrance. The box is pretty enough, and the bottle is gorgeous. It's 4-1/2 inches tall, with an icy, jewel-like quality. The eau de toilette inside is very faintly tinted violet. There's a tiny satin bow tied around its neck. A really fetching bottle, in my opinion, and one that would look beautiful on anyone's vanity.

Now on to the scent. I saw some reviewers describing it as a "grandma" scent. I don't know what anyone else's grandma smells like, but I got a completely different impression. I would describe it as very young, very fresh, very early-Summer. The scent makes me think of the month of May in a beach town with a sea breeze and llilacs faintly scenting the air. The top note is sharp & citrusy. Once the fragrance has dried and settled, what's left is sweet; not cloying, but girlish. It's lightly floral, ever so slightly powdery, distantly spicy, somewhat aquatic. Its name, "Fresh," suits it perfectly.

This is a very sweet and endearing, unsophisticated fragrance. So much so that I feel it's too young for me. Since Rochas is a Parisian house, I'll use the French terms: Rochas Fraiche is a scent for an "ingenue," and I'm a woman "d'une certaine age." Basically, I'm too mature for this bubbly concoction. Thinking of a 20th anniversary gift for your beloved wife? Skip this and get a sensuous, womanly classic -- say, almost anything by Chanel. Buying a first "real" perfume for a teenage girl or college graduate? Someone full of optimism, ready to take on the world but not ready to be too seductive? This is perfect.

Wow, I smell like Grandma with this perfume.  This smells very sweet and flowery and not very sexy or modern at all.  I have to admit that I will discard the remainder of this product.  The container and sticker emblem was pretty cheesy looking too.

This is a fresh summery scent in a beautiful bottle. The initial top notes are my least favorite; I found them somewhat soapy and almost sharp. These quickly dissipated to a very fresh, crisp, oceanic fragrance. After several hours of wear it's mellowed to a more chypre, mossy, musky base. Personally I like it more the longer I've had it on.

I have to say it's not as much to my personal taste as I'd hoped. I tend to like light florals and fruity scents, and I was drawn to the bergamot and white flowers in the description. This is probably more to the liking of someone who prefers fresh, oceanic scents. However, this is a nice eau de toilette that I will enjoy in the summer.
Very happy with purchase!
Does what product said, it helps make hair fuller and silkier.
I noticed an immediate difference in the thickness of my hair!  Very excited!
OK as a shampoo but don't see any improvement in hair growth.
I like it!!
It works!
Favorite moisturizer

This is a lovely sheer foundation with a luminous glow.  I am very fair (NC15) and the opal shade was just right for me.  This works like a lightweight BB cream.  On a good skin day I could wear this alone with concealer, but that is for very light coverage.  Most days I would wear this under foundation.  On my dry cheeks and undereyes I need moisturizer underneath this, so I wouldn't buy this thinking that it is a substitute for a tinted moisturizer.  But the good news is that it won't make your skin look shiney or greasy.  I thought at first that I should not use it in my T-zone, but it is absolutely fine used all over the face.  It is a lovely addition to my makeup because it creates a sheer glow.

I really wanted to like this product because besides being a perfect color match, it really evened out my skin tone and gave me the most amazing glow -- at least when looking in my house/bathroom mirror.  I didn't see a single sparkle; just a lovely sheen that made my skin look like it was glowing from within.  I was mesmerized by how perfect it made my complexion look that I was certain I had found my "can't live without' beauty product.

Fast forward to later that afternoon; while running errands I took a glance up in my car mirror and was shocked to see that apparently, a glitter bomb had exploded on my face.  I looked like a sparkly disco ball!  I gave this another try the following day using just a smidge; but it still was way too sparkly in sunlight.  Would only possibly wear this product in the evening and even then; I'm not sure it'd be worth it if there were any chance of flash photography or having to walk into a well lit restroom with my girlfriends.  I may get some use out of this as a highlighter for my cheekbones or legs; but at my age, this type of sparkle is a big no no for all over face use.  The itty bitty sparkles accentuate all the things I want to keep hidden in daylight!  Fine lines, pores, imperfections.  It only looks good under dim lighting conditions.

***Update***
I hate throwing out perfectly good products and just wanted to share that I did find a use for this as a highlighter.  After applying makeup, a quick swipe down the center of my nose gives the bridge of my nose the perfect contoured look without all the work of contouring; no need to blend!  I also use a dab on my cupid's bow to highlight my lips and as a highlighter on my cheekbones/brow bones.  When used this way, the shimmer doesn't overwhelm your face and sink into pores/fine lines.  I'll probably have this 'forever' at the rate I'm using it (just a smidge here and there) but it's pretty much become a staple in my daily beauty routine.  I wouldn't feel put together and polished without it :).

Was excited to try this out after reading the rave reviews on Birchbox and beauty blogs.  This product didn't disappoint!  The sheer formula absorbs well leaving my dull skin dewy not sparkly!  The lightweight coverage with SPF is perfect for summer weekends and those with generally nice skin who just need a little boost.  The tint does minimize the appearance of my fine lines, though I found a little concealer necessary to cover my under eye circles after late nights.

This is probably my favorite product from Jouer so far. I have fair, gold-tinted skin, and this is the perfect color for me. Put it on underneath Hourglass's luminizing powder, and it's gorgeous. That said, this is a little thick and provides quite a bit of coverage (medium-light) and I use this as a foundation as opposed to a tint. In any case, I really like this product and I'll be buying more.

Wow! I love this Moisture Tint by Jouer!  The first thing I noticed is that it smooths on my face really well.  The second thing I noticed, and it blew me away, is that it really does reflect light!  My face looked light and glowing!  My skin looks so much brighter and natural than when I wear my foundation.

This is fairly light weight, but heavy enough to smooth the skin and provide some coverage.  I have dry skin, so this does not replace my normal moisturizer.  But it's great to have a skin-smoothing tint that's lighter than a foundation.

I would definitely recommend Jouer Luminizing Moisture Tint.

I like to wear tinted moisturizer instead of foundation because it is less heavy and concealing and often has some suncreen protection.  This is a nice product but at this price point I prefer the Laura Mercier tinted moisturizer.  The Golden color works for my medium skin tone in the late fall and winter months but I tan easily so would need a darker color for the summer.
summary: I like this but prefer Laura Mercier

reviewText:
This is a lovely tinted moisture lotion.  I am using the Golden color and it makes my facial skin look so pretty.  It really adds a golden glow without looking oily or too shiny.  It's easy to apply and it lasts all day.  This has SPF 20 and also includes Vitamin E, Ginseng and Gingko Biloba - all anti-oxidants which are used to help our skin stay healthy and young looking.

It goes on light and covers well.  If I want a little extra coverage somewhere, I will wait a bit and then reapply a little more to any problem area I have and it works well.

Just a pea size amount of Jouer Moisturizing Tint gives nice summer coverage, but

1. whether that pea size amount provides good 20spf is questionable,
2, the pea size amount does not provide enough moisturizing for a person with dry skin

I fall into the slightly olive (part asian) skin tone and found the golden color to be a little on the pink side.  It worked ok, but I was hoping for something that had more of a yellow base given the "golden" description.

As a tint, the Jouer has good coverage with a small amount of product; however, as a moisturizer, I used my own layer of lotion/moisturizer before applying the Jouer tint.  That worked well.  I also did not count on the touted 20spf because of the small amount of product that I used.

Overall, the Jouer tint is a great summertime product because it isn't heavy & layers well with regular moisturizer and/or sunscreen w/ moisturizer.  For that reason, I gave the product 4 stars even though I wish it would have a yellow-based golden in its tint lineup.
summary: Golden Leans a little Pink, but Otherwise a Decent (not fantastic) Moisturizer

reviewText: I wish they made this in a body lotion. This lightweight facial tint is moisturizing and the "light-diffusing multi-mineral" ingredients help even out skin tone and make my face glow while seeming to reduce my fine lines around my eyes and on my forehead. The SPF 20 is a necessary touch in my state of Texas in the heated temperatures of summer and I liked the skin conditioning additives of Ginseng and Gingko Biloba Leaf Extract make my skin feel soft. I have never tried this brand before but I will be checking out more items in their lineup.
summary: Lightweight and easy to apply with even coverage for glowing skin

reviewText: Living in the hot and humid south, I always appreciate a lightweight alternative to heavy foundation makeup and have found that a tinted moisturizer is the way to go. Since I need color more than coverage and suffer from year round dry and sensitive skin I use the tinted moisturizer year round. The Jouer Luminizing moisture tint fit my criteria in almost all ways, unfortunately I found it a bit heavy to be thought of as mostly a moisturizer. It did hold up well throughout the day and gave a nice tint and glow without feeling like a Halloween mask. It goes on smoothly and almost immediately feels dry with no stickiness. Another good point is that it is SPF 20 so i didn't have to give a thought to being in the sun. It also washes off easily which is nice, no scrubbing required. I can't say how well it will hold up in the deepest humidity of summer since we haven't gotten there yet but at least it will be a lighter alternative, if not quite as light weight as I would prefer.

I have used tinted moisturizers in the past, but this is by far my favorite.  It has enough of a tint to add some light coverage, but is sheer enough that I think the color I used 'golden' would work on a large range of people. I fall into the "easily tans, wears a ton of sunscreen, Italian-olive skin tone" category and it is a great match for me.

My girlfriend, who I would consider a makeup guru, tried this and proceeded to order it. She agreed that it provided just enough coverage, a nice dose of sunscreen (20 SPF) and a healthy light reflecting glow.

As a moisturizer, it falls short for me. I layer it over my moisturizer but I also have very dry skin. I find myself using this almost daily instead of a full coverage foundation. I like how light it feels and how easily it blends into my skin.  I use this, a little bronzer (from the same line) and mascara for a nice "natural" look.

Definitely will be purchasing in the future, and highly recommend!

Get this! Jouer Luminizing Moisture Tint, 1.7 fl. oz. Combine it with the great bronzers Jouer makes and your ready for the runway looking fresh in next to no time. This product slips on easily over your moisturizer and gives a beautiful natural long lasting glow.

reviewerName: Leah Maines, best-selling, award-winning author, actor, and editor
reviewText:
This product is rather thick, and the "glow" produces too much shine for my face.  It makes me look older and oily.

One a positive note:  It did not cause any breakouts or irritation.  It has a pleasing scent, and there is good amount of product, but I just don't like the high shine on my face.

I know the golden shine is trending right now but I hope that trend ends soon.

Being a woman of a certain age, if one is clever, she is wise enough to know that how she looks iIN her MIND isn't always how she appears to others.  While acceptance of ones inner beauty is divine, eventually girl's gotta face the FACTS - ya ain't gettin' any younger.  All those years sunbathing, not drinking enough water and pulling all-nighters might have caught up to you.  Remnants of that huge zit you just couldn't leave alone are especially noticeable after a long, cold winter.

I hate wearing makeup.  It smears on stuff, smells weird, and usually looks really obvious on those of us who don't have stylists and make-up artists at our beck and call.  While I've been blessed with pretty great skin, I definitely look like a Midwesterner who hasn't gotten any vitamin D in ages and who spends every other day under unflattering office lighting.

So, I reluctantly gave this a try.  All of the other creams like this have felt greasy and LOOKED greasy.  I guess the idea of luminescence was to just have the light shine off your oily face a either distract or blind people so they wouldn't notice your skin.  But the Jouer looks great, isn't greasy or obvious and my white shirt shows zero signs of makeup smears, even after a hot day.  It made my skin feel silky and very clear, but is light enough to let only my most adorable freckles peek through.  I just look healthy and fresh, not made up.

I love this stuff.  I also use the lip balm/gloss/tint and love it just as much!

Ordering a tinted moisturizer from a brand I'd never used before I wasn't sure if the color would work for me.  Golden says it's for light to medium and I'm definitely on the light end of the scale (Alabaster is my color in Clinique), so I was pleasantly surprised that it turned out to be the right color.  I'm sure it helps that this is a tinted moisturizer rather than a foundation and that the color is buildable--I only did one application to have the right color.  I found the coverage to be closer to a foundation than other tinted moisturizers.  And it feels nice on; not too heavy.
summary: good match for my skin tone

reviewText:
Most women want a radiant "lit from within" healthy looking glow but unless you're in your 20's that can be a challenge.  If you're in your mid-fifties it's pretty much impossible without a little help.  I have read a lot of beauty magazines and followed their advise to the letter.  I have spent way too much money on products that promise to give me that healthy glow I had 35 years ago but don't deliver.  And, I can tell you from experience that there is a fine line between a dewy healthy glow and a face that looks shiny and oily.

So, I was looking forward to trying this product but at the same time not really expecting much.  I was surprised.  At first, I just tried using it as a highlighter, dabbing a little on my cheekbones.  It gave me a subtle shimmer without looking obvious and glittery.  Face it, glitter is something best left to teenagers and 20 something party girls.  Then I tried it all over my face and walla!  soft, dewy "lit from within glow" without looking oily.  I have tried so many luminizing products in the past that failed I really don't know what Jouer does that is so different but whatever it is, it works.  and you can't argue with that.

This cream goes on smoothly, is easy enough to get off with my make-up remover, and lasts throughout the day. My one problem was that it was a bit thick, and trying to use it in the summer, that really shows. You really don't have to use much at all to cover your face, and it blends very nicely with my skin tone. I read that other people have problems with it looking wet, but I always but on a coating of powder foundation, which settles it and takes care of the gloss. Also adds more sun protection, which is a plus.
Overall I'd recommend this moisturizer for its ability to do just that-moisturize. As a foundation it's not the absolute best, which is nothing a little powder can't solve.

In case you all took a different language requirement in school, "Jouer" is French for "to play".

I like this name for this company, and find it appropriate. There has been a lovely playful vibe to every one of their products which I have been fortunate enough to try, so far.
However, quality wise, Jouer doesn't kid around. It makes good make up! How do I know? Because I prefer to use good make up and recognize it. I am hip to makeup which is first rate, I like to think.

 It is so great to see what effects you can achieve with this particular product, Jouer Luminizing Moisture Tint in Golden. It is a bit like a BB cream, a bit like a foundation, but if you are a makeup lover, you will see, as I did, that it is actually so much more than only that.

I took my shower this morning and primed to try this out only with a very simple moisturizer. I really wanted to start from the ground up to see how this performed. However, I didn't want to use this as the "base moisturizer", as I am extremely fair skinned.  I decided that it would be too strong a tint if I chose to use it as moisturizer base alone.  So I focused on its feature as a luminizing tint.

I was correct in guessing that I would need to start with plain old moisture first. The reason I say this is that when I applied the Jouer luminizing tint in Golden I saw such a difference in my face it was a bit of an overkill. However, after I took a cloth and patted some of it away a bit, the effect was stunning!

So what I am saying is this:

Definitely try this if you love makeup and like looking pretty...just don't overdo it if you have fair skin.

I am also adding that I especially like the gorgeous "blending aspect" which Jouer Luminizing Moisture Tint in Golden has, even if I did overdo the applying the first time and had to pat some away.
Your face will look like you do not have a single wrinkle or a blotch. That alone is something I rarely say, especially when I am talking about myself and my face.

So I do encourage you to try this. I love it!

Effectively, I just needed to go easy on the application and use a light hand, I repeat. I started from the neck up and covered my whole face with the tint by gently applying it with my fingers and palms after rubbing my hands together when I had put what I originally thought would be the right amount on one of my palms.
So far it has lasted all day!

I am going to be attending a school reunion in a few weeks, and my Jouer is coming as MY escort. Why? Because it makes me look that good, now that I have figured out how to use it. ;)

I am "enchantee" with Jouer!  You will be enchanted with Jouer as well, I bet!
I do hope you like it as much as I do! It is a great boost for a fresh spring and summer look, alone and/or with other added makeup you might want to try when you are in the mood to look totally drop dead gorgeous!

Thanks,

jean

Note:
The way I applied it, after a steamy shower, and by using that other moisturizer first, did cause a bit of a stinging sensation. This stinging feeling dissipated rapidly.  I think my pores were really open from the shower and my whole face was a bit sensitive. The next time I apply Jouer Luminizing Moisture Tint I am going to prep a different way, washing my face thoroughly but ending with cool water, then using a light oil or serum, and then applying the Jouer Tint. I think this will solve the stinging problem which I believe I caused myself by jumping in too enthusiastically!
summary: Well another 5 star Wow from my new crush, Jouer!

reviewText: This moisturizing tint is not bad but there is no way it is worth $38. There is some moisturization and some tinting you get out of it but the results are nowhere near being impressive. I don't see any difference between this product and the alternative you can by at any pharmacy for $8. And for $38, you can buy from a really respectable, fashionable brand. If you have money to burn, go ahead. But I wouldn't pay any if my own money for this product because I don't see the point.

I don't use foundation on a daily basis and usually only do so for business appointments or dressy occasions.  I'd gone to Sephora for a one on one session to find a good foundation match for my medium light Asian complexion.  Jouer's Luminizing Moisture Tint (Golden) is great - it blends easily, feels light - not oily or too dry- and it looks polished.  It stayed on and comfortable for hours.  It's as good as the Bobbi Brown and Smashbox CC creams that I use, but Jouer feels even lighter.
summary: Blends easily, feels light and looks great

reviewText:
Looking at all of these reviews, everyone seems to love this product and I tried to. I really really did.

The nice thing about this is that it's a tinted moisturizer so even though my shade isn't really "Golden" because it's light coverage it wasn't some big huge shade difference. It leaves a nice finish and it blends super easily. I've always heard great things about Jouer face products and I'm so so glad I finally got the chance to try them!

The only thing I don't like was I felt like it had too much of a shimmery finish to it. I felt like I looked like a glitter ball. Now I didn't use a finishing powder with it because I don't like using a finishing powder usually over a liquid product when I apply it all over my face but perhaps using a mattifying finishing powder might make me feel a little bit better.

Overall I really do like this product and I'll be looking more into Jouer products in the future!
summary: I feel like I'm missing something...

reviewText:
I'm not a daily face-make up kind of gal, but I really love using this product.
The coverage is light, it smooths on nicely, has no scent (yay!) and provides SPF 20.
Love the combo!
Very pleased.
summary: Smooth application with a light, lovely tint.

reviewText: I should have gleaned from the name that "Golden" would be a little yellowish, but that's easily remedied with a dusting of Bare Minerals. This product gives a luminous sheen and is slightly on the greasy side, but as I have dry skin, that works OK for me. However, I see this as possibly being a bit too slick and slimy for summer use. It doesn't seem to mesh well with perspiration, and can be a bit muddy and streaky when the weather gets warm. But it's good for cooler, drier weather, and I'd recommend it for those with dry or normal skin... not good for oily skin.

when i first put this product on my face, it made my face look really wet - which is not a quality i seek.  I always use loose powder, and so I covered the product with loose powder and wondered if that would take away the look that the product touts.  But then I realized that, after the powder, what remained was a little glisten or sparkle.  I have friends who say that women of a certain age (actually over 25 or so) should never sparkle or use makeup with glitter in it, so I'm not sure that they would say this product with its sparkle is appropriate for me, but I love sparkle and glitter and refuse to comply with the rules of the senior fashion police.  So, i give this product a four for how it looks.  If it actually has the beneficial effects it claims, all the better.

As someone with very fair skin, it can be hard to find a product to add a hint of color without looking orange and/or really fake. I tried using this on its own, and the color was a bit too dark and shimmery. After mixing with my regular foundation, it provides the perfect amount. It leaves behind a really nice glow that doesn't seem makeup-based. The consistency of this tint lotion is very silky and goes on without feeling sticky. The luminizing effect is wonderful for the summer months in lieu of tanning and damaging the skin. After using daily for two weeks I was pleased that I didn't experience any breakouts or other adverse skin reactions from adding this to my routine. I do wish it were more natural as I prefer to use products with fewer chemicals, but I've yet to find a good tinted luminizer from a more natural/organic line that doesn't come across as too glittery, too orange, or too skin irritating.

I don't like to wear a lot of makeup and I go without it whenever possible.  On the other hand, I'm not averse to improving my appearance especially if it doesn't involve a great deal of effort and the slathering on of heavy cosmetics.  Jouer's Luminizing Moisture Tint is a wonderful solution.  It gives my face a healthy glow, evens out my skin tone and hydrates it at the same time while taking just minutes to apply.

The golden shade happens to be perfect for my complexion but there are 5 other shades to choose from should it not suit you.  Rounding out the package, Moisture Tint contains beneficial ingredients like ginseng and gingko biloba and has an SPF of 20.  Its sheer but flattering coverage will see me through the summer and beyond.
I don't use this as much as my "Thick Dry Finishing Spray" and think I will go directly to ORIBE next time to see if there is a difference in the product quality.

reviewText: I have had long hair for years and only used leave in conditioner as far as products go. I have a sassy bob now and read about this stuff on a few styling websites. I couldn't wait to get it. It smells terrific. I'm a wash my hair every day kind of person. Since using this, I can go 2-3 days without washing and barely need to re-style. I spray on roots and all over for volume and don't use very much. I refresh each day. I am using a hair protectant on my wet hair to keep the shine in there and protect against heat from flat/curling iron. You don't get that baby soft, touchy hair with this (it adds texture so you can't achieve both) but if you spray on and brush it through, you get hold without the poof and it's touchably soft.

Saw the hype in this spray.  I like that it does the job of texturing my hair, not used to the stiffness since I started using Loreal dry spray and it doesn't have that same stickiness.
This product may work bests for people who like that bolder and stronger texturing job, but since I'm more simple in my hair style look, the cheaper Loreal works better for me.
The smell is great.

reviewText: This product is very useful for thinning hair.  When you don't have time to wash you can spray this on and it will give lift to your hair.

Product did absolutely nothing for my hair. It seemed like this product was just scented air, and that's it! Did not provide texture, volume, or anything at all. I have very thick/heavy but fine hair, very long (to my waist). I think this is such a lightweight product that it'd work best on those w/ very lightweight / baby-fine hair that is easy to volumize. If your hair is difficult to get volume in it, then I don't think this product would do a thing for it.
This is AWESOME spray.  It gives texture and lift to my extremely flat, straight, but heavy hair.

like everyone else said, smells great, and it does give some volume to the hair, but the huge downside is that it does not LAST. after about an hour your hair is flat again, you have to fluff up the roots for it to give volume, but then it flops again. for the price that it is I'd hope it could last longer.. it's about a 20$ product, shouldn't be any more

The nozzle on this product is extremely difficult to depress especially if you have joint problems, but if you want volume for "sagging" hair, it will definitely provide it.  I would advise using it sparingly, especially if you have short hair as I do, as it will make it rather "gunky".  But if my hair is looking limp and I'm getting ready to go out, a few quick sprays will immediately help it look fuller.  I have found that  I need to shampoo it after one use.  Usually wash my hair every day anyway.  Might be different with longer hair.

Same elegant, expensive, not long lasting smell as majority of other Oribe products ( either great smell or perfume free), although not making a whole lot of difference in the care of my mid length, naturally curly, dry, freeze prune hair, also dyed with natural hair colors.
