reviewText: It works great!

I like this device overall. I did create some serious red streaks across my cheek but it was my own fault for mixing up the discs. I think that the day after using the PMD, my skin is smoother and more even and has a better glow.  I do not like that the refill discs include discs for the body.  I only want discs for my face and half the refill is for the face while the other half is for the body.

I would recommend this product! I was quite skeptical when buying this but wanted to give it a try.  I figured it would not give a real exfoliation like the machines I use, I figured it would be way to weak to even make a difference.  I WAS WAY WRONG and happily shocked.  I loved this machine we had which cost over 10,000$ which essentially did the same thing as this device just with the added benefit of infusing serum at the same time, which is why I was expecting this to not impress me because I am a snob about the cool expensive equipment I have access to.  You can't change the suction on this device but everyone stays at the same amount anyway.  So really theres no difference!

The reasons this is so great:
1.  Microderms/Silk peels at a spa cost around 100-150$ a treatment-depending on where you go.  In my opinion this pays for itself after 1 treatment.  In order to see "real" changes in your skin you need to have multiple treatments done, and keep up with it.  Every time thats another $100-150 spent, so most people aren't going to go even every month for life to have this done its just not worth it.  Whats great about this is you can use it at home as much as once a week.  You get the instant result of smooth soft "glowy" skin after immediately after using.  Since you are able to use this more frequently, you will get the lasting, more dramatic results then you would going to a spa once or twice very spaced out.  In my professional opinion I think it is better to do a treatment more frequently thats not as harsh, then one treatment once and awhile thats a lot harsher.  It won't give good results.  Which is why this is such an amazing product.
2. You can chose the amount of exfoliation you want and what's best for your skin.
3. The amount of suction it produced is powerful enough to be very effect without having to worry about causing damage.
4. They have videos and guides on how to best use this product.  I was comfortable because I already knew the proper form for a regular machine but still watched the videos and they are extremely important and useful.

I'm fifty years old. Suffer with large pores and just an all around rough texture on my face. I've used derma rollers, chem peels, creams ect.....Not enough improvement to continue any of them. The derma roller was AWFUL! My skin hated that thing. I got this at my local Ulta store about 6 weeks ago. Started with the gentler pads like they recommended, changing them with each next weeks treatments. I did treatments once a week only. This past Sunday was my 5th treatment and the results are quite amazing! My face is VERY soft, pores are alot less noticeable and my face has a sort of "dewy" appearance to it. It's also done a great job of lifting acne scars (I don't have deep scares) and evened out my skin tone. At first I wasn't sure if this was going to do anything as I saw no real improvement until I went to the green pad. I am now using the red one. BIG difference. But I still highly suggest slowly stepping up since this can and will burn your face. I proved this possibility for myself and burned my upper cheek this past week by passing the area twice with the red pad. Normally after using it leaves a small powder (your upper most layer of skin) behind it. I have used this as a guide and can see where my face has been treated and were it has not been treated. Not sure what happened but I saw a clean area and went over it again. Ouch! It's not too bad and will heal but I will have more respect for this thing from now on. I highly recommend and decided to not return this device.
summary: It works, just go slowly and skip a bad experince.

I bought this product primarily because it won Allure magazine's best anti-aging product award.  I don't have wrinkles except for a tiny one by my right eyebrow, but I wanted to improve the texture of my skin.

The product comes in a package that is made to look like prescription medicine and warns you that this is an INTENSIVE treatment.  I thought that was gimmicky.  "Behold this powerful, life-changing elixir..."  Meh.

Still, I had hope.  I applied it daily as directed for many months.  There was no burning or stinging or anything that suggested it was "intensive," and sadly, NO change in my skin at all.  Not even a tiny bit. Even my one little wrinkle was exactly the same. I didn't give up earlier because I was determined to give it a fair shot.

I realize we don't all have the same skin, so what didn't work for me might work for you.  Just be aware that you could be wasting $50.

This is the first retinol product I ever bought. I thought I could get my skin ready for a possible retin a treatment in a month (which I did get). It's a very creamy serum, has a light scent, not bad but I didn't appreciate that either. Packaging is great, which allows you to dispense as much or little as you need. It didn't do anything to my skin in terms of wrinkle care, but it slightly calmed my skin during a small breakout. It absorbs on the skin pretty fast and goes well with other products. It's also a gentle product, now that I'm using retin a for my face, I use this for the area under the eyes, which has some fine lines and is very dry, my skin tolerates it well even though there's no improvement yet.
But I think the retinol concentration is too low to be worth the money. I ordered this product in January, the price was $39.99. A couple months later, $56.99?? What's the change??
summary: Pricey retinol product, but very gentle

Well, 4 days later, I'll say it again, "WOW"!!!! My laugh lines are disappearing right before My eyes!!! MUST BUY FOR ANY LADIES WITH FEARS OF WRINKLES ;)))

Like the Redermic C, the smell tones down after about 20 minutes, but in that time I can develop a headache.  I would love to find this product unscented.

Love anything by La Roche Posay  - I have used this product for the last 10 years. Excellent quality - my Dermatologist introduced me to this line. Prompt delivery!
I recommend it!!

I use this two times a week after using their facial wash and then apply their mosterizer and eye balm on my skin before bed.

You can feel this tingle when you first start to use it.  It works like a face mask but is made for men and you aren't stuck with the mess.  I can feel a difference in my face since I started to use it.  It doesn't make your face break out, has a decent smell and I can tell my skin is tighter in the face.

Highly recomend this for guys who are concerned about aging facial skin
summary: Like a face mask but made for men without the mess

reviewText: Seems to do the trick. It removes a lair of skin and seems to reduce the visibility of freckles and other facial marks with use. A little pricey though.
summary: Seems to do the trick. It removes a lair ...

reviewText: Solid.

I ordered this for my husband and hes been using these resurfacing pads for about a month and a half now.  It suggests cleaning your face before using and it does have a warning that it will make you more sensitive to the sun.  My husband has had melanoma so he has been using it before bedtime two to three nights a week.  He said he likes the way it smells and feels when using.  Some facial products have that alcohol smell that burns the nose and eyes but this did not.  He said his face did feel tacky when he was finished but that it wasn't s problem since it was right before bedtime.  He doesnt think these pads have made a difference in the last month and a half and doesnt plan on purchasing more after he finishes the last of the container.
summary: No difference after a month and a half

reviewText:
I didn't realize it's supposed to be for men until I read all the info about not using it right after shaving. That said, women use this too and so I tried it.

I tried it, but it took a little while. I was kind of scared of by the "Power Peel" idea since I've seen chemical peels and they're kind of scary, how red the skin gets and peels off. Really didn't want that. But I requested it from Vine and had to give it a try so I did.

The good news (to me) is that it's really not a chemical peel. My skin did not get red and scaly and peel off. The effect was much more subtle, thankfully. I think it kind of helped remove dead skin and tighten pores. I didn't notice a huge change -- didn't keep up using it to go through the whole jar since you're supposed to be careful in the sun and wear sunscreen--but what I saw/felt, I did like. My skin felt tighter, smoother to the touch--these pads are astringent and probably also help close pores--and I thought it looked better. The smell is chemical, but milder than I expected.  They recommend using it 2-4 times a week (I opted for 2). All of the round pads should be used within 3 months after opening for maximum effect. You can't use it near your eyes or lips so I don't know how it would do with darkness under the eyes (also claimed as a benefit) but for the skin I think it -did- make an improvement.

I'm a 39 year old woman with VERY sensitive skin that is slightly oily and I have monthly hormonal breakouts. Due to my age, my skin has looked a little dull lately and light brown spots (due to foolish sun tanning in my younger years) have started to make an appearance lately. I also have some fine lines around my eyes and on my forehead. I felt very nervous to try this product due to my sensitive skin but once I started using these pads I couldn't be happier! My skin has cleared up, the fine lines look softer and overall my skin looks and feels healthier and more polished. My skin never had a reaction to this product and I use one pad every other day. I'm really amazed and pleased with the results of these pads and I highly recommend them to men and women. P.S. these pads do not contain parabens, sulfates or phthlatates.
summary: My skins looks fresh, healthy and soft

reviewText:
I am guilty of not realizing these were for men before I decided to try them, but I have to say, they work pretty well for the ladies too! Although now my husband is fighting over them with me...

The smell is very herbal and fairly strong, but I found it to be pleasant. The pads themselves are thin, but sturdy. You are to use on a clean face 2-4 times a week, and I strongly suggest you adhere to that direction- they are pretty strong, and I imagine too much use would wreak havoc on your face.

My one complaint is that they left a definite film on my face. I washed my face and then used the pad and it felt like a sticky, gluey substance was left behind. The directions said nothing about rinsing your face afterwards, so I left it for a little while, assuming it would dry and feel better. Instead, it dried and felt like a film across my face- like I was wearing one of those peel masks. It annoyed me so much I had to rinse my face thoroughly to remove the remnants of the pad. After the rinse, however, my face felt fabulous. Although, I kept thinking of all that gunk left behind from the pad and how that would have clogged my pores had I left it. I am prone to acne, so I am skeptical of anything that leaves behind a residue on my face.

After repeated uses, I have to say this stuff seems to have really worked well on my face. I am not sure I would pay the seriously high price for the product, but if you are willing to shell out the money, this isn't a bad product. But think about rinsing after you use the pad! I think it is an important step!
summary: Leaves Film on Face, but Works Well

reviewText:
These are little pads with a slightly rough texture soaked in an astringent type liquid.  They remind me of old school Stridex pads from the 90's.  Because they are made for men, they don't have the girly scents that many of these types of products have.  Recommended use is about 3 times a week, so don't plan on using them daily.  According to my boyfriend they aren't kidding about not using after shaving.

I used them a few times and found that with my dry skin they only made it more dry so I left them for him - he has oilier skin than I do and seems to like the feel of them.  He claims that they make him feel more clean so I believe that he will want to continue using them.  Because they only recommend using them a few times a week, one container should last for well over a month.

I am a fan of all the Jack Black products have been using them for years as they provide good skin and hair products for men without a girly scent( you can buy most of his line at Nordstroms or Sephoria) but I have never tried the reesurgacing pads ( I thought that was very masculine).  Turns out I was wrong to be afraid of the resurfacing pads.

The pads are slightly abrasive so they help with the removal of dead skin.  One great side effect is your skin feels very fresh after using.  Did not notice any difference using 3xs a week for 3 weeks.  Than on the fourth week a friend I had not seen in awhile mentioned that my face looked younger...what a nice compliment (I am 42 and my faces is starting to give away my age).

This product is super easy to use and you will see results you just have to give it some time and use the product as recommended.
summary: Takes some time but worth the wait

reviewText:
I love this product.  It works great -just don't use it everyday.  I have noticed my skin is smoother and clearer/more even.
After cleaning my face and neck I use the pads on both areas.  The pads have a rough texture that probably helps exfoliate.  However, I was actually surprised at how gentle the product is in general.  Usually using these type of pads you they instruct you to rinse your face with water thoroughly afterwards.  With these you can leave the product on which is more convenient.  I usually use the pads just before going to bed.  Then I usually put on a hypo allergic lotion or aloe vera on my face.  I really like is that I can use them 2-3 times a week and I have super sensitive skin. (Anything with perfumes or heavy lotions and many SPFs make me break out.)  But don't use the product every day!  Once I forgot and used it 3 days in a row and my face was a bit red and felt slightly raw.  Fortunately, I stopped using if for a week and my face went back to normal.
My face feel cleaner after using these pads and it looks better, too.  I highly recommend.
summary: I love this product.  It works great -just don't use it everyday.  I have noticed my skin is smoother and clearer/more even.

reviewText:
When I ordered these resurfacing pads through Vine I didn't realize they were for men. I will say they are perfect for women too. In just a couple of weeks I saw definite results in the firmness of my skin. And I only used the pads about three times a week. So you might see results in as little as six uses. The pads are also slightly abrasive so they seem to remove dead skin while applying the peel ingredients. I also have sensitive skin and the ingredients didn't seem to cause any irritation. I used the pads at night before going to bed and they seem to work great. I think this is a safe way to use glycolic acid. I also noticed my skin was clearer than normal after a few weeks of use. I put these in my shopping cart as I definitely want to buy more when I run out.

~The Rebecca Review

P.S. I looked at my skin today and thought something was different. What I finally realized is that my pore size has significantly reduced. My skin is starting to look like porcelain if you know what I mean. I'm so impressed.

Both my husband and I tried this and had good experiences.  The product has a pleasant smell and while it certainly leaves your face tingling - it's not as astringent and unpleasant as other products I've tried.  I got this because while I don't have a LOT of wrinkles or age spots (yet) - nicer looking skin would certainly be a plus.

The suggested use is 2-4 times per week - so I split the difference and went with 3.  After applying it to my face, my skin feels firmer (while a bit sticky) and I THINK I notice a certain brightness.  While certainly not a magic potion, I've been pleased with the results so far, and once I finish this jar - will certainly consider purchasing more.

This product is pretty good, but if you've got overly sensitive skin you might want to exercise caution lest you come face to power peel with a rude awakening.  While it doesn't feel highly astringent during use--like an isopropyl alcohol-soaked cotton ball would--the overall feeling when you're done is much the same.  Your skin will feel taut and oil-free, but it might also feel like it wants you to splash some water on it to give your skin a strong and relaxed finish.  Use sparingly.

I'm not one that is overly picky with accents, but these Jack Black face pads were unusable for me because of their odor. I have other Jack Black products, like Beard Lube, and love how it smells. However these peel pads smell almost like rose water, which is very off-putting for a man.  My wife agreed they smell lingered on my face after using.

Unfortunately I can't speak to their effectiveness, because I didn't use for longer than a week (3 applications).  On the plus side, they did not burn or irritate my skin (just offended my nose).
summary: Tried to use but can't stand smell

reviewText:
First: follow the instructions. DO NOT use after shaving. every hair shaft will hurt. Second: it is not for daily use. The instructions say 2-4 times a week. The jar should then last a couple of months.

So far my husband has not noticed any changes. I will update this review after he finishes the jar.

Even though Jack Black products are designed for men, I own a few of them (their lip balms and face moisturizer are fantastic!), so I was excited to try this peel out since I love skincare products.

As a bit of background, I have really sensitive skin, and have to be careful about using products that have harsh ingredients since my skin can get red, raw, and irritated quite easily.  This product has been really gentle to use, and doesn't make my skin flare up. It does tingle a bit when you first put it on, but it doesn't hurt or burn, which I prefer.

The instructions for this say to use it 2-4 times a week.  It's very simple to use:  you just wipe a pad over your face and neck (I've been doing my chest, too), and leave the product on; there's no need to rinse it or use a neutralizer.

Because you do leave it on, your skin does stay rather tacky/sticky, so I've been trying to use this at night before I go to sleep, instead of during the day so I don't have to try to get my SPF moisturizer or foundation to spread over it.

The pads also come in a neat little container; there is an inner seal, and once you peel off the inner seal, you can access the pads through the top lid, which flips open.  You're supposed to use these up within a few months so that the ingredients stay potent.

I've only used these twice, but have already noticed that my pores seem smaller after each use.  I will update my review after I've used this a bit more, but, for now, I do really like them!
summary: A more gentle peel for senstive skin -- and great for women, too!

reviewText: I have used these for quite a while now on average 2 - 3 times a week.  I love this product and can honestly say they have worked for me.  No, you can't use them for 5 days as another reviewer complained, and expect a miracle.  Those kind of reviews always slay me.  However, with consistent use these DIY pads will gradually work as advertised.  And no, you can't expect them to remove 20 years of wear and tear to your face.  However, if you are serious about skin care and using every advantage to slow down the aging process a little bit, then these are a good place to start.  A bit pricey, but highly recommended to anyone willing to put in the time and a few $$ to give Mother Nature the finger.  Forty pads last me 90 to 120 days depending on how frequently I use them.
summary: Great for Men Who Take Care of Themselves

This one is to be used in the evening for overnight repair.

We put in my young nieces stocking for Christmas and i was surprised just how excited she was. not the greatest color
This lip balm is nothing special, it has to be reapplied frequently. However the packaging is absolutely adorable and it always makes me smile when I see it floating around in my purse.

Initially when I first bought it, I thought there would be no color pay off since my lips in my opinion are pretty dark. Since a lot of lip products, or at least the ones I have, either don't give me color pay off or is the same color as my lips naturally. So I recommended cutting the part of the seal that had the # and stick it to the bottom of your gloss bar.
summary: #3 Juicy Apple, Really Natural and Pretty!

reviewText: Love these cute bunny glosses! The color pay off is nice and the tubes are super cute! I also love the way they smell!

Color is a little brighter on my lips than what I was expecting though, so I always need to apply it when checking with a mirror to make sure I don't look like a clown afterwards. Still, this is a super cute purchase that I don't regret!
I would buy this again. It is very helpful in keeping the Toppik powder from landing on your skin where you do not want it. Easy to use and I highly recommend it.
I love it, really works

spriking the toppik is better for me.

I've wanted to try the clarisonic Mia 2 for so long and I decided to make the plunge. I love taking good care of my skin and hand washing doesn't clean deep enough and the Mia was the perfect solution. Now I would give this purchase 5 stars but I received a different color than what I ordered??? I ordered the lavender color and received a light green? Now that's not the end of the world but my bathroom is purple themed.. so I will have to send it back and re-order
summary: I love taking good care of my skin and hand washing ...

reviewText:
Bought the Mia several years ago.  Initially, it was great and really cleaned my skin well.  I wear quite a bit of foundation, so I wiped that off first with a gentle cleanser, then followed with the Mia and the super-sensitive skin brush.  ThenUGH!  Pink mold on the spinner mechanism that would NOT clean off.
I rhrew away that dirty thing.
Have just ordered the Tao facial brush, which has a drying lightpromises to knock out all molds.  Well see.

This is my third Clarisonic. Broke the other 2 dropping them on the floor but I had them several years before I broke them. I have owned a Clarisonic since they first came out. They do an amazing job keeping your skin soft and exfoliated. Highly recommend.
summary: They do an amazing job keeping your skin soft and exfoliated

reviewText:
Based on the look of the Clarisonic Mia 2 and other Clarisonics, I figured that the brush would rotate, and I was a little nervous about what that would do to my skin; however, I decided to give it a try.  I'm glad I did!  The brush does not rotate and instead oscillates much the way a sonic toothbrush does.  Whether I use the included sample of Clarisonic face wash or my regular Basis wash, my face feels incredibly smooth and soft afterward because it removes all the dead cells sitting on top without actually scrubbing them off.

I also have the Mia Fit, which I love, but the Mia 2, despite its larger size, is better for travel because it comes with a case.  The handle also makes it less likely that I'll drop it.  This comes with a wall charging unit and a sample of the company's facial wash.

No matter which Clarisonic model you choose, it will be worth the price.  I make sure I clean mine regularly and have replacement brush heads on hand.  The company recommends new brush heads every three months, but I extend the life of mine to twice that.

Even though I'm in my fifties and no longer suffer from frequent breakouts, the Mia 2 is still relevant to making my facial skin look as clean and as clear as it can.  No matter your age or skin type, this system is likely to improve your skin.  Just make sure to clean it regularly.

-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann
summary: Awesome For Cleaning No Matter Your Age

reviewText:
If a friend who's in the cosmetics business hadn't convinced me to try this, I would never have bought it.  I thought that a washcloth was all I needed with cleanser and water.  Wow, was I wrong!  The Clarisonic Mia2 gets rid of clogged pores and leaves my face far cleaner than my old method.

I use my cleaner (about the size of a dime) on the brush head and it is enough to do my face.  The brush lasts about three months or longer.  There is also a firmer head (available for purchase) for body cleansing.

I like the compact travel case that comes with the unit.  And instead of a bulky charger, the handle attaches (via a thin electric cord)  to a small charger.  It takes up little space and that's good for daily use and when traveling.
summary: Without This, You Only THINK Your Face is Clean

reviewText: I was thrilled to save about $50 buying a Clarisonic Mia 2 on Amazon. Now it's just over a year later and my Clarisonic is malfunctioning and the 2 year warranty doesn't apply because I didn't buy it at an authorized dealer. It is a good product when it works correctly, but you want the warranty.
summary: Buy it at an authorized Clarisonic dealer.

reviewText: After reading a lot of hype about this, I caved and bought it. I can't believe that I spent so much money on a product that actually frustrates the heck out of my skin. If you have sensitive skin which is prone to breakouts, I couldn't recommend this in good faith. You know those exfoliants you can get at any drug store that have the plastic/synthetic "microbead" things? If you skin doesn't react well to those kinds of products, this might break you out as it did me. Little tiny bumps everywhere, not a pretty sight. If you have resilient, normal skin I can imagine that this would sort of buff it nicely. Sensitive skin? Too harsh in my book.

I've been intrigued by the Clarisonic for awhile. But since I have very sensitive, dry, acne-prone skin, I worried this would be too harsh for me. Then my sister, whose skin is similar to mine, got one and raved about it. Finally I received one as a gift from a friend who also had one and I've been hooked since. It's a very well constructed product. All of the included components feel substantial and the quality of the brush is great. Mine included the Sensitive Brush head and I thought it felt high quality. It's also nice that it comes in different colors. I could see that being great if you have a household of multiple women and don't want to get them mixed up. I also really appreciate having two built in speeds and a timer so I make sure I spend the appropriate amount of time on each part of my face. It's also done a great job of keeping my skin clean and soft when used with my regular, non-Clarisonic cleansers (Currently that is Aveeno.) It's important to note that it is certainly NOT a miracle worker. (Having acne-prone skin I can say that nothing has helped more than the right kind of prescription topical creams and prescription pills as well as regular medical facial peels.) But I do think it is better than a wash cloth alone. I'm always amazed at how much makeup ends up on the brush and how different my skin feels after in comparison to when I would wash only with my hands or a wash cloth. Very quickly after using it I noticed that my skin seemed softer, almost as if it was sloughing off dead skin. It reminds me a lot of how my skin feels after a nice skin scrub, but without the extra step. I can't say I conclusively can tell that the claims they make around Vitamin C absorption and other things are true. But since I am currently using Peter Thomas Roth Camu Camu Power Cx30 Vitamin C Brightening Serum, 1.7 Fluid Ounce I like the idea that this can help me absorb more of what I am putting on my skin. Those products can be expensive so who doesn't want to maximize the benefits. What I didn't expect was just how good this would feel on my skin. My sister mentioned this after she got hers and she was right! It almost feels like a massage for the skin. I like it so much that I have to keep reminding myself not to overdo it as I have read that you can negatively affect your skin if you overuse this. (1x a day has been great for me.)
summary: Love how this feels on my skin

I can't say I conclusively can tell that the claims they make around Vitamin C absorption and other things are true. But since I am currently using Peter Thomas Roth Camu Camu Power Cx30 Vitamin C Brightening Serum, 1.7 Fluid Ounce I like the idea that this can help me absorb more of what I am putting on my skin. Those products can be expensive so who doesn't want to maximize the benefits. What I didn't expect was just how good this would feel on my skin. My sister mentioned this after she got hers and she was right! It almost feels like a massage for the skin. I like it so much that I have to keep reminding myself not to overdo it as I have read that you can negatively affect your skin if you overuse this. (1x a day has been great for me. Really the only downside is that you do need to replace the brushes every few months and they are expensive so you have to factor that into the cost of this device. Overall I think this is a fantastic product and am glad I received it as a gift.
summary: Love how it feels on my skin

reviewText: This cream is magical. Truly. My face was totally broken out.  I used it overnight - woke up with healed, beautiful skin. I was so shocked. I bow down to La Roche-Posay, their products are the best and I will continue to purchase them over all others. Amazing. Ordering 2 more tubes asap...
summary: beautiful skin. I was so shocked

reviewText:
I really don't know how well this works because there is so little in the container I really couldn't apply enough to give any kind of answer. This is a Sample rip off! I expect the samples to be small but honestly I had to try so hard to get as little as a dime out and this is one of the more expensive samples so I expected a good enough size to give me some idea of what the product works like. From now on I'll be more careful about how much is in the sample which was clearly listed on the site and product so this was partly my mistake.

Ordinarily I love La Roche-Posay products if that helps anyone, the sunscreens are the best but this product I have no idea.
summary: I expect the samples to be small but honestly I had to try so hard to get as little as a dime out and this is one of the more expensive samples so I expected a good enough size to give me some idea of what ...

reviewText: All the La Roche Posay are great, no harmaful ingredients and engineered in one of the best laboratories in France.  Have used this and other products from this firm for yaers, I am 74 and have a great skin.

I love this stuff! I use it as a facial moisturizer when my skin gets really dry. It helps counteract any acne medication I put on my face. Its non irritating and super hydrating. I got a free sample with another La roche Posay purchase and bought a full size because I liked it so much.

When my skin is freaking out, this stuff always calms it down; it never burns and really helps my skin when it's been over-exfoliated or irritated by using too many skin care products. It never makes me break out. Usually I use it as an overnight mask/treatment.
summary: When my skin is freaking out, this stuff always ...

reviewText:
I went thru 2 whole tubes and found negligible effect, if any. My baby had contact dermatitis AND heat rash, and it did not relieve either, despite a professional recommendation. Granted, it did not EXACERBATE the condition, but it did not VISIBLY improve NOR soothe the itching. I also used it on diaper rash to no effect at all (it is a thin, water-based emulsion and thus wastefully absorbs right into the diaper vs an oil-based barrier cream.)

I would classify this as a neutral cream that is free of anything that would potentially irritate skin further, but that's it. This allows time for the skin to naturally heal itself which could allow some to feel it is working.
summary: No more relief than Placebo Effect

reviewText: This product is useful for sensitive skin, but I don't like it's texture and make a little white in my face.
summary: This product is useful for sensitive skin

reviewText: This works very well for sensitive skin - no fragrance, but has a pleasant, neutral smell. I only use a little dab on dry patches on my face, especially around the nostrils (especially during winter and nursing a cold).
summary: A little goes a long way

reviewText: excellent!

Really awesome lotion! I ordered it after reading it would help soothe facial skin after using too much acne medication (seriously dry spots), without causing new blemishes...and it's true. I always overuse, have dry spots, then get new acne from the moisturizer I try to use, but this didn't make me break out anew. It's got a great feel to it and soaks right into your skin. Very safe for your face!
very good product.

I get dry, red, itchy/irritated skin on occasion and have used products from Gold Bond and Aveeno in the past for relief. Comparatively, I have to say that Cicaplast Baume B5 Lotion is as good or better. It works wonders on mild eczema and itchy red rashes. Relief is almost instantaneous and conditions clear up quickly. The slight amount of zinc and combination of some other ingredients in the lotion also helps reduce the appearance of redness, though it can be fully rubbed into the skin if desired. Cicaplast is non-greasy, odorless, non-irritating, and is healthy for the skin -- all advantages in my opinion. It doesn't just cover up symptoms, it treats them. I will be getting more of this wonderful product from La Roche-Posay if needed.

~ Kort

This is a rich, luxe cream that feels deeply moisturizing, but not heavy. I used it both on my face, dry simply from winter air, and my son's, who suffers from mild eczema flair ups now and again. I found it suitable for both, and better than several more expensive creams we've tried on my son's dry, flakey patches. He still hates putting on lotion, for some reason, but this isn't heavy or sticky, which is a huge plus in getting him to actually use it as needed.

Definitely something I'll buy again.

This really keeps your hands moisturized!  My husband has started using it on his hand that has eczema and it is really looking a lot better.  It doesn't say it works for things like that but the moisture level was so good I thought it was worth a shot, and it is really helping.  No greasiness, no odor, just a really good lotion that keeps you moisturized all day.

When I received this lotion to review, the skin around 2 of my fingernails had been cracked & uncomfortable for a few days.
I applied this lotion before I went to bed & the next morning that cracked skin was not painful or tender in any way.
I know it was nearing the end of its course & would have  healed on its own in a few more days; however, I think this lotion sped up the healing process.
So far I've been applying it an average of once daily before bed.  After 3 evenings, the cracked skin is completely healed.

I don't normally have any irritation on my face from the cold weather, but my daughter does.  Right now we're experiencing warmer than normal weather so it will be a while before we can test it on chapped facial skin.

I wasn't expecting this lotion to be anything special, but so far I really like it.

This soothing lotion is designed to be used on dry, irritated skin.
Safe for adults, children & babies.
Can be applied to body, face & lips.
Avoid the eye area.

This lotion is free of paraben, fragrance & lanolin.
Suitable for sensitive skin.

It is not sticky or oily.

 I love the way it goes on.
summary: Use twice a day. Free of paraben, fragrance & lanolin. Healed cracked skin on my fingers. Not oily, not sticky .. safe for lips

reviewText: Very nice and smooth.  It's not greasy and absorbs in to problem spots very well. Were using this primarily on hands that have cracked from over handwashing. Feels nice goin on, no burning.

The La Roche-Posay Moisturizer is a fantastic moisturizer for people with dry sensitive skin.  During the winter, the skin on my face and hands always end up getting very dry, powdery looking, and uncomfortable.  This lotion absorbs quickly, doesn't leave a greasy feeling, and doesn't cause any breakouts or irritation.  It does look slightly shiny after application, so I use it before bedtime.  The lotion isn't very thick, so it applies very smoothly - you won't need to use a lot of product to get good results.  Overall, I'm very pleased with this lotion - it's definitely worth trying if you have very dry skin.
summary: The La Roche-Posay Moisturizer is a fantastic moisturizer for people with dry sensitive skin

reviewText:
I am LOVING the La Roche product line.  It is a bit pricey though.  I want to re-order this, but I'll have to save up.  This is SUCH a nice lotion.  I put it on my cleansed/clean face last night and woke up with the softest, most refreshed skin that I've been able to achieve in a while.

I have some dry patches that are really hard to find a good lotion that won't irritate my sensitive skin.  This however, absorbs into my skin beautifully without a greasy or heavy feeling.  Don't get me wrong, the product is thick, but it absorbs very nice, without a sticky feel.  There isn't an odor to it.

I really love it.  It has helped my dry areas literally overnight.  With continued use, I can only imagine how nice my skin will look and feel.

Highly recommend!
summary: Relieved my dry skin beautifully and overnight!  Love this product line!

reviewText: Excellent product. Works as advertised and is consistent with other 5-star Amazon reviewers experience.

I thought I would like this product. It sounds hyper-allergenic and it does not smell perfumey. I am quite sensitive and have difficulty finding skin care products that I tolerate. Before using this the first time, I roughed up a small area on the inside of my elbow, rubed in some of this lotion, and left it on overnight. There was no apparent reaction so I felt it was safe for my skin.

Last night I tried this on my face, just on my upper cheeks where my skin is dry. It felt a little chalky to me.  When I looked in the mirror this morning, I was dismayed to see reddening of the skin plus a couple of large blemishes. I happen to be over 60 so this is not acne. I will not be using this on my face again but may use it on my hands where the skin is tougher.

Your results may vary.
summary: Low odor but my skin is too sensitive for this product

reviewText: I received this through the Vine program.  This is a thick and very emollient white cream.  No parabens, and no fragrance.  I tested it on an area that has been particularly troublesome for me, a small patch near my elbow that gets very dry, rough and almost painful as soon as cold weather sets in.  This cream has made  a perceptible difference in just a couple of days and the dry patch has responded much better using this product than others I tried (Kiehl's lotion and Bag Balm).  Very small tube, but will seriously consider repurchasing for these small problem areas that get severely dry in winter.
summary: Exceeded expectations on severely chapped elbow patches

reviewText:
During the winter months, my already dry skin develops some targeted problem areas--my right index finger, the knuckles on both hands, and the area on the back of my left elbow. These areas aren't just dry, they are chapped and cracked enough to hurt. In terms of taking care of those problem areas and relieving the itch and the dryness, this lotion has been amazing. After just a few days (applying twice daily), there is a noticeable difference--my skin actually looks and feels like it's healing, unlike what I've experienced with some lotions where I get immediate moisture but only immediately after application.

I'm not sure what combination of ingredients is providing the relief I'm getting, but the one drawback I experience with this lotion is that it has zinc in it; therefore, it leaves a white tinge to my skin. It's not enough to make me stop using it, but it does make me a little conscious of what it must look like to others. The relief, though, is worth it.
summary: Leaves a whitish tinge to my skin, but has a marvelous effect on dryness

reviewText: This cream was nothing spectacular for me. It really didn't do anything for my skin. Very small tube.

This thick, ultramoisturizing balm is made without parabens or fragrance, but it does contain two different dimethicone (silicone) ingredients, which makes it unsuitable for my sensitive skin.  I foolishly applied this on my face when I didn't get a reaction on my hands, and patches of eczema appeared within twelve hours.  Yes, it's my fault for not reading the ingredient list.  While this is probably great for anyone without a silicone sensitivity, people who have undetermined or silicone-triggered dermatitis should steer clear.  Try Tri-Calm instead.

This is great for areas where my skin is tougher and less reactive, such as on my hands.  The consistency is thick, and it goes on with resistance, leaving a bit of a stickiness and sheen for an hour or more.  I really like that it's fragrance-free without revealing a chemical scent.  It is formulated to use on face, body, and lips.

If I didn't have a skin reaction to this, I would have given it four-stars, with one-star deducted for the after-application stickiness.  As it stands, though, it gets another star knocked off because my sensitive skin reacted badly to it.

-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann
summary: Paraben- and Fragrance-Free, But Not Silicone-Free

reviewText:
Like a few other reviewers, I'd seen makeup artist extraordinaire Lisa Eldridge recommend this before, but had never looked into ordering it.  I'm so glad that I've had the chance to try this out! This is such a nice lotion.

Although called a "balm" as part of it's French title, it's a thick lotion that spreads evenly and stays in place. It almost feels like it's matte in texture, but the nice thin about that is you can apply small dabs of it over your makeup without getting greasy-looking.

In this dry winter weather, I get a lot of dry areas around my nose (from frequent blowing due to allergies) and also in places that get red and raw.  (Using Retin-A doesn't help, since it leads to more dry areas.)  This lotion does a lovely job of soothing those red, raw places -- and I love that you can even dab any extra on your lips to soothe them, too.

Great, versatile product!
summary: Works well to hydrate and smooth dry patches

reviewText: La Roche-Posay's products are always excellent, but I've been blown away by their Cicaplast lotion/moisturizer. This has been a god-send for my sensitive, fair skin. Cicaplast goes right on, without sitting on the surface of my skin - and is a great moisturizer, especially under sunscreen or makeup. It has prevented and treated dryness, and I feel confident it will carry me through the winter - usually a nightmare for moisturization and skin comfort with the cold and dry heat (indoors). I use it after washing my face in the morning, and will continue to do so. It's really a superb product and I can't recommend it enough.
What can I add to over 100 glowing reviews which has not been said before?  This cream is pure perfection!!!  Smooth, silky, need just a little bit to moisturize.

What can the shopmaster say except I came back for more. I love all the colors. Umber is a unique choice in a liner and very different from the others. I tried it an I liked it. Give it a shot if black is not for you.

This crayon is fantastic and black is the best outer andinner rim useage One of many that I own. These are well made and go on with very little effort. Good staying power . Looks sexy and sultry and smokeyif you smudge it also looks good. But personal preference I like a good clean line , most of the time. But when I go out I smudge it to get that come hither look.
