I tried in sun/shade/indoors/lights.. but didn't work. The color is really pretty to naked eye.

Saturday Disco Fever is a bright pure orange color. This is not a very blazing neon, so I am able to wear it to work. It looks fabulous in sunlight as well as indoors. I felt that this color is more suitable for evenings and parties in Summer. I was a little apprehensive at first because I personally don't like Yellow/Orange shades. But this color worked for me. It is more red-toned than yellow-toned. This dark Orange looks good on nails too.

The formula on both the polishes is great. Two coats are enough for perfect opaque polish. They dry quickly but dry matty-ish. So top coat is a must for me. I applied a base coat (OPI Base Coat), 2 coats of polish and a top coat (OPI Top Coat). They lasted more than a week on me which is rare :-).

I love it

I have used this prophylactically against this problem and it has worked fine, even though I have been outdoors in cold for several hours.  At some point, winter will arrive in Michigan for real, and that will be its real test.

Ten stars! Yes, for my problem this product gets 10 stars. At first, I used this serum on my face thinking it would eliminate the minor redness I get on my cheeks when I drink even a single glass of wine. It had no effect. So I was about to join the naysayers when it occurred to me to try the serum on my arms where I've had this awful rash FOR YEARS. My dermatologist has tried endless diagnostic techniques (allergy tests, biopsies, microscopic analyses, etc.), has prescribed prednisone, steroid creams, UV therapy, OTC creams, etc. and has never been able to get me relief for more than a couple of hours. She has never even been able to give a name to the rash, just says it is not rosacea or psoriasis. I have been miserable for years. Sounds melodramatic unless you've had a life-damaging skin problem, but if you've suffered too, you understand.

I applied the tiniest drop of Rosaliac AR Intense to my rash and the itching stopped immediately. Frankly, that didn't impress me because almost any lotion will stop the itching for a few minutes or even a couple of hours. What I needed was something that would stop the itching and calm the rash so I could get a full night's sleep. Well, that first night I got a full night's sleep. In the morning the itching still had not come back. After my next shower, I applied a few drops again and the rash and itching remain gone. I continue to be able to sleep and to go through the day without any itching. I frankly cannot believe it, so if you're skeptical I don't blame you. But it's true.

If this serum stops working, I will definitely update this review because I don't want anyone to have false hope as I've had so many times. This serum is too expensive to purchase just to find it's ineffective. I believe the reviewers who say it didn't work for them. But I can swear to you that it is working for me.
summary: 10 stars! It cured my rash & redness (which is not rosacea)

reviewText:
I really noticed no difference after weeks of using this product.  I don't really think it did anything for my skin.  It didn't cause any problems, or feel strange or anything, but it didn't do what it's supposed to do.  I imagine results will vary from person to person, but it just wasn't for me.

I wouldn't purchase it.  Your results could be hit or miss.
Even using it twice a day didn't make a tiny bit of difference, I would not recommend this product.

My wife liked this very much. She has dry rough skin especially in the winter and she is always looking for a little relief. She used it for several weeks and she noticed a change rather quickly which was only a few days.

A little expensive but worth it.

I've been using this product for almost thirty days now and I can't say that I really see much of a difference.  I've learned that of all the rosacea products that I have tried, I still get flare ups if I eat certain foods and sometimes for no reason.  I think this product has given me lots of pimples on my nose and cheeks.  I can't positively say it's from this product, but I didn't have them before.  If you're going to try something I had pretty good luck with prosacea.  But I may stop using rosacea products as I still get flare ups.  I use Aveeno ultra calming face wash every morning as recommended by my dermatologist and that helps keep the redness down.

I don't have rosacea but I have dry sections of my skin that wind and cold weather are unkind to. My skin gets red and chapped during the colder months to the point where parts of it hurt badly. I was out in the wind a few days ago and noticed the redness that evening and the next day. I used this product for a few days after and it definitely calmed the redness on my skin. It didn't work overnight but took a few applications to see a difference. Once my skin gets that winter chapped redness, I find it hard to control. Everything hurts on it soap, toner, moisturizer, makeup  exacerbating the redness and it becomes an entire season of irritation and bumps.

In the short time Ive been using this, I can feel the difference and Im not dreading the winter as I usually do where my skin is concerned.

Its a little expensive at $40 but I can see this one tube lasting the season so that seems pretty reasonable. A little goes a long way.

Recommend.
summary: A bit expensive but it works

reviewText: I have a light case of rosacea these days and what I found is that this La Roche product did seem to help.  However it also made my skin break out.  Now I'm an old mom and my skin is unfortunately getting pretty darn dry, so the only areas left that is oily in my T zones are my forehead and maybe my chin in summer.  So breakouts on my cheeks are basically unknown.  And yet there they were.  These were no red, angry spots but rather just subtle pale bumps.

I have occasionally had problems with red spots on my face. Areas where the skin has been irritated, became overly dry or otherwise has a bit of scarring. This product has helped to even my skin tone and return uneven spots to their natural skin color. I like that it feels light, yet is incredibly effective. I have successfully worn this under makeup, and I like to apply it at night as well for added benefit. The container is small but it is a spot treatment and after a month of use it still feels mostly full. This is absolutely worth trying. I have loved everything I have ever used from this company and trust them to stand by their products!

This is very easy to apply, albeit a bit dry for me (need extra moisturizer afterwards), but that is me and my winter dry skin. Extra plus - no scent that I can detect. I have been applying it twice daily for about a week and have noticed a bit less redness, which is a blessing. It hasn't taken care of it all, but any little bit less red is more than welcome to me.
summary: This isn't a miracle worker of all wonders, but I am seeing good results after a week

reviewText:
After two days of use I noticed a clear improvement on my skin tone and after a week my tone is a more even. I have extremely sensitive skin and this serum does not seem to bother it at all. Other products I have tried in the past have burned and made my skin even redder, not so with this one!

My redness seems to be mostly localized in my cheeks and forehead, but I have been applying all over my face daily to see the most improvement. A small amount of this serum goes a long way, and unlike the recommended 2-3 pumps I have been using 1-2 pumps once a day after I clean my face at night. I have been able to use less foundation and I feel comfortable using blush again (which I did not when the redness of my face would still show through my foundation).

It feel nice going on however you have to wait at least 1/2 an hour for it to absorb in. I found that this left a moist tacky feeling on my face, I have not seen much in the way of noticeable results on the reduction of redness. Some people say it worked well for them, maybe the worse you are the more noticeable the results. I am not that bad so maybe that is why I did not have much improvement. I'm just saying everyone is different. It is worth a try so I gave it the 3 stars...
summary: Worth a try, but in my case, I did not see much in the way of redness reduction but my skin is not that bad to begin with...

reviewText: I was excited to try this because I have a problem with red cheeks. I was hoping that this would make it where I didn't have to cover my red cheeks with makeup. However, as soon as I put it on my cheeks get much redder. After awhile my cheeks go back to their normal redness, but even after diligently using this for weeks, my cheeks are the same color red that they've been for the past two years. As excited as I was to try this, I ended up being very disappointed. It's also very expensive for a product that doesn't work. I don't recommend this.

I do not have severe or chronic rosacea but during times of stress I get flare ups. So far I have gotten decent results with Eucerin Redness Relief products but keep hoping to find something even better. Unfortunately, this is not it for me.
This is a quality serum but it is a bit too heavy (almost Vaseline like) for my combination skin. For others, it may work and it does leave a silky finish to your skin. It just took a bit too long to absorb for me.
My biggest disappointment is that it really hasn't made much difference in my flare ups - certainly not an improvement over the Eucerin, which is a fraction of the price.
Given my results, I would be surprised if this is effective for someone with a stronger case of rosacea but you never know.
Definitely a quality serum but not effective for me.
summary: Quality serum but not effective for me...

reviewText:
I have a couple of broken vessels near my nose that are more annoying than anything. I usually cover them with foundation. I've tried this gel as directed and I have seen a moderate reduction in the redness over time. The gel feels like it would be tacky on the face but I have not found this to be the case. It dries smoothly.

For my purposes, I need very little gel so this small container will last me quite a while. If you were trying to cover a large area this might get pricey. I wasn't expecting to see any results so I am pleased with the outcome.
summary: Helped a noticeable amount with old broken capillaries.

reviewText:
Finally, something that works for my super sensitive skin! I started experiencing red, uneven skin as a teenager. No one suggested rosacea, because it wasn't severe and didn't look like the textbook photos. Of course, to a teenager, it all seems severe.

As an adult, the redness mostly subsided. Recently however, it came back and was accompanied by a light, raised rash and some white head type bumps. I could tell they weren't pimples and I quickly discovered I have a mild form of rosacea.

This product came into my life at the perfect time! Using this once a day has truly evened out my skin. It only takes a small amount, so it will last a long time. I alternate this with a regular serum that I top with Nelson's Acne Gel (which is a tea tree gel that works well with rosacea).

Although this is pricier than my usual skin product, it's well worth it. This doesn't clog my slightly oily combination skin. I usually wear it alone, but it smooths fine under SPF or foundation.

So glad to have found this product!
summary: A relief to find a product that evens my sensitive skin with mild rosacea!

reviewText:
This serum seems designed to help lessen redness on those who suffer from rosacea, and since I am in the beginning stages of the condition, I decided to give it a try.  After using it morning and night, as directed underneath moisturizer, I found that it had some effect -- not a miracle, mind you, but enough for me to continue using it.  It took a few days, however, before I noticed any difference.

I apply this primarily on my cheeks and nose, where my red skin is most obvious, and it takes only a small amount dispensed from the pump to cover that area, with some left over to rub into surrounding areas.  I found the serum to be scentless and mild, with no burning (sometimes tingling) on my sensitve skin.  I'm careful to apply in gentle circular motions with my fingertips so I don't irritate and redden my skin with rubbing.

This isn't a cure, of course, but it works well enough to make a difference.

-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann

OK, so whats in this Localized redness Intensive Serum?

Ingredients: Water, glycerin, isostearyl neopentanoate, butylenes glycol, pentylene glycol, polysorbate 20, tambourissa trichophylla leaf extract, glycerol acrylate/acrylic acide polymer, dimethicone, dimethiconol, ammonium polyacryloydimethyl taurate, and disodium EDTA.

I cant pronounce half the ingredients, and I always scoff when I see a list of what appear to be chemicals and polymers.  The true active ingredient, it seems, is the ambora extract, appearing here as tambourissa trichophylla leaf extract.  Ambora extract is believed to have properties which can relieve redness, blotchiness, and inflammation.  I don't think I have seen it available for sale anywhere other than in this product, and I think it is in some cosmetics.  I think Bayer owns a patent on the processed product (Bayer acquired La Roche several years back).

That said, I have been using the product for about two weeks and it does appear to lessen redness.  It doesnt make it vanish, but it does make it a bit milder, or did in my case.  We also tried it on some very mild eczema and it had the same effect.  It is not a magic bullet, but it soothed the area and lessened redness, perhaps if from nothing else than the soothed area not being itchy/irritated.

It is expensive, but no more than a doctors visit and prescription treatment.  A little goes a long way though.

If you suffer from rosacea, this is possibly a good product to try.  Obviously, results vary from person to person, but I found this to work in my case.
summary: I was skeptical, but it works for me

reviewText: I have pale skin that burns easy I try to wear sun block all the time and tend to stay pale all year and really white in the winter. It is only October as of the writing of this review and I have ready lost the little color I gained over summer. I have thin skin, you can see my blood vessel up close.  I have red skin along sides of my nose and chin, it's not terrible but noticeable and depending on mood or room temperature the redness varies. This serum has little to no scent. Pumps out small pearl of whitish liquid. I do feel a small stinging itchy type feeling from it at first. As I first rubbed it on, my skin turned redder from the friction. I was surprised to notice after a few minutes my red areas had faded. It is 1.35 oz, I only need one pump per application. Tried to look up some of the ingredients but can't find a third party verification on what the Ambophenol is and how safe it is, or the neurosensine. Everything I have found online ties back to this product. As for spring water being special I give them a pass. Will have to wait to use this long term to see if it causes allergic reactions or pimples but from what I notice so far, I like it.
summary: Appears to help with mild red skin.

reviewText: I've been using this for the past 4 days (both in the evenings and mornings) and every time it has made my skin looks redder with a slight burning feel.  I've decided to stop using it.
This product is for my husband's redness on his face and he uses it every night. It's wonderful to control Redness.
i love this product makes it makes my hair super soft and the smell great , this size is perfect for travel

reviewText:

Awesome

On the hunt for the perfect mineral sunscreen that does not dry out my face.  This has a moussey texture, no scent, not irritating on the skin, blends in very well but it makes my skin SO DRY.

Despite all the "goodness" in this sunscreen, it still is not perfect for dry skin.  I am currently using .05% Tretinoin so my skin needs as much hydration as it can get. This is not it.

reviewText: Orange mask of a face is not my style.

I use this daily for sunscreen and as a primer for my foundation! It goes on matte and absorbs quickly. It's effective at protecting my skin from the sun, has no obvious smell (which can drive me crazy), and has not caused any breakouts or irritation on my sensitive skin. Love it!
Used to be great, they changed the formula.

I love mineral sunscreens, but this anhydrous (water-free) formula is chock-full of silicones, which can: 1) Clog pores if not removed properly, 2) Migrate due to it's "slippery" factor, rendering the placement of your sunscreen less effective. Here's the thing: In order for a physical sunscreen to protect your skin, it needs to stay PUT. It can't slip 'n slide all over the place, and if you touch your face a lot, or layer a lot of makeup over this product, you can accidentally "remove" the physical veil that's shielding your face from the sun. The shade is more of a yellow tint to cancel out any redness; don't be fooled into thinking you'll get coverage like a BB cream. The texture is pleasingly smooth like a silicone primer and easy to disperse on skin but never "dries" on skin to set. I much prefer EltaMD UV Physical Broad-Spectrum SPF 41 85-Gram which has stronger lasting power (also mattifying), not loaded with silicones, and stays put on your face until you wash it off.
summary: LOADED with silicones; never fully "dries" on skin; migrates easily

reviewText: I had heard about this on some beauty blogs, and it is just as wonderful as I had heard.  It totally makes a matte surface for foundations and powders.

Unscented, Mineral sunscreen, One of six sunscreens recommended by allure magazine.  Active Ingredients
Titanium Dioxide (Sunscreen) 3.2%
Zinc Oxide (Sunscreen) 1.8%

Inactive Ingredients
Aluminum Hydroxide, Butyrospermum Parkii (ORGANIC Shea Butter), Cucumis Sativus (ORGANIC Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Cyclopentasiloxane, Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Glycerin (ORGANIC), Hydrogen Dimethicone, Iron Oxides, Isopropyl Myristate, Isopropyl Titianium Triisostearate, Linum Usitatissimum (ORGANIC Linseed) Seed Oil, Mica, Oenothera Biennis (ORGANIC Evening Primrose) Oil, Plankton Extract, Polyamide-5, Polysilicone-11, Propylene Carbonate, Rosa Canina (ORGANIC) Fruit Oil, Silica Silylate, Stearalkonium Hectorite, Synthetic Wax.

allure's article claims; allure 6 Sunscreen Solutions...Coola Costing $40 for 1.7oz, you are putting synthetic wax on your skin. Now I checked sunscreens in a tube not spray, 97% organic with 18% zinc, the best protection which costs five times less than Coola with less than a handful of ingredients in the mix unlike Coola which has how many ingredients... wow, close to thirty, amazing.

Zinc Oxide is a physical sunscreen rather than a chemical one, blocks both UVA (320-400 nm) and UVB (280-320 nm) rays of ultraviolet light. Chemical sunscreens are less effective and carry unnecessary health risks. ZO is insoluble in water, used in many industries, in ointments, creams and lotions. Non-irritating, non-allergenic and non-comedogenic, used by athletes as a bandage to prevent soft tissue damage during workouts. ZO must be NON NANO / UNCOATED UPS -2 ZO which has a mean particle size greater than 30nm, when applied to the skin do not get absorbed into the body, do not enter the bloodstream, and are not a threat to human health.

SPF is a measure of how much longer someone will be protected from UVB rays than someone wearing no cream. If the sun reddens unprotected skin in ten minutes, for example, a person wearing SPF15 can be exposed to the sun without reddening for 15 times longer - 150 minutes. While UVB rays are behind the redness of sunburn, UVA rays damage the skin's DNA at a deeper layer. Both radiation types can cause skin cancer. The EU recommendation is for sunscreens to offer a UVA protection factor that is a third of their SPF.

I make my own sunscreen as well as I purchase sunscreen for times when I do not have time to make any since I need to surf. For that reason, when I purchase a sunscreen mix, I need the same formula as I use when I make my own organic sunscreen mix since it only requires few ingredients but for more protection like my nose, I bump the zinc. Zinc is what you see surfers put on their nose for protection. The more zinc, the more protection but it means a mix that is more like a mud since zinc is a powder that I purchase and add to EVCO. Sunscreens are worse than processed foods (which I never consume) since there is no nutritional guide for sunscreens. For a small investment, sunscreens may offer me the possibility of avoiding sun burn, pain, cancer, medical bills, pain killers, etc. that come with exposure to the sun. For that reason, choosing a formula with the least amount of ingredients but high zinc oxide is the best solution. A good sunscreen formula should not have more than a handful ingredients, certified organic at least 95% and FREE OF; fragrances, biologically harmful chemicals like Avobenzone, Oxybenzone, or UV Chemical absorbers, paraben, phthalates, PABA and 1,4 dioxane.

For starters this product definitely does everything everyone raves about.  It is an excellent light coverage on my skin (which goes between fair and medium depending on how recently I self-tanned) and blends in seemlessly.  It seems to soak in well an dI've never had problems with it running if I workout after applying.

The reason for the 1 star reduction is that I think it feels a bit chalky, almost like there is flour in it.  This does not seem to effect the appearance, and the feeling fades from my face after about half an hour, so it's not the end of the world, it's just not my favorite feeling.
summary: Love it, would be 5 stars but can feel slightly chalky

reviewText:
For many years I have been in search of a quality, compact grooming kit.  Over the years I have had kits given to me as gifts, and have purchased kits myself, but all have been the typical Chinese junk one finds at the local discount stores.  For a long time I have had to settle for nice nail clippers made in Japan, which I really like, but I have still lacked the nice matched set I've wanted.  So when I received the opportunity to review the Zwilling J.A. Henckels grooming set I got very excited.  The set arrived in today's mail and was perfect timing as my nails have very much been in need of a trim, and I have been waiting for the set to arrive.

First off, this is not just over-priced junk.  This is a very precision-engineered grooming set manufactured by the same company known for its premium chef knives.  This grooming set falls in that same category of quality craftsmanship where you get what you pay for.  So before fainting at the price keep in mind you are paying for very high quality.

The set arrives in a nice box for gifting, and the grooming tools are neatly arranged in a stylish, thick leather case with a zipper closure.  There are only 5 tools in the set, but the case is overly large and has extra slots in it that lead me to believe it was designed to hold additional tools (a comb and/or razor, perhaps?).  Each tool has its own slot with the longer file and cuticle pusher needing to be kept at the edges of the case or it won't close.  The case is a bit bulky for this grooming set, but the leather is very nice and no doubt contributes to some of the high cost of this set.

The nail clippers are very unique and frustrated me at first.  Unlike other clippers, these are designed to fold completely flat for storage and arrive that way.  To open them you must gently pull back on the top half of the clipper (there is a small ribbed area on it to give you a surface to pull it backward with) which allows the two pieces to separate a little bit.  This is where I got initially frustrated as the tool will not clip or work properly without taking the additional step of lifting the back end of the upper clipper upward and then pushing it forward to lock it into a clipping position.  I don't know if the one I received had a stuck spring or if I just didn't use it correctly at first, but once I figured it out I had no problems using the clipper.  The manufacturer really should provide a little instruction sheet with this set as I have no doubt many have been frustrated thinking the clipper was useless from not knowing how to open it correctly.  The clippers are so lightweight and frail-feeling that I was afraid they might break easily, but I quickly found that very little force is needed for them to precisely cut my nails.  And when I say cut, I mean cut.  These have very precise and sharp edges that cut the nail off with absolutely no jagged edges or tearing like ordinary clippers.  Even the fine Japanese nail clippers I own do not cut this easily and precisely.  After clipping my nails I found little need for usage of the nail file, although the file in this kit is equally nice and works great.

The scissors in this kit are also remarkable in their precision and sharpness.  The rounded tip makes them very safe for trimming eyebrows, nose hairs, and hair that always seems to grow out of men's ears as we get older.  There is nothing particularly special about the cuticle pusher/nail cleaner or tweezers.  They have the same look and feel as the other tools in the set, but for my purposes won't see that much use.  In a perfect world, for the cost involved, it seems like a small stainless steel comb should have been included in this set.

Overall, this is a very fine grooming set.  I would say this is what I have had in mind in my years of searching for a quality groomng set.  The cost of this set will not be appealing or likely appropriate for many men, but for the man who appreciates quality and wants a nice grooming set to stay well-groomed this Zwilling J.A. Henckels grooming set is definitely worth its cost.
summary: for the man who has everything and willing to pay for high quality

reviewText:
This Zwilling J.A. Henckels 5-Piece Grooming Set comes packaged in a nice heavy black box with minimal markings on the outside. The inside of the box looks remarkably like the cover of a romance novel, perhaps one with vampires. That was unusual, and surprising. I guess it adds some interest, but I think the packaging would be classier looking without it.

Inside the box you will find first a lightweight pouch with a flap protecting a very nice looking leather zipper case. These are described as tools for men, but I'm not sure why. Each and every one of the five tools inside can be used by women as well. The tools are nice looking and a most of them are a good weight. The nail clippers are different from any that I have seen before, and frankly they seem to be not only the tool most often used, but they don't seem to be sturdy enough to last long. I may be wrong, but they are lightweight and fold flat. That is a nice feature, but it is also what makes me a bit leery about their long term use. They are also rather small for a man's hand in my opinion.

All in all, I think this is a nice set. It would make a nice gift for anyone who travels, or who likes to have nice looking grooming tools. Perhaps I am missing something, but aside from the case, I don't feel that these are much different from grooming tools that you can purchase almost anywhere. I am certain of one thing, you will be paying mostly for branding here.

This quality grooming kit is really geared for the person who likes the finer things in life.  Yes, it's marketed for a man but I feel it's suitable for a rugged woman too.

All instruments are stainless steel with a satin finish and come packaged in a supple brown leather case with a zippered closure. There are tiny holders sewn into the case for each instrument. Included are the following grooming tools listed in order starting with my most favorite:

- Flat folding nail clippers
- Sapphire nail file
- Blunted scissors for facial hair such as a mustache, nose hairs, and other small jobs
- Pointed tweezers
- Twin instrument that can be used as a nail cleaner and cuticle pusher

I've used every instrument in this package and love most of them.

The flat folding nail clippers are my favorite.  I found them very tricky to use the first time but once I got the hang of it, I was truly impressed. They are flat (almost like a thick nail file), yet when they are opened their cutting ability is the best I have ever experienced in nail clippers. I found it almost impossible to overcut my nails as I have done with other clippers.  Also they are easy to grip and use without putting extra strain on the hands unlike all my others.

The sapphire nail file easily and gently shaped my nail edges. The ease and smoothness of this file beats out any I've tried before and is no comparison to an emery board or cheap metal files.

The blunted scissors are great.  They open and close easily and cut small hairs with ease (including nose hairs).  I really love that they are blunted on the end to avoid the possibility of sticking myself.  This scissor far surpasses the one I own now.  Over 20 years ago, I purchased a mustache scissor and comb. I used the comb to comb out my eyebrows and the precision scissor to trim fly away hair and cut labels off soft objects like pillows and cat beds. I've also used them for trimming the extra- long hairs on my cats' paws. Therefore, the scissors in this package are a great replacement.  Unfortunately, I feel this grooming kit is incomplete without the mustache comb. I believe most men using this for facial hair will want a comb also.

The pointed tweezers are fantastic for removing a splinter or getting rid of that third eyebrow. I even pulled chin hairs with them.  One caveat is that since the tweezers are pointed, there's limited surface area with which to grab a hair. Only sometimes is a little more edge needed for grasping those smaller hairs between the eyebrows where the point can actually be a slight disadvantage. Nevertheless, these are wonderful.

The twin instrument is the only tool I get limited use out of. I like that one side can be used for cleaning the nails; however, I find that Sapphire nail file (which has a pointed edge) even more useful for this job. The cuticle pusher works well too but I prefer to cut my cuticles. I definitely will re-purpose this tool to wipe away nail polish around my nail edges when I paint my nails.

According to the package, this set is made in Germany, Italy, India, Vietnam, and China.

Overall, this is a high-quality grooming kit. At the current price of $199.00 I think this is expensive but it is also obvious quality and the leather case is exceptional.  I am, however, disappointed that at this price that a mustache comb was not included; to me that is a major oversight on their part especially since this is being marketed for men.  On the other hand, I feel this kit is also suitable for women who are a bit on the rugged side. I can tell you this is perfect for me and I plan on using this for years to come.
summary: Quality 5-piece grooming kit for men which this rugged woman finds wonderful too

reviewText:
Wow. Just wow. I have never had grooming tools of such quality, I will not ever be able to go back for my CVS 99 cent nail clipper ever, ever again.

Tweezers -- thought they would be tricky to use because they are so pointy, but the exact opposite is true, you can get that one stray eyebrow hair plucked with laser like precision. And these things grip on harder than the jaws of life. 5 stars.

Scissors -- razor sharp.have a nice grip, feel, and size and they open smoothly. 5 stars

Nail clippers -- the smallest, sleekest clippers ever. For some reason they don't seem that sturdy and I wonder how they will be long term. 4 stars.

Cuticle pusher & Nail cleaner -- most cuticle pusers are square, but the one is not and the rounded edge contours perfectly to the corners of each nail. The sharp edge is great to rid all cuticles away quickly. The cleaner end is nice because it is not as sharp as they usually are, which makes it easier to clean well without getting poked. This tool is sort of medium weight giving it a good feel and because the middle part is flat and wide, you get a good grip when using this tool. 5 stars

Nail file -- I usually hate, hate, detest nail files. It's like nails on a chalkboard and torture for me so I never use them. Ever. Was not expecting to use this one at all, but it is great. It has a rough and smooth side which leaves the tips of your nails so smooth like they have just been buffed. 4 stars (just because it is a nail file and no nail file will ever get 5 stars in my book ;) )
summary: Once you use this, you will never use drugstore grooming tools

reviewText: This is the kind of gift you give only to the very special man in your life.  It doesn't come across in the picture, but these tools are heavy, durable, and absolutely stunning.  Best of all, it does come in a sturdy black gift box, and then the tools are in a beautiful brown leather case (zippered).  I will have to check to see if this company is like Tweezerman's in that they have free grooming tool sharpening for life, but I can certainly see these lasting a lifetime.  This set reminds me of something James Bond would carry in his weekender, because it's just so rich and luxurious looking. My husband has already hidden his because he saw me eyeing the cuticle pusher.  The emery stick is very well crafted and the etchings are deep so that it only takes a few swipes to neatly file a nail instead of laboriously filing away for a minute or so. I can't say enough about how pleased I am with this set.
summary: Stunningly beautiful and useful grooming set.

reviewText:
With one exception, I love this set.  The case to hold the grooming tolls is some of the nicest leather I've ever felt in my life, supple and obviously extremely well made.  Inside, I found 5 grooming tools and actually a bonus!  The tools---first a pair of blunt in nose and ear hair scissors---very well made and my husband reported they worked well.  Next, a metal nail file, which I can use and did, and loved it!  Next, a metal tool with a pointy shovel-like end and a rounded end.  This is called a pusher-cleaner.  I assume you use it to push back cuticles and clean out nails, and it would work well for that.  Then, some wonderful tweezers---I am keeping these!  They are the nicest ones I've ever had.

The fifth item is the nail clipper, and it's a bit of a dud.  Unless I am simply using it wrong somehow, and I do know how to use a nail clipper, it just doesn't work.  It's very minimalistic and folds up, but when unfolded, it just doesn't have enough leverage to cut.

The bonus I got, not mentioned in the packaging materials, is a little key chain thing that looks like a Swiss Army knife.  It has a fold-out cute tiny pair of scissors, a little nail file and a little nail cleaner.  It also has a nail clipper on the side, which works a bit better than the loose one, although still not perfectly.

If not for the clippers, I would give this 5 stars.  As is, I still like it a lot---these are quality pieces and the case alone is very special, but I do wish the nail clippers were better!
summary: Great grooming tolls, a neat bonus key chain and a lovely leather case---but nail clippers are duds

reviewText:
There are very few personal items one can buy these days and know that they will last beyond the lifetime of the user.  This five piece grooming set is one of them.  I have one of my own that I received as a child from my Grandfather and it is as good as the day it was bought.  Considering that that was in 1951 (when they were given to me) and this is 2015 (well you do the math).  One of my sons has this exact set he purchased a while back.  All three were made by J.A. Henckel and as far as I can tell they've only improved the product this time around.  The clippers are now the thinnest folding ones you can buy (the originals were not folding back then but they are still sharp as a tack) The other tools appear to be about the same and of the same fine quality a little sleeker and a little slimmer but still sturdy and finely made.  I got this for my son to use as I don't plan on dying anytime soon and the upgrade will make it possible to pass along both sets to his two boys.  The price is up there for a personal grooming kit but the cut and the quality of the tools involved and considering they will be used month in and month out make them more than worth it.  Just be careful to keep them together in their leather pouch and don't leave them laying about when you're done.

It's good to see something just as well made now as it was a hundred years ago in this hurried world of ours.  If you're looking for a gift that will indeed become an heirloom passed on long after you're gone then you have found it.  Zwilling grooming tools are world famous for just that quality.
And considering the lifetimes they'll be in use the price is a pittance to pay.

I recommend this personal grooming kit without a shadow of a hesitation.  Hope you and yours enjoy it as long and as well as we have.
summary: Not Just A Personal Grooming Kit But An Heirloom That Will Be Cherished For Generations

reviewText:
This set of grooming implements is of the highest quality imaginable made by Zwilling, a German company that makes an interesting assortment of tools for personal and household usage. My first impression of this set of manicuring "tools" has held true, they are of the finest construction and built to last. Zwilling JA Henckels is a company that's probably more well known with their kitchen cutlery & cookware, I have both in my kitchen by this brand and adore my set of poultry shears. I find this grooming set to be top notch in the same way, with stainless steel and elegant construction that sets these tool apart from comparable cheaper brands.

An entire set of tools accompanies this kit; nail file, cuticle pusher, nail clipper, pointed tweezers, and facial hair scissors in a high quality leather case. All of the tools are easy to use, and I especially love the nail clippers which are a bit unusual looking, but are very sharp and work very well. I find that it's easier to nip the nail on each side then work towards the center to prevent tearing the fingernail, which does the trick with these clippers. The file is also excellent to pare down and smooth the nails, it looks like a "diamond" file. The rest of the kit is also very quality; pointed tweezers (awesome for pulling splinters out as well as hair particularly ingrown hair), cuticle pusher, and scissors with a safety edge to prevent nicking the skin.

A cute set of basic tools on a key ring is also included for day to day "emergencies". This set should last many years and would make a wonderful gift for both men (the target for this grooming set) and women. Highly recommended!

Hard to say what my favorite component on this kit is. Love the leather case it comes in and the overall quality of the tools. The case is top of the line and made of Neat's brown leather with a zip fastener closure, even on the zipper, the craftsmanship is impeccable. The quality of the tools is above average, the scissors for instance, it's like butter when you cut with them, so they work great as well as look great. The details, little details are top of the line, near the best you can get. Besides the leather case you also get the 5 grooming tools-

The tweezers that are painted, satin finished and stainless steel.
The nose and ear trimmers, satin finish and made of stainless steel.
The nail clippers which are made differently than your usual clippers, they're collapsible, thin, lightweight and sharp.
A twin instrument, pusher/cleaner that's satin finished and stainless steel.
A sapphire nail file, satin finish, stainless steel.

You get precision and quality craftsmanship with this kit. Company is based in Germany. For this kind of money It is near top of the line, something that will bring a smile to your face or you'll be proud to carry if you do invest in it, also you'll be satisfied with the results.

Ok, I'll admit when I ordered this, I missed the part where this was for men.

But then I thought "well men are human aren't they?  And humans have skin, right?" and decided to rub it on to my own freshly scrubbed face.  What I learned was:

-It is non-greasy
-It leaves skin satin smooth
-It feels soothing (I had a bit of sun from yard work)
-It is not strongly scented

Then I gave it to my husband (the actual target market) and his thoughts were:

-what my wife wrote above
-has a scent but very light and inoffensive
-his skin looked less "red and angry"
-that he likes it and will continue to use it

We both have very sensitive skin and had zero problems with this.  Did it erase wrinkles?  Sort of, skin looks smoother.  Only time will tell if it actually erases wrinkles.

Feels great at night. Takes while to get used to how little you need. It's expensive, but using the right amount allows you to have it last longer. Does it do any good? Who knows? But it does feel good and it can't hurt, right?

With the exception of Anthony's shaving cream and Aramis night moisturizer, Jack Black was the only product I was using for skin care.  I decided to try this for my night moisturizer when I saw it on Amazon and like their other products I love it.  A lot better than Aramis for a night time moisturizer.  I use the black jack facial wash to clean my face at night followed by their protein serum and then the dry erase cream and have noticed a difference since switching brands.

I would recommend this product for any man that cares about their skin

I am a 28 yo male and I use many Jack Black products because of their commitment to nature, science, and more importantly men's skin.  I use the Protein Booster Skin Serum, Energizing Scrub, Double Duty Lotion, and now this night cream.  It provides instant hydration without leaving behind an oily residue.  I used to use Zirh Rejuvenate as my night cream and that worked well but it is harder and harder to find Zirh in stores or online anymore.
The Jack Black Dry Erase Ultra Calming cream is just what it says it is.  It provides moisture and calms the skin after even the harsher and cheaper face washes.  Combine this with the Protein Serum and Double Duty Moisturizer for day use and you have a comprehensive day/night regime that provides your skin with the ant drying and ant aging moisture it needs.
summary: A Perfect Night Cream by a great Mens Line

reviewText: Works well but smells terrible.
Good evening moisterizer.

I love this nighttime cream by Jack Black. The directions note that you can use this in the morning if you'd like, too, but for the past few weeks, I've only been using it at night. So far, I've had nothing but positive things to say about this. It goes on easily, isn't greasy, and has done a good job overall. It does seem to do a good job evening out the skin. This is a bit pricey at $38, but you don't need to use a lot of it, so I'm thinking it will last a decent amount of time.

I am new to Jack Black's products and I simply LOVE this moisturizer!  I have used it both at night and during the day and find that it makes my skin soft and helps ease redness.  At my age, and in the climate that I live, I need all  of the help I can get!  Unlike many other moisturizers, I found I did not have to keep re-applying it.

The cream goes on smooth, it has no strong scent so men and women can use it without it smelling "perfumy". The tube is just the right size to fit in a purse, cosmetic bag or backpack.

I have been a Jack Black product fan for several years. I discovered the brand at a Nordstrom charity event years ago and began using their shampoo, conditioner and double duty moisturizer on a regular basis. I especially liked their sun block and it helped me get through this past summer without a hint of a sun burn despite hours working outside. Good stuff, all.

I really became a Jack Black advocate when I tried (through the vine Program) their Protein Booster Skin Serum. Despite the rather steep price, this product eased a consistent of dry skin problem on my forehead and cheeks. Then, I discovered that the Dry Erase Ultra-Calming Face Cream was a companion product and that they recommended that you combine them for maximum moisturizing.

I (and my wife) have been using this product for about two weeks and it definitely works as advertised. I have small red splotches on the top of my cheeks from years of wind and sun abuse and after a few days of regular use, the redness toned down and the skin felt less tight. Then, when I combined it with the (super expensive!!) Skin Serum, it seemed to work a even a little better. That could be the cumulative effect of consistent use or just wishful thinking but I am pleased with the way the products seems to work together on my problem areas.

My wife has fair skin and she sees occasional red patches on her cheeks when she has worked under the sun in the garden. With two weeks of use of just this face cream, she too sees an improvement. Yes, the summer sun is months gone but the product does seem to be helping her.

The Jack Black Dry Erase Ultra-Calming Face Cream has a pleasant scent. It absorbs easily and doesn't leave a greasy feel on your hands of face. I'm not sure if it's any better than the Double Duty moisturizer that I had been using but it is an effective product that does when the maker claims.

So the questions is: Is it worth the high price - especially when you consider that they suggest that you combine it with another even more expensive product for maximum value? Hard to say and I think that's a decision you'll have to make for yourself. My opinion - it works as claimed on my and my wife's skin and there is a noticeable improvement in overall skin softness. There is certainly a lot less dryness around the spots that were problems. So, on that basis alone, I recommend that you try it for yourself.

Have dry skin and want to try a quality product that could help - this could be your solution.
summary: Another quality product from Jack Black - does what they say it does on my skin

reviewText: My husband has used Jack Black products in the past and has always been satisfied.  This is no different!  The product is non greasy, goes on smooth and vanishes quickly.  The product is white, but disappears.  There is no scent to this product which is nice because it doesn't interfere with after shave/cologne scents.  The product leaves your face feeling clean, not heavy or pasty.  This works well after shaving, or washing your face especially after being in the sun.  He did not notice his face feeling any "tighter" or less damaged in regards to wrinkles, but would recommend this as a good moisturizer.

Although I'm a tried-and-true user of Neutrogena's sensitive skin facial moisturizer, I've begun using this face cream in conjunction with Jack Black's Deep Dive Glycolic Facial Cleanser with positive results.  Recently, I was hauled off by my wife and her friend to some spa in New Mexico called "Ojo Caliente," where I slathered my face and chest with mud from the mud bath spigot and baked in the sun for ten minutes.  Although I'm a frequent moisturizer (i.e. every time I was my face), the mud must have sucked all the moisture out of my face, which resulted in dry skin.  The aforementioned facial cleanser coupled with JB's face cream helped significantly to heal my skin over a two-day period.  It doesn't have a smell and doesn't leave your face feeling or looking greasy.  The price, however, seems a bit steep at 38 smackers.
summary: Got me through a rough patch (of skin)

reviewText: This is one of the best moisturizers I've ever used! It's so rich and creamy and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and soft without any greasiness. I'm a 39 year old female with very sensitive skin. My skin type is normal with an oily T-Zone and I have some redness on my chin and around my nose. This moisturizer not only leaves my skin feeling amazing but it also tones down the redness I have. My 44 year old husband has very sensitive, combination skin with slight rosacea. He's been using this moisturizer for two weeks and he said that this is his new favorite. The only reason I didn't give this 5 stars is because I don't care for the scent which is very faint but it smells like old lipstick. My skin loves this moisturizer so the scent doesn't bother me enough to stop using this. I highly recommend this to both men and women who have sensitive skin that's prone to redness.

This is an excellent non-greasy moisturizer for sensitive skin. It really does everything it says it will, and I did not expect any less. This is a great brand in general and all of their products so far have been excellent quality and very effective. We've been buying many Jack Black products for about 7-8 years now and never had a product not work well, never any complaints.

Sometimes with dry, sensitive skin, you get small little patches of dry skin on your face. Some moisturizers turn those dry patches into red patches, because it irritates those areas, especially if the moisturizer is too greasy. Sensitive skin tends to not like anything that leaves a residue or greasy feel. This cream hydrates those areas, and the rest of your face without irritating at all. It is soothing because it eliminates the tightness, as well. It makes your skin feel good and look good. As the weather is getting colder and drier now, the redness and dryness around the creases of the nostrils, outward onto the cheeks, becomes so apparent. This cream helps with that redness too. I don't know how else to describe it other than very soothing. The product name says "calming" and that does seem very fitting as well, as it calms down the redness and irritations. There's no itching or burning like there was with other moisturizers.

You don't need to use a lot, so this tube will last quite a while.

for men, but can be used by women. Expensive but just a very little goes a long way. Lightly scented by not at all offensive or over powering. The consistency is more between a cream and a lotion. Goes on nice, relieves dryness. Not really so sure about the making your wrinkles disappear. Just through it's nature of relieving dry skin, it may well plump up the wrinkle zones, but as for making them go away...maybe not.

I'm always looking for products I can use as a non-greasy moisturizing base for my face before I apply any foundation or powder. This is a men's product but it's surprisingly absorbent, calming after a hot bath, and does not make my skin break out like some face lotions.

A little goes a long way since it's not as thick as some shea butter based creams but more lotion consistency. The ingredients are aloe vera, shea butter, avocado oil and jojoba oil but it's not very greasy at all and very absorbent, probably due to the aloe vera. There is a very mild fragrance so it's not overpowering to use on the face.

My face gets red and itchy after a bath from the hot water and the soaps/shampoos and this moisturizer helps in calming the irritation. I would not use it in the summer as it's just too heavy for the face in that weather. It's a great product but it would have been wonderful under $20 for the size. At under $40 it is pricey and several other products are available in this price range that work better for me.
summary: A light, non-greasy lotion with several natural ingredients. Moisturizes, soothes and protects.

reviewText:
I use a face moisturizer every day, mostly because of dry skin, and the fact that I live in South Florida where the sun is a constant companion.  This moisturizer lived up to my expectations and then some.  While many moisturizers are greasy, or leave a residue on your hands this one was absorbed into my skin quickly with almost no residue whatsoever.

The other aspect of this product that I really liked was that it was not scented, and didn't leave a strange smell on my face after use (especially when combined with cologne this can be a problem).

I used the product primarily during the day, and not at night as recommended (when I normally apply moisturizer).  But I found that the product kept my skin soft all day.  I'm not sure that it would erase wrinkles (can anything do that?) but I certainly found it superior to my normal face moisturizer.  I think you will be very pleased with this product.
summary: The other aspect of this product that I really liked was that it was not scented

reviewText: Shaving with a blade can leave my skin irritated.  I use Nivea lotions typically to try to moisturize and soothe my skin after shaving. This Jack Black is a premium alternative.  It is very light and has little fragrance.  But it works.  I notice less redness, and my skin feels cooler and less raw with this product.

I sleep with a CPAP and, consequently, there are mornings where I wake up with a line, or lines, on my face due to my sleeping position during the night.  These sometimes stay with me all morning and the appearance isn't very flattering.  I've used this cream a few nights now and those lines have been gone by the time I have morning coffee since I began using the cream.  It doesn't take much, goes on nicely, and there is virtually no fragrance with this face cream.  So far, so good.  I like this stuff very much.

This cream feels much better than ceramide eye gel from Ulta. It's indeed noon-greasy, is almost immediately absorbed by the skin of forehead, cheeks, and neck.

The tip of the tube arrived sealed with aluminum protective foil. It seems almost entirely botanical:

- 10% ingredients derived from seeds of the Tara Tree fruit
- 10% Aloe Vera Leaf juice
- Rice Bran extract
- Vitamins C and E

The cream has a very-very distant healthy pleasant smell that I have  a hard time to figure out...  Very good cream!

I have both dry and oily skin that sometimes causes a rash near my goatee.  Went to Nordstrom and and got a Jack black serum and Jack Black double duty moisturizer.  It worked great and my skin looks great and no rash.  I was given a sample of  dry erase to substitute for the old formula moisturizer.  The dry erase seems to go on easier once.it's on my face it gets absorbed with little effort.  Also a little goes a long way which is nice.  The smell is a little overwhelming but not a deal breaker.  Only wish the ingredients were listed on the tube.
summary: takes off a year or two off my face

reviewText: One make up mishap can ruin a perfect morning!  With this product one swipe of the wand corrects the problem.  A great travel item as well; previously I carried a small bottle of eye make up remover and q tips just to clean up accidents (I use wipes to remove makeup when travelling-less liquid to haul). The clean wands are great and make this a 5 star product.  No oil residue either.

Two stars might make the reader believe this is a bad product, but it isn't. The VINCENT LONGO Olive Oil Fix Tip Makeup Remover is actually a very nice product. However, it has several drawbacks. First, the tube contains about - maybe, I don't know - maybe a teaspoon and a half of an "olive oil product" - I'd rather use pure olive oil than some olive oil mixed with chemicals (see label photo). The product itself does a very good job at removing makeup mistakes without disturbing much surrounding area. However, is this product worth $20? Absolutely not. As I stated . . . it's a tiny amount of oil, a fixed, stationary applicator, and a dozen extra swabs (overproduced, glorified Q-tips). The in-tube applicator defies explanation; if one is expected to dispose of the provided tips, not re-immerse them in the oil, it seems that providing the attached applicator is counter-intuitive. Its use would contaminate the oil, so why is it there? Also, immersing a disposable tip in the tube this morning, I managed to dislodge the white cap, which could create an oily disaster in someone's purse if the tip remained dislodged inadvertently. Yes, this product does the trick. But so do a host of other things, including water on a Q-tip. So why pay $20 for what is basically frou frou?
summary: Big expense doesn't reflect the benefit

reviewText: This is basically a container with olive oil and pointed qtips to touch up eye makeup mistakes and smears.  It works just fine. Just apply to the area and pat down the residue and you are good to go.  I think it's a good product but the price is pretty high considering you could pretty much make this yourself at home for a fraction of the cost.  It looks good however and this setup is very portable.  I think it would be much more appropriately priced at about half of what it is now.  If price is not an issue, it's a worthy makeup tool.

Olive oil fix tip, well named as it is just that, a small vile of olive oil, 12 plastic disposable wands, with a sticker on the wands that state..Made in China!
 You could probably do much better in a dollar store, as you could get a zillion plastic makeup wands for a dollar. Also a small vile from a pack of 100, fill the small vile with olive oil and bingo! For under $4.00 you have your very own Precision Makeup Remover ..Olive Oil Quick Fix.
This product list on Amazon for $20.00.  Gee z zoo ...People will buy any thing!
As I hate to leave a negative ending to this review, I can honestly say, without any guilt ....it does correct makeup mistakes.  So the product is not all a joke. Cannot recommend this product.

My teenage daughter definitely likes these - they're easy to use. There is that bit of oily residue as mentioned by other reviewers but all one has to do is towel off after as my daughter does. However, that's an issue as it seems like the product could be/should be less likely to leave residue since it's purpose is to repair. The rest of the makeup needs to remain unaffected and the area itself shouldn't have to be prepped for a redo. Otherwise, a tiny bit of remover on an ordinary Q tip would suffice. There are no instructions as to how to replace the wand though the kit comes with extras. That's odd. Between my daughter's appreciation of it and my doubts I'm going to give it a 3. It's far from perfect or necessary.

Unless you have the steadiest of hands, it's nearly impossible to entirely avoid makeup mishaps.  This is great for dealing with makeup mistakes on the go. The 12 disposable tips that come with this are also great - I love the slightly angled design because it makes it easier to remove unwanted makeup from even the tightest spaces.  Also even though I have sensitive skin I haven't had problems with stinging, burning or other negative side effects.  That said, the 'Olive Oil' in the name can give the impression that this is a natural product, yet when you read the actual ingredient list there are plenty of things that are hard to pronounce.  For me this isn't a problem (and looking up the ingredients on Environmental Working Group none of them seem to have known health risks) but worth taking note of if this is something important to you.

Overall all a handy and effective product.

The idea of this makeup remover is a good one.  It is portable, which is nice, but having the extra tips available may not always be easy to do if you are not near your makeup table.

This oil is rather slick in nature, and it has a pink pearl in it which allows it to look nice on the skin.  It does not seem to be so overwhelming that it is obvious, just blends into the skin a little nicer than just oil.

When using this right after a mistake with waterproof makeup, I can usually get it off using just a dry tip without the oil on it.  But if I have to wait a moment, it is nice to have the oil.  It makes the makeup come off pretty quickly and precisely using the tip.

The tips are washable if you need to make them last, but I am not sure where you can get more to replace them when gone.  I didn't find any info in the package about that.

There is no fragrance or other problem that I found with this remover.  It takes a bit to settle in my skin, though so replacement of makeup immediately is not always good. I have to wait a small bit and then it works better for me.

All in all, this is a nice remover to have on hand for small mistakes of waterproof makeup.  It works well and is easy to use.  I think I would like it a little better if there was a carry case with it to put in an extra tip or two so you can keep it in your purse or luggage for travel.
summary: Nice To Have Around But Not Always Convenient

reviewText: The Vincent Longo Olive Oil Fix Tip makeup remover wands do a very nice job in helping to clean up and fix makeup goofs. The olive oil itself works well. The wands are a bit clunky. This was a nice product to try out--I don't know that (at the price) I would go out and get another set. Hopefully that will come down a bit. It is a nice size, boxed, for travel. It definitely works, it's pricey, but if that's not an issue for the customer, then it is worth it.

A waste of money. Basically u get a vial and a few applicators. The oil based fixer is relative ineffective and obviously greasy. The applicators are rough for the tender under eye area and you have to press relatively hard to get under eye smudge cleaned up, especially with a black eyeliner smudge

I really love the idea of this Vincent Longo Olive Oil Makeup Remover. I also love that it comes with additional applicator tips.

I have used it a few times to remove the fallout from eyeshadow or mascara from my upper cheek areas. The makeup remover works fantastic. It quickly removes the makeup and leaves that area of skin feeling soft (but not slick like I was worried it might).

However, I have learned that you can not use it to remove eyeliner that is right around your eye..or any makeup where the olive oil remover touches makeup that you are leaving on. If you do use it in these areas, it will make the remaining makeup run. I found this out the hard way using Urban Decay Perversion (black) 24/7 eye pencil. These Urban Decay pencils do not run ever. Well, after I used this Vincent Longo Olive Oil remover to touch up my sloppy job of lining my eye, I discovered an hour or so later that my eyeliner was running and smearing.

So, I do like this makeup remover. However, it does not work for the spot that I really need it to work for: touching up eyeliner. I will continue to use it for fallout and mascara mistakes on my cheeks. It also works well for removing stubborn eye makeup that does not immediately come off with standard makeup remover.

For the price and flaws, I don't think I would buy this makeup remover again or recommend it.
summary: Works well for removing some makeup..but not for others

reviewText: It does work as described.  It takes off even the toughest mascara and eyeliner.  Unfortunately, it replaces the stuck-on-makeup with stuck-on-oily-gunk.  I guess if I used this and then washed my face with a washcloth before bed, it would be OK... however, I could never use this to "fix" a makeup mistake and head out the door.  The feeling of this on my eyes/face is too gross for me to leave the house with.
summary: Works but leaves oily residue behind

reviewText:
First of all, this makeup remover does just what it's supposed to do--removes makeup quickly and easily. I've found it quite handy, as I'm always getting mascara on my eyelids and under my eyes.

However, I'm rating it three stars for two reasons. 1: The price. I realize prices fluctuate on Amazon, but as of this writing, this product costs $20. That's for one .25 oz bottle of remover and 12 extra tips. I would pay $10 for this product, but not $20. 2: There is an applicator tip attached to the lid (as you can see from the picture), but it's not removable. I didn't realize this when I first used the product, so I immediately dirtied the applicator. So now, if I want to take this on the go, my choices are either to keep using a dirty applicator or to carry along an extra. Neither is a good option.

While I appreciate this product, I will not be buying it in the future.
summary: Works well, but what's the value?

reviewText: They are greasy and you are sticking that now dirty swab back into the oil to use again and you have to dab or wipe off the excess oil, especially if you are using it in trouble spots like under the eyes. I don't know if I would spend money on these.

For the past several months, I have been using the Elf Makeup Remover Pen ($3 on the Elf website, twice that here on Amazon) to fix makeup mistakes, so I was curious how this much more expensive Vincent Longo product ($20 on Amazon) would perform in comparison. The answer for me was: not very well.

This product page for the Vincent Longo Olive Oil Fix Tip Makeup Remover states:

"Quick-fix solution for minor makeup mishaps. Nourishing olive oil based formula allows precision removal without having to reapply your whole face. Makeup can be immediately reapplied on area after use without further cleansing."

Here are my thoughts on those claims after using this product:

1) It is NOT a quick fix because of the oil residue left behind.
2) It does NOT provide precision removal when compared with the Elf product.
3) Makeup CANNOT immediately be reapplied without further cleansing.

When you use even just the tip of the doefoot applicator (a lip gloss-type applicator) to remove a makeup mistake, it leaves behind a slick of oil on your skin. The first time I used it to repair an eye shadow mistake on the outer edge of both eyelids, I did not realize it had left behind a greasy patch, so I went on to my volunteer job. When I got home, I was horrified to find that my eye shadow, near where I had used this product, was horribly smeared, creased and worn off. This is something that never happens to me normally as I wear a primer.

The next time I tried this product, I knew this time to wipe the oil slick off my skin before finished repairing my makeup and left the house. That day, my makeup wasn't impacted nearly as much. BUT the product claims that I should be able to "immediately reapply" my makeup "without further cleansing" and that just simply IS NOT TRUE.

Further, this little tube of olive oil and chemicals is overpriced at twenty dollars. I could use the olive oil in my kitchen on a Q-tip and skip the chemicals if I wanted to deal with having an oil slick on my skin.

No thanks. I will stick with my 3-dollar Elf Makeup Remover Pen.

Not Recommended.
summary: Leaves behind a greasy residue that messes up my makeup!

reviewText:
Hmmm....I have mixed feelings about this product. The actual make-up remover works very well, and is great for smudges and smears. If you goof, you don't have to wipe everything away--just the smudge. But...the disposable applicators sorta throw me for a loop. The wand set up isn't intuitive. I nearly broke the screw-top wand, because I thought I was supposed to remove the existing applicator after use, and replace it with another. No, the screw-top wand stays put, and I guess you're supposed to use it last? Also, carrying around a bunch of applicators doesn't seem practical. Couldn't I just use a q-tip dipped in any standard make-up remover and achieve the same results? (Sidenote: I'm ready for someone to make a great balm-y, remover touch up stick. Paula Dorff used to have a product like this, and I was hoping this Vincent Longo product would make a good substitute. It doesn't. Sadness.)

Anyway, the actual make-up remover is top notch. I'm just not crazy about the wand set up.
summary: On the fence about this one

reviewText:
This Prosecco candle from Antica Farmacista is not literally scented like sparkling white wine, although it is of a similar color.  The fragrance is predominately that of crisp satsuma tangerines, balanced by a secondary floral element of lily of the valley.  The other fruity components are not readily identified by my nose, but surely must contribute to the complexity and richness of the luscious scent.

The wax liquifies completely and burns very easily and slowly, with no visible smoke after the wick is seasoned.  It did need a very slight trim before lighting, and the wick should be tended between burnings for best results.

The simple cylindrical glass container has a silver metallic laurel band circumscribed.  The sturdy box is covered with paper in a raised medallion print in the manner of a fine Italian damask.

Overall, this is a luxurious candle ideal for spoiling oneself or for presentation.

This cleanly and steadily burning candle is housed in heavy glass, and with a promised 60-hour burning life should last a long time.  The scent is pleasant but a bit strong if it were to be kept lit for a long time.  A good host/hostess gift!

This is a pretty candle with a lovely fragrance .  It is perfect for making a warm cozy ambiance
and cheering the mood of a room.

This is a beautiful light fragrance.  I lit it in my bathroom while taking a bubble bath and it was lovely.  Just a hint of fragrance and not overpowering.  The design is simplistic and matches any decor without being garrish or ugly.  So far this candle seems to be burning at a significantly slower rate than those cheap candles in the big box stores.

The fragrance is pleasing and not overpowering. The glass holder is very pretty and looks nice placed anywhere. However, i personally could never pay that much for a candle. I occasionally buy candles from Bath and Body works for half the price and i am just as happy with theirs. This candle says that its made from apricots, black currants, and other fruits, but to me, the smell is not fruity but more floral, which was unexpected but it still smells great.

The candle is gorgeous. It is packed well and comes in a lovely box, suitable for wrapping as a gift where a candle might be the right thing. It burns very nicely, giving off a not to bright glow. The downside is that the scent is a lot stronger than other reviews suggest, and this candle is not going to work for anybody with a scent allergy. No sooner did I have it out of the box that I could feel and smell the scent. So, great candle if you can do scents, but not light enough for anybody who cannot do scents.
summary: It burns very nicely, giving off a not to bright glow

reviewText:
This candle smells wonderful and fruity but it's a bit strong for me.  I also do prefer lavender or spice candles and will pick these first when available.  I do have to say though that this has that wonderful aroma of a good wine and would be perfect just to put it in your car beverage holder and let the sun do its wonderful work of melting the candle slowly.  The fragrance does linger quite awhile giving your home a delicious scent even as it lingers longer and longer.

I do love soy candles the best and this does not disappoint.  It burns slowly and evenly without any residual black smoke like the cheaper candles do.  I have sensitive fire alarms and this doesn't bother them at all whereas one or two of the cheaper ones I bought did set them off.  The glass that this candle is in is thick and really would make a wonderful drinking glass were it not for the decoration on the glass itself.  I did cut the wick a bit to burn this as it was a bit long but not overmuch.

Overall, this candle is a wonderful gift for someone who delights in delicious fragrance and loves to burn a quality candle.  The price is a little steep for a 3 inch candle but you get what you pay for and in this case it would be the quality of the candle and the wonderful fragrance.  I would honestly like to try the lavender one and the one that contains verbena and cedar.  Those are more on my scent list.  I can see this easily lasting the sixty hours of burn time due to it's high quality.

This is the most expensive candle I've ever had and I'm somewhat surprised to find that it is worth the money. The wax is very pure and burns cleanly and slowly. The scent used to be called satsuma proseco and that is a good description. Light floral notes that reminds you of a fine champagne.

It comes in a beautiful gift box that is designed to also work as a stand however mine was severely tilted. No matter, the candle jar is beautiful and doesn't need the stand.

Antica Farmacista Scented Candle Prosecco is contained by cylindrical glass 3.5 inch (89 mm) tall, 3.2" (81 mm) in diameter, and weighing 19.6 ounces (555 g).  It is packaged in a luxurious cardboard box, almost Italian, 4.4" (112 mm) tall, 4" x 4" (101 x 101 mm) at the base, and weighing 24 oz (640 g).  The glass can be held in the base, which is 1.4" (36 mm) tall.  The smell is very pleasant, strong, and not too aggressive even when the candle is not lit, just sweet.  However, after a few days, the smell of not lit candle subsided. So, the aromatic substances evaporated from the candle's surface or sublimated. Thus, the candle looses them quite fast and needs to be stored under zip-lock or will age.  The luxurious box is not hermetic enough to prevent candle's aging, but it slow it down.
summary: Sweet, strong smell, & not too aggressive

reviewText: This is definitely a very high quality candle, that burns very evenly, better than almost any scented candle I've ever had. It's packaged in a very attractive gift box, although not well suited for being tossed into a shipping box and sent through the mail, but thankfully the glass is very heavy duty and the candle did not break even though it was rolling around inside. The scent is very nice when I opened it up and took a sniff up close. Unlike other reviewers however, I was quite disappointed with the amount of scent it released into the room. It does a little better in a small room like a bathroom but compared to much cheaper scented candles of similar size it was quite inadequate for my living areas. I had to be right up next to the candle to detect the scent even after burning it for a couple hours. From a yard away, I could barely detect any scent in the air. For the high price of this candle, it's hard for me to recommend it when it is not strong enough a scent to even detect in anything other than small rooms.
summary: Beautiful, Even Burning Candle, But Not Enough Scent For Me

reviewText:
This is a beautiful candle that burns elegantly.  I was a bit surprised by its small size--it is about 3 inches tall by 3 inches wide.  It will be interesting to see if it does last 60 hours.

The fragrance when burning is pleasant--but I agree with another reviewer in that it can get a bit strong if it were left burning for a long time.

It comes in a lovely package that would make this an ideal gift.
No SLS to make scalp itchy. Too soon to tell if it keeps hair from falling, seems to be less in the drain so far but the scent of it is somewhat medicinal. Smells like coal tar!
Good smell, low foaming

reviewerName: Lover of Life, Sunsets, Cats and Cooking
reviewText:
My husband swears by this shampoo. He used to have light dandruff and it turned out that it was being caused by sulfates and parabens. After using this shampoo, it was all gone. Also, this is great for thinning and fine hair, it is gentle and non-drying / non-damaging.

I use it from time to time as a break in my normal shampooing routine. It tingles a little, lathers well, and has a great smell.
summary: Gentle shampoo, great for fragile hair and also paraben and sulfate free!

reviewText: This shampoo leaves my hair feeling silky and looking healthy. Great product at a great price
You hardly need to use very much to get a wonderful professional-type lather unlike any cream or gel in a can.
I know its for men but I used it for my underarms and legs. The cream is luxurious and rich. Gave me a very close shave which I like. Worth every penny.

Most people who are used to getting their shaving cream from an aerosol can would not call this a shaving cream. It is closer to an old fashioned shaving soap that requires you to work up a lather with a shaving brush. Not owning a shaving brush, I found that it required quite a bit of the product (about 2  inches out of the tube) to cover my face, so I would not expect the tube to last a very long time.  Although it looked reminiscent of shaving from a bar of soap, on those times when I traveled someplace without shaving cream, the oils in CADE allowed for a smooth, close shave.
While the scent is not unpleasant, I do not like scented shave creams, and I would not buy this product again.
summary: Couldn't convert a long-time Barbasol user

reviewText:
I am not great at shaving, so I constantly try new products to see if they help.  I often prefer shaving cream for men, so I wasn't afraid about the fact this was marked as a men's product.

I have never used shaving cream from a tube before.  You squeeze out a small amount, lather it in your hands, and then apply.  The tube looks small, but there's enough to last a decent amount of time.  The lather is nice but not overwhelming, and I got a pretty good shave with it.  This is pricey for shaving cream, but works well.

There is a smell (juniper), but it isn't overpowering.

My husband has a thick beard with very sensitive skin. He and I prefer a clean, shaven looks so he needs to shave nearly every day. For years, he has been relying on regular shaving gel without the desired results. He was anxious to try the L'Occitane CADE Shaving Cream.

The cream comes out like a paste but once you lather in your hands you realize how far it goes. It's as smooth as glass. It's very smooth and didn't leave his skin itchy or feeling uncomfortable. No nicks. No cuts. It delivered the closest shave he's ever had and his skin has been rash free. He will never use anything else. Though the cost is higher than shaving gel, a little goes a long way.
summary: Husband Will Never Use Anything Else Again

reviewText: I gave this to my husband and he balked at the price it's selling for, and when he actually used it for the first time, he was not overly impressed. He liked the way it lathered, and he didn't mind the scent, and he thought it a step up from his standard cream he uses all the time, but again, for this tube, and for this price...not worth it.
summary: He liked the way it lathered

reviewText:
Very dense product makes it less expensive than it seems.  My other gel shaving products have a good proportion of water in them, so on an ounce by ounce comparison, this product is expensive.  However this is very dense and just a very small amount is needed for a complete shave.  The scent is subdued.  Due to the denseness, and the small amount needed, you have a neat shave, without a lot of excess water, and the possible mess that goes with typical gels.  This product provides more shaves, in a neater manner, than typical gels. It's also a nice gift as it has an upper scale appearance.

I apply the product directly to my face.  I do not use a brush.  As others have stated, it it more of a paste than a gel.  That contributes to the neatness factor.
summary: Dense product that gives a neater shave with less mess.

reviewText:
My man has a beard, I love it. He likes to keep it nice and trim, so he looks good with his women.

L'Occitane Cade shaving cream worked just as well as shaving cream over the counter does. No better, no worse. I love the way it smells, manly and not overpowering. He did not notice his skin was any less irritated, or conditioned than cheaper shaving cream.

quite a lovely shave cream!  Both my husband and I have used it and both thought it helped give a smooth shave.
