We both enjoy the light fragrance and that it's more of a mild creamy lotion rather than a big foamy shaving cream.  It is  pricey at $28 a tube, which I think will probably last me 2 months.  I'm not factoring in husbands usage as I don't intend to let him have it back.  I would definately recommend.  I would purchase as I like the quality.
summary: You do get what you pay for in this case

reviewText:
This is my first "high quality" shaving cream. I've been using goat's milk shaving cream with a lather brush since it has very little ingredients in it. When in a pinch I'll use something cheap like Barbasol, such as when I'm on a trip and just need a small can of something.

Packaging:
I had to hunt for the English information as everything on this packaging is in French for the most part. Some instructions in four other languages. Once removing the metal tube from the box, there is one logo that tells you what it is and no instructions.

Travel in USA:
Speaking of trips. . .when travelling in the USA this is too large (exceeds the 3.4 oz size) to take through security and may get confiscated. Checking out L'Occitane store here on Amazon, they don't have a smaller size.

Lather:
I didn't have any trouble lathering a dime-sized amount in my palm or similar amount when using the lather brush. The small amount lathered just fine and went on thick enough, though it required a little more massaging once on my face.

Scent:
I'm use to Sandlewood scent or something menthol with my "cheap" shaving cream options. This scent I can't quite place, but it's not unpleasant. Since I tend to finish off with a scented after shave any dislike for this scent will someone be rinsed off then masked with after shave.

Shaving:
Once I spent sufficient time lathering, I didn't get much of any shave burns. It helped cut just fine and left my skin refreshed enough.

OVERALL: I'm a newbie when it comes to using different qualities of shaving products, so I admit I'm trying to judge this the best I can. What will be the true test is if I get some highly rated shaving cream that cost about 50% of this one and see between the three price ranges (goat's milk, mid-level and this one) if I can really tell a difference.

I appreciate it's concentrated, but time will tell how much I get out of the tube and if it's cost effective for the "experience" I'd get from shaving with it. So far, it's okay.

I ordered this for my husband, and he was very anxious to try it.  He loves it.  His skin feels much better (to him) a day after shaving with this than normal shaving creams.  He has sensitive skin, and shaving with regular shaving cream often leaves him irritated  This cream is soothing, and leaves his skin soft and smooth, and helps to prevent nicks and irritation.  He does wish it had a more powerful juniper smell--but I think it smells perfect, and not too strong.  It certainly would not interfere with any other fragrances and it is not overwhelming like some men's products.  Yes, it is pricey, but it is a luxury product, and I've found with products like this, a little goes a much longer way than the cheaper options.  This would make a nice addition to any shaving kit--and women will like it too, for the fragrance and for their own shaving needs.
summary: Lovely fragrance, leaves skin smooth and not iriritated

reviewText:
I have extremely sensitive skin and so finding a combination of blade, shaving oils and shave creams is an ongoing experiment. I switched to double edge safety razors years ago and found Korean Dorco blades worked best for me. Shaving creams that I like varied from Proraso to Dr. Bronner to Taylor of Old Bond Street. L'Occitane products always seem to be priced at the higher end of the scale, but I thought it was worth a try to see if their product was premium in quality or just in hype. I went in with a negative bias expecting it to be comparable to less expensive offerings, but I have to say I was happily impressed. Proraso, for example, extrudes from the tube as a very thick paste and provides loads of lather when used with a good shaving brush, but after rinsing it seemed to leave a residue that was hard to remove completely. Dr. Bronner rinsed easily and left my face feeling very clean, but the lather it produced while effective wasn't particularly thick and creamy. This L'Occitane, seemed to provide the best of both creams. First, it takes very little, perhaps a quarter inch from the tube per shave. The lather it produces isn't hugely foamy, thus filled with air, but is luxuriously thick and protective. I sometimes coat my skin with oil before applying shave cream for the added viscosity and glide, but with this I found it wasn't necessary. Everyone's skin is different and each person has their own preference as to what makes a great shave for them. But so far I'm very impressed. While expensive, a little goes a long way, so it proved to be unexpectedly cost effective. At the moment, it's become my favorite product so far and though I'll keep experimenting, I plan to reorder it when this tube is finished a few months from now.

UPDATE: MARCH 5, 2016;  I've been using CADE for over a year now and can offer two insights. First is that time has only reinforced that this is easily the best shave cream I have ever used at any price. Nicks and cuts are thankfully largely an unpleasant memory for my ultra sensitive skin. But second is the incredible longevity of a single tube. Since my work requires frequent flying, I alternately use an electric razor to avoid problems with razors and the TSA, so at least half the time that's my shaving tool. That still represents getting over 6 months of use from a single tube of CADE shave cream!  I'm nearing the end of the first tube and will be ordering my next tube in a month or so. So after a year of use, incredible satisfaction and remarkable longevity, making it a terrific value to me.
summary: Along with Dorco and Feather blades, it's become my favorite shave routine product.

reviewText: I have been a connoisseur of shaving with top end shaving creams and using an authentic Badger hair brush. I am picky about my products because I believe shaving is an art. I did not expect to be overly impressed with L'Occitane CADE Shaving Cream but I was. If you are just a squirt from the can kind of guy this may not be for you. There is no doubt that you can rub in in your hands and apply it to your face and get a decent shave, but this cream works best for me when applied directly to my shaving brush after it has been moistened with hot water (before applying the Cream to the moistened brush shake the brush once to eliminate excess water saturation). The amount of Cream squeezed from the tube to the shaving brush should be no more than the length of toothpaste you would squeeze onto your toothbrush. There is no need to spread this Cream on your shaving brush. Instead, working the brush starting on either side of the face using a circular wrist action will begin to work up this cream into a lather as you work he brush on your face. Once you have covered your face by circular motions, use a back and forth motion with your brush to make a consistent, smooth creamy layer on your face. I won't go into shaving technique but I found that this Shaving Cream significantly reduced the nicks I got in the shaving process. I still get nicks but they are few and far between and I don't get nicked every time I shave. To get the most out of your completed shave with L'Occitane CADE Shaving use very warm water to rinse your face and follow up with splashing your rinsed face with cold water.

This smells good, provides a nice glide and lathers up well using a standard shaving brush. Just put a bit in a bowl or on an empty soap dish, work in a bit of water, and work into a lather then apply with the shaving brush and shave as normal.

I had no drag using either my cartridge type razor or a safety razor. It just pulled nice and easily, leaving behind moisturized but not greasy feeling skin.

Recommended- but you should use a tube squeezer with it. It's thick enough to be difficult to squeeze out from the end easily.
summary: Nice glide, nice smell, nice lather- smooth shave!

reviewText: Though this shave cream is a bit pricy. . . . you use such a small amount, that it lasts and lasts. I'm glad that I read the Amazon information before I tried it. The package says to use an amount the size of a "nut". Which nut would that be? Walnut? Pecan? Peanut? With or without the shell? Hahahaha Amazon shows to use a "dime-size" amount, and that's about right. If you're accustomed to using shave "foam" then you're going to have to get accustomed to this style of shaving. It's not like putting whipped-cream on your face, as it is with "foam". If you're going to invest in this shave cream. .. then you will probably want to do it right and also use the L'Occitane Cade After Shave Balm as well. Just the right combination. L'Occitane Cade After Shave Balm For Men, 2.5 fl. oz.
summary: A Bit Pricey....But it Lasts and Lasts...

reviewText:
My husband really loves L'Occitane CADE Shaving Cream.  At first he was skeptical, having never used anything but the cheapest shaving cream.  The way this product goes on without becoming a mass of thick foam had him wondering if he was using it correctly; it takes a bit of getting used to when you expect shaving cream to make a thick, foamy lather.  However, he really liked how his skin felt after shaving and I really liked the scent.  He has been won over and now turns his nose up at the can of cheapo shaving cream in the shower.

In fact, my husband's love of the L'Occitane shaving cream tempted me to try it for myself.  I have sensitive skin that tends to be dry after shaving but is often irritated by body lotions.  My skin was much less dry after using this shaving cream and I had no irritation.

This would make a nice gift -- the packaging looks classy.  This shaving cream with a great razor would be perfect stocking stuffers or a good way to pamper the man in your life.  Especially if you can then borrow it from time to time!

This is such a great gift for the man in your life.  It's a bit pricey, but much like some of the fancy bubble baths, lotions and perfumes that we so love, this shaving cream is top notch and actually a treat to use.  My husband loved the simple, but manly scent (no strong smell; but there).  He loved how EASY his shaving experience was.  He usually uses the more expensive bottled and moisturizing shaving cream, but this one REALLY made for a smooth shave with zero irritation, zero pulling and zero little nicks.  Quality.

It's very thick, so you add some water to it and it lathers up nicely. Honestly, I am thinking this little tube will actually last twice as long as "normal" shaving cream, so it's honestly not THAT much more expensive in the long run even though it seems like it up front.
summary: SUCH a smooth shave; a perfect gift for the man in your life!

reviewText:
I am a female who shaves her legs with a razor.  And I absolutely adore this shave cream.
I find the scent is of a slightly minty juniper, one of my all time favorite fragrances.  Yes, this can go either way gender wise I feel.

This comes in a 5.2 ounce large tube which is metallic looking with a handsome brown and black label to let men know it's masculine. The cream is a soft white creamy paste that transforms into a delicate lather as you spread it onto your skin.  The scent is subtle but refreshing and clean smelling.

The best thing is the way this lubricates the skin.  It makes the slip of the razor on the skin with this a delightful experience.  Nothing could make that blade glide more perfectly.

This is enriched with CADE oil whatever that is, shea butter and one of my favorite skin ingredients, glycerin.  This rinses off skin easily and completely leaving skin moist and delicately scented.

I've become a fan of all things made by L'Occitane and this is no exception.  Certainly the wonderful fragrances are a delight for the nose, but the formulas are simple natural and elegant as well as the packaging.  This is wonderful, and I assure you it can be used by us ladies with pleasure.

The L'Occitane CADE Shaving Cream doesn't foam the way that the canned shaving creams do.  Instead, you're supposed to take a "nut-sized" amount (I figured double of the pea that you use for moisturizing the face) and massage this to your face to create the lather.  The product spreads easily and smells fresh, green, not floral.  It feels luxurious, smooth, creamy and it leaves your skin feeling soft and smooth.

My husband tried it on his face and though it took him a while to adjust to not having the lather of shaving foam, he liked the way that it felt both while he shaved and after.  I found it pampering when used on the legs.  It's more of splurge item, but a treat to use.
summary: Not a foamy shaving cream, but gives a luxurious smooth shave

reviewText: CADE Shaving Cream has a fragrance like the Forest after a rain storm. Definitely more masculine, although women may like it too. The large silver tube is classy looking, and the brown and black packaging even has writing on the side in Braille which I thought was a cool touch. The cream, not shaving foam, will take a little getting used to, but if you follow the instructions, which tell you to wet your skin and massage into the wet skin, or use a shaving brush to make a lather, it works just fine. I found the emollient factor was perfect and my skin felt smooth. My husband liked shaving with it too. This would make a great gift for the man in your life.

The CADE shaving cream feels great on my face and gives me a great shave. The scent is subtle and enjoyable. A little goes a long way. Just a dab on wet face will do. It spreads out like a paste (which i prefer) rather than getting foamy.

But, I've had equally nice shaves from simar products, like Proraso, for 1/3 of the price. So I can't really justify buying L'Occitane. But if money is no issue for you, go for it!

I use this shaving cream on my legs & my husband likes to shave his face with it.  We both love how nicely it lathers & allows the blade to skim cleanly over our skin, leaving it soft, smooth & smelling wonderful.  It is so gentle, I think even sensitive skin people could use it.  The lather is not huge like typical aerosol can shaving cream but there is plenty & really what is important is the way it helps your blade glide over the skin.
summary: Wonderful Shaving Cream for Men & Women

reviewText: Really takes off makeup, especially stubborn gel eyeliner. I have extremely sensitive skin and this doesnt irritate it at all. Not greasy either

I am a makeup artist and I love this. I bought the smallest size because I got tired of lugging around my giant one. This is so convenient for my makeup kit. I was looking at some of the views (Thank goodness I didn't look at them before I bought it) and they are terribly WRONG. I will purchase this over and over and over. My bottle did not come damaged or empty. It is exactly as advertised. If is wasn't I am a prime shopper and amazon would have taken care of it because it was a prime item. Now to the actual product... It is so amazing!!! Please keep in mind that this will NOT replace your face wash. I use this on my clients with a cotton pad to gently go over their skin, but I still ask all of my clients to come with a clean face. This just helps make sure that all the bacteria when you walk outside is gone before you apply your moisturizer. Even if they wash their face and come to my house, just stepping outside will give you bacteria. This is a great product for a fast gentle and easier clean before makeup application. If you put this on a cotton pad it will help exfoliate your skin as its cleaning it. If you put it on a cotton ball it will not exfoliate but it will still clean the skin.
works pretty well on waterpoof mascara I like that it doesnt leave my eyes feeling oily or gross.

I purchased the small bottle tontry after seeing a review about it online. When I got it I tried it out, right out of the box and I was very impressed that it didn't burn my skin first and foremost due to my ultra sensitive skin. It removes my make up and especially my eye make up very easily and it doesn't strip away the little moisture I have already in my skin if you have sensitive skin this is a good micellar water to try.
Amazing stuff. Takes off mascara that I couldn't remove with other removers!
Love this, running out, need to buy some soon, best micellar water ever!
Fabulous stuff!  I will buy this product again and again.

Great for removing mascara. I'm not a fan of using all over my face--I'd much rather use an oil cleanser, but it's great for removing bits of mascara that get smudged before heading out for the day. An oil cleanser leaves a residue, and this doesn't.

No oily residue! Woo! Really liking this makeup remover. I've heard that the Garner Fructise micellar water is comparable in performance, but at amazon's price, I don't see any reason to stray from this one.
summary: No oily residue! Woo! Really liking this makeup ...

reviewText:
This stuff is amazing.  I use it to remove my makeup and sunscreen and then follow up with a treatment/cleanser.
Prior to using Bioderma, my cleansing routine felt very much as though I were smearing makeup around my face rather than actually cleaning it.  Now, using the treatment/cleanser on makeup free skin, I am getting the full benefit of that product.

The best stuff ever! I've bought this many times and can't go with out it. It removes all make up, but not water proof mascara, with out the hassle of water. Plus, by using a cotton pad, I can exfoliate a liite bit too.
summary: Best thing I have found for cleansing my face

reviewText: Love it! Ordering another!!!

I typically use oil cleansing to remove makeup, and this just does not compare. Especially in removing mascara. I had to tug and rub at my eyes quite a bit to get my eye makeup off. Overall, not worth the hype.

This is effective in removing makeup. But, I found that my skin became a bit irritated because it took several pieces of cotton pads to get to a point where the cotton pads came clean. This is essentially water in texture so wiping your face multiple times with cotton pads soaked in a watery solution can irritate your skin.

This removes makeup effectively. I was using pre-moistened makeup removers and not happy with any that I had tried. So I ordered the travel size of this product to try. It is much more effective in makeup removal versus any brand of pre-moistened wipes I've tried. And it does leave my skin smooth without any stickiness. My only "complaint", is that despite it is a gentle product, if you have very sensitive skin or if you wear heavy makeup, and you need to go over your face multiple times with cotton pads saturated with this, you may find that your skin will be a bit irritated. That's not the fault of this product, but rather inevitable result of using a wiping process to remove makeup. At the end of the day, a cream or lotion makeup remover that results in less friction and pull on your face is still the better bet.
I ordered the larger size after trying the travel size.  It does take off make-up and leaves your skin feeling fresh and soft.  It does not take off mascara easily - for that stick with Bi-Facil.
summary: Refreshing way to get make-up off

reviewText: I've tried all kind of hair glosses for my hair and there is nothing like this Davines product.  It smells sublime and it gives my hair a great luster and shine.  It also can be used on your body for a nice moisturizer.  It is the best glossing product I have ever used.
summary: Great Gloss and Shine for Your Hair

reviewText: My hands down favorite hair oil. A must every day to keep the frizzies at bay. Not greasy, makes my hair look perfect every time. No smell.
summary: My hands down favorite hair oil

reviewText:
My hairdresser recommended this product, and I love it! For reference, I have straight, dry, thick, shoulder-length hair. I have a lot of fly-aways and frizz from dryness. My hairdresser recommended using 2 pumps of this product, but I find 1 pump is plenty. After I style my hair, I put 1 pump of oil in my palm, rub my hands together, then start running my fingers through my hair. To avoid a greasy look, I start at the ends and then really work through entire hair, with a final brush near my top part to get rid of fly-aways.

This product makes my hair very soft, and I love the scent! I've been using it for about three weeks and I started right after getting a haircut, so I haven't noticed a big difference in the health of my hair. This product is expensive, but only needing 1 pump means it will last a long time.
summary: Great Oil! Makes hair very soft!

reviewText: This stuff lets me get away with washing my hair less. It makes it less oily. It's incredible. Smooth hair and less oil. The smell is a little bit on the masculine side but it's not over powering. I shared a jar and it lasted 2 years.
I love this oil.  I have given it as gifts.  It can be used on wet or dry hair.  Adds shine and great control for the frizzes!  The Oi scent is delicious.  You will not be sorry with this purchase.
summary: Does what the description say it does.  Great product.

reviewText: This product makes my hair look healthy and fresh and bouncy! Just a couple drops is all I need for my long hair after I blow dry or curl it. Its perfect and it smells wonderful! Highly recommend!! I hope to never run out of this!
The smell is fantastic. This is a really high end product. My hair is so damaged that little can be done but it smooths it a little and smells amazing
Great oil, really tames frizzies & conditions.
I love this product and will never go without it as it smells good and it's good for your hair and has an ingredient in it that makes your hair grow.  Worth every penny!
Nice oil for hair and skin. I love Davines! Makes my hair very soft and gets rid of frizz! Adds subtle shine.

Davines is one of my favorite hair care brands, so I was super excited to try this. The bottle is small but has lasted me a surprisingly long time (my hair is midway down my back), I put it in my hair after it's towel dried and helps detangle it and leaves it incredibly soft. Will definitely repurchase.
This is a nice oil for hair. The SMELL is utterly FANTASTIC, like everyone else says. It's a nice basic oil good for smoothing and fly aways.
I love this stuff and after using it in my hair for a couple of weeks, I noticed my fingernails are strong and smooth -adding a nice bonus!
summary: More than just a fabulous hair treatment,

reviewText:
I have tried several brands of serum and this one by far is my favorite. This smaller travel size is fantastic and it doesnt leak like so many of them do. The product itself smells great; it has an understated herbal sweetness to it. This to me is nicer and more appealing than the usual clear dimethicone/dimethocol serums.

I usually apply three pumps to my palms to run through my thick, coarse shoulder length hair then blow dry. It smooths my hair without weighing it down, and makes it noticeably softer. I follow with the Davines No 4 putty to create detail after I blow dry and my hair looks and feels good all day. I liked this one so much I bought two.

Well, it's step 2 of 3 if you follow LIFTLAB's directions, that is. I didn't realize until I opened the box and read the directions (also printed on the jar) that this is the middle step out of three. The "full" treatment uses two other LIFTLAB products. I mention this in case you want to do a bit of research before investing this much in a moisturizer thinking that it's intended to reduce wrinkles on its own. That said - this is a very good moisturizer. Extremely good, actually. I noticed immediate improvement around my eyes upon using this. My wrinkles...ahem, laugh lines :)...are still noticeably present, but the area where I apply this is clearly smoother and looks better. I've also had no skin irritation from this, and I haven't experienced any effects from having it so close to my eyes (no burning sensations at all). While this is just a 1.7-ounce jar, a little goes a LONG way with this cream. I've been using dedicated facial lotions for years now (from Dove, and more recently from Nivea), and this is much more effective in a small dosage. I just dab the tip of my finger on top of the cream in the jar and pull out a small amount on my fingertip, and that's plenty. The scent is, for all practical purposed, non existent. I really can't smell it, and I'm not complaining. I like neutrally scented lotions. I read up and checked that this isn't tested on animals before I ordered it, as that is very important to me. While it is a fantastic moisturizer, it's a four-star product in my book. Some of that is due to the current cost ($145/jar), but I know that changes often. The other part is due to packaging. A while back, I was able to try out Scalisi Skincare Advanced Wrinkle Cream, 1.75 Ounce that is currently about half the price, which by itself is a meaningless criteria as my Dove and Nivea lotions are far far cheaper, but I think it also does a fantastic job. I also like that the Scalisi jar has a pump top that eliminates you needing to dip your fingers into the cream, and I never once had any issue with the pump getting clogged. So, I think that this LIFTLAB cream is extremely good, but I do wish that they had a pump top like the Scalisi - and I honestly think that the Scalisi is just as good for moisturizing, at least for me. I think that the Scalisi is worth checking out if you're in the market for a cream in this price class, but I absolutely wouldn't try to talk you out of the LIFTLAB if the price doesn't bother you. I think it's effective.
summary: Immediate results, but this is step 2 in a 3-step process

reviewText: I've used Liftlab Lift for a week, and I don't see any difference in my skin.  That said, I might not be a good judge of this product because I never see any difference in my skin no matter what I've used.  Someday, I'll just have to learn to accept aging gracefully...I gave this a 3 star review because it smells good and appears to be a good moisturizer.
summary: I might not be a good judge of this product because I never see any ...

reviewText: If cost weren't an issue, I would make this cream part of my daily routine. I love the way it improves the way the skin on my neck and chest, its smooth and silky texture and its absence of an unpleasant or artificial fragrance. But it's very expensive: $145 for a jar that lasts about six months. This makes it almost as costly as the Cadillac of moisturizers, Le Mer. So frankly, I can't give this product five stars. It's simply too expensive, considering that it does not contain SPF protection--and my doctor suggests daily use of SPF 30, even on hazy days. For the moment, I will stick with more moderately priced products--at least until the makes of LIFTLAB Lift & Moisturize Daily Cream add SPF--and possibly lower the price.
summary: No SPF, Very Costly, But an Appealing Product

reviewText:
I had deep concerns about this product.
How can a $145 product be worth it? It's so expensive?
I read Sneaky Burrito's review, and she indicated that the face cream has FISH PLASMA in it. Disgusting.
I anticipated a horrible fishy smell.

I was totally wrong, and I'm sorry for my negative assumptions.
First off, the product has no smell that I can discern, certainly not a fishy one.
I would classify the product as "unscented".
Second, the cream goes on lightly. Like air. Absolutely weightless.
Third, the cream is not oily and not drying. It locks in moisture for the whole day.
(I did a mini test by applying it to one hand and not the other; the next day, the hand with the cream was noticibly softer).

I will note that I live in Chicago and it is summertime here.

This product claims to have cell regeneration properties. This is how it gets rid of wrinkles on your face.
Honestly, I don't hate my wrinkles, and I'm not interested in spending large amounts of money to get rid of them.
I do, however, have a number of areas that would benefit from some skin regeneration. I have scars and areas that have gone through surgery and radiation, and am right now going through chemo, which is very damaging to skin. Frankly, on scarred areas, Mederma works a bit, but not really, and costs a small fortune anyway. With this product, a little goes a long way.  You can't compare the price to Mederma ounce for ounce, because you use a whole lot of Mederma, and a very small tiny bit of this.

I'll try this product for a few weeks (on my face and on my scars) and update this review with my verdict. If this product truly has cell regeneration properties, it would be very helpful for skin damaged by surgery, radiation, chemo, medication, climate, and life in general.

My initial impression of this product is very high, but it will take a few weeks to evaluate its claims.
summary: Unscented moisturizing cream with cell regeneration properties

reviewText:
Normally I would simply not be able to find the money for a product like this, but I received a generous-sized sample in a subscription box awhile ago and, by using it sparingly, I've been able to make it last for a few weeks.

Since the ingredients are currently not listed on the Amazon product page, here they are:

Water (Aqua), Cyclopentasiloxane, Glycerin, Trimethylsiloxysilicate Cyclopentasiloxane, Squalane, Dimethicone, Cassia Angustifolia Seed Polysaccharide, Peg-10 Dimethicone, Butylene Glycol, Caprylyl Methicone, Cetyl Hydroxyethylcellulose, Sodium Chloride, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Polysilicone-11, Sodium Hyaluronate, Acetyl Tetrapeptide-11, Melia Azadirachta Leaf Extract, Melia Azadirachta Flower Extract, Amino Esters-1, Fish Plasma Protein (Cell Protection Protein), Coccinia Indica Extract, Solanum Melongena (Eggplant) Fruit Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Flower Extract, Lawsonia Inermis (Henna) Extract, Ocimum Sanctrum Leaf Extract, Pearl Powder, Ormenis Multicaulis Oil.

This does have a fish protein in it, so if you are vegan or otherwise avoiding animal products, please keep that in mind.  From what I can tell, there are not any artificial colors in this product.  It does have a *slight* color, probably from one or more of the natural ingredients (it's a very light greenish/bluish color).  The smell is slightly medicinal but not very strong.

When you put this on your skin, there's a slight cooling/tightening sensation.  I don't have many wrinkles at my age, but I do see a little bit of a difference in some of the fine lines on my forehead.  It's also a pretty good facial moisturizer; we've had some harsh weather here lately (well, harsh for Georgia) and the skin on the lower half of my face was drying out.  I started using a bit of this at night and noticed a difference pretty quickly.

This spreads easily and a little bit goes a long way.  If all you are looking for is a moisturizer, you may want to go with a less expensive product.  But I do think the tingling is indicative of the advertised "plumping" on the product page, and I do think there is a difference with respect to fine lines.  As a multipurpose product, this is quite good.

I am 41 years ago and have fine, brown hair that is colored blonde.  Despite coloring my hair since the age of 13, I have never had any problems with breakage.  I began to notice that my hair was falling out - the amount of hair in the shower drain in 2 days was the equivalent of what I saw in a month before!  Also, I noticed that I could see more scalp - my hair was falling out and breaking.  I went to the doctor and was diagnosed with Hypothyroidism.  While waiting for the tests and the meds, I wanted to do something to stop the breakage and keep what was left of my hair.

I did not buy this product on Amazon (yet, will buy a refill here shortly) as I bought it from my hair salon that carries Lanza products.  After washing and drying your hair with your regular shampoo and conditioner, you put this on damp hair.  I have a short bob (hair comes to the top of my shoulders) and I use enough to equal about the size of a quarter.  You rub this into your hair while it's damp and dry as usual.

This stuff is AMAZING.  Within 48 hours of using this, my hair breakage was reduced by 60%.  Within 1 week of using this, my hair breakage was reduced by 90%.  It has almost no smell to it.  It's not like any other oil that you have tried - this is not greasy at all.  My hair dresser actually had me test it on my hands first, to demonstrate that it's not greasy.  It absorbed into my skin within 5 minutes with no greasy feeling at all.  My hair is shiny, not weighed down and strong - my breakage had almost disappeared as a result of using this product.  It was not the meds - I didn't even start them for 4 weeks.  Although it is only advertised as a product for your hair, I rub the residue on my elbows after I apply it - my chronically dry elbows are no more!

Note:  I did use this in combination with the Lanza Strength shampoo and conditioner.  These are also great products, but through process of elimination, I determined that this is the key to reduced breakage.  This product works great!  And, this is a great price on Amazon - they sell this for twice this price in the salon.  I will be buying my refill from here going forward.

I'm not a fan of keratin product. It seems to leave my hair with a film on it. I've tried using it as a protecting with high heat product irons and blow dryers. But it still leaves that residue where my hair feels weighed down and heavy. I like the fact that it does make the hair look nicer and smoother in texture.
summary: I like the fact that it does make the hair look ...

reviewText:
I was interested in this product because it says "for all hair types" and I wondered if it would make my medium fine hair more under control and healthier looking especially during muggy, windy or very dry days.  the oil has a scent that is pleasant but a little too strong for me.  I put it on very conservatively as directed, blow dried my hair as usual and my hair looked limp (but shiny!).  My guess is this would work well for curly, coarse, or maybe even thick straight hair.  It is just not for fine and straight.
.
summary: Not for fine or medium fine straight hair

reviewText:
Im a big fan of the LANZA haircare line and have been using their shampoo and conditioners for many years now.  This Healing Oil Hair Treatment just doesnt seem to suit my fine textured hair.  Even when I use just the tiniest amount, my hair seems to fall flat and lacks body or volume.

While this product does contain some interesting oils, the first three ingredients are all silicone or silicone-based.  Unfortunately, silicone just seems to weigh my hair down.  Ill use it in a pinch to fight the frizzies when the humidity is high, and of course it does add a nice shine.  As to the manufacturers claim that it decreases drying time by 65%, I didn't find that to be the case.

Bottom Line:  Silicone based products just don't work for my hair type, no matter how fancy the other ingredients may be.
summary: Silicone based products don't do great things for my fine-textured hair

reviewText:
I used this after a shampoo and towel dry.  I wasn't expecting much, since my hair is thin.  It actually feels better than before, more body, but best of all, the shine is quite noticeable.  The weird smell goes away, thankfully.

I applied this with my hands and avoided the scalp.

I'm a little on the fence about this product considering the price. I've tried using argan oil in the past to moisturize and protect my damaged, color-treated hair, but I've failed miserably. It's either not enough or too much and makes my hair greasy looking. I gave up on argan oil.

This product absorbs into the hair and I haven't experienced that greasy look. My hair is a bit calmed, very soft, and doesn't feel weighed down. The ends still stick up all over the place. This is excellent as a leave-in conditioner, and my brush glides right through my hair, which should eliminate breakage. I'll wait until I've used up the whole product to see if there is lasting change to my hair or if it's just a temporary fix.
summary: Protects without the greasy look you get from other oils

reviewText:
I have very fine hair and it's hard to find an oil that doesn't weigh it down but this works.  I've tried it in wet hair and dry hair and it makes my hair soft and tames the fly away hairs around my face where I use the curling iron the most.  I use a nickle-sized amount in my palm and I have medium length hair.  It has a very light pleasant fragrance which I love.

I was using Kukui oil from Walmart which is a spray on but I stopped using that because I didn't see any difference in my hair.  The healing oil makes my hair so soft.

Oddly, my hair needs to be washed less when I use this.

This is exactly what I need on special occasions or on very humid/rainy days.  It keeps my hair from going completely frizzy but doesn't weigh it down so it looks greasy.  This is a nice thick consistency and goes on very easily.  I prefer to use it on wet hair and then heat it in with a dryer.  Very pleased - yes, it is expensive but I use this occasionally when I really need to look my best.
summary: For those special days I need to look my best

reviewText: I've tried a ton of hair products over the years and this one truly stands out. Silk oils, argan oil, you name it, I've tried it. Most oils I've used leave the hair greasy and don't really absorb. This absorbed into my hair well. It must be the Keratin in it. I don't use styling tools or dye in my hair but it's naturally frizzy and damaged due to the mixed texture. This crazy texture is what has had me using oils since my teenage years. Even after conditioning my hair it's often dried out still so I tried this. It truly made a difference. My hair formed more bouncy and moisturized curls and was smooth enough to brush without pulling. I love that it can go in wet, damp, or dry hair alike. It also had a lot of shine to it. I read that it has UV protection and I can see why; it seems to protect and reflect. I also got compliments on my hair... which I can't tell you how long it's been since anyone's complimented my hair! I can wear my hair down and not condemn it to a bun anymore. Since I only use a little at a time the bottle is lasting me. The top twists and locks shut so I don't have to keep track of a cap.
summary: Truly Makes a Difference in My Mixed Texture Hair

reviewText: I have thick, coarse hair. I've been using this for a couple of weeks and I have noticed a huge difference already in the texture of my hair. The biggest thing that I've noticed since using this is how soft my hair is now. I use one pump of the oil and apply it to the middle/ends of my hair. The first time I used it, I also applied it near my scalp, but I didn't work it in well and I had some flakiness later. Since then, I have only used it on the middle and ends and haven't had any issues with flaking.  The scent is a mild floral/fruity smell. It's not overly oily or greasy. In fact, when I am finished working it through my hair, I just rub my hands together and my hands aren't greasy at all. If I don't have to wash my hands to get the product off. I haven't noticed any difference in the amount of time it takes to dry my hair. It's summer vacation, and I am letting it air dry most days. In addition to softer hair, I can run my fingers through my hair without any difficulties. My hair is also shiny and healthy looking since using this oil.

My colored hair is thin and straight but gets frizzy, and I've been getting noticeable breakage at my hairline- which makes my hair look even thinner. The only way I can smooth out the frizz and get some decent shape and style into my hair is to blow dry with a round brush after washing. I was using the highest heat setting on a professional blow dryer without using a heat protectant as most products weigh my hair down so it looks flatter and even thinner. But my damaged hair is so much easier to style and looks vastly improved since using L'Anza Keratin Healing Oil. I work just a small amount into my damp hair after washing (starting at the ends) and avoid the crown area because my hair type does gets weighed down easily and can look way too lifeless and flat if I over condition it.

Keratin Healing Oil has made a noticeable difference in how my hair looks and feels. It works best for me if I use only a small amount (a partial pump), avoid hair at my crown and only use it every other wash. I tried it everyday and my hair started to look over conditioned and flat. But with using it every other wash, I'm really surprised how smooth, healthy and thick my hair looks while also feeling so incredibly soft. The benefit is really obvious at the ends of my hair- my ends look and feel so smooth while holding style so well, and this oil really revives my hair so it looks like it was just cut and styled at the salon. Also, my hair looks shiny and healthy but doesn't look at all oily when I apply this oil to my damp hair. I tried it, but for my hair type I didn't see a benefit applying this oil to my dry hair.

So far I think this Keratin Healing Oil is a great product, though I can only judge it as a styling product and can't speak to any longer range benefits yet. My goal beyond having smoother and softer hair is to try to minimize or stop the breakage so my hair will actually thicken up again. I've gone to a medium heat setting on my blow dryer and find that my hair dries in the same amount of time using this oil as when I used a high heat setting without it, so I'll continue to use lower heat. Keratin Healing Oil is supposed to be a heat protectant, so I'm hoping it will help protect against further breakage. It will take time to see if this oil can provide that level of benefit, so I'll update my review as to any change in breakage down the road. This oil does have mild to moderate fragrance that doesn't bother despite being sensitive to most fragrance, and I don't notice a lingering scent in my air. I'm rating Keratin Healing Oil 4 stars as I'm really happy with the immediate results, and I hope to less breakage over time and upgrade to 5 stars.

7/28/2017 Update: After using this oil for another month, I'm upgrading my rating from 4 to 5 stars as I'm not seeing new breakage, and the texture of my hair has noticeably improved. Great product.
summary: Produces Visible Benefits In My Thin & Damaged Hair When Used Sparingly- Will Take Time To See If It Protects Against Breakage

reviewText: I just had a keratin treatment at a Boston salon and they had this line of products in stock, and several stylists were using this oil at their stations. It is simply amazing. It smells a bit perfumey at first but it dissipates quickly. It's a super lightweight oil that imparts amazing shine and protection from frizz without the weight. I have very curly hair - different curl sizes in different places on my head, and some very dry frizzy areas in the back. This is so much lighter than most other shine products and is not at all like the thick serum of a product like John Freida's Frizz Ease. It's much less viscous but it still imparts an amazing shine and protects hair. I've also used it 2nd and 3rd day after shampoo to add back some shine that often fades (unless you're fresh from the salon.)  But, it's definitely very pricey,which is why I took off one star. If this protected from all frizz, I'd say it was worth it but it wasn't quite that strong for me on very humid days. i'm not sure anything is except for a professional Keratin treatment and then maybe this on top - but $45 is super steep for any type of leave in hair oil in my mind.

I have long, dark brown, naturally curly hair and this hair treatment worked pretty good on it and does accomplish what it promises...softer hair with shine.  It reduced the amount of frizz I had by just a little too.
The instructions say that it can be used on wet or dry hair and style as usual.  I have tried this over the last two weeks several times on both my wet and dry hair.  On wet hair if I use just a small amount...it doesn't leave my hair greasy, heavy or wet looking and I can style my hair as usual.  Anything more than just a small amount and I do get that wet look when my hair dries.  If I use it on dry hair...it leaves my hair looking wet.  So I only use it that way on days I'm staying home or at night before bed if I'm going to use it on my dry hair.
The results aren't anything special where I would pay a premium amount for it though. I don't feel like it does any lasting healing on my hair and once it's rinsed out my hair feels as dry as it always does.
summary: Softens hair while product is in my hair, no lasting results though

reviewText: Love this Keratin. I live in Florida so this is key to keeping my hair nice and moisturized in the deep southern heat and humidity.  Use sparingly for thin hair (not to overweight it).  Leaves a great amount of shine and texture while helping to hold style thru humidity.  Overall I love this product.
summary: Overall I love this product. Not greasy or heavy on hair. Great SHINE TOO!

reviewText: My wife loves this:I have had the opportunity to try MANY salon hair oils for shine and damage, and this one is the BEST.  Im currently dealing with massive breakage due to over-drying my hair and overuse of a flat iron.  This oil in conjunction with the Lanza Healing Oil Shampoo and Conditioner is bringing hope back to my life.  The combination of these three products has made my hair feel like it hasn't felt in years.  I forgot hair could feel this healthy.  I don't care if its expensive This stuff is worth every penny.  For those who are concerned that its a fake product, I can tell you that mine wasnt.  Ive taken a picture of the bottle I purchased about three months ago at a reputable beauty supply store and the product I received from Amazon yesterday.  They are exactly the same; the text on the bottle, the aroma, the feel of the product.  The exact same.  When I use this product, I usually dry my hair slightly, let it air dry a few minutes, put about a quarter size in my palm and pull it through my hair.  If you put the oil in while your hair is damp, itll speed up the dry time, and then if you want to add a little more at the end for shine, you can do that.  I use it pretty liberally, and its taken me three months to get through half of a bottle.  The only caveat I would have is that I don't love the aroma.  Its hard to describe perhaps a little powdery, a little old-lady perfume-y.  That being said, the product is so good, Im willing to overlook that.  Give your hair a treat!

Another fine L'ANZA product. This one sprays on dry or damp hair before styling. It gives some shine and apparently builds body over time.  I've used it off and on for years, whenever I want more shine.  Don't use too much or it will look like you are conditioning your hair.  Experiment with it to find out how much you need. Less is better in my case.  It provides serious thermal protection for your hair as well.  Nice product!
summary: Works great to add shine, but don't use too much or you will look like you are conditioning your hair and need to wash it

reviewText:
This is like  I just got a haircut and walked out of a shampoo Ad at the same time.
My hair is fluffy and freely moves.
It's so pretty!

You must know, one pump is ALOT!
Please use cautiously and don't apply to roots.

You put one pump in your hands, rub together to warm it up & you'll see what I mean by ALOT.
What looks like a normal amount from a hair product, becomes the river of Nile in your hands.

Really works best by flipping your head & working it through that way,

I used this on wet and dry hair.
On dry, it didn't JUST calm the frizz but made my hair look like it didn't have frizz.
Although it did nothing impressive for the body but didn't weigh down the style either.

On wet hair, well, that's a different story.
I wash my hair at night to air dry & style in morning.
I woke up to shampoo commercial hair...Full & flowy.
But had to clean up my waves with a flat iron, I use to do a beachy wave.
(Check out the Remington One Pass. Works really quick & Cheap!)

I didn't like that my hair wasn't soft like when I use a leave in or argan oil but,
had that firmness you get from a styling product so, it had to be heat activated to get the run your fingers through hair.
Between you & I, after the style, I had a bit of a big head.
Couldn't walk by a mirror without shaking my hair like show pony.
It's amazing I didn't walk into someone with my momentary narcissism.

USA made which is a rarity on a luxury product!!

This is not a styling tool except for heat protection. Doesn't give styled definition without actually styling.
I think best for someone who blow dries.

I will blow out next wash & let you know.

Hair dried looking great sans frizz.

Absolutely recommend

Amazing product! I usually stay away from oil product because my hair is fine, and they are usually very heavy. This product just disappears into your hair leaving it unbelievably shiny and soft. I'm really having a hard time believing it. This product arrived during a very humid time and my hair was out of control frizzy. This product tames the frizz without leaving that oily heavy feel. Bravo, L'ANZA, Bravo!

This is the most extraordinary hair product I've come across in a long time.  I first used it on wet hair and then blow dried and gave me a very smooth blowout.  I used a few drops afterwards and it made my hair gleam.  And then I read the reviews, a number of which said to try it on dry hair.  So that's what I did.  I used two pumps in the morning and it made my hair look really greasy so I was all set to wear my hair in an updo that day.  But after I put on my makeup, which took about 20 minutes, my hair looked absolutely gorgeous!  It was soft and shiny and the ends were didn't look dry at all.  I proceeded to use the curling iron, as I usually do (the oil has heat protection up to 500 degrees) and my hair had body and bounce and looked fantastic!  So the next morning I did the same thing but used three pumps and I got the same great results.  I've done this every day for a month and it's like I have a different head of hair.  My hair is heavily highlighted so breakage and dryness are always issues.  But the keratin in this oil has made my hair so much stronger that I no longer have any breakage at all.  And dryness is a thing of the past.  Before, my ends looked like straw and now they are supple and lay nice and flat and smooth.  When I first apply the oil, my hair does look greasy, but that goes away in about 15-20 minutes.  My hair absorbs the oil and looks and feels like virgin hair.  It's the most amazing thing!  If your hair is dry and damaged, this treatment will restore it and make it healthy looking again.  And you can use it daily without making it greasy or weighing it down.  I use 3 to 4 pumps and distribute the oil to the last 3 or 4 inches, concentrating on the ends.  And I no longer have to worry about heat styling because this oil is an excellent heat protectant.  It can be used over styling products or hairspray too.  I've tried other oils, like argan, and they only sit on top and don't really soak in and end up making my hair an oily mess and weighing it down.  This oil soaks in completely and definitely doesn't weigh it down and is very lightweight.  It also smells amazing.  I don't know what oils are in this potion because the print on the bottle is too tiny to read, but whatever they are, they are amazing!!  I will use this oil forever and will tell everyone I know how awesome it is.  You can try this oil on damp hair but if you don't get the expected awesome results, try it on dry hair.  In the last month my hair has gone from frazzled and fried to nourished, supple and shiny.  It's an amazing transformation.  I highly recommend this awesome oil.  There's simply nothing in the world like it.
I bought this particular one for my mom but I had use it for a year now and this is the best oil I have ever try so far, I use around 3 pumps in my hair and then blow dry, you will love the results.

reviewText: Great oil treatment however you can only use a very small amount really works great after using the Lanza Shampoo and Condioner lighter than Moroccan oil I can only use every other day and 1 of the best hair oils! The new Lanza line is amazing! Can use this oil on dry and wet hair! Try All if this line you will love it all!!

This is a thick eye cream, which comes in a tiny tube of 0.5 ounces. It is nicely moisturizing, but too heavy for me to use during the day under eye makeup. (I have very oily lids, so it might be better for someone with dry skin.)  I haven't used it long enough to speak about the long term benefits, but in the short term, I like it. No irritation or sensitivity issues.

This is made in France, but for whatever reason, the packaging is primarily in Russian.

I already have a tube of this and saw it on Vine when I was running out. Felt very lucky to grab this. It is wonderful. A little goes a long way and it seems to work!! If I leave this at home on a business trip and miss using it for a week, I can see a difference around my eyes. It's not a miracle cream but it does really seem to help make my eye tissue firmer with regular use.
summary: It is wonderful. A little goes a long way and it ...

reviewText: LiftActiv Eye is an anti-aging eye care developed for use on all the delicate areas around the eye, including the eye lid. Visibly lifts the eye lid, reduces the appearance of wrinkles, depuffs the look of under eye bags, and minimizes dark circles. Well, I wish all that were true, but unfortunately this was not the case for me.  Now, when I got up in the morning, my eyes were definitely smoother looking and the under eye skin looked more plump but as soon as I washed my face, back came the dark under eye circles and wrinkles.  I used it in the morning before I put on my makeup and it made no difference in the dark circles at all.  My entire eye area has not changed one bit.  Only at night when I first applied it and kept it on did I notice a more smooth under eye.  I think at my age as I am in my fifties, you just need surgery or botox.  Any eye cream I have used doesn't give me any lasting results.  For the price, I would be like to see reduced wrinkles and minimized dark circles.  I think I will be happy using something a bit cheaper.  This is pretty pricey for a eye cream that really did nothing,

So far, Vichy LiftActiv Eyes is doing a good job. I don't really need my eyelids lifted and I don't have much in the way of crow's feet so I can't say whether this product is effective in those areas. I can, however, talk about other aspects of this cream.

I have mild to moderate under eye circles. Nothing out of the ordinary but they are there. Well, I have seen an improvement with this product. The skin under my eyes is more like the color of my cheeks. So, it's definitely doing it's job there.

As for the cream itself, it is a nice cream. It has a smooth, thick texture that makes me feel like it's really moisturizing the skin around my eyes. Plus, the cream doesn't have much of a scent. I like this because creams with strong scents tend to make my eyes water. I don't have this problem while using Vichy LiftActiv.

So far, I am very pleased with this cream's ability to moisturize and to reduce the look of under eye circles.

This odorless product seems to help with those fine lines around the eye, but not so much the deeper, dark circles underneath the eye. Perhaps it just takes a much longer time to see results there. It's easy to apply and the consistency is neither too runny or too thick.
summary: Seems to help a little bit

reviewText:
As I have gotten older, my skin has become drier.  My face, especially around my eyes, is very dry.  I have searched for an effective eye cream to help alleviate the dryness.  This product has been effective for me.

Why I like this product:

* It moisturizes without being really heavy and greasy.

* It has no scent.  I have passed up countless skin creams because of their cloying, heavy and artificial scent.  I am happy to report that this cream has no scent.

* It is easy to apply.  The tube has a tiny opening and all you need to do is lightly squeeze the tube.  Only a small amount comes out, and it is just the right amount to pat around the eye area.

The only downside of this product is the price, but you do get what you pay for and this product is a good one.

I have always had puffy eyes and dark circles since I turned 30. So I have used many eye creams and the truth is, I cannot live without them.
Dove, Olay, Dead Sea, Simple, InstaNatural.... I typically try one brand for 6 months if they are decent (often 2 bottles at .5 oz each, about 1 oz total) and decide whether I want to stick with it. The above mentioned are the brands that I had stuck with for more than 1-2 years until I happen upon another one.
Vichy LiftActiv is effective. I used it twice daily, morning and night, and I can see it obviously reduces puffiness under the eye, and in turn alleviate a bit of dark circle.
I may think twice before purchasing another one though because of the price.

This is not a moisturizing eye cream, not at all, but I think the purpose is so much better. That having been said, I have tried line smoothing products in the past, this one is probably the best so far. I applied to clean dry skin under my eyes. It seemed like and instant change! My fine lines pretty much disappeared, so much so that I had to apply a little on the cheek area just under the eye to smooth that out too. It really does instantly tighten the skin. Now of course it's not permanent, and it didn't work on my more set in crows feet, but fine lines were really gone. I would not wear this cream to bed - there is no real reason to, the line smoothing is temporary. Also, I found I still needed a cream after applying, so I lightly dabbed a bit eye cream over the area after this product had set and did its job. Eye cream did not take away the smoothing action at all. You only need a tiny dab, it doesn't have a strong scent, it was non-irritating, smoothed fine lines, and did an all around perfect job. Love this stuff!
summary: great at smoothing those fine lines

reviewText: This is a pleasantly-scented eye cream that does provide some temporary lift. There is no allergic reaction, no itching or burning, either.  The cream absorbs quickly. The tube has a very small opening, so only a little can come out at a time.  Not much is needed to lift the sagging skin around the eyes.  For me the price is cost-prohibitive, though.
summary: Works fast, but at a price

reviewText:
Vichy LiftActive Eyes is designed to visibly lift eyelids, reduce the appearance of wrinkles around the eyes,  to reduce under eye puffiness, & minimize dark circles.

I'm testing this product to see if it will lift my eyelids. Aging has caused my eyelids to droop.  I never noticed this until one of my friends had surgery to lift her eyelids because they were interfering with her vision. When she mentioned she was having surgery to correct the problem, I looked closely at my eyes & noticed I had droopy eyelids too. My droopy lids don't  interfere with my vision, but I'd like to lift the 'droop'. This product should help with my crow's feet & slight under eye puffiness too for an overall more  refreshed look.

Results so far:
 So far I've seen e a definite improvement with my crow's feet, wrinkles around my eyes & under-eye puffiness, but only a slight improvement with my droopy lids.
Overall, my eyes have a more refreshed appearance & I'm happy with this product.

This is a thick moisturizing cream, but  was quickly absorbed.
It is safe to use on your eyelids.

Instructions:
Use day and/or night on cleansed skin. Close your eye. Apply the cream in a gentle smoothing action from the inner corner towards the outer corner of the eye. Finish by lightly tapping around the eye.

I have a couple complaints about packaging.
I didn't receive any instructions, and
neither the box nor  the tube were sealed.
I don't know if Vichy routinely packages their products this way,  if it was a mistake, or possibly because I received this product through Amazon's Vine Program.
summary: Leaves my eyes looking more refreshed - Reduced Wrinkles Aound my eyes & Under Eye Puffiness - Slightly improved my droopy lids

reviewText: This does seem to reduce under-eye puffiness. Gave it four stars instead of five because of the high price.  This cream is quite thick, but still emollient.  The very narrow opening of this little tube dispenses the product in a very thin string so there is no waste.  The cream stays on for quite a long time, does not migrate, and is not irritating.  I like this very much and may have to spring for another tube when this is used up.

I evaluate skin care products based on multiple factors including the degree of improvement, value (cost vs. volume), usability, and side effects. I realize that each person's skin is different so my experience will be a highly subjective one. I am 51, so I'm likely a good candidate for this type of product as I have wrinkles, darkening and eye bags. My skin is fair and thin, but I don't suffer from dryness, oily skin, or blemishes - only the advances of age. At over $53 for .5 oz, this has a very high bar to clear in terms of value.

In order to assess more clearly what the effects of use would be, I took before and after shots of my eyes. Though I did see improvement for myself without the pictures, I didn't want to rely entirely on a subjective assessment and memory. There is definite improvement in terms of reducing eye bags/puffiness, dark circles, and lifting of the eyelids. It does live up to its promises, but I think it's the sort of improvement that only the user is going to notice. If you look at the picture I'm including with this review, you can see the bottom is somewhat improved over the top after using this product.

In terms of usability, I give the manufacturer props for making dispensing tiny amounts so easy. The hole in the tube's nozzle is very tiny so you can squeeze out just enough. The cream is thick and I'm sorry to say that my eyes felt quite itchy after using it. This settled down some as time went by (after about 15 minutes), but I experienced moderate itchiness for quite some time. This is likely just a reaction with my skin type and others may not experience similar problems.

This is a good eye cream, but it is very expensive and does not have a transforming effect for the price tag. You would have to have a lot of money to spend on modest results for this to be worthwhile. I've experienced similar results with products which offered more value and less irritation.
summary: fulfills promise, but made my eyes itchy

reviewText:
This eye cream is heavier-bodied than I typically use, so I have to rub it in rather than pat or "slide" it on. There's a slight tingle on application that goes away very quickly. It has made the circles under my eyes a bit lighter.

Even though it's a thicker cream, the nozzle opening on the tube is TINY, so you can control how much you want to use and don't accidentally squirt out too much, thus preventing waste.

I love this product!  I couldn't wait to try it and it really  lives up to its claim of rejuvenating the appearance of one's eyes.  It is very gentle and light on the skin and it gives a completely natural appearance.  I love it!
great

First of all, I've tried other eye creams and they all irritate my eyes like crazy.  This one DOESN'T.  When it says it's for sensitive eyes, I was very skeptical.  After using it for 3 days, day and night, it doesn't irritate me at all.  And to top it off, I'm seeing improvements already! In just 3 short days.
Wow is the right word for this.  It squeezes out very little portions and all of the goodness stays in the tube without drying up. I am seeing positive results and will continue to use it.  Maybe even buy a full line of Vichy products.
summary: I've tried other eye creams and they all irritate my eyes like crazy. This one DOESN'T

reviewText:
I'm 41. My skin, around my eyes, is still seemingly elastic enough that I don't feel like I need firming, specifically, from an eye cream, but I'm glad I gave the AHAVA Time to Revitalize a shot as it works beautifully as an eye cream- PERIOD (not just for "extreme firming", which I cannot judge as "extreme loosening or sagging" is not an issue I am faced with at this point, at least around my eyes...I may have to try this on the other 98% of my body and get back to you).

I have very sensitive skin and I have dry eye (I have punctal plugs and use daily rewetting drops) as part of autoimmune arthritis.  My eyes itch constantly as we have two pets which trigger my skin and eye allergies.  I am raising a special needs teenager and it has been a bumpy couple of years.  When I do sleep, I sleep on my side, in fits of 30-60 minutes and I'm always exhausted and dragging my aching bones around and since turning 40 last year, I just don't bounce back from the stress and lack of sleep like I once did and it shows that I have often just dragged myself out of bed to go to a doctor's appointment or to help my folks or to pick up my son from school.

Because I sleep on my side, I usually have one eye which has a lovely, bluish-purple swelling underneath it and the skin around the other one looks dehydrated and like it found some bonus creasing while I was attempting to nap.  I pat a little AHAVA around both eyes and within a few minutes the sides look fairly equal, with most of the blue and the swelling reduced and both eyes look less creased (I have less "I never sleep and I'm getting old" fine creases but leaves the "I have laughed so much at so many things my whole life" that I love) and everything looks and feels youthful and calm and refreshed.  I feel slightly more alert and definitely feel less like a completely stressed mama and more like a human being.  Yeah, I know. It's eye cream.  It's not a miracle worker.  It is, though, one of the tiny moments that I take for myself and that it leaves me looking and feeling better about just that one part of me is pretty sweet.

I am curious to try more of the AHAVA products, as this is the first eye cream I remember to use daily.  My sensitive eyes have not enjoyed previous eye creams or I didn't enjoy them for some reason (some are sticky or heavily perfumed) enough to use daily and frequently.  AHAVA Time to Revitalize applies smoothly, without stickiness and it's not greasy.  It is absorbed quickly and skin feels softer, more supple, and hydrated but not slimy, greasy, or wet.
summary: Makes me look like I sleep well, don't have a teenager, and have me time.

reviewText: I am a pure Ahava enthusiast having first found their products while touring Massada in Isreal back in 2009. I love the mineral ingredients which specifically come from the Dead Sea. My skin, and under eyes, have improved dramatically in the last 3 weeks since using this Time to Revitalize. Less puffiness and dark circles are beginning to fade. I will be purchasing more!
summary: Ahava hits another home run! This time for my eyes. Love it, love it, love it!

reviewText:
I have to admit this eye cream does seem to take away the bags and lines  that worn; look that I sometimes get even though I have had enough sleep.
I do not like this under make up, it seems to look slimy then, so do not wear it when I am going out in the morning.
I like the containers, they add to the enjoyment of the product, although I am not too sure it is worth the price they are charging.
It does say safe for sensitive skin. It does not bother me, although I normally do not have trouble
Its a nice eye cream, if you want to pay the price.

I have had a problem with sagging upper eyelids (hereditary) as I've gotten older and I have been trying a lot of different products to see if any of them would work since I don't want to have surgery to correct the problem. I have had several products (mostly cheaper lines) make some improvement, but this is the only one that has actually made it worse. I'm 65, but wrinkling hasn't been an issue and I don't usually have bags under my eyes, but after about three weeks of using this product, I do have some bagging and my upper eyelids are droopier than ever. When I used it closer to my eyelashes, I had quite a bit of burning in my eyes, so I have been applying it closer to the bone and under the brow, but not down on the lower part of the lids. The fragrance of the product is light and dissipates quickly, but it isn't a smell I find pleasant - only a very small issue since the fragrance doesn't last. It simply doesn't work on my skin. For the price, I was hoping for even modest results, but it isn't happening.

I have used AHAVA Extreme Eye Cream for a bit over 2 weeks both morning and evening, but so far, I am not seeing a positive difference. What I have noticed is what seems to be more bags under my eyes and no change with the wrinkles. This may be a coincidence because I'm looking closer, but when a close friend asked me if I was ill I was taken by surprise. I asked what he meant and he said I had horrible bags under my eyes and I look at least ten years older than when he last saw me (about 3 weeks ago). Like I said, it could be coincidence. Maybe 50 is just too old for this product and when it is supposed to plump wrinkles, it just plumps up my bags instead. I will give this product more time and continue to use it and I will post an updated comment if there is any change.

reviewText: This is a very nice cream, albeit a bit on the heavy side (your mileage may vary), and outside of the heaviness, very easy to apply. Bonus points for no noticeable scent that lingers on forever and ever. That said, it appears other reviewers are having better results from the product than I've been getting, after a week of testing this out.  I've had much better results with an Olay product I received a few weeks prior to this product, and with a lower price tag, and for that I've dropped a star off the rating, and again, your mileage may vary.
summary: This is a very nice cream, albeit a bit on the heavy side ...

reviewText:
Although I am old enough not to be sucked into labels on cosmetics, I still secretly hope that something will come around and wipe my wrinkles away. Even if this cream did not do that, I would still repurchase it. I have very dry eyes due to Sjogren's Syndrome. Many creams are too harsh, or if they say they lift and tighten, they make me feel dry. This cream is luxurious and leaves moisture on my eyes all day long. The only other cream I have tried that does this is Josie Maran's eye cream, but that one does not work on wrinkles.
This is definitely worth a try.

I have used other AHAVA products over the last few years so I was interested in seeing if this really did firm the skin under my eyes without causing irritation (i.e., tearing).  Although I didn't see a huge difference in fine lines at the corners (but I've only used this a few days), the product did reduce the puffiness of the skin below my eyes. What I really liked about the product is that it did not irritate my eyes. I've used some without a "trial" at home and gone out and then spent the time wiping tears away. The product goes on smoothly. The product is much thicker than most eye creams that I've used in the past, but I really like the hydration/moisturizing effect it provides. I'll be interested to see how well it hydrates when winter comes and the temperatures are below thirty in the dry climate I live in.

My wife found the cream to be reasonably moisturizing and liked how the cream felt on her skin. Although she had some minor complaints about the container, she felt that this was a decent eye cream that is worth the asking price.

Ahava makes fabulous skincare products. I currently use their soap, hand cream and body lotion. Adding this to my arsenal was a no brainer. I am almost 40 and have slight lines around my eyes. This firms them and perks up my whole eye area. It is not greasy and absorbs well, allowing me to apply concealer almost immediately. I hope to see much improvement with continued use as I do with all of the other Ahava products I use.

reviewText:
I'm giving this 5 stars because I still feel hydrated at night. I am very self-conscious about my under eye areas.  I have dark circles and some bags starting underneath at my age which is normal but not attractive.  I like this eye cream/treatment because it feels extremely soothing going on and it works.

I wear undereye concealer and it is a challenge to get it on in a non-conspictuous way.  I have tried other products, including baby oil which can be problematic because of the fact that it is runny if you get too much on. It just cannot look matte or dry or it shows every line. I do not like to putmy SPF 30 moisturizer so close to my eye either as it stings my eyes.

Putting this on every morning and night is recommended. It is made with some really exotic ingredients which are featured above.  This is opthomologist tested - No paraben  - YAY and non allergenic. I think this is a phenomenal product and I would spend serious cash to rebuy it. Just the feeling of it going on is what really gives me more incentive to use it. Really great product, and recommended for older women to get that well-slept look.

reviewText:
AHAVA cream does revitalize the skin around my eyes.  It's not oily or shiny, but it absorbs under the skin allowing you to put on your makeup over it as usual. The skin becomes firmer as days go by.  It's a very high quality product.

I recommend it.

I've only just started using this but it does do a good job of tightening the skin. Keep it away from your actual eye as it will cause irritation and redness. A little pricey for the amount you get, but then so many of these products are

I have been using Ahava products for many years. Although they aren't cheap, they make my face feel nice without causing irritation. My skin is very sensitive, so this is very important. This eye cream works well. I haven't done a scientific test, but to me the product plumos my lines. I like it and will continue to use this and other Ahava products.

reviewText: A little goes a long way.  The product has a nice consistency, good texture, and is very moisturizing!

It takes a small amount of AHAVA Extreme Firming Eye Cream to  improve the look of my eyes.  Sometimes I used it twice a day, other times I only apply it in the morning.  I've been testing it for a week now, but noticed positive results immediately.

I gently apply a small amount all around my eyes, eyelids, under my eyes & my crows feet & rub it in to be sure it's absorbed.
A few seconds after applying, the skin around my eyes firms up, & wrinkles are tightened up, leaving my eyes looking more youthful.
Every time I apply it & look in my magnifying mirror, the skin around my eyes isn't only firmer, but there's another look to them that I can't explain.
Their advertising states: "Additionally, this product provides an active shield for superior protection and imparts a "second skin" feeling, giving the eyes a youthful glow."  It must be the youthful glow I notice. I wouldn't call it a glow, but it's a look I haven't experienced with other firming eye creams.

I'm in my late 60's & have tried a few eye creams in the past 10 years.  AHAVA  Extreme Firming Eye Cream is the best I've used.
summary: This is the best eye cream I've ever used. It firms the skin around my eyes leaving a youthful glow/look too

reviewText:
