The main thing I don't like is that, for the price, half of the ingredients are man-made. Not good if you're trying to stick to products that have more "natural" or "organic" products.  In addition, for 24 hour coverage, it doesn't contain any sunblock or sunscreen for when you go out during the daytime hours, so I would consider this more of a "night" cream than an all-purpose one.
summary: Expensive 24 Moisturizer That Doesn't Contain Sunscreen

reviewText: I'm a sucker for fine French cosmetics and I had not heard of this brand - so I was eager to try it.  First, this has a floral fragrance that reminds me of honeysuckle, lilac and paperwhites.  If you prefer unscented this is not for you.  If you love fresh beautiful scents that are not overpowering, you will love this.  I love it.  I prefer my cosmetics to have pretty smells.  This has a very light whipped texture and does not take much at all to cover your face.  It feels very soothing, particularly after I've used my at-home microdermabrasion.  I think it will also be excellent for after sun care as well.  I've used it day and night and it leaves my skin soft and moisturized, lightly scented, but not greasy at all.  I've had not experienced any breakouts either.  I am intrigued to try the rest of the Nuxe product line.

This is a very light weight moisturizer with a fragrance that is so pungent, that I had a very difficult time wearing it frequently enough to review it on it's moisturizing properties. I even shared it with our daughter to test the hydration benefits. It absorbs very quickly, and is not oily at all, but I would have to recommend avoiding this face cream for those who are sensitive to fragrances. I'm not especially, but this is probably the most 'perfumed' face cream I have ever used and just don't experience positive enough moisturizing benefits to tolerate the smell, or the $46 price tag. (Reviewed by my wife)

My wife tested this cream and really enjoyed it.  It went on thick, and had the strongest scent of any that she's ever experienced (jasmine and honeysuckle) .  It successfully moisturized her skin in the dry Southern California climate and really did last 24 hours.  It did not aggravate any existing skin conditions.

The ingredients are not natural by any means with 24 or more unique ingredients. Nearly half of the ingredients are synthetic.  If you are a natural products evangelist like me, you should skip it.  If you are a fan of modern chemistry's ability to provide effective skin care, you should give it a try.  Keep in mind that it is a moisturizer, and not anti-aging.
summary: Effective moisturizer, but for the price, it should be anti-aging

reviewText:
I'm already a fan of Nuxe Dry Oil, so I was eager to try this product.
Before ordering, I had a hard time finding the ingredients.  I don't like to use any gluten containing skin products, especially on my face, because I have celiac disease.  I went ahead and ordered because I knew the Dry Oil was gluten free, but when it arrived, I see that it has tocopherol and oats.  Since I had ordered it to review, I went ahead and decided to try it on the back of my hand, then rinse off.  Not much of a review, I know, and I'm sorry.
I was offered the 1.5 oz plastic jar.  When I opened it, the first thing I noticed was the fragrance.  It's very floral, and I happened to love it.  But, it does remind me of my grandmother.  ;)  The cream is thick and when you touch it, it literally melts.  It feels REALLY good on the skin.  Once it's on, it doesn't feel greasy, but my skin felt moisturized and soft.  I would definitely use this if I could...but it's back to dry oil for me.

This is a great moisturizing cream.  I used it on my face and hands and it left them really hydrated and soft, without feeling greasy.  I also like the ingredients.  However, I could not get past this product's scent.  It has a really strong flowery scent.  I am sensitive to strong smells and this was just too strong for me.  It did not seem to dissipate for a long time.  Unfortunately, I don't think I can use this cream due to the strong fragrance.

If you don't mind strong scents, this is a great moisturizing cream with nice ingredients.  However, if you have an aversion to strong scents, you should steer away from this one.
summary: Fragrance was too strong for me

reviewText: This is a nice moisturizer.  It's really thick in the jar, but doesn't feel thick on your skin.  It smells really nice, like honeysuckle nectar, and I think the jar will last for a long time.  I've been using it for five nights, and I notice that my skin feels softer and more supple.  I haven't noticed a difference in the mirror yet, but that may be because I've only used it five nights.  It's a 24 hour cream, so you only have to put it on at night and it keeps your skin moisturized until you put it on again the next night.  I do expect to see a difference in my face and neck if I keep using it, which I will do.  I'm very happy with this, because my skin feels so much softer and well hydrated.
summary: Makes my skin softer and it smells very nice

reviewText:
Both my wife and I tried this lovely "Crme" and we were very impressed. It goes on easily and instantly refreshes, feels cool as a cucumber, with no greasy after feel. This is perfect for hot days. It starts with a rather heavy floral scent, we detected citrus and jasmine, maybe other. However, the scent dissipated quickly and didn't bother our noses at all.

It's really refreshing, which is unusual in this sort of "Crme" and we liked that.  It also didn't cause any allergic reactions, redness or anything out of the ordinary. Our skin immediately perked to life, and the feeling lasted until morning.

Thus, this would be recommended after a day of to much sun (altho not after a real sun burn of course). Apply immediately after getting out of the shower when getting home, and start revitalizing that sun damaged skin as soon as possible.
summary: Refreshing and cool as a cucumber!

reviewText: I'm really happy with this product. It moisturizes my face all night without giving me a greasy feeling, or worse, pimples. It has a terrific smell, I think floral. It makes my face feel smooth and the lovely smell can't hurt, especially if you put it on right after your shower, before you cuddle with your honey. He'll notice how smooth your face is and think you smell good too. I'm not seeing any insta-results as far as appearance, but didn't expect it. That will come with time.

Lovely moisturizer.
It's a thick cream but melts into your skin as it warms to your skin.
I have oily skin but due to use of retinoids, it can be dry and patchy.
I use this mostly at night.
During the day it's a little too much because I need to apply a separate SPF and with both my face gets too oily.
I love the balm like texture.
I also love the citrus/orange blossom fragrance .
However if you are sensitive be waned that the fragrance is VERY strong.
I find the scent soothing and refreshing to use at night, almost like aromatherapy.
I look forward to applying it.

I've been using this cream for a couple weeks now and I absolutely love it. The orange blossom scent is wonderfully and the light rich cream is easy to use. I use it in the morning after my shower and it truly seems to be making my aging skin feel a little younger and more hydrated.

This single jar will last a long time, too, even though I'm using in the morning and at bedtime. You don't need to dip fingers into it, just slide them across the surface of the cream and then apply.

I've always been terrible about remembering to use a hydrating cream, but the scent of this product is so delicious that I haven't forgotten once since receiving the jar. I look forward to using it.  And every single time I encounter my husband directly after applying it he tells me how good I smell - he loves it. The scent is brief but the moisturizing lasts all day.
summary: Moisture for Your Skin and Orange Blossoms for Your Pleasure

reviewText: This is a very soft and hydrating cream for the face. I have oily/combination skin and although I haven't had any breakouts from this, I'm still wary of using this everyday due to the silicone in this especially in the summer. The cream feels oily at first but is quickly absorbed and feels matte on the skin. There is also quite a bit of alcohol in this cream and since it has suited my skin well, I couldn't give it a bad rating. I do feel the price is a bit high but I would highly recommend this cream for fall/winter.
summary: I couldn't give it a bad rating. I do feel the price is a ...

reviewText: Love this stuff. Smells so fresh, and clean. Moisturizers with just a little bit. Not oily, and it soaks right in. Love the orange scent. Easy to use.

This smells wonderful to me - it is like neroli, or like being in the midst of a Florida orange orchard in full bloom.  I simply love the fragrance, but it is strong, and if you are sensitive to fragrances, you may not like this one.  I love fragrances, the more the better, and I am in love the scent.

The cream itself is light, like a mousse.  It's very moisturizing, and my skin just soaks it up.  It immediately smooths out the finest of lines, and undereye crepe, which is a big problem for me.  This works better than my eye cream for my undereye area.

The jar itself is basic, plastic, and easy to open and use.  It has a wide top so it is easy to get every bit of product from the jar.  The expiration date on mine is over a year in the future.

Downside- it contains a good bit of glycerin and dimethicone. so it can react with some makeup, spf, or other skin products to cause piling when used together.  Sometimes this is avoided by waiting longer after application, but a lot depends on the products being mixed.  This is not working well for me with my SPF products, so that limits my use to days that I stay in and don't wear SPF, or use later at night after I've washed my face for the day.  Otherwise, the piling is so bad it all just rubs off like my skin is peeling.  Still, I find it just SO pleasant to use, that I simply love it.
summary: Amazing fragrance,immediate improvement in undereye crepe, but it doesn't always combine well with other products

reviewText:
I don't think there is anything magical about this cream but it does a very good job of moisturizing dry patches on my face without making me feel greasy.  It has a lovely orange blossom scent that is not too heavy unless you really hate scent.  I had my husband try this (he really does not like scented moisturizers) & he didn't mind this.  The scent doesn't linger for long.  Strong scented lotions tend to irritate both our faces & this one did not.

I wore it during the day & at night.  It was fine under makeup & did not make my skin break out.

It is paraben-free & non comedogenic.  Made in France.
summary: Very Good Moisturizer With an Orange Blossom Scent

reviewText: This is a truly amazing moisturizer. I was introduced to this through Glossybox, and have since purchased another. I use it every night as a night cream and it sinks right into my skin leaving it smell divine, and by morning my skin looks so moisturized and healthy and it feels GREAT. I can tell this is a genuinely wonderful product because my skin looks and feels so healthy. This really deserves more hype.

I received a sample as a gift and I've been buying this Creme ever since.  My skin feels and looks amazing (43 years old), and given that I have sensitive skin and it has never caused a blemish, I highly recommend it. I use it every morning along with the Nuxe Dry Oil. The scent is lovely. I've been using this now for two years.

This cream-gel, textured eye cream from ELEMIS nourishes the delicate area around my eyes. It is made with chlorella, blue-green micro-algae, and padina pavonica, said to help with skin firmness and reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles around the eye.

I have found the product applies easily, provides extended moisture and smooths out the skin below my eyes and on my eye lid. A little goes a long way and one pump is enough. I pat in the Elemis Pro-Collagen Eye Renewal Serum under my eye and above. The cream-gel texture helps reduce the appearance of fine lines, though they are still there.

I apply it daily, morning and evening. I use one pump, use my ring finger and gently pat around the eye contour.

This is light and soothing.

Recommended. prisrob 02-13-17

I've only used the Eye Serum a few weeks now but it is quite nice.

The serum is very light and is rapidly absorbed under the eye. However, the price is totally unreasonable and I find the product gets used far too quickly.
I am a little concerned that my pro-collagen eye treatment package was not sealed. It also has a orange label with the following number -43028867.
summary: I am a little concerned that my pro-collagen eye treatment ...

reviewText:
I received a jar of Juice Beauty Blemish Clearing Peel for an honest review. A patented product, it is designed to clear blemishes through a gentle exfoliation using malic acid from organic apples, tartaric acid from organic grapes and citric acid from organic lemons. It claims to repair, heal and even skin tone and texture.

A patch test was suggested, using a place behind the ear. Because my skin is not unusually sensitive, I decided to forego the test and applied directly to my cleansed face, avoiding the eye area. The consistency is that of a gel, and it smells faintly of apples, not at all unpleasant. There was a slight tingling sensation on my skin after applying. Following the directions (which I might add are printed in microscopically small print), I left the product on for ten minutes and then rinsed. My skin felt soft and hydrated. The directions suggest using the clearing peel twice a week. Since I have only just received this product, I don't have time to comment on how it will work over a period of time, however, I will update this review as I see (or don't see) results.

What do I hope to achieve from this product? I have mature, but relatively unlined skin for my age, and few blemishes. I do, however, have tanned skin from exposure (I garden and am a water fitness instructor so get some sun regularly, leaving me with tanned cheeks and white squint lines. Im hoping these will even out and be less noticeable after a couple weeks of use. At any rate, I will report back.

So far, I like the consistency of the peel and love how soft my face feels. I also appreciate that it doesnt have a list of ingredients I cannot pronounce. Will I purchase another jar? Depends on the results. Stay tuned.
summary: So far, I think its great.

reviewText:
First, there are many good things about this product. It is all natural and organic and free from chemicals, which I really appreciate.

However, there are a couple of concerns on my part. They call it a "peel" (maybe because the ingredients help to exfoliate the skin), however, I equate that word with a mask that actually peels off, versus a mask that rinses off the skin, as this one does. To me, the name of the product is misleading, and I believe "mask" would have been more accurate.

Second, it has a rather odd smell. It is not a strong smell, but it reminds me a bit of rotting fruit. I realize reactions to the scent of a product is personal, and others may not agree with me, but when I give a review I like to be as honest as possible. Perhaps they did not add any scent to the product to keep it pure and natural, but I still think it smelled a bit strange. (And this differs from their moisturizer, which does have a light, pleasant scent.)

The price is high, but it may be worth it to individuals who are interested in a natural and chemical free product. I like the mask enough to continue using it, but I do not see me spending money to purchase it for myself in the future.

I haven't used a mask in many years, so this was an unusual experience for me. The product has a very faint smell of apples, but a much stronger waxy smell. It isn't unpleasant or overwhelming. This seems like something that isn't too perfume-y for a man to use.

Anyhow, the directions are simple, smear it on your face and neck and wait 10 minutes before removing it. The hardest part is the 10 minutes wait with a goopy face.

I thought the effect was slightly refreshing without being drying. The mask isn't overly astringent feeling, and didn't leave the skin under my eyes feeling raw.

As for blemish clearing abilities? Well, it's three days later and my skin is pretty much the same as usual -- greasy around the nose and chin, dry under the eyes, with a few annoying spots by my hairline. That's okay, since I'm not naive enough to believe that anything can really 'clear' your blemishes. The best you can hope for is a bit of control. This mask seemed to do okay on clogged pores, without further clogging them, and my face looked smoother immediately after the treatment.

It's not a miracle cure for blemishes, but they don't make that claim anywhere on the box.

The product is certified organic and doesn't contain anything you can't pronounce, so it's not like you're smearing chemicals on your skin. I'll use it on a weekly basis as it does make my skin feel cleaner.
summary: Skin feels cleaner and smoother without drying

reviewText:
This peel is made from natural ingredients (food mostly) and has a mild food-like scent.  I'm moderately sensitive to perfumes and this scent didn't bother me at all.  I didn't notice any skin irritation, even when I forgot and left it on longer than 15 minutes.  I can feel the tingling they talk about but it is not unpleasant.
It leaves the skin soft, and seems to exfoliate a little bit.
The instructions call for a "generous layer" but just enough to moisten the skin seems to work.

I've been hearing a lot about the benefit of peels, but have never actually tried one until now. I don't have sensitive skin, but the idea of a peel just turned me off. But the fact that this peel has all natural ingredients made me willing to try it.

I wouldn't say I have bad skin, but I definitely don't have great skin. I don't have acne, but I'm prone to blemishes and breakouts because of oily-ish skin. I take very good care of my skin, generally. I use a Clarisonic Mia daily with Cetaphil cleanser, and then makeup wipes and Cetaphil again at night.

I tested out this peel under my chin, and once I was satisfied that it wouldn't react badly with my skin, I proceeded to wash my face and then spread it on. I liked the smell (apple) and it tingled while it was on, a good indication that something was happening. What I was afraid of (with the word peel) was that it would burn, but it didn't at all.

I left it on for the directed 10 minutes and washed it off. My skin was brighter, and I felt as though some of the dark spots had even lightened a bit! A day later, my skin still feels more radiant. Overall, I'm really happy with this and will continue to use it once  a month or so.
summary: Great peel with all natural ingredients

reviewText:
Juice Beauty Blemish Clearing Peel works well on dry aging skin.  After 10-minute treatment, as recommended, the skin becomes smoother and livelier in color while the spots are significantly reduced.  Applying a moisturizer immediately afterwards quickens, reinforces, and protects the positive effect on somewhat vulnerable skin.

The Peel is based on organic ingredients such as apple and lemon juices, aloe barbadensis (aloe vera have rejuvenating, healing, or soothing properties), glycolic acid (chemical peel), hydroxypropyl starch phosphate (surfactant and emulsifier), sodium hydroxide or caustic soda (chemical peel), capryl hydroxamic acid (for product safety and longevity), sclerotium gum (improves emulsion viscosity, texture and skin's moisture), lysolecithin (gelling-emulsifying agent enhancing skin feel), pullulan (anti-aging and anti-wrinkle), caprylyl glycol (skin conditioning agent), grape seed extract, vitamin C, tetrasodium glutamate diacetate (removes metals), magnesium aspartate (to transport and deliver minerals to skin cell), zinc gluconate (antiviral, acne treatment, wound healing, prevents scarring), and copper gluconate (acne treatment).

This peel is very good for exfoliating your skin to even skin tone and texture. I like the ingredients that include antioxidants and vitamins like vitamin C and other natural ingredients. It leaves my skin smooth and hydrated.

My daughter and I have both been using this face mask.  I have occasional adult acne, and she has occasional teenager acne.  This mask is not clay-like, it's more like a fine grained applesauce if you can imagine what that would be like.  It's on the more liquid-y side.  When you put the mask on, it doesn't dry and crack like a clay-based mask, it stays soft but you can feel it tighten.  It smells a bit like old school paste, but that is better than the way some masks smell, so I'm okay with it.

It rinses off easy enough, since it doesn't get hard.  Both of us think our skin feels nice afterwards, and not too dry.  It does take several uses to really notice a difference, but I do think it is beneficial.  If there is one spot that I am having a problem with, I just dab it there if I don't have time for a full face mask, and that is better than nothing.

The best part about this mask is that it's natural.  So give it a shot if you are into natural products, I think you will be pleasantly surprised.

The smell and the gelatinous-like consistency are the reasons for the lower star rating. I love that this product is all natural. As I read that a tingling sensation will be felt after use, I suppose I was really gearing up for something a lot stronger, but it's an extremely mild tingling. After washing the product off, my skin felt okay, but I didn't feel as it does when I do a peel or mask.

Overall, I'm just not overjoyed with this product. The best thing I like about it is the fact that it doesn't contain any bad chemical ingredients.
summary: Love that it's all natural, but not too impressed with the results/smell/consistency.

reviewText: I liked this face mask. It is easy to apply and only needs to be left on for 10 minutes. As the product says it really does create a tingling sensation. The smell of the product isn't my favorite but isn't the end of the world because it washes off. My skin felt clean and tighter after use and I haven't had any blemishes since I have used it.

I was curious to try this clearing peel after reading the description.  I have been run a little ragged lately and my facial care has suffered, not exfoliating or moisturizing as much as I should be.  And with my oily combination skin that can add up, so I gave this a try.  The product does have a nice faint apple smell, nothing too much to that it smells like a candy.  Nor does it smell like chemicals, which makes me feel better.  I applied it per directions, I did have the tingling sensation as warned, and then when removed my face a little red for about 10 minutes then it went away.  But my face came out great.  Very very smooth, and it cleared up my oily spots and even left a few dry spots I have soft and smooth.  Even my coworkers noticed a difference the next day.  I hope to keep using this in the future although the box recommends suing no more than twice a week.  So I am thinking maybe every other week I may use this on Sunday nights to get me ready for the week.  A good product overall.

Both my teenaged daughter and I tried this peel, and we both love it.

I am a middle-aged woman with combination skin and get the occasional adult acne cyst.  I gave this peel a run for its money, as I am currently suffering from extremely dry winter skin as well as a painful, large zit trying to emerge on my jawline.  I use masques several times a month but this was my first peel.  The texture of the peel is very thin, which is good, because the product will go a very long way since you don't need much.  The jar is small and even so, you can't tell after one use that any is gone.  I anticipate it lasting longer than masques in containers twice its size.  So while it is expensive, per use it will probably end up being less than my usual mid-range masques.

I thought I would have to tolerate the smell, since I am not a fan of apple-scented anything that is not, well, apples themselves.  But it is a very pleasant, very light, clean and fresh smell, similar to facial treatments I have had done at spas or medical spas.  It goes on very light, no frozen face or feeling of cracking.  It is transparent enough that I could run to the school to pick up the kids and no one in neighboring cars would be able to tell there was something on my face.

I was genuinely amazed about how well this peel works.  How could it be blemish clearing and moisturizing at the same time?  But it is.  My skin is very noticeably less dry, and this after I'd been applying a thick facial cream once or twice a day for several days prior.  And the zit--it took me a minute even to find it after using this peel only once for about 10 minutes.  It is much smaller and dried out feeling, like how I would expect it to feel after a day and a night of treating with my Proactiv zit cream.  The overall appearance of my face has improved as well.  Nothing remarkable, after all it was only one use and I have been using masques all along, but the color seems a little more even, and the pores perhaps a bit smaller.

The directions mention that you might feel a slight tingling when applying this peel, and it was so slight as to be almost imperceptible.  My skin was not at all irritated during or after the peel.

My teenaged daughter has highly sensitive skin.  She has to use a special, gentle face cleaner as well as special makeup remover.  She was able to use this peel with no irritation whatsoever.  I forgot to mention to her possible tingling and she didn't say anything about it.  She had a few little breakouts on her face and was pleased that they were significantly smaller afterwards.  She also kept touching her face saying she loves how soft it feels.  She and I both agreed her skin looks brighter, too.  She has two presentations to give in school tomorrow and was happy to have tried the peel tonight because of how it has improved the look of her skin.

Based on my and my daughter's experience, I would definitely recommend this peel to anyone looking to moisturize, clear or brighten their skin.

So, at first I was really not a fan of this peel. I imagined it smelling sooo delicious and well, it doesn't. At all. It's kind of an icky color and it has a drippy consistency. I didn't love the way it felt on my face and I actually wish it would have tingled more.

But I have to give it 4 stars because I honestly feel like it has been working. My skin is pretty prone to breakouts and I swear that after using this a couple times a week for a few weeks, they are much less noticeable. Not only that, but my skin feels smoother and looks a bit brighter.

At the end of the day, I don't care too much what a product smells like or feels like so long as it effectively works! I will continue to use this and will update if I notice any changes.
summary: Not the best smelling or feeling, but it seems to work!

reviewText: I have been using this everyday, it takes about 10 mins to fully dry. Peeling is a pain, so I just wash it off  in the shower with a clean loofah pad. My face and chest is looking clearer and brighter everyday. It is gentle enough to use everyday.

Even though I'm 43, I still deal with hormonal, cystic acne each month.  I tend to get one or two really bad spots that turn into cysts if I'm not careful about treating them right away.  Although I've only been using this peel for about two weeks, it has helped me deal with my monthly acne, and also seems to be helping fade some scars/red marks from previous bumps.

Although this is labeled as a peel, it's still very gentle.  It actually feels more like a serum or light gel, and, after leaving it on for ten minutes, you just peel it off.  Right after using it, my pores are noticeably smaller, and my skin has a lovely radiance to it -- which is always a perk!

I also have sensitive skin that is easily inflammed, and this doesn't burn or leave any redness to my skin.  It actually feels soothing while it's on, and, because it doesn't  harden like a regular mask, I've found that I can still drink or even eat while I'm waiting the ten minutes.

I also love that it's low on the EWG's toxicity scale since I like to use more natural products as much as possible on my skin.

The jar also seems really tiny when you first get it, but you really only need to use a small amount of this product, so it should last about six months with twice-weekly use.

My daughter has been using this peel.  She has no complaints about it being uncomfortable -- she says it tingles a bit.

The effects after a few uses have been noticeable.  She gets mild acne blemishes that can leave her skin tone uneven.  This peel has helped to reduce the appearance of the acne and has helped to even out her skin tone.  So the product works, as one would hope at this price.

There is plenty of product here for multiple applications, and it derives from natural sources, so you aren't getting a face full of funky chemicals.  Bottom line, this is a beauty product that delivers.

I received a jar of this clearing peel in exchange for an honest review. I have used it 3 times now an really like it. The jar recommends a patch test but I just used it and had no problems. It goes on smoothly and has a very slight smell that was not unpleasant. I left it on the recommended 10 minutes and washed it off thoroughly. I felt terrific. I am 61 but have no real skin problems.  Still I felt glowly and tingly and like a million bucks. I am going to order their moisturizer as I like this so much. I think it's a great product.

I'm just recently using this so I can only say what has happened so far.  This is recommended for 2x a week and that's what I've done.  This hasn't left any redness for me at all.  My face feels like it has a coating on it after use..I mean that in a good way.. hydrates!  Since this happens to me everytime I use an exfoliant..my face breaks out, just a little.  I think it's just getting rid of the dead skin and crap that is on the top layer to expose some underlying plugged pores, whatever.  It gets better with use.  This is made with certified organic ingreds. with NO parabens, propylene or petroleum..just to name a few of what is NOT in this!  No added fragrance...lol..looks like homemade applesauce

This peel, works well to smooth skin, without drying, "Heals while hydrates". I like the natural ingredients in this product.  On the label it says: "Powerful Action without parabens, propylene or butylene glycols, petroleum, sulphates, PEGs, TEA, DEA, phthalates, GMO, silicones, pesticides, artificial dyes or fragrances.  This is a plus for me.  In one use, I felt smoother skin, immediately after I rinsed it off in the shower.  A gentle, natural peel twice a week, works for me!
summary: Patented Award winning peel, works well to smooth skin, without drying

reviewText: Foremost, I LOVE Juice Beauty and Ole Henrickson. I alternate them since I still cannot chose between these lines. Both are natural, organic, high-end, and super effective. Though they are a little more expensive than some products, you can also feel more comfortable using these than Olay, Neutrogena, Clean and Clear, etc. The "fragrance" here (it is a natural scent as a result of the components), is subtle and appealing. Therefore, if you have sensitives to fragrance, you should be fine (but feel free to pop into Ulta, smell this, and then buy it here). I've used some pretty aggressive peels. This is not one of those. HOWEVER, the results seem comparable to the more aggressive ones. I've had glycolic peels in my dermatologist's office and this feels similar to the softness and clarity I experience with those peels. (And, this is much more cost-effective!) it leaves my skin absolutely glowing! (But, do follow this up with an intense moisturizer. I use Ole Henriksen Truth Creme Advanced Hydration.) While the jar appears "small," it has about a month's worth of peels (and I use it twice a week ... so, that's pretty fantastic!) Use Juice Beauty and feel good about your choice! You will be truly impressed with the results!

Coming from someone that has suffered from adult acne, the Juice Beauty Blemish Peel provides relief.

While the smell and texture are off putting at first, the way it makes your face feel afterwards outweighs any negatives.  The smell is a bit strong at first, but after being applied actually presented a fresh, clean scent.  It is a little tingly on the skin -- it didn't burn -- but that could be because I have pretty sensitive skin.

I liked that it only required a 10 minute application, and to only use it twice a week, but it did leave my skin a little sticky feeling, which went away after I washed it off.

The container, at 2 fl oz, seems a little small for the price, but overall I recommend the product because that 2 fl oz is going to last for a long long time!

I decided to try this peel so that my three teenagers could also try it (if I approved and didn't find it too harsh).  It appears in the jar to be some kind of mud mask, and then I opened the jar and saw that it has an almost gelatinous appearance.  It applies easily, but I was expecting two things: a tight, drying of the mask, and a possible burning.  But for me, a very fair, freckled red head, neither of those things happened!  This is not one of those peel off masks.  I also experienced NO burning or tingling, which I think isa good thing.  To me, and my skin history, that usually indicates something too strong.  I felt like this was a gentle mask, and I'm not sure why it is called a "peel."  There may be some exfoliating going on, but nothing very harsh.

I applied this to my face before I got into the shower (my skin was clean, I washed my face earlier in the day).  This mask washes right off.

Afterwards, my skin felt soft, and looked good: no redness.  I did feel a little dryer than usual (I generally just use Dove soap), but I compensated for that by applying a little more moisturizer than I normally would.  I will definitely let the teens try this.  It is very natural, and beats the heck out of some of the masks and over the counter facial peels I used as a teen and in my early 20s.  It has no noticeable fragrance.
summary: Gentle facial mask--I would hesitate to call this a "peel."

reviewText:
This is the second product by Juice Beauty I have used and so far I am warming up to each of them. In my opinion I wouldn't consider this to be a peel, I thought the consistency of it would be thick but I was quite surprised that it was a light brown gel...more like a mask or a scrub. It smells very good and has a light apple scent, everything about this is organic and natural.

The directions state to apply a generous amount to a clean face and neck which I did, I'm not sure about everyone else but while applying I felt a tingly feel so be very careful not to get this anywhere near your eyes, mouth and nose. You let it sit on your face for 10 minutes, within those 10 minutes the gel starts to set on your face and hardens just a little bit, it is still sticky like so be careful not to lay your face on anything, after 10 minutes are up wash off with cool water.

Once everything was done accordingly, I loved the way my face felt, very clean and refreshing. You can then follow up with another Juice Beauty product for toning and moisturizing. Would love to try more products by this line because I'm very impressed so far
summary: more like a mask or a scrub

reviewText:
Here is my wife's take on this product:

I'm a first time user of a Jouer product and tried it considering such high reviews by other customers.

When I own a beauty product for the first time, I usually try it at home so that I can test its longevity, check the look I get after wearing it, the color as it shows on my skin and discover any allergies or reactions.

I did the same with Jouer and applied it on my South-Asian fair skin in the evening, covering half of my face. Although I was new to the texture of the tint moisturizer, I really liked the coverage it provided. A little went a long way. I liked the evenness and the brightness it brought to my skin without a cakey feeling. It also lasted for at least 5 hours (after which I removed it and washed off) and stayed intact with no touch-ups required. I didn't' see any allergic reaction, so no burning sensation or redness anywhere on my facial skin.

The only con I saw to this moisturizer was that, having a combination skin, I saw dry flakes on the drier portion of the face and normal coverage on the rest. I can certainly use my regular moisturizer to make up for the dryness, but had to bring out this point.
summary: Great coverage, but gets flaky on dry/combination skin

reviewText:
I'm not sure how these tints are supposed to work, but alone it looks a bit pasty and dry. I applied it on one side without anything else, while on the other side applied the Jouer anti-aging moisture primer. The side without the primer was much drier than the side with the primer, even though I thought I could supposedly use this "moisture tint" alone.

It is not as thick as my liquid foundations and the coverage isn't as good, and with the dryness factor, I'm not sure how I can use this alone and look hydrated and youthful. I think I will only use this with another heavy moisturizer. Then again, I am 36 years old, so maybe my age has something to do with it. Perhaps it'll look great on younger, wrinkle-free skin.

On the bright side, it did not cause my very sensitive skin to break out. I have tried other products such as the VINCENT LONGO Perfect Canvas Liquid Concealer and the HAWAIIAN Tropic Silk Hydration Sunscreen Lotion, and they did make me break out. However, even though this is "fragrance free," my nose did detect some sort of fragrance. It's not a very strong fragrance, but somehow I don't think it's a natural fragrance from the vitamins and minerals it supposedly has.

Overall, it's not bad. I have fair Asian skin and it gave my skin a darker tint. With the primer, my skin does look smoother. One caution, though - I had wanted something light and easy to wear day to day during summer vacation, but apparently, even though this has the SPF factor, it is not sweat-proof. Since my nose sweats fast and a lot whenever there is even a little bit of heat, it's quickly rubbed off when I dab or dry my nose. I would not recommend wearing this during summer time. Cooler weathers would be ideal for this particular make up.
summary: Pasty but did not give me a skin reaction

reviewText:
I have used tinted moisturizers in the past and really love them.  They give just enough coverage without being heavy, with the benefit of being hydrating.

This matte moisture tint goes on exactly as described.  It's does have a velvety texture, and within less than a minute dries to a smooth matte finish.  It covers better than I expected, while still feeling light.  I liked that about this product.

What I didn't like is that this really shouldn't be categorized for light skin.  It says it's for light to medium skin tones, though it is kind of dark for light skin tones I do think that the picture online is darker than the actual product.  It's also a bit orange, but once you blend it in that seems to go away.  If you are a person that wants a tinted moisturizer that you can use all year, especially if you get a little bit of color in the summer than it might work well for you.  The thing that didn't really work for me is the matte finish.  After a while it made my skin look flakey and dry.  I think I have fairly normal skin, but it made it look like it was dry and in some serious need of moisture.  So for a moisture tint, it didn't work well for me.  I want my skin to look AND feel hydrated.

I loved the way this product went on, I loved the feel of it I just didn't like how it made my skin look.  In the end that's the point of makeup so while I do like it, I didn't love it for me.  Maybe I'm not a matte finish type of girl.
summary: Better for Normal to Oily Skin maybe?

reviewText: I really like this makeup. It blends in well, it's nice and airy, not heavy or greasy. This color compliments my summer skin tone nicely, a light tan with neutral undertones. I can wear this and be confident that I already have sunscreen protection during the day. It is matte, but I can add shimmer powder or blush on top if I want. I like the coverage and the tint, so I would order more.

I love how this tinted cream goes on and dry to a silky, powdery finish. I have oily skin and keeping it oil free throughout the day is difficult. This cream doesn't cover as well as liquid foundation. It goes on more like a bb cream or tinted moisturizer, providing light coverage. The only negative right now is the Nude tint is too light for me.

I love this stuff!  I use it as a face primer under my Bare Escentuals powder foundation, and the combination makes my skin look pretty nearly flawless.  The formula doesn't clog my skin or cause breakouts, and the shade blends well into my skin.

This goes on very smoothly with just a trace of color.

It makes my skin feel soft and dewy and well hydrated.

I suppose if I were to pick best make up, this would be high on my list. It's light and airy and has a very natural look.

I recommend to all lwomen looking for a more natural looking coverage.

I've used Mary Kay cosmetics for years and never really considered using a tinted moisturizer for a foundation until recently when I've pared down my daily makeup routine to the minimum. The cosmetic foundations have really good coverage and all kinds of gimmicks (instant color match!) but I find that as I've gotten older my skin is drier and less absorbent. So my foundation goes on less smoothly and requires more blending-- and my skin feels dry after I'm done.

The Jouer solves these issues with a creamy application, minimal blending and fussing and good coverage -- plus a softer feel after it's applied. I use two small pea-sized blobs on my face and it covers everything. I also like it as a spot concealer on days I don't feel like a full application and it blends nicely on problem spots. Also, it has a very faint, nice fragrance, nothing overpowering or annoying to smell all day.

I didn't expect to really love this product, but I'm sold on it.
summary: WOW - Awesome. Creamy, good coverage and moisturizing too.

reviewText:
if you are approximately NC15W/C this is going to be too dark for you. I'm not even sure that the lightest color available will be a match for you. The NUDE was very orange on my skin.

As a primer, I'm giving it four stars. As a color match, much less. We'll call it a three.

It did go on and stay on matte. Because it was so orange, it affected the color of foundation on top of it. It had a nice slip but wasn't what I'd call a moisturizing product. I intend to find this product in store and see if the lightest shade available works for us really pale girls
summary: Orange, flat NUDE too dark for NC10/15 skin

reviewText: Typically my normal/oily skin is very fair and it has yellow undertones, so when I started wearing this tinted moisturizer at the end of Winter it was the perfect shade. Now that we're in Summer my skin is a medium color and this Nude shade is too light. This moisturizer has medium coverage (not too sheer and not too heavy) and the matte finish makes my skin look flawless. However, in the warmer months I prefer for my skin to have a more dewy look and I prefer a matte look in the colder months. I highly recommend this tinted moisturer for cooler seasons and/or for people with really oily skin.

This is one of my favorite face make-ups.  It seems to provide the most coverage for blemishes and uneven tone while still being natural looking and very simple to apply. (I put it on like a tinted moisturizer or BB cream and often wear it alone). It works well for my combination skin, though it doesn't seem to really be moisturizing to me. SPF and A, C and E are things I look for in a face product so I love this contains all of the above.

I selected nude as being the best bet for my skin color; my complexion is light and just on the rosy side of neutral. This looks a bit yellow going on but seems to blend to a great match; I don't know if this produced is that versatile or if I got lucky with a good match.

When I first looked at the color of the Nude Moisture Tint I thought oh no this is way too yellow for my medium-light complexion and will never work. Surprisingly though it blends in and did not appear yellow on my skin. It is much more opaque than expected for a moisture tint and you can layer it to some extent to cover under eye discoloration.
If you need a moisturizer though this product will not do it for you. It almost feels a little drying on my skin and sometimes very slightly itchy. Directions are to reapply every two hours for sunscreen protection.
Overall this product seems more like a foundation with sunscreen rather than a tinted moisturizer and as a foundation I was not impressed enough to continue using it.

I find this moisture tint to be perfect for a quick application for photo or video shooting.  It slightly conceals your imprecations on your face without looking unnatural, but gives you a healthy look.

It also tones down the oily shine and reflection from the camera flesh or video lights that you want to avoid. You might still need a thin coat of powder to further prevent light reflections.

Most importantly it saves time, comparing to applying a foundation, and it makes you look healthier on film.
summary: Perfect Moisture Tint for Quick Camera Appearance

reviewText:
I don't use a lot of make-up but my aging skin might benefit from some moisturizing and certainly SPF 15 can be a benefit. Unfortunately, the yellowish cast to this product did not flatter me, and the moisturizing effect was minimal.

Here are the ingredients as listed on the Jouer Cosmetics website: TITANIUM DIOXIDE 4.5%, ZINC OXIDE 3%. INACTIVE INGREDIENTS: WATER, CYCLOPENTASILOXANE, OCTYLDODECYL NEOPENTANOATE, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, POLYGLYCERYL-4 ISOSTEARATE, DIMETHICONE CROSSPOLYMER, PEG/PPG 18/18 DIMETHICONE, SILICA, DIMETHICONE, CETYL PEG/PPG-10/1 DIMETHICONE, STEARIC ACID, ALUMINUM HYDROXIDE, SODIUM DEHYDROACETATE, PHYTANTRIOL, HEXYL LAURATE, TRIETHOXYCAPRYLYLSILANE, NYLON-12, SODIUM CHLORIDE, RETINYL PALMITATE, TOCOPHEROL, TETRAHEXYLDECYL ASCORBATE, POLYDODECANAMIDEAMINIUM TRIAZADIPHENYLETHENESULFONATE, POLYVINYLALCOHOL CROSSPOLYMER, MAGNESIUM CHLORIDE, POTASSIUM CHLORIDE, ZINC CHLORIDE, LYSINE, SODIUM HYALURONATE, PHENOXYETHANOL, METHYLPARABEN, PROPYLPARABEN, ETHYLPARABEN, BUTYLPARABEN, ISOPROPYLPARABEN, POTASSIUM SORBATE. MAY CONTAIN (+/-): MICA, TITANIUM DIOXIDE, IRON OXIDES.

Some of these ingredients are listed in the "Skin Deep" database as being in the red zone of high concern. They are PROPYLPARABEN, RETINYL PALMITATE, and BUTYLPARABEN.  I suggest researching these and at least avoiding them during pregnancy since all three have "Developmental/reproductive toxicity" listed as possible effects. In fairness, most cosmetics contain something that's suspected of being bad for you, but that would not be the case in an ideal world.
summary: Doesn't Suit Me Personally and May Have Some Toxic Ingredients

reviewText:
I received a sample of this and gave it to my wife and daughter to try.  They both love it.  They say it covers well,  They like the spf15 feature.  They say it also works well with other makeup and washes off easily.

Being that I am the one who takes my 13 yr old daughter to buy makeup, I can say the price is right, the quality seems nice, and she is asking for more already.  She likes it better than the MAC she was using before.
summary: My wife and daughter love it

reviewText: Benefits of this product: SPF 15 protects from UVA & UVB rays while Vitamins A, C & E deliver rich antioxidants to the skin. Oil Free. Hypoallergenic. Noncomedogenic. Fragrance Free. Good coverage for a tinted moisturizer. See included video for a demonstration of the product and its coverage. I liked almost everything about it except that it did not come off matte on me as its name would imply.
summary: Very nice tinted moisturizer, but doesn't mattify me.

reviewText: I purchased this hoping it would give light coverage for everyday use.  Although it didn't cause any breakouts, the coverage is not what I expected.  I used a sponge (Beauty Blender) to apply but it did not absorb or blend well onto my skin.  It seemed very noticeable that I was wearing make-up and it looked like it was caked on (I barely used any product.)  The color seemed to match my fair/yellowish skin tone.  Unfortunately, this product is too thick and looked like caked on coverage.  The moisture aspect was good.  The "matte" look just looked bad on my acne-scarred skin.  This product seems great for sensitive skin but it just didn't work for daytime use like I expected.

This is a nice tinted moisturizer. I've used it for several weeks now and it's adequate - it provides light coverage for days when you don't want to use your normal foundation.  I didn't notice the "shimmery" effect about which other reviewers complained.  Overall, I found this product lacking in the wow factor. I confess I'm spoiled because I had a free sample of Kielhl's BB which is AWESOME, but oh-so-pricey! I've been looking for an alternative light-weight tinted moisturizer. While Jouer covers my needs in the interim, I'm going to keep looking.

I love this foundation. Easy to apply, and blend in, I usually go with lighter than Nude because I am very fair skinned but the Nude was just perfect without leaving that line of "girl you need to blend that in"

Its matte enough that if you wanted to skip the powder you freakin can!

SPF 15 and vitamins all in there are also pluses

Having tried a deluxe sample of Jouer's Luminizing Moisture Tint (think a cream bronzer/highlighter/blush depending on which one you get) in the past and really liking it I was really excited to finally try the Matte Moisture Tint. I tend to run in the Light to Fair shade range with neutral undertones so I went with Nude but wow... it is SO yellow!

If the yellow wasn't so bad I would probably like this product. It's lightweight but buildable. Feels great for the coverage you get. I don't think it's an ideal product for oily skin types but for those who run in the combo range it's a good choice. The matte stays great without powder and touch-ups for hours (my skin runs combo, oily T-zone, dry cheeks) on my skin.

I did notice some irritation after all-day wear, my skin can be very reactive and sensitive and I did notice dryness and mild redness in my trouble areas after my first few times wearing it. I would also not recommend this without a strong cleanser (or a Clarisonic brush) afterward, I was having a terrible time using my regular cleanser (Earth tu Face Cleaser is a cleansing oil) to get it off thoroughly.

While it was too yellow for me and I had some minor issues with irritation I would recommend it for non-sensitive skin types who have yellow undertones. I will definitely look into trying other Jouer products too, the quality is nice for the price.

I love tinted moisturizers for the summer, and was excited to try out this one from Jouer since I haven't used any of their products until recently. I've mostly used drugstore TM's, and the ones that have worked best for my oily, 42-year-old skin have been the Pond's Luminous Finish BB Plus Cream with SPF 15, Light Shade, 1.5 Ounce, the Boots brand BB cream, and Neutrogena Healthy Skin EnTancer, Fair ho Light 20, 1 Ounce. This Jouer one leaves a matte base that works well for my skin, but I prefer the Pond's one since it provides more of a "glow" to my skin. Since I do have some dry patches, I do need to use moisturizer under this, but it blends in really well and does a nice job of camouflaging dark spots. It also has nice lasting power, and stays put throughout the day, even on oily skin. The Nude color I got this in is a bit too dark right now for my fair skin (I wear MAC NW15 in foundation), but I'm hoping it will work better once I have a little color from summer. Foundations can be such a personal thing in terms of textures and coverage, so I'd suggest trying this out in person if you can before purchasing it. Overall, though, I really do like the texture and coverage it provides on my skin!

I'm surprised at how much coverage this gives you. I use regular glymed SPF 15 but the hint of color is great as I am not a foundation person. The best part is that it didn't make my sensitive skin break out. I highly recommend you try this!

Jouer Matte Nude is a good match for my skin color and level of moisture.  I usually don't use foundation but have been trying to make more of a habit of it at networking events and professional meetings.  It's sometimes hard to find a good match for my light Asian skin.

I'd attended a Sephora class on Foundations and settled on using Smashbox and Bobbi Brown's BB Cream SPF 35 (Medium) for the color match and the way that they feel on my skin.  The Joure Matte Nude has the same comfortable feel - it doesn't feel like you're wearing foundation but you have the added polish and SPF protection.

I've worn it on bare skin a very warm day in NYC (high 70s) and I didn't look shiny.  I'm very happy with Jouer - I'd tried one of their foundations through one of those beauty boxes and liked it then.  This particular Matte Moisture Tint (Nude) is a particularly good fit for me.
summary: Goes on smooth and light, stays fresh even in hot weather

reviewText:
I tried this on a few different people in addition to myself and came to the conclusion that it is not too great on any of us.

IS IT MOISTURIZING?
The title of this is Matte Moisture Tint, that implies to me that it is moisturizing somewhat.  In applying it to a variety of skin types and ages, I did not find it at all moisturizing.  In fact, it applied sort of like a very lightweight paste.  Every person I put it on made some kind of comment about how dry it felt going on- even the one with normal to oily skin.

COVERAGE
The coverage of this tint is okay in that it evens out skin appearance, that is if you are about 10 feet away. Once you get closer, you can see that it sits on top of the skin.  This tint amplifies facial hair, creases, little lines on skin, and really does not look natural at all.  If you feel old or icky some day, you will probably not feel any better after putting this on.

WEAR
As time went on, despite the lack of complimentary appearance when wearing it, this tint seemed to become a combination of silicone-ish and dry patchy feeling on the skin.  I really didn't like it, and neither did anyone I tried it on.

BOTTOM LINE
Some tints or foundations are better on one type of skin than others, or a particular age group, but this didn't seem to work for anyone I put it on, from teen to mature women.  The idea is good, but the product does not seem to deliver moisture or natural looking tint.
summary: Sits On Top Of Skin - Not Moisturizing

reviewText:
This works much better than most tinted moisturizers I have tried.  It's got as much coverage as a foundation, but it's also moisturizing.  I had been using a British brand commonly found at Target, but this gives much better coverage while still giving me the SPF and moisturizing benefits I need.  Once I used it, I realized that "velvety" really is a perfect descriptor for this.

I even wore it to my Sister-in-law's wedding last week, and her makeup artist even remarked on how good my makeup looked.

I can't understand why this looks as good as it does, since I have a pink complexion with blue undertones, and this one is decidedly orange in undertones, but yet when I put it on it manages to blend and look natural and good.  I feel that my skin looks fresher, more even, and less ghostly than with other foundations that seem at first to be a better match for my skin color.  I love the way it dries to a matte finish after smoothing on.  I do need to wear other makeup with it or I look strange, but this is a great base.

If you are looking for a natural no makeup look, then this is for you.  I have oily/dry skin, and Jour Matte moisture helps place a layer on my face to combat those areas.  It is like a light foundation and moisturizer in one.  You can apply it with your fingers, sponge or brush.  Glides on silky smooth with no drying or caking effects.

Just because it says it is a "Matte" does not mean it will look flat.  It just gives your complexion with a more even tone.  Does not leave you with that heavy feeling foundations tend to feel like.  Since this is what I would consider light/medium coverage, you may still need to use a concealer to hide blemishes. Otherwise, this is by far the best light coverage foundation/moisturizer in one and still have that natural no makeup look.
summary: Am I wearing makeup or not?

reviewText: Great coverage but too drying for me, and my skin is combination. easy too use, but you need to be extremely oily if you want this to be perfect for you.
summary: too drying even for combo skin

reviewText:
At the time I received this moisturizer my skin was very rough due to a bad reaction to another face product I used that left my face so dry that it felt rough. I applied this moisturizer to my face 3 times throughout the day. By the third application the dry rough feel of my skin had diminished significantly. There was a slight firming effect from using this, but smoothing out the roughness of my skin is the real star of this product.

As far as the product itself it has a nice creamy texture and is lightly fragranced. The expiration date on the jar is July 2020. This is one expensive product, but if you are in the market for high-end skin care products, this is a good option.

This review is for the Erno Laszlo Firmarine Moisturizer SPF 30, 1.7 fl. oz.

I think this is one of the first firmers that actually make your skin .... well firmer. I have tried tons of them.

It makes you skin very smooth. You can instantly notice a difference.

There is a very nice slight fragrance. Nothing powerful, as I am very sensitive to smell.
summary: There is a very nice slight fragrance

reviewText: I love this face cream.  It leaves your face supple and soft, not sticky or greasy.  The sunscreen SPF 30 is a huge factor for me, and I'll be using this daily instead of my regular skin care line.

I have been using this as my day cream during the coldest, harshest winter I can remember. It keeps my skin moisturized, and I haven't had issues with chapped or rough looking skin. It has a very mild, pleasant smell (I hesitate to call it a fragrance). It is tinted faintly blue, but it doesn't look blue on your skin. I have very fair, sensitive skin that tends to dryness, and this moisturizer is one of the best I have ever used. It is thicker than most day creams, but I love that as I feel it provides a better barrier against wind and sun.

My top favorite elements of this moisturizer are:
1) Spf 30 - It's difficult to find a daytime moisturizer than can protect me from the sun without my skin breaking out and this one does just that. According to the instructions, it should be applied every two hours but I do not have time for that. I apply in the morning, 30 minutes before heading out and that's that. It has been sufficient for me and I love how my skin feels.
2) There is a flat plastic applicator included so that I don't have to scoop in with my fingers and get product under my nails (which I hate). Very useful.
The smell is faintly reminiscent of the sea but for some reason, after application, I am reminded of wet pavement. It's not .
I have been applying this now for about 2 months on my face, neck, decolletage and hands.  While I do feel super-moisturized and protected, I have yet to notice any firming transformations.
The active ingredients are Avobenzone 3%, Octinoxate 7.5% and Octisalate 5%.

I own several different night creams, but not as many day creams with sunscreen for my morning routine. I was happy to try out this brand and to learn that it not only provides the daily sunscreen I was seeking, but also helps to firms, lift, and nourish my skin. I did notice that it is a bit thicker like sunscreen, yet it didn't feel heavy at all, and absorbed well into my skin. My make up went over smoothly and my face felt fresh and moisturized without feeling greasy. Happy with this product so far.
summary: I was happy to try out this brand and to learn that ...

reviewText: This stuff is only just ok.  It does a fine job moisturizing, and assuming that the SPF protection is not overrated, offers some decent skin protection.  It has almost no odor, which is a huge plus.  But, it leaves behind a greasy shiny surface, that is really annoying if you do not want to walk around looking the like a shining glistening beacon.

Where I live it's very important to have a good moisturizer since we have winter at least 6 months a year. This can be terribly drying to ones face and skin. I am a huge fan of this Erno Laszio Moisturizer. It has a blue tint, not much of a smell so I didn't develop a headache after using it. Didn't make my sensitive face break out either. It is a little thing but a little of it goes a long way so I feel it'll last me a long time. I don't know if I can vouch for the firming properties of this face lotion because I didn't notice much of a difference. However, I certainly love how serious of a moisturizer this is and would totally recommend this to anyone looking for help during the drying winter months.

This is a sunscreen before it is a moisturizer. It absolutely has the feel and scent of a sunscreen and lays on the face like a sunscreen rather than a moisturizer. The active ingredients in it are sunscreen agents, so that tells you something right there.

There's no way I would use or recommend this as an everyday moisturizer or firming moisturizer. As a sunscreen for summer or sunny months, it is fine and may have some skin improving properties on top of being a sunscreen. For everyday, year round use, I cant see using it. It has the heavy feel and texture of a sunscreen and the same sort of layer on the skin, rather than absorbing into the skin like a moisturizer should. It also has the same slightly greasy/slick feel that a sunscreen does.... because it is a sunscreen.

I think it would be much better marketed as a sunscreen rather than a moisturizer which has sunscreen in it. Again, go right back to the ingredients and see for yourself - the active ingredients are sunscreens. Then there is a list of inactive ingredients which are a combination of typical moisturizer ingredients as well as other ingredients found in sunscreens.
summary: It is a sunscreen before it is a moisturizer

reviewText: This moisturizer has a strong scent, which I cannot have in any face products, so I've been using it on my body. I've never had dry skin before, but now that I've reached a "certain age," I guess those days are over. It's winter, we have forced air heat, and I'm itchy all over. Been using this thick cream for a few weeks now and my skin is MUCH more comfortable. It has a sunscreen in it, which I obviously don't need on my (covered up) body, but it's always good to have in a face cream.

I was very pleased with this face cream.  I have severely dry skin in the winter, and often times moisturizers (even nice ones) tend to ball up when you rub them in and contain mostly water - so they evaporate fast and don't provide a lot of benefit.

This cream is THICK.  It looks opaque coming out of the jar and you barely need a fingertip full to apply over your entire face.  I love that, because it means I won't go through the entire pot in a week.  It has a distinctive smell, but I didn't mind it at all.  Most of the ones I really dislike have a sugary floral smell and this was more like a chemical/botanical smell.  It goes away after a minute or two.

The sunscreen is excellent.  As I get older it becomes more of a priority to me to protect my skin whenever I get the chance.  I can sunscreen my face and neck area fully with this cream, with no stickiness or residue getting on my clothes.

I'm not sure whether this has any actual anti-aging properties because that tends to be hard to confirm.  What I can confirm is that this is a heavy, smooth-applying cream that lasts and keeps moisture in through the day.
summary: Great coverage and texture, lasts all day

reviewText: I was excited to receive this product, since it is in the "luxury beauty" section of Amazon. Well, my experience with this cream has been lackluster. For the price point I was hoping for some real, measurable results. I prefer to wear my workhorse moisturizers at night, since that is the optimal time for these products to work, but this has a spf 30 if you would prefer to wear it during the day instead. The cream is thick, with barely a fragrance, and it soaks into the skin pretty quickly. I also noticed that when worn under makeup, it gave my skin, especially the eye area, a sheen that looked as if I were wearing highlighter. So that was a nice added touch. As for performance, I really didn't notice a difference in my skin during or after wearing this. I was putting this on nearly 40 skin, but maybe it would have more of an effect on mature skin. As far as presentation goes, the container is fancy looking, and it comes with a little black spatula. This product might be better suited to someone 50+.

This worked well as a moisturizer but I didn't notice any firming effects. It smells like straight up sun  screen, which I don't care for. The sunscreen component works well. I applied it in the morning and spent a few hours that afternoon outside in the sun. I have extremely fair skin and I didn't get any color at all. I think you can find less expensive moisturizers that work just as well as this one.

This is some pretty awesome moisture cream.  You can tell immediately that it is some top of the line product.  It is so creamy and luxurious.  It takes so very little of the cream to get a great result.  It feels like melted silk going onto my skin.  I have been using it now for almost a week and I swear I can already tell a difference in how soft my face is.

This is a very moisturize facial cream and is perfect for dry winter. The texture is very creamy, looks greasy on face in the beginning but it is absorbed in skin after few minutes. It keeps my face moisturized all day. The fragrance is fruity and blossom and I really enjoys it every morning. It has no obvious effect on tightening my face after using it for two weeks, but I would give it more time. Giving it 4 stars but not 5 because the price is a little bit high. Its overall a good facial cream but I would not buy it again unless I have extra budget.

I live in a very humid part of Texas, and during a majority of months, my facial skin does not show its age.  Come late Fall and Winter it's a much different story.  I look in the mirror and am startled by the surface texture.  And, no matter what night cream I used, the almost burning sensation from my dry skin was a problem.  This new product from Erno Laszlo gives me immediate relief in the morning and has been protecting me all day long.

I dab on a minimal amount, (probably less than what's called for in the instructions), and it soaks in almost immediately.  By the time I've unscrewed the cap of my foundation, this moisturizer has soaked in and my skin is ready for the color.  It is amazing how quickly my skin texture goes from that dry morning leathery look, to fresh, bright and plumped out.  It's easier to apply my foundation, too.

It is not at all greasy.  It goes on white (due to the sunscreen in it), but the opaqueness disappears immediately.  I usually break out from using a new moisturizer, but that was never a problem with this.  My skin is totally free of blemishes, and that is rare.

It has a slight, very pleasant fragrance that is not lasting.  It seems a bit lemony.
summary: Greatly improves skin texture in dry weather

reviewText:
I have tried Erno Laszlo products in the past and still use them regularly, so was excited to try their moisturizer. This was packaged beautifully (see pictures.) The cream smells very nice, no overpowering scents- just a nice clean scent. I applied it to clean skin each morning under makeup, and each evening on clean skin for the past two weeks. It is easy to apply, soaks into skin and is non-greasy. It feels light and silky on the skin. After two weeks, I can tell my skin feels younger, firmer and more dewy. I especially like that it has a sunscreen in it to protect the skin from the aging effects of the sun.
Erno Laszlo makes high end quality products. I would not hesitate to recommend any of his skin care products.
summary: Makes skin feel younger and firmer

reviewText:
Some of the features are as follows:-
1) It is very soft and creamy to apply.
2) The fragrance is mild and nice.
3) It absorbs to the skin quickly after applying.
4) It moisturizes and nourishes the skin well.
5) It removes the dryness and hydrates the skin to make it look fresh.
6) I am impressed with the product. My skin feels softer after each use.

reviewText:
Erno Laszio's moisturizer is rich, smells pleasant, and has SPF, which is hard to come by in expensive facial lotions.

The lotion comes in a large plastic bottle with a screw top lid.  The bottle is a lot bigger that the lotion that it contains, and at 1.7 ounces, it is not much.  Thankfully, the lotion is very thick and a little bit goes a long way.  It keeps my combination (dry cheeks and temples, and an oily t-zone) sensitive skin smooth and moisturized throughout the day.  The lotion has a slight fragrance that reminds me of cold creme.  The scent dissipates almost instantly so it won't interfere with any other perfumes that you may wear.  The lotion absorbs instantly and does not leave behind a sheen or greasy feeling.  It did not cause me any allergic reactions.

All in all... great daily facial moisturizer.

A very rich, creamy (but not greasy) cream that protects against sunburn with an SPF of 30.
They say it's firming, but I am not so sure my face looked any firmer.
Actually, I liked their night cream better.

I'm old and wrinkled, so don't expect miracles to come in moisturizer jars, even the high end ones.  And this is most certainly a high end product.  Having said that, I love the way it makes my skin feel, even if I am not magically transported into the face of a 28-year old.  This is a thick cream, so a little bit goes a long way.  I like that is is SPF 30, so unless I'm spending a lot of time in the sun, this gives me some protection. It works well under foundation.  To me, the scent is light and pleasant.

Is this worth that price tag?  As much as I like it, it isn't to me.  Perhaps if your skin is younger and more amenable to improvement, it might be.  And I really like this product but it doesn't give me the firming I hoped for.
summary: Very Nice Moisturizer, Doesn't Quite Live Up to Hype for Old Skin

reviewText: This moisturizer is pretty good. I don't wear products like this daily, just when I feel like my skin is dry. With the weather cooling down I've been needing a moisturizer more frequently and this works well. It's rather thick, it's not a little goes a long way product, but I've been able to stretch it by warming it in my hands before applying it. It has a moderately strong scent which isn't unpleasant but I find myself wishing it was unscented.

I've tried both the day and night cream. I like the day cream better, and like the SPF 30. However, I don't feel like this moisturizer offers anything special to justify the cost.  It goes on light and provides moisture, but I can get the same results from the Neutrogena Day Cream.  It just doesn't offer any special.
summary: It's Okay, But Doesn't Offer Anything Extra That A Lower Priced Brands Doesn't Offer

reviewText: Ive tried many moisturizers recently and this has become my favorite I only wish it was scentless even though the smell is minimal and fades soon after applying the product.  This moisturizer is thicker than most other products Ive tried and I like the way it goes on.  It stays in place and sinks into the. Skin more thoroughly though, because of its thickness, I know Im using more than I have of other creams.  My only complaint is if it gets too close to my eyes its irritating so Im conscious of the need to be vigilant it how close to the eye I apply it.

reviewText:
This moisturizer is really nice--it is thick (can leave white streaks if you're not careful) and stays put all day long.
The smell is strong--a eucalyptus smell to me--but not overpowering.
I have been using it for a few weeks and don't notice any difference in my skin's firmness.  I have had no irritation.
I like the SPF protection.  I have spent hours outdoors and had no sun damage.
I have used it on my hands, too, and like the way it moisturizes my overworked skin.
summary: Nice scent, thick and long-lasting moisturizer, not great in the firming-department, though.

reviewText:
My wife raves about this quite expensive moisturizer. I tried it and see why it's relatively expensive. It's active ingredients are octinoxate, octisalate and avobenzone. These chemicals cover separate functions and are mixed with stabilizers and other ingredients. Octinoxate is often used as a UV filter to protect other ingredients from degrading in certain conditions and is used in many skincare products. Octisalate is a skin penetrator and it also stabilizes avobenzone. Avobenzone absorbs the full spectrum of UVA rays. I used a little bit on my face.

What I noticed is my facial skin felt tighter. And my skin felt moisturized at the same time. One doesn't usually experience tightness with so much moisturizing effect. I can see why she makes a big deal about it.

I am really enjoying this.  It doesn't have the titanium compound smell that every SPF rated lotion contains.  It keeps the skin really moist and soft.  It doesn't irritate my eyes or cause any itching.  Very good quality.  The scent is very soft and light.  This jar goes a long way.
summary: Very good quality. The scent is very soft and light

reviewText: This moisturizer is quite pleasant and fragrant.  It is a little thick going on, but absorbs nicely.  It leaves your skin feeling fresh and is not heavy, nor seem to clog your pores.  I will continue to use it.  However, I must point out that I reviewed another similar product on Vine.  I got immediate and ongoing results, and I have continued to purchase this other  product.  I know it is not reasonable to expect immediate results, but it did happen.  I will definitely continue to use the other product since it is less expensive and works better for me.  Perhaps If I had not been introduced to the first product, I could be more enthusiastic now.  Therefore, I rate it a four.

reviewText:
I recieved the color AAL, upon opening I immediately decide I wasn't a fan of the packaging or the look of the tube. Small but bulky? The lipstick has that classic lipstick smell, and the color looks like it could be okay.

Wrong. AAL is VERY orange which does not work with my tanned olive skin tone at all, but if you're looking for a solid orangy color -- this might be it,

It's great that Amazon is picking up international beauty brands that are hard to get otherwise. Uslu Airlines is a German brand that is best known for their airbrush makeup, and used to be hard to get in the US. The thing with lipstick colors, though, is that because it's not like you can run by Sephora or Ulta and test these brands before buying online, Amazon needs to figure out a much better way to help customers choose cosmetics without fear of wasting money on the wrong shade.

This is a perfect example of the problem. It really depends on what monitor or display you're using as to how the shade appears on your screen. Moreover, it depends on how accurate the color correction was on the original photo. I checked out Uslu's website, and their images were no more helpful. When it first arrived, the AAL shade in the tube looked nothing like either of the photos shown here--it was a cooler pink that, try as I might, I couldn't get an accurate photo of, even using a light box. I may try taking another photo in natural light later. Nevertheless, the image shade here looks different on different screens in my house. On some, it looks more accurate; on others, it looks nothing like the actual product. (In a perfect online cosmetics world, companies would include a few different shots of the actual product on actual lips for each color!)

However, I'll do my best to describe the shade when you put it on. This is a sheer color, but is the oddest sheer I've ever tested. It goes on with almost a gloss/moisturizer feel, yet deposits more opaque, high-value [color w/ more white in it] peach pigments in the grooves of your skin in a very weird-looking way. Not pretty. Uslu's lipstick is meant to be somewhat sheer with a single application, but with the potential to be built up by applied layers to a more pigmented, dense look. In the case of this shade, though, that single layer does *not* work for a sheer look (unless you just want to use it more as a tinted moisturizer and rub your lips together). You can definitely build this up to a sort of 60's pale high-value peachy-pink look, but it's a bit too moist and shiny to really stay in place. Definitely not a good shade for my coloring, but if you're Caucasian and fair, this will complement you.

Bottom line: If the formula is the same for all shades, I'd see this product as a great, moisturizing sheer lipstick and go for the darker shades to match the tone of your skin. But if you're looking for a darker or more saturated (or matte) look, I'm not sure this would be the best pick, nor will you probably get the exact shade you're seeing on the screen.

A few minor things: I agree with the other reviewers--the case is awesome (yay German design!). Also, I may just be more sensitive than most, but this definitely wasn't tasteless. There's certainly a subtle typical plasticky lipstick taste when you first apply it, but it's not terrible and dissipates. There's no added artificial parfum or flavor to the formula, so that's what you get. Lastly, I can't go without giving Uslu products props for being cruelty-free. Say no to animal testing!
summary: Goes on strange in this shade

reviewText: I received this lipstick to review. Unfortunately, I was not able to choose the color I would have liked. I got AAL which is kind of a peachy color, and even though I don't love this particular color, I do love everything else about it. It is very creamy and goes on smoothly. It stays in place and doesn't smudge easily. There is no taste or smell and I really like the tube that it comes in. It's isn't hard and slippery like other lipstick tubes. I don't wear lipstick very often, but when I do, I don't like to have to worry about it. This lipstick is one of the nicer lipsticks I have tried.
pretty good.  Doesn't foam as much as they say though, be aware if you like the foam.
