The only negative is the price, but I will buy this soap again.
I started with Jack Black because of their lip balm, but I am becoming more of a Jack Black "snob" with all of my grooming products.

I have recently switched from Kiehls to Jack Black as I use many other Jack Black products and Nordstroms carries the Jack Black Soap so easy to purchase.  The Jack Black is a slightly smaller bar than Kiehls and it seems to not last as long.  However the Jack Black smell is much better.  Also I like Jack Black as it does a good job scrubbing where the Kiehls soap is like using sandpaper on my body and it can actually be painful at times.  All in all I prefer the Jack Black scent and level of scurb.  Will continue to use Jack Black as an alternative to the Jack Black Bodywash that I use several times a week.
summary: Smells Great Does Not Scrub As Well As Kiehls Scrub Soap

reviewText: Jack Black makes some legit products. I love the smell of this soap. It is a scrubbing soap so keep in mind...that's what it does. It's kind of rough so it can scrub yo body to cleanliness.

I have been using this product for about a week now, and I believe that is enough to provide my opinion for this specific "soap bar". The scent of this bar is not something that I find to be that good. I don't really even know what to compare the scent to as it is something that I have never experienced before. It is very strong and isn't very masculine at all. I would never leave the house without putting on something to mask the scent. This bar will last a different amount of time for nearly everyone. If you shower under the water with this bar expect it to disappear quickly, if you don't, expect it to last longer. Personally, I shower under the water because if I don't I find this bar to really "drag" with resistance and it's very uncomfortable. The little specs on the bar do a fairly good job of exfoliating, but this will dry your skin out. I found my skin to feel on par with the common "hotel experience". By this I mean that sticky feeling you get when you shower at hotels with hard water and cheap soap bars. This feeling disappears after you dry off, then the dryness hits you like a brick. I experienced the itching and tightness on my back, and it was very uncomfortable. Ultimately, I will not purchase this soap bar again because I highly doubt it will even last me a month, it feels like a cheap soap after rinsing off, it dries you out, and it only exfoliates decently at best. With the huge market of products out there it is very difficult to find ones that really impress you, this is one of those products that you simply mark off the list to try. Not worth it!
summary: $15 bar is on par with cheap hotel soap

reviewText: I got this for hubby but then stole it to use for myself.  Haha.  Great for shaving legs.  A little of this stuff goes a long way and in the world of shaving creams, I think this is the cream de la cream!

Let me start by saying all of the Proraso creams are excellent. They lather so easily! I have been partial to Proraso white; decided to give this one a spin. The blue is the best in Proraso's lineup of creams...and that is saying something. Gobs of pillowy lather with just a dime size dollop in your shave bowl or smeared around your wet beard if you prefer face lathering. Fresh, clean, pleasant scent. Face is smooth and soft all day due to the aloe in the cream. Rinses clean with no residue left on your face. I find no need for any aftershave. Just buy it and get your shave on!
If you use enough of it, it does a great job.

UPDATE: the "hard to describe" scent... I've been growing tarragon lately and perhaps there's a similarity.

Proraso White soap was the first real shaving product I tried - about 3 years ago, right when I quit the razor cartridges for good and switched to double edge safety razors and straight edge. That remains my favorite scent and it motivated me to try other Proraso products and other soaps.

I have about every Proraso product at this point and their soaps and creams perform very similar to me (good), so other than that it's mostly about scent.

I was hesitatnt to try Proraso Blue, in fact it was the last "color" I tried. Probably because nobody could describe the scent. Some have said it's "licorice". I finally ordered a sample from Maggards and I disagree. This does NOT smell like Ouzo or Italian Sausage, in other words like anise, licorice or fennel (all similar scents). It does not smell like ivory soap (to me). It's hard to describe, but it is very pleasant. Like the rest of Proraso soaps/creams it is both classy and old fashioned, yet without being stuffy or old-geezery. Not cheap smelling. Just very pleasant. Maybe in the vicinity of violets, lavender... but not really :)

While Proraso Green is great for summer and Red - for cold weather, I find the Blue and White to be somewhat neutral in that regard - great any time.

I like it for the price, and love the fragrance, but it really bums me out that there's no preshave, no soap in a tub and no splash for this. The scent doesn't linger on its own, but I sure wish it did! It won't clash with any fragrance you wear afterwards. I like that the balm smells about the same, but again, doesn't linger. If you applied the Proraso Green aftershave splash, it would work ok, would not clash.

I really HATE that Proraso changed their labels with the color of Italian flag. Not because it's the flag, but because it made some of the products hard to differentiate. The stripes are supposed to be like those on a barber pole. But I only see that on Amazon pics, not the products I received.
summary: Proraso Blue, lovely scent! Where's the preshave? Where's the soap in a tub? Where's the splash? Hm? :)

reviewText: I'm a fan of the Proraso products great performance and value.

I had been using Van Der Hagen soap for the last few months, until our hard water made it too difficult to get a good lather.  Of course, that's not really Van Der Hagen's fault.  I decided to go for a cream because they stand-up better in hard water.  I wasn't expecting much.  I put a dab of cream on my brush and whipped it around for a bit.  HOLY SANTA CLAUSE BEARD! This lather is awesome!

The scent is a really different.  I can't really explain it.  It almost smells like an Almond Joy candy bar.  It actually complements the Nivea after shave really well.  It has a nice subtle menthol feel to it.  It's nice and slick and I was able to get an awesome shave.  My face felt smooth and it smelled really good.  The wife loves it.  Two thumbs-up for me.

First, the tube ended up ripping, causing the cream to leak. I only got three shaves or so before it ripped and I was forced to discard it. I am thankful for this mishap -- I ended up trying some US-made artisan shaving products, which have worked much better for me. I admire the tradition behind Proraso, but I am convinced the cream's prevalence of preservatives -- something my new artisan-made products do not contain -- caused me irritation and redness. Proraso is a cost-effective option if your skin is neither sensitive nor prone to drying. For my sensitive skin, however, this was not conducive to a good shave. The cream dried my skin out, caused me irritation, and did not properly lubricate my face so that I might easily cut my thick, coarse facial hair. Clean, subtle scent. But I will never buy this again.

My husband loves this shaving cream and has tried every brand you can possibly think of. He smells so good and his face is so smooth after shaving with Proraso, I call it a girls best friend! He really liked Cremo till he tried Proraso. The only problem was deciding on which fragrance to choose. Problem solved, we got them all and honestly love all of them equally and would have a difficult time choosing which one we like best. I use the menthol one myself, it's a girl or guy fragrance and I'm a girl! This is a really excellent product, it lasts a very long time too and if he's going to be smooth for me shouldn't I return the favor! He loved the aftershave lotion too.
summary: Guys, use this for your girl she will love the way you smell and feel!

reviewText: Does a very good job, especially when used in conjunction with Proraso pre-shave and after-shave. I use all four flavors: green, white, blue, and red. Spice is the variety of life and I enjoy rotating through different products and experiencing what each has to offer. Buy Proraso products with confidence.

I think it's the mildest Proraso cream.  The scent is fine.  I think I may get an easier shave with the other Proraso creams, but I'm not sure if it was me, or just because it was blue.  I really like the sandlewood, but they don't have pre-shave products in sandlewood and it sucks to mix.

Creates the best lather I have ever had with shaving cream.  Before I was using the Art of Shaving's products which are good but are not cheap.  This thing is way cheaper and I get a much better lather which makes it easier to apply with the Badger Hair brush.  I mix it with a little water and about a quarter size drop of cream in a ramekin and it is more than enough for the 3 passes of shaving that I do.  I am using the Merkur Safety Razor and Personna blades.

I also apply the Proraso pre-shaving cream from this as I love the cooling effect and keeps razor burn to a minimum.  There is no magic product out there (except the alum bar) that I have found for my razor burn but using this product for 1 week I notice a big difference and less irritation.  Hopefully it will all go away in the near future but its looking better than any other product
summary: Best Lather, great price, easy to use, helps with razor rash

reviewText:
I ordered this in error, must have had a brain blip as I wanted the 'regular" menthol (green) cream. I was disappointed that the scent was so mild, but the shave results were what I usually expect from Proraso, excellent.  I use Proraso with a Panasonic electric wet razor. The combination of using the electric (when wet) with the Proraso cream produces an incredible amount of lather. The key is to keep the cream moist and by rinsing the electric frequently ` the lather whips up beautifully.  At times there is more lather on my face after the shave than when I began - that's how voluminous this product can be. I agree with another poster who said the shave doesn't feel as invigorating as the menthol, but then again, the formula is not designed for that. My skin was nice and smooth and this formula did a good job.

So, if you want a soothing shave result without a noticeable scent (as compared to the menthol) this is the product to get.

Vito

I'm new to wet shaving, but this stuff is very easy to work with.  Easier than a soap, in my opinion.  Soak your brush and get your mug/bowl warm, and slowly add water as you lather this stuff up.  Smells great, and has some good stuff in it for your skin.  It seems like one tube will go a long way
Excellent!
Have to have my Obagi!  Have been using the Obagi system for two years now--wish I had started much sooner.  Skin looks smoother, more radiant.
summary: Have to have my Obagi! Have been using the ...

reviewText: best product ever

Though I like quite a few of the Obagi products. . .  First, of course, is the crazy expensive price.  I know that this is just par-for-the-course with Obagi, but still.  What I really don't like about it is the fact that it does not absorb. . . at all.  It just sits on your face.  It feels a bit like paste.  I also don't care for the pump container.  As with all such containers, every now-and-then, you get a chunk.  I would prefer a tube.

Moisturizer works great. I have oily skin so I am careful about the kind of moisturizers I use but I wanted to give this one a try and I am glad I did. It leaves my face feeling smooth and hydrated but not oily and slick like many other moisturizers have done in the past. I also really like the nice light smell of this moisturizer. I don't like things that have a harsh smell and this one is pleasant and makes me want to use it more. Over all a great moisturizer for oily skin and I really like it.
nicee!!

I was using premier designer face/skin care especially for moisturizers but they all left me dry throughout the midday. After using Obaji, my skin is not flaky towards the end of the day. I also found that it controls my oil in the t-zone area.
summary: I was using premier designer face/skin care especially for moisturizers ...

reviewText: This left my face really shiny, which I am not fond of.  It dissolved into my skin quickly and was definitely hydrating, but I didn't like the shine.  There are other Obagi moisturizers that are matte, but this one is most definitely not: shea butter, avocado, glycerine...  it's too much for my normal-to-oily (with some dry spots) skin.

This is a very good, all purpose day-long facial moisturizing lotion. The product is thick, white lotion neutral in scent and appearance  - and once rubbed into the skin it absorbs easily and efficiently without leaving behind chalky residue. Moisturizing qualities are very good and results are quite apparent when rubbed into dried out skin. The moisture benefits really do hold up quite well and really does last a full day provided you're mostly indoors. It is a costly product so I do recommend trying out a sample first if you're able to get a hold of some.
summary: Effective and long lasting facial moisturizer

reviewText:
This moisturizer is lightweight and blended into my skin very well.  Left it moist and dry at the same time.  I used it under makeup no problems. This lotion did not give me any irritation.

I have fair skin, clear (for the most part) and sensitive.  I am also mid-thirties and female.

I usually use Olay's age defying daily renewal cream, which I love and is a fraction of the cost of this. So I was expecting something amazing out of this one.  Amazingly, it does work great, which says a lot because I usually have tough skin (combination and sensitive.)  This moisturized my skin great without feeling oily or causing any breakouts. It has practically zero scent to it as well, which kind of annoyed me but if you like that, then this is a good option.  The quality of the ingredients is much better than the cheap stuff, that's for sure, and includes shea butter and avocado.

My reason for taking off a star is that it's FIVE TIMES or more the price of my Oil of Olay daytime cream. Hard to swallow that price tag. If you find other lower quality creams are not working out so well for you, then MAYBE this one would be worth it.  Just not for me.
summary: Works great for my oily/dry skin combination; no scent; but just super outlandish price

reviewText:
For a week and a half, I used this as my sole moisturizer. I paired it with the Obagi foaming gel (https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00F6XZNOO), and some Vitamin C serum, but avoided all my other products in order to see what this stuff really does.

Like most face products, any directions given are mostly useless. In the morning and evening or as needed. Really, no kidding. How much should I use? No clue. So for about a week I used a full pump, then it seemed that might take me through the bottle too quick, so I cut back to about half that.
I used it every morning and every night, but Im going to stop that. Ill use it every other night or maybe just a couple times a week to refresh my skin.

First, I didn't break out at all. Normally I do when I switch face products. So thats a plus!
Second, this stuff does FEEL hydrating. My face seemed to like it. I don't notice any particular softness but I also didn't dry out. Its not greasy.
I didn't notice any particular improvement in my skin condition, but also it didn't hurt at all.

So 4-stars?
Well, I THINK it does what it claims, which is simple. Hydrate = Check!
But all the ingredients make for an odd smell. Its not scented, it just has a sort of buttery/flour-like smell. It definitely applies like a shea butter, really smooth and soft. So, I took out a star for the smell.

Also, there seem to be a lot of reviews that mention Obagi or Obaji. Those are two different names, so Im not sure if that has something to do with it, but there are also several people who have used Obagi from doctors offices and say this is different. Currently, this item is showing as Unavailable on Amazon, with no distributor.

So it seems the court is still in session on this one.
summary: Moisturizing and Gentle, Not for Everyday

reviewText: My wife and daughter have been using Obagi products. This moisturizer is a nice, lightweight, everyday moisturizer for any skin type.  It has a very mild scent that does not linger.  It is concentrated, and you only need a little for the entire face.  1.7 ounces doesnt sound like a lot of product, but only a little is needed, and at this rate, it will take several months to go through the whole bottle  The only reason for 5 stars was because of the price.  Very nice, high-quality product!

This moisturizer is a bit heavier and creamier than the Oil of Olay product I've been using, but it's not greasy and I don't think it's too much for my combination dry/oily skin. My foundation goes over it easily. My skin feels soft, which is especially nice when I put it on at night. While the list of ingredients includes some chemicals with jaw-breaker names, it also includes shea butter, mango butter, avocado and glycerin. The scent is light to non-existent. It's more expensive than many other moisturizers, but I think you get what you pay for in this instance.

I don't get it.  I have two Obagi moisturizers and I love one and can't use the other.  The one I love is this one -- [[ASIN:B01M0EP9EM Obagi CLENZIderm M.D. Therapeutic Moisturizer Glycerin 20% Skin Protectant].  It's great. No tack feeling and my skin adores it.

This Hydrate formula feels uncomfortable and burny.  At first I thought maybe my skin was just super dry so I waited and used the other Obagi moisturizer and waited.  I've tried 3 times to use it over the last month, with days and weeks in between each use and the same thing happens.  I end up rushing off to wash it off and apply a thick layer of heavy lotion to neutralize the effect.

I should add that I have very sensitive skin and this even burns the inside of my elbows when I tested it there. No obvious allergic reactions.  I also got my husband to finally try it and he said it prickled the moment it dripped onto his skin.

My wife has tried using the moisturizer in dry patches of her face next to her nose.  Her first comment was the lack of scent which was a positive since it was so proximate to the nose.  After the first application she remarked the skin felt softer in just a few minutes.  It is not something that lasted overnight.  For the past several days she has applied it when first arising in the morning, and then when she is going to bed at night.  The dry patches seem to be less troublesome after about a week of use.

Hopefully, this will continue he help her and the effects will be longer lasting.  Currently she says it feels less dry for about an hour or so.
summary: Does work to alleviate some dry patches, but we aren't sure of the longevity of each treatment

reviewText: I have tried many moisturizers. In addition, I don't know how this one differs from the ones in a doctor's office. Yet, if it is the same than I would be upset. The smell is a little off-putting. Not that it is a strong smell. I thought because this cream was thick that it would not go on smooth but it did. What I was very disappointed in this moisturizer is that it did not give me the hydration that I wanted. It felt like halfway through the day if at that I needed to put more on as my face was dry. In fact, I used this after recovering from a cold and a sore nose that had been peeling due to lots of blowing. It did not sting, so that was good but my nose was still dry. I went and put a different moisturizer on top of this one to give me the hydration I was looking for.

My wife loves this moisturizer because it does not cause her to break out after using it regularly - she has pretty dry skin. Another plus is that the moisturizer is not greasy or messy. All in all, this is a great moisturizer.

I never thought I would enjoy testing out these beauty products, I am a wash and lotion with SPF only guy. This Hydrate facial moisturizer works well per my wife, she did find it a bit on the heavy side. For me, I put on just a little bit and it does make my skin feel smooth, the only issue I have is it has a bad smell, maybe its just the raw product smell with no artificial fragrance added, but I didn't like the smell. I did tough it out and my face did feel smoother. Other than the smell, my wife and I find this a good moisturizer.
summary: Has a bad smell, but it works well

reviewText: I use this facial moisturizer for daytime skin care.  This product comes with a pump and the 1.7 oz size guarantees 304 months of use if used daily.  I absolutely love the ingredients which are perfect for moisturizing skin in a harsh climates with too much heat or too much cold.  Ingredients lnclude: glycerin, caprylic/capric triglyceride, shea butter, stearic acid, glycine soja (soybean) sterols, avocado oil and mango seed butter.  I combine this moisturizer with Obagi's Hydrate Luxe Moisture Rich cream at night for PM skin care which has similar products but more moisture since it is a cream not a lotion.  It is important to mention that this moisturizer dies not have SPF so I apply Obagi sunscreen cream on my face for protection from harmful UV rays.  This lotion is lightweight and will not clog pores.  It is suitable for all skin types and it retains moisture for prolonged periods of time (up to 8 hours).  IT is not tinted so one can use tinted SPF or powder/bronzer for more color on the face.
summary: Light pump up moisturizer bottle for all skin types

reviewText:
This is a good all-purpose facial moisturizer that can be used daily. It did a good job of keeping my face moist throughout the day.

The scent is very subtle but kind of earthy. It won't be to everyone's taste, but it didn't bother me.

The moisturizer comes out of a pump which means you won't use too much. The price is a bit too high for me to buy on a regular basis. Still, it should last a while, and I am happy with it.

Winter has always been rough on my skin drying it out, but for some reason it seems to be very worse this year, even my usual moisturizer does not help that much as my forehead and the back of my neck feels more reptilian than human.  So I have been looking for an upgrade in the moisturizer department and this more than fits the bill.  I notice a smoother skin after one use and is back to normal by the second use.  The smell is mostly generic cream smell, but it fade away quit quickly despite being applied right by the nose.  The bottle show last well past this winter.

Although it should be an odorless scent, I couldn't stand the smell. I ended up stopping usage after 3 days. The results were just ok, I didn't see a difference on my dry skin. The scent reminded me of when you first open a new plastic product. That fresh plastic scent. Unfortunately, for me it was a bit too overpowering for me. The scent got weaker the longer I work the lotion, but I still did not like smelling it at all. It didn't help that the lotion was on my face so near to my nose. Overall, despite my abhorrence for the scent, it was basically just a regular lotion, better than most over the counter lotions but not worth paying the full amount of this product.
summary: but I still did not like smelling it at all

reviewText:
Obagi Hydrate Facial Moisturizer does hydrate for 8 hours. It is also very concentrated, so a little goes a long way.
My problem with this Moisturizer is that the only time I can use it is right before bedtime.
It does not absorb readily and I wear glasses, which were constantly smeared because I would inadvertently touch my face then my glasses would get smeared when I adjusted them. It did not cause any skin sensitivity, or a reaction and in the morning my face is smoother.

My face didn't seem to like this moisturizer. I started breaking out a bit a few days after using it. The scent isn't all that great either. However, it does moisturize very well. My skin is oily, so I'm fairly sensitive to moisturizing products. I'm just a not a big fan of this smell.

Overall: 3/5 stars
summary: I prefer Olay, the Obagi smells and my skin started to break out a bit

reviewText:
This moisturizer works every bit as well as my usual moisturizer, Lancome Beinfat. I've been hearing about how wonderfully well this product works for years from friends of mine who have gotten it from their dermatologists, so I was eager to give it a try.

There is very little odor to this moisturizer, thank heavens, as I have had to get up and wash my face in the middle of the night because of the cloying odor of other moisturizers I used.  It goes on smoothly and leaves a non-oily matte finish, making it the perfect primer for foundation or wearing without any makeup at all.  I have older skin which is a combination of oily and dry, with the classic T-Zone of oiliness. This product seemed to keep down the oil while hydrating the dry areas. Just right!

My only concern with this product is the warning on the bottle to keep it away from your eyes and away from children. It's kind of hard to put on a facial moisturizer without getting it in your eyes, but I put it on very carefully, then use a specific eye moisturizer afterward.  Plus, it's a little pricey, but not too bad considering what other high-end moisturizers go for.

All in all, I like this product, it works well for my older, sensitive, combination skin. A solid four stars.

Hydrates, Protects And Seals In Moisture All Day

This is more like a cream than lotion, easily dispensed from the container. No dipping fingers in a jar and contaminating the product. This cream hydrates, adds moisture and seals it in all day long. You can feel its on your skin but it isn't bothersome in weight or smell. It's nice under makeup or stand-alone.  It's great for my Colorado cold winter so my skin isn't dried out and prune-y. I would purchase this item when it runs out
summary: Hydrates, Protects And Seals In Moisture All Day

reviewText: This moisturizer absorbs nicely and leaves my skin feeling smooth.  I have a tendency to break out with some facial creams and fortunately this moisturizer doesn't cause any problem with my skin.  At this point in my life I have some very oily places and very dry places on my face and I like the fact that I get the moisture I need in the right places, without making the oilier places worse.  Overall, it is great product that goes on well, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin soft.

This product is so thick it feels more like a body lotion than a facial moisturizer.  It is odorless, except for a slightly off odor, like it's old.  The bottle is dated 2012, but there is no expiration date.

The list of ingredients include shea butter and mango butter.  That probably explains the thickness of the product.

This 1.7 ounce pump style container will not last long as it's simply not a large amount of product.  It's called "Hydrate" but I don't see how all these heavy butters and gums can hydrate my face.  It feels like a lotion one should put on their skin when out in the sun, but not something to use as a facial moisturizer.

So I don't like the consistency, and really do not care for the odd odor.

I don't like it.

I really like the Obagi Hydrate Facial Moisturizer. It has a light, pleasant sent and is not greasy or oily on my face. I have oily skin and this moisturizer works very well on my face without adding any oily ingredients.  I use it after every shower and every evening before going to bed.
Arrived on time and as expected!
summary: Great for very Dry skin and doesnt cause break outs

reviewText: Use with obagi serum C 10% for sensitive skin types.  Wonderful product for really dry sensitive skin that flakes and cracks.  Does a good job with rosacea too!  NO Pain!
Came on time and worked fine
Anything by Obagi is very nice.  I am 59 and have young skin because I take care of it with products like these.
I had heard good things about Obagi but have not been that impressed.  For this price, it was fine. The moisturizer is not greasy but I will not continue with this product.
If you are looking for the best moisturizer, that feels natural not greasy, this should be your choice! I love It!

Since I live in a desert environment, I need a good moisturizer cream. Obaji Hydrate facial moisturizer is the best for my dry skin. I use it morning and night.
I will continue purchasing this product unless Obaji brings a better Hydrate moisturizer on the market. It is hard to say they can improve this item.

I was on the Obagi Nuderm system for a year and it worked WONDERS on my age spotted sun worshipped
skin but when I learned recently about parabens, which are lab made preservatives that have been
found in breast cancer tumors, etc, I threw all of it out.  I needed to take a break from the Nuderm
system anyways and my skin was where it needed to be.

My friend, whom I introduced Obagi to, got this Hydrate from her aesthetician's office and told me
that it was paraben free! She loves it so I thought I'd give it a try on the evenings sunscreen isn't
needed and to alleviate my dry chin and mouth area. I bought it here on Amazon and saved $12 instead
of buying it at my dermatologists office! YEs!!!!

I have used it about 3-4 times and I used it last night and I woke up this morning and the skin around
my mouth and chin was flaky. Unsure if it this is meant to be just an "as-needed" spot treatment for dryness
instead of as a night cream. This does go on silky though and it reminds me of how those
dymethicone products feel. It has no scent which I am very glad about. And I have not tried to wear it in the
morning/daytime because I wear an spf 30 under my tinted moisturizer.

I am currently on Image Skincare products and love it but some of my sun spots have come back even though
I do use spf 30 every single day so I want to eventually go back to the Obagi Nuderm line but I refuse
to until they make the entire line paraben free. (not only are parabens found in paraben users breast and

as 4 yr olds!!).

PLEASE OBAGI FOLLOW WHAT YOU DID WITH THIS PRODUCT AND MAKE ALL OF YOUR LINE PARABEN FREE!

I am so happy to purchase this high quality moisture cream. Obagi is my favorite skin care line.
Wonderful service by seller and the price is sooo great!
summary: TOP OF THE SKIN CARE PRODUCT

reviewText: I started using shellac again after a few years, and the product would peel off my nails. So I bought new base and top coats... problem solved!  The manicure stays for two weeks.
Works great!
Love this product.
Love
Love Shellac
I order this product frequently and it is the base for the gel nail products I use.  Will continue to order again and again.
A reorder for a friend that uses for a home business.  Always pleased with it.
CND is just the best. I have tried several brands and keep coming back to CND. This base coat allows the whole manicure to work perfectly.
Works great with my UV light
perfect

I like the worry-free convenience of gel polish.  I had been using Gelish but stopped because the removal process made my nails too thin.  After a gel polish hiatus, I asked my manicurist to give it another try.  She recommended the Shellac brand because it is easier to remove.  True!  To save the high price of having her do it, I order this, the Top Coat and a color to do at home.  I have a UV lamp but purchased an inexpensive LED lamp that I found at Sally.  I am very pleased with the results.
summary: I like the worry-free convenience of gel polish

reviewText: great color
Works great, quality product!
summary: Once you Shellac, you never go back!

reviewText: nice
You don't use a lot of the base coat at one time. But, it keeps for a long time. Even the small bottle is good for a bunch of manicures.
Does what it should, although I notice some slight bubbles with it, even though I do a very light coat before curing.

I use this product at home (I am not professionally trained, but have 8 years of doing my own gel nails) so I had the UV light already. I initially had a Shellac manicure at the local beauty college and really like it (but not the price). This system gives, by far, the longest-lasting nail polish manicure. Yes, gels last a lot longer, but I started having a sensitivity to a chemical in the process, so they weren't an option for me anymore. This way, I have a longer-lasting manicure but also have a little more flexibility in changing colors more often.

One caveat: this doesn't really last the 2-3 weeks they tout. After a week the growout from my cuticle is pronounced enough that I want to have a "fill" (which I haven't tried yet) or a re-do. But during that same week, I have no chips and the color stays very shiny and looking like new.
CND goes on smooth and stays put for weeks. This is a great base product, much better than the Gelish. Just a warning though: your nails might suffer damage if you use the shellac all the time.

Can't believe I haven't done a review on the CND Base coat!  Love this product!  The base coat is necessary to perform the shellac process.  Please note you MUST have the UV light to use these products.  Also note you only have the base coat under the light for TEN seconds!.  Some have suggested longer times but after doing this for almost a year I have found that longer than 20 seconds and your polish will peel off!  This base coat has lasted me for almost eight months.  I redo my nails about every ten days and sometimes will add a base coat, polish and extra top coat if needed in between times.  So do not let the price deter you from beginning this great nail process as the bottle will last a long time.  I have just reordered to have my next one on hand and my original bottle even down to the last little bit works just like new.
summary: Can't do the CND Shellac without this !

reviewText: I have been using the CND Shellac system for about a year now and I absolutely love it!  Nails are perfect every time and they last usually for 2 weeks for the fingers and about 4 weeks on the toes.  I just can't say enough about it.
Great product.
This is a great product and offers good coverage with. I like this product on my acrylic nails and I am able to go longer between fills.

This is my first time using Shellac. With using all the other Shellac products together helps. I've put them all on so I can see for sure if this is something I want to continue using and doing myself or not. So far it's been one week since I put them on and they are still on. :o) yahoo

I used have used this polish base now for almost a year with no problems. I am allergic to the base that is used with them. Very easy to use, and does the job its intended to do...prepare you nails for the polish.....

I love this product! It protects my nails and stays shiney until I remove it. It is so easy and quick to apply and remove. I was worried that it would be hard to take off. But I Soak it with pure acetone for 5 minutes and the gel just falls off. My nails look great for about 2 weeks. I had someone ask me where I get my nails done- she was shocked I do them myself. It looks like I paid $40 to have them done. I use the base coat, white polish for the French tip, and top coat. Cure  it for a few minutes then wipe with pure acetone and cotton ball and you are done!

I am 41 years ago and have fine, brown hair that is colored blonde. Despite coloring my hair since the age of 13, I have never had any problems with breakage. I began to notice that my hair was falling out - the amount of hair in the shower drain in 2 days was the equivalent of what I saw in a month before! Also, I noticed that I could see more scalp - my hair was falling out and breaking. I went to the doctor and was diagnosed with Hypothyroidism. While waiting for the tests and the meds, I wanted to do something to stop the breakage and keep what was left of my hair.

I did not buy this product on Amazon (yet, will buy a refill here shortly) as I bought it from my hair salon that carries Lanza products. After washing and drying your hair with your regular shampoo and conditioner, you put this on damp hair. I have a short bob (hair comes to the top of my shoulders) and I use enough to equal about the size of a quarter. You rub this into your hair while it's damp and dry as usual.

This stuff is AMAZING. Within 48 hours of using this, my hair breakage was reduced by 60%. Within 1 week of using this, my hair breakage was reduced by 90%. It has almost no smell to it. It's not like any other oil that you have tried - this is not greasy at all. My hair dresser actually had me test it on my hands first, to demonstrate that it's not greasy. It absorbed into my skin within 5 minutes with no greasy feeling at all. My hair is shiny, not weighed down and strong - my breakage had almost disappeared as a result of using this product. It was not the meds - I didn't even start them for 4 weeks. Although it is only advertised as a product for your hair, I rub the residue on my elbows after I apply it - my chronically dry elbows are no more!

Note: I did use this in combination with the Lanza Strength shampoo and conditioner. These are also great products, but through process of elimination, I determined that this is the key to reduced breakage. This product works great! And, this is a great price on Amazon - they sell this for twice this price in the salon. I will be buying my refill from here going forward. And, in this version, you are getting twice the size with a pump (as opposed to a screw off top) which is great.  Be sure to check the pricing on the 3.4 oz in order to ensure that you are purchasing this at a fair price.

I use this oil in two ways.  I use it before styling products when I blow dry and I get a very smooth blowout and again afterward I use a single pump and go over my dry hair, especially the last couple of inches.  I also use it another way.  More often, I air dry my hair.  I use my regular styling products and then air dry overnight.  In the morning, I use this oil on dry hair before using the curling iron.  I use two pumps and spread the oil on my hands and distribute the oil throughout my hair concentrating on the midlengths and ends and avoiding the roots.  I let the oil soak in for a few minutes while I put on my makeup.  This few minutes is critical.  At first, my hair looks a bit greasy but after about 10 minutes, the oily look disappears and my hair becomes very shiny and soft and is no longer dry at all.  My hair is color treated and heavily highlighted and this oil makes it look gorgeous.  It has also made it much stronger and reduced breakage significantly.  It also provides heat protection up to 500 degrees.  I  used the curling iron to create loose waves and my hair was bouncy with tons of body and shine.  This oil is a true miracle product.  Nothing I've ever used has worked as well.  More often than not, I use it on dry hair. Waiting the few minutes for it to soak in is crucial but after that amount of time, a miracle takes place.  The keratin in the oil obviously strengthens the hair shaft because I had much less shedding after about 5 or 6 uses and even less every time after that.  It also reduced breakage to almost zero.  And my hair has been heavily bleached so breakage is always an issue as is dryness.  This product totally eliminated the dryness and made my hair look very healthy and it feels great, almost like virgin hair.  This is a great product.  Either way you use it, it's an amazing oil that strengthens hair from the inside out.  Yes, it's expensive. I have a hall closet full of hair product FAILS that didn't live up to their claims.  This product actually does what it promises.  So I don't mind paying more for it.  Besides, it takes very little oil to do the job so this bottle will last a very long time.  And Amazon has an amazing price.  If your hair is dry or damaged and you've been looking for a remedy to soothe your parched tresses, look no further.  This is an excellent product to try.  It makes my hair light and bouncy and it looks and feels amazing.  I've never used anything quite like it.  I've tried other oils but they were heavy and never really soaked in fully and left my hair feeling greasy and heavy.  This one doesn't do that at all.  It's something entirely different.  I highly recommend this oil for anyone with dry, color treated, bleached or damaged hair.  You will really love this oil, I guarantee it.

This works almost exactly like Chi Silk Infusion...maybe a bit better, but I'm not convinced it's worth paying over twice what Chi costs.. It gives my fine blonde hair a nice shine and it helps to control the split ends, but so does Chi.
The Lanza product that i LOVE is the amazing Combing Cream. Using it, I never actually need this.
summary: Chi Silk Infusion at over twice the price

reviewText: This is my second bottle of this product, this is the best oil I have ever tried in my hair. I use around 3 pumps for my entire hair and then I blow dry. The results are incredible, it hides my split ends, hydrates my hair and it is incredible soft. I usually put some product really close to my roots and I doesnt make it greasy. I love this product so much I made my mom tried it and she loves it now.
Great
Color was off and it is cumbersome to apply.

I love this Stila Color Balm Lipstick so much that I have it in six different colors [Isabelle (adobe pink), Avery (soft peachy coral), Elle (pink coral), Amelia (pink taupe), Gabrielle (nude pink), and Valentina (orange poppy)].  What I love about it is that it truly feels like a cross between a balm and a lipstick.  Like a balm, it feels moisturizing, and wearable, and doesn't dry lips out or settle in lip lines.  It has a nice creamy texture.  But like a lipstick it's more pigmented and gives noticeable color with a more opaque look.  As far as wear time goes, I get a few hours out of this, BUT I'm also tough on my lipstick.  I'm often drinking and eating a lot and biting my lips so under these conditions I don't expect lipstick, gloss or balm to last an incredibly long time.  So for me, it seems on par to other lipsticks I've tried.  As far as application goes, I agree that the shape of the bullet can be less than ideal.  If I'm in a hurry I still find I can do a good enough job at creating a defined lip look, but ideally I find myself applying it with a lip brush when I can.  I also happen to enjoy the scent of this balm.  It has a soft vanilla mint scent to me (vs. a strong, pure mint) that I find really pleasant and enjoyable.  I have a sensitive nose for fragrance and sometimes added scents give me a headache, but I don't get that with this product.

Overall I really like it.  It's a great go to lipstick for daily wear and I really enjoy all the colors I own.

I've used Stila products for years off/on and decided to try the color balm in Ruby. I prefer a red lipstick that isn't too red. Since this is a balm I expected it to be a little lighter than what I received. I now use it to blot my lips slightly, because it has better staying power than other lipsticks I use. But I finish it up with "Ladybug" lipstick by M.A.C. which is a better color for me. Lasts quite awhile, nice mint scent--I would just like a better shade. Recommended overall.

Bought from amazon (seller). Not horrible but not my favorite. These aren't very smooth to apply, which I find odd because it isn't drying on the lips. I do not like the tingling feeling as well, it is VERY mild. There is also a slight minty smell, which I am not a fan of since I don't like mint. I do love the fact that you can go for a bright lip for evening if you apply more, or subtle for day if you apply lightly. And it does sit well on the lips. However the smell, application and feeling on my lips is my I said this is average. Personally I prefer my ysl lipsticks to this. They have a similar effect on the lips, MUCH smoother to apply. And they don't tingle on my lips. They are more expensive though.
Nice colour. Thanks Amazon for carrying this Stila products
Lovely formula.  Glides on like butter.  Peppermint scent and taste.  Gorgeous pigment.  Lasts a long time.  I just LOVE this lipstick.

Feels amazing on, smooth moisturizing with a little bit of tingle from the mint.  No funny taste and no cake, heavy or sticky feel at all.  Color has staying power and this particular color is so soft and natural looking.  Almost nude with a little deeper pink to it, but soft pink not bright at all.  This particular shade is nicely muted and natural on me and I am fair skinned (Irish and freckles), blue eyed with brown hair.

I apply with a lipstick brush and work it into my lips for a gorgeous soft natural look.  I don't like a heavy lipstick and even if I put this on directly without the brush I think it would still feel light and moisturizing.

I also bought the Ellie color and I was anticipating a very soft natural pink, but it was far more bubblegum pink.  So the pictures on line do tend to be far more muted than what actually arrives.  That being said that color applied very lightly with a brush also worked very nicely on me and I could pull it off for a soft, light day time, bit brighter look.  It actually looks stunning on my daughter that has light but not fair skin and her skin undertones are not pink like mine.

 These are pigment rich lipsticks so the color in the stick is much more intense and when put on the colors are more transparent and soft with clean, clear color and finish.  A little goes a long way which is a good thing considering the price.  But I would and am buying these again as I feel the price is justified to have the soft balmy feel and staying power of great color.
summary: New Favorite Lip color and brand

reviewText:
*****
I love this lipstick. It's really expensive, but it's the only "natural"-type lipstick that I've found that delivers on the look AND the feel on your lips as well. I love the color, and the coverage is wonderful. Stila lipsticks are a greta alternative to commercial lipsticks and the toxic ingredients that they use. I am sure that I will buy it again, just have fewer colors to accommodate the greater cost. For me, it's worth it.

Highly recommended.
*****
Great smell

This is the men's scent du jour, the way sweet fruity fragrances are produced in hundreds of iterations for women. It's not a bad scent, but a bit artless. All the components just try too hard: the spicy cinnamon is over the top, the woods are perfunctory but not particularly beautiful and well-done, there is an ozonic edge with becomes terrifically cloying and it's just too sweet in a potentially headache-inducing way. Bulgari Black pioneered this type of combination and remains the benchmark. It's gorgeous for both men and women, completely wearable, and still unique, with the faintest whiff of rubber tire. I know that sounds weird and awful, but the best (and most expensive) Scotch ever had reminded me of Bulgari Black, being in a motorcycle garage with a bit of rubber, diesel and leather. Plus, the Bulgari Black bottle is fabulous and the little shred of cheap (polyester, rather than the actual Burberry cashmere) fabric covering the bottle is tacky and annoying. It can be removed - as it is only glued on in a couple of spots. It's a let-down.
summary: Skip this and just get Bulgari Black!

reviewText: This BURBERRY eau de toilette is such a unique, masculine scent. It's not overbearing and not "musky" at all - a very strong masculine scent with just a touch of floral. Will make a great gift for any male that doesn't care for the musk scents.

Burberry does fragrances well. London for Men is elegant, classy, but with an edge. Totally a man scent, which this girl adores! The package, like everything Burberry does, is perfection - perfect for gift giving. Any guy who gets this is sure to be thrilled.
summary: Elegant, classy, but with that Burberry edge

reviewText: An expensive but nice cologne. The scent is woodsy (pine-like) and a little spicy-smelling when applied.  It reacts really well to being on skin, so don't judge it by sniffing the bottle.  It's long-lasting but not overpowering or too strong.  A little goes a long way. Typical Burberry quality.
summary: woodsy and spicy scent, not too heavy or aggressive

reviewText: My husband likes wearing scents, but he's never really tried any of the more expensive, not-drug-store scents, so we were excited to try this, and we both love it!  I'm not good at describing scents, but it has a little bit of a Maine woods smell, and somehow also takes me back to when I was very little and my father used to smoke a pipe---not smoky, but something that reminds me of that.  It lasts well---just a little spray in the morning and I could still smell it when my husband got home from work nicely.  I got this to review, but it's good enough so that if I could find it on a bit of a sale, I'd buy it again.  Somehow it just says "class"!
summary: A hard to define but wonderful scent!

reviewText: Smells great and the bottle is quite sharp looking. It's a slightly spicy and fairly masculine fragrance. I prefer the way it smells on my husband versus straight from the bottle. Like many colognes, the fragrance of this smells much better on clothing or on someone, compared to just taking a whiff of it from the bottle. The longer it's out of the bottle, the better it smells. And it's a long lasting fragrance. I can still smell it faintly on clothing days later when I'm doing laundry. Wonderful cologne!

Smells amazing! A little woodsy but not too much. It's a masculine scent, but, as a woman, I wouldn't mind wearing it myself. It's a nice sized bottle. The only complaint I have is that the fabric cover slides around a little when you are spraying it. Other than that, it's a warm, masculine scent. Perfect for fall and winter.

People's views about what is a pleasant scent, and what scent (if any) it is good to wear are enormously variable, and personal.  (E.g., I like the scent of lavender, but find it unpleasant when used as (or in) perfume.). So it's hard to provide much useful general information in a review.

That said: the man who will wear it likes it, but only if it is diluted and not slapped on.  Both of us are more soap-and-water people, and agree that--while it is nice to be able to wear some fragrance at (e.g.) holiday parties--a little bit of this stuff will go a long way.
summary: What sort of fragrance, if any, one likes is a personal and enormously variable thing

reviewText: I got this for my husband and it is VERY nice! It has a little bit of musk, but it is not at all overwhelming - just masculine. Highly recommend!
summary: ... got this for my husband and it is VERY nice! It has a little bit of musk

reviewText:
I'm not a fan of aftershave, perfume, cologne, etc...  I've never worn any, since they always seemed to just be too overwhelming or too generic.

I thought I'd try this just out of curiosity.

The bottle is unique - the wrapping is a material, a fabric, that's glued to the bottle.  But this was part of the reason for me taking a star off.  It's crooked, it's glued too high so I have this fabric up over the top of the bottle, and it's only glued in a few spots, so it isn't SECURE when you hold it.  And when you are holding the bottle "normally" and go to depress the plunger to spray some, it pushes the bottle "down" and you can feel this outer material sliding.  I wouldn't be surprised if after a little time of the adhesives getting pulled and pushed at, suddenly one day it slid right out of this material.

But on to the main part, the scent.  As much as I dislike colognes and such, I really, really do like this scent.  Another reviewer mentioned cinnamon, but I don't get that.  My problem is, I can't quite nail down exactly what this underlying bite of odor is trying to remind me of.  Might be a bit of red-hot, cinnamon, something else all mixed.  I can't put my finger on it, and if I ever do, I can update this.

But the bottom line is that it's actually a nice smell, not at all like the other things I've smelled people wearing.  Definitely a masculine smell, and this time that's NOT a bad thing.
summary: The first one I'd ever actually wear

reviewText: Smells pine and synthetic. House of Burberry has this acent accord that gives me a headache of I smell too long. Ill save for Christmas time and try on a cold day/evening.

The bottle is attractively wrapped in Burberry cloth. However, the scent is much too strong for my taste. I bit too much spice. A small spray was even too strong to appreciate. I got a second opinion from my hubby & he also felt the scent was too overwhelming.

I have no idea what "notes of spicy black pepper and smoky guaiac complemented by sweet and resinous opoponax and elegant lavender for an added touch of distinction" is supposed to mean (or smell like), but this is a very nice men's cologne.  I've been wearing it for about a month now - occasionally alternating with others, such as Polo and Gray Flannel - and I really like this one.  I guess you might say it's got a "warmer" scent than Polo, but I don't think it *lasts* quite as well.  The cloth covering the bottle is an interesting look, although it doesn't allow you to see how much is left.  The one complaint I have is the black color of the sprayer makes it a little hard to see where the nozzle is, and I've ended up missing a couple of times - a little better contrast would be nice.

I have collected my fair share of colognes over the years and I have to admit Burberry London shot to near of the top of my Cologne Power Rankings after just a whiff.  It is an addictive smell with a very rustic feeling to it which will make it the first thing I grab for when I go out in the fall.  This scent is perfect for autumn.  It is also nice that one spray is all I need to last me the day which should make the bottle last longer when it takes a couple to get that right level.  Sure putting the bottle in a sweater (which adds to this being the perfect fall scent) is a little silly but it does stick out on my cologne shelf.
My hubby tried this out and I really like it. It's not overly strong and not sweet. A light "manly" scent. I would buy this again for him.
summary: My hubby tried this out and I really like it. It's not overly strong and not sweet

reviewText:
Burberry London is a manly cologne.  While it may be pricy, it is well worth it.  I absolutely love the smell.  It is a bit spicy, and definitely masculine, making it a scent guys will like and women will loving smelling on their men. Another thing worth mentioning is the bottle itself.  I LOVE the design.  The signature Burberry fabric is a nice touch and something I would expect from a designer cologne.

I highly recommend Burberry London for those looking for a cologne that is not overpowering, but definitely will be noticed.  Love when my husband wears this!

Buying cologne for myself, I might not have chosen this. It smells fine - but then, so do a hundred other perfumes-for-men (you can call them what you like, that's what it comes down to). Main thing is, my wife loves this scent on me - and let's face it, guys, those of us who are married, what counts is that our Significant Other is attracted to our fragrance.

So for me, that's the perfect choice - something SHE loves to smell on me (so long as I enjoy it too). Be aware though - Burberry makes a number of scents and products. This is the one my wife likes: a couple others, not so much.

And the size is good - it's the big 100 ml bottle, so a better deal.

'Nuff said?
Awesome Primer my makeup stays on all day!

If you are like me, you have approximately 1000 sample tubes of Smashbox Photo Finish foundation primer around from subscription boxes, GWPs, etc.  Well, this LORAC POREfection primer is a very, very similar product, so if you like the Smashbox, you'll like this as well, and if you don't like the Smashbox, this one is probably not right for you either.  (If you don't know much about the Smashbox primer, I'm going to talk about this LORAC product's performance and properties without outside reference in the next few paragraphs.)

This is a clear gel with a matte appearance to it.  It is not runny and it stays homogeneous in composition even if it gets a little bit old.  A little bit goes a long way; you need more than a pea-sized amount to cover your whole face, though.  More like a dime-sized amount.  I have been using this after cleansing, toning, using a sheet mask, using a facial oil (Caudalie Premier Cru: The Elixir), and using a moisturizer, so even though my face is like super-hydrated by the time I put this on, this stays in place and provides an excellent base for makeup.

With this, I am using what I would consider to be a full-coverage foundation (Bobbi Brown Long-Wear Even Finish Foundation) and a finishing powder on top of that (a loose powder from Chanel).  I have no trouble getting the powder to set or the foundation to stay in place.  This does not thin out my foundation; it stays full-coverage.  I can easily blend blush and highlighter on top of the foundation and powder.  Plus, my makeup is staying on all day, even though it is getting to be in the 90s where I live (granted, I spend most of the day inside an air-conditioned building).  Not only that, but this primer really is mattifying -- I don't have to use blotting papers in the afternoon to remove shine because there isn't any shine.

Also, for what it's worth, it is not difficult to get my makeup OFF at the end of the day, though it helps to use a two-step process with an oil-based cleanser as the first step and a foaming cleanser as the second.

If you're wondering, at this point, why I've only given this product four stars, it's because I am pretty sure this is causing slight breakouts.  It's not a huge issue yet (after over a week of almost daily use), but it is looming in the background.  (The Smashbox product I compared this to earlier is worse for causing breakouts, I think, though.)  If you have a great skincare routine or are not prone to breakouts, this is still worth trying.  And this is probably still one of my top 3 or 4 primers, even with the breakouts (Paula's Choice Shine Stopper is #1).
summary: excellent at mattifying, makeup lasts all day, but this may be causing some breakouts (it's far from the worst in that regard)

reviewText: Great brand but wrong product for me. I exchanged for another Lorac foundation.
summary: Good product but drying for me

reviewText: This is my favorite face primer. I have tried several different brands such as tarte, smashbox, mac, bare essentials, elf, laura mercier, too faced, and many more. This one lasts the longest and works the best.
Does exactly what it is supposed to do and foundation looks great all day.
summary: Will definitely keep using and buying.

reviewText:
This is a clear gel primer. I am -not- satisfied with this purchase. I have huge pores and I don't feel this did what it claims to do. I assume this might work for you if you have smaller pores.

The primer goes on smoothly it is comparable to Smashbox's primer. It simply did not work for me, and I would probably never use it on a customer either.

 I am going back to Philosophy's poreless primer.
summary: Not the best primer I ever tried.

reviewText:
My morning routine for skin care includes applying moisturizer with SPF.  But since my skin is combination oily by noon, I start shining.  That requires re-applying face powder which I really want to minimize because I like my skin to have clean, natural look.  Also the last thing I want for my skin is to have clogged pores from using too much make up products.  I spend too much money and time on facials and there is no need to ruin it by applying too much makeup that will clog pores over time.

I have received a sample of this product and decided to try it becuase it advertised that it is alo pore minimizing - another issue people with oily skin (like mine) struggle with.  I was amazed from the first moment I started using this primer.  It has translucent color, so it will not interfere with your skin tone.  You will not need much of this product to apply on your face.  The best part is the atual application.  Product has velvety feel to it and applies smoothly and evenly all over the face.  Once product is on my face I top it off with Bioxidea's CC cream that gives my skin clean look.  I have ebeen using this product for over a wekk every day.  It control the oil producito on the skin adn therwe is no shine.  In the evening, I cleanse my skin and daytime skin products come off quickly and easily.  This product will became a stable of my skin care preparation routine fo rthe day or special evening outing when you want oyur makeuyp to STAY.
this has really great coverage and it doesn't take a lot of products to do a full face.  Very nice.  We will repurchase.
summary: this has really great coverage and it doesn't take a lot of products ...

reviewText:
Really like how the BaByliss styles my thinning, chin-length, tending-to-be-frizzy hair.  But, there IS a learning curve.  I almost gave it away before i figured out how to use it.

Previously, i had always partially dried my hair, then used a non-rotating hot air brush, then finally set it in velcro rollers to cool.  This BaBybliss  now gives a much smoother, much less set look.  The style stays in place longer, together with a brief spray of aerosolized hair wax.

Before i start, I must be sure my hair has both damage protector and a light oil applied.  (Like Lanza Healing Strength Silk Serum)
I first brush thru a hair section without the rotation, then let the rotation grab my section of hair, roll it into place againdst my scalp for a few seconds on high,  then toggle to cool before releasing.

Expensive, but a great tool for us amateurs.

Best product ever!! Where were you 20 years ago when I needed you? I have had thick long curly hair ever since I was little. At the age of 16 I started going to my local hair salon for regular blowouts. What that just means is that they would just wash and dry your hair and blow dry it straight with the round brush and a professional hair dryer. It was worth every penny. Ever since hair straighteners have come into my life I have tried and failed on random products and hair appliances. From the $200 hair straightener to the $200 blow dryer to the $50 curling iron's and the hot rollers
I've had some successes with some items but ultimately I have never been able to get my hair blown out like how it would be professionally until this morning. I've watched a couple YouTube videos and read the directions on how I needed to use this.
I'm not someone who can wash her hair 30 minutes prior to work. I need a good couple hours and usually do it the night before. I wash and conditioned my hair. When I get out of the shower I apply my Argan oil heat protectant/ leave in conditioner and a couple drops of oil to the ends. I air dry my hair till it's about 80% dry. With this specific item I was actually going to blow dry my hair so the roots could get nice and dry and then use the product. But my hair was pretty much dry when I started. So I decided to try it without actually using my blow dryer. I sectioned my hair. This item worked beautifully. After navigating the controls I was able to do it perfectly. My hair is smooth and perfect. I was actually nervous about getting it tangled in my hair. Because when I was little I've had things get stuck in my hair and I've had to cut out a hot curling iron with spikes before. I think I'm still tramaurized by it.
Anyways I did not receive this product free. I bought it with my money. I thought the item itself was a little pricey for what I was getting. But now I actually think the price is spot on because if I calculate how much I would pay trying to blow dry my hair professionally I do end up saving money. You need this item. You will have no regrets.
I use it eveyday! It dries fast, and leaves hair shiny!
This product worked well, but the rotation was too quick. It was very hard to keep it from rolling to fast and tightening to hard against my head, tangling my hair.
summary: This product worked well, but the rotation was too ...

reviewText: It's been a few weeks since I started using this product and I love it so far!  I have thick hair so it takes a bit time if I try to dry my hair with this so I usually use regular hair dryer for a few minutes then use this product to finish up.  It take a few practice to get used to it but once you are used to it its so easy to style your hair.  I no longer need to use my hair straightener and I noticed that my hair looks healthier and shinier when I dry my hair with this.
summary: ... weeks since I started using this product and I love it so far

reviewText: Would be better if it had some plastic bristels too and not just the soft kind, so that the hair could be gripped more and not just sit on top of the bristles. My hair is fine and short so it works fine but my friend with thick hair can't use it
Unfortunately I don't love this.  I can use my own round brush and hair dryer better.  I love the instyler much better.
summary: Unfortunately I don't love this. I can use my own round brush ...

reviewText: It works, but because it doesn't have much power- takes a long time. I like the instyler better. You can dry your hair (with a blow dryer or naturally and then quickly and easily style your hair- the results are more consistent and pretty/ professional than with this Babyliss product).

I have almost shoulder-length hair. It's fine--but slightly wavy and I have lots of it. I think this brush is for folks who don't know how to blow-out their hair. I can get a better blow-out with my dryer and big-ole round brush (albeit with more physical labor).

I do think it makes my hair look shinier--and I did notice less frizzing (and today was humid).

I was hoping to get more of a wave from this dryer/brush, but though I do get a little lift and it does smooth the hair, I have not been able to get any wave in my thick, medium/fine hair. The bristles just can't seem to grip my hair well at all. Plus, it's rather bulky and the handle is quite large so it's not too easy to maneuver even though it's fairly light.  Also didn't realize that you're not supposed to use it on wet hair - it's meant to be used on partially dry hair.
The bristles don't hold up.  Has to be replaced in about four months.  While it works, it works great.
I like it but it tangles my hair.  Good seller with quick ship
If you own the NuFace toning device this is a great addition to assist in wrinkle reduction.  Hoping long term results will be worth the price.

This product takes some time everyday.  If you are not retired or have children that do not give you time for yourself, I would not recommend this item.  I have been in the sun most of my life and now that I'm fifty I have time for myself.  I think its helping but it takes time and requires using it on a regular basis.  This is not an instant fix.  Just keep that in mind.

I do not always make the time to use the Trinity itself because putting on all the gel to use the electro device is not my fav thing to do! And I use aloe, not the goop that NuFace sells! I can always find time to use this wrinkle remover device! So easy and I really see the results in fewer brown spots and fine lines. You have to hold this on each section of your face for 3 min and you need to do this 5 days per week. I would be very surprised if someone commit to using this as stated and they did not see some positive difference in their skin. It does use the battery up in your Trinity much faster than the electro device so charge often!

Love love love everything about my nuface ; this is my newest purchase.  love it
Relaxing too.

Jouer Peony is such a very bright hot pink in the tube, but once it's on your lips it's surprisingly subtle and suitable for everyday daytime use.  Don't let the hue scare you.

The gloss color is subtle and nicely shiny.  It works a little better for cool-toned complexions than warm-toned complexions.  Staying power is average.

My major objection is the applicator design where the sponge thing must be shoved back into the liquid after being used.  That can't be a good idea, microbe-use, for a liquid product, and effective shortens the life span of the gloss to the same as for mascara.

The modular design seems good as a concept, but it makes individual glosses or shadows look weird when they are solo instead of locked in with their buddies for a portable palette.

Most of us mix products from many companies, using primer from one company, shadow from another, eyeliner from yet another company.  It's highly unlikely that I want my entire makeup capsule for the day to be composed of only Jouer.  I get that the company wants you to buy in and use as many of their products as possible for your everyday bag, but in practice, it's less elegant and not as easy as the company's vision.

I always enjoy trying new beauty brands.  I had never heard of this company, Jouer before.

This Jouer Moisturizing Lip Gloss, Peony, it looks like a very bright pink in it's case, which I love that the lip gloss is in a square clear case with a square black top, very sleek and modern looking.  It looks like a perfume vial to me in a way.

The color on your lips, it's more of a subtle soft pink shade, with lots of shine and a hint of sparkle.  It seemed to last longer on my lips too, which made them feel good, probably due to the moisturizing ingredients they use, such as shea butter, Vitamin E, and Jojoba Seed Oil.  It is paraben free.
summary: Not As Dark On Your Lips

reviewText:
Ive never been a lipstick kind of gal.  Lately Ive been using Burts Bees Lip Shimmers or Chapstick in lieu of the conventional products.  Ive shied away from lip gloss as so many Ive tried have felt sticky or gummy.  Jouer Moisturizing Lip Gloss is a great choice for me as it goes on smooth and has none of that tacky feel of other products of the kind.

I was looking for something to wear to my grandsons wedding last weekend that would give a nice glow to my lips without looking too flashy.  The Jouer Peony shade was perfect for me. I used it on bare lips and it gave the right amount of glass and shine but it could also be good for applying on top of lipstick.

The product literature says it is loaded with Vitamin E, Shea Butter, and Jojoba Seed Oil to moisturize, soothe, nourish, rejuvenate and protect, keeping lips smooth and hydrated.  I personally liked the moisturizing effect of this product.  It looks good, feels good and the color choices are beautiful.
summary: Looks good, feels good and the color choices are lovely

reviewText: Tacky and do not like the taste.  The color was quite sheer too.
I love Jouer lip glosses! They are moisturizing without being sticky. Blush is the perfect pinky nude.

While it is a bit tacky, it is pretty and wears very well. Love the little mirror on the outside of the gloss container - great color! Only thing better for the price would be a little light up in the container. Nice product!

I should probably just give up on lip gloss. I wanted a bright, summery pink for the warmer weather. This looked pretty. When it arrived, the brightness of the pink was almost frightening. VERY, very cartoonish pink. But when I applied to my lips it was a barely-there gloss of pink. Pleasant, but subtle.  Still, it just had the same gluey-sticky feeling that I detest in most lip gloss. It's just not comfortable and makes my mouth feel strange where my lips come together. Not planning to use again.

The first thing you'll notice about this gloss is the innovative container, which is designed with a grove in the side so you can build your own custom color make-up palette with other Jouer products. Pretty cool concept.

The gloss itself is okay. On pale skin it shows as a glossy ice pink. The consistency is kinda sticky and doesn't spread well. It smells slightly make-upy, but it's mostly unscented. The applicator tends to put too much on at once or maybe it's the liquidity of the gloss that comes out too much on the applicator?

Hours after use, the shine is gone, but the moisture feeling and look is still there. I wouldn't invest in this "peony" color again, but might consider a different color of the same gloss.
It's just lip gloss.  The color was too much like the color of bubble gum.  I received this from the Vine Program and it was free.  I would never pay $20 for this lip gloss.  It was nothing special.

The Peony color of this gloss is a very light PINK cotton candy-shade of pink.  (I'm still looking for someone to re-create the wonderful rosy baby-pink of the Carney UD lipgloss shade.  Loved that.)  This gloss is sticky, and the applicatory isn't quite the right shape to keep the gloss from piling up on the edge of lips.  It also seems to be intended to be worn solo, and usually I apply lipstick and then lip gloss.  My light beige lipsticks seem to work best under this gloss (which is too light pink for me to wear solo).

I usually use a base of chap stick, lip liner, then lip stick. Afterwards, I put this gloss on as the finishing touch. I only apply everything once in the morning and it all lasts for most of the day as long as it doesn't wear off too much when eating.

I didn't care for this color that much but on top of my darker lipstick, it blended really well.

Great product.
My wife's favorite flower is peony, but this color might not be for everybody.  It felt nice and moisturizing, and wasn't sticky (which is always a plus).  It lasted a decent amount of time, as well.

My wife tried this lip gloss (she's an Avon rep) and loved it.  The color Peony which is kind of a pink color is a perfect complement to her complexion.  She said the lip gloss felt refreshing.  We did a time-test to see how long it lasted.  It stayed on for about two hours before she had to "gloss up" again.  Wish it would last just a little longer.  This is one of her favorites now.
summary: Feels good going on and is moisturizing

reviewText:
Tasteless, non-sticky texture, and subtle shade. I am fair skinned and love the semi-sheer Peony color. Lasts for 2-3 hours.

Nothing will ever come close to my go to moisturizing like Clinique Long Last Glosswear, but Jouer is nice.

fyi the ingredients are on the side of the package :  Polyisobutene, Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate, Dipentaerythrtyl Hexacaprylate/ Hexacaprate, Bis-Diglyceryl Polyacyladipate-2, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Silica Silylate, Polymethyl Methacrylate, C18-36 Acid Triglyceride, Tridecyl Stearate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea Butter), Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Punica Granatum Seed Oil, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Neopentyl Glycol Dicaprylate/Dicaprate, Bht, Isopropylparaben, Isobutylparaben, Butylparaben. May Contain (+/-): Mica (Ci 77019), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Red 28 Lake (Ci 45410:4), Yellow 5 Lake (Ci 19140:1), Red 6 (Ci 15850), Carmine (Ci 75470)
summary: Use when your lips need some glossing.

reviewText:
This item was given to me for my review.
The Jouer Moisturizing Lip Gloss is a very pretty sheer petal pink color that is, thankfully, unfrosted. Any shine comes from the gloss itself. I find the color is perfect for summer and very natural looking. For those of us who are graying, and perhaps lost some color in our face, as well, it is a good choice of color to add that youthful blush. For young ladies, it is a nice, natural color that would look very nice if you want to have a pretty mouth, but not go overboard...like when you are playing up your eyes. So, color-wise, I find this to be perfect for pasty little me. The point off is in the rather oily texture. The gloss IS moisturizing, and my lips felt nice even after it had worn off, but I wasn't as fond of the oiliness. I will enjoy the tube I have now, and I might purchase again if I need a gloss, but I would like to find this very same color in a lipstick, I think.

This Jouer Peony gloss looks very bright in the bottle, but it goes on very nicely with a great shine and doesn't look like the bright pink in the bottle. It is much more subtle and pretty. This is a perfect spring color. Both of my teenaged daughters love it and when they borrow it, they tend to not give it back-is a great sign of this product's versatility. I like it too and the Peony color looks great on all three of us which is very cool because we all have different skin tones.

I love the compact container and it fits nicely in my purse and its a pretty little bottle. The sponge applicator makes it easy to swipe on and go. It's the perfect Spring color and makes lips shine and the peony, tho it looks bright is actually a nice tinge of color without being over powering.

The Peony colored Jouer Moisturizing Lip Gloss is a very lovely shade! I have a olive skin with cool tones, dark hair, yet the quite pink color of this gloss blends quite well. The pricing I was skeptical of at first but noted that a very little bit with a few applications a day tends to go a long way. The bottle the lip gloss comes in is quite fashionable but also convenient. Instead of being round like most other lip glosses on the market, this one comes in a rectangular tube. The shape ensures when you lay it down on a counter top it most certainly isn't going anywhere.

There's zero flavor here, which I like! The gloss is there but no overly noticeable or glittery or anything like that! There is hint of color and I for one am more for the natural look when it comes to using makeup. I found that my lips stayed moisturized and I wasn't having to apply the gloss as often as I expected I would have. This product has a lot going for it with such a great number of ingredients Shea Butter, Vitamin E, and Jojoba Seed Oil.  I certainly will be recommending this lip gloss to all my friends and I  am eagerly trying to decide what shade I want next with the 28 currently available to choose from on Amazon!

I don't know about you, but I'm always looking for fun lip gloss. Not only does this  Jouer lip gloss come in a cool square tube, it's a nifty shade of pink.  I loved it immediately, as I'm a very fair olive.

PROS
1) No flavor.
2) No animal testing.
3) No lip-poofing additives.
4) Goes on lovely and smooth -- and it really does moisturize.
5) Comes in a stunning array of colors.
6) "Jouer" means To Play in French. And who doesn't love to play with make-up?

A lot of lip glosses turn me off with either taste/scent or a watery texture. This one is not sticky (though I like sticky glosses) but it is not watery either. It stays in place well and feels nice. The particular color isn't great for me as it has just a bit too much blue undertone to flatter me, but that is just my particular coloring. It would be a knockout on someone else. Will definitely look at other shades of Jouer lip gloss.
summary: Good texture, no taste or scent

reviewText: Subtle pink color with exceptional shine. This glides on easily with the spongy-tip wand. The container is made to be connected to other Jouer products and has a slot on one side that you can slide onto another product.
