If you're just purchasing this one item the slot is a little annoying because your fingers catch on it. If you're using it for its intended purpose it's nice. Really nice to see that this is paraben free and that it has plenty of good-for-you ingredients, such as vitamin E, Shea butter, and jojoba seed oil. This is fragrance free.

...but once you apply it, it's a very sheer, almost clear, pink. I prefer the doe-foot applicators over the brush applicators that usually end up splaying. Very moisturizing and stays on a long time, considering it's a lip gloss. Not sticky, and no taste.
summary: The pink looks a little scary in the tube....

reviewText:
I'm always hesitant about lip glosses--although I love the IDEA of them, I dislike the sticky consistency (which my husband hates as well), plus they hardly seem worth it when they don't last long.  However, I read several external reviews of this gloss in which users suggested that Jouer was their favorite gloss brand EVER, so it sounded like it was worth a try.

First, I was impressed with the consistency of this gloss.  It feels more like a moisturizing lip product, with a texture that is smooth and comfortable, not at all sticky.  Second, I liked the color.  Although the "Peony" shade is a bit off-putting in the tube--it looks like a bright, bubble gum-like pink--when applied with a light hand, it is actually a sweet pink color that is just the right combination between sheer and opaque.  Like all lip glosses, however, I didn't find this one to have great staying power, although a hint of color does seem to linger on the lips.

The one thing didn't really like was the "tube," actually a rectangular shape.  It has a groove on the side that is meant to allow it to "hook" to other products in the Jouer line.  Personally, I don't think that hooking all of my makeup products together is very convenient, and especially if this is your ONLY Jouer product, the shape of the tube is not ideal, as it is rather uncomfortable on the hands.

Overall, however, I like this gloss and would recommend it.
summary: Attractive lip gloss that is NOT sticky

reviewText:
I hate to say it, because it does carry a hefty price tag, but this product actually works. It provides such intense, lasting moisture to the eye area that it plumps the fine lines away.

And while it is a bit pricy, a little truly does go a long way. I would say a bottle lasts me about 5-6 months, so it's well worth it. I have pretty intense smile lines (crow's feet) when I smile, so I NEED this product. A half a pump works for me. I use it morning and night (when I don't forget) and gently tap it under and beside my eyes.
The packaging is good as far as the pump mechanism. But they really need to change the silver bottle. It's fine at first, but over time, it begins to shed silver flecks. I would prefer a plain bottle to battling shiny flecks from my face and hands.

This, along with Nutritic, are my absolute must-haves, with TNS a close 3rd.

Highly recommend this product.

This is a nice light feeling eye complex that penetrates quickly and doesn't leave any sticky or greasy feeling. You can apply after your morning shower and then apply your make up once it's completely absorbed.
I also applied after washing my face in the evening which gave me slightly better results. If you're just beginning to notice fine lines this is a good eye treatment. Another lotion or cream needs to be applied to the rest of your face.
Bottle is larger than what's actually inside - there's a false bottom inside the bottle.

I've been using iS Clinical Youth Eye Complex for a little over a month now, at least once a day (sometimes twice).  In that time, I've seen no noticeable difference to the appearance of the skin around my eyes.  I'm 42 with some fine lines, but this product had no effect on them.

The directions do not indicate whether to use this product once a day or twice, at night or in the morning.  I usually applied it at night.  There's no noticeable scent and the product goes on easily.  The pump does dispense about twice the amount you need, so I would suggest only pressing the pump halfway down.  This moisturizer didn't irritate my skin at all, but it did tend to look a little shiny/oily after application -- although it doesn't feel heavy or greasy.  It just didn't do anything for me to justify continued use.

I really wanted to like this product since I am 49 and I have noticed bags under my eyes. This is a recent development but one side of my family has bags under their eyes. I was fighting my own DNA. I figured that since it is an IS CLINICAL product that it would be a good quality product that I would have success with. One pump was all it took and it was more than enough to be able to dab under both eyes. It went on smoothly and had no greasy feel. There was no sensitivity as a result of using this product.

It has been close to two months now that I have been applying this for a month; I have not seen any results. Perhaps, it takes more time to see results but I do not want to go through half the bottle to find out that it needs more time. I was fortunate enough to get this item free to try and review but any other person might not be thrilled to try this expensive product to find out that it doesn't work. I used this eye complex only once a day so maybe if I used it twice a day I might have noticed a difference. However, I have had better luck with increasing my water intake. Dehydration can cause bags and fine lines to appear too.

This eye area moisturizer is thicker than I'm used to but it absorbs right away and leaves my skin feeling pleasantly moisturized. There is no scent and for me it's completely non-irritating. I've been using this for about a month and to my surprise it has reduced the dark circles under my eyes--reduced but not eliminated, still that's more than any other product I've tried.
summary: Great moisturizer with the ability to reduce dark under eye circles

reviewText:
I've been using this for about a month now and the one awesome thing i can say is it doesn't irritate my face. As a mid-forty something I've tried LOTS of different eye and face creams simply because they irritate my face horribly. Sometimes to the point of a chemical burn. I wait for it to heal and just move onto the next in line.
This just feels like a light moisturizer. There is really no scent to this product. I don't notice it at all when it's on and absorbed. It's easy to pump just what you need and it absorbs quickly on your face.
I've been using  (see example in pictures) a pump dabbed around my eyes morning and night. I don't have bags but I do have fine lines. I don't know that I've noticed a lot of difference but my skin doesn't feel dry. I'm sure I've not used this long enough to see dramatic results but I do like it and will continue to use it and look for the improvement!
summary: So gentle you can't tell you're wearing it

reviewText: At this price point I wanted to LOVE this  product. The skin around  my eyes is definitely  more moisturized which makes my makeup go on more evenly in this area. I am 33 years old and have mild lines and  some puffiness but i did not really see any reduction in either  after weeks of use, twice a day. I give 3 stars because  the added moisture has made my eyes seem brighter and I do like that. But i have to take away stars because it does claim to  reduce puffy eyes and  fine lines, which I do not see personally. I kept waiting to review  to give it more time, but i think after 2 weeks I have been fair.
summary: Youth eye serum is a good moisturizer, not sure about other claims.

reviewText: This is a great eye cream. It's thicker than I'm used to but almost immediately soaks into the skin. There is no scent and I've never experienced any stinging or tingling when using it. It uses a pump, which is not my favorite. You use only 1/2 a pump on each eye, which I find peculiar. Why not design a pump that has one pump per eye? Still, that's just my being nit-picky. So why not give it 5 stars? After a couple of weeks of using it, I see no difference in the puffiness under my eyes, which is one of the benefits listed for this product. Also, I find that Olay Regenerist Eye Serum .5 Oz works just as well and costs 1/3 of the price. If you feel this product works better, by all means use it. If you love iS Clinical's Youth Eye Complex and don't mind the price, then stick with it. Once I use mine up, I'll return to using Olay.

I don't mind using this, but I just don't see any results after using it daily for a month now. It claims you will see immediate or rapid results, but I haven't even seen any slow results after all this time. The eye cream itself is fine as a light moisturizer and I had no problems with it as far as any irritations. It is like a light cream or a cream serum texture. It absorbs nicely and very quickly with no shiny skin afterwards. Previously I had been using kinerase extreme lift eye and extreme lift face, which are very hard to find now that they've been discontinued, but those do give immediate very noticeable results. I guess I was hoping this iS Clinical would be a good replacement.unfortunately it is not and I cannot justify to continue to purchase it with no results other than just being a decent moisturizer. Theres so many more cost efficient products for that purpose. Also, I do not have any major eye problems.. no deep wrinkles, no terrible under eye bags and I do not have any excessive dark circles. I just have fine crows feet at the corners of my eyes and occasional crepe-y look right under/along  my lower lash line. I also feel like I have some drooping at the corners sometimes. This product doesn't improve any of that, except the tiny crepe lines right along the lower lashing, but any eye cream or moisturizer takes care of that.

When I unscrewed the lid I found the applicator wand was broken.  It had cracked away from the lid and was floating in the moisturizer.  I used tweezers to try and pull it out to see if I could reattach it but it was too slippery to accomplish.  Right now there's enough product towards the top that's there no problem getting to it but since this is a dense consistency there could be a problem latter on.  I've been using it for a little over a week and have seen a slight improvement to the lines around my eyes but nothing drastic.  It has a very cooling, soothing feel that feels luxurious.
summary: Broken Applicator, Slight Improvement in Eye Wrinkles, Soothing Feel

reviewText:
3/24/17- Update
So after using this 2x's @day for almost 3 weeks, gave it to a friend bc although it was good, I have an organic cream I like better.
My friend is in her 30's and after a few uses, she saw dramatic difference. Even her dark circles are diminishing.
I am in my 40's so perhaps this cream is more effective for anti aging than already aging.

Also, this cream lasts for quite a bit!! I was using a half pump each use, as directed, on both eyes & she did the same.
Between the 2 of us, at least a 30+ day supply.

Hope this helps!

Org review-
I wanted to give this some time before posting a review because I did not see immediate results so waited to gauge the long term effects.
The claim is this cream rebuilds cells resulting in renewed tissue which takes time.
So if you're going to invest in this kind of price tag, I want my review to be accurate.

Even though it has been a slow process for me, I am seeing "filling" in the outside corners of my eyes where the skin was thinning & showing more wrinkles. Not noticing a dark circle difference but, I've accepted a life with under eye concealer. Wrinkles still the same.
But the skin is getting plumper.

I do love the pump but it is important to note, the directions say only to use half a pump.
Half a pump is just enough for both eyes as, this cream is very generous, it feels like a creamy serum..

Now, I also tried it on him. Saw immediate results. Skin softer and fuller.
He has sun damage but that "chiseled" looking bone structure. I'm more of a baby face.
So maybe speed of results is noticed differently bc of types of features.

My fave part is this absorbs quickly & doesn't not cause my liner to run.

I've been using twice a day for about 2 weeks now & will update as time goes on.

Hope this helps you.
summary: Long term effects of plumping under eyes

reviewText: So far so good with this eye complex. This is the type of product that can take months to really show its ultimate effectiveness, but so far I am enjoying the use of it and feel that my eye area has received some benefit. The ingredients are formulated to be potent, and as such, it is not a completely all natural product. However, it is free of some of the really suspect chemicals that people with sensitive skin or concerns about toxins might worry about. I find that it is mildly moisturizing on the surface, but I also always use a facial serum made strictly with organic oils such as rosehip seed, argan, and prickly pear seed. I do feel that my eye area is a little smoother, small lines are slightly less noticeable. I do not generally have trouble with puffy eyes, or dark circles (unless I really need to get some sleep), so I cannot comment on its effectiveness for those problems. There is a bit more brightness to my eye area. I have not experienced any stinging or sensitivity, but I haven't put it right near the mucous membrane; just pat gently around it. I agree with other reviewers that the pump container is clunky, a bit cheap looking for the cost of the product, and inefficient. It dispenses more product than is necessary, and leaves a lot behind when the container is seemingly empty. You can pry off the top and get weeks more use! For these last reasons, I have reduced my rating to four stars. Not a miracle worker, but effective, albeit costly.

This is a lightweight lotion to help reduce puffy eyes and dark circles. You only need 1 pump for this lotion to cover around both eyes. I put this on after washing my face. For the time I've been using it, I have not noticed any difference in my eye area. It has helped with some dry skin I had on my upper lids. This is a very expensive eye cream with no results.

I don't notice a difference, but my wife seems think it has worked miracles.  It is very pricey and I was lucky to get a free trial.  My wife does admit it does not seem worth the price if we'd pay for it and so far I don't think she will be asking me to buy more when this is gone.  She's thinking she can get 90% of the results with other products at well less than half the price.
summary: Effectiveness seems to be in the eye of the beholder.

reviewText: I love this. I've only used it a few times. I'm not sure about long lasting long term use results, what I really love is how this product feels around my eyes.  It contains glycerol, and it goes on nice and smooth. The instructions tell you to dab under the eye area, not rub, after cleansing your face. I use it in the morning and the evening. It's supposed to contain peptides with help improve your skin. I just really like the way the product makes the eye area feel.

This product is working well so far.  I haven't used it long enough to see a significant effect but will update after I have.  The cost is pricey and the results will determine whether it justifies that price. I will start out by saying I am a prime candidate for this product.  I am seeing a few more of the little lines of late but what's the worst are these dark circles under my eyes.  I remember looking at them last week and thinking I almost looked like I had a black eye on one side it was such a dark purple circle.  I like that this is a measured pump so it is very easy to get out without contaminating the rest of the product.  I have severe dry eye so my eyes are very easily irritated with creams and cosmetics.  I am pleased to say this cause no irritation at all.  It goes on easily and is not greasy.  I don't wake with swollen looking eyes either, so I am very pleased.  So far I'm very happy but I need to see a noticeable change to justify the cost as I said.  After I've been using this a while I will update.

Great ingredients, not greasy but creamy formula.
Leaves skin hydrated for along time, unlike OTC creams, that when water evaporates there is nothing left and skin feels dry.
Pricey but good quality and a little goes long way.
I use hyaluronic serum twice day under my moisturizers and my skin hydration level measured with BT analyzer was over 40%. I'm an esthetician and have some knowledge but even my colleagues at last weekend class had 17-25%. Maybe it's the cream, maybe HA under, maybe combo.
My skin for last 2 years was very dry due to hormonal changes so I'm pretty happy.
I always use quality skincare, doesn't mean expensive but lines you can find in spas, med spas, doctors' offices.

Although the product goes on very nice, and it will take a couple of applications to determine it's overall effectiveness, I'm writing this review based on the packaging itself.  After a couple of pumps, the product did not disperse at all.  I opened up the product to find the pump was broken and no longer pumps.  In order to continue using the product, I have to pound it out with the lid off.  Given the price of the product, I would expect the packaging to pump flawlessly.

As far as the product goes, it appears a little goes a long way.  It looks like a very light weight lotion. It's not clear like a serum, it is white, light, and absorbs quickly.  Keep in mind I have very sensitive skin, so if there is any adverse reaction, I will also note that.

I will continue using the the product, but the application has not been easy.  I'm also wasting a lot of product doing by pounding it into my hand and being unable to use the pump.

Updates to follow
summary: Pump broke after 2 pumps of product.

reviewerName: the old lady who lived in a shoe
reviewText: This product was developed to make your eye area more youthful. Cut down on puffiness, darkness, fine lines and repair damaged sites. How is that possible? Peptides. Yes, peptides and hyaluronic acid. Hyaluronic acid gives you moisture. Peptides give you repair. Oh, there is also collagen protectant that also encourages more collagen. The one stop, fix for your eye bags and dark circles. This seems to be a fine product and I will know more as I continue to use it and test it. For now, it is working perfectly. I can see the extra gleam for moisture on my eyes, above and below skin and I had zero reactions that would make me stop using it. Very easy to apply. Small amount on finger and dab on the eye area, being careful with delicate skin.
summary: Younger looking eyes? Count me in!

reviewText: I would normally never have shelled out this kind of cash for half an ounce of face cream. That's the kind of thing I am imagine a fussy old lady with too much money doing. But the dermatologist gave me a sample and recommended it for my tired-looking eyes and dark circles resulting from shift work and a hesitant march into the 30s. But to my surprise, the sample seemed to help. So I took a risk and invested in the stuff. Never thought I would be a person who uses a $100 face cream, but no regrets.
summary: But the dermatologist gave me a sample and recommended it for my tired-looking eyes and dark circles resulting ...

reviewText: It's OK.  I feel it is too thick-ish and makes my under eye cream go on rough.  I would not purchase it again.  There are far better and lighter eye creams out there.
summary: Noth worth the money in my opinion

reviewText: Love these cream for my baby with eczema. I use it really sparingly, just in targeted areas on his face, otherwise it makes him break out a bit. It is very emollient and a little goes a long way. If your child is prone to baby acne, I'd steer clear of this--but for dry, chapped, irritated skin, this is a great cream. It takes the irritation and tightness away immediately. This is not quite as emollient as the dry skin, cold cream version of this cream--but it still is very rich feeling and I wouldn't recommend it for skin types other than normal and dry.

I received a small sample of this Mustela Hydra Bebe Facial Cream in a registry gift, and I tried it on myself and absolutely loved it! It is a really light, non-greasy lotion and I feel confident using it on my baby. I enjoy the clean, fresh scent, it's a bit stronger than I was expecting but very pleasant. I was thankful that this facial cream is hypoallergenic, and 86% of the ingredients are from "natural origin." Also, it states on the box that Mustela prohibits parabens, phthalates or phenoxyethanol. It works instantly, providing moisturize and relief. My toddler scratched my baby's face accidently with a toy, and a dab of this cream healed it quickly. Love!
summary: Great gentle facial cream for any age!

reviewText: I've used the cold cream one, as well, and this is a lighter lotion but still very effective. It's thick and a little goes a long way.  It absorbs well and doesn't leave the skin greasy. The smell is pretty unpleasant but does not linger.  I don't get the impression this is added fragrance but just what this combo of ingredients smells like.

I use this all over my baby girl. It's one of the few lotions she will tolerate me applying to her skin without getting cranky. It smells fantastic and I just dab it on her during diaper changes as a little game to keep her in a happy mood. It rubs in very quickly which is one of the reasons I think she likes it. And it helps her skin feel even silkier than it already does. I like having it on my hands too.
I use this cream on my almost 3 year olds face because he has eczema spots and needs a daily lotion to keep them soft and not itchy. Some lotions burn his spots, but this one is gentle and effective.

I love Mustela products (generally speaking) but this cream's scent is far too strong for a product intended for sensitive skin.  I can't really speak to the long term performance of this product because I simply couldn't get past the scent and didn't want to use it on my little one.  A reformulation may be in order if Mustela wants a better seller on their hands.
summary: Scent too strong for such a product!

reviewText: I used this cream on my face since I have sensitive skin.  It applies very smoothly.  It feels good on my skin and feels very as though it's moisturizing well enough.  The problem is that it tastes awful.  It's not that I 'tasted' it ..but I was drinking a bottle of water and licked my lips and just could not get the taste out of my mouth.  I don't know how this could be used on a babies face, with all the drooling they do.
summary: It feels good on my skin and feels very as though it's ...

reviewText: This is a very gentle baby facial cream, and works well as a lotion too. The lotion has a nice scent to it, absorbs well, and doesn't leave a greasy film. It did not irritate my childs skin, in fact, this helped soften up dry patches on her cheeks. We have and use Mustela's body lotion and this cream is basically the same thing. It's priced a bit high for a 1.35oz tube. Product is made in France.

I would LOVE this product if it wasn't for the strong scent. I will grant you that the scent isn't unpleasant--who can dislike "baby" scent? It is just so strong and persistent that it doesn't fade away and just lingers. As a matter of fact, it seems that the warmth of the skin triggers the scent release because it doesn't seem as strong when you take a whiff of the cream in the tube.

Otherwise, it is great: it applies smoothly, is neither too watery or too thick; it is absorbed promptly allowing you to dress the child without having to wait for the cream to dry first; it does moisturize effectively. Other positive attributes include the ingredient list in which there is nothing to object to and the fact that it has been tested to avoid skin allergic reactions. (Although I wouldn't be surprised if the scent couldn't trigger a respiratory reaction in an asthmatic child!)

Despite its many virtues, I would prefer a less-effective product that is scent-free.
summary: The scent is too strong, otherwise very good.

reviewText: We've always liked Mustela products and this is no exception.  Scents are always fresh and clean, but light.  Goes on easy, no residue or greasiness.  And never had an issue with skin irritation.
summary: We've always liked Mustela products and this is no exception

reviewText: Like all Mustela products - we love this one too.  The lotion is really light and feels great.  It definitely moisturizes the skin without feeling oily.  It has the light Mustela scent and works really well.  It does not irritate our kids' sensitive skin and really helps the dry skin on their cheeks.  Very effective product.
summary: Very Effective - Does Not Irritate Sensitive Skin

reviewText: Ok really I think this is the only baby facial cream I have seen but I love it.  It smells amazing and leaves babies face feeling soft clean and hydrated.  I love putting this on my children's face after bath time.  I just love the Mustela brand and all of their products.  You can feel and immediately see the quality the first time you use it.
This face cream is very soothing and moisturizing. Mustela products smell amazing and work great. Our baby and children have such smooth,soft skin when we use this!

I love Mustela products for my two young children. I love the way it smells - leaves my little ones smelling clean and fresh( some people are bothered by the smell but I love it!!) This Mustela hydra Bebe facial cream is so perfect and comes in a 1.35 fluid ounce size. It's is great at home or  when traveling whether be on a plane or for a short trip to the zoo, etc. My son suffers from very sensitive skin and he has no adverse reaction to this facial cream. The size is perfect and easy to carry in a diaper bag or purse. Leaves my children's skin and face very soft and moisturized- it is non greasy. Blends into the skin very well and leaves no residue!! Awesome product! Love it!

AQUA/WATER/EAU, GLYCERYL STEARATE, HYDROGENATED COCO-GLYCERIDES, PETROLATUM, CYCLOPENTASILOXANE, CETYL PALMITATE, LAURETH-23, 1,2-HEXANEDIOL, CETEARETH-20, PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS (SWEET ALMOND) OIL, SIMMONDSIA CHINENSIS (JOJOBA) SEED OIL, BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII (SHEA) BUTTER, CARBOMER, DIMETHICONOL, GLYCERYL CAPRYLATE, CETEARETH-12, CETEARYL ALCOHOL, PARFUM (FRAGRANCE), SODIUM HYDROXIDE, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, XANTHAN GUM, TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE, CITRIC ACID, PENTYLENE GLYCOL, PERSEA GRATISSIMA (AVOCADO) FRUIT EXTRACT

This is a rich, well absorbed and moisturizing cream. Low on potential allergens and feels good on the skin. This product line is "from birth on" and benefits anyone with dry or sensitive skin.

The down side for me is that I find the perfume in this product very irritating and offputting. I can't see putting it on a child's face, let alone my own. I am not sure why this fragrance was chosen but it is noxious. Mustela products used to have a pine fresh scent but this fragrance is not at all pleasing to me. Short of the fragrance ( which is a very individual thing) this would be a 5 star cream.
summary: Nice skin cream but unpleasant fragrance

reviewText: This baby facial lotion is very moisturizing and smells similar, but not as strong, as Herbal Essence Shampoo.  The scent is still on the potent side though. I don't even know if they still make that shampoo but that's what the scent reminds of.  It doesn't contain paraben, phthalate or phenoxyethanol.  You don't get very much - only 1.35 ounces so use it sparingly if you want it to last.  As of this review it costs $11.50 for a tube.  It kind of comes out fast from the tube so a very light squeeze is all that is needed.

The fragrance is quite strong. My skin isn't super sensitive and it did OK--but I would be weary of using it on a baby. I actually never did use lotion on my babies as their skin was never dry, but if you like using lotion and you don't mind the fragrance, you may enjoy this lotion--it comes in a nice tube/dispenser and it feels great and not greasy.
Use it for myself. Really like it as daily moisturizer
The smell is fantastic! When I use this, I don't use any cologne/perfume. The plus is that it helps ward off dry skin and does not irritate my supersensitive skin.

I have used a great many tea-tree products in the past. And, while I like the scent, my family doesn't. So, I hesitated when trying this, worried that the smell would be off-putting or annoying. Well, it turns out, no such thing here! The scent is so mild that had I not known that it was tea-tree, I would have never guessed. Therefore, if you are sensitive to scents, you have no worries here. And, while it is a little thick, it can be worked into skin pretty quickly. (But, it did require some massaging).

The overall effect was nice. My feet were well hydrated, looked lovely and felt super soft. And, no one in the house was complaining about "that tea-tree smell" (which is great).

With winter coming on, my heels start drying and cracking.  I usually just try to use some of my body lotion but it doesn't work well.  I've been using Dead Sea Essential for several weeks now and I find that my heels are softer and I am not having cracking issues.  This will be a product that I will use daily for the next couple of months and will certainly buy again next year.
summary: Really nice foot cream for keeping my feet soft

reviewText:
It's like clockwork, when temperatures fall and humidity is at an all time low, my feet and hands seem to suffer the ill effects of dryness.  The heels of my feet need serious TLC, and I was glad to see Ahava has come out with a cream targeted for feet.

Tea tree oil in its pure form isn't my favorite scent, so I was very pleased to open the tube and really enjoy the scent.  There is a spa-like, calming and gentle vibe to this scent, and you don't detect a lot of tea tree oil scent in the fragrance, a big plus for those who don't particularly like that scent.  The packaging mentions that the benefit of the tea tree oil is to protect and deodorize.  The scent does linger on skin and I can see how it would counter odors well.  The cream absorbs quickly, feels cushioning and velvety but not too heavy.  After a few minutes of sinking into the bottoms of my feet, there is no tackiness.

Formula is made without parabens and phthalates.  Easy to dispense from tube and look forward to using it to get through another rough winter.  This year maybe my feet will still look like it's June!
summary: Fast absorbing, pleasantly scented, great moisturizing for cracked heels of feet

reviewText: This lotion makes my feet so soft, and it hides those unsightly cracks.  The lotion really stays on my skin.  It makes my feet slippery, so I have to be careful while walking, so I don't slip.  I also noticed this in the shower then next morning.  They weren't so slippery, that I was concerned about falling, but I could feel that lotion still on them.  I like that it sticks on my skin, because it shows me that it is a quality lotion that actually works.  It eliminates the dryness on my feet, for the long term, and not just for the moment.  The scent is wonderful!  Give this a try if you are looking for a high quality lotion!

This cream has a nice scent to it.  I've used it on my hands and feet and it does soften.  As for removing callouses, that hasn't happened.  However, my feet feel softer overall and I am satisfied with this product.  I have also enjoyed using it on my hands and upper arms.  It's an overall good moisturizer.  I took it down a star because it did not soften or remove my callouses, though it did overall leave my skin softer.
summary: Great Moisturizer And Does Not Remove or Soften My Callouses

reviewText:
I'm a fan of tea tree oil as an ingredient in certain body care products. However, sometimes the smell/fragrance can be unpleasant and/or over powering. Happily, this is NOT the case with this product. So if you share this concern based on past experience with other products with tea tree oil, know that this product has only a very light (and pleasant and "neutral" as it were) scent. I'm hyper sensitive to fragrance in products and this presented no problems either in skin irritation or aroma.

I like how lightweight it is and how easy it spreads. It is really moisturizing but it is not slick or greasy. After application, I found that my socks were not stained or soiled by having it on my feet.

This is not as thick as some other foot creams, which may be a plus for you as the "richer" and thicker ones can often be a bit of overkill.

This product reminds me, somewhat, as a more contemporary and lightweight version of a foot cream I got from the Pharmacie de Santa Marie Novella in Florence a few years ago. That cream is unbelievably effective, but also unbelievably expensive. I'm glad to have found this product, which seems to work as well, if not better, than what was my favorite foot cream.

This cream is especially welcome for use in hot weather. Some others just feel too heavy on your skin but this feels cooling and comforting.

(If our microwave had not died, I would have tried heating it slightly to see how it works when it's warmed up!)
summary: Lightly scented, lightweight but effective foot moisturizer that soothes, softens even super-dry and cracked feet

reviewText: This is a full size tube that's really easy to use. The cream is white, feels a bit more waxy than oily and glides on. It is good for a foot massage as it glides over skin - the Dimethicone helps with that. The cream delivers some nice ingredients: Aloe, Avocado Oil, Jojoba Seed Oil, Sweet Almond Oil, Wheat Germ Oil, Vitamin E, along with exfoliating Salicylic Acid and deodorizing, astringent/antiseptic witch hazel and tea tree oil. It doesn't have the medicinal smell of tea tree oil, the fragrance is fairly subtle and well, boring. I'm totally not in love with the fragrance though it doesn't bother me either. It's very natural. It doesn't do much to soothe tired feet- there's not enough mint in it for that, so other than the benefit that comes out of any foot massage, it mainly offers relief and some treatment for dry and/or cracked skin. My main complaint is that if I put it on before bed, I notice my feet are MORE DRY when I wake up. AHAVA makes another foot cream I really enjoy and much prefer- that one is AHAVA Dead Sea Mud Dermud Intensive Foot Cream, 3.4 fl. oz. which is more expensive, but thicker and richer seems to work better for me to bring tired, hurting feet back for another round of activity, and it leaves my feet wonderfully hydrated and ready for the next day when I use it before bed. After applying this one before bed, as soon as I wake up, I need to get some moisture on my feet.
summary: It's ok, but my feet seem more dry the next day when I use it before bedtime or a nap

reviewText: Dead Sea essentials foot cream is wonderful !!!I had rough ,dry feet. To the point I was embarrassed now after using this cream for a couple of weeks ,my feet are soft and smooth. I look good in my birkies .i will keep an extra tube on hand cause I don't want my feet to look that bad again I love this cream .

Some years ago, I read an article (where?) written by an internist concerned about the state of his elderly patients' feet.  In order to stress the importance of inspection and care of their cracked heels and gnarly toes, he would massage their feet with cream during their  appointment while discussing self-care at home.  Good heavens, these people must've loved this doc!  I never took up the foot massage routine in my own medical practice, but the notion resonated true enough as my own feet aged that I took up the nightly practice of cream application to feet which also doubled as a final lotion treatment to hands as well.  Always seeking better, yummier products for skin care, I jumped at the chance to try and review this AHAVA Tea Tree Oil foot cream.

In terms of ease of application over a rough and complex surface, this gets five stars top-notch rating.  The cream is rich with excellent spreadability.  With respect to tea tree oil benefits, a quick check on pubmed.gov confirms that TTO not only has anti-microbial action against both bacteria and fungus, it also--when applied with DMSO--stops cancerous tumor growth in the subcutaneous tissue of mice.  As this TTO is way down the list of ingredients in this cream, and there's no added DMSO of course, I'm not sure how much anti-anything one gets out of this product.

Finally...the smell.  This is not your mother's but actually your grandmother's favored scent, and only if that grandma was born around the turn of the last century.  Think Aunt Edna at the family holiday gathering when you were a kid and she'd hug you tightly to her ample bosom.  What was AHAVA thinking?  It still would be okay if only relegated to the feet all the way down there, but of course it's clinging to the hands as well, and so silly to wash hands post-creaming feet only to re-cream the hands with a fragrance-free choice.

Won't buy it again but will soldier on to use it up and the feet will be the better for it.
summary: Love the cream, hate the smell

reviewText:
We got this to try to solve some deep cracks in my partners heels.  She was excited to try this because she has used other AHAVA products and really liked them.  At the same time, two other people got her assorted foot lotions after they heard her talk about her feet.  Unfortunately, this one came in last in a popularity poll.

The two big objections she had were the scent and greasiness of this lotion.  The other lotions she had had pleasant floral and citrus scents (as proven when she forced me to smell both.)  This one had a distinctly lotion smell, or as she said "Old-Lady Lotion" smell.  It was not overbearing, but had some strength to the smell.  Likewise, she showed me how much greasier this one was when she applied it.

She did say that it is not horrible, and probably works although she has been applying the others.  She still likes AHAVA, but says that this is not her favorite product by them. She plans on using it, but not getting it again.
summary: Old-Lady Scent and a Little Greasy, But Seems to do the Job

reviewText: Unless the weather is too cold, I am usually barefoot. Over the years, my feet have gotten drier and no matter how often I use a pumice stone on my heels, they crack and get really hard. I have tried a lot of different products, and nothing has really helped much until I tried the Dead Sea Essentials tea tree cream. Man, what a difference! The calluses have softened considerably and the skin is much smoother and softer. I've been using the tea tree cream in the morning for about two weeks and have noticed a very big improvement. I even like the smell of the cream, which goes away once the cream is absorbed into the skin. I like that I know recognize what most of the ingredients are rather than chemicals and like even better that it is not tested on animals. This is the best foot care product I have tried (and, no, I have not tried the more expensive brands), and I plan to continue using it when this tube is used up. Recommended!

I have (or should say) had callouses on my heels and  the front ball of my feet but the Dead Sea Essential foot cream has worked what I would consider a miracle. It is not greasy feeling and really has soften my feet. I am not very good at remembering to use lotions on my feet so therefore have only applied this a few nights at bedtime. It is amazing and I will be telling my friends all about it.
summary: I am not very good at remembering to use lotions on my feet so ...

reviewText:
This is a great product. Creamy without being greasy, easy to apply, no scent that I could detect ... and it really seems to soften the rough edges of my feet! It's more like a lotion than a gel so it's easy to apply. Maybe it's my imagination, but my feet felt better immediately.

I'm hard on feet. I walk a lot. I work out and take dance exercise classes. I wear sneakers but always have trouble getting a good fit. So I need to use something evcovered it otherwise.ery day. So far this cream is even better than some products I've been using designed for feet, as well as the general skin creams and gels that were recommended by others.

So glad I got to try this in Vine.  I wouldn't have discovered it otherwise.

I have very dry, cracked skin on the soles of my feet, to the point where flakes of dead skin form and I have to "shave" them off.

Since I started using Dead Sea Essentials Tea Tree Oil Foot Cream, I've noticed less flaking and an overall smoother and softer feeling on the bottom of my feet.  It also deodorizes as well as moisturizes, which is great given that I work out twice a week with my trainer. Not only do my feet take a pounding each time I do so, but I worry about how my feet smell after a workout.

I'm a fan of AHAVA mineral suncare anti-aging moisturizer (I use it frequently during the summer) and this is another product in their line that I expect to be using regularly because it performs so well. Recommended.
summary: Excellent Foot Cream That Soothes The Cracked and Dry Soles of My Feet

reviewText:
My feet are so hard and cracked I'm ashamed to take them to get a pedicure. This cream is very, very rich and really does soften your feet immediately (well, after I scraped them a bit with my foot tool so the stuff could soak in).

I chose this foot product because it said it had tea tree oil in it. I like the smell of tea tree, and this does NOT smell like tea tree. This lotion is very smooth and penetrating but it smells terrible. It is very sickly sweet smelling, kind of like very old perfume from Avon.

I put socks on after slathering it on my feet and washed my hands and the smell wasn't so bad. If it keeps my feet soft with twice-weekly use it will be a first and I"ll put up with the smell.

The marketing material on the tube says you can use it on "feet and legs," so I tried both (although if you wanted to apply it to your legs on a regular basis, you'd go through a single tube pretty quickly). It was okay on my feet, but I was surprised by the immediate stinging sensation on my legs, which I don't get from shaving cream, sunblock, etc. I suspect it might have something to do with the perfume ingredients, because it is STRONG. I'm surprised no one else seems to be reporting this. It's not unpleasant, but the marketing material notes that it "deodorizes," so they've definitely ramped it up intentionally. If you tend to have any physical reactions to deodorant ingredients, I'd give this a miss.

On the plus side, it soaks in well and doesn't feel overly greasy. Given all of the above, I wouldn't buy it again, but I also wouldn't turn down another sample. 3 stars.
summary: Softens skin on feet; stings legs; strong aroma

reviewText: Okay this iron has a problem. I don't know why the reviews didn't mention how the barrel clip is short. If you have a long hair, more than half of your hair won't curl. Clip needs to be longer in order for it to curl well.

after just 3 years the wire came loose in the handle and now blinks on and off. Poor design!!!

works great

reviewText: This has been the best and most economical Curling Iron I have every used. I have medium thick brown hair, that waves past my bra line. In the past I thought it didn't hold curl, but with this iron my curls hold for hours. It also curls fast, you don't need to leave it on the same spot for long. I did a "ten second per curl" emergency fast curl the other day--and they held remarkably well. In that case, they didn't stay in beautiful ringlets obviously. But the waves they fell out into were wonderful and looked beautiful. I always finish with a light mist of hairspray, but the curling iron does its job on its own! :)
summary: I was skeptical, but it works!

reviewText:
This is the curling iron that you wanted as a teenager when you bought your first one from Target and spent hours cursing it because it wouldn't hold a curl at all. This iron is the preferred iron of stylists for a reason-it is a workhorse, and it is fabulous.

I have this iron in three sizes. I have the 1", the 1.25" and the 2". This size is by far my most used size. I have mid back length hair and it's medium thickness. It is wavy by nature but I typically curl it after blow drying it straight. This iron has been my go to after years of use, and it still looks as good as the day I bought it-8 years ago. It's in pristine condition and it works like a charm, and it gets USED.

There are adjustable settings for the temperature on here-it's a dial-set it once and then leave it alone. Not like electronic ones where you have to reset it every time you use it. I do wish this had an auto off feature, that's my one thing I want that newer irons have. The barrel on here is the PERFECT size for most hair types. It gives the loose barrel curl type, the "Victoria's Secret Curl" a lot of girls are after. The longer you hold the curl, the better longevity you will get. I have experimented with this thing for years and gotten tons of variety with it.

There is a longer barrel version of this floating out there now for women with really long hair, and I feel like while that might be useful, it might be harder to manhandle as well. This works well for me even when my hair has been exceptionally long. I think that had I known to buy this on Amazon back in college, I could have saved some money. The clamp is really strong, and while the iron comes with a replacement spring, I have not needed to replace mine in almost a decade of ownership with heavy usage.

If you are looking for a quality iron that will last a LONG time and won't leave you penniless, this is worth it. Only a few bucks more than the generic cheap equivalents, and it will work like a horse and leave you looking gorgeous.
