The color was darker than I expected but still in the correct tones for my skin.  This color is better for me in the summer.  This is a very matte mouse.  The coverage is not heavy.  My natural skin is still visible but with a more refined texture.

 I have sensitive skin, and I have no problems with this item.

It has no scent at all, something I like.

This is a bit darker foundation than I would usually wear.  I got the honey beige color.  When I apply it, it looks like I have a slight tan.  It applies easily, and feels very clean and natural. My one complaint is that it seems to accentuate my wrinkles. I actually have just begun using an air brush for make up and it gives a much younger appearance and a less wrinkly look than this, so I probably will not use this, but continue air brushing. However if you want this type of foundation, this applies easily and evenly and gives a nice look without being too heavy. I found the colors as pictured online to be accurate, but that depends somewhat on your monitor.
summary: Applies easily and doesn't feel heavy or greasy

reviewText: Color me quite surprised by the lightness of this product compared to the amount of coverage.  At first I thought it would be like a tinted mositurizer or BB cream because it feels that light (if not even lighter) but it goes on flawlessly and it covers like a foundation - one layer is completely do-able but two will be perfect for all day fave coverage.  I need to work on the color a bit, this was a shade darker than I imagined.
summary: So light, so free but covered!

reviewText: This foundation is unlike anything I've ever tried.  To be honest I don't wear makeup every day and most days just wear powder because I hate the way liquid foundation feels on my face.  I also have sensitive skin and have to be careful what products I use so I don't get red, itchy or breakout.  I had no issues like that with this foundation.  The ivory match my skin perfectly.  The foundation has a mousse like texture that is light, airy and glides on smoothly.  It is easy to apply and has a soft velvety feel.  It is so light and airy I can barely feel it on my face but gives me enough coverage that my complexion looks even with almost an airbrushed look.  I am really impressed by this foundation and just may start wearing make up every day now.
summary: Easy to apply and looks great!

reviewText:
I received Golden Beige , which is too dark for my skin color. I'm fair, blue eyes, blondish hair.
I put this on my face, but I had to get it into my skin fast, or it left brown tint on my face!
But When I put a little on at a time, used a sponge fast,  I looked like I had a little tan, and this blended in very well. I could Not see a
Line of demarcation!  Although this will not be my everyday make-up as it's too dark for my skin color.
This went on smooth, after I figured out how to blend it fast.
That said I would only use this sometimes  for the summer.
summary: Too dark, but blended very nice..

reviewText: I apply less than a pea sized amount & am able to easily blend this over my face & neck creating a flawless natural look.  My method creates results more like what I get when I wear a tinted moisturizer except this has a matte effect that my tinted moisturizer does not.  When I wear this, I don't need to apply powder.  My favorite thing about this, aside from how easy it is to apply (it doesn't dry out too fast, I can take my time with it)  is how my skin feels velvety smooth, not gummy or sticky like some products can make my skin.  I wasn't sure what to expect from this & have to say I am pleasantly surprised by the results, I don't even feel like I'm wearing makeup.
summary: A Little Goes A Long Way

reviewText: I was sent a tube for review in a dark beige color called "Hale" which isn't on the product page.  This color is way too dark for me.  However, it is so sheer that I  may be able to use it summer.  This foundation is very silky, probably owing to the dimethicone in the formula.  It is paraben, fragrance and preservative free.  My tube has an expiration on the crimp of 9/19.  I really like the way it applies and feels on the skin.  It seems very sheer to me and is a great companion to the LaRoche Posay Effaclur Blur, which I use where I want more coverage.  (That has become one of my favorite products.)  On the negative side:  no sunscreen.
summary: Feels great on the skin, very sheer, but no sunscreen.

reviewText: For whatever reason, this sits, mask-like, on my skin.  It doesn't matter whether or not I use a primer, or dust some powder on it afterwards. Though the shade is right (judging both by the color chart and in comparison with other foundation I have), the effect is chalky.  Maybe it's too matte?  I don't know. I just know that it isn't flattering.

I absolutely love this foundation.  It really makes your skin feel smooth, silky and flawless.  LOVE IT.  The only thing the company needs to do in order to help their customers who order online, is to describe the colors a little better.  I took a shot at this color because the bottle itself looked lighter and I had no way of gaging it's color.

I have light/natural skin with a yellow undertone.  I've attached a picture to show you that the "04" is for Beige Dark/Golden Beige skin.  Also, worth mentioning that I have sensitive prone skin and this is one of the few foundations that cause zero irritation.  So far, all the LaRoche products that I've tried, I have not had any reaction to.  HUGE plus.

I ended up getting the 02 Beige clair/light beige and I absolutely love it.  Definitely give this a try.  Really easy to apply, blends beautifully, doesn't cake, and lasts throughout the day.

Definitely give it a try if you're in the market for a new foundation.  This is excellent!

(Picture notes the 02 Beige claire - Light beige on the left and the 04 Beige dark golden beige on the right)
summary: Goes on smooth, lasts, looks amazing & irritation free!

reviewText:
I selected this in shade #2 but was sent #1 which is Ivory. It was a perfect accident for me since it matches my skin tone exactly. I applied this with a makeup sponge and it goes on smoothly, no streaks or uneven coverage. It feels light on my skin yet covers my age spots. It gives my skin a velvety look without being too matte.

I love how this feels on my skin and at the end of the day it looks just as good as the morning. Perfect balance of silky feel and enough coverage to blend in dark spots. I am thrilled with this product and will add it to my "must reorder" list. Made in France.
summary: Received in #1 Ivory, absolutely perfect for me.

reviewText: The color turned out to be a little too tan for my skin, but the consistency of the product is smooth and easy to blend. It does not, however, include an SPF to protect my skin, so I will stick to this company's BB Blur, which contains SPF 20.

Note: I got this in the IVORY color.

Leave it to my favorite skincare line to make the most perfect matte foundation EVER.

I've tried lots of matte foundations (and foundations in general), from both high end lines and drugstore brands.  Every one looked like a terrible, dull mask.  This La Roche-Posay foundation is awesome, though!

It's a mousse that you squeeze from a tube, so it's not drippy.  It has a whipped air texture that glides over the skin. It's not heavy or thick at all, but it makes my skin look PERFECT. I've been using it for about a week now and really can't get over how good my skin looks.

As for the shade, ivory is darker than I expected.  I have pale skin, but I never wear ivory (typically, the lightest shade in a range).  I'm usually a few shades darker. However, in this brand it's just right.  There is no pink in it. It has more yellow-neutral undertones.

This is a winner!

reviewerName: the old lady who lived in a shoe
reviewText: This face tint mousse feels a little on the stiff side but it blends very well. I tested it on my hands and I can see a difference. The age spots are lighter in color. The skin also got much smoother looking, With this being formulated more for sensitive and/or oily skin, it is not a product that I could use without a good moisturizer beneath. It does exactly what it says it will do. My hands looked smoother and dry skin looked less dry.

This is by far my absolute favorite foundation. It's light, airy, and feels like I'm wearing no makeup at all. For someone who, like me, isn't used to wearing a lot of makeup and is just looking for a little bit of coverage and mattifying, this is absolutely the perfect product. I put a little but on more t-zone in the morning after my shower, and I'm golden for the rest of the day. Also I love that it comes off easily when I wash my face in the evening, unlike a lot of the ticker foundations. I'll be sure to be reordering it when I run out.

While the container isn't very big, and much smaller than other nail polish, most colors don't get used enough before they go bad, so this works for us (although if you are a heavy user this might be a bigger deal).  Goes on nice and smooth, doesn't chip, and has a nice subtle coloring.
summary: most colors don't get used enough before they go bad, so this works for us (although if you ...

reviewText:
I like this and the concept, I'm just not a huge fan of the color but that doesn't reflect the actual product. A lot of people will LOVE this color. It's a very soft white/pink heavy on the white. It is super trendy right now and because as a nail polish it went on smooth (although a bit streaky) I honestly think it is a great buy (hence the stars). For me personally, this color was way too light and doesn't really work with my skin tone (olive). I do love a light pink, it's the heavy white in this pigment that doesn't work for me -- but for a lot of people it will be perfect!

I do get gel nails regularly so after my last set came off I used this exclusively for two weeks and honestly think it DID improve the quality of my nails. I also take biotin every day but there is no doubt that regular gels will DESTROY your nails. I am glad to see that there is a product like this to help in between sets or for whenever your nails need a breather. Julep is a GREAT company and I have been to their brick and morter stores in Seattle quite a few times. Awesome product, just not a great color (on me).
summary: I like this and the concept

reviewText:
This was ok, but nothing to get too excited over. I prefer good ole Sally Hansen products over this Julep. They perform better and are much more affordable. I am going on 40 years old and have been using the Sally Hansen products since I was a teenager. They consistently work wonders to strengthen your nails and help them grow longer (by not breaking or peeling/cracking).

I did not find this Julep product to be very effective for strengthening, or making them harder in general. The peeling still occurs because the product itself peels as well. This didn't work well as a hardener, even with multiple coats.

This Julep has somewhat of an opaque finish. So, like all opaques, you can end up with streaks unless you carefully apply thin, even coats.

This product claims to let your nails breathe, but really we have no way of knowing if it actually does.

These types of strengtheners are applied daily (or more often if you so desire) and this one peels and chips, whereas the Sally Hansen products do not.

This does give a clean look with a sheer pink wash of color and can be more appealing to some than just the clear products such as the Sally Hansen. However, you could also buy a sheer pink polish and it will last longer on your nails.

For me, this was just a "meh" product. There are better performing alternatives that are much more affordable.

I don't paint my nails with solid colors but like to take care of them and coat them with a clear gloss.

I love this nail treatment. It is like my clear gloss with the slightest tint of pink. When it fades, it is not that noticeable. I just remove what is left on my fingers and reapply new coating.

One thing, the brush seems to get a long of polish on it so be sure to wipe the sides well or you will get too much when you apply. My daughter loved the look so much; she has painted her nails twice with it.
summary: Classy looking with a small tint of pink...

reviewText: Nail polish works great. Very log lasting.  Cool colors as well.  Really like this brand and will try other colors.

I generally dislike wearing any kind of polish on my nails, but my nails are very weak and prone to breaking and chipping.
I was pretty desperate and more than willing to give this product a chance despite my dislike of polish.

It goes on easily and dries quickly. I found that it does help prevent breaking and chipping, and it only adds a light pink
see through coat to your nails, almost a natural color with a bit of gloss.

I would recommend trying this product if you have nails that break easily. My nails are not thin, but they break if you look
at them wrong and I found this product to be helpful.
As a light coat on nails instead of just a clear finish I loved it. I didn't see any great benefits and after about 5 loads of dishwashing, and 3 days it started to chip

For me, this doesn't work as a nail treatment. Sure, it's beautifully packaged with a well trimmed, supple brush, goes on smoothly and dries fast. The problem comes 24 to 48 hours later when it starts to chip or wear off at the tips. The tips are where my problem is, so when the polish comes off there it not only leaves the nail exposed, but also seems to take some surface nail cells with it as it goes. So chipping polish is worse for me than no polish at all.

A better solution for me is Nailtiques Formula 2 Plus as a base with this polish as a second coat. The Nailtiques seems to adhere much more securely to my nail, giving it real strength and not chipping or peeling off. As a second coat, this Julep provides a smoothing, subtle finish. But at the price it really does not seem worth it. The real improvement to my nails comes only when I use the Nailtiques (I tested for the full month before writing this review). Two other things I've done that really helped my nails: added biotin supplements to my regimen and treated my nails with castor oil between manicures. And both of those are cheap! Oh, and better yet, Nailtiques has been very inexpensive on Amazon as an Add-On item.
summary: Beautiful packaging and a great brush aren't going to give me great nails

reviewText:
Some of my nails peel, some don't.  In the past 3 years, I wore imPRESS nails which I loved & I've been using do it yourself LED (light) nail polish which I also love.  The problem is, I tend to pull the imPRESS nails off & pick at the LED polish instead of removing it properly.  Both these bad habits made my peeling nails worse & I've been having trouble strengthening them again.

Through the years, I've used a few different nail strengtheners.  I have a couple favorite brands that  when used according to directions they protect & harden my nails enough that my nails grow out again.  Their (my nails) nature is to peel, so eventually they'll begin peeling...no matter how healthy they are. I also found a filler polish which helps even out the ridges caused by peeling layers.

I've been testing Julep Take A Breather Oxygen Nail Treatment for about two weeks now.  It seems to act as a filler & a nail hardener.  It is a milky pink color which when applied looks more sheer.  It seems to hide imperfections pretty good...my peeled layers look much nicer & smoother.  It also hardens my nail. (I test this by trying to bend my nails that have peeled & are thinner on the edges)
I've been applying two coats, then wait a few days and apply another.  I've found that I don't like the looks of the polish when I use 4 or more coats.  For me to have the polish look presentable, I should remove the polish on about day 5 & start over.

This polish does seem to chip easier than some polishes.
According to instructions, it works best if used alone so I haven't applied additional color on top of it.
It is a sheer pink which looks milky pink but when applied it is sheer & surprisingly helps hide & smooth my peeled layers.
The polish becomes more opaque when 4 or more coats have been applied.  However, I don't like the looks of the polish if I use more than 3 coats.
The container looks like it would easily tip over, but its weight helps keep it upright.  Even at that I am more cautious when using it, especially when I remove excess polish from the brush.

I'm now at the two week mark of using this polish continually, as instructed, and it seems to be working.
I like the way it helps hide/cover/fill-in the layers caused by my peeling nails.  It doesn't completely hide them, but definitely improves their appearance.
summary: After two week test on nails that peel - it is strengthening my nails, my nails are growing out &  helps hide peeled layers

reviewText: The nail treatment is essentially another nail polish with some added ingredients for nail health, I think. It has subtle pink color and nice sheen. I did not notice much change in my nail condition with use. And it chips off way too easily. The package says to apply another layer in 3-4 days, but mine looked bad by the next morning, flaking away on all sides, no way it can stay on for 3 days.

This nail treatment gave my nails a much needed boost. The color when applied is a very natural and glossy sheer pink. After about three days, I applied a second coat. Now, after 6 days since the first application, it looks like the original coat is breaking up underneath the second coat, so I will probably need to go ahead an remove both current coats.

While, I don't think this will magically transform brittle nails, I do think that it was definitely not detrimental. My nails look healthier and I really like the light sheen this nail treatment gives them! I think it could definitely be a plus if you're needing to help rebuild strength in your nails after applying  artificial nails or harsher gel polishes.

As a nail polish, this is a nice very subtle pink gloss. My widened been wearing it for a couple of weeks now and has not noticed any difference in her nail strength or health on account of the alleged oxygenation.
summary: this is a nice very subtle pink gloss

reviewText:
I usually use NailEnvy for my severely weakened nails.  I am happy to see this really sheer pink on my nails.  It looks pretty.

My nail problem is causing me some difficulty.  They have become very weak.  I am having a protein problem that is just ungainly.  I have been seeing a nutritionist for over a year and she said once my nail and hair became problems, I would know I am not getting on top of it.

I'm not.  <sigh>

My wife says she doesn't see much of a difference and it chips and peels a lot. So I feel like it needs a clear coat over it but that the clear coat will probably negate the fact that this polish can "breath". So I dunno. It's fine, but I don't know that it's anything special.
summary: It's ok, but expensive for ok

reviewText:
I rarely wear polish on my nails because I'm busy and also garden a lot and polish never lasts more than a day without starting to chip off because of that.  I tried this because it was sheer with a little color and I really like it. It applies evenly and dries very quickly.  The first time I applied it, I applied two coats and that gives you a more frosted pink look.  The second time I applied it I applied just one coat and I prefer the sheer look of that and it seems to last longer before chipping if I only apply the one coat.

If this was marketed as just a nail polish and reasonably priced, I would definitely buy it and wear it a lot.  But marketed as a treatment with such an expensive price on it seems gimmicky to me and the price isn't justified to me.  It still chips off quickly and my nails are no stronger than using any other polish. I will use up this bottle and be done with it unless the pricing comes down significantly on it.
summary: Great sheer nail polish but nothing beyond that to me

reviewText: I like this bare nail color.. Again, no shine upon drying and it dries very quickly.  You absolutely need to add a shine nail  product to this. I use OPI Infinite Shine #3 .. Awesome product.
summary: I like this bare nail color

reviewText:
Julep is an expensive brand that has its own subscription service and sells in Sephora. In the past I've been wary of it, feeling that it's all about packaging and marketing, while the product itself is very watery, with the end result being that you have to apply several coats just to see the polish, and thus use up the bottle in no time.

This sheer pink, however, is not too bad. Using just one coat, it leaves a touch of pink that has the glossy transparency of a French manicure. Perhaps because the liquid is thin (typical of Julep), it dries fairly quickly. Though the product is reputedly "vegan" friendly, the smell of the nail polish was still very strong and kept my cat away.

This gimmick with this one is that it has ingredients to help you strengthen your nails. Since regular nail polish already adds an additional layer of protection over your nails, I'm not seeing any difference as yet. So far its chief value is its appearance. Overall, it doesn't look too bad, but I still prefer Essie polish, for the price and the thicker feel of the polish that you get.
summary: Leaves a Touch of Pink with the Glossy Transparency of a French Manicure

reviewText:
The sheer pink leaves a transparent healthy looking shiny finish. The instructions state it should be applied without a base and top coat, and whenever I apply polish that way, not just this brand, it begins to chip within a couple of days. That coupled with the fact that the bottle only holds .27 ounce, unlike most others that contain almost twice the quantity (.50 ounce) at a fraction of the cost, the product will not last long.

It does dry reasonably fast and acts as a cosmetic filler to mask imperfections but I am not sure I am seeing any healthy benefit to my nails, which have always been thin and tend to peel and easily split. The fumes smell as toxic as any other polish so even with the formaldehyde removed there is no noticeable improvement with that aspect. And, since using nail polish remover contributes to weakness in my nails, the quick chipping and need to reapply frequently actually seems to lessen their health rather than improve it.

And although I like the distinctive look of the tall, thin bottle, the design is impractical and unstable to actually use because it tends to tip over. While applying the polish I spent more time than usual just trying to carefully get the brush back into the bottle than with any other brand. Theres a reason why most nail polish bottles have a heavier base.

Ultimately I like the look of the polish on my nails and love the idea of a healthier product so nails can breathe and heal/improve strength Im just not sure that is happening. Perhaps because I am not trying to correct recent trauma but rather just contending with nails that have never been particularly strong, the results are not easy to measure.
summary: Julep Oxygen Nail Treatment Sheer Pink

reviewText: I'm not normally a person that uses nail polish very often. This "Take a Breather" nail polish appealed to me for the simple pale pink color and that 30% more oxygen gets to your nails. Julep is a quality brand for polish and makeup. Recommended.

I didn't think I would like Julep Nail Treatment/ Sheer Coat at first, because the fluid seemed to thin- the polish just dripped fairly quickly off the brush, and it seemed thinner in consistency than any other polish i have. Still, when i tried this on, it actually had good coverage, went on smoothly, and added just enough color to make my nails look healthy, covering the slightly stained/ dull yellow tint i get sometimes from long term polish use. It makes my nails look like naked healthy nails that have been buffed--and, it feels pretty good on.  I really like the the way this looks with one coat, and i don't think i need another. The directions say you can wear one or two coats, and then reapply another coat after three to four days. They recommend not using this with other polishes.  If you want to give your nails a break from your gels or acrylics, but don't want to have ugly looking nails, this is a good product to get.

update: i've used this for 2 mo. now, and i am surprised and happy to say that my nails do feel stronger, and have grown out without ripping off or chipping as easily as they did before i tried this. this treatment really sticks on the nails and does not flake off too easily. even if it flakes a bit over time, the color is so neutral, it's not very noticeable. i thought this was a bit pricey when i first used it, but it really does seem worth the money.
summary: Very Sheer & Natural- Just a Hint of Color and Shine

reviewText:
What's not to love?

This is a strengthener that polishes and shines nails with a very light sheer pink,natural tint.  It is great for summer when I like a bare, natural look and don't like to spend a lot of time fussing over my nails.  It goes on easily, and since it is mostly clear it is very forgiving if it's not perfectly applied.  It dries very quickly - with a fan on my nails it took about a minute to be 'finger touch' dry.

After application my nails look very shiny but mostly just natural colored with the lightest touch of natural pink.

The square bottle is easy to hold, fits in my makeup organizer well, and the brush is basic, but easy to use.
It lasts on me for about 2 days, then starts coming off.
summary: Very sheer color, quick dry, leaves nails very, very shiny with just a hint of natural sheer pink

reviewText:
On the box there is an information slip taped on the back stating this product is for nails damaged by acrylics or gels. I have neither issue but I do have weak nails with texture issues. This nail treatment goes on very easily (no running or blobs) and dries very fast. On me, a very pale person, this dries clear with no distinguishable color at all. It just leaves shine. This also seems to minimize ridges in my nails.

I was hoping for some color from this product and didn't get any. On the bright side, it is very easy to put on even for those of us not dexterous with nail polish. I really like the quick drying time. Good brush, unique frosted container. You can't mistake this for other brands! I like it a lot, wears well.
summary: Works as a nearly clear polish on me ( sheer pink). Does seem to hide some ridges and nail irregularities

reviewText:
I really like this product, in fact there is nothing to dislike about it.
Dries fast, leaves your nails looking nice.  The pale color is flattering to everyone I think.
I was trying to get my nail beds to improve since my last manicure was a gel manicure and it did damage to my nails.  Left them pitted.
Never again!
This nail treatment is helping my nails heal and they look good.
summary: Highly recommended---actually healing some nail damage I had from a gel manicure

reviewText:
I love that this product does not have any carcinogens in it. I quit using nail polish for years because my nails were always terrible about three days after when I removed the nail polish.  This nail polish is so light pink that ir was as if I was  just adding shine. So it matches my nails before using the polish.

I have had tearing, bending and breaking nails since I was a kid. I have tried a clear product before that was supposed to help but it didn't improve my nails at all. For me, this product makes a very good clear nail polish. If it does actually improve my nail strength after a couple weeks of use, I will come back and up date this review.

One thing that I noticed is that there is still the bad chemical smell when the bottle is open and you are applying it. I would love it if there was some way of getting rid of that.
summary: Looks The Same As Clear For My Nails

reviewText: This is unique nail polish because it actually lets your fingernails breathe! Wo knew that nails need to breathe? Well, if you normallr wear polish, you'll notice the difference right away - it just feels lighter.
summary: This is unique nail polish because it actually lets your ...

reviewText:
Love it! Gives nails a break between colors. Great for when running out the door and want nails to look finished and pretty.  Much better than clear.
The secret to no chipping and making this a long lasting finish is to buff your nails slightly before application. Stays on for a few weeks as a nice polished sheen.
summary: Love it! Gives nails a break between colors

reviewText:
I've always had weak brittle nails that are prone to peeling and tearing, especially when I'm trying to grow them out.  I've also really been into nail polish lately including gel polish that requires and LED light, so with all the acetone remover my nails have been especially delicate.  I've been rotating painting my nails with regular polish and painting my nails with this nail treatment and it really does seem to work.  I've been prepping my nails with a cuticle remover and then painting on two coats.  I like that it dries quickly, has a nice sheen, and that my nails do feel harder and more resistant to damage when I have it on.  I've been wearing it plain with no polish on top but I've also heard from women in a nail polish group I belong to that it works really well as a base coat as well.  I also like that I see the benefits even after I take it off.

The only thing worth noting is that Julep's regular sized polishes and treatments are smaller than most standard polishes so you are not getting a ton of product for your money, but it is very effective.
summary: Strengthens nails and makes them look pretty in the process.

reviewText: Lanza is my favorite hair product brand, for some reason this product didn't meet my expectations, it leaves your hair really greasy and I didn't see a big difference in my hair.

This product is absolutely amazing! I have very fine blonde and gray hair that's just below my ears. I was seriously going to have it cut short because it always looked  like cotton candy..flyaway with no body. The only way i could make it look good was to laboriously put curlers in it. With this shampoo, combined with the even more amazing Lanza Combing Cream (which I just re-ordered, because I don't EVER want to run out!) all I need is my hot brush and a few minutes. I get a smooth "do" with plenty of shine and body.

I'm giving 5 Stars since ever since my hairdresser introduced me to this particular line I have had much healtier and shinier hair I use this shampoo every time I wash my hair and it's a really rich texture that really moisturizes/cleans and smells wonderful the duo with the conditioner is very good also however I have been using this shampoo with other conditioners with great results! I have a lot of highlights and this shampoo is great for keeping your color staying bright, which is due to the lack of chemicals it contains - Love this shampoo it really does give great healthy shiny looking hair!! I have tried the other Lanza Shampoo's and they don't nearly compare to this one I actually had to return them and re-order this particular Lanza Shampoo! Thank u amazon for carrying this!
Delivered on time and is what I expected.

Juice Beauty's Green Apple Hand Cream is nice, but not a favorite.

This is a nice lotion that absorbs well.  I don't feel like my fingers are greasy after applying and I don't need to wipe my hands.  But with a name like Green Apple, I was looking for an apple fragrance.  What I get is more of a sugared lemon.  It's OK, but it doesn't knock my socks off.

Juice beauty says the hand cream will:

- diminish the appearance of dark spots and discoloration
- replenish and deeply hydrate
- brighten the appearance of skin and smooth fine lines
- nourish and hydrate

I don't have discoloration or spots, so I don't know if that aspect works, but I find the hydration effects to be short term and just as good as other lotions I've used in the past.

This is a reasonable hand cream, especially if you like the lemony scent.  It's not my favorite fragrance and I'll try something else next time.

One of the best hand creams I have used in awhile and it is safe! The smell is strong and does seem a bit like lemon pledge. I don't mind it but some may so if you aren't sure seeing if you like it first is never a bad idea. Doesnt leave hands sticky
summary: One of the best hand creams I have used in awhile and it ...

reviewText: I like Juice Beauty products-really their bb cream is excellent and has great coverage. This hand cream isn't this exatly what I was expecting-I thought it would smell more like a green apple jolly rancher and it's more like an herbal or citrus apple scent. That said, aloe juice is the 1st ingredient so maybe it shouldn't surprise me (apple juice, white grape juice, lemon juice and sunflower seed oil, all organic, are next). HOWEVER, it does a great job of smoothing my hands. I wouldn't say it lasts through a washing but they're much smoother and it's not just a 'feeling' of smooth, like silicone, but really smooth. As far as the claim that it lessens hyperpigmentation, I'm not sure how effective it is but with the lemon juice it would make sense. I like that there are no parabens and that it's organic and that my hands are really smooth.
summary: Great for Smoothing, Nice Citrus Apple scent

reviewText: My wife has been using hand creams for a long tome and is constantly checking out new products. She has a couple of tried & true hand creams she uses depending on bargains & prices. This product she like because it was non greasy, there was no detectable scent, and the hand cream absorbed very well. As far as the aging claims, the jury is still out. That takes more time than she has used it to tell. Over it is a good hand cream, yet the price is a little higher than she likes.
summary: Absorbs Very Well, Non Greasy, and No Detectable Scent.

reviewText:
The Juice Beauty Green Apple Age Defy Hand Cream was not impressive in my opinion. It is a lightweight cream which goes on smoothly and is well absorbed. It is a little too well absorbed for my skin. Two applications back to back weren't enough to make my hands feel moisturized.

Being a fan of scented hand cream, as long as they are pleasant, I was really hoping this would smell like green apples. It took a little while before I was able to decide that it reminds me of Pledge furniture polish. It is slightly lemony scented, not over-powering and the smell seemed to quickly fade.

The Juice Beauty line boasts that their products are organic. This hand cream does appear to contain some very healthy ingredients. But not everything in it is organic. You'll want to keep this mind as you consider making your purchase.

I'm including an ingredients list:

Organic juices of aloe barbadensis (organic aloe juice)*, pyrus malus (organic apple juice)*,  vitis vinifera (organic white grape juice)*, citrus medica limonum (organic lemon juice)*, vegetable glycerin,  helianthus annuus (organic sunflower seed oil)*, ethylhexyl palmitate, caprylic/ capric triglyceride, glyceryl stearate, stearic acid,  palmitoyl pentapeptide-4, acetyl hexapeptide-3,  cetearyl alcohol, organic plant oils of butyrospermum parkii (organic shea butter)*, simmondsia chinensis (organic jojoba seed oil)*, oenothera biennis (organic evening primrose oil)*, linum usitatissimum (organic linseed oil)*, borago officinalis (organic borage seed oil)*, xanthan gum, magnesium ascorbyl phosphate (Vitamin C), panthenol (Vitamin B5), allantoin, tocopherol (Vitamin E), ethylhexylglycerin, sodium benzoate, potassium sorbate, citrus reticulata (mandarin), litsea cubeba (may chang) and cinnamomum camphora (ho wood) pure essential oils

While I am not offended by the smell of this product, I am underwhelmed with it's performance for the price. I've not used it long enough to know if it in fact does diminish the fine lines on hands. I'm doubtful that it would in my case since it is not providing enough hydration for my dry skin.

I'll finish the tube and then probably return to using Aveeno Active Naturals Skin Relief Hand Cream for daily basis.

When able to afford it, I treat myself to Crabtree & Evelyn Lavender Ultra-Moisturizing Hand Therapy which is pricey but worth every penny.
summary: Did not provide enough hydration for my dry skin

reviewText: I have very dry skin and it drives me crazy after I wash my hands if I don't have a lotion to apply. My usual choices are either Cetaphil Moisturizing Lotion or Vaseline Intensive Care Healthy Hand & Nail Conditioning Hand Lotion, and a former favorite, before it was discontinued, was Avon's Rich Moisture Hand and Nail Cream. I mention these to give you a basis for comparison; if you like one of those, I think you would like Juice Beauty Green Apple Age Defy Hand Cream, as well. I don't usually care for apple-scented products, but this one seems more citrus than apple to me. I like the fragrance, and I like that it dissipates quickly. I also like what they left out of this product: parabens, petroleum products, phthalates, and dyes. Many of the other ingredients are organic, and most are naturally derived (though not all of them). I can't speak to whether it truly minimizes fine lines or diminishes hyperpigmentation; I think you'd have to use it for many weeks before any change would be noticeable. I can say it contains ingredients that claim to do that, independent of this particular cream. The cream goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and leaves skin feeling very smooth. The one drawback I've found is that I have to apply it twice to get the best benefit. Each time I use it, a few minutes later my skin feels somewhat dry again; after I apply it a second time, it seems to last until the next time I wash my hands. Possibly I'm not applying enough to begin with, but either way, it makes the Juice Beauty cream a pretty expensive option for me. Still, I like it better than many of the high-end brands I've tried, and I enjoy using it.

I am constantly washing my hands because I love to cook and to garden. In the winter this becomes a real issue as my hands chap and crack. I have used  heavy greasy lotions and found some relief but I really don't like using them because of the feel of the product. I also I worry about the chemicals I am putting on my hands possibly transferring  into our foods. This hand cream is a great alternative to the lotions I have been using. It is satiny smooth on application, absorbs easily and dries without leaving any noticeable residue behind. My skin looks hydrated and feels great. The product also contains more natural ingredients, so I don't worry as much about using it. My only quibble is the smell, I guess it is supposed to be green apple but it doesn't smell like any Granny Smith I have ever cut into! On the upside, the smell goes away very quickly and there is no odor noticeable on your hands afterwards.

Recommended.
summary: Nice light weight cream that moisturizes well

reviewText: What a wonderful hand cream.  It doesn't smell like apples though, to me it smells like lime.  It is thick and rich, but it absorbed quickly.

I love this hand cream! I work from home, and we have electric heat, so during these cold winter months, my hands become sore and chapped. I've been using this cream for about two weeks now, and have noticed that I no longer have chapped or sore hands!

I simply apply a small amount every time I wash my hands or do the dishes (no dishwasher here!) And it works! It really works.

Just a little dab will do you. My first application I put about a quarter size amount in my palm, and I thought I was going to hate it, because I felt greasy until the next hand washing, when I learned to apply between a dime size amount and a nickel size amount. It works in well, and leaves no greasy feeling afterward.

Like others, I was expecting a green apple scent; however, I was pleasantly surprised that the cream actually smells like lemon verbena, which is one of my favorites.
This time of year is very rough on skin so I was eager to try this. The cream is nongreasy and moisturizes my hands. I put it on at night and my hands felt very soft the next morning. And of course, the smell was lovely and not at all overpowering. The size is perfect for storing in a purse, car console or just tucked in a drawer at work.
The ingredients look very impressive (and yummy): aloe juice, apple juice, lemon juice, white grape juice. sunflower seed oil, jojoba, among others.
summary: Love the scent (but it's not green apple)

reviewText: I really like this hand cream, it keeps my hands feeling nice and silky soft, although in only a weeks use, I don't really notice a reduction in fine wrinkles.. The main reason I like it is for it's good clean ingredients - not a lot of crazy chemicals in it.  It is a small tube, but a little goes a long way.
summary: Nice organic option for hand cream, leaves my hands very soft

reviewText:
I tried some of juice beauty's eye cream and really liked it, so I thought I'd give this stuff a try. The smell is nice and fruity (mix of aloe, apple, grape, and lemon juice) and it leaves my hands soft and not oily. Though the package touts jojoba oil and shea butter as ingredients, they are pretty far down the ingredients list, behind octyl palmitate, capric triglycerides, glyceryl stearate, stearic acid, palmitoyl pentapeptide-4, acetyl hexapeptide-3, and cetearyl alcohol. I'm not sure how amazing it will be with its "age-defying Vitamin C", either, since that's even further down the ingredients list. But I still like it, especially now that it's almost winter and my hands and cuticles are going to be ripped to shreds if I don't moisturize!

The label is also kind of sneaky in its use of "CERTIFIED ORGANIC" labeling - if you read the fine print, you'll see that it's actually just made with SOME organic ingredients. Basically, any ingredient (like the juices) that can be certified organic are, but then there are lots of random vitamins and stabilizers and things that aren't.

I actually looked up some of the ingredients that sound like they came straight out of my Chem 101 textbook. The palmitoyl pentapeptide-4, for example, is made of amino acids and is apparently considered to be as effective against wrinkles as retinol, but less irritating. One study found that it was as effective as retinol in repairing sun-damaged skin but was devoid of side-effects.  Sooo... there may be some truth to the age-defying aspect of this product, but I'm not holding my breath ;)
summary: Nice smell, not greasy, and a good value

reviewText: This lotion is thick and rich, yet doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy or sticky like others I have tried. Instead my hands feel silky and soft. It doesn't smell anything like green apple to me, but I love the smell just the same. It's almost like lemon zest but it's not overpowering at all. You can smell it strongly while you're rubbing the lotion into your skin, but once it's absorbed the smell is gone. Best of all, when I look at the ingredients it's made mostly of organic juices and plant oils.
summary: Smells like lemon zest and leaves your skin feeling silky and smooth.

reviewText: I've been using this hand cream for several days now, and I really like the scent - it smells faintly like real apples, not the least bit fake'y or overpowering.  My husband is sensitive to perfumes, so this is a real treat for me to have something that smells nice that doesn't give him fits :)  It's a decent hand cream, you just need a small amount, about the size of your pinky fingernail.  I used WAY too much the first time and it left a greasy residue, but if you use the right amount that won't be a problem.

I assumed this would smell like green apple, but it really doesn't. It smells like the generic hand lotion they leave for you in hotel room bathrooms. Not too strong, but not too fabulous either. I would have liked a more distinct smell, but then again, some other people might prefer the nondescript scent of this lotion.

As a lotion, it is pretty great. Not too oily, but a deep enough moisturizing effect for dry hands. My office is terribly dry, so I keep it with me there and it has been great. It is definitely a tiny tube, though.

After doing the daily household chores and putting the utensils in the dishwasher, my hands had become dry and rough. I was looking for a hand cream that will revive my dry skin and make it soft and shiny. I found the solution to my problem with this hand cream.

Some of the features are as follows:-
1) It is organically made and does not contain harmful chemicals, parabens, petroleum,artificial dyes or synthetic fragrances
2) It is prepared with shea, jojoba and sunflower which hydrates and replenishes the dry skin and makes it soft and beautiful.
3) The vitamin C content moisturizes the skin and minimizes wrinkles.
2) It is not sticky and absorbs to the skin well.

This cream makes my hand soft and look more youthful.
summary: Makes dry and rough hands soft and hydrated ..

reviewText: I really like the texture and scent of the Juice Beauty Hand Cream. The fresh fruity scent is pleasant and lingers for a while without being overwhelming or cloying. The lotion is thick and rich and seems a bit greasy at first, but absorbs well into the skin after you vigorously massage it into the hands. After a short period of use, I can't really confirm the "Age Defying" claim, but my hands definitely look smoother and softer and less dry after use. It stays on for quite a while - until the next time I wash my hands, after which I reapply it. This is the first Juice Beauty product I've used, and I'm sure it won't be the last!
summary: I really like the texture and scent of the Juice Beauty Hand ...

reviewText: I am sensitive to scents, particularly in skin care products. Despite the Juice Beauty Green Apple Age Defy Hand Cream being a good hand cream, the scent is a turn off for me and I'm glad that it wears off before the cream stops moisturizing. My dry hands are the perfect target for this cream and it is absorbed very well without leaving a greasy film, but it's hard for me to enjoy the citrus smell. The acids from fruit juices are what work to remove skin spots, so they want those juices in this product for it to perform as an "age defy"ing cream. Otherwise, it would be a moisturizing hand cream and nothing more. I've placed this small tube at my kitchen sink and I'm using it after washing dishes but I'll continue using my Trader Joe's Nourish Shea Butter hand cream in the same size tube for other times during the day. The 2 ounce size is very totable, so I see why it's sold in this size. I have had larger tubes that just did not hold up in a purse or bag. A strong positive for this Juice cream is that the tube was sealed well so you don't have to wonder about it being tampered with or exposed to air. If I do note that my hands look younger by the time this tube is depleted, I'll update this review.
summary: Small tube can easily be carried and is TSA transportable

reviewText: This is one of the best smelling lotions I have tried this year--it has a lemongrass and apple scent that is crisp and refreshing, energizing and not overpowering. The ingredients are more natural than many, so that is an added bonus. No greasy finish. Excellent!

I like the feel of this hand cream - it's not greasy and you don't need to use much - which is a good thing as this is expensive.  I go through a lot of hand cream especially in the winter and with this product, you're only getting 2 ounces of hand cream for $12 (the tube is less than 6 inches tall) which will not last very long.

However, if organic hand cream is important to you, you may want to spend the money.

I'm not sure how much this hand cream will reduce fine lines and wrinkles. As a woman in my mid-50s, I've started to get crepe paper-looking skin on my hands. This hand cream reduced those wrinkles as much as any absorbent hand cream does.

I also found the scent to be unpleasant. It did not smell at all like green apples - more of a citrusy smell. The smell disappears quickly, but if you're expecting a nice apple smell, you'll be disappointed.
summary: Not greasy, but expensive with a citrus-like smell

reviewText: I really like this hand cream.  It goes on smoothly and does reduce the lines in my hand.  It just takes a small amount and that is a good thing as it is a really small tube and sells for $12 at tube.  If you like natural products this is one for you.

Unlike other hand creams I've used, the top of the tube has been stamped/sealed by foil, as if it were medication or Ben-Gay rather than a hand cream.  The good part about this packaging is that it keeps the cream tightly sealed and factory fresh. Perhaps the manufacturer did this because it's been made with organic ingredients.  Though I love the fact the cream has no harmful ingredients, I wonder if the tighter packaging was necessary because, in my experience, organic products tend to go bad faster than those that have lots of artificial and synthetic ingredients. But then, I don't have much experience with organic health and body products, so this is just speculation.

As for feel and smell, I love the fact that it makes my hands feel soft with no extra residue.  As for the fragrance, it was so subtle that I hardly noticed it was there.  "Green apple" made me expect the strong fragrance of similarly named Bath and Body Works products, but this one definitely didn't do it for me - it offered a light, almost imperceptible citrus scent.

As for the "age-defying" claim, I don't have that many wrinkles on my hands so I can't say if it works in that area. However, since the ingredients are organic, I might try using it on my face to see if it has any impact on the wrinkles there :)

Lastly, the price is higher than your typical drugstore products but I would pay more for anything with organic and all-natural ingredients.  However, I'm not sure I would buy this again - I like it overall, but the scent was just too mild for me and cream didn't do that much more for my hands than other products I already have (Aveda, Burt's Bees, Sabon, L'Occitane)

reviewText: Wow - I really like this hand cream.  I haven't used it long enough to benefit from its age-defying properties, but just as a hand cream, it is the best I've used in a long time! This cream must really soak in, as I can use it, do a little hand-rubbing, and pick up my IPad minutes later, ready to play Words with Friends without leaving icky residue on my keyboard! I love the incredible milk by milkshake so I figured Id give this leave in a try. I definitely prefer the incredible milk over the leave in.
