reviewText:
I have been using the NuFace Trinity Facial trainer kit with the wrinkle reducer attachment for a few weeks now. Best results take up to 60 days but I will give my best early impression now since I need to leave a review within 30 days in exchange for testing out the product.
This kit includes the facial toning device, wrinkle reducer attachment and a tube of primer gel. There are a couple of instruction booklets and the charger cable and cradle. I am impressed with the quality of the device itself. It is very well made and the curved design fits well both in your hand and on the contours of your face.
Bonus points from me for being dual voltage for use overseas and for the charger having retractable prongs for travel or storage.
I have pretty average combination skin and have had no adverse reaction to using this on a regular basis.
I was especially concerned about the red light wrinkle attachment but it actually feels very pleasant during treatment - just a nice, warm feeling when pressed against your skin. It is not necessary to use the primer gel with the wrinkle attachment, which makes it easy for me to stick to a routine of using just before bed. I keep the device next to my bed and use it while catching up on Netflix or listening to music. There is a built in timer so you don't have to watch the clock when using the device with either attachment.
It's too early to see what long term improvements there may be but I do like using this device. It makes me feel as if I am pampering my face and I like being able to do this in the privacy of my own home at my own convenience.
To get the best results, you need to make a serious commitment to using this as directed several times as week. But once I got comfortable with how the device works, it really has been easy to keep up with my routine.
I am a cynic when it comes to something like this but my skin certainly feels better than it did before. But the real test will be whether or not I see any significant improvement in the next 30 days. While this is a quality device that feels luxurious to use, unless it delivers the results it promises, it will not be worth the cost.
So stay tuned since I will definitely be back to update on my progress...

As I've gotten older I've noticed that my skin isn't as firm in some areas as it used to be.  I don't have a lot of wrinkles, but I have noticed a slight amount of sagging, especially around the jawline so I decided to try to head off any further decline with the NuFACE muscle trainer.

First I have to say, that I've haven't been as diligent as you need to be to see noticeable results.  Sometimes I use it a couple of times a week, other times I've not done it at all.  Even though the product is rechargeable the biggest downfall, other than the amount of time it takes and the cost of the gel, is that it needs to be on the charger for a long period of time and I have very limited space in the bathroom and only two outlet plugs.  The whole family uses this bathroom including small children so I don't feel like I can leave this out to charge like it needs to be in order for it to be ready to use as often as what you need to see the results I am after.  I wish the charges lasted longer and had a protective cap so that accidental zapping wouldn't occur.  I also wish that they would have included all of the attachments that are available for purchase into this kit considering the price.

From what I read from other reviewers, the manufacturer has significantly improved this version of the NuFace from the old one. I can only hope that when they decide to revise it again that they will take some of these things into account.

If I had it to do over would I get it again?  Considering everything, probably not.  That being said, I do feel that I've seem some change for the better so I do  believe that this product works.  I guess I just need to decide if I'm just going to try to age gracefully and let nature take it's course, or if I am going to work around the issues that I have and be regimented about using this product regularly to see even better results.
summary: Works if you use it as directed

reviewText:
First off, I chose to use an aloe vera gel instead of the included gel. I wanted a more natural option that I could feel good about leaving on my skin. As long as I have enough aloe gel, I really don't feel any of the micro current. When I do feel it, it's not overly uncomfortable, just noticeable.
Best of all...IT WORKS! Hang in there, give it a week or so of consistent use. I was disappointed at first since I didn't see an immediate difference as I had read could be possible. But, after using it for 5 days, in a row, I could definitely see a difference. What pleased me the most was the furrow between my brows lessened dramatically! That alone was enough to keep me using this.
I found a video online that shows how to use it on other parts of the body. I regularly do my neck and have also used this on my hands. Highly recommend!

I have only been using this product for about two weeks. Before using this device, the instructions advise removing all make up, wash your face, and apply the included gel. The gel is odorless and wipes off easy, but messy after you apply it to your entire face. As for the actual device, it delivers light electrical shocks as you run it over the gel on your face. It does sting a little bit, but not so much that I would describe it as painful, even on the highest setting. After completely the treatment, my facial muscles do feel tighter/twitchy, but I have not seen noticeable results yet. I will continue to use the product for a little while longer, but I am beginning to get bored with the process without seeing any results.

 I was slightly disappointed when I first received this product and discovered that the attachments shown on the box are not included and must be purchased separately.

As a Vine reviewer, I am required to post a review after 30 days. Because this is well under the manufacturer's suggested time with the product, this review only covers my first experience with the NuFace itself, not its effectiveness.

PROS

BUILD QUALITY: Other reviewers have complained about the build quality of the NuFACE, but I think it's quite nice and, as a designer, I have a pretty high bar. Granted, it looks a bit like a frog, but overall it's quite nice.

ERGONOMICS: The NuFACE feels good in the hand.

CONS

CHARGING LIGHT: Why oh why do products intended for bedrooms and bathrooms insist on bright, blue lights? Studies show that blue light triggers the brain to wake up. The light the NuFACE emits while charging is bright enough to illuminate my entire (rather large) master bathroom. I really don't need a "Facial Trainer" to be the most prominent thing in my bathroom. Nor do I need it to trigger me to wake up every time I make a midnight pitstop. Silly and unnecessary.

UNCOMFORTABLE: This isn't the most comfortable treatment. You'll feel a mild sting throughout the process. And if you have a problem with acne, forget about it. I've noticed that even the slightest facial blemish, scratch, or sunburn is irritated, rather profoundly, but the electrical current given off by the NuFace.

As for effectiveness, I'll update my review after I've had more time with the product.
summary: Mixed bag as a first impression, will update review after more time

reviewText:
I realize that using this product is a marathon, rather than a sprint. I am in my 30s and started noticing lines around my mouth recently, which is something that drives me crazy. I am willing to invest the time, for vanity sake.

This product requires an initial 12-hour charge and nightly charges after that. Most importantly, the toner gel that is included (and quite small, no big enough for a marathon)  needs to be used with the facial trainer, without it...not pleasant. I am using aloe vera as the gel in the interim because that gel is so dang expensive.

I have noticed a slight difference in my facial muscles and continuing my daily use to continue to see more. Will update as results become more clear.

I rated NuFACE Trinity four stars because it seems like a good home based treatment that can save you a lot of money in the long term. This is FDA-cleared, multi-solution, skin care device innovatively-designed with interchangeable treatment attachments  that are suppose to help rejuvenate and improve your appearance. The product is designed rather on the larger side, than what I had imagined it to be more comfortable holding and the metal spheres to be smaller aswell. There is a gap between both spheres, which I would have preferred a flat surface for better coverage of the entire wrinkle line.

I was drawn to this product to help reduce my deep forehead wrinkles. The directions were easy to follow and they suggest that you use it for atleast 5 days per week and 5 minutes per day. I have not done it consistently for atleast 5 days per week but I have done it for nearly 5 minutes at a time and have not seen results. The beeping is loud, even my husband came into the bathroom to ask what that beeping noise is lol.

Overall, this NuFace is worth a try, I would have loved to try out the Trinity Wrinkle Reducer attachment, since I don't need much help with this toning/facial trainer. I may end up testing this product on other part of my body, like thighs, to see if it improves cellulite. Tip: make sure the Gel Primer doesn't dry out because it can feel like a zap without it.

I realize there is no magic pill, bullet,or device to aid in anything related to the human body, specifically when it comes to aging. I am reviewing this as a Vine reviewer, who had 30 days to do so. I am reviewing this exactly 30 days after receiving it. So, when I tell you I've only started to see some signs of progress, I am more hopeful than anything that in the following weeks what is promised will be delivered.

Granted, anything worth doing is worth doing right. So, be patient. The good thing is is that this ergonomic device is rechargeable and very portable. You can do the training on the go which helps in setting your schedule. From what I've seen and then read, this will take some time.

It works by providing a mild electrical current to stimulate facial muscles back to a more youthful firmness. (Don't be stupid. Check with your doctor if you already have electrical devices in your body.) I am trying to lose weight  and as such, certain parts of the body shrinks more quickly than the other. One of those is the face. So, this has come in handy  or will come in handy  when I start to lose what the chunkiness once held taught.

Make sure your face is clean beforehand. They give you a gel to help cleanse it, but I would recommend an off-the-shelf cleanser and to make sure you really dry your face. Some users are reporting shocks. I suspect that this is because they didn't learn that electricity and water are a shocking combination. Understand as well that you can turn down the intensity of the current.
summary: prepare to wait to be happy

reviewText:
My first caveat would be to keep this item, while charging, in a hidden spot, or warn everyone NOT to pick this item up and try to use.  It will shock you, especially if you do not have the gel primer liberally applied everywhere you will applying this machine.  So beware of you have young, curious children, or an impulsive husband.

It is of utmost importance to apply the primer gel on every skin surface that you will be touching with the device, or you will definitely receive an unpleasant shock.  A very small tube of the primer gel is included.  Perusing prices for a replacement tube, a 2 oz tube goes for $12 and a larger, 5 oz tube goes for $40.  One tube does not last ling, especially if more than one person wants to use this device.  I've seen on other reviews where people just buy a big tube of ultrasound gel, and I think that would be a wiser choice.  I guess getting folks to buy the gel is how this company is making their money.  Especially since continuing and long term commitment to this treatment is necessary to get and keep results.

Instructions indicate some folks will see results immediately.  I have not.  I am 46 years old and do not have many deep or even fine wrinkles, except for some very small ones by my mouth and some on my forehead, so I will continue to treat those areas, as well as attempt to tone my jaw line also.  My husband is 50 and just has more wrinkles that I do (genetics!)  He is also using this item.  We will update as we see, or don't see, results.

I wish the item didn't need to sit in the charger cradle all the time.  The lights are annoying and bright.

If you do purchase this item, be prepared to spend a lot of time using it.  It does require a certain level of time and commitment, so I'm not going to express all my skepticism at this time regarding the results.  We shall see.  I will revisit and update my review at a future date.
summary: Requires a large amount of time and patience--do not expect immediate results.

reviewText:
When I was offered the NuFace Trinity Trainer Kit to try out, I was intrigued.  I turned 40 this past year and am definitely feeling the lure of products that promise younger looking skin, so I looked forward to trying this product.

First, I would definitely suggest watching the video which demonstrates use of the trainer rather than just relying on the written instructions (there is a website for the video in the product manual).  For three weeks, I've been taking the time to use the NuFace trainer as directed.  As long as I have the right amount of gel coverage, there is no sensation.  However, I also don't see noticeable results.  I will continue to use the kit as directed and am being a bit generous with the rating just in case long term use is the key.  I plan to update my review accordingly if after a longer period of time I still see no difference.

Although the video shows use of attachments, this kit doesn't come with those parts -- and they cost a pretty penny.  If you already have signs of aging that you want to minimize, I'd suggest sticking to a good skin care routine and trying an over the counter anti-aging cream.  I haven't bought one yet, but there do seem to be some products that can help.

If you are simply hoping to preserve the youthful skin you already have, don't smoke, use sunscreen, drink plenty of water, eat a healthy diet, and use a good moisturizer.

Wow! I have never tried a microcurrent facial stimulation device before and I noticed a difference right away! I am not a young person, so that may be why my skin appeared smoother and tighter so fast. If I skipped a day, it seemed that the smoothness did not last. I am going to use it daily instead of at least five times per week. You need to use the device for 60 days (at least five times per week) before you can reduce the number of days per week, but I have not used it for that long and had to complete a review in 30 days. Still, I think the results I have seen so far are remarkable! To maintain results, you must use this device 2-3 days per week. Now my daughter is trying it as well to see if it evens out her skin tone.

What IS In The Box
1 NuFACE Trinity facial toning device
1 NuFACE Trinity facial trainer (microcurrent attachment)
1 NuFACE tube of gel primer
1 charging cradle + power adaptor
1 user manual and quick start guide
1 year warranty (send in the registration card)

What Is Not In The Box
Extra attachments (you receive one facial trainer attachment) for the Trinity device - Trinity Wrinkle Reducer (full-face fine lines and wrinkles) and Trinity ELE Attachment (for lip and eye areas). These attachments are sold separately.

You need to charge the device for at least 12 hours prior to first use. You should watch the how to video at the URL provided in the quick start guide & read the user manual. The instructions advise the user to test the gel primer on the skin of your inner arm for sensitivity 24 hours prior to use.

I used both the gel primer and pure aloe vera gel as well. I could not tell a difference between the two but you need to keep enough wet gel on your facial skin for the microcurrent to be conducted well. I could tell when the gel was too thin or dried out when I felt a slight sting sensation. You need to glide the device in specific patterns of sweeps and repeat three times. You can also add a series of advanced positions by positioning and then lifting and holding, and then repeating three times. The device indicates when the end of a sweep or position is over by a beep. There are about 5 seconds between beeps. Total time per treatment varies from 5 minutes to 20 minutes depending on whether you choose the basic sweeps or add the advanced lift and hold positions. You use a wet cloth to remove the gel after treatment. I find that I really need to rinse my entire face with water because the cloth takes longer since it needs to be rinsed over and over. Highly recommended!

The NuFACE website states that an extended 2-year warranty is available for purchase but it must be purchased before the original one-year warranty has expired by contacting a representative at (888) 360-9171. I have not attempted to extend the warranty yet.
summary: Visible results after only one use! Need to consistently use device almost daily to "train" facial muscles

reviewText:
I have been using this daily for two weeks. So far, I haven't noticed any difference in the texture of my skin. This does not mean the device does not work. The included brochure states that it can take up to sixty days to see results. There are some peer-reviewed studies that indicate that microcurrent treatments can improve firmness, but not wrinkles. Time will tell.

This device is easy to use, attractive, and charges well. However, it does take a commitment to use this on a daily basis.

Some of the side effects of using this product include: eye twitch during treatment, metallic taste in the mouth. When I get anywhere near the hairline with this device, my scalp twitches as well.

A tube of gel is included with this product, but it doesn't last very long. I will soon need to buy another tube, which can add up over time.

Bottom line: this device can help improve skin firmness, but requires a significant commitment of time and money. It is also not very pleasant to use. Do I plan to keep using it? Yes. I need to give this a chance. Would I recommend it to friends? At this point, I'm not sure that I would.
summary: Possibly effective, but mildly annoying to use

reviewText:
This is not a quick fix. "Training" your face will take weeks if not months to see results and you will need to continue using it to keep those results (whatever they maybe). I started using the NuFace for only a few weeks ago but I have seen some improvement in the "tone" of my face. Keep in mind that I'm 40 and only have a few fine lines around my eyes, forehead and only very minor sagging around the jaw line.  But I believe in being proactive so I gave NuFace a try.

First of all I urge anyone to watch as many of the youtube videos you can on how to use this product; thats what I did and they were extremely helpful.  Second don't start on the recommended highest setting (it may really hurt as it did for me) but instead start on the lowest and gradually work your way up. Third, work in small sections. The gel primer they provide dries really, really fast and you need it for the NuFace to work.  You don't want to "pull" the skin upward but "slide" on the gel upward.  The best tip I got was to keep a spray bottle of water handy and spry between treatments to keep the skin moist, otherwise you have to stop and apply the gel all over again.  Finally, after you've used up all your gel buy something cheaper i.e. aloe vera will work just as well.

***Best tip I can give anyone is to purchase from a place with a great return policy because it will take a while to see (if any) results and this is a major investment.

I'm a complete skeptic when it comes to things like this, so I want to start out with the two most important words:  It Works!

I tried this on half my face so that I could really see if there were results.  The improvement in my skin was obvious and results came quickly.  In fact, I rather quickly moved on to doing my whole face so that I didn't look like some comic book villain with half a lovely face and half...not.

This is very easy to use and doesn't take too much of a time commitment each day.  Though the feeling was startling (not painful) at first, it soon became pleasant.

I will continue to use this regularly!

This is a electrical pulse stimulator that in theory tightens or shortens facial muscles to help flatten out lines and wrinkles. With a limited amount of use I can NOT make statements as to long term use but short term (two weeks) I can't see much if any change. I didn't feel much discomfort unless the gel was too thin, then it stings slightly. I'm concerned seeing more than one reviewer state the Nuface they bought stopped working and wasn't covered under warranty, this isn't a cheap item so I'm disappointed Nuface isn't helping customers with failures.  The video that shows this item also shows optional attachments so please understand what you get when ordering, the LED Trinity Facial Trainer Kit with Wrinkle Reducer Attachment is an extra $149 and the Trinity ELE Attachment is yet another $149, both are shown in the product video. A 2 oz. tube of NuFACE Gel Primer is included. If I see any noticeable changes I will update this review.
summary: I'm still waiting to see that younger looking face but will give it more time.

reviewText: Honestly, I really can't see the difference. People praise this product like its a miracle cure, yet I find no diffence from one week to the next. When mentioning this to the doctor, his comment was, "if you want wrinkles gone, don't age". That's all I have to say about this product. Use it if you must, good luck.

This little facial trainer looks like an alien frog, but don't be deceived.  It provides enough microcurrent to make faces take notice and improve texture and facial contouring.  I use it each evening, and I can feel the microcurrent (I have it set on medium power).

After a weeks use, I see my skin tone becoming more even, but I am hoping for more  much more.  My skin is visibly aging, and I want to see the wrinkles and other unpleasant features of aging skin leave for good.  I suspect it will take several months for this to happen, but this is what Im hoping for.  Right now, Im using it daily, but after I get the results I want, I anticipate scaling back to every other day.

Does the microcurrent hurt?  Its noticeable and not very pleasant, but it does not cause much pain.  Because I already had a TENS unit, I was not surprised by the tiny discomfort caused by the microburst.

The unit beeps when its done its job, so you know instantly when each stroke is complete.  A video on the website will show you exactly where to place the unit and for how long.  I find it very easy to use according to these instructions.

Overall, its a good unit that I hope will bring me extraordinary results like some of the photos on the website.  Ive taken before photos and will be able to tell how much my face is improving as I go through the process.

FIVE STARS! (Subject to revision according to my results)
summary: Visitor from Another Galaxy?  No, This is a Facial Trainer

reviewText:
**This review will be updated in two months' time with data about facial results.**

There is no doubt this thing is doing something. I feel almost an electric shock if I use it with a wee less gel. The results will take time to see, however. I am not seeing anything instant. My goal with this device is to get rid of the look of a double chin and the lines around my mouth.

There are immediately a few things I'm not crazy about though. The blue light when it charges...annoying. I wish there was a way to turn it off. I tend to charge things while I'm sleeping and this light was so bright, I had to close the bathroom door.

Also, I'm deaf and I don't find having to "listen" for beeps very helpful at all. I would appreciate if they'd come up with something else. Perhaps a light where one can see it whilst using it. A flash.

The instructions are easy to follow though. No complaints there. You charge the device 12 hours, you put gel on your face (provided), you hold the shiny balls in place (illustrations show you where) and glide it to another place until you hear a beep. Repeat in a different location.

Again, this review will see continuous updates when more time has passed.

**After a few days of using this, I am not seeing results (don't expect to yet) but I am getting pimples where I use the device. This is not normal for me. I may try using something besides the gel they sent. A previous reviewer said she uses aloe vera. I may try that.
summary: Would Appreciate An Alternative to Beeps

reviewText: Wow! Only 1 week, 3 times of use, visible signs of improvement.  The face used to look a bit sagging and flat and lack of roundedness and livelihood.  After just 3 applications in one week, the cheek, the side, the forehead and the chin all look very bouncy and full of shine.  I was skeptical at first.  But in one week, it made a believer out of my wife and myself.  It's amazing.  I am going to buy the other attachments to get rid of the wrinkles.
summary: It's amazing. I am going to buy the other attachments ...

reviewText:
Okay, here goes.

Normally, this isn't my thing, but I am not getting any younger, and I figured, "What the heck?"

it was very easy getting everything out of the above average packaging, and separating the various parts.

Following the directions was simple. They were well written, with just enough science type language to make me feel as if this might have some legitimate basis to it.

I was a little nervous about the micro current, but it wasn't bad at all, and even felt a bit nice after I got used to it.

I probably did not go an entire five minutes, but I have a short attention span.

I am going to make an effort to try this regularly for a long enough time that I can return and let everybody know how well it worked.

Here's hoping I soon have the face of a 20 year old!

(And that they do not ask for it back.)

I'm not above being vain and admitting that age isn't being kind to my face, so I've been looking at options other than botox and fillers in order to stave off the inevitable So the NuFACE Trinity sounds like a decent idea in theory. In order to get any real benefits, you're going to have to use this 3-4x a week for upwards of 8 weeks. I gave it a daily use for 3 weeks in order to get a review in, and I didn't notice anything in my face (nor did my wife, for what it's worth.) I even took photos of my face before I got started to see if it there was anything noticeable and didn't see anything. It's not to say that if I kept going for another 2 months that I might notice something - but I'm impatient. This item is definitely not for the impatient. A few of the youtube reviews along with the Amazon reviews I've watched seems that 8+ weeks is the consensus on seeing visible results. I'll reevaluate at 8 weeks to see if it's worth sticking with.

A few things: The unit itself feels pretty flimsy, and I was worried that with an accidental drop, it would shatter. Granted, I'm not going to drop it to test it out, but for a device that's upwards of $300, it doesn't feel like there's that quality associated with it. Also, the gel primer went fairly quickly it seems, and that adds to the cost of the overall kit - I'll probably need to buy a few more over the next two months. Additional attachments also run $150 or so, so this is clearly a system that would require a sizable financial commitment (along with the heaps of time!)

Overall I'm conflicted - the tons of positive reviews give me hope that this will eventually help out problem spots, but the time and financial commitment might make me consider the path of least resistance: a cosmetic dermatologist (or at least, a dermatology residency clinic.) But NuFace does give a 60 day money back guarantee, which I would expect (but only from NuFace's site it seems and at the time of writing this review, it's nearly $50 cheaper than Amazon!) But if you've decided to invest in the NuFace Trinity, you'll probably be investing an hour a week in using this on your face in addition to gel primer regularly.

3.5 stars
summary: Didn't work for me (yet), but requires serious long term committment

reviewText:
As a product tester, I am required to post a review within 30 days of testing a product.  I do believe this product will take longer than 30 days to show its desired results, so I hope to post an update to this review within the next few months.

I believe the NuFACE Trinity is a revolutionary product.  It was important to me that the product had received clearance from the FDA, which it has.  The device is designed to provide a solution for multiple skin care concerns.  It is designed to work with multiple treatment attachments, but it is important to note that the Microcurrent attachment is the only one included with the trainer kit.  The Microcurrent attachment is meant to gently and effectively stimulates the surface of your face to help improve your skin's appearance.  The other attachments are sold separately, and require somewhat of an investment.

In just a few days, I can honestly say that I have noticed some difference in my facial contour and skin tone.  I am banking on the accuracy of the clinical studies which state that after 60 days of use, 85% of users experienced improvements in facial contour, and 73% of users experienced improvements in skin tone.  I am personally looking for improved facial contour and skin tone around the forehead, eyebrows, jawline, and jowls.  If I continue to notice improvement, I will seriously consider purchasing the ELE (Effective Lip and Eye) and Wrinkle Reducer attachments.  But, since each attachment is $150, I would like to see significant results from the Microcurrent attachment first.

To use the trainer, I cleanse my face thoroughly and apply the NuFACE Gel Primer.  Then, I simply glide the Trinity Facial Trainer over the natural contours of my face for roughly five minutes each day.  When finished, I remove the NuFACE Gel Primer and apply my favorite skin care (Vitamin E Moisture Cream).  The instructions indicate that when I begin to achieve desired results, I can reduce the frequency to two to three days a week.

NuFace Trinity is an ergonomic handheld design making the process very effortless.  So far, I am very pleased with the product and its early results.
summary: I have already noticed some contour and tone improvement.

reviewText:
While the consistency out of the tube is more like a rich lotion than a balm, this is a real good emmolient moisturizer. I don't have eczema, but this product soothened my dry hands after a day in the cold. As most emollient balms it leaves a sticky feeling after application.

reviewText:
The Stelatopia balm and the Stelatopia bath oil have been total lifesavers for my son's eczema-prone skin. My son is 2 now, but when he was about 5 months old, I started to notice his skin flaring up with eczema. I knew what it was immediately because I also suffered from it as a child. 25+ years ago, my mother used Aveeno, Cetaphil, and Eucerin products to manage my condition (as recommended by my dermatologist). I'm sure over time, formulas have changed, and Aveeno, Cetaphil, and Eucerin now have baby-specific, eczema-specific products. I enthusiastically purchased them in my quest for my son's relief. I was shocked that none of them seemed to help! His condition stayed the same, or almost worsened. It was so frustrating.

I, of course, scoured countless dermatology websites, product reviews, and home remedies to try and find something to help, and happened upon Mustela Stelatopia. I had tried everything else, and figured, why not? I purchased the balm, cream, bath oil, and cleansing cream. I used the oil that same night during bathtime, then slathered him up with the balm, and put him to bed.

The next morning when I got him up, I felt immediate hope and relief. His bright red eczema patches were faded to light pink. The inflammation was markedly reduced. With continued use of the bath oil and balm/cream (I honestly think the balm and cream are equally effective and interchangeable for us), he cleared up completely. He's not totally cured and does flare up occasionally, so I always have the bath oil and the balm (or cream) on hand. I use the balm every night after bathing, when his skin is still wet. I rub him down really quick and then wrap him up in his towel. This seals in the moisture from the bath, and less balm is needed with this method. He has smooth, baby-soft skin, like he should have! I am so happy with the Stelatopia line and would heartily recommend it to anyone!

Note: I have purchased the old packaging and the new packaging of these products, and have noticed no difference in effectiveness. I am always weary when a brand "re-vamps"--but in this case, everything works just as well as it always did. I have purchased this from Amazon and Baby's R Us repeatedly (aside from this one free bottle). It is totally worth the cost and the balm lasts months for us--it's very concentrated to start with and using it on damp skin lessens the product needed even more.

Life can be truly awful if you suffer from Eczema-Prone Skin. I've not had this problem myself, but my daughter has struggled at times with Eczema-Prone Skin. This emollient has really helped her a lot, alleviating a lot of pain and discomfort. This is not cheap, but neither is it impossibly expensive and the relief that it can bring will probably be worth it. A little bit goes a long way, so you won't get the sense that putting endless amounts of emollient results in minimal results. If you suffer from Eczema, you deserve to give yourself as many weapons against it as possible.

This moisturizing balm is the same great quality of all Mustela products I have tried. My infant son does have eczema and sensitive skin so I stick with Mustela to stop the dryness and itchiness and this definitely works to keep him moisturized.

He's not a baby and maybe he needs something stronger, but I thought if it's gentle enough for a baby's skin it would probably work well for anyone. Perhaps not. Most of what we use is dermatologist prescribed but every once and a while I color outside the lines and try an over the counter cream and this one did not disappoint!  It is not a miracle cure but absolutely makes a difference!! My daughter was having a terrible outbreak on her hands & this calmed the eczema considerably! After several skin related infections due to over dryness, our pediatrician recommended the Mustela line of bath and skin products.  They are amazing. When using this product you can immediately feel and see a difference in her skin and these problem areas.  This really helps us to get through the exzema outbreaks quicker. If you are comparing prices one thing I can definitely say about any Mustela product that I've used is the idea " quality vs quantity" is something to really consider.  A little goes a long way with any of their products and this is one of my favorites.  I only need a small amount to do what a much larger amount of another brand might be able to do.

Backstory: We have a 2y11mo old and a 13 month old, both with eczema prone skin. Both have rough, red patches on their backs, arms, and elbows, and my oldest has an eczema patch on his right leg that has come and gone since birth. Since he can reach it, he scratches, and it always gets scabby and bleeds from time to time. This winter has been so hard on their skin. So much, in fact, that I rushed my youngest to the pediatrician one day because I thought he had suffered an allergic reaction to a vaccine and was covered in hives. Turns out, it was just a REALLY bad eczema flare up. Poor kiddo. Anyways, you can see that we were prime candidates to try this Stelatopia Emollient Balm in this house.

During bathtime, we apply Stelatopia Cleansing Cream, which goes hand in hand really nicely with this balm. I slather the cleansing cream all over their backs, bellies, and arms when they're in the tub and let them sit with it on their skin for a little while before rinsing clean. After bathtime, we pat them both dry with towels and apply Stelatopia Balm all over their backs, bellies, and arms and let them sit with it on their skin for a little while before putting on pajamas. The balm is thicker in consistency and takes a little while to absorb, so we make sure to let the balm sit for as long as possible.

Specifically designed for babies and children with eczema-prone skin, this plant-based formula is thick and completely covers the skin. Unlike other Mustela products, this is completely fragrance free and hypoallergenic. It's also Paraben, Phthalate and Phenoxyethanol free, which gives me peace of mind.

I included a photo for reference. Honest to goodness, with the use of these two products (cleansing cream and balm), the boys' skin feels so much softer, smoother, and our use of Hydrocortisone has dramatically decreased (which I really do hate using because it bleaches their skin).  This product is so effective that it is recognized by the National Eczema Association, and has been clinically-tested on eczema-prone skin under pediatric and dermatological control. The prices of these products are exactly the same as on the Mustela website (some other Mustela products were more expensive on Amazon for some reason). I couldn't find this Stelatopia line at Walmart or Giant Eagle anywhere, so I also love that there is an Amazon Dash button available to make sure that our supply doesn't run out since I can't run to the local store to pick up more.

This absolutely has made a difference in our household, and I am a true believer in this product.
summary: An absolute difference maker in our home for our babies' eczema prone skin.

I have loved Mustela since I first was introduced to it with my first born.  I love the clean scents, the quality of the contents - just wonderful.

This balm is no exception!  My daughter has excema - and emollients are great for her.  I have some from other companies - they seem to always put a strong scent in them which is contrary to what you would think.  If you are using an emollient cream/balm/etc - you typically are applying it to someplace that at a minimum needs extra TLC.  Light scents, organic/natural scents are best.  Mustlena Stelatopia NAILS IT!!
I thought this would smell great but its not for how expensive it is!

This is a fairly simple vanilla - especially simple for Montale.  It is vanilla (& a heavy dose of Styrax Benzoin, I think) with slightly bitter wood undertones and just a hint of spice; maybe cinnamon, nutmeg & cloves.  It's not really sweet but has a candle wax note that is a bit off-putting to my nose.  It just doesn't smell as deep and rich as most Montale parfum.  Perhaps too much styrax benzoin which often smells cheap to my nose.

The sillage is beyond arm length with a single spray & this lasts about 8+ hours on my skin becoming an even more simple waxy, vanilla scent.
summary: Vanilla With A Little Wood & Spice

reviewText:
On my skin I get mostly cedar, lavender, and vanilla with an underlying powdery iris & fresh green patchouli (not the funky/hippie kind).  There is some kind of delicious spice and nothing very flowery.  It's not sweet, not musky, not dirty.  I barely get any notes of lemon or bergamot.  I think they are there just to freshen it up, kind of like adding lemon to the end of cooking. To me this is a unisex fragrance; it's neither masculine nor feminine.

This has a huge sillage; a little goes a long way.  One tiny spritz will fill the room & it lasts until the next day on my skin when it is mostly lavender.

Opens with a big boozy vanilla and juicy apricot, then the flowers arrive - jasmine, ylang ylang & peach blossoms.  The jasmine is a little sharp at first but calms down to a distinct, lovely flower.  It's a full, juicy apricot but the sharpness of the flowers keep it from getting too sweet.  I would actually like a bit more apricot because this is a really good one - not the fake, rotting fruit type.  Underneath all of this is an exotic mix of sandalwood, wood and spice,  This is a huge Oriental-Vanilla-Flower-Boozy BOMB - delicious if you like these notes.

Not a standard vanilla.  It's not sweet, no patchouli & no musky notes.  Very adult fragrance and very well made.  It's like standing in a tropical garden with a glass of the most delicious, aged rum in your hand.

Even though it's supposed to be a female fragrance, I really think a man could wear this one.  The flowers are there but it's not girly and the boozy vanilla with spicy sandalwood say, "Seduce me, I know what I'm doing!"  I think men would have women wanting to sniff & get closer ;)

As with most Montale Parfum, the sillage is huge; it can fill a room so go easy.  One spray is plenty.  This lasts and lasts on my skin.  I still get the vanilla/flower scent the next day.
summary: Huge Boozy, Oriental, Vanilla, Apricot, Floral

reviewText:
This is a linear fragrance; it really doesn't change that much over time but it is a complex potion & not for the faint-hearted.  This is a brilliant, grown-up scent that I consider unisex.

My first thought was beeswax candle & when I asked my husband he said (unprompted) - "You smell like a candle".  Now, this isn't just any old cheap candle scent - it's a very nice honey/beeswax, sweet almond & a bit of really good dark/dry vanilla.  I barely get any flower in this at all - maybe a hint of rose but I have to really sniff to find it.  Perhaps heliotrope?  There seems to be something almost powdery & a tiny hint of spice - maybe nutmeg?  Marzipan or some other almond-based candy? Oud?

This is really lovely and really well made.  No fake, cheap notes but it is sweet.  No musky/dirty notes.

This has a really big sillage; you can smell it across the room with just one tiny spritz.  So use carefully.  This lasts until the next day on my skin becoming an up close scent.
summary: Smells Like An Expensive Beeswax Candle

reviewText: So pigmented and blendable at the same time!!!
Ok

Soft, smooth and highly pigmented! I picked up argyle and lace, both are vibrant shades of pink. Argyle is amazing for a fresh flush, while Lace is bright but still very wearable. The price is good, especially since a little product goes a long way.
The packaging is perfect, slim lined with a mirror. I would suggest starting out with a light hand. I honestly can't wait to pick up more colors in the inStain blush line!

These InStain blushes are crazy pigmented and last a long time. I don't know if they actually stain the skin, I haven't really checked that aspect of it out but it is super pigmented. I need to use a light duo fibre brush with it and even then it is easy to overdo it. I find I need to be very, very careful when applying this blush.
very pigmented
Excellent product

Very beautiful
Excellent company
Very nice
Thanks.....

Toile is a gorgeous, bright pinky coral shade that is very pigmented but easy to sheer out on the cheeks. Unfortunately I do not get the wear out of this that some other reviewers do. I've yet to find a blush that wears for more than a couple of hours on me though, and I suspect this has to do with my very oily skin. That said it does wear longer than most other blushes on my skin. The packaging of this is cute but makes me nervous because it is so lightweight and the product inside is heavy. Also, the pan on my blush was not even glued in so the first time I opened it it popped out and fell on the floor (luckily it did not break).
summary: Gorgeous, but I had issues with packaging and wear time

reviewText: I am using my husband's account. I love this blush! It is a beautiful pink. Makes my cheeks looks so dewy and smooth. Very pigmented and smooth to blend! I love every product I have by the balm!

I'm going to keep this short and sweet.....
This is the BEST blush I have ever purchased. I normally use NARS, Urban Decay, Too faced, MAC, Tarte, etc, but this blush beats them all. Plus, IT IS CHEAPER!!!!! And LONG LASTING?!!!! Okay, that's it, I'm buying more.

This is really fantastic blush! It's highly pigmented, creamy, and long wearing with no fall out. Just a little dab on the brush is all you need. I love the adorable packaging and the fact it's so compact and small. But don't be fooled, there is a lot of product in that pan!

I have pretty fair skin and this gives that rosy, just worked out flush without the work. I apply this product on the apple of my cheek and use theBalm's INSTAIN in Pinstripe as the contour along the cheekbone. It is much more wearable on a daily basis.

I can't recommend this more!
Great product, stays the entire day and you only need a little bit to show off on your cheeks.  You can build the intensity.  Love, love
summary: Great product, stays the entire day and you only ...

reviewText: This pink blush is very similar to the Down Boy color. I returned this one and kept the Down Boy. Both are great, I just liked the shade of Down Boy a little more. Good pigmentation and great color.
summary: Both are great, I just liked the shade of Down Boy ...

reviewText: the balm makes some of the best blushes on the market for staying power and beauty.
Amazing I love it

I love this blush since I got it in a sample pack last year. It has the impact and staying power of  stain with the convenience and blendability of a powder. Since it's a powder stain, it can go on quite dark, if you're not prepared (my sample was about an inch square, so when i got the full size, I had some pretty dark apples when I tried it.) A little blend on the back of my hand before application and it is better than any other blush I've tried. It blends really well, and stays on all day. The peachy color complements my skin very well. The blush pot is held in with a magnet, so don't get too rough with it or it will come out. The packaging is compact and cute. It comes with a sleeve to slide the box into when travelling for additional security. The case is paperboard with a mirror and magnetized closure, but it's not as strong as a snap lid, so hang onto the sleeve.
Because the pigment is so strong, I anticipate this lasting an extremely long time. I still have half the sample, and I've used it pretty consistently since I got it. It doesnt' take much, which to me increases the value.
I love The Balm products and this blush didn't disappoint. It leaves the perfect rose tint on my cheeks and because it's a stain i don't have to retouch.

i first got a sample of this blush in my birchbox.  I really liked it.  The full size is almost too much.  The blush is very deeply pigmented and it's easy to overload the brush and get too much.  However, it blends beautifully and lasts all day.

This is only my second product from theBalm and my first of their blushes. I love their packaging. It's not only beautiful but thoughtful and practical. Both my Balm Jovi Rockstar palette and my Instain blush come in slim packaging with magnet closure to keep the paper-based cases securely closed. And just to make it even better for travel or carrying in your purse, they put both products in an outer sleeve to further ensure that your makeup doesn't end up all over your purse or luggage. I give them a star for the packaging alone because it rocks!

As for the product, I ordered the Instain blush in Peach, which comes in a beautiful little package with a drawing of a beautiful lady on the front holding a compact. Inside, there is a small mirror (more bonus points!) and the blush itself. This blush does not come with a brush or puff.

The blush surface is bigger than some (like Nyx blushes) but not remarkably large (about 1" X 2.5"). I like the surface size of the blush for swiping my blush brush across. This blush is highly pigmented, so you will get not only great staying power on your face but the blush should last a long time as you don't need much to get some color on your face.

This peach is intense--nothing wimpy about it. It is a deep peach, not pale, and it has a matte finish. I find it to be a good neutral ground when I want to wear something other than pinks and reds. It's got a nice, soft finish.

For those who are fragrance sensitive like myself, there is very very little fragrance to this product. Just a bare whisper of a talc-type scent. I never noticed the fragrance until I held it right up to my nose and what fragrance there is I find pleasant and not at all bothersome.

Recommended!
summary: Great blush and great packaging...I'm sold!

reviewText: Perfumes/scents in products are an issue for me, especially scents are that flowery. And scent levels that others think are perfectly fine and way too strong for me. And some scents are fine so I just have to try products to see which ones work for me and which ones don't. Unfortunately the scent of this hand cream comes on too perfumey for me. However, that does not mean it is objectively too perfumey. I had a co-worker try it and she liked the fragrance and didn't think it was too strong. So if you aren't normally bothered by fragrance in a product, this should be fine for you. But if you have scent sensitivities, be careful. I also think it is a bit flowery for men but I didn't try it on any of my male co-workers. When I wasn't fussing over the fragrance, I thought it was a fine hand cream. But because of the scent, I prefer Skinfix Hand Repair Cream 2 Ounces, which is an excellent hand cream.
summary: Too perfumey for me but others will like it

reviewText: Dead Sea Essentials by Ahava Witch Hazel Hand Cream is one of the best hand creams I have tried in years.  With a very fragrant witch hazel scene, and a smooth silky texture. It is nice, smooth and creamy with a gentle witch hazel  scent. It leaves my hands soft and smooth after constant hand washing from working in a hospital setting and using hospital soap. It is nice and compact where I can take it in my purse. Is is free of Paragons and Phthalate which is good for me because I have very sensitive skin and easily reactive and irritable with too many chemicals. The first ingredient is water which is good makes it easily absorbed by the skin.
summary: Witch Hazel is a great scent!

reviewText: I try and use natural products as much as possible, and so that's what appealed to me about this hand lotion, however I wasn't too impressed with the ingredient list. It contains sulfates, silicones and a lot of other unpronounceable ingredients. If that doesn't bother you, well, I still would firmly rate this cream as very "average". After using nearly the whole tube, it did nothing special for my skin. The fragrance is very strong and artificial smelling; I definitely don't care for it. Also, $10 for a small tube of hand cream seems awfully steep to me.  In short, the cream isn't horrible, but I wouldn't purchase again, and can't really recommend it.

this lotion leaves my hands feeling silky smooth . . . but has such a strong fragrance to it.  I don't mind the fragrance but, man, it sure is strong!  If you are at all sensitive to fragrances or are around someone who is I would suggest avoiding this product despite how well it works.

I like the way this cream leaves my hands feeling soft and smooth. It has a nice creamy texture that at first feels greasy but is quickly absorbed. The only thing I don't like is the strong floral scent when the lotion first leaves the tube. However, it does fade after a few minutes and becomes tolerable.

This is a very nice hand cream.  It leaves my hands soft without feeling greasy, which is important for me.  I wash a re-apply hand cream throughout the day and this works very well.  The only problem is that it has a scent that lingers and, as I wear a particular perfume daily, it competes with the perfume too much.
summary: Nice cream but has a definite scent that lingers

reviewText:
The cream works very well on moderately dry skin, helps make my hands feel soft and supple. It does have a smell, but it is not too strong to make me stop using it. It is not a cure for very dry skin, though. I have a patch of skin on my elbow that is very bad - flaking and cracking all the time, and the cream did not really do anything there.
The cream absorbs well in the skin, and does not leave any unpleasant residue.

Rich and thick, this hand cream is rapidly absorbed and does not leave a greasy residue. Not quite a dry finish but rather a soft feeling remains and the skin feels hydrated.

I have been using this product for a couple of weeks and over-all like it very much. As winter approaches a good hand cream is essential protection against the cold and dry climate in my part of the country. The cream works well leaving skin moist. And, it contains no parabens and the product is not tested on animals.

Witch hazel is noted midway through the ingredient listing but I detect none of the fragrance. Instead the cream has a slightly floral mixed with cucumber scent that is vaguely familiar but not a personal favorite. So, although the intensity of this fragrance is mild and subtle, since I do not care for it, I still notice it.  This is completely subjective, but I would much prefer no fragrance.

I have had some difficulty with hand lotions.  Some leave your hands greasy, some have a strong scent,and others just seem to accomplish nothing.  This is the first hand lotion I have used that has given me any long-term results.  I have been using it for a few weeks and my hands are softer than they have been in a long time.  It does not leave them feeling greasy and does not have an overpowering scent.  I highly recommend.
summary: Best hand lotion I have ever used!

reviewText:
This hand lotion works very well.  It absorbs easily and my hands are super soft after using it.  The scent is mild and pleasant enough, but it's not my preference. If they have this in a vanilla base, I'll buy it because it works really well.  I've been using it on my feet as much as my hands because it works great for foot rubs and softening up my heels too.
I just came back to update this review because of how well it is working on my hands in the winter.  My skin really dries out in the winter and I put this on at night before bed and wake up with such soft hands and feet that I came back to update it to a 5 star.
summary: Leaves hands soft and not greasy

reviewText:
The first time I used this hand cream, I thought the scent was too strong, and not one I especially liked.  Now that I've used it many more times, the scent has kind of grown on me, and I don't find it objectionable, although I'd prefer if it were unscented.

Despite that, this is a truly excellent hand cream.  It takes just a little bit to make my hands feel soft and protected, and that effect lasts!  I like that it contains NO parabens or phthalate.  It is not unreasonably priced, especially considering that it seems concentrated, so it doesn't take as much as with some more watery products.  It is not so thick that it is difficult to spread, just not watery feeling.  I can feel it on my hands, but they don't feel greasy or oily, just soft.

This hand cream is a keeper!
I really like this! I have really dry hands this time of year and this moisturizes well, rubs in easily, and doesn't have much scent (which I prefer).
summary: I really like this! I have really dry hands this time ...

reviewText:
I have to admit, I was a little baffled by the product description at first. It's a hand cream made with... witch hazel and sea salts? Both of which are typically used as astringents, so it seems a little strange to put them in a moisturizing product.

Well, maybe there's not much of either in this cream, because it is magnificent. I've been washing my hands several times a day in the past week, and this cream is the only thing that can tackle my dry-to-the-point-of-flaking skin without leaving my hands feeling greasy. It's deeply moisturizing, and I think this is going to be my go-to hand cream once winter rolls around.

The scent is rather strong, though it's fresh and clean, and the throw dies down pretty quickly on my skin, so it doesn't overpower other scents that I'm wearing for very long.

This stuff feels really good on my skin! This was the first time that I have tried AHAVA Dead Sea Essentials products. The witch hazel cream smells very clean and makes my skin feel good. It has a very creamy feel to it, and a little bit goes a LONG way.

When I first applied it, it felt greasy. I was afraid to touch anything for fear of leaving residue on the things around me. However, it didn't take long to soak in. At that point, my skin felt like it had a coating, almost like silicone, but of course it was all natural. Moisture was locked in and my skin felt very soft.

The scent is soft and clean smelling, not too perfumey, and it's not overpowering. I keep smelling my hands because they smell so good. I'd love to buy this in a body cream. I imagine it would be perfect to treat dry winter skin. I'm already a fan!
summary: Feels wonderful on my hands, smells great, long lasting

reviewText:
I really like the way this hand cream makes my skin feel soft and supple. It is a thick, white hand cream. It takes some time to work it into the skin and does have a greasy look initially. Once it gets absorbed into the skin, it leaves a sheen look but without the greasy feel. I love how it leaves my dry and slightly cracked hands feeling soft and smooth.

One thing I don't like is that the cream is scented and it lingers after use. It's sort of a flowery scent with a hint of menthol. It isn't an obtrusive smell but it lingers for hours after application. For that reason, I'd use it at night before going to bed and the smell mostly goes away by the next morning. Other than that, it is an excellent hand cream that does what is advertised for.
summary: Excellent hand cream but with a lingering scent

reviewText:
If I had reviewed this Ahava Dead Sea Essentials hand cream on just Day 1 of my 3-week trial, I would have given it 5 out of 5 stars.  This cream has a lively multi-stage performance that is bewitching.

First, it feels thick and decadent.  Then, just a few seconds of warmth from rubbing the hands morphs that thickness into a super thin, almost oily layer.  This disperses more evenly over the entire surface better than any other hand cream I have used.  Lastly, further hand rubbing makes the oiliness disappear.  Just 30 seconds or so from the start of the application,  I would be happy to shake hands with someone.  Many hand creams leave me shaking my head to well wishers instead, with my hands in the air signalling "Don't touch me, i just put hand cream on".

But a hand cream has to have some lasting effect even after a few hand washings for me to pay good money for.  If you've got rough hands that can put runs in nylon stocking OR you can pick up a terry cloth guest towel using only the back of your hand, you know what I mean.

3 weeks in, I am just not seeing any lasting improvement in the dryness.  There might have been some improvement in my splitting nails, but that will take a couple of months to determine.

Fact is, when I went back to my favorite-so-far hand cream, I noticed a huge improvement in suppleness after just 1 day of use.  I will state what that is if someone asks, otherwise suffice to say I am a little disappointed I can't rate this Dead Sea product more highly.
summary: Mixed Results After 3 Weeks of Daily Use

reviewText: Good quality of lotion for my hands with dry skin and arthritis, worked well on my feet too!  This witch hazel hand lotion has received a lot of comments about it's scent which to me is a soft floral, not overpowering or unpleasant.  Lotion has the right about of thickness, substantial and soothing as it rubs into my skin.  Doesn't leave a greasy feeling and settle on the top or disappear before you feel like it's had a chance to work.  This is more than a pretty pampering product, I find it therapeutic.  It's very gentle for sensitive skin.  I have even put on broken skin without it stinging.
summary: Great for dry sore hands (and feet)

reviewText: Doesn't feel greasy. Makes the skin feel good and smooth. I found it has a faint, pleasant scent, not strong at all. My wife likes it as well. Note: It's meant for dry hands, so don't use it on your lips or other sensitive parts.
summary: A great remedy for dry hands

reviewText:
I have had the pleasure of trying AHAVA products in the past, specifically Ahava Dead Sea Water Mineral Hand Cream, which I loved. Not too surprisingly, all of that cream is gone, and the opportunity to review a new product by AHAVA appeared - the Dead Sea Essentials Witch Hazel Hand Cream. How would it compare?

Well, AHAVA has done it again with another smashing product. I love the scent, I love the texture, I love the feeling - not greasy at all, yet my hands feel smooth and moisturized. It works fine with my psoriasis - about the only "problem" is that this is a large container that cannot fit easily into a purse for transportability!

AHAVA has knocked it out of the park twice; I can't wait to try another of their products!

UPDATE 06/22/16: After using this product more and more, I have to take off a star. While the product does seem to moisturize, it leaves my hands so greasy initially that I just find myself avoiding using it. My sister likewise avoids it for the same reason - it leaves hands incredibly greasy.

Brought to you by:
*C.S. Light*
summary: UPDATE: I enjoy it but find it a bit greasy for my liking.

reviewText: This is a great hand lotion. It feels a bit greasy when first applied but it absorbs quickly. Great for dry hands.

This tinted lip enhancer is an oasis for dry lips. Thicker than a lip gloss it has a light, sheer peach tint. Among the ingredients are beeswax, jojoba oil, shea butter, castor seed oil and vitamin E. The website recommends applying three times a day for twenty-nine days for best results. It is supposed to "naturally increase the fullness" of lips while decreasing fine lines.

I like this product. It feels nice on  and does seem to moisturize and condition. I have been using it as directed with the last application at night before I go to bed. I must say my lips do feel better but I can't say I have observed any increase in fullness. The color is subtle and leaves lip looking fresh with a nice sheen. It does last but feels a little sticky as time passes. It also transfers to glass ware and utensils, leaving a greasy imprint.

Somewhere between a gloss and a balm, this product provides a little color and much moisture. It comes in seven colors, including clear,  shimmering peach, shimmering nude, shimmering rose petal, as well as "Shiraz", a sheer berry; "Cosmo", a sheer poppy pink as well as this product, the peach  "Bellini". I recommend it for its long lasting hydration and its delicate color.

This is not a lip gloss, although it has many of the qualities of a tube lip gloss. It is more than a lip gloss, however. It is far more of a moisturizer which hydrates your lips. Many of the properties of a lip balm, chapstick, or salve are similar to this Tinted Lip Enhancer. However, this is much lighter in weight. Jouer has made a very upscale product, which is like a treat to use. If you like cosmetics, you will enjoy pampering yourself with this product. It even comes nicely boxed.
The color of the tint is a light coral and very pretty. It is named Bellini, for the famous Italian drink made of champagne and peaches. As you can see, there is a lot of thought behind this brand and whom they are targeting.

If you like a light touch concerning your make up, and barely want your lipstick to be noticable, yet you would like to make your lips supple and smooth, this is a good choice for you.
I would imagine (although I don't use it this way) it might make a good glossy overcoat for a more heavy type of lipstick.

I do not think that enhancer in this case means "lip plumper" although it may be stated on the box that way. It simply means that if you choose to apply Bellini by Jouer, your lips will be enhanced in that they will be softened and the color will be lightly tinted a youthful (yet not immature or teen-looking) peach-coral.
I like this very much and recommend it!

thanks!
summary: Hydrating and long lasting Lip Enhancer by Jouer

reviewText:
This is a nice lip balm with a subtle color that will certainly protect against winter cold and wind and summer sun. But there are much less expensive lip balms available on the market, and I would therefore not run to buy another tube of this cosmetic.

I'll use the tube I received from Amazon Vine, gratis, but I will not buy any more, and cannot wholeheartedly recommend it for others, either.

This lip gloss was ok, but not one of my favorites.  The color in the tube is very pretty, kind of a pink-coral.  But when you put it on, it doesn't show up at all (and I have very pale skin).  It's shiny, but feels waxy instead of hydrating.  I think it's very expensive for what you get, so I don't really recommend it, especially when you could get just about any high-end lip gloss in this price range.  :(
summary: Very pale color, kind of waxy

reviewText: A nice, smooth and conditioning lip treatment, loved the feel and the color. Wish it was longer lasting, but like most lip glosses, they wear off fairly quickly. Really versatile and complimentary color, but didn't really experience an increase the fullness of my lips or decreasing of fine lines. Love the botanical ingredients, Vitamin E, Shea Butter and Jojoba Oil, and ultra rich moisturizer really was hydrating and beautiful shine and feel on lips. (reviewed by my wife)

Jouer Bellini tinted lip enhancer is a nice lip gloss that keeps my lips nice and hydrated. I don't have to replace it for a while and that is great because it wastes less time to keep replinishing it and it makes your tube last even longer. I like that the bellini color is so light that you really can't see it and I love that because when you need to reapply your lip gloss it doesn't look so bad. I love that it keeps my lips looking nice and shiny without being too glossy. I would imagine (although I don't use it this way) it might make a good glossy overcoat for a more heavy type of lipstick.

I love that the Jouer lip enhancer is classy and adults can wear it as well as teenagers. I would recommend this gloss because it will give you more wears with this tube and that will save you much time and more money.
I can't say how much I love this product! I use it every morning instead of using lipstick. Instead of drying out my lips, it makes them moist and fresh looking.

Jouer is not a cosmetic brand I am very familiar with.  However, I liked the shade of this lip treatment and its botanical ingredients.

Although it is much easier to choose lip gloss colors in person, the provided images are a very close match to what youll get.  Yet this isn't just lip gloss  it is a tinted lip treatment.  This treatment goes on thick and stays a bit sticky.  It is light and not loud and provides long lasting protection from the typical environmental elements.

Overall  this is a good product that looks nice and provides some benefits.  I would buy it again.

Very pretty, subtle color.  Goes on easy enough with a scent that I didn't care for at first but diminishes quickly.  I didn't notice any real enhancement or increase in fullness of my lips and didn't care for the feel of the gloss after applying it.  I kept rubbing my lips together because I could still feel the gloss on it.  Not crazy about that.  I want to put the gloss on and forget about it.

As lip glosses go, this is pretty nice. It isn't too tacky or gummy, it glides on smooth, and it feels nice on. Personally, I'm not a huge pink or peach color kind of girl, but this is really subtle, pretty, and wearable! I actually really like the color and the glossy sheen it gave my lips. I have to say, though, I have no idea what all this "plumping" nonsense is. It was gloss. Pretty, but certainly not plumping in any way. Also, this is pretty darned expensive for a lip gloss. I liked it, but I can't say I would ever buy it for $16. Maybe $5.

I was a little worried about the color of this lip gloss, as I tend to wear more pinks than peaches, but this is a very wearable peach.  It goes on with a wash of color and shimmer, and adds a nice gloss.  I consider this more of a lip gloss than a lip treatment.  It's kind of sticky, like a gloss.  As a gloss, though, it's quite good, and quite wearable.  There's a fair bit in the tube, and I expect it will last for some time.

I think this is the best lip gloss I have ever used. I've never had much luck with lip gloss - they usually make me look unnatural, look/feel too gooey, and leave a line of white on my lips after a while. I was fully expecting that to happen with this one as well but it hasn't. The color takes a couple of seconds to "settle" but once it does I get a nice light colored sheen, and it stays natural for quite a while. I love that this leaves my lips looking simultaneously natural, pretty, and even sexy, like those make-up ads in magazines. Great product.

I usually use a base of chap stick, lip liner, then lip stick. Afterwards, I put this gloss on as the finishing touch. I only apply everything once in the morning and it all lasts for most of the day as long as it doesn't wear off too much when eating.

It keeps my lips well hydrated, so its well worth the cost.

I've tried every lip balm under the sun-from the high end ones sold in department stores to the stuff from the health food stores. I loved this one. The color is superb and unlike many similar, tinted products, it is not overly sparkly. Rather, it makes my lips look good and feel good as well.

I got this for free via Vine, but I will be buying this once mine runs out.

I liked this lip color, it is lovely and long lasting. I didn't notice it "enhancing" my lips unless applied multiple times throughout the day which I just don't usually do. It is hydrating, which I appreciate because my skin is dry. My lips can be especially dry and prone to flaking or cracking, especially in the winter and springtime so I like to use products that both add color and keep them moisturized and healthy. To date I've used the Sugar Lip Treatments by Fresh like Fresh Sugar Rose SPF 15 Lip Treatment .15 oz (4 g), but I haven't loved the colors they have available. With my skin tone & features (I blonde hair with a slight ash tone, green/gray eyes and fair skin with a very slight yellow undertone (My pantone color is 1Y05)) the Sugar Lip Treatments always seem to be too red or pink, almost as if I have just finished eating a popsicle, which is hardly the look I am going for. This Jouer Tinted Lip Enhancer, Bellini seems like a great alternative. It also makes my lips feel healthy and moisturize and adds a little color and shine. I loved the color of the bellini, it was a slightly orangey pink and although it is not a color I would have chosen on my own (I tend towards more neutral pinks, nudes and mauves) I think it looks great on me. I've really enjoyed wearing it with Jouer Blushing Beauty Palette since I think it looks like a nice complete look, but it is also versatile enough to use with other makeup in my arsenal. I think it is a great product and a good alternative to Sugar Lip Treatments for those, like me, who found themselves underwelmed with the color options available with that line.

reviewText:

It makes my lips super shiny and healthy looking. The lip enhancer is basically a lip gloss. It is slightly sticky, but not much. It also makes my lips feel hydrated while it is on. I feel like it lasts about the same amount of time as other glosses that I have used.

The one thing that I don't like about this product is that it smells and tastes a little weird (kind of baby powdery). It is not strong enough to be a deal breaker, but I wish they had made it strawberry flavored or something.

Overall, I really like this gloss. I will probably buy another one when this one runs out.

reviewText: This is a very pale coral lip gloss with a waxy texture. It seems expensive for what it actually does, and I have not noticed any noticeable effects (though it recommends 3X daily for 29 days to see improvement, and I don't like it enough to use it that much).  It is fine, but not great.  Just OK for me.

In fact, when I mentioned the lip enhancer to my husband, he snorted as he didn't think I needed any enhancement to my lips. I have just started trying this out so I have not noticed any improvement in plumping out my lips. But I do like this.

It doesn't sting my lips; the color is a nice coral and softer than the lipstick I am trying out by the same brand (which is just a little too bright pink for my taste). This glides on nicely and keeps my lips soft for at least an hour (that's all the time I noticed. It might have lasted longer but I have short attention spans for different things like make-up because I am constantly distracted by different things).

It is a bit pricey for my wallet, but I might consider splurging on this if I see it in my local stores because I do like it. I know that I won't be having chapped lips as long as I use this enhancer. If it does plump up my lips, even better.

4/23/14

reviewText: You cannot go wrong with L'Occitane.

I'm a huge fan of the L'Occitane almond line of products.  The shower oil and body spray are amazing.  This has that same scent.  It is a bit strong, as scents go.  As it happens, I love the smell (and taste) of benzaldehyde, the primary component of most almond and cherry fragrances and flavors (and it is also in Diet Dr. Pepper...).  So the scent doesn't bother me in the least!  Also, for what it's worth, this doesn't irritate my skin, and that's important, as I have been sensitive to some scented hand creams in the past.  This does not appear to contain any artificial dyes.

Anyway, this is a cute little tube.  I find the hand cream to be moisturizing and non-greasy.  I have been using it at night, before bed, and it doesn't get all over the sheets.  Plus, my hands are nice and soft in the morning.  I find it easy to actually squeeze the tube to get the last little bit out, which I can't say about every cream or lotion in a tube.

The only thing I don't absolutely love about this is the thickness.  It is just a bit thinner than what I am looking for in a hand cream.  It has been OK during the summer, when lighter products are warranted.  But I would prefer a somewhat thicker product, as I feel those are a little better at creating a moisture barrier at dry times of the year.

Here are the ingredients; while they appear in the product image of the back of the tube, they are sideways and bent around the tube and thus hard to read:

Water, Isononyl Isononanoate, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Shea Butter, Polymethyl Methacrylate, Sweet Almond Protein, Sweet Almond Oil, Coconut Oil, Rosemary Leaf Extract, Sunflower Seed Oil, Ceteareth-33, Mannitol, Cetyl Alcohol,Polysorbate 60, Cetearyl Glucoside, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Xanthan Gum, Sorbitan Isostearate, Glyceryl Stearate Se, Ethylhexylglycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Chlorphenesin, Benzoic Acid, Dehydroacetic Acid, Polyaminopropyl Biguanide, Tocopherol, Fragrance, Limonene, Linalool, Coumarin.

You may want to avoid this if you are allergic to tree nuts because it does contain almond protein.  Overall a lovely product with a great scent that I will definitely use throughout the summer.
Smells so good omg. Didn't expect that!  It is very light so great for summer. Super small hence the missing stars

reviewText: It takes a lot of work to find a good foundation for me.  This one is my new best choice. I typically alternate between a traditional foundation and a tinted moisturizer on my face depending on how much coverage I want.  I've always intrigued by the CC and BB cream trends, but to date hadn't found one I really loved for my skin.  Often they didn't seem to blend in as easily as foundation or tinted moisturizer or I didn't like how the finish worked on my face.  Because I had heard good things about the Supergoop! brand and also because I have been trying to be more consistent with SPF to ease the effects of aging on my skin, I was intrigued to try this out.

I tried this in Light/Medium.  Texturally, I thought it felt nice.  It applied evenly and easily and it felt nice on the skin, creamy but not too heavy.  I also think the coverage is good.  It's on par with, or perhaps slightly more covering, than a tinted moisturizer, but not as full of coverage as most foundations.  My main nit with the product is I wish they had more color variation.  I know this is advertised as a self-adjusting shade, but it didn't seem as close a match to me as other products I've tried. (For comparison, I use Nude in Laura Mercier Tinted Moisturizer and Warm Ivory in Hourglass Illusion.  I've decided I think I actually prefer using the Supergoop! Anti-Aging City Sunscreen Serum SPF 30 under my foundation vs. using this CC Cream, but that's a matter of personal preference.

I do think there are aspects of this CC cream to like - like the texture and ease of application, but wish it came in more colors.

reviewText: This is a great CC cream for everyone, but most especially for those w/ oily or combo skin.
