Formulated with such goodies as shea and capuacu  butters, green tea, meadowfoam, ginger, olive fruit oil, argan oil, and coffee seed oil, it smooths and soothes without being greasy. It does not contain alcohol, parabens or colorant. It is vegan, cruelty free and made with certified organic ingredients. If the rating had been on the lotion alone, it would easily earn five stars on performance and ingredients. Unfortunately,the pump dispenser on my bottle has a leak at the base and after one push, the pump refused to operate. I wound up getting a pump bottle at the dollar store and transferring it. I don't think this was attributable to the packaging. It arrived carefully encased in plastic. The flaw seems to be at the bottom of the mechanism. So while the lotion is definitely five stars, the dispenser garners zero bringing me to three stars overall.
summary: Loved the Lotion, Hated the Dispenser

reviewText:
This lotion is rich and hydrating, yet feels light and absorbs readily. It's described as being for men or women, but the scent -- which lingers -- is quite sweet. It's sharp and tea-like rather than flowery, but still a fairly feminine scent.

The lotion contains natural plant ingredients rather than the petroleum by-products used in most lotions, and the pump bottle works well.

I have to be careful what products I use because of allergies. I checked out the ingredients in this product and felt confident that I could use it. I saw where it has Olive fruit and Argan oils and I know from using these two that they are excellent for your skin. There are other oils in it as well, but none of them caused me any reaction to the product.  The first day I used it, I put it on my legs. I am also smell sensitive and to me It does have a strong smell to it, not a bad smell, just a strong one.  However, it leaves after about five minutes or so.  It went on smooth, not sticky, which was nice and I didn't have to use a lot.  What was amazing is how my legs felt after it was absorbed into the skin, that didn't take long either.  I glided my fingers down them and I was surprised that they felt like  silk. Wow! After about a week of use I could also see where my legs looked much healthier and younger. Of course I liked that, what woman wouldn't?  I really feel this is a product that I can recommend. I'm excited to see the improvements as I continue to use it. Good product.

Firstly, I have never tried a body wash, but use high quality soaps.  I was offered this Jack Black Epic Moisture Clean Cream Body Wash for review, so I took the opportunity to expand my horizons,  At $26.00 for 12 fluid ounces, it is priced somewhere between Body Shop products and Crabtree & Evelyn.

I followed the instructions and used a washcloth to get the lather worked up.  I needed about five, easy to use, pumps to lather my entire body.  The smell was clean and refreshing.  The list of ingredients are a who's who of oils, root extracts and natural fragrances mixed with the usual chemicals needed to produce the lather.  While I did feel it cleaned my body, I was more impressed by the moisturizing aspect of the body wash, which left my skin feeling smooth and comfortable.

Below is a list of the ingredients from their website:

Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Water (aqua), Canola Oil, Sodium Chloride, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate,sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate, Fragrance (parfum), Argania Spinosa (argan) Kernel Oil, Butyrospermum Parkii (shea Butter), Moringa Oleifera (moringa) Oil, Olea Europaea (olive) Fruit Oil, Simmondsia Chinensis (jojoba) Seed Oil, Zingiber Officinale (ginger) Root Oil, Helianthus Annuus (sunflower) Seed Oil*, Aloe Barbadensis (aloe Vera) Leaf Juice, Tocopherol, Bht, Limonium Gerberi Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (rosemary) Leaf Extract*, Camellia Sinensis (green Tea) Leaf Extract*, Olea Europaea (olive) Leaf Extract*, Inula Crithmoide Flower/leaf Extract, Cocamide Mipa, Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Caprylic/capric Triglyceride, Cyamopsis Tetragonoloba (guar) Gum,guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Cetyl Alcohol, Caprylyl Glycol, Citric Acid, Coconut Acid, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hexylene Glycol, Dihydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Sodium Hydroxide, Butylene Glycol, Sodium Borate, Glyceryl Stearate, Peg-100 Stearate, Phenoxyethanol*Certified Organic

What a wonderful to my high quality soaps, however, on a down and dirty day at the dog shelter, I probably would gravitate to a bar of soap.
Good stuff. Great for winter time
Love the scent this has.  Will definitely order again.
summary: Great from Jack Black as usual

reviewText:
Although I typically prefer a bar of soap and a washcloth in the shower, I gave this product a try.  First of all, I love the smell.  Despite being made with ginger root, argan oil and organic olive leaf, it actually smells like verbena, which is, in the soap and candle world, one of my favorites.

The body wash is rather unusual in appearance, coming out as a white cream rather than the expected transparent gel.  However, the product lathers up nicely, smells great and doesn't dry out the skin like a bar of Ivory or Dove.

Although I love the product, 26 smackers is a bit steep for a guy like me.  I could use up this body wash in a week and a half of showers. . . .

Jack Black has great products and this is no exception. My husband is a big fan of Jack Black products and even though he prefers bar soap, he was eager to try this. It seems as though it is strongly scented, but is really light once out of the shower. It is a gender neutral scent and reminds me of tea. It lathers well and also moisturizes well. My husband's skin feels amazing. It is a bit pricey, but a little goes a long way. It would make a great present for any man in your life.
summary: Jack Black has great products and this is no exception

reviewText:
The body wash washes off quite easily unlike many other body washes that make you use a ton of water before your skin actually feels clean and clear of soap.

I like the smell and it does a good job cleaning my body.  It's strong enough to cut oil off your skin but gentle enough for dudes.  I have pretty sensitive skin (I suffer from psoriasis)  but so far I haven't had any issues using this product.

Overall a great product.
summary: Nice fresh scent, and very easy on the skin.

reviewText:
Don't let the packaging turn you away - Jack Black Epic Moisture Clean Cream Body Wash may be aimed at men, but it has such a delightfully gender neutral scent that anyway can use it. It smells faintly of ginger and lemon in a deliciously subtle way. Not overpoweringly cologne-esque like some men's products.

But beyond smelling great, it also works great. I felt fresh and clean but my skin felt moisturized and refreshed, not tight and dry. I didn't even feel the intense need to apply lotion after stepping out of the shower like I normally do. I love finding products that my husband and I can share - I think it is absurd to have to have gendered cleaning products, but that's the economy we live in - but I'm willing to have separate products if they work particularly well. Luckily, with this we don't have to split our body wash any longer.

This body wash is just as its name says, creamy. Unfortunately, it is too creamy for my taste: it does not lather that easily under running shower and tends to form creamy lumps rather than smooth lather. Perhaps one needs to spread a think layer over an area and then  use water, but this is not the way I shower.

It smells very nicely with a prevalent grapefruit scent. I have used for years Gillette Hydrator, which lathers perfectly under running water, but it has a somewhat strong unnatural scent. if Gillette only could make it smell like this body wash, then we'd have a perfect hydrating wash. Sigh... :)
summary: Good, but not great, and very expensive

reviewText: Jack Black's Epic Moisture Clean is the best!  Perfect for men or women with a light fresh scent, this creamy body wash leaves the skin very soft.  This product contains olive leaf oil and argon oil which provide lubrication, but it still lathers.  I've never been a fan of body wash, because they generally leave the skin feeling dry and are overly fragranced.  Jack Black's formula leaves your skin feeling soft and smooth with just a subtle, pleasant fragrance. I forgot to apply body lotion after using it the other day and my skin still felt moisturized!  This will be a go-to product for the winter months.
summary: Wonderful product for men or women!

reviewText: Not a huge fan of body wash because of residue and overbearing scents. No so with this body wash! I love the scent of this and there is absolutely no lingering residue. My wife has an aversion to flowery scents and she agrees this it the most pleasant we have tried. Normally I might take off a star for price for a product used daily but this is a premium product and deserves no less than 5 stars.

I've had a hard time finding a true body soap for men that gives a true moisturized finish. A lot of men's products in this category are obnoxiously perfumed (AXE comes to mind) or the moisturizing effects, while seemingly effective in the shower, seem to disappear once the body is towel dried and dressed. This Jack Black product met all of my expectations and then some by providing a smooth, buttery sheen that really lingers for hours while delivering on all fronts that you'd expect from a premium priced bath soap. This particular concoction utilizes a variety of premium oils (argan, jojoba, olive fruit, ginger root and shea butter) to provide a really nice finish that leaves you with a nice, healthy glow and good moisturized finish. The scent profile is also very pleasing with lemongrass, verbana and ginger that gives a crisp and refreshing fragrance that subtly lingers afterward and never overpowers. A couple of pumps on a proper wash cloth (for best results I use one of the nylon, scrubby Japanese bath towels that is great for exfoliation and the best lather possible -- Salux Nylon Japanese Beauty Skin Bath Wash Cloth/Towel- Aquamarine Green) is really all you need to get the job which means you'll be able to get many months of use out of the standard 12 oz dispenser.

This is a really nice body wash. It only takes about two pumps onto your wash cloth or sponge to generate enough lather to soap down your whole body.  The scent is pleasing while not being overpowering and the body wash doesn't dry out your skin.  In fact, it seems to leave it moisturized.  It's a little expensive, but again, it doesn't take much.  I like it.
summary: This is a really nice body wash

reviewText:
Love it, But,
There are 49 ingredients in this!.
Only a couple are Organic.
But some how my Skin feels fabulous.

Just using this a short time, I can't believe how soft my legs feel, and my body feels.
My legs have been so dry all summer, and I do use body lotion, but washing with this
Jack Black, everyday, and using lotion, my Legs are Not dry, or old looking. They even seem
more firm!! (I'm a older women).

The scent is not only for a man. I'm a women, and love it.
It is Not to strong, its kind of a citrus scent.  Does not interfere with my perfume.

I think it is a bit pricy, but if it works this good, I'm buying it.

I have never used such an expensive body wash. It is definitely on a higher plane than my usual ones. Felt very refreshed, lots of fragrance, skin was left moisturized and soft, and I felt pampered. The fragrance is a bit on feminine side in my opinion, but I had no qualms about it. This is like one of the high end products you get in the mall in the Body Shop or Crab Tree and Evelyn etc. I personally wouldn't mind getting this as a gift, or gifting to someone else, but for personal use, I wouldn't buy such expensive product :)

It's catering to a niche market, which is in my thoughts, gifting to special someone.
summary: This is like one of the high end products you get in ...

reviewText:
I guess, if you are a strong believer in all-natural cosmetics products.

The product description promises a lotion that  is alcohol-free, colorant-free, paraben-free, sulfate-free, certified organic ingredients, vegan, suitable for all skin types, cruelty-free, safe for sensitive skin, dermatologist tested. As far as these promises are concerned, I can attest that the lotion works very well on my very sensitive, allergy-prone skin. I like how creamy this lotion is, and I LOVE the scent  it reminds me of being at a spa. Too bad the scent doesnt linger on my skin longer. Once I am out of shower, the scent is gone in moments.

Is the lotion super-hydrating and moisturizing? In my experience, the end effect is very similar to the one I get from my regular Dove soap.

I like this lotion a lot, but I honestly can justify the price.

4 stars for the quality of the product only.
summary: For $26.00 per bottle, this lotion must be really special. Is it?

reviewText:
I tested out a bit of this before I actually got in the shower, and was surprised at how lotion-y it looked and felt.  I have to say that I really had my doubts as to how it would work as a body wash.

But with a poof (netted sponge?) what I found was that pumping out my normal amount of body wash resulted in a LOT of suds.  Too many suds.  I was surprised.

After that first shower, I stuck with pumping the top once, and it was perfect.  I find the scent to be pleasing, not that I could really tell you what it was that I was smelling.

My skin felt softer than usual straight out of the shower.  I did not apply lotion at all, just to see how I felt.  My skin is not all flaky or anything like that.  I'll probably be able to get by with only doing body lotion a time or two a week, instead of really needing it daily.

I love the pump.  That will keep me from using too much product.  If I choose to purchase more, it will be a bit of a splurge item, but the fact that I'm using less of it, and using less lotion too, keeps it from being a huge extravagance.

For a couple of hours after my shower, I could sniff at my arm and detect a light, fresh scent from the body wash.  My boys thought I had gone completely crazy though.  The things I do for a review.

I rated this body wash three stars because, in my opinion, it was just okay.  The pros are that it's pretty creamy and does seem to moisturize slightly better than my bar soap.  The cons are that it's really expensive at $26, it smells strongly of men's cologne (some might like this, but if you get migraines like I do and are sensitive to smells, this will be a problem), and the list of ingredients is ridiculously long and filled with chemicals I can't pronounce.  My natural bar soap doesn't have near as many ingredients.  If you don't mind paying a lot of money for body wash, like strong smells, and don't care about ingredients, then you'll probably like this.  It's just not for me.
My husband loves it.
Great product!
It's from Jack Black -- of course, it is great!!

I am not the type of guy that would rave about a moisturizer, but this stuff is seriously the s***. Works better than expensive prescriptions, absorbs immediately and you don't  smell or feel greasy. Highly recommend.
summary: I can't believe I got this excited about a beauty product - man card is surrendered

reviewText: I really like this!  I've been using it as a face oil at night before bed.  It smells a little citrus-y and soaks in right away.  Then if I have excess on my fingers I rub it into my hair!

I am impressed with this product, and believe me, I've gone through a lot of beauty products. I have extremely dry skin and am always looking for the best way to moisturize.  This works very well! It has an impressive ingredient list (10 natural oils!) and feels like a dream going on. Plus, the scent is very nice - not too strong at all.  In addition, it's great in your hair! Put a few drops in and it help calm the frizziness and dry ends that I'm always battling.

Yes, this is expensive, but it will last *forever* based on how little you use.  Recommended.

I have been a fan of Jack Black Products, having used the Hand Salve and some of the beard/face shaving/cleaning products.  All have been great and had great scents.  The oil is great and is scented although with more of a citrus note than the stronger Jack Black signature scent.

I used the product in both my hair (helped calm down the crazies, especially during dry/cold weather), on my face (helped keep it moist and prevented it from drying out), and as a pre-shave oil on my facial hair.  Each one worked well.  The bottle itself is small, and the price high, but you're using very small amounts of it each time.  It's quite expensive, but for how long it will last and what it will prevent, I think it is an indulgence I can do.

By way of disclosure, I received a sample of this product for evaluation purposes.

This Jack Black Nourishing Oil is light and has a light, citrusy scent.  It's good for various uses.  It can soften up dry skin or help give hair a little extra shine.  It is not heavy or sticky.  It goes on surprisingly light.

A little bit goes a long way.  A few drops, rubbed together on your palms, will let you apply enough to your hair to help tamp down frizz.  My wife really liked it.

Of course, it's incredibly expensive.  Maybe give it as a gift or pick up a bottle when you really need to spoil yourself.
summary: Nice with a light fragrance, but expensive

reviewText:
It only takes a little but it makes a big difference.  I've been using this on my face and hair for 3 week now and not only does my face feel softer but the flakiness that I usually have in the mornings upon waking is gone!

My hair is wavy with some curls and while I love it I don't love the dryness and frizzies Im constantly battling.  After using Jack Black oil on my hair I've notice an improvement on both the dryness and frizzies.  Theyre not completely gone but better than prior to using the product.

I guess the only question is  is it worth the cost? (currently at $32.00 USD)  I would say yes if you have tried less expensive products with no luck, then try this.

I am a female who ordered this product because I have extremely dry, painful skin in the winter months. My ankles, feet and elbows are the primary problem. This Jack Black Nourishing Oil does wonders for them! It also gives my legs a sexy, healthy glow.

First of all the scent is VERY light and doesn't really linger on your skin after applying. It is a slightly fruity scent that seems natural and from the oils within this product (olive, grape, Jojoba, Watermelon and Plum oils are among 10 natural oils in the product). It is light enough to where it should not be an issue for anyone and both sexes would be okay with using it.

The oil comes in a nice glass bottle with a well-gauged pump that allows you to have some control over how much you use at a time. This oil may be a little pricey, but you need a very small amount compared to what you use with other products (like lotions). A small amount of the Jack Black oil goes a long way.

When I apply the oil to my skin, my skin soaks it up and absorbs it quickly. This leaves my skin looking healthy and feeling extremely soft. It is not greasy at all. The only place where I don't seem to like the way the oil feels is on my palms. I normally try to wipe it off or wash my hands after applying.

I also like using this oil on my cuticles. I have always applied lotion to my nails when I use it, and so this seemed like a natural transition for me. It helps to strengthen the nails. This oil also makes them shinier and healthier looking.

I have not tried the oil with shaving (I use razors that have a moisture bar and it would be too slick). I did try it on the tips of my hair, but I don't really benefit from most oil based products in my hair because it already has a lot of moisture and can be oily.

Overall, this is a great product with many, many uses. I think it is worth it and would buy some more. I recommend Jack Black Epic Moisture Nourishing Oil.

I like Jack Black products, I use and like their lip balm for example.

I had some specific uses in mind for this product when I saw it come up in Vine. Recently I began bleaching the dye out of my hair to go natural rather than let it grow out; I've been using argan oil very happily as a moisturizing treatment. I thought the Jack Black Epic Moisture would be a great comparison item against the argan, but it hasn't been. Sure, it temporarily smooths your hair. It makes the ends stick together a little bit after you use a flat iron. But as soon as I wash my hair, it feels the same as it did before. The oil isn't imparting any lasting benefit to my hair. I have thick, curly hair for the record.

Yes, it makes my hands and elbows smooth(er) temporarily. But I have to keep applying it. As a moisturizer for my face and neck, it just seemed to do light duty. I need more than light duty, especially for the severe winter weather we are having. On the plus side this did not aggravate my rosacea and didn't cause any zits to form.

They suggest a use for a beard conditioner/softener; I'd never thought of that use but have to wonder if a man would enjoy this fragrance lingering near his nose/mouth throughout the day.

This SMELLS great. The temporary effects it gives are nice, if you are looking for that. It's not what I needed and I wouldn't buy it, but I know there are a lot of men and women who need just this light kind of oil and would find it beneficial. It's a nice quality product, as I've found most Jack Black products to be, but if you have heavy-duty moisture needs this one won't be what you want.

UPDATE: My husband decided to grow out a goatee, and he's using this oil on his facial hair twice a day. It's helped soften the hair so that it's not rough and stabby.
summary: For light duty needs, a temporary fix UPDATE for beard use

reviewText:
This oil has a silky texture, it is non-oily, even though it contains 10 natural oils.  It isn't sticky, but smooth.  I only used it on my hair, as I am a woman and don't have a beard.  But I can imagine that it would be great for a beard.  Directions say It is also good for shaving, but I wouldn't want to waste this stuff on that.

The information shown on this Amazon page is pretty much everything stated on the box.  One thing I didn't see but thought it might matter to some is that this product is vegan.

Yes, it's a bit pricey, but if you are in the mood to spoil yourself a little, try it.  It really is divine!

I mainly use this oil for conditioning my goatee and shaving my legs (Im a cyclist) but Ive also used it to moisturize really dry areas. The oil does a very good job of conditioning and softening my beard and preventing fly-aways. You need to use it consistently and it takes a little time for it to really take effect but I truly does work great. Your beard will be softer without looking oily. Its also scent free which I strongly prefer. Another review said it has a lemon scent. Im not getting that and typically Im pretty sensitive to odors. If theres a scent its very subtle. I also use this oil for leg shaving. It makes the shaving process faster and safer (little to no cuts or nicks). Oil is preferable to cream so you can see what you're doing and where you're shaving. Its thick enough to not require much product but not so thick that your razor is instantly gummed up. Ive also used Pacific Shaving Company oil (too thin) and Shave Secret oil (too thick). Since this is an oil, I don't often use it for moisturizing but its very effective in that capacity particularly if you have a very dry and stubborn area. Im giving this product 5 stars because it works great for all its intended uses but the reality is that Im unsure how often I will purchase it due to its high price. I will have to wait and see how long a bottle lasts. So far a little bit goes a long way so it very well may end up being worth the high price.

Argan oil is a superb product for the skin. This 'dry' oil replenishes the oil that is needed by our skin & lost due to age and the environment (to name but 2 reasons).
I have recommended this product to everyone - the earlier a person begins use, the better, in doing so the skin will be 'preserved' as one ages physically.
I no longer use other facial skin care products that are not 'natural, God given' products and my skin has never been happier. This natural product (argan oil) alone has helped my skin more than the expensive skin care regimen that I followed in the past. I have discovered that the addition of other 'natural' recipes/remedies increase the efficacy of argan oil, as well.
summary: Very impressed, OUTSTANDING skin care product

reviewText: This stuff works well as a pre-shave or as a serious moisturizer. It can be a little greasy and slow to absorb, but it does a good job of moisturizing your skin and it really makes a difference before a shave. Good stuff. Not magical, but worth giving a try.
summary: It won't make you 20 again (unless you're already 20) but it's good

reviewText:
I have a big fluffy beard. Unfortunately in the winter, it more resembles a brillo pad in texture and I sometimes look like a homeless person.

This oil works well to condition and treat your beard, and the skin underneath. I apply it right out of the shower after towel drying my beard while it is still damp. I use three squirts of oil, placed in my palm, run my hands together and massage into my beard. It keeps my beard soft and supple all day, and treats the skin underneath to stop dryness and itching.

I almost thought of trimming my magnificent beard down because it was so rough, and it was itchy, this is allowing me to continue to grow it.

My beard hair is soft, manageable, and free of knots.

The glass bottle is heavy duty, so you can take it when you travel.

My ONLY complaint is the cost. It's pretty expensive, but I think a bottle would last you 2 months or so, but it's still a pretty hefty price to pay for a soft and manageable beard, free of itchiness.
summary: This is nice oil. Works very well as a beard oil.

reviewText:
This is a very thin, clear oil.  It isn't as thick as baby oil and runs almost like water.  I would never put oil or an oil-based product on my skin because it clogs the pores.  Some people might be able to get away with it, but even though I have dry skin, my skin will break out if I put oil on it, so I have skipped that test.  I did rub it into my hands and it dries fast without leaving an oily slick.

What I did use this for is my hair, which is very thick and very dry.  After shampooing, I poured a little bit of the oil into my hand and rubbed my hands together.  Then I ran my hands through my hair, keeping the oil away from the scalp area.  Afterwards, I blew my hair dry then applied more oil.  Usually, I apply a gel in the same manner that calms the frizz and leaves my hair with a nice shine to it.  However, the oil did not produce the same results.  My hair still had flyaway ends with no gloss to it.  My newly washed and dried hair always looks better the next morning after the hair product has had a chance to calm the frizzy hair shafts, but the morning after I used the oil, the results were no different than the night before.

Ill stick to my gel product to end the frizziness of dry hair.
summary: Doesn't do a thing for me

reviewText: I use all these stupid girly oils ... and they are the best! I'm addicted to Fresh Seaberry Moisturizing Face Oil, but it leaves me looking like I stuck my face in a fryer at McDonalds. I admittedly use too much and that is why I slather it on only at night ... and why my boyfriend makes fun of me every evening!. So, when I saw this Nourishing Oil for men, I thought I would have an equalizer - he couldn't possibly laugh at me if he too looked like a lighthouse beacon. I could not have been more surprised when he applied this after a shave and it miraculously disappeared, leaving behind an incredibly touchable face. It makes no sense! Jack Black has made a pact with the devil!! I stole the bottle from him (crazy with jealousy) and tried it on my legs. Good grief!!! It was AMAZING! It left behind no residue and JUST GORGEOUS skin! Now, know that pictures cannot do the packaging justice. Here, it looks like a bottle of Purell. In reality, it an aesthetically pleasing glass bottle. So, if you are at all concerned about "cheapness," no worries! And, the "pump" feature is a bit easier to use than the fancy "dropper" systems with which I am accustom. Finally, ladies, it really does read for "men and women" on the side of the box!! And, trust me, this is a phenomenal product! Buy it for your man or buy it for you! And, Jack Black company, know that customers notice the cruelty-free stamp on your bottle ... this is also why I will purchase it again and again.

As a woman, I really like this product.  I wasn't aware that this was marketed towards men.  I'm still not sure if it is or not, but it does advertise on the package about it's use for shaving.

I have long wavy hair and I used about 3 'squirts' from the pump to put on my hair after I washed it.  It left my hair soft, shiny, and didn't weigh it down a lot.  I've used oils much more expensive and this is a great oil for this price.  I don't use so much of it close to my scalp, but down on the length of my hair where it is dry, it really helps keep it from being so dry.

I also used it on my face as an overnight moisturizer and on my elbows.  After just one night, my elbows no longer felt rough and dry, and it left my face feeling so velvety smooth that I've been using it under my makeup as well.  It doesn't leave my skin oily- my skin soaks it in and it's just left feeling smooth.  It's been great in this cold weather.

It doesn't have much of a scent.  It does not seem to block my pores in any way.  I think it's a great product.

ETA - 5 months later and I'm still using and liking this product.  My hair simply does not GET split ends anymore, and I've been able to grow it longer without a trim.  It has become on of my favorite beauty products.
summary: Great stuff, for hair AND skin

reviewText: Works great as a skin moisturizer both for face and body.  nice for shaving and personal lubricant.  a small amount goes a long way

This stuff is like magic oil or something.  I swear it must be made from unicorn tears or something.  I use as a pre-shave oil on my face, and throw it in my hair after a shower, leaves my hair soft and softens my beard to chop it off.  Great stuff.

Of the 20~ preshaves I've tried so far, this one stands up to some of the best. The dispenser adds to the ease of use. As far as preshaves, I like something that stays wet but sticks... and this is it. There are a lot of too runny and too thick options out there and this one seems to be right in the sweet spot.

Foreas Luna Face Exfoliator Brush is a luxurious little gadget that leaves my face feeling clean, fresh, and energized. Its very good at getting pores clean and removing dead skin. Its supposed to remove fine lines, too, but Im not holding my breath  thats a hard claim to live up to. However, Im so pleased with how well the brush cleans my skin  and how good it feels to use  that Im not holding that against it.

The rechargeable exfoliator is soft latex and can be set to pulse exactly how you like it. It turns itself off when you stop using it. It also holds a charge for a long time. One thing  it didn't come with a wall outlet for the USB plug so youll need to borrow one from another device unless you already have a new electrical outlet with USB capabilities.

So far I really like this face exfoliator. Its made of silicone so its easy to clean with soap and water and you don't have to worry about bacteria growing when not in use. The charging port is completely  sealed inside so you don't have to worry about damage when washing or using in the shower. When in use it alerts you with pulses when  to switch places and also when its time to start using the back side of the exfoliator for the anti-aging routine. So you cam complete  the whole  routine provided in their booklet without having to watch a clock. It also turn itself  off  to prevent ypu from over doing it with the exfoliation. It takes the guess work out of exfoliating.

I have never tried anything like this before and now I'm wondering why I waited so long! It is very well made, solid rubber coating and stands up on it's own for charging.  The bristles are soft and fell very nice on my sensitive skin.  The intensity of the pulsing can be turned up or down to your liking, very simply with a touch of the little + or - next to the power button.  It turns off automatically when it's done.  It has made my skin very soft and smooth.  It also has done a really good job at shrinking my pores.  My only complaint is that it comes with a charger that is USB, but no actual wall plug, so you have to find an extra USB wall adapter if you want to plug it in and charge it.  Overall, I love it and it has made such a difference on my skin!

I really like this product.  It fits and feels welcoming to the hand and face.  The cleaning bristles are super soft and tiny so they don't leave scratch marks or abrasive marking on your face.  They actually don't leave any marks at all while giving a nice rejuvenating facial massage leaving the skin fresh, oxygenated and supple while the other side of the unit helps to stimulate using a bristle-less wavy feel which leaves the skin warm and oxygenated helping to reduce fine lines and wrinkles.

I don't use cleaning products on my face at all, but the exfoliation is very important in skin rejuvenation so what I do is rub ice on my face for about 2 minutes and then use the exfoliator brush side to "clean" it for another 2-3 minutes, after which I put olive oil and use the gentle wrinkle side to warm and smooth the oil into my skin. I find that once per day is enough.

I really, really like the fact that this stays charged for a very long time and that it is completely waterproof and easily cleaned.

Great product indeed.
This is a genuine piece of junk. The instructions are impossible to follow; Looking up the web site and trying to understand the usage is a hopeless task, My recycle bin accepted this with open arms.

I purchased this item directly from the manufacturer, so I know it was genuine. I was super excited to try this product bc it looked so exciting and different. I also loved the potential anti-aging effects with this item. BUT...the big but is whether or not it cleans better than my Clarisonic Mia. It doesn't. I alternated using the Mia one night and the Luna the next night, several nights in a row. Whenever I used my Luna, my face still had grime on it - it was not as clean as the nights I used my Mia.

Also, I find it an oddly shaped and designed device for the face - it's hard to get it to fit everywhere. It's basically like taking a flat-ish rock and trying to clean your face with the tip of that rock. Not always a good fit.

For now, I'm sticking with my Mia and will be returning the Luna until the design is much improved....they should've waited to bring this product to market, in my opinion; it's just not up to par as the excellent face-cleaner that it's meant to be and marketed as.

Have had the Clarisonic forever. Had the first Clarisonic and had the Mia 2. Clarisonic worked great for me (yet too strong for every day use). I would end up using once or twice a week at most. Bought the Foreo a little hesitant. But I was tired of having to purchase head replacements for Clarisonic. The Mia, not having the stand, would leave me with the feeling of not having all the water removed. The foreo would be less expensive, considering I would no longer need to buy head replacements. I am using for two weeks (which I agree is not a lot), but it has cleared all my acne, my skin is clearer and my nose pores have become smaller. I am in love with it! Just bought the mini for travelling. The battery is very good (I seem to need to charge my Clarisonic all the time), I have travelled for three weeks and no charging necessary!!! Love it!!!!
summary: Clarisonic worked great for me (yet too strong for every day use)

reviewText:
I've had my Clarisonic Mia for about five years (I had asked my husband for it for Christmas) and have always loved how soft and clean it makes my face -- but have hated how it seems to attract mold and a funky smell.  Perhaps it's because I live near the coast, but the brush heads on the Mia start smelling moldy right away, even when I do weekly disinfecting of them and also properly rinse and dry the brush right after using.

I decided to ask for this Luna for Christmas this year, and love it!  I've been using it about three weeks now, and it leaves my skin just as soft and smooth as my Clarisonic did. I have sensitive, combo skin that also gets easily dried out since I use Retin-A, and using the Mia twice a day (even with sensitive brush heads) was too irritating.  I can use the Luna twice a day with no problems.

It's super easy to clean, and leaves my skin as soft as my Mia ever did. I also bought this from a beauty retailer that included the cleaning spray as a bonus gift, and I've been using that once a week to clean the Luna.

I haven't been using the anti-aging backside of it since I really bought this more for its cleansing abilities, and love how deeply it cleanses.  You just have to be careful to not use any exfoliating or grainy scrubs with this since they can damage the silicone nibs.

You also only need to charge this once every six months, which is great.

Also, I noticed that a few reviewers were worried about whether or not their Lunas were counterfeit, so it may be worth it to order it from a retailer that guarantees the authenticity of the product.  (I bought mine from a beauty store that begins with a "U," and was even able to use a 20% off coupon for it.)

This is pricey, but it is something that I know should last me for a few years.  It's well worth it!

I will update my review as I use this more, but, for now, I love this.
summary: So much better than the Clarisonic Mia!

reviewText: At first I wasn't sure what to do with this - it's for your face. I apply my facial soap, and use this on it's 2 different settings - high/low. I move it all around my face and neck. I have felt that my face is cleaner by using this. Also, dry patches on my cheeks have gone away. So I think it's doing something good. The box comes with 4 picture directions that are small. There is a charger for this. The brush worked right out of the box. I just run this under water to clean. I am not one to buy these kinds of items, but it's working ok for me. The only reason I wouldn't purchase this again, is solely based on the price.

I love this silicone "brush."  I have used traditional sonic brushes in the past, and they seem to push debris into my pores and I end up with little hard blemishes just under the skin.  This item does not introduce anything into my pores and is gentle on my delicate, fair, thin, mature skin.  The charge lasts quite a long time, and the item is, indeed, waterproof.  I use this daily in the shower.  It helps with the larger pores on and around my nose.appear smaller and tighter.
This feels great.  A mini-massage as you clean/exfoliate your face.  I just wish it had a charging base instead of a cable, as I don't like having loose electric cables around my sink.
summary: This feels great. A mini-massage as you clean/exfoliate your face

reviewText: This is pleasant to use but not sure it is getting my face any cleaner.  It reminds one of a vibrator.  Hard to reconcile this with its price tag.  Easy t0 charge, easy to clean. An improvement over the Clarisonic because the Clarisonic was very difficult to keep clean.  This Foreo brush is a nice-to-have rather than a must-have.
summary: Pleasant to use and easy to clean

reviewText: I have dry, sensitive skin, and the Luna mini has been great for it. I use it once or twice a day. I've experienced no irritation from it, after from a couple of days of minor breakouts at the very beginning. It helps serums to soak in better and has decreased the severity of my monthly hormonal breakouts, which has led to more even skin tone and fewer dry patches.

I love this product. It is gentle and makes my face feel really clean. It works great with my regular facial cleanser to deep clean the skin and remove dead skin cells. I use it in the morning and in the evening. Having been using it for a week, my face feels rejuvenated with a healthy glow. Breakout seems to be less severe and frequent as well.

The Luna Mini is easy to use and comfortable to hold. It has a button in the center to power on/off and to change speed. It has two pulsation speeds and three zones of silicone touch-points (brushes) for different skin type and sensitivity. The silicone touch-points are super soft and gentle on the skin. It takes about a minute to clean the face and has built-in pause signals to tell you to move to different areas of the face. It is also waterproof, so you can use it in the shower as well. The silicone material makes the brush easy to clean and be kept hygiene. A full charge lasts for a few months. It comes with a special USB cable for charging (the Luna Mini has a coaxial connector for charging).

All in all, this is an amazing product. I honestly wasn't expecting that this small and simple looking face brush would make such a difference in face cleaning. It helps clear my face up and make it really clean. It comes packaged in a clear plastic case which could be used as a protective case for travel as well. Love it!

I love using this with my facial cleaner.  It always the cleanser to get deeper into my pores and remove grime, makeup and dead skin cells.  The bristles are super soft and gentle on your skin.  The battery life is super long.  I just leave it in the shower and use it every day to wash away the days impurities.

This Luna Mini Silicone Face Brush by FOREO does a fabulous job of getting my face really clean.

I have been using a Clarisonic facial brush cleaner for quite a while now and while it also gets my face very clean, I hate the expense of buying new brushes and I worry about keeping the brushes really clean.

The Luna Mini is quite small but it does a great job. It has two sides for regular and deep cleaning. It has a timer that prompts you to move to the next section of your face. There are two speeds so even if you have delicate skin, you can probably use this without irritation. It's completely waterproof so you can use it in the tub or shower.

When I first opened this Luna Mini, I didn't think it could possibly get my skin as clean as the Clarisonic because the silicone brushes just feel so soft. I took it to the shower, wet the brush and applied my facial cleanser and then began cleaning my face. It felt so gentle that again, I didn't think it would get my face clean but surprise! It did a fabulous job of getting my face amazingly clean. I also used it on my body with my regular bar soap and it worked wonderfully.

I have skin that tends toward being oily and I have found that getting my skin squeaky clean and then applying a good, acne lotion prevents almost all breakouts. This Luna Mini gets my skin squeaky clean. However, people with dry, delicate skin can use the lower speed and the gentle side and a moisturizing, facial cleanser to avoid drying out their skin while still cleansing away of all the daily dirt and makeup.

I came out of the shower with a rosy glow and my skin looked and felt wonderful.

It has an internal, rechargeable battery. It comes with a USB charging cable that you will either need to plug into a computer or a USB a/c adapter in order to use however, you can order a replacement charger that has an a/c plug on the end. Mine arrived almost fully charged - it only took 30 minutes longer to fully charge it. As far as I can tell, the battery is not user replaceable.

I love that it's so easy to clean. Just use soap and water and rinse well and then allow to air dry. FOREO doesn't say anything about this but I clean my silicone kitchen wear with alcohol from time to time with no adverse effects and I likely will do the same with this device.

It also comes in a nice, clear plastic storage box which is good for travel.

One disappointment is that the included instructions are printed in minuscule print. Go to the FOREO website and you'll find blessedly large instructions for use.

I'm so, so happy with this device! I'll be giving my Clarisonic to someone else.
summary: Does a fabulous job of getting my face really clean

reviewText:
More Use Options at Lower Price

This Foreo Luna Mini competes effectively, surpasses it on costs and use options and pricing in these ways:

1. 2-sided silicone "fingers" are like two brush heads in one, delicate AND Stronger/Deeper ny changing sides NOT brushes
2. silicone IS anti-bacterial compared to other brush heads,
3. NO brush head replacement needed every 3 months,
4. I can use this for cleansing, toning, moisturizing by simply rinsing the brush between the steps - NOT my Clarisonic Mia2

7. Various online stores have coupons, sales and/or value packages that ARE less pricey than my initial Clarisonic, purchase, replacement brushes etc

1. built-in timer/signal to move to other parts of face
