reviewText: I expected this to work better than ordinary drug store polish remover. While it works, it's definitely not better, and I'm not certain it's as fast. I won't repurchase. Not worth a higher price, plain and simple.
I purchase this to see if shellac would come off easier. I also purchased a no name brand and got 3 times a much for a couple dollar, that work just as well nothing special with name brand.

Carven Le Parfum is a sweet and fruity perfume with notes of pear, guava, and jasmine.  The high quality fragrance remains consistent after multiple hours of wear on bare skin and clothing.  It does not decompose into powdery or artificial scents like cheaper perfumes.  I would characterize it as a youthful and flirty, fit for all occasions.  Had I encountered it during my dating life, I would have been swept off my feet.

I tested a small dab on myself and a full spray on my wife.  The scent was strong up to the first four hours, and gently declines until it is just a hint after 12 hours.  The EDP concentration rating is the strongest available, and one spray should last all day.

Advice from a former perfume seller- if you buy Carven for below full price from other sellers, beware that the bottles are often sourced from other countries and there is no guarantee of authenticity.  Go to Neiman or Nordstroms to smell the true scent if buying it for the first time, and don't hesitate to complain to Amazon if you receive a dud.

The scent is not overwhelming. It is delicate and perfect for everyday use without attracting unwanted attentions.

As stated in the outer box, the product is made in France.
summary: Delicate scent perfect for everyday use

reviewText: Incredible! My favorite new scent! It is everything a great perfume should be: an elegant delicate smell that is warm but not too floral, light but not bitter or sour, and it lasts all day. I don't remember when I last had a perfume with such staying power. It simply lingers without fading all day. I have even gone to the pool and it did not wash away. The smell compliments my appearance without taking over; it blends well with skin's natural oils, and does not change as the day goes on. Wow! And I have never heard of this perfume before!

For me this is three star, but if I were using it as a gift, it would definitely be higher.  My rating is based on my own preferences for perfume.  It is a bit too floral for me.  I tend to like Opium and the blue bottle I can never find anymore.  I smell a lot of things I like, especially jasmine, hyacinth, and sandalwood, but it seemed like they were a bit overpowered by patchouli.

Funny enough, it smells more like my grandmother.  It is a beautiful bottle and would make a great gift.

This light and floral scent is perfect for those that prefer a delicate rather than overpowering aroma.  The scent lasts around 4 hours, which is fairly standard in relation to the few perfumes I tend to gravitate to. You would need to spray again for evening use.

I started noticing that my 2 month old had some very dry patches/cradle cap on his scalp. I tried coconut oil and brushing it out but it didn't work. After using this for one day, my husband and I noticed a huge difference. The cradle cap wasn't completely gone, but it had improved drastically. I also really love the scent, it smells like the Mustela body wash and my baby's hair smells really good for two days after using it.  One thing I noticed is that you really have to use this consistently for it to continue working; we went on vacation and forgot this shampoo and the cradle cap came back.
Gets cradle cap gone easily, and it doesn't seem to bother her eyes!

love this for cradle cap. the self foaming shampoo is easy to rinse out and also easy to use. it is an essential part of our routine and even though i have tried many other organic and natural shampoos for my children, this is the one i still come back to.

So it never helped with the cradle cap it promised, but we used 1 pump a night of this shampoo and it lasted over a year, never hurt my baby's eyes, and kept her hair great. It actually lasted almost 2 years because I diluted it with water and continued to use it. Bought another bottle for year 2.

Just finished using this  shampoo on my baby and I love it. It smells heavenly and got rid of his flaky dry skin on head and eyebrows instantly. He's been having a case of very mild cradle cap since birth and now it's gone in one time use only. I used this shampoo in conjunction with a cradle cap brush. My baby's hair feels like silk.

This hair dryer is AMAZING. I'll admit I have only had it for about a month - so I have not experience the problems of those who have had it for longer.

I did have a bit of a problem figuring out how to turn this hair dryer on - you have to hit some buttons on the plug first and then you hold down the power button for a few seconds and it turns on. From there, you can increase the speed of the dryer as well as the heat level. I used this with the fan and heat level all the way up with the concentrator attachment. I have long, fine hair. However, I've got a lot of hair. So, what would take me 25 minutes with my old dryer only takes 10 minutes with this dryer and concentrator attachment. I also found that this left my hair feeling much softer after use.

If you value your time and want to cut down on amount of time spent getting ready, this is the hair dryer for you. It is high quality and works very well.

This is an awesome blow-dryer! There is only one thing I don't like about it and that is the power button, it's hard to explain but it should be a separate button that you don't have to hold for so long to get it to turn on or off. But I love everything else. It is quiet (for a blow dryer) it has a low pitched hum that doesn't hurt my ears. It is so powerful. I can't imagine using this one the highest setting. I love how many different settings it has! There are 5 fan speeds indicated by the digital reader turning colors as you push them up or down. There are many heat settings the hottest one would burn your hand. The cool shot doesn't have to be held down, leaving you free to leave it on as long as you want and maneuvering in different ways. I love all the attachments, the defuser is smaller and doesn't take up so much space in my drawer. This is the nicest blow dryer I have ever used at a salon or in my home.
UPDATE: STill works great a year latter!
summary: The blow dryer of the future

reviewText:
Update: three months later, I'm in love with this dryer. When I first used it I thought it was fine, and the customization was nice. Now that I've used it for months, I realize that it truly shines about 3 hours *after* you've used it. Seriously--with most of my (admittedly inexpensive) hair dryers, my hair looks a bit more frizzy and tired as I go through my day. For some reason, with this hair dryer the opposite happens--2 hours after I've blow-dried my hair, it lays flat, looks super-shiny, and holds its style well. I usually buy dryers for about $30-50, and now I understand why someone would pay more. This dryer will make your hair look phenomenal.

PROS:
* Your hair looks super-shiny throughout the entire day--it will look better rather than worse 2 hours after drying
* You can customize temperature and air volume a lot more than with most dryers (maybe 8 settings each instead of the usual 2 or 3)
* Comes with a diffuser, concentrator, and pick attachments
* A lonnnnnng cord means you don't have to worry about whether you can have dryer plugged in *and* see yourself in the mirror at the same time
* An included velcro wrap makes it easy to store the cord, and there's a loop for hanging it on the wall (though as a non-hairdresser I don't need that)

NEUTRAL:
* Buttons are a bit small - a tiny bit harder to adjust, but it also means you don't bump them by accident
* Resets to Celsius every time you turn the dryer off (annoying, but fixable and you honestly don't need to read the temp much)
* Has an illogical color scheme (IMO) as you go from gentler to more harsh, (with blue meaning "almost red" in terms of heat)... but fortunately it's easy enough to figure out since it's directly in response to you pushing the + / - buttons... and I assume the color was designed that way so colorblind people can also see the changes

TIPS:
* To turn on/off: press and hold the "reduce fan" button for a couple of seconds (if you look, you'll notice a power symbol underneath it)
* To switch to Fahrenheit: press and hold the "increase fan" button for a couple of seconds (it resets to Celsius every time you turn it off)... fortunately you can usually tell how warm it is by pushing the up/down buttons and ignoring the number displayed
* In general, the faster you dry your hair (high heat + high air volume), the more damage it will do. I have fine hair so should avoid those extremes, but also don't want to spend an hour drying :-P I settled on medium heat + medium volume, and my hair still dried fairly quickly
summary: super customizable, makes your hair look fantastic

reviewText: Lightweight and powerful, this is a much nicer dryer than a cheapie from the big box store.  I have thick curly hair, so I only use the diffuser.  It goes on and off smoothly and stays secure while you use the dryer.  The long cord is a very nice feature, and the velcro strap attached makes it easy to wind it up neatly to stow the dryer.  So far, I am very pleased with it.  Haven't had it long enough yet to talk about durability, but it feels solid.  The only thing I can see to nitpick about is the buttons.  They are small and out of the way on the back of the handle(good thing!) but would probably be difficult to push with long nails.  Not an issue for me, but it could be frustrating.  The press and hold feature to turn it on and off will also help prevent accidental button pushing.

When I saw some of the same notes as my favorite perfume I ordered this to give it a try. My favorite is an oriental: Obsession by Calvin Klein. On me the scent of Roma is strong at first especially of powder or "dry down" and dying down a great deal after two hours into something I like better. I feel it is strong of powder and florals with base notes of my preferred woody, oriental scents with vanilla and amber. I figured out what the confusion is. The product info on Amazon is incomplete for describing the scent. What it says at the time of writing this review is only a partial listing of the notes in this perfume. It says: "This scent captures the essence of femininity built around a core of woodsy notes that form the base. Layers of vanilla and almond continue the theme of warmth, while mandarin orange and cyclamen round out the top." That description is far too short and gives the wrong impression.

For the purpose of writing this review I wanted to know more about what was in the scent to give it that powdery aspect and why I felt it was not as oriental as I prefer. The official site has no words only images. I then turned to Fragrantica who describes it as an oriental spicy with "top notes are black currant, sicilian bergamot, pink grapefruit, mint and hiacynth; middle notes are carnation, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley and rose; base notes are amber, sandalwood, singapore patchouli, musk, civet, vanilla, oakmoss and myrrh".

To me this is very feminine and powdery while oriental spice, musk, patchouli, vanilla, oakmoss and myrrh are all unisex and dominant earthy scents. Trust me, this is more of a daytime feminine scent than a sexy evening scent.

I rate this 3 stars = It's Okay. It's just not for me.
summary: Very Powdery and Feminine With Florals - Daytime Scent - Girly

reviewText: Lovely soft "powdery" floral toilette, it's not something I would wear daily as its a bit stronger than I am used to, but this (to me) would be perfect for going out for any kind of get together day or evening, it lasts fairly long too. I probably stand alone in this next comment, but I do not like spray bottles, I think its nicer to have just a very small opening so you can shake a drop out and put it where you want it...I feel a lot is lost in a spray...plus there is always something left at the end you can not get to.  Otherwise its a lovely designed bottle, definitely one to leave out to enjoy looking at.  Overall a very feminine scent, very floral and romantic to me.

Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette is soft and gentle and reminds me of baby powder but with a hint of muskiness. Other reviewers have said it is bold and woodsy which only shows that body chemistry and noses and tastes are different for each of us.

What most of us can agree on is the pretty slanted, gold topped and ribbed, frosted glass bottle with a wider glass pedestal at the bottom.

I imagine this Eau de Toilette would be fine for any age because it feels innocent.

It's difficult to describe perfume without sounding extraordinarily pompous, but "it smells nice" doesn't seem sufficient for an amazon review. So here I go -- 'm not sure this scent "captures the essence of femininity" but it is a very feminine scent.  Seems more formal than playful to me, something I'd wear for an occasion rather than every day.

The box reads:
This scent captures the essence of femininity built around a core of woodsy notes that form the base. Layers of vanilla and almond continue the theme of warmth, while mandarin orange and cyclamen round out the top.
An elegant, sensual and classic scent to make you feel unforgettable like Rome.

This scent comes on strong right out of the bottle and it smells very formal and floral to me. Pretty overwhelming -- very "perfumey" and old-fashioned.  I want to say grandma-ish, but nearly all of my friends are grandmas . . . and they sure don't smell like this.  The initial pow dissipates quickly, and fades to a light, pleasant, powdery citrus scent.  I do not detect warmth, muskiness, almond or woodsy notes, nor do I detect the kind of fresh, green scents I usually go for.  I smell citrus and powder, with floral overtones. Pleasant and feminine.  Nothing earthy or exotic of woodsy, and no hint of vanilla.  Does it remind me of Rome?  Not exactly.  But it does smell nice.

The more I wear it, the more I like it.  It is very long-lasting!  Although it's an eau de toilette, it is longer lasting than most perfumes I have.
summary: Pleasant floral/citrus scent that packs a punch initially and dries very powdery

reviewText: Other reviewers noted a powdery scent; I definitely did not (and I love powdery scents like Forever Krystle). This had a slightly musky/earthy scent on me. It put me in mind of Coco Chanel (which I can't wear). It is a strong lingering fragrance. Even after having it on awhile it didn't change greatly. That's not to say this is not a very nice, quality fragrance. Like other perfumes/EDT's, it's very individual. My niece tried it and wasn't crazy about it; my sister tried it and on her it was good. In fairness, I'm giving it 4 stars--on other folks it might well be a 5 star "I love it" scent.
summary: For those who like a bold, earthy type scent

reviewText:
Because of body chemistry, the same fragrance can smell differently on different people. When three of my family members test the same fragrance, it smells differently on each of us. Two of us tested Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette, and no, surprise here, it smelled differently on each of us. However on each of us, the fragrance changed to a powdery scent within a half hour or less of applying it. And, to add more confusion to my review, I like this fragrance, my daughter-in-law doesn't.

Most of my favorite fragrances are the ones that change to a powdery scent...and I love some vanilla added too. I think Essenza di Roma is strong when first sprayed; I  spray it sparingly now; a little goes a long way. Each time I've worn it, it changed to a powdery scent rather quickly...within 10 minutes or so. As the day wears on, the powdery scent becomes softer & softer. The long lasting fragrance doesn't diminish, but becomes softer.
I don't like the fragrance when it's first sprayed, but love the powdery scent that becomes softer as the hours pass.

The main fragrance accords are: woody, citrus, vanilla, sweet, powdery.

From Amazon's product description:  "This scent captures the essence of femininity built around a core of woodsy notes that form the base. Layers of vanilla and almond continue the theme of warmth, while mandarin orange and cyclamen round out the top."

The frosted bottle, with soft gold cap is elegant looking & designed to look like a Roman pillar. The top of the attractive lid is slightly angled.

I like Essenza di Roma and will use it often.
summary: Starts out as a crisp scent which changes to a long lasting powdery scent with a hint of vanilla

reviewText: This perfume has a strong warm earthy scent, and it comes in a very attractive bottle.  I prefer a cleaner, lighter scent myself, but I can see where some might find this pleasing.  Its not offensive, just bold!

I would think it is quite a challenge to order perfume on-line unless you are familiar with the scent.  The sense of smell is such a selective thing so one person's rose can be another person's skunk Cabbage. And a perfume can smell entirely different, on different people, when it combines with a person's individual chemistry so all I can give you is my personal opinion.

Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette for Women is in a very attractive bottle with a gold-tone top and spray dispenser.  This is an eau de toilette which isn't as long lasting as a perfume and it is cheaper than a perfume, of course.

This is a "gourmand" scent.  Or a "foodie" scent. It has almond, vanilla,mandarin orange and slight floral undertone.  The only scent I can think of, which is similar, is Jessica Simpson's "`Sweet  treats".  I consider this a daytime scent, light and fresh.

They say:
 "benefits....  A soft and elegant fragrance capturing eternal values and celebrating true emotions "

I'm not sure what that means but it smells sort of good anyway.

Made in UK
summary: Laura Biagiotti Essenza Di Roma Eau de Toilette

reviewText: This is great so far! It leaves a tightening feeling on your lips after application. You do have to apply with your finger, and it is creamy, like a small jar of lotion. When I woke the next morning I could feel more smoothness overall. I will be applying at night, and I'm really enjoying the short term results of only 3 days.  Very nice product.

I like this lip treatment as It is very moisturizing.  It is .34 ounces which is a small amount of product but a little goes a LONG way. It also,has a nice citrus scent.  As most skin care products it takes time to see results and I will update my review in about a month.

I am not a fan of lip balm but I thought that I would give this a try. I was pleasantly surprised that it did not feel like lip balm and was not the usual "sticky" feeling you sometimes get with a lip treatment.  I was impressed that it was made for women by women. It contains no paraben. It is hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic. The jar is small (0.34 fl oz/10ml) but you do not need but a little dab because it goes a long way. It does not have a flavor which is a plus and the scent is miniscule that it is almost non existant. Made in the USA
summary: SUPER LIP TREATMENT AND NOT A LIP BALM

reviewText: I find it interesting that all but 3 of the 36 reviews for this product came from Vine reviewers (so we got it free). I'm not counting all the 5 star reviews from "Amazon Customer" who has no history except this product. Today's price is $85 for a teeny amount.  Granted you don't need much, but come on.  I took before and after pictures of my mouth to see if the appearance of vertical lines was in fact, reduced, as promised.  Nope.  Does it plump the lips?  Maybe momentarily.  A fine enough lip conditioner with a mild, pleasant fragrance, for free.  Does it work better than the tube of Chap Stick for a buck?  Not in my opinion.

The VENeffect product seems to do what it promises but wow is it expensive!  The crevices around my lips are much smoothed. I don't notice that my lips are plumper but perhaps they are. I am quite surprised at the difference in those deep wrinkles above and below my lips.  If the cream we're not so expensive there are other parts of my face that I would like to use it on. The only negative thing I can think of about it is that my lips seem dry when I am using it. I apply it twice a day and have only skipped an application once. The next time I put some on I could tell the wrinkles were already deepening.
summary: Seems to work but very expensive!

reviewText: Good stuff.  It feels great going on your skin, absorbs quickly, and leaves your skin refreshed.  I cannot vouch for the long-term efficacy of the product, as we've only used it for a short while, but it seems to do all it is advertised to do.  We're pleased with this one.

I specifically chose this product because I am beginning to get little wrinkles (and one deep wrinkle) around my lips and I was hoping for something that would help plump the area to reduce the appearance of them.  While this cream is very thick and makes a really nice chapstick for dry lips, for the price, I was hoping it would do more.  As of today, I will continue to use the product as I enjoy the scent, the non-greasy/waxy feel, and the way it hydrates my dry typically flaky lips, however, this will not be a re-order for me.
summary: Makes a nice chapstick, however, I didn't see much improvement on the wrinkles around my lips...

reviewText:
A review from my wife since this was one of our Vine items and I don't wear makeup or use products of this nature....

A lot of plant based or all natural treatments contain aloe, which Im allergic to.  So I was very glad to see that this treatment for lips didnt.  It does promise a lot, though.  Its supposed to visibly reduce the appearance of vertical lines, smooth, soften, and plump the delicate lip area.  Also, lipstick will glide on beautifully and you can say goodbye to lipstick bleed!

This lip treatment is different than anything Ive ever tried.  Its neither a balm nor a gloss and its not in a tube.  Its a very light cream (the box describes it as delicate) and its in a tiny little jar. It has a very light, very soft feel to it as it goes on.  Unlike practically anything else Ive ever used on my lips, this product absorbs into the lips really quickly.  And while it doesnt leave a waxy or greasy layer on the lips, you definitely know its there  lips are moisturized, soft, and rosy (even though its not tinted at all). A little goes a long way, which is great considering the price.

I haven't been using it long, only about two weeks.  So I cant really say if it will ever really reduce the signs of aging around my mouth.  But I have noticed that my lips look healthier. Ive always had a huge problem with chapping and peeling  I have lip balms stuck everywhere because of it  and that has not been as severe since Ive been using the VENaffect.  In fact, I don't reach for the lip balm as much as I used to.  Lipstick does go on smoother when using it and it stays truer to color because the balm isn't watering it down. Actually, I prefer to put it on before any other makeup and smooth it in the area around my lips, too.

Its not exactly the type of thing Id want to carry around in one of my nice handbags for fear it the lid would come off  it would take up more space than a tube of balm anyway.  I try to use it at least three times per day: in the morning under my lipstick, before I go to the gym, and then again before bed.

The only sticking point for me, and the only reason I didn't give it five stars, is the price.  Eighty five dollars ($85.00) is a lot of money to pay for a tiny jar of lip cream.  As much as I love the product, I cant imagine paying that much for a lip treatment regularly.

Absolutely loved this lip treatment. I typically use moisturizers on my face, but I guess I never thought of how my lips probably are one of the first areas that show my age. This cream is a smoothing addition to my daily beauty regimen now. I use it at night before bed and in the morning when I wake up. I can honestly say that after using this for almost two weeks now, the results are amazing. I see my lips looking fuller (I typically have thin lips) and the skin around them is smoother. If there is any down size it's the size of the product and the cost. I mean, I will probably be through this little jar in less than a month. Not sure I will spend $60 a month or so for this. But, maybe in this case, you do get what you pay for.
summary: Great addition to your beauty regimen. Amazing results for your lips and surrounding areas

reviewText:
I have a lot of dry lip/chapped skin issues in the cold weather so I was pretty enthusiastic about trying this lip treatment. The usual treatments are either too slick or too waxy but the consistency of this is more like a cream. Although this absorbs easily and has a light citrusy feeling/fragrance. I have been using this at night for the last week and I can feel a difference, especially when I was in the mountains this week for a few days. I don't a lot of lines around my mouth so that's not a problem but I believe this would work considering how quickly it helped with my chronically chapped lips.

This is made from all good, organic ingredients and is made in the USA, which I like. However, the price is way too high for my budget and I'm guessing for many others, sadly.

It's a really high-quality product but the price will limit its audience.

Recommend if you can afford it.
summary: Excellent product but way too expensive

reviewText: This stuff is great. It not only makes your lips feel smooth but they also feel plumper like they actually say. I've only been using it a short time but can already feel the difference. It smells really nice too. It only takes a small amount so it will last a long time. I've only been using it at night before I go to bed but think I will start using it during the day too since my lips get chapped a lot.

This is the first time I've ever heard of an anti-aging lip treatment. Being in my 50's, this is something that I wanted to try. I don't have the feathering lines around the lip area (yet), but who can't use a good treatment? This has a light pleasant citrus scent. Just a little amount makes my lips feel smooth and the taste isn't bad either. However, I didn't feel like the treatment did anything more than a good lip balm would do. Except for the fact that it's supposed to help with the aforementioned feathering lines, I can't see paying so much money for this product.

Like most expensive beauty treatments, the VENeffect Anti-Aging lip treatment is top notch in ingredients, usage and results. It's quite nice to use, its light scent is pleasant, it feels great on my lips and absolutely moisturized my always dry lips. I generally have some lip balm with me at all times. The .34 oz tub is small enough to tote around and I have been using it several times a day to great effect. This tub should last months, given how little you need to use.

The moisturizing it gives my lips is quite unlike the lip balms I have used. It's not waxy or greasy and really it is unlike anything I've ever used. I don't have to keep reapplying it and it doesn't come off leaving residue. It's truly unique to me. I can't speak to the anti-aging effect, but I'm a believer that moisturizing is good for long term effects of all my skin.

So, the downside. It's $28. Sure, it's probably going to last me 6 months and it's really really nice. I'm also less likely to lose it than a $3 tube of Whole Foods lip balm. So, I'm torn. I'll probably buy it again as it's not that extravagant and has done wonders for my lips in a short time.
summary: Unilke any mositurizing your lips have ever had

reviewText:
This stuff is fantastic! We get really dry lips up here in the High Desert, and this stuff is fabulous. One of two applications, and you can already see and feel a difference.

No waxy or greasy feel, no strong scents, no off flavors.

Price point aside, this is a wonderful product!

Very simply put, this product while seemingly making my lips more "smooth and moist" is so ridiculously overpriced, it is the epitome of the make-up industry pushing overpriced, make you feel younger, make you look younger products on the population.  Not to mention, if the opposite sex, or same sex for that matter is looking at your lips to determine the viability of a long lasting relationship, then you know what, move along from that individual.  You lips, should be the LAST thing anybody is concerned about considering anti-aging.  How about you handle those sagging eye lids, or wrinkles around your mouth, face, neck, forehead, whatever.

For the current price of nearly $85, you get just over 1/2 TBS.  Yes that is correct.  You get the luxury of paying $85 for a company that sends you just over 1/2 tablespoon of product.  Think about that.  Go look at your measuring spoons, pull out the 1 TBS and 1/2 TBS and figure you are getting something in between those two amounts for $85.

Honestly, my Burts Bees, or some other higher end lip product will make your lips feel just as good.

I seriously can't imagine anyone paying $85 for such a small amount of product and thinking that perhaps the smallest surface area on your face (your lips) are even in the conversation of anti-aging products to make you look and feel better.
summary: You have got to be kidding me.

reviewerName: Leah Maines, best-selling, award-winning author, actor, and editor
reviewText:
This lip treatment works very well to fight the signs of aging around the mouth--think smokers lip.  The cream is not sticky like a lip balm, it is more like a lip moisturizer that you use on lips and surrounding area.  I did see an improvement in the fine lines around my mouth.  I really could not discern any fragrance.

I would give it five stars except I had a slight allergic reaction to it--which is not uncommon for me.  I have very sensitive skin, and I have had allergies to lipsticks as well.  If you do not have severe allergies to lip products, this might be a great treatment for you.  It does work.
summary: Good lip cream, and helps fine lines.

reviewText:
As I don't have visible signs of aging, I can't comment on the anti-aging properties of this lip treatment, but I can say how amazing the hydration is. I have tried everything for chapped lips and this works like a miracle. I usually don't wear cream lipstick because it ends up looking flaky, but after using this for a couple of days, I can now wear any lipstick I want. It is very pricey, but if it keeps my lips smooth like this, it's worth it.

It has a slight chemical scent and taste, but nothing overpowering.

This is a good product for the lips.  It goes on easily, does not have an unpleasant taste and does quickly improve the appearance of even chapped and dried out lips.  However I personally do not think it is worth $85 for a third of an ounce even though only a small amount is needed daily to be effective.  I received this free as part of the Vine program and am not used to spending that much on cosmetic treatments.

The jar is quit small but since this is for your lips, you don't need a lot. It has an odd scent/flavor to it. Kind of reminds me of cucumber but not quite. It's also not something you can put on your lips then immediately apply lipstick.

After using the treatment, I didn't notice any real difference in how my lips looked or felt. The treatment left my lips feeling a bit dry.
summary: The jar is quit small but since this is for ...

reviewText: Does not disappear like some and seems to help fill in some lines. Wonderful scent. I put it all around my lips and it felt very soothing and moisturizing.  So far, this is one of the better lip treatments I have used.

VENeffect Anti-Aging Lip Treatment, 0.34 fl. oz. is top of the line  product. It is not like a chapstick or other lip balm. It does not go on waxy or leave a residue. It feels nice after being applied and has a light pleasant scent.

This is all natural and made in the USA. It is an expensive product so using this is for sure a luxury, but for someone who has a serious problem with dry lips to the point they are hurting, it would be worth the expense. It would really work where other products simply won't. The container is small but a little bit goes a long way. Use some type of applicator as opposed to a finger when administering the product and you will reduce waste. Start with small amounts, it goes on very easy.

This product is truly a high end item. You can of course buy cheaper lip treatments, but with this it is one of the rare cases where the quality matches the price. VENeffect Anti-Aging Lip Treatment, 0.34 fl. oz. highly recommended for those with bad lips that need help.

five stars on this product... although it's hard to give a proper evaluation after only a week or so, this product has a big thumbs up for several reasons:

1. a nice, smooth texture
2. it goes on easily
3. it is not greasy
4. seems to last and stay on long enough (on at night and the lips are still smooth in the morning)
5. doesn't have a taste, but has a fresh smell - which is nice
6. it will easily last a month if used several times a day

the immediate effects are good - but the jury is out on the long-term benefits

With so many products looking to coat or protect and so few that actually treat lips, I ordered this for my wife.  She's tried a variety of solutions, and while some fill a compulsion to apply something, the results are minimal.  At least she likes trying to apply something, the smell, taste, etc...

This here is more of a treatment, and while the quantities are all but infinitesimal, it's the good stuff.  I wouldn't say my wife's lips are aging, but she feels that they are now firmer and smoother.  More than anything, she feels as if something is actually happening.

Sadly it's not all roses.  The quantity listed .34 oz is correct and an absolutely tiny amount.  I tend to leave the "is it worth it" question to you, as we all have different budgets and priorities.  In this case, it seems so out of whack, I dropped it to four stars, but for what it's worth, my wife esays she hasn't used anything better.
summary: Works wonders but costs a fortune

reviewText: Im outdoors a lot, which means exposure to sun and wind -- and damage to my lips when I am not careful. Thus, this products promise to moisturize and protect my lips was quite appealing. Thanks to high-altitude backpacking and other activities, Ive had some serious damage to my lips and want to ensure their longterm health. I have a number of products, including sunscreen sticks, anti-chapping sticks, and lip moisturizers/healers. The first two leave a waxy deposit, and the lip moisturizers either seem like face lotion and feel slimy on my lips, or have a medicinal bite. This VenEffect Lip Treatment is much more pleasant. A small dot of this cream is enough to coat your lips and the margins beyond them. The cream glides on smoothly and absorbs so that it is not tacky to the touch within a couple of minutes. The first few times I used it, I had two patches of chapping from being in the sun and wind. The cream kept the patches moist for several hours, and I avoided the flaking that usually follows. Applying the cream also didn't make those areas burn the way my medicinal cream did. The cream has a slight hint of yuzu fragrance that is true to the aroma of the yuzu I grow in my yard. It is pleasant when you open the jar and for the first few minutes after you apply the cream, but the scent fades quickly. I am sensitive to scented products and would have noticed if it had been strong or had lingered. The product materials note that this includes ginger and cucumber; I did not notice ginger, which can have a bite. This cream is made in the United States; instructions say to apply morning and night and during the day as needed. Because it contains resveratrol and other ingredients aimed at restoring collagen and boosting elasticity, I have been using it three times a day and using my sunscreen stick when Im outdoors.

The thick finishing spray volume spray is good, but the lingering mist is a bit much. Love Orbie products but this is not my favorite, only because of the heavy mist left afterword.  It gets all over everything and it leaves a fog in the air for a bit.
Oribe can never go wrong in my book. This smells amazing to refresh second day hair, and it's great for boosting flat hair.
Great Product works well with my colored hair
Not to be confused with a dry shampoo.  Adds texture to clean roots.  Smells
This product has amazing texture and volume.  I was really pleased with the overall look and feel of my hair when I use this product.
Mousse is light and you do not need a whole lot.  Holds well and is manageable.
This does provide volume but the effect is short lived. If I reapply my hair gets "crunchy". For the price and brand, I expect more.
Works great with the other products I purchased great hold highly recommend

A bit pricey but it's good for refreshing your hair when it's a little oily. Therefore you get a bit of volume to otherwise limp hair between washings. I'm not a big fan of the smell because it's a bit strong for my liking, but it doesn't leave any residue or flakes which is a plus.
summary: A bit pricey but it's good for refreshing your hair when it's a little oily

reviewText: I love the product but the new pump is not as good as it used to be. I did got a replacement product but still the pump is not as good as the old ORIBE mousse. First pump was defective and the second is still pretty hard to use. Pump looks different than the product I purchased through my salon, I asked if it was original and they said yes. So I guess is not the same pump anymore.
summary: I love the product but the new pump is not as ...

reviewText: perfect! not sticky. ORIBE sells great products.
Its Oribe ..... need I say more.
item exactly as described great quality fast ship

This is a very mild smelling cologne. It has a wonderful scent that is so pleasant it can be worn by a woman as well... definitely reminiscent of those old Calvin Klein unisex perfumes . It is more "flowery" smelling than you would usually expect for a men's cologne. I do not, however, feel that this scent lasts all day. It is so soft and mild that it seems to wear off by early afternoon. The benefit of that is this cologne does not overpower you. You get a wiff of it and think, "Mhmm. What is that delicious scent?!" ;) I love when my husband wears this cologne. I find myself attracted to him and his smell without even knowing why. It almost has a subtle magnetic factor to it. I have been a fan of other Burberry perfumes in the past and I don't know if this is their best scent but it is definitely enjoyable. I love the bottle as well!

Although this is a clean fragrance, it's also a bit too sweet for my preference in a man's cologne, leaning towards a feminine scent. It has a very strong after scent of baby powder.

My 21 year old son isn't that keen on this scent, and neither is my husband. Let's just say we'd all choose a different cologne over Burberry Touch, however, none of us thought it was offensive or abhorrent. Check it out at your local fragrance counter before ordering it on Amazon, which is your best bet as all scents are subjective.
summary: Not my favorite; but not offensive.

reviewText: I like it. I think because of the softness of the scent and the floral notes that it should be marketed as a unisex scent.  But the Virginia cedarwood gives it enough earthiness to make it also suitable for men. I ordered it for my husband because he likes Burberry scents. He likes it. But I wore it for a couple days last week and got a couple of positive comments on it.  People wanted to know what it was. It's not a strong scent, one of the people was a stranger in a crowded elevator and the other, a friend who smelled it when hugging me hello. It's kind of a soft scent.  I love the bottle design which I would describe as "simple sophistication".  Actually, the scent could be described that way too.
summary: Could be marketed as a unisex scent

reviewText: This is a little strong fragrance for men, but I love it. The smell lasts longer than any other mens perfumes I have used before. It is refreshing with a certain amount depth in terms of aroma. I am sure many younger guys would gain special attention of ladies with this perfume. It is definitely grade A perfume. The package was delivered on time and the product was intact. I definitely recommend this product.
summary: Very masculine, but a little strong

reviewText:
I'm conflicted on this cologne.  I have a few other Burberry colognes and they all seem unique and I enjoy them.  Something about Burberry Touch that is somewhat bland.  It has a powder like smell, and it seems to stay, with a light floral smell.  My wife upon smelling it for the first time thought it was a perfume, and it could be used as one, but it still is more of a masculine scent.

It's a safe scent, slightly floral but kind of unremarkable.  Yet I still enjoy wearing it, and I still enjoy the smell.
summary: I have a few other Burberry colognes and they all seem unique and I enjoy them. Something about Burberry Touch that is somewhat

reviewText:
My nose is hypersensitive when it comes to colognes and perfumes.  If someone bathes in that stuff it gives me an instant headache.  Also, I can't wear colognes around my wildlife so as not to spook them.  I do, however, like a classy, light-on-  the scent hint of scent.

This Eau de Toilette hits a home run on all counts.  It is not sweet.  It does not give me a headache.  It has a pleasant, fresh scent that strikes me as a mix of wood bark and dainty flower.

My husband judges a cologne by how long the fragrance remains detectable for his nose.  I just sneaked in the bedroom and sniffed his wrists without waking him up.  It's there, whisper light and pleasant.  I could sniff on this all night...

But the deciding vote lay with my husband, and with the simplicity of a guy he declared that he likes this.

Oh goodie, I am married to the best smelling man in town!

Very highly recommended!

Burberry Touch for Men is an impressive scent.  It is quite different than many of the colognes that I have smelled before.  It is very light and not as musky as many men's scents seem to be.  It smells very clean, almost like a soap.  I like that it is light and subtle and kind of sneaks up on you.  There is also a slight sweetness to it, it is definitely a lot less earthy and woodsy than most scents for men.  The box comes in the classic Burberry plaid pattern and presents well; it would make a great gift.  I definitely enjoy this scent.

A simple and elegant design makes the BURBERRY TOUCH for men an attractive perfume. The fragrance matches its simplicity, yet, has a gentle transcendence in its aromatic sophistication that makes you a distinguished, yet humbled gentleman. The price is on par with most department store colognes and will not squeeze your wallet much knowing that the bottle will last you well enough through the winter - even on a daily basis. Your woman will certainly be pleasantly surprised if you lightly spray yourself in this while your business co-workers will wonder what  confidence you are wearing today.

I pretty much go with any scent my wife gives me.  She uses Burberry Touch for Women, and used to have Burberry Baby Touch as well.
She loves this scent.  It does not have an overwhelming aroma, which I like.  I would prefer to use this during fall/winter months, I think it is better fitted for cooler weather.
Overall, a great scent that lasts all day.  This smaller bottle is a good size for travel.

My husband doesn't wear cologne except on the very rare occasion, and then generally not very much of it. When he does wear it, I tend to like the scent on him while we're in the house, but as soon as we get into the enclosed space of the car, it becomes overwhelming and gives me a headache. I don't know if it's because he generally uses a cheaper product or because of the particular scent of this cologne, but I've found that I'm not bothered by the Burberry Eau de Toilette at all.

The scent reminds me of the spicy notes in Polo (or even Old Spice), but without being overwhelming or stinking. As with any scent, body chemistry plays a big role in how the scent works on people, and I find that I really like how this scent interacts with my husbands body chemistry. It's clean, spicy, and kinda sexy, too.
summary: A bit of spice, but not overwhelming

reviewText:
The manufacturers use a lot of fancy language to describe all the layers of this scent. For me it all adds up to a delightful complexity including sweet and spicy, powerful but not overwhelming. I love the way it smells on a man, so guys, this is the one to spritz on for those special occasions. It doesn't take much to get the effect, so you can make this bottle last a long time.

As a woman, I'm not generally fond of a lot of popular men's colognes and aftershaves. Some of them are too potent and make me sneeze, and a lot of them just smell to me like overwhelming men's deodorant you would put on after a trip to the gym. This classic Burberry scent strikes just the right note, noticeable yet subtle. Definitely worth the price if you're looking for a more sophisticated men's fragrance.

Burberry's cologne for men is a classic, masculine aroma that exudes several qualities at once. First aroma impressions bring to mind a sense of confidence, a degree of warmth and layers of complexity. The base woodsy notes of Cedar and Sandalwood are the first elements to reveal itself followed by citrus/lavender and finishes out with a lingering glow of Amber. It's really a classy, timeless scent that complements equally well whether suited up to impress or in casual attire of chinos and a polo for a leisurely afternoon of rest and relaxation.

Note: Keep your spritzes light as the fragrance comes on strong, particularly during the first 30 minutes of application. A couple of hours later and that initial spray becomes a pleasant, lingering accent note to accompany you through the remainder of your day and/or night.

I'm super picky about what colognes my husband wears. Most give me headaches or trigger my allergies. This one smells wonderful to me. It's not too strong, and it doesn't bother me.

My husband likes it, too, but said it smells a little more on the perfume side than the other colognes he wears.

Overall, two thumbs up from both husband and wife!
summary: Not too strong, but smells wonderful

reviewText:
I have never liked mens perfumes, except on my grandfather.  He always had a combination of spice and hair wax that was just the most wonderful scent in the world.  This reminds me of him.  I don't know what it is exactly, but everywhere I spray it, I have that memory.

For everyone else, I like a nice uncomplicated smell.  Fresh, clean, just out from the shower, is the perfect scent.  Then they always mess it up by getting all sweaty  nice, sometimes, but mostly, not.

It is hard to convince a teenager he should not smell like a womens magazine, especially when all his friends seems to be dipping their heads in one.

I showed him how I put scent on and invited him to try it.  I send a tiny spritz in the air in front of me and let it dissipate a little and then step into it. He didn't like that, not at all.  Apparently he prefers to spray it all over himself so he, too, can announce himself, five minutes before he walks into a room.
This scent smells so wonderful on a man. My significant other loves this. It has a nice woodsy warm smell , not too overpowering or strong. A little goes a long way and most of all lasts all day.
summary: A woman loves a man who smells good!

reviewText:
On first spritz, I detected some Sandalwood smell, thereafter the smell was fresh but not overpowering. Lasted for maybe about the first half of the day then its just some light overtones of the smell.

One of my favorite cologne after BOSS elements aqua and cK Eternity.

I've long been a fan of Burberry products and this product doesn't disappoint. The best thing that I like about Burberry products is that it doesn't take much to give you a scent that lasts throughout the day - my husband uses two spritzes and when he comes home, he still smells wonderful. The description of this says: "The scent features bright top notes of bergamot, combined with the summer scents of lavender and mint. Heart notes of moss, geranium and sandalwood add depth and vitality. Warm notes of amber, cedar wood and tonka smooth the base. " Now I don't get all these different scents when I smell this cologne, but I do get wood and vanilla that combines in such a warm and pleasant way. My husband loves this cologne, and I do too. Highly recommended.
summary: A warm scent that lasts throughout the day

reviewText: When you first spray this on it smells peppery, like a big jar of gourmet peppercorns. As it dries down I smell wood, and then it continues on to a spicy (not sweet) peppermint. The scent lasts at least 12 hours on clothes and smells like a handsome man wearing a leather coat going out to dinner on a chilly fall evening. This has passed up my long-time favorite men's cologne, Kenneth Cole Black.

This cologne smells absolutely heavenly. The fragrance is light and reminds me of a fancy men's department store. It definitely smells manly, but it's not overwhelming or too strong of a scent. I particularly like the Sandalwood in it. The fragrance seems to last for several hours. The 50 ml bottle should last for quite a while.
I love this cologne and how it smells on my husband! He has about 40 colognes, this is definitely in the top 3!

Nice refreshing smell. It is fresh but warm and not overpowering. I think it can be used all year around and especially great for summer.
I like it because it does not screams I used cologne today! Just gives nice cloud of masculine modern smell.

I vacillated between 2 and 3 stars for this review.

After reconsidering back and forth, 2 stars is the way our personal assessment of this mens Eau de Toilette goes.  We didn't like it and would not purchase it.  This fragrance was for our review for the Amazon Vine Program.

As a woman, I have enjoyed and repeated purchase of Burberry Brit for women. Every time I wear this fragrance, I am sure to get compliments.

Anticipating the same for the Burberry for men, we were excited to try this Eau De Toilette.

Our impressions:
When first spritzed it has a nice fragrancelightly assertive and crisp.  However, this scent faded quite quickly.  I kept inquiring if my husband had it on.

My husband then applied an extra spritz or two.  It again faded quickly.

I tried it myselfsame outcome.

It also seems to fade to a very light non-memorable scent.

From all I have read about personal scentsit is just that.

Chemistries are unique.  Hence, varying impressions ensue.

For us, not a winner, but for some others, it could be a wonderful.

Ha! I used my husband as my test dummy on this product and I was the sniffer. A short and light spritz on my hand told the story. The dominant scent was bergamot with a slight mix of lavender and mint. Loved the touch of mint! It was ever so slightly fragrant without being overpowering. The rest created a woodsy feel and complemented the slight fragrance. I thought it was masculine and sexy. Subtle yet still out there. Very nice.
Being forewarned that a little went a long way, my husband applied this judiciously. What can I say? He always smells nice, but this upped the ante from my point of view. This scent lasted for at least eight hours. It reminded me of the way the woods smell in early fall as in 'fresh and invigorating'. I also picked up on a touch of vanilla. Just so nice.
I'm not always crazy about scent for men or women, but this is so pleasant and subtle that it is hard to imagine this not being a great choice for any man.
summary: Clean and Warm Scent That Doesn't Overpower

reviewText:
My husband likes scent which is good, because I like it too. It's pretty potent when he first sprays it on and he only uses a single spritz. At first I thought it might be too overwhelming but after about 10 minutes it calms down to a nice level. This is definitely a manly scent, not one of those that I would borrow. The scents that I pick out the most are the woodsy, sandalwood and cedar. The lavender and mint are more subtle. Overall it has a warm and sophisticated fragrance, not one of the teen variety colognes. I think this is targeted more to the businessman or mature personality.

The bottle is elegant, very simple and understated. It comes in a wine colored box and would make a nice gift.

I wear cologne pretty much daily, unless I'm bumming around the house in a t-shirt.  My usual favorite brands are Armani for men, Escada, and Marc Jacobs.  I've not tried or smelled Burberry before.

I enjoy the scent of this product a lot.  It's light and fresh.  Masculine without being overpowering or overly musky.  Seems to have citrus and sandalwood undertones.  I think it's the sort of cologne that makes a nice impression.

As a man, nothing is more of a buzzkill than meeting a pretty lady who is wearing horrible perfume.  I once had a date with an attractive blonde who's eau de toilette actually smelled like a dirty toilet!  Well, more like Black Flag bug spray actually.  But I'd guess that an overpowering or nasty cologne can also kill it for a guy too.

That shouldn't be an issue with Burberry for Men.  I like it a lot.

Burberry is not a brand I have used in the past so I was not sure I would like this.  I own some Burberry menswear - I just didn't know they made cologne until I saw this.

The official notes say "A fresh and energetic fragrance with top notes of bergamot, lavender, fresh mint and thyme.
Heart notes of moss, geranium and sandalwood give depth and vitality to the scent. Solar notes of amber and cedar wood add a warm and woody aroma."

I agree with all of that.  Here's my take on it:

A complex, sweet, yet woodsy scent with touches of lavender, cooling mint and grassy herbs atop a base of vanilla.  This product is relatively long lasting yet not overpowering.  Having said that, a single spray/spritz is really enough.

I like the scent enough that I would purchase it again.

This is a wonderful scent that my son enjoys very much. He always gets a lot of compliments when he wears it. It's got a great woodsy scent and you can get hints of vanilla and lavender.  It goes a long way as you don't want to overuse. It smells clean and is not over powering. He says he gets more girls when he wears it. That's just what a mother who wants to marry him off wants to hear. It smells sophisticated and down to earth at the same time. Great buy.

This is a potent fragrance and a little goes a long way, which is beneficial, as you can use it very sparingly.
It has a distinct, warm spiciness that is very inviting - with wood and vanilla scents also distinguishable. Like Burberry Brit and Burberry London, I would classify these as "cold weather" fragrances. London and Brit remind me of Fall and Winter. I would say that this cologne also falls into that category.
Great scent for a mature man.

This Burberry Men's Cologne comes in a 50 ml (1.7 oz) sleek and simple bottle that fits comfortably in the hand.

The first blast of spray is sharp and bracing; reminiscent of a first sip of a martini or any kind of blast that makes one stop and think,  Whoa. This will definitely wake you up.
The scent then becomes subtle, soft and clean; almost like background music. You know its there but it doesn't call attention to itself.
I think professional men would be comfortable with this slightly indefinable (to me) clean and woodsy scent.

This Burberry for Men Eau de Toilette isn't overpowering at all.  There's a subtle scent, slightly woodsy and citrusy.  It's refreshing and seems like it would work well both for summer when scents are strong and in the winter when a subtle scent is preferred.

Though it's a scent for men, I like it enough that I'd be willing to wear it once in a while, too.

This is an excellent Hair removal laser, it works as expected. You should first and foremost make sure this will work for your hair color and skin tone. The photo of the box at Amazon is not terribly useful, just google search and go to their website and check out the more detailed chart tool on triabeauty.com . Once you determine it's going to work for you, you should follow the instructions carefully and follow the schedule. My wife is Indian, with brown skin and dark brown-black hair, and it worked properly. At high settings, we would not call it painful, but depends on your tolerance level and the area you are using it at. You can always choose a lower setting and do the treatment a while longer. The hair does diminish and results are begun to be seen even in as little as 4 weeks. Quite handy to have, less expensive than going to laser treatment at dermatologists, more long lasting results than waxing or shaving. The device is high end and is worth the price.
summary: This is an excellent Hair removal laser

reviewText:
I went through a couple years of very expensive laser hair removal. It was marginally effective. I thought this might be a good touch up/improvement solution. Given the feeling and the process, I'm doubtful.

Pros:
- Easy to use and understand. I figured it out in just a few minutes.
- It's not very painful. This is also a con. The industrial laser they used at the clinic hurt a ton. It was kind of effective. It was a lot more powerful. See where I'm going here?

Cons:
- Haven't noticed any difference. It has only been a treatment, but there's no impact. Given how little it hurts compared to the commercial version, I'm doubtful of its efficacy.
summary: It's an adequate product. Doubtful about long-term impact.

reviewText: I do believe after a few month my hair has lessened and gotten thinner.

I got the Tria Beauty Hair Remover Laser 4X for my wife, since I have no unwanted hair. Here are her observations after the first use:
"The directions are lengthy and very thorough. Sometimes a little repetitive, but its really important to read all of it to prevent injury. There were several things I didn't know, such as, its unsafe for ears, eyebrows, nipples or genitals. Directions say you can do the bikini area, but that must mean high on your thighs. I am disappointed about the eyebrows.
"But my daughter and I found it quite easy to use on our upper lips and chins and expect good results, as we are fair skinned with dark hair. We will update this post as we continue the three-month treatment period. Men cant use it on their beard and mustache areas because their hair is too dense. (I know that from reading the booklet.) But womens facial hair is fair game. Not on moles or areas with dark pigment, though.
"Using the machine was quicker than reading about it. Operation is intuitive. The device beeps to let you know when to move it. And it was relatively pain free. You get to choose the level of intensity and control the pain. The directions say it may feel like a rubber band snap, which I was not keen to feel on my upper lip. We didn't experience that, but we did both experience a little bit of heat here and there. You can always decrease the intensity level. The instructions tell you how to start low and work your way up to avoid pain.
"It won't work for white, red or blonde hair. And it may burn people with dark skin. If you have dark skin, research carefully before you buy. The machine won't unlock until you let it check your skin tone to determine if you can use it safely.
"Instructions say the battery may run down with use, but we did two upper lips, necks and chins without disruption. There is a fast-charge mode if you do run out in the middle of a job.
"The packaging looks like a spa in a box."
Obviously, this device is not for everyone because of limitations imposed by hair and skin color and hair density and the dangers of using a laser around the eyes. These are things you need to be aware of before spending a substantial amount of money on a hair removal laser device.
summary: Make sure you're in the proper hair and skin color range before ordering

reviewText: OK--not as good as professional salons but great to have in between sessions. I was hoping for this to be my new "go to" instead of the salon however I found that unless I use it religiously I have to constantly do it. What is great about it is that the hair grows back much thinner and finer than before. The downside is that it is relatively painful and the diameter is quite small so it takes a long time to have done. However I would much rather do this in my own home than have someone else do it. I would recommend this product as a touch up product after having the salon treatment done a few times. Then I think it would work great. But to use it to remove all of your unwanted hair will take quite a while. I found that if I slacked at all, the hairs would just grow back to their normal texture/amount so you really have to use it often for it to work.
summary: OK but Salon is Better Honestly

reviewText:
I bought this off of  the shopping channel - and I am returning it - I'm not sure if it works or not because I have only done my body once - but it is very painful on just a 3  and they say at 3 it isn't very effective. - it feels like someone is burning you with a cigarette lighter - an epilator is much less painful - also after much more research I've decided that I would rather try the flash n go - so I ordered it instead - mostly because this is only good for so long and then it dies and also the amount of surface area that it does at one time is too small - the pain would be more tolerable if you could at least get finished faster. after doing a lot of research and watching lots of youtube videos it seems that people are having better results with the IPL technology and have also heard that it isn't as painful - so guess we will see.

Update 8-19-14
well I was getting ready to return this - and I had previously done my chin and face - I was putting on my makeup and went to tweeze a few chin hairs and noticed they were just falling out! and I had much less than normal - so I was pretty exited and thought maybe I was being to hasty after all I have 90 days to return it - I was going to go ahead and finish using it on my legs - but then I noticed that where I had started using it before on my legs I have little white dots like little scars all over my legs where I used this machine - only on a 3! I have contacted customer service to see if this is normal or if it will go away.  in the meantime yesterday my flash and go arrived - I tried just a few flashes just to see how it compared - and turned up on 5 it was not anywhere near as intense of pain as the tria on 3 - however with it - it seems like it takes forever in-between flashes where as the tria is much faster.  after 1 use of the tria I am seeing some results ( nothing spectacular but enough to see that it is doing something) but I am not willing to get all scared up over it  so I am boxing the tria up and returning it and will try out the flash and go and will write a review on it at a later date.

This is a beautiful make-up bag.  Unfortunately, the leather is so delicate and soft, it will be damaged and dirty in no time. The size is a little odd for me. I think the bag is better suited for an evening clutch, or afternoon wedding bag than a make-up bag. The bag is  very thin, and won't hold more than your phone and a lipstick, so pack light.  I can't imagine trying to squeeze my make-up in this bag. This is a beautiful luxury item, for someone who has nothing better to spend $65.00 on than a make-up bag.  Ooh La La!

I have auburn hair, and I have a suntanned face but this was too dark for me.  It went on well, not splotchy, and it glided on easily and was much lighter after I read that I should be tapping the brush to remove excess before applying to my face.  Now I really want to find a color that matches my skin tone.  This is just a tiny bit too dark.

Doesn't come with a brush.  I noticed Jouer brushes are really expensive but I found this one which has great reviews and much less expensive here at Amazon.  http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B007O7AZBG/ref=gno_cart_title_2?ie=UTF8&psc=1&smid=ATVPDKIKX0DER

Took me a few seconds to figure out how to open the compact.  Also the case is made so that you can clip to another compact which makes a bigger compact and a bigger mirror.

I love the Jouer Mattifying Powder Bronzer. I always enjoy a good bronzer and this one is just the right color to give me a natural looking warmth to my complexion. It comes in a convenient size to keep in my purse. The extra plus is the matte look to get rid of shine on my face. Quality product with great results for me. Highly recommended.

This is a very nice bronzer for anyone who has a light complexion.  My skin tone is very pale in the winter and this bronzing powder works great to contour and add color to my face.  I really have been more and more interested in cream bronzers, but this is a nice powder option.  I find that cream bronzers look better on my skin as I have aged over the years.  powder bronzers look great on younger skin.  Nice compact with mirror.

since i do not  wear the make-up in the family. i gave this to the wife  to try. she used it and advised that this has a good color and applies very easy and the color  lasted all day for her.  she said that she liked this product.

Jouer Mattifying Powder Bronzer is a wonderful easy wonderful quality bronzer you almost get addicted to. Its sleek, soft, and packaged well for running around with. I love this product. I even use this instead of face powder at times to just hit the main spots that need a bit of healthy glow and simply keep going.

Pretty case but no brush or applicator included.  The bronzer goes on smoothly and gave my skin a healthy, natural glow.  I cant speak to whether it helps hydrate the skin since I use other products for that but it didn't leave my skin feeling dry so thats a plus!  It did help decrease the shiny spots which seems to occur more often as I get older.  Overall, a good product, just wish it came with a brush tucked into the case.

I really loved that this Jouer bronzer had a matte finish (at 61, I dislike shimmery bronzers). In addition to having a matte finish, this bronzer claims to mattify the skin.  Since I only used it for contouring (the color of the product was not something I would want to use as an all-over bronzer), I can't say for sure whether it does or doesn't mattify. I certainly didn't find its mattifying effects noticeable. Then again, where I apply contour is not usually where I'd have shine.

I'm not sure whether Jouer's bronzer comes in more than one color, but the one I am reviewing is called Sunswept. It is unlike any other bronzer color I own. In the compact, it appears almost an brownish terra cotta shade. On my skin, which was light toned for most of the time I tested this product, it was just dark enough to be seen as contour. Once I have more sun, I doubt it will even be noticeable on me. The color of the bronzer on my skin is almost peachy with orange undertones. To orangey for my taste.

I like that the bronzer compact is small and slim, while still including a fair-sized mirror and a good amount of product. However, opening the compact for the first time is like a bit like solving a puzzle. It's an odd little case that I later realized was designed to attach to other Jouer products to make a palette/collection. The method for opening the compact is not intuitive.

I feel that the $28 price tag is too high for this product, and that is coming from someone who regularly buys high-end makeup and skin care products. I am happier using my matte Revlon Photoready Bronzing Kit, which costs under 6 bucks here on Amazon. Compared to many higher-end products I've used, I didn't find the texture of this Jouer bronzer all that impressive.

Finally, this bronzer does not come with a brush. I didn't find this all that unusual, since other brands of higher-end makeup I buy don't often come with a brush either. I have my own brushes, so this was not a problem for me.

I took off 2 stars for the high price, the too-close-to-orange shade and its case being unnecessarily complicated to open/use.

3 stars
summary: Kind of a strange color for a bronzer, but I love that it is matte!

reviewText: The tint on this was a little dark for my wife's complexion, but she did say she liked the application.  When I asked her to describe it a little better she said "it's fine".  Not a woman of many words clearly.

This goes on light and smooth. I was worried about whether this would provide even coverage and it does.  It is the first time I am using a powder bronzer.  I think I still prefer the cream-type bronzers but I was pleasantly surprised with how easy to use this one is.
The texture and feel are fantastic! It being matte is every better, but it's far too orange. If you use fake tanner this will work for you. Otherwise someone as fair as me and this just looks silly.

I recently tried several Jouer products after seeing a number of beauty vloggers talking about the brand. The other products didn't work for me, so I wasn't expecting this to be great, but it was!  The color is perfect on my fair skin, but the formula is so nice and buttery that I could see it working equally well for darker complexions if you use a bit more.

It has no shimmer, so it's great for contouring.  I used my EcoTools Skin Perfecting Brush and it picked up the perfect amount of product with one tap.  It was super easy to blend and it lasted all day even in scary Arizona temperatures.

The only thing I didn't love was the packaging.  It's designed to snap together with other Jourer items (blush, eyeshadow etc.) which i can see being very convenient. However, if you aren't snapping it together, the edges look a bit weird and the lid is a bit awkward to open.
summary: Beautiful formulation that looks perfect on fair skin and lasts all day

reviewText:
This bronzer gives your cheeks the delicate colour you might get if you had been out in the sun for a while. While I do not have pale skin, it is not even slightly dark, so this colour worked well.

The case can be a bit of a puzzle to open, mainly because it has grooves that it can allow it to be snapped together with others of the same brand. It has a nice mirror, but no brush which would make it hard to carry with you in a purse. For the higher price tag that it has one might think it would contain at least a small brush for travel or carrying.

Just for full disclosure....Part of the promotion for this is that it has the properties of gingko biloba leaf extract and aloe vera to hydrate the skin while mattifying properties keep it from shining and also vitamins A and E to improve the skin of all types. However there are at least 10 ingredients listed before the gingko and aloe including petrolatum, which the Environmental Working Group, a U.S. non-profit organization that does environmental and safety studies, says has a "moderate hazard" safety rating, and that cosmetics that use petrolatum need more study for safety.

At first I thought this was too dark for me, but then I realized you need to use a light touch and a kabuki brush (I recommend e.l.f. Studio kabuki face brush, which can be found here on Amazon). Once I used my kabuki brush and used the bronzer sparingly, I realized it gave me a lovely healthy glow. I brushed the powder lightly over my cheek bones, chin, nose and forehead. It can also be used on shoulders, neck and colorbone when wearing summer clothing. It sort of reminds me of the glow I would get from Indian Earth back in the 80's when I was just a kid. The case is kind of weird because it's meant to be attached to a kit and it doesn't come with a brush, but the powder is smooth and silky, so I don't have any complaints over the lack of brush. The kabuki brush I recommended is inexpensive ($6) so it's not a big investment. This powder will be great for summer. It sure beats wrinkles and skin cancer. And I don't look ompa-lompa orange.
summary: Nice, Healthy Color Without Wrinkles and Skin Cancer

reviewText: She needed green nail polish and thought she might like the color.  I bought it. she got it, and i'm surprised but uses it all the time.. She loves the color and I may have to buy another now.  Totally worth it to see the expression on her face.
summary: she had a great big smile

reviewText: What a fun and unique bright pink. This color is thinner then the darker Essie colors making it a lot smoother and easier to paint. reviewText:
First off, I love the color.  I don't have anything like this and I used it immediately upon receiving it (it was June's High Shine Club selection for me).

I did have to use 3-4 coats to really get it to be opaque, but light colors are often like that for me.  I think I am going to try it in the future over an opaque white polish; it should look great that way.  It was a good texture when wet (not too thin or too thick) and was easy to apply and I like the brush.  The finish on my nails is super smooth.

However, I did get chips on a couple of fingernails within 24 hours.  I had tried to be careful, and my nails aren't that long, so this was a little disappointing.  I touched up with new polish in the chipped areas and it's hard to tell I did any touch up unless you get really close.  So, I think my manicure will still last for a few days, though I expect to have to do more touch-ups now.  (I did peel a whole bunch of oranges and the polish didn't get messed up, so that was nice.)

I used a Seche Vite quick-dry topcoat with this.  I do have an Essie topcoat and I may try that next time to see if staying within one brand results in increased performance.  Overall, however, I'm pretty happy with this.
I was looking a finish like this for a long time. It's just what I want!!! Little bit pink and transparent.

I actually came across this sort of accidentally. See, I was removing some dark red nail polish from my fingernails, and it left behind this really awesome pinkish hue. No, I did not use a base coat, and yes, I do realize the pinkish hue was a stain. But this got me thinking...I would pay for this look. I had no idea if I could replicate it, and it was a little uneven so I thought, "Wouldn't it be great if there was a nail polish that could give me the same effect?!" Turns out, there is. It's Essie's Pink Glove Service. I ordered it a couple days ago, received it today, and put it on. My nails are adorable. They look so natural and feminine! I would recommend this to anyone looking for a classic, elegant look for their natural nails. :)
summary: Love it, love it, and love it.

I'm forever in search of the perfect blue. This is getting there color-wise, but the formula leaves a lot to be desired. It's thin and streaky, very sheer. I wore it over white and it looks kind of terrible. I'll be changing my polish asap.

I saw this color at the salon and knew I had to have it.  I got a pedicure with it at the salon, and when I applied it on my hands it came out a bit brighter, but I actually like it better like that.  I used two coats and it looks exactly like the color in the bottle.
This is a great light almost nude color. I received this polish very quickly. Great fall color. Love Essie polish.
Too many coats have to be applied to get the color. I was disappointed when I had to keep reappling. Polish is very thin.
Love this nail polish. I have worn it more times than not already and it is my go to color of the summer.
Really love how bright the color is. Already have the whole Neon collection but wanted a 2nd of this shade.
Color is beautiful and as stated in description.  I have been looking for this type of blue polish for the longest time.  The polish goes on smoothly.  Great quality!
Great summer color.  New nail polish dries so much better.  Very happy with color. It was a risk online.  I love all things hot pink and this is true to family.  Yipppee
The texture of the nail Polish is off compared to other essie polishes that I have. It makes me wonder if it is not real? Other than that the color is nice.
Long wearing and easy to apply formula.  Love the Essie line.  Was not able to find in the local store.  Fast shipping and brand new bottle
Long wearing and easy to apply formula.  Love the Essie line.  Was not able to find in the local store.  Fast shipping and brand new bottle.

This is a great summer polish for toes and fingers, but I mostly wear it on my toes...it's a great shade of pink that doesn't clash with anything else you might be wearing and Essie pretty much won't chip (at least on your toes) for at least a week.  Great great color!
Love the color.  Very summerish. It's a great polish.  And the price was great. Less money than I have seen it at any store  The quality is great too. They use it at all the nail salons
Beautiful sheer gold color. Applies smoothly. Opalescent, I love it! The name is also fitting for the color. Very pretty.
I have had nothing but problems with this polish. It's streaky no matter how many coats or how much Seche top coat I use. It's super pretty and makes me sad that the formula is so crappy.
