reviewText: I love Essie because of it's staying power. It lasts for more than one week and this color was rockin'. I received many compliments on the color.
a cream color very pretty magenta purple pink not super bright just right. Would recommend for others to purchase for nice summer or all seasons color.
It's a pretty color if you have the time and patience to apply 3-4 coats. Even after 3 coats you could still see my nail line.

I LOVE the color of Too Taboo but unlike most of the Essie nail polish colors I have tried so far this color started to chip rather quickly. I put on two coats as it does streak a little when applying the first coat, and also Essie's top coat. Within 2 days I noticed one nail was starting to chip and in 3 days another one. I can usually wear most Essie nail polish colors for at least 7 to 9 days with a base and top coat and I put my hands through a lot. The color pictured is not as pink. It is a deeper pinkish color, not quite a plum though. I would wear it for a special occasion but not for the week. It is fun but not one of my favorites because it chips so easily.
This is pretty. It wasn't the hot pink I expected because it has a hint of orange in it. But I am very fair.
I love this color. Essie is always a hit or miss for me. This is definitely a hit! Plus i love the name!

A friend and I saw this polish on Pinterest but couldn't find it anywhere.  We were so happy to see it on Amazon.  It is an awesome neutral color for any time during the year, as well as any occasion.  You can top with a touch of sparkle for a fancier event!
great polish and received a lot sooner than estimated, very satisfied!
I thought the color would be more on the pink side, but it had a slight orange undertone at least on me which was not flattering at all.
summary: A little on the orange side

reviewText: I don't know why Essie stopped selling this in drugstores, but I absolutely love this color.  Seller was prompt. Great great wedding nail color.

The color looks just as good on as it does in the bottle (if you use a super shiny topcoat), but the formula is pretty awful. It went on super gloopy and dried extremely fast making it hard to work with. And despite my buffer, base coat, and Seche Vite top coat, the polish chipped the next day. It reminds me of Butler Please... gorgeous color, but don't expect it to last more than one day on your nails.
pretty color
I love love love this color. No matter what season, it always looks great and I get compliments on it.
I love Essie nail polish and this will be a favorite of mine.  It looks like turquoise and that is my favorite color.
I had not used Essie polish before but am satisfied with my purchase. Love this color. Neutral but with color.
I love nail polish (what girl doesn't) and this pretty, girly color stays on fabulously. I'll definitely be ordering more in other colors.

Love this rich color, that's good to go in one or two coats! It is a cool-toned magenta, but it is hard to see in the picture that there is also a very fine silver glitter.  Very subtle but very beautiful! I find I can really pull this color off any time of year.
summary: Beautiful cool-toned color for any time of year!

reviewText: This is the perfect pink and I really love it.  Order and I don't think you will be disappointed at all.

LOVED this nail polish! Such a pretty purple/grey color. Not shimmery at all and looks awesome on my nails. Is not too thin and streaky but is not too thick either. I love Essie colors, especially purple and will continue buying them!

I like wearing neutral color on my nails and I usually love Essie.  I went with this color to get some subtle glitter.  I was disappointed with the product.  It goes on with lots of streaks.  It needs at least 3 coats to get the right coverage and the nice milky pink finish.  I stay away from 3 coats for nail polish because it doesn't last as long.  The good thing about this color is that it wears well meaning that chipped color doesn't show.  I wore it for almost a week, so that's good.  I doubt that I would have been able to do it with 3 coats, but I will experiment.  It is a good color for the office, but I still wish that it was less "watery".
summary: It lasts, but it is very streaky when it goes on

reviewText: I ordered one color and they sent me a different one. Luckily I liked the color they sent me but it just wasn't the one I ordered. It came on time thought

I'm in love with this polish! Its the perfect neon pink for summer and looks super hot with my tan! People keep commenting on how much they love the color and want to know brand and color. This could possibly be my new fav!
summary: This is the perfect neon pink for Summer!

reviewText: Great color and product. Essie is a great nail polish! This color was difficult to find at my local stores. So glad I found it on Amazon.
I loooove the color of this nail polish - it matchs exactly what I wanted it to match. the only downside is that it chips fairly easily without topcoat, so that is necessary.

I'm not a connoisseur of different brands, but when I did an online search, Essie and OPI came up as as some of the better brands. I chose Essie because of the colors that so many of the other reviews where raving about. However, I liked the color of this nail polish better on the screen than on my nails. But the color is objective, it probably just doesn't go with my skin tone. The quality seems good - I had to put on about 3 thin coats to get a solid color, and if you dry them well in between, it will stay on for at least 5 or 6 days.
Im use to Essie polishes being of better quality. I had to put on 3 coats to get an accurate color pay off.
essie is by far my favorite nail polish! I needed a good green color. While yes, I do like this color, it is not as thick as I would like.
I love Essie nail polish. It is easy to apply. Goes on smoothly. Color is beautiful! Long lasting. Will buy more Essie nail polish.

Bottle services goes on matte so if you like that shine which i do I had to use a high gloss top coat. I also had to layer up to get the desired coverage I wanted. I would describe the color as Barbie Pink and I love it.
This is not the real thing. It's fake and a horrible one at that. If I could put zero stars I would. So disappointed.

I don't know what colors the other reviewers are talking about but I bought Green, Shake your $$ Maker.  The color looks awesome in the bottle, but when you paint it on your nails it is a very translucent green.  As one reviewer said, it looks watery.  After three coats it still doesn't look right.  I always use a clear top coat and that doesn't help it from looking terribly matte as well.  Just beware, maybe other shades fare better.

I'm a huge Essie fan and it saddens me because this looks like such a great color and they currently do not offer anything close to it.  I have discontinued colors that are similar but don't have the punch that this one has.

This color was a lot of fun. Very neon. I used about 3 coats and it is so nice
.I got a lot of compliments on it.
I love Essie for the quality and colors and I love that Amazon often has a good price.  Pleased with my polish.
I love this color. Wore through recent holidays and it was just great. Many compliments. Thank you so very much.

I really loved the color, and that's why I gave it one star. After I put the polish on, it was bubbly, it was very thick to put on, like polish does when it gets older, really disappointed since this was my first Essie polish purchase.
This was part of a nail polish gift package for my sister and she loved it. Great color! Excellent service too--very fast shipping and appropriate packaging.
2 coats and a topcoat and still it chipped.  Thought at this price it would be better quality polish but no!

The color is a beautiful dark pink berry color, not a dark color but for pinks, considered dark. The formula is great and super easy to work with and very shiny. I can decide if this polish is a creme or jelly so ill go with crelly.
I was surprised to receive RED nailpolish. This picture is deceiving. I was expecting a pink color. It shipped fast but the color in the picture is not accurate.
This Essie is a really cool color and looks better on the nails and has cool white sparkles in it
Love this color. It just might be my new summer color. It has just enough sparkle with a beautiful pale pink.

Essie's The Lace Is On is a beautiful color and has become one of my favorites. Nice cross between purple and magenta with some shimmer (but not glitter) that adds depth to it. Sophisticated color suitable for all ages.
summary: Gorgeous color: The Lace Is On

reviewText: I am not a fan of this polish.  It has a relatively dull finish and take 3-4 coats to effectively coat the nail.  I would not recommend that other people purchase this polish.
The color is really beautiful, it lasts a lot, doesnt fade. I always buy this nail polish and have never had any concerns about it.
The color is nice and stays on a long time unlike other polishes I have tried. Would definitely buy this again.
Nice color my wife likes how easy it went on.  Not too bright not too plain.  A cool natural tone for every day.

Very pretty. Good quality polish that is easy to use. Looks as pretty as a french mani. Highly recommended if you are in a hurry or don't want to pay for a salon white tip mani. Skip the tips and use this .
This polish is watery. Way more so then the other colors. maybe its a fake i don't know. I should have bought in store
a true fushia which is really hard to find.  Very nice formular coverage is good and the color is WOW!
This is my favorite Essie polish in the orange family.  It is perfect for fingers and toes in the summer.  Stays on well too.

I bought this for my sister who loves nail polish.  It arrived very quickly and she was so happy with the color.  She gets compliments on it all the time, and like other Essie polishes, it doesn't chip easily.
Made a great gift for a friends birthday! The color is beautiful! I would highly reccommend this product to anyone.
It was a gift to my girlfriend and she loves it. She wears it all the time. She loves the color and it stays on for a while
I love this nail polish color so much!! The color in the bottle doesn't do it justice. It's gorgeous on the nails!!
Pretty color . Great for summer on toes. I love Essie polish. It wears well and a long time.
Nice vibrant color! A beautfully deep blue. I love the quality of Essie and how long it lasts. Worth ever penny!!
Great nailpolish but I thought it was going to be more lavender.  Its more gray than anything but still a pretty shade.
Love love love this color! Perfect mix of purple and pink for a new fall color. Dries just a touch darker then the bottle shows, in my opinion. Perfect.

I saw this color and it looked beautiful, a very orange coral type color!!! But once you put it on it's like matte.... In a bad way ! It doesn't have the shine and beauty as other Essie nail polish have!! Very dissapointed
summary: Don't buy, cute color but ughh

reviewText: Love the color and the quality of Essie.  Dark blue/navy is pretty in as a color this year so I plan on wearing this polish a lot.

Got a lot of compliments.  Polish is naturally chip resistant.  Good brand of polish, OPI is my other fav, this is the first time I tried Essie.  Now I am open to Essie as well as OPI.  (tip----learned from my manicurist that the Essie sold in drug stores with white lettering on the bottle is NOT the real Essie- beware.)
Picked this out at the nail salon today. Wanted a pink that was pale but not too pail to wash out my hands. Love it! Perfect Pail pink color with a tiny bit of sparkle.

The picture shows it kind of pinkish, at least on my screen. I knew it wouldn't be the exact color pictured; all products differ at least slightly from the picture. But it's really a pale brown color instead of anything even along the pink spectrum. I'll still wear it, but I was really hoping for a neutral pink color, and instead I got a brown that won't match much of what I wear. I'm rather upset that it isn't what I expected, and I really don't much like the color.

reviewText: So bright. It did last. Everyone gave me compliments on the color. I'll be wearing it next spring and summer again!
Perfect for fall!  It's a nice grey with just a little bit of shimmer in it.  I liked it so much, I bought one for a friend too.
This is the perfect medium brown color for fall. Very polished look, and a great change from the normal bright colors.

my granddaughter has been asking for these nail polish the day after I ordered them she loves the color and the nail product. they came all together and in very good condition. They came on time.
Thanks Teresa

Great color, when I bought it - I thought it was very similar to 'Jamaica Me Crazy' by Essie; but 'The Lace is On' looks very different, it is a pretty purple. 'Jamaica Me Crazy' is a bright pink shimmer (more fuchsia). Great finish and formula.
This is definitely one of my favorite colors for fall!

reviewText: I'd been dying for this color from the day I saw it on the Essie site, and for anyone who's been on there you'll know it's been sold out for months! Finally I found it on Amazon and I nearly cried. It's the most perfect pink and definitely a must have nail polish color. No matter the season, hot pink is always in style, and it's absolutely perfect for nights out! It makes me feel ten times hotter when I'm shaking it in the club and my glowing pink tipped nails catch the flashing lights. Definitely buy this color!!! You need it I swear.

Love, love, love this color!  Essie is always great!  The bottle was actually a little bigger than I expected.  I got a lot of nail polish for my money.  Will be buying Essie products again and again!
You definitely need to add more than 2 coats. Super sheer and my nail shows through. I'd resell it if I could
The color is amazing. Perfect for fall. As with most Essie brand nail polishes, you'll need to apply 2+ coats and it only looks good for a few days max. The color is awesome though.

Essie always comes out with the best colors and this was no exception.  The only thing i did not like about this nail polish is that you have to paint your nails white before you use this color or else it looks awful.
I love all of the Essie nail polishes. They go on perfectly and last for a lot longer than regular polish.
The color has a lot of brown and a slightly noticeable burgundy, a rather nice mixture for fall. I would recommend this color in place of red or brown.
Gorgeous, deep color that looks great on all skin tones. Nice consistency and great shine.  Another example of color and quality from essie brand. Great price from company, too.
it's actually the color for my wedding so i'm a bit biased, but this looks amazing and essie is a fantastic brand.
Love Essie's nail colors. This is a perfect color of red not to bright but very soft. Had a hard time finding it in stores. Thanks to a Amazon you can find anything.
I love the color, but again I am a purple girl, and Essie did not fail to deliver here either. Love!!!
This is my new signature Fall polish!! Love this color! It looks black, but in the light there is some shiny wine undertones

I really like this nail polish.  All Essie colors are amazing.  This one lasted a long time.  However, when I purchased it, I thought it was a dark pink.  It goes on a very dark red.  I love the color, but it was not what I was looking for.  If you are looking for a dark pink, don't choose this one.  If you are looking for a burgandy, I definitely recommend it!

This color is surprisingly unique. The closest thing I have to it is OPI's Let Me Entertain You, but this polish is quite a bit more purple. It's a nice brighter shade that still reads on-point for fall. Great application, passable with one coat.

This color is so pretty!!! I saw it on pinterest and had to get it! I is pretty light so I have to put on about 3 coats to get my ideal color, but I usually put on 2 coats of any color anyway just to get good coverage.

I so badly wanted to like this polish.  I am all about wearing pink in October, so I jumped all over this when Cut & Blow offered a good deal on it and its companion polish, Pink Works.  Imagine my disappointment when I tried to wear it last week.  This might be the worst formula polish I have EVER worked with.  Sheer but patchy, lots of dragging, and even after three thin, even (well, as even as I could manage), there were still unevenly-colored spots on my nails.  Such a disappointment.  If you're looking for a pretty pale pink shade - KEEP LOOKING!!
summary: Many, many better pink options out there.

reviewText: Love this colour, exactly as described. Wish I could give more stars since this was the fastest, cheapest shipping for any purchase I've made on Amazon, ever. Would definitely purchase from this seller again.
Great color if you are fond of the new green colors. Shipment fast and I am satisfied with this seller.
The color does not come out like it is pictured until you apply about 4 coats. Who's got time for that.

Loved it everything was easy thank you!! Will shop again because it was so easy to do and the producta are great. Love that it comwes right to my house so simple, thank you, I will be buying more colors again.
I wasn't sure about this color but the minute i tried it on I was in love!  The color has a bit of shimmer and its more of a pinkish coral color.
Perfect for the summer.  Looks like its very shimmery in the bottle but its actually very subtle when it's on and makes it look brighter in the sun.

This is a very nice color from Essie.  It seems to be a winter color to me and I have it on right now.  It is a very deep purple with a brown tone to it.  Almost coppery.  Essie polish is always easy to use and has very nice colors.
SOME PEOPLE HAVE COMMENTED THAT THE POLISH WAS WATERY, NOT THE CASE WITH THE ONE I GOT. I BOUGHT IT AS A BACK UP FOR MY PEDICURE IN CASE I CHIP I CAN DO A TOUCH UP WORKED JUST FINE
The color was a lot darker than I had expected. It reminds me of Sally Hasen's Brick Wall, which I already have.
summary: The color wasn't really what I expected, but still pretty.

reviewText: Fast shipping! Loved this color. I usually go for darker reds and thought I'd try something different. Absolutely love it for fall!
the finish is very matte so you definitely need a clear coat (i use sally hansen quick dry). the color is nice though
Love this color. I couldn't find it anywhere in the stores. It was sold out. You need a top coat for sure!
summary: Luv this color. Sold out everywhere.

reviewText: I ove the navy blue with just the finest hint of sparkle, not too teenage-y looking and perfect for fall!
It's nail polish.  It was unopened, it was the color I wanted, and it arrived relatively quickly.  What more can I say?
I guess I should have read the reviews before I ordered, this polish has absolutely no shine! It looks terrible, hate it!!!
I love Essie polishes. Essie products are very consistent in the quality. It goes on smoothly and dries very fast.
Maximilian Strasse is a great color that goes on smoothly.  This grayish green complements my skin tone and works with both casual and professional attire.

Love this color on!!! Great spring/summer hue, and been an addiction to pair it up with Essie's Matte About You topcoat!!! Great price, shipping time is quick, and great addition to my Essie polish collection!!!
I have been using delicacy for years and wanted to stock up. I love this color and it suits my tastes.

Saw this color featured in several magazines, and was happy to see it available here. The color is a vibrant glazed deep pinky purple that goes with so many fall and winter colors. Stunning with grays, jewel tones, and a real pop with black. I like Essie because it stays on nicely without chipping. Essie always has the perfect updated colors. This color will look great with whatever you wear this winter (The Lace is On).
  Also bought another 2013 color, Vested Interest. This is a lovely matte color, a greenish gray, that also goes great with tweeds and other fall colors. Love the slightly edgy vibe, but super wearable, and looks fabulous on short nails.
I saw this color on Pinterst and had to have it.  Much to my excitement, the bottle was much less expensive then in the store and arrived quickly.  I've worn already and it lasts on my nails great.

Ok to be clear I have to point out that the seller was great! I received the product early and it was packaged securely. The issue I have with this polish it that it NEVER DRIES. I love essie but the formula on this one is aweful. The color is gorgeous but it goes on pretty sheer so it takes 3 coats just to get to what you see in the bottle. BUT even with one coat (I tried it out just to see if it'd dry that way) it'll smudge as soon as you touch anything. The better buy would be sinful colors endless blue!! The colors are identical and the formula's great!

I loved the color.  But this entire color line by Essie chips VERY FAST.  Even with a great top coat.  Fortunately it dries fast.  But I found myself having to redo my nails almost every day with all of the colors that I bought from this line.  Making me shy away from Essie for a while...
I would do without the glitter in the polish. It was a great color and amazing for summer. Great part of the summer collection.
summary: Only one thing I could do without

reviewText: I loved this bright shade a lot so much that I bought two! I am African American but I think it will work for many skin tones... it's great!

I ordered "The More The Merrier" and I really enjoy the color. Essie quality is great about 99% of the time, so you can't really go wrong. Stays on well, for about a week.
They sent me the wrong color at first, but when I emailed them about it, they quickly fixed the mix up!
This nailpolish has a little shimmer to it.  I love this nailpolish.  I've worn it several times since I've purchased it.
Nice color for summer. Essie polish lasts a good week and a half without chipping. Would recommend Essie polish. Great deal.
Love the color!  Perfect for summer.  Just like what you buy in the store for more than half the price.
goes on nicely, I would recommend using a topcoat over it. Color doesn't fade but normal chipping happens with use

I was looking for a rich royal blue nail polish. Had seen swatches of Essie's Bouncer It's Me on the interwebs and thought this was the one! First coat was thin and very watery. Not at all what I expected. Second coat...still watery and sheer. I'm a fan of L'oreal's Miss Candy nail polishes. They're sheer and gel looking. I thought this would be something like that, but it dries matte-ish. A coating of Seche Vite improved it and gave it plenty of shine, but was still quite sheer. If you want a more opaque look, you'll definitely need at least 3-4 coats.

I honestly did not expect the polish to be so sheer (4 coats required to be opaque yet still not bright). I recommend painting your nails white then putting about 2 coats of this polish on. Thanks so much!
I love Essie Nail Polish - It's the best out their - and the prices here are fantastic!  Very happy with this purchase!

i absolutely love this color for summer! The pink has a tint of shimmer in it which looks amazing in the sunlight! I received this product a day before the expected delivery date so I am very happy =)
The color is true to the picture! I think it's a perfect color for fall, and I received the product a day before my expected delivery date! I am very pleased.

Excellent color! It literally goes well with any season! I bought it for the summer but it looks fantastic so I will be wearing this all year long. If you haven't tried the Essie brand you're completely missing out!
summary: Bright bold & all year long color

reviewText: I was never really into the expensive nail polishes like Essie. However, one day I fell in love with a color my friend was wearing. It was DJ Play that Song. So I asked her if I could borrow it. The polish went on very smooth {I always were a bottom coat}. I only had to put 2 coats on to achieve the desired color. I loved it!! I am a faithful fan of Essie now, with DJ Play that Song as my most favorite polish color. It is a slight neon purple color, however not to bold. I have it on my toes now and receive tons of compliments.
I love this color (and many of Essie's colors), but the polish gets so many bubbles as it dries that it's unusable.

Usually, my nail polish chips in 1 day... this one is long lasting, but I find that I need to shake it often (almost between each nail) or it gets clumpy, and then it dries with a dull finish.  Nothing that a little attention to detail and a clear coat can't fix.  I'm really impressed with the long lasting wear which is what bumped it up from a 3 to a 4.
summary: Long Lasting but has a dull finish

reviewText: I LOVED this nail polish, I had seen it around the blogosphere and was so excited to try it! I ordered three different essie polishes, and they arrived before scheduled time! Highly recommended seller!
I was excited to receive, but it is watered down and is not the real thing.  It came out matte and runny.  I was extremely disappointed.

this nail polish, although Essie brand, is horrible quality. I don't know if it's the manufacturer or the distributor, but it went on like paint thinner, no shine, chipped after a day, very flat. I do not recommend.
IF YOU LIKE COTTON CANDY PNK! THIS IS FOR YOU. MY FAVORITE PINK ESSIE NAIL POLISH OF ALL TIME!

It's a very pretty color, and it has smooth application.  I put 3 very thin coats on and my nails look flawless.  In sunlight, the silver shimmer is very beautiful, but still subtle.  It's a very summery feminine polish. The color looks like a shimmery less pastel version of Coral Reef by Sally Hansen.  I painted my nails with Sunday Funday last night and they haven't chipped 24 hours later.  Usually I chip polishes fast because my nails are in awful condition from school, work, guitar, and piano.  But it's held up so far with a top coat.  Definitely in my top 5 favorite polishes out of the 50-something I have.

On a side note, the polish arrived very fast, a day before the shipment stated.  The polish was properly wrapped in bubble wrap and then put into paper packaging that was encased with bubble wrap as well.
This is not really neon. You have to put 3 coats since it's sort of clear the first coat and streaky the second coat.

Went to get my nails done and chose this color.  I love it.  So many people have asked me about who made it.  I would have given it a 5 star rating but sometimes, you'll need 3 coats instead of 2 to get the true color.

This looks amazing in sunlight -- it's not quite a neon but it's definitely bright and noticeable. I love this color because I've been looking for a bright bubblegum pink, and this is perfect! The formula is typical Essie - kinda gloopy and thick - but not too bad.
The color is pretty, after 3 or 4 coats, but it is more of a dull pink.  I expected it to be brighter.  I am a pink lover, so it worked.

reviewText: It's a jelly formula which means it takes 6 coats or so to be opaque. I'm super disappointed!!!! I was so excited only to be extremely let down. Awful formula, do not buy. Even over white it just looked ugly and messy.
This color is really cute! Cute coral with shimmer on it. Originally was for me but my mother ended up taking it for herself.

Saw this nail polish color on pinterest and I searched the stores trying to find it and then I saw it on here and I was a little skeptical buying nail polish online but it came brand new and the color is a dead match!
This was not as purple as it looks here. If it were more cool toned gray I would have loved it too. This color is best on darker skin tones. It looked odd next to my fair skin.

reviewText: I loved the way that this looked in the bottle but once i placed it on my nail i hated it, it made me look like i had barney hands. I may look a little better on fairer skinned people though.

When applied, this looks horrible and watery...nothing like when purchased in a store.
I would not recommend buying these online.
Very disappointed.
it's not as bright as the picture -- it's like a neon grass green in reality --- and i can't get enough of it! it's such a unique color... a must buy for the polish obsessed!

I LOOOOVE Essie polishes - they wear great, don't chip, and have dozens and dozens of colors you can't find anywhere else -- this color is vibrant and has the TINIEST [and i mean TINY] amount of sparkle to it -- it is a great go-to color for when you can't decide at the salon -- for ALL AGES! :) I highly recommend this one, ladies :)

Shipping was fast and overall I can say nothing bad about the shipper. The product itself is horrible. The neon color applies streaky and when it dries it almost looks like candle wax, even when applying a glossy top coat. I heard that you should apply a white color nailpolish base first and then apply the color. I am going to try that. The product itself is a little hard to work with. I love the color though.
beautiful neon baby pink. perfect for those who want something bright but don't want any loud colors. Essie never disappoints.

This is one of my favorite colors from Essie. I have been looking for a pale pink nail color for awhile and Pink Glove Service is just perfect! You have to paint at least two coats before you can see an obvious difference, as it is so sheer. Perfect for a french manicure as well as just wearing by itself. I've gotten many compliments on it :)
I love Essie nail polish! It's my favorite brand and one of the brands I buy most. Love this color!
Love Essie products and love this color. Looks great and lots of fun for summer. Very bright. Would definitely recommend
DJ Play that Song is a vibrant purple/ magenta hue. It goes on fantastically & is as bright as the bottle. There is more pink in the polish than I thought from viewing online, but I love the shade.

The color is a fun, bright summer color.  Neon without being ridiculous.  However, it was very thick and not smooth.  It was difficult to put on smoothly.  It also took three coats and dries matte.  I put a top coat on so its shiny anyway. It's ok, not great.

reviewText: So I love essie and the color was rich and beautiful, though the picture is not really what it looks like in person. The color is more of a pink, then light coral. It took almost three weeks to be delivered.

reviewText: As usual Essie has another hit!  Great color for a mani/pedi for summer.  Looks great on most skin tones  Shipped quickly too.

DJ Play That Song is a semi-neon purple color with red undertones. I say semi because it's not a blazing neon. It can be worn to work. It looks just like it is pictured in the bottle - pinkish purple. I tried to take pics after applying but my camera wouldn't capture the real color. I tried in sun/shade/indoors/lights.. but didn't work. The color is really pretty to naked eye.

Saturday Disco Fever is a bright pure orange color. This is not a very blazing neon, so I am able to wear it to work. It looks fabulous in sunlight as well as indoors. I felt that this color is more suitable for evenings and parties in Summer. I was a little apprehensive at first because I personally don't like Yellow/Orange shades. But this color worked for me. It is more red-toned than yellow-toned. This dark Orange looks good on nails too.

The formula on both the polishes is great. Two coats are enough for perfect opaque polish. They dry quickly but dry matty-ish. So top coat is a must for me. I applied a base coat (OPI Base Coat), 2 coats of polish and a top coat (OPI Top Coat). They lasted more than a week on me which is rare :-).
summary: Essie DJ Play That Song and Saturday Disco Fever

reviewText: Love this fun color. I get tired of only pink and red shades. This was a great way to mix it up without the color being too young looking for this 30-something woman! :)
Just put this color on my hands and feet Luv it !!! I would recommend this color to all my friends
I can't recall when I first found this color, but I'll keep ordering it online since Essie has discontinued it.  It's the best summer time pedi color.

I love the purple color.  It's not in your face purple, but almost a little more pink and soft looking.  The one thing that I'm still on the fence about is the flat sheen.  It's not really matte and not shiny.  I haven't decided how I feel about that.

A squeezable tube for mascara so you can get every last bit. Genious! I love how easy this mascara goes on, and I'm not sure how to explain it, but it dries differently than any other mascara I've owned. Definite staying power, and it doesn't smear. Ever. Love this stuff.

reviewText: Per the wife: This is a nice eye cream, not too thin and not to heavy - just right.  It melts into your under-eye area very quickly and does not cause my mascara to bleed beneath the eye. I have been using it for three weeks now, and I don't know that I see much difference but I will continue to use it. Even though I say that I see no difference, that is actually good because ordinarily when I try new eye creams I see a worsening of the fine lines and crows feet and I don't with this. I am 56 this year, so a good under-eye cream is a must! StriVectin makes good products and I am going to stick with this.

I have been using this twice daily for 4 weeks.
Light, non greasy and absorbs well.
I do think my under eye area is smoother but no cream is a miracle
I am 52 and am starting to get crows feet.
This has softened them
I love StriVectin products because they use excellent ingredients that really work over time if you use them.  I'm very pleased with the results.
summary: Very pleased with the result. Great ingredients.

reviewText: There are so many eye and skin creams with Retinol. It is tough to decide what works and what doesn't. My experience was not as drastic of an improvement as what I was hoping for, but still an improvement to the appearance around the area around my eyes. Be sure to use this sparingly and don't make the mistake I did when applying for the first time and end up working it in for nearly an hour until it was all absorbed. I did not experience any side effects from this eye cream after 4 days of use.

As a grandmother of advanced years, I definitely need "advanced" eye cream for my aging eyes.  Strivectin is a well-known name in skin products, since its beginnings as a company that just produced a skin cream to reduce stretch marks.  Now they have branched out into any number of skincare products.

According to its description, this Advanced Retinol Eye Cream has been proven to (1) deliver benefits of retinol without skin irritation, (2) minimize fine lines and crow's feet, (3) firm and fortify the eye area, (4) nourish and hydrate, and (5) smooth and refine texture.  To make this sound even better, it has a patented NIA-114 technology to do all this.  (Yeah, I don't know what that is either.)

However, a reading of the list of ingredients, of which there are more than 50, does not inspire a lot of confidence that this is truly revolutionary.  Other than the retinol, it looks like the usual ingredients for skin creams, some of them perfectly innocuous, some of them slightly iffy.

But how does it work?  Does this grandmother have minimized fine lines, smoother and more refined skin texture, less visible signs of aging around the eyes?  Well, to be perfectly honest, I don't notice that this works any better than many less expensive eye products I've used in the past.  And, even though I only use a very small amount under each eye (maybe a dab the size of a sesame seed), it takes quite a while to be absorbed.  It feels somewhat greasy and looks somewhat shiny, and, if I put on mascara, there is sometimes smearing when the eyelashes touch the moisturized skin under my eyes.

After I have used up this sample, I won't be purchasing it again.  Considering its high price, I don't consider it effective enough.  What I really need is to get enough sleep.  That's what makes these old eyes of mine look better.  Then I just moisturize with any old inexpensive cream and I'm good to go.
summary: Doesn't seem any more effective than other eye creams I've used.

reviewText: I'm male well over 60. The StriVectin is delivering visible firming and smoothing to crow's feet at the outside edges of my eyes and the very wrinkled area below the lower eyelids.  No substitute for youth but the results have indeed shaved a few years from the appearance of the skin around my eyes.  Very pleased.  I note that this stuff is pricey.  But it's looking like this 0.5 oz. tube is going to last quite a long time even with the instructed twice daily applications.

I've only used it a few times, so I can't yet comment on its anti-aging effectiveness.  But it goes on smooth, has a light clean scent, left my eyes feeling moisturized but not oily & most importantly there was no eye irritation at all.  My nighttime ritual is long and involves multiple products so I usually do it earlier in the evening before I'm too tired, which means I'll be awake for a while with the eye cream applied. I almost always end up with some irritation from eye cream getting in my eyes or the product itself being so potent it irritates my skin.  Not the case with this eye cream.  Fingers crossed it keeps my fine lines from getting deeper, because if it does, this will be my new favorite eye cream.

I tried this for its intended purpose, around my eyes. I just could not tolerate the feeling of weight, like I was wearing a mask. I also had a bit of a burning sensation. However, I am not one to waste retinol so I have been using it as a localized treatment on my age spots. Here, the density of this cream seems to work in my advantage as it stays right where I apply it. It seems to be as effective as other retinol preparations at reducing rough areas and diminishing dark spots. Id be unlikely to buy it for this purpose due to the expense but it it is a handy, no waste source of retinol right now.
summary: Felt heavy around my eyes, using on age spots instead.

reviewText: This product smells AMAZING. Ive never been so addicted to a cake batter scent before! I love putting this in my hair because of how good it smells and of course it works! The first day I tried this product I put it on before blow drying my hair. My hair was about 60% less frizzy than when I don't use this cream or put other products on that don't work. I was amazed really. I noticed my hair was more shiny and manageable throughout the day. It also gave my hair a very healthy glow. It does work well as a detangler as well. The only downfall is the price for how quickly its used up. This bottle would last me maybe a week and a half is used daily. Buuuuut hands down, I love it!
summary: Birthday cake smell mmmm. Works amazing!

reviewText: Love

I have been using this for almost a year and I love the smell and my hair feels amazing. I usually use this product before I blow dry my hair and my hair smells amazing for a few days. It doesn't get messy and it makes my hair less frizzy too.
This product makes my hair super smooth and it smells good
Made my hair feel waxy and gooey. Will stick with It's a 10.
PERFECT TAN

This bronzer is two things: it's too dark for my light complexion and it's as orange as it can be.  I can't figure out why it has so many positive reviews.  It goes on smoothly and looks fine for the first hour, then it oxidizes and turns pumpkin orange.  The last thing I want is to look like an oompha-loompha, lol!  I bought it in San Francisco and at the time I swatched it, it didn't appear orange at all.  In fact, it was a nice bronze color that appeared perfectly matte (which it is despite the color shift) and would have been perfect.  My skin is not oily but is normal, so I can't blame the oxidation on oil.  I also use a mattifying primer under my foundation, so it shouldn't have been an issue at all.  When first applied, this bronzer looks quite nice and gave me a nice nude, sunkissed look.  However, an hour later, I was struck by the color shift and I saw that I had orangey brown areas all over my face.  If you want a decent bronzer, either keep looking or try Hoola by Benefit.  Hoola doesn't change color and will give you the nice tan color you're looking for in order to achieve a nude or sculpted look.  This product has totally turned me off to The Balm and despite good reviews for other Balm products, I think I'll pass.  I definitely don't recommend this product.
summary: Too dark and as orange as a pumpkin.

reviewText: I would compare this bronzer to NARS "Casino", except without the shimmer. Just as dark. very nice shade for olive complexions.
i love it and i bought again for my sister its very nice
thank you so much

This has a rich and silky feel that I like but Im not a big fan of the scent. It says it has a scent of Sweet Orange & Cedar Wood but I don't really get the orange or cedar. I was hoping for a strong orange scent with the mention of sweet orange and the orange packaging. The cedar could be a yay or nay for me, depending on how it comes out. This just sort of smells generic like any type of lotion but then it sort of smells a like floral to me which I dislike.
summary: Don't Like the Scent Which Doesn't Smell Like Orange or Cedar

reviewText: This body cream smells more of the cedar wood than oranges to me.  The smell is a strong smell, but I like it. I think it is more of a male scent than female so I was thinking this would be great for my son.  I did try the lotion and felt that it was smooth and did not feel sticky or that it was too much.. I like the feel of my skin after I put the lotion on.  You do not have to use a lot of it either. I just dabbed my fingers on the top and then applied to each spot.  I think it feels nice.

Ritual's Happy Budda body cream is a very appealing lotion.  The lotion comes is a large red clear plastic tub with a copper colored metal lid.  The container was a lot bigger than I was expecting, and has a generous 7.4oz of lotion inside.

The lotion itself is white and has a thick and gloopy consistency.  It reminds me of Turtle's car wax.  Thankfully, despite the heaviness it goes on very smoothly and absorbs quickly.  It leaves behind no greasy residue, just smooth and supple skin.  It has good staying power and keeps my skin feeling soft for hours.  I had no issues with allergic reactions.

The fragrance is pleasant and smells warm and sweet.  It reminds me of cinnamon.  It smells wonderful while being applied but the scent is not overbearing and either sex can use it.

All in all... a great lotion.
summary: Pleasant fragrance, nice moisturizing, and pretty packaging.

reviewText: Best eyeliner I've ever found, and will never use another again. Bear in mind that this liner is not meant to smudge to give a proper smokey look; so if that is something you want from a liner, this one may not be for you. I have small eyes and small lids that lend to guaranteed eyeliner and mascara smudging. I used to rarely wear liner for this reason, and on the infrequent occasions I did, I would spend much of my time fixing the smudges on my lower lids. This liner is not fussy, is easy to apply and remove if one reads and follows the instructions.

Aaaaah this is a great smudge proof pencil liner for those of us who are not good enough at life to use liquid liner but still want to do a little bit of a wing from time to time. I do a feline eye with this and smooth out any mistakes and rough edges with a qtip dipped in a tiny bit of moisturizer. I have to say it is a little itty bit dry going on, not a smooth pull like a gel liner, but that's for the best for me!! I need to be slowed down. I used this on NYE and wore it all night and it stayed in place.

Update though, I was just sharpening this and when I took it out of the sharpener, the top got stuck and the whole bar of pigment from inside the pencil PULLED OUT of the pencil. It's ruined. Debating buying a new one or not :(

Im giving this 4 stars.  I like it, and its a good quality pencil.  I just don't think it goes above and beyond or is really any better than the other eyeliners I have.  I just paid more for this one.  Its true, its long lasting but so are my other cheap ones.  It doesnt smudge which means when you draw that line on.....beware and be careful because theres no smudging it out for a smokey look or wiping off to correct a mistake.  I like it but its just a regular eyeliner pencil and overpriced at that.

I didn't like this eyeliner at all.
It doesn't go on smooth.  It doesn't perform the way a gel-liner does.  It seems very waxy.

this white liner works well on your water line to give you a bright eyed rested look. lasts a long time without running. try the black to if you like to use dark liner on your water line. this is the only liner i can find that doesn't end up under your eyes by 11:00.
summary: try the black to if you like to use dark liner on your water line

reviewText: This is the only eye liner pencil I can wear without getting raccoon eyes. It goes on smoothly and really does last. I have always avoided eye liner pencils as the smudge would end up in places that no smudge should go and I would always be using Kleenex throughout the day to remove the smudges in my eye corners or worse,  But this liner stays in place all day and the color is intense and doesn't fade. Wish it had been invented 20 years ago.

reviewText: finally found an eyeliner that you can put on your inner eye lid and lasts all day with that fabulous black!! worth the money.
There's barely anything in the bottle. Way overpriced.
I love this. L'Occitane products are phenomenal. Doesn't weigh hair down. LOVE the scent.
Excellent conditioner, and my hair needs it. Nice.

This stuff smells so amazing. Like childhood--a hint of cotton and so fresh! It's definitely pricey (the bottle isn't huge) but it's a nice indulgence and my hair is so dang shiny after using. Highly recommend!

I won't be using it again, not even just to finish the products off. It really is that bad.

This is my second diffuser, I had the same one for probably 7-8 years until it started to get really worn down from daily usage. I really like the prongs, they add the right amount of lift and product nice curls.

Works nice, squeals a bit on my blow dryer.
Well, this diffuser is nice quality.......but it doesn't fit on any dryer I've tried it on.
Ok product. After testing, I would rather use the Its a 10 linez
Not really sure if this is helping my hair or not. ???

I love this stuff I have wavy to curly hair and really struggle with finding stuff that helps moisturize my hair but also not make it to greasy. The fact that it protects my color is really fantastic. I use before I go out to the pool and and I use it immediately afterwards. I really helps my color from fading.

reviewText: Best for super shine & detangling.

This product is amazing.  I do a lot to my hair with color and a yearly body wave, and it's relatively long.  This stuff is light weight, detangles and makes my hair smooth and soft...and has a nice scent.  Will definitely buy again.

2nd purchase. Great for medium to thick with tangley hair. Thin hair?  Spray in hands and use sparingly. Gets my knots manageable, nice smell. Howeverrrrr, works on fuzzies when it's humid out and so ok, 20% use in summer and 70% in the winter. I really don't even care what is in it at this point. My hair feels great use after use so if there is protein it can't be too high because I can't use protein consistently. Well no one should but anyway that's my review.

reviewText: I'm not a huge fan of this. I love the shampoo and conditioner, but even though this makes my hair super soft when wet, it makes my hair feel sticky and my ends look frizzy after blow drying so it's a no go with me. And before anyone says anything, I don't pile on the hair products. Just 2 or 3 sprays and I comb it through so the texture isn't because I use too much.. It does shorten drying time quite a bit so I'll give it that. I can't comment on the color-sustaining properties because I couldn't get past the other bit to use it for more than a week, but I wouldn't be surprised if it did protect your color quite well considering how well the shampoos and conditioners preserve it on their own. Oh, and it smells lovely so that's a plus too.

reviewText: I love pureology!  This spray has done wonders for my fine hair, it's soft, no more breaks, I love it!

Prefer Pureology's Perfect for Platinum Miracle Filler over this product.

I wouldn't call it a miracle product, but it does work.  I can use quite a bit without it weighing my hair down.  Not sticky or heavy.  I've already bought several bottles.
Best blush I have ever purchased. Abbey Rose is a beautiful color to brighten up your complexion.

Nice blush. And buttery! (truly) Goes on easily, but may be a little oily for me, now sure yet. The color is a little lighter than expected, but that may make it look more natural. A nice rose, not very peachy and not too pink either.
This blush is very creamy and stays on well.  You can layer it if you need to make it darker.  This particular color, Naughty Biscuit, is flattering to my fair, warm-toned skin.

Really great natural color! A little goes a long way and the pigment concentration is high. Must work fast! I think though mixed with some moisturizer it will go on much better. I had tried it on without it. Gives your cheeks a great natural look. Does not settle into lines, which is a plus for aging skin! Will be buying more colors!

If you put 2 coats of dark dahlia and one thin coat of a red on top, this beautiful wine color comes out.  Depending on the darkness of the red, a color close to "Essie Wicked" can be achieved. summary: I don't always paint my nails, but when I do it is with CND Shellac!

reviewText: My new favorite CND Shellac polish color. Excellent coverage with beautiful color in sunlight - dark brown with a hint of dark purple and black. Gorgeous!

This a fantastic hand cream that has a great scent to it.  I happen to love strong scents in creams, shampoos, and soaps, so this product fits me perfectly.  The texture of the cream is rich and creamy, but it absorbs into my skin very well.  The only negative comment I would make is that the amount of cream you get for the price may not be worth it to many.

Antica Farmacista Hand Cream is an excellent hand cream.  It is light, not at all greasy or oily, and makes my hands feel exceptionally soft and silky.  I absolutely love the feel of it, but I do not love the scent.  Appreciation of scent is highly subjective, and for me, personally, the scent is overpoweringly floral.  I prefer much lighter scents, and I rarely wear perfume because most are too strong for me.  However, if you want a perfumed hand cream and are not bothered by heavy fragrance, the Antica Farmacista Hand Cream in Bergamot & Ocean Aria may both feel and smell divine to you.  For me, it only feels divine.
summary: Excellent Hand Cream, Heavy on Fragrance

reviewText: This hand cream goes on the hands smoothly yielding a silky,non greasy  feel.  The citrus fragrance of bergamot is combine with saltwater, jasmine and lavender to create a subtle yet pleasantly noticeable scent that will appeal to most.  The cream itself is composed of shea butter, vitamin E and skin pleasing botanicals.  At $18.00 for just two and a half ounces of product it is a little pricey but worth it for a small thoughtful gift or a practical but luxurious treat for oneself.
summary: Good Quality Hand Cream With A Lovely Fragrance

reviewText: Antica Farmacista is a fragrance company known to high end boutiques in the United States, Europe,and Asia. The Bergamot and Ocean Hand Cream I got to try is really a perfume that soften hands. The scent is strong and long lasting but not at all overpowering. You can pair it with the scented bath salts, soap, or shower wash for a layered scent. In no way would I wear my normal perfume or cologne in combination with this hand cream for at least a few hours, the scents would compete. As far as I can tell, the company does not sell a perfume in the Bergamot and Ocean scent which would solve the problem for me. The scent is lovely and soft and the cream is not at all greasy on my hands. I would recommend especially if you're interested in the other items in the collection.

Pleasant scent with lovely bergamot notes more apparent an hour or so after application.  Lotion absorbs quickly with no greasy feeling.  Sealed to maintain freshness.  Loses a star due to cost/value for small quantity.  Scent is 5 star.
summary: Pleasant scent, smallish tube of lotion

reviewText: I've purchased many many hand creams and body butters over the last 22 years. However, I have a few favorites and this hand cream just made my list as my third favorite. One of my favorite hand creams over those 22 years was and still is Camille Beckman Glycerin Hand Therapy, Glycerine Rosewater, 8 Ounce. (I only like the Camille fragrance in this cream.) However, at a local craft fair a couple of years ago I discovered the ultimate hand cream. It is actually a body butter by Cirese C. Skin Therapy (see comments section for a link to her site). I fell so in love with her body butter, which I use as a daily hand cream, that I purchased 30 jars at once. Therefore, this hand cream has difficult competition and surprisingly it is almost as good as the above with two slight differences. Antica Farmacista Hand Cream, Bergamot & Ocean Aria, 2.5 fl. oz. is as heavenly and strongly fragrant as the Camille Beckman and Cirese C. Skin Therapy products. The only differences are that this leaves my hands lightly moisturized and feeling like silk. The other two products leave my hands deeply moisturized and feeling soft. This hand cream is not as long lasting as my other two but it's perfect for the summer months. I absolutely love this hand cream and am definitely going to try the other fragrances. Since this is a light moisturizer, I would only use it in the summer months where less moisturizing is needed. I think anyone who loves a heavily fragrant, lightly moisturizing cream would love this. I know I do.
summary: Heavenly fragrant hand cream that leaves my hands silky; it is comparable to Cirese C. and Camille Beckman creams

reviewText: This is a very fancy tube of lotion! The scent does remind me of bergamot and ocean, but I'm not sure if these 2 things are smelling very good together. Comes across a bit like fruit and chemicals in my skin at least. It is very highly perfumed. It does make my skin feel softer! For the price though, personally I don't think I'd buy this because the tube is very small. For the per ounce cost, I think I'd rather buy some really nice L'Occitane lotion. Hope this helps!

As a hand cream, this is a nice product. It does not have even the slightest bit of greasiness to it, and it goes on smoothly and easily absorbs into the skin. It's a rather small tube of cream, though, so if I were to use it after every handwashing, I don't think it'd last more than a week. So the scent becomes a bigger factor to me.

Although the scent is named "Bergamot & Ocean Aria," the description on the package reads "Built on the allure of the ocean, ozonic saltwater notes blend with jasmine and lavender while crisp bergamot adds sparkle. Warm notes of oakmoss complete this lush and captivating scent."

This hand cream has a lovely scent when freshly applied; I got more jasmine and lavender than bergamot, and I thought it was quite nice. The problem is that the scent was completely gone within an hour. And I don't mean that it dissipated, I mean that there was a strong (but not overpowering) scent when I applied it, and less than an hour later, there was no scent at all. I might have said that the scent is secondary to the effects of the hand cream, except for the fact that the 2.5 ounce tube is so small that, at the price listed, I need it to be more than just a hand cream.
summary: Softens hands with a lovely scent, but it does not last very long at all

reviewText:
If you're considering ordering this hand cream, the main thing to be aware of is the scent. It's very strongly scented, but with a good quality perfume. The odor doesn't last very long, but it's pretty potent at first. It's slightly greasy, but not in a bad way--just that you might not want to hit the keyboard immediately after application. It moisturizes well. The tube is attractive.

I like it a lot, but i wouldn't use it around anyone who might be bothered by perfumes.

The good part about this handcream is it is light and greaseless.  You can do whatever you want after applying it.  The bad news is it's expensive for the amount you get and the scent is overpowering.  The scent reminded me of strong gardenias and was too strong for me.

Needless to say, if you love gardenias you may love this non greasy shea butter cream.  It's hard to find shea butter products that don't leave you feeling greasy so you may enjoy this.  It would also make a lovely gift for someone who likes heavily flowered products.
summary: Bergamot and Ocean Aria smell like Gardenias

reviewText: Antica Farmacista's Bergamot & Ocean Aria hand cream is a nice product.  Since using the hand cream, I have noticed that my hands have become incredibly soft.  With the weather quickly changing, I usually reapply lotion to my hands several times a day.  After applying Antica Farmacista's hand cream, I only reapply once at midday, because its moisturizing effects are long lasting.  I would have given this hand cream five stars, but I am not fond of the fragrance.  It is a bit strong and reminds me of an old woman's perfume.  Other than the smell, this is a great hand cream; I will definitely be adding it to my collection of daily beauty products.

I really like this product. The Antica Farmacista (what a mouthful!) hand cream has a wonderfully fresh scent, which lingers nicely, and is a non-greasy hand cream that leaves skin soft and supple. Very nice product.
summary: Fresh Scent Leaves Skin Soft and Moisturized

reviewText:
This is a  smooth and soothing hand cream with fantastic fragrance for ladies (and gentlemen) who like to keep their hand smooth and protected.

The only surprise is that the tube is smaller than I expected. It looks bigger in the picture but remember that it's a 2.5 ounce tube.

Other than that I recommend it to anyone who loves to protect their hands in the same time enjoy the luxurious scent and creamy rub.

I do really love this product and find them very handy. They aren't smelly like all of the Butter London products I have tried. The only reason I give it 4 instead of 5 stars is because in the description it says that one pad should clean ten nails. I have not found this to be true. I don't know if that is because I always use 2 coats or because I like to have my nails completely clean and maybe they are big(?), I don't know. I cant get about 8 nails done really well with one cloth. Also I have noticed that it does go further the lighter in color your polish.
I gave as a gift. Very luxe.
Removes butter London nail lacquer quickly and easily.  Normally purchase this product directly from bL, however the box purchased through Amazon was fine, too.
summary: Removes butter London nail lacquer quickly and easily. Normally purchase this product directly from bL

reviewText: Sure these work well, but at $1.00 per wipe, that's pricey for convenience. I've found a better deal: La Fresh Eco Beauty Nail Polish Remover Pads Acetone-Free, 20 Count for only $12.38 (current Amazon price). That's 0.61 cents per wipe! The La Fresh ones also don't use acetone but a oil-based remover so your nails/fingers aren't dried out afterwards. Just as effective and fast as these Butter London wipes.
summary: Found a CHEAPER version that works just as well--

reviewText: i love these for travel

After reading reviews of how wonderful these scrubs are I was expecting a little more out of them.  I actually had to use 2 of them to just get the polish off of my fingernails and we're not talking glitter or anything else heavy.
summary: After reading reviews of how wonderful these scrubs are I was expecting a little more ...

reviewText: These really do work! I love them they take half the time of everything else! I highly recommend them!!! :) I use kwik-off religiously and I am now a butter london fan!!! WOOHOO.
Does remove nail polish, but it takes about 3 or 4 sheets to do the job and get all nails clean. Does not remove glitter polish well at all. Not recommend.

I have never tried a get eyeliner before but when I got this I was so excited to try it out. This eyeliner went on smooth and I had no trouble with application. I was a little worried since I had never tried Laura Geller cosmetics before that my eyes might be irritated or an allergic reaction may occur because I have such sensitive skin. I can only wear like 2 or 3 different cosmetic brands other wise I look like I have chicken pox lol I honestly did not have any reactions skin or eye wise to this eyeliner and I was so happy about that. Then I read that this particular brand of eyeliner was ophthalmologist and dermatologist tested for sensitive skin and that made me fall in love so much more. I am happy to see cosmetic lines taking interest in the fact that most women have issues such as allergic reactions to particular ingredients in basic make ups. SO far this is my FAVORITE eye liner and my go to at the moment. I honestly am shopping for more of her cosmetics because it is so rare for me to find make up that I can enjoy. Oh another big plus to this eyeliner is that it is waterproof which means no runs or streaks if i feel a need for a cry or a swim. I manage to wear this from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m without having to reapply or even touch up my eyeliner

I'm a fan of Laura Geller-I love her personality when she's on tv or in interviews. And, like many, I love her baked blushes, highlighter and powders. Rather than sticking her name on the usual, I think she really tries to be innovative with her brand. This is no exception. It's a black, highly pigmented gel liner. If you want to smudge it, do so quickly because it will set. I tried it both ways and both lasted but once it sets, it's not budging. In addition to being a twist up liner, the bottom hides a sharpener so you can keep the tip pointy.
(Note from Captain Obvious: Eyeliners like these can go 'flat' when you apply them and, because they twist from the bottom, you're stuck with the flat top for the rest of the product. This prevents that!)
I wear contacts and line close to my lashline and it did not bother me at all. I didn't try to do a wing or anything-I tried it with a tightline, a smudge for night and a heavy look that traced the lashline. All lasted the day/night. Application was smooth and never tugged. Pigment was dark. I usually use an eyeliner pen to line but this could make me switch. My mascara rubbed off before this did. I removed it with the dual-phase Clinique eye makeup remover and had no problems. Really, the high quality and innovation I'd expect from Laura Geller.
summary: High Pigment, No Irritation Love It

reviewText:
Works very well
Lasts all day, super easy to apply and the perfect color.
Much better then the cheap ones and worth the money

This eyeliner from Laura Geller New York Blackbird INKcredibile Gel Eyeliner is the smoothest eyeliner I have ever used. I think it is because of the gel that it goes on so smoothly. Even over my not so plump 56 year old eyelids was I able to smoothly and cleanly draw my eyes. It was non- irritating and dried very quickly. I found that with a bit of practice and a sharp-edged card I could draw thick or fine lines. I am in love. I previously used Revlon Color-Stay in charcoal, but the lines with the Laura Geller are so much more flawless looking.
I have to go draw some cat's eyes now!

I see this is no longer offered by Molton Brown on their website. What a shame. Spouse and I discovered this years ago when our hotel offered it (under a different name). I thought this would endure, but apparently not. Glad that Amazon still offers it. All I can say is that the fragrance of this is unisexual and makes me feel 'real good' when I use it in my morning shower. The fragrance doesn't linger all day, but that's okay with me. I also have their Black Peppercorn, but like this one more.
summary: A bright, refreshing scent for men and women

reviewText: Got a small bottle in a hotel and loved it...so happy to find it here to use at  home!

I bought this orange and bergamot scent as well as the Ylang Ylang body wash and they are both very nice. I prefer using the orange one for a morning shower and the Ylang Ylang for an evening shower. The orange is more of a 'wake up' in the morning shower while the other is more an evening shower smell - at least for me it's a more relaxing fragrance. Both lather well on a washcloth and a little goes a long way which justifies the price of a bottle. I have only recently discovered that Amazon has even more scents to choose from and while looking at the various options available I decided to write this review as a testimony to how good Molten Brown is. I am also anxious to try their body lotion to complement the body wash. The fragrance makes the entire shower smell good but doesn't really linger on the body. Both are moisturizing for my dry skin and after using either one it feels clean and soft. In my opinion the orange could be for men as well as women while the Ylang Ylang is a more feminine smell as well as more relaxing. I would definitely recommend this product!
summary: Very nice fragrance and good for the skin!

reviewText: Im really liking this molten brown body wash. It smells great and can smell it throughout the day. My only complaint is the price. As much as I like the product, im not sure I'm willing to repurchase due to its price

Not sure what's up here but this is not smelling quite as good as I remember - I've gone a little crazy buying Molton Brown products lately and must say that this is disappointing. I remember this as having a unique smell that pleasantly lingered , now it smells like deoderant . The Assam tea -Ould wash is so much more interesting . Why is there not more care put into packaging ? These cost a fortune and there's not even a seal on it.
summary: Where is the fragrance I thought I remembered ?

reviewText:
Not much that I can say other than the Molton Brown Black Peppercorn body wash is my all-time favorite wash. I use the sport wash as well and it's awesome too. This one is my favorite though and just the smell alone is invigorating and long lasting but not over-powering by any means. I don't use a deodorant with a scent, instead just an unscented antiperspirant. I do use the Molton Brown sport antiperspirant on occasion, generally this wash leaves me clean and fresh enough without the extra need for scents or colognes which I prefer to go without anyhow (I am a light sweater which probably helps with this so you may need both if you sweat more).

My only complaint will always be that I REALLY wish the bottles were twice the size (at least) for the price. It's very expensive for a body wash when others are 4 to 6 times less expensive for at least 1.5 to 2 times as much.
summary: Expensive, Still My All Time Favorite

reviewText: I was sent pink pepperpod instead. Smelled delicious, but I would still love to try out black peppercorn.
summary: but I would still love to try out black peppercorn

reviewText: I have used other Molton products in the past and based on the price, I thought this might be great stuff. Does not lather up and there is no pleasant odor. The bottle is nice, but the contents are absolutely overpriced. If I had not bought it on Amazon, I might think the real product was replaced with a look-alike product. Pretty hard to imaging how this could cost as much as it does.

We first encountered this body wash during a stay at the Broadmoor in Colorado.  My wife fell in love with it and we were very happy to find it sold on Amazon for far less money than the Broadmoor was charging!

The smell is light and refreshing.  A bottle lasts my wife about 12 months so the cost isn't as bad as it seems.

I need a little more than just soap and shampoo in the morning.  I'm always looking for something to add a little interest to my routine and changing up shower gels is a great way to keep the morning streamlined and add a little  pre-coffee wake-up to the day.  Lately I've been using Molton Brown Pink Pepperpod Bath & Shower and it has certainly added some spice!

Pink Pepperpod is a light pink gel that comes in a clear plastic bottle.  It is rich, lathers well, fills the shower with fragrance and leaves my skin feeling clean.

I do like the spicy scent, but patchouli isn't at the top of my fragrance list.  I'd use this once in a while, but it wouldn't be a bath-time regular for me.

The fragrance does not linger beyond the shower.

I do like Pink Pepperpod Bath & Shower.  The bottle is nice, the color of the gel is pretty, and it makes my shower feel special.  When I'm in the mood for something spicy, I'm sure I'll be reaching for this shower gel again.
summary: Pink Pepperpod: A Spicy Addition to Your Day

reviewText: I love it, definitely see some improving in skin tone, of course, its not a cure, but using cream and lotion from same brand for pigments definitely help a lot to improve and lighten up pigment on my face.

If you like a rich foamy lather, you'll like this cleanser. Just a small amount will get you a nice rich foam. It rinsese off completely and quickly. I have my doubts about the "brightening" part so 4 stars.
I got a replacement of this and maybe it might be fake or not, although it has the same qualities reviewers described here. I did not notice any brightening or reduction in blemishes with this
I love this face wash, it really does help brighten your complexion and it's super refreshing. I have combination skin and this has helped with my oily t-zone and it has helped with random breakouts.

You literally only need a quarter of a pea sized dollop to lather your entire face. Even though the tube is kind of expensive compared to other cleansers, it lasts a very long time. You skin does feel a little dry afterwards (but not nearly as dry/tight as using LRP's Effaclar cleanser).
summary: A little goes a long way!

reviewText: Feels so clean afterwards.

This is a very gentle and effective deep cleansing lotion from La Roche-Posay.  As you first apply it, you will realize that the scent is very calming and inviting.  Even small amount will bring out nice lather that is easy to rinse off.  Face feels very refreshed the moment you rinse off and pat dry.  The recommended usage is in the morning and in the evening.  Feel free to use other skin products afterwards to maximize your ultimate skin goals.

I can't say there is anything wrong with this product. It gives my skin a nice, bracing feeling like alpha hydroxy acids, e.g. While the tube is on the large side, and you don't need to use very much, still I think you could find an equivalent product for less. I don't know about lightening dark spots. I have two small ones and nothing seems to budge them.

I love the luxuriant lather and fragrance of this face wash.  However, I have dry, sensitive skin, and I'm finding daily use to be a bit too drying.  Every other day is about right, but I like to minimize my skin-care regimen, and I'd rather have a single product to use every day.  It does do a very good job of cleansing and is very nice to use, and I would highly recommend it to anyone whose skin is on the oilier side.
summary: Really nice cleanser, but unexpectedly drying

reviewText:
This is a fantastic cleansing cream for dry skin. You only need a tiny (very tiny) amount to make a good lather that will cover your neck and face. When I rinse this off, my face is clean, radiant and soft. I am thrilled with that alone as my skin is very dry.

There's not too much fragrance in the product, which is a big bonus. Since one really needs to rinse thoroughly, whatever fragrance there is is gone after washing. I use a thick washcloth to help remove the product. The only downside (not enough to take away a star from this review) is that it rather feels like using shampoo on one's face. I'm not crazy about that, but I love the results so much that I don't mind.

Because I'm a member of the Vine program, I have to review this earlier than I would care to. Whether or not it lightens my age spots remains to be seen. If it does, I'll amend this review, but I can't add any stars! Honestly, I've tried so many products meant to cleanse dry clean and none of them do such a good job as this one.

Update: believe it or not, it took me over a year to use up this product! In the meantime, it's name changed. It did not do anything to lighten my age spots, but it is a great facial cleanser, and I am about to make my third purchase.

I have used La Roche Posay products with successful results so I decided to give this cream a try. This requires just a small bit to provide a nice lather. The odor is quite pleasant. I do have a very sensitive skin so I am quite careful about product usage and every other day is about right for this cream.

Smooth, creamy formula leaves your skin the same way; smooth and creamy!  As my grandmother would say, it leaves your skin as soft as a baby's bottom.  It feels great when you use it and it rinses off well without leaving a residue feeling.  The scent is light and inoffensive.  I've only been using it for a week, but I love it so far.  It may not last that long though because my teenage daughter is now using it too :-)

This creamy cleanser easily forms a lather that covers your face in fluffy softness. It is kind of like a shaving cream in consistency. I wasn't sure it would remove foundation makeup, but it did so easily. I used it with my Olay scrubber. I haven't noticed a difference in my skin, but I have only used this a couple times so far. I have redness in my cheeks, and this didn't seem to change that. However, it is hard to tell if the redness is surface redness, or if it runs deeper, so depending on what type of condition you have, this might not help. I didn't notice that this did anything different then my normal Biore Combination Skin Balancing Cleanser, 6.77 Ounce cleanser. I do, however, really like the La Roche cleanser. If you are looking for a high quality cleanser, then give this a try!

The scent reminds me of peach with a bit of floral.  It dissolves and removes makeup very quickly, so it's quite effective.  It has the consistency of liquid hand soap.  Overall this is a wonderful face cleanser.

The La Roche-Posay deep cleansing cream was just ok for me...it was too drying for my sensitive skin. A pea size amount is all you need, as it goes a long way.  My face felt very clean, but dry afterwards. I'm going to scale back my use to twice a week.  Works well with the clarisonic.

Don't be put off by the price tag.  You need such a little amount of this to go a long way.  It's been extremely kind and soft on my sensitive skin.  I recommend if you have a lot of redness and uneven skin tone!
summary: A little luxury goes a long way.

reviewText: This is not a product that I would purchase.  While I do feel like it does an excellent job on cleaning my skin, I haven't seen any difference with pigmentation.  I have very sensitive skin and this dries me out completely.  I've had to reapply moisturizer two-three times a day, whereas every other cleanser I've used is a one and done type of thing.  I will say that it's nice this doesn't have any additives to be worried about, it foams up really well, is easy to rinse off, and this tube will last a long while.  I'd say a small tip of the thumb sized squirt is more than enough to wash your face and neck.
summary: Very good, but too expensive for my blood

reviewText: While I typically use foam cleansers, I recently got a Clarisonic inspired facial brush that requires a cream cleanser. You only need a small amount of product-though I tend to glob on products of this nature (more means better, right?), for this cleanser to be effective. It has the consistency of a masque, a quality I really love because it makes the application quite easy. This is a great face treatment for those with sensitive skin. It seems as though a lot of cleansers use menthol or some agent that makes the product 'tingle' to let users know that it's working, but let's be real for us people with sensitive skin: tingle usually means burn like crazy!  Immediately after using, my face felt squeaky clean! My skin hasn't felt so clean after using a cleanser in a very long time. Clean to the point of it almost being a little dry- so definitely make sure to apply a serum and moisturizer after! If you're looking for a relatively inexpensive, high quality, effective cleanser- this product is for you!
summary: Achieve a deep clean from a gentle cleanser!

reviewText: La Roche-Posay is a great brand of many items, but some I really like better than others. This deep cleaning formula has a smell that is unpleasant to me. It's not strong, but it's sort of medicinal. Just a little cleanser is all you need. I thought I was using just a little, but looked like I had cold cream covering my face. It made my face soft, but I had a little tingly reaction--maybe allergic. I don't think it helps with my adult acne problem like other brands-Tatcha to name one. So,overall, it works, but my face doesn't really like it. It might work well for you.
summary: Deep Cleans, But I Had A Reaction

reviewText: I like this cleanser even more that I thought I would. It leaves my face feeling squeaky-clean but not dry!  I can honestly say my skin has never felt cleaner than when I use this product.  It produces a very rich, thick foam with just the smallest amount of product.  This tube will last a very long time!  It rinses off easily and leaves no residue.

Leaves skin feeling soft and definitely clean.  It's good for my sensitive combination skin.  I would recommend although, it is a bit more money than I would generally pay for this sort of product but you do get what you pay for with a high quality product that cleans and is truly gentle on your skin..
summary: If the price doesn't put you off, it is a high quality, effective cleanser.

reviewText: Exfoliates without stripping out your face's natural moisture. It's exfoliating without being way too coarse.

Cream cleanser with a luxurious feel.
A little goes a long way and it cleanses thoroughly without stripping skin dry
The LHA ingredient is supposed to be an exfoliant hence the "brightening" label.
I have not noticed any particularly brightening after 3 weeks of use, but that is probably because it is meant to be used as an entire system with the other Mela D products.
Does anyone know the pH of this product?
In general I stick to cleansers with pH <6.0

Great product - packaging by Amazon awful - box was ripped open and would have been unfortunate if it was meant for a gift. This is a great cleanser. It's thick and rich and very little is needed. It exfoliates but you can't feel any abrasive sensation but skin looks bright and fresh after use. And, it feels smoother. The scent is traditional scent - a bit like light flowers and baby powder, not too strong.
summary: Great product - packaging by Amazon awful - box was ...

reviewText:
