i like  BURBERRY Brit Rhythm

The bottle itself is very masculine. Big, heavy and strong.

The fragrance is a bit woody with a touch of lemon, similar to Nautica and Ralph Lauren that I purchased last holiday. But the fragrance is quite weak -- you may need more than two or three sprays on your neck.

I love this scent. It is classic, masculine, elegant, wonderful.

The scent is long-lasting. This is a quality product that would definitely make a nice gift. However, I'm keeping it for myself.

I know it's marketed to males, but as a female I've always preferred scents like this. I also use it to scent the house and car.

This isn't scent for any man, but it does have a nice appeal on the right person. I picked this up not knowing if I'd give it to my hubby or my son. It wasn't a match for my hubby as light woods and citrus scents are better suited for him, but for me son it was a perfect match.

When buying scents online, it is best to first go and learn which scents and notes are best suited to your skin, then you can look for those undertones when purchasing online. However, sometimes it is fun to try something different.

To me this has a youthful yet masculine scent. The patchouli note is a hard one to match to the right man, however if you are able to wear it...wow. The black leather note is what give this a rebel, youthful touch and why it was perfect for my son.

reviewText: My husband rarely wears a fragrance, but I kind of liked when he used to have a little something on when we had a night out, so we gave the Burberry Brit Rhythm a try.  I don't know what exactly makes this a young or edgy fragrance, I think it is just a nice smell.  I read what it was supposed to smell like and really couldn't say it smelled like one note overtook the rest or that it had a strong scent of one particular thing.  It smelled a little like wood/cedar to me and I thought it was a nice blend.  It was not too heavy-handed on the fragrance and tended to stay on when he wore it.  Overall, I think it is nice and would love to have him wear it occasionally.  He thought it smelled good, though it didn't seem like a real "wow" factor for him.  Nice packaging, good fragrance and stayed on.  May purchase again, depending on whether he gravitates to wearing it more often.

I'm a sucker for scents.  My husband has put up with the fact that I like it better when he wears aftershave and cologne more than when he has nothing on.  Just a little spritz near the collar of a shirt and I can curl up and cuddle against the smell.  Honestly, I don't know many women that dislike that.  This is a fairly mild scent.  It has a spicy scent.  I think that I can smell the cardamom more than anything else.  Just a few well placed sprays definitely are enough to last the whole day.  My husband has even gone to spraying a couple on his hands and wiping it down the front of his shirt because it "takes the flowery laundry smell out of my clothes."  While it may do that, it is not enough for me to smell him when he's more than a foot away.
summary: Nice mild scent that fits my husband well

reviewText: Very nice fragrance. Came stylishly packaged and looking like a gift you would give someone. It's a 90ml bottle, so should last a while if used sparingly. Burberry is a British luxury brand, and this was made in France which piqued my interest as well. Overall, excellent fragrance and nicely designed bottle.

Burberry Brit Rhythm cologne has a very nice strong long lasting scent.  This is 3 oz of a floral, juniper, cedar wood  and several others.  Well worth added to make any guy carry that distinguished scent that is Burberry.

There is nothing wrong with the Brit Rhythm cologne.  I tested it out in my classroom and let my students smell it.  I used a sample of boys and girls ranging from 17 to 19 years old and they pretty much said the same thing.  It was ok.  I let my aide test it and she is a bit older then my students and she said it was ok but smelled a little sweet.  I tried it as well and agree with what my aide and students said.  It was ok and a little sweet smelling.  I have another student that I teach after school and she thought it was a little sharp smelling.  She said it was good but not for her and she wouldnt want her boyfriend using it.

That all being said  It is a good smelling cologne.  It isn't overpowering after a few minutes and mellows into a a smell that people will wonder about.  I do not like people spraying scents in my room because of how long the linger and this one really does get light smelling quick.  I have to give props to Burberry for this one  You apply a small amount and it does add a good scent to your body/clothing that is very distinct and not overpowering.  You don't have to be embarrassed to wear this if applied correctly.

All in all this is a decent deal for the price.  Good cologne isn't cheap.  You can tell cheap when you buy it and use it once.  This is a solid product and a solid deal.  My reason for four stars, It just isn't something I would want to wear on a daily basis.  I do have a few I would but this isn't one of them.
summary: Good smelling, good deal, pretty solid all around.

reviewText:
The Brit Rhythm struck me as bold, fresh, and pleasing without being overpowering. It is great for everyday use at the office, going out, and special occasions.

The bottle is exquisite. Rectangular, edgy, and looks stunning. The all glass shell makes nice for leaving out on the desk. No need to hide this guy.

I am in love. I feel confident.
summary: Excellent cologne for everyday use and special occasions

reviewText:
I use one spritz and walk into the spray, at a distance of about two feet. I usually find that I find it to be a very weak application, but when I walk into the next room, I'm immediately called out as being overpowering. That fades off after about 20 minutes or so.

In reviewing proper application protocols, it's said to apply at a distance of at least six inches to avoid over saturating one particular area. Some sites also suggest spraying your chest/biceps so that it becomes trapped in your clothing, so people have to be really close to you to take in your scent. As a general rule, colognes are supposed to be smelled within the personal circle, which is generally considered to be a couple of feet. If the room smells like you when you leave, you've just become "That guy." I hope every high school boy using Axe reads that...

My grandfather, my dad, my hubby, my sons and grandsons all have tried and loved Burberry fragrances and it continues to be among the worlds most exclusive aromas for distinguished men.  You can wear it in the boardroom or in the club and it will always have people asking what are you wearing?

This Brit Rhythm continues the saga of Burberry fragrances making men ready and able to put their best foot forward.  This aroma is light with its top the notes being spicy with a woody undertone.  The spray bottle delivers the proper amount but be sure to use only one squirt as this keeps it light. I think this is a very Euro-sexy spray cologne for men.
summary: Five generations of family men have chosen Burberry fragrances

reviewText: I never tried Burberry cologne or Eau de Toilette, and really didn't know what to think. reviewText:
I have used Jouer lip products before so was excited to try this eyeshadow crayon, and I was not disappointed with the results. The crayon applies beautifully for an overall shadow and also works well if you want to use it as an eyeliner instead. I tested the baroque shade and have predominantly used it as a liner and love it for mornings when I don't want to worry with the precision and attention needed for a sharper pencil. I can swipe this in a hurry and go.

There have been no problems with melting, running or fading when coupled with an eyelid primer.
Jouer Crème Eyeshadow Crayon is a soft beautiful accent for your eyes. It does not pull at the skin where your most delicate. It lasts nicely too. Did not have to touch up often.

Baroque is a wonderful color.  It is like a bronzed brown with a tiny touch of a pink tone if you compare to other browns. This eye shadow contains a shimmer but not sparkle.  The pencil is similar to MAC Shadestick in texture, but it does not set as fast as Shadestick does.  This is a 2 edged sword in that the fact that it does not immediately set gives you time to blend and smudge a bit.  Once set, it does not move for much of the day.

There is no perfumed odor to the pencil, although it has a slight odor from the chemicals and ingredients that fades after the shadow sets.

However, I did find that when applied on my eyelid, it did begin to crease after about four hours or so- by the end of the day, much was missing on my eyes.

This was remedied somewhat by applying this crayon over top of an eyeshadow primer.  I used Too Faced Shadow Insurance and also tested with Milani's eye primer and both did help it not to crease as much.  If my eyes watered, however, it did come off quite easily.

All in all, this color is very beautiful.  It would work on cool or warmish skin tones (very fair red heads might find it too pinkish), and the staying power is good as well.  If you use it over an eyeshadow primer / base, you can easily get an entire day's wear out of it.  If you don't, you probably will only get part of a day, especially if you have oily lids or watery eyes.

I give this four stars.
summary: Fantastic Color- Needs Primer To Stay On All Day

reviewText:
The product quality itself is quite good - the eyeshadow crayon (more of a cream stick though) is smooth, stays on nicely, and lasts a long time. This particular color is nice as well, softens the eye a bit without overwhelming. And since I'm one of those people always rubbing my eyes, I appreciate the fact that it doesn't smudge all over the place.

I also like the casing which is like a fancy lipstick. It's easy to hold while applying the product and stays closed in my bag (I hate when cosmetics have flimsy caps - this one is very good).

The main issue I had with this product is the "girth" of the crayon portion, which is just slightly too wide and rounded. I think it needs to be tapered a bit more, not pointy like a pencil but more like actual crayon size. It would be easier to apply it in a thinner line in certain places on the eye. Finally, the staying power of this eyeshadow is so good, I've had a few moments of difficulty when removing it, so now I just apply a bit less product and it's generally okay on clean-up.

Overall, a good, quality product at a decent price point (as cosmetics go).
summary: Good but could be great with a couple of tweaks

The color is a little dark for regular day wear but that;s okay because the first time you rub at your eyes - it's gone.  I tried several different variants of my morning routine to try to make it last at least 3-5 hours, to no avail.  I put a primer on first, I tried it with no primer, I tried it on dry moisturized skin, I used it as a primer for a lighter eyeshadow, I tried powdering over it to set it.  Nothing I tried so far has managed to make this last through my lunch break.  Which is unfortunate because I like the creamy feel, the color, and the ease of application.  But none of that does me any good if it all ends up under my eyes instead of above them.

If you use it EVERY night the results will amaze you and everyone else!
**UPDATE** May 15th 2013~
 GrandeLash MD has created another miraculous growth spurt for my Lashes! They are long, thick, full and silky again. The other day I didn't feel like wearing mascara so I just used my eyelash curler on them. They look beautiful. I will never stray from this product again. It has proven to be the best of its kind on the market. It's gentle on my eyes and on my pocket book. Worth every penny. This is one of my beauty MUST HAVES!

I had high hopes for this product since my daughter has had wonderful results with it. Her lashes are so long and full since using it. But it makes my eyes burn and get very dry and uncomfortable.  I plan to try it again after a little time passes. I sure would like to be able to use it.

This aftershave balm smells so good!  I had my fiance test this out for me, and he loves it.  It smells so good on him, plus it is good for his sensitive face.  I think this is a great aftershave balm to use, and I hope my fiance will continue using it in the future.

My wife told me that she could smell me walking down the steps the first time I used this yesterday. I think that's more because the bathroom door was open and I went back to get dressed before coming downstairs. The first use out of the bottle was also more than was required because it was difficult to get a small amount out since this is a balm (leave a little more headspace!) and not a spray bottle.

I feel like the pungent aroma faded rather quickly. It was evident when we got in the car some 30 minutes later, but it was never mentioned again that day. I normally wear Acqua Di Gio, which I find to be a little more refreshing than this Burberry product. I will continue to alternate between these two products as this is a pleasant scent. It receives 5/5 stars on most all of the other websites out there.

The spin top bottle is a bit annoying... You have the product on your hands from application, and then have to close the bottle which is difficult because your hands are now quite slippery. You'll be washing the threaded bottle cap after every use.
summary: Overpowering out of the bottle but fades nicely

reviewText: My husband opened the package when it arrived and handed me the container.  I thought it was glass and I squeezed it too hard, and some of the lotion spilled out on to my hand (the container is plastic).  I spread it on my arm and ohhhhhh la la! It soooo sexy!  I kept taking big whiffs all night.  It would make me want to bury my face in my husband's neck all day long.  I was in bed for the night when I put it on the arm, and wouldn't you know it, the scent was there the next morning!  Not overwhelming, mind you -- although the smell had changed.  It almost feel like some of the ingredients evaporated leaving others still on my arm.  My husband loved it so much, he said it's going to be his body lotion as well as his aftershave!  I love it!

I selected this for my boyfriend.  I really like the nice manly fragrance.  The aftershave has a light, fresh scent and leaves his face feeling soft and smooth. He did not experience any sting after applying it like he usually does with the "cheap" aftershaves he uses. He and I both like the bottle which has ridges on both sides and prevents it from slipping out of his hands.  Although, he only uses non-scented aftershave, this one is not overbearingly fragrant so he actually likes it.

I rate this aftershave 5 stars because I am tired of having him smelling like nothing and I love the fragrance. He gives it 4 stars only because he likes unscented aftershave.

Since this is 150ML and the 90ml bottle on Amazon is $79, I can only guess that it's much more expensive. As of this writing the price is not posted. I think this is a special gift for the men. Indirectly it is a gift for the women who are within smelling and touching distance. Anyone who purchases this has to be willing to pay for the brand name. As to whether I would do that or not, I'm not sure.  Nevertheless, price aside, this aftershave is excellent to me and well-liked by my boyfriend. It is definitely a 5-star product.
summary: Nicely fragrant aftershave that has a manly scent and leaves no sting

reviewText: I purchased this aftershave for my brother as a birthday gift. Although he rarely wears aftershave, this product has converted him to an almost daily wearer! Like most Burberry products, this is a lovely, high quality aftershave. It has a unique smell: almost like a delicious blend of woods, cedar, and leather. This item would make a great gift for any of the guys in your life!

This Burberry Brit Rhythm aftershave balm was a bit of a disappointment: though there's nothing really wrong with it, its quality is not really commensurate with the price or the upmarket image. The fragrance itself is a pleasant, if generic, aquatic accord with only the faintest hint of the claimed gourmand spice layered underneath; it reminded me a lot of Bvlgari AQVA. But the way it's packaged in "balm" form here is unimpressive, leaving the scent thinned out in a generic, thin-feeling moisturizing lotion. The packaging is similarly unimpressive: an entirely unlabeled plastic squeeze bottle that tries unconvincingly for a clear-crystal look. I'd recommend just combining the scent itself with a better-quality unscented lotion instead of purchasing this product; given the packaging, it doesn't even make an impressive or luxurious-seeming gift.

The first thing I noticed about this was that the bottle seems poorly designed for a lotion, it was a little awkward and it seems that a tube or pump would suit something of this consistency better. That said, it still gets the job done so not a huge deal.

When first applied I felt a slight tingling/warming sensation especially on the more sensitive areas of my face. I thought it felt nice and never got intense enough to be uncomfortable. After giving it time to soak in it left my skin feeling moisturized and smooth and never greasy like some other aftershave lotions I have tried.

I found the scent to be pleasant and not overpowering, but I do not traditionally wear cologne and it might be a bit much if combined with something else.
summary: Smooth aftershave lotion with a pleasant fragrance.

reviewText: Smells great and goes on smooth.  I have a problem with lotions and as a rule I can only use a moisturizer otherwise I rash up.  However I thought I would try the Burberry Aftershave and after a few uses no rash what so ever.  The one drawback is the smell is nice but can be over whelming so be careful when using after you apply cologne or people may smell you a mile away.  This size bottle will last several months as a little goes a long way.
summary: Smells great and goes on smooth

reviewText:
A few things you need to know to begin: this is a thin aftershave lotion, not a liquid; the top screws on and off and you squeeze the balm out rather than tipping or shaking it.

Now to the good stuff. It smells incredible! Burberry is incapable of putting out a mediocre scent but this time they formulated a great one. It's something between fresh, clean and woodsy and since it's in a balm it can either be left alone and left as the barest hint of scent or layered on with more product for something stronger.

The guy of the house loved this but umm, honestly? I stole it from him and swab a little near my pulse points when I don't feel like using my own scent. It smells good!

Burberry Brit Rhythm is a very pleasant and earthy scent, with noticeable hints of cedarwood. The body wash / shower gel is mildly scented, washes away cleanly, leaves your skin feeling soft and the scent remains subtle hours after use.

**Review provided by husband and adjusted by the wife.

My husband, while not normally a "shower gel" kind of man, agreed to try this product. And because he is not one to traditionally use scented soaps or gels (although he occasionally wears a little cologne, selecting scents like Tommy Bahama or Dolce & Gabanna), he gave this product a 3.  He doesn't like scents that are overpowering or loud. He liked the Burberry scent (stating that it is definitely subtle). He said that it left his skin feeling smooth or slightly slick. He liked that the scent did not linger or hang heavily in the air. Within a few hours, the scent was delicate and undetectable.

Now a wife's perspective. I liked the scent. I thought it was sexy yet subtle. It did not need to be enhanced with an extra splash of cologne. Alone, this shower gel offers a pleasant scent for several hours. It doesn't linger in his clothes or on the sheets. I found this shower gel to be affordable and for under $35, you have a nice "all occasion" gift (i.e., Father's Day, Birthday, Christmas or Hanukkah).  And finally, the container is beautiful. You would think that it is glass but it is actually thick plastic. In conclusion, I overrule my husband's 3 star rating (because he is not really that into colognes or shower gels) and give this product 4-4.5 stars!

While this shower gel does have a great smell, it doesn't seem to clean very well and after using it a few days, it felt like it was starting to dry out my sensitive skin. I would never buy this a gift for anyone or let it replace any of my current body wash.

I had no idea Burberry made stuff like this. This shower gel could easily be mistaken for a cologne - it has the same packaging, size and eye-catching bottle that pricey colognes come in. The bottle is gorgeous, cut-glass silver and crystal. I'd like to display it on my dresser table next to my collection of perfumes and colognes but it feels funny to be doing that with a shower gel.

As for performance, the smell is intense, just like a men's cologne. It has a strong woodsy, highly masculine scent and lathers up well, though I felt I had to use more of it to get a good lather going, compared to a much cheaper drugstore brand like Suave. Since the bottle is cologne-sized instead of hefty like other shower gels, I don't expect this to last long. It's quite pricey for what you get.

Most shower gels are unisex but I'm not sure a woman would appreciate this scent as much as a guy. I really associate the musky, aftershave woodsy smell with men, but I could be wrong.
summary: Feel Like I'm Washing My Body With a Pricey Men's Cologne

reviewText: This gel has an intense aroma, and reminds me of Lagerfeld. It foams well and I like the bottle. My only criticism is the price, which I find almost twice as expensive as some other good brands, like Molton Brown, which I really like.
summary: Intense aroma, for a pricy splash in the shower

reviewText: My wife used this product.  She prefers the mens line as the scent is stronger and lasts longer than the womens line. Lives up to the Burberry name.  Wonderful scent, tons of lather, and scent lingers for quite a while after the shower. Highly recommend this product.
summary: Great for women or men.  Stronger scent as expected for a mens brand.

reviewText:
My husband has used this for a week.  It smells divine and lasts (without adding the Burberry Brit Rhythm cologne) for four hours on his skin in full blown hot, muggy Georgia summers. Some of the scent rubs off onto his undershirt and I can smell it on the tee after work (9 hours).

It has a spicy undertone to it.  The initial blast last a few minutes after the shower but the drydown smell is unique and leathery.

It's a bit pricey but a little goes a long way.

Once you've tried one cologne shower gel, you've tried them all. The scent is strong, but the bubbles are slim. No pouf in the world can give you the soapy suds you desire and it never feels like it's doing any cleaning. This is especially true of the Burberry gel.

If you are determined to buy it, I recommend using your usual bar or favorite body wash first so you will actually be clean and then follow up with the Burberry so your skin will smell like a Dillard's Men's Department for the next thirty minutes.

Admittedly I do love the Burberry Brit Rhythm scent. It's conventionally masculine but a step above your typical locker room clich. It's deep and sexual, but not especially overpowering. The gel does not linger on your skin for long, so if you aren't going to follow-up with the cologne itself, you better move fast and get someone in bed because otherwise, no one will notice.

OVERALL: I would never recommend any shower gel that is from a cologne line and do not recommend the Burberry either. They all fail as a cleansing soap, are overexpensive, and, most surprisingly, the fragrance doesn't linger. I do like the scent, though, so if you're shopping around for a new cologne, you might give Brit Rhythm a sniff to see if it fits your needs.
summary: Just Like Other Cologne Shower Gels  - Strong on Scent, Short on Bubbles

reviewText:
I'm not a fan of this. I usually use Ivory soap after a run. I find it to be the only soap that can actually get me pretty clean and tame my odor. This didn't work at all. I used nearly a quarter of the bottle and it still did nothing for me. Afterwards, when I went to towel off, I saw dirt streaks all over my white towel. I had to hop back into the shower and use my standby Ivory soap.

The smell is unoffensive, it reminds me a bit of Cool Water. It does fade pretty quickly (that can be viewed as a plus or minus if you like the smell of Cool Water).

I can't recommended this. For the price, you should look elsewhere or just rack up on Ivory.

Terrific flat iron.  I tried both curly and straight hair styles with it.  Usually my hair is somewhat dry after styling.  The vapor really helps.  It's very simple.  You fill the cartridge, plug the iron in,  put it on the heat and vapor setting you want,  wait about 3 min. I was afraid the cartridge would leak,  but so far so good.  I like that it comes with a spare regardless.

My only quibble is the price of the refill oil.  20 bucks.  It only lasts about ten uses so depending on how often you style your hair,  you could spend 40 a month on oil.

***Edit*** I've nearly used the first bottle of oil. My initial cartridge is already leaking, and not where you'd expect it to, not where the oil goes in, but along the side of the cartridge. Further inspection shows there is a crack in the plastic, on the side that faces the iron. This iron has not been dropped or mishandled, so there is no reason for the crack. I could merely start using another cartridge, which was included, but I don't want to spend 20 bucks on oil that's going to end up all over my hands before I've even used the bottle.

I have been using hair straighteners since they came out almost 30 years ago. At the time you could remove the plates and go from straight to crimping your hair. I remember those days well. Then about 20 years ago I spent hundreds of dollars on a Chi. Since then they have dropped in price but I loved it. Now I buy what I feel is practical and also works.

I will admit I have never used one that had vapors to it. I was interested it trying it. Boy, does it make a difference! I have really long hair so it takes some time to get all of it but the difference in my hair is night and day. I have been asked if I had it professionally done or what did I put it in. When I say it is a hair iron, they look puzzled.

I like that this comes with two cartridges to use in case one breaks. Comes with the vapor infusion which at the time of writing this seems to run around twenty bucks, it is worth it! The unit itself has a switch to turn it on and off and them lo, med, and hi. On the outside you can turn the vapor on low or high, I have been using high for it. However, you can remove the cartridge and also use it without the vapor. I love all the option you have.

Cons would be no auto shutoff and just a standard plug in. Most of my hair devices have a trip in case there is an electrical issue. I have to make sure to unplug it.

I really love this. I have never used one of these before but the results are amazing! It might be better served for someone with shorter hair; mine is really long and takes some time since the iron is not that wide. I wash it at night though and do it the next morning.

Very impressed, I can see this becoming part of my daily rituals.
summary: Amazing what it does for your hair!

reviewText: This is a really cool vapor iron, and my first of it's type.  It was easy to use and made my hair really smooth but not oily looking in which I was afraid. I do have to use at the lower setting though as my hair is thin and I am afraid with the oil it will fry it but many of the reviews say the opposite. It was easy to put together and I have a lot of my own oil I am going to use when I run out of the oil included. Will update the more I use, but for the last couple uses I am loving how soft and how great my hair looks!
summary: Easy to Use! Soft Shiny Hair!

reviewText: Prior to receiving this I was more familiar with the Agave brand for their hair care products than styling tools, but I've always had great experiences with their Healing Oil Treatment (I love using it after a deep conditioning hair mask to lock in the moisturizer and give my hair a silky feel) so I was curious to try this. I'm someone who has been regularly flat ironing my thick, naturally wavy, color treated hair for 15 years so I'm pretty picky about my flat irons. I look for something that is comfortable to hold, gets my hair straight on the first pass, creates minimal damage and lasts over time. Generally to get all of this I've had to look to the pricier brands vs. drugstore hot tools. (Generally I found the drugstore flat irons died after a year of regular use so over time, I was spending just as much as a pricier iron because I had to replace them more quickly.) Before getting this my go-to flat iron has been TS-2 Millennium Professional Flat Iron which I LOVE and has outperformed pricier irons (I'm looking at you Ghd Limited Edition Pastel Collection Classic Flat Iron Styler, Periwinkle, 1 Inch that was so beautiful, but died just after the warrantee period ended. **Sigh**). Setting this up, it's immediately clear that what makes this flat iron different from others I've tried is that it integrates a vapor infusion treatment (included). Essentially this iron has a removable cartridge that you fill up with the included vapor infusion treatment. It also has the option to select whether you want the vapor function off, low, or high. Once you've completed these steps, the rest of the process of flat ironing is pretty similar to other brands. In my case I fully blow dry my hair with my leave-in products of choice, and then section my hair out with alligator clips and flat iron using the highest heat setting in two-inch sections starting at the roots and working downward. So far, I'm pleased with the experience of using this. It's easy to hold and the plates get a good grip on my hair without any hair getting caught. I've also found I get my hair pretty darn straight in a single pass (with the exception of the back of my head but that tends to be more because I miss strands than anything that is the iron's fault). And my hair does look healthy afterwards, or as healthy as it can considering my hair is dry/coarse to begin with and gets bleached and toned several times per year. The only thing I haven't really figured out is whether the way this iron dispenses the infusion is really any better than just using another iron with Agave's Healing Oil Treatment. I will say while it feels healthy it doesn't feel dramatically healthier than when I make sure to use good styling products with my flat iron that protect my hair from heat and add moisture and shine. That said, having it integrated into the iron does save a step and means I don't have to hunt around for my Healing Oil Treatment when I'm ready to style my hair because it's taken care of for me. Either way since it meets my criteria of what makes a great flat iron, I'm happy. I think the big test for me will be how long this iron lasts with regular use, and will update accordingly. It would be nice if all irons in this price point lasted a long time, but my experience with GHD shows that is unfortunately just not the case.
summary: Meets all my criteria for a great flat iron

reviewText:
After having a CHI burn the heck out of my hair and the Remmington Frizz Therapy flat iron working better than my CHI did I swore I'd never own another flat iron that cost $100 or more again. Then I saw this and decided I absolutely had to try it. Unlike any flat iron I've ever used before, this one actually uses agave oil and infuses the oil into your hair while flat ironing. I was skeptical before trying it, but once I saw the difference it made I was sold. It's definitely worth every penny they are asking for it.

The first picture is my hair before flat ironing. It's actually not that bad of a frizz day if you can believe that. The second picture is a section of hair that I did with the Remington flat iron and the third picture is a different section of hair I did with this Agave Healing Vapor Iron. The pictures don't quite do it justice since you can't feel the hair through a picture or really see the actual amount of shine but the difference in person really is amazing.

First, I like that the flat iron comes with a back up oil reservoir in case the first one gets damaged. This is the plastic reservoir that you pour the included oil into. Filling the reservoir is really easy and the directions were not at all hard to understand.

There is also a dial that allows you to adjust the heat settings so you can set the iron to the lowest setting that will work for your hair, preventing unecesarry heat damage.

The cord is quite long and I was able to easily stand in the middle of my double vanity and move around while doing my hair, which is nice. I don't like being stuck near the wall just because the cord won't reach.

When you are using the flat iron you can actually see the agave oil vapors coming out of the plate that has the reservoir on the outside of it, so you can see it working.

The oil itself is about $16 a bottle for replacement bottles, which isn't bad considering what I pay for some of my hair products and how soft and sleek my hair felt after using it.

Overall I have to say I'm eating my words after having said I'd never fall for believing that a $100 or more flat iron is better than a $50 Remington. While I would never go back to CHI, this particular flat iron blew me away and you can really see and feel the difference it makes in your hair. I'd definitely recommend this to anyone who fights a daily battle with frizz or really anyone who wants to use a flat iron that actually seems to be good for your hair.

I personally haven't owned this long enough to notice issues with durability and longevity but will update my review as time goes on if I run into any issues.
summary: Blew Every Other Flat Iron I've Used Out of the Water

reviewText: I have shoulder length hair that's fairly straight, with an easy to maintain layered hair cut. I don't often do much to my hair besides a little flat ironing to fix funny kinks. I typically go to sleep with wet hair rather than bothering to blow dry it, I'm that lazy with hair styling. I love this iron! I just kept going and did more than usual because it made my hair so smooth and silky. I think the vapor definitely contributed to that. It smells nice and it's very easy to fill. The iron is a pretty color too, it matches my bathroom. The cord is really long for people who have a plug that's not close to where they like to use it. I've had friends try and steal it after using it. I love it!

I am a 44 year old female who has very fine and thinning brown hair which is highlighted blonde and cut in a bob above my shoulders.  Because of my hair type and the fact that I live in the very humid Northeast region of the US, it is a constant battle to prevent frizziness.  I am not exaggerating here - my hair looks like I got electrocuted!  I am always looking for products to manage this, as it is just not acceptable to go out in public looking like that.

I saw this product in my local Ulta store.  Because it was expensive, I was hesitant to try it.  Boy, I am so glad that I did!  This is not your typical flat iron.  It has a small compartment at the top of the iron where you pour the oil.  This is a special oil that comes with the iron - you one bottle of it when you buy the iron.  A little goes a long way, but yes, you can reorder the oil separately when you are out of it.

Once you pour the oil into the compartment, then, you turn on the iron.  It has the typical heat settings (anything from low, medium or high) which you control via a small temperature wheel that is on the lower bottom of the iron.  Not the best placement for this, as it's hard to reach.

Once the iron has reached the target temperature (the red light will stop flashing), then you press a button under the bottom iron to turn on the oil.  This is a nice feature because you do not have to use the oil every time - only if you wish.  The iron starts steaming (yes, steaming) and in this steam is a small amount of this oil.  You use the iron like a regular flat iron on your hair.

Wow, it works great.  My hair is so shiny and smooth, I just can't believe it.  And, it lasts me all day.  Also, it takes me less time to use this iron from a traditional flat iron.  I guess because of the steam?  Not sure, but it works great.

I am so happy to have found this iron.  I use it every single day.  Love it.
summary: Uses steam and oil to lock in smoothness all day

reviewText:
I've never used a face primer before, although I have considered it. I usually look washed out by 5pm and have to freshen up before I go anywhere again. I use an eye primer regularly and don't know why I've never tried one for my face. I looked forward to trying this product.

This product promises:
 - Help makeup last longer
 - Provide smooth canvas for your makeup
 - Reduce appearance of wrinkles
 - Wear with or without makeup
Does it deliver?

I tested Julep Blank Canvas several times over the course of a week, using different types of makeup and blush.

I applied Julep Blank Canvas Primer to one side of my face after using my normal moisturizer. It felt a little strange, like a silicone gel. It went on smoothly, but I had to apply more than I expected to for adequate coverage. The side with the Julep turned red and I felt a slight irritation, but it went away within three minutes. I don't believe my skin is sensitive, and this is the first time I've experienced a reaction like this. It was quick and mild enough that it didn't deter me from continuing use.

I applied my makeup (foundation and blush) as usual, then went about my day. By 5pm, the primed side looked much better than the unprimed side! It had more color, while the other side had washed away and faded. I tried this several times using different foundations, and both powder and cream blush. Each time my face had equal results with more color remaining on the primed side. I also felt that I looked less tired.

I wondered how my face would look with just primer and without makeup, since it was suggested on the package. My face felt smoother when I touched it throughout the day, but I don't believe it looked any different. Perhaps if I had oily or dry skin then I might have noticed a difference, but it had no impact on my normal skin.

Was it supposed to plump up fine lines? The product description indicated it would help reduce the appearance of wrinkles, so I assumed it would plump them a little. I'm over 50 and have very fine wrinkles around my eyes and mouth. I didn't notice any difference between the two sides of my face, or any full use day since. I'm taking away a star for not living up to that claim for me.

Did Julep Blank Canvas live up to it's promises?
 - My makeup definitely lasted much longer!
 - The smooth canvas helped my foundation glide on easily and more smoothly than without it
 - Did NOT impact the appearance of fine lines on my face
 - Works well with makeup, didn't look any fresher when worn alone without makeup

I'm hooked! I would definitely recommend Julep Blank Canvas to my own friends and family.
summary: Keeps my face looking fresh all day

reviewText: The idea of a primer underneath foundation is new to me, but I see the appeal. It does create a bit smoother texture to the skin before applying anything else and does make it seem more youthful and moisturized. It's unfortunate, however, that it doesn't have sunscreen. This way you have to apply sunscreen, then primer, then foundation on top of that. (Hopefully the sunscreen is still in place at the end.) It's expensive for a 1 oz tube and is doing something I thought foundation was supposed to do. However, it does help the skin, and has some decent inigredients, so all in all it's a good, if not perfect, product.
Goes on thick but quickly absorbs and leaves a smooth, soft face. Just don't get it near your eyes. It will burn.
summary: Smooth Face, Just Keep Away from Eyes

reviewText:
Using a primer happily in summer is both necessary and impossible.

It's necessary because the weather requires one to use both non-pore-blocking sunscreen (or primer with sunscreen)as well as something that cuts down on the unattractive appearance of super sweaty face/running make-up. It's impossible because any make-up on hot skin makes it hotter, blotchier, and likely to be (unevenly) sweat off.

That said:  this primer appears to do better than most.  It doesn't run, blotch, or clump.  I do wish that it included sunscreen, since having to add it over or under the primer makes for a heavier and less-breathable layer of stuff on your face.
summary: Good enough primer.  The lack of included sunscreen is both something of a mystery and something of a nuisance.

reviewText: The face primer applies very evenly with minimal effort and without a "painted look."  It's very smooth and fills in thinner wrinkles very easily.  I was somewhat impressed with the application usability.  It also feels refreshing.  One word of caution, the product was left in my mailbox all day in the high heat.  Had to let it sit for a while inside normal temperatures.  Depending how long it is exposed to the unusually high heat (i.e. like Phoenix), I believe the product could break down and not work correctly.
summary: " It's very smooth and fills in thinner wrinkles very easily. I was somewhat impressed with the application usability

reviewText: Apply before foundation for a silky finish; gives a polished smooth look and makes me look younger!

Julep Blank Canvas Mattifying Face Primer, 1 oz. is made to help reduce pore size, absorbs shine, and keeps skin moisturized for 24 hours. It does all off that and keeps my makeup on my face without huge amount of sweat. Goes on smoothly- I just put a small amount on my finger tips and massage into my face using an even amount everywhere. Looks great under my foundation and combines well with my primers and toners to give me a crease free look. I have had people tell me that my face looks to have a more even skin tone. I do not need to touch myself up later in the day, as all of my makeup stays perfectly on my face. The only thing I add at the half way point is new powder and some bronzer just to give me a complete look.

After such a positive experience with this product, I will be looking at others by Julep.

After using this product for over a few weeks, my face has not broken out at all. I do have sensitive skin, and tend to stay with higher end brands, but feel very confident that this fits me and my face perfectly.

My daily face routine (All of my makeup is either Clinique or Bennefit):
Toner
***Blank Canvas***
Moisturizer
Primer
Foundation
Powder

For the price, how well it works for my face, and how well my face looks after 8hours of wearing... I really love this product and have to recommend it to everyone. For those who are worried about the price, all of my makeup ranges from $22-45 so this fits right into that range. Do not be afraid to buy due to price because you really get your moneys worth. I have been using it everyday for about a month and believe that I am not even half way through.
summary: Now part of my daily routine

reviewText:
The primer has a smooth, non-greasy feeling and goes on easily. It's not as light-feeling as I would like, but absorbed quickly. There was no noticeable scent.

I used the primer first and then applied my usual moisturizer with sunscreen and regular makeup which consists of a light foundation and powder.

After several weeks of use, I did't see any difference from my regular makeup routine. I also tried using it on only one side of my face but even then I could only detect a subtle difference.

I was not expecting to like this product as much as I have. I normally don't have great luck with face primers doing what they say they will do. This Julep face primer really delivers. My skin was not as shiny when I used this product as compared to when I do not use a primer. It also made my make up last longer and stay fresher looking.

I will say that I was a little worried when I first extracted some of the primer from the tube. This is a really thick product and it almost feels like sunscreen. It does, however, go onto your face really smoothly and easily.  Don't be put off by the consistency because this is a great product.

Excellent product that primes your face for application of makeup -- and makes the makeup just glide on and stay put.  This was a little heavy for the heat of the summer, and I wouldn't use it when I planned to spend much time out of doors in the heat, as I felt like it made me a little more prone to sweating..  But it does do a fabulous job of evening out the skin surface.
summary: Great primer for makeup but a little heavy for summer

reviewText:
I rated Julep Blank canvas primer 4.5 stars. I have only used a couple of primers in the past, which did not work well for me before and the smashbox one gave me little bumps on my skin which was causing pore blocks. Since I live in a tropical climate, I have one major requirement that this primer must do...to mattify and absorb shine on my forehead and nose. This Julep canvas primer does that and also minimizes my pores and doesn't dry out my skin.

I would recommend this primer, it doesn't contain "glitter specks" which makes my skin look shiny. This primer has 18 plant extracts and creates a smooth, even canvas that assists my pressed powder or liquid foundation in staying put and looking nice after many hours of wear.

This is a decent face primer. It goes on easy, and is non-greasy as long as you don't apply gobs of it like it was clown paint. Most people tend to over-apply a product instead of realizing that less is more in many cases. This has a very light smell that fades almost immediately. The primer surface allows for all day wear of makeup that stays consistent and doesn't need reapplication. This product doesn't seem to cause any irritation on the skin, and at the end of the day comes off readily enough with soap and water.

reviewerName: Meryl K. Evans, Digital Marketing Pro
reviewText:
The primer felt OK on the face. I've had better. Per the directions, I applied a thin layer, but it was still like applying sunblock -- a little sticky and slightly thick consistency -- and even smells similar. On one application, it burned a little and I don't have sensitive skin. I tried it with and without makeup. I didn't see a difference in how my face looked except for one thing. My make up didn't look shiny, so it did its job as a matte.

The make up didn't last longer than when I use any other primer. A few people made comments on the size of the primer tube. I haven't seen many primer products in a larger tube. So I don't think it's unusual. The tube is 4.4-inches long. Look at Amazon's picture of a person holding the primer to get an idea of the size.

I won't be using this product after I finish the tube.
summary: Average primer that burned a little on one application

reviewText: This primer has no color.  I was expecting a slight nude color.  It came out clear to whitish. It made my skin feel incredibly soft.  So, why the three stars?  It did nothing else for my face except make it itch!  Now mind you, I have extremely sensitive skin - EXTREMELY.  It may be just fine for someone else.  But, this is my review and it made my eyes itch so badly that they are swollen now!  I have eczema, though.  Like I said it may be fine for someone else.  I did not feel as though this product did anything in the way of priming my skin.  It made it feel soft.  Did nothing for the small and fine wrinkles.  Did nothing for the open pores.  Why would I want to use it?  I did not wear it alone.  I put makeup over it as I do with all my facial primers.  This one is a definite "don't buy."

First day I used the Julep Blank Canvas primer under my usual foundation (NARS) I got a very lovely compliment that my makeup looked amazing.  I find this primer very easy to apply and smooth out, without irritating my face.  Other primers I've used seem to make my face ruddy at first, and one of the prior primers I tried had an odd scent -- not the case with Julep Blank Canvas primer.
I really appreciate that I can use less foundation over the primer than if I use foundation alone.  It gives a bit more glide to the liquid foundation I typically use.  Makeup still looked refreshed after many hours of wear & photographs well.  I highly recommend using a good cleanser w/ facial brush (such as Clarisonic) &/or an exfoliating mitt (I use Jane Iredale's) when taking off makeup -- primers do tend to cause breakouts when not well removed.  I found that Julep didn't cause any considerable breakouts and I'll continue to use this primer as the first step before applying liquid foundation.

My wife tried this out:

I wanted to love this so much, but it fell short of expectations.  When the primer arrived, I was first surprised at how small the bottle was.  You do receive 1.0 oz, and that is pretty standard for amount of product per primer, it was just a bit surprising.  I suppose that means other companies just put the same amount of product in larger-appearing packaging so that you think you're getting more, so thank you Julep for that. The product has a nice light aroma, however it did not work well with my foundation.  I tried several brands of foundation and ended up with the same result: foundation that appeared cakey.  Additionally, it did not appear to make my makeup last longer than usual either which was a bummer. Perhaps my skin type was just not meant for this primer, but Id say I have pretty normal skin, though middle-aged. So far this product has really good reviews from others and is from a reputable company.  Sorry, Julep - I still love you, but my skin/makeup did not love this primer.

reviewerName: Gina Pera, Adult ADHD Expert and Author
reviewText:
Being more familiar with priming walls and outdoor furniture than my face, I found the concept hilarious -- primer for your face!

Then my more cosmetically savvy friend confirmed that a facial primer has its benefits.

I wasn't sure what to expect with my 50-something dry skin, so I tried the half-and-half experiment one day when I wasn't leaving the house.

The coverage seemed to remain more even on the primed side. But only minimally so. (To be fair, I'm not very fastidious about face-painting, and I don't use eye makeup. Evening my skin tone is the main priority.)

This would be something I'd use only for certain events where I am on the go from morning to night.
summary: Works better than the spackle I've been using :-)

reviewText: I really like the Julep face primer. It feels a little thick while applying but that feeling goes away quickly. My face feels smooth and for almost 60 looks really good. I use this after applying moisturizer and under a light application of liquid make-up. I have used this several days now and it did seem to burn one day when I put it on after working outside in the sun. Only that day did I notice any irritation at all and I do have sensitive skin.

reviewText: I am not a user of face primer normally because I use moisturizer with SPF to help protect my skin before applying makeup. Adding this step to my routine was easy and the tube is easy to spot on my counter since it is black and I love the cap being at the bottom to squeeze out the amount needed since gravity helps empty the bottle.  I smoothed this on before applying my mineral powder makeup with a brush. I liked that it absorbed quickly into my skin and my wrinkles appeared less prominent and my skin felt soft and moisturized while my makeup didn't rub off.  In 100 degree Texas heat this product helped me stay flawless throughout the workday and on weekends by the pool.  I love that it is made with 18 plant extracts to help my skin and natural ingredients are preferred to keep me from having a breakout.
summary: This product was easy to use and made my wrinkles less prominent and kept my mineral powder foundation in place

reviewText: Great "keep your makeup looking great all day" product! At first I was skeptical because this is a thick formula that felt greasy between my finger tips. I don't need any more grease when wearing makeup. However, don't let that keep you away because as you apply it (and it disappears), it doesn't feel like anything. I worried about a break out with this because of the feel but did not notice any issues!

OMG, I must say that I absolutely love this primer and this has become my go to primer this month (I have 8+ primers - yes I love makeup). I have never used a face primer before and I was not sure what difference it makes. I put it around my eyes because I have the oiliest eyes and can't keep eye shadow or eyeliner on ever. I've not used a face primer before but I've thought about it for some time. This doesn't actually add any color, but provides a nice surface for the rest of you makeup. I'm very pleased with how this feels on my face.

It works the way it claims, making makeup last longer and helping it look nice. The downside is that it seems like a tube won't last long, so it could get expensive (but maybe this would be nice to use for occasions when you really need to look particularly good). reviewText:
Not everyone understands what a toner is for, so in addition to doing this review, I would like to summarize some of what toners are supposed to do, and whether this product fulfills that need.

WHAT IS A TONER FOR?
Here are a few things that toners are supposed to do:
-replenish skin after cleansing
-reduce size of pores
-hydrate skin
-remove traces of makeup
-prepare skin to absorb moisturizing creams and skin care

WHAT IS THIS TONER LIKE?
This toner is blue in color.  It has a slight fragrance.  It has a reducer top on it so that you pour it into a cotton pad or whatever, but with control.

WHAT ABOUT THE ALUM?
One of the ingredients in this toner is of concern to some people, so let's explore this.  The ingredient is potassium alum.  Potassium alum is a mineral salt.  It is used in food preparation, oral products, and as an astringent.  Some people feel it helps control perspiration, others do not feel it does.  This stuff is typically found on weathering rocks that contain certain minerals.  It is reported to have a very low level of aluminum in it.  If you are not wanting to use aluminum in any form, then this product is probably not for you.

HOW DOES THIS TONER PERFORM?
This toner is nice, but it is not the best I have ever used.  It does go on nicely, no alcohol feeling to it, no overwhelming odor, and a little goes a long way.  After applying to the skin, I do notice, however, there is a bit of a drawing feeling on the skin, which means it feels tight.  I have other toners that do not do that.  It could be part of the tightening sensation for the pores.  My skin is not dried out, it just feels a bit tight.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This toner cleanses remnants on the skin, tightens pores, soothes somewhat, but does contain potassium alum.  It is not the best toner I have ever used, but it is not the worst either.

THREE stars for this due to it having potassium alum in it.  I just don't think it is the best ingredient to add to a toner.  Also because it is nice, but not WOW.
summary: CAUTION-Performs Okay, But Has A Questionable Ingredient In It Which Some May Not Want To Be Using
