reviewText:
The packaging both box and bottle have clean clear lines. Even the plastic that draws up the perfume is so clear, you have to look closely to even see the straw.'
The bottle has a sweet little hang tag, and the cap fitted properly.
I do have a signature sent, an old favorite from Jean Patou ,Joy, and normally do not wear a perfume on a daily basis, as any sent, if you work in a garden attracts critters.
When the Toilette Burberry, The Beat was offered from the Vine program, I selected this  toilette,I find that in the evening, after bathing after the garden work, this is a refreshing, light and breezy in scent.  It does last a while as I can wake up to a nice fragrance.
I would describe the scent as a fruity, nature scent.  Clean and refreshing.
The one con would be the price for a toilette, I am used to high prices for a perfume and lower prices for a toilette.  Of course, time has marched on for this old crone and seems like all have given rise in prices.  For a special gift, for a special person, I would recommend this.
Recommended, I liked it.

I don't have a "signature scent"--rather, I love using a variety of fragrances to suit my mood as well as the occasion.  Although I usually prefer testing a new fragrance in person, the description of this Eau de Toilette suggested strongly to me that I might like it, as it mentioned notes of mandarin, Ceylon tea, white musk, and cedarwood, all of which I tend to like in perfumes.

With the name "The Beat" and the check-patterned bottle, I get sort of a preppy vibe from this fragrance.  However, the glass container is also sleek and modern, and I do like the cute little Burberry hang tag on the side.

I'm not an expert at describing fragrances, but I definitely like this.  Although other notes are mentioned in the description, the strongest ones I get are the white musk, a subtle cedarwood, and a citrus-y scent that must be the mandarin.  I find THE BEAT to be very reminiscent of CK ONE, although the later scent definitely has more powerful citrus notes.  But both also are subtle fragrant of tea, although the description of CK ONE purports to be green tea, whereas THE BEAT mentions Ceylon tea.  These two teas must be quite similar, as THE BEAT also reminds me of another green tea fragrance, Elizabeth Arden's GREEN TEA, which is much softer.

Overall, I am extremely pleased with this scent, which is perfect for daytime.  Furthermore, although I frequently wear CK ONE during the summer, I will now swap out with THE BEAT on occasion, especially when I want something a bit lighter.  Although the scent did fade slightly over time, it had excellent staying power--I could even catch whiffs of it on my skin the next morning.  The only (slight) negative I have to mention is that when I go to pick up the bottle, the cap slips off in my hand (the cap was actually loose in shipping as well), so a larger/more secure cap would have been nice.  In summary, if you enjoy the other scents I mentioned and like the type of fragrance I described, I would highly recommend THE BEAT to you.
summary: Subtle, long-lasting fragrance perfect for daytime wear

reviewText:
After trying Brit and having it be such a terrible disappointment, I was not sure what to expect with The Beat.  I tried it on both me and my teenage daughter so that I could have two different types of body chemistry to compare it on, plus two age differences too.

The bottle of The Beat is really cute and I like it better than Brit.  The top fits well and the little handle looking thing on it is a cute addition although I am  not sure it is good for anything but to look at.

1st stage
The first stage of the fragrance is a quick one so you have to smell it right away.  It is a beautifully invigorating explosion of pepper and spice, maybe cardamom?

2nd stage
The second stage shows up quite quickly.  It moves into a wonderful energetic fresh explosion of green and fruit with a splash of citrus.  That is my favorite stage.

3rd stage
The dry down goes to a great light summery fragrance which is fresh and green yet has a fruity fresh appeal of like peach, nectarine, and perhaps grapefruit.  It is subtle but definitely there.  This stage does not tend to last all day but I would say maybe six hours.  I don't mind in that the reapplication is another exciting explosion of scents and energy, so if it is not too inconvenient to reapply, I gladly do.

FINAL COMMENTS
This scent is a winner for me and my daughter.  We both wear this fragrance and love doing it.  It is rather ageless too.  I would say that any age would enjoy this as it does not seem to have itself pushed into one specific age group.  I would say it is a great spring and summer scent mostly.  I can not see wanting to wear this a lot in winter unless I needed a boost in the dead of winter.  It is quite invigorating.

I have a problem finding scents that don't turn sour on me, so this is a surprise that I could wear this as well as the Burberry Body Tender with no problems.  It is also unusual for me and my daughter to both be able to wear the same scent and like it.  Not only because of the age difference, but also because of the huge difference in our body chemistry.

I highly recommend this fragrance for summer as a fresh light energetic fragrance for all ages, but the key is to try it first and see if it melds well with your body chemistry.
summary: Invigorating Energetic Fragrance Perfect for Summer for Any Age

reviewText: For a long time I only wore BURBERRY Brit perfume, but I was intrigued by this new scent, The Beat. While I think I still prefer Brit, I admit that this one has grown on me. I have to be careful not to over apply, but it's light and like the tones that linger later in the day. Recommended!

Some time ago, my wife made me a gift of Burberry's French-made British cologne (or "eau de parfum," "water of perfume"), and it has become my favorite scent. So when I saw the new Burberry "The Beat" perfume for women, I thought I'd return the favor.

As usually with Burberry, the packaging is appealing -- which is important when you want your gift to be appreciated. The 50 ml. glass bottle comes in an impressive box, slightly oversize (5.5" tall) . The perfume itself is well padded inside, and the glass bottle is striking. It is printed in a pattern reminiscent of the "London" cologne check, baked on the glass. There's a pleasing style to the whole presentation, down to the leather and metal strap on the side (says "Burberry").

While perfume is all about how it makes you feel, it's the contents that truly count. For this, it is impossible to top the Company's own description: "intense and energetic scent with warm top notes of bergamot [the stuff that gives Earl Grey tea is distinctive aroma], cardamom [the Indian sweet spice], pink pepper and mandarin [citrus zest]. Heart notes of Ceylon tea, iris and bluebell add a floral texture. White musk, vetiver and cedar wood give depth to this sensual fragrance." Yummy!

(As usual with perfume, some reviewers didn't like the scent. We do. These things are certainly a matter of personal taste!)

My wife, who was already a Burberry fan, couldn't be more thrilled, so "The Beat" is a hit at our house.

Recommended!

A wonderful scent - lasts for hours! I really like the mix of scents in this perfume. I like the mix of white musk with some modern scents of bergamont and fiery pink pepper. I wear Burberry for those times when I want to change up from my usual perfume. I also like that the bottle has a nice sleek look to it. Makes a nice addition to my fragrance collection!

LOVE this perfume! I'm not into really girly, floral scents so this one is perfect for me. It smells just as good on my skin as it does in the bottle. If you want to smell great, but not like a fruit or a flower, this is the one.

Burberry is known for its trench coats and Burberry-checked scarves. When I saw this perfume, I just had to try it out.

The packaging of the bottle is very cool and does fit the brand very well. It looks great sitting on my vanity top, but unfortunately, I think that's where it will stay. Despite the cute bottle design, the top pops off too easily and the bottle is hard to grip with the Burberry signature tag in the way. Cute, but not good for actual use.

The Beat has a great summer fragrance that is part flowery and part musk. It's light but has a strong presence. However, it doesn't stay on the skin for very long, so reapplying is necessary. I've tried another Burberry fragrance and really did not like that one, but this one is pleasant. BUT - I wore this fragrance for two weeks and not one person commented on the scent (good or bad). When I had a girlfriend sniff my wrist after only a few hours, she could not detect the scent.

Cute bottle, nice try, but I won't be buying more.
summary: Cute bottle, but fragrance dies too soon.

reviewText:
I have always enjoyed the quality of Burberry trench coats, scarves and purses, so had a feeling this would be a great cologne.

And I was right! Not only does it come in an attractive, rather elegant bottle, but the aroma is also sensational. It smells like spring...  fresh, crisp, clean... Like new beginnings...  I love the spritely feeling I get when spraying it on my pulse points.

reviewText:
Burberry The Beat Eau de Toilette is a scent that has a lot going on. This complicated scent was launched in 2008 by creators Dominique Ropion, Oliver Polge and Beatrice Piquet. The Beat has top warm notes of Bergamot, Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Mandarin. These very spicy top notes stay quite predominant and give the scent a very masculine intensity. The middle heart notes contain Ceylon Tea, Iris and Bluebell creating a light floral fragrance. The bottom notes of White Musk, Vetiver and Cedar Wood give the scent a very sensual fragrance, yet quite masculine with it's very animal and woodsy aromas.

This is a scent that many Burberry parfum fans felt had too many hands in it's creation. Created by two men and one woman may be the reason there are so many masculine top and bottom notes and a very light middle of feminine floral scents. This is definitely one scent you should try on before buying it, if you are not certain how the stronger Spices, Wood and Musk scents will mix with your own body chemistry. I worked in a cosmetic factory for over half a decade and I know this is a very Uni-sex scent that someone like me who prefers a more feminine aroma will not like.

If you are familiar with Burberry Brit, this scent is very similar without the lime citrus notes. It is also quite similar to DKNY Pure. For myself, I like light-medium Oriental Floral made in Paris scents- Chanel No. 5, Chanel No. 5 Eau Premiere, Ecusson and Boucheron are some of my very favorites. If you like the same scents I do, you may not like the added masculinity notes of The Beat. For those who like a more complicated clean smelling Uni-sex scent, you will like The Beat. This scent is made in Paris and is packaged in a checked pattern bottle with a little metal and leather hang tag around the neck. Even though The Beat is not my type of perfume with it's masculine top and bottom notes, this 3 1/2 Star scent is overall nice and light with it's clean and crisp smell, with only one drawback and that is- it doesn't last a full 8 hour day. You will need to touch up after a half a day, as it is light and does fade.
summary: Clean Light Scent Of Musk, Wood, Spice & Floral

reviewText:
Burberry The Beat is not the greatest smelling designer perfume.  Yes, it has a nice, light, flowery scent, but it may be a bit too light.  I found myself spraying more than usual just to give off a slight aroma.  My number one complaint is that the scent does not last as long as other perfumes I have worn, meaning I would need to reapply during the day.  While this is not a scent I would wear often and would not likely purchase for myself, the product description says this has a youthful fragrance.  I would agree.  The light scent would make for a nice first perfume for a teenage girl, as it is not overpowering.

If you're looking for a fragrance that would probably go unnoticed. Burberry The Beat may be for you.  However, if you're looking for a scent that would garner compliments, I would try something else.
summary: Light and Flowery, But Just Okay

reviewText: I enjoy this fragrance very much. The seductive white musk is most noticable followed by the clean floral scent. I did not find that it faded quickly at all like some did; and I found this fragrance to be quite strong so I use only one spritz. It lasted for many hours and the husband loved it on me! I hadn't heard of Burberry before but I definitely will buy another bottle when I run out.

I wanted to try this new fragrance of the Burberry brand Eau de Toilette. I wasn't disappointed. The Beat has a very delicate fragrance, but it's almost a musky kind of smell, but with a little bit of a clean smell to it as well. The first day I wore it, my 24 yr. old daughter asked me what I was wearing. When I told her what it was, she immediately asked if she could borrow it. She has used this brand before, and is a big fan. I had never heard of it before, but am now a big fan as well.

This is a light, fresh tea scent.  To me it smells predominantly of green tea, with a slight fruity complement.  The green tea note is a true one, it smells almost exactly like dry green tea leaves waiting to be brewed.  I appreciate that this smells like actual green tea.  I've found that what often masquerades as a 'green tea note' in perfumes smells nothing like the real thing.  This one is the real thing.  The slight fruity complement makes it smell like a lightly flavored green tea.  This is a light, fresh scent that is easy to wear.  Unfortunately it does not last very long.  After an hour or two it's basically gone from my skin.  I've used both the EDP version of The Beat, and this EDT, and I like the scent of the EDT better.  Unfortunately, though, it does not have the staying power of the EDP.

I've found this to be a delightful fragrance that is not overpowering, yet lingers long after I've applied it.  It has a nice balance of spice, citrus, and floral so that it doesn't really fit into any of those categories.  It seems tailor made for summertime with its clean, fresh scent.  While advertised as "youthful" this is not a sweet or simple fragrance.  It's nicely layered.

It comes packaged in a clear bottle with a white design on the glass, a white cap, and a Burberry tag.  This would make a lovely gift.

This has hints of floral but not your grandma's floral perfume that is overpowering and just ..um..."stank".  This is a light fresh clean floral smell with a hint of sweetness.  I really love how it smells. I could stand there and sniff it forever.  However, on my skin type or chemical makeup the scent is not long lasting.  I get to work and the scent is gone. :-(  Everyone is different but trust me when I say this smells heavenly.

My wife and I were both very pleased with this scent, in fact it has become my wife's go-to daily wear perfume.

The perfume itself has a very pleasant and mild oriental scent, with great sillage and a delicious smelling dry-down.  There is some citrus and some floral, and the whole thing is nicely balanced and very feminine.

The perfume is pricey, but within reason for a quality name-brand.

Its rare that we both like a scent equally, so five stars from us!

The BURBERRY Touch for Women Eau de Parfum arrived in a stylish box that was ready for presenting it as a gift.  The bottle itself is simple but elegant.  My girlfriend, Tammy, loved the fragrance.  I tried a dab on my own wrist and approved it.  Tammy enjoys a sweet, soft fruity fragrance that is subtle and not overpowering.  She loves to wear it everywhere she goes:  work, church, and gatherings with friends and relatives.  It sprays easily and is a fragrance that lasts a long time.  Normally, she wears Halston Perfume.  Now she plans to alternate between the two fragrances.  It would make a great Christmas, birthday or anniversary present.
summary: She Will Love You For The BURBERRY Touch!

reviewText:
This is the second fragrance that I've used from Burberry and this is just as lovely as the first one. Burberry Touch comes in a cool box that is unique and the bottle itself is simple yet beautiful. I love the smell, I could smell the woody elements in it. Two small spritzes (one one each arm) were enough to last most of the day. It might be on the stronger side for some people, so I don't recommend going overboard with spraying yourself-a little will go a long way.

Overall, I'm very happy with this perfume.

Fruity, flowery, and woodsy are the words that come to mind in describing Burberry Touch. It is a fresh feminine scent that is natural without being overwhelming florid. It is hard to find a fragrance that lasts as it tones down after several hours of wear, but it seems as though Touch has it down.
I'm not a big perfume wearer because I find a lot of fragrances too heavy. Some make me sneeze and sometimes my eyes just water, but not this fragrance. Much like the clothes and accessories from Burberry that I have enjoyed for a couple of decades, this fragrance is modern and smart. It is subtle and nifty in that you can define the scent without it defining you. Unlike my mother's chosen scents, you can't smell this a mile or a block away. However, people do notice its pleasant fragrance and will comment on how lovely and serene it is.
I'm a outdoorsy type. I like to hit the woods and hike and I like the mix of flowers and plants. Touch is lovely and can fit in anywhere. The packaging is simple and modern. It is not your grandma's overdone idea of chic, but you will get noticed.

I am not a perfume fan. In fact, many years ago a gal was selling some in a parking lot and my husband was going to purchase me some for Christmas. I vetoed the idea. This is because I am sensitive to strong scents. There has only been a few perfumes that I have ever owned. I took a chance on this one. I was very surprised in a good way with this one. It is very light and not overwhelming at all. While all of the nice ingredients of: California orange, blackcurrant, fresh dewberry, subtle rose oil, jasmine, Madonna lily, tuberose, peach, raspberry, Cedar wood, oak moss and vanilla are nice but I can not smell have of the scents in this perfume. Which again while I would have liked to smelled more of these scents, this is also the same reason I like this perfume because it is light.

This bottle comes in a typical Burberry box. Nothing fancy, saving the dollars to go into the product instead. You will not be disappointed. This is a light fragrance, suitable for fall and spring with its floral base. A very nice blend which does not overwhelm. A dab does the trick for a full day or evening out. A very nice treat for yourself, or as a gift for a friend.
summary: You will not be disappointed. This is a light fragrance

reviewText:
I love the clean lines of the bottle for this spray-on perfume. I like the scent, too.

The smell didn't change much after I applied it, and it lasted at least five hours. To me it seems at heart like a more feminine version of a male cologne. I don't get a lot of floral or fruit from it -- more woody with a touch of vanilla. I think I'd describe it as powdery and a bit intense.  I asked my husband to describe it, and his best effort was "kind of musky."  My 14-year-old said it smelled like an elegant woman should be wearing it when she went out somewhere fancy.  It definitely is a smell with a presence, something I would wear when dressing up to go out. I'm not sure I'd wear it to work unless my office was fairly private or I knew for certain that my coworkers weren't bothered by it, because it's not a scent that can easily be ignored.
summary: Long-lasting woody scent for women who are going places

reviewText: The closest  perfume I can think of that this reminds me of is "Cashmere Mist", it is a very pretty light, powdery scent upon first applying but it changes to a more floral woodsy scent on me after about an hour. Perfume is such a personal preference type of item, it would be best to sample it first at a high end fragrance counter to see if it is one that you like/ love. For me it is Heavenly, a very feminine scent that I really, REALLY like!
summary: If you like Cashmere Mist you will love, Love, LOVE this!

reviewText:
This Burberry Touch perfume comes with a very elegant packaging, but I don't like the bottle design so much.

The fragrance smells very much like the traditional Chinese fragrance ( Flower Dew Water), which became popular in China since about 700 A.D. However, this Eau de Perfume is a little milder, maybe due to less alcohol content, making it smell more like a classier designer perfume.  The scent also lasts all day but is not overpowering.

I recommend it!

Smells pretty nice! I like it when my fiance wears this.

To my nose, I think it's a little pungent, but not overbearing.

This is the sort of thing you'd wear on a nice night out (not casually or at a crowded bar scene).
summary: Decent, I like it on her!

reviewText:
This arrived today and I couldn't wait to try it out.  It's a decent size bottle for the price and love that it is spray vs. splash on.

I liked the smell well enough but can't say I loved it. It's stronger than my current scent.  My husband loved the scent, and 2 of our 3 cats won't stop licking my wrist:)
summary: Not bad and nice size and packaging

reviewText:
I hate hate hate fruity fragrances--the sort that celebrities seem to make, and the common drugstore shampoo scent. I am not overly fond of most florals--I much prefer "mens" type fragrances like vetiver, leather, oak moss, spices (like cardamom and nutmeg) and sandalwood. This lands somewhere in between. It is definitely floral, and feminine, but not overpoweringly so. It doesn't scream "old lady" or "teeny bopper" either. It smells the most like the John Frieda Color Gloss, if this helps. The dry-down is meh. I love either a powdery iris dry-down or a sandalwood/musk/vanilla one, and this seems floral-ish to me.
It would be lovely to wear to a wedding, a tea, something like that, or maybe a date? Studies show men like the smell of desserts, so maybe better off choosing a vanilla scent?

Light and fresh scent. I enjoy it very much. To me, it's a softer feminine scent which wears well for the greater part of the day, for me from morning through the late afternoon. The scent becomes more subtle but is still there.  Choosing a perfume is very personal. I enjoy this one a lot and would purchase it again. I can't denote particular fragrances but the overall blend is very pleasing and not overpowering.

Living in the Bay Area of California for a time, my wife & I were always captivated by the smell of jasmine in the air.  It seemed to be everywhere and we always loved the fragrance.  This perfume has those same notes layered with orange and a touch of rose.

Best of all, it is not over powering yet it lasts and lasts.

Great stocking stuffer or a gift for any occasion.

I couldn't wait to try this perfume.  I love perfumes that have a clean as well as a woodsy scent.  This perfume has a light and fresh scent that is not overpowering.  I think that it is not the kind of scent that I will grow tired of any time soon.  It's got a really fresh appeal that I love and that suits me.

Of course we all know how personal choosing a scent is.  Someone else could really dislike this kind of clean uncloying scent.  I personally really enjoy it!  It does not overpower me and it seems to fade gently.  I use it at night after my shower so my sheets and pillow cases smell yummy, too!

I generally wear Ralph Lauren's Safari for women as my signature scent.  For "dress-up" I like to wear Yves Saint Laurent's Opium.  I was interested in trying Bruberry Touch for women because of the floral notes that are used in making it.  I discovered that it is a very light floral scent - nothing overpowering - just pleasant.  When I first put it on, it had a more pronounced scent but as the day went on it mellowed to a light floral that is just enough to awaken the senses.  It is a lovely scent and one that I will certainly add to my collection.
summary: Lovely light floral scent that mellows as the day progresses

reviewText:
This is a safe and easy fragrance created in 1998.  It has a clean powdery woody (cedar) scent with fruit and flowers.  Nothing is too heavy and it is fairly simple & doesn't change too much during the day.

It opens with a woody & vanilla note that quickly moves on to a fruity but not sickly sweet scent with peach, black currant and orange hint.  Then the flower notes with tuberose, rose, lily & lily of the valley.  None of the flowers are terribly strong but you do get a flowery feminine scent.  The wood notes last thru wearing, underpinning the fragrance & keeping it interesting & not cloying flower/sweet.

Burberry Touch is a cuddly feminine fragrance that is not the disgusting, overly sweet, frooty-tooty scents that are in so many bottles today.  I like this fragrance best in cold weather.

Buying perfume for my wife can be like walking through a field of land mines - she's *very* particular! But she loves this one! (much more than the BURBERRY Brit for Women Eau de Toilette). The scent is hard to describe - floral and light at first, but a second spray and it seems much stronger and richer, yet not overwhelming. Plus it lasts well throughout the day. After a number of misses, I'm just glad I found something she likes.

I had no experience with this scent prior to ordering the sample, certainly a risky move when ordering a personal fragrance. After several applications on various models, I must say, it's not to my liking at all. It's not to anyone in my household's liking, either. In a word, it's simply overpowering. It has that old person's scent strength of roses that I don't find appealing at all. My wife doesn't care for it either, for the same reasons; it's simply too strong. There isn't a hint of subtlety in the fragrance. When you factor in the price tag, you've really got to sample this before ordering. Go to your local department store and give it a go. Maybe you'll like it, but there are three women in my life (ages 45, 24, and 18) and not one of them cared for it. Neither my 19 year old son nor I care for it, either. That's all the evidence I need.

I used to wear Burberry Tender Touch (the one in the pink bottle) but they stopped making it years ago. Recently I tried Burberry Body and I love it but feel like it's really a summer only fragrance. My other favorite is Kenneth Cole Black for women. Burberry London for women is that perfect perfume, I can wear it every day. It's not chemical smelling, it's not overpowering, I never feel like I need to wear a certain outfit to pull it off. I love it so much I've moved the bottle from my bathroom to my nightstand so that when I put it on in the morning the scent hangs around in my bedroom all day. Buy it for yourself or for a gift without worrying about the season or your age, it's just wonderful for everybody!

What a beautiful unique fragrance!  I have been hearing about Burberry London on the beauty vlogs I subscribe to on YouTube and was so excited to get the chance to review. The scent is simply awesome.  It's a flowery warm woody scent that I can't get enough of.. And for once I have a fragrance that doesn't fade a hour after I apply..

I have been wearing for the last week, and hours after applying I can still smell..  I always hear about finding your "own" scent.. I have found it with Burberry London.. Its just the perfect "me" fragrance.. Totally in love..
summary: I have found my signature fragrance!

reviewText:
This BURBERRY PARFUM comes in a Burberry plaid box.  The Burberry/London logo is a glued on block.

When you pull the bottle out of the outer box there in an internal split sleeve that easily falls out of the way.  The bottle is covered with a textured cloth that makes it easy to hold.  The cap pulls off to reveal a sprayer.  You can see through the glass at the top all the way through the perfume through the bottom.  The perfume has a slightly pink tint and I like being able to see it so I can tell home much is left.  [Not needed now but in the future I'll be able know when to drop hints that mom needs some new scent.]

I love the scent.  It's not overwhelming but gentle flowery with strong hints of sandalwood and musk.  It took me a while of inhaling but I finally did recognize the patchouli.  Very nice done.  To me the scent is unique.  And I really like it.  It's warm and friendly and quite affordable given how much you get for this price.  I actually prefer this now to my Chanel 5.
summary: Lovely Scent That is Moderate in Tone -- Balanced and Not Too Flowery

reviewText:
I did a test with this perfume (parfum) with several of the girls in the office.  When I say this, I mean I went around to the creative peeps in the office and did the old school department store lady who squirts your whether you want it or not.  For the most part it was a hit.  Roz, Traci, and the new girl liked it and recognized it right away as a floral smell.  Laura was on the phone so her palm got it instead of the wrist.  She liked it though.  Jacque was also on the phone and didn't like me squirting her because she has so many allergies.  She said it was too strong and washed it off.  (I find this hard to believe because she does so many essential oils).  Then my BFF JSCAH came over to my pod and said, Okay, let me try it.  She said she could not smell it all the way over to her office, but she is sensitive to smells because shes pregnant.

Jacque did have a point because it probably was a little strong.  About 45 minutes after I tried it, I had a smidge of a sneezing attack.  I tried to stifle it as much as I could for what reason, I don't know.  Several hours after, it still smells on my wrist; little goes a long way.  It has a better smell after time and the floral does come out.

One of my coworkers, who did not want to try it because she already had perfume on, knew the brand.  She buys expensive stuff and I knew the price was high when she recognized it.  Sure enough, the Amazon price is a whopper at $92, but the bottle is quite large compared to some perfumes.  Im giving it four stars.
summary: A hit with my coworkers at work.

reviewText:
This is my first Burberry perfume and I love it. It has an intriguing and attractive floral scent. An initial rosy scent that opens up to a boutique of jasmine, and finally a base note of musk and sandalwood. Very pleasant and lovely.

This perfume appears to be quite long lasting. I could still detect a faint hint of it in the next morning. I also like the beautiful package that it comes in. A rectangular glass bottle that is wrapped in a classy checker fabric. It would be a lovely gift for yourself or your loved one.

I'm in love. That's all I can say - I'm in love with this perfume! I'm someone who doesn't wear perfume often - not because I don't like perfume, but because it tends to be tricky for me to find a scent that I not only like but that also works well with my body chemistry.

When I got this perfume I put a spritz on my wrist and rubbed and a spritz that I walked through. I wanted to make sure the scent was thoroughly on me to see how strong it was, if it was off-putting or if it wasn't too bad. Firstly, the scent was definitely not too strong. Every person that I came across I asked to smell my perfume. I wanted to see what their opinion was without me telling them how expensive the perfume was. Every single person sniffed my wrist and their eyebrows shot up. "wow - that smells REALLY good!" they all said! My husband, Mr. Cheapskate himself, took a whiff and immediately said that he loved the smell - then he started sniffing my neck to ask if I'd put any there!

I have now learned that you should ignore the price of something and go with what works for you. This perfume absolutely works beautifully for me and has enough of a scent that it smells amazing but not so much that it's cloying. I'm definitely a fan!!

I was not familiar with Burberry London, but I like its fragrant scent which is predominantly floral. It surprisingly lasts a long time while being neither overpowering or too much. It is just a soft and pleasant scent that is nice and perfect for me.
Since scent is a personal thing, my advice is go to a local store and sample before you buy. While I like this very much, everyone's body chemistry is different.

This is my first Burberry perfume and I really like it. When asked, I describe Burberry London as a subtle yet sinfully sexy scent. It is a lovely combination of florals (honeysuckle, peony, and jasmine to name a few) with a hint of sandalwood. I personally have found that it smells better the longer you wear it. In the morning, I spray a mist in the air and then walk through it. This prevents me from putting too much on or wearing it too heavily.

The price of this perfume is comparable to other high end perfumes/colognes. This 3.3 fl ounce bottle costs under $95, which if you use sparingly, should last awhile. Aesthetically, the bottle is simple and attractive. It is a slightly tinted glass bottle with the signature/iconic Burberry fabric wrapped around it. In conclusion, I am enjoying this parfum and would highly recommend it to those in the market for something out of the ordinary.

This fragrance for women comes wrapped in the signature Burberry check pattern fabric. I like glass bottles but the fabric wrap looks nice too, since it's iconic Burberry. I have the original Burberry as well as Burberry Brit and I like both, but love Brit. This fragrance is also a little more floral like Brit.

It is meant to embody the spirit of London - cosmopolitan yet alive with the history of the ages. Burberry markets it as the fragrance for an independent woman with relaxed confidence. It is subtle yet long lasting. Since I love Jasmine based fragrances, I really like this one. The Burberry original is more fruity, followed by vanilla and musk but this fragrance is more flora.

The top notes are rose, honeysuckle and tangerine. The middle notes are jasmine, peony, tiare flower, clementine. The base notes are musk, patchouli and sandalwood. The jasmine really leads, and is very noticeable, along with honeysuckle. The dry down is fabulous, as it's musky and oriental with the patchouli and sandalwood. Again, it's very long lasting, a great thing about Burberry fragrances, if you can get a genuine bottle. I am so loving this fragrance, I want to spray it and then sniff my wrists all day long. It's very lasting and I can smell it on my clothing even after a full day, makes me feel so sexy!

After 2 months of using it, I like it even more and more. I never thought I'd like London so much as I never cared as much for the original Burberry scent or even Burberry Brit although my daughter loves Brit as it works well with her cooler body chemistry. But this one has me hooked and it works magic with my warmer body chemistry, I have even women asking me what I am wearing and have noticed men turn around when I walk by them and they get a whiff. Something's working.

Some fragrance sites have it for half the price or less, which makes me very suspicious, but previously I have purchased fragrances from some of these sites and it has been the real thing, so it may be worth taking a chance. I have purchased fragrances from Amazon that turned out to be fake, so make sure you buy the bottle directly from Amazon as seller and not a third party seller.

Overall, a very nice fragrance, it's a good one for round the year. It also smells very classy, elegant and fresh so I really love it for work.
summary: Elegant, modern yet classic, and long lasting. Really, really love this fragrance!

reviewText:
My wife got a bottle for her birthday last year and loved it-it has been a staple in her own personal perfume department. She loves the hint of jasmine which she loves as well as the family. She puts it on and it stays with her for hours and every room that she goes into it smells that way for a long period of time which I personally love. Some of these perfumes/colognes seem watered down-they smell good at first but then disappear but not with this product.

Great London scent from the great Burberry!
summary: Great Scent that lasts a Long Time!

reviewText:
From the female of the family: some time ago I was perusing the cologne counter, looking for a special gift for my husband, and I came across "London Burberry." It was intoxication at first sniff! It's been my favorite thing to scent on my man ever since.

Recently I discovered that Burberry London has an Eau de Parfum for women as well. I thought I'd give it a try.

First comment. This is an entirely different scent than the man's version. When I first misted some on, I thought it might be a little too sweet or floral (probably the honeysuckle), but those "top notes" soon fade a little, and I really like the effect. I can't match the company's own write-up so here it is: "...elegant rose and a sweet heady blend of honeysuckle. Deep heart notes of tiare flower, jasmine and peony are uplifted with a whisper of fresh clementine zest. Solar notes of sandalwood, musk and patchouli...." I wasn't sure what "tiare" was, so I looked it up. It's probably better known to you as gardenia -- a fragrant tropical flower. "Clementine" is a type of tangerine, so that is the citrus. I was a little taken aback by the "patchouli": worn too heavily, that is the classic "hippie" scent of years ago. However, you'll probably be pleased to know, the patchouli is so blended, I can't pick it out.

I'm don't usually trouble myself with product boxing, but I do like the "whole package" by Burberry. If you are buying "London" as a gift, ladies, the box itself looks good - understated and yet expensive. It is printed in the "check" pattern of the bottle itself -- a harbinger of good things to come.

I don't like the women's version of "London" as well as the men's, but I do find it fresh and summery.

Recommended.
summary: French-Made Burberry London Perfume for Women

reviewText: This is such a beautiful perfume, it is quickly becoming one of my new favorites.  The primary notes are jasmine, honeysuckle, and mandarin, and it smells like a beautiful mix of the three.  The flowers really smooth out the orange notes, and I find it lasts quite a long time.  This is a scent that really captures the spirit of London.  It is both classic and new, much like the city itself.  This is a very feminine fragrance, well-suited to all seasons.  I love it.
Smells great

Received for Christmas, this is a flowery formulation that is perfect for an evening out. While I find it a bit heavy it is not really overpowering and used sparingly it creates a little mystery that lasts the whole night.
The main scents I pick up on are Bergamot, Lavender, and Thyme.
summary: A Little Heavy So Use Less To Balance The Flowery Fragrance

reviewText:
This fragrance launched in 1995 and became an instant classic with it's flowery and refreshing top notes, amber and musk base notes. I have been using it for 20 years, but not exclusively. I like to wear it in the evening in winters as it is a rather heavy perfume. It's a distinctive fragrance, almost instantly recognizable due to the Bergamot top notes, the sandalwood and mossy middle notes with a hint of geranium and the musky dry down due to amber. If fragrance could be defined as a mood, Burberry evokes sensual but practical at the same time. A woman who knows she's arrived. Some days I find it overpowering and other days I reach for it like an old friend.

Top Notes: Lavender, Bergamot, Thyme, Mint
Middle Notes: Geranium, Sandalwood, Moss, Cedar
Base Notes: Amber, Tonka Bean
summary: A friend for 20 years, still sensual but also still modern and relevant.

reviewText: I am really particular about any fragrance that I wear.  I don't like heavy scents and ones that are overwhelming.  This fragrance fits the bill.  It is a light scent that doesn't make you pass out from an overwhelming scent.  I have had comments of how pleasant the scent is and what the scent is.  I would highly recommend this scent if you are looking for something light.

This is a very well rounded women's fragrance that is both pleasant and inoffensive. Released in 1995, this fragrance has been around a while and with good reason. Some of the notes I manage to pick up throughout the day consist of lavender, cedar, sandalwood, and amber. The fragrance starts out a bit sweet and with the impression it might end up being too cloying on a hot, muggy day, but within half an hour the fragrance starts drying down into a more fresh, clean, dare I say "soft" aquatic sort of smell that lingers mostly unchanged for the rest of the day. This could easily be a year-'round fragrance. Because of its inoffensive nature, many might consider it more of a generic scent with nothing particularly memorable about it; but sometimes that's exactly what you want, especially if worn in a business setting.

This is a fantastic scent. It's not too sweet and not too musky. And it's not at all overpowering. This is a great scent to wear anywhere. The only reason I didn't give it five stars here is because of the price. I've seen it cheaper other places. I highly recommend this perfume. It also makes a great gift!
summary: This is a fantastic scent. It's not too sweet and not too ...

reviewText: Very pretty scent. I seldom wear perfume, but I do really love this fragrance. It is not overpowering, just sweet, and a little bit flowery with deeper undertones.  It still has a freshness to it, and does retain the same scent profile all day. I cannot analyze all of the fragrance elements in this perfume, but I can just say that it is a sophisticated feminine scent, and I do enjoy using it very much.

This is my first time using this perfume, and I like it.  The description seems accurate, as this is a complex scent.  The alcohol is a little strong at first, but it mellows quickly to a pleasant, all day wearing aura of femininity.  As with all perfume, you should smell it for yourself in person if possible; but if you can't do that, you can be assured that this will be an intricate enough aroma that you will find occasions for which you think it is perfect.  I like this one.

Burberry Eau De Parfum reminds me of being in a mossy, wooded place after a heavy rain.

There are layers here. A little sweetness comes through at first, and later it is mostly sandalwood with a hint of orange and a hint of jasmine that comes through -- on me, anyway.

Perfume is a very personal matter -- this is not going to smell the same on different individuals.
summary: Like A Walk In The Forest

reviewText:

I liked this just smelling it right from the bottle but it smells even better after you have it on for a bit because of your body heat.

I once read that men tend to like "food" kinds of scents on women like vanilla, lemon, etc but that women prefer florals/musks for themselves and with this scent you kind of get the best of both worlds. My husband thought this smelled wonderful and he probably only ends up liking about 3 out of 10 of the perfumes that I like.

This is a long lasting scent. I only did one spritz on the inside of my elbow and even after wearing for at least 6 hours, I could still smell it when I got back home. I think this bottle would last a very long time.

I am a 42 year old woman who has been shaving daily for 25+ years and recently switched to Proraso soaps & a brush from canned Barbasol. I started off with the Proraso green, which I loved, but wanted to try others and ordered the red and white soaps. My skin tends to be dry, and I thought the more moisturizing red formula would be a good fit. First, it has a fantastic sandalwood fragrance. Woodsy, warm, and spicy, but not overpowering. reviewText: Great smelling shave soap! If you like sandalwood scent you must try this one. Proraso has high ratings for a reason, they put out great shave products. I also use the sandalwood aftershave lotion and it is fantastic!

Ok before I start yapping about this product I know there are countless reviews about it, regardless of how many stars it is given, my review will have tips,  info about this product, and will have comparisons to other products that will help shine the light and allow me to share with you my wet shaving experience.
Without further due even if you're new to the wet shaving lifestyle if you haven't seen this product or it's brand before, in your grandpa's den, in your barber shop's counter, on the store shelves, anywhere ! Then you're on a different planet. This company from Italy set the bench mark for the wet shaving industry by just having a simple line and a number of products that can go head to head with known and luxury brands out there. Known brands from the likes of Gillette , Cella, mitchels wool fat, etc. and luxury brands like Aqua Di Parma, Penhelgon , Creed, Taylor of old bond street, Xpec and so on. It's accomplished this by its ingredients , performance, and the price it set itself on. It showed the world that you don't need to pay 100+ dollars worth of soap to get the best shave in your life.

Proraso red (that's what I call it) is a soft soap in a tub meaning there is no need to bloom it. For the people who don't know the blooming term, blooming is when you fill the soap tub with warm water in order to make an easier brush load, extract the essential oils present in the soap, and to intensify and bring to the surface the scent of the soap.
This soap is easy to load on any brush, also people who are new to the term brush type , I mean you can use a synthetic (e.g. Plisson) , boar bristle (e.g. Omega, semogue etc) , badger ( Seville row, paladin, Simpson , etc) or even a horse hair ( e.g. Vie long) brush. Barber shops prefer to use boar bristle for its convenience and longevity.
I usually load my brush for 30 seconds because that's what works with me. I also use the pre shave Proraso cream green which you can find the review of as well which will be published in a couple of days time.

The reason I would hold this soap dear to my heart is because of its scent. I will be direct, forget the earthiness, etc . Point is if you have never smelt this soap you can't pick it up by just reading what someone else decribed it even if it's spot on. Every nose is different. My spot on explanation to this scent is go to 'the art of shaving store' pick the sandalwood scent there and sniff it. Done! Why I told you to do this? Because you will realize the price difference. The Proraso red has the same yet toned down scent of "the art of shaving" sandalwood soap. It's not too strong and it's not too faint. It's there. Perfect balance. I personally think that The art of shaving sandal wood old formula soap is the best sandalwood soap made in wet shaving history period. So when I compare the scent of the Proraso to this other brand then you know you are getting the real deal.

The lather , even on the brush load is rich, rich is not the right word even, its thick and cushiony, this is the sign of great protection to the face. Not only that but the slickness this soap provides is amazing. Tip: if you want to judge the slickness of a soap while shaving; do a one pass with the grain, once you're done pick an area where there is no soap anymore on your face, dip your finger in water and run your finger on your face. You will be able to judge the slickness by how oily your face feels with the water. Usually this also means to the pros of shaving ( de or straights) that they are able to run the razor a number of times over the same area before moving on.

I usually do a three pass shave. Personally I love this soap because its performance is second to none on all the brushes I mentioned above, yes... I have all the different kinds listed. What to say I am a shave addict! The reason I say this is because I have used certain types of brands and they tend to have different results on different brushes. For example Taylor of Old bond Street cream tubs hit my soft spot with boar bristle brushes ONLY. You can see my review of the Sandalwood, peppermint, and grapefruit soon when I publish my reviews under Taylor of Old Bond Street!

I have to say one thing I sometimes have to re lather a spot of my face if I leave it sitting for a while. This sometimes happens to me when I am using a straight razor or a shavette because I have to be careful and work slowly to avoid slashing my face with the blade. I usually go for extremely thick face lather with Proraso, some people like a thin wet layer. If you're the thin wet layer person then forget what I just said lol.

All in all the value you pay to get the performance , and experience and protection of this product to your face is second to none. In my experience the only other comparisons you can get with the same price value are some artisan soap makers like Razorock soaps. You can also check my reviews that I will publish on these soon in the coming days. Thank you for reading and have a great shave.

Ps. The tub will last you long enough. I am a daily wet shaver , I personally like to change my rotation and have different tools of shaving every time. This enhances my experience and allows me to learn about other products and combinations. This is more than a hobby to me, it's meditation, and one that gave me pleasing pleasure of patience. I have to say Proraso never disappoints me and it's a must to be present in every gentlemen's den.

Shave on!
summary: you don't need to pay 100+ dollars worth of soap to get the best shave in your life.

reviewText: This is great stuff, but frankly, if you use a super high quality pre shave, and an excellent after shave balm, you'll be fine with a decent can of shaving gel like Aveeno, as long as you work it in well and the lather is real moist...and you're using a Smoothere or equal razor.

Proraso White soap was the first real shaving product I tried - about 3 years ago, right when I quit the razor cartridges for good and switched to double edge safety razors and straight edge. That remains my favorite scent and it motivated me to try other Proraso products and other soaps.

I have about every Proraso product at this point and their soaps and creams perform very similar to me (good), so other than that it's mostly about scent.

I was hesitatnt to try Proraso Red, because I thought I wouldn't like the scent (i.e. I don't like the smell of smoking incense or sandalwood burning). It turned out to be very pleasant and masculine - great for cold weather and it lingers well without any perfumes needed. The soap still has a classy "barbershop" scent, yet without feeling like an old geezer. Some people might still hate the sandalwood scent, it's just not everyone's thing. From whatever I could find this is the real essential oil of sandalwood and to me it smells pure, not "plasticky" like some people claim. By comparison, TOBS "sandalwood" smells VERY PLEASANT to me, even woody, just not really like sandalwood. Totally different products, both great.

I love it for the price and also use the Red preshave (use maybe an almond's size worth, rub in your wet palms, then apply to face, THEN apply your hot towel - that's the way it's intended).

I really don't like that Proraso changed their labels with the color of Italian flag. Not because it's the flag, but because it made some of the products hard to differentiate. The stripes are supposed to be like those on a barber pole. However, I only see that on Amazon, all of the products I receive have the old labeling, which looks classy.

NOW, where are the Red aftershave splash and balm? Hm? ;) There's rumors of a splash coming out in May and even a picture on their site.
summary: Proraso Red - my cold weather shave! Now, where are the Red aftershave products?!

reviewText: I am really impressed with this product.  It takes some time to use, but it is a once a week treatment, so I do it on the weekend. I am really excited about this product and I am going to look into other products by this brand.

reviewText: The StriVectinLabs 5-Minute Weekly Glycolic Peel is easy to use. Each bottle is clearly marked. It actually takes a bit longer than 5 minutes, as there is some prep work and cleanup work after, but it's really simple and easy to follow. The first time I used this, I think I slathered a little too much on. The second and third time, it got a little better. So far, I think the result are encouraging. This is a very expensive product, but given that it's a weekly use and you don't need much of it, I could see these lasting a very long time. Maybe a full year, but I don't know if they would start to lose their effectiveness at that time. Regardless, this is a nice addition to my weekly routine, and I will continue to use it.

I have been using this weekly peel for a couple of weeks now and I am impressed at how well it works. It did not irritate my sensitive skin at all (no burning sensation, nor the dreaded red face!) and left my skin nice and smooth. And because I use it only once a week, I'm seriously tempted to chuck my Lancome Genifique or Olay Nightly Micro peel. I am just sick of the multiple products (cleansing then the toner, then the micro peel., moisturizer....blah blah). Who has time for all this?!?! More power to you if you do but I just want to simplify my routine and this works.

So that I could do a good comparison, I used this on only one half of my face. After using it twice, one week apart, I didn't see any change in my skin at all, so I decided to step it up and used it again after five days - nothing. I used it again after four days, then three, and still no results. In addition, the detoxifying primer has red 33 and blue 1, and both the primer and the activator have fragrance which I don't like and which does linger. I find the addition of these ingredients unnecessary and annoying.

I've gotten amazing results with the [[ASIN:B00IONTP06 StriVectin SD Advanced Intensive Concentrate for Wrinkles and Stretch Marks, 4.5 fl oz.], and was hoping that the StriVectin Glycolic Peel would be just as amazing, so I'm very disappointed that it didn't work for me. Based on my experience, I can't recommend this product.

I've seen different Strivectin products for wrinkles before, but have never tried any of them.  Being 68 years of age I feel that my skin could really use some help.  I like the idea of reducing the appearance of wrinkles and having luminous skin that glows!  Did I actually see these results?  Yes & no.  My skin does feel very smooth and makeup does glide on very easily but I don't see a youthful glow after a few weeks of use......maybe with continued use the wrinkles will become less visible & my skin more luminous.  I like the ease of use of this product & Instructions are very clear.  I like the fact that dead skin cells are removed during the process, that does cause my skin to look fresher.  I will continue use & see what future results will be and then decide if I will buy this product.

The proprietary and Trademarked ingredient NIA-114 in this StriVechtinLABS 5-Minute Weekly Glycolic Peel was invented by two biochemists searching for a cure to skin cancer. NIA-114 is a unique and patented technologically advanced form of Niacin that nourishes the skin surface to address multiple visible signs of aging and give skin a more healthy and radiant appearance. This product contains 5% NIA-114.

This 5-Minute Weekly Glycolic Peel, with powerful glycolic acid, alpha hydroxy acid and NIA-114 indicates it will revitalize, hydrate, and transform skin.

Instantly, it declares it will: enhance luminosity and radiance for a youthful glow, help improve skin clarity and smooth the skin surface so that makeup application is easier and more even.

After four weeks, it declares it will: diminish the appearance of lines and wrinkles, refine skin texture, leave appearance of pores less prominent.

I've been using this for about four weeks (3/27 thru today 4/26). I've used the product five times. This is a two-step process: 1) Detoxifying Primer and 2) AHA Activator. I definitely feel a tingling sensation during use, and that's okay and to be expected (it's potent and it's working). I only used this on certain areas and I would say that where I've used it, my skin texture is slightly improved and pores appear slightly less prominent. Lines and wrinkles appear about the same.

I find the "sunburn alert" precaution inconvenient. Because of the AHA in this product, there is a "Sunburn Alert." AHA may increase your skin's sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of a sunburn. A caution on the box suggests that you use sunscreen and limit sun exposure for a week after using this. If you're using this product once a week, as suggested, you will have to continuously limit sun exposure. That's very difficult to do.
summary: Potent Two-Step, Five-Minute Glycolic Peel / Watch Sun Exposure After Use

reviewText: I used this according to the instructions and I'm not sure I will be able to continue using it. It made my face extremely red and irritated. The second try was about 10 days later with the same results. Maybe not quite as severe as the first time. My skin does feel a bit softer so I may continue using it but not as often as they suggest.

I'm in my early 30's and lucky enough to have very few wrinkles. Unfortunately, I also have somewhat oily, acne-prone skin, which makes trying new products a bit tricky (I never know what I might have a reaction to!) The first time I used this, I was wary, so I didn't apply it all over my face. I used it sparingly on my forehead, between my eyes (where I have a little wrinkle from too much scowling!) and on the outer corners of my eyes, where I have some darkening skin. Of course, I would recommend caution when using around your eyes! After I washed it off, my skin felt taut and more refreshed.

The second time I used it, I applied a bit more. It's an easy two-step process. You apply step 1, wait a minute, then apply step 2. I'm happy to say it didn't cause a bad reaction on my sensitive skin. In fact, I feel like my skin looks very nice after using it. It looks youthful & dewy and feels very soft to touch. I don't know if it has any long term effects and I can't really say if it's diminished that dreadful wrinkle between my eyes, but I did see some results immediately after using it.

On the box, it says there might be some tingling. I didn't really experience that at all. For me, the process was painless and pleasant.

For the most part, I was happy with the results I got and was impressed by how refreshed my skin felt after using this!

For a long time, Ive been wanting to use a product like this so I can do some skin treatment at home.  My impression so far is that I think this may not be aggressive enough to produce much of a noticeable effect unless it is over a much longer period of time. I've only had it for about three weeks.  I haven't observed any redness inflammation yet and no irritation either. I think my skin is still fairly resilient despite its 71 year age.  After I apply the two-step product, it leaves the skin very shiny. Without any effort, I can see exactly where the lotion was applied.  It is kind of an unusual appearance in fact. Im still not quite acclimated to the end result.  Sometimes I wonder if it is a good result or a mediocre result or an unnatural appearance.  I think Ive got to use it much longer to make a determination.  But for certain, I don't think it is a bad result.  And it is doing something.  A lot of products don't seem to do anything.

I have only one light colored age spot and it has ever so slowly increased in size over the past half dozen years. The dermatologist said it is nothing about which to be concerned - rather normal for a person in their early seventies. So I think maybe this two step process might give it a lighter color eventually. I think it will take a long time, so no reason to predict any outcome at this time.  Otherwise, I have lots of fine lines around my eyes from squinting and forehead wrinkles from frowning, but far less than other people my age. I so regret not wearing sunglasses in my lifetime.  Eye wrinkles are almost exclusively caused by squinting. In fact nearly all facial wrinkles are avoidable if we just avoid frowning and squinting and even excessive smiling. I didn't know this in time, so now it is damage control that I must do.

I'm extremely cautious about putting this product anywhere near my eyes.  I am surprised there aren't any warnings I could find about using this in proximity to eyes. Maybe its just common sense to stay away from our eyes.  That is best left to a professional such as a plastic surgeon except they charge so much money.  I actually underwent an acid peel just after I turned 60.  The doctor put some eye shields onto my eyes and pulled my eyelids over it to protect my eyes.  And, of course, he sternly warned me not to open my eyes in the slightest. He applied a moderately strong acid for 15 minutes feathering out the acid to avoid a demarcation line.

The first three days it looked like I had a very severe sunburn.  I didn't go out because it was really obvious that it was only the area around my eyes that was deep red in color. And then the skin started peeling off just like a severe sunburn. Naturally the area was moderately swollen from blood rushing to repair all  the skin damage.  It really worked well for about two weeks except for the redness.  The wrinkles were gone, but it was mostly because the area around my eyes was mildly swollen which stretched out the skin and naturally the wrinkles, too.  After a few months, the skin was already returning to its original state, wrinkles and all.  But the new skin was definitely better than before the treatment.  After a year, the procedures effects were completely gone.  That cost me $700 and that was 11 years ago.  This product isn't cheap either.

 I have a fair number of neck wrinkles that are beginning to annoy me, but none that are deep. So that's one particular area where Im using this product. Its still too early to make any claims. I have to write this review now because it is a requirement of the Amazon Vine program.

Recommendations:

If you are still young enough, the very best thing you can do to avoid future wrinkles is to stop making so many facial expressions, wear sunglasses and stay out of intense sunlight.  Keep your skin hydrated with lotions and drink lots of water to avoid dehydration from the inside. When your hair turns gray, color it.  That alone will knock off a lot of years. Dont become overweight.  Of course, never smoke. Alcohol in moderation or not at all. So when you look into the mirror, you will see a younger person and that just might motivate you to do the other things to avoid aging so fast.  I did a fairly good job of some of those recommendations.  People are genuinely surprised and oftentimes shocked when they learn my age.  Ive had to show my ID to get my senior discount several times or get my benefits.

I think this may be a good product if you plan to use it regularly and for the long term.  Nothing magic is going to happen overnight or even the first month. The best thing to do is prevention. Otherwise, you have to do damage control and it is never as good as prevention.  I will update this review as time progresses. Im giving it a 4 star rating just because I haven't owned it long enough to make a fair conclusion or recommendation.  I refuse to exaggerate reviews or knock a product down without making a fair scientific test. Everybodys skin is different, so you can expect a lot of variation even if everybody follows the directions exactly the same.
summary: Off To a Good Start - But Too Early to Make Conclusions

reviewText:
Immediately following use, complexion has a healthy natural glow.
Skin appearance starts to improve with the first time used.
Pores start becoming smaller and smile lines around the eyes start to diminish.

The product feels slightly tingly, which isn't an issue and doesn't last long.
Our daughter has used this before on her sensitive skin without issue.
She was happy with it and believes it works..
Leaving skin well exfoliated, with a clean natural shine.
But more importantly,  an over-all blending of tighter, more vibrate skin, fainter lines.

Step one - Helps detoxify skin, and is preparation for application of step two
> Dispense a quarter size amount in palm, with fingertips, apply uniform layer over clean face.
Leave sit for 1 minute, Don't remove. Apply step two on top.

Step two - Is an excellent exfoliating treatment.
> Dispense a quarter size amount in palm, with fingertips, apply uniform layer over detoxifying primer.
Leave for 3-5 minutes, remove with damp towel and rinse with warm water.
ALWAYS USE TOGETHER > For best results use 1-2 times per week.

Even at Costco, which happens to carrier a couple StriVectinLABS anti-aging products,
this brand is fairly expensive. ($90.00-$100.00)

PRODUCT STATEMENT > As close to anti-aging treatments as you can get with out the dermatologist.
Contains 5% NIA-114 - 10% AHA Acid & 10% d'adide AHA

This is not an effective glycolic acid treatment. I was suspicious when I saw the ingredients: the "primer" has baking soda as a main ingredient. So you're layering an acid over a base. What's the point?
I tried this on my face and, to do a better comparison, tried it a few times on one hand. Sure, skin felt softer immediately after treatment: there are moisturizers in the mix, so it's got the short term softening effect of any skin mask. But that faded within hours, and over a couple of weeks I could see no difference between the treated or untreated hand.

This product doesn't work. You can find effective glycolic acid treatments for far less.

I have to say I am really quite impressed.  I have used many chemical peel products in my time including prescription Retina A as a teenager.  I have also used various strengths of Glycolic Acid ranging from 5% to prescription strength 30%.  This amount of 10% is "just right"--just enough to make you peel, but not so much that it leaves you red and flaky.

I am an ingredients nut and I for the most part like to know what I am putting on my face.  I saw an ingredient Myristyl Nicotinate and looked it up.  Apparently this ingredient helps protect skin from skin cancer.  That is very thoughtful of them!  That is not to say that there are not any chemicals in this product, but there are some natural ones as well including Aloe Leaf Juice, Myritilus Fruit Extract, Willow Bark Extract, Sugar Cane, Orange Fruit Extract, Lemon Fruit Extract, and Sugar Maple Extract.

The process is quick and easy and the product does not have any scent for those who are sensitive to fragrances.  It is a 2 step system: 1) Apply the detoxifying mask and leave on for 1 minute, then 2) Apply a thin layer of the Activator (Glycolic Acid) and leave on for 3-5 minutes (I went for the full 5 minutes).  Then, wash it off with a damp washcloth.  That's it!

The instructions say to use it once a week, and I really would not use it more than that.  From the first moment of application you feel it "tingling".  Then after you wash it off, you can feel it working.  Day 2 my skin felt sensitive but no peel yet.  By day 3 I was able to slough off a think layer of dead skin cells with a loofah in the shower.  Unlike Retina A, you do not continue to flake and peel during the day.  Afterwards I did see a significant difference in my skin.  It felt more taught and the fine lines were diminished.  This one for me is a home run!

I like this product very much.  It is extremely easy to use and actually works on contact.  The first step is putting on a small layer of product #1 on your freshly cleaned face.  It is a thin gel like product that goes on easily.  Leave that on for about a minute/two and then apply the #2 product, more of a cream on top of the first coat and leave on for 5 minutes.  It can be left on for only 3 minutes, but to be honest, I always leave it on longer because I am usually brushing my teeth or getting dressed while doing this.  Ok, then, just remove by rinsing with warm water or using a damp, warm cloth.  Done.  I have sensitive skin so I made sure to do this 3 times prior to this review just to make sure it didn't adversely affect my skin.  Happy to say, all is well and beautiful.  My skin looks good.  I have always used only coconut oil as a moisturizer and I continue to do so.  Once a week I use StriVectin 5-Minute and then apply coconut oil and off I go.  I will continue purchasing this item.

This product has a two part application process. The first tube's material comes out as a cream, perhaps a little thicker than good hair conditioner. It has no particular scent, applies easily with a finger, and then is left in place for about one minute. Atop that, you place the product from tube two. This material is a clear gel that goes on a bit thicker than the first. The combination is left in place for 3-5 minutes. It is then easily removed with a wet washcloth. My skin, which is quite dry in the winter, feels soft and clean after the process. There is no greasiness or dryness. While the product is called a "peel," this is not a mask with strong exfoliation, nor do you so peel it off after time has passed; your skin will not be irritated or bright red at the end. Feel free to use this in the morning or evening once or twice a week. I did not find it to be drying or otherwise annoying during the 3-5 minute wait time. Overall, after two weeks of use, I've found the product a helpful addition to my washing regimen.
summary: Easy to apply and remove. Great results.

reviewText:
I have been really stepping up my facial routine because Im in my mid-40s. I have been using a 10% AHA acid exfoliator for a little while and I can already tell that my skin is looking better. My pores are tighter, cleaner and my skin looks smoother.

I have always heard great things about StriVectin Labs products, not just reviews but clinical studies have reported good things. I was very excited to try the StriVectin Labs glycolic peel. It interested me because it is 10% AHA acid which was recommended to me by a skin specialist but also claims that it is quick and gentle. I have pretty dry skin so although I want a thorough exfoliation to reveal better skin, I don't want something that is going to dry out or irritate my skin.

The StriVectin Labs glycolic peel comes as a 2-step process. You get 2 tubes of good sized product; each tube is 1.7-oz. According to research, products that comes in tubes or pumps are better for skin care because active ingredients start to break down and become less effective when exposed to air. Open jars can also allow bacteria in so the tube application is good.

Step 1 is a detoxifying primer. You apply on a clean face and allow to detoxify and prime your skin for 1 minute. Do not rinse. Immediately follow with step 2.

Step 2 is the AHA activator. You apply over the primer that you already applied from the first tube. You leave on for 3 to 5 minutes. Rinse off when time is up.

It was easy to do and I didn't find anything unpleasant. AHA can produce stinging, especially if you have any broken or irritated skin but nothing unpleasant.

Results: I have to say that I am very impressed. Although I have already been using a 10% AHA exfoliation, I think since this sits on the skin in a thicker mask that it really kicks up the exfoliation process. My pores pushed out things that I didn't even know were there. Ive had small places on my face that weren't quite blemishes but were small raised areas. Later in the day, these places had pushed out grease and dirt. That is saying a lot since my older, very dry skin doesn't seem to produce enough oil any longer to really keep my pores cleaned out on their own.

It says that you can use 1 - 2 times a week for best results. Im using twice a week and will continue to do so. My skin looks better than it has in awhile.

Just wow! I have never used any of the StriVectin products before, so I had an open mind and no real expectations when I started using this weekly peel. After all, all these types of beauty and skin care products claim to improve your skin, reduce the appearance of wrinkles or blemishes, etc etc etc. I have yet to find one that actually lives up to the hype, until now.

 It's a pretty simple three step process. 1. Apply the first cream in a thin layer on your face. 2. Apply a layer of the gel over the cream on your face and wait five minutes. 3. Wipe off with a damp towel and rinse. This is easy and fast. AND IT WORKS!! There hasn't been any irritation or breaking out after using this system. The first time I did have a bit of tingling sensation,  but that passed quickly. There has not been a repeat of that in subsequent use either. After three treatments, I have seen a slight smoothing overall in my complexion and a friend commented yesterday at lunch about how great my skin looks. She said I just look brighter.  With no make up on. That alone means I will continue to keep this StriVectin peel in my closet and part of my beauty regime on a regular basis.
summary: Really does work to smooth and brighten your complexion, super easy to use

reviewText:
I've used this for over 3 weeks now with no results noticed.  I like the clean smell of the product, but that's the only positive thing I can really say about it.  I already exfoliate my skin almost daily, so perhaps this product is for someone that doesn't care for their skin as much as I do already, but minimal steps to take care of your skin does not have to cost a fortune.  Drugstore exfoliating products work as well as the expensive ones,  in my experience.

This set contains two products to be used simultaneously, starting with the first step, which is a detoxifying primer.  After this product is applied, you wait one minute before applying the second step, an AHA activator, on top of the first product still on your face.  The second application is kept on  for 3-5 minutes, then you rinse it all off.

I experienced some slight burning, which is listed as normal on the packaging insert, and some redness each time I used this set.  My face feels soft, but it always does after exfoliating my skin.  Perhaps there is a bit of puffiness, which might be confused with a reduction in lines, but I am not convinced puffy is better than non-puffy.

My face feels kind of sore and raw after each treatment.  It does not feel tight, but feels sore.  I experienced discomfort around my nose and  where my glasses rest.  I am not considering these to be positive side effects of the Glycolic Peel.

I can't see any advantage to using this product.  Again, daily exfoliation with drugstore brand facial scrubs seem to have pretty similar results.
summary: Not Seeing Any Difference In My Skin

reviewText: This peel comes in 2 tubes, both 50 ml/1.7 oz (so it is a fairly large size with sufficient product to use for months).  The directions said 1-2 times per week.  My wife gets monthly facials, and uses retinol and Hydroquinone skin bleaching creams (she is 52 and has age spots due to sun damage), so her skin is used to harsh peeling agents.  This product requires application of Step 1, the detoxifying primer (a thick cream) that you leave on for one minute, and then Step 2, the AHA Activator (glycolic and other AHA acids to slough away dead skin cells), which is a gel that you leave on between 3-5 minutes.  The product carefully warns users to never use either Step 1 or Step 2 alone - always together.  My wife followed the directions carefully.  It is easy to apply, although time consuming.  She left it on for 5 full minutes (in light of her skin that is used to peels), and  - Nothing.  No tingling.  No exfoliation.  Nothing.  It has a pleasant odor, and feels fine on the skin, but in the end my wife did not notice any difference.  For a product this expensive, you would hope for something; however, I acknowledge that my wife does a lot of peels that are medical grade, and perhaps if you don't do that your skin would be more susceptible to this peel.
summary: It Did Not Really Do Anything For Skin Used To Medical Grade Peels

reviewText:
Vichy describes the LiftActiv as having the highest concentration of retinol of all of its products.  I've used retinol in the past, so I was very careful to apply generous amounts of SPF after applying the LiftActiv.  I've been using the product for about a week and have noticed that while it smelled great and felt nice on my skin, after days of use my skin was red and much more sensitive.

The instructions say to apply the retinol every morning and then to apply SPF.  It might be too strong for me to use everyday, either that or my skin is taking some time to adjust to the strength of the product.  I've decided to use it once every 3 days -- to take some time off from the product and see how my skin feels.

I don't have many wrinkles, but a few are forming around the mouth area.  Ive been impressed with other Vichy products, and thought this might help.  The box touts, instantly skin appears dramatically smoother and plumped and in eight weeks youthfulness is visibly improved.  My first application burned and shortly afterwards my upper lip area resembled something akin to using a bad hair removal creamred and patchy skin.  I was glad I had no plans for the day.

This is the first time I've used a retinol productis this to be expected?  Even worse, that area looked even drier and tighter as the day went on.  I didn't think my skin was sensitive, but Im afraid to try this product again.  I followed directions, used it sparingly and applied to a clean face.
summary: First Application Caused Redness And IrritationNot The Look I Want

reviewText:
I'm a big fan of Vichy's skin products, but this one isn't quite as effective as the other products I've tried. It's good rather than great. After several weeks use, I find the results ok but not spectacular. The packaging says that your skin will appear dramatically smoother and plump. I do think it's helped with smoothing my skin, but I haven't seen the plumping effect.

The lotion is very moisturizing. Combined with the Vichy Aqualia serum that I apply first, this lotion has kept my skin from getting even the least bit dry during winter. The lotion is very gentle and hasn't irritated my sensitive skin at all. It's not greasy and it's absorbs very quickly. It's very rich and it takes only a small amount to cover my face and neck.

I like it enough to keep using it for now, and I'm curious to see how the effects will be after 2 months or so of use.

I have other Vichy products that I really like, all five stars, but this one fell short of the mark. The claim is that it "Visibly fills wrinkles & expression lines; Instantly smoothes & plumps skin". I purposely used this on only one side of my face, so I could see if it made a difference, and it did not. There was no difference between the two sides of my face even after repeated uses. I've been using other wrinkle reducing products for a few years now. Maybe my wrinkles are so fine that this product doesn't affect them, but there wasn't any plumping either.

While a month is really to short to verify lasting effects, this does seem to have a very nice immediate effect on appearance (as does any good moisturizer).
