The instructions say to apply in the morning with a sunscreen, but I found daytime application to be too drying for my dry and somewhat sensitive skin. I later read that dermatologists strongly recommend against daytime use of retinols, even with sunscreen, as they enhance the damaging properties of uv exposure, but they're very safe and effective at night (still use sunscreen in the day when using this product, as it will increase your overall uv sensitivity). After I switched to night use, combined with a good moisturizer (but not an anti-aging moisturizer, because I want to get a sense of whether this is working on its own), the dryness and sensitivity disappeared.

This spreads and absorbs really well, so a little goes a long way, but you do need a normal face cream aw well, since it's a targeted treatment and not an overall moisturizer.
summary: Gentle enough for sensitive skin if used at night with another cream

reviewText:
I love this cream so far. It has not irritated my skin, which other retinol products have done. I always apply an SPF moisturizer over it. It does seem to be helping with fine lines; at least on a temporary basis. With continued use it does smooth and plump the areas you apply it. I love that it's lightweight and doesn't feel heavy or greasy on my skin.

For some reason the tube was really hard to open, and I felt inept until I saw a couple of other people had the same problem. TIP: As with all metal tubes, start squeezing from the crimped end even when the product is full, otherwise it will be impossible to get all the product out later on!

This Vichy product claims to instantly minimize wrinkles. My wrinkles are finer rather than deep, and if this claim is true, I should have noticed a difference during repeated trials. I did not. The serum has a smooth, silky texture, and moisturizer goes on over it very nicely. Persistent use didn't obscure any wrinkles. I feel the company overreached their claims. Perhaps that is why they discontinued this product and it is no longer available on Amazon.
summary: Product does not live up to claims.

reviewText: I generally have very good luck with retinol. It plumps up the face, it manages to moisturize, reduces fine lines....and all of that happened when I used this product. This is probably the third or fourth product I have used by Vichy, and an unfortunate side effect, at least for my skin type, has been clogged pores.  I have very large pores, combination skin, that is typically sensitive to harsh perfumes.  I get the plumping, the fine line reduction, a nice balance of moisture, but my pores start to look pretty scudzy by day three of use.  Then I need to do a quick exfoliation before problems begin.  This might just be typical of my skin type.
summary: Nice results, but not for my skin type

reviewText: It's true, I do look younger!  (Insert happy face emoji here)  My wrinkles look plumped up and less noticeable and the deep lines that framed my mouth are almost gone.  For someone over 55, that's pretty awesome.  I will definitely buy this again.

I've tried quite a few products that promise to reduce wrinkles - most of the time they turn out to be pretty good moisturizers, but the wrinkles? Still there. With this Vichy LiftActive Retinol, the real surprise is that it works. Not instantly as suggested in the Amazon writeup - but after 5 days of usage my deepest wrinkles (my "smile lines" and the creases on my forehead) are visibly diminished. They are not completely gone, but they've filled in enough that folks who know me have commented on it. So I'll give this product high marks for that. I'm taking off a star because the smell lingers and isn't particularly pleasant, and because my skin feels a bit greasy when I'm using it.  I have not had any other adverse reactions to this treatment - no rashes or soreness or other side effects.  I guess I have the right type of skin for it!  After trying it out, I'm tempted to try the version they have for the sensitive area around the eyes too!
summary: The real surprise is that it works - my wrinkles aren't gone, but they are visibly diminished, and folks have noticed!

reviewText: seems to take the wrinkles out a little bit but certainly not worth the cost. got same results from less expensive products. results last a few hours, little longer so you have to re-apply often. just an ok product. hard to get out of tube initially.

Let me first say that my wife experienced no burning with this product and we also had no problems with the tube it came in.  So, I can't confirm that the products "burns" or has a defective case..

Naturally, these type of products try to make your skin look better, but it is a temporary solution - not permanent.  If you like it, you will have to continue to buy the product which can be relatively expensive.

My wife says that it does work well and makes her feel better about her skin.  I guess that is worth four stars!

This is a faintly scented, softening and smoothing cream.  I had a hard time getting it out of the tube at first and needed to stick a long pin down into the tube before any of the white cream would come out.  It turns transparent when I put it on my skin.  This leaves my skin very soft feeling.  I still see wrinkles and the tone and texture has not changed, but it is much softer to the touch.  I will continue to use this to see if the benefits are cumulative.  So far it's not impressing me much.
summary: Average skin cream, softens the skin

reviewText:
When I first received this, I tried to twist off the cap and it came apart in two pieces. I then saw that the tube itself had a foil seal, so I pierced it with a fork.  There are no instructions explaining how else to do this.

I spread a little of the formula on the back of one hand to test the consistency. It's very light and absorbed easily. However, my skin began to sting and burn.  It wasn't severe, but it wasn't subsiding either.  I don't have sensitive skin, especially not on my hands, so this was problematic. On the other hand (no pun intended), the skin immediately looked great. I mean REALLY nice and youthful.

With great trepidation, I applied the tiniest bit to a small area of my face, next to my mouth.  Sadly, it burned, and I had to wash it off.

If you've used other retinol products before, this might be a good step up. However, it might be too strong for a new user.

I've used a prescription retinol that irritated my skin if I used it too often, but the results were undeniable.
This product works almost as well, without the irritation.
One word of advice, however, a little goes a long way. More is not always better.

A tiny bit has really softened the 'marionette' lines running from nose to chin.
Miracle? No. One of the better facial products? Absolutely.

Used it sparingly, and my skin isn't especially sensitive, so no reaction. Skin looked better but not dramatically within a few hours. Goes on easily - creamy but not  greasy. Just used it for a short time because I wanted to get this review in; I'll add a comment if I change my opinion.

And it IS hard to open, hence 4 stars! I finally figured out it works like the flea product for the dog: punch down with the cap and it clicks through. At least that's what I think. Definitely needs instructions!

UPDATE:  After about 10 days of steady use, I did find that this irritated my skin somewhat, as retinol products are prone to doing. I have changed to using it every other day and am still seeing positive effects.  Happily, this means the product will last me twice as long.

I was eager to try this, but really kind of hoped I wouldn't like it, since I wasn't eager to routinely add an expensive face cream to my skin care.  Turns out, I like it a lot.  My skin is fair and tends to be sensitive, but I have not had any of the burning or irritation others have reported; this must be just the right combination for me.  There is no sunscreen in the product, so one needs to layer it with either a sunscreen or a moisturizer containing sunscreen.

In just a few days' time, my skin is noticeably smoother.  It's too soon to tell whether it will have any real effect on my wrinkles, but it has made enough difference to my skin's texture that I will keep using it.  Note that this tube is about as big around as a lipstick and not a whole lot taller; it's only an ounce of product.  Fortunately, it's a light formulation and a very small amount goes a long way...long enough to let me save up for my next tube, I hope!
summary: Oh no!  I really like it.

reviewText:
I got this product to fill visible wrinkles.
The product uses concentrated Retinol + LR2412, also known as sodium tetrahydrojasmonate which comes from the Jasmine plant.

While I have had success with other Vichy products, this one caused a skin reaction and caused me to break out.  After discontinuing use for 1 day the skin cleared up.

I don't know which component of this formulation causes an issue for me but I won't be using it again.  Oddly, this product is allergy-tested, non-comedogenic and suited for sensitive skin.

At any rate, the product goes on easily and absorbs readily.

I am reducing two stars for the reaction which I haven't gotten with other products in this category.
Not bad for wrinkles, but it irritated my skin a bit the first time I used it. I don't plan on using it anymore.

I've been putting this lotion on every night before I go to bed for about two weeks now and my hands feel great. I'm afraid that they are the driest and most roughened body parts, due to constant washing, so in dire need of moisturizing.  Within moments of application, my skin absorbs the lotion, without leaving any greasy residue. I also love the lavender scent - which is very soothing, especially at night. One thing I don't like is how the container seems to dispense too much. I prefer that it dispense less but there appears to be a lot of air packaged in. The lotion is not thick but more the consistency of whip cream.

I am in LOVE with this hand cream.  I love that it is a bigger size tube, I love the smell of this lotion, the consistency and how easily it absorbs.  I have noticed a change in my hands since I started using this throughout the day when I wash my hands.  You don't need to much and it absorbs right in, it is not greasy at all.  If you look at the ingredients the first ingredient is water, which is something I always look for.  I would highly recommend this hand lotion.  Perfect for dry weather.
summary: Best hand cream I have found

reviewText: As one who loves the scent of lavender, I was looking forward to using this cream; however, the lavender scent is a little too weak for my taste, I really can't smell it too much. The cream itself goes on smoothly on my hands without leaving them greasy and it does leave my hands pretty soft. I don't care much for the screw-on cap, it's small with sharp edges, I think it would be better and easier to use if it had a flip-on cap. According to the package it also contains shea butter and macadamia nut oil which I think that would explain the price. I think overall, it's a good product.
summary: THE LAVENDER SCENT A LITTLE TOO WEAK

reviewText: My wife is a hand lotion, hand cream and hand therapy aficionado. She is a user several times a day. She said that it takes just a small dab of this product to accomplish the effect she seeks. The little dab goes a long way which makes the C & E last a for a while longer than anticipated originally. It absorbs quickly and easily leaving a smooth feeling to the hands. An added bonus is that the scent is very pleasant.

I have used Crabtree and Evelyn Lavender hand cream off and on for years. It is very difficult to find it in my local retail market area and I generally have to order it directly from the company website. It leaves my hands smooth, absorbs into the skin quickly, and leaves a very natural scent of fresh lavender. This is a generous size tube and since a little goes a long way one can expect it to last a long time.
summary: I have used Crabtree and Evelyn Lavender hand cream off ...

reviewText: Love it love everything from Vichy - better than any expensive product and always gentle on my skin!
Aweful coverage, like mud on my face

The photos on the Amazon description page showing the four shades available are fairly accurate at least on my computer screen. I was offered Opal under the Vine program and took it on the theory that it would work for the lighter parts of my face, the parts I want to "contour" (undereye triangle, center of upper nose, outer cheekbones, etc.). It was a good color choice for that purpose. I regularly wear LOreal TrueMatch W3. The Opal, as an all over shade, is too light for me and leaves me with a ghost-like paleness. The 15.6752% titanium dioxide probably adds to the ghosting. Nude, the next darker shade, would probably work better for me, but given the other problems, I decided not to give it a try.

For me, the small range of colors isn't the problem. Nor is the packaging or application, both of which are truly excellent. No, the problem is that the foundation, which looks lovely at first, settles into my fine lines and pores. It may be that powder could stop this, but I am not about to use much, if any, powder because my skin is dry, I'm older, and a heavily powdered older female face has always been anathema to me. If you have perfect, small-pored, wrinkle-free skin, this foundation might work very well for you. It feels great on the skin. It applies smoothly and luxuriously. It provides great coverage. I tried the foundation with lots of moisturizer, a moderate amount, and none. It never looked natural on my skin no matter what. I like a lot about it, but I cant recommend it.
summary: It never looked natural on my dry, older skin

reviewText: If you're looking for extremely thorough coverage, this is the foundation for you. It doesn't feel like spackle, but it covers like whoa. If you have a lot of discoloration or scarring and want to really cover it up, Dermafinish does the trick. It's definitely not a natural, dewy sort of look, but it gives heavy-duty coverage to completely even out your skin tone. Unfortunately it just isn't pale enough for me; the Opal shade is quite light, but I'm reaching vampire levels of paleness, and this just wasn't quite light enough for me. I'd suggest finding a store with samples to make sure it will work with your skin tone. The coverage is so complete that if it doesn't match your skin tone, it's going to be really obvious.

Corrective Fluid Makeup for the Face Like Correction Fluid ((White Out)) for Paper This Vichy Finish covered my skin like that. In a thick Opal colored blanket. I was looking for basic coverage that would hide some of the signs of aging. I always wear a Natural Looking makeup. I may be wearing foundation, blush and powder, eyeliner and mascara, but if I go heavy it's on the eyes, not the foundation. After multiple tries I could not find a way to tone this product down so that I could wear it. Fortunately I had Vichy Puret Micellar Cleaning Solution to get it off. That latter Vichy product works great. Soap and water, not so much. SUMMARY I was ready for a clown nose after putting this on. It was just too thick and heavy for me. BUT that might make it perfect for someone with small scars to hide. I was looking to hide the signs of aging and for the most part, while this would hide age spots and broken veins, it presents wrinkles in a bad light. If used around the eyes you are going to hate what it does to those crows feet. (not me, I tried them on a friend, lol) Don't Recommend except for special cases.
summary: Not For Those Seeking A Natural Look

reviewText: I don't really buy Vichy products because they are on the pricy side, but I was given a chance to try out this foundation and luckily it was in the shade I needed so I gave it a go. I use foundation sparingly, as I don't like the caked-on feel all over my face. This is made to cover imperfections, marks, etc. I have a few minor acne scars and some redness and even with minimal coverage this foundation covered them up nicely. I used my finger to carefully dap on the areas I wanted to cover and in a few seconds it settled smoothly on my skin. I did use a primer beforehand(which is a must, IMO) and the foundation never clogged my pores. I did notice however, many hours later, that it started to almost dry up on my face in certain spots, like if I had a blemish or for some reason at the top of my cheekbones. I have naturally very oily skin so I found it odd that it would look this dry. Other than that I'm very happy with this foundation and will continue to use it and see if there are any weird side effects (so far none).

When I read the description of "corrective fluid foundation," I really expected this to be more of a cover-up cream. However, all of the text on the tube actually talks about it like it's exclusively sunblock. I think that's the issue---it doesn't work well as either.

SUNBLOCK: If you look online, you are supposed to put about a "nickel-size" amount of sunblock on your face. Recommendations vary. Using that amount, you would go through a tube of this pretty quickly---and it's pricey.

FOUNDATION: Again, based on the word "corrective," I expected this to be a good cover up for some of the sun spots on my nose. Unforunately, there is a powdery component (despite the fact that it comes out of the tube pretty watery) that settled right into the pores, making it looks like I  have dry, flaky skin, which isn't even the case. My face looked so much better without this produce than with it. I am in the mid-40s, so maybe if you have younger skin it will work better for you, but it certainly did not work well for me.

GENERAL PERFORMANCE: As noted, it comes out a bit watery but dries quite powdery. We tried using it simply to cover a few acne spots on my daughter's face. It was ok for that, and I expect that's what we'll do with the rest of the tube, but I wouldn't buy it specifically for that reason, when a cover-up stick is so much more convenient, costs less, and lasts longer.

This product seems to have quite a few high ratings, but it didn't work for us and we won't be buying it in the future.
summary: Dries with a powdery finish that highlights pores, dry skin, & wrinkles

reviewText:
Vichy Dermafinish comes in a medium sized squeeze tube, and the shade I received for testing was correct for my skin tone.

The foundation is creamy, smooth, and applies easily with fingers or makeup brush, and gives even coverage whether applied in a light, medium, or full layer.

Unfortunately, Vichy Dermafinish didn't wear well during the day; on dry patches, it flaked off (ugh - not a problem I ever have with my Bare Minerals Complexion Rescue), and on my cheeks it sank into every pore.

The foundation is a physical sunblock, courtesy of titanium dioxide, so it photographs poorly and changes color in different lighting. It also includes dimethicone near the top of it's ingredient list, so it would cause break-outs for me or anyone else sensitive to silicones.

If you need the specialized coverage of Vichy Dermablend, you'll love the texture and easy application, as well as the SPF30. For normal coverage needs, there are better options.

I love makeup, and am always searching for THE best foundation. However, this is not it. I have pale Caucasian skin, and although this shade (Opal) is in the right color family, it has that chalky look that comes from titanium dioxide. It is very matte, but instead of looking flawless, I felt it had a mask-like effect. On the positive side, it is non-comedogenic. If you want a nice matte foundation, I suggest Too Faced Born This Way Foundation WARM BEIGE (choice of shades). It looks very natural while being full-coverage and oil free. For a dewy, radiant effect, I love CoverGirl Advanced Radiance Liquid Makeup, Creamy Natural 120, 1.0-Ounce. That's just about the prettiest foundation I've ever used.

The tone is a bit more "yellow" than I would like for color, but otherwise it's a pretty good product.
It's main ingredient is sunblock, also known as Titanium Dioxide.  It's been tinted to a skin tone color, and it gives a little better than medium  "coverage" for blemishes and such.  Using titanium dioxide as a sunscreen with liquid foundation makeup is nothing new.
It does go on easily as it is liquid. Removal with a make-up wipe is easy.

They could make it even more perfect by making it non-comedogenic, (they could add some salicylic acid so it doesn't increase acne problems.) But do far, they have jumped only onto the sunscreen bandwagon.
summary: Titanium dioxide and tint for foundation

reviewText: This is for areas you want to become a blank canvas. I would not put it on my whole face because it erases all natural blushing and freckles and you'd need to paint normal blush and contouring back on which is a game I do not play. This really sings as a less heavy than your typical concealer. I dabbed it under my eyes and it lifted the signs of exhaustion away. I put a touch on my brow bones to add some staying power to my highlighting powder and it stayed true all day.  I love it applied with a brush and blend in with a sponge.
summary: Great for covering problems or if you want FULL BLOWN coverage

reviewText: Maybe it's what they use for the sunscreen, but this foundation settled into my pores and looked horrible. I tried putting a moisturizer under it, but it didn't help. Maybe it would work if I use a primer, but I'm not really into a lot of fuss. A young woman with smooth skin might not have this complaint. The opal color was exactly right for my skin tone, which is very fair. But I guess my go-to product will remain BOOTS No7 Dual Action Tinted Moisturiser).

This is a product that lives up to it's description: it's a full-coverage foundation designed to hide blemishes, flat scars, etc. I was fortunate this product arrived when it did. After years of thinking my acne was finally under control, my breakouts came back worse than ever leaving me with a very spotty forehead. This foundation certainly covered them up and took away the redness. One application in the morning-about 8 a.m.-lasted until around 7 in the evening. Unlike many of its ilk which have a consistency like spackle, this foundation has a very light, liquid consistency. Plus, a little of it goes along way. It's a great foundation to have on hand for bad skin days. A welcomed addition to my make-up bag.
summary: Provides full matte coverage as promised.

reviewText: Ooohhhh very happy with this Dermafinish foundation by Vichy. First of all the color I received, "Opal" was more of a light/medium shade with yellow undertones which made me very happy. Just right for my shade. Be sure to use just a little product, otherwise it looks like a mask. It goes on smoothly and evens out my complexion. It doesn't have a perfume smell either which is a plus for me. The shade online and on the box looks more peach color than it is. It really works! Recommended

I was pretty happy with how this foundation went on and covered my skin damage and freckles. it looked very natural and didn't show wrinkles as badly as some other foundations. However I personally did not find it stayed on well over the course of the day, I was out and about for about 8 hours and by the time I got home, it looked pretty bad. If I was just sitting around all day it might have performed better but I really need a foundation that performs better during activity, and this didn't do well for me. I also really dislike the squeeze tube. When you are paying a fairly pricey amount for foundation, you want to be able to use every bit of it, and short of cutting the tube open, there's no easy way to make sure you get all of the product out. While it may be intended to be more portable than the breakable bottles a lot of foundations come in, they could certainly have used a wide mouth plastic bottle design of some kind that allows for scraping all the product out more easily.
summary: Good Coverage, But Didn't Hold Up Well for Me and Wasteful Tube Packaging

reviewText: I have some scars on my neck that make me self-conscious about wearing lower necklines, and I have tried a number of makeup options for coverage with great disappointment. The problem is that if the coverage is adequate, the result was a corpse-like, cakey appearance. In fact, I did try a product that was originally used by morticians. Good coverage always equaled a bad look. Until I tried this wonderful product that seems to melt right into my skin and cover my scars! It is quite easy to use and I think the warmth of fingers make it just the right consistency to cover but not look artificial. Apply just like you would a regular foundation, then apply your regular foundation right over top of (if you wish) it for a very natural appearance. I am a middle-aged woman, and this product did not accentuate any lines or wrinkles, which is a miracle! I am very happy with the results achieved with this concealer.

This foundation is light and easy to apply. I was surprised at how light it came though. In the pictures, it looked darker than it should be. However, once you put it on and spread it, it blends in fine with your face. I actually just used a very small bit and it was on fine. It covered up a scar on my face perfectly. If you take a look at my picture, there's usually a scar below my mouth and as you can see in the picture, you can't even tell it is there.

Make sure you moisturize well beforehand. I didn't and there was slight flaking right by my mouth. It lasted all day and really cannot feel it.

My only gripe is the price. While it is nice, I don't know if it is truly worth the $30. I've used cheaper foundation before that does a similar job.
summary: Good coverage - comes on lighter than the picture

reviewText:
I tested the lightest shade, Opal.  My skin is very pale so I was concerned that the foundation would be too dark.  I was happy that the coverage blended well and was a very natural color (not too much peachy or pink undertones).  The foundation blended very well and provided excellent coverage.  The foundation I currently use is Urban Decay Naked shade 0.5 and I think the Vichy Opal shade may be just a bit lighter.  The Vichy is also a bit more natural than the Urban Decay (I have struggled to find a good foundation that is not too dark-this may be the one).  The coverage was excellent, I have a sun spot that I am looking to cover, this foundation minimized but did not completely cover this spot.  This also minimized but did not completely cover the dark circles under my eyes that I am prone to.

I was happy to read the ingredient list.  This is one of the better sunscreen containing foundation on the market.  This contains 15.6725% titanium dioxide, a mineral sunscreen that provides both UVA and UVB protection and the concentration is high enough to be truly effective.  There were no ingredients that raised safety concerns.

This is a well formulated foundation with good coverage, a natural shade, and an easy to apply texture.
summary: Very good foundation with excellent sunscreen

reviewText:
(First I want to mention that at the time this review was written, the name of this product was "corrective foundation STICK -- it's not a stick, it's a liquid concealer/foundation.  They also make a stick, but this review is for the 1 oz. "Dermafinish Corrective Fluid Foundation.")

I have never used a Vichy or Dermafinish product before, so I wasn't sure what to expect.  I have a lot of facial redness due to rosacea, and have used practically every concealer out there to try to cover or minimize it.  This Dermafinish foundations is the best I have ever used -- there isn't even a close 2nd place!

The foundations comes in a small 1 oz. tube, and goes on like a liquid, on the thinner side for a foundation.  It spreads on the skin easily, and it feels very moisturizing for such a thin liquid foundation.  I cannot at all agree with another reviewer who commented that it felt drying on the skin -- my skin is always extremely dry, and it feels wonderful!  I wouldn't use it AS a moisturizer, but it certainly doesn't dry the skin, I think it adds a small amount of moisture (if it added any more, it would probably slide off too easily).

The coverage is AMAZING -- I put it on half my face the first time I used it, and the effects were remarkable.  It covers redness better than anything I've ever tried, including concealers that feel much heavier and look like spackle!  Prior to this, my only partial success with covering redness was using a green concealer WITH a skin shade concealer over it -- but the Dermafinish foundation worked better and looks more natural.

The color is "Opal" (15) -- I have very fair skin (picture a Viking who has never been in the sun, but with red cheeks!) -- the color blends in very well on my skin.  I would think someone with slightly deeper skin tone would also be ok with the color.  I don't think it would work for anyone with olive skin or darker, or anyone with a good tan.

The coverage lasts well -- it makes it through a work day.  Viewed up close, my skin definitely looks like it has foundation on it, but not any more so than an average foundation -- you can tell I'm wearing makeup, but it's not like it looks like stage makeup or anything.  So it's not going to just disappear the way a tinted moisturizer would, but with coverage this thorough, I don't think that would be possible.  It looks great in photos!  It doesn't give a weird "clown" look with flash photography the way some foundations seem to.

Oddly, although it is SPF 30, I am able to put it close to my eyes to cover my undereye circles (I avoid getting it right up to my eyes).  Most SPF products (including all BB creams I have ever tried) begin irritating my eyes and making them water even when I get them in the vicinity of my eyes -- but the Dermafinish doesn't cause any issues.  It also doesn't irritate my skin at ALL, which is really saying something -- my skin is very sensitive, to both makeup and many sunscreens.

If you have skin redness, dark circles, blemishes, or other things that are hard to cover with normal makeup, I would definitely give this a try.  A little goes a long way, and it is seriously worth the money.  I am amazed with the results!!

I have very pale skin and a quarter sized age spot on my right cheek. Regular foundation doesn't cover it at all. I needed head shots for work and was playing with concealers and heavier foundations. Nothing worked well until I got this product. I use makeup sponges; I applied a thin layer of this (shade: Opal) and the age spot vanished. It is invisible from my photos. I also used DermaFinish for a wedding I attended and my skin looked great and age spot free.

I also tried this on an ice pick scar on my back and it made it remarkably less noticeable. It can't fill in the hole but makes it blend in better with my back. Great product, thrilled to have it in my arsenal!
summary: Wow. Made my head shots flawless!

reviewText: I have very sensitive skin so it took me a while to find a foundation that offers good coverage but won't irritate/dry out my skin. This is it! I like the fact that just a dab of this product goes a long way - it lasts a looooong time. It also provides sun protection and looks natural (if used sparingly! Don't overdo it!). I recommend this product!
perfect.

Smells beautiful and feels great on my skin.  I am not sure I believe all of the claimed benefits, but since it smells so yummy I am game to use it wherever my skin is a little upset or red.  In addition to my face, I have sprayed it on my chest and underarms to smell great.  Has a very pure and fresh scent.
I have ultra sensitive skin, and this rosewater spray is so soothing when it's feeling itchy.  It works as well on my body as on my face.  It smells amazing -- just like fresh roses on a summer day.

I  love the smell of rose water.
This seems to  be just rose water.  Not so strong that anyone notices, just enough to lift your  spirits.  I can't use actual perfume at work so this is a nice olfactory treat,  I can't comment on the health or magic benefits as I'm pretty immune to placebo effect.

I loved the fragrant rose smell as soon as I opened the bottle.  The oil itself is sheer and goes on easily and absorbs well.  For an oil it does not leave a greasy feel.  I love using it on the back of hands as well to help them look less their age as well. It is less expensive then I would have thought and yet I still have a guilty pleasure whenever I open it to put on. Over all its a really nice product.
summary: Great Smell and Works Well too

reviewText: I have been using different rosewaters for about 4 and a half years now. I have found that rosewater differs greatly from brand to brand. I originally began ordering it for Edgar Cayce's skin care recipe.  However, over the years I have found it useful for more than just this. One thing that I have noticed with rosewater is that it sometimes gets a peculiar smell that smells un-fresh like an old rosy syrup and that smell is not something I enjoy. In fact, I look out for this and will not re-order if it smells like this.  Some rose waters leave a residue as well leaving my skin feeling unclean. This rose water is light and refreshing.  It does not have an unpleasant after smell and smells similar to rose oil but has a somewhat plant like undertone.  It absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue on my skin.  I use it on clean skin as a base when applying. It feels fantastic as an evening refresher and allows for a restful sleep because it cools my skin.  It seems to work well with my skin and leaves it feeling quite refreshed. I really like the additional ingredients in this formula.  This feels like a special formula and that a lot of thought has been put into honing the formula. I wish there was an option for a larger bottle for summertime use. This is a nice choice for rosewater.
summary: One of my favorite Rosewater sprays

reviewText: This rosewater spray is conveniently packaged, and is really charming and refreshing. It helps tone and moisturize the face, and it also helps me feel refreshed after a tiring day before retiring for the night. It simply feels pleasant, aromatic (not too much overly, just the right for me), relaxing. I did not use cotton ball, but just directly sprayed a bit and massaged onto face and neck. Rosewater has been suggested as a beauty remedy in Asian countries since old times, and no wonder, it does work. I did not feel any itch or rashes or stickiness due to this rosewater, and it has a reasonable price.
summary: This rosewater spray is conveniently packaged, and is really ...

reviewText:
Oh, I love this!

I don't wear makeup, or at least hardly ever, so I have no idea if this would actually work as a cleanser for nighttime use for those who do, but for me, yes, it does work well as a cleanser.  I did also try cleaning my face as usual and just spraying this on my dry face, and I really love that.

It smells lovely, and as it dries, my skin feels noticeably softer and firmer too.

I love simple.  I really love simple.

Lovely Rosewater spray with a light consistency that gently sprays on and provides a refreshing, natural scent while perking up and hydrating your tired skin. The product comes in a small spray bottle containing 1.7 ounces of fluid. Its small enough that it can fit in your bag or pocket with relative ease and a few small spritzes is all you need to enliven your skin.
summary: Quick way to perk up and refresh your skin

reviewText:
The cleaning property claim should be better defined. Since you apply it and let it stay on without rinsing it off, don't expect it to clean like soap. If you have dirty hands and rub this on the dirt will just get smeared around and smell like a rose for a while. It cleans more like a Clearasil cream. It draws dirt out and help break up dirt in pores, making it easier to clean later.
It definitely leaves skin feeling tighter, so will help smooth skin. It doesnt take long to dry, for me, after rubbing a good amount on, it only took 2 minutes to dry completely. It has no oily feel during or after application, and dries without a trace except for the lingering rose scent. I could smell it for a good half hour if I put my nose against it. For others to smell it on you at a distance would be very unlikely after even 10 minutes.
summary: Not oily, tightens skin well, a pleasant rose scent that lingers for a short while.

reviewText:
glsha Ultimate Rosewater Spray is an exquisite treat for those who love the scent of roses. It smells like fresh picked roses from the garden. It is a lovely scent to have around.

This rosewater spray is great to moisturize your skin when it is dry, especially in the winter months when we tend to overheat our houses. Now, when fall and winter are fighting to determine the next day's weather, it is so nice to be able to spray on this moisturizing spray that dries in just a few minutes and leaves your skin feeling soothed and refreshed. You can use it in the morning, or at night, or both, if your skin needs it.

I have sensitive skin and like the fact that this rosewater is so pure. It is steam distilled and only natural ingredients are added, nothing to impair its purity.  I have been very pleased with this product and think you will be also.
summary: glsha Ultimate Rosewater Spray is a lovely, refreshing water to spritz on your skin

reviewText: This has a very pleasant scent and consistency.  You simply spray it wherever you like on your body and it absorbs within about 10 minutes.  It is a thin, but good oil.  It claims to help with inflammation, among other things and I did find that it help with my foot.  I sprayed it on my foot and put on a sock prior to going to bed, when I woke up, my irritation was reduced and so was the redness on the skin.  Overall, it works pretty well and smells good.

This Rosewater spray provides a nice light scent that quickly dissipates.  Especially for days when you aren't wearing makeup, it's a nice refresher that does light cleansing and gets rid of that 'greasy' feeling if you've been indoors most of the day.

Because this has a lovely presentation box, it also makes a great gift.

My wife really loves rose scent and really loved this glsha Ultimate Rosewater Spray ("glsha" is kinda a odd name, dontyathink?)

Besides the nice but delicate rose scent this is also a  antioxidant and  anti-inflammatory skin refresher spray for when you need just a bit of moisterizing, toning and refreshing.

The first thing you notice is how good it feels on your skin, like a morning mist. I wasn't super enthralled by the scent but it dissipates quickly as it dries. I has a little face lift action but not as intense as egg whites. If you face feels a bit draggy during the day this is a perfect pick me up. All in all a quality product.

I love the scent of a true rose. It reminds me of my grandad who used to grow all kinds of roses in his garden. This spray has a wonderful scent and does a nice job adding a spritz of moisturizer to my skin. It's not the same as a lotion style moisturizer but it has its own benefits and qualities. Very nice quality and scent.
summary: Reminds me of my Grandfather's Garden

reviewText: I love this stuff. Mix a few drops with my facial lotion and it smells clean, smoothes and softens my face unbelievably. Keeps the zits at bay too and only a few drops will do you.

I read that rose oil is good for skin ailments and I suffer from hives so though to add this to my daily rose oil routine because the oil itself is so expensive. What I've been doing is spraying this as a base to cover a larger area and saving the essential oil for specifically afflicted spots. It seems to be working.

Also smells nice and feels refreshing.

The price is very low for something that contains real rose oil.

I also spritz it on my hair in between washings.
summary: I read that rose oil is good for skin ailments and I suffer from hives so ...

reviewText:
I love the smell of rosewater. This is an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory aromatherapeutic. Spritz this onto your face or a cotton pad. Wipe your face and neck to soften, stimulate, hydrate and tone the skin.
The fragrance of this product is so delightful it smells like rose petals. This is a great toner and cleaner. It is very reasonably priced.

My Achilles heel is beauty products....the more natural the better.  I was very impressed with gulsha Rose Elixir. I have read that essential oil from Rosa Damascus is especially useful for dry and sensitive skin complexions.  I used gulsha's beauty tip and mixed 4 drops with my moisturizer in the morning.  I felt my skin was hydrated throughout the day without any greasy residue....and did not clog my pores.  The dropper is easy to use and appears well made....the smell heavenly.  This product also had an expiration date of 05/19.  I am so frustrated that my suntan oils do not have an expiration day....forcing me to throw them away too early.  This is an expensive product....probably comparable to a moderately priced serum......used before your moisturizer.

This is a beautiful bottle of rosewater spray in a beautiful box. It's a little bit of luxury in a bottle, and makes me feel quite fancy spraying this on my face, body and even my sheets. The scent is very light, and this provides moisture and micro nutrients from the rose more than scent itself. I sprayed this on my face after a shower, feeling quite pampered, and my face felt great. Information on the box suggests that when you put on makeup, you can set your face with this spray, so that you don't have a powdery look. This definitely works, and also helps to keep your skin feeling and looking good throughout the day, esp. in dry, enclosed air environments like the office.

I have never used a product like this before and found that it is really effective as a cleanser.  My usual first product, a Clinique Clarifying lotion, that I use at night when I have been out or sweaty, does not usually take that much dirt off my face.

This left my face feeling a little oily rather than dry.

The scent was a little heavy.

This is wonderful.  It has the scent of a Damascus Rose  spicy, green notes & dewy rose petals  heavenly if you like rose scents.  This feels lovely when sprayed on my face & neck.  I love beauty products with real/natural rose extracts like this one.  I don't know if all the claims of antioxidants are true but my Bohemian grandmother swore by using pure rose water & oils on her face & she always looked much younger than her age.  She had beautiful skin.  Using this Rosewater & the Rose Elixer remind me of her & make my skin feel soft & moisturized.

This special  rich rose essential oil can be used for all skin types. It has a very pleasant scent. We found that it is easy to use and is not oily. It penetrates quickly into the skin without clogging pores. It is the perfect solution for a smooth and perfect facial skin. it smooth the facial skin of some of the age related wrinkles and it continues to work an entire day.

I recommend this product for women and men of all ages.
summary: We enjoy this spray; it does what it advertizes

reviewText: This rose water spray smells so lovely and fresh, and I love the rose design packaging, which I am a sucker for any good packaging. The smell is wonderful, and the spray feels good with a mister top bottle that works great. My only complaint would be that I still needed moisturizer after this spray as it left my face tight. However, as a toner and cleanser this works very well. The smell alone is worth the spray and I even sprayed this on my bed pillow, and in the air a few times, which of course is not the intended use of this item. The price is amazing as most rose water sprays are much more costly than 10$. Also, this is not oily which I love, and definitely is a mood enhancer. So, for the price and the lovely smell as a toner and cleanser this is well worth the purchase.
summary: For the price and the lovely smell as a toner and cleanser this is well worth the purchase

reviewText:
This is so refreshing.  It has a light rose scent that is uplifting.  I use it after Bikram yoga for a nice spritz of joy.  It is a simple water spray and has no trace of oiliness so I could use it as a setting spray over foundation.

Just delightful - would make a perfect gift for adults who enjoy healthy living.
summary: Delightful Light Scent - Great for Gifts Too

reviewText:
While refreshing and soothing, you'd have to spray half the bottle on your face in order to use it as a cleanser if you wear any makeup at all. Believe me, I tried. All I wear is BB cream and powdered blush, and the spray didn't make a dent after several spritzes.

It smells lovely and I'd go so far as to say it can be used as a light toner, but as a cleanser it falls short.
summary: Refreshing and smells nice, but not a cleanser.

reviewText:
This spray is mostly pure rose water, formulated in France and produced in Turkey. It smells like rose petals in a bottle, and it is very refreshing when sprayed on the face. It is a natural toner and cleanser and the pure grades have cooling properties, and was used in many herbal treatments.

I have been using pure foodgrade Rosewater that I purchase from the Indian store, that can be mixed in food, for instance in yogurt to make a lassi. This one smells very similar to that pure rosewater, but it comes in a spray bottle. It is natural and gentle and refreshing for the skin. I used to mix rosewater instead of apple cider vinegar with bentonite clay or Fuller's clay for a gentler mud pack. It's also nice and cooling after an application of such a pack.

Overall, this is a great product to spray on the face compared to the chemical based sprays.
summary: Natural rosewater spray, acts as a natural toner and moisturizer.

reviewText: wonderful hand lotion, for seriously dry skin, stays on a long time, a little goes a long long way.. go easy.. wonderful scent.. maybe a bit strong at first, but dissipates after a while.
Thanks!!
Nice lightweight hand cream for the summer.
Best hand cream ever.
'Love this stuff.  Very smooth, very moisturizing.  Got it as a gift and reordered it as soon as it ran out!
I like the cream it's so beautiful
There is no evidence to me that this product is an improvement over many others that are similarly priced...or less.
The Best Hand Cream Ever, I love this product. Not greasy.
My sons favorite hand cream for his dry hands. No greasy and absorbs well. I am a return buyer.
I love this hand cream. I'm on my fifth tube. Love love love.
Beautiful! Easy to apply. It's everything you have heard about.

my fav zoya polish by far and I have a few dozen. first coat will be gelly like, you will be able to see through it a little. second coat will give you the most amazing result- a galaxy on your nail. im not kidding. those holographic glitters totally look like stars in the navy base. and they look like they are not all on the same flat surface but they really do look like stars in space-some are further away, some are closer. I don't know how that's possible but its true. also this polish is very long lasting, even compared to other zoya
GREAT!!! I will use this seller again.

I can't stop looking at this polish on my nails. It is so rich, a beautiful deep wine/purple color, with a very subtle sparkle that you only catch in certain types of light. Sadly a seasonal color, but maybe Zoya will keep making it.
summary: Gorgeous deep rich color with just a little sparkle, does not feel gritty when on, removes easily

reviewText: Beautiful color!

I bought the three above and I love each one they work well together if you do an accent nail etc. I layers Seraphina over Dream and it looked like a winter starry night. Gorgeous. I love the coverage of Zoya . I a. A die hard Butter London fan,so I am glad to have other colors from this brand to choose from. Nails Inc is also great they stay put.
summary: Dream , Mosheen and Seraphina were my buys

reviewText: Nice, smooth and creamy. I feel it's a bit darker than expected. I have somewhat of an issue applying, it seems to bulk in one area over another, and the shading is a bit off, rather than one hue. So I have to play around with it, which if course makes it darker then I'd like. It comes in a small little box, and you would either have to use your finger or your own brush for application. I actually prefer a cotton swab at this point so I can remove smudged or darkened areas. It's copper in color, very fancy looking after applied - correctly. It did take me quite a few tries. I've used it as a shade and an eye liner.

I would not call this an eyeliner per se because of its ultra soft texture but is nonetheless a great product. It is very soft, almost whipped in texutre. My flat brush sinks right into it when I try to use it as an eyeliner. However, when I apply and blend it more as an eyeshadow, its fantastic! Its a highly pigmented gold that is sparkly but thankfully not in a glittery way. It blends well and creates a beautiful color on my lid. It lasts for hours and still looks good and blends well with other products including liners and powder shadows. It picks up a slightly richer color if used with primer, but primer isn't necessary for it to perform well.
summary: Very soft product makes a great eyeshadow

reviewText:
The Golden Orbit VINCENT LONGO Crème Gel Liner goes on so smooth with a stiffer eye liner brush. I think it looks best with a pearly, shimmer eye shadow in white, camel, or pink. It also works with light shades of shimmery purple, green, or blue. Perfect for parties or a night on the town! Using as a touch of highlight on your regular eye shadow can really make your eyes pop!

It takes a little practice to get the hang of using a Gel Liner if you've never used one before applying to go out. But it is well worth the time for the fabulous look you can't get with any other form of eyeliner.

I love this creme gel eyeliner by Vincent Longo. The golden color is SO pretty and the metallic tone really stands out. It is similar to Bobbi Brown's eyeliner in that it lasts all day and doesn't rub off in a line above your lid. I like to wear it covering my whole lid, not just as eyeliner. I recommend  it--it is very glamorous! It really lights up your eyes and makes your face look that much more pretty.

The Golden Orbit color s is super duper sparkly and sparkles irritate around my eyes and are a bit, ahem, young, for me.  Color aside - This is creamy smooth application and dries super fast in a will-not-budge-dance-til-4am-sort of way.  I am going to purchase this in the plum shade which is more my style because I am so happy with the ease of application and longetivity

This is the first time I had ever tried a crme gel eyeliner and I must say I really like it. I used a smaller tipped brush than what I would usually use and blended it into my upper eyelid after applying my regular eyeliner first. I have enclosed a picture of what it looks like on one of my eyelids.

I didn't think I'd be able to use it this particular shadow because it is iridescent and golden toned and usually gold does not look good on me...(not sure if it is because I have brown eyes or because of my fair skin) but as it turned out it looks great! It's water resistant, It doesn't irritate my skin, it feels weightless on my eyelid and lasts all day with no need to reapply...I can't even tell it's there at all. It performs just as well if not better than powder eyeshadow or eyeliner that I'm use to using and has long-lasting staying power. This will become a staple in my makeup regimen!
summary: A pleasant surprise for my eyes!

reviewText: This is a very nice gel eyeliner. It's easy to apply and stays on throughout the day, though the color does lighten some throughout the day, but not enough to warrant reapplication. The color does go on lighter than it appears in the tub, but again this is expected given the typical amount applied. The sparkly glitter doesn't really make an obvious show of itself after application, which I opine to be a good thing. No irritation has been noted with this eyeliner, but then again, no eyeliner has ever been an irritant in this case.

I usually gravitate toward pencil liners or liquid liners, but this Gold liner was calling my name!

It's texture extremely soft, so keep that in mind when you dip your brush in for the first time. It's a bit hard to get crisp lines wit this product, I had to use tape to create a sharp winged line.

That being said, the consistency allows this product to be very versatile. I've used this as a bold statement lip- seeing as metallic liquid lips have been getting more popular, and have used it for over-all eye color!
summary: I usually gravitate toward pencil liners or liquid liners, ...

reviewText:
This review will be from a makeup artist's perspective.  I have had the opportunity to use MANY gel liners and I have learned to use them for a variety of purposes in makeup.  I plan to update this review with photos if I am able to, but for now, a brief summary is how I am going to start.

WHAT IS THIS PRODUCT LIKE?
If you are used to using other gel liners like Buxom or MAC Fluidline, for example, this gel liner might be a challenge for you.  It is a brilliant bronze gold color and the consistency is very mousse like.  It is so light that it can be a challenge to apply well.  The particles are glittery, but when put in a line you don't see them.

HOW TO BEST APPLY THIS PRODUCT
For this liner you are going to need a liner brush that is densely packed and quite stiff with just a little give to it.  You are best to dip the brush into the gel liner and then work the product evenly into the bristles and THEN apply a line.  Test it on your hand first until you get the hang of it.  I prefer to use a slanted brush with this, but I also have a densely packed liner brush which is not an angled brush and that applies well too.

HOW WELL DOES IT WEAR
I have found that if applied well the first time (working the product into the bristles evenly) that this will stay in place all day on lids that are not excessively oily.  I have only had to apply once and it is fine for the day, especially if set with powder or shadow on top.

ANOTHER USE
If you use a good eye cream which soaks into the lid quickly and well, you can apply to your lid, then use a synthetic flat brush with rounded tip.  It is designed for cream eyeshadow.  You can quickly apply to the lids as an eyeshadow as well and when the cream has set, so will the shadow and stay in place all day long.  The cream on the lid gives you time to work, and gives that ability to do a wash effect and not look patchy.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a bit of a tricky gel liner to use, but once you get the hang of it, it is beautiful metallic liner.  It stays in place all day.  If you are careful to follow a few steps you can also use this as an eyeshadow on the lids.  A little goes a long way.  If you keep this covered at all times even while using, it will last quite some time.

FIVE STARS for now.  I will update as I have more experience with it should the information contribute to the overall evaluation of the product. I also plan to add a photo or two if I am able to as well.
summary: Beautiful Metallic Liner Can Be Used As Shadow, But Different Than Most Other Gel Liners

reviewText:
So this arrived and I'll be honest - I hadn't tried a gel eyeliner before.  I really like the concept of it and though you have to be one of those individuals with brushes to use this, it does work and it says on well.

I was offered this for free to try - they sent a shade that is similar to a penny.  Unfortunately my complexion (most easily described as "vampiric") did not mesh well with the color as an eyeliner.  I didn't have any issues with irritation and to be honest - I just went ahead and painted upword using this as an eyeshadow.  It worked for that on me because the coloring.

also I will be the first to admit that I have almost no skill when it comes to applying makeup with brushes - the odds of me actually being able to outline my eye with a gel eyeliner are pretty slim.  I can use my fingertips to use this as an eyeshadow primer though and be very happy with the results.  I would have to order a different color to actually wear this as a liner - but because of the extended wear of this product I am not opposed to that at all.  I also liked the feel of the product at application and the fact that it didn't bother my skin at all.
summary: excellent gel eyeliner if you have a brush and pick the right color

reviewText: Just in time for the holidays.  This cream eyeliner gives a golden bling look that's perfect for special occasions.  It goes on easily and doesn't bleed out of place.  A fine line brush is all you need.  I don't often use eyeliner but I'll go all out for special parties and was more than pleased with the look and quality of this product.  I found the price point on the high end of what I usually spend on product but sometimes it's worth it.
summary: Eye Bling just in time for the Holiday parties

reviewText: This product is best described as a "creamy" gel compared to the more solid types.  Color was very good and should be for the price.  The texture was very good and wears for a very long time.  We experienced absolutely no irritation was was pleasantly surprised at the ease of application.  If you receive this in the winter time in a cold climate, I would let it set at room temperature overnight prior to use.

Really like the look this pomade gives my hair - it's very natural, matte but not greasy at all. The citrus scent is also great and not too overpowering which is perfect.

Unfortunately the hold just isn't strong enough for my hair, it acts more of a medium hold rather than firm/strong. I have medium hair length. It's also a bit drying and can be tough to rinse out with just water.
summary: Great scent and shine, hold isn't firm enough

reviewText: love the product and super fast shipping

This adds nice volume to short hair without making it crunchy or greasy, even though the cream does feel a bit waxy. I was surprised when I first tried this because it seemed to be completely hard... but once you "break into" the top of the coating, the texture is more like a thick cream.

I found the scent a bit feminine, considering it's marketed as a men's product. And like another reviewer, I wasn't thrilled that it's packaged in a glass container. Anything meant for the bathroom is something I'd prefer to have in plastic because of the likelihood of it ending up falling onto my tile floor or countertop at some point. That said, the glass is pretty thick, so it doesn't seem prone to shatter easily.

All in all, a good product if you're looking to add volume and texture.

The pomade has nice floral faint smell, and goes on easily. It helps to hold hair shape throughout the day, even after brushing or combing. Unfortunately, it also makes my scalp somewhat itchy, and hair starts looking oily faster then usual.

Huge points for aesthetics! The glass container looks lovely whether put in the medicine cabinet (where it belongs) or lazily left-out on the sink-top by a rushed boyfriend. I know it seems weirdly insignificant, but once you hold this tribute to the old-world, you will see what I mean. Bravo, Baxter!

The product has a lovely smell and gave my boyfriend's hair soft control. And, what is most important, it washes-out with absolute ease.

Finally, do not let the price deter you. A little bit "goes a long way."

Well worth the investment! (And, re-purpose that container ... it's super cute!)

My husband prefers pomades because they don't get crunchy or flaky like gels or hair spray can, and it's generally easier to restyle/comb during the day. After his favorite pomade stopped being made, we've tried a lot of products and found that Lockhart's Pomade does the best for his hair.

This one failed so completely that it's not even being kept in the bathroom as a backup pomade for him. He has very thick, but very fine hair straight hair. This clumped in his hair, and the hold was not sufficient. The day he tried this, he wound up having to recomb more often than usual.

He likes the matte finish, and like all Baxter products it's gorgeously packaged. But unlike the other "not quite" products, this is one that I can't even use. It's too thick for my hair, and it's hard to wash out even using a tiny amount.

So after it failed in both my hair and my husband's, I decided to let my son try it in his thick ringlets. It did a lot better in his hair, using a fine comb to style his hair. His hair usually seems to laugh at any attempts to style it and the thick cream and hold did keep his hair semi-tamed without the clumps and "sheets of hair" look that my husband and I got.

So the end result is that I like this for thick, curly hair, but if you have straight fine hair- it's probably not going to be the best product for you. If you haven't used cream or wax pomades in the past- they can be a little difficult to wash out. Shampooing twice seems to do the trick for my husband.
summary: Thick hair, but not thick fine hair

reviewText:
I have wavy and fairly thick hair, and this never clicked completely with my mane. It's fairly waxy, and when I put it in, my hair never lay completely right or smoothly. I'd often end up with locks and clumps sticking out at odd angles, like I had slept in it. It's a disaster if my hair gets a little long, and is best with shorter hair. At least, like other Baxter products, it does have hold without getting brittle and crunchy, but I also disliked the waxy, slightly greasy feel it gave my hair. It might work well for other types of hair, but not for mine.

EDIT: I got a new style, fairly shorter than I normally wear, and this pomade works great with it now. I'm giving it another star and throwing in a recommendation: BEST WITH SHORTER HAIR!
summary: Doesn't always work well with my hair

reviewText: First off, I take issue with many hair products because they seem to make my thick hair oily or too crunchy or too heavy.  This does none of that.  On my long hair, it works well at the roots to lift for volume and also keep my hair in place when I style it (I also uses Bumble & Bumble's basic hairspray).  On my son's short hair, it's even better...styles his hair softly but keeps his underlying curls and cowlick at bay.  Has a nice shine to it but is not oily.  Scalp doesn't feel like there's residue.  AND, it rinses out well. Smells really good too!.

This Baxter of California Pomade works just as it is supposed too. Don't be turned off by the "hard" in the title, it is not a hard cream and is very easy to apply. One thing we did notice is if you use too much at one time it tends to leave a white film on my husband's hair (he has almost black hair). I usually buy the Got to Be brand pomade for him. My husband and I both agree that while this is a good product we will stick with the much cheaper brand.

I've been using pomade or similar types of hair product since discovering it as an alternative to LA Looks hair-gel back in high school. Pomade gives hair a good hold while avoiding the helmet hair look and feel of the 1990's. My current product of choice is American Crew and I'm directly comparing Crew's product versus the Baxter of California.

--------------------
PRODUCT:

The Baxter Pomade comes in a heavy glass container that some will probably find more of an annoyance than anything else. I tend to leave my hair product on the bathroom counter-top in the mornings and my wife already commented that she almost knocked the container off the counter while using her hair-straightener.

Other than the container the product has a slight pink hue and has a distinctive floral scent. Applying Baxter's pomade for the first time is interesting... the product had sort of congealed into one mass and took some pressure to dig any amount of the pomade out.

Once started though it was easy enough to get more pomade as needed.

--------------------
HOLD & STYLING:

The pomade blends into hair easily enough. I apply pomade to slightly damp hair and the Baxter is as easy to blend as the Crew brand that I traditionally use.

Baxter's pomade dries clearly and does not give a wet appearance to hair. Hair remains soft and doesn't feel oily.

I had no problems with this pomade holding my hair in place all day. Though I have relatively short, thick hair so this should't be much of an issue for any decent pomade product.

--------------------
WHAT I LIKE:

(+) Does exactly what it's supposed to do - hold hair without feeling oily or leaving residue or helmet hair

--------------------
WHAT I DISLIKE:

(-) This is marketed as a premium product and it's priced accordingly... I just cannot find a reason why to switch to Baxter. For the price I can usually get two 3oz containers of American Crew at a local department store and get similar results

(-) The glass container while nice is a bit of a hazard if it gets dropped in the bathroom

(-) Floral scent is not to my liking
summary: Premium Product at a Premium Price... I'll Stick with American Crew

reviewText:
Ive used Baxter of California Slick Pomade it the past and thought I would try this Hard Cream Pomade. The Hard Cream Pomade is a much different consistency than the California style. This one is a thick paste not as hard as the Slick Pomade. It .

Baxter of California Hard Cream Pomade goes into my hair easily and doesn't leave a sticky feeling residue in my hair like some gels I've used in the past. My only problem with this pomade is the cost it's $5 more than American Crew and you only get 2 oz verse the 3 oz in the Fiber container.
summary: Strong hold but not overly stiff

reviewText: My teenage son has very thick hair and though cut short it is still often hard to manage.  I talked him in to experimenting with this pomade and while just a small amount did help control his hair I don't think it is something he is planning to add to his daily routine.
summary: OK But Not Something I Am Likely To Order Again

reviewText: I have a torrid history of crunchy hair, but I have since repented and tried to prevent my hair from being a weapon.  On the other end of the spectrum is greasy.  This pomade falls into neither trap, giving hair that remains soft and natural while giving some control of what it is doing.  Application is easy -- warm it up with the hands and run hands through hair.  I like to use just a little, which allows it to move in the wind while still having some shape.  Regardless of how you like to use pomade, this version is worth a try.

This pomade is tricky to use at first because the texture of it is very hard. You only need a little smudge of it to hold hair down or create a dip, curl or wave.

It has barely any scent.

This jar will go a long way because you use so little.

It is very long lasting, it lasts a full day into night. It did last that long for me. The hold isn't hard-feeling, it's semi-flexible. The long wear is exceptional. I haven't tried this in high humidity, our weather has been so dry, but I am curious to see if it retains it's hold in damp or humid weather.

I am very happy with it.

This pomade works well for a few reasons. It has a pleasant yet subtle smell that you notice during the application process but it doesn't linger throughout the day. My hair is generally pretty smooth yet can be frizzy and I've found that the pomade works well in either state.

Another good thing about this one is that you really don't have to use much of it at all. 2 ounces doesn't seem like a lot, but this will last you a long time if you make it count.

It's lightweight enough to make you forget that there's anything in your hair yet it's effective enough to last the whole day. Couple that with the professional packaging and you're looking at a really impressive product. I really enjoy this pomade.

I compared Baxter's Hard Cream Pomade to their (Soft) Cream Pomade as well as the Hard Water and Soft Water pomades. They're all surprisingly different from each other, despite their similar-sounding descriptions. The Water pomades are much more like a hair gel or "product," and the soft Cream Pomade is much more like a traditional hair pomade -- that is, it's a kind of thick hair oil or grease. This one, the Hard Cream Pomade, is basically a wax: its main ingredients are beeswax and lanolin, and the waxy consistency and oily smell are consistent with that. It feels heavy and waxy in the hand, without the goopy, plasticky, consistency of the Water pomades, and though the cream softens as your hands warm it, it's still much thicker and waxier than the soft, greasy Cream Pomade. It feels heavy and a bit sticky in the hair, and it stiffens and clumps hair considerably while not feeling rigid like a gel. I personally prefer the lighter, drier feel I get from a light application of the Soft Water pomade to this Hard Cream product, which feels a bit clumpy and waxy to me. But if you're looking for a more natural, oil-restoring, waxy-spiky hair feel without the rigid hold of a gel, the Cream might be a better bet.
summary: Waxy: a beeswax-lanolin hair treatment, not a gel or oil pomade

reviewText:
I have several of the Baxter pomades and like the line of products very much. This Hard Cream Pomade is a lot closer to a wax than the others I have used. It warms up nicely in  the hands and applies smoothly to give me a finished top line to my hair. it does not add shine but control is good.

I don't like the scent of this variety as much as the others. It has a faint medicinal smell that I don't much like. For that reason alone, i'd still prefer the Bumble & Bumble Semisumo even at a higher price. Scent is very subjective though; if you are looking for a clay/wax style pomade with good hold, you can't go wrong with this product.
summary: Nice job with smoothing and control

reviewText: A great pomade.  A little weird at first, it comes out grainy out of the jar, but rub it on your hands and through your hair and it goes in nice. A nice medium hold with a matte look.  A pleasant but neutral smell that goes away once it dries.  If your hair gets messed up during the day just put a little water on it and it reshapes very well.  It is a small jar with only two ounces, but you don't need a lot of product to get a good hold.  Overall a great pomade, if you have a question about it leave a comment and I will do my best to answer.

My thirteen year old has the kind of hair where every single strand has a mind of it's own.  I don't know what to call it but coarse and wiry.  We keep it cut short and the Hard Cream Pomade works really well to keep it looking neat when nothing else will.  Doesn't really work when it grows out much, but it might if his hair was softer textured.  It has a nice clean scent and is easy for him to wash out.

My live-in cousin is young and has thick, short hair and especially an undercut that looks like early 60s.  This product is for guys like him.

It left his hair finely up on over with an appearance of volume and yet not wet or weighed down.  This is a masculine look that takes more care on the front end - the haircut, and then can be maintained well enough with this pomade.
summary: Just right for thick short hair and an undercut

reviewText: It is nice that alot of companies are now making products that are made for men. I go into CVS or Rite Aid and instead of the 90% womens hair products to the usual 10% men hair care products has changed considerable. Men actually have their own aisle now. Lol This was great on my straight hair held my hair for the whole day with the help of a little hair spray. Smell was great too. The only thing I was somewhat disappointed was the size of the container. Very small plus the cost is a little high for my budget. But the product itself is a definate winner!

It seems like the majority of reviewers don't know what a "pomade" actually is, so my first point is to clear this up. A pomade is generally designed to give hair a slick look, and just enough hold to ensure a style is maintained. A pomade is not a spiking gel or an aerosol designed to hold outrageous hairstyles in place. Generally, if the hairstyle you're going for could conceivably be termed "dapper", you're looking for a pomade or other cream product (see: Brylcreeme). George Clooney's character in "Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?" used styling creme. Compared to that slick, old-fashioned look the Baxter Hard Cream Pomade has less of a sheen but a good bit more hold. It is ideal for most mens' hair styles.

As a pomade, this product is pitch-perfect. My hair is thick to the point it surprises even seasoned barbers, and I maintain a pretty simple parted style. The pomade applies easily, with wet hair just wet your hands and dab two fingers in the creme. Rub your hands vigorously, and finger-style your hair. I did my 'do in seconds, and had a hold good enough to survive winter weather for the bulk of the day without requiring a single adjustment- even being out in some decent wind. Five stars, zero qualms.

Again, a pomade is *not* meant to hold spiky hair, or lift a mohawk, or hold a Conan-O'Brien-style bouffant. A pomade *is* designed to enhance a wide variety of relatively short, masculine styles. To touch on a couple of other prominent points, this particular pomade does have a pink color in the jar, but it's not going to stain your hair with ribbons, so deal with it. The overall finish isn't greasy or slick, it's just that nice healthy shampoo commercial finish. Highly recommended for anyone looking to improve their manly style. Baxter makes fantastic products, and I am consistently including more of their products in my repertoire.
summary: This is a pomade, not spiking gel

reviewText: This cover stick has excellent ease of application, and I am very happy with the thorough coverage it have on particular areas. It is a bit pricey, but there is wonderful coverage here, and if that's what you are looking for you will absolutely not go wrong. I applied it in the middle of the day getting ready to go out to two different occasions. So, it lasted from noon 'till the wee hours of the morning. When I checked in the mirror as I was getting ready to retire for the evening, I was very happy to see that what was covered so many hours ago was still invisible under very bright bathroom lighting. Therefore, if it's results you are looking for, you will probably consider this an excellent purchase! The odds are I will return to get this same item again when it is used up.

Vichy Dermafinish Corrective Concealer Stick, 0.16 oz Gold is a very well made concealer. It goes on smoothly and rubs into the skin nicely. It has a few things about it that the buyer should be aware of.

First, the color runs a bit darker than what was expected. I would suggest going a shade lighter than you normally use and you will be fine. For me it was easy to lighten the shade by simply applying a thin layer and using a bit of white talc powder to bring it to a lighter tone. Also, it is thick, apply a small amount and spread it, let it absorb into skin. If you put too much it will cake up and not look right and you will have to wipe it off and start again. Apply lightly and then add more if needed. Also the price on this product is a bit high compared to other very good brands available in stores. This high price is somewhat justified by the quality of the product and the less you need to use per application.

Vichy Dermafinish Corrective Concealer Stick, 0.16 oz Gold is a good product. Make sure to pick the correct shade and you will be very pleased with it.
summary: Good coverage, requires small amount per use.

reviewText: Reason it is not a five is that if you don't set it right away with a powder it creases.  Other then that it does as is expected.  Gives full coverage that lasts all day.  Excellent product with the one exception.  Good price as well.
summary: Good all around but you need to do one thing first.

reviewText: This is a great cover stick. It covers easily and the edges can easily be blended into surrounding areas. But here's the one difficulty: It is very difficult to pick out colors online as every computer screen is different. The color I got turned out to be too dark. I recommend checking the color out at a brick and mortar store before you order online.
summary: Great product, but it's hard to pick color

reviewText: This "nude" stick was WAY TOO DARK for my lighter, winter complexion.  The metal tube is nice, and the product does supply "full" coverage.  I found it a bit heavy and way darker than I need.  I doubt I'll use this overmuch.

Foremost, like all correctors, concealers, foundations, etc., the key is blending. So, apply this lightly (very lightly) and then blend out with a Beauty Blender. If you need just a touch more, layer a bit more. Then, blend. Add foundation and then blend. This will provide the most natural and uniform look.

The product itself is easy to use, offered in many shades (so there is one that will surely complement your skin tone), and treats skin with care. I am allergic to just about everything ... I did not have any form of reaction to this product. For me, that says a lot about how gentle this formula is (for me).

Also, I love the convenience of this very small tube. I keep this in my makeup bag in my office for the occasional mid-afternoon touch-up.

Vichy products are phenomenal. If you have never tried their line, grab this corrector and give it a spin. I think you will be pleasantly surprised!

This was a little darker than I expected but it covered well. It was a little obvious I had something covering the spot. Didn't seem like it totally blended but if I used foundation I bet it would blend better.

I had some reservations about this, and some uncertainty about what shade would be right.

I got lucky.  Though the name of the shade deterred me, I thought that I would try it anyway.  The paler shades OUGHT to be closer to right, I thought.  But...they weren't.  This, blended with a little bit of lighter cream concealer, worked very well for me.

I don't wear foundation.  What I do is use a primer and then concealer (to cover a sun-darkened spot, and a little red spot).  I then dust my skin with a very small amount of fine finishing powder.  I like the effect I get from doing this, and this concealer works better than others I have tried.

It should be noted, though, that I am not using this to try to lighten dark circles.  Once one gets to a certain age, one has to make a choice between unlightened dark circles and concealer sitting in one's tiny under-eye wrinkles.  I opted for living with the dark circles.  I can't comment on how well this would work to lighten dark circles on a younger face.

I do wish that this make-up stayed on (and looked good while on) longer.  Initially, I thought the wear-off problem was being caused by the fact that it has been very hot, and pretty much nothing looks good after hours of being out and about in such hot weather.  But it has been cooler for a few days, and the performance of the concealer was not improved.
summary: Works well as a stand-alone concealer.

reviewText:
I absolutely TOTALLY love this corrector stick! I have serious dark circles under my eyes and some redness around my nose that requires concealing. I use the stick on those areas and apply my regular foundation over it, and you would not believe the results!
