I had my doubts about this as I have used almost every type and brand of corrector sticks on the market. Usually they don't do that good of a job of camouflaging the flaws, or, after application, it is obvious that you are trying to cover something because the area looks cakey or uneven.

This is really different to others of the kind. It is much darker than I thought I required, but I run the stick under my eyes and around my nose, pat it in with my fingertips, and then pat on foundation over it. Voila! The difference is really noticeable to me. It goes on smoothly and blends perfectly. I use translucent powder to set it. I love it and would highly recommend it.

This is the best corrector stick that I've ever used. I love it! It goes on smoothly and covers extremely well, blending with other foundation to give a flawless finish.

Having aging skin and too many wrinkles, I have to be careful not to apply a heavy coat of anything, but this, possibly blended with a little moisturizer, works very well at covering the red and dark areas around my eyes without exaggerating the creases and wrinkles. A bit of setting powder and it lasts until I remove it.

I've not had any problems yet with irritation so I'm hoping that will last. It is a bit expensive but I don't need to use a lot so it should last a long time.

Ok, so I looked at the picture for this tube, and thought the color looked light enough for my skin tone, but I was wrong.  There's nothing wrong with the product, it does cover blemishes and dark circles very well, but the color was off for me.  It has a creamy texture and goes on smooth.  The bronze is a dark creamy yellow base.  Pictures included.  I really like the tube it's in and how easy it is to apply.  It goes on a little thick, but blends easily.

Well, I wrote a really long review and lost it when I went back to see how much this item costs.  I'll remember as much as I can.

I don't have dark circles under my eyes.  I do bruise easily.  I am fortunate enough to have a Maine Coon cat that thinks nipping me lightly with a small amount of skin between his teeth is thanking me for treats and ice in his water disk.  Not true in my brain.  So, when I don't catch him beforehand he barely holds my skin and for that, I get a bruise.  I wanted to see if this would cover that.  It does not completely but certainly hides it a good bit.

I've also used this to contour and I like it for that a lot.  It goes on smoothly; blends well with other products.  I use a makeup brush or a sponge for this and find that I like it better in thin layers.  If a product works well and does what it says it will, I guess I won't worry about the cost....I'm certainly not going to go back and check the cost and lose this one, too.
summary: To me, this was a good product and I shall buy it again.  I hope you enjoy it, also.

reviewText: This is a great bronzer color and the application goes on smooth then blends well. The tone is a bit dark for me (it's a bronze correcting stick, I'm pale), but it works great as a contour color for me or to give me a bit of color on my cheeks. As noted, it's a very 'fine' cream stick and works great with my makeup, blending very easily and covers well.
summary: blends very well, versatile stick that's great for contour

reviewText: I didn't really care for this as a concealer but I really like it for contouring. You do have to use a setting powder with it if you want it to last more than a few hours but it really does work well as I use a setting powder anyway. It goes on easy and blends easy as well. If you're looking for a concealer that offers VERY light coverage this is a good choice. If you're looking for an extra contouring tool this is great.
summary: Works Better for Contouring than Concealing

reviewText: This product makes it look like I have been in the sun. It gives me that sun kissed look. I am fair complected and this is too dark for a concealer but is perfect for my cheeks and lips.

Not my favorite. This stuff is quite thick. I recommend applying it with fingers or a brush as opposed to swiping it directly on the skin. It doesn't feel heavy on the skin, but it looks heavy. You'll also definitely want to set this with a powder as it's pretty creamy once you blend it in, so it is prone to creasing.
summary: Looks a little heavy on this skin

reviewText:
Does really well on dark circles, makes a HUGE difference. I did have to apply it a few times.
Caused no irritation at all.
The applicator is great , almost like Chap Stick.
Only downside is price, but that being said, you don't use a lot to cover.

reviewerName: Leah Maines, best-selling, award-winning author, actor, and editor
reviewText: For the first time in a long time, I have a tan.  I found that my concealers were all too light for undereye coverage or to use as a corrector.  The Vichy Bronze worked great for my undereyes and also for covering up little flaws on my face.  It looks natural and gives me great coverage.

I like this corrector ~~ and as I work night shift I'm always looking for anything to approve the appearance of my under eye shadows.  This does a good job ~~ it goes on easy and smooth,the color is about exactly what I need, but it goes on a little heavy for my taste.  I actually started using a makeup brush to put it on to get it to not go on as thick.  I have a little redness in the apples of my cheeks, so I VERY lightly applied it to them, and it did well.  It's not the best corrector I've used, and I would use it, but would not replace my current brand with it, no.
For a bronzer, this is really light. It is too light to be a bronzer, too dark to be straight concealer. Product is fine, color is all wrong.

I think the colors on the website are hard to distinguish but the color of this concealer seems to be a medium to medium dark beige.  I still have some residual tan on my face and it blended in well for me.

I like the stick form because you can just "draw" over a blemish or something you want to conceal and then blend it in.  I initially thought this might also work for undereye circles but it is a little too firm a consistency for that.  I think it would pull on the undereye skin too much.

It didn't last even to lunch for me, but makeup generally doesn't last long because I touch and rub my face too much during the day.
summary: Concealer in a convenient stick form

reviewText: Applies very way to the face to cover up and not dallow blemishes to be seen.  Wife likes this product and its ease of use. Works fast and is a small stick that can easily be taken with you on the go.

The  concealer is rich, creamy, and blends easily. While I like the feel and quality of the product, the color wasn't quite right for me. When I tried to cover a minor blemish and used enough for coverage, it was too dark and I could see the spot. It worked much better blending an area with a few age spots and uneven skin tone. I like it enough to continue using it but next time I would choose a slightly lighter shade.

This is a very light colored concealer that works very well to cover up the under eye look of someone who hasn't slept in days.  I don't sleep, LOL, and I don't like powdery concealers because of the powder (and the brush) in the eye and besides, it just looks sopowdery.

I don't generally wear any makeup except mascara, certainly not the stuff that clogs up a persons pores and goes all over the face.  This is nice because it blends in to normal skin tones easily.  Sand worked perfectly for meas all of my slight summer color is now gone.

The sand color corrective stick is darker than I expected. It does hide skin imperfections, but not for long, especially if you touch the area or try to  apply another product there. It did not cause irritation for me. It is very creamy and easy to apply
summary: does not last long, darker than expected

reviewText: My wife has been using this product for a while and says that it is not thick enough for her skin type. She has many skin conditions and she is always excited to be trying something different to find the next best thing that will fit her needs. Although it worked so so with her she will not be using it in the future. Plus it is a bit pricey for what you get(according to her).

$28 for 0.4 oz of product.

We can all agree we're always on the search for the newest holy grail, right?

You can find me usually using ELF's concealers as I have been for years. It takes me awhile to consider switching since I've had some awful results with some of the higher end products.

Virchy is a brand I have not heard of before and when I received this product, I assumed it would be much more. As much as I hate the price, the product does a good job of covering up my dark circles, blending in like butter and staying on all day. Of course I also put a thin layer of foundation on top and set it with a setting powder but I could go without the foundation and just set it with the powder and be fine (remember to always set with a finishing powder to help products stay on longer)!

So glad I gave this product a try. While it won't be replacing my affordable everyday ELF concealer I will be keeping this around for date nights and days when I'm expecting to be photographed!
summary: We can all agree we're always on the search for the newest holy grail, right?

reviewText: For covering discoloration this stick is ok. I found it to give the look of a heavier pancake style makeup. Having had an injection that left a black and blue mark on my chin I used the corrective stick to cover it with only fair success. After applying I used my finger to blend the product and then a brush to even out the cover up. My friend noticed the discoloration so obviously it was not a good cover up for a black and blue. When applied under my eyes it was difficult to blend and settled into wrinkles.

This is a very effective concealer, that works perfectly for the dark circles under my eyes.  It is easy to apply, and spreads evenly on my skin.  After applying it, I use my finger to spread it in.  I am then able to apply foundation over the top of it.  I have fair skin, and this particular shade was perfect!  It blended extremely well with my skin tone.  It stays in place all day, and doesn't run or smear.  I really like it!  If you are looking for a concealer that corrects the darkness under your eyes, then give this a try!

It has a bit more yellow in its tone than I expected for the color "nude". I have dark circles and it was adequate to cover them well. I applied it lightly dabbing it on AFTER moisturizing, also not swiping the stick (like a lipstick applicator) under my eyes.

 It goes on OK, I am 58 years old and if I swiped it across, under my eyes it would have pulled on my old/crepey skin as it does NOT glide across, but is a thicker, denser formula.

So if you have older skin, do moisturize first then definitely dabbing and blending is the way to go. I applied my foundation over it and I think it worked pretty good. The yellow/warmer than I normally would have chosen color blended right in so it looked fine. BTW I used a 12X mirror attached to my window so I could see how it looked in natural daylight which is the ultimate way to test/evaluate it.
summary: The nude color is a warmer tone than I anticipated, it had a yellow cast to it but it still worked good under my foundation.

reviewText:
I have light skin and normally wear L'Oreal True Match foundation in soft ivory and use L'Oreal True Match corrector in N123 fair/light and I found this Vichy corrective stick in nude was darker than I was expecting it to be and a little too dark for me.
I do like the product though, it applies nicely and blends in well.  I would consider it light to moderate coverage.  The pricing on it is way too bloated for me to switch over to it though.
summary: Works well but darker than I was expecting

reviewText:
My daughter, 15 yo, and myself, old mom, got to play around with both the NUDE and SAND colors.  It was fun.

One thing I can tell you is that neither the SAND nor the NUDE will work for anyone with a really pale complexion.  My daughter is blessed with a peaches and cream complexion and both of these concealers looked like blushes on her.

One the other hand, I with my slightly reddish complexion did fine with both.  Go figure.  I put it on my cheeks where I have a tiny broken vein and both hid it.

PROBLEMS
-- When I say that the SAND and NUDE concealer hid the tiny red line that is my broken vein I mean that if I dabbed them on that they did their job.  If I swiped them on they did not cover the spot.  You have to build up some of the slightly waxy concealer.

-- Which brings up another problem that I noticed.  The moment I put a foundation on over the concealer the concealer vanished.  It would appear to have dissolved and blended too well with the foundation.

-- I also found another test subject.  One with an age spot on her hand.  I've put up two pictures with and without the concealer so you can see it at work.

-- Pale skin.  I talked about it above but if you are pale neither of these concealers will look natural.  With my poor camera skills you might not be able to make out the difference, but I tried to show what they look like on my daughter.

SUMMARY
I'm actually likely to wear this without foundation.  The reason being that if I dab-dab-dabbed it on it certainly covered nicely but it didn't stay put when I tried it with foundation.

If you a pale go with something other than Nude.
summary: Works But Not for a Porcelein Skin, Doesn't last.

reviewText:
I have tried many different corrective sticks. I have an autoimmune condition which has left me with several broken capillaries on my face and these type sticks have proved to be godsends. I have a light complexion with if anything, a little bit of yellow so I have to be careful about getting any foundation or cover-stick that is too dark or rosy.

This color - sand - worked great. I put just a dab on after moisturizer. The directions tell you to layer the cover stick and I don't know why I hadn't thought of that before, but it does help. Personally, I have to put a little bit of a foundation (really a lightweight BB cream) on top to help blend it in.

I do recommend this. You may be able to find similar products that are cheaper but do know you are getting a nice, creamy quality cover stick if you go with this one.
summary: This really works nicely to cover your spots and dots

reviewText: I really like this concealer. I've used it consistently under my eyes and on a few dark spots. It works great to make my dark circles less visible. And it takes a layer of darkness out of the dark spots. It works very well on acne as well. I've found that if I use it in the morning when putting on my makeup, it lasts well throughout the day. Note: I use light foundation/makeup. If you have a lot to cover up, I'm not sure how it will work.

Vichy skin care products are some of my new favorites, so I was a little disappointed by the Dermafinish corrective stick. It's essentially a concealer, for applying alongside foundation + powder. The corrective stick provides medium to high coverage, and blends easily into the surrounding skin to make concealment natural. The biggest suggestion I have is to make sure you get the correct color.

I have very fair skin and chose 'opal.' WRONG choice. I was hoping it would be like other brands' ivory - it's not. It has a darker tone and doesn't effectively blend, as a result, on my skin. (It would help them a lot to use more standardized color descriptions for the product, I think, too).
summary: Need better naming conventions, but good medium/high coverage concealer

reviewText: I use the shade Medium Brown on my Level 5 brown all-over color on gray hair. This if the best root touch-up I've used. It does not make your hair feel dirty like many others. Maybe it is like eye shadow, as a reviewer wrote, but I've tried eye shadow, and this product is way better. Maybe you could use this brush in eye shadow, after product is gone. I don't know, though. I'm just going to keep buying this! And it is a little messy after you use it a while, gets brown powder on my vanity area and in my drawer. So now I put it in a snack-size zip bag, problem solved.
summary: Great product, couldn't manage without it

reviewText: useless. I returned it
This product really works as it says.  It is easy to apply.  It is not messy.  You apply it and it looks so natural and it lasts until you wash you hair.  Amazing product

Love, love,  love!  Stays on well and is soft on my hair. Color blends well and it can even be used on eyebrows! I wish it was a bit less expensive but as any good product, it's worth it. Lasts for months.
PERFECT!

helps me to extend my root colouring by a week!  It goes on easily , is waterproof and stays on well.  It is great, the only thing I might say is that if you have it on and then you are going to colour your hair, I'm not sure the colour will take as well.  Probably better to wash your hair first and then the next day to colour if you are using this.
Its better than anything I bought in the past because it does not create a mess or makes my hair sticky. I am giving it a 4 because it does not stay on for a long. I have to reapply.
This is a really good product. Works just as asvertised and is quick and easy. Works great for brows too!
summary: Just for the quick touch up

reviewText: Great for root touch up coverage. There's a video tutorial on their site that's very helpful in how to apply it.
Covers roots really nicely.  It stays on all day. Some touch up the next day. I have medium brown hair & I ordered the light brown looks really good!
this really helps!
Letting my hair go gray so am using this on the intrum...it works really well and seems to last for a good while too.
summary: Happy to have this product available...good for inbetween coloring too.

reviewText:
I have dark brown hair - almost black - and it's very noticeable when there's any gray. As my son says, "kind of looks like sparkles." Not what I want to hear.

I have colored it for years but the older I get, the less flattering it is to have it too dark - especially near the face -  and when I've tried to make it lighter I end up with it looking brassy. I wish there was some sort of semi-permanent color that would just color the grays and have them look like highlights but so far that doesn't exist.

So, for the past several months my hairdresser has only been highlighting and lowlighting my hair and not using any more base color and I think this is going to be the answer for me, but it's been frustrating knowing that I have a ways to go until it looks right and is more fully grown out. The white/gray still stands in too much contrast to the rest of my hair - so I decided  to  give this a try.

I am so glad I did. At first I tried the blonde root cover because I figured that would work best to just highlight the white  but it turns out that for me, the light  brown is best and covers the gray better. The blonde almost leaves it a little gold/orange wheras the light brown turns the gray into more of a carmel/beige which is just what I was looking for.

I use the brush (both ends  work fine for me) and just brush the color on the gray, starting  at the root. If I go too fast a little bit will end up on the scalp but it's light enough to look okay and so much better than having the gray stand out.

Highly highly recommended. It truly adheres to the hair and it doesn't make your hair "sticky" like some of the mascara-like coverups.
summary: This was just was I was looking for; makes the grays look like highlights and doesn't make hair sticky

reviewText: i ordered it for my mom and she really , the brush so small and take time but it do it work ,,
summary: i ordered it for my mom and she really, ...

reviewText: I was skeptical about this because it's in powder form.  Didn't expect sufficient coverage.  The name of the product is WOW.  That is exactly what I said with the first brush stroke. I was really surprised. Takes a while to get used to, but I think it works great.  Not sure how long it will last, though.  Nice brush and big mirror, too.
No different than most good exfoliating cleansers.
Nice gentle exfoliating cleanser.  I use it once a day and it's lasted for quite a while.
This product is amazing!
Love the way this makes my skin look and feel

I ordered one of the luxury sample boxes and the Wow styling cream was included. I love this stuff. I have gray hair in the front, darker in the back, and it's all frizzy and out of control, even cut short!

I don't like messing with my hair, a simple wash, air dry, so styling gels and creams that are put on wet or are for using with blow dryers or curling irons just leave my hair looking greasy and limp. The WOW instantly smoothed the frizzy bangs and sides and left my hair smooth and shiny. I can also use my fingers to add some texture and it holds.

For me wow is truly WOW

Have used MANY frizz control and smoothing products, and this Color Wow did not WOW me.  It was OK, but at this price?  Have bleached hair that can get really POOFY when it is humid, and this product helped.  But I can't really say it did a much better job than the products and serums I've used that command half the price.

On the other hand, my boyfriend, who has a long goatee growing (think that guy from Anthrax), really liked how it turned his coarse hairs silky smooth.

I have to say I kind of love this stuff.  I have a ton of hair and I am not always in the mood to blow every strand straight.  I allowed my hair to air dry and put about a quarter sized dollop of this stuff through it.  I should also add that we were at the beach all day, it was misting and my hair was wild!  I noticed that my hair became smoother without feeling slick or sticky. I loved what it did to my hair. My husband also used it and he had great results, too.

I think that this is a nice extra product to have on hand when you want smoother hair without a lot of work.

First I will say that while I give this 3.5 stars for my own hair experience, Color WOW mousse received five solid stars from me. That particular product worked wonders on my baby fine hair, and I highly recommend it. Best styling product I've used in my hair in a long long time.

I don't care for the scent of this one - when I apply it, unlike the other two WOW products I've used, it seems to irritate me-the scent does. In a strong unpleasant-for-me scent. I can "taste" it even. This is one I can't use for that reason - 2.0 stars for that!

However, color WOW shampoo and this styling cream don't work quite as well on my baby fine hair. If I apply just a touch of this cream to my ends (if they become a little frizzled) it does help to smooth them out, but I'm not as happy with the texture. If I apply it all over, and even trying the shot of blow drying (my dry hair - it's made for dry hair), I still get that kind of "dirty" look and feel to my hair - it's a bit too heavy for me.

All that written, I believe that like the shampoo, this cream would be great for someone with thicker hair that tends to frizz. I'm going to stick with WOW color mousse - that stuff did miracles on my hair! But the cream isn't made for my hair type.

Even though I gave it three stars - that is only my experience because of my particular hair type - I do believe this cream would be a five star for many of you out there, so give it a try! And if you have super baby fine super soft hair as I do, then do try the WOW mousse--that stuff worked miracles on my hair!
summary: A good product, but a little too heavy for my hair type

reviewText:
This stuff smells wonderful.  It is highly scented and after it all dries, it does leave significant scent in the hair.  It smells tropical to me, but more like a pineapple vanilla scent - it doesn't really smell like anything I've smelled before.  It's nice, and works well for men and women.

I love that this goes on dry hair.  It lets me put it right where it's needed.  It's a thin white cream in a tube container, and it comes out evenly and well.  It's easy to control the amount that comes out.  It only takes a bit for me because I am able to put it right where I needed it instead of all over my head.

It works good for my son's curly frizzies - he color treats his long hair and gets some serious frizz where his hair is very curly close to his ears.  This controls it well.  I like it for smoothing down sections of my hair before braiding it.  It makes braids look a lot neater and shinier.  Also, the very ends of my braids are often like straw because that is the longest, most damaged hair.  It softens those dry straw ends well.

It's not by any means a 'natural product.'  The ingredient list is long and mostly stuff I can't pronounce, but it does work.
summary: Really great for long braids- smooths the strands well, and softens the ends; fragrant

reviewText: My hair is bleached, in an inverted bob style, and has a slight natural curl. On humid days my hair frizzes out at the bottom and my entire head looks like a pyramid in Egypt. This tames my hair, but no better than other frizz taming products such as Frizz-Ease. I tried it both ways: applying and pulling through with a flat brush, and also the 15 second blow-dry method.
summary: OK, no better than others I've used

reviewText:
Frankly I had no high hopes with this product and thought it would be similar to other brands like CHI.  Color WOW is much different, it's a white colored styling cream, looks and feels the same as any thick face cream.  It's very easy to apply and not at all sticky. I have long and thick hair and use only a small drop size cream. When first applied to may hair, I didn't see any difference BUT the moment I started using my hair straightener, I could see the amazing results. My hair were straight in no time and looked and felt silky. It didn't add any shine though.

I definitely recommend the product, it has already become one of my favorite and reliable beauty products.
summary: A Reliable product that gives WOW Results

reviewText: I have very thick, darkly dyed hair.  This styling cream is a good consistency-not too thick, but not too thin.  I used about a quarter size amount (for hair that is just below the shoulder).  I used it as instructed and worked it in from the root to the tip after drying my hair.  (Prior to using this, I also washed my hair using WOW brand shampoo and conditioner).  It did make my hair smell nice and gave me a little bit of body with some smoothness, but overall, it left my hair looking a bit greasy and after using it, I could get 2 days of my wash.  I slept on my hair and the next morning it looked so greasy I had to wash it again (which only happened when I used the styling cream, not just the shampoo and conditioner).  Overall, it works for the day, but left me a bit greasy, so I don't know that I would use it all the time.
summary: Ok, but left me a bit greasy

reviewText: I don't see anything Wow-worthy about this.  It didn't smell bad, or make my hair seem dirty, nor did it seem to do anything that improved my hair texture without blowdrying, or in addition to blowdrying.  Meh

There are two things that would keep me from actually buying this product (I was given a sample to test and review) and they are the ingredient list (scary) and the price. I have very fine, color-treated hair I wear in a bob. If I don't blow dry it it usually looks like a seriously dowdy mess. This stuff DOES make it easier to shape when dry. However, I found there to be a residue that felt kind of icky if you were too generous with it, or spread it unevenly. Seriously, don't put a lot on at first and if your hair is fine, be very judicious.

I live in a place that has NO humidity and the wind and dry environment leaves my hair straw-like. I tend to agree with another reviewer who recommended olive oil. Seriously, olive oil or aragon oil are both about the same as this and much cheaper.

Yes, the older I get the drier my hair gets making it hard to manage not to mention looking good. I often wash my hair before I go to bed, in the morning its frizzy and all over the place. WOW goes best on dry hair, you only need a small dab, work it in and arrange your hair as you like it. Using a hair drier and a brush( I find my boar bristle hair brush works best) style your hair as you wish and if you have the same results you'll have shinny hair thats come alive, its NOT greasy or oily just smooth shinny hair that looks like you spent a lot more time getting it to look so good. I understand its safe for dyed hair too so if you don't have lots of time and want your hair looking fresh and smooth this might be worth a try.
summary: Makes my dry hair look alive and feel soft and smooth and its quick and easy to use!

reviewText:
I have fine hair and live in humid Ohio, so when the summer comes with it's Lake Erie humidity, my fine hair goes to frizz. I always use a good rinse out conditioner, so it keeps my hair somewhat normal, but absolutely no amount of conditioner helps when the humidity is really high.

What I like about this WOW One-Minute Transformation is it's a quick alternative to blow drying your hair. Less heat, means less frizz. You put it on dry hair where you need it to control the frizz. You can also put it on and using a round brush and a blow dryer, can style your hair.

The smell is lightly pleasant and it does tame the frizz. What I don't like is the price- $24.00 for 4 ounces. One humid summer day, we had unexpected out of state relatives stop by. We took photos and I didn't realize on this hot muggy day that my hair was a frizz nightmare, until I saw the photos later. I asked my hair dresser what could I have done to tame the frizz that day in a pinch. He said you probably have it in your house- EVOO. Extra Virgin Olive Oil. So, even though this WOW Transformation is great to tame frizz, for me it's cheaper to put a couple drops of EVOO on my hair on those super humid days here in Ohio. It's still a good product that can tame your frizz, but that price keeps it from getting 5 stars.

If I had done my research before hand, I would not have ordered this product.  I did try it before I read the ingredients and found it only marginally helped my dry, frizzy hair.  It did make it bit shinier, but didn't really tame it like the video shows so I don't feel like I'm losing the best thing ever by not using it. I certainly didn't say "wow". If you use a hot dryer and a round brush, even without products, it will smooth down and shine more so I don't think that part of the video is a good representation of how it works.
Now that I have read the ingredients and done my research I can't recommend this product. The second ingredient is PROPYLENE GLYCOL, an ingredient that various websites warn against using.  It's the same ingredient that is in anti-freeze.  It works by breaking down the hair so it appears shiny and relaxed, but it can irritate the skin and can be absorbed. Factory workers are told to use goggles and gloves when handling this ingredient, according to one website.  It is a very common ingredient in shampoos and conditions, and I'm not saying this product is any worse than another, but I, personally, am trying to put less chemicals in and on my body since I'm so sensitive to so many things these days.. There are a lot of other ingredients listed as well with long chemical names that may or may not be bad, but since Propylene Gycol is number 2 after water on the list, I stopped there and won't use it again.  I advise anyone to do their own research and see if it is a concern, or not, to you.  As I said, it's in a lot of products and has been used for years, but of course that doesn't make it a good thing.

This worked well on my fine straight hair.  I have Asian hair which doesn't get frizzy even on the most humid days.  I have a lot of hair and  need product to help style and keep my hair in place.  It doesn't clump up and isn't sticky.  I put the Color Wow on my damp hair and it kept my hair well styled as it dried.
summary: Works well on straight hair too

reviewText:
This stuff is  AMAZING!  It works just as advertised!  A small bit is plenty enough to help tame my frizzy mane.  I love wearing my hair in a ponytail or bun, and always is hairs standing up on end everywhere.  Hair spray never does does trick, and hair gel just makes my hair look like I just sprayed a coating of shellac on my head.  A small dollop of WOW evenly distributed on my head after putting it up keeps my hairs down all day long.  It slides on smoothly and no greasy reside or look left behind.

The only question I have is if it can be used with flat irons?  There is no mention of it anywhere.

This really does work! I was skeptical, but read the other reviews and decided to give it a try. I love it and am honestly shocked that it worked as advertised.  Yay for a product that truly helps control the fizz!
summary: I love it and am honestly shocked that it worked as ...

reviewText:
I have ugly hair--there I admit it.  It's fine but there's a lot of it.  It's color treated once a month to hide those horrible wiry gray hairs.  I have a huge cowlick near my bangs.  It's started to curl in the past four years naturally.  It frizzes in humid weather and in cold weather. It's past my shoulders.  Again it's ugly.

I use copious amounts of Sebastian's Potion 9 for several years.  It works but I saw this and decided to give it a try.  For a week I used it daily.  Wow is right.  It ranks right up there with the Potion 9.  You use it sparingly and I worked it into towel dried hair to tame that cowlick and I kid you not, it tamed it.  I didn't have use a blow dryer to wrestle it down.  I combed it through and the WOW flattened it and actually made it look natural.  There's a small smell--not unpleasant but it goes away.

I can't decide if I'll stay with Potion 9 or completely switch over to Wow.  I'll be trying the shampoo next.
summary: Color Wow One Minute Styling Cream

reviewText: This product seems best suited to those who wish to straighten curly hair with a blow dryer, and 'touch up' in between. It wasn't suited to me, since I let my natural curls 'go' natural. It made the hair look messy and fly-away.

okay I can actually say "WOW" to this product. My hair is not good with just putting styling cremes like this in and going without a blow dry, it always ends up with it being awesome for taming fly aways, but not very stylish with my flat flat hair. I put this in my hair, it smells wonderful by the way, and then used my curl brush and blew my hair out. OH so smooth, it styled wonderfully without any added products! It left my hair super shiny, and I can run my fingers through and the style still stays! I love that its for colored hair, that it helps me keep my color vibrant!

I got a new radical haircut with a million layers in strange places.  I found out the heat and high humidity where I live combined with my frizzy wavy, and now curly hair, make my fashion forward new cut look like a tangled rat's nest.  No amount of straightening nor blowing out will tame this.
I got this, put on a quarter sized handful, and my hair tamed down and the frizz was gone so the shape of the haircut was again visible.
This is exactly what my hair needed.  It does not make hair dirty or greasy at all but is really does tame frizz completely on the frizziest hair.
It smooths it down and gives it a bit of texture and weight.  The instructions say to use it on dry hair.
This has no scent.  It is slightly expensive and the tube is on the smaller side so it's a premium product but I admit that without thinking I did say to myself "wow", then looked at the tube and laughed.  They named it right.

I have short, fine hair that tends to be frizzy and dry. This product, applied after my hair has been washed and air-dried, adds shine and tames the frizz. Since my hair is short, I put a bit on my fingers and run them through my hair. For longer hair, it might work better to use a brush after applying. The cream has a light, pleasant scent that's not overpowering. I'm satisfied with this product!

I was wary of ordering this, since so many hair products are over-scented or have a scent I just don't like (i.e. they usually smell cheap). I was pleasantly surprised by this one. It is perfumed, but not heavily, and it makes my wavy/curly/frizzy hair MUCH more manageable. I love it. This is one product I plan to keep on buying. Recommended.

reviewText: This really works fast.  I was afraid it would weigh down my fine hair, but it worked as promised.  My hair has been a bit dry and fly-away frizzy recently.  I occasionally color my hair.  This color wow product really brought shine to my hair and smoothed it down without making it flat.  I applied it to dry hair and used a brush.  I have not needed to use a dryer to smooth down the pieces.  I'm glad I tried this.  I recommend it.
summary: Wow is right! Great for fine hair.

reviewText:
I've been using Nexxus mousse for awhile now,  which is around a similar quality and price point as this mousse, however I have I am much more pleased with the WOW results.

First the volume is much better, I can use less product and get loads of volume and bounce, which is great because if I use too much of the other brand it sometimes actually weighs my hair down.  This mousse also makes my hair very soft and untouchable, so I get more of a natural look.

I like what it does to my dyed blonde hair too, I feel like the blonde is a bit more natural looking after use and definitely shinier and prettier. I use it with the shampoo and can really see the difference. Trying the conditioner next!

What styling mousse can do to light blonde colored hair is a nightmare- it's usual chemicals and alcohol can turn blonde hair brassy and the alcohol will dry it into a breaking nightmare. That's why I've always avoided mousse until now.

This WOW Brass Banned Correct & Perfect Mousse For Blonde Hair is so gentle on colored hair, it's hard to believe it's a mousse. When your hair is damp, you just shake, turn the can upside down and spray some into your palm, then smooth on and style your hair. The product is light and full of air bubbles in a lovely lavender shade. It's the texture of airy meringue and it smells beautiful.

There is no stiffness nor is it sticky. It is smooth, light and airy. It really gives color treated hair body and bounce without the drying alcohol damage. The best part is, as light as this mousse is, it lasts all day, giving your hair hold and style a full 8 hours. I find this WOW Mousse perfect for my light blonde colored hair and for it's gentle non damaging or drying formula earns my 5 STARS.
summary: Beautiful Body & Bounce Without The Brass & Alcohol

reviewText: Not a blonde but I am blessed with intentional and unintentional silver streaks.  Aforementioned streaks get brassy as well and this mousse does well to keep them bright and shiny.  Also, this is simply a fantastic mousse - not sticky - airy with lots of volume!

4.5 because of water like consistency.

This shampoo is very safe for all types of hair that has been colored.  I have about 4 different colors in my hair right now.  The base has been colored mostly Ash with the bottom blue and purple.  When I used different shampoo, the color faded quite quickly.  I have now adjusted to washing my hair twice a week and with cold water in order to preserve the bright color longer.  This does a really great job of cleaning without stripping the color and leaves it soft.  The only issue I have with the shampoo is that it has the consistency of water and just pours out of the container.  I always end up using too much.  I wish it had a thicker feel to it for easier use.
summary: Really does preserve color but too watery.

reviewText: Love the smell, and the product seems to keep my color longer than my normal shampoo. Will update after longer use.
summary: So far, so good; seems to have the color hold longer.

reviewText: I like how thick this shampoo is. I use less, and the tube lasts longer, than the drugstore brand I've been using. However, it works just the same as those drugstore brands. I haven't noticed any difference in how it enhanced/preserved my color.

I know there's a movement away from high lather shampoos.  And believe me, I tried WEN and L'Oréal's Evercreme like everyone else in hopes of some miracle for my baby fine hair, but conditioning cleansers just weighed my hair down, making it look limp and greasy.  So I need to start by saying I'm thrilled with the super-rich, almost pudding-like, lather you get from Color WOW Security Shampoo.  I've been using it for two weeks, in conjunction with the Color WOW Conditioner (which I absolutely adore) and, so far, am pleased with the results.

The big distinction between the two is that the shampoo's fragrance is much milder (and more pleasant) than the conditioner, which smells a bit chemically.  However, of the two products, I think the conditioner provides more tangible results.  That's not to say that the shampoo isn't top notch.  I love the rich lather and the shine it gives my hair.  I just wish it was specially formulated for fine hair (like the conditioner) because, since using the shampoo, I've noticed that my hair starts to droop by day's end.  Also, the price is fairly prohibitive.  The cost of the two together is $46 and, while a little really does go a long way, that's just too expensive for every day use.

All in all, an exceptional haircare line if you can afford it.

I've been doing color weaves on my hair for many many years, and never had trouble with the color fading.  But recently I added a burgundy streak (to match my Oscar dress) and pretty much assumed that it, like the Oscars, would last about 6 hours.

It is now the end of April and the streak is still there.  I started using COLOR WOW and this morning, it seemed a bit brighter than it had before.  I'm not sure i this was a trick of light or some COLOR WOW magic, but I'm always happy to believe in magic.

My only issue with the shampoo is that I can't get the %&^*ing top open.  It's a very thin brittle plastic and mornings find me in the shower trying to pry it open with anything I can find, from toenail clippers to waterpiks to toothbrushes.  I fear that, one morning when I manage to get it open, the top will snap off completely and it will hemorrhage all my magic shampoo right down the drain.

I am always looking for a non-sulfate shampoo for my color treated hair.  I like to keep the color vibrant for as long as I can before dropping a small fortune at the beauty salon.  I used this shampoo three times before writing this review and was pleased with the fresh smell and the healthy appearance of my hair.  My only complaint, there was absolutely no way my hair worked into a lather with only a coin sized amount of shampoo.  I needed to use double the amount all three times I used this product before my hair would lather.  The shampoo rinsed out easily and did not leave my hair feeling greasy or limp.  I guess the real test will be time and how long the color will look and feel vibrant avoiding a trip back to the salon.  This is a very expensive shampoo so that is the question that is most important in my decision to buy the shampoo again.
summary: If it works as it claims, it will save money at the salon

reviewText:
My hair is dyed blonde and has been looking a bit over processed, dry and the color could be a bit shinier.

I used the product as advertised and have to say first of all, it lathers up nicely and has a pleasant, light scent.  It took a few times of using it, but I noticed after awhile, my hair started looking fresher and shinier and not as dry and over processed. I have not tried the conditioner with it, but definitely notice a difference just from the shampoo and hope to see continuing improvement.

This shampoo lathers a lot, and can leave your hair a little greasy if you apply too much, so you want to use only a tiny bit. Good thing because this shampoo is whoppingly expensive.  Yes, it washes my hair and yes, only a little color comes out; but there are less expensive shampoos that work just as well for me.
summary: OK shampoo but not worth the price

reviewText: This may do wonderful things for my damaged and color-treated hair, but I can't get past the fact that it doesn't lather at all. If it doesn't lather, it doesn't really spread throughout your hair either. I tried it twice, once after another, in an attempt to lather and spread throughout my hair and scalp, with no luck. I did not obtain that "squeaky-clean" feeling. Shampoo is not a winner for me.
summary: This may do wonderful things for my damaged and color-treated hair

reviewText: I used this in conjunction with the Color WOW Conditioner, as recommended.  It lathers very well and rinses clean.  It has a good scent, but is not overpowering.  It left my hair vibrant and the color looked very shiny (It's dyed a dark, black cherry color).  It is a bit pricey (currently $22 for 8.4 oz) so I knocked off a star for that, as I've used less expensive color guard shampoos that work pretty much the same as this one.  Overall, when used with the conditioner, it works well, but nothing super spectacular (and a bit pricey for me to purchase regularly).

Luxury shampoo with low sudsing rich lather, and very little scent. This was very pleasant to use on my platinum/white hair, keeping it soft, with some nice natural shine. The tube is really huge, and a little went a long way on my very short hair. I would guess the tube will last 4-6 months.

Expensive, but definitely worth a try if you are having salon color done regularly and want to offer your hair some extra-kind care.

I spend a lot of money coloring my hair and don't want the color to fade away and leave the gray.  I was surprised at the amount of lather considering that this is a sulfate-free shampoo.  Obviously it didn't give me a huge head of lather, but I had expected a lot less.  And it didn't take very much product to lather up my shoulder length hair either.  There is a light scent but it didn't bother me.  I used it with my old conditioner but wanted to try it in combination with the conditioner that goes with it so I bought some of that to go with it.

My hair felt shiny and soft.  This might be my new"go to" shampoo.  It is a little more expensive than I usually pay for my sulfate free shampoo that I buy at Target but paying a little more for a good product might save me some touch up costs for my hair.

I do a lot of coloring to my hair, thanks to premature grey running in the family and, well, let's just say I like color. Right now I'm going with chocolate brown on the roots/top part and violet on the ends, so yeah, that's a lot of coloring. I've also tried a lot of different shampoos to protect the various colors and help my hair recover from the bleaching, ranging from the higher ends to the low.

WOW is nice in that it is sulfate-free and doesn't have much of a scent (at least for me). You don't need to use a lot (though since my hair is longer, I did need a little more than a 'coin size'). It lathers up well, and my hair was in good condition when I was done (though I do use a heavy, non-WOW conditioner to help with the bleaching et all). However, I have to say that I did notice some color-run off still while using this product, from the violet dye. Since that happens even with other color-'safe' shampoos I use, I can't say too much, but the brown seems to be holding up well.

This does seem to work well and I'll continue using it, but not sure I'll buy another tube since it doesn't work better than a cheaper color-safe shampoo I've been using.

(As an update: I let a friend borrow this shampoo who has very long thick hair that tends to "frizz" and she loved it! Couldn't say enough good things about it--so, for her she'd give this shampoo 5 stars)

Bottom line on this shampoo is: for $22 a tube, am I impressed enough to want to purchase it, or recommened it to a friend? And the answer is: not really. Now, that written, it doesn't mean the shampoo does not have merits or isn't really great for my, or your, hair. However, a shampoo this pricey has to make me go "wow! I love this product!" And I didn't have that experience.

 I have tried many many shampoos and what I look for to "wow" me is: do I like the scent (if a scented product); does it make my hair look shiny; do I notice any difference in my hair; price compared to experience; etc.

I used a "coin-sized" amount and applied to my wet hair - it did lather up quite well. I didn't notice any scent at all with my experience--so if you like a little or non-scented product, you may like this (I don't know why some reviewers noted a heavier scent - that has me puzzled why I had little or no scent at all) - I like my shampoo to have a fresh clean or exotic scent so I was a little disappointed in this. The product rinsed out well.

After towel-drying, I blew dried my hair, and I didn't say "wow!" My hair didn't look any different from when I used another shampoo in my arsenal that cost half as much.

As well, I had just applied semi-perm color to my highlighted hair to deepen the color a bit, and was hoping the Wow would extend the color but from the first shampoo with Wow, some of the color was still lost--I don't "blame" the shampoo; I was just hopeful that the first shampoo wouldn't strip any of the color using an expensive shampoo.

The next day after shampooing, my hair was limp. This happens often with certain shampoos, but I was disappointed that my hair didn't look Amazing for the price of this shampoo. I will say as for the price: I have bought Aveda products that were quite pricey, but I have that experience with those products of:  "My hair looks and smells amazing!" That's what I lacked here with this shampoo. Some shampoos just work for some and not so well for others: it's all in how our hair reacts to a product.

On a positive note, from the claims and ingredients or lack of certain ingredients, this shampoo may be healthier for hair, but I as I wrote above, I have shampoos that cost half as much for which I am pleased with the results. They claims as stated: "Color Security Shampoo is a 180 degree departure from typical color care products. Not only formulated without sulfates, it also does NOT contain silicones, conditioning agents or pearlizing agents...one or more of which is found in virtually every sulfate-free shampoo on the market."-- this may make this shampoo great for my hair but I still want that "My hair looks and smells amazing!" effect that prompts me to want more.

As with all my reviews, I ask myself: would I purchase this and would I be excited enough to recommend it to a friend? And the answer is: I am not sure I would--perhaps with continued use I'll be convinced, but so far, I can't imagine spending $22 on shampoo. I would recommend to someone who wants a shampoo that doesn't have the silocones and sulfates and etc as this shampoo advertises. For me, I just want a shampoo that leave my hair looking great, smelling great, and is in my budget.
summary: I wasn't wowed but it does have its merits

reviewText: This shampoo is just as good as any other similar product. It has a light, pleasing scent.

I was a little astonished by the price ... could this really be worth it? Turns out that the answer is a resounding ... yes! Not only is this an excellent styling product (volume galore!), but the lilac tint really does tone-down any brassiness. So, is it a gimmick? For, what I am seeing, it truly is not. Moreover, I have been using this for over three weeks now ... and there is still plenty left! So, even though the price is daunting, it seems that you will need to buy it fairly infrequently.

Finally, does it stand up to the boyfriend test? It does! My hair is not crunchy, shiny, or stiff! Nice!

This is a wonderful surprise! I am so happy to report that this is worth every penny!

Highly recommended!

I have blonde thin but naturally curly hair.
I normally do not color my hair but have a special occasion coming up so thought would splurge for it.
Glad I have this product to help keep the color longer and it really helps to keep the curls under control.
Normally my hair can get unruly but this mousse is not only good at keeping the color brighter for longer it is helping keep the frizz under control.
I do not need to use very much at all and it seems to add more volume to my hair than only other mousse I have tried in the past.
It took a bit to get used to the color though since it is not white but more of a light purple.
The scent is not over powering for me which most of them are this one is more light clean scent to it. Nothing overly floral thank goodness.
This is working well for my hair type and texture.
summary: Color WOW helps to keep the color brighter and frizz away

reviewText:
We had an incident of bright red hair in our house recently.  This was the shade I thought would best because it says it takes out brassy tones.  LOL.  Theres a lot of brass involved.

Anyway, the other issue was stiff hair that seems really brittle.  I am using this on it, hoping to help the consistency of his hair.  It's helpng.

Color WOW Brass Banned Mousse comes out just as pictured, a faint purple mouse, just right for balancing out that nasty brassy cast colored hair can get when it needs to be touched up.

The mousse is only faintly scented, and adds light body to my hair. All of that being said, the lavender of the mousse is just a bit of help when your hair needs it; I'd recommend using it daily to be sure the hair is getting a steady violet toner to offset the brass, rather than waiting until the last two weeks before coloring when hair can really look bad. There just isn't enough violet to help that sort of brassy situation!

I was very pleased with the effect this had on my super pale platinum blond/grey hair between colorings.
summary: Tones out the loud and brassy

reviewText: This mousse is just like other's of it's kind, in that it works just like your typical mousse.  It accentuates my curls, and leaves my hair soft.  I have highlights in my hair, and they are subtle.  I didn't notice that this mousse did anything in terms of making the color look better.  Perhaps, it works more effectively for someone who has blonder hair than I do.  It is pretty expensive for mousse, but if you think this will work for you, then give it a try.  As a mousse, I can say that it is a nice, quality mousse.

This acts like regular mousse like was common many years ago.  It is advertised as brass-banning, and I didn't see a difference in my foiled/highlighted hair, and I was hoping for one.  It has only the faintest lavender tint, so I'm thinking there is not enough of the tint to really neutralize gold/reds, since most color balancing products for blonds are a deeply saturated purple color.  At any rate, it seems it will not contribute to brassiness, and it is a pretty good mousse. Although I don't try to get "big hair" anymore, I used this and I liked that although I straightened my hair as usual, the next time I re-styled my hair I used hot rollers and it actually "took" the curl, which I've noticed is a problem after straightening my hair with a straightening iron.  Not sure if any mousse would have this effect, since it is not a product I buy anymore.  I did get this for the brass-neutralizing effects and would give that two star, but as a mousse, it is a great product.

I usually never use mousse because it seems to weigh my fine hair down and it feels icky to the touch.  I have tried all sorts of hair products and end up just not using them and throwing them away.  But I tried this one and it seems to neither weigh my hair down nor does it feel unpleasant afterwards.  I applied it to my half-way dried hair and it seemed to give more volume.  Also, after just coloring my hair and having a lot of brassiness it seemed to tone it down.

I don't recommend it for very thick hair, but should be great for fine hair.

I liked:
Easy to apply
Increased volume
Nice smelling, not too strong
Reduced brassiness
Not too much comes out, just the right amount

Did not like:
I didn't like the way it felt the next day, hair felt sticky and I thought I should wash it again
summary: Good for fine hair and fly-away hair

reviewText:
As far as a mousse goes, I'm a huge fan of COLOR WOW. I have fine, soft hair - so mousse is a great way for me to get texture and hold without using hairspray to make everything sticky. I used this before blow drying and using my flat iron to create beachy waves and it worked well. Because my hair is fine, it gets greasy too fast to ever feel like I can do the whole "second day hair" look - but I can tell from the texture and feel of my hair the next morning that you could absolutely style it again and get the same hold - which is awesome.

As far as the color goes, mayyyybe my gray hairs are a bit more stubborn that the other reviewers, but this did absolutely nothing to cover them up. I have a balayage/ombre color so my ends are blonde and the roots are brown, so that could be why it didn't work as well for me as it does for others. I feel like it did give my highlights a little pop when I used it, though!
summary: Great mousse, okay with the color

reviewText: Great mousse. It works just like a typical mousse. It also adds bounce and volume to my fine hair, leaving it nice and soft looking. I don't have blonde hair or color treated hair, but slightly highlighted hair. That said, it doesn't seem to make the highlight look better though. Perhaps it would work better for blonde hair. It is pricey, but it does volumize my hair better than other mousses that I've tried. Great product.

I have blonde hair with purple highlights and the blonde part is now more ashy, so I am trying to keep the yellow tones out of my hair.  I have used a shampoo with purple in it to protect the blonde so this is a new twist on that formula.  I am currently using the Wow shampoo and conditioner so this next step is a great way to continue the product.

The mousse has a really nice pump that doesn't get out of control.  It is easy to get just the right amount.  I use about a dallop the size of fifty cent piece for my shoulder length hair.  It is light enough to not weigh down my fine hair.  After using this for about a week, I find that any brassy tones are not appearing inbetween colorings like it used to.

I am very happy with this mousse.

(corrected typo - updated 5.23)

The hardest part of using the WOW shampoo was getting it out of the tube.  Nothing would come out no matter how hard I squeezed.  Of course, I finally realized that it had with a seal inside the cap. With that problem solved, the WOW emerged as a clear liquid, which I rubbed into my hair.

I have been using the WOW without a conditioner, although it would be interesting to try the WOW conditioner too.  The WOW leaves my hair smooth and shiny.  It may take a while for me to determine how well the color will last while using WOW, but so far, so good.

Too much flowery scent, but at least it dissipates after rinsing. I like shampoos that lather; others have said this lathers a lot, but I don't find that to be the case. My hair felt "dirty" quicker when using this shampoo compared to others I've used, most of the time it's Paul Mitchell products that I use. I also didn't notice more shine, but that's hard to achieve when you color your hair blonde. As far as retaining my coloring job longer, that takes time to evaluate.
summary: Not enough lather, and my hair felt dirty sooner

reviewText: So far I am liking this shampoo! I have thick, wavy, color treated hair and I definitely notice a difference if I am using shampoos that are not formulated for color treated hair.  This stuff lathers well and leaves my color shiny and vibrant. I personally like the smell of the shampoo, it smells more like the high end salon brands. I do not own the conditioner that goes with it but I think that I would like this shampoo even more if I did! If you do not mind paying a higher price for your hair products I would see no reason not to buy this brand!

The problem with hair color is that it leaves your hair looking flat and dull.  This Color Wow shampoo works very well to make your hair get back some of the shine.  It goes on easily and lathers very well.  It has a faint smell that is somewhat generic but pleasant.  It left my hair looking clean with a light sheen.  The only real downside to this product is its price.  I have purchased Fekkai products which offer similar cleaning and shine yet are much cheaper than this.  This product is very good but the high price is hard to justify.
summary: Great Shampoo But Very High Price

reviewText:
I have extremely thick hair that resists lathering, so I can only report on this shampoo from that particular standpoint. This shampoo is a clear gel that doesn't have too strong of a perfume and made tons of rich, thick lather on the first shampoo. My test of a good shampoo, though, is if you can open your eyes while using. There are no stinging eyes with this shampoo, and it cleaned my hair thoroughly without stripping it. I did not have the WOW conditioner, so I used my own (Purelogy), and my hair came out shiny clean and very manageable, even though it was a humid day where I live.

This is a pretty pricey shampoo, for sure, but you don't need to use much (about a quarter-size dab makes loads of lather), so it will last a long time.

In summary, this shampoo did a wonderful job getting my hair clean with one shampoo and left it soft and easy to manage. Good stuff!
summary: Easy on the Hair, Easy on the Eyes

reviewText:
I have naturally blonde hair with highlights.  The highlights are because my blond hair has gotten slightly darker with age.  I only have highlights put in about every 3 months.  Being a natural blonde, I do have a rainbow of blonde colors in my natural hair, some of which are very yellow/gold looking.  This COLOR WOW Brass Banned mousse for blonde hair did tone down my brassiness.  I was actually surprised that I could tell a difference.  It just seemed to brighten things up.

I have thick hair, but it is baby fine. It is also about shoulder length.  I don't normally like using mousse, because my hair tangles easily, and other mousses have made it difficult for me to dry my hair without adding extra tangles because of the stiff feeling.  The COLOR WOW mousse did not make it feel like that.  I did feel a little difference in my texture, but nothing extreme enough to bother me or to tangle my hair.

I wash my hair at night and fix it in the morning.  I figured the mousse would not affect anything about the styling, because it felt like it normally does in the morning.  I straighten my hair with a straightening brush (looks kind of like a paddle brush but is heated).  The COLOR WOW made it so that I could wear my hair flatter if I wanted or with more volume if I wanted to go that way.  I don't like a lot of volume, but it was easy to control.

The only negative I have about this mousse is that when I brushed my hair and was straightening it, I had white debris falling onto my shoulders.  It didn't seem to do it once I was done fixing my hair, though.  It could be my reaction to the ingredients, or it could be that I waited overnight to style my hair.

My hair is rather thick, wavy (frizzy) and cut into a chin length bob.  I had it red, but have been highlighting and stripping it back to blond..  This product didn't work for me the way I'd hoped, BUT, I can see how my negatives might be a good thing for other hair types.

First of all, it made my hair feel crackly and not soft.  My hair is already thick and unruly so this was not a plus.  For people with fine hair, this may be great.

Secondly, I had trouble getting my hair to curl.  I just didn't like the way it behaved with the InStyler that I use.  It felt like it would be easier to straighten my hair with this product instead of curling it.

Lastly, I didn't notice any difference in brassiness control.  Maybe my hair is still too dark to notice much, and maybe it is cumulative.

What I did like -

The container. Dispensing is easily controlled and does not continue to bubble out like some mousses I've used.
The scent.  Not overwhelming, just nice and clean.
The texture of the mousse.  It was easy to distribute through my hair.

Conclusion -  I cannot recommend for my hair type, but I think this would work for  finer textured, straight hair.

I have color-treated blonde hair, and my hair is exceptionally thick and unruly. I do need some control, but I cannot stand stiff or sticky hair. This mousse is very gentle, and gives me styling control without stiffness. Shake the can vigorously before using, and the mouse will be nice and thick. I used it on my towel-damp hair before blow-drying and it gave my hair lift and helped tamed my crazy mane. I used it yesterday, and got up this morning with no bed-head!  My hair is still pretty much styled without any noticeable stiffness. My hair looks very natural, as if I have not used any product at all.

Good stuff--I recommend it!
summary: Works Well, Leaves Hair Looking Natural

reviewText:
My hair is naturally wavy/frizzy and out of control.  And long.  I used this the other day, some darker blonde and grays were sprouting from the roots.  First of all, the foam is a tinged lightly purple.  Okay, I thought, taking the handful and messing it in.  I will tell you that it does wonders for the hair color.  I have another 10 days or so before new color, so that is a huge plus.

Now the crazy.  My hair is volumized to the point I could go onstage with Poison or another hair band.  Usually, my hair is a mess, but the 300x volume is just crazy.  It is too much volume for this one head!  lol  My daughter can't stop laughing and staring at me.  I wish she would.  It's getting creepy.

So two thumbs way up for color boost.  And if you need a volumizer - Good Gravy, this is the product for you!
summary: WOW is right.  Too much volume - excellent color boost

reviewText:
I have a fine hair, bleached and this product is perfect for me. Looks like after a month after getting highlights my hair becomes dull a bit darker and this mousse makes them look fresher.
Also it gives nice volume which is always needed for me.
Great product.

I was doubtful this would work especially when I saw the foam is blue!  I am so happy I was wrong! This worked great on my hair, I recently dyed it and it was brassy.  This product not only took away the brassy look but worked as a styling product.
Highly recommend!
summary: Love this product! My hair looks great and no brassy tones :)

reviewText: As someone who has blond hair I dread the brass that my color can turn.  This tones it down considerably with giving my hair amazing body, lift and a bit of fullness.  This makes my hair look fantastic.  I spend a lot of time outside in the sun and in pools so my hair color can turn hideous quickly.  This makes is a neutral blond.  It also smooths the cuticle.  I have found this brand of products to be really among the best I've tried and as a product junkie I've tried a lot.  Buy this if you have brassiness in your hair and want extra body and control as you blow it out.

Hair: collarbone length; highlighted; very baby fine (super soft).

This WOW mousse is perfect for my hair! Finally, I have found a "styling" product that works. While the WOW shampoo did not work for my hair at all and I gave it three stars, I was curious about the styling products, so I ordered this mousse. So glad I did because it worked very well for my baby fine highlighted hair.

I shampooed and conditioned with my regular shampoo/conditioner, towel dried, combed. I applied the mousse and combed it through. Then I blew it dry using a round brush. My hair looked amazing. It was full and lush - as if I grew more hair. With this product, it was as if I had at least twice the hair I had before.

I save my five stars for when I am completely amazed by a product and will purchase it again, and yes, I will purchase this mousse again, even at the expensive price--it's worth it to have my hair look this good.

After applying the product, my hair isn't as soft but for baby fine very soft hair, this is a good thing. My hair is really like a baby's hair - and anything that will make it a bit "rougher" helps it look thicker and fuller. And it didn't make it stiff or sticky, just with enough texture so that it looks fuller. All day it stayed that way, and into the next day. I resisted shampooing again and this morning my hair still looks good! Still looks thick and sexy, though by now a bit like Bed Head - but not particularly in a bad way.

I wanted to take a photo (below) of the mousse to show the lavender color--this is to help blonde hair or blond highlights not to look brassy - I don't know how much that will work, but my highlights did look brighter. reviewText:
I've been using Retinol for many years and I have fewer age spots in the areas where I use it.  So this ingredient does make a difference.

Both Retinol and Reinoids are made from Vitamin A and it's the best thing available to reduce wrinkles and age spots.  Retinoids are the stronger variety that requires a prescription (Retin-A, Tazorac, etc.)  Retinol is the light duty variety that is good for daily use if you don't want to bother with a prescription.  Since Retinol promotes the growth of healthy new cells, your skin can get sensitive with these baby cells exposed on the surface, so it is important to stay out of the sun or wear sunscreen when using this product.  It is also good to use a moisturizer.

This is the real product -- Amazon is an authorized seller for SkinMedica products.
summary: Reduces age spots with long term use

reviewText:
Wow! Very nice Retinol night product.

I really like this product.  It is a smooth and soft application from one pump which isn't really a lot from this generous bottle, and I am seeing my skin look very nice in spite of the dehydration I normally experience because of medications and caffeine. I started using this awhile back and in between I have had a couple of incidents with peeling that I am not sure is 100% related, but it isn't significant, and certainly it would be expected according to the bottle. I am reading that this particular dose of Retinol is generous, so I can see this being kind of pricey.  But this is well-worth the money in my opinion.  I haven't experienced any burning from applications, and have used it most nights.  However  I don't recommend sunning, or at least not all at once, because I sunburned easily the other day, which caused my peeling, possibly related to this product, and it was accompanied by some scratchy-feeling sensitive skin, which I treated with applications of baby oil and no more sun.  The problem disappeared within one day. The previous peeling problem might not be traced back to this night product necessarily, because there was another product that I used within an hour of the peeling, so I had attributed it to that product at the time.

When I am using a night cream product, I like a bit of tacky which won't be greasy and rub off during the night.  I am looking for a product that is compatible to my dry, aging skin, and I like soft skin the next morning.  Having an extra benefit of the Retinol is a much appreciated bonus due to its anti-aging benefits. This SkinMedica product from E-Salon LLC, fits that bill.  Nice product, and I would order it again.  Enjoy.
summary: Wow! Very nice Retinol night product.

reviewText: I've been using actual Retin-A (tretinoin) .025 cream for several months for its anti-aging properties, and when I got this Retinol Complex I switched to see what the difference is and evaluate whether this has actual pharmaceutical properties or is just a fancy cream. reviewText: Careful, you have to get used to it....can burn your skin if you go overboard... But it works.

Not since we were yuppies (yes, I'm old) have I had a bar of soap in the house which was this pricey.

But, if price is of no consequence to you, this would be a lovely soap to have for yourself or guests.  First, it's very attractive.  The bar is basically a creamy white, with the green stripe you see.  The green having a hint of translucence.  The overall effect one of having been poured/made by hand.

The odor is delightful.  To me is was limey and 'fresh'.  For a man it might have been too strong a scent to carry from the shower, but I found that most of the scent is washed away so no one should object to using this bar --man, woman, child.

So a very nice guest soap.  It's perhaps too harsh for babies, but for grimy visitors fatigued from monument hopping in the stern summer sun... it should get them clean and possibly refreshed enough for dinner.

I would not use this on my face because of the fragrance, although it is so wonderfully gentle and effective, with a creamy lather, I would love to. It does not leave a film, just moist skin. I wish there were an unfragranced version, so I could. It is still a great soap! The only issue I have is that it does not smell like lime and pomegranate to me. It has a weird green vegetable smell, somewhat bitter, that fragranced my bathroom. Fortunately the scent does not linger on skin!

This is a BIG manly-man bar of soap (7oz compared to the usual 4 oz)

It lathers well and has a pleasant citrus-y scent which dissipates quickly and doesn't leave you smelling like a fruit salad.

The soap left my skin  feeling very soft and hydrated, like an expensive body-wash.

I think us ordinary, common dove/zest soap folks may suffer a little sticker shock at $16 for a bar of soap but if you want a luxurious treat for yourself, or someone else, this might be a nice choice.

It's about as good as you can get for a "cleansing bar". I'm the kind of person who wants actual soap for the bath, so no cleansing bar is ever going to equal real soap. This bad does a very credibly job of simulating a soap. It lathers amazingly well, without dissolving like a bath bomb. It leaves a long-lasting, subtle scent with a hint of citrus and musk. It rinses easily, without leaving any odd feeling on your skin.

This might be the perfect cleansing bar- I'd be in love if Baxter would make this exact same fragrance in a proper bar of soap.

This refreshing, masculine soap was a hit with the gent in the family. He tends to pooh-pooh the fancy man products, but this soap is really nice, so no eye-rolling. Though I'd place it in the man range of flavor, the citrus & herbal scent was subtle enough for a woman to use without feeling doused in aftershave, and the scent isn't super strong on the skin.

Good lather, and a pretty bar (though not quite as pretty as the picture on the box). The price is a bit too spendy to buy on the reg, but a nice treat.

reviewText:

When I had the opportunity to try the Baxter Lime soap, I thought it was a great chance to see what's out there and go beyond the industrial cleansers that I've been using.  Now that the bar is gone from heavy use and I feel satisfied using it, but not compelled to spend the premium pricing on a single bar of soap.  It's just not worth my budget.

The overall effectiveness and lather the Baxter soap provides is very nice and I did notice a slight difference in how my skin felt (smoother) after a few days of use.  On top of that, I began to notice a strong lime smell emanating from the bathroom as the bar released a strong, but pleasant, aroma that only lasted about a week.  It was really nice to have that smell in there, but it didn't last long enough to be a selling point.

The size is large also, but not bizarrely large like some soaps from health food stores. When using it, the bar doesn't break down fast, so I can see this soap lasting a while.

The fragrance is quite interesting, being a combination of Lime and Pomegranate. Personally, I smell more of a honeydew melon and cucumber than lime and pomegranate. However people interpret the fragrance, it's definitely a fresh, light smell. Despite the melon reference, this bar is NOT cloying or sweet smelling.

I've read that some people were turned off by the 'overpowering' scent. I am highly sensitive to smells (I can smell everything!), and I personally found it not to be too much.

If this is your price point for facial and/or body bars, I don't think you'll be disappointed with the purchase.
summary: Sudsy, Gentle on Skin, Fresh Fragrance

reviewText:
Moisture is the best thing about this soap, in my opinion. It leaves your skin feeling silky smooth and hydrated. Many bar soaps have the opposite effect.

The scent of the 'Italian Lime and Pomegranate' bar I received is pleasant. Not overbearing, not especially feminine and not especially masculine. Just fresh. There is virtually no pomegranate smell, so I would really just call it Lime.

The size of the bar really is too big for the average sized hand. It slipped out of my grasp time and time again. I'm not complaining about the quantity of product, but I would have preferred they cut it in half and sold it as a two-pack at the same price. Of course, after a few washings, the size of the bar does reduce and becomes more practical - but that first week was a little irritating.

OVERALL: While this is obviously a luxuriant splurge of a soap and certainly a step above your Dove or similar mass-marketed soaps, it's not better than the local soaps I've bought from Whole Food stores, which smell significantly better and offer a more thorough clean. Personally, I would not pay the current listing price ($16.00) for another bar, but I understand that disposable money varies from person to person, so I rated it based solely on my experience with the product. It's good, above average, but not unbelievably great.
summary: Luxurient soap that's long-lasting and slightly above average

reviewText:
This is a hard (that is, it won't melt in the shower), high quality soap with moderate sudsing that easily rinses clean. The scent is sweet and fruity but not lingering -- guys can enjoy it without smelling sweeter than they'd like all day and it won't clash with your perfume.

The solid white bar has a translucent green stripe in the center that looks elegant in the bath. The soap is made of palm oil and a variety of botanical extracts, not of petroleum as so many soaps are. Altogether, a very nice affordable luxury.
summary: Soap that Will Dress Up Your Bathroom

reviewText: I'm a little spoiled when it comes to soap because I haven't used commercial soap in years-- I always buy handmade soap that's loaded with moisturizing agents, rather than soap that's typically very drying. This was a good pick as far as that goes-- it's more moisturizing than other commercial brands, and it lathers well. It is a bit awkwardly large and would have been better cut in half and delivered as a two-pack, but my larger problem is with the scent. It does have a vague lime scent to it, but that's not the main scent. I really can't identify the main scent, and I'm confused about whether it's supposed to be masculine or feminine. It's not a typical sweet fruity smell like I'd expect with lime and pomegranate (which, by the way, I don't smell at all)-- it's a more unisex, garden-ish thing. Not my favorite, but I'm certain that others would like it. It's just a shame there's no way to smell before you buy. Maybe Amazon can work that in after their drone program. ;)
