I initially tried using the sponge that was included in the compact. This left my the makeup looking terribly cakey. If you end up putting too much of this on, it will easily highlight imperfections and fine lines. Using a brush allows me to lightly sweep a little on a time, so I don't overdo it.
summary: Perfect for a Matte Finish (I Recommend Using a Brush to Apply)

style.Color:: 50N Olive: For tan skin with neutral undertones with a hint of yellow

reviewText:
This is a nice light powder that is fragrance free.  However it transfers easily and in my opinion needs to be reapplied occasionally if you want to have that shine-free finished look to last all day long.  It helps to even out uneven skin tones and blotches, but when it comes to blemishes or dry patches they seem to stand out more since the powder sits in the cracks and crevices which makes them look more obvious.  The powder is silky smooth and soft to the touch with a matte finish.

Works great to control shine, uneven tones and blotches,  but I prefer to use cream concealer for blemishes and scars.

style.Color:: 20W Nude: For fair skin with warm undertones

reviewText:
The Dermablend Intense Powder Camo is an excellent quality powder foundation. It gives what I would call light to medium coverage depending on how it is applied. Instructions say to apply with a dry sponge (included) for medium coverage and a damp sponge for full coverage. I prefer using a damp sponge and was able to get good but not really "full" coverage.
The compact includes a sponge and mirror and is very nice quality.
It is perfect for toting around in a purse or when traveling.
The "nude" shade is a good neutral - no hints of yellow or pink undertones.
While I prefer a cream foundation during the drier winter months, this powder foundation is perfect for the hot and humid Mid-Atlantic summers.
summary: Nice coverage, good for humid weather

style.Color:: 20W Nude: For fair skin with warm undertones

reviewText:
I usually use cream foundations, but I thought I'd give this a try because it sounded easy to apply. I'm not crazy about it.

First, it was cracked when it arrived (see photos).

Second, I found it difficult to apply evenly and thickly enough with the very thin sponge applicator. I followed the instructions and applied it with the damp sponge. It took much longer to "build" than my cream foundation and it didn't go on smoothly or evenly. It felt splotchy and uneven. At the end of the day, when I used a makeup removing cloth to remove it, there was no color left! So, obviously it did not stay on my face. I will probably use the rest as a powder after applying cream foundation. I think it will work well for that.
summary: Takes a long time to "build", didn't go on smoothly. Also arrived cracked.

style.Color:: 35W Toast: For medium skin with warm undertones and a hint of gold

reviewText:
I am picky about my makeup. For reference, I am Caucasian with a medium skintone. I have combination skin that is oily, but dry in certain spots. I also have uneven skin with a lot of red in it. My go to is a full coverage CC cream. However, I am always looking for a better or different alternative. I am happy to say that this powder can not only substitute in for my normal CC cream, but it also works great with it to improve my look.

The powder is medium to full coverage which is accurate. With this product this means that one application will give you medium coverage (lighter coverage) and then you can apply more layers and build up to full coverage. One layer doesn't quite do as much as my CC cream. If I want light makeup, that may be perfect. If you are worried about picking the perfect shade with this makeup, don't sweat it. I received both toast and honey which are drastically different shades. Both work for me! This makeup blends really well.

My favorite aspect of this powder is that it helps with the shine I get on my forehead and nose from oil. This is why I like wearing it over my normal coverage. It also stays on well, even when I sweat. I live in Florida. Its hot and I sweat a ton in the summer. I was wearing only only makeup last weekend when the air conditioning broke. It was 85 at the house I was stuck in for 6 hours (long story) and this makeup was still noticeably there after sweating and splashing water on my face.

I really like this powder and I am reaching for it daily now. I highly recommend it.
summary: Buildable coverage and helps with shine

style.Color:: 40N Bronze: For medium to tan skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: This is an easy to use powder that can be applied with  brush for light coverage and a sponge for heavier coverage.  I used the brush and found the light coverage to be right for me.  It lasts all day long and did not cause any irritation to my sensitive skin.  A good product that is easy to use.

style.Color:: 50N Olive: For tan skin with neutral undertones with a hint of yellow

reviewText: From my daughter: nice makeup for a reasonable price. The color wasn't a pefect match, but I still tried out the powder on my face and it went on nice and smooth and had a good amount of coverage. I also like that there isn't any fragrance and it didn't irritate my skin at all.

style.Color:: 10N Beige: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: This is a very nice powder that works very well.  You do not need a lot to make a difference.  I put a light layer on with a brush, then use the foam pad to apply a bit more under my eyes and on my nose, then use the brush to blend that in.  The more you apply, the more coverage you can achieve.  Very build-able, so you can use a little or a lot.  Good quality powder that lasts in the heat, I re-apply in the evening before going out to dinner and it is perfect.  Nice compact as well.

style.Color:: 50W Honey: For tan skin with warm undertones

reviewText: I received a color a bit darker than my skin tone, but I'm not going take any stars away from that. What I will say is that Dermablend Intense Camo Powder is a very finely milled powder that goes on smoothly and did cover any slight imperfections in my skin (not that I had any marks that were too dark, mind you), that it is one of the better facial powders I've come across and obviously is of great quality. It lasted throughout the time I tried it on (obviously at home) and the case is sturdy, easy to open with a nice mirror and a soft applicator stored beneath so you can carry it with you, but a brush works great with this as well. A little goes a long way with this powder, and I'm interested in trying this in a color that will match better. As for now, this works great as a bronzer/contouring blend so I'm still very happy.
summary: is a nice powder to add to my makeup

style.Color:: 20W Nude: For fair skin with warm undertones

reviewText: Wonderful product. Stays on until you take it off. Water resistant and natural colors. Has excellent coverage

style.Color:: 50W Honey: For tan skin with warm undertones

reviewText: This shade is dark for my fair skin. Having acquired the color that matches perfectly for me, I selected this one to use for a contouring blush. It worked beautifully. I am struggling with rosacea, which simply causes uneven redness on my cheeks. The lighter shade followed by the darker one covers the imperfections completely. Other  blushes I've tried to use over my red splotches went on unevenly, but this coverage is amazing.

style.Color:: 0C Ivory: For the fairest skin with cool undertones

reviewText: Wow! This powder compact is the kind of makeup I knew was out there somewhere, but I didn't know what it was and how to find it. This powder makes my skin look flawless, and my face glows just a little. My skin looks as good as the women's complexion on the television news programs. I'm delighted to have it, and I highly recommend it. Supposedly, it will work with different skin types.

style.Color:: 65W Suede: For tan to deep skin with warm undertones with a hint of gold

reviewText: See pictures attached. I thought that would be helpful to show the true color against skin.  It's a nice product. I didn't give it 5 starts b/c I found it to be a bit thick and I really wanted something thinner and less heavy.  That being said it does work and it was the color I expected.  I am going to try it again tomorrow with a better foundation under it. The packaging is nice though and it comes with a nice application tool under it.  It's definitely a warm tone and would be great for highlight your cheeks as well.
summary: It's a nice product. I didn't give it 5 starts b/c I found it to be a bit thick and I really wanted something thinner and less

style.Color:: 65W Suede: For tan to deep skin with warm undertones with a hint of gold

reviewText:
Reviewed by my wife: I have several Dermablend products: the "CoverCreme" in several colors; the "Liquid Camo Medium Coverage Foundation"; the "INTENSE PowderCamo". I got them for my daughter to use for stage makeup (she has been doing character makeup for a small Shakespeare troupe in our county). It works amazingly!

This medium-to-full-coverage powder foundation is smooth, easy to apply and gives complete coverage with just a very, very tiny amount. I used the "Suede" color, and swiped the included foam pad very gently across the pressed powder surface and it produced complete, near opaque coverage on my hand (see image attached - the medium color between the thumb and index finger on the back of my hand). It gives a satiney finish that allows for layering with other colors or highlights. It has an almost undetectable fragrance, and produces no irritation on my very sensitive skin. Truly excellent product.

style.Color:: 10N Beige: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText:
This product has both positive and negative aspects.

On the positive side, it doesn't clog pores or cause acne, which is great if you have skin that breaks out easily. It's portable and comes with an applicator pad for easy touch ups on the go. It nicely covers slightly red areas on my face, such as around my nose. The color, beige, is a good match for my complexion. I'm pretty pale, with neutral to yellow undertones. It would not be suitable for someone in the pink/cool range, in my opinion.

On the negative side, this is VERY matte. It claims "never cakey or masky," but applied to the whole face it is extremely cakey and mask-like. I think the only exception would be if you have very young, smooth skin. Otherwise, it highlights every pore, imperfection, and dry area. It truly looks awful.

Also, the coverage is medium and I was never able to get it to be full coverage, no matter how many layers I applied. I have a tiny red dot on my forehead and yep, you could still see it afterwards.

Overall, I like this as a spot treatment for bits of redness here and there. As a full coverage foundation? Not a chance.

style.Color:: 35W Toast: For medium skin with warm undertones and a hint of gold

reviewText: Living in Florida the humidity is really bad. I have often found that my makeup basically comes off from the heat and humidity and cannot seem to find anything that will stay in place during the day. I have to say that this product was wonderful. It is easy to apply and feels light which is a big plus. I do not like when makeup feels caked on. I just loved the idea of having a separate compartment to place the makeup pad so it does not accrue more powder. Even though the description says powder it glides on as a foundation. It stayed put for the majority of the day and felt as though I was not wearing makeup which is a big plus for me.

style.Color:: 10N Beige: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: Well, I've tried Dermablend makeup products for the first time today, and I'm very impressed with their quality and ease of application!  I applied the concealer stick (Ivory) around the eyes, and on age spots with great results.  Then I smoothed on the Cover Creme (Pale Ivory) all over my face to give it a nice velvety finish.  Finally, I used the Dermablend Intense Powder Camo (Beige), using the provided sponge, dry, to complete the look. Actually, all three products were very close in color, so it worked very well on my very fair complexion.  I then added some of my own blush for some extra color.  I was very pleased to see that Dermablend is part of my favorite makeup products...L'Oreal.
summary: Excellent coverage for my older face, and it stays in place beautifully!

style.Color:: 10N Beige: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText:
Back in my twenties, I was a loyal Dermablend customer because I had quite a few dark blotches from old blemishes.  In the 1980's, the formula options were strictly limited to a pot of dense foundation that had the consistency of concealer.  If I'm not mistaken, they didn't offer either liquid or powder foundations back then.

While my skin issues are pretty well resolved now that I've hit middle-age, I am starting to see a bit of hyper-pigmentation along the jawline so I thought it was time to give Dermablend another look.  They're now owned by L'Oral and have a more comprehensive product line.  This particular formula reminds me of the Bare Minerals solid foundation in that it applies like a powder but turns [somewhat] creamier as it sets.  The compact comes with a flat sponge applicator that makes it easy to control the intensity of coverage.

I received the Beige shade which was a fairly good match for my fair skin with yellow undertones.  The coverage is buildable but it takes a bit of practice to achieve the correct application, particularly if, like me, you don't want to look too "made up."  If you need to hide blemishes or discolorations, this stuff does a superior job.  However, I felt that even the lightest application gave my skin a slightly shiny, taut appearance that was aging.

The verdict?  I think this would be an amazing foundation for someone who wants heavy coverage and it would work best on someone with firm, youthful skin.  For someone my age, sometimes less is more.

style.Color:: 0C Ivory: For the fairest skin with cool undertones

reviewText:
Overall the Dermablend powder acted much like I expected. I only put it on once a day since I have dry skin and only use it to set my foundation. I have to say, the foundation covered pretty well. Once, I rubbed some over my lips when I was in a hurry to put foundation over my face and my lips disappeared. I looked weird. But unfortunately, the foundation didn't completely cover some brown spots. Really make-up, you make my lips disappear but can't  camouflage brown spots? The powder helped cover the brown spots a bit, but no better than Cover Girl powder. So, I give it a four. Decent powder, but a bit pricey. It does last all day for me, but again, I don't have oily skin.

Here's a trick I use, if the powder is a little too light, which it was for me, you can add cinnamon to darken it. Cinnamon adds a tan color, is inexpensive and good for your skin. I had to add a touch of to this powder to match my skin tone.

style.Color:: 20W Nude: For fair skin with warm undertones

reviewText:
When we first tried this foundation powder, it seemed like it would leave a powdery look on skin.  However, the more we spread it, the more it blended and acquired a natural look.  We tried adding more layers, and discovered the more you put on, the better it covers.  However, the color was a bit lighter than we expected.  Indeed, this color is for people with relatively light skin, meaning virtually no tan, and relatively light natural pigment.

This foundation is a powder, but it seems to blend nicely with the sponge or a decent quality brush.  We have dry skin, and the powder went on with little difficulty.  We are unsure how the foundation would go onto moisturized or oily skin.

The powder applied without irritation.  Since the significant other has slightly sensitive skin, the lack of irritation is a plus.

We were slightly surprised that the powder came without any SPF rating.  Some foundations have SPF 30 or higher.  We guess avoiding the sun is a good idea with this foundation.

The price is a bit high compared to budget priced foundation, but then again, there is something to "you get what you pay for" when it comes to makeup.  We consider the quality of the foundation to match the price quite well.

Because the powder applies easily and smoothly, and blends into skin well, we like this foundation powder a lot.  It is great for covering up blemishes, especially with lighter skin.  The price, while a touch high, is reasonably competitive with other high-quality foundations.  We further enjoy the compact case with mirror, which is useful.  We are unable to find any flaws with the review sample we received, so five stars!

Enjoy!
summary: Applies smoothly, can be added in layers, and the case has a mirror

style.Color:: 40N Bronze: For medium to tan skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: This stuff is just as bad as their foundation.  It doesn't cover acne scars or bumps, it enhances them.  I'm so disappointed in the brand & their products.  My skin looks so bad when I put this on.  It's like a neon sign pointing to my acne scars & bumps, they stand out so clearly.  I'd be better off going bare skinned than using these products.  It also feels so heavy on the skin.  I've tried blending & blending.  Nothing seems to work.  I hate it.

style.Color:: 50W Honey: For tan skin with warm undertones

reviewText: Fantastic products. Covers everything you can imagine and stays on in hot weather. Perfectly water resistant and only comes off when  you take it off
summary: Fantastic products. Covers everything you can imagine and stays ...

style.Color:: 35C Caramel: For medium skin with cool undertones with a hint of peach

reviewText: I've used IT Cosmetics for about six months now and I've been more than happy with them. But I tried this and it's an acceptable substitute. The colors seem to be lighter in reality than the picture. I wear the It Cosmetics Celebration Foundation in Medium (Medium Beige) .30 Ounce Compact by It Cosmetics and this Dermablend shade is about the same. It's considerable less expensive than the IT powder. I wore this all yesterday in the hot Georgia sun (89 degrees and 80% humidity). It stayed and didn't streak nor settle into my wrinkles around my eyes. No irritation and it completely covered my rosacea and pores. About 5 hours into the day, I reapplied on the nose and chin since I do sweat there a lot. It came off easily with makeup remover. Two thumps up.

style.Color:: 30N Sand: For light to medium skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: This Dermablend Intense Powder Camo Medium to Full Coverage Foundation Makeup  is amazing. I have brown patches on the side of my face from sun damage, and they totally disappear with this product. I was very impressed. I did think the product runs a bit lighter in color than usual. I have very light skin and the medium was still a little light for me. Great product!

style.Color:: 30C Suntan: For light to medium skin with cool undertones

reviewText: This powder is one of the best I've ever tried, and I love its compact case, which includes a mirror and a separate compartment to store the sponge. It applies over my skin smoothly and it helps the foundation to last all day. And in a warm weather like we have right now, it keeps my face looking fresh and free of shine. I plan on continue using it from now on. It can also be worn alone for a natural look. And this color helps me to have a little tan after a long winter.

style.Color:: 65W Suede: For tan to deep skin with warm undertones with a hint of gold

reviewText:
I was quite happy to receive this review product.  I have been looking for something like this for a while. When I first opened this and felt it I was impressed.  It did not have a strong smell, I was glad and it was not to soft or too hard.  It was quite easy to apply to my face and wasn't all over
the place like some I have had.  It blended quite nicely and left my skin feeling softer than it did before.  I did not have any reactions to it which is
a big plus for me,  It gave me just the right amount of color that I wanted, not too outstanding but rather like it was always there, which was nice. I didn't say anything about using a new product to friends and family but they all noticed how nice my face looked and asked me what I did. Hum, should I tell them? Of course I did.  So far I really like this product. I didn't have to put it on again during the day, nor touch it up.  Maybe some will, but I didn't. This has not caused any allergies for me which again is a big plus. This may be different for others I suppose depending on how much you want to use.  So, I'm glad to recommend it to you. I really do like it and hope you will as well.

style.Color:: 35W Toast: For medium skin with warm undertones and a hint of gold

reviewText: I've never used this brand but I'm totally impressed. The shade is just right - although during summer when tanned I plan to switch it up a bit - and the coverage is excellent. I have a tendency to get red blotchy skin and this covers it entirely. It's gentle, non-irritating (so far) and easy to apply. If I were to have a wish list, I'd really enjoy a bit more natural ingredient list but this is certainly better than most as far as irritation/sensitivity goes. The case also feels solid enough to toss into a purse without problem. Overall very pleased!

style.Color:: 30N Sand: For light to medium skin with neutral undertones

reviewText:
This Dermablend Intense Powder Camo Medium to Full Coverage Foundation Makeup with Matte Finish has been my regular foundation for the past 3 years and I'm still happy with it.

This is a powder foundation but it has more pigment in it than Bare Essentials so it gives better coverage, IMO. It blends out skin discolorations quite well and doesn't seem to get cakey if you apply it for medium coverage, as I do.

Although Dermablend says it is buildable, I find it makes my skin oily and it settles in creases if I apply it heavily so I would not suggest this particular product for people with oily skin that need full coverage. Dermablend has other foundations that work better in that instance.

This comes in a nice compact with a good mirror and a sponge applicator. It's easy to apply and stays on all day if I use a primer first.
summary: This has been my regular foundation for 3 years now

style.Color:: 20W Nude: For fair skin with warm undertones

reviewText: I am enjoying the full coverage of the powder in this compact.  The compact is quite nice also with the applicator and powder separated.  I applied the powder in the morning and it lasted all day without reapplying.  This shade is a tiny bit darker than I think I needed but the lighter may have been too light.  It covers my dark spots and blends in with my freckles.  My face looks more alive with this powder and does not feel painted.

style.Color:: 35C Caramel: For medium skin with cool undertones with a hint of peach

reviewText: I was really pleasantly surprised.  I wear a 350C in my Lancome foundation and had no idea if this would be a close match.  It's just a touch lighter, but not in a clown like way.  When I tried applying it alone, it was too powdery and noticeable. When I applied my Lancome foundation first, and this just gently blotted on top, it looked great.  It is easy to get too much out if trying to use a foundation powder brush.
summary: Great coverage, worked better for me over my liquid foundation

style.Color:: 60N Cocoa: For tan skin with neutral undertones with a hint of peach

reviewText: Got this for my wife who likes to try out new products. She was not  impressed with this but did give it an OK. Nothing special to say about being good but not really bad either.

style.Color:: 50N Olive: For tan skin with neutral undertones with a hint of yellow

reviewText: Gave this a try as I am still in search of my Jane Irdale replacement of Golden Glow. I need something with more olive in the summer and this is not it. I found the powder to feel soft on my fingers but applied "rough" chalky and really showed up my pores. It seems a bit shiny on my face though it sure looked matte in the compact. The shade was a bit dark on me as well. Though it's a Dermablend product, I felt it did not offer much build-able coverage to wear alone as foundation.

style.Color:: 30N Sand: For light to medium skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: This is the best combo foundation/powder I have ever seen.  I hate the "creme to powders" because they don't always play nice with combination skin - I have extremely dry skin with oily patches, even in my late 50's and they are sometimes hard to apply.  Overall my skin is still pretty good but I have a lot of redness in my cheeks down the sides of my nose and by my mouth, which I am very self conscious of, so what I've been looking for is something I can use for "partial" coverage only where I need it.  This has done the trick and allows me to "blend out" those red areas with a product which matches the rest of my facial skin tone, and I'm not stuck with a heavy foundationed or powdered looking face.  Most of my friends weren't aware I was even wearing facial makeup!

style.Color:: 0C Ivory: For the fairest skin with cool undertones

reviewText:
***update- I just found out they test on animals. Will never purchase again. Next time I'll try 100% PUre or The Organic Face.**I bought this at Ulta and paid about $7 more. I have always used Bareminerals...I mean always. Sadly I read their ingredients are actually quite harmful to the skin, as well as the endocrine system (harmful chemicals build up and are absorbed through the skin)
The EWG ( environmental working group) gives this product a great score. What that means is its not harmful to your body. They look at the individual ingredients and score them based on that.

I miss the "glow" original bare minerals gives, however I think my skin actually looks healthier now. The coverage is moderate, not too intense. I have to cover a couple acne scars with concealer.

Pros:
Good coverage
Lasts long
Doesnt wear off on my clothes as much as other products
Doesn't pull oils from your skin=less drying
Doesnt accentuate dry skin like others I've used or settle in creases

Cons:
Becomes cakey if you over-apply
Better when used with a seperate concealer instead of building coverage

Tips:
kabuki brush is a must, the sponge doesn't provide good coverage and looks more cakey
Use a primer, I love UD's primed and poreless (gives a little coverage and hides imperfections more than most primers)
Finish with a mineral veil or similar product
summary: Better for your skin than Bareminerals

reviewText: I've used these products for years and they are the only ones to date that have the best coverage for flaws and scars....even bruises
summary: ... are the only ones to date that have the best coverage for flaws and scars

reviewText: Love Dermablend products. The do what they say. Great makeup and worth the price.. as long as they don't raise it now since I have written this review.

I took off a star for the "non-sticky" advertisement since it is a bit sticky. I didn't have quite the same problems as a few of the other reviewers, but it's important to note for people looking for a non-sticky gloss.

Other than that, it's a pretty good product. I like the smell. You don't have to apply too much. Would I pay twenty dollars for it? Maybe.

Personally, I'd go for one of the darker shades. But if this is the color you want, you may be pleasantly surprised. I was.

As far as lip glosses go, this one is a lot less stickier than others I have tried. The test is when the wind blows your hair on your lips.  With some glosses, the hair gets really stuck and then when you remove it, you have lip gloss on your hair.  With this Julep brand, hair would still stick to it, but it wouldn't feel like glue and would not coat my hair.  I know, kind of gross, but that's how it is.  It has a pretty good smell and doesn't taste awful.  It says it is paraben and sulfate free, and the company claims it does not test on animals.  It still has a long list of chemical names in its ingredient list, all of course okayed by the FDA and such.  That should make you feel warm and cozy.  It is hard to find lip products that are not full of things I would rather not ingest.

I think the product looks good on, this is a subtle color, I am over 50 (barely), and didn't think it looked awful or that it bled around my lips.  It is nice overall, but I think I would stick with glosses where the first ingredients (hydrogenated polyisobutene, pentaerythrityl tetraisostearate, butylene/ethylene/styrene copolymer) are not chemical derivatives.
summary: Not overly sticky or thick.  Pleasant smell, great color, but...

reviewText: This lip gloss is light and non-sticky, but the color (which is supposed to be very light, or so I thought) bleeds easily and makes my mouth look like I have chapped lips.  I am over 50, so maybe this is a gloss that would work on a younger person's lips, but for me it doesn't do anything.  I've tried using it for two days and have not noticed any improvement to the softness of my lips or anything that makes me want to use it regularly.  The price is awfully high for a gloss that does not plump the lips or make any improvement in looks.
summary: Pricey and not for older women

reviewText:
The Julep Lip Gloss in Charming is so much prettier than I had expected! The color as shown on the very fair model looked like a pale sungold...yet this is definitely a YLBB (your lips but better) shade, so hard to find, but a real joy when you do!

There's a light scent -fruit? vanilla? chocolate? that disappears pretty soon, leaving just the smooth and pretty gloss. In the tube, it looks light there might be a bit of shimmer, and on the lips, there's just enough to keep the gloss from looking flat or lifeless; there isn't a "teen" amount of gloss or shimmer or shine. I'm getting a bit older, and glosses that used to look great are now in the "toss that gloss" category, but THIS gloss is is in my new PERFECT gloss category; sophisticated, luxurious, unflavored, virtually unscented, and a gorgeous flattering color. It applies with a doe-foot applicator that pulls out a single coverage swipe. There was no drying or irritation to my mouth, and no "glitter friction," and no creep or slide.

Julep, you're on my radar for future purchases! I'm so glad I got to test this beautiful gloss, in a generous-sized tube. It's already in my purse for regular use.
summary: A perfect gloss in a perfect shade for fair skin

reviewText:
I like this shade of lip gloss. It's a very natural looking shade of light pink. It has a slight sheen to it which gives lips a moist look, but it doesn't look overly sticky or glossy. It does, however, feel slightly sticky after you first apply it, but I've found that most lip glosses have this same feel. After a bit of time, it seems like the stickiness fades.

It has a nice vanilla-like scent and goes on smoothly. This shade is ideal if you're looking for a light/subtle/natural look.

The main reason I got this is because it's advertised as "non-sticky lip gloss."  It's very sticky, and it doesn't last more than 30 minutes before I have to reapply the gloss.  The color (Charming) does look pretty on my lips. In fact, the color is darker and prettier than shown on my monitor.  For the color, I gave it three stars.  If it hadn't been sticky, or if it had lasted longer, I would've given it more stars.

I'm not usually much of a lip gloss person because so many brands have a very sticky and tacky feel that I'm not a fan. I thought I'd give this one a try because my friend recommended it and I'm so glad I did! The formula is super moisturizing and makes your lips feel wonderfully smooth, not sticky at all! It's got subtle color and shine and even smells delightful. It's like a cross between vanilla and cake. I take it with me everywhere!
summary: Changed my opinion of lip gloss!

reviewText: I love this gloss. The color is light  and easy to wear and stays put without smearing or getting sticky.  I packed it around in my purse for two weeks in the Las Vegas summer heat and it didn't separate or turn gummy.  The applicatior is angled, giving better control for coverage. It has a nice subtle fruity scent, that doesn't embarrass me with a teeny boppers tooty-frooty aroma.  Very much a five star hit. I'll be looking for some other colors to add to my makeup bag.
summary: Charming color and a royally nice consistency.

reviewText: I rarely use lip gloss.  This Julep lip gloss has changed that.  I've worn it every day since receiving it.  It does need to be applied a bit more frequently, but that may be my personal habit.  The shimmer lasts quite some time.  The pigment isn't neutral but it's natural, and blends into my olive complexion well!
summary: I rarely use lip gloss. This Julep lip gloss ...

reviewText:
Julep Lip Gloss in Charming is a barely there light pinkish mauve gloss that adds a hint of color and shine to my lips.  It applies easily and quickly with the wand, and does not feel tacky or gloopy.

Having read the previous reviews, I was expecting the color to be almost non-existent on my lips, so I was not surprised when I applied the gloss.  It wears pretty well, and does not need constant reapplication like glosses I have tried in the past.

I like the color and feel of the product, and would likely purchase it for myself.
summary: Lovely hint of color and no tacky gloop

reviewText: (WARNING- This is an in depth review of this lip gloss. As a makeup artist, I realize it can be difficult to purchase makeup online. I wanted to cover the most information possible to help make an informed decision. If you prefer, the last paragraph titled THE BOTTOM LINE will give a brief summary of the review). It is very difficult for me to find what some in the online makeup community term as MLBB. That stands for "My Lips But Better". That is a term which indicates that the lip product in question matches the tone and color of your actual lips, but enhances them nicely. For me it is a challenge to find lip color that is like my lips. My lips are very pigmented and are not the usual color that most people think of when they say natural looking lip. Most of those colors look OFF on me. To my utter amazement, this lip gloss was not what I expected. It is one of the very few I have encountered which is MLBB. WHAT IS JULEP LIP GLOSS IN CHARMING LIKE? Julep Charming Lip Gloss is in a clear tube with a black top. The wand inside is a standard style lip gloss tip similar to what you might find in say MAC Lipglass. It is not a doe foot. The gloss itself is not sticky. It is what I would call a mauve, pink color with just the tiniest touch of taupe-brown to it. That makes it look more like lips and less like a pink/mauve lip color. The scent is a gentle vanilla type scent which has no flavor and disappears quickly. HOW DOES THIS LIP GLOSS PERFORM? I have used a LOT of different brands of lip gloss. I have used high end professional that is used on TV, a lot of high end lip gloss the likes of Chanel, Laura Mercier, Tarte, Urban Decay, Buxom, Lancome, Estee Lauder, Lorac, gosh the list goes on and on. I have also tried out many drugstore lip gloss tubes, some of which are just as nice as high end. I would say that the performance of this lip gloss is up there with some of the best that I have tried, but not as nice as the Lorac 3D lip glosses or their Lips With Benefits which was the most perfect lip gloss ever made. It moisturized lips, stayed on very well, and left lips in better shape than the best lip balm I have ever used. What I mean by that is that this gloss has good coverage. It stays on the lips a good amount of time. For me, it stayed about an hour, but I found myself eating or using my mouth that made me have to reapply it more often than most. For my daughter, it stayed on her for several hours, but she was not eating or doing things that would make it come off more quickly. UNIQUE COLOR OF THIS GLOSS This lip gloss is the identical color of my lips. I am cool toned, so it looks very natural on me. It has a slight pearl to it which only shows up in the tube. On the lips it is not really obvious. The most unique part of this gloss is that it seems to change when you put it on different people. I tried this on someone who is a bright warm toned person. We rarely can ever wear the same of any color. It adapted to look perfect on her lips too. I tried it on someone who is more of a subdued warm tone and same thing- the color adapted to her for her own perfect lip tone. It is unusual to find a lip gloss color like that. Most of the time they are limited in who they look good on and rarely cross certain lines of tones. This one is a winner! SIMILAR COLORS This lip color reminds me most of a variety of colors if you happened to have seen them. Lorac Chuck lip gloss in Lips With Benefits was similar to this color, Heidi Klum's last lip color from Victoria's Secret that she did with the India theme to it is similar as well. I think it was called Exotic Spice. The last color that comes to mind is one you can check on Amazon : Laura Mercier Stickgloss - Brown Sugar THE BOTTOM LINE Moisturizing without being drying, Julep Charming Lip Gloss is the "My Lips But Better" type color that is hard to find. It seems to adapt well to a wide range of tones of people, and looks really good on them. It is easy to apply, lasts a decent amount of time before you have to reapply, and is not sticky at all. The generic vanilla type scent is not really that noticeable to me and fades quickly anyway. The price is a bit high for a lip gloss, but worth paying if it is hard to find a color like this and you will wear it often. I give this FIVE enthusiastic stars as my favorite lip colors are not discontinued and it is nice to know that I can wear something close to them without missing a beat! I will update if anything changes over time.
summary: Unusual Color Which Crosses A Lot Of Tone Lines To Look Great On A Variety of People

reviewText: This is a great lip gloss for everyday wear. The color (Charming) is light and sheer but at the same time provides a nice glossy shine. It looks good alone or over lipstick. I often have a problem with lip gloss being too sticky or tasting like plastic but that was not a problem with the Julep gloss. It has a subtle, pleasant taste that fades quickly, and it is not sticky, yet still stays on my lips for an hour or so before I need to reapply. And when I do, there is no left over residue and my lips feel great.

I don't know if this has any anti-aging abilities, but what I do know is that it's a really nice gloss and that the Charming color is such a pretty rose color.  It is, however, a lot lighter than it looks in the tube, which was rather disappointing.  That being said, it isn't sticky, feels soft on your lips, and works well to add a pop of shine over lipstick.

I tend to shy away from glosses since I like more punch with my color and like how lipsticks last on me, but, as mentioned, this Julep gloss works nicely on its own or over lipstick.  When wearing it by itself, I've been using either MAC's lip base or a Makeup Forever clear lipliner underneath; adding that step helps keep the liner from bleeding out of my lip area, which has been a problem ever since I hit my early 40's.

There are also no irritating ingredients in this like peppermint oil, and it feels very smooth going on.

I like this overall, but prefer NARS and MAC lipglosses since they have more actual pigment to them, and are in the same price range.
summary: Not very long-wearing, but a lipstick primer underneath this does keep it in place longer

reviewText: Beautiful neutral color. Perfect for the summer. Goes on smoothly. It smells yummy and isn't sticky. No caking nor clumping.  It lasts a few hours. Nice gloss that adds a nice pop of color.
summary: Neutral color adds a pop of color. Not sticky.

reviewText: This lip gloss is rich and shiny, but the color is the exact color of my lips, so it's very understated. (I'm a blonde, fair-skinned Caucasian.) There is no flavor, but the smell reminds me of cake somehow. It's not quite vanilla, but close. Anyway, it's a great lip gloss with low color contrast for my particular skin tones. I love the natural look it gives.
summary: this lip gloss is the exact color of my lips!

reviewText:
Wow, I really love this lip gloss.  I had hoped this would work nice for me and I was not disappointed.

I'm using the Charming lip gloss and it looks so pretty on my lips.  It adds shine without it being too bright or showy.  There is a slight color, just enough to make my lips look finished and a bit polished.

It goes on very smoothly.  At first, it feels a little sticky/tacky.  But, after a few moments, it dries and I don't feel it any longer.

This gives my lips a natural looking shine and a very lovely look.  It accents my lips perfectly.
summary: Makes my lips look so pretty!

reviewText: This is a very nice gloss. It is a bit sticky the first few minutes it's applied, but once it sets in the stickiness subsides.  The color is a nice, muted pink color that is classy but stands out.  It lasts pretty well once applies (about 2-3 hours).  Overall, I like it

I am 70 years old and this is the first time that I have ever tried lip gloss! It was very easy to apply and actually less messy than lipstick. I don't know if that is true of all lip glosses to my lack of experience. I didn't smell anything when I applied it but that was a faint vanilla taste when it hit my lips.

It didn't bleed like lipstick sometimes does for me. I would choose a different color because it almost matches my lips. My lips are skinny so most of the time they look like a straight line. I feel encouraged about how easy it was to appy, I am used to applying my lipstick over and over again throughout the day so it doesn't bother me if it has to be applied several times a day. My lips feel liquidly which is fun. I need something to moisturize my lips so I am happy to try this lip gloss.
summary: Fine For My First Lip Gloss!

reviewText:
I rarely use lip gloss because it's usually really sticky and needs constant reapplication. I was pleasantly surprised by this gloss, which has pretty good staying power and isn't too sticky. The texture is fairly thick, but more slick than goopy. The "Charming" shade is a fairly light pink, which is mostly fine for day with my fair skin and red hair. There's a faint waxiness to the finish and flavor, which I suspect gives it the additional staying power.

Other reviewers seem to really like the vanilla-heavy scent, but it reminds me too much of the vanilla-crazy heydey of the '90s - and I really don't care for lip products that smell like baked goods. I also find the shininess and slight glimmer to be a bit much for 40-something beauty. And out of curiosity, what's "power cell complex" supposed to be, other than marketing hype? The product description really needs a list of ingredients, so you can be sure you're getting the "age-defying, skin-boosting, ultra-hydrating ingredients" that are promised, and not just, well, petrolatum and wax.

I chose this as an experiment. The picture of this color on a model reminded me of the light to white shades of the 60s which is not a look I'm going for. Fortunately this is nearly a neutral gloss for me which is exactly right. I am very pale year around so I don't want even lighter lips. This color ( charming) imparts a bit of pink but mostly gloss. I have very reactive lips and have had no rashes or irritation from this. I'd definitely buy this again and would go for a darker shade for impact. However, I really love this one as a day to day gloss. Great product.
summary: On me, low color lip gloss. Not at all like the photo. Very pleased.

reviewText: While I Love this lip gloss, it's a bit pricey.  It is a perfect shade of pink, not too blue and not to peachy. It reminds me of a lighter and glossier version of Origin's Petunia colored lipstick. It's a pretty gloss, not too shiny, not sparkly at all and soothing to lips.  No taste or scent that I can discern. hard to gauge how long it  lasts as I drink water constantly and talk a lot - probably has affect on wear and I reapply fairly frequently
summary: While I Love this lip gloss

reviewText: I liked this lip gloss immediately upon first use.  It appears to be dark in color, a deep mauve, but when applied it is just a hint of color with a lovely shine to it.  It applies smoothly and quickly.  It's not too dark of a mauve, but it has a very subtle color.  It is almost a nude with an undertone of deep mauve.  I prefer lip glosses to lip stick.  I like the ease of application.  It doesn't stay on long however.  It must be re-applied after eating and drinking.  I love that I can sweep it on in the morning without any time and it looks great.  It makes my lips look very natural with just a whisper of color.
Good for dry skin!
IT is not useful and I won't buy it again.

This ended up being too yellow for me 
If you have fair skin with pink undertones do not purchase.
summary: This ended up being too yellow for me  If ...

reviewText: I love Lorac products and though I would give this a try. I like it but its not my favorite foundation. The color match was perfect but if I don't use it with Mac Fix Plus it just sits on my skin.....not a good look. My skin is more on the dry side so of you have normal to oily skin I think this will be perfect for you.
summary: Just OK for my dry skin...perfect for normal/combination to oily skin.

reviewText: I asked a niece what she was wearing because it looked so good.  Very pleased with this.  I used the same color she had.  I have fair/medium skin, and I like a golden tone.  I probably have 8 - 10 foundations, and this is the one I'm using every day now!
Amazing

I've gotten so many compliments while wearing the shade Dominatrix, it's really fantastic. Like all matte lipsticks though, it can be a drying. Some preventive measures can be taken to help the consistency- lip primer, chapstick, etc, but I can understand people's frustration with the formula. I would not categorize this as "cream". The application is not as easy as a non-matte lipstick is, so I definitely recommend using a brush to apply. The colors are great and worth the effort it takes to put it on!
summary: Who doesn't love a nice matte lipstick?

reviewText: I SO Loved it!!! The Color is Just to Die for! <3
Got this in Centerfold and it has to be THE perfect nude! So soft and creamy and just the perfect pinky beige.  More beige then pink...
summary: ... this in Centerfold and it has to be THE perfect nude! So soft and creamy and just the ...

reviewText:
Nowhere does it say these are matte lipsticks!  I always go to the mfr website if I plan to buy lipstick online; I find that comparing the color swatches from 2 or more sites helps me get a better visual idea of what the actual in-person color is.  LORAC's website clearly states these are opaque, matte lipsticks...information that is not given on the Amazon site anywhere that I can find.

Also, comparing department store photos to LORAC photos to Amazon photos makes them all look wildly different.  I will stick with Armani for my mattes and look elsewhere for moisturizing lipstick.

I find this makes my face shiny.  so I am not crazy about it.
it really looks like you are not wearing any foundation at all.  the color seems to adjust to my complexion.
it goes on smoothly and you don't need much.
 I bought the perricone no blush blush and the bronzer because I thought it was a good concept.  but kind of disappointed.
for all these products a very little goes a long way.  you honestly just need one drop to do the job.
I like the blush the best.  very natural looking.
I don't know -- I am not feeling this stuff lives up to the hype.  and quite costly too.

NOTE:  there are only 2 foundation shades - light and medium and the color self adjusts to your complexion.
But if you have a dark or tanned complexion, Perricone wants you to buy the bronzer and mix it with the foundation until you get the right color.  If you are really dark, maybe you can just use the bronzer as the foundation ?
summary: Not crazy for this.  it's only OK.  Expensive.

reviewText: this is very light and has a mat finish - the color was ok but a bit yellow - there were a few things that I liked about it - I don't need much coverage and don't really like anything to heavy - this was very light and  no greasy  and a little goes a long way - however I noticed that after I started using it I started having larger looking pores and blackheads which haven't been a problem in the past  I ( I use my clarisonic every night) only used 1/2 a bottle - just stopped using this and  started using IT foundation  and love it! no more blackheads and back to good skin and small pores -  in fact in the past I have tried several products in this line and haven't found any of them that impressed me - if you really want to try this product I would suggest paying retail the 1st time  at an Ulta or somewhere were you can return it if you don't like it.

I've used 2 1/2  bottles of this formula and it's taken me that many to finally make up my mind.  I am happy that the sun protection is good but the color leaves a little to be desired.  It's slightly too dark for my light skin so I use just a little bit.  It spreads easily and blends well and give me a little color, which everyone can use I think.  The trouble is my skin is oily and this is just slightly too oily for me.  If I'm going to be out and about all day, I use something else.  For a few hours this is fine but after that, the oiliness really begins to show. This is an expensive product and therefore I wish this had some significant treatment ingredients.  The newer formulation promises this I think.  I won't be buying another bottle of this however.  I've found a foundation that has treatment ingredients, no oil, silicone or paraben, just pure pigment, and it's far less expensive than the Perricone.  It gives me light to medium coverage and blends seamlessly with my skin.  And it's the right color, thank heavens.  The foundation I've found is Bare Minerals Bare Skin Foundation and it's a miracle in a bottle.  I've set aside my Perricone bottle and I don't know when or even if I'll ever pick it up again.  There are better products out there, but if you want the sheerest coverage possible with a little color, then the Perricone is for you.  It's just not for me.  It would work well for medium to olive skin and for those who are normal to dry. Too bad it took so many bottles for me to make up my mind.

Had high hopes for this Perricone product and was again disappointed.  Apparently, his products do not work for me.
I have a good complexion and thought that this would work as I don't need/want a lot of coverage.  The color is too orangey/brown and not a universal color at all.  It also has a rather stickey feel to it after applying.  If the product worked the money would not be an issue.  But when it doesn't, the money is the issue.  Too costly for such a mediocre product.  Would not recommend this to anyone.
This foundation is so fantastic for a natural dewy look.  The amazing thing is that it really, really works for any skin color.  I've used it for years and just loved it.
Nice color but not for me you will need to apply at least 3 coats to get the full effect
Love my CND!
Great product, shipped fast
aLL ok

I found this color hard to apply.  Used three thin coats and I still feel it's streaky looking.  It's pretty so I think next time I will only use on my toes where it's harder to see those small imperfections.
summary: Color is nice but hard to apply

reviewText: I was hoping for a nice spring yellow color, but when I painted it on my nails it was much lighter than I expected. I know everyone's computer screen is different but mine looks like a much bolder yellow than the product that arrived. I think it's almost more of a tan/yellow or even nude. There is a lot of white pigment which washes out the yellow color. I just ordered the bicycle yellow shellac and I am hoping it is the bright yellow I was hoping for when I purchased this one. Maybe my bottle was part of a bad batch or something but I was disappointed...
summary: It is more pastel light yellow than in the picture.

reviewText: Went on okay. Nice and smooth and without ridges. The color is not my favorite. Unfortunately, the polish started chipping off after only one day. I suppose you could try putting a top coat on over it and it might last longer. I can't, in good conscience, recommend it.
summary: Quality price, but not a quality product.

reviewText:
Julep has its own subscription box service and is sold at a high price at Sephora. So this is supposed to be a high end nail polish, but I don't understand why. The polish feels thin to the touch, like someone diluted it, and while it does offer a glossy sheen when it dries, you have to use three or four coats before it looks thick enough to stay put. Anything less than that, it washes off or chips easily. Even with four coats, I feel I need to add another gel or clear coat to protect it, something that's unnecessary with Essie and Revlon.

The bottle shape is also a gimmick - pretty to look at it (yes, the shape is made to resemble your finger), but in reality allows only a small amount of product for the price and easily tips over, so you might lose even the little you have (so that you'd buy more sooner, of course).

I keep hoping that I'll come across a bottle of Julep that will make me change my mind about this product, but not yet. I'll stick to Essie. The two stars are for the color alone, the packaging and quality would get only one star.
summary: Nice Neutral Color with Some Shine, But Polish is Overpriced and Feels Diluted

reviewText:
The color is a unique neutral shade that seems a blend of gray, brown and lavender which result in a color that most closely resembles, but is not exactly, taupe. It looks good whether on toe and/and fingernails and is a nice subtle change from colors I usually select.

The polish is thin and smoothed out easily, drying within a couple of minutes. I applied two coats, and for longevity, used an inexpensive (S. Hanson) base and top coat. After almost a week, the polish is wearing well with a re-application of the top coat a couple of times during that time period.

The bottle is distinctively shaped but because it is easy to tip over, is somewhat impractical. Containing only .27 of an ounce when many other brands contain .50, the result is less product for a cost higher than many other polishes. It is hard to judge, but I am not seeing a clear distinction in quality to justify these differences. But, with make-up items the decision often rests in personal preference not an in depth analysis. I really like the color.

The Julep nail polish goes on smoothly. The color on my nail is exactly the color it appeared in the bottle. The nail polish is vegan and made in the U.S.A. I applied only one coat and it took three days before chipping started. By day six, the color was thinning out some and the tips of the nails were showing wear. That is without touch ups, without an undercoat, or a top coat. So the color lasts well. The packaging is really nice too. It looks very high end.  They have a label on the top of the bottle brush that says switch me. It is for you to put some of the nail polish on there so that when you store your bottles you can see the color right on top without having to pull the bottle out. It is a really nice feature & I wish all companies did this. Of course since it's on the brush part of the bottle you need to use a q-tip to apply the color onto the label, but that's no big deal.

I got the color Alaina classic with a twist.  It a grayish color with purple undertones. My spouse really liked the color. It looks very chic. I have nothing negative to say about this nail polish. The picture below shows the packaging compared to the color on the nail and a picture of the swatch on top.
summary: Color in bottle true to color on nails

reviewText: When I first applied this nail polish I was going to give it 2 or 3 stars.  It went on very thin and after two coats I could still see through it.  However, even though it was thin, I didn't have a problem with it running all over my cuticles and skin and the nails looked great when they dried.  The polish also held up well to a lot of abuse.  I washed dishes, scrubbed floors, opened boxes without tools and there were no chips after 5 days.  For a top coat, I used a quick dry product that doesn't normally improve the duration of my manicure but makes it shiny.  I was very pleasantly surprised that this lasted as long as it has.  I took off a star because you really need more than 2 coats and the bottle is tiny and easily tipped over.
summary: Very strong and lasted better than I expected.

reviewerName: make me a vine reviewer again please
reviewText: Love the Julep Color Treat Nail Polish. It went on smoothly and not too thick. Dried fairly quick.  Have had the polish on my nails three days and not having any chipping. I did two coats because I have very thin nails. Great nail polish. I do love the color. It is just muted enough to go with any outfit. Eventually I would like to try a tan color.

Maybe I got a bum product, but we really can't say anything good about this product.  Even from the start, it was difficult to get it out of the package.  then you are left with a tall, skinny bottle that seems designed for tipping and spilling.  We shoot the dickens out of the bottle and it was still watery thin.  We shook it again to the point of ridiculousness and still watery.  Each time we tried to apply it, it would run down the edges of the nail and bleed every where.  When we finally got something of a base layer on, the color was a little along the lines of bruised finger nail.

I really think we got a bum sample so I'll put our experience out there and let customers see if it's a trend.
summary: Maybe I got a bum product

reviewText: Julep is my favorite nail polish brand because of the high quality of their polish. This color is a gray with a tad bit of purple hues. The polish is a great texture that is smooth and not to thick or thin and goes on in a smooth layer. With two coats of this polish you will be all set.

I had been searching for a gray nail polish to love, but hadn't found one I really liked until now. This is the perfect gray with just a tiny hint of warmth to it. The beauty of this polish is that you really only need to put on one coat for full coverage - I put on two, just to make sure it lasted. This polish has tremendous staying power and lasted all week without chipping. The only negative is that it's about half the amount of the average nail polish, but it may be worth it.

I thought I was getting a neutral white polish but I simply didn't read the product description correctly.  I like the square bottle, as it stores better this way. Color aside, this polish spreads fast over the nail and dries fast. It's really not that outlandish, either.

I don't think this polish is any stronger or weaker than the standard polish I've tried over the years.  The only people who have "perfect nails" are the ones who never use their hands.  I can wear a fresh coat for three days before I see cracking.
summary: No better or worse than other nail polish

reviewText:
It looks slightly more pastel in the bottle, but on the nails it is a nice taupey/gray/purple. I didn't notice it drying substantially faster than my other polishes. It went on a little streaky for me initially, but it was almost opaque with one coat (the picture shows two coats). Some reviewers have complained about the bottle tipping over, but I had no problems. I actually really like the thin bottle shape as it is easier to store.

I haven't used this long enough to know if the healthier nails claim is true, but I can't see myself paying this price for that benefit if it does.

I don't like the tall bottle, which is easy to tip over while applying the polish.  It dries quickly.  Unfortunately, the polish chips easily, so you may want to use a good base coat (like China Glaze) first, then this polish, then a quality top coat (like Seche Vite).  Without the base coat and top coat, the Julep polish lasted less than a day on my nails.  After reapplying, this time with the base coat and top coat, it lasted a week before it started chipping.

Another thing I didn't like is the color.  On my monitor, the color (Alaina) looked like a lovely lavender.  On my nails, it's lavender mixed with gray.  Maybe if I were younger...  My husband called the color horrid.  I don't like the color any more than he does.  It might look pretty if you stamp your nails with a dark color over the Alaina.  By itself, not so much.
summary: I don't like the tall bottle

reviewText:
I really like this polish.  It is very easy to apply.  Not thick at all, but rather on the 'runny' side so that it distributes evenly.  It also dries very quickly and leaves a shiny finish.

The color I received is not one I would normally buy.  It's one of those colors that looks different in different lights.  Sometimes grayish, sometimes a hint of lavender.  It would be an intriguing color on toes, and made better on fingers if used for a French effect.

I would definitely buy this brand in a different color.  It went on so well and looked very very good --smooth and shiny.  The bottle isn't especially stable which is why I gave it a minus star.

While this is not exactly a colorful shade, it is a neutral one and will go with virtually any outfit. It was easy to apply, provided two coat coverage, a dried quickly to provide a ice protective finish. This is a high quality polish that is really nice.

Although the bottle is an odd shape and falls over too quickly, this is a nice nail polish. The nuetral gray-brown is on trend and goes well with all outfits. My teen loves this color. It does chip easily, I would equate it to Revlon rather than Opi.
summary: Beautiful shades, odd bottle, does not last too long.

reviewText: I really wanted to like this, and my most counts I do. The ingredients are not nearly as scary as some face creams and It does a great job of moisturizing while not feeling greasy in the least. I didn't really notice any "correction" on my fine lines, but honestly I didn't expect to since I keep my face well moisturized and use other, similar products. Well that and the fact that I couldn't make myself keep using it beyond a short trial period. I would continue to use this, but as my review title indicated...the smell. For a product touting that it is 93% natural, you would think they would have toned down the perfume, but nope. this stuff smells so strongly that I could smell it on the washcloth when I washed my face that night. I'm pretty sensitive to strong perfumes; they're a major migraine trigger for me, so I'm calling it quits with this correcting cream. There are plenty of other products out there that don't make my face smell like the scent isle at the dollar store.
summary: Fantastic, if you can stand the smell.

reviewText:
Nuxe Correcting Cream does more than correct.  It is a great moisturizer.  Only a small amount is needed, it rubs on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and doesn't feel greasy.  It softens my skin and helps with elasticity.  This cream is very moisturizing, so you only need the smallest amount.  This 1.5 oz container will last me much, much longer than I expected.

My one issue with this cream is the scent.  It is much too strong for me. (I will mention I like most things fragrance-free, so you know where I'm coming from.  Even so, my husband noticed the strong floral-rose scent).

It is made with many natural, plant-based ingredients, but also includes some chemicals.  The bottle says 93% of the ingredients are natural.

More time will tell if it helps with fine lines and wrinkles, but I do know it's a good, softening moisturizer.
summary: Luxurious Cream with very strong Fragrance

reviewText:
This correcting cream is very smooth and silky and it absorbs without feeling greasy or heavy.  I love the way that it feels on my face and it is even very good under makeup.  I haven't noticed any change in facial lines yet, but my skin does feel good and my skin is more moist.  That helps me a lot at this time of year when everything dries out.

Now, for the down side.  I do not intend to offend anyone, but this smells like some sort of '80s kind of perfume that older women seemed to prefer.  I can't really describe it.  It just takes me back to my childhood and what the older women in church smelled like.  I don't normally buy anything with a pronounced fragrance for my face.  I don't mind a slight smell, but with this being applied to the face with such a strong scent, you can't avoid smelling it.  I love the way that it has made my skin feel.  If they came out with a fragrance free version, I would like it much better.

The product claims you will see a noticeable difference in lines after 7 days. I think that is a bit unrealistic, I have been using this for over two weeks and I don't see any huge difference, I am 50 so I do have a few wrinkles to put to the test. I think it is a good moisturizer but the claims of wrinkles being much less noticeable are overstated from my experience with this cream. The product does have a pretty strong floral fragrance, but surprisingly I actually liked it and I usually hate fragrances and it didn't linger very long. The product is a good moisturizer and I did like it, I just wouldn't pay anything near this price for just an average face cream.
summary: Unrealistic claims just an average cream

reviewText: So it turns out that I'm allergic to the perfumey smell of this product. Unfortunately, it gives me a headache, especially since, you know, you rub it on your face and it's right by my nose. *sigh* If not for the smell and resulting headache, I think I'd actually like this product. It's smooth and seems to absorb pretty well. I only used it twice, though, because of the resulting allergic reaction. I did want to add that I have terrible allergies and that many strong scents give me headaches so I'm more sensitive than most but, if you have this type of reaction, just be aware of a stronger-than-normal scent to this product.
summary: Strong smell doesn't work for me

reviewText:
Overall, I'd say that this is a good product, although I don't know if the price is justified. The packaging certain doesn't justify the price, since it has the look and feel of a drugstore product, but my review isn't about the packaging. Initially, I thought the cream was a bit heavy and thick. However, is absorbed well and I've used it under make-up even though I prefer to use a primer under make-up.

The reason for my 4* review is that I actually could feel my skin tighten slightly and my skin has better texture when I wear this than when I don't. The results can be felt. Are they visible results? Not to me.
summary: Good product ... results can be felt but not visible

reviewText:
Shades of My Great Aunt!

When I opened the jar, I had a vision of my great aunt applying what is very likely the same product.  The aroma stayed with her all day, every day.

While I loved my great aunt, I did not love the smell of her moisturizer, and I do not care to smell the same way -- ever!  The product goes on smoothly and may work to reduce visible lines, but the aroma is overpowering.

Sorry, this is way too much perfume for me!

Two Stars

It is a nice cream and doesn't leave a sticky or tacky feeling to your face. I haven't used it long enough to know if it will truly help with my wrinkles and i will have to get back her to let you know after about a month. The one thing I can tell you is that it is too perfumey and the smell will last quite a while. It does seem to wear off after a couple of hours but it is not a perfume or scent that I care for. I would prefer unscented to having perfume under my nose and perfume can be an irritant plus drying to the skin so my question to the company is What were you thinking? If it were not for the scent I would give it 4 stars for being creamy and easy to spread and absorbs so that there isn't a tacky feeling left.

First of all, this appears to be a good product in all ways except one.  (Okay, maybe two, the tamper proof cover was hard to get off, and then a big chunk of the product sticks to it, but that is minor). The cream is smooth and glides on nice, absorbs well and does not leave a greasy feeling.  We can't tell that lines are disappearing, but it is not causing any bad reactions.  Except for that one.

My partner describes the odor as old woman perfume trying to hide the smell of fish. I don't know that I sense the fishiness, but I am not fond of the scent. The cream seems good otherwise so it will get used, but the smell just isn't overly appealing.  So decent product except for the smell.
summary: Having problems getting past the odor

reviewText: This turned out to be a cream with nice light-weight consistency which is great for the face, but unfortunately I couldn't use it that way after the first time because of the strong strong floral scent that irritated my eyes. I ended up using it as a hand cream instead but it's not thick enough for those purposes.

This Nuxe cream has a lovely texture to it, and sinks into the skin rapidly.  It feels clean, and does provide some moisture, although not a lot -- if you have dry to very dry skin, this won't likely be moisturizing enough.  (If you have combination of oily skin, however, this may work quite well for you, as it won't feel greasy or over-moisturizing.)

Unfortunately for me, this cream is not a good match for me -- my skin stung and burned slightly with each application, and within a week that reaction had worsened to cause small red bumps all over the area I applied it, so I had to discontinue using it.  I evidently have a slight allergy or sensitivity to some ingredient in it.

I am sure others can use it successfully; it is not uncommon for me to react to skin are products, as I apparently have sensitive skin...but if you do as well, this may not be the right choice for you.
summary: Too harsh for my sensitive skin

reviewText:
In the words of my wife: "I loved it! I didn't even mind the floral fragrance, though it's a bit too much. I've always felt there is no need to add perfume to facial products. In my opinion they should leave out unnecessary ingredients whenever possible. But in any case, I give this cream 4 stars, and it would be 5 if not for the perfume.
It claims to be a correcting cream for visible lines, which fills in, firms and moisturizes skin. The directions are to apply it in the morning, and I found that it worked AMAZINGLY good under make up. Usually I use a primer, but with this cream, it was not necessary. It gives a very soft look, this is definitely my # 1 under-make-up cream right now. I tried to apply it at night also, but I couldn't handle the smell a it soaks into the pillow and lingers.
I noticed after the first time I applied it, that my skin was lifted, more firm and moisturized. After using it for a longer period of time my skin looked better and firmer. This cream definitely passed my test and I'm adding it to my regular skincare product list."

Oh I WANTED this to be a daily use item for me....I was excited to receive it and anxious to try it...being a woman of a certain age ;-)  Nice and thick, went on smoothly...couldn't tolerate it but for 10 minutes.  My husband was calling out for me...where did I go...lol to wash the stink-um off my face!  I really wanted to love this...and probably would have IF it wouldn't of had such a cloying fragrance that really isn't necessary OR desired.  I don't know ONE woman who wants her face cream to ALSO be her cologne.  Gave it 2 stars vs 1 as there are people who aren't sensitive to scents...for them this might be a doable product...just not for me.
summary: Ah nuts!! on NUXE Merveillance Expert Correcting Cream

reviewText:
Young, kicky, cheerful, flowery, sweet smell that lasts surprisingly long for an eau de toilette.

The sweetness makes it especially appropriate for teens or young women.

I really enjoy Juicy Couture perfumes. They usually have a vibrant, sparkling quality to them and this one is no exception. The pink grapefruit scent is youthful and has a beachy, youthful twist to it. And the bottle is gorgeous on my vanity. I love this fragrance for the summer.

This is a very nice scent.  It is not floral at all, which I really like. It has a fresh and kinda beachy scent that is strong, but not overpowering and lasts all day (8 hours or so) but is not intrusive to the nose.  The bottle is beautiful as well. Overall, I really like this scent-very modern for a younger woman.
summary: nice scent, but not over powering

reviewText: Sweet smelling perfume, but not overly sweet or fruity. My 35 year old daughter liked it and said it could probably be worn by any aged woman. It only lasted about 4 hours with one spray rubbed between both wrists.
My teenage daughters LOVE this perfume. The scent is pretty but not overwhelming or cheap smelling and the bottle is really pretty. Excellent perfume for teens.

This is an adorable "eau de toilette!" Very feminine and youthful. Lots of detail. Scent is a matter of taste, but I thought it a tad mature for the teeny audience that favors Juicy Couture, though it is light. You may not agree.  Otherwise, a lovely gift that will make a girl feel very grown-up and loved.

Don't want to give this a bad review, because my dislike of it is personal taste. From the description, I expected something a little sweeter with a mix of exotic and floral. This is VERY heavy on the floral. Like a pure flower water. And for a "toilette" which is generally lighter in fragrance, one light spray was way too strong. It just doesn't strike me as a fragrance for a young girl (which is who I planned to give it to). Much too heavy and bold for that in my opinion. Think I'll be passing it on elsewhere.
summary: Heavy on the floral, light on the sweet

reviewText: "Spring has sprung" with Juicy La La Malibu.  Love the scent.  It is light and airy and not overpowering.  I use different scents all the time depending on my mood.  This scent is uplifting and lovely, crisp and clean.  A definite "buy."

Juicy Couture La La Malibu Eau de Toilette Spray, 2.5 fl. oz.

Another beautiful Juicy Couture perfume in a beautiful bottle with a lovely scent. It's very lively and fresh. It isn't over powering. It's light and airy, a mix of flowers and hard fruity candy.  I think it would work well on the younger woman and those that are young at heart. I know I've smelled this scent before and didn't know what it was. I think it's great. I'm sure your lady will love it and so will you. It will make a great gift for your someone special.

This is the first juicy fragrance I've tried and I'm pleasantly surprised. It's sweet and light, nothing overwhelming about it which makes it a great go to scent for summer months or for times where I'd rather not compete with food or floral smells like at weddings. The scent is fruity with floral notes. The description says musk too but that doesn't come across to me. My middle school age daughter likes it even more than I do. She says it smells pretty and she likes to sneak in and put it on before school. It would make a nice gift as a first fragrance for a teen.
Such a lovely lightweight lotion! It is just what I wanted and I love the light scent. I have oily skin and this works SO well to give me moisture but not too much
summary: It is just what I wanted and I love the light scent

reviewText: The women in the family report that they do not particularly like the feel of the gel/cream as it gets applied. As far as moisturizing goes, it appears to do the job.
summary: Not loved by the women in the family

reviewText: This face moisturizer makes my face feel beautifully smooth and supple. It slides on so easily without being greasy at all. Then it sinks in quickly so it is perfect to go under your makeup. It has a very faint, pleasant smell unlike some other brands. I think this is well worth the money, and I highly recommend it.

AHAVA Time to Hydrate Active Moisture Gel Cream
The first thing I noticed was how nicely this product goes on and it is quickly absorbed into the skin. It is a bit pricey at approximately $42.00 for 1.7oz, however, it goes a long way since you only use a dime size amount at a time, making it cost efficient. I like this product. It feels good on my skin.
summary: ... Gel Cream The first thing I noticed was how nicely this product goes on and it is quickly absorbed ...

reviewText: I have used Ahava hand lotion for years, but this is the first time I have tried facial lotion. So far, it has been great. I like the fact that the smell is light and natural. My face looks and feels noticeably softer after using it once a day for 2 weeks.

I've been very impressed with the AHAVA line of products, and was certainly interested in something that promised to moisturize my face.  I have such dry skin, and I live in a very dry climate besides.  So moisturizer is pretty essential for me.

This does a great job, I like how it absorbs into my skin quickly, I like the very mild scent.  But my face feels a bit sticky for quite a long time after I apply it.  I'm not sure if I'm putting on too much, but when I've cut back on the amount I use, it still seems my face feels sticky.

I don't use it if I'll be applying makeup.  So I use it at night, or in the morning when I'm hanging out and not going anywhere.

Love the results though.
summary: Leaves my face feeling a bit sticky

reviewText: You can't lose with AHAVA!  They deliver again with a delicate and light long lasting moisturizng cream gel.  Going on smoothly it is easily absorbed and will continue throughout the day.  You will feel spa like fresh using this after a bath, shower, shaving.  Excellent product.
summary: AHAVA does it again and lives up to its excellent reputation

reviewText: My wife reports, "I have used Dead Sea Mineral skincare in the past, and I was never disappointed. It is quite popular in Europe and you can find them in regular drugstores and for a pretty reasonable price. What I found very interesting is that a lot of men choose these products. I was very excited to try this Deadsea mineral gel cream, since it has been a while since I've had a chance to use it. Anyhow, this gel cream did not disappoint me. From the pictures and description of gel cream I was expecting something more like Biotherm Aquasource gel, but it is not, this one is little bit creamier and white, it is basically more creamy, than gel like. The smell is very light and fresh. Because of its light texture it applies very well. Absorbtion time and level are ok, not super fast, and you still feel a thin surface/film. But it feels right, not heavy.  A little bit of product goes a long way, and is enough for your face and neck. I had to wait a little bit before applying make up, so it absorbs better. After using Proactiv+ Advanced Dark Spot Correcting Serum, which I liked by the way,  my skin was a little bit drier and sensitive, like after some acne treatments--I needed some extra hydration.
