This AHAVA Time to Hydrate Active Moisture Gel Cream did its job and made my skin feel great again! I am very satisfied with the results. I also like to store my creams in the refrigerator and applying it cold for a fresher feel!"
summary: Definitely worth a try! You might like it as well!

reviewText: I've been using this daily for 3 weeks.  The first time I applied it I used it like my other moisturizer, but found that when using a larger amount the fragrance was too much.  So my next application was in tiny dots on cheeks, chin, above lip and temples lightly smoothed with fingertips and that lightened the smell so that it didn't bother me. AHAVA is non greasy and dries soft to the touch. I like it because it contains Dead Sea minerals.

I like the idea of a moisturizer that's a gel, many creams make my face feel warm and within minutes my upper lip is sweaty.
This is a gel-cream, kind of gelatinous but more like a cream. The scent is very light, I doubt most people would be sensitive to it. It's just a fresh, clean smell.
Unfortunately, it made my face sticky.
Even when using a small dab, it has a tacky feel.
If you don't mind that sensation, this AHAVA product might be right for you. For me, it drove me up the wall.

I often make my own face masks and lotions, and often incorporate honey for all the benefits natural honey has, but I hate the way it feels. This reminded me of my love/hate relationship with DIY skincare that has honey.

I've amassed a large number of moisturizers and this is another one I really like, just maybe not on my face. I like the scent (sort of a fresh, cucumber/ocean smell to me) but it's just this side of too strong for too long to have near my nose and eyes. It doesn't irritate my skin but the gel leaves more of a dewy finish than I want and what little makeup I wear applies unevenly over it.

However, it's perfect for my *ahem* slightly crepey décolleté. There's enough moisturizer in it to plump up the delicate skin without leaving it slick and over-lotioned. Since it does have a lot of fragrance in it, I'm mostly using it at night but in the winter when the curse of my thin dry skin hits, I'll probably start using it during the day too.
summary: A little too slick for face, good for other areas

reviewText: the texture was like no moisturizer I have used before. It is a gel, and while slimy is the wrong word, it was slimier then pure aloe vera. the scent was fine, just on the strong side and luckily it subsided after 30 minutes or so.
summary: I will certainly use the jar up but will not be reordering it.

reviewText: As warranted by my other reviews on Ahava products, I exclusively use them as part of skin care regimen. Having traveled to Israel in 2009 and visited the Dead Sea, I learned of not only the therapeutic qualities for the richly mineral waters, but of its benefits to aging skin. I took home several products while I was there and have been hooked ever since. I turned 60 earlier this year and I honestly can say, my skin has never looked better. This was the first time I tried the Time to Hydrate moisture gel cream. It goes on thick and luxurious and, at first, I was afraid it might be two rich to use during the day. I was entirely wrong. It sinks into your skin within a minute or so and my skin felt almost instantly plumper and silkier. I am using this now several times a day and it is wonderful. If your skin is dry and in need of a quick dep moisturizer, you need this product. I love it and will be buying more as soon as this runs low.

Ahava means "love," so I'll start with a couple of positives associated with this product:

* Attractive jar design, includes instructions in Hebrew, French, and German, guaranteed to make your bathroom countertop appear more cosmopolitan than ever.

* Fragance is mild and mostly inoffensive. If you have visited the Dead Sea and worried that this gel cream would smell like sulphur, fear not. It doesn't.

The negative: I have never tried a moisturizer of any kind that seemed so ineffective. I've slathered it onto my arms, used it on my face, spritzed water on, then applied cream, but the experience is the same. A slight stickiness, and then...nothing. Two minutes later, my skin feels exactly the same as it did before I used the product. I've now gone through about a half jar and remain mystified as to how this product ever made it to market. Maybe it works on people with super delicate skin? That is not me.
summary: My active moisture seems to be asleep...shhh

reviewText:
I have a serious love/hate relationship with moisture gel product.

I love how cooling they feel on your face when I applied.

I hate everything else.

Most moisture gel's claim to "lock moisture in" and while that might feel like the case as it's drying... it might not seem like that later on in the day. I tend to apply this on at night, before bed. Again, I love the feeling of it when applied and it does have a luxurious feel to it... but I can't say for sure if it's helping with the moisturizing fact when it comes to my face. There are a lot of factors that go into dry skin and not just having the right moisturizer but also diet, weather, physical activity.

I will continue to use this product as it usually takes a few weeks/months for me to see a difference but so far I have no complaints!
summary: Nice product. Luxurious feeling. Not sure if it's worth the price though.

reviewText:
I wish it had made a difference, and perhaps it just needs more time, but I applied it to my right eye only for the last 4 days, and as you can see by the picture, there is not really a noticeable difference. Note that MY right eye is on the left side of the photo, for when you are comparing, so IF it had worked, the left side of the image would look better. (Photo has no makeup or alterations of any kind...which is pretty evident, but I'm stating it here for the record.)

The metal tip applicator is very clever, and yes, it is quite cold against the skin. I am assuming there is something with anti-inflammatory qualities in the ingredients, but that is speculation on my part, as I did not see a difference. I guess I should try sleeping more...if only that were as easy as applying cream to my face.
summary: I had hoped for results. See pic and compare left (used product) and right eye

reviewText: I've used plenty of eye creams for wrinkles, for eye shadow priming, for skin softening...but I've never used one to get rid of dark circles.  I've just always used concealer for that.  I have no idea whether I have blue or brown dark circles or both, but this cream has noticeably brightened the area around my eyes in about 5 days.  I'm an early to bed and early to rise girl, so I don't have "party into the wee hours of the morning" types of dark circles around my eyes, so the dark circles I battle may not be the same as the ones you fight.  One thing I can say about this product is I am blown away by the cooling applicator!  At first I thought "this is just a tapered applicator for dispensing the product".  Then, when I used it, I couldn't believe how cooling and soothing it actually was.
summary: My dark circles are less visible

reviewText: It's a nice concealer, but I find it a little shinier than I'm used to. It blends well, and while I see the point of the metal applicator, I don't like it. It's uncomfortable enough I stopped using it. It reduces circles under the eyes as any good concealer should, and does it somewhat better than most.

Easy way to target blue-black darkness under eyes from allergies, lack of sleep, or unknown cause. It has light-refracting properties that do instantly make the skin look lighter.  It comes with a unique little applicator which makes it easy to apply. It goes on easily and works instantly.
summary: Goes on easily and work instantly with a light-refracting formula that makes dark spots under the eye lighter.

reviewText:
I can see where people think this is an eye treatment, and I guess it is, a bit. This is way more of a concealer; it's pigmented and has some pearlized material to deflect light (and get rid of the appearance of dark circles.) Although La Roche-Posay as a company has the reputation for a strong science component to their products, they are also a cosmetic company, and that's pretty much what this product is - a cosmetic.

It does contain caffeine, which has a diuretic effect to relieve puffiness. It also boasts something called Phe-Resorcinol, which I guess is their own proprietary compound. Resorcinol itself is an ingredient in argan oil. The company states that its own blend is "known for its targeted action on melanin", making it sound like this is some kind of skin whitener - all products that claim 'brightening' qualities are really talking about lightening.

Puffiness can cast a shadow, which can cause the appearance of dark circles. This particular product has a metal applicator. I gather the point of that, in using it to spread the concealer around, is that the cold metal will make the puffiness go away. You can get the same effect by putting a metal teaspoon in the fridge or in a glass of ice water, then using the back of the spoon to press down the puffiness (also watch salt intake, which causes water retention and adds to the puffiness.)

You might think caffeine would work on dark circles, but that would depend upon the cause of the circles. Some are hereditary, others can be lifestyle related (tiredness), or can come from age. If your circles have a brownish tinge, use an apricot colored pigment to counter it (this can be in a concealer or just put on the skin, then use a concealer); if your circles have a blue cast, try a yellowish concealer.

This particular product is fine as a concealer, but make no mistake. This is much less of a treatment than it is a cosmetic to hide, not cure, dark circles. Short of surgery and injections, nothing permanently gets rid of dark circles. But a good concealer, and knowing how to use it, isn't a bad second choice.
summary: Make no mistake: this is a cosmetic concealer, not a dark circle treatment

reviewText:
I love the La Roche-Posay Pigmentclar Dark Circle Eye Cream so far because it's thick and easily absorbed. You need just a bit and it blends in quite well. It doesn't leave a slick residue on my top lids like my other eye cream. I'm glad because it's easier to apply eye shadow over this product.

I have some sun spots near my eyes--since eye creams don't come with spf!--that I'd like to lighten. I'm hoping the ingredient Phe-Resorcinol in this product will help with these spots since they're touted with lightening melanin. I'll update as I use this more. In the meantime, it blends in easily and feels smooth and well-absorbed.

The one thing I don't care for is the chrome tip (as seen in the photo) that you are supposed to use to dab the cream on your eye. It's ice cold and entirely unpleasant for me. I just use my finger.

My guess is that the Phe-Resorcinol takes more than a week to begin lightening. I have another product I used for Melasma, and that took about a month to see marked differences. I was doing a study for skin cream, and the photographers couldn't believe the differences from the month before. So I'll give this a month.
summary: Blends nicely, easy to apply makeup over

reviewText: So how long does this take to work??  I have been using for a week and see no difference in my dark circles...the blue or brown.  I do like the metal applicator that dispenses just the pea-sized amount recommended for each application.  I also like the no fragrance of the product...I just want to know when does it work??  How long do I use this to see results??  Does it take one whole tube or two tubes  or what??  I did not expect a miracle overnight but did think  I would see something in a week.  I will revisit this review with an update when/if I see results.  My dark circle cream came from Amazon and will return for more should this give me the desired results.
summary: La Roche-Posay Pigmentclar Dark Circle Eye

reviewText: This is a very nice under-eye concealer cream.  It goes on easily, and covers well.  In fact it does a better job than anything else I have used and lasts all day.  Another majorr plus is the fact that it is unscented; fragrance is the last thing I want near my eyes.  It is pricey, though you need very little, so I expect it to last a while.  As far as I can tell, it just comes in one shade, which suitw my skin well, but a variety of shades would be nice, as women are not all one color (minus a star for that).
I am allergic to most under eye creams and this was no exception.  But it seemed like a decent product.  I think the more a cream attempts to do, the more I am allergic to it.
summary: But it seemed like a decent product

reviewText:
I've reviewed almost a dozen "Dark Eye Circle" products on Amazon. I've had blue-ish circles for many years and probably more noticeable in the past 10. I have very translucent skin, so the pigment shows up pretty well. In my case, it's all genentic. So, I decided to try this and see what happened.
I tested this for 3 weeks, following the directions of applying 2 times daily. This is a very nice cream, no scent and goes on cool because of the applicator. It did reduce the puffiness around my eyes. It did NOT change the color of the circles. During the day, it does act as a bit of a cover, although I still use Benefit's "Boing" to also conceal. The cream makes the Boing a bit smoother so it doesn't settle in the small wrinkles, giving me a more even look.
I wish it did take away the bluish tint but alas, it did not.. I liked but did not love this product and for the price, I'm not sure I'd buy it regularly.
summary: Good for Puffiness but Not for Circles

reviewText:
This review comes from the female side of the family. The French company La Roche-Posay is a familiar and respected name to me but I hadn't run across their products for some time. Then I got the chance to review a tube of this eye dark-circle treatment called "Pigmentclar" and jumped at it. I don't use a lot of makeup, but I do suffer from dark circles under the eyes, so I always apply something before I go out.

I have been using the Pigmentclar product daily for a month and I am  impressed. Let me say first that I'm hard to please with makeup or anything that goes near my eyes! If it stings at all, out it goes. It helps that this eye treatment is hypoallergenic, and free of paraben, alcohol and fragrance. Like some other reviewers, I've suffered from allergies all my life and this seems to go with dark circles. I also want to say that I am light skinned, so my circles just look like a kind of bruising -- not perhaps the very dark circles some of you ladies of darker skin may have. I don't know if or how this would work for you. For me, this product is just right.

I've long used cosmetic dark circle concealer, but I have to say, some of it looks artificial, a heavy cover up that is obvious. I don't like that. What's great about this product is that, while it does have pigment in it (mostly zinc oxide like you get in sunblock), it is mostly light and translucent. It is a little "opalescent" -- part of how it conceals is that it reflects light. It does have finely ground mica in it, so maybe that is why.

The end result is that I get the degree of lightening under the eyes I like, without it looking like it's painted on. This is a cosmetic, but it is also a skin treatment, given the ingredients. So while it does help you cover, it is also treating fine and tender skin with a number of good ingredients. The company tells us the water is from a spring that has a lot of selenium in it, known to help heal eczema and other dermatological problems.

You dot the product around the eyes with the cooling metal applicator tip. You could smooth it with that tip as well, but to tell the truth, I find I use too much when I apply it that way. I prefer to dispense a little on a fingertip, and then dab it on.

I trust this product to be safe for my skin. I looked up most of the ingredients and discovered that they are ruled safe in Europe as well as the States. In fact, I'm so impressed with La Roche-Posay that I'm going to try their anti-aging line as well. I looked up their website and signed up for the newsletter (and there's no way I'm saying that just for the price of a tube of eye treatment!).

I'm delighted to have renewed my acquaintance with the company, and that their products are as good as I remember.

Recommended!
summary: Delighted! Both Helps Hide Dark Circles And Treats the Skin

reviewText: I'm not quite sure what to make of this. On the one hand I like putting it on and it does seem to de-puff and soften my dark circles. On the other hand, I don't think it's the serum itself but rather the slight tinge of color and the cool metal head, because at the end of the day after I wash my face, I see little or no difference. Still, in the morning and throughout the day it does help make the skin under my eyes look and feel better, so I'll keep using it and see if the serum part of it really works eventually.

I gave this product to my wife and heres what she had to say: The metal applicator seems a little silly at first (why not use your finger?) but it does feel kinda good and I guess it doesn't tug on the skin like your finger might. The cream seems to have a little tint to it, so it provides an immediate cosmetic effect to lighten the under eye area. And after application, I have noticed a subtle tingling feeling, which makes me feel like it is working, or doing something.  I haven't really noticed any permanent changes yet, but I'll give it a little more time since Ive only been using it a few weeks. So far so good though.
summary: so far so good but I need more time for evaluation

reviewText: La Roche-Posay is a trusted name in skin care that I first came across, actually, when I was in Paris in 1997.  I bought a bunch of it and brought it home.  Now, of course, the internet does that for us and this brand is much more widely available.  That's why I jumped at trying the dark circle cream.  Too many nights staying up late working and not enough sleep will give me dark circles.  I was hoping this would be more of a soothing cream to help staver the puffiness off, but it's really more of a concealer than anything.  I liked the coolness of the product when it rolled out from the metal ball, but it wasn't a protective cream as much as something to cover up what was already there.  I used the product for a couple of weeks and really didn't see any change in my skin tone.  That being said, it did well to cover the discoloration and wasn't heavy at all.  Not sure I'd purchase it again, rather look at other products from the La Roche-Posay line.
summary: More of a concealer than healer

reviewText:
I'm not sure how La Roche can claim this product reduces the dark circles.  I thought the metal applicator was the revolutionary process plus maybe the caffeine.  Not so.  It may be used as a concealer and, as such, it's not light enough for me.  I tried it several times, morning and night and found no difference.  I added a concealer on top of this product and it seemed to work better but, honestly, I couldn't tell if it was the combination of the two with the added enhancement of another texture.

The pigmenatclar has a smooth texture and the actual case is sturdy and of high quality.  Unfortunately, it was not the miracle to erase years of genetics, age or irregular skin tones

This is really easy to apply, and seems to perk up my eyes before my makeup goes on. I like the way that it feels but I wouldn't say it will leave permanent results. This is a great temporary fix for dark circles, and can help to make your face look brighter and more refreshed. I absolutely plan to continue using this as part of my daily beauty regime. It will last about 2 months of daily use before I will need to buy more. There is almost no scent to the product which is really nice.

I've tried many brands of dark circle correctors and had given up finding one that would work. Most left a filmy or tacky look that was worse than the dark circles.

The La Roche-Posay system is different. It combines a quality concealer with gentle eye massage to move the fluid and puffiness away from under the eyes.

The concealer blends cleanly, absorbs quickly, and didn't leave a trace. It noticeably brightened my skin. It's fragrance-free and non-irritating. I wear contact lenses and this did not bother my eyes at all, even when I got a little too close and some got in my eye.

Using the metal applicator to apply the cream worked well, but I found it a little awkward for the massage and ended up using my fingers to gently massage out from the inside of my eye.

After using the cream and eye massage twice a day, morning and evening, I definitely see a reduction in the dark circles under my eyes.

This is a great under eye concealer for those who are on the lighter end of the skin tone spectrum.  It helps reduce the appearance of dark circles under the eye, and helps improve the texture of the skin.

I have been using this twice a day for two weeks.  My dark circles are purplish in color, and hereditary (thanks, Mom!).  They are not terribly obvious since my glasses hid much of the marks, except with winter pale skin.  And winter is coming.  So, when offered the chance to try this product, I decided to get it.

The cream is a pale, creamy light beige color, and goes on smoothly with the applicator.  After application, you blend it into the skin with the fingertips.  If your skin is darker or particularly pale in tone, it may take a little more blending so the cream is not noticeable.  I have to blend more than my daughter does (she's really pale).  It does cover the circles, but, as others have remarked, it does not fade them or make them go away.  I have noticed an improvement in the texture of the skin under and around my eyes.  It is smoother and less crepey looking.
summary: Good concealer and under eye cream.  Not an under eye circle cure

reviewText:
So far, I really like this product.  I've been using it morning and night and my skin feels great!  I have extremely sensitive skin, so I am always wary when it comes to trying new products but I've had good success with this one.  There is not an over bearing scent to it, which is great.  There is a slight tint to the cream and it blends beautifully into my skin.  It doesn't lay on top either, it literally blends beautifully and then is absorbed without any greasy or caky after effect.

The applicator is really smooth and contoured to fit the eye very well.  It is designed to give you some circulation while you apply it which is TERRIFIC for puffy eyes.

Over all I am extremely pleased with the product, although I haven't noticed any significant changes under the eye with regard to my dark circles, I have noticed that my skin feels really good and I do like the brightening effect it has on my overall skin appearance.

I will continue using for a few more weeks and post any updates with regard to improvement.

The La Roche-Posay Pigmentclar Dark Eye Circle Cream does work to lighten up dark areas around the eyes. This has a metal tipped applicator that I really like, the cream feels good going on with the cool metal tip. I thought at first that this product was a dark circle treatment but the more I used it the more I realized this is a treatment for under make-up or when you want circles lightened up such as from a bad night's sleep. This is a light colored cream and a little bit goes a long way. The directions say to use it with the applicator above and below the eye area, and rub with the tip until it's absorbed. This is a long lasting tube that does provide results. This isn't a treatment however, but more of a cosmetic type product. You could probably get the same results using a concealer that you do with this product, although, I find this cream unique with its light color and metal applicator. This is an interesting product that does lighten under eye circles pretty well.

This is a beautiful oil. It's light, so it feels like it almost instantly absorbs. The scent isn't too heavy, but it is pleasant. Like a light spicy floral.
My skin feels velvety after usage, and not oily or over moisturized.
This is liquid gold in a bottle, just lovely!

The elixir is mostly oil and it just did not sit well on my combination skin.  It worked great on my dry areas but gave me an outbreak in the oily areas near my nose and chin.  It may work well for individuals with dry skin over their entire face but for me, it just was not a good product.
summary: Worked well on dry skin areas but was not good on my oily skin areas

reviewText:
I love this Vichy Vichy Neovadiol Elixer. I'm not a girly girl and don't really have any set beauty routines and if not for getting this stuff to review I would most likely have never tried it or even heard of it before. But I am glad I didn't miss out on this. I have very sensitive skin and most things that I put on my face causes me to either break out in acne, or causes my skin to look raw and chapped.

I really didn't have any expectations that this would be any different, but I am happy to say that it is. My skin is more plump and soft and smooth and it really does look younger. I'm 52, and this may be the first real girly beauty routine that I hang on too. When my bottle is gone, I will definitely buy it again. My skin feels better than ever.
summary: Works very well and I will be buying again for sure!

reviewText: This is oil based and gives the skin an instant protective layer and adds soft silky feeling. It smells like mineral oil to me. Comes in a yellowish clear bottle that says keep out of direct sunlight. They might want to sell it in a brown bottle if they want to protect it from light. It has a push top dropper, you only need a small amount. After using it a few weeks I can say I have had no skin break outs or irrational from it. Will continue using through the dry winter months, might be to oily in warmer weather. I use other face products and haven't noticed any changes besides the soft skin. I do like that it keeps the skin from getting dry and itchy.
summary: Silky feeling skin, oil keeps the skin from drying out.

reviewText: What a luxury facial oil. Unfortunately, within 4 or 5 days of starting to use this as a serum, I developed a deep subcutaneous pimple on one cheek (near the laugh line). I quit using it for more than a week and returned to my neutral skin care routine until my face cleared up. I think tried this oil again, and I got a pimple in the corresponding spot on the other cheek. So I can only conclude that this oil is too rich for my combination skin. I'm sorry, because I liked everything else about it -- lovely texture, mild scent, nicely thought out bottle for dispensing. Just didn't work for me.
summary: Maybe just too rich for my combination skin ... ?

reviewText: I've been using this product for a few weeks and I can actually feel the improvement in the texture of my skin. Normally, around the mid fall season, my skin begins to dry and Crack and no amount of creams or lotions help relieve the discomfort. After trying this serum, I see an instant improvement with my skin and it's become softer than its been in a very long time. Also not a lot of product is needed, so it will last you a very long time! This serum shouldn't be limited to only a particular age group and should be advertised for the use of woman of all ages. Will be purchasing again!!
summary: Woman of all ages should use this elixir!

reviewText: I've been using this serum for about a week and have noticed that the fine wrinkles on my face have started smoothing out.  It's a very light oil and my skin absorbs it quickly.  I've been post menopausal for 5 years and noticed my skin is getting thinner and showing signs of aging.  My arms have especially started looking "old".  I've been applying the serum to one forearm and not the other so I could see if it makes a difference.  After a week, the arm with the serum does look a little less wrinkled than the other.  I plan to continue using this product.

I did not see much difference with this products performance versus products like Cataphil's moisturizing lotion or creams which are much cheaper. The bottle will look nicer on your dresser and has a slightly sweet apple smell, which is probably pentyll pentanoate which can be used as a solvent for fatty acids, that some might find more appealing. My wife did not like the smell.
summary: Did not see any visible benefits compared to cheaper products.

reviewText:
About six months ago I started using oils for facial care, especially in the evening.  I add them as a last step in my evening skincare regimen.  It helps "seal" all good ingredients coming form toner, serum and moisturizer.  One of the advertising points for this product is that it can be used either or: serum, moisturizer, or mask.  I guess that is partially true,.  I would not bet that this particular product is one for all fix.  Especially not for all skin types and not for all kinds of skin problems.

Product has ingredients that include: shea butter, rice bran oil, safflower seed oil and fruit extract.  Shea butter is great for moisturizing, rice bran is one of the best skin care oils.  I love that product has rich, deep yellow color.  But I find product to be less superior to many other oils I used in the past (try Body Shop's new line if facial oils, you will not be disappointed).

This oil will not leave shiny residue on your face.  But I would not use it as a moisturizer on my combination skin during the dat.  I just do not feel like my skin would not be shiny.  And I definitely do not believe that this product can be effective mask.  Oils should penetrate into skin for  along time and having is as a 10-15 min mask on the face will just not do it (at least not for me).

In general, this is OK product, but I would turn to other, more superior oils with more concentration  and mix of carrier oil like rice bran and essential oils with known healing properties for the skin.  Would I spend $50 for 1oz of oil heavily mixed with preservatives (which is the retail price of this product)?  Absolutely not.
summary: It helps "seal" all good ingredients coming from toner

reviewText: This is another excellent beauty product by Vichy.  Vichy is a brand you can trust, and this wonderful elixir is no exception.  It goes on smooth, and leaves your skin feeling luxuriously healthy and shiny!  My wife loved it, and even I enjoyed putting it on my face!  If you are in the market for a product of this sort, look no further.

This serum provides an abundance of moisturizer and seems to really refresh my face and neck.  It seems to be a rich moisturizer serum that is a bit oily when applied but the moisturizer sinks in and has a lasting effect.  I have used it at night and have had benefits without any irritation or notable problem.  It has minimal fragrance that is not noticeable after a minute.  The serum is applied with an eye dropper to hands and then applied to face and neck.

This oil has a very light flower like fragrance. The fragrance is very sweet and gentle. I have three autoimmune skin diseases and they have left my forearms a wreck. I am constantly putting a moisturizer on them. Also because I am 69, almost 70 they are tissue paper thin. If I don't watch out, I snag my skin.
After I applied the oil to my forearms, they did seems to have a light coating of oil. So now they are nor dry.
My only question is the disclosure about the ingredients. Since my skin is so very thin I would like to know more about what is in it. Will long term use of it everyday be alright for me?
summary: Put the Oil on My Tissue Paper Like Skin. Great so Far!

reviewText: I will probably only use this product in the winter time when my face is dryer. I'm afraid of making my face too oily otherwise, as the description says for normal-to-dry skin. I'm pretty much only using this on my forehead and cheeks for now, and the effect is immediate. It goes on very smooth and is absorbed right away. A little bit goes a long way. I'm younger than the target 45, but have a spot on my forehead that I'm looking forward to seeing if prolonged use helps.
summary: I'm pretty much only using this on my forehead and cheeks ...

reviewText:
I am really enjoying this Vichy Vichy Neovadiol Elixer. I like it because it's a dry oil and it replenishes my skin quickly. When I first tried some on the back of my hand when I first received the bottle, I looked at my hand sometime later and my skin was smooth and silky and younger looking from just testing it out. Where I really see a noticeable difference with this oil is around my eyes, on my neck and chest. This has a soft fragrance and a pretty bottle with a little dropper and a tiny bit of oil is all that is needed. I've tried dryer oils before and this one is my favorite so far. My skin absorbs it quickly and this works doubly well if you use it with a Vichy Vichy moisturizer, especially before bed. I do use this in the morning too but add the moisturizer as well under make-up.

This product for me, produces visible results. I really would like to keep using this in the future so I may purchase it when I run out. I like to use oils and use different types for different things. This oil is good for fine lines and on areas with thinner skin. It really soaks into your skin and it's got really great ingredients that nourish skin.

I LOVE this elixir from Vichy Vichy! I was worried that it would be too oily to use on my face, but i goes on really smooth and absorbs in quickly. I have been using it as a substitution for my usual moisturizer. I only have a to wait a couple of minutes after using it before putting on my makeup. My skin is definitely starting to look younger.
summary: I LOVE this elixir from Vichy Vichy

reviewText: A light oil that absorbs in the skin especially formulated for menopausal (or post) dry facial skin and out really is very light and absorbing with no oily our greasy feel. But I really dislike the fragrance to the point that I don't want to continually smell it after applying. It's not strong but some kind of floral, herbal, grassy mix that reminds me of mosquito spray. Soooo a bit disappointing.

This stuff is pretty amazing. I always use an cream/oil of some sort on my face before bed, but never anything as expensive as this. This just might have won me over.

The elixir is so smooth and luxurious feeling and really coats the skin. The great thing about it is it soaks in very quickly so you're not left with a residue that can smear on clothing or pillows. I often times use coconut oil on my face at night, but that takes a long time to soak in and can leave residue on pillows and sheets. This stuff is absorbed pretty quickly though, so I don't have any trouble with that.

I feel like I noticed a difference in my skin pretty quickly after using it. I already have a regular face regiment of oils/lotions/exfoliations, but this just seemed like it added a wonderful extra touch that kept my skin smooth, soft, and even after using it for a few days. I definitely recommend trying this especially if you have trouble with dryness or redness of any kind. The price tag might discourage you, but I don't think the results will.
summary: Great product definitely worth a try

reviewText:
I like volcanic water (I've used products with it), which is part of this anti-aging elixir. We tested it and we like its potency--you only need a couple drops to smooth on your forehead or to mix with (my favorite) hyaluronic acid cream or whatever day/night cream you prefer. Have not tried it as a mask but look forward to using it underneath a Japanese rice paper mask for ten minutes.

This is non-oily, creates a glow (I notice a difference), and contains great ingredients such as safflower seed oil, rice bran oil and shea butter. The product definitely feels French (albeit with instructions inside the package in English and Russian). Luxurious and feels wonderful on your skin.
summary: A little drop will do you. Ahhh.

reviewText:
As odd as it may seem I need skin replenishing oils for my lower arms.  Ive gotten lucky with my facial skin and the gene pool as dealt me a winning hand as far as dryness and wrinkles are concerned.  What is the sad tell for me is the thinning of the skin on my lower arms. Old Lady skin for sure.  Just like my mom, I now have bumps, bruises, peeling spots, discoloration and generally skin so thin that every bump leaves marks.  I was very impressed that with one weeks use of this Vichy Neovadiol Elixir Ive already seen improvement.

The product is made in France but the packaging has dual English/Cyrillic wording so Im assuming that the company exports both to the East and the West.  Another oddity is that the directions are printed on the inside of the package.  You have to tear open the cardboard package to read how to use the product.  This is not a condemnation, just an observation.

The oil itself is thin and absorbs quickly.  It has a much understated, sweet aroma that will not conflict with your cologne. It claims to replenish essential lipids that are lost in the post-menopausal aging process.  I have seen visible evidence that my lower arms seem plumpier (in a good way).
summary: I need help with my lower "old lady" arms

reviewText: This oil amazingly IS what it says...non-greasy AND matte finish.  The directions are printed on the inside of the box, so a bit of tearing is required.  The delivery system is basically an eye-dropper contraption built into the top, which means the last few drops won't be easily extractable.  Overall, a nice skin product.

This is a very light oil that absorbs well into facial skin and does not leave any sort of oily feel or residue. It has a lovely, light flowery scent, which I also enjoy. I am using it as a night moisturizer and also under foundation. It leaves the skin feeling smooth and silky. I have sensitive skin, small pores, and classic T-zone so I omit using it on my forehead. This definitely compares quite favorably with other high end products; so far I am liking this immensely. If anything changes I will update this review
summary: Leaves Skin Feeling Silky, Soft and Smooth

reviewText: This is nice oil, it feels good and smells nice. My only complaint is that it doesn't completely absorb into the skin, and you have to wash it off your fingers, unlike lotion. Otherwise very nice, if a bit pricey

I applied this to my face and neck but avoided my eyes since the facial image on the directions did not highlight the eye area. Note that the directions are written on the inside of the box, so I had to tear it open to read them. This elixir has a clean scent and does not feel oily once it got absorbed into my skin, which was almost immediate. Neverthless, I prefer cream moisturizers and definitely like their LiftActiv Supreme over this "oil" even though it moisturizes just as well. This product is made in France but most of the writing on the package appears to be in Russian. I would really have preferred the application directions to be either on the bottle, on the outside of the box, or as a paper insert inside the box rather than having to tear open the box at the seams to read them. Overall, I would definitely choose a cream moisturizer over this replenishing oil even though it did a good job of "quenching" my skin. NUXE from France is my favorite brand of moisturizer with Oil of Olay a close second and their LiftActiv Supreme a more preferable moisturizer for me than this elixir.
summary: I prefer their LiftActive Supreme moisturizer to this oil even though it left my skin supple

reviewText:
This is a difficult review to write for my Amazon readers because Vichy Laboratories has not been forthcoming about the ingredients of their Magistral Elixir.  This is all the information that is provided on Magistral Box: Contains a unique blend of oils rich in 10% Omegas 6-9 to immediately nourish the skin with moisture and help replenish skin with essential lipids. Paraben-free.  Folks, thats not good enough.  With some difficulty I found that the Magistral Oil contains Safflower Seed oil, Rice Bran Oil, and Shea Butter.  OK, thats better, but still not enough.  Additionally, much of the box containing the Magistral oil is written using the Cyrillic alphabet.  Vichy is a French company owned by LOreal.  Why the box has Cyrillic writing on it is a mystery to me.

What about the oil itself?  It comes in a one ounce bottle with a useful dropper to dispense the golden colored oil.  I placed six drops of the oil in the palm of my hand and rubbed it gently into my face, hair, and neck.  The oil has a light, flowery smell that is most pleasant.  It is immediately absorbed into the skin.

Almost all of the Amazon reviewers have positive things to say about this product and I must agree with them.  I like it and will continue to use it.  I will return in a month and update this review for Amazon readers to comment on the long term effects of using this product.

Update 1: As promised, I am updating this review to report on daily use of this product.  I am adding a star to this review.  This oil works well to promote the health of the skin on my face.  As mentioned, it smells good and is easily absorbed without any greasy feeling.  This is an excellent product.
summary: Light, flowery smell; oil immediately absorbed into the skin.

reviewText: The Vichy Vichy Neovadiol Elixir is easy to use. I will be honest and say that the bottle confused me at first through. I kept pressing the white top thinking it was a dispenser button. So, if you buy this know that you need to unscrew the top and it is an eyedropper dispenser. After that confusion, I used this product by dispensing a few drops into my hands and then rubbing it on my face under my moisturizer. It softened my skin. When I tried it alone, however, it made my skin feel oily and broken out. I also like this as a mask. Alone though, not so much. If you're looking for a product to make your facial skin nice and smooth, this is the one to grab.

Being a woman of a certain age, actually a few years more than a certain age, I know that products such as Vichy Vichy Elixir are not going to give the same results as an invasive cosmetic procedure. But they can give some temporary positive results when applied, such as softer feeling skin and the minimizing the appearance of lines and wrinkles. That is certainly the case with the Elixir, as upon application I noticed that my lines were not as noticeable. The Elixir has a nice feeling on the skin because it is not greasy. I use the dropper to deposit the Elixir on the palm of my hand, then use my fingertips to apply it to my face, forehead, and neck. There is only a faint scent which disappears upon application. Using the dropper will make this 1.01 fluid ounce bottle last longer.
summary: The Elixir has a nice feeling on the skin because it is not greasy

reviewText: Feels good, smells great but after few months of usage, I still don't feel or see much improvement, no better than my other facial creams

I am bothered by a few visible dark spots on my facial skin. This is caused by an excess production of melanin. It is a part of the aging package for many of us. If you have this too, or you have an uneven or dull tone to your skin, it can be helped by using La Roche Posay's Pigmentclear Serum. I am loving what it is doing to make my skin look its best! The dark spots which I have are visibly lessening. My face has a more even looking tone and is generally brighter looking.
La Roche Posay's Pigmentclear Serum has won several awards. There is a good reason for that--it works!

How does it work? It works by using a combination of ingredients, including Phe-Resorcinal and ferulic acid, which contain antioxidizing properties.
LHA (Lipo-Hydroxy-Acid) is also a part of the ingredient list. It provides micro-exfoliation. LHA exfoliates more efficiently and effectively than the exfoliant I was more familiar with, salicylic acid. I have tried plenty of creams and serums which contain salicylic acid previously. Some of them actually bothered my sensitive skin, instead of helping it. With La Roche Posay's Pigmentclear Serum, my face is looking wonderful; clearer and brighter. I am expecting even more good things as I continue to use it!
The serum comes in a pump bottle. I use two pumps. If I have any excess after applying to my face and neck, I use what is left over on the backs of my hands (it gives them a fighting chance, looks-wise, too!).  It goes on quickly and lightly. It has a clean, pretty scent. So far I have used it with no problems, and I really like the results. It is an excellent choice for your serum, if you. like me, have a dull skin tone problem and dark spots. Great for us hot house flower types with fair complexions and sensitive skin, too! I love this wonderful serum! It is a gentle powerhouse. It enables me to keep putting my best face forward!
Worth it!
summary: This gentle powerhouse of a serum lets me put my best face forward!

reviewText: Awesome, thanks!

Read reviews saying it works so I bought it. I use sunscreen everyday religiously. I put pigmentclar on my skin morning and night time. Didn't see any change. I'm Asian with light skin but not super pale. I have mild freckles and some darker sunspots. I'm almost 40. Sadly, this didn't do anything for me despite using it liberally as directed and also using la Roche Posay sunscreen. Very disappointed.
summary: Didn't work for me (Asian, fair skin with sunspots, with sunscreen).

reviewText: This did nothing for any of my dark spots.  I saw it recommended in a beauty magazine and thought I would give it a shot but it didn't work.
Love
I am using it, waiting for results.
I like it very much, does do the difference if you just follow through with face wash, cream, serum and of course sunscreen, don't give up, keep using it !!!

The active ingredient: Niacinamide. Skincare industry vets know that it improves dark spots by blocking/inhibiting the melanin that causes them in the first place. The function of Niacinamide is really preventative: it's effective at PREVENTING existing spots from getting darker and PREVENTING new ones from forming (provided you wear sunscreen). It will effectively maintain your skintone's current state, especially if you're prone to darkening in the summer months. Niacinamide has clinical data behind it --- not a bunch of fluff, so you know it's actually *doing* something.

HOWEVER, it's not-so-good at lightening/depigmenting EXISTING spots that you already have. With continued use (maybe 2-3 months or so) you may see existing spots get slightly fainter (but not much). This is not the fault of the brand, but just a given with Niacinamide.

CONCLUSION:

If you have existing spots that you want to lighten/brighten, it has clinically proven actives that inhibit melanin over time, but it's slow-reacting. It's not a quick fix, but it's much better than a lot of "snake oil" brightening remedies that don't have the clinical data of Niacinamide. With each bottle costing about $50, that's quite pricy for a slow burn that will take months. Instead, i'd rather spend $150 on an IPL treatment that would zap away the brown spots in a minute. But if you want a serum that has data behind it, this is one that i'd recommend--- just know that it's made to effectively PREVENT your skin from developing new spots.

If you already have ridded your skin of spots/pigmentation (via IPL, retinol, or another method) and want to maintain its current state, this is an excellent, effective prevention product when combined with sunscreen.
summary: An Industry Professional's Opinion: Good at preventing new spots from forming, but not-so-good at lightening existing spots

reviewText:
The box for this serum suggests that after four weeks it will visibly reduce the look of dark spots and discoloration.  It also says it will immediately leave skin tone fresh and luminous.  I have been using it for about four weeks.  I think it is true to its word. The serum seems to contribute to a healthy looking and feeling skin.  I think it has softened discolorations.  After 8 weeks, dark spots should further reduce.  Over the long term, its use should lead to even and radiant looking skin.  I think based on my short term results that the long term "promises" are probably trustworthy.  It looks like one bottle will last about 5 weeks using morning and night on my face.

I have not experienced any irritation from the serum, even when accidentally rubbing it in my eye.

I've begun using the La Roche-Posay pigment serum for the past few weeks and haven't noticed any results. On the label it says after 30 days you should see some lightening and after 4 months a greater improvement. I have been applying the serum once a day as the label suggests and can't say that I see anything different. I have noticed that some of the reviewers apply twice a day, maybe that is the key. I'll continue to give the serum a try with double applications because it is pleasant smelling and easy enough to apply. It goes on as a thin quick drying layer. I make sure to apply a moisturizer with sunscreen over to be sure to minimize any sun exposure which seems to be important when using this product. I'm glad that I'm trying the product in the fall/winter months because that already cuts down the amount of sunlight and make it easier to avoid exposure. Hopefully the results come with continued use.
summary: Easy application but still waiting for results

reviewText: I really like this La Roche-Posay Serum. I have uneven, red skin and I was hoping to even out my skin tone some. I don't think it has evened out my skin tone yet, but I have only been using it for about 2 weeks. However, it does make my skin look much healthier and more vibrant. It seems to moisturize my skin pretty well too. The serum is soft and applies easily. It doesn't feel greasy or heavy. I also have sensitive skin and it did not burn or irritate my face at all. I am hoping that with long term use it will even out my skin tone. Even if it doesn't, I love the way the product makes my skin look and feel. I would definitely recommend it!
summary: Makes my skin look glowing and healthy

reviewText:
Pros: The exfoliant that also helps lighten really does brighten up dull skin, especially for those of us starting to age. After using the product for about a week, several people who don't normally comment on my appearance told me I seemed happier or brighter than usual, when nothing was different besides the use of this serum. Since it takes a minimum of 4 weeks to show noticeable lightening, I'll have to update at that time. Overall, it seems to encourage less breakouts of adult acne, which is always a win.

Cons: The acidic products used will likely bother those with sensitive skin or who are allergic to fragrances.
summary: Great product but caution suggested for those with sensitive skin.

reviewText: This is a faintly colored, SPF-containing serum. It'll do a good dual job of moisturizing and hiding very minor imperfections. Great if your skin is good overall and you need a little something light and natural.

11/24/15 Update: This works! I was going to update in 4-8 weeks, but I could see noticeable improvement from daily use in 3 weeks. I'm updating with a photo after 3 weeks to show the improvement. The spot in the front hasn't disappeared completely, but it has minimized. But that second annoying age spot under the freckle closer to my ear is almost gone! I'm still using this serum and would like to update at 8 weeks if the system will allow (it sometimes won't allow edits to photo reviews). This serum may not work for everyone, but I see a huge improvement. I highly recommend this serum.
------------------

I have two noticeable dark spots on my face that really bug me and also areas where my skin tone is uneven on my face. I'm hoping this pigment serum will result in a more even skin tone and noticeably lighten my dark spots (though I don't expect them to disappear). The serum takes 4-8 weeks for a visible difference for dark spots according to the box, so it will be awhile before I can say whether using it regularly will minimize or fade dark spots. For now, I can say that I really like this serum a lot so far - enough to want to continue to use up the bottle and apply it daily to see if it fades those annoying dark spots. This serum is NOT for dark circles under the eyes as it's not supposed to be applied in the delicate eye contour area.

After washing my face, I'm applying just one pump (once or twice a day) as one pump is enough to smooth over my whole face (avoiding the eye area). It feels good like it stimulates but doesn't irritate my skin (my face feels warm but not hot), and the texture of my skin is feeling softer and smoother. Mainly, what I love is my complexion is already looking brighter. I apply one of my regular face creams (I use one with sunscreen if I'm going outside) after I apply this serum. The serum has a faint scent, but I find it light and pleasant even though I dislike most fragrance.

I'm already so pleased with how this serum makes my skin feel smoother and look brighter, so even based on short term results it's a 5-star product in my opinion. I can't claim at this point that it's made my dark spots fade or has evened out my skin tone as it's just too soon. But I do have high hopes based on how the serum feels and performs so far, and I intend to use this serum daily and update my review in 4-8 weeks as to any noticeable improvement over time. Reluctantly, I'm posting a not-so-attractive closeup picture of the dark spots on my face (no makeup) and hope to post a picture later that shows improvement!
summary: Highly Recommend- Smoother and Brighter Skin After A Few Days, Noticeable Improvement In Age Spots After Just 3 Weeks

reviewText:
I ordered LA ROCHE-POSAY NEW PIGMENT SERUM, 1.01 FLUID OUNCH for the dark circles under my eyes. My greatest issue. It comes in a nice, long sleek bottle with a convenient pump. It goes on light, and smooth. A little goes a long way. The fragrance if pleasant and it last for a surprisingly long time.

Product Description:
With continuous use Pigmentclar serum and moisturizer help fight against underlying and existing dark spots as well as preventing their reappearance.

Brand Story:
Recommended by more than 25,000 dermatologists worldwide, La Roche-Posay offers unique skincare developed with dermatologists for every skin type to complement treatments and promote good skincare practices at home every day.

this I really like. Light doesn't clog my pores, or make break outs happen. Which I have had a problem with with past items like this. I usually use oil of olay so this was very different for me. Thinner and  a little goes a long ways. I do like it and it did lighten the darker patch i have on my face from sun damage.

I have very sensitive skin and this serum was very difficult on my skin.  It gave me some peeling and irritation.  The scent is nice and a little bit goes a long way.  It rubs in smoothly and absorbs into the skin easily.  it did lighten some of my darker spots, but overall, the redness it caused on my sensitive skin wasn't really worth the improvement on the darker spots.

In just two weeks of use, I've noticed a significant difference in the new sunspots that have accumulated on my face over the summer. The serum goes on smooth and absorbs quickly, so there's no messy or sticky feeling, just smooth clean skin under it. Also I was glad to see I had no eye irritation with this as I've had with some other products. One thing I do have to say though is that sunscreen with this is an absolute must. The first day I used it and went outside without sunscreen, my face felt very sensitive and tingly but the next day when I did apply sunscreen, I had no such issues. Will continue to use it and see how it improves my older spots.

One of the most reputable names in skincare is La-Roche Posay, and I eagerly awaited to try this product. The new pigment serum did not disappoint. The lotion is thick and silky and dispenses evenly and smoothly out of a top-shelf bottle that the product comes in. The serums scent is very delicate and barely noticeable. To me that is another bonus. If I want perfume, I BUY and WEAR perfume.

After a mere five-day test, not only are my dark spots fading, my entire face is aglow, resulting in a very natural look. Nice! Even the dark circles under my eyes look better. I would highly recommend La Roche-Posay New Pigment Serum and can easily understand how the product has won a number of beauty awards. Best face forward, this stuff works!
summary: La Roche-Posay New Pigment Serum, stands up to its reputation

reviewText: This was a tough product to judge.  First of all it works, and it works within a few days.  It crazy works.  HOWEVER, my facial skin was way to sensitive for this serum.  It burned quite a bit, for quite a while.  And two days later it was still sore when I used my gently exfoliator.  After the first application and the burning, I decided to use it on my hands that have HORRIBLE liver spots.  And I am WAY too young for those!  lol  Too many years of sun exposure.  Here's the thing.  The skin on the back of my hands did not get affected at all from this product.  AND the spots all but disappeared on my left hand.  The huge ugly spots on my right hand are still there, but they have gone from deep ugly brown to a cafe au lait color in no time at all.  I think if you could live with this on your face, you would bleach yourself all one color in no time.  Unfortunately, I can't use it on my face, just my hands.  And it works really well.
summary: Not sure how to rate this - WORKS GREAT - BUTTTT - Burns on my face

reviewText: My wife and I both enjoy this particular scent.  The bright citrus topnotes are quite pleasant and crisp without being overpowering.  The basenotes last overnight and even into the morning with a warm musky scent that is subtle and really great-smelling.
summary: Lasts a long time and smells great throughout!

reviewText: Wonderful, deeply layered scent that lasts forever. Like a good wine, the flavor notes change with longer exposure to the scent. It is bold yet not overpowering, starting with crisp citrus teases, and deepening to a slightly sweet musk. The lotion feels wonderful going on, silky and smooth. I love this!

This body milk has been described as "light weight" and it truly is.  Some creams can be so heavy and thick, and while not necessarily a bad thing, during the warmer months, I like something that glides on smooth and doesn't make me feel like I'm wearing an extra layer of skin and this body milk certainly fits that description.

The scent is lovely, richly layered and sensual, yet never overpowering.  Applying this cream is an overall feast for the senses!  I think this just might be my new favorite!
summary: Light and sensual feast for the senses!

reviewText:
Review of Burberry Body Tender for Women Body Milk.

When it comes to perfumes and fragrances my wife is hard to please.  I have purchased everything from Chanel No. 5 to Calvin Klein's CK One and everything in-between for her.  Usually she is nonplussed and will just say something like it is "OK", etc.  With this scent though my wife absolutely loves it.  It was kind of shocking.  She told me she wants to order more when it is gone.  She likes that it is a light fragrance, not overpowering, and that is fresh, crisp, and clean.  I personally enjoy the unique fragrance and I know immediately when she is wearing it.  I can't easily express the scent.  It is definitely unique.  What lingers after the fact is definitely the musk base which is, in my opinion, what the fragrance transitions to in it's final form.  Nice.  Five stars.

The thing with any type of perfume is that whether it works for you or not is so dependent on your individual body chemistry and your personal olfactory aesthetics and sensitivity. Personally, I don't wear scent very often because I'm too sensitive to it and it gives me a headache when other people wear too much (or sometimes, depending on the scent and alcohol content, any at all).

I really liked this body tender milk from Burberry because it has a light scent that's neither too musky nor too floral. I can't really describe it too well except to say that I like it. It's feminine but not sickly sweet.

It sprays out of the (very generously sized) bottle as a lotion, so you have complete control over how much you and where you apply it. For me, one tiny little drop rubbed wrist-to-wrist goes a very long way. A drop is just enough for me to notice the scent but not be overwhelmed by it. I still won't be using it every day, but it's definitely a lovely special occasion treat.

This Body Tender Milk comes out in an ultra-fine stream. The fragrance is light and delicate. I applied this lotion before bedtime and the scent was still subtly there when I woke up in the morning. This would be a great alternative for someone who wanted a light perfume fragrance without needing to spray it onto your body or clothing.

I really enjoy this fragrance, and while the lotion isn't ultra-moisturizing, it has a lovely scent and helps provide a little bit of moisture to the skin.

I am so in love with this fragrance. It is very light and goes on smooth.
This is a spray lotion not a perfume so a little goes a long way. The packaging is beautiful, I love the crystal like bottle. It is made of glass so be careful not to drop it and keep it out of reach from small kids.

Everything about this is  unique and I'm glad to have it a part of my fragrance collection!

Burberry Body Tender Milk has a rich floral scent that is not overpowering and smells expensive.  Spray the lotion onto your skin, then lightly spread it around.  It makes my skin feel smoother, softer and the fragrance lasts about 6 hours indoors and about 4 hours outdoors (heat seems to make the scent fade more quickly).

The bottle is beautiful as is the box it comes in.  Just looking at the box tells you here is something special inside and when you pull out the gorgeous bottle, you can hardly wait to try it.

Considering the high quality and long lasting scent, I think the price for this product is right on point.  Will definitely buy this again, both for myself and as a gift for my mother.
summary: Luxurious scent in a beautiful package

reviewText: Burberry's 'Body Tender' is a crisp, lighter version of the 'Burberry Body' fragrance. With 'Body Tender' the floral lifts are more pronounced versus the dominant spice and musk tones found in 'Body.' The 60 ml of scented lotion (or 'milk') is contained in a beautiful glass spray bottle that dispenses gently and allows for precise portion control. The milk absorbs easily into the skin, provides a light, buttery sheen and even a modest application dose will sustain a subtle lingering aroma throughout the course of a day. Made in France this is a quality skincare product with a pleasing and complex fragrance.
summary: Complex and refreshing scent, beautifully packaged

reviewText:
Scent is a personal preference. I really like the Burberry Body Tender scent and have been complimented on it. It's described as being the youthful twist on the Burberry Body line. It still smells grown up, but not too musky. This lotion is not meant to moisturize your skin. It is can be worn on it's own so you just get a light scent. You can wear it with the Body Tender perfume on top to make the scent last longer. Or you can use it as a base for layering a different Body perfume on top for your own scent.  The Body Tender Milk is very light and goes on smoothly.  It pumps out only a small amount at a time. Which allows you to control how much you put on a little at a time. It comes in the same bottle design as all the other Body products.

If you already love the Body Tender perfume, I would recommend the Body Tender Milk. It is great to wear on it's own or for layering scents.

I have never tried a Burberry fragrance other than magazine samples but this one intrigued me as I love crisp apple scents so I opted to try it out. I love the sleek glass bottle that is easy to hold and the lotion dispenser is strong and targeted with no drips.
The scent is very different and it has green absinthe and sandalwood as a top note and then it brings in lemon, rose and apple with amber and musk with the dry down.
It is a spicy subtle addictive scent that men love and I let the ladies in my office try it and one of them went and bought a bottle for herself.
It is a unique scent that is great for a daily perfumed lotion as it absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling silky and moisturized. It would make a great gift!
summary: Subtle, sexy, spicy and long lasting scent

reviewText:
Am sure this is a nice product if it did not come broken in pieces. My wife cut herself with the fine broken glasses while trying to throw the product away. Its a pity as my wife love her Burberry touch perfume and thought that this would be something that she might have like to get.

Would not recommend to get it online but rather just pop over to the nearest store to self-pick up this fragile product.
summary: Broken on receiving, recommend to get this product from retail

reviewText:
Burberry Body Tender Milk is like a light lotion, packaged in a beautiful glass bottle with a apple/floral, slightly spicy fragrance with some subtle musky undertones. I like it because it isn't a sweet scent. I love the smell of some sweet perfumes on other people, but they don't seem to react the same with my body oils and seem overwhelming after a very short time. This one stays fresh smelling even after wearing it for hours. It doesn't seem to last all day, but perhaps that's because I grew accustomed to smelling it and don't notice it as much after a while.

The glass bottle looks luxurious on my dressing table. It has a pump type applicator that dispenses a drop or two of this scent at a time which is the perfect amount. The scent is light and rather delicate and never seems overwhelming. It seems sophisticated, a scent suitable for business or formal wear. That's partly because it isn't too strong. I think a person would have to be standing close to smell it rather than noticing it when you walked into a room. This is the type of fragrance I like.
summary: Lovely delicate scent in a beautiful bottle

reviewText:
I would give this 5 stars.  It's light and not greasy.  Yet, it moisturizes very well.  It feels light, not heavy.  I think that "silky" is a good description.

The scent is light, fresh and feminine, but in no way obtrusive or overpowering.  In short, this is a very nice lotion.  It works great and has a terrific smell to it.  5 stars and highly recommended!
summary: I think that "silky" is a good description. The scent is light

reviewText:
Opening this was like Christmas morning. This body milk was beautifully packaged in an octagonal box and at first I wasn't certain what I received. Purely based on appearance, I knew the packaging was setting me up for an experience that I'd either love or hate.
I am absolutely crazy about this scent. Forget all this stuff about fruit and roses. They are in there,  but what this scent is about is fresh yet fragrant. It is whisper light and yet a pleasing combination of scents that is subtle and sophisticated. I gave this a quick spray on my neck and this lasted for hours and did not need to be replenished.
I'm usually not into scent and use a Meyer Lemon soap when I bathe. It is faintly sweet smelling and very light, but is not nearly as distinct as this body milk.

I love this scent but I'm not a fan of this being a lotion in a tiny bottle. It's 50 on here. I used it on the majority of my body (I'm only 5'0) and it wasn't overwhelming or strong, a few hours I can still smell it but I disagree with other people saying a little goes a long way. My husband said he could hardly smell it.

The bottle is very nice looking, but I'd go with the perfume, not the lotion.

I have heard of Burberry but never tried their perfume lines. I do wear perfume daily and lotions.

This is a very mature scent. I would not think a teenager would wear it but a business/mature woman.  I have seen it listed as such on certain websites. I was able to try the lotion and must say it is divine! It smells light but yet enough that you can wear it alone for a few hours and it will emit enough fragrant off of your skin. I noticed it seems to last 4 to 6 hours before it fades.

It reminds me of Juicy Couture. It has a distinct scent to it and that was the first one I thought of. I also have a sherbet I use with my Juicy Couture; the texture is very much the same. I love the milk (lotion) it glides on easily but yet is not greasy. It smells so good I was hoping I would not fall in love with it but I have. Now I need to buy the perfume so I have a matching set.

I have worn this lotion alone and it is strong enough for people to smell it. I have worn it out for dinner or drinks. I think if you are going out for the evening and want a scent to last; this is one I would choose.

Very lovely! Everyone that has smelled it on me loves it. Again, your own body chemistry will be the deciding factor. My body seems to agree with it so off I go to buy the perfume for it!
summary: I have fallen in love with this scent! Buying perfume now!

reviewText:
Very nice mild feminine scent. It is barely there, not overpowering. Fresh, crisp and warm at the same time. Kind of out of bed, out of shower mix.
The bottle is definitely luxurious, can make it nice gift. It is glass.
It is spray pump and lotion might squirt in wrong directions and hit your face. It absorbs really fast and I would not say that a little goes long way.
Lotion is lightweight and not greasy. Not extremely moisturizing but it is not drying at all.

This body milk is very luxurious with a lovely scent.

The body milk is lightweight, yet spreads nicely, so you don't need a whole lot.  While strong at first, the scent faded to a very delicate and youthful scent quickly enough, however lasted about eight hours.

Now, I have sensitive skin and am prone to sneezing fits when I use many different lotions and scents.  This was gentle on my skin and I experienced no allergic reactions whatsoever.

The Burberry name indicates both quality and luxury and this body milk is no exception.  This would be a lovely gift for the young woman in your life!

This is a pink lotion in a gorgeous glass bottle, and it has the most wonderful fragrance.  Even the pink box the bottle comes in is gorgeous.

This is a pump bottle, and pressing the button on top squirts out a stream of the heavenly lotion.  You can aim it to get the lotion exactly where you want it, since the stream is thin and the lotion comes out with pinpoint accuracy.

Now to describe this light, subtle fragrance.  The jasmine is the first topnote to meet my nostrils.  And everyone loves jasmine.  A white rose is the next note. I would have chosen water hyacinth as the middle note, although this mentions sandlewood (which would be a bassnote) and lemon for the middle note. And yes, the lemon is there, but I had to search for it, which is for me unfortunate as it is the most favorable note in fragrances for my body chemistry.

There is also something of water, clean laundry, sunshine, with rainclouds on the horizon.  The lemon peeks out in the dry down.  The initial happy aroma quickly dies down into a skin scent.  What is left is a silky, watery moisture drenching my thirsty skin, and I keep putting my arm to my nose to inhale the soft, delicate sunny scent.  And I love the artistic, subliminally phallic bottle.  It's not only gorgeous, it's suggestive, especially with the unsubtle word "BODY" on it.

This is all what a top of the line body lotion with scent should be.  The pretty box, the glamorous and unique bottle it houses, the delicious moisturization without grease, oil, or heaviness, combined with the elegant high quality, nature-inspired fragrance that lingers in the background on my skin, all speak volumes about the seriously decadent attitude Burberry takes toward its line of perfumes and lotions.  Burberry means quality, and is an English version of the House of Chanel in many ways.
summary: Delicious light scent in a lotion

reviewText: Smells nice, this is the only Burberry perfume that has worked with my body chemistry. I love the opening of lemon, it's a nice and crisp refresher on a warm summer day. I'd highly recommend if you like this scent.
summary: Opening of crisp and zesty lemon

reviewText:
NOTE: This review is for the BURBERRY Body Tender, Eau de Toilette, NOT THE BODY MILK. Amazon inadvertently sent us the perfume to review instead of the milk, and as my girlfriend (and me) really like the fragrance we decided to keep it.

This product has been a refreshing change. Due to having migraines, asthma, and a VERY sensitive nose, my girlfriend is generally unable to wear most scents. With the BURBERRY Body Tender, Eau de Toilette, however, she found she could apply small amounts of it to places generally not near her face (on the small of her back, I believe), and it didn't cause any reaction.  She's pleased because she LOVES the Burberry fragrance and says it make her feel "sexy". I wholeheartedly agree with her assessment!

It has a subtle citrusy, floral scent that smells clean and fresh. Over time it seems to smell more like sandalwood and musk, but never too heavy. The scent lasts much of the day, though she says she will occasionally apply a bit more in the evening if we're going out.

The fragrance comes in an interesting, tall, narrow, octagonal pink/mauve box, and the bottle within is heavy glass in the same narrow octagonal design, with a silver cap. It looks very classy on a dressing table.

Overall a great, high quality fragrance from a premium brand, with the commensurate premium price, which is the only thing I'm critical of. It's Made in France, BTW.

**** RECOMMENDED! - 4 STAR ****
summary: Has a subtle scent that is pleasant and not overpowering.

reviewText: I originally bought the tria 4 x - I saw results with it immediately but on a setting of 3 it felt like someone was burning me with a cigarette lighter - my motto is it takes pain to be beautiful so I would have endured the pain except after 1 use on my legs I noticed it had left little white scars all over them - so I returned the tria4x and purchased the flash and go -  I have been using the flash and go once a week - I know it says every 2 wks because of the growth of the hair cycle or whatever - I don't get that because I'm part Italian and my hair never stops growing I shave my legs every morning  and by night I have stubble - the flash and go I turn it up to a 5 and there is no pain a slight discomfort if that - now it took about 3 or 4 uses before I started seeing results but I am seeing results - by the end of the night my legs are still smooth the hair is growing back softer and not as quickly on my arms I only shave every few days now where it was once a day - on my chin and upper lip before where I had to pluck every day now its just once in a while and I see hairs just pushing themselves out where they have died - yay!  also I like that if you have questions you can call customer support and a live English speaking person answers the phone - with tria you have to send an email and someone MAY get back with you - also with the flash and go the replacement cartridges are very reasonable and the machine doesn't ever quit on you where as the tria 4x it only has so many uses and then its time to throw it away

I love it!

Lacoste offers an elegant, hearty and sophisticated perfume.  From the appearance of the bottle to the fragrance, it proves classy and up to the standards of the best evening out or professional gathering.  It is a perfect gift for a woman who wears perfume and is open to trying to fragrances.  This subtle and pleasant scent should draw the right kind of attention.

A touch goes a long way with this scent.  This bottle should last a significant time and make it a worthwhile investment in fragrance.

I requested this for my wife to try.  It has a sweet smelling scent that initially makes me think of cotton candy or bubble gum.  The scent starts out a bit strong when first applied but settles into a more subtle and warm sophisticated scent.  Once it settles in, it becomes noticeable without being overbearing.  Two to three sprays is enough for a nice projection.  People nearby will catch a light whiff when standing within  a couple feet or closer to the wearer.  Thankfully, it's not one of those overwhelmingly strong scents that would make your eyes water from across the room. I love this fragrance on my wife.  We're both a tad shy of middle-age but I think this fragrance is appropriate for any age group.  It's sophisticated without coming off as too mature and versatile enough for any event, whether she's wearing an evening gown or jeans and a sweater.
summary: Love this sweet and subtle scent

reviewText:
Sensuelle radiates sophistication from its unfussy bottle to its complex feminine fragrance - sweet but not overpowering. It has depth and a touch of mystery. Category-wise this is what is referred to as a gourmand scent which means it contains significant food-based notes such as vanilla, chocolate, coffee and berries.

In this particular fragrance, I noticed nougat, black current and pepper. I found nougat to be prominent in the middle and base notes, the part of the fragrance that lingers for hours. The initial scent is black currant, which is layered with a light floral fragrance. The longer it was on the more pleased I became with how the scent developed. Although not the same, it reminded me a bit of Lauren by Ralph Lauren.

This is not a light fragrance so I will probably wear it only in the evening and I will use it judiciously because it is strong. I sprayed the smallest amount I could control on the inside of my wrist, from a distance of about seven inches, and let it air dry, and it easily was noticeable for seven or eight hours. I recently learned that something I had been doing for years, rubbing wrists together after applying scent, actually alters the balance of the fragrance and should not be done.

Allowing time for the fragrance to develop rather than judging on the initial sniff is wise, and often offers some pleasant surprises. I do not have a signature scent but rather select what to wear based on my mood, and this is a very welcome addition to my usual group of fragrances.
summary: Lacoste Sensuelle Eau de Parfum for Women

reviewText: I had no idea what to expect when I ordered this perfume since I'd never smelled it in person. To date Love Struck Eau De Parfum Spray for Women by Vera Wang, 3.4 Ounce has been my signature scent but as it is becoming increasingly difficult to find so I've been open to trying something new. If Love Struck is my more floral, warm weather scent, this feels more appropriate for the cooler months. It has a nice warmth and richness about it that I found really appealing and quite different than a lot of fragrances for women I've tried. Initially when I sprayed on my skin I wasn't sure I liked it, but after it settled into my skin I LOVED the fragrance.
