It's lightly sweet without being cloying or smelling artificial and every time I smell it I get a hint of a different note, which I love. I'd highly recommend it.
summary: Love how it smells on my skin

reviewText:
This was gifted to me by a friend who knows how into fragrance I am....this is not one I would choose on my own.  It is sweet - too sweet for my taste.  But if you like sweet gourmand fragrance, you may like this.  It is well done for a sweet gourmand & not sickly sweet fake fruit like so many are today.

It starts out a bit sharp & fizzy with pink pepper & moves quickly on to black currant followed by nougat (sugary, a bit of nutty sweetness).  The nougat scent lasts the whole way thru.  The flower notes are just background.  A bit of rose, a bit of sweet pea but barely there; they just keep this fragrance from going too far to sugar overload.

It doesn't have a huge sillage but go easy with it.  It does radiate more than arm's length.  This lasts at least 12 hours on my skin and I get whiffs of it the next day.

Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Sensuelle Eau de Parfum  is such a sweet smelling fragrance and it's powerful but not too strong just enough where you only have to use a small amount. The parfum smells so good that I get compliments whenever I where it. I where this at work and as it fades it smells even better. The bottle is beautiful with a charm hanging off and this will make a perfect Valentine's Day gift.

Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Sensuelle Eau de Parfum smells so sensual and heavenly the price is a little high but a little of this goes a long way, so it will last a while and if you want a quality scent then this is the perfect choice.

Scent is a very personal thing. What works for some does not work for others. In this case I am in the "other" category. To be fair to Lacoste very few perfumes interact well with my body chemistry. About the only two that work without changing chemically after I apply it are Joy and Byblos.
That said, I didn't care for the smell of this at all. I looked at the description which describes it as: "an elegant, sensual fragrance that captures the natural intensity of soft floral notes on a relaxed, warm evening. Eau de Lacoste Sensuelle opens with the tangy tartness of ripe and lush blackcurrant. The heart has the rich elegance and femininity of Turkish rose. The base finishes with the enveloping sensuality of the nougatine accord."

I didn't find it to smell at all floral let alone that of a black currant or Turkish Rose."  And actually the smell reminded me of Thierry Mugler's Angel which also reacts badly in terms of smell with my skin. After about 30 minutes, the perfume had a very chemical type smell.

My rating of three stars is my personal feeling towards the smell of this perfume right out of the bottle. As I said it smells similar to Mugler's Angel. I didn't get a real feel for the above described floral notes.

First, I admit I will have a hard time accurately describing the nature of this particular fragrance. Definitely sweet, definitely complex. To me, more fruity than floral. Another reviewer used the phrase "sour grapes" and "black currants", and these would be the closest I'd come to. I generally liked it - definitely a "grownup" product you wouldn't find a teenager getting excited about.  It lingered a long time, perhaps a bit on the strong side. Maybe the kind of fragrance you wear the evening after a grueling tennis match or something...I'm sure this is what they were aiming for. But I'm not sure words are an adequate way to describe a fragrance like this, so definitely try to sample it firsthand if you can.

A dark shade of violet is the hue that comes to mind while inhaling the fragrance of this sultry, spice tinged mix. The scent will work wonders when worn in a setting with soft mood lighting, delicate flirtatious conversation in tow and a libation or two to dull the edges downward a notch or two.

Dried cherries, red wine, toffee, nutmeg are the scents that stand front and center upon initial whiff while gently tapering down with hints of musky, floral components (jasmine?). Remnants of the aroma will stay on your skin through the entirety of a day/night and within a few hours softens up by revealing more pronounced baby powder inflections while still carrying forth the primary accent of dark spice.

The fragrance is well packaged in a beautiful dark blue glass orb that lends an air of mystery and sorcery that complements the contained scent perfectly. Excellent fragrance and presentation for a mid-tier range perfume.

I seldom wear perfume, but when offered this product I decided to try it.

I am not sorry. It is a much fruitier and more flowery scent than the one I otherwise use very occasionally---a musk oil I've had for eons that is quite subtle and (I think) unusual, as it was custom made.

I could never have accurately described the scent as well as the perfume connoisseurs who likewise grabbed this offering. They did remarkably well. One reviewer agreed with LaCoste---it is "tart" and further noted the scent of "bitter grapes," as well as the sensual and youthful nature of the floral tones that give this perfume a gravitas appropriate for the board room. Agreed.

Like my musk oil, this scent requires only a dab to do the trick and lasts a very long while. Over use can also over-power those around you, and is not recommended.

I would not pay $68 for this (or any scent) but I am very glad to own it and am sure the contents of the beautiful cobalt blue jar will last me for years.

I'm very much a fragrance addict - I have dozens of bottles of cologne and perfume that I mix or save for certain occasions. Part of why I like to mix my scents is because I'm rarely 100% satisfied. Perfume these days tend to be either too sugary and sweet or too old-fashioned and flowery. Adding a musky cologne can tone down an overbearing perfume and, alternatively, a hint of sweet perfume can make a cologne less intimidating.

The reason that I have chosen to give 'Sensuelle' 5 stars is because I feel like it is pretty much perfect as is. There is a brooding darkness that lingers just underneath the floral overtones that is the perfect combination of naughty and nice. I like that they describe the blackcurrant as 'tart' because there are some notes of bitter grapes. The floral aspects are indeed sensual, but in a youthful modern way. It's very much a strong, powerful businesswoman fragrance. It's not something I would wear to the club. It smells too important for leisure and frivolities.

My only warning is that you should not overuse this fragrance. A little goes a LONG way. Too much will have a dizzying effect that will be counterproductive to the mystique that makes it work so well. The bottle is simplistic, but perfect. This fragrance doesn't have a gimmick or celebrity sponsor, it's just classy. The dark, purplish blue color of the bottle is an excellent representation of the scent in a hue.

OVERALL: To be honest, some of Lacoste's fragrances have left me underwhelmed. This one, however, is worth trying. It doesn't try to pander to a youthful audience but it doesn't repeat the same problems of 99% of the floral fragrances that are on the market. I love the darkness mixed with sweetness. Highly recommended!!

Lacoste is a French company that sells high-end clothing, perfume, watches, etc.  Their items are high quality, but pricey.  I love the fragrance of this Eau de Lacoste Sensuelle Eau de Parfum for Women.  It has a sweet, floral aroma.  It is a strong smell, so it might be a little much for those who like a more subtle fragrance.  It comes in an attractive, round, dark blue bottle with a gold Lascoste logo (crocodile) on it and a gold tassel around the neck of the bottle with the Lacoste name, so it is fancy-looking.  However, there are less expensive perfumes I like just as much as this one.  I would recommend this perfume for those who like a strong, floral scent and do not mind spending the money on a high-end brand.

All my life people (aka my mom) would tell me I need to wear sunscreen daily and while I can't argue with that advice I could never seem to get behind it because I really didn't want to smell sunscreen unless I was laying on the beach. But this product COMPLETELY changed by perspective. It does not smell like sunscreen at all. It applies nicely to my face and I wear it everyday under my foundation. I am a true believer of supergoop and will be using their products from now on!
Great for kids.

This has to be one of my favorite SPF's of all time, but I especially love it for the summer months. It's not a physical SPF, so the white-cast isn't even a factor. This sinks into the skin quickly, not greasy at all, and does not have a strong scent.  It feels great on the face and does not clog pores or cause breakouts, it actually feels moisturizing. I always purchase these two or three at a time because my family loves to be out in the sun all summer. It's also waterproof which is a MUST during the heat.
Above all else, I really like Supergoop as a company. The wealth of information on their site is very helpful, and I love that they specialize in sun protection, and because of that, they are always looking for ways to make sun protection better. As it is, the U.S.'s initiative to find better ways to protect people from the sun is antiquated at best. So many other countries are way more advanced in this area while in the U.S. we continue to limit the research that would take us further than what we know as physical & chemical sunscreen.

The bottom line is that I very highly recommend this product for adults and children alike.
Love this so much. Light texture and doesn't feel greasy at all.

I used to love Super Goop but they changed the formula, I think.  It is now super stinky and the consistency is strange - runny and not lotion-like.  Its a shame because I have had three of these pumps over the last couple of years but I'm not buying again.
I am on an endless search to find the right red lipstick. This is it.

This lipstick is very bright and gets attention.  Lip Lust is an appropriate description of this color.

It goes on smooth and doesnt clump up on your lips.  I like that I can apply it and don't have to touch it up for 3-4 hours.  15 minutes after I applied it, it left barely any marks on a glass that I was drinking from.

One negative is that even though it stays on and doesnt leave smudge marks on my wine glass, if you rub it with a Kleenex it comes right off.  So you have to make sure not to push on it too hard or youll have to re-apply.  But light touching doesnt mess it up which is nice.

My daughter has dramatic coloring, and unlike her mother, who has pastel complexion and hair, she looks great in colors that play up the drama of her dark hair and eyes with a creamy complexion. She is using the red lipstick and loving it. The color is vibrant, not in a glaring way but simply beautiful. She likes to wear it, and it has become her favorite lipstick. She says it moisturizes her lips, but she has not noticed that it plumps her lips.

I liked the tube. I don't think either of us has ever owned such a fancy lipstick tube.

I only use lip gloss to protect my lips from the sun.  This product goes on very smoothly and evenly, something not all lipsticks do.  I prep my lips with vaseline and then apply this color.  The color looks as depicted: a dark red that's best in the evening away from the office.  I don't sense a fragrance or a taste.

I have never used a product that I only needed to apply once a day.  This color does fade over the day.  It does come off on glass or anything the lips touch.  By the end of the day there's still a faint color left.

The one negative is the asking price.  This is a very expensive product.  While it moisturizes the lips, I wonder if the asking price is an honest price.
summary: Goes on smoothly, but at a price

reviewText:
The tube is quite attractive and eye-catching.  It looks expensive and feels luxurious.

The color of the red lipstick in the tube is quite deceptive.  It looks like a deep tomato red.  It goes on, however, like a medium-dark red with pink undertones.  It is a lovely color.  By reference, I have extremely pale skin and ash blonde hair.  I tried it on for the first time at work, walked out of the ladies room, and immediately someone commented on how pretty my lipstick was.

After a while, though, it was not so nice.  Oddly, I wound up with hints of color on the skin around my mouth, especially around the corners.  The color seems to come off fairly easily.  So the lipstick is very, very pretty but needs attention throughout the day.

Fire engine red - this color is perfect for attention grabbing.  It does need to be re-applied every 2 hours or so because if you want that attention grabbing color - touchups are necessary, especially after eating.  It doesn't smear, so you don't need to worry about it going everywhere, but it does transfer to other products like glasses, food and napkins.
This is really nice lipstick. Lips get very excellently colored and it stays on all day.

I want to preface this review with a disclaimer: I have never spent this much money on a cosmetic product. I think I spent $16 on a lipgloss from Clinique before, and that felt somewhat over-the-top. However, I could certainly tell a difference with this lipstick. This is a VERY high quality product. I applied it once in the morning when I did my makeup, and this creme lipstick lasted all day. Unlike most lip products, it didn't rub off on my coffee cup or disappear after I had lunch. This product lasts all day, which is nice!

In addition to being long lasting, this lipstick feels smooth and is easy to apply. It doesn't require any primers or pencils or anything like that, which is a huge bonus for me: when I'm rushing around trying to get ready, I don't have twenty minutes to apply lip color. This is a quick swipe of color, and it lasts a long time.

I wound up giving this lipstick four stars because of the color. I was expecting this to be a bright, fire-engine red, but it's really more of a pinkish-red color. I still like the lipstick, and I will certainly keep wearing it, but this color would not have been my first choice. I don't think the pink-red color is as flattering on me, and I think a bright red would have looked better with my coloring. However, if you're looking for a color that's more of a blend of pink and red instead of bold, bright red, this would be a great choice.
summary: A Lovely, Quality Lipstick, but Not My Favorite Color..

reviewText: This lipstick went on smoothly and stayed on well. The color was a bit too bright for my taste. I prefer deeper reds. When I wiped it off, some of the color stayed behind and looked like a nice lip stain. If you find a color you like, this would be a nice, creamy lipstick. But this one just wasn't for me.
summary: some of the color stayed behind and looked like a nice lip stain

reviewText: This is a pretty color red lipstick. It's on the bright side, and goes on very thick (full coverage). However, it doesn't last at all. Certainly not if you eat anything, but it comes off if you even talk too much. I used it with a lipliner and it still got kind of smeary and feathery. I really wasn't impressed (except with the packaging, which is beautiful). As much as I love a good luxury lipstick, I don't care for this one and don't recommend it, especially at a $40+ price point.
summary: Pretty, But Smears and Doesn't Last

reviewText:
I have a really hard time finding a red that doesn't look orange-y with my uber pale skin due to its pink undertones. When I do find a red with a blue tint, it's usually on the darker side. Finding a red that comes across as a true red - no orange, no blue, just red regardless of the skin tone its worn on - is rather difficult to do. This lip creme from Oribe is one of those rare true reds. When applied, this color is the classic red lipstick that needs nothing more than a simple cat eye makeup to look perfect. It applies very smoothly and easily, doesn't have a prominent scent, and doesn't have a funky taste. The color in the photographs for this listing are not representative at all of the color when it was applied to my lips. It looks like the color was photoshopped on to the lips of the models for the different skin tones for each of the three colors Oribe offers

While the color is gorgeous, this isn't a lipstick I would really recommend, especially for this price. if you don't use a lip primer and lip liner, this lipstick will migrate and feather and come off on everything - anyone you kiss, your cup, your eating utensils, your teeth. If not applied to something to adhere it to lips and then set properly, it was shocking how fast it came off. If you have any trace of dryness on your lips, this color will exacerbate it. If you apply it with too much pressure, the bullet is so soft and creamy it is like smooshing frosting between your fingers. If you can, use a lip brush to apply this over prepped lips. The creaminess helps to keep your lips from getting dried out, and you can remove this lipstick with just a swipe of a tissue.

Even though this lipstick is a such lovely color and perfect shade of red, I can't really recommend this for more than a special evening out or for photos. For anywhere from $5.00 to $30.00 less you can get lipsticks from Dior, Marc Jacobs, Urban Decay, BITE, Tarte, Besame, or others are as creamy and pigmented as this from Oribe but last all day. Even $6.00 lipsticks from Nyx (the Butter Lipstick or Gloss) gives pigment as good and stays longer than this one from Oribe. Finding this perfect red in lip friendly formula is great, but with the prep work needed to make it last for longer than a cup of coffee is a lot for a lippie that costs this much doesn't justify the cost with the options out there.

The ORIBE Lip Lust Crme Lipstick in Red is very nice! The applicator tube is very sophisticated in appearance. It stays closed well and you'll hear a click once it's sealed in place. There's no worries of the lipstick part becoming detached from its lid. There's nothing worse than a favorite lipstick opening and ruining where it was placed and itself in the process.

This lipstick applies with ease. It's crme formula goes on lightly and provides a silky smooth finish. The red coloring is a true a red. If it's too much you can dab it a few times lightly to reduce the color. I typically wear more neutral blends but wanted to add this shade to my collection for special more formal occasions like parties and dates.

I don't usually wear lipsticks but I made an exception due to this one not having parabens, pertrolium or mineral oil.  I also like that it is vegan, cruelty free and gluten free. My lips never feel dried out when wearing this. The lipstick is long-lasting and doesn't seem to rub off on cups, mugs, etc.

The lipstick does seem a bit high in price but I found a little bit is seeming to go quite the extra mile. It's not often you come across a product that looks good, feels good to wear, and is great for you as well as the environment  I highly recommend this made in the US lipstick!
summary: Looks as Good as it Feels to wear!

reviewText: This has the fanciest case I've ever seen in a lipstick, so it feels special right from the start. While the color is bright red in the tube, applied  it has more pink and purple than I expected, but I like the tint and it feels perfect for spring flower season. The color is so bright you have to apply it carefully, especially since it lasts a long time.

This is my first time to use Oribe brand.  I never used any of their product and this lipstick is offered in three different colors:  The Red, The Nude, The Violet.  I have received red color lipstick which is a very dark color.  Lipstick container looks very luxurious.  This picture does not do it justice.  The packaging is actually  dark gray and there is gold  intricate emblem on top of the lipstick.  This creamy lipstick is also labeled Lip Lust on the carton packaging it comes in.  This product has no parabens, pertrolium or mineral oil.  It is vegan, cruelty free and gluten free.  Product is made in US but apparently there is location in UK and I have not done enough research to find out if this product actually originated in England or if it is distributed in England.
What is unique about the product is creamy feel it leaves on the lips.  It is moisturizing because it makes lips feel soft without "wet" look.  The color is very deep red and I find it more suitable for use in the evening than in daytime.  especially if one works in the office or corporate environment.  I cannot see on the packaging if this product contains any perfumes, but is has a very faint pleasing scent.

This is luxurious product and if I had a choice I wish I could have picked nude color.  It would make it more suitable for daytime use considering that I work in the office and also teach yoga.  I personally prefer more subtle and discrete colors.  To check out any other products Oribe brand makes one can visit Oribe.com or look up their products that are offered on Amazon.
summary: Luxurious lipstick in rich, deep red color

reviewText: this one has many things special about it. one the casing. it is pearlized blue.  with gold accents. at the top has what looks like an emblem on it for when you seal envelopes in the olden days. fairly bulky so I would not have this one in my purse.snaps open and close with audiable clicking sound.  Lip stick is true red.  Will smudge. Applies smooth and creamy. Will last at least a couple of hours before needing a touch up. Makes my lips feel really super nice and smooth too. slim lips stick compated to the bulky outside packaging. Over all like it.

This is the perfect shade of red for me.  It perfectly matches the "Big Apple Red" gel fingernail polish that I use.  The bright and vibrant red creme lipstick goes on easily and the reason that I gave it four stars is that it seemed to come off a lot when I blotted it after I first applied.  I had to reapply it several times to keep the bright vivid color applied to my lips.

The lipstick tube was easy to open and did not cause damage to the creme.  It was easy and smooth to apply.  The moisturizer included in the formula made my lips feel good even after I removed the rest of the lipstick at the end of the day.
summary: Vibrant red color that matched my "Big Apple Red" gel polish

reviewText: This is a rich, true red that would look flattering on anyone.  It is super creamy, it feels great on the lips and quite rich.  It stays on fairly well but will not last through a meal.

My first impression of this lipstick is the ornate case! It's resembles gray marble with the Oribe logo. I use red lipstick all the time and I'm fairly picky about the color of red. This one looks like an orange red in the tube, but when applied it has a pink red hue It resembles one of my favorite lipsticks, MAC in the color Ladybug. It's easy to apply and stays on fairly well. I didn't notice any plumping to make lips fuller, which is fine since I don't really need that for my lips. It has a nice sheen to it too.

This is red with a slight pink hue, rather than a deep red. It's subtle, but seems like more of a spring color to me. Easy to apply, stays on fairly well. It seems a bit overpriced, but I don't tend to buy expensive makeup. I think you can do just as well for $10 or less, but this is certainly a nice color and good quality.

This is a generous supply of a premium skin face cleaner. It is a gel and has a very verdant (grassy/green) scent which is somewhat sharp and refreshing. One point about this that I did like was the scent. It comes in a squeeze bottle that doesn't have any other air inlet/outlet so, if you don't squeeze out a lot, it tends to get sucked back into the bottle. I found that I had to squeeze out more than I needed and had to waste the product because of the distribution method. The cleanser is a thick, clear gel which lathers a little when you rub it between your hands. It's not especially soapy and rinses off cleanly.

I will say that I am older (52), fair-skinned, with skin that tends toward dry rather than oily, but overall tends to be closer to average or normal. I do not wear any kind of make-up. I usually wash my face with fairly generic soap (Ivory or Kirkland) and then apply a fairly heavy moisturizer after evening showers. With this product, I stopped using soap on my face and only used the Obagi cleanser for about 3 weeks.

During the first week, this left my skin itchy, dry, and flaky despite my having applied the same heavy moisturizer after washing my face as I do when I use soap. After about three weeks, this abated some, but was still happening to some extent. It also was leaving a residue on my skin or not exfoliating as soap did as I could scratch off a white substance when I was either scratching my dry skin or scrubbing my face with my fingers. I had to start using an abrasive exfoliating mitt after using this cleanser to make sure I got everything off. On the plus side, my skin was left feeling soft and pliable compared to soap (which can often leave skin feeling dry and tight). However, in the long run, the itchniness and lack of exfoliating as well as the higher price make this a product that didn't work out for me.
summary: left skin itchy and flaky, but soft and supple in feeling

reviewText: It does a great job getting the skin clean without leaving that dry-ish, stripped feel.  It has a nice light aroma that could be described as fresh-floral.  The scent is light, so it won't linger long which I prefer.  Great product.

Obagi Gentle Rejuvenation Soothing Cleanser.
I have never used anything from this brand before.
Was not sure what to expect.
Turns out this is just not the right cleanser for my needs.
The scent of this gave me a headache but I am overly sensitive to soaps and perfumes due to allergies.
Now it does not really lather up and was a bit hard to control when you try to get just a little bit of this out of the bottle.
Really do not need to use much of this and it did not dry me out most days but never really noticed softer skin than usual
I think it was starting to dry out because I used it too often perhaps so changing my routine to every other or every third day instead.
Once I did that I noticed it did not dry me out anymore but still does not seem any softer than my other product.

I have sensitive older skin and am always looking for facial cleansers that are targeted for this type of skin.  So as a Vine reviewer, I thought it would be a good product to try, and compare with my usual product of choice.  First off, I found the scent very strong and it reminded me of the old Ivory hand soap I used as a child.  On the plus side, a little goes a long way.  The first time I used it, I squeezed out a normal amount based on my usual high end facial cleanser.  And it was way too much.  So even though it is a high cost product, it is actually much less when you consider how little you need to use.  In terms of its ability to cleanse gently (as advertised), I feel it does a good job, but it is more drying than I like.  However, it is more drying than my Lancome facial cleanser (Lancome Galatee Confort Cleanser For Face 6.7 oz).  And the price is higher than Lancome (although as I mentioned, you use less per washing and therefore about the same price).  But overall, I will stay with my Lancome.

Lovely gentle cleanser for sensitive skin. Not overly foaming, but still cleaned my skin, leaving it feeling smooth and soft.
Non drying formula.
Of course, I used a moisturizer afterwards.
summary: Very good cleanser, but a bit pricey

reviewText: This is a definite skin pleaser! Obagi Gentle Rejuvenation Soothing Cleanser is a great way to cleanse your face-for me, it keeps my skin soft after using, even if I don't put on moisturizer. I am also letting my daughter use this because she has some angry acne. This will help sooth her painful skin. This is a clear liquid cleanser that really does soothe and cleanse skin very gently but with great results. If I use this at night to wash my face, the next morning my skin still feels very soft. This cleans off make-up and soothes. It will be great for the summer months when the sun dries out my skin.

This is a cleanser which lathes well on the skin, and is not oily. The smell reminds me of hay, but this cleanser did not irritate my skin which is very sensitive and what I was most worried about. There was no burning, itching, redness, peeling, flaking. The only thing I noticed was that my skin seemed dry afterwards. Otherwise, I found the cleanser to be fine. The bottle is not small but not big either, so will last longer if you use a little bit at a time.

I really don't like this cleanser. It's hard to squeeze out a really small dab, and anything marble-sized or bigger ends up being way too much product.  It neither lathers well nor is a creamy cleanser, plus it's kind of slimy, so it's kind of the worst of all worlds.  It does leave my face clean, I will give it that, and my skin hasn't been irritated.  I need a separate product for eye makeup.  I have no idea why it's called "rejuvenation" because my face does not look younger upon use, but if anything feels dry and tight, and really crying out for moisturizer.  So it's not a fantastic product for me.
summary: I don't like the texture and it's very drying

reviewText: I really do like this cleanser.  It removes make-up well and feels great on the skin.  If it were less expensive, I would make it my regular cleanser.  However, I do find it to be a little too costly; I don't know that it necessarily does a better job than many less expensive cleansers.  Too bad, because it is very nice.

My wife cannot live without Obagi products.  Well, maybe that's a tiny exaggeration.  She loves this cleanser.  It does a good job of cleaning pores and removing leftover makeup, without being harsh.  She loves it.

This is a gentle cleanser that will probably work for most skin types.  It has a gel-like consistency and you only need a dime-sized amount (or less) to thoroughly clean your face.  It does lather (but not a rich, bubbly lather) and it rinses easily without leaving behind any residue.  This cleanser has a subtle herbal scent that I find pleasant.

This is my current favorite cleanser.  I love the way it leaves my normal/combination skin feeling clean but not tight or overly dry.  My skin feels soft, and Ive experienced no irritation, redness or breakouts while using this cleanser.

While I love the product itself, there is room for improvement with the container  its really difficult to dispense only a small amount of the product, and with this price tag I hate wasting even a drop.  A pump style dispenser would probably be more efficient.
summary: Leaves my skin feeling soft and looking fresh.  Non-drying; lightly scented

reviewText:
I have rosacea and sensitive skin, so it's extremely important for me to get a facial cleanser that won't make me break out. I've been using L'occitane Precious Cleanser at night and Vichy Pureté Thermale Fresh Cleansing Gel Cleanser during the day, which has worked fine, but it's never a bad thing to try something new!

First off, this is a very thick cleanser and you don't need very much - maybe a dollop the size of half a pencil eraser or less. The first time I used this product, I had trouble juggling getting the lid unscrewed and trying to squeeze out product, so I ended up with way too much. (I quickly learned to compensate.) I rub the product between my fingers then smooth over my face. It won't create bubbles, but after some massaging, I removed it and felt clean but not dried out. I then followed with my moisturizing and prescription rosacea creams.

Overall, I love the results - my face feels so refreshed! The only wince-inducing thing is the price, which is nearly double that of what I pay for the Vichy. However, I think it may last longer, as I use even less of Obagi than I do my Vichy. Honestly, if it continues to feel this nice, I may have to consider ponying up and just buying my own refill of Obagi.
summary: Pleased with the results - does not irritate my skin!

reviewText:
I guess I'll have to be the odd man out on this one. Many reviewers seem to love Obagi Soothing Cleanser. I guess it's true that one size doesn't fit all, because this cleanser didn't work out well for me. I felt that this cleanser left my skin dry and flaky. I wasn't impressed with the smell, and the ingredient lists contains a large number of what I consider questionable items. I was able to confirm that these are genuine Obagi products, but they are not the same prescription products you may purchase through a medical spa or doctor.

The first time I tried this Obagi cleanser, I thought the lather reminded me of detergent. I also thought it smelled like plastic. The cleanser did a great job stripping my face of any traces of makeup. It also seemed to strip it of all natural oils. It rinsed easily, but left my skin feeling dry. I used it twice a day. By the 4th day, my face started to get a little flaky. I should also mention that I kept the rest of my skin care regimen the same, only switching out the cleanser. I still moisturized using a high quality product. I realized that my face was noticeably flaky in patches and embarrassing, so I stopped using it.

I checked the ingredient list and thought it sounded more like drugstore shampoo than a luxury cleansing product. Many people choose to avoid sulfates and parabens, and the list of these is long in this product. I personally feel that at this price point, higher quality ingredients should be used.

I was confused by the package directions to use this as part of a physician directed skin regimen, since purchasing through Amazon does not involve a physician. I also noticed a warning on their website to avoid buying from unauthorized dealers and to only purchase through physicians, medical spas, and other skin care and medical professionals. I contacted the company to ask if Amazon was an authorized reseller. They confirmed that Amazon sells genuine Obagi products, and that they were able to prevent unauthorized resellers from selling on the Amazon marketplace. They also explained that the products sold here are only Obagi cosmetic and over-the-counter products, not the prescription products sold by medical professionals and spas.

At the end of the day, not every product is perfect for every person. My own experience with this Obagi cleanser wasn't very good. You'll have to check the ingredients and decide for your self if this is a good fit for your skin care regimen.
summary: Odd man out - Made my skin flaky, wasn't a good fit for me

reviewText: Very nice mild facial cleanser even for my very sensitive skin makes this a winner. I followed the directions on the bottle and my skin felt soft and refreshed, not tight or irritated. I realize everyone's situation is different, but I think that for most people this would be a natural.
summary: Very nice mild facial cleanser even for my very sensitive skin ...

reviewText:
Obagi Medical Gentle Rejuvenation Soothing Cleanser has a gel-like consistency. It has the faint scent of beauty products from long ago; reminds me of the 60's or 70's and my grandmothers facial creams.

The instructions say to apply to damp face and neck with moistened fingertips and rinse completely.  The soap easily rinsed with water and left my face feeling clean and very soft.  There was no soap feeling whatsoever.  My skin was not tight.  The claim for this product is to make your skin feel comfortable and soft.  My skin was already comfortable so soothing wasn't needed in my case.  The cleanser definitely made my skin soft after use.

The bottle is 6.7 fluid ounces, which is pretty small for the price.  You can get by with using about a quarter sized portion of cleanser, though.  A little does go a long way.  Still, the price is steep to me.  If I had sensitive and irritating skin, I might think it was worth the price though.

I generally try to exfoliate my skin once a week or so, but otherwise do not use soaps or products on my face.  I moisturize after showering and after removing makeup with water.  My skin is in great shape after years of this simple regimen.

If you need something for sensitive skin and can afford this, you might want to try it.  It does make your skin soft.

This Gentle Rejuvenation Soothing Cleanser by Obagi is great for people with sensitive skin. It has the consistency of a light, soothing gel and is unscented. I've been using the cleanser for a couple of weeks and I really like it. A little goes a long way, so this portion should last about 6 months with twice-daily cleaning.

I would give this cleanser five stars if it weren't so expensive and didn't have a faintly soapy smell. On the plus side, it's as gentle as promised, leaves my skin feeling clean without any residue, and requires only two or three drops to foam into enough product to give my face a good once-over.

Forty years ago, a dermatologist  told me not to wash my face with soap, he said to use only water! So now I am daring to step out and try this cleanser. I have extremely sensitive skin.  I applied it to my face as per the direction, rinsed it off and patted my  face dry. Now my face feels soft and comfortable not dry and tight like the way that soap used to feel. So I am very pleased with this product.
I do not recommend this conditioner. It is not a lightweight formula as advertised. I found it to be thick and sticky. Also, it smells like sour milk. Not good.

Hello everyone and hope everyone is okay.  I tried Ouidad leave-in conditioner, and the Botanical Boost, and the Climate Control.  The only one that did a little bit for my hair was the leave-in conditioner.  It took out most of the tangles, but it weighed it down alot.  I have oily, down past my shoulder length hair and I was not happy with the products at all.  First, the Climate Control was supposed to do just that, but instead of making it bouncy it came out extremely dry, crackly and frizzy!  The Botanical Boost just made it limp and flat and not at all shiny.  Now, maybe someone with hair that is not oily and more curly than mine would be happy with this product, but I was not.  I'm going to give them away to whomever may want them and like them, but I would not purchase again.

I have loved this line, and it is one of the products I rotate for my kinky, curly hair.  It smells good, light scent and I use it with the curl quencher.
Good combination.
I have impossible hair. Thinning dry frizzy gross. If I use this with an oil like Davines or the Oribe it actually looks soft and curly. Great product. Took me awhile to figure it out.

I have baby fine, wavy to curly hair, I think it would be a 2B.  I am able to get a lot of spiral curls when I use this product.  It enhances defines my curls to a 2C. It adds shine.  I can't tell I have product in my hair.  Sometimes I will add a gel on top like Deva.  I started out with a small bottle just to try it out.  A little goes a long way.
summary: a little goes a long way

reviewText: I have type 3b/c curls and I'm always looking to get shiny, soft, defined, frizz-free curls.  I got a small bottle of this product as part of a Curl Quencher set and I absolutely love it.  It is perfect for my hair type.  It leaves my hair soft and hydrated and gives my hair enough weight so that it doesn't look too poofy/wide.  I don't think this product is a good pick for women with wavy curls or loose curls because it'll weigh it down too much.  But if you have tighter curls like me then this is a good product.

This is a very fine face cream.  It is derived primarily from the stem cells of the  plant Helichrysum, also called 'Immortelle'.

On first inspection, it's a great little jar, the packaging is pretty (suitable for a nice gift), the smell is nice and not overbearing. The cream is immediately soothing when applied.

It is a rich and luxurious thick facial cream that goes on evenly and smoothly.  Absorption into the skin on your face is rapid and complete--you really feel as though you are doing something helpful for your skin!  There is no greasiness whatsoever and no facial skin  "break-outs" have occurred.

The face feels great all day long. A little cream goes a long way.  (Get more for the price).  This cream is especially helpful to keep your face well hydrated-your defense against those dry winter days and indoor heating.
It's good to have a daily facial protection against all the harsh elements off our environment  pollution, forced-air, ultra-violet A & B rays from the sun, etc.

Strongly recommended- especially for dry and mature skin. It's just a great moisturizer and would fit in well with your skin care regimen.  Protect your face with a great cream!

5 stars:  great cream
4 stars: price
summary: Worth the price. This is a very fine face cream-a natural, plant based product.

reviewText: I love L'Occitane men's soaps and colognes, so when I saw this cream, I asked my wife if she would try it.  She agreed, and really likes the visible difference it's made on her facial skin.  She's been using it on her neck and face, after washing her face and before applying her makeup in the mornings.  After about a week of using it once a day, it's improved the texture of her skin, giving it a much softer feel and smoother look.  Compared to a department store hyper-allergenic brand she had been using for years, she feels it is as good, if not better.  It is made with immortelle flowers'  essential oils, which are rich in active molecules that have anti-aging beauty results, from a sustainable and organic plantation in Corsica.  In addition, the cream was developed under dermatological supervision, and is proven to be non comedogenic.  Therefore, my wife highly recommends the Immortelle Precious Cream.

This is another great beauty product by L'Occitane.  Although on the expensive side, it only takes a little and it goes a long way.  This non-greasy face cream does a wonderful job of smoothing your complexion without irritating your skin.  Apply in the morning after your shower or washing your face for a smooth look all day long.
Very creamy and easy to apply. Makes her skin feel very soft. It may be too early to say it has helped with wrinkles but she says she does see a slight difference.

Just because I'm a dude and a superhard madre-effer, doesn't mean I have to go out and kick butt with dry jowls.  I make sure to use a generous dollop, so that there is some left over for my wintery, chapped hands (especially around the cuticles, right ladies?)  The L'Occitane may be Immortelle, but I'm Precious.

I ordered this to try although I have been very satisfied with the moisture cream I have been using for some time.  I have to say this is one of the nicest feeling creams on my skin I have ever used.  It soaks in immediately leaving no film, which is great in the dry Winter air.  I can't say as I've seen noticeable results  yet, however I will update this review in another 4 weeks.  Right now, I would definitely recommend--it's very nice.

This is the best line of facial care products I have ever found (and I have tried a great variety.) After only a week of using L'Occitane Immortelle Precious Cream on a nightly basis, I wake up in the morning, trudge to the bathroom, and stop in front of the mirror, feeling stupefied by the image of myself the way I looked ten years younger.

I don't know how they do it but whenever I use a product from the L'Occitane line, I have the most radiant, fresh and luminous skin in over a decade. This is a pricey product and it gets used up fast (especially since my husband is now also a great fan), but it is definitely worth the price. I don't think it makes sense to buy any other facial care product when L'Occitane works so amazingly well.

I got this as a gift for my wife and she LOVES it.  She seems to always be playing with her face, cleaners, masks, lotions, a mindlessly confusing jumble of products (for me at least) yet she never seems happy.  When I gave her this, she was excited to try it but skeptical.  After a couple days, she was raving about how much she liked it and said she wanted to get more when this was done.

She is a nurse and works weird hours, so she lives with puffy tired eyes.  Unlike everything else (being the clueless male that I am), I could actually notice a difference.  She seemed a little less haggard looking around her eyes (PLEASE don't tell her I said she sometimes looks haggard).  She comments that her face feels nice, without being greasy like dome other products she tried.

So, from a guys perspective, if you are looking for a cosmetic type gift for the wife, this is a good option.  If you're a woman reading this, I can say my wife is never happy with face products, until she got this stuff, so give it a shot.

I have tried lots of face moisturizers such as: Cetaphil, LOreal, Oil of Olay, Cindy Crawford.  This is my favorite.
It feels wonderful on my skin.
I like the smell of it.
It goes on easy and absorbs fast.
Its not greasy.
I believe it has helped to smooth out my face tone.
I have 50+ year old somewhat dry skin in New England and it is perfect for me.
The only issue is that is it expensive and its not just a small dab needed.

This is pure joy to use -- its a thick, luscious cream that hydrates effectively and absorbs completely and quickly, without leaving the slightest trace of shine or oily residue.  I have no idea how it works so well.  Others have commented on the herbal scent, but I was unable to detect a scent or any sort.  This is so luxurious.  If you're up for a little indulgence, try this a try.

Foremost, know that the blue glass jar will help protect against decomposition from sunlight, but it should still be stored somewhere cool and dark. Likewise, know that these come completely sealed to further preserve the product. Therefore, these can be housed in a supply/linen closet (if you are obsessed with keeping extras on-hand like I am).

Now, I was a little thrown by the herbaceous scent. But I quickly grew fond of it ... a little mossy, a little earthy. It may take you a day or two to adjust, but I have a feeling you may end up liking it. (I was using fruit-based products by Ole Henrikson, so this was a slight adjustment).

The creme is pleasantly thick, leaves no residue (no white marks, no greasy feel, etc.), and just melts into skin.

Since I use a prescription retinoid, I use this on my off-days (every other day). It soothes my skin and leaves it incredibly soft and touchable. This is especially true for Clarisonic users. When I am dutiful, I apply after using my Clarisonic, and the results are amazing.

When used in tandem with a prescription retinoid (prescribed by your dermatologist), the results are genuinely impressive.

Truly, high recommended.

I have tried other L'Occitane products (hand and body lotions) and was curious and eager to try a face cream. I do have rosacea and so I'm cautious about trying new products on my face. I started with a test area, and after experiencing no redness or burning, used a broader application. It is a really lovely, luxurious cream. It is thicker than other products I have used (I am primarily a Dermalogica customer). I will say that my skin definitely feels softer and smoother when using this. I rather like the fragrance -- noticeable when applied but it fades quickly. After about a week, I have noticed a bit of break out on my chin so I may need to use this product only on my cheeks and neck.
summary: Luxurious cream with a noticeable firming effect

reviewText:
*I've been using this for over 6 months now and have decided this is going to
be my new go-to moisturizer.  I've received so many compliments and people flat out telling me I am not telling them the truth when I tell them I am over 50.  My skin tone is even, pored smaller, and complexion smooth. I will invest in this product and it lasts forever, so worth the money.*

I have very sensitive skin prone to break outs.  I am also 52, so one of those adults who had to fight wrinkles and acne at the same time..thanks Mother Nature.
Anyway, I've used this for a week now and I've had no break outs, but yet my skin feels soft and smooth.
Since I use Oil of Olay and it works for me (and it's half the price) I'll stick with it, but this is a nice face cream.

I am really enjoying this face cream.  It has a slight earthly scent to it, it is nice but not overpowering or too perfume-y.  I have been applying it every night and when I wake up in the morning my face is still moisturized and smooth.  The creme is smooth and white and it only takes a little bit to cover your face and neck, which is nice considering the price.  I was not familiar with this brand prior to ordering this creme but it is one I would use again.  I have not had any sensitivity or breakouts from using it.

L'Occitane Immortelle Precious Cream 1.7 oz  is the best face cream I have tried so far. It goes on very smooth and light .It is absorbed very quickly by my skin and my face feels very soft. The scent is very light and pleasant  and doesn't linger. It has also helped with the crepey skin on my neck which was driving me crazy. I am 60 and will continue to use this because I am very happy with the results. It pays to take care of your skin. Try it and you will see the difference in your skin.

got this for my wife - she says that she liked the smell (i did too) - very delicate - less perfumery more herbal; she also liked the texture, the smoothness, how it applied, 'wasn't greasy,' how it covered and 'absorbed well.' She also liked the packaging - heavy blue glass jar with a little over one and a half ounces of product; she says she's unsure about helping with wrinkles (she doesn't have many, even at her age)

all in all, this was a positive hit for her - and i'm sure it would be a great gift (hint, hint, guys!)

Using the powers of essential oils to protect and heal skin. It is an amazing product. The scent is very strong, as anything with essential oils in it usually is, but it does fade pretty quickly and I didn't find it overpowering. My skin was well moisturized and firm after a week of using this. My skin tone seemed more even and my face overall was smooth. I really love this cream and can see myself using this from now on. This container will last about 2-3 months of nightly use for me. I am 31, with normal skin.
summary: Like a trip to a spa!

reviewText:
I've been somewhat reluctant to try really high-end creams, feeling like the probably aren't so much better than the drug store varieties, but the L'Occitane Immortelle Precious Cream really does leave my face feeling tighter when I apply it. There is a light fragrance to it that dissipates almost immediately, but I have to admit that it makes my makeup look better, and even though I still have pretty oily skin, the moisture soaked in quickly and I don't actually have as much shine as I do when I'm not using it.

This appears to be a new formulation without parabens, but it does have Tetrasodium EDTA which might provoke some reactions in people with sensitive skin and is a derivative of formaldehyde and sodium cyanide, but is also why the product does such a great job penetrating the skin.

For me, I really liked this product and fully expect to purchase my own when I am through with this bottle.
summary: Skin feels tighter and less oily

reviewText: I've only used this cream for two days and I am very impressed as it goes on smoothly and penetrates my skin without any feeling of grease.  It has a nice scent and I didn't have to use a lot as it covers evenly.  Based on what other reviewers have stated, I'm pretty sure that I'm going to see some improvement in my skin within the next few weeks.  And, I was so impressed with what others have stated with regard to L'Occitane that I ordered the hand cream!

I'm a cynic when it comes to expensive beauty products and was fully prepared to dismiss the L'Occitane Immortelle Precious Cream as just another overpriced, overrated face cream. Boy, was I wrong.
This is a very luxurious cream that goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling soft, supple and hydrated.
Consistency is that of a thick cream rather than lotion but once applied leaves no greasy residue.
I have combination rather than dry skin and expected this to be too heavy for me. But it absorbs so well I can see it working for all but the oiliest of skin types.
I also noticed that my makeup - even my drug store foundation - looks much better since I have been using this cream.
The only drawback for me is the scent, but at least it is faint and doesn't linger.
I truly am the last person to tout such an expensive product but the difference this has made in my skin is amazing.
At this price, it is a luxury product but if you can afford it, it is worth giving a try to see if it works for you.
Great moisturizer you can not go wrong it is all natural and great non greasy and you will love it

I have thick, mid-length, coarse, curly hair. Hairspray is an essential part of my daily routine. Finding a spray that holds, isn't sticky, won't weigh down my style, and not smell like bug spray can be a challenge. This Calista Tools product does pretty well.

Breaking it down:

Hold - 5 out of 5 stars - My hair still looks good the next morning, and I am not a light sleeper. A little curl refresher, and I am good to go.

Stickiness - 3 out of 5 stars - Calista Tools Embellish Volume Finishing Spray can be a bit sticky upon application. The trick is to hold it far enough away from your head, then let it dry before fixing your style, and respraying. This is NOT a styling spray.

Weight - 5 out of 5 stars - The product is lightweight, but with a heavy hold. Once it dries, my hair moves naturally, but doesn't lose the style.

Smell - 3 out of 5 - While it doesn't smell like bug spray, it doesn't smell great. Not awful, but not great.

Shine - Adds shine, which is great for those of us with thick, coarse hair.

Bottom line - I really like the hold, the shine, and the weight of the product. 4 out of 5 stars, overall
I didn't care at all for this product. I didn't like the scent or the stiffness. I wouldn't buy it.

This product works well, but in my opinion, it's overpriced.
I have moderately curly hair that usually needs some control.

Finishing spray is a fancy name for hair spray. I had to read on the directions to be sure that it was for holding my hair in place and not for giving it shine or something else. My hair is getting thinner as I get older so it takes a little more effort and work to get the same results as when I was younger.  After I wash, blow-dry, and style my hair, I lift up areas of hair around the top and sides of my head, hold the can about eight to ten inches away from my head and spray the roots of my hair.  I let it dry and then smooth it down. I give it another spray around the crown of head and I get great hold for the rest of the day. My hair does not feel stiff or sticky at all with the CALISTA Finishing Spray. It really has no smell. It does not smell good, nor does it smell bad. I really like that it does not compete with my lotions, cologne, or other beauty products.  This is a very nice hair spray, but the price is on the high side. I don't mind paying more for a quality product, which I think this is, but this would be more than I would be willing to pay.
summary: I like it, but a bit too pricey

reviewText:
VERY happy with this spray with my hair.  The best test for me was HOW it held my hair-styling in place during an outdoor concert (breezy & warm) without being sticky and looking stiff or unnatural.  Wow!

Due to aging and some thyroid issues, I've been losing quite a bit of hair.  What used to be full is currently thin in comparison.  Thankfully, I have some natural curl/wave.  Wanting my hair up (high pony tail) with softness around the bangs and face, I styled and sprayed.  Very natural (yay!) and soft looking.  I also spritzed the pony-tail curls.  After sleeping with it (in same style), I was even more impressed that the curl remaining in my pony tail the next morning.  When I took it down, my whole head of hair had more volume/hold and I could get away with no re-washing it (time crunch).

I am "scent sensitive" and the Calista spray was not strong, allergy-inspiring, and any scent dissipated quickly.  My sensitive-nosed husband with whom I sat next to (in the car & the concert), never said, "what's that smell?"... which is the TRUE test!

I am very happy with this spray and look forward to testing it with other styling.  A little goes a long way, so I'm encouraged the price will equal its value.  Fun!

This is a great finishing spray that gives volume and helps my hair to keep its longer-lasting style.

The info tells us that the unique three-blend volume formulation has a complex volume blend to help plump and thicken hair. it also keeps my hair Feeling Soft and easy to work with.  It gives my hair shine, holds well, and doesn't dull my hair color.  I have fine hair that is difficult to manage in the humid weather. This works very well for me to hold the hair in place without weight or stickiness.

To use:  I shake the cam, hold can 8" to 10" away and spray on my dry hair. To build volume, I spray in short bursts into the root then lightly mist entire head. This works so well. My hair does not feel sticky at all.

Recommended. prisrob 08-21-17
summary: Great For Volume and Holding Hair In Place

reviewText:
I have thin fine hair so I am on the constant lookout for volumizing products. The Calista hairspray is a good hairspray for holding a style. Once you spray it, your hair stays in place.

It gives volume when  you pick up the roots and spray. It has a nice fragrance too. However, this spray also makes your hair almost unmovable to the point that it will not blow in the wind. You cannot run your fingers through your hair at all, so though the style stays it can look a bit unnatural in that your hair freezes in place like a helmut. I found the bangs and roots to be especially stiff and once on, this hairspray stayed until I washed it out the next day. This is good in breezy or really humid weather but not so great for a natural look.

As much as I want and need volume for my hair, I just don't think Calista products work for me. I have long, colored, layered straight hair. I like to try a variety of hair products, so I was hoping Calista would work this time. (I've tried another item in the past.) It's a large can and you don't need much for volume. So, yes, it gave instant volume, along with sticky stiff hair. If you like the look of hair sprayed hair that doesn't move-you'll like it. I liked the volume. Too bad it wasn't a soft look.
It is the Best Sunscreen, even for very sensitive skin.  It really is cooling on sun heated skin.  I will buy this again next summer.
summary: It is the Best Sunscreen, even for very sensitive skin

reviewText: I bought this and have used most of it up. My one qualm here is that La Roche-Posay used to have amazing sunscreens ... this is the biggest bait and switch... seriously, folks, go to Phamix.com and buy Mexoryl sunscreens. This tube has Oxybenzone which is verboten by the EWG.
Finally I don't look like a clown
I have been using this for almost 6 years, it's not white nor sticky, like water on the skin.
This brand is my go-to suncare line -- quality products and my skin feels wonderful.

Highly ranked by dermatologists and doctors for its protection.  I wasn't that impressed.  It left a slight residue (besides being greasy) to the skin.  Made your skin look slightly gray and if hot outside it seemed to melt into the creases in your elbow area and turn white again.  Not something I would recommend.

The first thing I noticed about this sunscreen is how generously sized the bottle is.  Per the description it has no scent however that's all but impossible to achieve.  There's a slight smell reminiscent of lots of other sunscreens but it fades to nothing quickly so essentially it is scent less.

It's creamy and lightweight which makes it easy to adhere to your skin.  With an spf of 60 it's ideal for fairer skinned people who don't tan.  There's also no greasiness.

Really meant to order same brand but at 50 spf.  I can use the lower spf during southern California winter.  Recommended by my dermatologist and was told not to go below 30 spf so I am safe.  Also seems to leave less of the yellow color on my clothing.
summary: Very good brand / recommended by my dermatologist

reviewText: Excellent sunscreen. My sons always complain about sun tan lotion burning their excema skin. However, they didn't complain about this one. Works well, and protected their skin for the all day excursions at the amusement park. Great product!
summary: Excellent sunscreen. My sons always complain about sun tan ...

reviewText:
At 60spf, this sunscreen lotion is good for even the most fair skin. I always struggle to find a sunscreen that is strong enough for me.

At this strength, a lot of sunscreens are very thick and sticky, but  La Roche Posay is completely different. It is very light, provides thin and even coverage, and washes off fairly easy after a day  in the sun.
summary: Great even for very fair skin

reviewText: La Roche-Posay is the sunscreen brand I like to use these days. The Anthelios 60 sounded interesting with the cooling water like lotion. I thought it was cooling, but I didn't notice it being water like, although it is light. It says it's fragrance free, but it still has a sunscreen scent-just a slightly medicinal smell. I like the SPF of 60, water resistant and Paraben free. It's not cheap, but this brand is excellent as a sunscreen. Recommended.

I started using Anthelios sunscreen over ten years ago before it was approved by the FDA for sale in the US.  It was the biggest selling, most highly researched, most effective sunscreen in the world, but because the licensing was owned by a European company the US Big-Pharma lobby was able to block it's sale here for years.  So I used to order it from a Canadian pharmacy online.  I lived in Palm Springs, CA at the time so I needed the best, most effective sunscreen available and because the temps there spend half the year in the triple-digits, I needed something that wouldn't just sweat off.  Anthelios was the ticket!  The only downside was that it cast a whitish tint to my skin - not a thick zinc-like effect, but a pale layering that gave my skin a pallor so I always had to wear foundation and makeup over it... even when I was going to the pool or golfing!  It was inconvenient, but it was still extremely more effective than anything that was available here, and since skin cancer runs in my family I preferred dealing with the inconvenience and staying alive.

I was so pleased to find out that La Roche-Posay has finally figured out how to provide the protection of Anthelios without the white pallor!  This sunscreen goes on clear and light - I can use it without piling makeup on over it.  Yay!  It seems just as effective as the older version, just more convenient.  And you can buy it in the USA now!  Life is good!

PS - Writing reviews has become an accidental hobby for me, and it always makes my day to know that people find my reviews helpful (and if not, why.) Also, if you have any questions, clarifications, or comments please feel free to leave a comment below. I usually respond pretty quickly and almost always within 24 hours. This item was provided for review consideration.

Cheers! Claire
summary: Intense sunscreen without the clown face!

reviewText: Dermatologists recommend applying a sun screen produuct prior to putting on makeup. Makeup with SPF is usually ineffective because the amount of product that needs to be applied would require too much make up for most women. Using Anthelios 60 under make up is a practice to adopt. Since I had skin cancer on my hand I am very conscious of protecting my skin from the sun's harmful rays. Also, I am wary of  smelling of sun screen when not on the beach. The fragrance of the sun screen disappears after awhile. However, for everyday use under makeup this is a bit too strong for me. But as a sun screen for a holiday or beach day this is wonderful. It is not greasy, in fact it is about the weight of a good body lotion. Water resistant for 80 monutes without reapplication makes this a great choice.

While not exactly like water, this white lotion quickly melts into skin and is invisible. No residue. No white mask type of look that many products have.
Has a wonderful 'beachy' scent that lingers for hours. It isn't strong and did not set off any perfume headache.

Sunscreen isn't just for summer. This is a really pleasant way to protect your skin.
summary: Delightfully Beachy, Any Time of Year

reviewText: Sunscreen can be a hard one. So often the wrong scent, white streaks or greasy feeling turns me away from so many brands. It's very important to be protected but the thick goopy sunscreens out there make it a challenge to apply before sun exposure. This lotion by La Roche-Posay is far and above the best I've tried. It has a very pleasant mild scent and a nice thin consistency that goes on very light. Plus no streaky white marks on my face. It's on the pricey side but I'd say well worth it when it comes to protecting my skin and feeling good.

I love the La Roche-Posay brand. I use their line of acne products with great success.

This broad spectrum 60 SPF sunscreen is very light and supposedly transforms into a "water-like" lotion.  It doesn't really, in my opinion. You still have to rub it in and it feels like a light lotion, not water. (By contrast, Estee Lauder once sold a Verite sunscreen that did indeed go on like water! Naturally, they discontinued it...)  I still like it, and it's better than most suncreens, but it wasn't what I was expecting.

Also, note that this is fragrance free but it does indeed smell! It smells like sunscreen. Non-comedogenic and suitable for acne-prone skin, which is a requirement for me.

This sounds like a lot of negatives, but it's good enough to warrant 4 stars. Minus one star for the $36 price!

It really does feel like water!

I've been using La Roche-Posay anthelios for the last few years, but I have to say that this one feels pretty different!

It's light and it applies on really smoothly. It feels like water!

However, it does smell like beach sunblock - not a fragrance, but the neutral, sunblocky-smell that you associate with sunblock on the beach.
summary: It really does feel like water!

reviewText: For a person who burns easily just in  the backyard, it seems to be working.  60 SPF UVB/UVA  lotion is a little on the thin side. Sinks in very well. Have not tried putting it near or above my eyes.  I do realize that anything above 50 rating is overkill. Recommended by my dermatologist.
Great moisturizer. I use this during the day and the obagi hydrate without sunscreen in the evenings. No fragrace, spreads nicely. Love obagi

I like the OBAGI360 HYDRAFACTOR SUNSCREEN, but I don't find it to be better than other brands that cost far less.

This lotion still has the slight scent of sunscreens and it absorbs very fast and makes your skin feel well moisturized. Even though it doesn't feel greasy it makes my face shiny, which I don't like.

The SPF 30 is great and it doesn't make your skin ashy looking like some in that range.

I think the brand Kiehl's has a comparable moisturizing sunscreen that costs less than this while giving you nearly twice as much.
summary: It's OKAY. I Don't Think It's Worth The Price.

reviewText:
My family are big fans of Obagi products and this HydraFactor sunscreen continues that tradition.  As usual, high quality formula that does not irritate my skin.  Just a small amount needed for easy application to face...and feels non-greasy, light, moisturized.  Most importantly, good SPF (30)...reducing sun damage is probably #1 anti-aging secret.

At current price of $56 for 2.5 ounces this Obagi is not cheap...I've got plenty of good face creams with SPF that I like in sub-$15 range.  But still this Obagi is a very high quality moisturizing face cream with SFP that feels better than most and irritates my skin less than most...4-STAR rating by me in consideration of price/value.
summary: feels better than most and irritates my skin less than most...

reviewText: I am highly allergic to the trinity of ingredients used for sunscreen in this product (the oct/oxy trinity) and that normally causes me to have itchy, red tortured rashy skin. Oddly enough I can use this product on my face and neck WITHOUT any allergic activity on those areas....but it makes lower down on my chest itchy. I'm willing to live with that because it can't be seen and while I'm wearing this product it feels like skincare! There is no weird 'sunscreen smell' as is normal with these kinds of products. There is no odd white/pink cast to my skin. It DOES cause my makeup to separate on my skin within a few hours but i just make sure to wear this when makeup isn't an issue. (Right now I'm wearing this on my  neck during riding time---no smeary greasy residue on my clothes or helmet!) This product just sinks right in, it's like you are just moisturizing. I know I should rate it lower because of the allergy issue, but I know that it's an issue for me and that doesn't mean it's not a good product for someone who CAN wear these chemicals. This is a very worthy sunscreen for that reason. It's hard to find one that is all but invisible and doesn't stink or smear everything up, OR cause your foundation to oxidize. If you have dry skin you could probably wear this under makeup with no problem. I have combination skin and the oily areas plus this sunscreen equal foundation separation. For dry skin you could probably skip your primer and just use this.
summary: Doesn't give you a white/pink cast, absorbs fully and no greasy residue

reviewText: Of the 5-6 different Obagi Suncreen creams I've tried, I have to say this one ranks as my most favorite. If a cream can be described as light and fluffy feeling, then that is how I would describe this lotion. It evokes the feeling of light and fluffy on my skin. Most sunscreen are either heavy or leaves some sort of residue that you can feel that remains there even when it's absorbed in your skin. Whereas, this product feels completely natural once it's absorbed. A very nice and refreshing feeling. My favorite Sunscreen out there, whether it's Obagi or other brands, this is my go to sunscreen daily now.
summary: I have to say this one ranks as my most favorite. If a cream can be described as light ...

reviewText:
I used Obagi Professional-C a while back but my skin did not like that formula.
This Obagi360 Hydrfactor does not not bother my skin. Over that last week we have had unseasonably warm weather and I have been outside doing yard work. It does protect my skin and I have no redness, itching or breakouts. I tend to wear physical block sunscreen yet that doesn't always work because it's hard to sweat through and leaves your face with a white sheen. This is a chemical block. The product has a pump and the cream is slightly off white. I don't know if men can use this as it leaves the skin shiny for a while. I use a dry powder matte foundation after applying it. I don't normally wear make up unless going out. Even with the shine I would use this product again. Easy use pump, goes on smooth and moisturizes my skin while protecting it from UV.
summary: Nice pump, off white cream shiny finish. Blocks UV well.

reviewText: My favorite sunscreen from Obagi skincare line is the one with the tint.  But this one definitely has advantage of being both skin moisturizer and skin protector.  Product has SPF 30 which I find to be an absolute minimum for any product I like to use for protection from the damaging sun rays.  The other nice thing about this product is that it comes in a sturdy 2.5 oz bottle that is easy to carry in a pursue.  That makes it a perfect to have on hand since most people forget that sunscreen needs to be reapplied every 2-3 hours or on a sunny sweaty day when sweat can wipe it off the face.  Very hydrating moisturizer too that absorbs quickly and without any smudging.

I've tried many Obagi products, and I love them all.  This sunscreen is light enough to wear under makeup and goes on smoothly and evenly.  There is a very slight sunscreen smell, but only when it is being applied.  This absorbs really quickly.  My face feels soft, and the SPF protection is more than adequate.  It's nice to use a sunscreen that doubles as a moisturizer, also.  Obagi products are more expensive than most, but for my sensitive fair skin, I have found few other brands that consistently work well for me.  Glad to add this one to my daily regimen.

The Obagi360 line is great, its a 3 step system, however I only have the Exfoliating wash and the this Hydrafactor moisturizing sunscreen. This is my style of facial regiment, just wash and moisturize with SPF. I have used this sunscreen a couple of days now, there hasn't much sun in California lately but I like how the sunscreen feels on my face. It feels very light and it give my skin a nice glow. My face is naturally oily, but after a good wash, it feels good to apply this product.

Great product, this is marketed for people 20s-30s, but I believe this can work for everyone.

While the consistency of this sunscreen is light and definitely soaks into the skin easily, I'm still very aware that I'm wearing sunscreen.  It has that telltale sunscreen odor and when sweat carries it into my eyes, it stings.

I've used some makeups and moisturizers that provide SPF 30 protection, yet don't smell or feel like sunscreen.  And those products give me adequate protection, (as I do not have fair skin).  I will save this for when I'm out and about working or playing hard without makeup.  I feel it's too much for use under makeup--despite its lightness and ability to absorb into the skin.
summary: Light and absorbing, but I'm still aware that I'm wearing it

reviewText:
I have fair skin and I was a sun worshipper in my younger days.  I am now paying the price.  I am very careful now to always apply sunscreen whenever I go outside, even in the winter.

The active ingredients in this product are:

Avobenzene -1%
Octinoxate - 7.5%
Octisalate - 5%
Oxybenzone - 5%.

All of these ingredients help protect skin from harmful UVA/UVB rays.

What I like about this product:

* It's SPF 30.
* It has no smell.  Some products with no fragrance have a chemical smell, but this product has no smell.
* The pump feature is easy to use.
* It is high quality.  I have purchased Obagi products from my dermatologist, so I know the quality.
* It also moisturizes.

What I didn't like about this product:

* It stings if you get it in your eyes.  This means I can't use this when I am exercising.
* Watch the expiration date.  I ordered this product in February '17 and the expiration date for my bottle is April '17.  I will need to use it this spring.

You may want to give this product a try if you are looking for a combination sunscreen and moisturizer.
summary: Good for sun protection and moisturizing

reviewText: I have such a love/hate thing with sunscreen. It's often so heavy and sticky, and smells like a cocktail. This stuff is NOT like that. It's super light and absorbs very well. Best of all, only a very faint odor!  At first, it leave a slightly weird feeling on your skin, but that quickly fades. After it absorbs, it leaves your skin feeling really moisturized. I'd love to be able to comment on the sunscreen factor, but it's mid-winter in Oregon. The sun is pretty much non existent for a few more months! I'll revisit this review when I've got some sun experience with this!

This sunscreen, yes sunscreen, is very moisturizing... it's actually a  cream with sunscreen added.
There is a warning saying that this is not to be used on broken or damaged skin and to liberally apply 15 minutes before sun exposure.  I do not believe this is water resistant because the label suggests that you use water resistant sunscreen if you're planning on going swimming.
Most of the active ingredients are for sunscreen purposes.
This product is called "HydraFactor" but water is the least amount of ingredient added into the product. (it's listed last on the ingredient list)
A little goes a long way...so don't put a lot in your hands at first

This moisturizing SPF 30 Suntan lotion is not only rated to protect from the sun but I definitely felt moisturized after using it. I also did not have any bad skin reaction.

We haven't had much sun here yet so I assume the protection stated is correct. I really love the product but not the packaging or price. This smelled like typical suntan lotion without any added fragrance.

There are two negatives for me.

- First, the current price of $56.00 is expensive. Previously, I purchased two $55 SPF face creams in the past and I paid the high price because I could use it on my entire face, including my eyelids. This product requires you avoid the eyes and also avoid any broken skin. If I could use this in the eye area as well, then I would not balk about the price.

- Second, I do not like the pump tube because it takes a lot of pumping action to dispense the necessary amount of product. Also, I always feel there is wasted product left behind once I get to the end.

Despite the above, this moisturizing suntan lotion felt good on my skin.
summary: This moisturized my skin while it is rated to protect me from the sun but I don't like the pump

reviewText: Good moisturizer and works well as suncreen. Good, small packaging.

Great combination of moisturizer and sunscreen.
I'm in my mid-sixties and have had fair, freckled skin all my life.
Since I'm older, my skin is drier and thinner so I appreciate products that provide moisture and sun protection.

Doesn't take much at all to cover your face and neck.
The product is fairly thick and very white.  The pump dispenser is great.
One of the reasons I gave it four stars instead of five is I'm not sure this product would work for me in the summer months when I need it most.
I garden and have backyard chickens, so most of my time spent outside involves working and sweating.
This stuff really burns if it gets into your eyes and sweating is likely to cause a problem in the summer months.

Even though it's fairly expensive, it should last a long time because you only need a little bit.

This Obagi360 sunscreen is definitely hydrating and moisturizing, and feels like the best whipped night cream when i'm putting it on my face. It's also water soluble, so that it's easy to rinse off and doesn't leave a heavy feel on my skin. I also like that it has nearly NO smell. This probably has the least amount of chemical smell of any cosmetic product I have used- it's that neutral- impressive, actually. The reason, however, for my lower star rating is that this is not a night cream, but a sunscreen, and that's where I have some problems.

Because this is easy to wash off, I found that it gets into my eyes more easily than other sunscreens I have used- esp. if I'm sweating. It stings my eyes, and was unpleasant enough where I had to wash my eye area w cleanser (wiping my eye w just tissue or water couldn't make it better).
