I put it on, and it completely changed my skin to looking "perfect." This one doesn't do that. It might not be totally a bad thing, though. This primer made my skin look healthy in a more natural way, rather than "perfect."

If you don't mind looking a bit more natural rather than perfect, you'll probably like this one. If you want that super smooth perfect skin ready for the camera look, you might not want this as much.

Personally, I like to look "perfect" rather than "natural," so I'll probably go with another primer. I do like how I can wear this day to day without any other make up to look like I have somewhat hydrated skin though.
summary: light and smooth and does not make my skin break out in hives!

reviewText:
I love this Moisture Primer even more than I expected!

First, it provides a light, non-greasy moisture.  It smooths on easily, dries fast, and feels refreshing. It's chalked full of good things for the skin, which I love.  My skin already feels smoother and softer, and I'm sure as I use it longer, I'll start to notice the anti-aging benefits of the hyaluronic acid and other antioxidants.

Next, it helps my make up apply easily, smoothly, and last longer.  It leaves my made-up face looking smooth, and really enhances my make-up.  I can absolutely tell a difference on the days I use this, compared to those days I skip it.

As I'm writing this review, I realize I haven't even noticed a smell from the primer.  The container is rather small--I do wish it came with a little more in it.

Really, this anti-aging primer is a great product that I would buy again and recommend to others.

I am in LOVE with this primer! My face is naturally oily so in the summertime I stop using a moisturizer, which is both a blessing (no more oily skin) and a curse (still dry skin). This primer's coverage is so well that I barely have to put any on to get full coverage. It's light and not sticky and takes to the humidity quite well. I love it and will continue using it long after this bottle is gone.
summary: Jouer Anti-Aging Moisture Primer, 1 fl. oz.

reviewText: As a male, I couldn't really test this product on my face since it is supposed to be used under makeup (I didn't know what Primer was until my Wife pointed it out).  I let my wife give this a shot and she loved it.  It absorbs quickly and she says it helps her face feel more refreshed and she feels that it helps make her face look more youthful.  To be quite frank I did notice a marginal difference when she first put it on but throughout the day she did look more perky.  Perhaps it was a placebo effect that caused her to smile just a bit more, nonetheless she did look like the same youthful lady I married a decade ago!!

The person I gave the Jouer Anti-Aging Moisture Primer to found the moisturizer part of it excellent. She said that it seemed to leave a glow to the skin. On the otherhand many of the age related lines didn't vanish as the user had hoped.

This anti aging moisture primer does exactly what it promises. I have used many moisturizing primers which can be very expensive, but this one goes on under your foundation, and really brightens up the look of my make up. It plumps up your skin tone, so that the make up doesn't go into the creases of your face. It does a good job of moisturizing too, because I have gotten many compliments on my skin after I began using this. I actually use it on days that I don't even wear make up, like on the weekends, because it really makes my face feel refreshed. I would highly recommend this product, in fact I'm buying one for my sister.
summary: Actually makes your skin feel refreshed

reviewText:
I have tried a lot of primers over the years, ones that help minimize pores, fill in wrinkles, even skin tone and brighten my skin.  And they all did what they said they did, so why did I keep trying every new formulation that appeared on the shelves?  Well, because a lot of these primers felt very "heavy" on my skin, probably because a lot of them use silicones to fill in those lines and pores.

This primer is different.  It feels more like I'm applying a light weight moisturizer rather than spackle.  Jouer Anti-Aging  Primer contains peptides, antioxidants, Argan Oil and Shea Butter and while it DIDN'T immediately fill in my fine lines or minimize my pores it DID make my makeup stay fresh looking all day, even though it was hot and I was outside for a couple of hours.

Now, I have some foundations that I don't wear because they make me feel like my skin can't breathe, like I'm wearing a rubber mask.  So, just for kicks I tried these OLD foundations with this NEW primer.  The makeup went on smoothly (and these foundations have been lying in a drawer for over 2 years, so they are not fresh), they stayed put all day, they didn't settle into my fine lines and they didn't feel like they were choking my skin.  And what's amazing is that when these foundations were brand new, they didn't perform like that. In fact, this primer alone does a better job than my old primer plus my day cream combined.

I don't know what Jouer's secret is but it's like magic.  It remains to be seen if, with continued use, this primer will help minimize my fine lines and improve my skins texture but I'm willing to give up the "instant fix" of silicone based primers for something I actually like putting on my skin.

While I use eyelid primer every time I put on makeup, I don't often wear face primer because I don't often wear foundation. I am 61, retired, live near the beach and have very dry skin, so a full face of makeup isn't something I want or need most of the time. When I do use face primer, I use either Smashbox Photo Finish or BareMinerals Prime Time, which both contain silica so they feel completely different than this primer. I know that a lot of folks want to avoid silica, but since I use face primer so rarely, I would rather use one with silica because I love the way it glides on and performs.

I appreciate the fact that this primer promises anti-aging as well as moisturizing properties. However, I did not use it long/often enough to see any anti-aging benefits and I did not see any appreciable increase in moisturization, which you would think I would easily notice as my skin is so dry. One of the reasons I didn't use it long/often enough is that I had a pretty substantial skin reaction the first time I used it under makeup (the first time I tried it, I just put a little on my face by itself to get an idea of its texture, how it would absorb, etc.). The packaging says it is hypoallergenic, so perhaps the reaction I had was not to this product but an inter-reaction of this product and something else I was using. I immediately discontinued using this, my lactic acid peel and one other new face product I had just started using and applied a prescription cortizone cream to the hot, red welts on my face and I was fine in about 24 hours.

This primer is a white cream that looks and feels more like a moisturizer than a primer. On my dry skin, it absorbs in a very short time. I can see where that may have anti-aging or moisturizing benefits over the long haul, but I can't see how that makes it good as a foundation primer (or any better primer than my Olay Complete moisturizer).

I appreciate that the Jouer primer is fragrance-free as I am very fragrance sensitive (as such, I would not exactly call it fragrance free, but certainly it has very little scent). Unlike the other two primers I use, this one is silicone free, which will be a big benefit to those who prefer to avoid silica. It is also paraben free.

As for price, this 1 ounce tube is currently selling on Amazon for $38 and the seller (not Amazon) is charging $6 shipping, for a total of $44. One ounce of BareMinerals' Prime Time Foundation Primer and Smashbox Photo Finish Foundation Primer are currently selling on Amazon for $22 (free shipping) and $28 (+ $6 shipping), respectively. Even if I did wear foundation primer regularly, I would not be willing to pay the extra cost for this Jouer primer.

In summary, while some women may be willing to pay the extra price for this product over even other higher-end foundation primers, I am not. I did not see any benefits in the short time I used it (not even as much as my drugstore moisturizer) and felt that it absorbed too quickly and fully to serve throughout the day as a primer for foundation.
summary: An okay primer, but not worth the price.

reviewText:
I've never actually used primer before and truthfully don't know it's full purpose. I started putting this on before my moisturizer but have not noticed much of a difference( was I supposed to?) It takes a little while to thoroughly rub into your skin but afterwards it does feel very light and not even noticeable. After I've finished with the moisturizer and a little bit of foundation I hardly notice I've put it on at all.

I like that the ingredients are all natural and it's fragrance-free which is very important for me as I hate harsh scents of any kind. For this price, I'm not sure if I will purchase once I run out of it, especially since I'm not really seeing a difference in my face after wearing it for a few weeks. I'm still optimistic though and will see how things progress.

I normally use a moisturizer with sunscreen under my makeup during the day, so this was adding another layer of makeup that I wasn't sure I needed. After a few weeks of use, I found I liked the effect. If it had sunscreen in it I would have skipped my regular moisturizer altogether.

I was also happy to find that it has all natural ingredients and is silicone free. It didn't make my makeup last any longer, but it did give a nice glow to my skin, which is normally quite dry. On the down side, it didn't minimize the small lines under my eyes on my over age 50 skin. I like it enough to keep using it and maybe given more time, the fine lines will fade away.
summary: Smooth and creamy and gives my skin a nice glow

reviewText:
I don't usually use a primer, although I have purchased some in the past and have found that they just feel too heavy on my skin, although they do seem to keep my foundation looking good longer. I was interested to try this Jouer primer since I love their moisturizing tint so much.

The primer does go on light and has no oily feeling. Unfortunately, it's a little tough to apply, it doesn't smooth on easily unless I use more than I feel I should. Once applied it feels like nothing - no moisturizing that I can tell, no anything.

To test, I used the primer on half of my face, and my regular moisturizer on the other, then applied makeup. Foundation does seem to lay better on the skin on top of the primer-side, but the appearance of fine lines is the same with or without the primer. My makeup looked the same on both sides of my face after 8 hours, but the side with the primer did look a tiny bit better on my cheek where I rest the phone.

Overall, it's not a bad product, but there's not enough of a noticeable difference over using my regular moisturizer and foundation, or my new fave, the Jouer Moisture Tint.

Review of "Jouer Anti-Aging Moisture Primer, 1 fl. oz."

Jouer Anti-Aging Moisture Primer is a "Hyaluronic Antioxidant Treatment with Peptides" and claims to be a "rich, hydrating primer formulated with clinically proven Matrixyl 3000, containing a blend of peptides, (which) helps restore elasticity and diminishes fine lines and wrinkles. Argan Oil and Shea Butter nourish, lift and smooth skin texture, while Vitamin E, Ginseng & Gingko Biloba Extract deliver antioxidants to skin, promoting a healthy, youthful glow."  In addition it boasts properties such as being "oil free, hypoallergenic, paraben free, silicone free, fragrance free, and dermatologist tested."

What caught my eye was the additive of Hyaluronic acid.  This acid is a substance that is normally produced by the body and is what gives skin its volume and fullness.  Therefore this product is a true wrinkle fighter!  My wife reports that she has experienced some "plumping of skin" and good moisturizing which serves to reduce wrinkles.  The skin does absorb the product readily and as such will serve as a makeup primer if needed.  My wife is happy with Jouer and claims that it is a beauty product of "high quality."

Ingredients: Aqua (water), isopropyl palmiate, caprylic/capric triglyceride, cetearyl alcohol, glycerin, dicaprylyl carbonate, butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter, palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7, sodium hyaluronate, retinyl palmitate, argania spinosa kernel oil, tocopherol acetate, caffeine, biosaccharide gum-1, ginkgo biloba leaf extract, panax ginseng root extract, polyquaternum-10, kaolin, polysorbate 60, polysorbate 20, propanediol, buytlene glycol, carbomer, sodium hydroxide, ethylhexylgycerin, phenoxyethanol.

Wife gives five stars/mascara sticks!

I have sensitive skin.  I break out using the most simple soaps, make ups & lotions.  This went on smooth, blended in extremely well.  it did not leave a trail of oil or the feeling of product on your face. As for anti aging, it does give a smoother feel to your areas of concern around the eyes and forehead.  I have not noticed a drastic improvement, but it does make the skin feel soft & smooth. This will be in my cart soon!

I keep my skin care regimen simple and don't fall prey to the marketing messages that one needs multiple products to keep the skin moisturized and healthy; however I'm really enjoying this delightfully light and fresh primer. It's not quite moisturizing enough for me to forego my moisturizer which I apply immediately after showering; however, a bit later in the morning, when I'm ready to put on the makeup, a tiny dab of the Jouer Moisture Primer spreads smoothly across the skin, leaving no sticky or perfumed residue. The makeup glides smoothly on over the primer, and my face looks fresh and ready for the day (well, as fresh as you can look at my age...) Although the tube is just 1 fl. oz., it appears that it will last for months since such a small amount is required daily.
summary: Lovely Product, Feels Wonderful on the Skin

reviewText:
This is a great makeup primer/moisturizer!  I am all for products that multitask and this fits the bill by taking the place of two. I apply it on clean skin. The product is smooth and light. I then apply concealer and/or foundation, which stays put all day long. My skin never feels or appears dry, always appearing moisturized. I love that this product doesnt have a heavy scent or irritates my skin, which has happened before with other primers.

Ingredients: Aqua (water), isopropyl palmiate, caprylic/capric triglyceride, cetearyl alcohol, glycerin, dicaprylyl carbonate, butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter, palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7, sodium hyaluronate, retinyl palmitate, argania spinosa kernel oil, tocopherol acetate, caffeine, biosaccharide gum-1, ginkgo biloba leaf extract, panax ginseng root extract, polyquaternum-10, kaolin, polysorbate 60, polysorbate 20, propanediol, buytlene glycol, carbomer, sodium hydroxide, ethylhexylgycerin, phenoxyethanol

I am always in the market for a good primer, that does more than prepare my face for foundation.

Jouer Anti-Aging moisture primer is magnificent, comparable to my usual brand of Smashbox.

It moisturizes enough, that I do not have to PRE moisturize my face, and I have some dry-ass skin sometimes. I am talking a gallon of lotion to beat back the Florida crunchy face.

It does not have a strong smell, and goes on and soaks in splendidly. I don't know about the "anti-aging" part, I am immortal anyway so who cares.

My daughter told me you need to use primer. I thought she was talking about moisturizer or foundation, but no the industry has made another necessary layer.  This is a nice MOISTURIZING primer so maybe you can skip the moisturizer.  However it does not have sunscreen. that
Given my prejudice that this is an unnecessary product, I really liked it.  It is soothing and moisturizing, and feels nice.
summary: Still not sure why you need primer but this is nice. It is above my pay(beauty)grade.

reviewText:
This primer goes on as smoothly as a moisturizer, and keeps your makeup fresh looking, longer. The package says it nourishes and lifts your face, the kind of claim that always makes me skeptical. I doubt that any of us has tried a product for a few weeks and then thought, "Ah, my face is so well nourished now!" However, a lot of us older women do hesitate to use foundation for fear of looking in the mirror at the end of a busy day and discovering that it has settled into lines, gotten blotchy, or otherwise made us look worse than we would have if we hadn't bothered.

This product solves those problems. Jouer's own foundation, the matte moisture tint, goes on much more smoothly and evenly over this primer, and other brands I tried it with perform better. If you have moist skin, this primer might take the place of a moisturizer. If not, it's lightweight and doesn't quarrel with the other products you use.

I have been wanting to try this Jouer moisturizer for some time, as I know that the Jouer name is one to be trusted. I absolutely LOVE this product! It literally has NO SMELL - not like other so-called "unscented" products that smell awful. It goes on so smoothly and lightly that you don't even know you have it on. Only time will tell if the anti-aging properties work, I suppose, but for now, I love it as a primer and moisturizer.

Nice light cream that lasts.  My skin seems less dry and wrinkles lessening.  I always heavily moisturize right out of the shower and the only thing I've disliked is that this small bottle is hard to find in my makeup basket by the sink.  It hides on the bottom and blends in.  No scent is appreciated.
Great blush, but the high amount of gold pigment make t suitable only for evenings. Not natural looking in day light.
Fresh, natural-looking color. Goes on easily and lasts for the day. I would recommend.

A decent basic blush. Works well for cool skin tones. Overall I think it lacks pigment that higher quality brands typically have higher concentrations of. The powder was firmly pressed and not as soft as expected
summary: Works well for cool skin tones

reviewText: I really like this blush. I found the color to be light, and exactly what I was looking for on my fair skin. I used a brightening brush, and found that this allowed for a small amount to go across my skin, so it wasn't too much for me. The blush looked nice on my skin and wasn't too much for me. You only need a little bit, so this compact will last a while.

While I love the color and the makeup - this is hard to apply because the makeup mounds up in a ball.  Even with a large brush, it's hard to get the even coverage n the brush.  If the makeup was actually concave, it would be easier to apply.  I swirl my brush in the makeup and then tap the excess off before sweeping my cheeks.
summary: While I love the color and the makeup - this is hard ...

reviewText: Previous reviews were right--it has a hint of shimmer and a little goes a long way.  Pushing 50 years old, I read "shimmer" and thought I might have to pass this on to my daughter.  But no, it looks great on me, too, very subtle.  I would say it adds a bit of luminosity rather than shimmer, just brightens up the face.  The color is very natural looking and even though I use about half as much as I would my regular blush, it goes on smoothly, super easy to apply, and stays on well.  A win all around!
summary: Applies beautifully for a natural look

reviewText: This is a really nice blush, its replaced Nars as my new favorite.  One point of caution, the pigment on this is very concentrated so a little bit is enough to last all day. But, I am very very fair and was able to wear this without it looking too bright or gaudy.  It does create a nice natural looking blush with more depth of color than a traditional blush.  The product is easy to apply and doesn't fade during the day.  No irritation nor did this cause any break outs.  Great product
Everything about this, from the design, to application to results....is perfect!!

I am very impressed in the pigment and the glimmering effect this blush has.  It blends in easily and looks very natural.  Last all day, however I do use a setting spray after applying my makeup.  The glimmering effect is shimmering and not like a tacky glitter either.

The only reason it loses a star is because it does have quite a bit of "fall out" when applying the product to my cheek brush.
This is the perfect color blush for every skin tone.  Its not a cream.  It goes on with a brush but it is not drying to the skin.  It's been my fave for years.  Try it.  You won't be disappointed.

I have this in "Tropic Hues" (I got it in a limited edition Birchbox).  I think the actual product has a bit more purple in it than is evident from the official product image here, but the color is quite pretty, and it's a lovely, rosy color on my cheeks (I'm the palest foundation shade and it's not too dark for me).

I am a fan of the baked blushes.  This is one of the first I used, but there is something about the baking that makes it not very powdery or crumbly, so there's not a lot of fallout and pretty much no wasted product.  So the package lasts a long time.  (Though I don't think I've ever finished a blush...)  I just take a little bit onto a brush and swipe it across each cheek, then blend with my fingers.  I have on primer, liquid foundation, concealer, and powder foundation under this, and it doesn't interfere with any of those, but rather blends pretty nicely.  It also looks good with some highlighter added on top of my cheekbones, when I am wearing this.

This lasts all day for me and does not irritate my skin, nor does it make me break out.  It is easy to get off with my standard facial cleanser.  It *is* possible to put too much on if you are pale, so be careful if that is the case.  But it is at least somewhat buildable if you have a darker skin tone, so it should work for people with a wide range of complexions.

Love!  I was and am always looking for my HG cosmetic items - and trust me, I have a LOT of cosmetics, but I am always buying more and more and more.  This has a silky feel, I love the swirly colors, and on me, it gives this beautiful hint of color with a built in luminizer.
I am blonde and kinda a medium (not totally fair) but am Scandinavian.  Not pasty white, tho.  I do have color to me.  This is just a gorgeous product.  I ordered 3 colors.  I am tempted to order all of them!
summary: Love! I was and am always looking for my ...

reviewText: This blush looks great on everyone.  It's not a single "flat" color... the mix of colors is a perfect pinky shade with depth.
Great product and priced well.  Absolute MUST for the NuFace facial toning device.  Love the device and the results it delivers.

Need it for the NuFace - but expensive for the 2 oz product
 Could be cheaper
love it!
great need it for your nuface - love mine!  USE IT WITH YOUR MACHINE!

One must use this gel for the Nuface facial item, this 2oz does not go very far at all for the cost. 13.00 for 2 oz is way too high. I am searching for a better buy. They do have a larger tube but again it is way too expensive for as much as one has to use on the face for the 20 minutes of therapy.

I would try to find else where.
summary: Way to expensive for the amount.

reviewText: It's cool and all but way too little for the cost. Not only that but it's harder to come off when I'm done. I'm constantly wiping and rinsing my face. I've since gone with another brand that gives way more product for the money, comes off easily and has not caused any problems with my skin. Will not be ordering this again. It's a rip off to me.

Great product.. but... (I'm sure I'll be in trouble for posting this as I know NuFace wants to keep selling their primer..)  I ran out if the NuFace primer and had read where several people have used plain Aloe Vera Gel as a substitute. I remembered I had a bottle of Solarcaine Aloe Vera Gel in my refrigerator and the Aloe Vera Gel worked perfectly.
This is my "upteenth' tube of this gel primer. It allows me to use the Nuface device with gentle conductivity with no irritation to my very fair, sensitive skin.

This little box packs a lot of makeup. About as large as a deck of thick cards, it snaps together to give you a nice way to transport all you many need for a short trip or night out. The colors are very neutral, so don't expect dramatic color. I am embarrassed to admit that i did have trouble opening everything. It took me awhile to get the lip gloss unlocked. The plastic case itself is attractive and it came in a nice little gift bag. Would make a nice gift for a teen girl or someone going to college as a 'take along'. Not sure if I would pay almost $60 for it for myself, however. If it was half the price, perhaps.

I am a bit of a connoisseur for these types of items and this impressed me. I found this palette to be convenient and have unique packaging and to be a well put together kit with all the 'must haves' in one package. I also didn't find the product to be small like some, I found it to be a decent size and the quality of the make-up to be above average. Jouer has all the basics wrapped into one here, each with their neat little compartments and mirrors included. You get a palette for eyes, face, lip gloss and a tint and highlighter. Only thing they didn't have was a small applicator or brush with it. This they could've added for conveniency as i've seen in other palette's such as this but still it impressed me. I also think the colors included are very neutral/wearable and blend well or would look good on most people. Product comes in a nice sheer translucent bag. Would make a nice gift for yourself or someone else, if you're willing to spend a bit extra for what I'd call quality.

TThis was my first experience with the Jouer brand and I was impressed.  If you are looking for a small set of makeup for traveling, the gym, or to keep in a clutch for last minute applications, this set is perfect.  It covers a lot of the makeup functions- powder, bronzer, blush, highlighter, eye shadow and lip gloss.

I think what really sets this set apart from others I've purchased or browsed in the past is the ingenious way all the items lock together.  It is great because it keeps everything in one place without the added bulk of a makeup bag.  It's also small enough that I can easily tuck it into a small clutch or a jacket pocket, which is great for when I don't have a lot of storage space.

I also really liked the makeup products themselves.  I thought everything in the palette worked well together for an overall look and was flattering with my features and coloring  (I have blonde hair, green eyes and a fair skin with a very slight yellow undertone (My pantone color is 1Y05)).  It is definitely a more subtle, daytime look vs. a dramatic nighttime look, but I tend to like makeup that is on the natural side, so this fits well with my style.

I also thought the makeup was easy to apply, though I did use my own makeup brushes rather than my fingers, so I do think this set would be more complete if it came with mini brushes.  However, I have a lot of makeup brushes lying around so this wasn't an issue for me.  The only product I had a little trouble applying was the highlighter and blush.  Because I have dry skin, the creamy constancy made these a little harder to apply than a standard powder.  However, they seem like they would work really well for someone with normal or oily skin.  Otherwise, everything else was easy to use, even for this relative makeup novice.

And I liked how this makeup felt on my skin.  Even though I have sensitive skin, it wasn't irritating or drying.  I especially thought the lip gloss had a great texture.  It wasn't sticky or tacky and applied evenly.  (Though it does have a slight shimmer to it that I could see being polarizing.)  I also thought the staying power of the makeup was reasonable, it seemed on par with other brands I really love like Laura Mercier, Makeup Forever, Nars, Smashbox, Stila, and Benefit.

Overall, I love the functionality of both the novel packaging and the makeup itself.  It is great for taking my makeup on the go and has also been a nice introduction to the Jouer brand.

I did not like the feel of the products, as I like something more creamy in texture, which was not what I received with the Jouer Palette of pale neutral tones. I am in my 60's and recently read that women in my age group should go more toward nude or neutral tones in color cosmetics. As someone with silver hair and a pale complexion, this palette just washed me out. I did not care for the lip gloss, as it went on unevenly. I think that women with more natural color in their complexion would find the shades more flattering. Although it is a little hard to reassemble, the size makes this palette good for traveling.
summary: A Handy Palette for Travel, but the Products are Just So-So..

reviewText: I wish I had something more complementary to say about this palette and brand. I feel as if it is a product that is trying hard, but priced too high. The powder and bronzer seemed a little on the chalky side to me. The eye shadows were less so, but just didn't have the buttery pay-off of brands like Chanel, Christian Dior, Yves Saint Laurent, Chantecaille, or even many MAC shadows. They were finely milled without chalkiness, but almost excessively sheer; it would take quite a bit to build up color. They were more of a wash. The colors were attractive, but feel a lighter highlight color would have been more versatile. The blush and highlighter creams were nice. but for me a far more useful addition would have been a concealer, rather than a cream highlighter, since the eye shadow could double for that if one really wanted to shimmer their face. It seemed weird to have the blush and highlighter as creams; were you then supposed to put the matte powders over them? The lip gloss had an unpleasant odor/taste and, as another reviewer has noted, didn't apply evenly. I'm not sure why, but it was splotchy, and the color was a bit artless. The products are better than drugstore brands, but not even most ordinary department store brands. Certainly brands like Chanel, Shiseido, Clarins, Urban Decay, MAC, Bobbi Brown are superior, in my opinion. The containers were not cheap plastic, but they were ridiculously frustrating to snap together or separate. Trying to use the set without separating them would be somewhat of a hassle, but I can't imagine trying to separate the elements, for instance, in a restaurant or airport bathroom. It's like they were manufactured without much testing of a prototype. I find the personality cult around the business creator and owner a bit overdone and I wonder about her being just a front for a huge corporation, sort of a Betty Crocker for cosmetics. For $58, I'd invest in a few small pots of mineral makeup from a company like Alima (foundation, blush, eyeshadows, concealer, highlighter) and cute little bag to stash them in. Plus -- what about brushes? It defeats the whole purpose of having the click-together elements. Do you really want to dig your fingers into your cream blush and then try to put on powder and bronzer with your hands or a piece of tissue? You still need to purchase some if you don't have small ones for your purse, and then something to put them in. I'm almost talking myself into down-rating this to two stars!

This little compact is perfect to keep in your bag or purse. When all put together it's about the size of a CD case and just a little bit thicker. It can also click together to be about the size of two packs of gum (like Orbit) put together. As for the makeup itself, it goes on incredibly smoothly. The colors are pretty neutrals, and will flatter most skin tones except those that are darker (the bronzer and finish powder would be too light, but the eye shadow, highlighters and lip gloss would still work well).  I am very fair with cool undertones, and these colors worked well for every day use. The eye shadows can be layered or applied wet for more depth. When using a primer, the shadows still looked good when 5pm rolled around.

The bronzer and finishing powder section was the best part for me. Both are matte, and in a bronzer that works for fair skin a matte version can be hard to find. I was pleased at how natural both powders looked, and having them with me to do touch up during the day was handy. Being able to leave the make-up bag out of my purse is wonderful. The highlighters are just the right amount of oomph. Not to shimmery at all but provides a nice lift. The gloss isn't overly sticky or tacky, but the staying power isn't great, but then again it's just like most lip glosses. Even with a lip primer it didn't make it through a cup of coffee. It's a nice addition though over long lasting lipstick. The only thing missing from this kit is a little click-on mascara and eye liner.

I have used Jouer off and on over the years, mainly off because it is on the pricey side even though it is a really good product. Another is that it isn't widely sold off of the internet. While this kit is small, it does the job quite well. If you don't like packing a full make up bag to tote around or travel a lot, this kit is worth it. Otherwise, other products will offer a better value for the price.

again since i do not wear make-up, i gave this to the wife to try out.  she applied it and she advised that these are good colors, it applies very easy and the colors and make-up lasted her all day.  she said that she liked this product

I'm pale. Think the following foundation shades: "001," "fair," "Snow White." Yeah, like THAT pale. So, when I say that these type of "sets" tend not to work for me, you can probably understand why. So, with this in mind, here is my experience:

A.) I LOVE the way these pieces slide together to create a single unit. While it is a little difficult to see this here, even the lipgloss slides into place! And, when all locked into place, the entire set is about the size of a deck of cards. For me, this is incredibly convenient. Until receiving this kit, I has a small cosmetics bag in my briefcase that was filled with very similar items and was taking up about three times the space in my briefcase. Therefore, this is a welcome change! (More room for energy bars! Wooo!)

B.) The lipgloss is gorgeous. It seems that this product would complement anyone's complexion. I has a VERY similar lipgloss a few years ago ... it was from Stila's "Kitten" collection. I am so thrilled to find a near replica! It has a little shimmer and feels great on my lips. Awesome!

C.) The tint and eyecolor are also lovely. Again, these seem fairly universal, require minimum effort, and deliver a genuinely "pretty" appearance. Additionally, they seem to last a typical length of time (I do wear a powder over my foundation, so that may help these "stay put" well).

D.) The bronzer. For me, this was a "no go." It was so dark that it made me look like that "Tan Mom" from New Jersey. Even with a light, light touch, I still looked bananas. HOWEVER, this goes back to my introduction ... I am super pale. So, know that this could look amazing on you.

E.) No brushes included. I have two Bare Minerals brushes that I added to this kit, but I now the bag (which I love) and the individual pans are kinda "dirty" from the brushes rolling around in the bag with them. Bummer. I wish there were one or two little retractable brushes included. (I have a Benefit blush that has a little brush in the top of the container ... now, it's not the ideal shape brush, but it works in a "pinch" ... I wonder if something like this could be an option?)

So, while the bronzer will go unused, the rest is truly amazing (and, I'm keeping the bronzer part since the large mirror inside it is super handy)! And, as a final note, these pans seem really resilient. They made it through a long shipping process without a crack and have been in my briefcase for about a month now without a break. I keep waiting to find one of the powders destroyed (since I always toss my briefcase on my desk or on the floor) but no such thing!

This set is bound to attract some "oooo"s and "ahhhh"s ... why not set the trend in your school or office right now?! These Jouer products will become your new obsession!

Beautiful neutral palette with soft matte look and feel to the shadows and contour highlighter.  Compact easy to carry.  I normally wear Bobbi Brown or MAC and very impressed with Jouer and the wise shades and colors they have put together here.  Lip gloss is smooth and doesnt get gummy later.  This set is the perfect gift for any woman at any age.
summary: Beautiful neutral palette with soft matte look and feel to the shadows and contour highlighter.

reviewText:
I felt the kind of frustration when one wants to open a bag (of chips, cookies, lettuce even) and the packaging toys with you!  Tempts and teases while laughing at your fumbling.  Okay...so, yeah... I sometimes take things personally.  I'm simply not gifted in remembering THE WAY it does work.  And then I'm so happy that I finally got it opened and can use it, that I don't pay attention...

Writing this review...I finally paid attention.  The lid opens where the "Jouer" is printed (duh)...anchor the case on the sides of each case and lift the lid with your other hand.  I kept gripping the front section...hence prohibiting the lid from opening.  (brave of me to so honestly express my klutziness)

The products are really light & lovely and I loved their compactness for a wedding trip I took.  No brushes or pads are included, I used my fingers, which worked fine for the highlighter & tint case, the bronzer, and the eye shadows.  The matte powder would benefit from a brush or pad.  The gloss is thick and lightly tinted...nice shade.

There is a small mirror inside that tricky little case and the product easily falls out when not upright.  (laugh)... maybe I should give it 3 stars..

4 positive stars for the (light, lovely, and scent-free) quality product, remove 1 star for not applicators, remove the same 1 star for awkward lid-opening. Add a smile for finally figuring it out!
summary: Frustrating packaging for really nice make-up!

reviewText:
I'm not quite sure what the deal is with makeup kits these days - this is the second product I've gotten that doesn't include applicators, which used to be a feature of every makeup compact I've bought. Truly, are sticks with a wad of cotton that expensive to include?! The most unique thing about this beauty palette is its packaging - each part interlocks with the other, like a puzzle, including the lip gloss.  This is a very clever and space saving design, but why not include the applicator in a box that can be interlocked with the set as well? As a result, if you pack this on a trip, you'll still need to have your makeup in two separate places - one consisting of the palette set and the other, just the applicator.

It's too bad, because the palette contains everything you need to make up your face in one small package. The foundation powder feels soft and went on smoothly (using my own brush) and I liked the fact that the eyeshadow, highlighter, tint and gloss are all so shimmery. However, I'm not sure I would pay over $50 for this - I like quality makeup, but there was nothing outstanding that would make me want to choose this brand over, say, Benefit or MAC cosmetics. The amount of eyeshadow, highlighter and tint are also quite small.  So I would buy this on sale but never at the original price.
summary: I Would Rate This Higher If Applicators Were Included!

reviewText: Perfect purse size compact for fresh ups during the day and fits into an evening bag too. They should have darker color ranges.
I didn't care for this product. This particular color was not complimentary to my skin  tone. It was chalky on my lips and eventually  made them very dry. I think I'll pass on this one.

This is part of an interchangeable makeup set.  You can connect the colors and components that you want.  This particular product is a blush, lip tint, for wherever on your face you would like to put it.  It has a matte feel to it, not shiny or glossy looking either.  For me this color was too light and too peachy.  I do like the way it feels, so I can't deduct stars for that, I only deducted one star because it's hard to tell how much I would actually like it if it were a color I could wear.
summary: Not my shade, but feels nice

reviewText: This blush is great and I've tried many, mostly powder which on drier aging skin doesn't work as well. Also liquid blush is too runny and seeps into the pores. Jouer Tint is a perfect cream base. I put it on after moisturizing and it blends well and stays on. The color I'm using is Petal, and it is perfect for my medium/light complexion. It can be used on lips, but I found the color a little light and somewhat too matt for my look. I have sensitive skin and this blush tint didn't cause any problems. Great product.

I love lip color and was very excited to try this.  The color (petal) was a deep pink-y rose color.  It looked like it would be complementary to all skin tones.

Pros:
Color is very nice
It is compact
There is no taste.
As a cheek color, it was pretty and stayed on me despite the hot sun melting the rest of my make up away.

Cons:
Dried my lips out within the hour of the application
No application tool.

If you don't have sensitive skin/lips, try this.  Because it chapped my lips so quickly, I can't recommend this for everyone.

I was happy to receive this product from Jouer to review.  I am older now so I don't like to use a lot of makeup but that old saying, "a little dab will do you," definitely helps. I applied a small amount to my face and I was surprised at how it added just the right color to give my face a brighter, healthier look. I then applied a small amount to my lips, both times it went on smooth, and easy. I used my finger to apply and that worked well.  I really liked how it looked on the lips. I think sometimes too much lipstick on an older woman doesn't look good, but this was just a touch of color that gave a healthy look. All in all a nice product, one that you can control the amount used. Simple and quick to apply, and will definitely give you a warm glow.

I've never worn mineral powder makeup before, so I wasn't quite sure what to expect from Jourer.  This tint is in a pretty pink color and can be applied to lips and/or cheeks.  I used a finger tip to apply the color to my lips.  Application was simple and the color was very nice; I've got a medium skin tone, so it looked very natural, which is very important to me when I wear makeup.

I checked the Leaping Bunny website to see if Jouer cosmetics are cruelty-free and couldn't find them on the list.  There are some companies who don't list themselves as cruelty-free.  I hope that they are.  I emailed them to ask because using cruelty-free products is important to me.

So, all in all, I'm pleased with the product.

Jouer Tint Petal is the most natural lip and cheek color I've found in years.

It's  easy to apply because it's creamy.  I washed my hands first and then lightly swirled the surface of the cream.  I know some people like makeup sponges, I prefer the warmth of my fingers to "melt" the product.  It's blends easily on  cheeks and lips.  It looks great without foundation.

I think this would be flattering for any age but especially the very young and kind of old - like ME - HA!!  Very pale skin needs color and Jouer Tint gives perfectly natural color without being obvious.  I love this product.

I really do not like cream blush - way too hard to make it look natural while you're trying not to slide the rest of the makeup off your face. Jouer has a wonderful powder mineral blush I can't praise enough. The cream blush? Meh. Same problem as with all crem blushes.

This is highly pigmented, and comes in a case so small you could just barely hide a half dollar in it. The color is pretty, lighter than the swatch here.

I know there are a lot of women who like a greasy look to their skin. They think it makes them look more youthful. Who am I to tell them it makes them just look like they're the fry cook in the local diner? You can't use this on a powdered face; it only works with other grease....errr, liquids, such as liquid foundation.

I'm sure there is someone out there who is a wiz with cream blush. That person is not me. I'll stick to Jouer's amazing mineral blush while hopefully finding one of womenfolk who will take this off my hands.
summary: Pretty color, but meh on the delivery system

reviewText:
Absolutely loved this product! Not only was the formula creamy and easy to use, it was buildable so I could strengthen the level of tint I wanted on my cheeks. As someone who has a skin tone in the fair-light range with neutral undertones I was really pleased that it didn't look too warm or cool on me either. The color I got, Petal, is a very flattering pink that I think would look great on anyone.

I didn't quite love it as a lip-tint since it's on the dry side of creamy (if that makes sense) and made my lips look flat and dry but it paired well layered under lip balm for a more tinted-balm look than a lipstick. I would love to try Honeysuckle and Poppy to see if they might not be great lip colors for me.

Overall, very satisfied, would definitely recommend to a friend.

I am a fan of cream blushes & have been using Ulta's Extreme Wear Cream Blush.  I am not a heavy make-up person, so the lightness of the cream blend suits my style.

The Jouer cream blush has a consistency similar to the Ulta cream blushes but comes with less product in the container (2g vs 5g).  It is fingertip application & goes on smoothly and blends well.  Lasting power seems to be equal to the Ulta Extreme Wear.

Color-wise, Petal has an underlying pink tone, but it still seems to work well with my slightly olive complexion.  With the Ulta, I combine the Nude Glow & Berry Glow to come up with the blend that is best for my face.

The Jouer tint is a very nice cream blush.  It is a little pricey per gram, but overall results are very positive.
summary: Nice Cream Blush. Blends Well. Lasts about as Long as Similar Cream Blushes

reviewText:
Jouer is a smooth and easy fingertip application, though I prefer final blending with a foundation brush. Claims it can be worn on cheeks as a blush or on lips for a bit of color. Worked best as a blush on my skin type.

Blends nice and sheer shades could easily complement all skin tones. I still prefer a mineral powder blush, just seems more natural for my skin but if you prefer a cream blush this is a very good one. (reviewed by my wife ;-)

This is a nice little blush. It is very creamy so it really needs to be applied with your fingertip or when it gets down to the bottom of the case a q-tip will work.

It is described for cheeks, face or lips. However when I applied it to my lips it looked chalky and unnatural. On the face it was fine, but it did look less natural than the same brand's mineral powder blush.
It is very tiny just about 1 " x1  ", so it is pricy. The case can be connected to other items from the same company.

My face typically eats blush. I'll put it on in the morning and it's gone before lunch.  I have found great success with the Tarte 12 hour Amazonian Clay blushes which stay on until I take it off, but cream blushes have never worked for me in the past.

Until Jouer Tint.

I got 10+ hour wear from this as a blush and the color was soft and naturally pretty on my fair skin (the color Petal looks pinker in person than the picture on amazon, more like a muted rose color). I was super impressed. I applied it with a synthetic flat brush at first, which ended up being a little too heavy. But when I took a clean kabuki brush over it, it blended out perfectly.  I did tap it on my lips as well and was happy that there was no discernible taste or scent. I think it would be nice for a no makeup look on the lips, maybe more if I layered it.

As a brand, Jouer has been hit or miss for me, but this tint is lovely.  It's half the size of my Jouer bronzer (another big hit for me) and the interlocking packaging design allowed me to connect the two products easily.
summary: I got 10+ hour wear from this as a blush!

reviewText:
I was a bit nervous ordering this online.  Its so hard to tell how a makeup color will look on you.  I am happy to say that this product looks very nice.  It gives a sheer tint and just a hint of color, which is exactly what I want my makeup to do.

While it glided on nicely to my cheeks, I didn't like the way it felt on my lips, so I will only use it as a blusher going forward.

The container is a bit small, so I don't think it will last very long.  It is meant to be clicked together with other Jouer products, which is kind of a neat idea.

I have light blond hair and very pale skin, and this shade was a nice fit for me.

First off, I think the packaging is really smart.  Different elements and clip together to form a palette.  I'm planning on stocking up on a few more Jouer products so I can make a nice travel compact.

I love the consistency and color of this blush.  It blends really well and is very natural looking.  It's a lovely cream blush, and I apply it with my fingers.  I like that it's a small size.  This makes it very portable for travel.  My skin can be fairly sensitive, but I haven't had any reactions to the Jouer products I've tried.

Jouer is the best blush (though most expensive) I've ever used. It is a creamy, light tint (I used Petal on a fair complexion) and glides on as smooth as silk and allows you to control, blend and build the level of color.

Jouer comes in a small, shiny black plastic case with a mirror inside for on-the-go- touch ups. But you probably won't need to reapply as the color lasts all day.

Twenty dollars is expensive for a blush; a purely, guilty indulgence.
But this may be the best blush out there.

Its the best Ive ever used.

Was a little shocked to open up the package and find this inside. Seemed super small and quite expensive for what you get and the size. I know this is a luxury type of brand so if you're willing to pay that for a small container of a blush like product than you may like it if you get the right shade. The Petal color is akin to a flushed type of look, not bad, looks good, works well but not sure if this shade will blend with all skin tones.

Good Points: It's easy to apply. You can use your fingertips and apply on cheeks as a blush or lips for a flush of color. So it's versatile. Plus it's loaded with Vitamin E and Shea Butter to nourish and moisturize the skin. It's Paraben free as well.

If you buy this you can also custom build your Jouer Palette by attaching compacts side to side and lining up tracks that slide together or simply align the pegs back to back and slide together to expand the palette, Which I find to be a unique feature. My opinion is you'd get a better value with the whole palette ( which is also expensive) but contains a lot more of a diverse mix of products and a lot more of the product(s) for the money. Overall, It's a nice brand but I'd give this alone three stars and go for the palette with everything included instead.

I think this is a lovely color (I'm fair, with warm undertones of blue/pink).  I love how this feels going on, and it blends beautifully.  I did not like it on my lips at all (too drying), but as a blush it's wonderful.  It looks very natural on me; just like a little flush to my cheeks.  It is a tiny container, but it does seem that a little goes a long way.  We'll see.  I don't have other Jouer products to try snapping them together in a custom compact, but I love the idea.  I also have been using Jouer moisturizing tint, and I can tell I'm falling in love with this brand.  It's good stuff!
summary: Tiny but really nice; use on cheeks not lips

reviewText: This is a lovely pale pink shade. The formula goes on easily and looks very natural as a little flush to cheeks. It's too light for me to use on lips. Now I want to try other shades of Jouer Tint. Highly Recommended.

I love the Jouer powder blush and lip glosses, but I was disappointed in this Jouer Tint. It was the shade more than anything as it made me look ruddy (I'm fair, cool toned). It stayed on all day as a blush (I wasn't wearing a primer). As a lip tint, I didn't like it; it made my lips very dry.
summary: Petal - not so great for cool complexions

reviewText:
I really like using this as a blush. I use my finger tips to apply it and it goes on very smoothly without feeling too greasy or oily. The color looks natural on me (I have pretty fair skin) and it stays put for most of the day.

I also tried it as a lip tint and found it less successful that way. Applied to my lips it actually is oily and doesn't stay on too long.

The compact is a nice little size (I don't have any other Jouer products, but it does have the ability to interlock with them so you can create your own makeup kit). It usually takes me a few tries to find the right side to open it on, but that could just be me.
summary: I use this almost daily now

reviewText:
This product for cheeks or lips is versatile, easy to apply and adds a nice hint of color. The size and type of contains make it useful at home and easy to stash in the smallest purse - I like that. A particularly good feature is that it doesn't have the unpleasant smell and taste of most lipsticks - again, I like that.

So if you are looking for a product that gives you subtle color and is covenant to use, try Jouer Tint.
summary: Nice addition to the cosmetic bag

reviewText:
As other reviewers have noted, the smell of this lotion is rather potent. I've been a fan of L'Occitane's products for many years and was pleased to have the chance to try this. After using it for a week, I'm pleased with what it does.

My skin feels great. A little glob of this goes a long way toward healthier skin. I spend a fair amount of time in the pool and feel like this counterbalances much of the dryness that the chlorine causes.

This product makes a great gift for skin care lovers. The almond smell is wonderful as are the results.
Smells SO good!  Creamy but not pasty.  Keeps my skin moist in the high dessert climate.
tiny sample, but it feels and smells great.
Excellent product worth the experience
returned
Great soothing, softening light body cream...and it won't interfere with your fragrance.

Loved the sample, but it was so small!  I guess that was done on purpose in order to get me to order more.  It is effective as a body moisturizer and I liked the scent.  But, I didn't like the price and will give it some thought before I order more.

Mrs. Boilermate says:

First impression: highly scented

Second impression: VERY highly scented

This is so scented that I can only use it in very limited amounts.  Just applying this concentrate to one forearm is enough to fill the entire room with the scent. It is not a bad scent, but it is too overpowering for extended use. The scent also lingers for quite a while after the lotion has been applied.

I like how the lotion makes my skin feel smooth and supple, but I can only tolerate the scent in small doses.

At this rate, the jar will last me years.

On a positive note, this concentrate is excellent when used on small patches of tight, dry skin that are healing from a close encounter with the edge of a hot turkey roasting pan.

I got this for my wife as she is always on the hunt for a better lotion.  She states, "This lotion is very rich and creamy.  I've been using it for a few weeks now and my skin looks smoother!  At first I thought it would be too "greasy" and I would only be able to use it at night, but due to colder winter air, I'm able to use it during the day as well.  It soaks in relatively quickly and I like that there's no perfume smell to it.  I've been a MK fan for years, but I think I will order this lotion again. (I actually like it better than the MK cream for dry skin!)."  I hope this helps.

I usually use Aveeno Active Naturals Skin Relief Moisture Repair Cream because 1) it works and 2) my skin is highly reactive and does not do well with any ingredients found in skin creams.  But I was offered L'Occitane Almond Milk Concentrate to try out, and I love it.  It has a gentle scent which, happily has not caused me to break out in a hideous rash, and which I find quite pleasant.  It seems to moisturize as effectively as my Aveeno repair cream, so I can't say if one is more effective than the other.

The real difference, of course, is the cost.  The L'Occitane Almond Milk Concentrate goes for $49 for 7 ounces.  My Aveeno Active Naturals Skin Relief Moisture Repair Cream costs about $9 for an 11 oz. tub.

I compared the ingredients of each.  The L'Occitane Almond Milk Concentrate has the standard indecipherable ingredients plus Almond Oil and Milk.  The Aveeno Active Naturals Skin Relief Moisture Repair Cream has the standard indecipherable ingredients, along with a number of oat products.

So why am I tempted to buy the L'Occitane Almond Milk Concentrate again?  It makes me feel pampered.  It smells divine.  The jar is a heavy glass in an elegant design.  And while it might make me feel poorer, it makes me feel special .

And we all need to feel special every once in a while.

I'm a big fan of milk creams, as they are always very silky and super moisturizing for dry skin.  This cream is no exception, in fact it's probably the best milk concentrate I've ever used.  I love the scent, but I'm a L'Occitane fan and have tons of their products.

This cream is very soothing, and I'd say almost chilling on my face and neck, I love the way it feels and would buy it next time.

The jar this milk cream comes in is heavy and beautiful, with a silver-type lid and details.  Just the weight and design are standouts.  This jar will last you a very long time, no doubt in my mind.
Like rubbing buttery heaven on your skin! L'Accutane leaves your skin soft and nourished without feeling oily. And the smell is nice but not overwhelming.

Smells lovely and is easily absorbed. I really like that it's got a lot of all natural ingredients. It's just like a cold cream, but not a thick and heavy one; this is lighter and more delicate. Haven't been using it for a month quite yet, but will update later regarding a longer use of the cream.
summary: Delicate cold cream which smells heavenly.

reviewText:
The cream completely soaks in, immediately, without an oily feeling.
Leaves skin looking alive, soft, silky and smelling wonderful. Even softens elbows.

Not sure which ingredient ~ I'm guessing the Almond tightening extract, but something gives the skin
a very, (very) slight tingle which even more boosts a feeling of enlivenment and refreshment.

Best cream I've eve used. Recommended!
--------------------------------------

Very nice to see all the areas L'OCCITANE is committed to support.
> Purchasing Almonds to revitalize the purpose of Almond trees in the South of France.
> Committed to supporting visually impaired people.
> Encouraging economic emancipation of women in Burkina Faso
> Using paper obtained from sustainable forests.

Mada in France
summary: Simply ~ Wonderful! ~ Instantly satisfying on skin.

reviewText: I think L'OCCITANE is the best when it comes to their rich moisturizers. They have such a huge variety in all kinds of scents and skincare needs. This moisturizer is rich in scent and texture and I know that you'll love it. It goes on smooth on your skin with its creamy, silky textur. In my opinion it would be a great addition to anyone's beauty regime and is great for all skin types. Your skin will thank you. It will not only be soft but also hydrated and we need that in the winter.
summary: Bit of a Splurge but so Worth it

reviewText:
This is one of those products that really needs a women's input. My wife has used Clinique products for her skin, and this is a big change. The jar and packaging are classy and let you know there is some premium cream in here. It feels very light and smooth. I put some on the back of my hand and it melted into the skin quickly. I love almonds, but couldn't say this product has a convincing almond scent. However, it is a pleasant fragrance.

My wife has used this cream for a few weeks and loves it. She like to use it on her face, and says it is very soothing and she loves the fragrance too. As a guy, I would never spend this much on moisturizer for MY face, but women are different and tend to indulge in these products. Would much rather spend my $50 on a good bottle of tequila or scotch. I think this jar of cream would please most women, especially if they received it as a gift. Thank you, Vines, for letting me and my wife evaluate this nice product.

A few years ago I bought a lotion that used a "milk" fragrance in it. It was called milk and honey and was used as a soothing aroma to help one sleep. It wasn't a fragrance that I immediately loved. Instead it grew on me over time. I've had 2 or 3 lotions from various companies that use the "milk" fragrance to it, and they all have a few subtle similarities. This one by L'Occitane also has some of the same notes, but is definitely different than the milk lotions from other companies.

For one, the scent is stronger. Most lotions that say they are a "milk" fragrance, tend to be very subtle. You have to virtually hold your nose up to your skin to smell it. Not with L'Occitane's lotion. I put just a few dabs of it on my hands and while working at my desk, typing on my keyboard, I smell the lotion.

The L'Occitane version is sweeter than others. It's like milk mixed with something super sweet smelling, that I can't put my finger on. It's a clean yet sweet fragrance.

It comes packaged in a beautiful heavy glass jar with a silver-tone twisting lid on the top. Because the fragrance in the lotion is so concentrated, one jar will last a long time. It wears almost like a sweet perfume, because the scent lasts so long. And actually because of the strong scent, I prefer to wear it on the body more than my hands and arms.
summary: Strong fragrance like a perfume, in a sweet scent

reviewText: This is a luxurious lotion for special occasions, but it's worth it to put it on to go grocery shopping!  Why not? I teach at a university, and I deliberately put some on while the students were doing a writing assignment with their faces looking down.  The closest five or six students looked up when they smelled the lotion and smiled broadly.  I heard murmuring and snickering of how good it smelled, and one young lady dared to ask to try some on.  Of course I let her and and her reaction to the velvety feel of it was priceless! We could've been a commercial. I won't be bringing it back to class, maybe it'll be the only thing I wear to bed on my wedding anniversary. It's so nice!
summary: I heard murmuring and snickering of how good it smelled

reviewText: I usually love L'Occitane products and this one did not disappoint.  It is not at soothing as the shea butter products, but works well as an everyday hand lotion.  And the smell is great, it's not too strong, but is a nice aroma.

This item was given to me for my review
I am new to L'Occitaine products. I have heard others rave about them, but I thought they might be overstating things because they had paid so darn much for the item. I admit I was wrong. I tried L"Occitane Almond Milk Concentrate, and it is a pretty wonderful product. It goes on silk smooth and is not oily. At the same time, my skin was left very smooth and supple. Trust me, that is a small miracle. I am one of those individuals who has had dry skin since I was a girl. I was pretty amazed at the difference in the rough, crocodile skin of my hands, made worse by my constant washing while I had the flu. The scent is almonds with a light, floral undertone. Not too much, and very feminine. I am converted. I still cannot afford to buy this in large quantities, but I know what I am asking for my next birthday, anniversary, Christmas, etc...
summary: Did my skin such a favor

reviewText: This is the most wonderful and luxurious lotion I have ever used, and I've tried quite a few. The lotion is rich and creamy with a heavenly scent that makes you feel like a queen. It does not smell overly almond-y but has a light scent that smells fresh and pretty without being overwhelming. I especially like to smooth it only my winter-chapped hands and feet. The lotion blends in easily and does not feel at all greasy or sticky. I'm going to use it sparingly so that it will last as long as possible. This would be a wonderful gift for any woman.

What a fantastic moisturizer! I got this for the better half and ended up using this myself. One of the common traits in the reviews for this is the smell. Neither I or my significant other actually noticed much of a smell. I had half expected to be overwhelmed but the smell was pleasant enough. It melted into my skin fairly quickly and didn't leave my fingers feeling greasy or left a residue. The jar seems rather small at 7oz but I didn't use more than a small amount so we could potentially get a few months out of this jar. As for the price? It seems a bit expensive but you get a lot of utility out of such a small jar. Absolutely recommended.

This is my first encounter with a L'Occitane product and I have to say that I am a fan so far. The moisturizer is thinner than most I've been using lately, but it does not leave a greasy footprint like the thicker options. The formula feels very loose and liquid-y, almost as if it were water-based. A small dab - about the size of half a non-shooter marble - is enough for a foot and calf. A little goes a long way here.

The fragrance is probably the biggest love-it-or-hate-it point. The fragrance is very strong in a "insistent" sort of way. I don't find it overwhelming, but you won't forget that it's there. It does remind me of almonds in a drinkable almond milk sort of way. However for those calling the scent chemically, I can see that too. It doesn't smell natural, but it doesn't smell wholly artificial to me either.

Performance-wise, I am a fan. The moisturizer soaks in quickly and works for at least 24hrs between showers. My skin is soft and I do not find myself needing to reapply as the day goes on. Having said that the scent isn't offensive, I wouldn't suggest using this as a face cream - the smell is probably too much for that proximity to your nose.
summary: First time with a L'Occitane product, and I am a fan

reviewText: I really love the feel and results of this exquisite body lotion. While I have tried many different types of lotions, drugstore, natural foods, to Avon, and department store brands. So if this one really had a more appealing, almond fragrance, I would have given it a solid 5 stars. It's not offensive, and I am very sensitive to smells and chemicals, it doesn't really have that sweet almond fragrance that I expected, but it is so outstanding, creamy, absorbent at so effective at softening the skin that the slight disappointment in the fragrance, is easily overlooked. While it is an expensive product, it really spreads like silk, but absorbs like no other product I have ever used. It really is a 'concentrate' and I love that since it only requires only a scant amount. The jar even feels satiny and has a nice heavy weight to it, great packaging and an exceptional skincare product that will last much longer than other products with better results. I love it!  (This review was written by my wife)

I am so pleased with the LOccitane Almond Milk Concentrate. It goes on smoothly and soaks into my skin without much rubbing. Its not greasy and it makes my skin feel so soft. The moisture lasts for a long time and I usually use it before bed at night so its got hours to help heal my dry skin. The scent is pleasant going on and is not strong enough to last and be bothersome. The 7 ounce container is fairly large and it seems to be lasting a long time, making it a good value for me.

reviewerName: Leah Maines, best-selling, award-winning author, actor, and editor
reviewText: This is a very creamy and soothing body moisturizer.  It absorbs quickly and leaves my skins feeling soft and smooth.  This is a very high quality cream. The scent is a bit strong but is very pleasing.  I really like it.  It makes my skin feel like silk.
summary: A very high quality cream body moisturizer

reviewText: I'm really liking this shampoo- Very clean and fresh smelling and gentle on my post chemo hair
This is another great shampoo from Biolage. It smells great and makes my hair feel light and clean. This rinses out very easily. Good for hair that is on the dry side.
Great as usual!
Leaves my hair feeling so clean. Smells good too!

Pretty transparent red similar to Decadence but with tiny sparkles. I was hoping for the sparkles would be more prominent (like Dorothy Ruby slippers), it's only visible if you stare at it close enough.
summary: Pretty transparent red similar to Decadence but with tiny sparkles

reviewText: love it

Works pretty much as advertised - spray on, rub in and in a few minutes, you have softer, more supple skin without an oily or greasy feel. Only thing is that I'm not crazy about the fragrance...although not unpleasant or overpowering, it is stronger than I like - the good news is that it dissipates reasonably quickly.

Otherwise, this is a great product from L'Occitane that's worth a try if you don't mind the somewhat strong fragrance when you first put it on.
Makes my skin super itchy!!!

I love this oil . It goes on light and easily spreads . It gives moisture without feeling weighed down or greasy . I am big on light moisturizer due to not liking the feeling of thick cremes . I highly suggest this !
My skin is so soft from this.  The spray is helpful, but don't use it on a tile floor if you are spraying on your body.  Spray into the palm of your hand and then rub that on your skin.
summary: My skin is so soft from this. The spray ...

reviewText: Im a lover of L'Occitane products but after showering and applying this to my legs I broke out in the most severe allergic reaction ever. Had welts for a couple days. I didn't want to give this product a poor rating because overall I have super sensitive skin. Hoping for others they do not have the same result.
summary: Still love the name but broke out

reviewText:
Yes, this product is heavily-scented.  But it is like my favorite scent of all time (benzaldehyde, which is the component you will find in many almond and cherry scents and flavors).  So I am happy to slather it all over my body.  For what it's worth, the scent doesn't last a super long time.

More to the point, this is an effective product.  As a light oil, I have found it to work well in place of a body serum.  I apply it to towel-dried arms and legs and my skin is so soft and smooth after using this for awhile.  (I often do follow up with other products designed for specific purposes -- tightening, moisturizing, KP treatment, etc.  It is compatible with everything I've put over it so far.)  It absorbs into the skin without actually leaving the skin oily.  I don't think my body skin is particularly dry or particularly oily, compared to my face, but this is nicely hydrating either way.

To me, this is a lighter type of oil (especially since it can be sprayed rather than coming in a dropper or pump).  I am of two minds on the spray nozzle.  On the one hand, you can control the amount dispensed quite well with the pump, and I appreciate not getting too much (which would lead to product waste).  On the other hand, the pump is kind of hard to depress, so I usually just dispense this into my hands and apply it (as opposed to spraying directly on the body).  It spreads reasonably well (and does a little better as it warms up to body temperature).

Here is the ingredients list (it is in one of the product images but that is kind of hard to read):

Sweet Almond Oil, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Oleyl Alcohol, Fragrance, Camelina Sativa Seed Oil, Sunflower Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Dioleyl Tocopheryl Methylsilanol, Limonene, Coumarin, Linalool, Citral.

Also, this will contain some residual almond proteins so you may want to avoid if you have a tree nut allergy.  But otherwise, if you like cherry/almond scents and flavors and are looking for a light, hydrating product to use after a shower, this is definitely worth checking out.
summary: love, love, love the scent (and it's nicely hydrating)

reviewText: L'Occitate Almond Supple Skin Oil felt nice putting it on and left a light smell after. My skin felt softer after a few weeks of using it consistently. It is on the pricey side, but such is the way with name products. Its a small bottle but lasts quite a while.
summary: L'Occitate Almond Supple Skin Oil felt nice putting it on and left a light smell after

reviewText: This is my first experience using an oil as a moisturizer and I love it!  The oil is wonderful for dry skin and smells amazing!  My only hesitation in purchasing once my sample runs out is the packaging.  When I spray directly onto my body, I find that inevitably some of the oil lands on the bathroom tile making it slippery.  My solution to this is to spray the oil on my hands and then rub into my skin.
summary: Love the product but not the container

reviewText: I love this oil!  I actually use it on my hair, which is thick, wavy, and dry.  After showering, while my hair is still wet, I slather it on the ends and when it dries it's hydrated and shiny!  This has a strong, sweet fragrance that fades quickly.  Maybe the only thing I don't like is the heavy glass bottle.  It seems like it would be easy to drop if your hands are wet or oily.
summary: I use this on my hair!

reviewText: My wife and daughter, and l used this skin oil several times.  We all said the same thing about it:  We liked the way it felt on our skin, making it  feel silky smooth and hydrated.  It was a little on the "heavy" side, feeling just a bit too oily, but not overly greasy.  We liked it a lot  when using it after being in the hot sun and pool...it's not something we'd use every day.  We had various opinions about the fragrance.  I thought it was pretty nice, the women not so much...they called it a little overbearing.  Overall, a fairly good skin oil but in our opinions it wouldn't wind up in our shopping carts.

Like most products from L'Occitane, this is simply wonderful. The scent is light and pretty with just a hint of almond. The texture is rich and moist but it quickly sinks into your skin and leaves only a soft, silky touch and slight dewy glow. I have very sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me at all, and it feels simply amazing

I am a big fan of oil as a moisturizer, less chemicals.  The viscosity of this oil is thicker than other brands, like neutrogena, but it does smooth  into the skin without much stickiness.  Last all day, and the skin continues to feel smooth.  I love it for my heels during the summer, keeps the dry skin moist.  A little goes a long well.  Smells nice too.
I wash my hands a lot - this skin oil keeps them from getting dry and cracked. It's easy to spritz on and not too greasy.
This almond oil skin smoother works - my skin seemed smoother and glowed a bit when I used it but the scent was way too strong for me.  It reminded me of my elderly aunt's perfume.
This oil is great for dry skin -- a little goes a long way, and the scent is fresh and light. I really enjoy it -- perfect for hot, summer days.
summary: A great boost for dry skin

reviewText:
L'Occitane Almond Supple Skin Oil, 3.4 fl. oz.
Category: Skin Care
Much to my astonishment this product really works. Love the spray bottle and design too. A definite must have for anyone!

I am very fond of L'Occitane products.  I have used their other moisturizers and liked them very much.  This almond oil was very nice.  It was light and emollient, disappearing into my skin quickly and leaving a moist not oily feel.  I was thinking it would help with some of the loose skin I have from losing weight.

My one objection was the scent--not really almond, more like a musky artificial scent which did not add anything to the product for me.  And the scent lingered which finally made me stop using the product.  I would try it again if they had a different scent.

My wife and I are long-time users of L'Occitane products - from shampoos and soaps to moisturizers.  We both use the almond shower oil and my wife swears by L'Occitane Amande Firming and Smoothing Milk Concentrate...so this looked like a good product to try.  We were not disappointed.

The supple skin oil sprays on light and penetrates / melts quickly.  It leaves a satiny-smooth finish and a really pleasant scent.

I don't think this product replaces a moisturizer but it certainly seems like a good product to use in a daily beauty ritual.  I'd certainly recommend it.
summary: Light, not oily and a nice scent

reviewText: When I use L'occitane products I feel like I'm using top-quality ingredients, and this almond skin oil is not exception.  It feels and smells luxurious.  The oil comes in a glass bottle and sprays onto the skin.  I wish the bottle came with a pump instead of a spray mechanism, as I think it would be easier to handle.  Maneuvering a glass bottle with oil on your hands can get slippery, quickly, and I'm afraid of dropping this on the bathroom floor.  Once on the skin it sinks in quickly, and has a light almond scent.  In cold weather don't count on this as your sole moisturizer, but it works well to form a base protective layer.

I do not know about the rest of the universe, but I like having soft skin. I like when people tell me its touchable. L'Occitane Almond Supple Skin Oil takes my soft skin and turns it into a velvety epidermis of silk.

I love the way it smells, like almonds but more like untamed forests of almonds. Its earthy and sweet. not overpowering and definitely not perfume-y.
It soaks in so fast, I loved rubbing it into every curve and crevice. I did not use it on my face too much because I am super sensitive but I did try it out as a makeup remover and it was magnificent, no problems what so ever. It also did not irritate my skin anywhere.

It is supposed to firm up your flesh, I did not find that happening. I was happy enough that it made me feel like a queen.

I used this for already established stretch marks 94 years old). While this was not a cure all, this does leave a very soft afterglow in the area. It is on the oily side and my fair skin only needed a light spray to absorb into the skin. I loved the almond scent. subtle when on.

I've used drugstore body oils and dry oil sprays but none like this.  This is super moisturizing but absorbs quickly and didn't leave my skin sticky or greasy.  I also didn't have any negative skin reaction which is nice since the last body oil I tried made my legs itch if I used it post shaving.  This also has a very light fresh scent that doesn't smell like almond extract (thank God-I'm not a fan of almond scented baked goods so I really wouldn't want to smell like them).

The only negative I can think of is the bottle.  The bottle is very attractive with a chic French minimalist vibe, pretty without being "girlie".  It's made of a very thick glass which I was afraid I would drop when my hands were slick rubbing in the oil post shower.  I never dropped it but I was afraid I would.
