Since the bottle is so thick I didn't know if I dropped it if it would break the bottle or crack the tile.  So, an easier to grip bottle would give this 6 stars but it can get 5 stars without it no problem.

This is expensive but you don't use that much, even applying it neck to toe, so it's still not a bad value.  I will definitely purchase more when this is gone.  I have not seen this in any department or beauty stores in the South Bay so online is your best bet if you wan to spoil yourself.

This is a really lovely product from L'Occitane. I am in the process of losing some weight and was wanting to get something to help soften my skin in the process, hoping my skin will have that nice elasticity of younger years. And the idea of an almond scent sounded really nice.

I have been applying this after showering and it goes on smooth, and easily rubs in so you do not feel greasy. I noticed that even getting dressed right afterwards, I did not feel like my clothes were sticking to me, so that was a nice surprise and definitely a big plus for this product.

My only wish is that the scent was a bit lighter. But then again, I do have a very sensitive nose and also deal with allergy and sinus problems. I am usually fine with natural scents and real essential oils, but some can bother me, hit or miss, usually the heavier ones. This skin oil has a pleasant smell. Almost like a vanilla-almond scent. But it just seems a little too heavy for what I would personally prefer. I wish it was a crisp orange-citrus scent, or maybe rose or lavender. Orange and jasmine is a really nice blend also.

But even with the scent, I have been using it because I have seen an improvment in my skin. My legs and arms especially. If they would come out with this product in different scents, I would definitely reorder it all the time. I am really impressed with how well it seems to improve my skin's overall texture and softeness.
summary: Softens So Nice (just a bit heavy on scent)

reviewText: This oil is fabulous! It doesn't leave a greasy film on your skin, it absorbs quickly. I love the soft smell of it. The spray bottle is convenient. My skin is always dry and this has helped it greatly!

Its not often my wife gets so giddy over new review products. But when this L'Occitane Almond Supple Skin Oil came out of the box, I swear she almost jumped for joy.  Apparently, in the world of ladies skin care products, the brand name L'Occitane is something to get excited about.

After using it for a couple of weeks, she assures me that it lives up to the hype.  I can attest that the almond scent is lovely. I like the way she smells when she puts this on. It is a subtle scent, not overpowering or chemically like cheaper products.  The oil rubs in smoothly, without leaving any residue. I got to try a little of it myself in order to write the review, but she greedily pulled the bottle away saying the rest of it was hers.

The bottle itself is nice also. I like how this is an atomizer spray, which means you don't use more than you need. Thats good, because while the price isn't completely outrageous it is expensive enough that you don't want the precious oil going to waste.

This product was a HUGE hit at my house. My wife loves it. I love it. And I bet that we will be getting another bottle when this one is finished.

The scent of this L'Occitane oil is worth it alone. It's absolutely delightful! The oil is not TOO oily and spreads and soaks in fairly quickly. This is definitely not a gross, heavy oil that some products provide. The bottle and label are attractive, the price not so much, but that's L'Occitane for you, right? This is a luxury item and if you're searching for a gift or luxury product for yourself--and you like being massaged--then I can NOT find a reason not to recommend this one.

L'Occitane is a brand I've never felt able to afford and have never experienced, but the experience with THIS product has me reconsidering. I want to try more L'Occitane now, and honestly, when this one runs out, it will be hard to not rush out and buy a new bottle. I might just do that.
summary: Can't speak for the skin tone, but the scent and performance is out of this world!

reviewText: Love spraying this on my knees and elbows.  Works wonderfully after shaving your legs.  Not the super sweet scent I expected like the baking extract but much more subtle and almost like a perfume.  The spray is an excellent way to disperse this oil in just the right amounts.  I spray into my hand and then rub on the above mentioned areas before it starts to run.  Soaks in quickly. Too much for my face but love it everywhere else.
A quarter sized amount provides such a luxurious lather! I love it. Im going to try the smooth pureology next!
summary: I love it. Im going to try the smooth pureology ...

reviewText:
I purchased a few samples of Pureology shampoo+conditioner through the Amazon sampling program, as I was interested in trying Pureology products. I never tried this brand before and wanted to have at least a vague opinion on their products before buying the full size.

The `Strength Cure` line has over the top claims (in the end, just the scissors will `repair` damaged hair), but manages to provide decent shampoo and conditioner formulas. I somewhat felt my hair strengthened (they're the kind of product that give body to hair), I think that `velvety soft finish` is kind of a good description. But I have frizzy hair, and while it left it hydrated, I prefer shampoos/conditioners that help me with that as well.
The shampoo did a nice thick lather and cleaned my hair surprisingly well. Pureology shampoos (from which I tried) are not the kind that leave hair squeaky clean. I have sensitive scalp with a tendency to get dandruff, the shampoo didn't aggravated my itchiness.
The conditioner wasn't very thick and even my thin hair basically absorbed quickly everything. When I rinsed it off, I felt my hair very smooth, almost covered in a silicone like layer. Once dried, my hair was hydrated, but very frizzy, so I needed to follow with a leave-in conditioner.

Pureology usually has those aroma therapeutic scent blends that I just dislike, too strong, But the `Strength Cure` had a milder scent, a hint of herby lavender and honey; I personally also felt a bit of nettle in there. I really liked that the lavender scent was almost toned down, natural, some hair products have a strong artificial lavender scent.
summary: Gentle and hydrating formula, but not enough to convince me to try it again

reviewText: Excellent

I use this shampoo, along with the matching conditioner, and these two products have absolutely transformed my hair.  My hair is highlighted, color treated with permanent color and I also heat style several times a week, so dryness and breakage are always an issue.  This formula has stopped the breakage and has definitely made my hair more resilient.  It has also helped with the dryness because it contains oils and emollients that hydrate really nicely.  If your hair is weak and damaged from chemical processing and/or heat styling, you can't do better than Strength Cure.  It also smells amazing, although the scent dissipates quickly.  My colorist has definitely noticed a difference in the condition of my hair and when I told him what I was using, he agreed that this formula is awesomely wonderful.  He said he can always tell when his clients use Pureology.  I was using the Essential Repair formula but it was discontinued and Strength Cure is the replacement formula.  It's just as great as Essential Repair perhaps even better.  My hair is soft, strong and shiny now when before it was dry, frizzy and wouldn't respond well to my styling efforts.  It looks amazing now and I get compliments on it all the time.  This formula is color safe and a little goes a long way, so these bottles last a lot longer than you might think at first glance.  Yes, it's expensive but it's so worth it.  I have a hall closet full of hair product FAILS that I've wasted countless dollars on.  So I have no problem paying  a premium price for something that actually lives up to its claims.  And this Pureology formula does just that.  If you have damaged hair, this is the perfect formula that can remedy that situation and transform your hair into something gorgeous and beautiful.  It worked its magic for me and it can do the same for you.  I highly recommend both the shampoo and the conditioner.  They work beautifully together.  However, I wouldn't purchase these products on Amazon, where fakes abound.  Buy them at Ulta or somewhere else where you can return them if you don't like them.  There are too many unscrupulous people on Amazon who are desperately trying to make a buck by ripping off unsuspecting people.  Don't take the chance.  Buy these products from a reputable online store or from a salon.  You will have no recourse if you receive a fake you've bought on Amazon.  Don't waste your money.  Saving a few bucks is not worth it if you receive a counterfeit product.

What an awesome shampoo!  My hair has been abused by repeated coloring and heat styling and this shampoo reverses the damage and leaves it soft, supple and shiny.  I purchased it at Ulta, thinking it would likely work for me because my hair is definitely stressed and it felt dry and brittle.  The directions say to use a quarter size dollop, which was more than enough to work up a frothy cleansing lather on my shoulder length hair.  Some reviewers have complained about the fragrance but I actually like it and it dissipates quickly anyway.  I also use the Strength Cure conditioner (and it only takes a very small amount of this to do the job).  I really like this shampoo and I think it's made a big difference in how my hair looks and feels.  It's sulfate free so it protects my precious hair color and it cleanses well and yet is very gentle to my tired tresses.  I do think that this formula is for rather dry and/or damaged hair (the bottle says "micro stressed" whatever that means, lol!) like mine.  I have put my hair through quite a lot lately: regular coloring with a high volume of developer, a color remover and subsequent recoloring with bleach (using Olaplex thank heavens!) and heat styling several times a week. So my hair's not just "micro stressed" but is fully stressed!! However, I noticed a difference the first time I used Strength Cure shampoo and conditioner.  My hair was soft, shiny and full of body and my hair color looked amazing and these products didn't weight my hair down at all., I think these two products are miracle workers and am pleased with my purchase.  I also happen to like the fragrance, it's quite different.  This shampoo (and conditioner) made my hair very hydrated, sleek and shiny.  What more can you ask for?
My all time favorite. My hair loves it. Thank you for the fast shipping and great price !!
Love Pureology and this one is the best.

I bought this with the shampoo and I've fallen in love. I have limp, oily, fine, boring hair and I've had volume like I cannot believe with these products. I did have a new haircut the same day I bought this product and it may have contributed to helping with the volume but I think this product is awesome.

I have not had this much volume in.... well in ever that I can remember. The scent of this is not really like the shampoo and I don't feel it's as good, but its not going to make me stop using it. I'm so glad I decided to get this. It was the best decision I've made in a long time.
Works pretty good even on dry hair.

I recently purchased this, obviously, in hopes of getting more voluminous hair.  I have only used it a few times and I do feel that it does what the product description says.  My problem with this stuff is that a sediment has formed in the bottom of the bottle and it prevents the sprayer from working properly.  I am able to spray once and then I have to wait several seconds before I can spray again...if I can spray at all.  It has been completely clogged.  I tried heating the bottom of the bottle with my hair dryer and letting it sit in a bowl of warm water in hopes of loosening up the sediment.  The hair dryer had no effect and the warm water did work some but not nearly enough.  I think I will be contacting the manufacturer and will try to update this review afterwards.

Update:
I emailed Matrix and they are willing to reimburse me for the purchase of this product.
Crap. The sprayer bottom was filled with what can only described as solidified wood glue. Terrible.

reviewText:
My thought when I ordered this was, "Well, this had better be  fantastic or at very least, good".  After all, the name of  this is NUXE RELAXING FRAGRANT WATER.....keyword being w a t e r.

If my figuring is correct, the contents weigh 3.3 ounces and it costs $29.00 which puts it at $8.79 for1.1 ounce. Well, I thought I should  look into this a little deeper.  This is what I found out.  This 50 year old, Parisian company has a 53 year old female as it's CEO and they manufacture and market face, body and makeup products.  The company offers cleansers, makeup removers, moisturizers, lip care, masks and scrubs, eye contour, reviving products, first and visible expression lines, deep wrinkle and loss of firmness products, anti-imperfection products and re-densifying care products for mature skin.  It also provides moisturizing and nourishing, slimming, and hands and feet products plus bath, shower, dry oils for face, hair and body.  They make gels for shaving, moisturizing and shower plus eye-creams and deodorants for men.

So, after reading all that, I figured this is worth a shot....maybe it will help my wrinkles disappear as they seem to be multiplying each day.

Here is my review on this product:  it smells great, it does make you feel refreshed, it does make you relaxed.  I am impressed with that so I'm going to give it some more time to see if I DO have any negatives.  And, if I do, I shall upgrade this review.  Right now, it does what it says it does.  Can't say THAT for everything we buy.
summary: I think I just might have found a replacement company for my aging skin.

reviewText:
When I read all the flowery descriptions I think oh WOW, I think Id love that.

Im speechless!  This stuff is really awful. It reminds me of some sort of bug spray with an overtone of wet cardboard. Sorry, Nuxe, wish I could say something good.

I'm not one to wear perfume on a regular basis. As a previous reviewer said, it has a musky scent to it. It's very light, it's not crazy strong or overbearing. I like this and it especially feels nice to spray on in this hot summer heat. Is it worth the $28 price tag? For me yes as I think the scent is nice and feminine.

Fragrant water?  Oh, please. This is just a run-of-the-mill perfume, and a cheap one at that. It's not light or relaxing, and even one spritz left me reeking of baby powder and aging flowers.  It brought on a headache within 10 minutes, and I'm not susceptible to that.  I wear perfume every day,  but expensive ones and this one does not measure up.  Honestly it reminds me most of my daughter's Axe body sprays, which I also hate.  But if you love Axe, maybe this is what you're looking for.
summary: Yuck! A cheap, strong, overly sweet perfume

reviewText:
This is a delightful scent that adds just a dash of excitement to an evening out.

It is very pleasant and I highly recommend it over an expensive perfume.

Lovely scent.

I absolutely love NUXE Huile Prodigieuse Multi-Purpose Dry Oil, 1.6 fl. oz., and have used it for years and also given it as gifts. In the last couple of years, I've also been using their honey lip balm and several of their moisturizers, and have really liked them all. While I do love the cooling sensation of this new body spray (for that's essentially what it is), it has a really strong floral scent to it that lasts for several hours, meaning that you wouldn't want to use perfume when you use this. It's a really cloying scent -- one that smells strongly of baby powder. I know that scents are a very personal thing, but this one just feels outdated and is very strong. The positives are that this comes in a beautiful frosted glass bottle, and the spray mechanism works to evenly coat your skin. It looks beautiful on the vanity or bathroom counter. Despite those positives, though, I may pass this along to a friend because the scent is just too much for me personally. My advice is to try to smell this before purchasing, or only purchase if you like floral, powdery scents.
summary: Has a strong smell, but it feels cooling for the summer

reviewText: Goes on rather floral and sweet, lightens to just barely the very slightest musk notes, then pretty much disappears altogether. This didn't relax me, and it doesnt last long, but I do like the scent.

Nuxe is a UK beauty company with quite a few beauty staples, so I thought I would try out their fragrant water. It's a strange way of putting it, but think of it as a perfume that feels good going on your skin. The smell is really floral and feminine. It's quite beautiful and relaxing. I was surprised at the quality of the bottle. It feels like sturdy glass. It would make for a lovely addition to a spa-themed bridal gift or mother's day gift! Anyone that could use some pampering.

My first experience with a NUXE product and I am very pleased!  It's a very nice fragrance, a subtle blend of fragrances actually hard to pinpoint the exact elements in it.  It's a very "spa", nature inspired and certainly relaxing.  I like that it doesn't hang in a a perfumed cloud behind me when I spritz it on!  Just the right strength and  whisper of something tropical.
summary: A bit mysterious but definitely deserving five stars!  I love it!

reviewText: I was SO excited to get to review NUXE Relaxing Fragrant Water, having been absolutely and totally in love with Nuxe Dry Oil for years.  It comes in a lovely glass bottle with a solid acrylic cap.  I couldn't wait to get it open and try it! One spritz on my arm and I knew this was not going to be for me.  The fragrance was completely overwhelming, almost headache inducing.  I left it on to see if I would grow to like it, but unfortunately, I did not. In fact, I liked it even less as it mellowed on my skin.  I will admit that I'm very sensitive to scents, and maybe this product wouldn't bother most people like it does me.

A relaxing, sweet-scented, fragrant water that should be used last in order to leave a nice scent and to relax the skin. I have tried several of these NUXE products and have been happy with all of them. Good stuff!

I was curious to try this.  It sounded like a total luxury.  Well, I'm not sure what this is or what it is for.  The scent is chemical and unpleasant.  ( I have many perfumes and love scent but this is just commercial, artificial and awful).  It leaves a shiny sticky icky layer on your skin.  I received this in exchange for my review and it pains me not to be able to say nice things about it.  But it would have pained me a whole lot more if I had actually shelled out cash for it.  Scent is a very personal thing, I realize, but this reviewer thinks this is just awful.  (For reference, I hate most mainstream perfumes.  I like niche fragrances like Safran Troublant, Le Labo Rose 31,Annick Goutal Rose Absolue.  So, if you hate perfumes like these, and prefer things like Blue Water, you might actually like this.)
summary: Scent is a very personal thing, but this reviewer, personally, found it very awful

reviewText: What I liked best about this body spray was not the fragrance but the way it left my skin feeling silky soft. The spray itself is encased in a tall, slim opaque bottle. It sprays evenly and lightly. It smells like baby powder although the manufacturer's website says it is a blend of coconut sorbet, orange blossom and almond blossom flowers, musk and vanilla. It is soft and it does linger. does it relax and refresh? Perhaps. I guess all perfume is aromatherapy in a bottle to some extent.  And a cool spritz of anything is refreshing. My taste in fragrances runs to the crisper scents so it is unlikely that I will purchase this in the future. However I was impressed with the effect it had on my skin so I will most certainly investigate this line. 3.5 stars

Although I buy everything fragrance free that I can, I have a large and well-loved collection of rare, vintage, and high-end niche perfumes. I remember experiencing some other NUXE product and found it pleasant. I had a Shiseido Relaxing Water years ago that was really quite lovely, like you had just been in a room where Japanese incense had been burning. This: a potentially head-ache inducing (if you are susceptible to headaches; it might just make you lash out at some someone if politeness is your weak link, or trigger an asthma attack) brew is bad. Why? Why was it created? It's just an overpriced bottle of strong chemicals that you should never wear around infants. If you must wear it (I will try to extend tolerance), ONE spritz is enough! Well, actually too much. The scent is an insulting cliché, with notes of baby powder, plastic toy pony, fruit Twizzler and musk scratch-n-sniff. Frighteningly bad.
Smells rather strongly of baby powder mixed with fragrance. It's a bit too pungent, but it does fade away much more quickly than perfume.

Everyone's nose smells scents differently on their skin when it comes to fragrance.  That being said, my nose is finding this NUXE Fragrant Water a bit too powerful.  When I first sprayed it on my forearm for my sample test, I was overwhelmed with a strong lemony, citrus, woodsy scent, with powder undertones.  Unfortunately on my skin, it smelled like a bug spray insecticide!  It's been two hours now, and it has mellowed with the powder scent more pronounced, but still not to my liking.  (I'm more of a light floral scent kind of gal.)  I know that LUXE of Paris, France makes great products, but this one is not for me.  I must say though, the presentation is very nice with the frosted glass of the tall slim bottle, and the clear plastic top completing the sleek look, and the perfumed spray was evenly diffused.  I know that there are other ladies that will enjoy this fragrance, I only wish I would have been one of them.  ***JUNE 25 - DECIDED TO REVISIT the NUXE Fragrant Water that looked so lonely on my counter:  I've upped my rating to 4 STARS because, guess what!, using just a small amount of this by spraying into the air and moving into the mist, it works much better than spraying directly on to my skin.  The scent is not as overwhelming, but pleasant and subtle.  I feel comfortable wearing this, especially around the house, for now.  This experience has reminded me to not make such a snap decision, to approach something differently, and to be willing to give something a second (or more) chance!

Just wow. I thought it would be  a clear liquid in the bottle but it is a cloudy liquid that made me think of a body fluid.  I held it at arm's length and pushed the button and a bug bomb went off in the living room.  This lets out a huge blast of mist that is in an almost 180 arc and hovers in the air in visible droplets like a toxic chemical  cloud.

The smell is the strongest thing out of a bottle I've ever smelled aside from the bug bombs you pull the plug on like a grenade and run for your life from and leave it in the garage or shed to kill the bugs and anything else within ten feet.

So I gave it two stars because it is a potent, powerful blast of pure alcohol and citronella, and is exactly what I was hoping to find to keep the zida mosquitoes off me this summer.  And it accomplishes that perfectly.  An added bonus is neighbors don't hang around to chat.  Everyone smells me coming.  And I continue to walk around in a citronella cloud for hours with JUST ONE BLAST.

The marketing for this is totally wrong.  They have a huge money maker here if they market this as a mosquito repellent and I say that with all seriousness.
summary: Best Mosquito Repellant ever--- STRONG citronella that never goes away

reviewText: This body spray has a wonderful baby powder fragrance that lasts all day. I find it refreshing and would definitely purchase this as part of my fragrance collection which consists mostly of Victoria Secret and Bath & Body fragrances.
summary: Refreshing baby powder scent that lasts all day

reviewText: As fragrance is different on every individual's skin, I can only say that I think that NUXE is OK, but it's not a fragrance that I would enjoy wearing, and I did wear it twice before writing this review.  What I did like about the product was the spray which diffused the scent evenly.
summary: An OK scent, only not for me

reviewText:
When I was offered this product through Vine, I had never tried a NUXE product before.  "Relaxing Fragrant Water" sounded pretty great so, when it arrived, I was anxious to see what it was like.

It's nice.  It came in a pretty, opaque-white. heavy glass atomizer bottle as is pictured.  It sprays a light mist of scented fragrance that is actually relaxing.  It has a sort of musky scent yet is different.  It's not sweet or floral.  I wish I knew better how to describe it but it is pleasant.  It didn't last a long time for me, maybe a few hours.  I think that that is pretty standard for this type of water-based fragrance.

The ingredients list that it is mostly alcohol and fragrance.  It seems a bit expensive for that but, if you like it, I guess it's worth it.  I like it but probably not enough to pay the current price of ~$25.  I'll keep using it and see how I feel over time.

It is pleasant and relaxing. Is it addictive????  We'll see. Three and a half stars.

5-10-17-  After having this and using it for awhile, I've remained loyal to my former preferred fragrances.  This is nice for an occasional change but I will not be repurchasing it.  It's pretty expensive, for what it is, and I'm just not that big of a fan.  Lovely bottle though!
summary: Pleasant and Relaxing Fragrance- A Spa in a Bottle?

Great

I'm obsessed with my original Lorac PRO Palette, I've used that sucker to the point where I've reached bottom of tin on 75% of my colors. I knocked off a star on this 1 because I just don't like it as much. It's a personal preference. Maybe I don't like as many of the color options, but overall it's a nice product.
summary: The orig PRO is more my cup of tea, but this is nice...

reviewText: Omg this pallet is GORGEOUS. All the colors are amazing. I am not a cool toned color liked usually but these colors are absolutely perfect and pigmented. The eye shadow primer is an added bonus too. There is a little bit of fallout but nothing terrible.
Love Love these products.

This product causes my skin to itch.  I love using serums, but I probably won't purchase this product again.  Unless I apply a super moisturizing cream on top of it, this serum makes my skin burn/itch.
The items may be great for others but these products left my face extremely dry with scars on my face.  I now have to see a dermatologist to help clear.

I use "IMAGE" products because the Professional Skin Therapist I go to recommends these.  She uses these on her clients and also sells these products in her shop.  I've been very happy with the order & shipment experience going thru AMAZON.COM for these purchases.

My doctor recomended this line to me and I have slowly started to use more and more.  I am not sure I saw a significant difference in my skin because of the serum or if I saw a difference from another product on this line.  I can say that my skin feels tighter, the lines are less noticable, and the spots have faded.  I use, not only the serum, but also the Total Repair Cream, the Eye Lift Cream and the Total Cleanser, in additon to the resurfacing mask,  which is my favorite thing ever!!.  I can not, however, use all of them at the same time everyday or my skin will go dry (I am guessing due to the Retinal).  I use the serum in the AM and just the Total Skin Repair at night, if I try to combine the two my face itches and is a bit uncomfortable.  I would absolutly recomend this line to anyone my age (40) and up, just use caution and introduce new products slowly.

This perfume is made of Cherry blossom, mandarin, rose, sandalwood, bare musk, and some more notes, but all so enchanting. Its perfect for daytime, not very strong but refreshing, uplifting, and feminine. My 6 yr loved it too :)

As some reviewers said that it fades after a few hours, it is true, for me it was 5-6 hours period. But then I would not want a perfume on me for the whole day, I would get sick of the smell, so actually its a positive thing for me that it fades away after a few hours.

I would definitely recommend this perfume, its a great addition to my perfume collection.

Because the base notes are bamboo, sandalwood, bare musk accord, I thought this would be a more natural, deeper scent.

When first putting it on it is very strong, even the littlest amount is very overwhelming and it actually gave me a headache.  After a couple hours the scent is more subtle, but still very flowery.  I was hoping that initial floral scent would fade away and the musky undertones be left, but it's just flowery and too strong for me and I only put a tiny amount on.

If you like strong floral type scents and perfumes, you'll probably like this.  The scent is lasting and the bottle it came in is pretty.  It's not the scent for me though.
summary: Too strong and floral for me

reviewText: The combination of scents in this perfume are contemporary, delightful, and inclusive of varied aromatherapy flavours. First rate.

I wore for several hours loving the scent of sandalwood and musk mixed with some floral notes. This is not a perfume that will hit you with a blast of scent, but is much more subtle and sophisticated. The scent does fade but that is normal and to be expected. I like to spray on a cotton ball and place in the lingerie drawer to give a subtle scent to underclothing. The bottle is lovely and would make a statement on a dressing table.
summary: I like to spray on a cotton ball and place in ...

reviewText: The Calvin Klein endless euphoria Eau de Parfum is now my girlfriend Tammy's favorite perfume. She has been smitten by it. I gave it to her as an early Valentine's Day gift without telling her I got it from the Amazon Vine Program. She thinks the world of it. She likes it much better than her Chloe Eau de Toilette Spray (Chloe By Karl Lagerfeld For Women. Eau De Toilette Spray 3.0 Oz) that I normally buy for her. Tammy likes to spray the endless euphoria on her wrists and neck. She has to be very careful with sprays and oils because her extra-sensitive skin breaks out. So far, she hasn't experienced any allergic reaction with the endless euphoria. I like to call it endless love because of the hit movie, "Endless Love," starring Brooke Shields and Martin Hewitt. Out of curiosity, I sprayed some of the endless euphoria on my own wrist and loved its heavenly scent. However, according to Tammy, the scent doesn't last more than a few hours. This isn't a deal breaker with her because normally, after coming home from work, she takes a shower and sprays more perfume on her. It wouldn't be a deal breaker for me either. I normally use Obsession for Men (Calvin Klein OBSESSION for Men Eau de Toilette, 2.5 fl. oz.), which, coincidentally, is also manufactured by Calvin Klein; I always spray some more on me when I want to freshen up before going out for the evening. I seriously believe that Calvin Klein endless euphoria Eau de Parfum would make an excellent gift for the special woman in your life.
summary: Calvin Klein endless euphoria Eau de Parfum Smells Heavenly!

reviewText:
I have bought my wife lots of perfume over the years, but find that I can't stand the powerful ones.  So I was on the look for something very light.  I like the light smell, but it matters if the person wearing it likes it more.  So I asked my wife to comment.  She says,

"A light, floral scent, definitely suited for Spring and Summer.  I don't have a "nose" so can't tell you exactly what florals I do smell.

According to information found on the internet, it has "top notes" of: cherry blossom, mandarin, bergamot; "mid notes" of: violet, pastel rose accord and syringa; and  "base notes" of bamboo, sandalwood and bare musk accord.  I don't smell musk (which I don't like) and it's not a heavy scent.  Not too sure about sandalwood, either, (but I do like that scent on my man).

Information from the internet also states that Endless Euphoria is the "daytime counterpart to Euphoria.  Now we have daytime and night-time scents?  So I have to buy two kinds of perfume - daytime and nighttime?  Good marketing ploy - for the rich or those who have too much money on their hands.  (Say, if you have too much money, why don't you send me the amount you would spend on either the daytime or nighttime version, and we'll both be happy!)

Not an overpowering scent, and I'm noticing it doesn't linger/last "forever", so you might want to get a small, purse-size one to carry with you to refresh scent throughout the day, if you're one of those ladies (me, I'm just a once-in-the-morning-does-it kind of gal), or layering is good - body-wash, powder/lotion, scent."

Now my wife gives it a 4, as it is light and disappears after awhile.  I give it a 5 because it is LIGHT.  A heavy or even medium perfume is too much for me to be around.  So since I am rating it gets a 5.  However, to the ladies who would actually wear it, please think about what my wife said if you want a stronger scent.  I really hope this helps.  It is so hard looking for the perfect perfume that everyone around can like.

This perfume is definitely a winner.  My wife has used primarily softer perfumes in the past--Pleasures by Estee lauder, Beyond Paradise, etc.--but she really likes this one.  Endless Euphoria is stronger both in terms of length of time it lasts on the body and in terms of intensity of smell.  But it is not overpowering and has floral tones that soften the stronger sandalwood and musk.  I also really like it on her.  This is a perfume that can be worn in any season but can take the heat of summer, I think.  It will be a winner for women who like floral perfumes that have a full-bodied, long-lasting sense to them.
summary: A real winner.  Good value and long-lasting floral notes.  Compares well to Pleasures, Beyond Paradise.

reviewText:
I am very picky when it comes to scents. If I smell perfume on women, I like it to be a more feminine, sweeter type of scent. This perfume smells great. Its lightly sweet, with a nice floral scent.

The price is reasonable for what you get and the scent itself lasts several hours. Many are complaining about it not lasting long enough, but you can always add more. The bottle, with its broad shape and pinkish color looks nice too.

Its hard to write a review for a scent, since its one of those things that is intuitive. Heres the bottom line: this smells great and if the women in my life wore it, I would definitely compliment them on it!

This is a lightly sweet, floral fragrance. It's rated as an "Eau de Parfum", which should be less concentrated than Perfume, but stronger than Eau de Toilette. However, my wife feels that it is a much weaker scent than some of the typical Eau de Toilette fragrances she uses. With 6 sprays onto her clothing, it was barely noticeable (smelling the clothes & skin directly) 3 hours later. Even though its supposed to be more concentrated, it did not seem to last very long or have a strong scent to begin with. I don't like a fragrance that is overpowering, but of course you want to notice it. I do like the scent itself. But my wife would not choose this as a "summer fragrance" (as it is advertised), but thought it was ok for evening wear in the semi-tropical climate where we live.
summary: Slightly too sweet and wears off, but pleasant scent

reviewText: I really like the scent on this. Of the notes used, I can definitely smell the citrus but it's toned down with the base notes of sandalwood and musk and then there is that wonderful hit of floral from the cherry blossom and rose. An very nice well round scent, only one spray is necessary anything more would be overpowering. I would definitely wear this for special occasions as I don't wear perfume much but did enjoy the wonderful mix of floral, citrus and wood/musk.

This perfume has light, fresh overtones, but it also has a definite musky heart.  The airy breeziness of the topnotes is definitely the most euphoric thing about this scent.  On me, however, it dries down into a rather musky fragrance, something that is not especially euphoric, and something that I don't particularly like.  My skin tends to amplify the musks in perfumes, and that's absolutely the case here.  I've also used the original Euphoria perfume, and I do prefer Endless Euphoria to the original.  I find that Endless Euphoria is lighter, and maintains its floral notes better than the original.

Scent aside, the packaging is beautiful, and the bottle fits nicely with the concept.  This is a generous-sized bottle; there's quite a bit of fragrance in here.

I knew I liked this perfume from the moment I spritzed some on my wrists. It's an awesome fragrance; not too strong, not too light. It lasts for hours, which is good enough for me.

It's been a long while since I have braved going from the milder colognes to genuine longer-lasting perfume, but after reading the reviews I decided to get this Calvin Klein Euphoria... and I'm glad I did.

It's just the right blend of floral and woodsy to suit my tastes... and the men in my life agree.

With the cost of living so high now, everyone appreciates a good buy and since this name-brand perfume is $20. cheaper than my favorite department store, I am beyond pleased.

In addition to the fragrance being so pleasant, I think the bottle is well-designed... pretty, elegant and rosy pink... It looks lovely on my dresser next to a family photo in a mother-of-pearl frame.

I recommend this highly to anyone who likes their fragrance more light, airy and lasting. To describe it in one word... well, that would be "euphoric." :-)

Reviewed by Betty Dravis, February 23, 2015.
Author of "The Search for Bobby McGee"
summary: Euphoria is euphoric... Light, airy, long-lasting...

reviewText: Nice floral scent reminiscent of of roses.  Not overpowering and very pleasant.  the main failing here is that the fragrance only lasts about 4 hours tops. Tops.  Otherwise another winner from CK.
summary: Great scent but not very long lasting.

reviewText: I love Euphoria but it is a little heavy so I only wear it during the colder months or for date night.  The new Endless Euphoria is much lighter.  A sweet floral that's perfect for Spring or Summer.  I really like this new scent but it might be a little too sweet for some.  Your best bet is to smell a sample before making up your mind.

Love this scent! Perfect for everyday. Not too heavy, but also not sickeningly sweet. I can easily wear this out and about without feeling too showy. Just a nice smooth scent that actually doesn't give me a headache. It seemed like it doesn't last as long as my standby, DOT, so you might need reapply if you need it to last all day. Overall very pleasing!
summary: Lovely scent, not too sweet, not too floral

reviewText: I'm not too much of a perfume wearer but this sounded nice as I like the Bath and Body Works Cherry Blossom scent. The scent of cherry blossoms is definitely forward on this scent. It's a little too sweet for me but my husband liked it. It's light and not too overpowering
summary: ... too much of a perfume wearer but this sounded nice as I like the Bath and Body Works Cherry ...

reviewText: I love everything about this scent. It's feminine but not so floral that it smells like grandma or an Aunt.  I love the bottle, it's big and substantial and the color alone is just very subtle and pretty.  The smell is really light but not so light that it's gone quickly.
summary: My bf loves it...that's all that matters to me

reviewText: Great product
I love this product!
Light and airy!  It goes on so easy and it is a little shimmery but I like it a lot.  Plus it's all natural.
Best eyeshadow ever!
Great price. Arrived on time. Works as advertised.
Smooth and well pigmented. This particular color is matte.
Great product
I like the new compact. The product was always great, but as I travel so much the plastic compact eventually would break. So thank to for the improvement to the case.
I would purchase this product again.
did not realize it was frosted, I wanted matte
Nice, expensive for what you get but nice neutral colors and last all day.
Jane Iredale is the best.  Nothing else need be said.  Be sure to get the perfect color for you at a salon - Prefessional recommendation is needed. It is worth the extra step.
Love these color combinations and it lasts all day!
Nice color palete. No irritation. Love it!
Best concealer hands down.
The colors aren't anything special; just pleasant  and easy to apply.

reviewText: Great everyday colors for green eyes.
MY favorite combination!
Love the colors!
Good colors....

Lovely colours - my only complaint about this trio is that the lighter colour is really still a mid-tone so I have to use another colour for the lid - if I just use these three colours it's too dark for me
summary: Lovely colours - my only complaint about this trio is ...

reviewText: Looove this color. It is the exact shade of my eyelids, and I've been told repeatedly that my features are enhanced with only having a little on, because women don't want to show such a great difference when wearing or not wearing makeup. I highly recommend it!
summary: because women don't want to show such a great difference when wearing or not wearing makeup

reviewText: Truly the best eye shadow ever!  Never creases or cakes up and last all day. I also noticed that my eyes don't water so much when I put Jane Iredale makeup on.  This is a keeper and a must buy!

I wouldn't say it makes a difference in terms of "brightening" anything, but I can say this: I have VERY sensitive skin (breakouts, hives, etc), and this did not trigger anything bad! It goes on smoothly, doesn't really have a smell, and absorbs really well. It is so soothing that sometimes I use it all over my face. Nice ingredients, no noticeable brightening, but great moisture and no irritation. That counts for plenty!
summary: no brightening, but very good otherwise!

reviewText: I like the brand, Obagi overall, but this item falls flat for me. It's light, goes on easily and has caused me no irritation. However, after a few weeks of use....I don't feel like it's helping with wrinkles or under eye circles. I apply it at night, but the eye cream by Laura Mercier seems to be a better product for my dark under eye circles. I will keep trying this at night and see if there's improvement after a longer period. It's rather pricey too.
summary: Good Brand, but This Doesn't Help My Dark Circles...So Far

reviewText:
From the female of the family. This product gives you Kinetin, Zeatin, and Eye-Pro 3x, to reduce the appearance of "aging skin" around your eyes. All in all, there are about 30 ingredients in the cream, and many of them are desirable natural products. You need to look at the product and description carefully. This does nothing to moisturize your skin, or get rid of wrinkles. What it does is this: "Creates optical diffusion, blurring the appearance of fine lines and shadows." In other words, it is makeup.

I apply a moisturizer to my entire face. I don't use makeup over my entire face -- just a tinted see-through foundation. Once moisturized, I use a little of this on a fingertip and apply a very thin layer under my eyes. It gets rid of any dark shadows and just lightens up the area. You don't want to use too much, or it will dry out and have the opposite effect. If you use it alone, it may dry and give a wrinkled look -- one point off for the fact I have to use a moisturizer beneath it.

Overall, I like this lightening effect and find it makes me look younger. However, I find the price of $95 for half an oz. to be high. I think you can find similar product for less, that work just as well.

Recommended, with caveats.
summary: Not a Moisturizer -- Makeup "Optical Illusion" to Lighten Dark Eye Shadows

reviewText: My wife used this product and it is described as a product to "reduce the appearance of skin aging around the delicate eye area.  Her right eye is puffy and she is always trying new products in hopes of reducing the puffiness.  So far, this eye brightener has not helped that problem.  However, it does a good job of smoothing and brightening the skin around the eyes.  You only need a small amount of the product and need to be careful to pump out only a small amount.  She does not use a moisturizer on top of it because her skin is not dry and she has not found a need for an eye moisturizer on top of this product. The product has a nice non oily texture as long as too much is not applied.  It does improve the appearance of the area under her eye.

I've tried Obagi products before and their skin care regime has dramatically changed my face.  More evenness in pigmentation and smoothness.
So I wanted to know it this eye brightener works?  After having used for the past week and a half I do notice that under my eye it appears whiter.  Dramatically?  Maybe a shade or 2 lighter.  This product only contains half an ounce.  It is pumped out in a milky gel that is easy to apply.  I would recommend at night before bed for best affect.  It also claims to reduce puffiness, this it true to an extent probably due to the moisturizing effect of the gel which is very gentle for the under eye.  However, I stopped using the product for a few days and under my eyes seemed return to a more normal state.
This does work although not as powerfully as their other skin care systems.  However, not sure if there are long lasting effect.  Seem like you must continue use of the product daily for results.
summary: Does brighten the under eye and gentle but unsure if there are long lasting results you probably will have to use daily

reviewText: This is a super nice eye serum that glides on super easy, then settles into my skin. Part of the instructions say to follow it with moisturizer, but I have found that I don't need to, it has just enough moisture on its own. This is a think clear-milky formula. One pump dispensed is too much for both eyes, so I carefully pump out just a little less, then I tap it onto the eye area with my ring fingers. It either dries in place or soaks in very easily. Some days a put a very small amount of light eye cream on to supplement it, but most days I don't need to. I really love this, but the price tag is just too high for only a half ounce of product. I'm hoping that, since you don't need a full pump, that this will last for a while. I know I'll miss it.  It could totally be wishful thinking on my part, but I could swear that it smooths out the fine lines under my eyes. As for the dark shadows (I have seriously bad dark shadows), I don't know if it works on those yet. But I'm mainly thrilled with the smoothing effect this cream has.
summary: a light eye cream, not super moisturizing

reviewText: I tend to become a little concerned when treatments for the eye areas contain warnings to keep the products away from the eyes. Such is the case with the milky eye treatment lotion by Obagi. First off, I don't care for the large plastic dispenser because I can't determine how much of the product remains in the bottle. I also find that obtaining a tiny amount isn't easy, especially when I'm rushing to push down on the pump. The product itself is rather nice, and a tiny amount applied by the ring fingers of both hands to the eyes takes just a few gentle pats. There is no real scent and the lotion quickly dries on the delicate skin surrounding the eyes. There is a pretty quick feel of tightening which lasts for several minutes that almost feels like a drying of the skin, so moisturizer applied to the remainder of the face seeps onto the eye product to counteract that sensation. I only use this lotion for daytime, but you can use it at night, too. I never tried the Obagi line when Dr. Obagi actually owned it, selling his formulas, so I'd like to compare his current line of products with this one that wears his name but is not his product.
summary: Curious about how this compares with Dr. Obagi formula

reviewText: This is my second Obagi product and I am really impressed with the products. The eye brightener is amazing. I pat a small amount below my eyes after my shower and again before bed. I can tell a difference after several days use. The puffiness is less noticeable. I have used eye products that have caused dryness under my eyes but this does not cause any irritation. This is a product that really works.

I would love for this to work because I am so tired of the dark circles under my eyes. The pump bottle contains only .5 oz or 15 ml. A tiny squirt goes a long way, so this should last a while. The product went on smooth and creamy but was not heavy. It did not leave any residue or a greasy feeling. Perhaps this was not the best time of year to try a product like this. I have very sensitive skin around my eyes and our flip-flopping weather does not help. I had slight irritation that left redness. I will wait a few more weeks and try again. I will then be in a warmer, less drying climate.
summary: Seems nice, feels good on skin

reviewText: Eyes can age quickly- especially tired mom eyes. This cream/brightener keeps my eyes looking not so tired even when I am. Don't be surprised when you receive this- the package is small. A total of half an ounce. A little goes a very long way. I use one tiny pump and split it between both eyes- I dab it under my eyes and on the crows feet area- and gently rub it in. This cream has kept me looking youthful, helped me with my wrinkles and puffiness. This cream doesn't seem to have a smell either which is great. I've noticed an improvement in my skins elasticity and softness within days. Has not dried out my skin. Highly recommended.

Incredibly, the sunspots on my face are noticeably fading after a few weeks of use! I also received a compliment a few days ago about how smooth my skin looked. This rich serum actually works. At first my skin felt a little dry, so I coupled it with moisturizer, which helped. It comes in a nice, air-tight and light-protected pump, and a small amount is all I need to cover my face. I like the mild, citrus scent, and the smooth texture of the cream. I will use this religiously. The only downside is that the price is a bit steep for me.

I've been using for about 3 weeks now and I have not noticed any difference.  I wasn't expecting miracles but I don't see any difference in texture or color, or firmness of my skin.

Maybe, it needs to be used with other Obagi products, but for the price, I would expect to see some type of change after 3 weeks of using it alone.
summary: After 3 weeks, no change in skin.

reviewText: I realize that there is nothing you can really smear on your face that is going to erase wrinkles. Still, I would like to hope that with better moisturizing, I can lessen the appearance of them anyway. This smells very light and really sinks into my skin quickly. I like that. Before this, I used some Olay gel type, but it is terrible with using under makeup. It sort of lays there and leaves some sort of film that can slough off a little when I apply makeup. I will probably still buy that gel stuff because has a cooling feel and I like the way if feels under my eyes. This Obagi does sink in nicely. As for lines, it does help...but is no miracle. I am not sure if it is better or the same as other creams. After a week, I didn't get any real compliments or anything (even from my mother who always comments if my skin looks good or bad!) Maybe I haven't given it enough time. I will lay off the other kind and use this only for the next few weeks. If anything changes (bad or good) I will update my review. For now...it gets a B.

I have nothing negative to say about the Obagi Professional-C Peptide Complex.  It has the consistency of a thin lotion and a little bit goes a long way.  It has a light citrus scent that totally undetectable once the product is applied.  I apply it in the morning and at night focusing on the areas where I have age lines on my forehead and in between my eyebrows.  Mine are the type that most people refer to as worry lines.  I have noticed a definite lightening of the lines in those areas and it makes my face look younger and I no longer look like I am frowning all of the time.  The lines are not completely gone away.  I have only been using this for a few weeks, so hopefully the improvement will continue.  I think that the improvement would be better for people with fine lines.  I plan to continue to use it until I run out, then I will be able to see how good the improvement will be.  I'm also not sure if the improvement is permanent, but so far I am quite impressed.  I think that it is worth a try for people with fine lines, but I don't think that the deep lines will completely eliminated.
summary: Probably the best for very fine lines

reviewText: The cream has a pleasant texture when applied - and the tightening effect may please some older women - but that effect is achieved by drying the skin and the long term effects are not beneficial.

My wife loves this product!
I used this with the Obagi Eye Brightener and the results were immediate.  My skin was firm and my lines were smoothed.  I was pleasantly surprised, because Im pretty skeptical about skin care.  Most products can improve the appearance of your skin a little, but this and the brightener were amazing.  Ive never used a peptide product, so I really don't have experience to draw from - I just know that this improved the look and feel of my skin instantly.  Love it, and will keep using it for sure!

Peptides are the best ingredients for keeping skin young, healthy and firm.  I love Obagi skin care line and this is the first time I used their peptide product on my face.  I use this product as a serum and apply it on my face after toner and before moisturizer.  This product can be used in the morning and at night.  The size of he product is generous too and it can last for at least 3-4 months even if it is used twice daily.  Product absorbs well.  Major ingredients include:  Kinetin and Zeatin, which have been clinically shown to help improve the appearance of firmness, brighten tone, and improve the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, sweet almond oil,  stearic acid, tocopheryl acetate (Vitamin E) and panthenol (Vitamin B).
summary: Peptide complex with Kinetin and Zeatin

reviewText: This is a very light weight cream that goes on easily with 2 -3 pumps for full facial coverage.  I am using this with the C-serum at night and I have noticed a difference in my 50 something years young skin.  I am blessed with great genetics, so I don't have wrinkles yet, and I find this to keep my skin nice and smooth to touch.  I gave it only 4 starts, because the price is ridiculous for the amount you get.  I don't know how long it lasts, as I am into the small container for 3 weeks of use and I can't tell how much I have left.

I've used this for a month, and given that my skin is in bad shape from swimming and outdoor abuse in winter, I was curious to see if this could help clean things up. It certainly is a good moisturizer, and there was no odor or irritation that went on from the application. The cream itself isn't thick and absorbed in rather nicely to my skin. My better half recognized that my skin was getting better, so that felt good (it's always nice to have them notice without being prompted.)

So I like this. A lot. But the price...

I generally have no problems spending money to get a quality product, but at $100/oz, it is a luxury I can't really justify. When compared to my normal moisturizers (Neutrogena is what I've normally used off and on), I just can't notice the difference. If I did notice a difference, I'd definitely consider it (but the "feel good" to cost ratio would have to scale accordingly.) Bottom line: if you can afford this regularly, then go for it. If you're trying to mind your wallet, there are a lot cheaper alternatives that come close to doing the job.

Using this cream on one side (undereye) for 3 weeks, then asking a 3 friends to see what they observe, letting them know I used a new product on one eye, but the regular on the other. Could they tell a difference between the two sides? Two could not. The third picked the side with my current product.

Pros: absorbs quickly and with no greasy afterfeel. Very limited scent to it, and it doesn't linger. The texture under my eye felt softer afterwards.

However, for the price, considering not a single friend could notice a difference, this is not a product I'd purchase on my own.
summary: Absorbs quickly but no noticeable difference

reviewText:
I absolutely love Obagi C-Peptide Complex! The first thing I noticed when I initially used this lotion like complex was the amazing and invigorating citrus smell. I've never used a product like this with such a wonderful scent - it's light, not overwhelming, but invigorating ... like bath and body works aromatherapy "energy" products.

This complex goes on smoothly, spreading nicely - without clumps or balling up once it's started to absorb. A little goes a long way. Facial coverage can be achieved in just 2 - 3 pumps. There was no stinging with this product. My skin is sensitive and doesn't always react well to products, but this one feels great, I don't get any oiliness or breakout, and my skin feels is starting to look less dull and more evenly toned. After having kids my skin tone became splotchy and I have spots that have uneven coloration... almost like I peeled off a scab and the color just didn't come back. One one side of my face there are areas that lack color, however, on the other side I have some more brown splotches. These are probably things I'm more sensitive to noticing, but I'd been looking for a product to help with these issues, and I think given some time, Obagi will come through. I haven't seen much in the way of fine line improvement, but hey, I'm in my 50's and that goes along with aging.

I highly recommend this product!
summary: I absolutely love Obagi C-Peptide Complex

reviewText: Wife's review- I am currently pregnant and my skin is a mess. I have hyperpigmentation, acne, dry & oily areas.  I don't typically use new skin products when I'm having such trouble with my skin, but I figured it couldn't get much worse... And wow, was I ecstatic about the results!  My acne started clearing up, hyperpigmentation spots are less prominent, and over all my skin is brighter and firmer after use. And I've only been using it ~2 weeks!  I've used so many expensive and various brands of skin products that I've lost count. I've never had such obvious and fast results before. This is very pricey, but  if the results stick, I would certainly purchase.

I already take good care of my skin and exfoliate regularly and use good serums/creams, so usually adding a new product doesn't always make a dramatic difference. After using this Obagi for almost two weeks I'd say that there is an improvement in evenness of color and texture in my skin. I've had no adverse reactions, breakouts or irritations from the product and I think it does a good job of adding moisture without being heavy. It's a light cream and takes about two pumps to cover my full face and neck. I very much like the citrus scent of this product versus the flowery scent of many other products in this class. I usually layer with a moisturizer with sunscreen which seems a good combination that is not greasy but well protecting.
summary: Nicely moisturizing and skin tone evening, with a light and pleasing citrus scent.

reviewText:
At age 63, I thought it was time to try a product that helps minimize visible signs of skin aging.  Obagi Professional-C peptide complex sounded like a good place to start because it is advertised to improve facial firmness, tone, wrinkles and fine lines.

I gave it a try for three weeks, but also wanted to see if this one ounce tube was worth the cost.  I took a photo of myself before I started using the serum, and then another photo three weeks later.  Other than a shorter haircut and a smile, I cant see any difference in facial appearance or skin quality.  I still have the same eye puffiness and wrinkles Ive always had.  I made my poor husband be a part of this tooas much as he didn't want to be negative, he admitted to not seeing any changes or improvements either.  If we both have to scrutinize this hard, Obagi Professional-C cant be doing much.

Maybe others have better luck with this product, but I won't be using it again.  I did learn something, thougha smile seems to camouflage facial imperfections just as well as many beauty products.  To me, the second photo does look better, but Im certain its because of a shorter, lighter haircut and a simple smile.
summary: Little To No Improvement After Three Weeks Of Use

reviewText:
This serum works to reduce wrinkles. However at its price level now, other products I have used, that are less expensive have worked just as well.
The 2 ingredients:  Kinetin and Zeatin that the ad states are the key ingredients are 19th and 20th down on the list of ingredients. The primary ingredient is water and then sweet almond oil.
There is huge list of components making up this serum. If you have any allergies you should make sure to check the ingredient list that is shown on the ad accompanying this product.
It works, but the price is high.

I found the texture of Obagi Professional C to be between a serum and a very lightweight cream. It went on smoothly and the coverage was just right with three pumps. It is almost scent free but there is a tiny whisper of a citrus scent. After it had absorbed into my skin, I felt a slight tingle, noting big but there was definitely a reaction. It left my skin feeling smooth without any tightness. I can't speak to long term use on wrinkle appearance, it's only been a week. The container is very small so be sure you take the size into account when purchasing.

I've been using Obagi's Professional-C Peptide Complex on my face for several weeks now, and I'm very pleased with the results. My skin looks smoother and feels firmer. The fine lines I've been developing are hidden and  my face looks fresher. Since I prefer to skip makeup, this makes me especially happy. I've gotten several compliments on how youthful my skin looks - something that hasn't happened since my late forties.

It goes on in small pumps and you don't need very much at all. It massages pleasantly and quickly into the skin without a trace of oiliness. What fragrance it possesses is very mild and agreeable. (Likely it's considered odorless but I'm odor-sensitive and tolerate few fragrances.)

The main ingredients - kinetin and zeatin - really do work. Looking in the mirror is all the proof I need that the claim is true. It far out performs my usual skin creams. I didn't use it this morning and my skin still feels nicer than usual.  You could say that I love everything about Obagi's Professional-C Peptide Complex except the price - it's simply prohibitive for many of us- so I will be looking for more reasonably priced skin products that contain similar ingredients.

update 3/10/2017:  I have used about 90% of this product.  I cannot see any difference or improvement in circles, wrinkles or spots.

I like the formulation:  It is a light cream in a pump.  No smell at all that I notice (yay).  I wear it morning and night and it did not irritate or dry.  This would not be a moisturizer for most people, but is perfect for me, since I really don't need a moisturizer and have bought serums in the past.  I am at the age where I need a little more heft to my skin products and this seems like a perfect consistency.

I'm targeting my under eye circles/lines and a particular sunspot.  I will update over time if I see the great results I'm seeing from other reviewers.

This Obagi SPF 30 sunscreen goes on smoothly with a nice matte finish. I like to use this on my face and tops of hands. It does, however, smell like a typical sunscreen. It really works well, but the price isn't worth the amount in the bottle. I've tried other sunscreens that work just as well for a far lesser price.

This sunscreen works as advertised.  I've been using it for a few weeks now on, particularly on weekends when I go running in the Florida sun and do yard work, and there was no evidence of skin tanning or burn.  The bottle is rather small, so there isn't an apparent bang for your buck here over more economical sunscreen choices.  The cream is extracted from the bottle via a pump, but in order to get enough of it to suitably coat one's face, a lot of pumping has to occur first.  Although it could serve as a post-shower or post-shave moisturizer for the face, it doesn't fit that purpose as well as something like Eucerin.
summary: Works well.  Seems geared toward facial application only.

reviewText:
I love the way this sunscreen feels on my skin - soft and silky and not at all greasy or oily.  It seems to work as a sunscreen even though it is only 30 SPF.  It is a broad spectrum lotion, and has extra ingredients that are supposed to help prevent skin aging.

However, for me, this is just not a practical product,.  A general rule of thumb is to use a shot glass amount of sunscreen.  I think this whole container holds about a shot glass worth of product, 1.7 ounces.  It is supposed to be reapplied at least every two hours, and if you sweat or swim, you are supposed to use a different water resistant sunscreen.  It does pump out in a small stream, so you don't end up pumping more into your hand than you need.

While this is a high-quality product, I think it depends on its good brand name to justify such a high price.  The ingredients, no matter how good they feel on my skin, don't justify the price.  Or the need for frequent replacement because this stuff just doesn't go all that far.

Even though I like using this, it is not going to be part of my skin protection arsenal.  I'm going back to the more common drugstore stuff, and splurging on something else.
summary: Tiny Bottle, Just Not Practical for Everyday Use

reviewText: This contains many of the usual chemical sunscreens. I loved the silky feel of the product on my face. I like the pump and sealed container. Unfortunately my skin had a reaction to something in this as my face became itchy and red after applying it. I used it on my face after cleaning it with water in the morning. I tried it the second day with the same results. It may be the vitamin C or the Homosalate. I do have sensitive pale skin. Product is just not for me.

reviewText:
Pros:
The product itself is terrific.  It's got a great antioxidant (vitamin C) which has been proven to build cell regeneration in aging skin, combined with ingredients that block both UVA and UVB rays (the rays that will sunburn you AND the rays that will age you.)  And it goes on with a smooth, matte finish that I've never seen in drugstore brands, or any brand that costs less than $25.  It's probably at least in the top 3 sunscreens I've ever used.

Cons:
That cost.  I got it for free because I'm a Vine Voice -- I can't imagine shelling out $72 for such a small quantity.  On a related (downside) note, the packaging is this tiny pump that only pumps out a little at a time.  To get the necessary coverage on my face -- because sunscreen is not the thing you want to skimp on - I need to pump this sucker a good 8-9 times.  That tries my patience, and, if you're someone who isn't familiar with the science behind sunscreen and the necessity of making sure you really cover your face, is going to lead to insufficient coverage. And what's the point of blocking UVA/UVB rays if you don't actually put enough on?  So, at the very least, I think they need to change the packaging to encourage women to get the sun care they actually need.

I'd give the product itself 5 stars easy, but that bad packaging requires a few star knock-offs.  So, 3 stars.

A decent spf 30 skin protectant by Obagi Professional with 10 percent vitamin c for a youthful appearance. However, on the bottle it clearly says not intended for sweating or swimming. When I put sunscreen on, I do mainly wear it for sun exposure when it's hot out (sweating) or swimming (pool or ocean). This is more of an everyday sunscreen that helps with wrinkles and complexion versus a full on sunscreen you slather on in the summer. Just a tiny pump goes a long way. I focus on the areas around my eyes and where I tend to see fine lines, mainly. It leaves my skin very soft and youthful and does work well for mild sun exposure.
summary: I focus on the areas around my eyes and where I tend to see fine lines, mainly

reviewText: This product comes form the Obagi Professional care skin care line and it is unique in what is has to offer.  It is an SPF cream with vitamin C.  One never sees skin care companies create a product that combine these two ingredients in one product.  In the past I always had to use SPF cream separately nd layer it to my vitamin C serum, but this product is an exception  The ingredient list is as following:  Active ingredients: Avobenzone 3% (sunscreen), Homosalate 8% (sunscreen), Octisalate 5% (sunscreen), Octocrylene 2.79% (sunscreen), Oxybenzone 3% (sunscreen), Inactive ingredients: ascorbic acid, citrus grandis (grapefruit) peel extract, fragrance.  I mean how many types of sunscreen ingredients can one ask for?  This product will definitely provide multiple benefits to the skin.  The only catch may be for people with sensitive skin (and i am not one of them).  Thsi product contains fragrance so if one is llergic to fragrance that may be a deal breaker.  But if the light fragrance is not oyur concern, thsi is a must have product on your shelf for daily daytime skin care routine.
summary: Vitamin C sunscreen product for Obagi Professional line

reviewText: I like this sunscreen very much. It is a smooth, silky cream that goes on very matte and light. It has an extremely delicate and pleasant scent that is very refreshing. reviewText:
This is a tiny pump container of sunscreen. It sells on Amazon for a crazy high price (to me) and I was curious to see what the big deal was. The pump dispenses a thin stream of lotion which has a light citrus fragrance which is completely overrun by sunscreen scent. On me it really lingered. I could never wear this on my face.

The up side is how great this feels on my skin. It is like velvet, no greasy slick or sticky mess. I put it on my arms and the skin actually looked better, more hydrated and smooth. Unfortunately the sunscreen-y smell overwhelmed me. I can get that for a couple dollars at Walgreens.

reviewText: This is by far the best facial sunscreen I have ever used. It goes on smooth & dries with zero shine. It's pretty amazing. My skin feels rose petal soft. There is a noticeable fragrance but it dissipates almost immediately which is a huge relief because I hate having any type of fragrance on my face. I apply Physicians Formula Organic Wear 100% Natural Tinted Moisturizer on top of this & my skin remains totally free of shine. I have no idea how they do it. Normally I need to use pressed powder by Organic Wear to reduce the shine, but with this Obagi sunscreen, it is now totally unnecessary. Prior to this I was using Meaningful Beauty Anti-Oxidant Day Crme, Broad Spectrum SPF 20 Moisturizer with Vitamin C & was pretty happy with it until trying Obagi. If you are a fan of Vitamin C skin care like I am, I highly recommend Avalon Organics Vitamin C Cleansing Milk. It does a lovely job & feels amazing. Overall, this is a fantastic product.

There is a huge benefit to adding C-Serum to suntan lotion - it protects the top layers from additional sun damage, while replenishing the deeper layers.

But there is also a huge challenge - the C-Serum has a short shelf life (it breaks down, becomes inert). My bottle expires in just 8 months, which means I basically have to use it up this Spring/Summer.

After the best use date, it is my belief the sun block will still work, but the L-Ascorbic acid will have oxidized.

I will add that the C-Serum definitely works, it does wonderful things for the skin. But this is not the cheap sunscreen you lather on. It comes in a small bottle, it's more like a cream, just apply a thin layer every few hours as needed.

I'm also aware that the current trend is higher SPF (like 80 & 100), but I personally believe that SPF 30 is fine for most situations (unless you're in high altitude, on the water all day, or something like that). FYI, SPF-30 blocks 97% of UVB rays, and SPF-50 blocks 98%. So I don't think that's enough of a difference to worry about.

For anyone interested, you can mix up your own batch at home. There are two distinct advantages. First, the cost is only pennies per batch (as opposed to $50-$70 per bottle). The second is, you avoid the problem of short shelf life of C-Serum products. If you mix as you go, you don't have to worry about the bottle expiring. Here's how:

You can buy powdered L-Ascorbic Acid online (about $20 per kilogram), and simply mix with your favorite sunscreen. It goes bad after a couple days (when L-Ascorbic Acid turns yellow, it's oxidized and no longer works), so only make small batches at a time. Keep that in mind with your Obagi as well - if it comes out yellow or clumpy, the C-Serum has oxidized. You can also mix with your favorite night cream, or with vegetable glycerin for a normal daily serum.

I love this product, my only complaint is the price. The short shelf life really can't be avoided, just be aware of this.
summary: Love the idea of adding C-Serum to suntan lotion. But it's pricey w/ a short shelf life. There is a mix-at-home option

reviewText: I didn't find anything with this product that even remotely justifies the price.  Additionally, the product I received expires in less than 7 months.  That seems like a very short shelf life for something like sun care.  The spray is quick to go on but as one other reviewer has commented, it is thick like a primer.  I will probably not continue to use this as it feels as though it may cause me to break out.  I recommend sticking with normal sun care products and avoid overpriced sprays that do not provide any further functionality.

I'd heard a lot about the Obagi brand, but hadn't used it myself largely.  This Professional-C is a sunblock with vitamin C to help protect against sun damage.  It goes on smoothly and though the ingredients include "fragrance" the sunblock seemed scentless to me.  I didn't find it greasy nor did it leave white streaks.  I did like that it felt weightless and is colorless.  At $70 for 40g, it is pricier than my other sunblocks - I'm not sure whether I'm willing to splurge on it for continued use.

reviewText:
As I understand it, this sunscreen is not for use while sweating or swimming.  It seems to be more of a primer to use under make-up. It absorbs almost instantly, leaving a smooth surface. The fragrance is very subtle. Re-apply every two hours. Rinse with water to remove.

reviewText:
I expected this to be a little better. I suppose I had high hopes based off my previous experiences with buying various products of this brand.

The lotion smells good and mostly rosy at first, but then really dwindles down quickly to just a perfume smell and not like roses at all. All of the scent goes away rather quickly, though, too.

The moisturization was not as much as I expected either. Usually Loccitane lotions and creams are very rich and long lasting on the skin. This one wasn't like that, even my hands felt dry after just an hour or two, which is very unusual for the brand. I buy a lot of their body products, as well as face and eye creams. They've always been very luxe feeling on the skin... very rich, very moisturizing, etc. I do realize this one is called a body milk, which typically does indicate a lighter lotion, but I guess I just didn't expect it to be this light. I will use it up, but I will continue my search for a rose scented body cream or lotion.

This bottle is very cute with a little gold colored flip top opening. It will be hard getting the lotion out once the bottle gets low.

I have loved pretty much every L'Occitane product I have tried, so I had no hesitation about buying this in full size despite never having tried a sample.  And, as I expected, this is another wonderful product.

First off, this definitely does have a rose scent.  So if you do not like that scent in your body care products, you should avoid this.  Because the scent lingers.  I use this after a shower at night, just on my legs, and I can still smell a bit of the rose the next morning.  (I don't like floral perfumes but I do like floral scents in bath and body products...)  I happen to love the scent of this.  It's not too strong and it's not cloying, but it's also definitely detectable.  It's basically just at the right level for my preference.

This is super moisturizing.  I would say it was a lotion in terms of consistency.  Definitely thinner than, say, a body cream or body butter, and able to be squeezed out of a relatively small opening in the top of the bottle.  But thicker than an oil.  It is easy to distribute across the surface of the skin and it absorbs pretty quickly and without leaving residue.  It has not irritated my skin (and this is something I *do* have to watch for in body products, because a lot of fragranced lotions tend to give me hives or welts -- but this one doesn't after a week of use).

You can see the full ingredients list if you zoom in on the image of the back of the container.  What I really like is that this has a bunch of actual rose extracts and oils (although it does also contain artificial fragrance and dyes), plus the usual sunflower oil and shea butter and glycerin for moisturizing purposes.

In the end, I love how the scent lingers and this has been quite moisturizing (as well as non-irritating), so I'm a fan.
summary: has a lovely rose scent that lingers

reviewText: First, I'll give you a tip: This appears to be virtually the same as the Dermablend Quick-Fix Concealer Stick, which I use on my face. So if you're buying this for your body and it matches your face's skin tone as well, you can use it on both -- at least I have, with no ill effects. This stick is absolutely fantastic for truly covering nearly anything you want to hide -- though it might sometimes take more than one application. It's worth carrying with you if you're using the Leg and Body makeup, because I've found that that can rub off even if you've used the Dermablend powder or spray fixative, and you might need touchups. Like the Quick-Fix Concealer Stick, this goes on very smooth and generally stays put if you don't put a bunch of friction on it, and if you match the color it's dang near invisible. Of course, you must match the color exactly, because Dermablend colors are very precise. I recommend ordering a free color match kit from the Dermablend website. It's really hit and miss if you try to go by the colors shown on your monitor.
