Another reviewer said it was a warm pink, but I disagree because I think it's more neutral than warm. It's bright on my fair skin so I need to go very light with Petal Pink blush so I don't look like a drunken clown.

I've been using this and really like it because it's quite natural looking: https://www.amazon.com/Neutrogena-Healthy-Blends-Sheer-Highlighting/dp/B00U2VQYZM/ref=sr_1_6_s_it?s=beauty&ie=UTF8&qid=1468255591&sr=1-6&keywords=neutrogena+blush

The Julep blush in petal pink color is a true pink with no overpowering tones, and easy to apply with one stroke of the brush. The price is on the higher side, and no brush is included - however the product is good quality, doesn't itch or irritate the skin. It kind of wears off around 6-8 hours which is ok. The color i photo looks more hot pink than it is. Massaging the color in a bit with the hand made it more even, that's just a personal preference. The price point and lack of brush is preventing me giving it 4 stars.
summary: and easy to apply with one stroke of the brush

reviewText:
The Petal Pink is a very pretty color.  I'm fair in complexion and it looks quite flattering and natural.  It is well pigmented so I only need a bit for each cheek.  It reminds me of Bare Eccentuals blush in the way it looks and wears.
The compact is nice and has a little mirror, and there is a fairly generous amount of product.  It doesn't come with a brush or any kind of applicator.  I have been usinf a standard blush brush.  I give it about 2 passes and a tap.  Some loose powder ends back up on the color pot; it isn't a very hard press, so it lifts easily.
It wears for 8 hours in normal wear, without a lot of sweating.
summary: It performs like a mineral blush, used lightly, it is very natural looking

reviewText: I have previously used urban decay afterglow as my go to blush, but I actually like this one better. The pigment isn't as harsh on my fair skin. The powder is more delicate and gives a much more natural look. It seems to last all day and makes me look naturally pretty. The powder is pressed nicely in the durable compact. I use a regular blush brush to apply this. The powder smells nice, which I noticed as soon as I opened the compact. Overall a great blush, that I will plan to stock in the future!

My wife normally does not purchase high end blush or marker pencils because she prefers to use that money on makeup that really counts such as a high quality foundation or lipstick.  She was really amazed by this Jelup Glow Pore minimizing Blush.  Compared to the cheaper brands she has tried (and even a few of the more expensive ones) this blush tends to go on very easily and does seem to minimize pores a bit.  The effect is not huge (she does not use a whole lot of blush at one time) but it is noticeable.  Overall this seems like a very good product that requires only small quantities to achieve the desired effect.  The one downside is that this does seem a bit expensive when you consider how little you will use on a regular basis.
summary: Great Product But A Bit Pricey

reviewText: I like Julep products and I like this blush too. I have the petal pink and it is nice, but very pink. If you use it with a light hand and a blush brush, it will give you a natural looking glow.  Plus, it will last a long time. Nice blush and recommended.

While often people think of Julep as a nail polish brand they've also been branching into makeup and skincare in the last couple of years. I've had the chance to try quite a few of them since I've been a member of their Julep Maven subscription box since February of 2016 and have found the products to be hit or miss.  To date I've tried their lip products, eye liners, and eye shadow, but this was my first time trying one of their blush products.

Opening this up, the package reminded me a lot of other Julep products. It feels premium and substantial. Their packaging always seems to be a bit on the thick/heavy side to me. On the plus side it doesn't feel cheap, but on the negative side it does mean that the products can be a bit bulky and probably take up more space than they should, which isn't great if you travel.  (You could depot into a Z-Palette to save on space but I personally wouldn't recommend that with Julep's products since in my past experience they've had REALLY strong adhesive and I ended up damaging the makeup a bit when removing it.)

I thought the blush itself looked pretty close in color to the picture on Amazon, which is good since I sometimes find variation between how the product looks in Julep's photos and how it looks in real life.  I think of the Petal Pink I received as being a bright, true pink.  It can look a little shocking in the pan, but I've found it to be incredibly wearable, in part because it's very buildable so you can control the saturation of the color.

I applied this using my Sephora Pro #59 brush.  I swirled the brush in the blush, tapped the handle against my arm to remove any excess, and then gently applied to the apples of my cheeks.  (I hold the brush towards the end to apply less pressure and therefore a more subtle amount of color.)  Using this technique I found it very easy to control the amount of color.  One swipe gave me a more subtle look but repeating allowed me to build the color into a bolder pink if so desired.  (Definitely too much for a day look but quite cute with a bold pink lip for a night look.)

I also think this wears well.  As long as I'm consistent with my skincare routine, use a primer before, and a setting powder or spray afterwards I find my cheeks look great for a few hours of wear.  Though if I'm applying this in the morning for work I do tend to touch up 8 hours later if going out for the night.

As far as the claim of minimizing pores goes, I can't say that this brush emphasizes or de-emphasizes them more than any other powder blush I've tried.  I do think in general cream blushes are the most flattering when it comes to pores, but for powder blushes this seems about average.

Pores aside, I think this is a great blush.  I love the shade and buildability.
summary: Very pretty, buildable color with Petal Pink

reviewText: This was my first use of Julep makeup. I will say that I was happy to see that the 'petal pink' color does apply lighter on the skin than it looked in the box (I thought it was going to be dark). I was a little disappointed to see that this compact comes with a mirror (nice to have when you are away from your vanity) but doesn't come with a brush. Luckily, I have several makeup brushes that I keep when I apply at home which I used. I will have to purchase a smaller brush to keep with me if I expect to take this in my purse when I go out. This goes on smoothly, light and has a nice finish on my skin.
summary: Nice blush, only wish it had come with a brush for applications on the go

reviewText: This blush applies really easily.  You barely have to put any on your brush in order for you to see color.  This shade is a bit bright for me, but it looks pretty.  I just have to be careful not to get too much on my brush.  I have very pale skin.  This shade would be better for someone who is a little darker, or more tan.  The blush is high quality, and soft.  The powder doesn't go everywhere.  I don't have large pores, so I can't speak to the pore minimizing that it advertises, but if you are looking for a pretty blush that stands out, give this one a try.

I have combo skin with large pores on my cheeks and nose.  While this blush doesn't minimize those pores (as it claims to do), it's still a lovely blush that lasts on me all day.

The color I have is Petal Pink, which is a pretty shade that looks like you have a winter chill to your skin.  I tend to gravitate towards pinky blushes since they work well with my fair skin tone (I wear MAC foundation in NW20), and this is a pretty pink with a touch of coral.  It's perfect for spring and summer.

As a point of reference, the photo shows this Jouer blush in Petal Pink on the top left.  The top right is Tarte's Amazonian Long-Wear Blush in Amused, below that is MAC's Sheertone Blush in Pinch O'Peach (it's actually a pink color), and on the bottom left is NARS' powder blush in Mata Hari.  The Jouer blush in Petal Pink has the most coral tone to it.

Over my primer and foundation, this lasts all day on me.  It's a really nice product!
summary: Doesn't minimize pores, but it's a beautiful, long-wearing blush

reviewText:
Julep has become a product I use for my nails. I love the colors, the ease of application and the staying power of the nail polish. Now, I have tried Julep's blush.

 I am glad that this product was offered to me. The color of this pink blush is very bright, and I may not have tried it. However, the brightness of the blush is not the color delivered to your cheeks. Applied lightly with a blush brush, we have a light pink hue glow. This is lovely, one of the prettiest blush colors I have tried. I have light skin, and this blush brightens my face. The glow looks natural, and is not heavy or too much. I very much like this blush. The compact has a mirror, and this completes this small blush compact.

Recommended. prisrob 07-02-16

I'd heard of the Julep brand for nail polish. Nail polish doesn't interest me, but blush sure did. This comes in a beautiful box. The pink looks really really pink in the box. When you apply it, it's just like the name, it glows. My search for the most complimentary blush is over. The color looks very natural. Love it! I look forward to trying more Julep products.

I am pale with cool tones. It has always been hard for me to find a shade that works without making me look clownish. This is an excellent blush shade (petal pink) for light complexions. It is enough of a shade to bring out my cheekbones without looking obvious or overdone.

I used a makeup sponge since this does not come with an applicator. Lasted all day and I still looked good in the evening. Packaging is very nice and this did not open in my purse on its own. Many have! Very sleek well made container. Super happy with the product and the shade.
summary: A+ from me, best blush I own

reviewText: I have never used Julep products before but am happy with this pore minimizing blush. The color is TRUE pink and goes on just as easily as described. It does not come with any type of brush but I have a nice set so it was not an issue for me. The color seemed to last all day but I think the price tag is a bit high. I have worn many high in brand products that don't charge this much for a blush. If you are not worried about price then product is great.
summary: I have never used Julep products before but am happy with this pore minimizing blush

reviewText:
The tone of this blush is a bright, rose pink, probably most appropriate for cool skin tones.  It has no orange or gold undertones to it, making it a "true" pink.

It is fairly fine milled, so it goes on smoothly, but unlike some of my other finely milled face powders and blushes (Hourglass in particular) it doesn't seem to have the staying power after it's applied.  I noticed that after work (8 hours from application more or less) I had almost no blush on my face.  I'm not a face toucher, so I have to chalk this up to the blush itself.

I also noticed that it tended to cling to dry areas, so the first time I applied it I actually ended up putting another layer of moisturizer on my face, then reapplying my foundation and blending it out before reapplying the blush.  This may be an effect of its "Pore minimizing" feature, but I don't prefer it, as my cheekbones don't really have large pores - I have larger pores along my t-zone, where I would never apply blush.

I have no idea how this qualifies as anti-aging.  That seems to be purely tacked on as a concession to the trend.  It is a fairly bright, youthful pink, so maybe that's it?

The box that it comes in is gorgeous.  I love the shiny black compact and the generously sized mirror.  It also closes securely!
summary: Lovely blush in a vibrant true pink, but it's "features" seem to be lacking.

reviewText:
So wanted to like this, but at this price point would NOT recommend this blush.  First of all, it's not highly pigmented, and that's exactly what you would expect from a blush this expensive.  The color in the pan looks dynamite, however the color payoff is POOR.  Am very light, so this should really show up on me.  Also, it does not even last long.  Also kind of pearlescent, which I'm not crazy about.

Pore minimizing?  Who has large pores on their cheek bones?  Large pores usually appear on the nose or down the center of the face. Cannot see how this is any different than CoverGirl's Cheekers, which can be had for less than $4.00.

Packaging is VERY nice and a good mirror.  Shade is pleasing and natural.
great tool to dry damp hair and stayed at one time. I've got straight fine hair and this has improved my hair.
Made my hair frizzy. I found this hard to use. Some of the bristles look like they are fixing to fall out, and I've only used this a few times. I was wanting to love this, but I don't.
I know use this more then I use my curling irons.  I really can't complain about anything.  I love Hot Tools and I Love this Hot Brush
summary: My favorite Hot Tools product yet, and I love all of them that I have

reviewText: I love it! Heats up fast & does a nice job. My hair doesn't get caught.

I've had several hot brush stylers in the past and liked them. This one seems a bit heavy and I'm having more difficulty using it. That being said..it does what it advertises and though it takes me more time than I'd like, it does turn out large loose curls on my medium fine blonde hair.

I am really liking the scent. The hold awesome. Wish it made hair much more shiny, but that can be remedied by just applying a topcoat of a lighter pomade. I like to use a wod of of it as a base in combo with another pomade, but it should be sufficient for most guys to use on its own. Good stuff. It may be a little more pricey that other pomades, but this one is well worth it. I love the tin it comes int too - the top screws on to keep your grease secure. This is now my go-to grease for my daily routine. You can get a kick-a$$ pomp, executive contour, side-part, or sleek slick back with this grease. Get some!
summary: Great grease to slick your hair. Get some!

reviewText:
This is my first oil pomade.  I'll never go back to the regular water based.  Such better control.
Has a prominent green apple smell; which does wear off after a while.  Your hair stays in place
and no crunch or crusty aspect.  Descent shine.
summary: Such better control. Has a prominent green apple smell

reviewText: Pomade is too oily for my taste
Got a new haircut at a local barber shop and they recommend this pomade. Great product. Smells good and has a great hold. Much better than the others Ive tried and doesn't flake.
summary: ... new haircut at a local barber shop and they recommend this pomade

reviewText: This dries crispy and crunchy.  This should be sold as hair gel, seriously.  I'm not giving up on this brand though as I haven't tried their petroleum based pomades yet.
summary: This should be sold as hair gel as it dries crispy and crunchy.  I don't like it.

reviewText:
Good hold, washes out easily. If applied to wet hair, it leaves a nice(not greasy) shine to hair. Holds most the day for me, and my hair is on the fine side, and length is average male short hair.

I'm not crazy about the smell. It's very sweet, and fruity. Think pina colada. The good news is scent fades fast. I prefer the scents of Steadfast, and Suavicito X(pink container) over this. Steadfast has a more masculine aqua cologne scent, and Suavicito X has a fresh clean scent. Also similar to Layrite, but Layrite with it's vanilla Glade candle scent is my least favorite.
summary: It's good stuff, but not crazy about the fruity scent

reviewText: The pomade is okay but a bit too shinny for my taste

Excellence!  I was really impressed with the product.
1.  This stuff holds.  The pomade is easy to work with and where you put it in your hair, it stays there.
2.  It holds for loooong time.  All the quality poms,I've used have done a good job at staying in your hair,but Reuzel does an especially good job.
3.  The smell. It's great!  The best of any Pom I've tried.
4. The container. It's a metal tin. Most poms come in a plastic container , but the
Metal plus the art work is great.

SIDENOTE:  this Pom for me was hard on my hair. Experienced a little hair loss because of it.
As other reviews have noted, these face gels are for short term use. If you are okay with that, then these have potential for occasional use.
I don't see any difference but they do feel nice and cooling while they are on and for a little while afterwards.

In reviewing this product, I've enlisted the help of my wife who is much more the natural market than am I.  She's also fairly critical when it comes to products and skeptical when it comes to relatively wild claims to do things that then happen only in moderation. The product is produced by Ulta Beauty, a chain of cosmetic superstores out of Bolingbrook, IL.  Their lines include all kinds of cosmetics and some very big names.  They even have two stores (apparently) in my home city of Philadelphia.

These gels are placed around the mouth and on the forehead for a period of ten minutes at a go.  Its suggested to use them once a week or more often if you, as consumer, think its necessary.  I'm pretty sure that skyn (since when is capitalization a marketing brand?) would love if you used the ICELAND product every day.

I will suggest that the actual gels are simply weird feeling.  They feel like theyve been refrigerated (they werent), like theres some kind of moisturize on their surface (there doesnt seem to be) but they do feel effective.  To call them gels is probably an oversimplification.  These are peptide-packed (infused) transdermal patches, but a far cry from nicotine patches.  These are comfortable, easy to use and relaxing.
The gels seem to be some kind of soft cloth with the gel material facing the skin.  They are individually and carefully wrapped and require a little work to get out of their casings whole.  But once applied, they cool wonderfully and feel great against the skin.  After use, twice, my wife is happy to report that she likes the product a lot, wants to buy more and (you're welcome, skyn) and use them more often than once a week.  She really believes they alleviated wrinkles and I agree with her.

Be aware that we are not in a position to offer advice as to the long term effects (or lack of effects) of using the product.  I suspect peoples mileage in this regard will vary based on their own complexions, how often they use them and for how long.  But I know my wife is satisfied and thats good enough to warrant their continued use.  Having gone through a bunch of products over the years, that she is satisfied makes for a happy surprise.
When I say that it feels like theres moisturizer on the gels, a finger test seems to come up dry.  But theres actually a lot going on here. The ingredient list (cribbed from the website) includes: Water/Aqua/Eau, Glycerin, Olea Europea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Angelica Archangelica Root Water*, Sodium Hydroxide, Acrylates Copolymer, Agar, Ginkgo Biloba Leaf Extract, Hydrolyzed Elastin, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Caprylyl Glycol, Perfluorodecalin, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, PEG-75 Shea Butter Glycerides, Glycosphingolipids, Xanthan Gum, Ubiquinone, Thymus Vulgaris (Thyme) Flower/Leaf Extract, Buddleja Davidii Extract, Rubus Chamaemorus (Arctic Cloudberry) Seed Oil, Oxycoccus Palustris (Arctic Cranberry) Seed Oil, Aluminum Glycinate, Butylene Glycol, Polysorbate 60, Phenoxyethanol, Benzoic Acid, Dehydroacetic Acid, Propylene Glycol, Sorbic Acid, 1,2-Hexanediol.

The website also points out the gels are: Free of parabens, petroleum, mineral oil, chemical sulfates and phthalates. 100% vegan and cruelty-free. Dermatologist tested for sensitive skin.

All in all, a really good product that I believe we will be reordering in coming days.  As well recommended as any product weve used twice can be.
summary: Review: skyn ICELAND Hydro Cool Face Gel.  Exec Summary: Great product, seems to do as advertised!

reviewText: I have used all of the skyn Iceland Hydro Cool Firming Face Gels!  I really like these for the vertical lines on the right side of my face, the side of my face I sleep on.  These are so easy to use and they only have to stay on for 10 minutes.  It gives my face a tingling sensation besides puffing up my deep lines.  I used them on both sides of my mouth as I have lines there also.  I used them before I put on my make-up and liked my skin better.  There are 4 forehead patches and 4 frown line patches.  I would like ones for just the face lines.  These are great to use before you go out on the town.
summary: These worked for me so see if they work for you!

reviewText:
I'm 30 years old. This should have worked wonders for my soft lines. I was willing to ignore the list of ingredients (terrible!) if it would erase my fine lines for a wedding I was attending. The cooling felt nice for like a second and that's about it. I didn't see any appearance difference and lets not even talk about long term use. I used it all up and nope, nothing. My suggestion: don't waste your money.
If you want to know what has worked wonders and you won't even believe it: bone broths. Google it. Probably better than any product.

This product is one of those ones where it sounds great, but I am not sure if the "results" are placebo or not.  It feels nice though and smells nice.  I can't say that I saw any noticeable difference when I only did one side of my face.

I like this product's cooling sensation, but as a Botox substitute you can expect only so much. There is no expectation that this product is going to last for months let alone days. I applied this and waited five minutes.....no change. Ten minutes and my target points looked more relaxed but really there was no miraculous improvement. My skin looks pretty good because I use a lot of moisturizers and see a dermatologist on a regular basis. The flaws I see on a regular basis are apparently insignificant or non-existent because I get a lot of compliments about my fresh looking skin and lack of laugh lines, crows feet, and wrinkles.
Anyway this product didn't perform miracles and didn't make me instantly 30 again. The effects lasted a few hours. The next morning I went back to being me.
Try this if you will. The results may be better, it does have a great cooling feeling, but it is only a temporary topical fix and not a Botox substitute.
summary: Fine For A Night Out But That Is It

reviewText: Honestly didn't see were they made any difference in my face. However I can't speak for everyone since all skin types are different. My skin is dry and I don't have a lot of lines so they don't run deep. I didn't find this product made any difference for me personally .

I'm always highly skeptical when products give a specific number of minutes of how quickly it will work, or how many years/months of damage are rolled back.

The product claims that doing weekly 10 minute treatments will work like an injection filler and will smooth out your face and also prevent future issues.  On those claims the product seems to produce almost no results.  Maybe a slight improvement immediately after the face gels are removed, but then it soon fades (probably just because the skin is being firmed up by the 'cool').

As a face gel and 'spa' treatment they are pleasant and soothing, unfortunately giving it a poor rating for it's seemingly exaggerated claims.
summary: Soothing and Pleasant, May Not Live up to Claims

reviewText: Feels great on my face.  While I don't think they have a dramatic effect on my appearance, they still are nice to use for pampering and relaxing.  Great gift for new moms!

First of all, I'm 39.  I am not vain and while I enjoy trying new products, I prefer to stick with proven basics as my skin and wallet are very sensitive.  I have noticed a few deeper lines/creases, particularly one large one under my left eye (I was sick for a few years and spent a great deal of time horizontal and on my side, which definitely exacerbated that one spot. I am not/was not bothered by it but my mother has pointed it out on a few occasions and she is the product junky/youth hound).  I still break out, so I'm usually battling that and it doesn't often occur to me that maybe my skin is showing general age as I'm just happy when I have a clear and comfortable skin day.

But I decided to try these as they are not fragranced and I was intrigued, though I was skeptical as my forehead and parentheses are non-issues, or so I thought.

I really like that these are so gentle and not smelly/perfumed; definitely a bonus with my hypersensitive, fair skin.  They are not drippy (like the Juice Beauty patches I reviewed earlier, which were nice but so wet).  They stick without any fuss.

And the results?  Wow. Just wow.  I have bangs so it's not like I'm going to actively invest time and money into my forehead, but even I was impressed by how luminous and youthful, plump and ironed and firm the skin looked.  The results were not as obvious on my parentheses, but still nice for a special day.  I also used one on my neck/under chin area and really liked the extra boost it gave that area, offering a mildly slimmer (temporarily) and tighter profile.

I will definitely keep these on hand for big days and special events. I'm especially thrilled as the lack of a strong odor definitely makes these friendly for my sensitive skin and allergy prone system.
summary: These work and are not drippy, gooey, or perfumey.

reviewText: These face gels are a short-term face firmer, best used before a special event.  The menthol cools and plumps the skin somewhat, reducing the appearance of fine wrinkles.  Certainly not a more long lasting solution like Botox, but doesn't paralyze your face like Botox.  I'm not sure I would repurchase these as I find it difficult to incorporate them into my usual routine.

Nope. This did absolutely nothing. I'm in my mid thirties so I am starting to see wrinkles in my forehead. I thought this might 'diminish' them as the product claimed, but not so much.  I'm not even going to bother posting the before and after pics I took because I legitimately can't tell which is which.
summary: Throw your $$ directly into the trash

reviewText: My wife used these patches to address a few wrinkles around the forehead and mouth. The gel patches were a departure for my wife, who typically uses a cream or serum. As she described, the patches were applied for 10 minutes and felt cool on the skin. There was also a slight tingling sensation. Nothing too horrific though - even when left on for longer than the suggested 10 minute application time. Overall, she found that the patches firmed her skin up and was very pleased with this product.

This product contains a total of 8 individually packed face gels. Four are forehead gels, and 4 contain a pair of smile line gels. So that gives you a total of 4 treatments. The current Amazon price is $35 per package, so that comes to $8.75 per treatment. That is very expensive in my opinion.

These gels are fairly easy to use. Just peel back and apply to freshly cleansed skin. Leave on the skin for 10 minutes and remove. The instructions say to use once a week or whenever you need a quick fix. That, to me, implies the results will last up to one week. While I did notice a little plumping of the skin and diminished lines, the results only lasted a very short time. The results for me were completely gone within an hour or two. That was disappointing. I kept using it once a week for 4 weeks. That continued use made no more improvement in my wrinkles.

The "8 count" referenced in the title does not refer to 8 separate treatments but instead to 4 forehead patches plus 4 pairs of the smile line patches.  If you use both together as I did, this makes 4 treatments.

I'm not sure what is in them that does this, but when you put them on your face, they are much cooler feeling than room temperature.  I didn't think they were uncomfortably cold -- and in fact thought they might feel very good after over doing it in the sun.

I thought my skin looked a very slight amount plumper around my forehead and smile lines, but it was so subtle that I wasn't sure if I only saw it because I wanted to see it.  In any case it didn't seem to last very long so if you want to smooth out wrinkles for an important event, use this maybe the night before, or earlier the day of, the event.

For some reason my package had all forehead gels so this review is specifically for those.

The gels come individually packaged and are very easy to apply. They stick well but they were a bit big for my small forehead (a little past the hairline and eyebrows) but that wasn't a big deal. The gels feel very nice and cooling as you let them sit for the instructed 10 minutes.

I see only a very minor difference afterwards so I'm not entirely sure these are worth the cost. However, they do feel nice and it's easy to apply them and leave them on for 10 minutes while you go about the rest of your routine. I would use them mostly before a big night out or some other special occasion.

Refreshingly cool while on, smoother skin afterward, but on skin with permanent wrinkles it's that .... a nice feeling... you're left with, as opposed to an actual decline (temporary or otherwise) in the look of the wrinkles. They just looked refined, the skin affected enough that from some angles the light seems to be less harsh. I remember my mother having a similar product many years ago and they were stiff and sticky. These come off as easily as they go on, enhancing the sense that you are doing something nice for your face. At $35.00 they're pricey but I'm tempted to see if there's an improved long term effect.

Review of skyn ICELAND Hydro Cool Firming Face Gels:

These firming face gels are a nice, easy to use facial product that appears to be quite good for your skin.  Give yourself an extremely comfortable, cooling, and relaxing 'spa-experience' at home while doing something beneficial for both your mind and your face.

They are called gels but a better description perhaps is that they are specially infused (peptides primarily) and very comfortable facial patches. They can be somewhat delicate so use care when taking them out of the package. Although not on ice, they are nice and
cool.

These are a good part of a lifelong regimen of taking care of your skin. And it is a different way to moisturize than yet another face cream.  Agree with a prior reviewer that these gels are probably best for mild- minimal facial lines around the forehead and mouth. A beneficial muscle relaxing effect is easily achieved with these gels.

One does indeed experience a diminution of those fine lines, albeit temporary and not long-lasting.

Quite possibly a good hallmark of a fine sampled product is the frequency of further purchasing by reviewers.  Yes, I'd buy these gels again and again. They're that nice.

5*: gel product experience

3-4*: short-lived result

3-4*:  cost
summary: Take 10 minutes and care for yourself!

reviewText:
These were fun to use -- the package contains individually wrapped foil packets containing either a forehead gel pack, or two smile line / frownie gel packs.  The product consists of thin layers of gel -- maybe 1/8" thick each -- with a sticky backing.  You pull off the backing and then place the layer of gel on your forehead or on either side of your mouth.  You apply it like you would apply a Biore strip or one of those Breathe-Rite things, although it doesn't feel as sticky on the skin.
The gel feels cool and provides a nice pick-me-up.  It doesn't seem to draw out impurities or clean pores like a mask would -- rather it feels good.  Whether it is effective at helping wrinkles -- I don't know -- but it is a refreshing and relaxing treat.
summary: cooling gel for the smile lines and forehead

reviewText: This is a good product. I'm new to French skincare but I don't think I'm ever going back lol. It was recommended by my dermatologist, he recommended effaclar duo specifically. But I saw this in the trio and figured it was a good deal. If you can use it over a weekend when you will NOT go out in the sun, that's a good bet. Certain products in it make your skin sensitive to the sun, it says that on the packaging. The first time I used it was at night so I didn't notice it, the next morning when I used it and headed to work, my skin was on FIRE. I have sensitive skin and I'm African American so it really REALLY hurt. I didn't get a sun burn thankfully.  The gel cleanser has sort of a minty tingly feeling, the clarifying solution just makes your skin feel clean and soft. I use the duo as a spot treatment if I have a pimple. One day I had a blackhead on my forehead near my eye, I put the duo on it and when I woke up in the morning the pimple was gone. I mean COMPLETELY gone. Again be careful with this product, use it every other day until your skin gets used to it. And don't forget the sunscreen.
summary: Good product but be careful in the sun

reviewText: This product saved my skin. I'm 42 years old...so now fighting wrinkles and acne. Always had oily acne-prone skin...but it was under control until my face care line was discontinued and (no doubt some hormonal shifts as well) contributed to a very stressful face full of problems. This line has been great for me and my skin has finally cleared up (especially breakouts around my mouth and chin)...and the glycolic acid has done wonders for discolorations and fine lines. I would recommend taking it easy with the clarifying solution. I was using it twice a day and "broke out" again...then realized it was a sensitivity reaction to the glycolic acid. I do not have sensitive skin as a general rule...so be mindful if you do. I now use it only once in the evening...and have taken to leaving my face wet after cleansing and applying gently with a cotton pad. The irritation is gone and the results are great. Use the spot treatment as a spot treatment. Sparingly and only where needed. Not on large parts of your face.

Skin was great until I went off pill. 5 mos later I had 4 monstrous zits on my chin. After doing some research I tried this and was pleasantly surprised. It does not wrk over night but after 2-4 wks I saw major results including reductions in oil without irritating my skin.
Excellent I recommend shipping on time, exceeded my expectations !!! very good.

This is a good way to try this skin line.  I have acne and this is a good affordable line to use for acne.  It is drying so I would recommend following the instructions of starting out slow and building up the usage.  I think I will purchase it again.

This kit seems to be effective at reducing redness and minimizing the amount of pimples. I noticed that the cyst type pimples did not get nearly as bad or big and sore as usual, so that is a huge plus. It did seem to dry the skin too much though, so it was necessary to cut back to every other day, or at least use a light moisturizer. For the first several uses, the skin sort of freaked out, but that is normal. Usually, the problem will get worse before it gets better when you try new acne or face clearing products. So, if you try it, or any other new product, don't be discouraged if it seems like your skin is not looking any better or looks a little worse for a week or so - stick it out a few weeks and give it time to really work and bring the dirt, oils, and impurities up out of the skin.

I used this for thirty days. Twice a day. Since using this I saw a big difference in my skin. This is easy to apply. Use fingers put on face. I waited six minutes. Then washed off. This can be used twice a day. The Scent is not overpowering or strong. Did not irritate my sinuses or skin. Overall after time it does work.

My skin is generally very dry, but I get cysts frequently. Probably as a result of using too-rich moisturizers and other comedogenic chemicals. So I took a chance on this 3 step system. At first, I used it only every other day or even less and used all 3 steps. I never experienced peeling or flaking as a result, but I could tell my skin was getting too much. So I backed off to twice a week and eliminated the middle step, the Clarifying Solution. This seems to be a perfect solution for me. The first step, the Medicated Gel Cleanser, seems to be what I need most, so in the future I will try to buy it separately. The 3rd step, the Dual Action Acne Treatment, works very well when applied sparingly to the small spots that need extra help. I really like the 2% salicylic acid in the Medicated Gel Cleanser. I also like the 5.5% benzoyl peroxide in the Dual Action Acne Treatment. It also includes isostearyl alcohol, which some have misread as a drying alcohol. It isn't. The only step that includes drying alcohol, which is denatured alcohol, is the middle step, so if you need that kind of drying, you have the 2nd step. But my skin is already dry, so I now avoid that second step. This is a difficult 3 step system to evaluate for anyone else. I would have thought it would be much too drying for me. But the 1st and 3rd steps work for me when used infrequently and judiciously.
summary: I now use only step 1 and step 3 and get good results

reviewText:
I find it quite outlandish that anything could claim visible results in one day.  You cant fix acne in one day.  This didnt.

However, I am a firm believer that you can help heal acne by being incredibly consistent.  Every day.  Same thing.  This 3-step cleansing helped out teenager in mediating problems.  I tend to think that most things will work up to a certain point but you have to find the right system.  Our teenager got almost nothing from Proactiv even though he used it sort of reliably.

When I get a zit, I tend to just get one or two in the same area on my face. I used this system to remedy the situation.  They did not go away any faster then they would have, had I not used anything.  I see that there are mixed results.  Give this a try if you think it might work for you.  It didn't make a difference to me.
summary: Didn't notice a difference on my skin

reviewText:
Tested the kit on my husband - it did not do much for him at all. He got a few acne, which is something that does not happen very often for him, and doing the whole regimen did very little. Maybe salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide works on teenage skin, but it is not for adults.
Teenage son outright refused to use it, though I suspect it is because the box shows a girl, not a boy. I did not even try using it because I know what the ingredients will do to my skin with rosacea, no, thank you.

My 15 yo daughter has a porcelain peaches and cream complexion and so far has been blessed with less acne than I had as a girl.  When this kit arrived the breakout she had was on her forehead.  They were tiny red spots.

She started using the kit and liked it.  She reported and I saw no signs of irritation.

SUMMARY
As you know when it comes to acne products, results will vary.

My teen used this product on a fairly large breakout of small red spots on her forehead.  They were not the large or even medium size zits that most people think of when someone says, acne.  I mention this because it could be that this product works better on some 'styles' of acne than others.

On the plus side nothing in this system irritated her pale, delicate skin.  The system stopped the breakout and seems to have kept any more zits from appearing.

On the downside, the system didn't zap the zits.  It may have accelerated their decline but they didn't vanish over a period of 3 or 4 days.

A big problem for teens is that 3 steps is a lot.  In fact my daughter would only use this once a day.  Twice was just too much.

Conclusion: I'd say there are good results but not miraculous ones for us.  It might have to do with the type of breakouts she has.  I won't buy more for her because of the time factor and I don't want to have to ride herd on whether she keeps up with this or not.  Other teens have better stick-to-it-iveness so it would be better for them.
summary: Mixed Results and would love if it was a 2 step process

reviewText: This three-step process is a little arduous. Now, subscribing to a multi-step process is pretty easy when the results are spectacular. In fact, one person in this house has so many Proactive elements in his/her regimen that it nearly seems obsessive ... except for the fact that his/her skin is baby smooth and completely gorgeous. Such results were not seen here (at all). So, I think the take-away here is that consumers should stick with the original and the best. For the price of this kit, you could pick up some Proactive and truly, justifiably expect the beginning of clear skin!

With three teenage girls in the house, acne supplies are a must, and the reasons I ordered LA ROCHE-POSAY EFFACLAR 3 STEP SYSTEM. There are times when breakouts are worse than others are, as well as more crucial to be eliminated  on special occasions such as school picture day.

My daughters are not fond of having a three-step system. For me, ten days seems like a rather long time to clear up acne. However, if it is affective when suing on a permanent daily basis in keeping acne away, that is something to consider.

Product Description:
Effaclar Dermatological Acne System treats blemish-prone skin with a three-step targeted system. The first step rids skin of excess oil and tightens the pores, the second step gently exfoliates away dead, dull cells that can get trapped in pores and cause acne, and the third step treats and reduces acne in three days while minimizing irritation. In just 10 days, La Roche Posay Effaclar Dermatological Acne System reduces acne by 60 percent leaving a clear, healthy complexion. medicated gel cleanser 3.4oz. + clarifying solution 3.4oz. + acne treatment 0.7oz.

Brand Story:
Recommended by more than 25,000 dermatologists worldwide, La Roche-Posay offers unique skincare developed with dermatologists for every skin type to complement treatments and promote good skincare practices at home every day.
summary: WOULD BE NICE IF NOT A THREE-PART PROCESS

reviewText:
I'm not acne prone, but I do occasionally get small targeted outbreaks of pimples or blackheads which are contained in small clusters about dime or nickel sized. Left untreated I find these annoying more than anything else. I know they are there, but according to friends and family they are not noticeable.
This is a three step system that performs the following steps like a 1-2-3 step punch. It is supposed to clear up skin in 10 days. There is a twice daily cleanser to be used at morning and night, a toner which is applied with a cotton pad that does not need to be wiped or rinsed off and is used morning and night, and a tube which contains something to zap zits. This goes on about three times per day.
What surprised me was how effectively this removes deeply imbedded dirt. It illustrates how poorly plain old soap and water does on a daily basis. If you have acne or a minor outbreak you may have oily skin that feeds an unhealthy condition. The twice daily cleansing seemed to handle my problem. The zit zapper seemed to almost dissolve the blackhead problem within 48 hours though it was a tad drying. Once the blackhead issue vanished, I stopped using the drying cream.
Overall this was really good and did a remarkable job of taming oily skin. Under a magnifying glass my pores appeared to have closed up. My skin looked smooth, clear, and fresh. It felt very clean.
I would definitely recommend this for a serious problem or even a minor one since it works quickly by attacking the source of the problem.

I have sensitive skin with occasional breakouts around my chin area so thought I'd give this a try. Only tried it once because it stung so bad and it sort of smells like bleach. Decided to give it to my son's girlfriend who has mild to moderate acne. She was only able to use it for a few days because she said that she had a stinging sensation from day one that intensified. She gave up after four days because her skin was so dry and burning that not even putting on lotions helped. (Even putting on sunscreen felt irritating). Based on both of our experiences I'd say use if you have normal to oily/very oily skin and expect some irritation. This is because of the active ingredients in the products but not worth the hassle for us.

So both my daughter and I used this product.  I tend to get hormonal outbreaks and she is a teenager and has more of a tendency to get outbreaks.  For me, it didn't work.  In all fairness, my skin is pretty sensitive to many products.  This definitely caused a reaction.  My skin was puffy and red and hot.  On the flip side, it worked quite well for my daughter.  She had no reaction to it and felt like it helped control the oil she gets in her t-zone.  For that reason I'm giving it a 3 star rating right in the middle.  If you have sensitive skin, you might want to avoid it, but if not, it might be worth a try for you.
summary: Not for those with sensitive skin

reviewText:
So far this 3step system seems to be working well for my pre-teen daughter who is suffering from a bit of acne.
It doesn't seem too harsh for her and with is very easy for her to use. I know it is going to take some time to see results so I will more then likely come back to update this review. But so far so good. Please be consistent with use!
summary: It doesn't seem too harsh for her and with is very easy for her to use

reviewText:
I have been a fan of this product line for awhile, problem being is that the American version is not nearly as good as the European version. I don't know why this would matter but I'm guessing that inferior ingrediants are used in the US whereas the EU version has higher quality ingrediants.

This doesnt mean it doesn't work, just not as well. Since I've recently spent a lot time in Europe and have all these same products in the EU version and have been using them for a long time, I know I like them.

The facewash is very cleansing and not drying, the clarifying solution is gentle yet cleans off any residual makeup and then my favorite is the dual action treatment -- a daily staple. Using this system along with some Juice Beauty products has really calmed my stress-related breakouts! Give it a shot, you might be surprised!
summary: problem being is that the American version is not nearly as good as the European version

reviewText: So, mixed feelings from me on this. Let it be known this will probably work wonders on many a face. But there is an intensity this that not even Proactive has that seems less useful and more confusing. The formulas work well with my skin, but it also takes a lot out of it, even with redness on some days. I'm dealing with this my scaling back my use of this system to once a week. Now, for severe acne, this trial-by-fire might be just the ticket.

reviewerName: Keleigh Crigler Hadley, author of Revenge Inc.
reviewText: They advertise that it takes 10 days to see results, but it only took 5 days for me to see results. VERY HAPPY!
My son says this made him itchy. That led to redness. Because im highly allergic to lotions, i had him discontinue using it.
I just started using this as an overall face cleanser, but rather than feeling cleaner, this has been irritating my skin.  It's not for me and I can't recommend it to others.
summary: It's not for me and I can't recommend it to others

reviewText:
I have sensitive skin but have had success with La Roche Posay products in the past. My skin is dry in spots but largely oily in the T zone.  While I usually don't have acne, I've been traveling to different climates over the last month and have suddenly begun to break out.  I just started using the Effacer Acne System and it's helped calm my skin down and get rid of the zits.

The system has a cleanser, a toner and a clear ointment.  The cleanser is light, unscented and left my skin with a slight tingly feeling but it didn't feel stripped or overly dry.  I applied it on the affected areas, let it dry and then used the ointment on the affected areas only.  Within 3 days, my skin has mainly cleared up.  I'll continue to use it until all the zits have disappeared.  It's effective and i'll use it again when I have a breakout.  It's a good system to have in hand.
summary: Worked well on my sensitive skin

reviewText: I tried the face wash and couldn't go any further. It dried my face out, and it's not even winter yet. This is a face wash I'll save for when I have breakouts only - not for daily use. I can see it doing more harm than good like other reviewers. I don't have sensitive skin, just normal with a sometimes oily t-zone. But this is much to harsh on my skin for any time other than when I have a breakout.
summary: I can see it doing more harm than good like other reviewers

reviewText: Got this for my son who has eczema. After reading the other reviews, I told him to use it just once a day rather than 3 (another reviewer suggested this - Thanks!)  Then he applies a moisturizer so his skin doesn't dry out. That works well.
summary: A little goes a long way

reviewText: My face is EXTREMELY sensitive and I have eczema. Yes it dries my face out (as others have mentioned), which is why I only use it once a day rather than the ridiculous 3 times it suggests. If I did that I'd have no skin left. In order for my face to not be a dried, red mess, like I said I only use each item once and that's in the evening before I go to bed, and then I slather a thick moisturizer on to add moisture back in my face; it seems to do the trick. :)

I've suffered from acne since I was a teen. Hard to believe I'm middle-aged and still have it multiple decades later. I have tried everything over the years, both prescription and OTC, except for Accutane. I first tried this system after seeing it in a drugstore (CVS). I was having a major breakout and was desperate, and I noticed this had glycolic acid in it, which was a little different than the usual benzoyl peroxide/salicylic acid offerings. Step 1, the cleanser: This is fine, just a regular salicylic acid cleanser. I find it a tiny bit drying in the winter for my older skin, but my teen daughter loves it. I think I like Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Wash, 9.1 Fluid Ounce (Pack of 3) better. Step 2, the toner: Ah, this is so nice! In my younger, extremely oily days, I needed an extra-strength astringent, but have found most too harsh now. I really hadn't been able to use any toner at all until I discovered this. It makes the skin smooth and seems a bit moisturizing, without being greasy. Step 3, the treatment: An amazing discovery! This is the only product ever in my whole life to completely eliminate blackheads. I wasn't even expecting that. Within days every one was gone. I attribute that to the glycolic acid. Now...did this system alone give me clear, beautiful skin? Sadly, no. While it certainly controlled it, I was still getting the occasional painful, cystic pimples. Completely unrelated, I decided to adopt a low carb lifestyle (Atkins) about 8 months ago: no sugar, no junk food, only eating things found in nature. Within a week my face was clear! I have not had a single pimple since then (but I do continue to use these products!). I'm putting this out there because "they" always say acne is not related to diet, but in my case it certainly was. I wish I had known this years ago! Hopefully this info will help someone else. :) Overall, I love this system because it's not harsh, and it's effective.
The only system I've found that works for me.
This acne treatment is the best! Excellent quality and kind with my skin. If you use properly you will have the best result
summary: This acne treatment is the best! Excellent quality and kind with my skin

reviewText: This product is SO much better that other well known products wh claims to clear acne.  My teenage son used this for the first time before going to bed, when he woke up 75% of his acne was gone!  Say what!?  After about two days, part of his face broke out more because what was already under his skin however now, 2 weeks later, MAN!  What a huge difference.  We love this stuff!!!
summary: This product is SO much better that other well known products wh claims to clear ...

reviewText: LUV see same product review for this great adult acne system
summary: Great for adult non cystic acne

reviewText:
I have been using a 15% vitamin c serum for months, and I've seen improvement in my skin. This product, however, does not have a percentage listed, which makes me believe it is a low percentage.  I don't get a slight tingle upon application as I do with 15% serums. If there was a significant amount, why wouldn't that be noted on the package? And that makes me think there's a negligible amount of the other vitamins as well.

This serum also does not feel like any serum  I've tried before. The first ingredient is a silicone, which  makes this feel more like a primer. It has an almost powdery smooth finish, which does mean you can apply makeup without waiting for it to absorb.

To me this seems more like a really overpriced primer than a serum that will actually improve skin.
summary: WHAT IS THE VITAMIN C PERCENTAGE? WHY ISN'T THAT STATED?

reviewText: From my daughter: its hard to say if this is worth the money since I haven't notcided any significant difference in my skin since using it. But, it smells nice, doesnt irritate my sensitive skin, feels light on skin, hydrates it and makes it feel a bit softer.

I have been using topical C serums for years, and thought I would try the Citrix product.

As any topical C fan knows, there are a ton of products out there, and it isn't that hard to concoct your own mix. You can buy a lifetime supply of ascorbic acid for under $10 (but might wreck your skin in the process). Many affordable C products on Amazon have artificially inflated reviews. Buyer beware! I'm a big fan of ReviewMeta for this reason.

Now to the Citrix. If you check the ingredients, you'll see a lot of skin conditioners and silicones at the top of the list. A vitamin C cognate does not appear until fourth place. The serum itself is watery, with a slight orange fragrance, possibly from the citrus terpenes, a substance more frequently found in cleaning products. I have had neither a positive nor a negative reaction to the serum, but then, I have pretty tough skin and I'm used to C serum. I usually use serums that are 15-20% C. Citrix does not list a percentage, and I suspect it's very low, maybe 5%. I'm not sure what "pro-collagen" means either, as there aren't a lot of the usual collagen-stimulating ingredients in the mix.

I've been using the gold standard C serum, which costs more than its weight in gold, so would welcome a more affordable alternative. There are some decent C products out there amidst the scams, many at better price points than this one. So I am not tempted to switch, but will continue to use for a few more weeks to see if anything changes.
summary: C serum: a must for the daily routine

reviewText: There are many things to like about this serum - the lightness of the feel on the skin, the absorbency, the light aroma of orange, the vitamins A,C and E - and the inclusion of a collagen boost.  I haven't been using it long enough to expect visual results and don't know if I will see any on my 80 year old skin.  Several things are bothersome - it has a very high price compared to what appear to be so many other competitive products that promise the same results with many of the same ingredients.  The lack of packaging and instructions also makes one wonder.  At the price, one would expect to receive it boxed with explanations and instructions.  Instead, it arrives just as is, with directions that require a magnifying glass on the back.  There must be a " backstory" here that we're not privy to.  Since I like the ingredients, as far as I know them, and it does seem to make my skin softer, and I like the aroma - and it all agrees with my sensitive skin, I'll continue to use it.  If it turns out to be a miracle for 80 year-old skin, I'll amend my review right away!

Im new to using serums, this is the second I have tried. Citrix vitamin D pro-collagen brightening serum  is a water-based serum in my research found that this is intended or alright to use under a moisturizer. I have been using it at night after removing make up and cleansing my face. The directions state to massage a thin layer once or twice daily or as directed by your physician.

This product contains the following ingredients which Citrix claims have beneficial properties: TETREHEXYLDECYL ASCORBATE, L ASCORBIC acid, ARBUTIN, bearberry, EMBLICA, and vitamins A, and E, and Co-Q10.  The claims are to improve skin texture and tone resulting in a healthier looking skin and to brighten the skin. My experience is that if my skin is dry this adds moisture. Its soaks in immediately. I have to use about six drops to cover my face. This is not greasy or sticky.

This has a strong scent of orange which actually seems to be from the Orange peel, natural, in the ingredients it states it contain citrus Turpines, that is what is in the natural orange peels oil which gives an orange its scent.

My cousin recommended this for my dermaroller.  I was a little worried that it would be too heavy on my skin or make me break out, like most other products do.  However, was pleasantly surprised at how well it absorbed and my skins reaction.  I felt my skin was thicker and more even complexion, even after just a week.  I'm excited to see what it looks like after a month....

I am 35 years old, have mild acne scarring from my pregnancies, and relatively clear skin now.  I am very pale, and flush easily.
summary: My cousin recommended this for my dermaroller

reviewText: Just recently my skin on my cheeks on either side of my nose has gotten rough and bumpy. I used some oils on it from various other products and the skin smoothed, but needed constant attention with the moisturizing. After using this for about a week I've seen a lot of improvement. I don't need to use it several times a day like the other facial oils I used. Not sure what ingredient in the product is providing healing, but I'm pleased. Noticed improvement the first day of using this (about three or four times) and for the next few days I also used it several times a day and my complexiion remained smooth and healthy looking. Around the fifth day I used it in the morning and forgot to bring it with me to work and was a bit concerned that my face would revert, but it didn't. And now I'm using it just in the morning. I can't speak for all the claims the product description makes--but it got rid of my bumpy, patchy reddened skin!
summary: Impressed with my skin after a week's use

reviewText: I tried to give this a fair rating, but after a few uses with irritated skin and no noticeable difference, I gave up. I am a firm believer in natural products only, but will make an exception if a product actually works. This one has a lot of scary sounding chemical type words, but a quick research on the Skin Deep Database shows that it's mostly safe. If you don't have terribly sensitive skin like I do, give it a go. It just may work for you.
summary: Not for my sensitive skin, but might be fine for you.

reviewText:
It seems that almost anything will make my skin break out. It is hard to tell the immediate cause. It could be food, allergies, the cat, or using the wrong shampoo. Wasn't this supposed to go away when you stopped being a teenager?

Citrix comes with an eye dropper for applying the colorless liquid. I have been using it for over a week. I rub it on my face twice a day, once in the morning, and once in the evening before bed. Citrix has made a remarkable difference.  In one week, it has almost completely cured my pimples and blotches. Wonderful result!

To be fair, I haven't had this long enough to notice a big difference in my skin.  My concern is two things 1. Very high price, and 2.  This is full of silicones.  As far as the silicones go, of course it makes your skin feel soft and smooth.  It leaves a thin layer of silicone over the top of your skin, smoothing over pores and fine lines...just like a makeup primer that is 1/10th the cost of this product.  Maybe I am not giving this product enough credit, and in a few weeks I will be thrilled with the newfound luster of my facial skin...but I'm pretty sure that isn't going to happen.

This cleanser is gentle and more like a lotion. It doesnt foam. You just mix it with water and wash. The process is fairly quick. It washes away easily. Ive used it alone and with a toner and moisturizer. Of course, its less drying when used with a moisturizer, but I didn't find it drying. I enjoyed using it.

I thought the scent was light and it smelled slightly familiar. I haven't been able to peg exactly what it reminds of though.

My first impression of the MEG 21 Cleanser was a good one. I really love the packaging. Not only did the bottle have a clear wrapper on it but it also had a small cap over the lid to keep the content from spilling out. The bottle is simple and classy and the pump is hygienic. I had never heard of the brand so decided to check it out. I was excited by what I read. The MEG 21 product line was started by Dr. Annette Tobia who has a PH.D in molecular biology along with a law degree.

While working on diabetes treatments, Tobia discovered that a drug being tested could slow down the aging process. They were able to formulate products that delivered this substance externally in the MEG 21 products. There are several products in the line with more to be added. The active ingredients are intended to target inflammation, glycation and oxidative stress. The product claims to reverse signs of visible aging within a few short weeks.

I looked up Ms. Tobia and she has pretty skin which was another check for the product. I washed my face with the product and it worked nicely. My skin felt soft and clean after.

So far so good. I will have to give it time to see if my skin shows appreciable results but according to the descriptions I read on the product I should see less lines, wrinkles and a clearer tone within two weeks and even better results at four. The cleanser is not cheap but if it works it is well worth the price.

My one negative so far on the product is the fragrance. It has a strong scent in my opinion and I don't like applying fragrance (nor do I see the need) to my face. I would not buy it for that reason alone but if it does deliver what it promises - younger looking skin I can look past it. I will see how my skin is looking in a few weeks.

I have used this cleanser a few days now and I don't think its anything special. I mean it cleans my face and leaves my skin feeling smooth and clean, but not sure I'd pay $23 a bottle. I will say it is a big bottle and since you only need a little bit, it will probably last a long time, but I don't know how long yet. It is a smooth cleaner, no scratchy beads in it. This would probably be great for those with sensitive skin as well since it seems gentle and simple. It has a light, clean scent.

Great face wash with a very pleasant light scent.  No adverse effects and I have sensitive skin.  Removes makeup very well.  I wish it had a thicker texture,  just my preference. It probably wouldn't be in a convenient pump bottle then though.
summary: Great face wash with a very pleasant light scent

reviewText:
Customarily, I only cleanse my face at night - removing my make-up with a cleansing oil (Shu Uemura, mostly) followed by exfoliation.  In the morning, I tend to just hit my face with a few splashes of hot water and give it a good buff with the towel.  Since I didn't want to alter my evening routine (a modified version of the Korean ten-step beauty regimen), I opted to use this cleanser each morning.

It has a very thin, slippery consistency that feels nice on the skin.  The aroma is surprisingly pungent.  The ingredient list includes several citrus oils (orange, lemon and tangerine) as well as rosemary oil, but the scent itself most reminds me of one of those cult 1970's fragrances (like Robert Piguet's Fracas or Guerlain's Jicky) - yes, it's that potent.  Personally, I liked it, as I tend to prefer perfumed skincare to "unscented" which just smells like a bunch of chemicals, to me.  But if you don't like heavy fragrance, this is definitely NOT for you.

In terms of efficacy, while I can't vouch for the label's seemingly outrageous claim that it contains an amino acid that "inactivates toxic sugars,"  I can say that my face felt very soft all day and, after a week, my skin is moist and clear-looking.  It's certainly a vast improvement over water alone.

Overall, a nice product that seems to have a positive impact on skin tone and texture.

First, I love the name! It's personalized!

This is very gentle with no distinct smell to it (always good).  A soft lotion going on, my skin doesn't feel tight after.  Very gentle.

I don't have acne so I'm not sure if that's what this is for, maybe my son will share it with me. But so far, it looks good on the counter and feels great on my skin.

I loved how my skin felt after I used this cleanser...soft and clean.  There is no scent I could detect.  There is a clear plastic cap over the spout, so don't stand there pressing the top waiting for the cleanser to come out...hehe...not one of my smarter moments.
I wish I could bath in this gentle cleaner!
summary: My skin was so soft, smooth and moist after using this cleanser...love that!

reviewText: We both have been using the Meg 21 Cleanser prior to sleep and its been amazing. The cleanser is easy on and easy off. Leaves no residue and our skin feels silky smooth. There is no lasting fragrance and the overall verdict is that its a hit.
summary: MEG 21 Clean and Clear Moisturizing Cleanser Cream

reviewText: I'm allergic to basically everything, so I'm always really hesitant to try new products.  I also have noticed that I continue to develop new allergies as I get older or have a child.  I also greatly dislike the feeling of lotion on my skin.  My husband can chase me around the room with lotion on his hands and I will run screaming.  This is how much I dislike that feeling.  I complain far more than my children about having to put on sunscreen.  Anyways, because I'm allergic to everything and I don't like lotion, I have to find cleansers that are super moisturizing so that I can wash with them and not add anything on afterwards.  I started with a small spot below my chin to make sure that I wasn't allergic to this.  So far so good, I have not had any hives or itchy places.  This leads me to believe that it will most likely be good for people who have very sensitive skin.  Secondly, this is more lotion than cleanser.  It is a thick cream that you use with water (so probably in the shower) and it both cleans and leaves your face super moist.  I don't add anything on top of it, so it makes me very happy.  My face also feels very soft and doesn't have any flaky bits around my forehead, which is often the most dry part of my face.  It doesn't do the tingly thing that most cleansers that have anti aging properties do, so I can't speak to if that is working or not.  All I can tell you is that is cleans and moisturizes at the same time, which is seriously what I want it to do.
summary: Cleans and Moisturizes without needing more lotion

reviewText: Very good daily cleanser! Not only does this moisturizing wash leave skin feeling refreshed, clean, and moisturized, it has a nice and not overpowering scent that's gender-neutral. Will be using on a daily basis and buying more when I run out.

I've used  many different types of moisturizers. This one is really good. It's not at all oily or creamy but leaves my face with a nice, refreshed feeling, and smooths my skin right away. It's odorless and easy to use and it does get skin clean. I didn't test with a lot of makeup so I can't say how well it removes makeup. But it's really good for basic cleaning and it's pleasant enough to use every day.

I was sent this along with the MEG 21 cleanser. I love what I am reading about the science behind these products. These products contain Supplamine which is supposed to target skin aging. The toner disperses nicely from the bottle but as with the cream cleanser the scent was very strong to me. I did not see added fragrance listed on the toner bottle (Note: fragrance is listed on the cream cleanser), so it is possible this comes from the botanicals and/or other ingredients in the formula. I do want to believe the marketing and will use this product and see if it helps turn back the clock on my facial skin. However, the smell turns me off and the price point is more than I currently spend for toner. So I would not purchase it unless it makes a big difference in my skin. Read my review on the cleanser here: MEG 21 Clean and Clear Moisturizing Cleanser Cream, 6 fl. oz. I will update this review in a few weeks with my results.

I use toners and essence regularly and was happy to try the MEG 21 toner. Its packaging gives it two covers to prevent it from leaking or accidentally spraying. It has a spray pump. I sprayed the toner on my freshly washed face, then patted the toner in and waited for it to dry. It left my skin soft but with no lingering wetness or stickiness. I like that the toner uses plant extracts that supposedly counteract the bad effects of sugar in your diet. I haven't used the toner long enough to see a significant change in my skin quality but it feels just as good as the popular and expensive Japanese and Korean toners on the makrket.
summary: Left my skin feeling soft and hydrated

reviewText: My favorite time to  use a toner is on the go. Especially when I am shopping.... store to store or on vacation. I love carrying antibacterial wipes or gels but they dry out my hand. I spray toner right after my hands are dry and clean.  It's really fast and I love it.  I've used many different toners with Clinique being my favorite.  This toner is right up there it's nice and herbal , with sufficient oils for skin.
summary: Right up there with best toners

reviewText: I am not a fragrance in my cosmetics kind of person, so I became concerned at the prospect of a scented moistrizing toner arriving at my door. Perhaps because I was really impressed by the packaging, maybe it's the actual liquid inside the bottle, but either way I look at it, I'm willing to look beyond the noticeable scent because I like how it feels and that makes me look better. A very complex assortment of ingredients are combined in this formula, one of the first being witch hazel, an astringent. It also contains arnica which heals and a bunch of essences. The floral/citrus scent wears away over time, especially when I follow the application with my moisturizer and sunscreen.  We'll see if it truly tones the skin over time.

Having tried a few toners with varying results, I thought this MEG 21 Moisturizing Toner was refreshing. I applied it to freshly washed skin that had been lightly dried. I liked this product because it didn't seem to have a sticky residue after application. My skin felt not only fresh but extremely soft and moist and remained that way. I liked the vaguely astringent property of tea tree oil which I think is really great stuff. This toner is definitely nice and works well in terms of maintaining a nice moisture balance without having any negative chemical reaction.
summary: An Extra Source Of Moisture While Maintaining Freshness

reviewText: I actually like how this feels on my skin. It seems to firm it up a little without making my skin dry or itchy. I thought it would be sticky because of the sugar in it. It's not sticky at all. It worked well under my cc bronzer without having to moisturize or use foundation.

This is a refreshing toner. It feels good going on and makes your skin feels fresh after application.  I can't truly review this as a product that I will use daily. One of the ingredients listed on the bottle, which I didn't see on the Amazon product page, is witch hazel and it is just about the only thing I am allergic to.  If it gets too near my eyes they swell big time. I did use it on my lower face and it seemed to work. However due to my allergy to witch hazel I will most likely be 'gifting' this to a family member!

My wife reports, "This toner has a very natural plant smell, like an herbal essential oil blend, it is pretty noticeable, but not overpowering. The bottle has a spray head, which makes it super easy to use; just spray it on a cotton pad, or sometimes I spray it directly on my face and dcollet and wipe it off with cotton pad. It does refresh my skin very well, and since my skin type is more oily, which causes occasional breakouts, this toner is enough for me to keep my face fresh and moist. At first it seemed that I had a little tingling effect from it, but after using it for several days that feeling disappears. It seems to work on shrinking pores too. I do use this toner several times a day to refresh my skin and wipe off excess oil/shine from my face.

I would say if you have a slightly oily skin type this would be a great toner; at least it works great for me."
summary: Refreshing and cleansing, great for cleansing oily skin

reviewText:
Toner is not a regular part of my skincare routine. I use it occasionally especially after wearing heavy makeup or using sunscreen for some extra cleansing. It feels nice going on but doesn't seem to provide any long term benefits. This toner claims to be different. Not only does it relax and refresh, it also has anti aging properties. The ingredient list is impressive. It includes a patented substance called Supplamine which is designed to address inflammation, oxidation and glycation as well as fruit  and floral extracts including arnica and calendula. It can be sprayed directly on clean dry skin  and used as a skin freshener throughout the day.

I must say it is refreshing and my skin feels great after application. Their is a fragrance that doesn't linger. The spray is a terrific way to dispense the product, providing enough but not too much. It is still early to see results but this does seem to soothe and enhance moisturizer absorption. My skin is fairly sensitive and tends to redness and this seems to alleviate the irritation. I have not experienced any negative side effects such as break outs or rashes. It is too early to realize any observable anti-aging benefits but thus far I am pleased with this product.

I suspect that there is added fragrance to this formula, and that is what caused me to deduct one star. However, I do like it in that I used it the morning after I exfoliated. Not only was it not irritating, it did seem to calm my skin and prep it for a light application of makeup. There seemed to be no addition of oiliness at the end of the day, which is always my fear with trying new moisturizers or toners. In effect, I do recommend this product based on my own experience using it. The price is a bit steep, but I have a feeling that when this bottle is empty, I'll be back for more.

Seems to work alright, though this is a long-term kind of product so just a few treatments won't reveal much effects.  I did not really like the smell of the fragrance so long-term use isn't really too attractive to me.  This is very subjective though, as some might be okay with the fragrance.
summary: Alright, though has a fragrance I am not too fond of

reviewText: I use only Revision Skin Care products now but am on the fence about this eye cream.  I have only been using this for a month so this may not be a fair review.  I will continue using this bottle but seems I had better luck with an Estee Lauder cream I had before. Maybe I'm just expecting too much too soon.

I am a middle aged woman whose age has only shown up so far on my eyelids.  This works. It does not sting.  It does not irritate.  It soaks in to my skin right away and smooths the creepy part of my eyelids instantly.  I don't know if I can continue to afford it but for now I am thrilled.  Maybe the long term results will convince me for the next order.  And a tiny bit goes a long way.
summary: I know, I know it's really expensive BUT a tiny bit goes a long way and it WORKS

reviewText: this eye cream is superb and superior to any others I've ever tried.  Will re-purchase it again!
Helps soften my wrinkles and lines...

This is one of my favorite eye creams.  It was recommended by the dermatologist and really works. I am very happy with this eye cream as it seems to fade away the fine lines and wrinkles and helps with the undereye bags.  I have now started using the Revision face wash, vitamin c cream, and moisturizer.
Great for smoothing and moisturizing under eyes and eye lobe area! This is my 3rd purchase thru Amazon. First purchase bought thru surgeon and over paid by 30 dollars! Not happening EVER again!!!
I like the way it feels & it has added lift to my eyelids!!!

The Revision D.E.J. Eye Cream is a very good product.  I can use it under eye make up with any problem.  It keeps the area around my eyes moist, which gives a more youthful appearance.  I will be reordering when I run out.
summary: HIGHLY RECOMMEND REVISION D.E.J. EYE CREAM.

reviewText: Best eye cream available and it is affordable.
This product has literally lifted the appearance of my drooping upper lids. I can actually SEE my upper lids for the first time in years!

I swear by this product.  It made the area around my eyes look better almost immediately.  I liked it so much that I bought one for my mom.  I am on my 3rd bottle.  You only need to use a little bit of product for application, morning and night.
Like product
Long time Revisions product customer. First time using this particular item from Revisions. I am starting to see a difference under eyes. Will continue using it.
New product for me but I really like the results I'm getting-helping to smooth out the lip lines too. You only need a tiny amount so bottle will last quite a while.
I'm 51 years old. I decided to try this product to see if it would minimize fine lines and puffiness around my eyes. It does both.

This mitt is a must have when applying St. Tropez Self Tan Bronzing Mousse. It creates the most perfectly applied tan, and keeps you from over or under using too much product.

This is the exact same mitt that is sold with some of the St. Tropez Self Tan Bronzing Mousse kits. It actually made by the St. Tropez company, this in not a knock-off version.

While the mitt works great, for the cost I do wish it lasted longer. I take very good care of the ones I use, always hand washing them after each use. But they're sort of cheaply made and definitely don't last more than one short summer. It's very thin, but I suppose if it was any thicker the tanning mousse would just get completely absorbed into it instead of onto the skin. One mitt lasts about as long as one bottle of the mousse.

Definitely don't try and throw one of these into the washing machine. Between getting tanner all over your clothing, it will just get torn to shreds. Just use a bit of and hand soap on it and rinse it out in the sink. Then set it out to air dry.

If these were priced a little less or lasted longer they would be a 5 star product.
