summary: A must have when using the St. Tropez Self Tan Bronzing Mousse

reviewText: You get what you paid for.
I gave this one star because the St. Tropaz that I bought was garbage and this mitt just spread around bad product.  Better off going for a spray tan.

If you currently self tan or are thinking about starting (which I highly recommend if you enjoy having that lovely summer glow) BUY THIS PRODUCT NOW. Its $6 which is a steal. Its perfect. And is great for applying self tanner. DO NOT make the same mistake I did for years and attempt to apply self tanner without a mitt. I honestly do not know why I waited so long. This mitt is worth it. Its a staple in my self tanning routine. So make it a staple in yours. YOU WONT REGRET IT.
Great mitt, really allows for smooth application and leaves no streaks. Very easy to use
Highly recommend the mitt when it comes to applying the St. Tropez self tanner...unless you want brown hands!

This tanning mitt is nice. I like that it's more affordable when comparing other similar mitts. However, it's not the softest and does slide off of my hand during application which can get annoying at times. It's okay, but I won't be repurchasing in the future. Visit my blog at christinaschiccorner.com to read more details and what self-tanner I use with it.
Absolutely awful I've only used this mit twice and it has completely fallen apart! Now I have to spend more money to buy a new one and hopefully I find a more durable mit
I purchased to apply my Bondi sands tanning lotion and it works great.
Love the mitts, they make it so easy to apply tanner. The color comes out so evenly and no streaks.

This is a must have for anyone applying any type of mousse self-tanners. It appears as if the mitten is soaking up some of the (decently expensive) product, and it is. Why should you still use this?

Instead of using something like latex gloves-think about how that might affect the outcome of the tan. The latex can affect the chemicals in the mousse and cause it to change color prematurely, or worse-your fingers might leave streak marks. The real best reason I have found for using this thing is getting that DREADED CENTER OF MY BACK which nobody can ever seem to reach on their own. Try reaching that and getting an even coating of tan with just your bare (or gloved) hands. I use this thing, flip the mitten over so the foamy side is on the back of my hand, and then go over my shoulder as well as under it, and my back is just as evenly coated as the front of me. Worth the $5-6 for this to not have streaky marks where I can't see them.

Why not 5 stars? Because even being delicate, it won't last as long as you think it will, and it will start to shred at the most inconvenient time. Mine started to fall apart on me on New Year's Eve after I had been paler than ever after not seeing the sun for months. I made it work but then immediately ordered a new one. Hand washing is a must with these guys and air drying too. I can do so after every second use to avoid excessive washing to keep it from falling apart a little longer.

This will work with products aside from St. Tropez as well, I have used it to apply some of the gradual tan moisturizers as well to avoid staining of the hands and get a more even keel coating. I haven't tried the mini size for the face since I use just the corner to do my face with a light dusting.
summary: A must have for Mousse Tanning Products...

reviewText: perfect
This is a must! Puts the St Tropez self tanner on smoothly, no streaks, no mess.
must have when putting on st tropez tanner! it trully makes a difference trust me, you end up with a flawless tan using this
summary: must have when putting on st tropez tanner! it ...

reviewText: Did not work as well as kits from other companies we have tried in the past.

I bought this to go with the St. Tropez Bronzing mousse. The mousse is great, this mitt is not. After two uses, it's beginning to wear.

I rinsed between uses and let air dry. I guess this item is just meant to be a throw-away mitt. Not worth the money in my opinion. For the price, you should get a few.

I will say using a mitt makes it way easier to apply though.
summary: The mousse is great, this mitt is not

reviewText: Takes the mess and streaking out of self-tanning.  Very smooth, even application.  Love it!

After 2 uses it already started cracking and separating. There aren't many other mitts (the ones that I have tried are as bad, if not worse) on the market so I don't really have a choice but to get another one of these...

I've never used a mitt before so I'm just going off of this mitt. I liked it, I do put on a disposable glove under it, cause the tanning stuff does go through it, but when I do this, it keeps sliding off, I'm going to try without the disposable glove and see if it slips off still. It's very easy to clean, even if you don't clean it right away, I waited 4 days cause I forgot, just put a little dish soap and came clean almost like new!! It doesn't leave streaks which I've always gotten streaks from just using my hands, I would recommend the mitt with any self tanner

You guys.  This is no joke.  First of all it's a really cool product to use...it looks & feels very high-tech, but the ingredients are very simple and organic.  And it works!!!  It has a great cooling effect, but the results are really lasting.  It makes you look wide awake!
summary: First of all it's a really cool product to use

reviewText: This eye lift works like a charm. I used it for the first time after I had been up all night with my husband who had a kidney stone. It took the bags from under my eyes and also made them look brighter and fresher. I will definitely use this again.
summary: This eye lift works like a charm

reviewText:
I pretty much can't stand anything about this product. First, there is SO much packaging. Second, you get a whopping six applications for $75. Wow. Third, the process for using it is a) poorly outlined and b) messy.

You start by opening the package of under-eye pads. Then you pour the activator liquid all over them, There's really more liquid than you need, so you have to wait for it to absorb. The pads turn to sheets of slime. You pull them apart, they stick to themselves and your fingers. Finally, you get them on your face. They stick in place okay, but they drip all down your cheeks. You wait the 15 minutes the package recommends, all the while wiping drips with a paper towel. Finally, you pull the sheets of not-so-slimy-anymore slime off, and....nothing.

The only thing positive is that the ingredients are organic.

I didn't really believe that this eye lift would make a huge difference for me as I don't have any major lines or eye issues (yet). And, it really didn't make that huge of a difference visually, although I think it lightened the slight bags under my eyes a bit. What is different it how my eyes feel - the skin feels tighter and less "tired" somehow.

The applicators go on easy and you leave them on for ten minutes, which you can use to relax and pretend you're in the spa. :) There is a very nice light scent - hardly noticeable at all.

Overall, I actually really enjoyed these treatments and do think with repeated use I'll see more of a difference, especially as I get older. Worth a try!
summary: The applicators go on easy and you leave them on for ten minutes

reviewText: Great for tired eyes. It made my eyes feel better that's for sure, hopefully with continued use these will make my eyes look better too. I have just started having fine lines under my eyes, as I'm nearing 40 and I try to take care of my skin as well as I can. These are a bit of a pain to use, but they are worth it. Organic, and it seems to work well.
summary: Made my tired eyes feel better

reviewText:
I don't believe this product has offered me any benefit in terms of what I wanted, the relieving of puffiness under my eyes.  I have very few wrinkles in the eye area, but do have noticeable puffiness.  My husband said he thought it looked a little better, but I believe he was simply trying to make me feel good.

The manufacturer suggests using this one to two times/week.  I've applied the treatment 2 times since receiving it because I was anxious to see if it would help. Perhaps longer term treatment would show more improvement.  Two main problems with that solution are (1) the Vine review process would have been exceeded (6 weeks to use all the contents at 1/week), and (2) the cost factor would prohibit me from going forward beyond this trial.

Maybe 2 treatments are insufficient to be a proper judge, but I don't believe I will use the balance of the package.  The mess of dripping fluid is sort of irritating and I would rather go for a facial once a month for that amount of money.

Thank you for the opportunity to try this product, but it seems there is little that can be done to prevent the effects of aging.
summary: Not unpleasant to use, but no noticeable improvement in eye puffiness

reviewText:
I am pleased to say that the product is not causing any skin irritation or discomfort but at the same time it is not really producing any noticeable results. One tiny vial container contains enough activator fluid for mere one application with the included pure marine algae Eye Masks. These eye masks are very fragile and tends to tear and break apart when you pour in the activator fluid. In the end the areas around the eyes does feel hydrated but nothing spectacular improvement that was noticeable with the suggested 10 mins.

Having said, The main reason for using the included pure marine algae Eye Masks is to apply the applicator fluid without using cotton based puffs which may contain pesticides that causes skin irritation but this also causes a lot of wastage of the applicator fluid since it drips and causing a messy waste since you are doing it at home alone and not in a professional SPA where someone else applies this for you while you lie down and sleep.

What I have discovered is that the applicator fluid is good for the skin around your eyes. It does make skin softer and feels well moisturized. Does this remove the black circle marks around the eyes - Maybe but that means you need to keep spending a lot of money and wasting a lot of these applicator fluid & pure marine algae Eye Masks each time you use them.

Instead I suggest that to make most use of this package and the six tiny vial containers by applying the applicator fluid directly around the skin of your eyes by your index finger just enough to moisten before you go to sleep every night and you will find positive improvement around your eyes. Not only because you are not wasting the applicator fluid but also long time application for 2-3 weeks every night does make the skin clear, tight and rejuvenated.

For the price & wastage of applicator fluid and messy difficult to use algae Eye Masks I am forced to rate this with two stars. Otherwise the product does not cause any harm to you other than raising eyebrows looking at the price-tag :)

The process for applying these eye masks is messy, and my face was dripping the entire time. I took before and after pictures the three times I have used this and have seen no results. The areas around my eyes feel a bit swollen and puffy afterwards, but don't look different. I am just not seeing anything that justifies the cost of this kit.

Messy...very messy. You open the pack, set of two pads, pour the vial into the little container holding the kidney bean shaped pads (one for each eye) and let it set for a minute or two while it sops up the fluid from the vial. Then place each pad under your eye. Be ready with a paper towel or something to sop up the fluids that will continuously run down your face during the time you are supposed to leave it there. At the end of the time take the pads off and supposedly you will see less wrinkles. The wrinkle and puffiness reduction...totally not sure on that account but very sure on the messiness. Really quite pricey. It also doesn't smell all that great, however the scent really doesn't linger and is not all that strong. The product tells you to use it for special nights out and special occasions, but honestly, the results were minimal.

At last an eye product that delivers exactly what it promises.
This two part system is a patch and a vial of activation fluid.
The soaked patch is placed where 'crow's feet' wrinkles are, and just relax for 10 minutes. After rinsing, pat dry and apply serum.

If you don't have a high quality serum, you need to invest in one, and it is an important investment.

All the above is the good news. Now the bad news.
You get a good result, but it needs upkeep. And it isn't cheap.

Back to the good news, it works.

I've been impressed with some of the Juice Beauty products, so I was interested in trying their instant eye life.  My undereye area tends towards dark circles and slight bagginess, and this product promised to firm and brighten.

Now, I knew some of the claims were ridiculous.  Rubbing stem cells from plants on your face does absolutely nothing.  I don't know why they're trying to claim that as a selling point.  But some of the other ingredients are good, and topical patches are proven to temporarily help with the undereye area.

I was underwhelmed.  The first time I used this product, it left my face very sticky.  The second time, I let the patches soak in the activator less, which worked better.  But I really didn't see any difference.  Plus, you're supposed to buy a second product (and eye cream) to use after this one.  (The package does include a small sample.)  The best part was playing with the patches as I put them on and pulled them off.  They have a delightfully gummy texture.

This package includes six uses.  I like that Juice Beauty is organic, but I was very turned off by the packaging of this product.  It is very wasteful and mostly non-recyclable.  Not impressive for people interested in the environment.

A lot of money for what? I have never spent $75.00 for any beauty product. I liked the idea of this product. When this came, it came in a box with six vials and six packages of 2 moon shaped pads. The pads are really big. They go from the corner of my eyes to my hairline. The vials have lots of liquid. So no worries of not having enough. However once you put the liquid on the pads, the real fun begins. Trying to apply the soaked pads is a real messy job. They are so thin and with the liquid they do not hold their shape. So you have to pat the pads to get them to stay so that you do not tear them apart. Also too much handling makes them turn to glue.

Next time I think I will apply a little bit of the liquid and then use a q tip to apply the rest of the liquid so that I can control how much I need or it just runs down my face. Plus, I doubt I will see any effects from using this.

This is obviously not meant to be a product for every day use, as it includes only 6 treatments, but the instructions don't tell you how often you can use it either. The first treatment did not have any visible effect that we could detect* (except feeling moisturized), and did one eye at a time to compare the "before" and "after." By the second and third treatment (done the morning and evening after the first), there was definitely a noticeable improvement of wrinkles, moisturization, and skin tightness after each following application.

It was great that there was no smell or color. The eye masks require gentle handling when wet, to keep from tearing. A treatment takes at least ten minutes, but my wife kept it on longer. The masks stays in place on your skin well so you can walk around and do things while you are waiting.  My wife also liked the small sample package of "stem cellular repair eye treatment", for use after the eye masks, and only wishes there was more. Altogether we were quite pleasantly surprised by how well the treatment works for reducing the appearance of wrinkles and hydrating the skin under the eyes. Great for an occasional boost and refreshment for eye wrinkles, and without harsh chemicals. Would definitely recommend to others.

*advertising claims visible results after first treatment. We noticed after 2nd.

If you look at my Amazon reviews over the years, I have tried many under eye treatments and creams. I had high hopes for this product as it's all natural and I've long wondered about leave on pads. I was struck by the lack of instructions, especially with the pads stuck together. I did separate mine first and soaked them with the solution. They turn very thin and sticky. I wear glasses and needed my larger mirror while placing them. I didn't want to wear my contacts as I might have got some in my eyes. You can't wear glasses while these are on so I laid down in bed and rested for 10 minutes. The pads were cool and very soothing. I liked the feeling a lot-- especially on the sinus area. Mine did not run, I put enough on to saturate but did not over soak them. The results? Alas, they were minimal. The area felt nice and a bit "brighter" but it really didn't reduce the puffy portions all that much. The product also says to use it "before a night out" which also means you'll be putting make up on the area as well. All in all, this is an ok product for pampering but for dramatic results? No.

I received the Juice Beauty Stem Cellular Instant Eye Lift in exchange for my honest review.  It arrived with 6 vials of "activator fluid" and six pairs of eye masks.  The packaging was great, it has the six vials in front, three in a row, with the six eye masks tucked into an opening at the back.  The box dimension is approximately 3 x 5 and fits very nicely on my bathroom counter.  The description of the product is that this is "Made with Certified Organic Ingredients" and "it will instantly revive, brighten and lift eyes in 10 minutes." Antioxidants and nutrients reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and puffiness, leaving your eyes brightened and refreshed. It will reduce the appearance of puffiness around the eyes.  The instructions are extremely simple.  Only three steps are Step 1). Activate.  Step 2). Apply.  Step 3). 10 Minutes.

The first time I used the system, I honestly didn't think there would be enough activator fluid to completely soak the two eye masks, but there was just enough. I tried it at night before bed as that is when I have the most time to dedicate to a beauty ritual.  I opened the package and laid out each mask separately on the bathroom counter and applied the fluid.  The masks are extremely thin but I had no problem applying them to my eye.  I had to slide them around a bit to get them in the exact right place.  Once I did, I went into my family room to sit and watch TV while the activator fluid went to work.  I immediately noticed the dripping down my face, so I kept a tissue with me and blotted the drips.  It didn't drip for long, but there was a definite running of fluid for a few minutes.  After 10 minutes, I went into the bathroom, removed the masks and looked at my under eyes and they did appear smoother and plumper.

After about four days, I thought I would try them again.  Again, I tried them at night.  I went through the same routine with them, but this time I did not get the fluid evenly distributed between the two masks.  One mask had more fluid on it, so I had to pick up the other mask to try to work a little bit of fluid into them off the counter, but they immediately tore and wadded and the second mask was totally unusable.  I was going to try another pair of masks but then I thought let's see if this really is noticeably working, so I only put one mask under my left eye.  Again, I went to sit down and read for the recommended ten minutes, again the dripping began, but stopped pretty quickly.  I let this mask sit for 15 or 20 minutes.  When I removed the mask from under the left eye, there was a noticeable difference in the under eye area.  It was smoother and the skin was definitely plumper as I have a blue vein under my left eye and I was amazed by how little I could now see the vein.  The skin around and on top of it was fuller and softer.  So, if you want your under eye area to look better for an evening out, or any kind of special event, I know for myself that there was a definite improvement.  Does this improvement last long?  My eye still looks better into the next evening.  Is it worth $75.00?  I don't know.  I guess I will have to continue with the other four masks to be able to say whether this would help in the long run or is this just a temporary fix.

Wow! The Stem Cellular Instant Eye Lift maybe one of the best facial skincare products I have ever used around the eye area. I have tried many of the middle to upper end, quality, skincare products over the last ten years so while initially I was very skeptical of this two step system, I have been extremely impressed with the results.

The Juice Beauty description and claims for Eye Lift system are right on and I'm not sure I can improve on their claims that it, "revives, brightens and lifts eyes with this revolutionary system to dramatically transform eyes' appearance in 10 minutes".

It's not as complicated as I thought it could be when I saw it was a 'two-step process', quite the opposite actually. The Instant Eye Lift product uses a serum, Stem Cellular Activator Fluid and a surprising clever and effective "pure marine algae Eye Mask" to increase the "level of potency" and I would add 'effectiveness' of this eye lift and skin rejuvenator. It really is so simple, peel open the foil covered packet to uncover the mini masks, open a single-use bottle of serum and slowly pour it over the two silky, cotton-like masks. And magic happens! Or so it seems - but this serum/activator really does transform the eye mask product into this glorious gel-like substance that is easy lifted out of the container and placed under the eyes. There are two in each tray, one for each eye. I leave it on for 10-15 minutes and because it feels so effective and glorious, I can't bring myself to throw it away after I remove it from under my eyes. I slide one mask up onto my frown lines and the other over my top lip and let it sit for another 10 minutes. Another reason this product gets five stars, because I don't have to stop what I am doing and lay down with these treatments. These "algae bio-matrix masks" literally seeps into and clings to the face without the slightest sense of compromise as I go about my daily routine at home.

I can feel the antioxidants and nutrients from the algae masks absorb and revive my eye area as I work on the computer, fix coffee or get dressed. And it genuinely reduces fine lines, wrinkles and puffiness, and my eyes feel, and look brightener and refreshed. Fantastic product. The only negative about it, is the price - so just use one a week for 6 weeks and for about $12 a week, this is a better investment than many other skincare products that cost much more and are not as effective as Juice Beauty's Cellular Eye Treatment. Great product with great results. (This review was written by my wife)

Not anything to write home about.

1. Not that easy to apply; have to go back and forth for coverage.
2. Even though it's cacao, it's not that dark. I expected chocolate brown, but this is a wishy-washy brown.
3. Coverage is more transparent than opaque and I don't think most women like this. I don't.
4. Rather pricey for this quality of eye pencil.

Would not recommend this product.

Although I usually wear black eyeliner, I like to mix it up in the summer when I lighten my hair. This eyeliner promises rich color in a creamy, long lasting waterproof formula. I had some difficulty removing the twist on cap. The liner itself is a lovely dark brown. There are no weird reddish or yellow off tones. It is universally flattering, a pleasing deep chocolate brown. Consistency wise, it is not noticeably more creamy than any other liner I've tried. It took a couple of swipes to get the intensity of color that I wanted. Application was easy. The pencil glides on without pulling or tugging. It does last without smudging or flaking even in humid conditions. It removed without issue with Neutrogena Makeup Remover Cleansing Towelettes, Refill Pack, 25 Count I do wish it was self sharpening. Vincent Longo does make a relatively inexpensive pencil sharpener but it would have been nice had it been included. If you are looking for a smoky look, you must work quickly because it resists smudging almost immediately. I wasn't much impressed by their stay fresh twist on cap. I haven't encountered any problems with pencil liners drying out and the pencil was not notably soft or creamy. That being said, I liked the color and was impressed by its staying power. It is a good choice for hot or busy days when reapplication is a challenge.

I've never used an eyeliner that goes on so beautifully and I've used eyeliner for decades.

The color is an intense dark brown - 100% better than  harsh black.  It glides over my eyelid - NO tugging - depositing a perfect thin line.  I don't even need mascara on a casual day because the pencil is easily applied directly on the lash line.  I have perfect definition.

It's hot but the eyeliner is waterproof so even when I perspire - no problem.

Once again, Vincent Longo has impressed me with a superb product.  Bye Bye to store cosmetics.

This adheres to your skin pretty quickly so if you want to smudge it you have to do it quickly.  It stayed on about 10 hours.  It did not seem to irritate my eyes although I only used it on the corner of my eyes and not all the way across.  It is a nice dark brown, not black, not milk chocolate brown.

This review is for the "Yogi Flow" scent, although some of my comments are about the container and will apply to any of the scents.

I like the scent of this. It's lightly floral. I am not noticing the "almond" from the description much (almond is one of my favorite scents, too). I feel that this gets me clean without irritating my skin and it washes off without leaving residue. I don't really think the scent sticks around. At any rate, as a shower gel, it's decent and it has really nice lather.

What I don't care for as much is the can. The dispenser nozzle is pointed in a way that you might not expect, and it led to me wasting a whole bunch of shower gel when it sprayed all over the shower curtain liner instead of onto my pouf sponge. In general, I found that I had to dispense a lot of this relative to what I would use from a more traditional bottle. This meant that I used the product up super fast. Since it is not the cheapest shower gel around, that is something to keep in mind. (Also, it probably can't double as bubble bath like most shower gels/body washes normally can.) I really just don't feel like I got as many uses out of this as I have with some other shower gels I've used lately, despite having a similar package size. The can was sort of conducive to product waste.

It's a good shower gel but I don't like the dispenser. If I could get this in a (recyclable, of course) plastic bottle, I think I'd be able to give a little higher rating. Also, please note there may be shipping restrictions because this comes in a pressurized can. 3.5 stars.
summary: like the scent; don't like the can

reviewText: I'm in love with the beautiful and rich sent this has. You need the teeniest tiniest bit too clean your whole body. It lathers up huge and feel so luxurious. And even though I really love the scent in the shower I also really appreciate that it stays in the shower and doesn't linger after so I can use any perfume that I want. I'll definitely be looking into other products with this sent.

Quite possibly what I received was a defective bottle, or one that was badly affected by being shipped during the recent heat wave.  The cans dispenser just never worked properly.  By the third use, it wasn't reliably dispensing product.  By th fourth use, it simply didn't work at all.

I tend to stick with a simple organic olive oil soap bar for my daily shower. But last night I showered with Rituals of Ayurveda Indian rose and sweet almond oil foaming shower gel after a long hot day, and it was the most enjoyable, relaxing and reviving shower ever.  This shower gel creates an ultra thick, white foam like Ive never experienced.  I try to avoid sulfates and don't generally go for foaming products, but this foaming gel smells divine and feels so silky smooth and luxurious slathered all over Ill gladly make an exception. This gel cleans beautifully and is comforting to my sensitive dry skin. It does make the bottoms of my feet a bit slippery, so some may want to avoid the feet or use a nonslip tub mat.

My skin feels calm, soft and more moisturized than usual after using this gel and still felt amazing by the next morning. Im not a fan of strong fragrance, but this has a scent thats delicate and light. The scent lingers lightly on my skin and makes my skin smell so good but its subtle.  The fragrance doesnt trigger my allergies like some products, and this gel doesnt irritate or dry my sensitive skin. This gel comes in a shiny red container that looks so pretty and has a high end look that suits the premiere quality of the product. Mine arrived with a clear cap and functions perfectly.  This isn't a natural product, but I like that it doesnt contain parabens. This shower gel feels decadent, refreshing and uplifting. I absolutely love it. Made in Germany.

PS: Im attaching a photo of the ingredients for this particular shower gel. A good photo is hard to get as the shine of the container is brilliant, but hope those who need to check ingredients can see it.
summary: Ritual Of Ayurveda Indian Rose & Sweet Almond Oil Gel Makes Thick Foam- Decadent & Relaxing With A Lovely Delicate Scent

reviewText:
I love trying new bath and body products.  Especially ones like this.  This Rituals The Ritual of Ayurveda Foaming Shower Gel, first of all it should have a cap on it.  Mine didn't.  The product is supposed to come out as a gel, and once added to water turn into a foam.  Mine actually came out as a foam, and it foams and foams!

This is supposed to smell like Indian Rose, whatever that is it is not related to the rose flower, and Sweet Almond Oil.  I didn't think it smells like that either.

I am trying to think of what it does smell like. For some reason I want to say sandalwood or musk, maybe a little beachy.  In any case to me it has a nice, warm, pleasant scent.  The scent, you can definitely smell it on your skin, but it's not overpowering, but I found myself wanting to smell it, so that's good.  I'd love to try more of this companies products.  This scent would make a nice hand soap or bar soap, candles, etc.  The firery red of the canister is different too.

I love the sensual fragrance of Ritual of Ayurveda (Indian rose and sweet almond oil) but getting it to dispense properly and in small amounts is a real pain.  The button is very hard to pushwhen I finally do get it to work, it expels way more than I need per shower or bath.  There's enough foam to wash my entire body (and probably someone else) and I still have enough left over to shave my legs.  Not exactly economical.  To make it even worse, the bottle is a mess after the foam comes outmust be rinsed off after each use.

This dispenser needs to go back to the drawing board.  As much as I like the fragrance, the hard-to-use cap and messy distribution is enough to make me not get it again.
summary: The Cap Doesnt Dispense Foam Well At All

reviewText:
A little goes a very long way!
My only complaint is that the scent is so feint, I didn't smell it at all.

This is amazing foaming shower gel. It is so rich and thick, it's unlike anything I've ever used. I squired out what I thought would be a normal amount of foam from one pump. It created a very soft and thick foam I could have used to cover my entire lower leg. It is perfect for shaving. It's creamy and amazing. I am seriously blown away! The only thing I'm not a great fan of is the scent. it's not bad, it's just not my favorite but it's such an amazing product!
summary: This is amazing foaming shower gel

reviewText: So I have to admit I had a little fun in the shower with this one. The product's formula allows it to perform a little trick, which is that the cleanser comes out clear, with the consistency similar to hair gel, then as you watch it slowly starts to foam and turn white. Rub your wet hands together and it turns fabulously soapy, more like shaving cream. In fact, you could use it for shaving cream in a pinch. The formula is so rich and creamy, the most lather I have had with a body wash. The product rinses cleanly, and I feel like my skin is a little more moisturized out of the shower. My personal preference is that a body wash smell delicious, the scent on this wasn't bad, just almost nonexistent. I also like that it comes in a hairspray-looking container. If you like a lot of lather with your body wash, and don't mind the muted scent, this one is a good choice.

This shower gel really foams up so you only need to use a small amount and I have found that all of the scents offered smell really good.  I can be prone to sensitivity from some soaps and haven't had any issues with this brand/type.
summary: ... found that all of the scents offered smell really good. I can be prone to sensitivity from some ...

reviewText: Very interesting and unique scent that lasts the whole day.
Love the scent but bottle doesn't last very long.. :(

I first purchased this from a local spa where I live and really liked it. I was pretty unhappy when I returned to purchase more and they no longer carried this so I was happy to find it on Amazon. This is my second purchase on Amazon with this particular product and it's amazing .Smells so  good and I don't need alot ,a little goes along way. This isn't something I would use daily because while I do believe it's moisturizing for my skin I think their are better products for my skin in the Winter that tends to get very dry. However this is basically a great splurge now and than when I want that just left the spa feeling. I love the scent it leaves in my Bathroom after I shower ,it lingers a while. It also wakes up my senses in the morning before I even have my first cup of coffee. Definitely rates 5 stars in my opinion and price point is resonible for the quality. My only issue which is small is I have to remember not to leave it on the side of tub because with a previous purchase not only did it hurt when it landed on my toe it also could have done a little damage to tub. That's petty but I know now to leave it in the mesh organizer in shower.

Love this line of shower gels! I tried the orange and the white, I prefer the white. But they all lather beautifully, smell great, and a little goes along way. I received a small bottle in my glossy box, and had to buy the full size, that's how great it is!

This shower gel foam is amazing.  It only takes a small amount to get tons of lather and the smell is great.  you have to be careful not to hold the nozzle down for too long or you will get much more product than you need.  If used in smaller amounts the product lasts a long time.
summary: This shower gel foam is amazing. It only takes a small amount to get ...

reviewText: Love it!
Man, I love Avene. I use tons of their products. Expensive, but sooooooooo worth it.
summary: I love Avene. I use tons of their products

reviewText: Love this product!
stuff good
It is uesful

I am new to this line of skincare and am absolutely hooked!  Every product I've purchased is gentle and seemingly effective--with a great price!  I've begun to switch to this line as my other products run out.  I'm a very happy customer.

This product is wonderful for my blotches and aging skin.

The liquid foundation comes in a glass bottle with a pump dispenser that gives a small but right amount. The foundation goes on smoothly and leaves no stickiness but left my skin feeling soft and dewy.  The foundation minimizes pores and leaves you with a polished finish but looks matte.  It's similar in quality to the high end foundations that I rely on (Jouer, Smashbox CC and Bobbi Brown) and similar in price.

Japonesque is a European product that might not be formulated for Asian complexions but I found to be a very good match for me in color and in the underlying tones.

Be careful about traveling with this foundation - the bottle had leaked en route to me.
summary: Looks matte and left my skin feeling soft and dewy

reviewText:
Had never heard of Japonesque, which seems like a strange moniker for a product made in Italy and distributed through London and California.  The packaging is a glass bottle (not plastic) with a pump that lets you dispense just a tiny amount, which is very nice.  However the clear plastic top that sits over the dispenser was not on tight and some product had leaked out on to the bottle and inside the cardboard box.  Not a lot, but enough to warn against packing this in a travel bag or makeup bag.

The web site does not provide any information about ingredients.  This does not contain any sunscreen, so will be relegated primarily to night time use.  The list of ingredients is printed on the box, and this contains the usual things -- for example dimethicone, glycerin, talc, mica, PEG 10-15 cross polymer, butylene glycol, silica, fragrance, among others.  It does not state whether it is paraben free, which suggests it is not.

The color I received, No 4, is a light-medium shade that is on the cool side, without any yellow or pink undertones.  The fragrance is negligible.

On the skin this feels like it is at least partly silicone based, rather than  cream based.  It has very good slip but still covers quite well, without feeling at all heavy or oily.  I usually use tinted moisturizer with SPF during the day -- and sometimes I further mix that with regular facial moisturizer when I apply.  Not generally a fan of "coverage," so was pleasantly surprised to see that you can control this and attain a very natural finish.  Does an especially nice job in the slightly darker areas under the eyes so I may even use this as a concealer primer in those areas even when I am using only tinted moisturizer on the rest of my face.

This is a lovely product.  As I do not generally use a true foundation  I have little basis for comparison.  I would definitely reconsider repurchasing this, but would be even more inclined to do so if it had some sun protection, preferably physical rather than chemical.

Appears to be a light foundation with a fine smooth coverage ability.

Made in Italy, this is a very interesting line of cosmetics to explore.

The attractive, unique bottle might lead you to believe it is larger than other liquid makeups, it is not.  Holding the same abmount of product, it dispenses such with a light touch of the cap. Very neat indeed.

Fragrance is pleasantly light and immediately dissipates.

Coverage is youthful and bright.

The shade 4 which was provided for this reviewer is a bit darker than I would normally choose but workable.

Believe this product has the ability to minimize complexion flaws and more can be applied to further reduce any imperfections.

The price is the only drawback for most.  I do have some high end cosmetics in my favorite purchases, but I also have some bargains.

As I continue to use Japonesque, it might become evident that this may join the higher end favorites.
summary: Price might equal quality...will update if it no longer deserves fifth star...

reviewText: I usually do not buy makeup by the higher echelon of makeup manufacturers...Lancome, Clinique, etc...I use mostly Maybelline or Cover Girl because they seem to work well and are so much less expensive.  I received this foundation which is pricier by a company I had never heard of "Japonesque".  I can see why it costs a little more.  I barely had to use any and it completely negated the need for a primary cover up stick and I had a luminous and flawless face.  I have a sun spot and acne scarring so for this product to be able to do that is pretty amazing.  I am actually very pleased with it and you get a bigger bottle than you do normally.  I am considering using this permanently because it just went on so easily and now without having to by a separate concealer it may be worth the price.

this is really very silky feeling. I like that it is very light so even though this is a shade darker than i would usually go, it still covers and works.  its almost like a moisturizer is in it too when it just tints your face slightly.  I like it for a day look.

Because I have sensitive skin, I'm reluctant to try products unless I am at home where I can wash my face immediately if necessary. Fortunately, I have had no reaction to the JAPONESQUE Luminous Foundation, so I was good to go after an hour's test. As with most cosmetics, this foundation has a scent, but it's not offensive and gave me no problems. The glass pump bottle allowed a small amount to cleanly be obtained and I applied it with my fingers instead of the recommended cosmetic brush. I always do this and saw no reason to change my technique. The coverage was average, not as full as other products I've tried, but it can be reapplied for more coverage. I prefer a lighter coverage just to smooth things out, so this type works well for me and it washes off very easily, leaving no evidence behind. Fortunately, this foundation has not dried out my skin or caked as some others do on skin types like mine. It's difficult to determine the correct shade of any cosmetic and I will visit a local store to see exactly which is best for me. The Shade 04 I received has yellow undertones and is very close to my complexion right now but I want to see the other options available or if I can mix this shade with another. I was very surprised to see that a company called JAPONESQUE was made in Italy, as I was expecting something comparable to Shiseido. Their prices are about the same. I also prefer a hydrating foundation, so I'll check out other JAPONESQUE products for comparison. Sun protection would be great, too, but that sometimes introduces a scent I can't work with, so I typically use a separate sunscreen. This seems like a good product in a good line.
summary: Shading can be tricky with any foundation

reviewText: I love Japonesque.  I had not known about this product until it fortunately became available to me via Amazon.  It lives up to its claim to be flawless liquid makeup.  You gently apply it to your skin and it will even out your skin tones.  An added bonus is that your skin will have a healthy glow.  It does not cake up and flake off, so if you have someplace to go where you want to know you look good, then you want this foundation.

Japonesque has the most beautiful cases for their makeup. The eyeshadow I received in shade 03, is a very light shimmering gold color. I try a lot of beauty products and find that this brand is high quality. This particular shade though is too light for me and I prefer more of a matte look. Recommended brand.

I only knew Japonesque as a maker of brushes and tools such as eyelash curler and a brow kit. It seems they have branched out into eye shadow.

This is a typical Japanese eye shadow. They favor a highlighter look (shimmery and light) that opens up an eyelid rather than contour it. So this is fair skin colored and not dark at all. It comes in a tiny compact and you need a separate brush for it in your makeup bag. The case is a small work of art; a 3cm square of polished acrylic with an abstract design in purple, black and a touch of seafoam green. #03 is a mid coppery peach and yeah, it has shimmer and a small amount of larger glitter (fewer pieces of glitter) in it. It can be applied and then wet with your finger on your lid to make a "foil" effect.

A simple and fast way to use this shadow is to dust it all over your eyelid up to the browbone and use a dark, sharp eye pencil just on the lashline. If you blend the pencil (a soft one) up into the corners, you have a very good eye makeup, not too over done for work and easy to touch up. Your makeup bag would only need the pencil, a brush and this eye shadow.

If you don't like light, pearlized shadows, this probably wouldn't be for you. The price is a bit more than Shu Uemura shadow (very similar but many more colors.) However you do not need to buy the separate compact, so it's a bit less in actuality.

I usually use mineral makeup  but thought to give the Japonesque shadow a try.  This goes on smoothly and covers the eyelid well.  There is no brush with this, I used my own make up brush.  This shade is a bit light.  I have fair skin, so it worked better as a brow highlight.  This was long lasting.  It has a pretty shimmer that works well near the brow. It also did not bother my sensitive skin.  Overall I liked the shadow but would pick a different shade personally, one that was a little darker or even lighter than this shade.
summary: The shadow is nice but not in love with the shade

reviewText: I really like Japonesque cosmetics and this one is no exception. It is quite small (which is difficult to tell by the picture). It goes on easily and evenly. It has a nice shimmered hue too to it,  it without being overly sparkly or overbearing. I have very fair skin, so it didn't show up on its own, but when I paired it with a darker brown (brown as base, then this as the accent on top) it was very nice for a classy look. Overall, it's nice,but if you have fair skin, you'll want to use this in complement with a darker shade as well.

The JAPONESQUE Velvet Touch Shadow, Shade 03 is a very neutral skin tone color shadow that is perfect for those that want to add a bit of sparkle to a natural look or for highlighting a more bold look. The pigmentation is not very noticeable when you use it straight up, but is when used as a highlight. There is a nice color saturation that holds up well. Color retention is good and there is no smudging or creasing noticeable after 8 hours. With lids that seem to get oily during the day, it was nice to not have to touch up my makeup during the day!

The JAPONESQUE Velvet Touch Shadow, Shade 03 comes in a 1-1/2" x 1-1/2" compact complete with mirror. There is no applicator included. This goes on nicely with brushes (Japonesque has a nice line of them). The compact is very colorful - mine is black, purple with a smidgen of light blue in the bottom right corner. (my photo show the compact more blue than it is)

This is a very nice shadow and I'm impressed with how well it holds up without having to use a lot or having to reapply during the day.
summary: Over 8 hours without creasing or having to reapply.

reviewText:
This review is for the Shade 3 Eyeshadow. First, it's not very big and has a very small cake of shadow. The color goes on nice and even and is a little sparkly. However, I have very light skin and this shade 3 shadow isn't dark enough to even see on my skin.  If you want this shadow for highlights it would probably be okay, otherwise I would recommend a darker shade. But even looking at the darker shades, I think it might be too light. The color saturation that they are claiming just isn't there.

The item description says it is richly pigmented. I'm sorry, but it's not. $18.00 is too much to pay for the small amount of makeup.
summary: Too expensive, and barely shows up on skin.

reviewText:
It is a very lightly colored eyeshadow, just adds a bit of glimmer to my lid (my skin is very pale).  It goes on pretty smoothly. I'll have to wear it more to really know how long it has the potential to last though.

My only real complaint is that it is a little tricky to open (its completely adorable--really, I love the sort of artsy graphic on the case). The catch is really firmly latched.

What a beautiful color! And it has great coverage to match. It really helps your eyelids pop. It's metallic enough to be luminent, but not too much to be trashy.

The compact that it comes in snaps tight to prevent accidentally opening in your purse.

It does not come with an applicator, but I don't have a problem with that. Less stuff to carry around.

Your typical high quality Japonesque makeup. It's a keeper!

Japonesque products have rarely dissapointed.  This shadow is very small and compact, much smaller than expected.  The hue provides a shimmer in a muted way- but it does highlight.  Application was not as smooth as I am used to when using Armani  or Christian Dior.  I also notice that in terms of coverage, Smashbox did a much better job (trying to compare similarly priced items), either wet or dry.

The Japonesque  does not come with a foam brush by the way.

Lovely, silky soft eye shadow. Light, airy. I feel like an old time movie starlet! A beautiful soft, golden color, this can be paired with any other color I want. Perfect for parties, special occasions, or any time. I give this five stars and a big thumbs up.

I have been recently exploring this line of make up.  I have to say I am impressed.  This is a really nice shade of eye shadow.  It is perfect for a lid color, or a highlighter.  It is a nice fleshy color with a slight shimmer.  This goes on creamy and and doesn't flake off.  If you are wondering what these are comparable to I think they are like Urban Decay.  These are a high end and high quality eye shadow.

The packing is pretty, a nice multi-colored case.  It has a nice clasp and isn't going to come open.

Overall I really like this eye shadow, its great for everyday wear.
summary: A brand that is worth checking out.

reviewText:
For my everyday eye makeup, I typically use a mineral based pearlish peach color on my lids, and a mineral charcoal for the outer edge over waterproof eyeliner, blended to look nice, finished with mascara.  This shade of Japonesque Velvet Touch Shadow actually matches my current favorite Smashbox color perfectly.

I will say that my Smashbox covers my eyelid a little better than the Japonesque, but this one does look nice and covers well, it just seems to be not as fine as the Smashbox shadow (so it seems to take a little more for the same coverage).

Once I get the right amount on, it looks great, and it blends nicely with my other shadow to finish off my daily look.

I use this with my eye brush (it does not come with a foam or brush, so you will need your own), and generally use it dry, although it is fun to change it up a bit by getting the eye brush wet first.  It makes the color a bit brighter, and changes the look just a bit to stand out a little more.

Overall, I'm very pleased with this color and coverage.  I will certainly use this shadow going forward.
summary: Good Coverage, Love the Pearlish Peach Color, Nicely Packaged

reviewText: I've never used products by this company. I am very happy with the result.  I didn't get to chose the color as I received for free.  I lucked out that it is a shade I have been looking to replace ever since sephora discontinued my fave beige peach.  As I have deep set eyes, I like to use shimmery shadows like this on the inner corner of my eye and for other peope along the brow bone.  I use Too Faced shadow primer to make eye shadows last longer. with the primer it didn't crease on me like another reviewer mentioned and lasted through the night.  The case is also beautiful purple and green (my fave colors).  I'm happy all the way around.

This is a rather underwhelming eye shadow; it's almost like it isn't there. The color promised to be quite nice and versatile, a light peachy shade of the type that I enjoy wearing on my lids in the summer, or can be used to add some warm shimmer to a darker lid color. In practice, it didn't work out as well as I had hoped. The texture is on the fine side, but it is nowhere as buttery smooth as some of the higher end brands like Chanel, Giorgio Armani, Christian Dior or even Bobbi Brown and Shiseido. The payoff is really quite poor; even with layering I couldn't build up much color. Glittery fallout is not as bad as some MAC mineral eye shadows, NARS glitters or inexpensive brands, but still more than I prefer. It might be nice to use over a matte color, but I wouldn't recommend it only for that purpose. It can also be used wet to improve the payoff, but I judge an eye shadow dry as most people don't use them wet except for lining purposes. The case is sturdy and attractive, with a good sized mirror, but I found the catch to open it a bit tricky. It's possible some of the other colors are better, but 03 is what was sent by the amazon Vine program, so I can't comment on them. For most people, an eye shadow is something that can last years, so I would highly recommend passing this over in favor of a more expensive brand, looking at the higher cost as worthwhile investment.

there are several points about this product (i'm going on the feedback from my in-house product tester) - here are the pluses:

went on easily and smoothly - even with a finger (even though no applicator was included)
little mirror in lid was a nice touch
it stayed on all day
it washed off easily

downsides?

no mention of 'cruelty free' or animal testing info
the color was not good for personal skin tone (YMMV)
'way too shiny' for older user - perhaps better for a younger consumer?

thanks!

This is my second attempt to try something from this brand because I do love their packaging. Unfortunately I think the products are not for me. This particular eye shadow had zero staying power although it applies nicely and looks really cute when you put it on. It is a very nice shimmery champagne color that is sort of nude on med skin tone (like mine). The first time I used it it creased like crazy and it felt like my eyelid was sort of greasy, but I thought that maybe it was because I had worked out. The second time I wore it to school (did use primer) and by lunch it had already creased into a thick line so I had to wipe it off. I use other shimmery shades and haven't experienced the same problem, in spite of having a little bit of a hooded eyelid.

How do I describe Japonesque Luminous foundation in a word? Impressed. When I purchase foundation the first thing that I always try to match is my shade, for obvious reasons. Too light and it looks medieval renaissance, too dark and it looks mask like and heavy, neither of which are not a good look. Even though all the shades in the Japonesque range have more yellow in them than most 04 matched my skin perfectly. It evened out some redness without making me orange, and it perked up my under eye and jawline sallowness. Its slightly sheer, so if you are hiding a lot of imperfections this might not be the one.
It's light weight, very fluid and smoothed over my skin without pulling. It is a light coverage, medium at most. Could you build up to full? Yes, but I don't recommend it. The finish is luminous as described, but not greasy looking. I would say more of a satin finish. However, if you add a dusting of finishing powder you don't have a slick surface, just a soft smooth canvas.
The price point is high, but well worth it. I loved how it made my face feel and look.
I usually do a three step testing, but two of those steps involve no spf. Since this does not have SPF in it, I only applied it over my usual high SPF. It worked together beautifully, and lasted a full work day.
I will be purchasing this agin, even though the price is high it's really not much more than most drugstore brands. It will last awhile since it doesn't take very much to cover my face, and I love the feel and finish!

I don't have much experience with foundation. In high school, I wore the cakey stage make-up for shows, which I think may have had something to do with my general aversion to it. But recently, I have started experimenting a bit more into the world of foundations. The first foundation that I tried is more of a tinted spot-check, very light coverage. This is a more substantial foundation. It feels a lot thicker and has better coverage. This shade is perfect for my winter tones - with a summer tan this will be a bit too light, I think. But overall it goes on nicely, and provides a smoothing look that evens skin tone color. I feel like, overall, my face looks smoother and I don't feel like my face is too stiff or cakey with this makeup.

I may not wear this everyday, but I will certainly wear it on special occasions!

As far as foundation goes, I find this incredibly average, so I'll break it down in the good and the bad.

The good:
*Decent coverage; being that I don't need heavy duty coverage, I was really pleased with this.
*It also builds really well if you do happen to need more coverage.
*If you happen to be super pale, Japonesque has you covered. Normally I'm either the lightest or maybe one shade up, but 04 worked really well for me.
*The dispenser works really well
*I didn't find the scent offensive. This is a biggie for me because I can't stand to walk around smelling my face.
*I'm not allergic to it.

The bad:
*I found that this stuff dried FAST. This meant that if I don't blend it in at lightening speed, I have ugly lines all over.
*It hangs on to any "flaw" for dear life. Have some peach fuzz? This will highlight it! Skipped exfoliation this morning? Helllllo dry skin accents. This is made worse by the fast dry time.
*It didn't really last over the course of the day; I noticed my slight redness peeking through about halfway through the workday...I work in an office, so I wasn't sweating it off or anything.

I'll likely finish the bottle, but will not repurchase. Of course, I will opt for a different foundation if I don't do some serious exfoliation (Clairsonic style) that day.

JAPONESQUE Luminous Foundation in the Shade 04 works wonderfully on my skin. My complexion is olive and I tend to go for shades that are fair to neutral. I've found this foundation to even out my skin tone and after many daily uses, it hasn't caused any unwanted breakouts. Note that my skin is on the more oily side.

The foundation tends to go on easily whether using a brush like recommended, a sponge, or my fingers. I've worn it upon my face nearly all day and my skin is left feeling comfortable and non-irritated. Honestly, I've all but given up liquid foundations till I tried this one. It's left my skin feeling silky and looking great providing excellent full coverage. There's a subtle scent but it's not incredibly noticeable but it does smell nice!

The foundation comes in a glass bottle with a squirt top. I find that little bit tends to go a long way only really having to pump it out once to cover my whole face. I can tell I am wearing make up but not drowning in it. I really can't stand a plastered or chalky look and this one doesn't have those results. I like I can apply as little or as much as I like building layers if needed. I've found that using a light layer still offers a lot of coverage with a more natural look, which I tend to prefer. Also when applying blush and other types of make up on top of the foundation layer that everything blends very well together.

I'm quite happy with this foundation and will opting to get another bottle when I'm through with this one. The price is higher than I'd usually like to spend but the effectiveness and how nice it leaves my skin is worth it!

This is a really nice lipstick.  It applies well and stays on very nicely over the course of a day, through meals, family kisses, etc.  It is not inexpensive, but what Italian product is?

This color - Shade 07 - is sort of a deep mauve but with a definite red hue to it.  Shade 06 is a more true mauve. It looks velvety/creamy once applied and is really a nice stick.

It does last all day and night long, much better than a more basic brand though, so between its look and its staying power, it may be worth the price to you.

This is my first experience with JAPONESQUE products and I'm impressed. I've been using the Luminous Foundation for about two weeks and my skin looks radiant when it's applied. A small amount covers like a much thicker foundation and it last all day. I love the pump on the bottle: it distributes just the right amount of product and keeps the foundation from building up inside the cap. The only complaint I have is that the foundation doesn't breathe as well as other products I've used. My skin feels like it's suffocating a bit underneath.

The packaging on this foundation is chic, with an easy pump handle and a transparent cap. My wife says that shade #4 is silky and smooth to the touch, but the color has a slight golden orange hue that does not improve the look of her reddish complexion. She will be passing the #4 shade on to a darker skinned girlfriend.
summary: Shade not quite right, but weight and application is great

reviewText:
I can't believe the shade almost matched my skin perfectly. It was maybe just one half shade darker, which I can live with, for the most part. The product itself was fairly light on application. I found that you need to apply the foundation and then give it 15 minutes or so before finishing your face. It disappears into the skin, mostly, but helps even out all-over skin tone.

There is a slight fragrance - very slight - but it's a nice one, natural or perhaps a bit floral. Not overwhelming by any means but I mention it because some people prefer no fragrance at all and should be aware.

The morning application of this product did last through the day without disappearing and kept my skin looking even the entire day. I think you'd need to reapply if you were heading somewhere in the evening but otherwise, lasting.

I should mention that although I have dry skin, I don't have a lot of lines or discolorations so this worked well on me. It upgraded the look of my skin, for sure, but I can't attest to it's effectiveness for other skin types.

I think the price is reasonable as compared to the Prestige brands in the big department stores. If you can match your color correctly, this is a good value.

I would love to see these shades named better.  I received shade #4 to review (As a reviewer, I didn't get a color choice.)  I normally wear ivory, or the lightest foundation shade.  Color #4 reminds me a lot of Revlon Colorstay "Natural Buff" - it is about the same fairness as Covergirl's "Fair" or "Ivory" but with more or a yellow tint, and less pink, in the actual color. It reminds me of the Bisque #5 in Vincent Longo's line, and bisque is, I think, a good 'color name' for this shade.  I find that it evens out the ruddiness that creeps into my fair complexion exceptionally well.

In coverage terms, and in feel once it is ON the skin, it reminds me of Vincent Longo's 'water canvas' line - the product is a highly pigmented liquid however, but it goes on feather light and disappears into the skin, leaving only a very fine layer of pigment to even out skin-tone.  It can also settle into fine lines and pores like the Vincent Logo can, though not quite as bad.  I tried it with hyaluronic acid and a light moisturizer on under it, and I had much less problem with it settling into fine lines.  It really looks about as perfect as any foundation has ever looked, WHEN I am careful to prepare my skin with moisturizer first.  Directions say to use a foundation brush.  I used my fingers and that worked fine.

It feels and looks very natural- it stays on for hours, certainly getting me through the day.  It is simply, for me, one of the best foundations I have ever used.  (And I test a lot of them!)  Of course, I have very, very fine pores and only a few fine wrinkles, and my skin type is normal.  This may not work as well on other skin types, or even my own skin in a few years as aging becomes more of an issue for me.

The bottle is nice, though the lid does come off easy and I'm sure I will lose it in no time.  It has a pump applicator that delivers a small amount.  I only needed one pump's dispense to cover my face well- it should last a while.

I wish they could be more descriptive in their shades.  That's my only complaint.
summary: Highly pigmented coverage that is feather light and natural in appearance, one of the best foundations I've used

reviewText:
I give this 3.5 stars.

I apply it with my fingers as I don't have an appropriate brush to use. It goes on okay, but doesn't work so well on the pores of my nose. It goes into them rather than smooths over them, making my pores looking even more prominent (!) so I end up layering more and more on in the hopes of covering up my pores. It looks a bit caked on the drier parts of my skin. I do moisturize before applying foundation but I've got 2 spots on my face that remain a little on the dry side no matter what. I don't find this to be a "luminous" foundation and think that it probably works best on oily or normal skin. On the plus side, I think that I have less of a shine issue than with my other more "luminous" foundation.

Surprisingly, the color is perfect on me. I say surprising because I got this for a product review and didn't have a choice as to color, but the 04 matches my (light Asian) skin perfectly. It really blends in so well that it doesn't look like I am wearing makeup (except for my nose and the other dry spot on my skin).

I do like this foundation just fine and am so happy to have finally found my shade. When I am done though, I might just go back to L'Oreal's True Match Healthy Luminous Makeup which works well on my combination skin. This time I will know which color to pick.
summary: Good foundation, but maybe better for oily or normal skin

reviewText: I have quickly become a fan of this foundation after only a couple days of use. It's a liquid foundation, but it doesn't go on slick or greasy and once it settles on the skin it's practically unnoticeable (no "dried on" feel you sometimes get from liquid foundations). It's gentle on my skin, which sometimes gets irritated when it dries out (like now when the weather's colder and the furnace is on). I'm not sure whether the tint I recieved, Shade 04, is the absolute best for my complexion (it feels a little too "warm" for me) but it looks fine with just a little powder over it. Also, it has a pleasant smell.

If and when I wear make up, I generally use concealer, primer, and a mineral powder. Sometimes I use a tinted moisturizer. I am not fond of foundation makeup. I find it usually looks too fake on my 50-something skin. When I was younger, I didn't need it as I had an excellent complexion.

When I was offered this product through the Amazon Vine program, I didn't expect to like it. First of all, I thought "Shade 04" was probably too dark for my skin. I am pale, though no longer "porcelain" and have a somewhat yellow cast to my skin. I once had an expert permanent makeup artist tell me that my skin was truly neither warm nor cool and quite difficult to find the right colors for, so I didn't hold out much hope for a free product that was a random color match!

Luckily for me (and this review) "Shade 04" turned out to be perfect for me! The pearlescence of this foundation makes it go on lighter than it looks in the bottle. That is also what makes it look natural (which I did not expect). It looks so pearly in the hand, but goes on looking simply beautiful, neither dull matte or too shiny like many foundations. It is not "sparkly" looking as I feared it might be. It just looks good.

The foundation has a soft floral smell upon application. I am quite sensitive to scent and have found that much makeup these days has too much of it. I don't like having a scent right in my face. I also wear perfume and hate having the scents clash. I was more than pleased that the scent of this foundation was unnoticeable only minutes after application. It has less fragrance than many a "fragrance free" product. Many foundations and primers these days smell like acrylic paint to this artist's nose, and I do not want to put stuff like that on my face! Bravo Japonesque for getting this so right!

It is opaque enough to even out skin tone and give the skin a nice even quality without looking harsh and overly made up. It is sheer enough to feel like one is wearing nothing at all. The first time I tried it, I neither applied concealer or primer and it did a great job! I used it with primer to see if it made much of a difference. Of course, primer helps with fine lines, and if I want to look really made up, I'll use it. But, I would rather do without primer and so I'm quite happy to have tried the Japonesque Luminous Foundation because it really does not need the primer. The foundation stayed on all day both with and without it.

At first I thought it was pricey, but when I realize that I do not need either concealer or primer, it isn't. This is really a great foundation. I also like the look of the bottle and the nice pump that lets one dispense very small amounts (though to be perfectly honest, the cap doesn't stay on well). I don't particularly care because I keep makeup products that don't get used up quickly inside their boxes so they stay fresh longer and don't fall out of my cabinet. Bottom line: this is my "holy grail" of foundation. It is simply perfect for me, and I plan on purchasing it again when I've used up this bottle.

This is a nice foundation. It goes on sheer but lets you build the desired coverage. Although they recommend applying with a brush, working with fingers or a sponge is equally effective. The color is neutral with perhaps a subtle vanilla tint. It was a little darker than what I prefer but still workable. It applies smoothly and covers minor flaws, pores and fine lines. At most it provides medium coverage  that drys to a soft non greasy matte finish that does not look dry or chalky. My skin is slightly sensitive and ranges from normal to dry. It felt nice after application and I suffered no negative aftereffects. The coverage did seem to last and I did not need to reapply it during the day. It works well with other products like primer, blush and powder. It provides polish and is fine for work and day as well as evening outings. I would purchase this product in a lighter shade  since it looks and feels good.

I'm extremely partial to my smashbox studio skin 15 hour foundation and didn't think this could possibly measure up, but I have to say that I'm really impressed.  I wanted something a little more luminous to wear, at least on my t-zone and cheek bone area now that winter is around the corner.  Studio skin is great for a polished matte look in the summer but on dry skin (which I only get during the winter months), it has a tendency to sit atop the skin, which also accentuates the pores.

I'm really pleased with the finish (natural skin look) and longevity.  I've tried dozens of luminous finish foundations in the past 1-2 years and most of them make me look oily, shiny, sparkly and/or have a very short lasting power.  This stays on me for nearly a full day without touch-ups.  I like the sheer formula because I don't like looking as though I'm wearing a face full of makeup - though I do wish it were a little more heavily pigmented (thankfully I'm having a good skin month but this really doesn't cover very well).  I just can't bring myself to try and layer anything on my face - it never looks natural IMO and my skin hates me for it later.

I dab and then buff this on to my T-Zone and cheekbones using a round dome-shaped brush, then I use my SB Studio (which is about a shade darker since it's my summer color) to frame my face and blend inwards.  Never heard of Japonesque before but I'm really happy to have this foundation and will continue to purchase.  It has not made me break out in the slightest and seems to keep my skin normal (with regards to not drying out my skin or making it too oily) where I use it.  Additionally, I appreciate that it is sunscreen free because it can be really difficult to find that in a foundation nowadays.

Japonesque foundation offers light to medium coverage. It is priced to fall mid-range between drug store lines that sell for about ten dollars a bottle and luxury lines that go for over sixty. It comes in a good quality, glass bottle with a pump applicator. I tried the #4 shade which was a neutral to cool beige that would be appropriate for those with light, as opposed to pale or medium, complexions. I have a light olive complexion and usually wear the second to third lightest color offered and #4 was maybe just a tad dark on my untanned skin. I followed instructions and applied the foundation with a brush and then feathered it with a sponge. I also applied the foundation with my fingertips and then feathered with a sponge. Both times, the foundation went on smoothly and was able to be layered over areas that needed slightly more coverage. The foundation took some time to fully dry and set. At first it seemed a bit sticky but it dried to a soft finish and did not feel mask-like. I used a full arsenal of makeup over the foundation: under eye cream, cream and powder blush, contour powder, cream highlighter, powder, and all blended fairly easily into the foundation. The finished result was ok, but I have to say, it really did not enhance the quality of my skin. Nor did it look particularly "natural" nor particularly "luminous." In fact, Japonesque was not noticeably better than the highly rated L'Oreal Paris True Match Super Blendable Makeup which comes in over 30 shades and sells in drug stores for one third the price of Japonseque. Perhaps I would have liked it more if the shade matched my complexion better? Foundation preferences are quite personal. My favorite is Giorgio Armani Luminous Silk Foundation  which I wear in shade 5.5. It sells for over sixty dollars but I find that I use very little at a time and a bottle lasts almost a year. It sinks into my skin, dries quickly, offers good coverage and is truly, wonderfully luminous. Another favorite foundation is Smashbox Liquid Halo HD Foundation SPF 15 which I wear in shade #2. It sells for about forty dollars, has sunscreen, and is a good every day, less pricey alternative to the Armani. Japonesque is a good choice if you are confident about your shade and are looking for a basic, light to medium coverage foundation base that sells in the thirty dollar range.

This lipstick is a pretty shade pretty true to the picture of it online.  It comes in a nice sleek black case with the color exposed at the bottom and on the top has a pretty swirl of pink and red.  The lipstick goes on smooth, no caking or flaking.  It seems to be very moisturizing and long wearing. I haven't had any problem with it ending up on my teeth, which some tend to do.  Also it doesn't bleed like some reds or dark colors tend to do. While I did give it five stars and think it's awesome, I don't think I would be spending $20 on a tube of lipstick.

I have used Borghese cosmetics for years and I love how rich the lipsticks are when applied.  I'm loyal to Borghese but sometimes I find their color selection lacking so when I was offered a sample of this new Japonesque lipstick I was happy to give it a try.  I am so surprised!  This lipstick has an almost identical feel and appearance to Borghese.  The color is beautiful and the texture is soft and creamy without being slick or glossy.  The color selection isn't huge, but the choices are nice - there are about five colors I'm considering buying.  Being  20% less than Borghese doesn't hurt either!

This lipstick is a pretty shade. It's a sort of neutral red, possibly leaning towards cool tones. It looks really nice on my skin, which has definite pink undertones.  For me, it's on the very edge of what's acceptable wear for work- probably the darkest color I could get away with in a professional environment.  Lasting power is pretty good.  It held for 3-4 hours, which is not bad, especially as I usually have something to drink in that time.  This lipstick is described as moisturizing, and I think that's taking things a bit far.  It wasn't especially drying, but it did not feel moisturizing at all.  So, not my favorite lipstick, but pretty, and I enjoy wearing it.

I used Japonesque products in the past and was impressed. The quality is what I would expect from a luxury line. Also, the packaging is sleek and chic and sturdy. This lipstick is no exception. This semi-matte lipstick goes on like velvet-even over not so smooth lips. It wears well and the color I received-07-is beautiful. Those looking for quality products should really check out this product along with the concealer I also reviewed. A+!

I am absolutely nuts about lipsticks. I can't pass a makeup story without stopping in to grab a new shade. Until now, my absolute favorite lipstick has been Yves Saint Laurant Rouge Volupte, and I never thought anything could knock it from its top spot. But Japonesque Pro Performance is all that and more.

The formula is super pigmented and lasts all day (at least 9 hours until I finally just took it off). Normally when a lipstick lasts all day, it dries out my lips, but not this. The Japonesque is super buttery and creamy. It applies smoothly, like lip balm, and my lips felt moisturized and soft all day. Normally if a lipstick is moisturizing, it doesn't stay on very long. Only YSL and Japonesque has combined the two perfectly, but Japonesque goes even a step further. The lipstick lasted a bit longer than YSL and the pigmentation was just slightly better.

I love the curved tip of the lipstick, which makes application easy, though of course that may wear down over time if you don't take care to maintain the shape. I also love the big color swatch on the bottom of the lipstick, it makes picking a color for the day even easier. I also love the slightly matte color - I say slightly because it isn't exactly matte - it has a very slight sheen, but it isn't glossy.

As far as plumping goes - meh. I often use Buxom lipsticks, which claim to have the same effect, but I honestly don't notice a difference, either with this or Buxom, in the size of my lips. I do get a minty tingle now and then, but no plumping. There is also very little smell or flavor to this lipstick, which I like. But the plumping effects are not the reason to buy this lipstick - the perfect formula and pigmentation is the reaso0n. Absolutely worth the $20, which is almost half the price of YSL, and I plan on buying every single color.

I got this for my wife to use. This is the second Japonesque product she has used. She has used their blush and thought she would try out their lipstick. She says that you can tell that this is a high quality product. It works great and stays on. She really liked this lipstick and it is great. She likes it better than some of the cheaper kinds she has also used. She really likes Japonesque products and will try out some others in the future.

Japoneque is a great brand in my opinion. The lipstick is supple, smooth, and vibrant. The color isn't as dark as it looks but it definitely is deep. It didn't stay on all day, but I got a good 5 hours out of it

This is a very creamy lipstick that goes on dark. The color lasts as long as a typical lipstick; nothing exceptional about the staying power. The color was a bit too bold for me -- a blue-eyed, fair skinned, blonde. But my teenage daughter who has darker coloring than I do sported it with flair and got several compliments on it!

I love how smooth this lipstick goes on and how long lasting it. The shade is 07 and I can tell you it's a beautiful burgundy red. First time trying this brand and I'm very impressed at the quality of the lipstick.
