I can't say it works miracles but maybe after more use and maybe it will work better for someone with a different skin type (my skin tends to be on the oily side) or maybe for someone with more signs of aging.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: great device

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: I was surprised, I really did not expect to see any difference after the first use-but amazingly I did.  Immediate tightening around the eye area and cheeks-I was shocked.  I was also surprised at how quickly this process takes-about 5 minutes from start to finish--not bad for great results.  I will continue to use and update my review again later-but at this point-I have to give it a 5 star and absolutely recommend.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: I used this mini version for almost a full month to give it a real test. I started to see more toning in parts of my face after about a week of use. It was most noticeable around the eyes, and not really around my cheeks (I admit I do have chubby cheeks).  I noticed less of an improvement later in the month. It seems to have reached a plateau in most areas, which isn't necessarily bad. If it maintains the improvement, it seems good enough. I've used the larger size in the past and this Mini version is much easier to handle.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: First off, I have the regular sized NuFace so already knew I loved the results. I choose to use an aloe vera gel instead of the included gel. I wanted a more natural option that I could feel good about leaving on my skin. As long as I have enough aloe gel, I really don't feel any of the micro current. When I do feel it, it's not overly uncomfortable, just noticeable. Think of it like exercise for your face..it only works if you commit to it! But...IT WORKS! Hang in there, give it a week or so of consistent use. This Mini is a great travel option or one that I can put in my gym bag. Very pleased!
summary: Perfect for travel or the gym bag!

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
This one (mini) is more comfortable in the hand than the full size.  The write-up stated 80% saw significant results.  I did have results but they were subtle. My facial skin was definitely smoother and tighter around the eyes.  I am OK with that--I really don't want to look like I have had work done on my face.  I use this with the included primer.  I also started to use it with the NuFace serums.  So, far, I don't see additional benefits but I did like the serums on their own.  I have only been using the unit in combination with serums for 2 days now so it is really too soon to tell if results will be even better.
As is, I like the unit.  On one hand it is a little pricey but on the other it is far cheaper than a spa.
summary: This one (mini) is more comfortable in the hand than the full size

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
This device uses an electrical microcurrent to stimulate your facial muscles. Thankfully you don't feel anything other than a mild tingling sensation due to the included gel (which is ridiculously overpriced to buy alone, however). I like the fact that you don't need to do more than five minutes per day and the device is small enough to take with you on a trip, so you don't have to miss any treatments while traveling.

I have crow's nest wrinkles by my eye, but you can't use it too close to that area - instead I had to use it further down below, around my cheekbone area and move it gently upward. After two weeks, my jowls appear to be sagging less and look tighter, the way they did when I was younger. I'm pretty pleased with this effect, though it hasn't done that much for the wrinkles around my eyes - the effect is very subtle, not a big improvement.

Overall, I'm cautiously optimistic. I'll keep using it past the two week mark and will post an update if I see any noticeable improvement.
summary: Appears to Work Well For My Sagging Jowls, Less So For the Eyes

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
Photos-two weeks ago and today.
I honestly think a full 30 to 45 days every day will achieve the best results, after that period of time manufacturers suggest use three or four times weekly.
It's very important to start with a clean face!
I've noticed a degree of improvement in fine lines and wrinkles but mostly I've see results in the tone of my skin and a major reduction in my pores which was almost ridiculously noticeable after three day.
It's become an easy part of my morning ritual and really requires little time, but it is important to follow the instructions on handling and swiping (there is a correct way to move the NuFace --using it incorrectly will not bring about the results you want!)
It really is a magic wand when used regularly. Anything that can add some tone and firmness to aging skin (55) is appreciated and worth it.
I also used KY or aloe Vera gel (you want a moderate amount, not skimming, not generous) since it was much less expensive than their product.
UPDATE: 4 Months later the device has stopped working, which is unacceptable! Will attempt to contact customer service and if successful will add an update.
UPDATE: Customer Service contacted me via email and gave me a list of instructions to follow: to continually charge the device for 16 hours (if I had not been charging it regularly) until the light no longer moved on the device etc. I followed the instructions and the NuFace still does not work. I went to down load the return form to return the device (I will have to pay for shipping) but since I have no proof of purchase I can't just send it to them? Last laugh on a free product review. Did love it while it was working but so glad I didn't pay for it!

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: I got this for my wife but please understand that she absolutely does not need it!  I am surprised to say that this actually works.  As other reviewers have suggested, we tried this on one half of her face to do a side by side comparison.  The results are impressive but not permanent.  We are thinking of trying a cheaper aloe vera gel.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
I am always open to trying new facial products....this one did not disappoint.  As suggested, I did the treatment on one side of my face first.  There was a noticeable difference, I was stunned.

The NuFACE Mini comes with a gel that you put on before using the device, you don't rub it in, but leave it on the surface of your skin, then rub the device in an upward motion, 3x on each area.  You hear little beeps which should correspond to beginning and ending each swipe across your face.  The first night I used level 1, the second night I decided to try level 2, with level 2 I felt tingling...but on night 3 with the same setting there was no tingling sensation.

One big difference I've noticed just after a few days of use, my skin has cleared up considerably and looks much healthier...that in itself is a wonder for me, with adult acne it's great to see a noticeable difference.

I will definitely continue using the Mini and plan to buy additional creams to use with it.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: Nuface Mini. So far so good. If this replaces actual spa visits, it will be well worth the money. I can tell a little bit of difference, but her friends can see it even more than I do. She likes the fact that she can do this at home without spending the time in town at the spa. I like that it will be a cheaper alternative over the long run. It is easy to use and she thinks it will be a good investment for her skin care "plan".

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: This product does work, though the results are incremental and will vary from person to person.  Its not a surgical facelift, its more of a gentle toning.  Also, people react to the electrical current differently, thus its best you try it out keeping an eye of the return window.  This mini size is very convenient for travel.  Just go into it not setting your expectations too high, its akin to a face work out, not a facelift.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
This product seems to be promising. During use, I could feel some sort of electrical microcurrent running in my face as well as a tightening sensation shortly afterwards. It is still early to tell if it will make a noticeable difference but I like how I feel after using it. It feels like it is simulating my skin to renew or something. It can take up to 60 days to see results and hopefully, it would prove to be helpful by then.

The NuFACE Mini device is lightweight and easy to use. I'm following their 5-minute facial lift procedure. Out of the box, it took me 16 hours to fully charge it. Applying the gel primer on the skin before gliding the device over it is a must, otherwise there will be a discomfort from the electrical shocks. The gel reduces the discomfort to a somewhat tingling sensation. The sensation begins to be noticeable at mid power level. At full power level, it really begins to bother me.

The gel primer provided with the device would probably last for a month or so. I'll have to get a replacement down the road. It is pretty expensive though. I've tried a regular aloe vera gel that I have as a cheaper alternative. It seems to be just as effective in terms of minimizing the sensation caused by the electrical microcurrent.

All in all, I like this product and it seems promising. The 5-minute facial lift procedure for 5 days a week doesn't take much time and it is pretty painless (apart from an electrical current sensation depending on the power level setting). It has become a part of my regimen now. If it doesn't produce a noticeable improvement on the skin in due course as advertised, I'll update this post.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
I have both the NuFACE Trinity and now the mini. The mini is a good size for travel and for smaller hands.

I researched microcurrent technology and I found no journal articles stating that microcurrent works for either wrinkles or scars. There's been no conclusive evidence so far.

 "I tested this for 2.5 weeks when I was alone without my family. This was perfect because then I could see what they thought when I returned. I used it 6 days a week and did the full treatment  When I returned, no one noticed anything different." This was from my original review of the NuFACE Trinity. I have since used it on and off for about a year (I know, you are supposed to use it consistently, I did start using it consistently for the past month.

NuFace has an app (available on iPhone and coming soon to Android) which will remind you to do your session at a time you choose and days you choose. I now use the mini 3 days a week and the Trinity (because I can use the attachments) 2 days a week, when I have more time to dedicate to its use. The app actually helps me to use the NuFACE consistently.

Since I've been using it consistently for a month - and using the mini during those sessions. You cannot change the attachments on the mini, but most of the time I use the mini anyway. The one difference I have noticed with the mini is that it gets warm (the Trinity doesn't do that). It doesn't burn me and I make sure to use lots of gel, but it was unnerving the first time because the Trinity doesn't do that.

So, even though I still don't think this really does much, I keep using it (holding out hope that all my little lines will disappear and my skin will firm up magically). It does help me to remember to wash my face daily, so that's a plus.

Overall, I personally wouldn't spend the money on this. However, if you go to the spa regularly to get these kinds of treatments that just make a hint of a difference, then it will pay for itself over time.
summary: A nice alternative to the full size Trinity - but I still don't think it does much

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
I have been using the NuFace Trinity since last July and really see a noticeable improvement in the tone of my facial muscles. The naso labial fold area has been lifted and I see a much more clearly defined jawline....the jowls I was developing have disappeared. The mini works exactly like the Trinity but is more compact....sort of a "travel size" version. I love how this device feels in my hand! This might seem to be a side issue but it's very important over the long run since I'll be using it for years to come. The pulse is the same as well.

There aren't many differences between the Trinity & this smaller device. The main one is that the Trinity has a 5 level button and this device has a 3 level button. Other than that, and the fact that the other attachments (like the LED head for the Trinity, etc.) cannot be swapped out and used on this machine. The mini is a stand alone device, period.

I do see the same results with the mini. I highly recommend that you check out the NuFace site for the how to on doing both the short and longer (advanced) routine. This device takes some getting used to using it, that seems to be half the battle....to simply make the commitment every day. I find that using the shorter routine did the trick, I was not so resistant to taking the time and that programmed me for the habit of doing it daily. Yet I feel the longer routine is the one you'll want to do for RESULTS. I didn't get nearly the result with the short routine. I didn't consider this a waste of time, rather a "break in" period for me to become accustomed to it as much as brushing my teeth. I use the device daily....it really is now as much a habit as brushing my teeth.

I have not had any of the problems mentioned in other reviews with the device working properly and have owned the Trinity since last July and have just received the mini. NuFace has a great site to connect with customer service if you have any questions, I found them to be exceedingly helpful. They promptly and courteously answered my questions, even the more detailed questions I presented as a retired skin care professional.
Given the strength of this device (335 microamps) it would have been a great alternative for me to use on my clients when my prof. sized microcurrent machine broke down....I wish I had known about this device sooner....that's how powerful it is! Yet it can be deceiving because you won't feel much when you do the routine. Make certain to use plenty of gel, you can get a slight snapping sensation if you don't use enough.

This is a wonderful device for lifting the muscles! Note that surface wrinkles and lines are a different issue, that's not what this device is designed to address. However, you can certainly use some resurfacing products WHILE using the NuFace to improve both issues at the same time. Wrinkles are caused by damaged SKIN, and the NuFace addresses slackened facial MUSCLES. I have been using the NuFace serums and also highly recommend them for improving the surface texture of the skin. My skin is glowing, hydrated, and looking YEARS younger and more refreshed. I'm over 40, so there IS a definite difference! Like exercise for your body, seeing results takes time.....don't give up too soon! This isn't a machine for instant gratification, only surgery can do that for you. Instead, this is a safe alternative that will gradually tighten the facial muscles over time to resculpt a more youthful appearance and it's cleared by the FDA. I cannot recommend NuFace devices highly enough, they absolutely work with committed effort. 5 well deserved stars....
summary: Like a spa treatment but much cheaper!

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
Two pertinent facts:  1. Im in my 70s.  2. Im currently on a very restricted weight loss diet.  I thought that this NuFace device may be effective to use from the start as Id like to avoid that saggy face look you often get from rapid weight loss.  I have no intention of having surgical intervention so when I was offered this Facial Toning Device it seemed like a good idea.

Ive seen the larger toning device and think Id prefer this smaller size.  It fits comfortably in my hand.  There are instructions included but I tend to like to go to the website or YouTube for the videos.  So far I really think that my under chin area is tightening although Ive not had friends or coworkers mention anything  yet.
summary: Small size fits comfortably in hand

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: This product works. I use it a couple of time each week and have noticeable results. The charge lasts a long time, as after the initial first charge I have used the NuFace Mini over 20 times and have not had to recharge yet. The gel is necessary, as you can feel the current when it dries or you did not fully cover the area of the face you are using it over. I bought medical gel, Spectra 360 Electrode Gel - Parker Laboratories - 8.5 oz Tube - (Pack of 3) that is used for ultrasounds, instead of purchasing the name brand gel. Works the same and a fraction of the price. I will continue to use this product indefinitely! Love!

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
It Takes Time!  But slowly you will see the difference!!!!  I have this mini and the regular size.  The current is the same at 335 microamp. The professional unit in the salon is stronger and also monopolar, this is bipolar which penetrates not as deep as the monopolar.  That's why when you go to salon there's a plate they place on your back when you lie down, that's to ensure the micro current passes through to the other end.  But this device for home use, the micro current travels from one node to another very fast but not going deeper into your skin and safer. That said, the effects may not be as fast or as obvious; but over time, you will see results.
Be sure to use the gel primer or the electric shock will be a bit painful.  The use of gel primer as conductor ensures the current penetrates into skin in a non shocking manner.  After using this for a few days, plus other collagen treatment, I can see obvious improvements with less wrinkles.  The bag under my eyes are not as obvious and the facial lines are receding.  It's a great daily regimen if you have 5 minutes.  I would use the highest setting, at 5 min each side of face.  Be sure to work your neck as well.
summary: Be sure to use the gel primer or the electric shock will be a bit painful. The use of gel primer as conductor ensures ...

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
It's hard to give a decisive review on this, as it says it could take up to 6 months for results to appear, and even suggests you use it only on one side of your face for a couple of months so you can see the results. Uhhh ... no thanks! I don't want to look like the Batman villain Two-Face just so I can prove that this works!

Using it for awhile, it definitely stimulates. At first I tried it without the gel, and could feel the microshocks being delivered. With the gel it is much smoother, and glides over the face. It is a fairly arduous process. You have to commit to 5 minutes a day for several months in order to get results from this. So it is not for the casual user. Obviously, it isn't a permanent solution. As soon as you cease your regime, your face goes back to saggy baggy elephant.  But so far it seems to be working, sooooo ... we'll keep at it!

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: Very easy to use with clear instructions. Been using this for about a week and I can already see positive results in terms of how my face looks and feels. Others are noticing as well.
summary: Very easy to use with clear instructions

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
I own a NuFace Trinity and a NuFace Mini.  While I have achieved subtle but favorable results with NuFace Trinity, I get lazy and don't use the device as often as I should.

NuFace Mini looks almost identical to NuFace Trinity.  The main differences are:

1. The size.  NuFace Mini is about 1/3rd to 1/2 smaller.

2. The charger.  NuFace Trinity has a nice stand/charging base while Mini has a jack on the bottom of the unit.

3. NuFace Trinity has interchangeable heads and comes with the Trinity tool.  NuFace Mini has a fixed head.

4. NuFace Mini is cheaper.

I'm candidly not sure about power output.  It seems similar.  I believe that this process works but you have to stick with it.  I prefer NuFace Trinity because it allows for more flexibility due to the changeable heads.  But both are worthy additions and should improve your appearance, again if you are willing to stick with it.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
For full disclosure, Ms. Cthulhu has been a user of NuFace Trinity for the past 10 months or so. Testing involved Ms. Cthulhu trying it out and me making sure that she does it 'as directed' and observing the results. 2-3 weeks later her face looks generally more glorious and youthful to me if that was possible and it looks so when we compare the 'before and after' pictures we took as the NuFACE manual suggests. Several of her friends who do not know that she's doing this have spontaneously noted that she looked 'different' at the time and, as she continues to use the NuFace, this holds true to the day.

It's not known to us for how long the positive changes lasts after she discontinues the process because, at this time, she's so happy with the results, she would not stop using it. She has just reached the point where she is confident to use the treatment 3 times a week only, as the manual recommends to do after the initial 'shock' (no pun) period. Of course, nothing in life is totally 'free'. In this case, the price, besides the high price of the kit itself, a few good minutes per session, of course so one must be prepared to invest half on hour to one hour, weekly once the intense initial period is over. And, of course, it's the small discomfort caused by the microcurrents. It's tolerable but it's not a pleasurable experience so one has to be motivated to keep going with this. Ms. Cthulhu's skin, by the way, is quite sensitive and she rejects most face creams after trying them once or twice and it was the case with the included gel primer. However, she was able to find a replacement that does not cause irritation so, for anyone who can't tolerate the supplied primer, look for something that you tolerate.

The kit itself is very nicely packaged and presented which it better be since it costs so much. Everything looks pretty and the manual is well written. There are links to a website where you find videos showing exactly how to use both the Trainer and the ELE and nobody should skip them. There's also plenty of advice.

Once you watch the videos, you are ready to go, provided you spent the few minutes required to unbox everything and a few hours to charge the device. I tried it on my face and the discomfort is easily tolerable. I would trade shaving for the NuFACE treatment anytime but... we all must carry our own burden, don't we :). All it takes in this case is motivation and discipline and use the devices as demonstrated at their website and then keep comparing the 'after' photo to the one you took before. If you see improvements, then this is good for you. If you don't, make sure you use it right or, if your face simply doesn't respond to the treatment you may still be able to return it all to Amazon for refund if you are still within the 'return' period.

My conclusion, and Ms. Cthulhu agrees, is that the kit works for her or rather it worked after she replaced the prep gel with something that she could tolerate. Now, that she graduated to the 'only 3 uses per week' level, she will continue for who knows how long but, at this time, she loves this so it's a five stars.
summary: Ms. Cthulhu Loves It, what a Relief

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
I have used the Nuface larger size, which you can swap out attachments.  I personally like the mini better.  I like the one attachment that is on here, which is what I use the most frequently.  I like the size of the mini, I like its portability, and that I don't have to leave it plugged in all the time.

Nuface requires a commitment.  If you want to see results, you need to use it often.  I am 37, I have little to no fine lines, no crows feet, no smile lines.  Recently we were out with some of my relatives who are my age and younger, afterward, my son asked if I was the youngest.  I said no, what made you think so?  He said your face looks so much smoother than their faces.  Loved that!

I have been using Nuface for a little over a year.  I have ordered the face primer a few times, but I try to use less chemicals on my face, so I make my own aloe vera gel and use that.  I have heard other people using 80 to 100% aloe vera gel purchased through Amazon.

Lasers get your face doesn't seem too natural, but I have read an awful lot of studies about using lasers too lose fat, to smooth wrinkles, yadda, yadda.  Long and short, It's pretty safe.
summary: Love the mini more than the full size, but you won't be able to change the heads

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
Per the wife: I got this NuFace Mini because I already have and love the full size NuFace, and wanted one for travel. The microcurrent device really works as long as you use it regularly. I have not really noticed any difference in my wrinkles (I am 53 and have not had botox or surgery), but where this device really shines is in the jowls.  A few years ago, after I hit 50, I started to notice that I was getting jowls, and I did not like it. It drags down your face and makes you look tired and old. I use good face creams and Nectfirm (which I believe is the best for tightening of the neck). But my jowls... So I talked to my  Esthetician about the issue and she recommended that I get a microcurrent device.  I did extensive research and decided on the NuFace. The downside to these devices is that you must use it regularly or it you do not maintain the benefits; in other words, it is a lot of work, and all of the benefits you see will go away as soon as you stop. I use mine about four or five times a week once a day. My jowls are gone, and my skin is toned.
I got the mini because I am doing a lot of traveling (including a two-week trip) and did not want to lose the benefits I had already achieved.  This mini is just as powerful as the full size and is great. You need to simply plug it in to the charger (24 hours the first time) and then unplug, press the center button (a few times to get it to full strength) apply the gel (the one that comes with it is as good as any I have used) and glide across the face (watch the video online for easy to follow directions). The mini automatically turns off after five minutes, and I never finish that fast so I simply press the center button and continue on. After completing the process, I wipe off the device with a towel and then clean the heads with rubbing alcohol and hook it back into the charger.  I know others complained about it charging, but I have had no problem. Just make sure to charge it for the full 24 hours after you first get it before use. Thereafter I keep it plugged in and charged when not in use.
The size is perfect for travel. It is small and light.  I am very pleased. Note: You cannot use the lip/eye attachment with the mini - those only work with the full size device, but I don't use those anyway. If you want to turn off this device, you need to hold down the button (the same one you press to turn up the strength, which should be at the highest level).
Update 6/23/16 - I just got back from London (leaving from Los Angeles).  I charged the device before I left. I did not have any problem getting it through security (I worried because it is an odd looking device and I did not know how many TSA have seen). I used it twice over the course of a seven day trip (I was busy or would have used it more) and it stayed charged with no problem (in other words, I did not have to charge it the entire trip and it remained charged and ready to use). I am really happy with this little machine that packs so much power.
summary: Great mini microcurrent device - perfect for travel

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: I have the larger size of this one. It does work wonders. Will take a couple of weeks to see real results. You will need more gel that what comes with this machine to see the full effects, so might want to get an extra refill just in case.  Easy to follow directions.  I like this size of this one just makes it much easier to use.  The results are not forever. They will last as long as you are using the machine.  Very important to follow directions so you get the best results.
summary: Love the size of this one

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: I've been using this for six months now, and wanted to wait that long to write a review to make sure that this works. I originally splurged (thanks to a great coupon on Sephora) on the regular-sized device, along with the ELE eye and lip enhancer and the laser adaptors, but only used them twice before returning the set and getting the NuFace Mini from Amazon. While I saw results when I used the regular NuFace after each session, I decided to exchange it for the Mini since I quickly realized that the Mini would allow me to do almost everything that I had been hoping that the ELE attachment would enable me to do. As a bit of background, I'm a few months shy of 45, and, while I think my skin looks decent overall because I've been using Retin-A for about fifteen years, I do have some slackness to my face and my crows' feet have been getting more pronounced. I don't have any desire to get injections, so this seemed like a good alternative, and it has been so far. While it hasn't done any miracles on my face, my crows' feet do seem improved, and my skin looks tighter. It hasn't made much of a difference in my naso-labial folds, and I really had been hoping it would. When I used it the first time, the ELE adaptor left a huge indentation along my left-hand smile line that took 48 hours (!!!) to fully go away. I was following along with the video when this happened, and have to say that it really freaked me out. Even my husband noticed and asked me what was going on. When I contacted the company, they said that they couldn't really advise me what to do, but, as I said, it did go away. After that, I decided to return the large NuFace since using the ELE attachment again made me nervous, and that's when I bought this Mini. The way that this works is that you use it in sweeping motions and in certain held positions until it beeps at you after five seconds. In the places where you sweep, you pass it over three areas, three times each, in a certain pattern. Because this was such a large expense for me, I read a ton of reviews on various websites before buying the regular NuFace and then the Mini, and here are some things to know before you buy: --Realize that this does take a time commitment. When you first get it, you're supposed to use it six days a week for the first two months, and after that you can cut back to a few times a week. You only need to use it five minutes a day, but you can add on a few extra holds in other areas of your face, which is what I have been doing since I got it back in November. Even doing that, a treatment session takes about fifteen minutes, which is much better for lazy me than the twenty to thirty minutes that using the two other attachments (the ELE and laser) would take. I know that Im lazy about the extra commitment that using the ELE and laser attachments would require, so, for me, the Mini seemed like a better option. --I definitely taste a metallic taste after using this along my jawline and near my mouth. It goes away after about an hour, but is still a bit unsettling at first. --Other reviewers are correct that the gel that this comes with is pretty awful. It dries right away, and if its not wet, youll have to keep applying it or you will feel a sting. I ended up buying some aloe vera gel, but it didn't work that well and I had red marks on my face. I decided to get some ultrasound gel (Spectra 360 Electrode Gel - Parker Laboratories - 8.5 oz Tube - (Pack of 2)), and it works perfectly. --Speaking of the sting, if you do notice this, use more gel and those stings will go away. I also had some red streaks the first time I used this since I hadnt realized that I needed to re-apply the gel since it dried up really quickly on my first pass of the device. --When you get the device, the instruction manual will include a link to a NuFace site with some videos on how to use this device properly. I followed along a few times, then I placed the printed out instructions in a sheet protector so I could keep it on hand for reference and not be worried about water dripping on it (a lesson learned the hard way). --The company also has a free app you can download to your smartphone that will walk you through using it and also give you reminders. --Im on the smaller side with a long, narrow face, so the regular NuFaces balls felt almost too large to get in smaller places like under my eyebrows and above my lips. The Mini glides along my face and is easier to use for me. --I had really wanted the light attachment, but it sends out constant pulses of light, and that made it a challenge for me to use since it hurt my eyes while using it. I know you can wear goggles while using that attachment to avoid the annoyance, but the flashing light around my eyes would still be present when using it on those areas. --Expect for your face to hurt a bit after you first start using this. I haven't experienced any bruising, but the soreness I felt in my face is similar to that I feel after lifting weights, when the muscle feels fatigued. That feeling lasted about two months, but I now no longer notice it. Overall, I'm pleased with this little device. If you get into a regular habit of using it, it makes a difference, and it's a nice way to make your skin look more refreshed and toned.
summary: Makes a subtle difference, and has helped me with crows' feet

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText:
I received this unit through the Amazon Vine program, HOWEVER I did actually purchase one of these in early April and have been using it every day, with no days off, for nearly two months now.  It really has made a perceptible difference.  I have a small narrow face and I am thin.  My cheeks had become very hollow and my nasolabial lines were more and more pronounced.  I was seriously considering having Sculptra but decided to try this first. I purchased my unit at Skinstore as they had a 20% off promotion.  I started out using the nuface mini for ten minutes a day.  After a month I decreased to five minutes a day.  I have been concentrating on my cheeks and the area where the nasolabial folds are.
Some observations:  I used the Spectra gel at first and it works satisfactorily and is cheap.  But I saw a You Tube video made by an aesthetician who recommended using Lew Mieux soothing gel, so I got some of that and like it better.

At first I used it on the outside corners of my brows.  I cannot be sure of this, but I think it may be stimulating the corrugator muscles in the frown area where I get Botox.  The Botox seems to be wearing off faster than usual.  I wrote to Nuface to ask if the micro current could be working to revitalize the corrugators even though I wasn't using it in that area.  They responded quickly and basically said nothing "Talk to your doctor".  They really ought to have an answer to whether this works antagonistically against the effects of Botox.  I was disappointed
I have found that my cheeks are definitely fuller.  I am really delighted with the results-- I have to say I was skeptical when I purchased but I am really really pleased.
The Nuface mini works reliably but it has one of those soft switches that you press.  After you turn it on you have to press it once or twice more to get it to go from low to medium or high.  It is difficult to get it to move to the higher setting.  It frequently shuts off and you have to start over.  A minor gripe but they should fix this.
The process of using this is somewhat tedious especially if you go for ten minutes and do the advanced moves.  I don't have time in the morning so I use it at night when I am getting ready for bed and I have to say it has not been an enjoyable addition to my routine.  I certainly think the results are worth it and I am committed to using it "forever" as I know coach will turn back into a pumpkin if I stop.  But I read online that someone bought a second one so she could use one in each hand.  I was actually considering doing the same thing but then had the opportunity to get one on Vine.  So now I will be doing double fisted micro current treatments.
So, net net, I am really happy that I bought this.  I have a few small gripes with it but on balance it has way exceeded my expectations, now at the two month point.

Update:  I am now nearly at the three month point.  I use two of these, one on each side of my face, for five minutes a night.
I am not seeing additional improvement beyond where I was at the two month mark but will be happy to maintain the improvement that I attained during the first two months.  I do think that both the contour of my face and the skin surface has been noticeably improved--to my eyes, anyway.  But there has not been enough of a difference for anyone else to notice.  I remain very happy that I started using this and committed to continuing on a daily basis.
summary: Few little gripes but overall has way exceeded my expectations for filling hollow cheeks.

style.Style:: NuFACE mini Facial Toning Device Set

reviewText: I decided to try this device on just one side of my face. I admit I did the advanced session. An instructional video for the basic and advanced sessions can be found on QVC.com. I noticed a difference immediately, but when I arrived at work and my sister saw one side of my face drooping more than the other.. she almost called 911 thinking I might be having a stroke. If that isn't enough for you to try this device I don't know what is. I like to use this before bed so I will have 8 hours of relaxation without my newly-toned facial muscles having to fight gravity all day. UPDATE: Unit will not turn on after 6 months. It will charge.. but will not turn on.

What a great eyeliner!  This looks like liquid when applied but it is a pencil.  I have used it daily for a week and have not needed to sharpened it, however;  if you like a fine line it might need sharpening, I like a fuller line.  The end with the smoky brush needs to be pulled out to get to the handy sharpener.  The product lasted all day and did not run or smudge.  It is waterproof and I will buy it after using my review product.

Eyeliners are very hit or miss for me, and price doesn't seem to be a factor.  They either slide off, cause an allergic reaction, or don't go on smoothly.

I love this one!  It goes on like buttah, it stays on, and so far (fingers crossed)  I've had no redness nor itching.  I really like the attached smudged, which blends without removing.

There is a flaw, however, and I've deducted a star accordingly.  I stored the case upside down.  That shouldn't be an issue; the liner is retractable, after all.  The next time I opened the case, a two inch section of product was hanging out, and a quarter inch piece had broken off inside the case.  I managed to save the larger piece, but there's no excuse for such shoddy packaging of a product at this price.
summary: Nice eyeliner, but has one flaw

reviewText: Excellent for thin or thick eyelining.  It is a cool black and is easily applied.  The nice thing about it is it removes very well with a make up remover wipe.
summary: Excellent for thin or thick eyelining

reviewText: My 17 year old granddaughter tried this eyeliner, as it came in black, which is her desired color choice. She said it really worked well on the waterline of her eye, considering that it was a "pencil" style (vs. liquid) liner. She was also able to smudge the line on the upper lid to her satisfaction, which gave the liner a "fade" affect, as the original line still stayed dark and true. It is definitely great that they include the small sharpener right with the pencil, but I think you probably have to take care while sharpening so that the eyeliner does not break (it is small and thin, which is great for drawing thin lines, but also makes it more fragile and susceptible to breakage). I gave this four stars because I think the price is high compared to other brands that work equally as well at a much lower cost. so I recommend that consumers shop around to find a better value for their money.  Other than that, it was great and looks beautiful.
summary: Very Good Liner, But Shop Around

reviewText: This is a very good pencil liner.  It is retractable, no need to sharpen.  I do find the tip gets a bit rounded, so like most other pencil liners, you really aren't going to get the most precise thin line.  But I tend to smudge my liner anyway.  The shade of black is nice and dark, although not quite as dark as Urban Decay Blackout if you are familiar with that shade.  It is closer in color to Urban Decay Zero (which I prefer, but not everyone does).  I find that this stays on really well.  I don't really use it on my waterline, just smudged on my lid, but it stays well and smokes out well with a brush.  The pencil has a smudger sponge, but I don't find the smudger all that useful.  It kind of tugs on the lid, so I prefer to use a brush to smoke it out.  Overall, this is a good liner.  I have it in 2 other shades as well (chocolate and bronze).  I like it just as much as my Urban Decay 24/7 liners but appreciate that I don't have to sharpen them.
summary: This is a very good pencil liner

reviewText: My daughter loved this liner by the very popular You Tuber star, em michelle phan. She said while the line it draws is 'average' in width, she was able to smudge it afterward for the effect, without disturbing the original line. It worked beautifully. (Often that smudge meant to highlight, undoes the line you've worked so hard to draw perfectly.) She likes the design and, as a mother, I do too - it's a twist to release, which means the product discourages over-uses: keeping/using the product too long. Her eyes are sensitive due to her allergies and I know she's not as conscientious as she should be about replacing liners and mascaras as often as she should. No one likes it when their favorite eye cosmetic dries up, but sometimes it's the only way to be sure they remain fresh.
summary: Pricey at $18.00 but a good liner for the discriminating customer.

reviewText: Very dark black that does wear nicely all day.  This is a dark eyeliner that lasts all day for normal wear.  It has a fine tip as well as a built in smudger, so it is an all-in-one product.  It is as nice as any I've used thus far, as it does not pull my eyelid and it does stay where I put it.

I found this eyeliner just okay.  It wasn't horrible, but it wasn't great either.  It's no better than any you can snag in the drugstore isle.  I'm actually more fond of the Ulta brand ones than this.  It worked okay, but it's nothing amazing or revolutionary.  I didn't find the color any more intense than other brands, either - it's black, of course, but even so it was not super thick like some are.  Maybe I got a dud eyeliner?  I'm not sure.  However, there are more inexpensive brands that work just fine.
summary: Not the best, but not the worst.

reviewText:
I picked up the michelle phan Waterliner Intense Color Eyeliner for my wife. She generally goes with something a bit lighter than the Black Night, but darker hues really bring out her eyes and we were both pleased with the product there. She likes the Waterliner and said it goes on smooth and that the lines were more intense than some of the dark eyeliners she'd used in the past. The pencil tip is retractable...with a twist of the barrel, more comes out. As far as convenience goes, you basically have everything you need, right down to the "smudger" tip (basically a soft foam rubber bit at the end of the waterliner kind of like a pencil eraser) and hidden sharpener.

As for the not so great, this definitely isn't smudgeproof (if it really was, why would there be a "smudger" tip?). It might be smudge resistant, but it's definitely not smudge-proof (an observation my wife made the first time she put it on). The sharpener seems like a great addition, since the tip ends up rounding pretty quickly, but you have to be careful not to break it, because you'll end up wasting a lot of product if you do. They may not be the biggest deals in the world, but they're things some may want to know.

As for my wife wearing the Waterliner, she definitely seemed to like it. The Black Night shade really brought out her eyes, at least in my opinion, and it went on easy and lasted for hours (I noticed). When asking my wife whether she'd recommend it or not, she seemed to be aboard, right up to the point where I told her how much it cost. She winced a bit and then mentioned that some of the ones she had were just as good (or preferred) and cost half as much. It's a good product and comes in a convenient package, but there are the couple of aforementioned issues that stop it from getting her total recommendation thanks to the asking price.
summary: Nice eyeliner in a convenient package, but there are a couple of problems.

reviewText:
I've tried a variety of liners and have fallen in love with a handful of them ranging from drugstore to department store brands and use them all for various looks.  My go-to liner, however, the one I keep in my purse for makeup on-the-go has always been Sephora's basic Retractable Waterproof Eyeliner because it's got a built in sharpener and smudge tool at the tip, making it perfect for a small makeup kit.

I think my old standby has just been usurped by this liner.  Although they're of similar quality, the black of this liner seems just a little more bold and intense than the Sephora one I use, and I get less of the little black flakey things at end up leaving smudges on my cheeks and under my eyes.  This clings to the waterline really well, and the smudge sponge at the tip is softer on the eye skin than the one I'm used to (I always smudge my liner when I use this kind of pencil, so unfortunately if you're looking for a very fine, natural looking line, I don't think this is your tool.)  Overall I'm very pleased with this liner and will be adding it to my regular makeup kit as well.

This eyeliner pencil is great if you're going for a slightly more relaxed look with a hint of smudginess (is that a word?) but it's not possible to have that very crisp, clean line you get with a gel eyeliner - which is what I'm used to. I do like the little nub at the end of the pencil so you can smudge it to your liking (good for the smoky eye look) but I wouldn't use that feature, personally. Nice, thin line to give you more control and you can smudge that to get a thicker line as well (or angle it).
summary: A pretty good eyeliner, as long as you don't want really crisp lines

reviewText:
I am a fan of easy to use eyeliner pencils. I am also a Michelle Phan fan, so I was excited to try this. I received black night which is the perfect dark black. I love color eyeliner, but dark black is sexy and timeless.

This eyeliner comes with a smudger on one end that can twist off to reveal a small sharpener. I don't think the sharpener is necessary with this type of eyeliner since it is an extremely thin, push up stick...not an actual pencil. However, it is a neat thought. You can also use the smudger to clean up the lines on your eyeliner right after you apply it since it acts somewhat like an eraser.

This eyeliner glides on dark and easy. You do need to leave it alone for a minute or so after applying (if you don't want to smudge it), otherwise it may smear or smudge. If you give it the time to dry, then it does not smudge. The eyeliner lasted all day for me (I did use Urban Decay primer potion to help set it).

Overall, I think that this is a good eyeliner. I personally still prefer my Urban Decay 24/7 eye pencils for the price.
summary: Decent eyeliner, but not my favorite for the price

reviewText: I generally prefer gel liners applied with a brush, but this liner has more of a gel-like look than most, especially in comparison to pencils that need sharpening.  The liner is a bit unstable in the tube (mine fortunately hasn't fallen out as some reviewers have experienced) which means it's a bit hard to control where the color goes on my eyelid.  So while I can get a similar look without the trouble of using a brush, I still prefer that method for accuracy.  This liner has staying power, but that means it's also a little difficult to remove.

My wife is a bit of a makeup aficionado and part time salesperson, so she approached this with a bit of cation, and she's been pleasantly surprised with the rich intense color, smooth application, and durability.

Pros:
* rich vibrant color
* smooth application (likes the sponge & sharpener)
* durable (she uses a setting spray, so that helps)

Cons:
* cost

It's hard for me to review this properly as I'm not sure if I received a defective eyeliner or not. I see that a few other reviewers also noted that the product detached from the inside and fell out, like it wasn't properly attached to the base. Hopefully this is a fluke. But I'd say that if you order this product (mine was a free test product) and experience this, just contact customer service and ask for a new one--if you paid for this and the case has a problem, let them know. It may just be a bad batch. I'm also guessing that's why the first reviewers product dried out quickly--if some were manufactured with the product not fully attached at the bottom of the plastic casing, I could see more air getting in each time it comes out and you have to put it back in and push it down.

Now, if it weren't for that flaw, this is a very decent liner. I'm a bit of a black liner junkie as it's really my only eye makeup product, so I've tried way too many. And even the higher end ones can be disappointing (Chanel!) as can the super popular mid-end ones (Urban Decay!). For me, it's about not sliding off in two hours, but going on smoothly without tugging, smudging nicely, and has a good shade of black (not too blue). And not coming off in two hours!! Sure, it depends on the shape of your eye and lid--so some eyes don't shed their liner as fast, but if you have a problem with this, you know what I mean. Finding a liner that isn't a liquid one (can't stand the look of those on my eye, even if they look nice on others) and stays put is tough.

This one stands up with comparable ones I've tried (and there are many). It's going to need retouching later in the day, but it's adequate. And for me, that's saying a lot!  It does go on smoothly, and the black is a rich shade that's not too blue and looks very natural when smudged. So had this not had the casing problem, I would have probably given it a 4 or 5. Hope the company (or Amazon, if they were sending testers a bad batch) figures out the problem!

UPDATE: I'm giving this one another star as I've gotten somewhat attached to this liner. I do have to reapply, but I feel it does stand up *better* than other comparable waterproof brands...and in spite of the liner coming loose every time I opened it for the first month or so, eventually it started to stick to the bottom screw thingie better.
summary: Very decent liner (if not for possible casing defect)

reviewText: I don't know how to describe smells, so I can't tell you if it has a "hint of sandlewood" or a "touch of fruitiness."  All I can say is that it smells good.  More importantly, the best-looking woman I know likes it, so my thoughts are largely irrelevant.  It's probably meant more for someone in their teens or twenties.  The packaging is nice and it would make a nice gift

What started off as a pleasing, light, sweet fragrance, turned sour by the end of the day.  My wife agreed that while she liked the way it smelled straight out of the bottle, by the end of the day we were both wrinkling our noses...and I'm not normally a very stinky guy.  For some reason, this particular scent just didn't sit right with my own body chemistry.  If possible, I recommend using a tester or sample fragrance if you can.
summary: Ask for a tester first; body chemistry concerns

reviewText: Ignoring the silly marketing blurb, L!ve has a pleasant clean smell that lasts a full day that is not overbearing.

How does one really review a cologne?  Once it hits your skin, you body's chemistry makes it what it is.  Lacoste is pushing this as an energetic fragrance and I'd say it certainly hits the mark with it's fruity yet spicy scent.  A relaxing scent would be more musky.  Once applied the scent lasts for a while.  Some are saying it's strong, I disagree.  It could be stronger.  Once again, your body's chemistry sets the tone.  I can picture this scent as I look at a display of Lacoste clothing at Macy's.  Bright, vibrant, and stylish.
summary: Fruity with a hint of spice

reviewText: I am a pretty active guy, and I love the outdoors. My choice of Colognes/Eau de Toilette are usually a little more subtle. This is pretty strong. I liked, but did not love it, HOWEVER, my wife is not a fan. She said it was too strong and sharp. I don't know that I agree with the scent description, but I understand there is a lot of marketing there. Neither my wife or I think of "elegance" when we smell it. By the packaging, it seems to be meant for a younger demographic, not someone who is, ehem, middle aged +. I prefer Armani or Bvlgari. If my son were in high school, I think he would love it. I put it on at 6 pm and it was strong. Three hours later I could barely notice it.
summary: Probably meant for a much younger crowd

reviewText:
Refreshing fragrance.  Lively and clean .  When the packaged arrived I opened this and sprayed a little on my wrists, I know it said for men but, as a female I like the woodsy fragrance.  It lingered an average length of time  ,  and when my hubby came home for lunch he still held a light woodsy smell.  Not heavy but a light lingering
He recommends this and I do to!

Lacoste L!VE is a brand new fragrance for men launched in the spring of 2014.  It falls under the crowded "male oceanic fragrance" category.  The top notes in this fragrance are citrus with middle oceanic notes and a dry light woody base - a classic non-offensive oceanic male fragrance. The twist in this fragrance is that there is a subtle hint of anise/licorice as the scent wears.  This scent is definitely worth a try for those who like oceanic fragrances and either like or are not offended by anise/licorice.

As a new fragrance launched after the updated EU regulations on the scent industry, this was developed strictly adhering to the new guidelines. Therefore this fragrance is exactly how it should be - exactly how the perfumer designed it to be.  In terms of wear, this fragrance lasts for most of the day.

This is a nice day-time cologne that is appropriate for work. My husband likes the scent - it has a hint of black licorice/anise mixed in with the citrusy. He said it smells kind of outdoorsy and "green". It is a long-lasting scent that is heavier than others. He thinks that since it lacks spice it has a "younger" smell than his usual colognes (Chanel, Givenchy, Bvlgaria) This will last for an entire work day, which is a plus. But, the bottle shape is kind of awkward, making it more difficult to spray with one hand in the morning. It would make for a nice gift!

I really like the smell of this cologne and so does he. The fragrance to me is more of a sandalwood with subtle hints of citrus, licorice and saffron. But I also get a hint of myrrh even though I don't think it has myrrh in it. A little goes a long way. The fragrance gets better as it settles on the skin and it lasts for several hours. It comes in a pretty cobalt blue square bottle. This is a spray on cologne rather than a splash on cologne.

I am very picky about fragrances of any kind because I can't always tolerate them, but this one doesn't bother me at all. I like it a lot.

Nice changeup from my regular cologne. Hint of lime and sandalwood, very fresh, with enough earthiness to be manly. A cologne fitting for a young or older man (I'm 39), very masculine and fresh. I only wish it lasted longer, as it seems that the scent wears off, by later in the work day it's mostly gone, but I've gotten rave reviews from it so far. The bottle is nice, and the spray works well. Just the right size too.
summary: Nice and fresh with enough earthiness for older gentlemen. Scent doesn't last long though.

reviewText: The best line.

This is a well made sunscreen with an SPF of 30. I live in California, so a higher SPF will be better for me in the summer months. I like this formula since it really absorbs in to the skin quickly and easily. This is better to apply on my face, neck and hands. It doesn't really have a scent either and I appreciate that as well. It is expensive though. However, I can see this lasting quite awhile because as I mentioned before....I would use it just on my face, neck and hands and not much product is needed. Recommended.

I think mineral sunscreens are better for your skin than chemical sunscreens. From Nia, I kinda expect perfection, but this kinda adds a pasty or white layer to your skin. It just doesn't feel as nice as some of the other Nia products.
summary: say it doesn't whiten, but it did for me

reviewText:
Nia 24 Sun Damage Prevention 100% Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30, 2.5 fl. oz. works well for me but I do have to mention a few negatives. First the price is a bit high. As well as it works, the price is a bit much. Also, the zinc will leave you with a white face if you are not careful about how much you apply. Start off with a small amount and rub it in well. You do not need a lot. It is very easy to overcoat and this not only leaves you with a white clown face, but it can irritate your skin. With this product less is more. It works really well so over applying is too simple. And that leaves you looking odd and feeling uncomfortable. Used is the 'less is more' style you get the full benefits with none of the negatives.

Nia 24 Sun Damage Prevention 100% Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30, 2.5 fl. oz.is reccomended. I am pleased with it, but be careful as to the application. This is a very good product that you have to pay attention to how it is used.

This sunscreen provides excellent coverage and protection.  I like that it does not really have a "sunscreen smell" to it, and the scent is very mild.  I applied this before leaving for a sun-filled afternoon, and it was not greasy or oily. However, the zinc oxide does make it very thick, so be prepared to really work the cream into your skin.  Also, the zinc oxide creates a white tint, but the more you rub it into your skin, the less white it gets.  I am very susceptible to sun rash, and this product prevented it.  Mineral-based sunscreen looks and feels different than regular sunscreen, but the benefits are exposure to fewer chemicals and longer wear time.  I'm very pleased.

To get thorough coverage with this my face turned white, this is not suitable for wearing anywhere where other people will see you. As my husband said, "you look like a ghost and you are getting ready to go to a costume party as a ghost". It absorbs well but leaves a white cast on the face due to the zinc oxide. It is not greasy. I find this unusable. Rating 1 star = Hate It.
summary: Zinc Oxide Made My Face Go White

reviewText:
The active ingredients in this sunscreen are zinc oxide and titanium dioxide. They are both opacifiers and are often used in artists paint. Also diaper rash cream so if you apply it too thickly it will show up as white. This sunscreen is not water resistant so if you're swimming or sweating this isn't the one for you. I really don't know how far 2.5 ounces will go if you have to re-apply it several time during an outing.

The pro-niacin can cause flushing so use sparingly the first two week until your skin adjusts. It prevents sunburn but does nothing to prevent skin cancer or signs of ageing. I really don't see the benefit of adding niacin to a sunscreen, but what do I know?

Maybe its just me but I really cant figure out what makes this sunscreen worth almost $50 for 2.5 ounces.

I am always looking for alternative healthier sunscreens. The ingredients in the sunscreen are not too bad except for the perfume. This made my skin dry, red and itchy.  So this is definitely not for sensitive skin. The perfume in here is horrible. It started to give me a headache on top of the itchy skin. It also leaves white on your face. If you put it on too thick it looks like you have diaper cream on your face.

This stuff gave me a terrible rash on my chest. Definitely not for use if you have sensitive skin. I started out using it every day. Then went to once every other day. Rash didn't start to clear up until I stopped use altogether.
summary: This stuff gave me a terrible rash on my chest

reviewText:
The only nia24 product I don't like. Not only does it leave white film on my skin but it also irritates it
 I prefer all natural think baby sunscreen and andalou naturals skin perfecting beauty balm.
summary: Irritates my skin, leaves white film

reviewText: This stuff is wonderfu

I used this products for a few months but did not really notice any benefits from it.  I still have all the dark spots that I had prior to this product and I am aware that I should stay away from the sun and I do stay as much as possible (except for the drive home when I cannot completely avoid it).

I finally stopped using it completely as I did not see any benefit and the summer heat just became too much to wear this and expose my face to the heat/sun.
summary: Did not do much for me

reviewText: My skin is nearly 50 and starting to look its age. In my opinion, regular use of Obagi Nu-Derm over the past few months has returned some of the glow to my skin. My skin looks better without makeup and, when I do apply foundation, it seems to go on more smoothly and evenly. I can sometimes be prone to skin irritation when using new skin care productions but I have had no issues with Obagi Nu-Derm. A pea-sized drop of Obagi is all you need; it feels good during the application process and it absorbs quickly with no oily residue. I just wish this product wasn't so pricey.
summary: My skin has a renewed glow

reviewText:
I'm a 50+ year old woman who still has occasional issues with breakouts, but haven't really had major issues for the past 5 or 6 years using a regimen of Cetaphil  cleanser and Neutrogena Healthy Skin moisturizer.

I was excited to give the Obagi cleanser and lotion a try, but after a month I was experiencing constant breakouts around my nose and chin, so I discontinued use and went back to my regular regimen. I also did not see any positive changes to my skin in regards to a "brighter" complexion as advertised. Two weeks after returning to my old regimen my skin is back to normal. Yes, it could be a coincidence, which is why I'm giving this 3 stars rather than 1. I might try again in a few months and see if the same thing happens again, if it does, I'll come back and revise the review according to those results.
summary: Seems to cause breakouts on my skin, your results may vary.

reviewText:
This was my first experience in using an OBAGI product and I must say it is an excellent product for me.  I am a senior citizen and my skin is not as sensitive as some.....probably cause it's older than most.... but it does what it's supposed to do to exfoliate (which is to to remove dead cells from the surface of the skin).  I once looked up EXFOLIATE cause I thought it had to do with removing hair from the body and/or face but learned differently.

This is not the most expensive skin product I've ever bought but darn close.  Fortunately, it does make my skin feel smooth, and soft and for an old woman, that is a step in the right direction.  I have not had any sensitive reactions,,,,no itching, redness, or  burning sensations.  Will I buy this product when it's time?  The answer is YES as it makes my self feel and look younger and that's a plus.  After all, I can't take it with me.
summary: Great product .... a little pricey..... but worth every penny for me.

reviewText:
Obagi's Exfoderm is a great chemical based exfoliant and works well removing dead skin and helping restore skin's natural brightness. Having said that, it's pretty much the opposite of a natural exfoliant and is pretty harsh on the chemical side. The Obagi works great as like nuclear option - it will exfoliate the skin and really help bring that new skin to the surface. However I found that it also threw my skin's natural chemistry off a bit, leading to some reddening and hyper-sensitivity. You'll notice that this product comes with a sunburn warning - this is why.

Personally, I found that the #4 works well as a now-and-then spot exfoliating treatment, while working gentler, natural masks or scrubs in between. However there might be times when your skin needs to look flawless in a short amount of time and you don't have the option to do a whole routine. The #4 is a great way to skip a few steps and jump right to the end. Just remember that you might have to baby your skin a bit more than normal for a while after.

Ideally, the #4 is supposed to be used in an entire Obagi regimen, but I find it works just fine with other toners and cleansers. It is supposed to be used in the morning (so make sure to use a moisturizer with SPF).
summary: A super strong exfoliating serum, but might make your skin more sensitive for a while after use

reviewText:
This lotion works about as well as any other lactic/glycolic acid treatment I've used, no better or worse. It has the same amount of drying I'd expect, as well as the same level of exfoliation after a few weeks of use. I do find that the slightly medicinal smell is unpleasant, but that fades quickly. It soaks in quickly and only leaves a slight residue on skin, which is much less noticeable after applying moisturizer. I haven't experienced any irritation while using it once daily (morning) under moisturizer and sunscreen. It also doesn't affect my makeup application at all.

For the price, I admit I had higher expectations for skin clarity and overall brightness of my complexion. The results after several weeks are just... meh. I can't really tell I've been using it, other than my skin feels drier. In my super-arid climate, dry skin is more of a problem than a benefit.

Maybe a lactic/glycolic acid treatment can't be improved on much beyond basic exfoliation, but this new line did seem to promise better than average results. For the money, I'll go back to my favorite REN Glycol Lactic Radiance mask twice a week, or the Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha/Beta Peel. Or I'll switch back to retinol products (Peter Thomas Roth has one that's great), which seem to do a much better job for anti-aging and overall brightening without drying, even though this claims to be "specially formulated to help transform the appearance of aging skin."

This product has a light cream texture, doesn't have any smell, and absorbed super fast. As the instructions suggest to use a small amount first, it really was enough for my face: one and a half pea size drops. It absorbed super fast and leaves no residues, but just a matte feeling. I was able to put make up on right away. This was the first chemical peeling product I have used, so I can not compare it with other similar products, but I can say that this one does the job. For my skin I found it best to use it couple times a week, every day seemed too much and made my skin feel uncomfortable, but this might also be from the fact that I am using acne treatments (from this same brand) at the same time which also dries my skin a bit. So for my situation, having acne, I could still use this product and improve the spots left by acne. As far as sun sensitivity, yes you should take this warning seriously. Use sunscreen on top, or choose the time of the year when try this product with minimal sun exposure, according to where you live. It will make your face burn if you are going out in the sun.
This product together with my OBAGI acne treatment has helped my skin look better for sure. The skin tone is more even, feels cleaner and seems tighter too. I have nothing bad to say except to follow the precautions when using this type of product

I am very eager to try other OBAGI products. My experience has been very positive.
summary: Chemical peeling + Acne treatment = Good Results for me

reviewText:
My wife uses this and she says that it does help to keep her skin looking fresher.  There are many people who are trying to make older skin look better.  Keep in mind that these product's effects are only temporary, but they do make a difference.

If you care about your skin, this is a good product to use occasionally.  It does seem to help with aging skin.

My wife tried this and loves it:
This is one of my absolute favorite Obagi products!  Its a cream-based product that goes on like a moisturizer but it exfoliates the skin and brings forth smooth, new skin.  It does have a slight burning feeling at first (like all good exfoliating products do), but its light enough to use every day.  I use it at night, but you can use it twice daily.  I noticed a difference in my skin within a week.  Like the Obagi moisturizers, a little product goes a long way, so this bottle should last a couple of months at the rate Im using it.  GREAT product!

If you are considering buying this Exfoderm Forte product, I suggest you visit a skin care professional first.  Get their advice and directions for proper use.  This product page does a poor job of explaining just what this product is supposed to do for your face.  The directions on the box and the back of the container advise you to use a pea-size drop (or a bit more) and rub it on your face in the morning.  It also advises one to use a quality sunscreen while using this product.

Questions I can't find answers to anywhere:
--What kind of results am I supposed to see?
--How long should I use this?
--Do I use it around my eye area, or avoid sensitive skin?

There are NO tiny grains or particles in this lotion.  The lotion is soft, smooth and with gently finger motion will absorb into the skin.  At least that is what I experienced.

It is NOT greasy or waxy or heavy in any way.  At least that is what I experienced.

After reading many of the reviews here, I was more that a bit concerned that I would wake up and find my facial skin peeling.  That has not been my experience--and I've been using it faithfully for well over a week--in my morning routine.  I have followed up its application--faithfully--with the Obagi sunscreen.  My skin has not peeled.  My skin has not gotten red.  My skin has not dried.

Do I see any results?  What results am I looking for?  Who knows......I've gone to the Obagi website and I've done internet searches, and I still don't have a firm grip on what I'm looking for.

If anything, I've gotten a bit of breakout to the sides and below my lower lip and to the chin.  It could be caused by the Obagi sunscreen, though, and not this Exfoderm.

I'm going back to my previous routine:  Biore charcoal bar which has some scrub in it, witch hazel spray toner and my favorite "brightening" serum (with hyaluronic acid and a hodge-podge of other goodies in it).
summary: Not sure what results I should see, but thankfully there is no peeling, sluffing or burning of skin

reviewText: I love to use skin scrubbing solution up to three times a week.  Scrub removed old skin and allows new, fresh skin to show at the surface.  This is very gentle scrub that uses glycolic and lactic acids.  If you like more powerful solution for your skin you can have peel done with your esthetician but this is great at home maintenance tool that can be used as frequently as recommended by your esthetician or medical doctor.  It can be used for any skin type and it helps younger people who suffer from acne to use this gentle scrub and remove oils and dirt form the skin before applying anti-acne creams or lotions.  Main ingredients are: water, glycerin, glycolic acid, lactic acid, cetearyl alcohol, emu oil, stearic acid, cetyl alcohol, stearyl alcohol.  The only reason I give this product 4 starts is because it contains parabens - which I personally prefer to avid in my skincare products.
summary: Exfoliator with glycolic, stearic and lactic acid

reviewText: This is a light moisturizer that soaks into my skin quickly and easily. No detectable smell.  For this price I expected more.  I haven't seen any difference in my face as of yet, but its only been about a week.
summary: nicely designed bottle, a little bigger than necessary

reviewText: I use this after using Obagi number 1 Cleanser and number 2 Toner. It seems to be working as most of my peeling skin is starting to go away. The only negative part of this product is that it leaves my skin feeling a bit sticky. And because of that sticky feel, my skin doesn't feel refreshed and clean. For the time being, I only use it at night.
summary: I use this after using Obagi number 1 Cleanser and ...

reviewText: I couldn't use it.  It burned my skin - it's a no go for me.
Seems to be keeping my face very clear!

My wife used this, and was pleased with this product since it has improved the appearance of her skin.  Her skin is oily and has been less elastic as she got older.  She uses several skin care products and has added this one in the morning as an exfoliator to improve skin quality and appearance.  She uses a small amount and uses other products over it.  It is not heavy and a small amount is sufficient.  It is an excellent quality product and Ishe will now try other products from Obagi.

This seems very expensive for that it is, a pretty good AHA based exfoliant.

While it's supposed to be used as part of the Obagi regimen, in conjunction with their other expensive products,  it can be used alone as an exfoliant. It goes on a bit waxy and I did not prefer using it during the day for that reason, but for nighttime, I had no complaints. It seems gentle as AHA exfoliants go however the results were not better than other cheaper AHA exfoliants I've tried such as those from Paula's Choice.

I've got very sensitive skin, and most exfoliating treatments -- even those for sensitive skin -- cause an allergic reaction on my face.  Sometimes it's mere redness, sometimes it's an allergic rash.  Obagi Ne-Derm is mild enough for even my skin.  After a week of daily use (after toner and before applying moisturizer), there has been absolutely no reaction at all.  Even better, my skin does seem seem softer and a bit younger looking.  I don't need a lot to apply to my entire face and neck area, and I expect the 2 oz. bottle to last at least a month.  The scent is very light, almost non-existent.  While I'm not bothered by scented products, I know people who are will appreciate the light scent.
summary: Much milder than most exfoliating treatments.

reviewText: I am loving this product.  I have been using it about a week now just at night.  I do notice my skin looks better and I feel like it has more color.  I am interested in trying their other products since this works so well.  You do not need very much, it goes on easily and absorbs quickly.  I use only once a day.
summary: Makes my 50 year old skin look and feel great

reviewText: This is a great  lotion containing glycolic and lactic acid.  It absorbs very well and helps my skin exfoliate.  It stung a bit the first few times I applied it but then my skin became accustomed to it.  I do find it a bit odd that it is meant to be applied in the AM, rather than the PM.  I thought lotions like this are applied at night and then a morning scrub is used to help get rid of dead skin.  However, I have been using it according to the directions and it has been working great.  My skin looks youthful and it absorbs nicely so that my makeup goes on with no problems.

This is a really rich lotion. The base is really thick, but it absorbs well. Keep in mind that the fruit acids may burn a bit. My only complaint is the font on the directions, almost impossible to read.
Update: I have continued to use this and my skin has continued to improve. I have had a lot of sun damage and this seems to really help clear some of that up.
This is a very good product! I feel very good when I use this. I think I will buy it again.
summary: This is a very good product! I feel very good when I use ...

reviewText: I use this serum along with the gel moisturizer. I'm 35 so I don't have many wrinkles but nonetheless this serum gives my skin radiance. It also helps with the oiliness of my skin. Description says it's oil free but upon arrival I saw castor oil in the ingredient list and thought "WTH? " Well apparently castor oil is really good for oily skin. I love the price, too. Not too much more than drugstore brands. Well worth your money.
summary: A little goes a long way

reviewText: My favorite serum ever. Absorbs quickly and makes skin feel so fresh, soft and smooth. Use it with a moisturizer for best result. I use it with La Roche Posay Hydraphase Riche and that works perfectly.
Very moisturizing, great for summer!

My Holy Grail morning serum. Provides instant hydration to layer under daytime moisturizer. Pleasant scent, reasonable price. Never want to be without it. I'd recommend something more intense for night serum - something packed with vitamins, beneficial plant oils, etc. But especially if you're new to the world of skin serum, you can't go wrong with this. It's wonderful for dehydrated skin (different beast than dry skin!) and gives a plumping, hydrated feel to your face due to the hyaluronic acid. This serum is beloved by beauty journalists across the pond (like Hughes and Hirons), and for good reason!
summary: Essential serum especially for dehydrated skin

reviewText:
This serum is a really great product. I've been using it for about a month, and I'm very happy with it. It's the perfect product for fall and winter, when my skin gets really dry. I use the serum after cleaning my face in the morning and evening. It goes on easily and absorbs into the skin very quickly. It's not greasy, and it works well under my usual moisturizers. Since I've been using it, my skin has felt fresher and I haven't had the usual issues I experience with dryness as this time of year.

The serum isn't cheap, but a little goes a long way. One pump is enough for my face and neck, so the bottle will last a while. The serum does have a scent, but it's quite mild and doesn't linger.

I have sensitive skin and a sensitive nose and because of that I don't like most fragrances and have to stay clear of anything oily or fruity (talking to you Garnier).
