It covered my brown spots and uneven skin really well. I was definitely surprised how well it did that. I would say if you want medium coverage, you can dilute it with a moisturizer. I think this brand is really good quality and you can feel it on the skin. I have oily skin but if you have dry skin, you may need more moisturizing before putting this on. The hardest part was just picking the right shade. I don't think the pictures on their website helps that much. You definitely should go in the store to sample this.

style.Color:: 35W Chai: For light skin with warm undertones with a hint of peach

reviewText:
Nice coverage and no rash. The ingredients seem good for a make-up product.

Very smooth and refined, not chunky.

The color works really well, but all colors are subjective. Kind of hard to tell how it will work in a computer screen.

Overall very satisfied.

style.Color:: 50 C Honey Beige: For tan skin with cool undertones

reviewText:
DermaBlend Smooth Liquid Camo Foundation covers up red spots and other imperfections on your face.  Apply to discolored areas, by using your fingertips or brush.  I prefer my fingertips.  Lightly tap the product over discolored areas, and blend gently.  The redness goes away.  The next step is to apply a setting powder. Just apply a small dusting of loose powder, using a large brush.

This quality foundation is a lifesaver for those of us with small blotches on our skin. It's excellent for me. I am a 53 year old woman and I am starting to see age spots.

This is a good product. Just find your shade.  Use it sparingly and this one fluid ounce bottle will last you several months.  It also has SPF to help protest your skin against damage from the sun and sunburn.  Use the smooth camo to dab over discolored areas, and you will be pleased.
summary: Use This Product Lightly Dabbed Over Discolored Areas on Your Face to Camoflauge

style.Color:: 55W Copper: For tan skin with warm undertones

reviewText:
I am quite happy with this foundation.
It has a pretty good coverage and it masks considerable skin imperfections like acne.
These guys have an impressive variety of shades and the color is true to the picture.
The most important part for me is that the foundation is oil free and it does not aggravate my acne. My skin is very sensitive and most make up products just make me break out. Then I get it to the vicious circle of using more and more makeup to mask it which makes my skin even worse.

style.Color:: 10N Cream: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: I am almost 60 years old and you cannot use this alone (over your moisturizer) if you have lines/wrinkles as it will settle into these lines and accentuate them. You HAVE to use a good primer first which gives you a fully made up look, which is not my favorite for outdoors events activities but if you work inside an office it will do nicely! It matched and blended into neck/jaw area seamlessly & coverage over my freckles was good! Just those pesky lines.....
summary: Good if you plan on "fully made up" look, not that great IMO for outside activities if you're older & want lightly made up look

style.Color:: 35W Chai: For light skin with warm undertones with a hint of peach

reviewText:
I do not wear heavy make-up. This was heavier then expected, but after putting it on, Blending it good, I thought it was more of a yellowish color on my skin!
Im fair, blue eyes, and blonde weave. Im also older.
That said, before putting this on, I used a nice moisturizer. After the Dermablend I put on a pink powder blush. I didn't notice the yellow then. It does cover very good.
If I had anything under my skin, it did Not show up. My skin looked smooth. Btw, this is a SPF 25, I also put a little on the top of my hands. Looked good.
 I went to the grocery store, and bumped into two friends separately,  I have not seen in a long time. One said, You never age, what is your secret!. I could not agree lol.
Then another friend that I saw said, you look good, you never get older!!!..Ok, we now know this Dermablend does make me look younger, I have to say!
My Granddaughter was in a bad car accident a few years ago (drunk driver hit her head on). She tried this Dermablend, and her face looked very smooth, and I could not see any glass marks on her face. That said, she does have nice skin, but after a few years she still will have glass come out of her skin!..

This is not a make-up I will use everyday, although its very nice.
Although if you want good coverage, I think this would work good.
Giving it 5 stars.

style.Color:: 65N Caf: For tan to deep skin with neutral undertones and a hint of bronze

reviewText:
I have had no luck with my on-line shade selections.  It is just too difficult to make sound guesses about  the deepness of a shade, or the impact of yellow (or pink) undertones. I entirely missed the bus with the choice of this shade.

That's less Dermablend's fault than mine.  Still....I think that Dermablend could substantially improve the on-line shade assessment material that they supply.
summary: Hard to figure out which shade would be a good choice (or, more importantly, a bad one.)

style.Color:: 0C Linen: For fair skin with cool undertones

reviewerName: Gina Pera, Adult ADHD Expert and Author
reviewText:
I'm not sure what to make of this product.

For me, the answer is easy. It's useful in both camoflaging and SPF-protecting a few red spots, but it's far too unkind to my "aging skin" (i.e. emphasizes every crevice, crack, and dry spot) to use on my entire face.

Once on, it feels soft and blends well.  I cover those spots and then use another SPF tinted cream on the rest of my face.

I could never use this as makeup. Makes my skin too "crepe-y."
summary: Not a match for my "aging skin"

style.Color:: 10N Cream: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: I'm fair/cool and normally when I select a new foundation to try I pick the shade next to the lightest of all shades, and it's almost always a good match.  Not with this shade, Cream 10N. It's like I've transformed into a vampire unless I put a light dusting of bronzer over it. Otherwise it's a good foundation. It's a neutral tone and not too yellow, not too pink. I use a slightly damp Takelon make-up brush but I put it on so sparingly I'm not sure if I'm getting the full effects of the SPF 25. I'm sensitive to scent and there is none. It covers my freckles across my cheeks & nose and a couple darker age spots with ease. I recommend going a shade darker than you normally do...maybe even 2 shades. I have slightly dry skin in the summer, and while this isn't moisturizing, it's not too drying either. I don't use the Dermablend setting powder and this stays on long enough for me....from 7 AM until I get home from work, around 5 PM.
summary: Review of Cream 10N - lighter than others - go a shade darker than you normally do

style.Color:: 10N Cream: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: The Dermablend Smooth Liquid Camo Medium Coverage Foundation has been working very well for my wife.  It provides excellent coverage without adding additional oiliness to her already oily skin.  The color cream is a good match for my light to medium color complexion.  The foundation includes SPF 25 which is a necessity for her since we live in sunny Southern California.  Since the coverage is better than the products she has used in the past she needed to use less product to avoid settling in pores and avoiding a heavy look.  She likes her makeup to look natural and she achieves that goal by smoothing the product around her face and using a small amount of foundation.  Her skin would definitely look too oily if she used more foundation and did not smooth it evenly around her face.  It seemed to last throughout the day despite her oily skin.  She would definitely recommend this product to anyone looking for good coverage with sufficient sun protection.

style.Color:: 0C Linen: For fair skin with cool undertones

reviewText: For daily use, I stick with a tinted moisturizer having a high SPF. I just don't like the feel of foundation. But there are days I want to kick it up a notch, especially if I know people will be taking lots of photos. Despite having some years behind me, I have little problem with my skin. I just like to cover the spots (which are few, because they can be lasered off... that's the way to go!) and lighten the dark area around the outside of the eye. This medium coverage foundation is a good compromise for me. I don't really like the way it feels, but I can put up with it when I need to. The linen color is the lightest available Dermablend color and is good for my fair skin.

style.Color:: 80N Cinnamon: For deep skin with neutral undertones wih a hint of red

reviewText:
All Day Coverage!

I finally have tried DERMABLEND! It does cover very well. The trick is finding the right shade or shades for my mixed-race skin. I do need to remove this every evening without fail or my senile acne has a fit and the hyperpigmentation spots multiply. I believe this does it's job as advertised, I just need to do mine to have the best mature skin possible.

style.Color:: 10N Cream: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: I am not happy with this makeupno matter how little I apply, it still feels heavy and settles into every flaw on my face.  The foundation may cover discolorations and even out skin tone, but it just doesnt look natural.  Seems more like a concealer than all-over face makeup.

style.Color:: 35W Chai: For light skin with warm undertones with a hint of peach

reviewText: I love the Dermablend Smooth Liquid Foundation Makeup. The Chai color is perfect for my daughter and me. It is easy to apply as a makeup foundation and sun screen in one.  The directions suggest that you apply every 2 hours if you are in the sun, but I use it as a foundation and only apply once in the morning.

style.Color:: 60N Cocoa: For tan to deep skin with neutral undertones

reviewText:
The significant other's complexion is a little bit darker, so lighter foundation does very little for her.  The color of this foundation is nearly perfect, being slightly darker than the significant other's skin.  To manage the color, the significant other spread the foundation until she got the color effect she wanted, which provided a color-smoothing effect on her skin.  The foundation seemed to have no odor at all to us, which is a plus given that the significant other would prefer to set her own odor.

I tried the foundation on the back of my hand to see how well it covered age-related blemishes, and it did really well.  I thought I had a bit of skin irritation for a short time after application, but that could have been psychosomatic because within minutes I noticed nothing.

This foundation is perfect for people with a slightly darker complexion, or when covering for darker spots might be needed.  The makeup goes on smoothly and evenly.  The lack of odor is a bonus.  Neither the significant other nor I noticed any issues with irritation (exclulding my temporary imagined irritation).  The price is a tad high, but the price is inline with the price of quality makeup.  We think this foundation deserves our four-star rating.

Enjoy!

style.Color:: 45W Honey: For medium to tan skin tones with warm undertones

reviewText: A very nice and easy to apply medium coverage foundation. It stays put and keeps my skin looking flawless. I dab it on and apply with my makeup sponge. It lasts all day which is a huge plus!!!
summary: A very nice and easy to apply medium coverage foundation

style.Color:: 35W Chai: For light skin with warm undertones with a hint of peach

reviewText: This liquid camo is medium to high coverage. It goes on pretty smoothly. It can be layered for more coverage. It doubles as a sunscreen. I couldn't seem to get it to blend that well even with a makeup sponge. It felt tacky  on my face after application.

style.Color:: 50 C Honey Beige: For tan skin with cool undertones

reviewText: The Dermablend went on smoothly and covered fairly well. The color was just right for my medium-olive toned skin. It didn't quite cover up an age spot I've had for years, but it did lighten up pretty well. The makeup didn't bother my dry skin, nor did it have an aroma. The only thing negative is the price. I suppose $37 (at the time of this review) may not be much for makeup for some women, but it's a bit pricey in my eyes. I do like the fact that it's SPF 25. That's a nice addition.
summary: but it did lighten up pretty well. The makeup didn't bother my dry skin

style.Color:: 10N Cream: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText:
I was so surprised when I put it on, it actually covered my newly appearing age spots!  It made my skin look so much nicer now that the color is even all over.

It did not cover the darkness under my eyes, but it did lighten them.

I'm very pleased that it lasts all day. Go to their website for video tutorials on how to apply. Better yet, go to a store that sells the makeup to get the right color for your skin. They have 33 different shades. After you find the right shade for you, buy it on Amazon for the best prices!

Also, wanted to mention that I have very sensitive skin and this foundation did not cause any problems.
summary: Very nice coverage and sunscreen, too!

style.Color:: 25N Natural: For fair to light skin with neutral undertones with a hint of peach

reviewText: This color was much darker and warmer than I expected. It will be okay as a contour or if I get a tan. It applies easily and has no aroma. the coverage is buildable and initially it covered a red mark and a slight discoloration I had. I was satisfied with the camouflage initially. The marks were almost unnoticeable. but I was surprised that it did not last. In less than an hour The marks were visible, less so than if the skin had been bare but definitely noticeable. It does blend nicely and  it didn't get cakey. but for the color, it looked smooth and caused no irritation. I do appreciate the relatively high SPF but was disappointed that the spot coverage was as transient as it was.

style.Color:: 30W Bisque: For light skin with warm undertones

reviewText:
This gives good coverage, but it is very liquid and easily squirts out in large amounts.  I think the container could use some re-designing.
There is no scent and it does cover imperfections nicely.  I like that it has a strong sunscreen in it. It does have a bit of a cakey look - probably not the best choice for "mature" skin like mine.

style.Color:: 10N Cream: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText:
I've used ITcosmetics, Tarte and Laura Mercier.  Basically everything Ulta carries.  I got this to cover my dark circles under eyes and red splotches on cheeks.  IT Cosmetics usually is pretty good but with the summer heat, I wanted something more.

I started out with Clarins Beauty Balm as a primer and applied this.  It covered everything.  Smoothed out wrinkles and completely covered redness BUT I looked like a vampire.  It just didn't cover redness--it obliterated it.  But the coverage was great but so light on my face.  I walked out of the bathroom and my hubby about peed on himself.  I scared him and the dog who immediately jumped down and took off like shot leaving her beloved master to be killed by his undead looking wife.

It came off easy.  I used IT Cosmetics melting balm and with minimal cleansing, it's off.

style.Color:: 30W Bisque: For light skin with warm undertones

reviewText: This product gets an A plus at covering age spots. They disappear with the application. Since I have had several pre-cancer spots on my face removed, I really appreciate the protection of SPF of 25. That protection should be more than enough. Only problem that I have with it is remembering to put on again  two hours later. It comes in a small container with a cap that should not come off in my purse.  The color goes with my face great except my forehead which seems to be a lighter shade than the rest of my face. All in all, a good product.
summary: Good Product for Protecting Your Face From the Sun

reviewText:
I love this night cream. It goes on smoothly and have given me nice results. It's thick and fairly clear, without too strong of a scent. I have sensitive skin and had no issues with this cream, other then liking it.

I've used some other Vichy products in the past and have had good results with the brand. Nice night cream and recommended.

A cream? Not to me it isn't - it's more like a pale tan gel/serum that quickly melts down when it hits the body temperature of my skin. I squirt some out onto the top of my hand and apply it from there, it seems to spread more evenly this way. It has a strange earthy/perfume-y scent but it's not overwhelming and doesn't bother me. Vichy says to expect results in 4 weeks as far as spots are concerned--I'll report back later on that. It's a very nice treatment that leaves my skin soft and glowy when I wake up in the morning == IF I remember to use it at night. It supposedly is designed to work at night and I can never remember to apply skincare before bedtime.
summary: I think this is more like a thick serum than a night cream

style.Color:: 40N Chestnut: For medium skin with neutral undertones with a hint of pink

reviewText: Personally I was expect a whole lot more for the price tag of $31.00.  Prior to ordering this product I watched a few Youtube reviews where the reviewer stated that the foundation was cakey because I have seen commercials of a woman effectively covering her tattoos with this foundation I though that this would provide full coverage. Unfortunately for me I have very dark acne scars and dermablend did nothing to cover the scars even with a foundation. I am not a fan of this foundation and I did try it daily for a week. IMO this foundation is not better then revlon colorstay and the color was entirely too light even after  I had did a color match on dermablands website.

Goes on smooth with a light scent. I do have some dark spots on my face and hands and did see some fading of those spots but they are not completely gone. I hope the results will continue and the spots will fade completely.

It doesn't leave my skin feeling dry. But I also wouldn't say it leaves my skin feeling moisturized either so I do continue to use a moisturized along with the night cream.
summary: Goes on smooth with a light scent. I do ...

reviewText: So far so good. I haven't used it for a month yet so I don't know how well it will work on dark spots, which is what I am hoping for. That it will lighten this one I have right next to my ear. It feels good going on. I am using it nightly and my skin feels nice and soft. I'm nor sure about using it super thick as a masque as suggested, it absorbs pretty quickly - I'd have to glob it on my face just to glob it on my face. To be honest, that seems a bit scummy to me.
summary: So far so good. I haven't used it for a month yet ...

reviewText:
First off, manufacturers say Vichy Proeven Night Cream REDUCES the appearance of dark spots. Following the directions exactly, Ive given this night cream, which is definitely a gel, a fair trial of one week. I would definitely say my dark spots DID NOT disappear. Did the cream/gel REDUCE the appearance of my dark spots? PERHAPS a smidgen or at least Id like to think myself into a placebo frame of mind. I mean when you get this kind of beauty product, you want it to work!

One thing certain, my face does look brighter, and my complexions tone seems to be a little more even. Also, the dark circles around my eyes seem lighter. I don't think there is any miracle cream on the market, but this one ranks somewhere in the middle of the road with other similar brands. In addition, the smell is powerful, not bad, just powerful, which makes me want to THINK this cream is a true breakthrough. Oddly, the scent reminds me of strong coffee.

The cream is loaded with chemicals, which also creates some wishful thinking about the results someone can achieve from Vichy Proeven Night Cream. Of course, wishful thinking is just wishful thinking. Its not the most expensive product out there. So if you consider the price and the results, adding the cream/gel to the beauty regime is a sensible decision.
summary: Vichy Proeven Night Cream, 1.35 fl. oz. EVEN better than I thought it would be

reviewText: I've only been using this for a few days and I can already see the difference.  The dark spots have been reduced, slightly, but reduced.  I'm hopeful that if I use this for a few weeks/months, they will be barely visible.

While I don't have dark spots on my face (yet), my complexion can get blotchy from time to time, especially if have too much wine the night before or I don't wash my face before bed or Im too rough with the washcloth in the shower, etc.  So, one night, late, I looked in the mirror after brushing my teeth and told myself to make some changes.  I gently washed my face and applied about a dime-sized spot of this night cream on my face and got a decent nights sleep.  The next day, I was surprised to see noticeable improvement in my complexion, with a decided lack of the preceding nights blotchiness.  All the redness wasn't gone, but it had certainly abated to a non-shaming level.

The product has a light fragrance that smells somewhat like a cross between vanilla and maple.  Also, its translucent, with a viscosity akin to Johnsons baby shampoo.

Good stuff.

Gave this to my wife to try.  My wife is pale and her skin nearly transparent, but she wanted to try it to fade some dark spots. (I tried to tell her those were called blood vessels - just kidding)  The product says it takes a month, so we'll have to report back on that.  Her skin is also sensitive.  So far she has had no reaction from htis product despite the many chemicals listed in the ingredients.  She loves using it as a night moisturizer and claims it works very well.  My beef with this product, and frankly most women's skin products, is the cost.  I was fortunate to get this on a free trial, but nearly $40 for a little over an ounce seems pretty steep.
summary: Pricey, but seems to do the job.

reviewText:
The Vichy Proeven Night Cream is a nice night time use serum for helping even out dark spots and even out general skin tone. The bottle I received is relatively small - 1.3 fl oz - when doing a thin mask, just a little of the cream is enough to spread across your face, but the instructions suggest a heavier mask twice a week - which would eat up this bottle pretty quickly. The serum goes on lightly and does not feel greasy - the scent doesn't really remind me of anything specific, just a general chemical / cosmetic smell.  I wouldn't call it bad or good really, just there.

The cream worked well I think, for evening out skin tone, but I haven't seen much improvement in spot reduction - I think it might take a little longer than the suggested 2 to 4 weeks to really see any large shade lightening.
summary: A nice night serum, long term use required for spot lightening

reviewText: This is a lovely cream. I can't tell if it is really evening my sensitive skin's tone, but it does make it feel good and doesn't cause irritation.  I only using it nightly and not as a mask like is recommended. I tried that, but it was just too much for me.

My wife likes this night cream and has had positive results regarding its exfoliation properties. Upon washing her face in the morning, she indeed has evenness of tone.

The company, Vichy Laboratories, claims on its site that clinical research shows 35.1% reduction of intensity of visible dark spots.

The instructions provide two ways to use the cream - as a night cream and as a facial mask. My wife uses it as a night cream.

style.Color:: 10N Cream: For fair skin with neutral undertones

reviewText: Application on skin was smooth but then gelled in certain areas for an uneven look and finish.  Not great
summary: Not great application on skin but lotion feels smooth to apply

reviewText: I had issues with the Dermablend Quick-Fix Concealer Stick with SPF 30 for Full Coverage, 10C Natural, 0.16 oz. (the one that is like a crayon) causing skin irritation, so I was reluctant to try this. But I did anyway. This product does not cause irritation to my skin the way the other product does. I got the tan shade, and it blends well with my "fair" Indian skin tone. But the undertone of this color is kind of weird. It's not a problem when covered with powder. I like this as an undereye concealer. Four stars, because even if this is a good product, I think you can get better products for the Indian skin tone for this amount of money.
summary: Tan works all right for Indian skin, but has a weird undertone

reviewText: Everyone needs a good concealer, sometimes.  This seems true to color and it doesn't irritate my skin, like many concealers do.  I am very happy with this order.

This is a great product.  I use it to conceal my under eye bags, which are always too dark.  It goes on very smoothly and the color is great, it blends right in with my complexion.  I only have to apply it twice a day.

DERMABLEND SMOOTH LIQUID CONCEALER

I put this concealer on at 7AM in the morning and it lasts until I wash my face at night -- and that can be anywhere from 9PM to the wee hours of the next day.

I have dark circles under my eyes, who knows what causes this?  Is it my normal skin tone there?  Lack of sleep? Too much wine?  Diet?  Who knows?  But I don't really care because this liquid concealer takes away the darkness and brightens up my eye area. It does not cake or flake during the day.  If I happen to cry, there are no tear tracks.  Add mascara, eye shadow, and liner and I am good to go.

I received this concealer through the AMAZON VINE program -- I select a product, I review that product, I receive that product free for a fair and honest review.  I was not able to select the color of this concealer and received TAN.  It looks pretty good with my skin tone, hair and eye color.  My skin tone is medium, I have dark brown hair, and hazel eyes.  The shade of TAN, by dumb luck, looks decent.  In the winter I will wear foundation make-up and when I compared the concealer with my foundation color, they looked to be almost the same shade.

Good stuff about this concealer --

Created by an American dermatologist
Opthalmologist tested for use under your eye ball area
Allergy tested
fragrance free
smudge resistant

You may use this concealer to cover birthmarks, acne scars, circles under your eye, redness, and mild cases of rosacea.  The concealer comes in a tube with a wand for easy application.  The size  is a little small, only 0.2 fluid ounces.  When I compared this to my other concealer, they were about the same size, although my older concealer was 0.3 fluid ounces.

I certainly like the look of this concealer and I think you would too!

This color is absolutely perfect for dotting under my eyes. Just 3-4 dots under each eye is enough to cover my whole under eye. It applies easily and it did not dry out or cake on my skin. After I apply it I use a little setting powder and it lasts me all day.

With the small amount I am using, I expect this tube to last me many months. I am very pleased with this product.
summary: Doesn't Dry Out Or Cake Under My Eyes

reviewText:
Dermablend has a great product lineup with some great camouflage blends. From heavy to lighter coverage they all feature some amount of SPF protection.
This concealer is very convenient to use and travel with. The applicator is just the right size and works well.
I really like the quality and feel of it. It leaves skin feeling smooth and is not greasy nor sticky. The texture is silky which is a nice surprise.
The coverage is excellent and a little goes a long way. Even applied to hands and neck this works well on most areas.
It has good water and sweat resistance and stays on well. A quick scrub with a good skin cleanser and water washes it off. You do have to put some effort into it.
Great foundation and camo. Professional strength.

I found this Dermablend liquid concealer to be the right color for me. Goes on very easily and blends very well.  No irritation and it does last all day.  I attached photos so you can see more of the color, hope that helps. Highly recommend.

Some of the features are as follows:-
1) This shade of cedar/tan is darker for my skin shade.
2) It does not suit my skin type and does not provide the required hydration to skin.
3) The skin becomes dry after using it.
Therefore I do not like it.
summary: Does not suit my skin type

reviewText:
I had heard of Dermablend makeup, but never tried it until I saw it available in the Amazon Vine program. Dermablend is makeup that helps hide imperfections, major and minor. I was interested to try it because I am getting dark spots on my face from past sun exposure. My daughter also wanted to try it to cover the few pimples she gets from time to time.  We also had an opportunity to try the Dermablend Intense PowderCamo.

Based on description and reviews  and cost  my daughter and I hoped the Dermablend Smooth Liquid Concealer Makeup would do a better job of hiding our flaws than our usual concealers. However, we both found this not to be the case.  We had the same disappointing results with the Dermablend Intense PowderCamo.  Obviously, skin types and imperfections vary by individual, and some people may find Dermablend makeup effective on their skin.  However, based on its price and our personal results, my daughter and I will not be buying Dermablend products.
summary: Did not hide flaws any better than less expensive concealers

reviewText:
This concealer works great to conceal dark spots and scars on your face and body.  However it is not so great for acne or dry patches which will make it more visible since it has a matte finish.  It lasts all day and goes on and dries silky smooth.  A small amount goes a longs ways.

I have deep medium colored skin with natural tones and the "Tan" was a perfect match for me.

This concealer works better over the foundation, at least in my experience. Most concealers are applied under the foundation to hide imperfections, this one is too liquid for that. The first time I tried it I was disappointed because it get absorbed by my skin and it is as if I hadnt applied anything. So, I decided to try after having applied my foundation to cover the still visible imperfections, and then it works. It blends nicely with it, and it is small and lightweight to carry it in my purse. Basically, Im using it for retouch while Im out of the house.
summary: A little too liquid for being a concealer, but I found a solution

reviewText: This liquid concealer is just average. It is a little thin and doesn't cover very well, which came as a surprise for a Dermablend product. It is also a tad dry and not very long lasting (requires touch-ups through the day). The color appears to be darker than expected. That said, the concealer is very smooth and creamy. It is easy to apply with the integrated wand, and doesn't produce irritations on sensitive skin.

Reviewed by my wife: I have several Dermablend products: the "CoverCreme" in several colors; the "Liquid Camo Medium Coverage Foundation"; the "INTENSE PowderCamo"; and this Smooth Liquid Concealer. I got them for my daughter to use for stage makeup (she has been doing character makeup for a small Shakespeare troupe in our county). It works amazingly!

This medium-coverage concealer is smooth, easy to apply and gives almost complete coverage with just a very, very tiny amount. It dispenses from a tube and gives a nice satiney finish. I tested "Cocoa/Deep" on the back of my hand (see image attached - the lightest color below my middle finger on the back of the hand). It has an almost undetectable fragrance, and produces no irritation on my very sensitive skin.

As with a couple of my other DermaBlend products, I have to sort of shake my head at the name they've chosen for the color. For example, the Saffron foundation I have from them isn't any sort of Saffron at all. I do think that this color is not any sort of "Cocoa", and I would have expected "Deep" to be darker, and less orange. That said, if it were covering a blue-tinted place (like at the temple, with blood veins peeking through) it would probably be perfect.

I have been decidedly pleased with my other Dermabland products, and this one is perhaps less perfect than the rest, but still very, very nice.

I have heard of DermaBlend but never thought to try it! It is most definitely worth it!! It goes on so smooth and evenly! VERY easy to apply! It is very light. Not caked on and looking like you have a ton of makeup on. It breathes well! I love it

This did not work so well for me. The color was darker than I expected. It did not cover that well, even after applying several layers per directions. It was sticky and dried streaky. Try their camo version for better coverage.

This was a miss all around, color was closer to brown then the mocha with some tan it shows. Also that could be a me issue, color wise, but it just plain didn't work. It was thin and drying and didn't leave any moisture so it just wasn't thick enough to cover. Which is amazing because so many of the products by this company are way to thick. Heres one that I thought would work well and its too dry. Like maybe I got a batch that forgot to add the moisturizer-- that would have made it perfect. Because of the nature of this product it seemed to dry out in places applied and have to be constantly re-applied. After a couple days trying for review purposes it definitely wasn't worth it. Might be a winner for people with especially oily skin since its matte and almost like a liquid powder with no real moisturizing. In fact maybe thats the intended use and it wasn't on the packaging.

This is way too dark for me. I expected medium coverage to be only a little darker than beige but this is most likely for a woman of color or with deep olive skin or a deep tan.

On the positive side, it goes on easily and does conceal but it's not something I can use due to the color.
summary: Concealer for women with olive or darker complexion

reviewText:
I did not realize this concealer is too dark for me.
I'm fair, blue eyes, blonde weave .
Its very creamy, as it says it is Liquid, which I find odd for a concealer. It does not stay put!
A very small amount goes Far.
I tried this on the back of my hand to cover a couple of brown spots, this Dermablend did not cover at all.

That said, I love my other Dermablend products.
summary: Too dark of color for me, Very creamy, its liquid.

reviewText: I got this from my godmother who normally uses they crazy expensive Cle de Peau stuff that is ocer $1000/jar. I know she doesn't recommend bad stuff, but I was still skeptical at first and extremely hesitant to try this CC cream because I have exceedingly sensitive skin that is extremely prone to break outs and has a tendency to get red and inflamed at the slightest provocation. I'm the type of person that likes to find one product that works and just stick with it. Anyway, I finally tried this product and it absolutely is my must-use-product everyday now. It doesn't make me break out, it has moderate coverage (I don't look like I'm wearing make-up when I have it on. I just look like I have naturally clear skin, which I actually don't!) and it doesn't leave me with a weird sheen that slides off my face like other products with sunscreen. I have this super weird combination skin that is super dry,  but then becomes super oily if I don't use the right moisturizer. This product has been amazing for me. I'm writing a review because I'm done with my first bottle (that I got as a gift) and need to buy more.
summary: Great for me (my skin is sensitive, prone to acne, and oil/dry combo)

reviewText: I use this product in lieu of foundation.  It really evens out my skin and makes getting ready so much easier in the mornings.

If I could give this product minus points, I would. It leaves a horrible orange looking paste all over your skin and eyebrows and sits on top of the skin as a very unnatural looking paste that is also horrible to feel. It's easily one of the worst products I have ever bought and I would not recommend it at all.
summary: Only if you like an orange paste on your skin

reviewText: I love it

This stuff worked OK on my wife while other Rosaliac creams have worked better.  My wife found the creams to be too thick and too strong scented to be used regularly and I agree as I can smell it almost as much as her perfume.

I would recommend the Rosalic AR Intense Hydrating Serum by La Roche-Posay, instead.
summary: Not Bad but There are Better Ones Out There

reviewText:
Light and airy that helps with my wife's rough skin beautifully. Some of these creams can be oily and slick but she says that it applies evenly and smoothly. Worked great with her skin type and she said she would use it again.

Costly but well worth it.
summary: Costly but she liked it very much!

reviewText:
I am Not a fan of CC creams.  Ideally I should be the perfect candidate for them because I like light natural makeup.  Most CC creams I've tried though are either too oily or else too transparent.

This La Roche-Posay Rosaliac CC cream covers beautifully, but lightly.  It evens out my complexion and doesn't accentuate flaws.  It's also not overly oily.  It did leave my skin feeling moist, but it wasn't weighty.

The only think that it didn't cover were things like freckles.  It glosses them over but doesn't hide them.  And I'm actually okay with that since a more natural look is what I wear.

Worth Trying.
summary: Evens Out Complection WithOut Being Oily and Heavy

reviewText:
DISCLAIMER:  This review was written by my wife.

I've used various BB/CC creams for years, and this is one of best.

Pros:
- It provides sheer, natural modest-glow looking yet fairly good coverage, especially on redness
- It's glide-on texture cream requires only small quantity to cover up your face
- Long lasting, does not get oily or runny after hours even when you sweat
- Great moisturizing effect
- SPF 30

Cons:
- Pretty fragrant. My husband could smell it on me at the passenger's seat from the driver's seat. It can be a con for those who does not like fragrant cosmetics. The fragrance goes away after a while you wear this though.
- Seems to be a bit pricey

When compared with Diorskin Nude BB Cream, which shares all the pros with this product, I'd say that Diorskin Nude BB Cream is better on all the cons except for SPF (SPF 10). For those who are looking for the very best BB/CC cream, I'd recommend Diorskin Nude BB Cream. But Diorskin Nude BB Cream is $45/1 FL OZ.(30ml) while La Roche-Posay Rosaliac CC Creme is $38.99/1.7 FL OZ.(50ml). Though Diorskin Nude BB Cream may require a bit less quantity than La Roche-Posay Rosaliac CC Creme to cover the whole face, the price is almost double per unit. So for those who don't want to pay that much, but want to have a great product, La Roche-Posay Rosaliac CC Creme is a great choice!
summary: La Roche-Posay CC Cream vs. Diorskin Nude BB Cream

reviewText: This product is touted as the only CC cream that corrects redness.  I have been using it for about two weeks now, and find that it does not aggravate my senior acne (just went on Medicare & still dealing with zits!).  I have also found that it does a decent job of reducing the red appearance of my skin, though I use additional products (base, concealer, etc.) to fully cover up my redness.  Can't say that the redness in my skin is diminishing, but this product certainly isn't aggravating it and does help with concealment.
summary: Helps to Cover Up Redness Without Aggravating Other Skin Conditions

reviewText: Thus left my skin looking amazing. I was astonished at how different my skin tone looked instantly. I've never had such great coverage and evening if skin tone with a light weight product before. The only issue that I have is the scent, I didn't really like the scent and I found out to overwhelm me at times. Scent or no scent, this CC cream will be the only foundation I will be using from now on. It lasts all day, leaves my skin looking fresh, and radiant all while working to even my skin tone and protect me from sun damage.
summary: The only cc i will ever use again!

reviewText:
This product is like a base makeup--it's not potent enough to cover large scars, but it does do a decent job of covering skin discoloration (freckles, etc.)
There is a scent to it--some might find it displeasing.  I found that it went away (or perhaps I just went nose-blind to it) after it set.

I wore this all day and my skin still looks fine.  It's not greasy, and seems like it hydrated my dry skin well.
summary: This product is like a base makeup--it's not potent enough to cover large ...

reviewText: I missed one critical word in the description of this product - "foundation." Anything tinted should probably be referenced somehow in the title of the product, but shame on me for overlooking the fine details. So it doesn't actually eliminate redness, it just covers it up, but it also has a 30 SPF and a moisturizer, eliminating the need for multiple products. My sensitive skin has not reacted after a week's use. Not sure how it would work for all skin tones, but it does a decent job in smoothing out color on my face without looking cakey. Recommended, as long as you know what you're getting in to.
Covers well and goes on easily. Does a great job of masking reddish areas and doesn't feel harsh. That is has SPF-30 protection is a bonus. Would buy again.
summary: La Roche-Posay SPF 30 New Rosaliac CC Cream, 1.7 Fl. Oz

reviewText: Great product. My favorite

First the positives: the color lingers between light and medium and could easily blend with most caucasian or Asian skin tones. Unfortunately it would not work for very light or darker skin tones. It has a rich, smooth consistency and one pump was enough to blend all over my entire face for a semi-sheer finish. That's all great but the earthy scent was too much for me. It smells a lot like Juice Beauty products can. This was like it and more - I tried to leave it on hoping the scent would dissipate, but it didn't. Ultimately, I had to go wash it off my face because I couldn't stop sneezing. Now, not everyone will necessarily have this problem. If you aren't sensitive to strong scents, then you might like this cream. I really wanted to love this product, but unfortunately the scent was so strong that I gave it away.
summary: Strong scent was too much for me

reviewText:
I have very ruddy cheeks, but most corrective creams either have a mask-like feel or do not neutralize the redness.
This is a CC that feels soft and toned down the ruddiness so much I could actually wear blush. If you have ruddy skin or rosacea you know how you have to forego blush. How many times have you done your makeup including blush and after a few hours you have splotches everywhere.
With this you can but a blush where it looks best, and hours later you still look good.

I've used this for a few days now, and I really like it.  While I don't have rosacea, I have sensitive skin that is easily irritated, and this feels soothing and calming on it.

The coverage is thick enough to cover blemishes and dark spots, but not so thick that you feel like you have foundation on.  I don't even need primer under this, and it also plays nicely with blush (both powder and cream) on top.

The color also blends in well; for the first minute, you feel as if it won't match your skin tone, but then it sort of "gels" into your skin.  I wear MAC foundation in NW20, and the light in this works perfectly for my skin tone.

If I want my skin to look flawless, I'll use my Lancome Miracle Teint, but this is perfect for days when I don't want a more made-up face.  I really like it!
summary: Provides nice coverage and is gentle on sensitive skin

reviewText:
This item was given to me for my review.
Before I say anything else, let me preface my review with some background information. I have a terrible track record with sunscreen. I am supposed to wear it, as per doctor's orders, but I find it hard to find anything that I can wear more than an hour or two and that provides good coverage. La Roche-Posay SPF 30 New Roasliac CC Cream does provide good coverage, goes on smoothly, and I can wear it for a few hours before I must take it off. By about the third or fourth hour, I feel like my face is drawing up like a prune, and I start to itch. Thankfully, I have not broken out in hives, but I do have to remove it rather than wear it all day. I mean, it is nice to have something that I can wear outside for the short periods of time that I do yard work or am out there, but it would be nice not to have to trot in and wash my face. Still, this is a relatively successful lotion, and I wish I could wear it all day. The coverage is nice, and it goes on like a dream. If your face is only mildly sensitive to sunscreen, it might work. However, if you are very allergic, then it may not.
summary: I can only wear this lotion for a few hours

reviewText:
I really was surprised on how well this blended into my skin color evening it out and giving me a more even appearance than l have had with other high priced foundations like Lancme. I have freckles and very uneven skin color with darker patches in places and this went on very smooth and even while still being lightweight. The first time I tried it I applied it just with my fingers and while it looked fine it was a bit of work to get it applied evenly, I use a 12X mirror that is on an exterior window so I get natural light and can see how it will look close up and in daylight.  So I am pretty critical regarding evaluating this. So the next time I used my make up foundation brush and it went on much, Much nicer. I have looser skin under my eyes with a bit of the crepe factor as I am 58 years old so using the make up brush made all the difference in the world!
It not only makes the red disappear but also evens out other skin discoloration issues like mine.
aS a bonus It also has a good SPF factor already in it so that is one less application you'll need to do! I will definitely be reordering this and my daughter who has a lighter colored skin tone tried it and it blended in and adjusted to match her shade also!
So it is quite forgiving and versatile in this regards.
summary: I had GREAT results, not just for redness issues, evens out other skin discoloration issues and has a good SPF already in it.

reviewText:
I have only been using La Roche-Posay for a few days.
My skin is a bit oily, and I'm older.

I found this to be drying, looked cakey, and felt heavy on my face. Which makes me look older.
This has a very light wonderful scent to it.

I think my Olay Total effects, pore minimizer is more of Moisturizer, 15spf, with a nice lite coverage is by far better for me. (Got it from Amazon)
Going to keep trying this when I don't go out. If I found this gets better with time, I will be back for a different review.

I'm guessing this CC cream was made for those with rosacea, which I don't have. I do have blotches on my skin, which covers up well, so I think they could market it as a BB cream instead. It is rather thick, but it moisturizes and protects against UV rays (SPF 30) and my skin looks great when I'm done applying. I like it and will continue to use it.

This product exceeded my expectation.  Great moisturizer without being too greasy... Great coverage without being caked-on.  I use it on days I want some light coverage without using foundation and need SPF coverage as well.  This product gives my skin a nice even glow and smoothness.  The ONLY reason I gave it four out of five stars, was the scent.. it's too flowery smelling and gives me a slight headache as I am sensitive to perfumes in this way.  The smell does eventually fade though so I use it anyway due to the other things I like about it.

I do have significant redness, and I do see some improvement when I have this on my face - it's not perfect, but I'd have to wear enough makeup to frost a cake to get those kinds of result. My aging skin is a bit dry, and it wants an application of another moisturizer prior to putting this on, or I get some flakiness - but that's me and I'm not the norm for a product like this. Same goes if I try to apply foundation over this, I'm getting that dry dry flakiness coming up.

I did notice some strong scent when I first put this on, but it seems to dissipate quickly, and I am one of those who are sensitive to scents and avoid them like the plague. I also found this a lot light than wearing makeup, and it's especially nice on the weekends (as long as I remember to wash it off prior to bed). The only deal-breaker for me is the price point, but then again that's me - I'm a bit frugal.

This product combines a complexion corrector and a sunscreen in one. It is light and non greasy, but it's also viscous as it is also meant to be a sunscreen. I am a little sensitive to ingredients in most sunscreens so I was happy that this one did not itch or burn my skin. It also smooths out my skin and acts as a primer over which I can apply a little moisturizer and powder foundation or a BB cream for an even glow without the redness.

Unless you have severe redness this is a good coverage product. My cheeks become fairly red in winter so I will be using it regularly. I wish it did not have the sunscreen as I cannot use it around my eyes as it makes them itch and water. So I have to use it on the redness prone areas of my face. It's fairly expensive, but it's worth it for the people who have extremely sensitive skin and cannot use anything else.
summary: Provides redness coverage and smooths out skin.

reviewText: I am SO EXCITED about this product.  I do NOT wear much makeup.  I like to wear eyeliner and mascara, but I NEVER use foundation.  I prefer a much more natural look.  However, even in my early fifties, I get a lot of blemishes.  I have found this Daily Complete Tone-Correcting Cream PERFECT for my needs!  It evens my skin tone and covers my blemishes without making me look "pasty" like foundation does.  It also serves as a wonderful daily moisturizer.  The SPF 30 is an added bonus to protect my relatively fair skin.  I am very happy that I am now evening my skin tone naturally with Ambophenol, a powerful natural plant extract.  I highly recommend this product for those who prefer a natural look.
summary: I highly recommend this product for those who prefer a natural look.

reviewText: Rosacia seems to be genetic in our family - my grandmother, aunts and mother had it, and now I do. I was looking forward to using this cream as both a daily moisturizer and sunscreen. However, I find this cream to be VERY heavy and dense - more like a pancake make-up than a sunscreen. Yes, it covers the red and pink in my cheeks. But it is SO thick that it also spotlights any wrinkles or indentations anywhere on your face, especially around the eyes and mouth. Not a plus in my book. Does it do what it says? Cover up spotting and discolored areas on your face? Yes it does. And I believe it also acts as a sunscreen. But this product may not be for you if you don't like a heavy, thick makeup.

Note: I am not sure why the listing now says "Toleriane Dermo-Cleanser". I am pretty sure that it was listed differently when I ordered. I received the CC cream as pictured. It is definitely a CC Cream/ Sunscreen and not a cleanser.

I am a huge fan of BB creams. However, I have not been able to find a CC cream that I like...until now. CC creams tend to be heavy on sunscreen and with my oily skin that often means breakouts and slick, greasy skin after wearing it for a few hours. I have tried about 8 different CC creams previously and had pretty much determined that I didn't like CC creams. Three things drew me into this La Roche Posay CC Cream to make me try it after so many CC cream fails: 1) the brand name - I have heard great things about La Roche Posay 2) Tone-correcting cream - I have very uneven skin and I am always attracted to tone correcting products 3) redness-prone sensitive skin  - My skin is very red and can be sensitive

When this CC cream arrived, I tried it immediately. It does have a slight sunscreen feel, but it is very, very light. I don't love the initial feel of putting it on my skin, but it is tolerable. What I really love is the great coverage that this CC cream gives you! It definitely evens out my skin tone and redness. It is also comparable to my favorite BB Cream/ Foundation in the amount of coverage. I recommend blending it well with a beauty blender or similar beauty sponge (there are some cheaper ones on Amazon that are comparable). After the cream is blended into my face, it does not feel heavy, sticky or yucky at all. I have been wearing it all day long and it does a decent job of staying put. It also does not make my skin greasy or break out. This is a huge change from all the other CC creams that I have tried!

I personally really love this product and I will continue to use it. I will note that it says to reapply every 2 hours and it is not sufficient enough if you are swimming or sweating. So, like most CC Creams, this can not be used as your sole sunscreen product. However, it is great for your typical everyday wear. I highly recommend trying it.
summary: The only CC Cream I have tried that did not make my skin greasy, oily and break out!

reviewText: The color is mid-beige. It does even out the tone for the areas where I do not have much redness, but it does little for really red ares where my rosacea is most active. I usually get better results with green-tinted concealers for redness. This one also is quite dark, makes me look way too tanned. On the other hand, it does not seem to irritate my skin so far. It has nice consistency and goes on nicely. It is easy to spread over the skin, too.
summary: too dark and not very good at concealing redness.

reviewText:
I used this product recently and I really love it.  There are tons of BB and CC creams out in the lovely world of cosmetics that are far more expensive than this one.  They say they are going to do anything and everything but many of them are very drying.  You can actually see your skin flake as you apply.  I don't need tons of coverage but I love that this is a 30 SPF and I like the way it smooths on.  It wasn't drying at all and I did not feel as though my face was encased under a heavy product.  It is light and moisturizing.
Again...light and moisturizing and left my skin feeling very refreshed.

We are in fall in Minneapolis, not the best season to test this product.  But I tried this out on a sunny day
(1) No negative/harmful effects - no rashes
(2) Good sun protection.

It is smooth and easy to apply
summary: Good for my mild redness + Sun protection

reviewText:
I would recommend this for oily skin only.  It is very matte-  there is no moisture in it.
Definitely use with caution if you are dry (you would need to moisturize first).
summary: I would recommend this for oily skin only

reviewText: I love this concealer! I tend to get dark circles under my eyes, and I also suffer from rosacea, and this concealer covers both perfectly, goes on easily, is very light and blends easily. New staple of my makeup routine
summary: Great for dark under eye circles and rosacea coverage

reviewText:
Typically, this sort of concealer with the wand has not been enough (with other brands) for coverage of melasma and my inherited dark circles but I thought I'd try it anyhow since I've never tried this brand's version. I'm pleased that I did. Unlike the products I have used previously, this product is buildable, I can "tap it" onto problem areas and feather out the edges for a natural look. What I REALLY love is that it doesn't make lines and wrinkles around my eyes look worse, on the contrary, they are more diffused in appearance. I don't expect this concealer to perform like thicker products from this line since it's designated as "medium coverage". If you need high coverage for imperfections, try another product. This is a liquid, after all.

I was seeking a lighter product for daytime usage since I wear lighter makeup during the day, especially during the hot Summers we have (over 100 degrees). Heavier makeup looks ridiculous when it starts to melt off of my face. For evening or special occasion wear, I'd definitely reach for a heavier product than this one. So far, I've had zero irritation, even with contact lenses, my eyes sometimes water from the "fumes" of certain concealers which ruins my eye makeup whenever it happens. I'm also happy there's no fragrance, I have never understood needing to put fragrance into products that are used in the most sensitive area of the face, it seems absurd to me....who cares what their eyes smell like? This product is easy to apply and has changed my thoughts about "wand concealers", I'm very happy with the end results. Since it's lighter I do expect I may need to reapply during the day, especially in humid weather. I'm OK with that, I enjoy using this liquid, it suits my needs perfectly for certain situations when I want a more natural look with the emphasis on my skin rather than on my makeup.

This concealer works really well as long as you let it dry completely before putting on foundation.  I tried to apply foundation too quickly and it wiped off and smeared on my face.  I love the applicator as it makes it easy to pat on small areas with the tip of the wand.
summary: Great Concealer with a fantastic applicator

reviewText: I have always heard wonderful things about Dermablend, so I was eager to try one of their products. I have some redness on my cheeks and dark areas under my eyes, which this product covered fairly well. However, it does not blend very easily and takes some work to keep from looking chalky on my skin. When I apply mineral powder foundation over this product, it does even out the red areas and looks natural. That said, it isn't exceptional enough to justify the high price (currently $22.80). I have used drugstore brand concealers (Maybelline, Cover Girl, etc.) that work just as well for a fraction of the price. To me, this is just an "ordinary" concealer and not what I was expecting from Dermablend.
summary: Covers red areas and dark circles but overpriced

reviewText: I have extremely fair skin and as a result, I have a really hard time finding makeup that is light enough for me.  This was also too dark, so I had to apply more than I actually needed to help it "blend".  It did have good coverage, was easy to apply and lasted a long time, I just wish it came in more variety of colors for us fair skinned people.
summary: It did have good coverage, was easy to apply and lasted a ...

reviewText: very good at hiding blemishes, scars and dark circles. blends well with same makeup brand and doesn't rub off easily.

I don't use a lot of makeup, but a good concealer is always handy to have. That said, I've had a lot of trouble finding anything that didn't cause more trouble than it covered. This Dermablend product is much better! It's quite opaque, but blends quite well. It doesn't get cakey or settle in creases.

You don't need to use much, but since it is so potent, it's important to get the right color. Fortunately the web page here offers a lot of help. (I only got one color to test, and I think it's a teensy bit too light for me, at least in the summer.)

Recommended.

This product matches it's description. It's a liquid concealer with medium coverage. I like to use it under my eyes to brighten the area and conceal dark circles. A little goes a long way and if you put on too much it can cake and settle into lines. It dries to a nice matte/powdery finish. I was not impressed with it's ability to cover blemishes. I prefer to use a thicker concealer for pimples since liquids do not provide as much coverage or stay put well.

The formula does not have any noticeable fragrance and did not cause me any irritation. It lasts most of the day under my eyes, but I do need to blend it with my fingers periodically to keep it even.
summary: Great under eyes, not for blemishes!

reviewText:
What surprised me about this Dermablend product is that it was lighter shade than I expected.  All the other products from Dermablend that I have tried have been surprised me with how dark they were compared to the photo, but this one was a bit lighter.

What I like about this liquid concealer is the matte finish.  It's easy to apply and it's not greasy and it works well with foundation.  It's not heavy like many of Dermablends products that are almost like a paste.  This is like other concealers I have used in the past.  And it should cover most broken veins (you know those tiny red ones) and most freckles.  I tried it on a this yucky age spot on my hand and it couldn't cover it by itself.  It would definitely need foundation.

**Would I pay more for it?  Answer is no.  This is a nice product but not a superior product.
summary: Light Coverage in a great matte finish

reviewText: Perfect for the circles underneath my eyes and small blemishes. I use a very similar concealer made by MAC for the same thing. Dermablends glides on smooth and is easy to blend. It gives light to medium coverage when blended with a brush. The color seems too light for my skin, but it's perfect for under the eye. A make up artist had told me to go light to give your face some highlights and to not get the same color that you would use for the rest of your face. I am normally around 25N but biscuit suits my underage just fine.

I like a full coverage concealer (my current fav is Tarte Shape Tape Contour Concealer - Light) so I wasn't sure if this "medium coverage" would be enough for me. It isn't as full coverage as my Tarte, but it isn't as drying either, and the finish was a true medium coverage, which, for me, makes it perfect for more natural makeup days. It didn't crease or cake up (if set with a powder) and the yellow undertone added a much-needed brightness. I'm a fan.
summary: Great for more natural make up days

reviewText: This concealer (for me) was a once-a-day application for gnarly, angry zits on my face. It blends easily with my skin tone and while I don't use it often (I'm male), it does cover skin blemishes very well as needed.

Lucky me, I got to test four Dermablend products. I liked the other three better than this one. I think I do not have the problems this product solves. I have fair skin with freckles and age spots. I need light camouflage, not heavy camouflage. I think this product provides heavy camouflage. It goes on kind of thick. It hides things, but it looks like you are wearing makeup. I recommend this product for people who need a heavy concealer to hide something a little worse than freckles and age spots. For normal skin with ordinary blemishes, try the creamy concealer stick. That one blends in better and looks more natural, in my opinion.

I really like that this concealer is a fairly light formula for a concealer.  It dabs on without feeling overly heavy, and because it is a more liquid product that some other concealers I've tried, it doesn't tug at your skin when you blend it in.  A light application will not get cakey looking, and it wears well.  It does a good job of covering minor imperfections.  The Biscuit color that I got is a fairly light shade, not the lightest, but meant for fair-skinned people.  I don't use concealer every day, but when I do, this one does a great job.

There's a difference between the Fair and Light tints on this concealer, but it's miniscule. Honestly, I think the two are misnamed. The Light tube is actually a bit darker to my eye than the Fair. See the photo.

The Fair turned out to be the right shade for me and after several days of use, I like it. I haven't had any skin irritation when using it to cover under eye circles. It doesn't cake up, but I use a very tiny amount so your mileage may vary.
summary: The Fair is a bit lighter than the Light. Works well for dark circles

reviewerName: Leah Maines, best-selling, award-winning author, actor, and editor
reviewText:
This concealer is incredibly lightweight and does not settle in creases or lines.  The coverage is much better than expected.  It covers well even without a primer.  The color was a very good match for my skin.  It wears well--it lasted.

I have very sensitive skin, and I had no problem with this product.

This is a good medium coverage concealer.  If youve got some minor imperfections, moderate redness or mild to moderate discoloration this will do the trick, but if you're looking to cover any significant scarring or pigmentation issues youll need something heavier.

This formula is very easy to work with  its creamy and easy to blend.  Just dab a *tiny* amount on the area you want to cover then gently tap it in with your finger or a concealer brush.  Ive been able to use this on the under eye area and as long as I apply it sparingly it doesnt emphasize the fine lines and wrinkles.  I generally shy away from concealers for everyday use as they tend to look unnatural, but I really like this formulation  a definite Thumbs Up!
summary: We've all got something to hide...

reviewText:
Years ago I tried a Dermablend concealer, but it was thick and cakey--I didn't like it. Well, they have improved this product 100% and I just love it!

The color runs just a bit darker than expected, so I recommend purchasing a shade lighter than you usually might buy (I have an extremely fair complexion, so I don't know about the darker colors).

The wand applicator carries just enough product to dot along areas you wish to conceal. After dotting, you tap the product in with your finger or a sponge. The coverage is very good and the product doesn't settle into fine lines, which I love! After applying the concealer, just apply the rest of your makeup as usual, and it looks very natural.

Good stuff! Five stars.
Wonderful concealer, great coverage, water resistant and stays on until you take it off. Would recommend these products highly

This container and wand remind me of a brand name concealer I used for years and years before it was discontinued.

I have tried the baked powders and the liquid concealers and the stick concealers, but this Dermablend is the best by far.  A little bit goes a long way and if you have dry skin like I do, make sure you have moisturizer underneath the concealer, but make sure it is completely morphed into your skin and not tacky before applying this concealer or it will not stay on.

Definitely recommend and thrilled I found it.

I've always had trouble with standard foundations finding my perfect shade of brown. Especially during the summer when i tan, i was really skeptical trying Dermablend, but fell in love instantly with their liquid foundation. Like a lot of women on occasion i need a good concealer so I decided to try their liquid smooth. This concealer is light and blends almost instantly with liquid foundations. . When applied with the foundation it  will leave your skin looking very healthy and smooth.

I will say it doesn't cover for me personally as well as the "quick fix" stick however it does the job especially against the occasional spot. Overall for all of us brown skin girls, this is the color and cover we've been searching for.  I would definitely give it a try, it's worth the extra $$ for the quality.

Dermablend Smooth Liquid Concealer goes on smoothly, blends well, and doesn't settle into my "fine" wrinkles. Dermablend liquid is more on the thicker side of the concealer spectrum, so a little goes a long way. I find it best to blend/spread using a brush.

I have lighter olive skin & the nutmeg color works well for my summer tones. The color does not have a pink base, and is more of a "medium" color.

If you are looking for a concealer that lasts all day long, Dermablend is worth trying.
summary: Goes on Smoothly, Blends Well & Doesn't Settle into "Fine" Wrinkles

reviewText:
Covers intense.  Sets up quickly . Not sticky but smooth.  Best liquid conceal I have found. Intense and covers the darkest of imperfections.
Waterproof
Doesn't smug or rub off.
Must use soap and water to totally remove.
Good product
Highly recommend

I think this dermablend Smooth Liquid is a really good drugstore concealer. It works great to cover dark circles and it lasts all day. It's also easy to blend. I have a few different concealers and different price ranges and this is a good value and does its job. It's not too heavy and the shade matches well to my skin tone. I don't think it blocks pores and it works for a long amount of time without creasing.

This does it's job pretty well even compared to higher priced concealers.

I would say this is a medium coverage concealer. It goes on smoothly and lasts all day with foundation and setting powder.  The wand applicator makes it easy to apply just in the right place and with just the right amount of product.

Also works for freckles and small acne scars. Ophthalmologist approved.

Dermablend Professional Smooth Liquid Camo Medium Coverage Concealer Nutmeg (****) is by far most popular medium beige, but it has an interesting application for concealing & neutralizing makeup not by hiding blemishes and discoloration in order to achieve an almost perfectly uniform appearance, which is extremely rare and thus uncommon, but by greatly reducing their intensity to make them appearing like a natural only slight variation of color typical to the rest and vast majority of us additionally intensifying with aging.  It is especially useful to cover darker or more reddish blemishes and discoloration, so the resulting hue, which is a product of making natural slightly darker, becomes a typical natural variant.  In other words, of 2 methods: (1) to choose a color matching the complexion to cover entirely the discolorations, or (2) to choose the natural color and to cover the discolorations with a thinner layer showing slightly trough, the second is much cheaper, as using much less creme, and does not produce artificial, mask-like effect, but requires more artist-like skills.

It does cover little imperfections.  I used it not only under the eyes but on my chin where there are broken capillaries and on my laugh lines to camouflage.  It can look a little chalky when dry though.  I was worried that the color might be a little dark on my skin but it was almost a touch light.  I consider my skin fair with some redness.  I still use it to cover certain imperfections but not under the eyes because it seeped into my eyes and irritated them.

After trying dozens of concealers, I was sure that the two concealers I used the past several months were the best for me, but I gave this a shot anyway... and I am very glad that I did!

This concealer is lightweight and is easy to apply evenly and seamlessly, with natural looking result.
I mostly apply concealers in two areas, under eye and on the sides of nose. Most concealers that are light enough to apply under the eye do not have enough coverage for my nose, but this one does! This means I don't have to use two different concealers anymore! The has good coverage, even for the most delicate, mobile areas of the face, which means it is good for your entire face.

Great news when travelling!  Its economical, but not only because you need one instead of two. The applicator touches the skin directly, meaning it brings back some germs to the container every time I use the concealer.  It is not good to keep using the same concealer for a long time, but because you use very small amount at a time, it usually lasts forever! I am guessing this concealer will last even longer than most other concealers because it is not too thick. If you use multiple concealers on different parts of your face, you only use a little of each, and may end up in throwing away unused portions of the products, so having just one versatile concealer should be more economical.

The color happened to be perfect to me. I usually use second to third brightest color of foundation, and my skin is more yellowish than pinkish.  This is a great, versatile concealer!  Highly recommended!

The photo shows before and after using the concealer, under eye and side of nose on (not under) with BB cream, after washing face and applied only moisturizer.

I naturally have dark circles under my eyes even though I could have had 9 hours of sleep... genetically, I have dark circles so I actively look for a concealer that has nice coverage for this area that withstands all day in a humid environment. Although this is moisturizing and does not feel as if its drying out my eyes, the coverage isn't as great as I would prefer... For minor imperfections, this would work great-  maybe for slight acne scars or some redness... but for dark circles or a freckle, I don't think it would be that effective. Overall, when compared to other concealers I have tried, it goes on smoothly, does not cake or clump, and feels light.
summary: Seems like a great product, but didn't work for me...

reviewText:
Although I've been using Dermablend foundation for several years now, I had never tried this Smooth Liquid Concealer Makeup for Medium to Full Coverage with Matte Finish til now and I'm very pleased with how it works.

This is a liquid concealer and it comes with a sponge tip applicator like you find in lip glosses. It smooths on very easily and covers dark, under eye circles very well. It also covers small scars and discolorations but if you have larger scars or birthmarks, Dermablend makes products that will cover those better. I would consider this a medium coverage concealer.

This concealer is oilier than my normal concealer and it seems to work best - like most makeup - when you use a setting powder after application. Note: the product page says it contains mineral oil but the packaging only mentions sunflower seed oil (helianthus annuus seed oil.) Based on how it feels, I think there *is* mineral oil in this concealer but it's hard to say. Anyway, since my skin tends toward oiliness, I likely will not use this in the summer but for people with normal to dry skin, this would be a great, year-round concealer.

It has no fragrance and the Nutmeg color is just as depicted and works well as a concealer on my dark skin.
summary: Covers under eye circles very well but it's a little too oily for my skin in summer

reviewText: Wife says this is a good product but it is just a tad darker than she prefers. However, she will keep this on hand to tide her over to use when she runs out of a lighter color and has not had a chance to renew the lighter color.

Dermablend is a division of Loreal.  I have ordered this product online and I am not sure if it is available in the retail stores.  I use this little wand under eyes to enhance coverage once foundation is added to my face.  I like the shade, it is not too obvious and it helps conceal any imperfections such as dark circles or undereye bags.  Wand is easy to store and one can easily carry it in a purse.

The shade of the sample I got is a bit too light for my skintone, but if you can pick the right color- this would be a pretty effective concealer.  The wand applicator is certainly handy for precise targeting of the desired areas.  I'm using it under my regular foundation.  It doesn't completely cover the dark patch I have on my face (or at least not with the amount I'm willing to slather on) but it certainly minimizes it.

As far as performance, this concealer goes on well and does not cake up.  It blends in nicely.  Like any pigmented product, it requires determining which shade is best for your skin tone.  Nutmegs goes is actually fairly light to medium.  Unless you are very pale/fair-skinned, it should blend in nicely for most medium to olive skin ones.

The applicator works well for general application, but also to apply a dot of concealer directly over a very red blemish.

Dermablend is a bit pricey for the quantity, so you may want to look at other concealers that do a similar job at a somewhat lower price. It is absolutely a quality product, but at $26 for 0.2 of an ounce............it is a bit high-priced.

Silky smooth concealer. I love the fact that it blends in well and leaves skin looking covered, but natural. Works well on all areas of the face, including eyes. Stays on for a long time. No need to reapply during the day. Love how it looks and feels.

I especially like to put a little dab of Dermablend Smooth Liquid Concealer Makeup under my eye in little spots and then blend it in with my fingertip. It blends well with my fair skin tone. I deal with rosacea which tends to break out with certain cosmetics. Needless to say I was pleased that this corrective concealer did not cause any outbreaks. I can truly say that this product works for me. This corrective concealer tube COMPLETELY eliminated the appearance of those dark circles. I am very pleased with this product. I like that the concealer tube is not opaque and therefore you know whether or not you are almost out of concealer.  I recommend this concealer for every day wear.

I love this coverup and the applicator.  This concealer covered my age spot, large pores and tiny red viens.  I use this under foundation to complete a smooth, even facial tone. I did not break out with acne after use.  Typically this price point is high for me but the old expression,"you can what you pay for" would apply in with this product

I've long been curious about StriVectin products. I also tend to splurge on facial products so I liked the notion of something that would enhance the effectiveness of what I've already been using. I've been also using the Clarisonic Mia 2 Sonic Skin Cleansing System, Lavender which claims to improve your skin's absorption of Vitamin C, but this was the first topical product I've seen that claims to boost performance of your skin care routine. To give context to the rest of the review, I'm a 30-something with skin that is acne-prone but also sensitive and dry as a side effect of two rounds of Accutane in the past. As a result, I look for products that make my skin look soft and hydrated, while avoiding things that overly irritate my skin or aggravate breakouts. When opening this product I first appreciated how well packaged it is. My bottle came tightly sealed in plastic and not a drop was unaccounted for. Given how expensive this is per ounce I much appreciated that none is wasted. The instructions, however, leave a lot to be desired. It seems to be one instruction sheet for many StriVectin products. In fact, at first I thought it was a sheet for the wrong product until I realized the Booster Oil was mentioned, just for only a couple of sentences. It's a shame because with a product this expensive I always want to better understand how it works and how to best apply it for maximum effectiveness. Here the instructions were simple and straight forward. Apply 2-3 drops to my face with or without moisturizer and then follow up with my usual serum. It didn't specify that it had to be StriVectin Serum so I used Ole Henriksen Truth Serum Collagen Booster 1.7 oz because that's what I'm using at the moment. When I went to apply this the first thing I realized was that I didn't love the application process. Essentially you screw off the lid to reveal a dropper. I like that the dropper gives you a precise measurement of how much you need, but I don't like that the rest of the container is essentially open making it easy to spill.
