It feels pleasant when it's applied, and there's enough product to last a long time (which is good because this stuff is VERY expensive). According to the package, the ingredients include Pro-Niacin, Lipodipeptide Tensor, Algae Extract, and Sodium Hyaluronate--all of which contribute to slowing down the skin aging process--and maybe even reverse some damage.

The product definitely made my skin feel softer and tighter. Also, the next morning I thought the product made my neck look better. Maybe it's an illusion, but I definitely plan to continue to use this.
summary: Crazy Expensive But Seems To Work

reviewText:
I didn't experience skin irritation as some of the other reviewers did--sorry to hear people have had reactions, my skin is extremely sensitive, so I can empathize. Thankfully the Nia 24, with its hyaluronic acid (one of my fave ingredients) and niacin, has smoothed my neck. I feel tightening underneath my chin--over time the skin does loosen and become baggy. Definitely an improvement there.

The other tester and I noticed how nice this cream feels, how pleasant once you apply it. It's only been a few days, but already our necks seem smoother/ We have reddening and discoloration from life, but what we see in the mirror and how the skin feels to the touch...what a difference! We knew about the Nia 24 product line before and always had a favorable opinion. This newest offering does not disappoint, but delights.
summary: No redness or itching, softer, more supple, tighter, together skin

reviewText: My wife says it works well. Neck seems a smoother. Really don't need much at all to rub in. Been using for a couple of weeks and seems quite promising. No redness or other ill effects from the use of the cream. Unlikely to be a miracle cream but does seem to help a bit and every bit counts.
summary: Luxurious Cream That Does Seem to Work

reviewText:
I have sensitive skin and was a bit concerned about whether this cream would cause problems for me.  Fortunately, I didn't experience any redness or irritation at all, so that's really good.

I have fine lines in my neck as one tends to have at my age, so I was rather hoping this would help minimize them.  Unfortunately, there hasn't been any noticeable effect other than general moisturizing, which I can get from much less expensive creams.

It also has a pretty strong aroma for me, but perhaps not for people less sensitive to fragrances.

As reported by my wife...this cream really has a rich texture as it states, and does moisturize skin very well. The algae extract in this cream is supposed to help immediately tighten skin. There was no uncomfortable tightness, but neither were there any signs of desired tightening.  Mainly I chose this cream because it said it is for sun damaged skin. We live in a hot sunny place, and neck skin usually shows early signs of aging, so I was hoping for resulting skin texture improvement. The package says it is allergy tested, but my neck got pretty red and irritated. However it must be the Niacin in this cream that causes this reaction, and is not really considered as an allergic reaction.  This cream is very similar to  StriVectinLABS Extreme Cream which I tried before this cream. I had a severe reaction with StriVectinLABS Extreme Cream and could not use it at all. This NIA24 cream created a milder reaction, and I was hoping to continue using it and that my skin would adjust, as the packaging suggests. It suggests using this product for 7-10 days and that Pro-niacin may cause slight warmth and blushing on application, but for me after 2 weeks skin my skin is still reacting and staying red. I apply it only in the evening but my neck is still reddish in the morning. Nevertheless, the skin texture seems to be improved. I don't normally have sensitive skin toward cosmetics, but consider your skin sensitivity if choosing this product. If you can live with some redness, you will see some improvements for sure. This gave better results than StriVectin for a smoother, softer skin.
summary: Redness of skin, but effective moisturizer

reviewText:
I ordered this cream hoping it might improve my dcolletage, which is chronically red and bumpy to the point that I didn't feel comfortable wearing low-cut dresses and blouses.
After using it on my neck, jawline, and chest for about 3 weeks, I have some tiny red bumps on my chest, Despite this minor reaction, there was an overall marked improvement (though probably not enough to justify the price).
The consistency of the cream is like a thick school paste, and it doesn't emulsify much when warmed in the hands (not that one wants to use it as a hand cream). It's too thick and plasticky to get out of the jar with fingers; fortunately, I had a cosmetic spoon from another product that I pressed into service, but at this price, they really should have included a little plastic scoop or spoon.
My dcolletage, though still mottled and uneven, is much better, and my neck also looks smoother and lighter.

Despite an interesting list of ingredients, including fragrance, the abundant thickening agents make this product difficult to use.  It has the viscosity of Play-Doh, and very slick slip agents.  There is no dipping of fingertips to remove product.  Rather, one must apply pressure and dig it out of the jar, but it does spread nicely.

I used this for two weeks with no apparent effects until about day twelve, when my skin began feeling tight and itchy.  Since I wasn't seeing anything happening, except redness, which isn't unusual for my skin, I got a bit bored and at the two week mark, switched back to my normal skin-care routine.

The very next day my husband told me my skin looked much better; the redness was gone.  He didn't know I'd stopped using this cream.  He just made the observation.  I was using it, but he came up with the testimonial.  Not recommended.

I was very excited to see this product on Amazon Vine!  I'm 68 and the one part of my body that really gives my age away is my neck!  It is rather saggy and wrinkled.  I've tried other products with no visible results.  After reading about the product I knew that I could experience some side affects, but I didn't think I would be awake half the night clawing my neck!  I had extreme itching!  The next morning my neck looked a real mess!  It looked like I had a bad sunburn plus signs of my scratching.  But, being rather vain, I didn't give up!  I waited a couple of days and gave Nia 24 another try.  The itching wasn't as bad, still there, but not as bad.  Some redness also.  I continued day and night and after three days the itching and redness went away.  Thank goodness!  Now, if only it will improve the looks of my neck.  I haven't seen any visible difference, but I've only been using it for a couple of weeks.  I glides on very smoothly and easily.  It is rather thick and waxy.  I notice no odor at all so that's a plus since its applied every morning.  I'm hoping that I will notice a difference in my necks appearance soon.  It is rather pricey, but if it really works I would buy it!
summary: I really want this to work!

reviewText: Very nice daily cream that is a applied morning and night.  It has a very slight floral smell.  With it being a lifting cream, I don't notice big results overnight but over a couple of weeks the skin under my chin does seem somewhat firmer.  This is a long term product so I will have to update my results at a later date, but so far so good!

This unscented moisturizer is more like a butter than a cream, and it has made my neck soft and supple, if not noticeably firmer. A little of this product goes a long way, though, and the pot of cream still looks quite full. I'm very happy with it as a moisturizer, and will watch for long-term effects.

Niacin is a popular anti-aging cosmetic ingredient. Some people find that it causes a flush or a feeling of warmth, but I have had no trouble with it.

It's easy to ignore the neck, even if you are diligent at caring for the skin of your face. This product can help you catch up.
summary: A Luxurious Cream for an Often Ignored Feature

reviewText: NIA24 Neck Sculpting Complex: Niacin-Powered Skin Therapy is similar to $89 StriVectin-TL Tightening Neck Cream debuted in 2002. Both are based on myristyl nicotinate (NIA-114) - a pro-drug (inactive form, which converts to active) for delivery of nicotinic acid (NIC/vitamin B3) into the skin. NIA-114 is a great alternative to tretinoin, the gold standard routinely prescribed by dermatologists to keep aging skin looking (and acting) younger. Tretinoin is sold under brand names like Retin-A, Renova and Atralin, but its side effects can include redness and peeling. NIA-114 provides many of the benefits without those tolerability issues. The published studies prove that NIA-114 makes the top layer of the epidermis thicker and improves the skin barriers ability to retain moisture, which can help with modest wrinkling, and may fade sun spots. Howevr, NIA-114 is hardly a replacement for Retin-A. Skin collagen will not start renewing after four weeks use of NIA24. It takes two or three months to produce new collagen. Improving the skin barrier of sun-damaged skin inherently makes skin texture softer and repair fine lines, but it does not necessarily mean making new collagen. Other ingredients are secondary. Ingredients: Aqua (Water, Eau), Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Myristyl Nicotinate, Butylene Glycol, Isononyl Isononanoate, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, C1 2-15 Alkyl Benzoate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Hydrogenated Ethyihexyl Olivate, Dimethicone, Ethylene/Acrylic Acid Copolymer, Pentylene Glycol, Steareth-2, Polyacrylamide, Behenyl Alcohol, Sodium Polystyrene Sulfonate, Acetyl Dipeptide-1 Cetyl Ester, Algae Extract, Ceramide 2, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Tetrapeptide-21, Zingiber Officinale (Ginger) Root Extract, Caprylyl Glycol, Panthenol, Sorghum Bicolor Stalk Juice, Cl 3-14 Isoparaffin, Bisabolol, Sorbitan Laurate, Pullulan, Laureth-7, Cyathea Cumingii Leaf Extract, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Acrylates/C1O-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Hydrogenated Olive Oil Unsaponifiables, Parfum (Fragrance), Xanthan Gum, Sodium Hydroxide, Tetrasodium EDTA, BHT, Phenoxyethanol, Benzoic Acid, Sorbic Acid, Chlorphenesin, Benzyl Alcohol, Limonene.
summary: Revitalizes, hydrates, & transforms skin with 5 % NIA-114 (B3 pro-drug)

reviewText:
Because of warnings from other reviewers, I tested the cream on a small spot first. I have many allergies so I thought I would probably be one who would have a reaction; however, I was fortunate to have no problems.

I apply the cream at night but it doesn't show. It's absorbed easily with no residue and feels refreshing though I didn't realize that stroking upwards on my neck would be awkward. I guess it's just not something you do every day... well, until now when I do it every night.

An application requires a minor amount and the jar is a generous size so it should last a long time. I received mine in exchange for a fair and honest review so I'm not sure I would have paid the asking price for it.  If you are uncomfortable with your looks and want to avoid plastic surgery, this may be a good way to go (and ultimately less expensive?).

I like the product though I don't know the long term effects. My skin seems a bit smoother and tighter but I'm still early in the testing process. I think when it runs out, I will be "comfortable in my own skin"

While it works, well enough, its not my favorite neck complex. It does an okay job at moisturizing, but I didn't notice much difference in the texture of the neck. It also stays a little greasy, which is fine at night but means I don't reach for it during the day. And while It did do a wonderful job of evening out my skin tone, which was great, leaving my skin more luminous with less tiny sun spots, I still felt like my skin was 'crepey'.
The smell was off-putting the first couple of times I used it, which I appreciate that it's not perfumed the chemical smell was a little weird. But, either I got used to the smell or it dissipates more quickly after each use, because I didn't notice it nearly as much after day three.
I did have the red neck reaction it warns about on the package (always a good reason to read the instructions on anything before use!) it didn't burn or itch, it was just that my skin was a vibrant red. I use this neck complex at night, so it didn't bother me, (a little freaky to see, yes), and my skin did get used to it and doesn't do that any more when I apply it.
The texture of the cream itself is thick and firm. Think of it more like a neck balm, but applies without tugging.
I think for the product size and price I want something a little more moisturizing and luxurious. But, I'm glad to have tried this and will probably replace it when I run out if I haven't found another suitable replacement.
summary: Worth sticking your neck out for

reviewText: After reading some reviews about redness, soreness, or even burning, I was afraid to give this to my wife, but she had no such issues.  It's relatively thick, but it's not greasy, and it goes on dry.  I cannot say any effects have been encountered thus far (only a week into the experiment), though that includes both positive and negative effects.  As for the cost, well, hopefully we'll see some significant benefits, but we'll update this review either way.  4 stars for now.
summary: No effects thus far, either positive or negative.

reviewText: I've been using this for almost a week now, however, I started seeing results by day 3. I'm only going to be 40 yrs this year, but I am busty and so I was starting to get the lines around my collarbone and lower throat area. I use lotion everyday, but it only masked the signs of aging. Since I started using Nia 24, I've noticed the lines are starting to fade out and my skin is looking more youthful. Not totally like it did at 20, but it is looking more like my early 30's again.
summary: Great Product to Reduce the Signs of Aging

reviewText:
Since reaching my 40s, I've begun noticing that my neck has begun to look more dry and crepe-y than I remember it being. I've long used my daily/nightly moisturizer (La Mer and Algenist, respectively) on my neck, but it no longer seems to be enough. Enter this neck moisturizer. It's an extremely thick, rich cream, about as thick as La Mer creme, so it's nice to feel like you're not getting watered-down moisturizer. It goes on very smoothly and absorbs quickly. There's no residue or tackiness at all. As for results, my neck actually looks much tighter and less dry. I also use it on my decollete during the day, and have noticed improved texture of the skin there, too.

I can't say whether it firms - I don't have any sagging yet - but it's genuinely excellent at giving my neck a more supple look without any crepiness (sp?) at all. Another plus is that it has caused no breakouts or irritation of any kind (yes, I'm dealing with both wrinkles and acne).

My only reservation is the fragrance. It's a light, clean smell that reminds me of Fresh brand products, but it's very noticeable. It's not strong and lingering like, say, Clarins or L'Occitane, but it *does* linger. I notice it less after a couple of hours, but if you're sensitive to fragrances this might irritate you. Otherwise, I'd recommend this cream for anyone looking for extra moisture on the neck and decollete.
summary: Excellent for extra moisture, if you're not fragrance-sensitive

reviewText:
This cream works over time to strengthen and tighten the skin under your chin. I noticed a slight difference with just one use.

Over time with daily use skin looks tighter. Also works great as a moisturizer.

Skin felt a bit warm and tingling the first couple minutes after application. According to the packaging,  that is to be expected.

I like the way it makes my skin look and feel.

I love NIA products.  This is the first NIA 24 product that I have felt any ambivalence over.  Usually I love anything NIA 24.  I also pretty much believe anything NIA says.  Among the information on the page is Lifting Cream.  It clarifies that by saying that it lifts as the natural moisture is restored to the neck.  Since I use all moisturizers on my neck as well, I am pretty sure I already have the neck lifting result.

The other question I have is why does it feel so waxy?  I don't mind it at night after I put my curlers in and my granny nightgown on but I don't like that feeling during the day.  I am not finding wax on any of the many ingredients I could not and should not pronounce.

I have lots of sun and age damage so I am willing to keep giving it the old college try.  After some use of this product, my neck does feel soft.

Although I'm not sure whether this cream has had any effect on wrinkles, it is definitely highly moisturizing.  To my eye, after using this for several weeks, a scar that I have on the side of my neck appears lighter and less noticeable - perhaps the effects of the niacin/vitamin B, or perhaps just from being moisturized daily.  In any case, it's an improvement.

I'm glad that I read the other reviews before I began to use this, because it did cause a reddening appearance and a slight burning feeling when I tested it out the first time.  I used my wrist as a test spot, and the redness went away after a few minutes, so I went ahead and tried it on my neck.  It did get a little red and warm feeling for a bit, but this decreased to the point where it is unnoticeable after 2 weeks.  I absolutely think that they should put this as a warning on the side of the jar.

The cream itself, outside of the health effects, is nice to use, although not my favorite.  It seems that some people can smell a weird or chemically smell from it, and some can't or enjoy the smell.  I fall into the first category.  The smell, to me, seems like compost or soured greens.  I'm not a big fan.  The feel of the cream is cushiony but I find it slightly greasy compared to some of my other creams.  On the other hand, unlike some of the other creams I've used, it has NOT caused acne on my neck.

Over all, it's a good product given that it fades scars and moisturizes extremely well.  If it smelled a bit better and didn't burn the first couple of times it would be perfect.
summary: Good moisturizer, doesn't cause breakouts, fades scars - but test on your arm first!

reviewText:
This is a soft foam applicator that my wife used with her smashbox foundation.  (No concealer actually comes with the tool, so it could not be tested with any of the Scott Vincent Borba products.)

First, negatives out of the way:
1-Way too expensive at $40, as of now. The price needs to be lowered for this product.
2-There are no cleaning instructions with the tool, so one is left to their own vices as to what cleaning product to use. She finds warm water and facial cleansing soap work just fine.

On the positive side, this tool helps blend really well and the smoothness of the stem makes it easy on the hands--ergonomically friendly. The angle is perfect for reaching otherwise difficult areas, which she would normally do with my finger.

She is giving it 4 stars solely on the basis that this item is overpriced. Had it been about $20, I would have given it 5.  Because it is so new,  she does not know how long the foam part will hold up. However, it appears to be well made.
summary: Easy on the hands, Hard on the pocket book

reviewText:
I know there are many brushes and sponges out there that are supposed to be used for a variety of cosmetic needs. It can get confusing trying to figure out which ones do what and whether or not they are even effective for your personal needs.

Saying that, I really like this cosmetic tool and it serves an important purpose if you want to use concealer, especially on the under-eye area where many of us have shadows or dark circles.

In the past, I have tried brushes and expensive shaped sponges on this delicate area and they've all just been okay. I ended up just using my fingers to blend but that's never really been that satisfactory. I am happy to say that this tool is really good for use on that delicate under-eye area and it's both effective and gentle. You can really guide and easily distribute whatever lotion or creme you decide to use.

I know this on the expensive-side for a tool like this, but do know that it is very effective and I plan on using it all the time.

Recommended.
summary: On the expensive side, but I really like it and it's a handy and effective cosmetic tool

reviewText: I am very new to using things like this. It was easy to use, which was important to me because I am not used to make-up type products, and it seemed to do a very good job of making me look a lot less tired than I feel.
summary: I am very new to using things like this. It was easy to use

reviewText: I used my normal foundation with this. I like how this brush is made it fits in my hand really well.  the soft spong tip is gentler than my fingers.  I think if someone really wants a professional look this would help it is easy to use, I cleaned it like i normally clean all my sponges with warm water and let it air dry.  Now for does it reduce bacteria I think only if you are meticulous about cleaning this item would it do that.  But for ease of use this is amazing.
summary: like how it is is made to fit my hands

reviewText:
Once they get the price down this will sell in droves.  My wife loves how easily this applies, especially how well designed the foam applicator itself is.  It's gentle, smooth, and goes on flawless.  The length is great too.  I'm not sure if this is what's supposed to make it anti-fatigue, but the length and thickness seem to help make it more ergonomic.

The flawless nature of the application are five stars, but $40 for a foam brush, not so much.  Maybe keep an eye out for a sale.

The applicator is very uique and does the job perfectly. The sponge is the perfect shape and size, and is also gentle enough for the sensitive skin under the eye. The application after applying my concealer looked almost airbrushed and flawless! I really love this item and I would have  recommended it if not for the insane price.
I'll have to give this item 4 stars only because the price is ridiculous but the purpose for of the item is excellent.

-Jessenia

Although this soft, foam-tip applicator for concealer is a great way to apply cosmetics under the eye, I struggled with how to rate it.  The current retail price is $40, and that's far too much for what it is.  But it's well-made, with a solid, matte-finished stick, an angled end for scooping up concealer or foundation, and a plush, foam, teardrop tip.  Concealer applies smoothly and without tugging at delicate under-eye skin.  If this were a $20 product, it would get an easy five stars from me.

Because I don't have Scott-Vincent Borba concealer -- it wasn't offered to me as part of the Amazon Vine program -- I used Clinique foundation to test it.  I can't imagine that there would be much, if any, difference between how the two are applied.  I scooped up some foundation with the angled end, placed it on the back of my hand, and dipped the teardrop foam tip into it.  I swept the makeup under my eye, and it went on with ease.  Blending it was a breeze.

The marketing copy says that this is a way to keep bacteria out of your cosmetics.  While it does remove your finger from the bottle or jar, the tip is still coming into contact with the skin on the back of your hand.  And you still have to wash and dry it if you want to minimize bacteria.  I rinse mine under warm running water, much the way I would clean a foam paintbrush.  When I'm done, I gently squeeze out extra water, and let it air dry.  Because the box doesn't contain cleaning instructions, I hope I'm doing the right thing.

This "anti-fatigue" brush feels great in my hand and is just the right size -- about 5" long from tip to tip -- for easy manipulation.  It's a well-made applicator.  I'm just not sure it's worth the current retail price.

This sponge applicator has nice pressure and length.  For general use, it's not that much more versatile than concealer brush or using a q-tip or your fingers, and it's harder to clean than any of those.  It's hard to justify why it costs a lot more than even a good brush, though.

It's especially suited for under the eyes.  For the delicate skin in this area, a brush might be too rough, but a cotton pad or q-tip, and yes, clean fingers, all work there too, although this brush will offer more control as well as softness.

If you strongly prefer the foam texture and density and desire the greater control that this offers, it is a nice tool, but it's also expensive.
summary: nice tool for those who don't like brush, q-tip or finger application, but expensive

reviewText: It's a great idea with some flaws. This pulled on the skin under my eyes worse than my fingers ever did. My liquid make up didn't go on smoothly at all. It's nice you can use the end to get out more make up and not waste it. Overpriced for what it is. It should be a tenth of the price

I'm really torn with rating this item. While I love it as a concealer applicator, it's priced too high for what it is. This would rate 5 stars if priced around $15 to $20. It's a small sponge-tip on the end of a brush handle, around 5" long total. The pointed end is great for getting into the inner-corner area of your eyes. Washable with warm soapy water (I use a little shampoo). Less tugging than using a pinkie finger to pat the concealer.
summary: Nice concealer applicator, but priced way too high

reviewText:
This is a wonderful little tool but in my opinion is an outrageous price. It is a great size and feels nice in my hand. I use it to apply my BB cream in the harder to reach areas (around my eyes and nose especially). The applicator sponge is incredibly soft and does not pull on delicate skin. It applies my BB cream smoothly and evenly.

There were no instructions on how to clean the sponge so I just ran it under water and gently squeezed it to remove the excess water and then laid in on a clean towel to air dry. I hope I am doing this correctly because this is something I am hoping to use for a long time but there is no way I would ever pay $40 for it. If you are someone who is willing to pay any amount for an excellent beauty tool then this is for you!

I don't use a lot of make-up anymore except for BB Cream and a concealer for the lines and darkness under my eyes. So, I thought the Scott-Vincent Borba Anti-Fatigue Corrective Concealer Tool with Line Smoothing Tear-Drop Blending Applicator would be helpful with applying concealer. The tear-drop shape makes it easy for application (I tried BB Cream first, then next day tried the concealer) to see if there was any difference. The shape allows ease when applying either product, making it an quick fix for eye issues. As for the anti-fatigue aspect of the product, so far I haven't seen any improvement, which is why I gave it four stars instead of five. I will update the review if over time I see any improvements. Otherwise, I really like this make-up product.

This brush is very light and comfortable to hold. That assists with making application smooth and easy, which I really appreciate. It applies simply and easily and is very gentle, showcasing the quality of the product. It feels good, in fact, which is a lot better than items that have been used in the past. Speaking of quality, this is very well-made; looking at it and feeling it apply, you can really tell. For application and quality, this is easily five stars.

An issue I had when reviewing this is price as an overall factor. Normally I consider how much something costs as part of the review and compare it with other items at the same price point, but this was difficult to do that with. That said, the current price on this is 40.00 and, to me, that is a blow to the pocket/pocketbook. Considering this is only a brush with nothing accompanying it makes me rate that at around 3 stars.

Overall, I would have rated this an easy five stars and hope the pricing comes down soon.
summary: Great item at currently quesitnonable cost.

reviewText: There is no makeup/concealer included.  This is for the very small applicator.  It works well though and would save you a lot of frustration if you want to spend the money.

This review is for the tool only, not actual concealer.  My wife uses the YSL Touche Eclat Concealer Radiant Touch.  The YSL concealer comes with its own brush, but there is no real way to apply it without leaving a messy appearance that is smudged and fills in wrinkle lines, so she was excited to try this product.  This blending brush has a precision tip sponge on one side with egg shaped sides with an angled end on the other side to dip into your concealer (if you use a product that does not already have a brush - this avoids contamination).  The sponge end allows you to apply and blend concealer, and truly does not not pull delicate skin under the eye for a perfect appearance.  The brush is able to reach difficult-to-reach places and blends concealer/makeup into your natural tone. The sponge-tip absorbs concealer to evenly camouflage under eye circles and discoloration. To use, grip with the 5" wooden handle (ideal length for easy use made of wood) and roll with the egg-shaped sides for a fully covered appearance. It is made of latex-free sponge.  The tool is made in USA.  My wife loves the ease of application and the perfect blending, however there are no instructions and it is not clear how to clean the sponge.  The 4-star rating is due to the cost.  This item is twice the price of what it really should be, unless it came with the concealer.
summary: Blending Brush Able To Reach Difficult Places To Evenly Camouflage Under Eye Circles and Discoloration

reviewText: This concealer brush is nice and light, and comfortable to hold and works as expected. The quality is nice and the tear-shaped foam brush is gentle on the sensitive under eye area. That said, the price for this brush is beyond ridiculous. I'm not even sure how long this brush will last, since most people do use concealer on a regular (everyday for me) basis, so to buy something so expensive, when there are similar, cheaper alternatives, is mind boggling. I was given a chance to try this product out, and while I don't have anything negative to state about the brush itself, I can't even begin to understand where they came up with this price.

When I first put this on, I actually got a hint of fruitiness that I thought was a little strange (not unpleasant, but strange). However, after having had it on for most of the day, I am really liking it. (It did lose a bit of intensity so you may want to reapply partway through the day.)

The product page describes this as "solar oriental" and that's actually a really good description. This has the sandalwood and woody notes I love in fragrances but this just has the feel of a daytime fragrance. (I am really not noticing the salt at all, although maybe that was part of my initial impression and those notes have worn off? At any rate, I'm happy with what has stayed around after a few hours.) I don't really notice the peppery qualities, either, but that may be my body chemistry at work.

The bottle design is attractive but a little obnoxious. You have to twist the top pretty hard to get it off. But I like the fragrance quite a lot.

Please note that this item is flammable and can only be shipped via ground shipping methods, so it will take a longer time. Also, please note that it is probably not able to be returned. So if you are unsure if you like this, I would suggest trying to find a sample first. As of the time of this writing, Amazon is the seller. However, if a third party seller does add a listing and you plan to buy from them, check seller feedback before purchasing. A seller with good feedback is more likely to send you a genuine item. (Sadly, large bottles of designer perfumes are often counterfeited. So only purchase from trustworthy sources.)
summary: I don't love the top notes, but give this one time -- it turns into something nice

reviewText:
I need to preface this review with the fact that I hate all those floral 'LOUD' perfumes.  If you get headaches from certain scents then you can fully understand what I mean with my LOUD statement.

Now CK's Reveal is something different that I can't necessarily pin.  The bottle is a glass, rounded square shape with the uppper triangle portion being the lid.  The lid is a metallic goldish/silver that is a fingerprint magnet!  The scent is something different... as time wears, the scent subtly changes.

This is the type of perfume that should be labeled, 'Less is more'.  A simple short spritz on my wrist fills the room.  Right out of the bottle the scent smells peppery with a few masculine notes thrown in.  When I am in the Department stores I find myself drawn to the Men's section.  The frilly, floral Ladies department always gives me a headache.  This scent has that earthy, masculine, musky and at times, peppery aroma.  It's sexy, yet can be worn in a professional environment without overwhelming others.  When you first spritz, it is just too strong!  Given ample time it wears wonderfully.  I can't specifically nail all the nuances... peppery, powdery, ambergris ( is that the salty pick-up?) with a hint of Playdoh!  Personally the scent lasts 24 hours on my body, but by that time it has evolved into something completely different.  It is a wonderful little memory the next day when I open my eyes and catch a slight aroma.

Highly recommend if you are the type that loves masculine scents with peppery and salty undertones that isn't overtly flowery.
summary: Is this what sexy smells like?

reviewText: Reveal is a nice fragrance. It's musky with a hint of fruit, not heavy or overpowering. Sprayed on in the morning, it was still detectable hours later and was true to its original application, no degradation. Some perfumes have very distinctive notes and become signature scents. While Reveal is very pleasant, it didn't trigger immediate recognition each time I tried it during the review period. As a side note. I did a little research. Reveal is sold by a number of vendors but it's only available on line. I don't know about you, but I wouldn't invest in an expensive perfume if I didn't have a chance to try it first.
summary: Worth a Try......But How Would YOU Know

reviewText:
This Eau de Parfum presents the wearer with a host of contradictions.  It is light and airy for daytime, yet salty, spicy, and sensual enough for evening. It really is unusual and not like the other scents out there.

A great combination of sandalwood,  musk, salt, pepper, and flowers!

Even the "bottle" is unique and complex. Kind of reminiscent of one of those children's folded paper puzzles.  The presentation package is great- this would be a wonderful gift.

Like an interesting wine, this perfume is a bit of a conundrum-musky, salty, sweet, spicy- all at the same time.

Neither heavy nor cloying, this scent leaves a nice cloud of mystery in its wake.  The scent lasts a while, but is clean, crisp and not over-powering.

Highly recommended for that unique individual...................

My granddaughter found this product to be too strong.  She said it had a very heavy scent that smelled too much of musk and not enough of the described salts.  In fact she thought it was a scent for a male when she first smelled it.  Her opinion is that it rates about 3 Stars but that's the opinion of a 19 year old college girl so bear that in mind.  I also thought it was very strong but I kinda liked the scent and found it to be a bit titillating to say the least.  So if the opinion of an old guy counts I think it's sexy!!

I wanted to like this, I really did.  The description sounded intriguing, and I love scents with pepper and sandalwood as notes.  The bottle is interestingly shaped, and holds a generous amount of scent.

I open the package, remove the rounded square bottle, take off the cap and spray lightly in the air, walking through the mist.  I smell nothing but generic CK scent-vaguely artificial and synthetic.  A few minutes later I begin to get a headache.  I try again the next day, and the same thing happens.  It lingers on clothing and the skin, lasting through a shower, or several days in the closet (some spray got on a sweater).  I let my daughter try it, and thank goodness she went to school shortly after, as even on someone else it was triggering a headache.

I am glad that so many people like this scent, it just is not for me.  I cannot give it to my daughter to use, unless I want to move out of my house.  I will dispose of this as soon as I am able.
summary: Wanted to like this, but cannot

reviewText:
Its decent.. but to me the scent doesnt last that long. ive tried the "not correct" way of doing it by spraying on the clothes, also on pulse points, and anothe rfew spots a friend told me about... just seems like others last MUCH longer.

with that said all in all its good. it has a slightly floral smell, kinda woodsy outdoors type too.. its NOT musky at all (ew, i hate musky smells).
Im not a fan of square bottles.. if you drop it - chance it will shatter if it hits a corner. i prefer vertical tube shaped bottles.
summary: just seems like others last MUCH longer

reviewText:
OK WOW!

This sultry perfume lasts almost until the next day, without overpowering at all.  It is delicious, yet subtle.  I just put some on my wrist and let the perfume do the magic.

I am not familiar with other Calvin Klein perfumes.  Truthfully, I have in the past collected quite a bit of samples of the good perfumes from various companies offering them as a free gift with a cosmetic purchase.  I have a cosmetic bag full of them.  This is one of the nicest, because it doesn't make me smell like I am raining perfume, or have been showering in flowers.  Please do not slather it on, as a little goes a long way.

Seriously, though, aside from my initial clumsiness in not being able to open the cap (it pulls off), I believe REVEAL is at the right price point at 1.7 FL OZ.

It is a almost a rectangular shape, and with the golden cover (top-left angle) it looks classy, and edgy.

I recommend this.
summary: I have in the past collected quite a bit of samples of the good perfumes from various companies offering them as a free ...

reviewText: When my wife first applied this, we both thought is was far too string.  However, after a few minutes it seemed to settle down and really is an interesting scent.  There are "notes" of vanilla and nutmeg in it, as well as some other "spicy" notes.  It is definitely not a "flowery" sort of perfume.  It is subtle and seems to change over time.  It is not something you have smelled before.

This perfume, from bottle to scent, is very attractive both to wearer and to people admiring it. That is saying a lot about it, because I am not a fan of the majority of scents out there. The bottle has an simple design that is both elegant and colorful, with the upper half's metallic gold offsetting the bottom's glass-and-perfume display. It looks very attractive under good lighting, adding something to countertops while accenting modern amenities. The bottom is also weighted well so it sits upright with ease and I do not worry about it getting cracked by the occasional "oopsy." As for the smell, I like the way "woods" or "warm woods" seems to capture it. It has a springtime scent that is a bit floral without being too flowery and goes on light, does not overpower ,and stays for a while. I like the way this compliments people at work or going out, too, and think this works as an everyday scent.

The bottle is so beautiful, that I was drawn to it the first time I saw it at a store. However, I realized it's not a great design for everyday use, but still pretty.

Calvin Klein has managed to churn so many successful perfumes that they made them smell generic. I want to hate them as they're so popular but I can't find anything to hate about most of them! Everyone wears a Calvin Klein perfume at one point. Obsession was an obsession when I was a teenager, and Eternity, One, and Euphoria are very pleasant fragrances from the same house. And I can name so many others I've used in the past. I thought Reveal would be another Euphoria Lite, but it's really not.

I would classify Reveal as a Fall/Winter perfume for the Day melding into evening. This scent is deceptively unassuming at first but grows on you as you wear it and then, you're hooked. I would still wear it in the Summer but at or after sunset rather than in the day time.

The perfume is called a solar oriental, designed to be like a second skin almost. When the sun is out the skin smells of salt and as the light fades the skin takes on a sandalwoody and musky tone. This perfume mimics that natural scent of skin. Reveal is an apt name as the perfume tends to evolve slowly over time but is never overpowering.

The top notes are raw salt, pink pepper, white pepper, and black pepper, revealing a salty earthiness and spiciness. At first whiff, it almost smells like a male fragrance as it is more salty and subtly spicy and woodsy than floral.

The middle notes are Orris and Ambergris. Ambergris used to be thought of as sperm whale vomit but now it is known to be whale excrement. The whales imbibe the sea flavor and release them as highly prized ambergris - it is said to release pheromones and have aphrodisiac properties and makes perfumes longer lasting. Orris root has a similar fixative property.

The base notes are sandalwood, cashmeran, vetiver and musk. All very warm and sensual notes that make the dry down smell like a second skin but so much more pleasing.

This is an expertly crafted fragrance with less drama and fanfare like some others, but still sensual and feels closer to a natural scent. I cannot wear many heavy vanilla and flowery perfumes close to my skin as they give me a headache, but I was able to spray Reveal on pulse points and it smelled great, wafting gently rather than cloying and sweet.

It is fairly long lasting due to the presence of musk and sandalwood but for me that is just 3-4 hours, and the sillage is moderate. That's why I will use it as a day or early evening perfume rather than late night.

There are some perfumes you simply can't sniff from the bottle, you have to try them on your skin and sniff at it over a few hours to understand its true colors. Reveal is that type of a perfume and it has the potential to become a favorite.
summary: A solar Oriental, enigmatic - starts salty then turns musky. Love it.

reviewText:
Calvin Klein Reveal has a scent much like CK One Eau de toilette: spicy overtones with no herb elements and no florals.  As such, it's rather unisex and quite attractive.

But it is not long-lasting, thus 4/5 stars.
summary: This Spicy -  but Short-lived - Scent Crosses Gender Lines

reviewText: I love the presentation- The bottle looks like a pretty, soft, elegant pillow. While at first I wasn't jumping for joy over the fragrance, as it has faded some over time I have a completely different opinion. While perfume smells different on everyone, on me the nuances in Reveal emerge more and smell better with a light application and after it's had an hour or so to fade.  When first sprayed, Reveal smelled very sweet and powdery with a woodsy or musky scent on me, not my favorite combo. But as some time passed, I could smell the lightly sweet (not spicy) scent of peppercorns with a hint of floral, powder and what I think is sandalwood, and it's really pretty and not overpowering like it was when first applied. I don't smell sea salt, but the fragrance is complex as it mixes a variety of scents that might not normally be combined and doesn't fall into a precise category, such as floral, musk, spice, etc. The longer I wear it and it fades some, the more the nuances of the fragrance come through and the more I like it. I think it's pretty and recommend it, but definitely a lighter application is better as I think the nuances of the fragrance are "revealed" more when not applied too heavily.
summary: Attractive Pillowy Bottle And A Pretty and Unique Fragrance That Reveals Its Nuances When Applied  Lightly

reviewText: My wife had not heard of this perfume before, so she didn't know what to expect; trying it out was sort of a gamble.  In a word, she was pleasantly surprised (I was too!).  She really likes it because it is sweet (but not too sweet like a teenage girl's perfume) and flowery (but not too flowery like perfume for an older woman).  She says it's not overpowering, but is easy to smell (sort of a nice "light" scent if that makes sense).  Anyway, she's glad she got it (so am I!) and she recommends it (so do I!).

Calvin Klein has done it again. REVEAL is perfect. I absolutely love it. Somehow the combination of pink peppercorns, salt(!), floral, and then woodsy is just perfect. This scent is totally unique and totally captivating. It is definitely a scent that will appeal to the young, as well as the young at heart. It is great for daytime as well as evening wear. I appreciate that it is long lasting, and the unique design of the bottle captures the essence of the perfume perfectly! REVEAL is a scent for a woman that any man will definitely appreciate. Enjoy!

I ordered this perfume not sure if it was for a man or a woman based on the description.  Im happy to say, it is a womans perfume so I got lucky since that was what I was hoping for.

I realize liking or disliking a smell is a very personal thing, but I really like this.  It is kind of a combination of sweet, light floral, and musk.  Now, let me say, usually as soon as I see the word musk I head the other direction, but combined with the other scents, it is very pleasant.

This perfume has staying power too.  I squirt one squirt on my shirt in the morning and it is still very much there when I take the shirt off to go to bed.  Honestly, this probably has more staying power than any perfume Ive ever owned.  I think this might be a perfume that would be easy to overdo just because the scent doesnt dissipate much at all throughout the day.
Overall, Im very pleased with the product and would most definitely recommend it.
summary: Pleasant smell that stays all day.

reviewText:
To give this a bit of perspective, my favorite scents are all the sweet ones.  Channel #5 is a great favorite.  If you love that, you won't love this.  If you think that's too flowery, too girly, not right for today's woman, you may well adore this.

It's not at all like a normal perfume.  The initial impact, when it as its strongest, smells like vomit.  It's horrible.  After a few minutes that fades and you get a kind of spicy musk, almost like a feminine variation on a man's cologne.  Then you get the more subtle layers of sandlewood and spice.  It is a very sophisticated, very different scent.  It takes a bit to get used to.  I would not debut this at an important event.  Try it first, because it is not for everyone.  And definitely give it time to settle down before going out in public with it.

I would give it five stars but for the first few minutes after putting it on.  I know perfumes are always a bit overwhelming initially, but this was far worse than I've ever experienced before.
summary: A very different sort of fragrence

reviewText:
This is NOT the usual Calvin Klein fragrance.  In fact, this fragrance is downright different from pretty much all fragrance on the market.  It has a very salty and peppery scent - salty as in sea salt to my nose - that briny ocean scent. Then there is a very big cashmeran wood & sandalwood that lasts the entire way thru.  There is also a powdery/musk undertone but it is not too strong.

I really did not like this the first time I tried it - that sea salt was funky in a bad way to my nose.  I tried it again after I smelled it in the air on someone else - it smelled good; I recognized it immediately & once I got home I sprayed again.  It was better but I don't think this is really my kind of scent.  But I have a large sample, so will try again....maybe it will grow on me. :)  I tend to like more white flower scents but I also like to explore & try new things.

Sillage is arm length & beyond so go easy with the spray.  This lasts about 8 hours on my skin.

Without question the best shave cream I've ever used. I have really sensitive skin and of all the creams I've tried this is by far superior to the others.
It doesn't create a super foamy lather which takes a little getting used to but that's a small price to pay. Has a light invigorating scent too.

This shaving cream is so much better than foam and I find it hard to use anything else now that I've used this. It smells great, leaves my skin smooth and doesn't leave a film behind. It gives a close shave and I highly recommend it for a thicker hair.
summary: This shaving cream is so much better than foam and I find it hard to use ...

reviewText: I love (my husbands) shaving cream!  I love the scent so much.  I love smelling it on him so much that i use it for myself for shaving my legs.  The eucalyptus scent is soooo soothing and relaxing.  I used to use his Gillette shaving cream, but the scent is so strong and cheap smelling and it would stay and linger for a long time.  This scent is much more subtle and enjoyable.  The cream is really silky and has seems to calm the skin to shave it.  Love this product!
summary: Love this shaving cream and it's scent!

reviewText: I tried this shave cream after using foam for several years. The feel of my face after shaving with this is soooo much smoother. This stuff even cools and soothes my skin when I get a little razor rash. Fantastic results and simple to apply.

Anthony's shave cream works wonders on my husbands face.  This cream paired with the Anthony ingrown hair has done wonders on my sensitive skin husband.  He has a very rough and thick beard and he doesn't need a lot of Anthony product in order to shave a little of this cream goes a far way.  It comes in an easy to squeeze bottle as well so he doesn't over use like he does with the cans.  Highly recommended!
Beautiful shades, some fall out, kind of patchy. Maybe try the Carli Bybel, it is similar but more affordable and includes highlighters.

This is good, not great.  The amount of shadow in each pan is rather small.  Packaging is as expected.  It's just OK in terms of pigment.  I like this but wouldn't consider it a great value for the price.  That is why I'm not giving it 5 stars.  If you're a make-up junkie, it's nice to have, but for the price I'd go with another brand.
Love this palette. Super pretty colors and they blend well, very buttery.
Nice
Good Product

I have VERY sensitive skin and the first few days I used this cream it made me a bit red here and there (no rash, just sorta looked irritated and inflamed).  After about 3 days, the irritation went away and it did start moisturizing my skin.  It has a very luxurious feel to it-it spreads nicely and covers thoroughly and a little goes a long way (which is good b/c you only get a little in this package).  I does seem to have tightened/filled in the lines under my eyes a small amount, but nothing super noticeable.  Overall, for the price, I'd say "pass" on this one-it is rough on sensitive skin and the benefits are very minimally noticeable.

I was totally intrigued by this $90 Extreme Cream by StriVectin since I have been quite happy with some of their creams in the past. This cream is very soft and has a thick consistency. That said, it does not feel greasy at all. I do have acne prone skin and haven't experienced any problems at all. With the weather getting colder, my skin feels moisturized even in the mornings.  There are no dry spots or flaking skin problems. I will say I'm a little disappointed in the jar packaging since we all know that overtime, the antioxidants do tend degrade faster in a jar than in a pump style bottle. I hope they will fix that going forward since you don't want to pay $90 for a cream for it to stop working halfway.
summary: Good cream but needs better packaging!

reviewText: Using this for a week or so now, twice daily as the packaging recommends. I didn't feel any tingling (as other reviewers have said). I honestly have no complaints about this cream. I will say that it is think and silky to the touch (think of your mom's cold cream consistency, but lighter and softer). I swear after such a short time I see my skin looking tighter and clearer and definitely softer and smoother. I will be turning 60 in a month (yikes, can't believe it) and I know my skin has been lacking in overall moisturizing. I love this Strivectin and will be a continued user even after this jar is gone. Yes, it's a little expensive, but you get what you pay for with this product and it's still cheaper than going to a dermatologist and I love that I can get this over the counter from Amazon.
summary: Great facial cream for aging skin. Worth the money. Invest in your looks!

reviewText:
I have had mixed reactions to the StrivectinLABS Extreme Cream. It is very nicely packaged, and has a very light lemony fragrance. The cream itself feels silky and smooth. It spreads on evenly, and absorbs quickly.

I used this on my face, neck and upper chest, as I do every other cream I have ever used. This was at night, before bed. When I woke the next morning, I glanced at my reflection as I entered my bathroom, and I noticed my face looked a little red. I thought I needed coffee! No, seriously, I thought it was from sleeping. About half an hour later, when I went to take a shower, my face was still red, like a light sunburn. Then I saw my neck, and my chest. Guys, I was lobster red. Like first-sun-exposure-of-the-year red. 5 days later, after multiple showers, I am still red. And now it itches.

To give the cream credit, though, all of the wrinkles on my chest were gone. Not on my face, though. Still have laugh lines, and those lovely grooves at the side of the mouth.

I have used the cream lightly on my face for the last 5 days. I still have a light reddishness on my face, but nothing like my chest, and no itching. At this point, I think I am going to discontinue use, because I am not seeing any real effect on my face, and I am kind of afraid my face is going to eventually do the same thing my chest did.

Bottom line - The pluses of the product do not outweigh the negative for me. I would recommend trying a sample of the product on a small inconspicuous area to see if you have a reaction, as at least one other review I read mentions getting a rash.

**12/22/14 Update**

About a week ago, I had run out of my regular moisturizer, and the StriVectin was all I had on hand. I decided to try it again, using sparing amounts. So for the last 6 days, I have done this. My skin looks different. The laugh lines are starting to fade, which thrills me. On the negative side, I have about 5 small red spots, maybe 2cm in diameter, on different areas of my face. Not sure the two are connected, as I have been noticing some skin discoloration before using the StriVectin. Anyway, my makeup seems to be applying more smoothly, and the skin on my face is soft and supple. I will continue use, and update this review as warranted.
summary: Updated - Nice fragrance and feel, but I had some problems with this

reviewText:
I am always on the look for products that will help to keep my skin looking its best. My greatest concern is not wrinkles as much as the dark bags under my eyes, though I do tend to get wrinkles under my eyes when I smile. After discovering STRI VECHTIN LABS EXTEME CREAM, 1 FL OZ, I thought I'd give it a try.

I am a very frugal person, so the price is quite shocking to me. Even more shocking was the tiny amount for the price. However, I have to say I was very impressed with how little is needed. I expected I would need a good amount to cover my face and that it would feel heavy. Neither was true.

STRI VECHTIN LABS EXTEME CREAM goes on effortlessly, nice and easy, with just a few dabs here and there, and a true sense of lightness. The fragrance if neither good nor bad in my opinion, with a light lemony smell to it, if I had to name it. Though the price if high in my opinion, the fact that you only need a little, I imagine will result in lasting a long time, diminishing the high cost to something manageable over time.

As far as reducing wrinkles, I will update as I continue to use the product as to any noticeable differences. I admit I am a little concerned with the chemical aspect. Many products may do what they claim, but at what cost? Eating right, not wearing makeup, removing makeup before bed, no harsh chemicals, the environment, getting the proper sleep, the temperature of the water you use, and what materials you use to clean your face with what degree of abrasion, can all play into your overall skin health.

Product Information:

This potent age repair cream contains patented, age-fighting NIA-114(tm) technology that helps strengthen the skin barrier, bolstering its defenses against the environmental damage that can accelerate the aging process. An Energizing Oxygen Complex breathes new life into skin for renewed energy and a glowing, healthy-looking complexion. Moisture seeking molecules, known for their ability to maintain water reserves, deliver 24 hours of continuous hydration, while the appearance of lines and wrinkles is noticeably smoothed. Skin looks and feels replenished, plumped and nourished with deep hydration throughout the day.

Product Description:

A deeply nourishing hydration cream formulated with patented NIA-114 technology and moisture seeking molecules known for their ability to maintain water reserves and prevent
dehydration.

Benefits:

Activates cell renewal and stimulates collagen formation, diminishing the appearance of lines and wrinkles.
Suggested Use:

Apply moisturizer all over cleansed face in the AM and PM.

About five years ago I tested a product called Pro-X wrinkle smoothing cream and after using it for a month I was still wrinkled.  So, here it is 5 years later and this product comes along.  Should I try it or not?  Before ordering it I first went to the StriVectinLABS website (strivectin.com) and read reviews from women in my age group (60+) that were very positive, so I thought I would give it a try.

I could definitely use some wrinkle repair, especially on the lines around my mouth.  I have used it regularly for about a month now; not always morning and night though because on days when I swim I don't want to put it on and then end up washing it off soon after.  But most days I've used it twice a day on the lines beside my mouth and the bags under my eyes. I wish I could tell a difference (really, I wish I could tell you I can see a difference), but neither my husband or I can.  When I first put the cream on and smooth it out my lines are softer, but that's pretty much the case using any cream.  The 1 fl. oz. jar does last about a month, which I'm surprised to find out, because that's not really a lot of cream. It does feel nice and has a pleasant not overpowering scent and I feel pampered when I use it.  It seems expensive for the amount received, but if I could tell a difference I would gladly put out the bucks each month.  Unfortunately, not gonna happen.  :-(  But my hubby still says I'm beautiful.  :-)

This is a pretty decent anti-aging cream. I will say that first of all, it is extremely expensive for what you're getting. Also, the size of the container is deceptive, making me think there's more cream in there than there really is. Some initial thoughts when I opened it is that it has a pleasant smell. It is not overpowering and does not smell too perfume-y.

I have been using it for almost 30 days now and I do notice the days I put some on there is a bit of difference. I do feel like my skin looks a bit younger although I still have some sun spots that won't go away. It also gives a tingling feel to it right away. It is a nice soothing feeling on the skin and moisturizes it well. I can feel my face is a bit smoother than before. My biggest gripe is the price. I think if it was a lot cheaper then it would be worth it but not at the price right now. It feels like there's a serious upcharge on it.
summary: Feels Nice and Moisturizes well but too expensive

reviewText:
I have been using this cream day and night for 20 days now.
At first I figured that nothing would change but that at the very least I would have a moisturized face.
My opinion has changed.  I actually do see a difference!

At about day 13 I realized that my skin looked different.  It looks more refined, smoother if you will.  My face has an over-all fresher, not so dry and tired look.  My makeup goes on easier and looks better as well.
I am not one to say something works when it does not and am pretty skeptical overall.  So, I really mean it when I say that this is working on me.

This cream has a scent that is fresh, slightly citric and reminds me of going to a spa.  I enjoy putting the cream on because of the light scent.  I will note again that I am not typically a person that would like scented cream.  I love the smell of this.

You can read all of the ingredients from the pictures and all of the claims for this extreme cream in the notes already posted.

I surely can't tell if the cream has a defense from environmental factors or if it is actually strengthening my skin.  I can say that is smells great and has made a difference in my skin texture and moisture level.  Maybe over the long term I will see my fine lines diminish as it claims...

I read some reviews saying that the cream irritated their skin.  So I looked up StriVectin products and they suggest trying their creams every other or every 3rd day if you only have a mild irritation.  Maybe that would help.
I have an issue with the cost of this product.  At 90 bucks for 1 oz, many people can't afford this.  If it is possible it would be great if the price could be lowered since it only last about 6 months.
summary: Works if used daily-Smells Great-Nice product!

reviewText:
Great moisturizer, noticeable difference in softness of face after using it for just a few days, even works on winter roughened skin.
Pleasant light scent that made me think of citrus, rich luxurious feeling cream.

Rather pricy though, so you might want to shop around for something less expensive and try that first. But I was using this while my allergies were acting up and it even helped the sore skin around my nose from blowing my nose every 5 minutes.
summary: Even works on winter roughened skin, but a bit too expensive

reviewText:
Once again, I get to embarrass myself in the interest of saving my Amazon friends a few bucks. A few years back I decided the best way to test an expensive skin cream to see if it really lived up to its promises was to actually test it head-to-head against the inexpensive stuff I typically used. My results from that test proved to me the cheap stuff was just fine. When I had a chance to get a batch of this StriVectinLABS cream I thought it was time for another test.

Unfortunately, this means putting close-up photos of my 50+ year old makeup-free face out there for everyone to see. Ugh. Oh well, at least I've still got my sparkling personality and great sense of humor to keep humanity from ostracizing me.

This test was performed using my regular Neutrogena Rapid Tone repair on the left side of my face, and the StriVectinLABS Extreme Cream on the right. I washed my face using my regular liquid Neutrogena twice a day, and applied both lotions morning and before bed every day for 15 days.

Overall, I like the feeling of the StriVectin Extreme Cream, it is rich without feeling heavy or greasy, my makeup applies nicely over the top of it. The smell is not organic, it's more medicinal, sort of like Witch Hazel. That's fine with me, since I find some floral scents irritating. I also like that a little goes a long way with the Extreme Cream, it's easy to apply a very small amount and get smooth and even coverage.

So, it feels nice, how does it work? I see no visible difference after 2 weeks. The photos show the same thing, no difference with the possible exception of slightly softer fine lines around my eyes, although this might be attributed to softer ambient light seen in the second set of photos.

Before photos were taken with natural and fluorescent light at 1pm using my Canon SL1 with the same settings and white balance for both sets of photos. Light and white balance were somewhat different due to a cloudy day during the second set.

My conclusion is that either the Neutrogena and StriVectin are both not doing a darned thing for my skin, or that both are doing something and doing it equally well, either way, it's not exactly a ringing endorsement for the very spendy StriVectinLABS product.

I will continue this test for another two weeks and report back with any further changes/findings.

--------------

Update 12/29/2014

I've continued using the StriVectinLABs Extreme Cream, now on both sides of my face. There is no change in feel or appearance of my skin when compared with the "before" photos, so unfortunately there's no great miracle that occurs after using this product for more than a month. It does feel good and is very easy to apply, so I'll continue using it, but I definitely won't be buying any when this container is empty.
summary: Face-Off! StriVectin vs. Neutrogena - My life as a face cream guinea pig

reviewText: The best comparison I could give this was to hope in a jar by philosophy, which I have always loved. After using this for awhile now I would say I like this better. My skin looks amazing. I feel my tone is more even, my skin is more hydrated and visibly smooth. It feels really nice going on, and a little bit seems to go a very long ways. One jar will last me about 3 months with once daily usage.

StriVectinLABS Extreme Cream has a nice luxurious feel to it. It goes on easily and a little goes a long way. It keeps my skin feeling moist all day long without reapplying. I apply it in the morning and before bedtime. It hasn't caused any irritation and it makes my skin feel good. But after using it for about a week I don't really see any visible difference or reduction in wrinkles on my face. (I have plenty to experiment on.) To be fair, I have been using other products prior to trying this StriVectin. The products I used were pure coconut oil, pure jojoba seed oil, Pure Argan oil, and a product called Gene's Vitamin E Cream. I didn't use them all at once, but rotated them, using each for several days and then switching to another. So, my results so far with StriVectinLABS Extreme Cream is that it's not any better and not any worse than these other options. But given the current price of $89 per ounce compared to around a dollar per ounce for these other products, I couldn't recommend it based on my experience so far. I am going to continue using it until it runs out and if I see miraculous results I will update my review.

Update 7/17/15 - After writing this review, I continued using this product for over a month. I didn't really see any big improvement. The good news is that it goes a long way and I still had some left in the jar. A couple weeks ago I decided to try putting this StriVectin on half of my face and apply pure coconut oil by Viva to the other half. After 2 weeks both sides looked about equally softened. The wrinkles weren't gone but both products provided enough moisture that they seemed less noticeable. The coconut oil is  takes 20 to 30 minutes to be absorbed, so it's less convenient. But it costs a little over $10 for 16 ounces and it's a simple, natural product and that appeals to me.
summary: Feels nice on my face but no miraculous results

reviewText: I have to admit, before I even tried this stuff I was writing the review in my head about how it works fine, but come on can it really be better than the stuff that's 1/3 the price? I have to admit that I'm kind of shocked. It is a really great moisturizer, and much to my surprise, the little crow's feet around my eyes are less noticeable after only a week of use. That's got to be worth something! I'm just not sure if it's worth the price of this moisturizer.....

I've been using this product for about a week. It smells nice and is a thick creamy "extreme cream." I generally use Nivea and have no problems with that. My skin in winter gets dry and literally soaks up the thickest and greasiest of creams. I love the way this goes on and the way it feels. Unfortunately though it made my skin break out so I had to discontinue use. I think for someone who is not sensitive to it--it would be a great "extreme cream" for cold weather. Not sure I'd use it in the summer as it is pretty heavy duty.  I was really disappointed when my skin started erupting and I'm not sure what ingredient caused it. I've used many skin creams and occasionally one doesn't agree with my skin and unfortunately this was one of them :(.

Skincare is one of my splurges.  I was excited to try StriVectinLABS Extreme Cream since I'd been happy with the few StriVectin products I'd used in the past.

At $89/ounce, the Extreme Cream is among the pricier moisturizers. It's supposed to encourage cell renewal and collagen production to fight the onset of wrinkles. I haven't seen this yet, but it's a rich and non-greasy cream. It went on easily on my skin and left my face feeling soft, dewy and well hydrated. I have very sensitive skin and had no sensitivity with Extreme Cream.
summary: Rich, non-greasy cream well suited for cold dry weather

reviewText:
This StriVectin Extreme Cream is rich, thick, and luxurious.  It feels silky going on your skin, and has a pleasant smell.  The cream was a lot thicker than my normal moisturizer (Clinique), so I decided to use it just at night.  I have combination skin and large pores so I was careful to use less product on my oily sections.  But even with just a light application and only using at night, I had numerous pimples appear after just a few days of use.

So if you have normal or dry skin this StriVectin Extreme Cream would be great, but use with caution on the oily patches of your skin.
summary: Rich, thick, luxurious cream, but made my oily/combo skin break out

reviewText: StriVectin makes extremely good products. I had already used their eye serum when I got the opportunity to try this product and I have to say: although their products are very pricey, they are truly worth the money. The difference in looks (and touch) is almost immediately noticeable.

This is the most wonderful fragrance!  Its a bit woodsy at first, but blooms into a delightful blend of crisp and fruity/flowery.  Its perfect for day or evening, and it lasts!  Its probably more suitable for a mature woman over a teenager, but I think anyone would love it.  It doesnt scream, Perfume!  Rather, its a lovely clean cloud of confidence.

The bottle is beautiful, with a tortoiseshell top that you cant really see in the picture.  I am thrilled to have this in my collection!

To start, when ordering designer perfume online be sure to take note of which seller you are buying from. Amazon is a market place and other sellers may offer perfume at a lower price on the same product page, so you'll want to be wary of fakes. Making sure you are buying your perfume from Amazon themselves or other sellers with a reputable sales history is your best bet to know you are receiving a genuine product.

I found My Burberry to be a very strong perfume that lasts a LONG time. Hours and hours later I can still smell it on my skin. Very floral, it's a wonderful spring/summer time perfume. Very feminine with strong notes of geranium. It's a fragrance that you can spray on a sweater or shawl and you'll still be able to smell it on them the next day.

I have the 3 oz bottle and it's beautiful. Very weighty and the cap is a marbled mix of dark brown and tan. A little bit of this goes a long way!
summary: Strong, floral perfume that lasts and lasts.

reviewText:
I love the colors and the compact with mirror.  There are 6 eye colors, 2 lip, and one blush that creates a natural look...love that. There are step by step instructions but I could not read them as the font was small so I reviewed the instructions on the internet.  I really liked that, as I was never good at applying makeup, so these little tutorials are perfect for me.

There is a small two ended brush that does not fit into the compact which is a shame, and you will need a bigger brush for the blush. I am not sure if this makeup is hypo-allergenic, but my skin did not have any negative reactions. I could not read the label on the back of the compact that explains which color is for what use.

Overall I really like the makeup, compact and video tutorials.  Highly recommend.
summary: Whats not to love? Perfect selection of makeup in a sturdy compact for a complete look with instructions.

reviewText:
What is not to love about this compact?  The cheek, lip and eye colors blend in to create a natural look, from plum to creams to bronze and glittery black.  A double brush helps apply the eye shadow, to keep skin oils off the colors.  The colors last for several hours before showing creasing. These colors are all refillable, too.

Impressive is also the compact case as well.  It's heavy and has a nice-sized mirror that is designed to handle a fall.  The entire ensemble oozes elegance.

This is a nice set of color-coordinated make-up to create a specific shimmery, wintery look.  The make-up is high-quality and doesn't smudge, particularly the eye shadows.  Since 6 of the 9 colors are intended for eyes, it is particularly important that the quality is good for the eye make-up.  The lipsticks are fine, but they have a bit of a sticky consistency, and I find them difficult to apply in this form, but I don't mind that too much because I have other lipsticks I prefer to use.

As others have mentioned, there is some redundancy in colors here.  There are two bronzes for the eyes that are very similar in color, and there are two dark grays that are also very similar.  I could have used just one of each of those.  I really like the shimmery ice blue color.  It's a fairly unique color for me, so I liked discovering that.

These are generally "cool" colors so keep that in mind when ordering this for yourself or a gift.  Not everyone looks best in cool colors, depending on your own coloring.
summary: A nice set of color-coordinated make-up

reviewText: I absolutely love this palette! The colors are perfect for my complexion and I can wear them for a day time look and night time. The eyeshadows are pigmented and vibrant and the 2 lipsticks creamy and long lasting! A great and affordable palette to have in any girls collection!

Not bad shadow as far as quality and pigment strength but the colors in this palette seem redundant and clashy. The silver is very metalic and seemed to end up everywhere after a few hours. Not sure why I need two browns so close in shade and dark grey and black liner very similar in one palette. The brush is useless for the blush and liner the other end was good. As I said, the quality of the product is quite good, I just don't personally care for the color selection at all.
summary: Odd redundant color selection and useless brush

reviewText:
I've been wishing for this palette, or at least an EM palette, for a long time. This is a limited edition New Year's palette. Other than the sparkle I'm not sure how it relates to New Years - these are colors that can be worn year round. There are quite a few things I really like about the palette:

1. It has a magnetic clipless closure that stays securely shut unless you open it
2. The mirror is a nice enough size that you could bring it somewhere with you and freshen up your look
3. The colors are dramatic without being gaudy
4. The compact itself feels heavy and very solid - feels like it is made to last a long time
5. It's refillable - when you use up a favorite shadow or lip shade, you can pop another one in

I tried nearly all the eye colors and they looked nice without looking overpowering. The two little lip colors were beautiful, especially when you put the dark one on first and top it with the light shimmery shade - felt good too. Though the blush looks very dark, with the right brush and a bit of practice it went on looking natural instead of made up.

There was just one negative about this entire package, but it's not a deal breaker: The brush that came with the set is not a good brush for eyes. The larger end didn't layer the color on well and was a tad too firm and too small to be effective. Seemed more like a decent lip brush, but didn't work for lids - I ended up using one of my own favorite brushes. The smaller chiseled end did work well for using the shadow to line the eyes.

All in all, even with the horrible little brush, this is one of the most beautiful sets I've gotten recently. The color goes on light, but you can put more on for a more dramatic look. Also, the shimmery shadow is not an overly bright shimmer, a subtle soft shimmer.
summary: Beautiful palette with a horrible little brush

reviewText: The colors are nice, but the brush is worthless...doesn't matter much since I have a set of brushes that I prefer to use anyway, but the quality of the eye shadows and blush are worse than the cheapest drugstore makeup I have ever used. NYC, Wet N Wild, etc, are all better than this.

We have come to rely on the Michelle Phan palette's.  This product provides and easy to travel with solution with the minor issue taht the brush does not fit in the case (more on that below).

The Palette construction is very good and it will withstand typical abuse, even in a household of girls.  The design (about a little less than 3x3) is very good in terms of usability and portability in a handbag.  However, functionally, they should have found a way to allow the brush to be stored inside the case for an even more comprehensive travel solution.  It is a shame because I found the brush of high quality, but likely to be lost since it cannot be stored inside the case.  The palette can be refilled as needed with replacement colors, or even changed out for variation.

Overall, we really like it.  Except for the brush not fitting in the case.

This is a nice compact, it's attractive and solidly built.  I really like the eyeshadows as they blend beautifully.  I found the large pan of black eyeliner to be especially nice.  It might be black shadow, but I used it as eyeliner with the small end of the brush and it was really easy to work with.

The shadows seem long wearing.  The blush was very natural looking.

The lip glosses were fine.  I'm not a big fan of lip gloss, so my opinion probably shouldn't count on that.

The pans remove from the compact very easily (I just stuck a 00 knitting needle in the hole, but I think a paperclip or pin would work just as well).  The pans appear to be held by magnets.

Downsides:
The brush doesn't fit in the compact!  I think this is just absurd.  there isn't even a carrying case for the brush, so don't even think of putting this in your purse for an evening out.

You can't find replacement pans of eyeshadow.  I want to throw out the gloss (not because it's bad, but because I don't like gloss) and replace that with two more eye shadows, but I can't find replacement pans anywhere - not on Amazon and not on Michelle Phan's site.
summary: Nice compact, but the brush won't fit, can't find refills
