reviewText: Great Colors, applies well, looks awesome. I would recommend.

Oh, my. I ordered this without looking at the price tag. How I wish I hadn't gotten pulled in. Never one to purchase higher-end make-up because I felt the "cheaper" stuff (L'oreal, Revlon, Maybelline) was just fine, I am now questioning my long-held beliefs.
This is so rich, and the texture so fine and creamy. Unlike "cheap" make-up that crumbles a lot and has to be dusted from your cheeks, this goes on smoothly, without making a mess. So there IS less waste, but probably not enough to compensate for the price difference.
These colors are very classy. Not tacky or trendy, but classic and elegant while not looking "old lady" at all. Beautiful.
My only complaint is the brush, which is limiting because it doesn't have enough tips for all the content of the palette and I dread mixing the colors in any way. So I pull extras from my stash.
I also think it would have been helpful to have a place on the container to attach or hold the brush. Most women (like me) take their make-up with them for touch-ups at work or out on a date. This isn't designed for keeping the brush, which means I can't simply take it from my make-up drawer and drop it into my purse. Because you don't want the brush flopping around loose in a purse, which is damaging to the bristles and leaves residue in the purse, I suggest slipping the whole into a baggie.
So, if members of the company read these reviews, I strongly urge you to add more brushes and provide a hold for at least one of them. It may sound silly to you, but if it comes to choosing between 2 similar products in the same price range, many of us are going to choose the most convenient option. Take note, please.
summary: Fabulous make-up. Just wish the brush had a home.

reviewText:
This is a very nice little compact with everything in one place except brushes. I don't really care for the included brush especially for the blush. If the idea is to carry the compact in your make-up bag you need something to protect the brush and keep it clean.

The eye colors blend very well together. The lip glosses are really just that. Glosses, with not a lot of color and they feel sort of sticky to me. They're not very long-lasting.

I think the colors would be flattering to most skin tones.  In my opinion the make-up might work for evening but it's not really something I would choose if I wanted a good quality make-up that would last all day.

I was very pleased with this compact, the "New Year's Eve Countdown". What a great idea, having blush, 2 shades of lipstick (darker mauve and lighter slightly pinker shade) and 6 shades of eyeshadow (shimmery cream, flesh-colored, light brown, pinkish mauve, gray and regular dark gray). These are all neutral colors that will look good on most people. They apply smoothly, no odor that I could detect or anything else to dislike about them (the one thing is the little brush that comes with it--fine for the eyeshadow, except that it doesn't fit in the compact! For the blush and lipsticks, there isn't a separate applicator. I put some on with a finger, but it doesn't come off easily--good for lipstick, not for fingers.)

Another plus was the compact itself, seals magnetically and is a good size--about 2 1/2" square with the same size mirror--the mirror, imo, is a real plus. I hope this catches on, because it's a great idea.
summary: Lovely Color Palette and Excellent  3-in-1 Compact

reviewText:
I am a big fan of Michelle Phan and think she is a genious for creating a make-up line after gaining fame demonstrating make-up application on YouTube. You can buy this compact and then go on line to watch her instruct you step by step how to apply it! For anyone who is a novice at applying make-up, this is great!!

As for the compact it's self it is on the larger size. I would estimate it's dimensions at 3" x 3", which could make it difficult to carry in smaller purses. It also has some weight to it due to the magnets inside which hold the refillable make-up inside. It has a large mirror, which spans the entire case adjacent to the make-up like usual. One issue I have with the make-up line in general is that there doesn't seem to be any replacements that you can be order. I would assume since this is a newer make-up line, this is a future feature which will eventually make it to the market.  I would also suspect that the colors available through the multiple compacts may be interchangeable, so you might be able to mix and match. This compact does come with a double sided brush wand for lips and eyes, but it does not fit into the compact which stinks. Who wants to carry a make-up brush loose in their purse?
 In my opinion this compact comes with very neutral colors, which could fit nearly any skin tone. I am very fair and all colors complemented my tone. I believe these colors could easily go from worklife to nightlife. As for the colors themselves which are included, there are three dark brown crease colors, 1 metallic medium tone beige color for upper eye, 1 light colored metalic beige color for lids, and one silver for wherever. The blush is more of a deeper coral. The 2 lip glosses (mauve pink and apricot) are thick and meant to be barely there. Of course look at colors in the pictures from the manufacturer to make your own call. The make-up seemed to last as long as my usual top brand does. Overall, a great product that I would recommend.

I received the Life Palette Moment in Ice Bunny. I am a Michelle Phan fan, but I am finding as I test various em products that the quality of her makeup does not live up to her reputation. For the higher price points, it should be better quality. This set pretty much followed that same line. I am going to break it down into the separate components of the set:

Palette- The palette is a little on the heavy side for it's size, but that is due to the magnetic feature. All of the colors in this palette can be removed and replaced. I love this feature! The only problem is that you will probably have to replace them with more em products due to the size and shape of the pans. I also like that you can have your eyeshadow, blush and lip gloss all in one palette that is convenient for traveling.

the brush- This comes with a small dual-ended brush. I personally did not like this brush. I feel like the blush/eyeshadow end is too fluffy for eyeshadow and too small for blush. I am spoiled by my Urban Decay brushes and I ended up using them for the eyeshadow. I attempted to use the em brush for blush, but quickly switched to a small kabuki brush. I did use the small flat end for the lip gloss in the palette because I didn't want to ruin one of my brushes. It worked fine. The brush also does not fit inside the palette which is a pain.

The eyeshadow- I LOVE a few of the eyeshadow colors. They are good for a day or night look. I recommend using snow day on the inner eye (a really pretty shimmery bronze), bundle up on the outer eye, ice bunny to highlight the corners and under the brow and a dash of winter chill or black pumps to darken the outer corner of the eye. I loved this look on my eye. Unfortunately, without primer it didn't last very long. I wore this look along with an Urban Decay 24/7 eyeliner and L'Oreal mascara to dinner with friends. When I arrived home 2 hours later there was NO eyeshadow left. It had all faded and all I was wearing was eyeliner and mascara. Definitely use primer to make this eyeshadow stick around.

The blush- The blush is pretty and I think I would like it if I had different coloring. However, this color does not show up on my skin at all (I am pale with a lot of red tones).

The lip gloss- The lip gloss will make your lips shiny and super glossy, BUT so will vaseline...and that is what it feels like. The lip glosses are extremely thick and sticky and feel really gross on your lips. Both of the colors in the Ice Bunny Palette came up clear on my lips. It just looked like I had a thick layer of clear gloss on. I don't like the lip product and probably wouldn't use it unless I had to.

Overall, I would not recommend this eye palette. There are much better makeup products that you could buy for the current price of $35. I hope that Michelle Phan starts making quality makeup that she would actually use soon.

I like this. I don't wear a lot of nighttime makeup so a couple of the eyeshadows aren't ever going to work for me. But the shadow goes on very smooth and I love, love, love! the lip color and gloss. The case is well made and the brush that is included will get the job done on your eyes and lips.

We're all looking for that perfect makeup compact -- the one that has it all - lipstick, blush, eye shadow and applicators.  This em michelle phan palette almost fills the bill. One thing I don't like about it is that the brush on the applicator is not big enough to use for blush (maybe apply with fingers?) and there is no place for it in the compact -- has to be kept separate, rolling around somewhere in my purse or cosmetic bag, not keeping clean itself and spreading the dust from the cosmetics.  The colors are long lasting and the color saturation is good, unlike some cheaper palettes.

All in all, I think if you are looking for a portable winter makeup palette and can make peace with the whole applicator thing, this is a good choice.
summary: A good choice in a portable winter makeup palette

reviewText: I love this makeup palette from em michelle phan. The colors are great and the makeup itself is high-quality. I love that it comes with an applicator brush, although I did find that I need a bigger brush to apply the blush (which I already had on-hand, so no big deal). The website for these products also includes tutorials which were very helpful and gave me more confidence in applying the eye-colors and not coming out looking like a clown. :) Love this product!
summary: I love this makeup palette from em michelle phan

reviewText: Recommended by my doctor, I use this every morning. Good complex for facial skin. Very nice texture. Helps with needed vitamins. No sunscreen in this.
Love PCA
This cream is slightly gritty and better used at night for restorative measures.  After using it for over a month, this was my 2nd order.  It seems to undo sun damage.
I like the consistency and feel of this product - I'm just not sure how much good it really does my skin, overall.  Not sure I would buy it again.

This C E strength max along with the intensive brightening treatment 0.5% retinol are the 2 PCA products that are a must for me.  They have both improved my complexion more than anything else I've ever used.  My skin is clearer, firmer, has smaller pores & glows like it did when I was much younger (I'm 58).  I just had lunch with a friend I hadn't seen for a while, she thought I had work done - nope, just PCA.  Since this is a wonderful line of skin care I do use many of the other products however these 2 are my favorites.
The sample box was okay EXCEPT my perfume sample was missing. The holder was there but not the Riviera perfume sample. Other than that, it's fine.
Great gift.  My wife loved it and it was FREE!!!
summary: Surprise - "look what I got for you Baby"!!

reviewText: love this. buy it buy it buy it. You won't regret it.  It's amazing to get to try these high end brands and then get a credit too for future purchases!  These sell out fast, buy when you can!
Beauty box

I just bought this by itself instead of receiving it as a GWP (just put a qualifying item in your cart, this will appear, then remove the qualifying item- this will stay and you'll just pay shipping). Decent sample sized products (none are luxury IMO), just nothing to make me want to buy it again.
summary: I just bought this by itself instead of receiving it ...

reviewText: What a nice sample box.  I am really excited to try all the goodies I got.  There was a full size eye shadow, and nail polish. Generous samples of Shaving balm, foot exfoliating balm, hand lotion, shower oil, Hair Fattener, toothpaste  and two face lotions. Also there were two envelope samples of face products and one of body lotion.  There were three perfume samples.  What fun!
summary: Full of lots of fun stuff!

reviewText: If I could give it 10 stars I would! This is probably the best deal I have got on Amazon in quite some time. I love it! For the price it cannot be beat! Just one of the items in the box alone was worth more than the cost of the box. The other samples were very nice and well worth what it cost. I hope that Amazon will start doing this monthly or at least more often! I am really happy with my purchase! Thanks Amazon!

I got this as a free gift with a luxury beauty purchase (I bought a Lorac eyeshadow palette I'd had my eye on).  It was definitely a good GWP, and competitive with what you would get from places like Ulta (including some foils and perfumes).  I think it was a good way to spread the word about what sorts of luxury beauty brands Amazon carries.

I received the MAKE eyeshadow in the pinkish color, which is pretty wearable for me.  I got the Jane Iredale sample in a peach color and the majority of the product had broken off in the tube.  I didn't bother to complain since I have used this product before and know that I prefer it as a cheek stain as opposed to a lip stain.  So I can just dig it out with a brush.

The Nuxe toner was a liquid which was an interesting choice for a foil packet and unfortunately I dumped most of it.  (Silly me for seeing "lotion" and assuming anything about the consistency...)  Really liked the Rituals body cream and would totally buy it in full size.  Was actually a fan of the Juice Beauty products (that brand doesn't always work for me) but the samples were kind of small.  I'd like to try them in a little bigger size to see if they work for me before committing to a full size purchase.

I'm not a fan of WEN at all, having tried it in the past.  At least not as a cleansing conditioner.  Sometimes I use it as a regular conditioner and/or a leave-in, and it works better for me that way.  I do like the pomegranate scent, though.  Catherine Malandrino Style de Paris is a Birchbox staple so I've received this before.  It's not my favorite CM perfume (that is Romance de Provence) but it's all right.

Kind of wish there hadn't been any men's samples here.  I don't know any men who would want the samples so I had to get rid of them.  Seemed wasteful.

The Strivectin product alone is worth more than the price of this GWP, if you had paid separately for it.  Pretty much the only way I ever experience Strivectin is in GWPs because of the price of the brand.  I also did use the promo code that came with this set to purchase more luxury beauty products (fragrance, a highlighter, another palette).

So, although every product wasn't for me, that is usually the case with a GWP, and I was able to use enough of the items that I feel like this was worth getting.  I hope Amazon does something like this again soon.
summary: fun to see what Amazon has to offer in the luxury beauty category

reviewText:
I am not sure why there was a lot of negative reviews for this product. I currently subscribe to four other monthly beauty boxes and love perfume samples.  The other products were nice as well, I think for the $8 ish dollars I paid it was priced right. Getting the chance to sample a nice trial size of the StriVectin-AR was worth the money paid as it is.. The box it was packaged in was very nice also and reusable!

Hopefully Amazon will do more of these boxes!

This is a luxurious, elegant bubble bath with a soothing, pleasant aroma.  It comes in an attractive bottle that sets it apart from the cheaper brands.  This is an excellent gift item or a way to reward yourself.  The bubbles and the scent are long-lasting and a little goes a long way.

The bottom line though is that it is still just bubble bath, so the price seems steep compared to others less costly; the fine quality of this bubble bath doesn't seem to be that much of a distinguisher.
summary: Turn Your Bath Into a Relaxing Reward

reviewText:
Soothing bubble bath!  I like it a lot. It makes a good bit of bubbles but they don't last long. I just used about a capful, so others maybe used more. It's a decorative bottle - hard to believe it's plastic when you're looking at it. It didn't leave any residue on my skin. I don't use lotions because I can't stand to feel as though my skin is greasy, so I was happy that it didn't leave any residue.
The top wasn't on tight and it leaked during shipment. Amazon is always great about taking care of those type problems, so no worries.

This is a wonderful soothing bubble bath. It smells wonderful! The bubbles stay for a while as you soak. It leaves your skin feeling like you just rubbed body butter all over but without the residue on your skin. This is a great bubble bath:}

I take a bubble bath every day and have for years. When I saw I was offered this pricey bubble bath via the Amazon Vine program, I was thrilled. At $38, I imagined it would at least be very good.

I was sent the Prosecco (Champagne) scent. The company lists the fragrance notes exactly the way one would with perfume. "Top notes of Satsuma citrus. . ." was there (well, at least the sense of citrus) and and quite nice, but like most top notes, it faded quickly. As one fills the bath with hot water, the other notes all combine into what I call "nice shampoo smell." Fruity & sweet, but without much character.

Now, the bubbles. I read the other reviews and I wonder how much of this product people used. Indeed, one reviewer seemed to suggest there was enough of this for five or six baths! This is a big bottle. It should last a good long time.

I put about one heaping tablespoon in my bath. This is the amount I use with every other bubble bath product I like and use. With this product, I got about an inch of large bubbles that dissipated quickly. A truly good bubble bath produces lots of small foaming bubbles that hold up for the duration of the bath. This product did not do that with an amount that is reasonable for one use.

Additionally, after the bath, I do feel a dry residue of product on my skin that begs for a shower and some moisturizer. I don't feel that way with other bubble baths I use. I will not use this again. For the price, there are many really excellent bubble bath products out there, some of which cost less than 1/3rd the price.

I have been using this product over the last four weeks and I must say that this is an average product. I generally use about two to three table spoons of bubble bath solution per bath. The fragrance is mild and not overwhelming, and it does not leave a whole lot soap scum at the end of the bath. The product moisturizes the skin and you experience a sense of relaxation. The bottle has enough solution that could last 10 to 12 baths. I have rated this product three stars for overall satisfaction.

It's hard to write a review on bubble bath, so I hope you find this helpful.  Let's start with the bottle.  The picture doesn't quite show the elegance of the bottle.  Although it is plastic it does have the appearance of being glass and gives a good first impression.  The product is the perfect thickness so that it doesn't run wastefully from the bottle when you pour it.

I found it didn't take much to get a nice amount of bubbles in my bath.  The smell is very natural and I found it to be lightly floral and very pleasing.  There was a silkiness to the water and yet it wasn't oily.  When I was done with my bath it left my skin soft and lightly scented.  Because I don't take very many baths I have also been using it in the shower as a shower gel on my scrubby.  It makes a luxurious foam as I shower and even works great for shaving my legs.

Overall I really like the product.

I'll start off by admitting that I'm *very* sensitive to most bath products.  In fact, until today, the only bubble bath I've been able to use without causing an allergic rash is Avon's Sensitive Skin Bubble Bath.  While it doesn't have a pleasing aroma, it didn't cause a rash.

Then I tried this Antica Farmacista Bubble Bath, and all I can say is, "Oh my!"  The smell is utterly delicious, and the feeling of my skin after stepping out of the tub!  Oh my!  It leaves me with soft smooth skin that doesn't require lotion afterward (which is the first time -- EVER -- for me).  Even more important, this leave no trace of itching at all.  I've found a new favorite bubble bath!
This is a product I was given by my Dermatologist after some injections. I LOVE it. I'm too old for injections now but I will never stop using this product. Just wish it had some sunscreen.
summary: I LOVE it. I'm too old for injections now but ...

reviewText: The best lip conditioner out there. Hands Down.
Great lip smoother, plumper and moisturizer. Feels like heaven on your lips!

I really like it while I'm wearing it. It does not do anything spectacular or noticeably dramatic to my lips. Just seems like just another lip gloss. It smells very good and goes on thick. If you have long hair you might be irritated if you are outside and the wind is blowing, because your hair will stick to your lips. It's been a while since I bought it and still have it in my purse. I use it when I run across it, but other than that it's not a product that I would buy again especially since it does not plump my lips at all. Regular lip gloss is much cheaper.

Works great! It's a night-care routine that leaves the skin appearing rejuvenated and detoxified. This is really good stuff that is designed for daily use to help make your skin look recharged and smooth. Recommended!

This anti-aging cream seems to contribute to healthy skin and perhaps decreases signs of aging.  The results have not been instantaneous or miraculous, but the cream appears to have worthwhile benefits.  I have not had any side-effects or irritation.  After using it at night, my skin feels moisturized and healthy in the morning.

The cream comes in an easy to use twist and pump container.

Update to my original two-star review: this morning my wife says a propos of nothing " that last cream you got me is really nice."  Turns out she is referring to this one and she thinks now she would pay $75 for it, because she thinks it really does make her skin softer and reduces wrinkles.  My original review said: "She thinks it's nice but nothing special and certainly not something she would pay $50-$75 for.  For what it's worth she is in her 50s and full-blooded southern Italian.  She never uses sunscreen."
summary: She likes it more after four weeks of use

reviewText: This Detox night cream absorbs very well into your skin, but it would be hard to stretch two pumps to cover all the face and neck, as the marketing describes. The smell is not strong, and not particularly pleasant or unpleasant--slightly floral. The concealed pump head is a neat design. Will update  later on results...

I really love this cream. In the morning my skin looks better, with less fine lines and it definitely has a plumping effect. On the down side though, I still wouldn't pay this price and I don't like the fragrance. I'm not a floral person and prefer a citrus or fragrance free.

I love to wear nighttime creams, its all the work without having to make sure you have the lotion on and let it dry and then put on make up etc. Nuxe Nuxellence (sigh that name really?) is an amazing, lightweight, creamy cream nighttime detoxifying lotion/elixir. It pumps easily, I love the design of the pump itself. The smell? well that is the worst part for me since I am so sensitive to aromas/fragrances. its like old lady...church lady even. but it does the job so well? I am willing to praise Nuxe for it. When I wake up in the morning after using it overnight, I do feel a difference...softer skin...less dry...less oily...less creasing from pillows.

After many nights of use, I see no difference in my skin. But, full disclosure, I have to say that I use so many products already that this Nuxe Detox likely is unable to make a further difference. FYI: I use retinol, glycolic acids, apricot kernel and other oils, mineral sunscreen (daytime only, of course) and other products on a fairly regular schedule. Except for the retinol, none of the products I use are expensive, so this Nuxe Detox really needs to deliver if I'm going to put it into nightly use at $75 per 1.5 ounce container. I didn't see additional improvement, so I won't be adding it to my routine. I will continue to use up the remainder in the bottle.

Performance aside, this is a beautifully packaged, nice smelling, smooth, easy to apply, pleasant, light cream. On me, it soaks in completely within a minute. In fact on those few nights when I didn't add moisturizer after application of the Nuxe Detox, my skin became extremely dry. So, for me, it cannot be used alone, even at night. If you have a very simple routine and don't already use retinol and AHAs or BHAs, this may work for you.

It has some great ingredients. I have read that safflower seed oil is an excellent choice. INGREDIENTS: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, C14-22 Alcohols, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Octyldodecyl Myristate, Dimethicone, Albizia Julibrissin (Persian Tree) Bark Extract, C10-18 Triglycerides, Dicaprylyl Carbonate, Butylene Glycol, Tocopherol, Parfum/Fragrance, C12-20 Alkyl Glucoside, Lauroyl Lysine, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Ethylhexylglycerin, Dehydroacetic Acid, Allantoin, Polysorbate-60, Sorbitan Isostearate, Hydrolyzed Candida Saitoana Extract, Sodium Gluconate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Lupine Protein, Citric Acid, Passiflora Incarnate (Passionflower) Extract, Papaver Rhoeas Petal Extract, Benzyl Alcohol, Anchusa Arvensis Extract, Lepidium Meyenii Root Extract, Sodium Benzoate, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Theobroma Cacao (Cocoa) Callus Powder, Araucaria Angustifolia Seed Extract, Geraniol, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone.
summary: Beautifully packaged, lightly scented, pleasant cream (INGREDIENTS list included)

reviewText: It is hydrating and makes my skin look better at least until I wash it off. I have not seen any changes to my skin otherwise but like most products usually it take a month or more. It is easy to dispense and feels nice on my skin, not tacky and doesn't pill. One thing I don't like is that there aren't any real instructions with this or I am not seeing them because most of the language is french. So far I don't think it is working any better than other creams i have tried, not any worse either. I guess time will tell as to whether it will make a difference but the past 1-2 weeks have not made any difference after it is washed off/
summary: feels good but not results yet

reviewText:
This is a nice, light moisturizer but (not surprisingly) like nearly every other one one the market it makes claims that are exaggerated at best. I don't think the results are any better or worse from the Aveeno Positively Radiant moisturizer I use from time to time. There are some differences: the Nuxe is silkier and thinner and it has a stronger scent that I like but might bother someone who's sensitive. It absorbs quickly and the next day my skin does feel a bit plumped but it's also a little greasy and I had a minor break out the first week. It's difficult to say whether or not I'm looking more radiant; I use a glycolic acid product every morning and it's been keeping me looking fairly bright.

I don't even know what Nuxe means by increasing detoxification of my skin. I don't even know if that's a chemically possible thing considering you're constantly turning over skin cells. Exfoliate and you'll do it quicker, you don't need a fancy product to do it for you. I also can't imagine using this under a moisturizer unless you have very dry skin. I'd have an oil slick on my face.

This is a nice moisturizer and if you're into luxury skin products then this is a fine choice. There's nothing actually wrong with it. If you're someone looking for function and you don't care what kind of bottle or brand you end up with, there are much less expensive ways to find the same results.
summary: Perfectly nice moisturizer but not particularly unique

reviewText: I had high hopes for the Nuxe Nuxellence Detox lotion.  I used it at night and again in the morning beneath my moisturizer as it says to on the instructions.  I have normal to dry skin.  The first 3-4 days things were fine and I liked how it left my skin feeling rejuvenated.  However, after about a week, I noticed that it left my fore head feeling greasy, so I only used it before bedtime, without my moisturizer.  I must be allergic to an ingredient in the lotion because I started breaking out and my face was itchy.  Too bad because I really did like the way it moisturized my skin.  From the packaging information (in many languages), I could not tell exactly how this product detoxifies your skin or why that is important.

The Nuxe Detox Facial Lotion is a lightly scented and skin softening lotion.  As a I age, I notice my skin look and texture is changing from normal/oily to normal/dry. This means I'm much more prone to wrinkling and flakiness.  I have Asian skin, no particular product sensitivities, and I generally wear sunscreen lotion on my face during the day.  The Nuxe lotion is working well at keeping my skin well hydrated in the evening, and I've noticed that it does a good job at minimizing the dry patches on my face as well.  I haven't had any issues with breakouts or allergic reactions, and for the most part, my skin looks very good in the morning after use.  I only need one or two pumps of lotion to effectively cover my entire face, and since I'm using so little product, the bottle does last quite a while.

While I do like this lotion, at $75 per bottle, I was expecting a much more dramatic difference in skin condition after extended period of use.  Unfortunately, I don't think this lotion works any better than comparable lotions purchased at my local department store beauty supply counter.  Without naming specific brands, I have used lotions that are about half the cost of this lotion and experienced similar results.  With that  in mind, this lotion does work very well - it's just much pricier than I would like to spend on a facial lotion.  Like most skin products, results will vary depending on individuals....for me, it was worth a try, but likely not a lotion I would purchase in the future.
summary: Works Well, Although Not Better Than Other Department Store Lotions I've Used

reviewText:
I do like Nuxe products but some of them are too strongly scented for me. This serum is great. The scent is light and pleasant and it feels wonderful on my skin.

I've been using it at bedtime, after I wash my face and my skin really does feel smoother and looks great. Wonderful night serum and recommended.

Amazingly after just one day of use I did notice that my skin felt much, much softer, and after a few weeks I do think my skin looks a little plumper.  But sadly I don't think this cream makes me look more rested.  I only get 6 hours of sleep during the week, so I was hoping this cream would make me look less dog-tired, but no such luck.  When I use the cream, my skin looks the same regardless of how many hours of sleep I get.

The cream itself it thick and has a silky feel.  It has a slightly strong scent, but it disappears quickly.  My skin and eyes are very sensitive to smells and chemicals, but I haven't had any issues using this cream.  No itchy, watery eyes or breakouts.

So I do like this cream, and even though it doesnt make me look as if I had two extra hours of sleep, it does make my skin softer and more hydrated.  Im going to keep using it as part of my nighttime skin regiment because it seems like an excellent moisturizer.
summary: Makes my skin softer and plumper - but not more rested

reviewText:
This is a fairly light cream for a night cream.  It seems bizarre to me that the instructions suggest using this "under your regular night cream."  Why on earth would I do that?  It does seem moisturizing enough to me. I'm 44 years old. Do I look "as if I had 2 extra hours of sleep" when I wake in the morning, as the bottle promises?  Not particularly. But my skin is sufficiently moisturized.

I do think the scent of the product is too strong, particularly for a face cream.  I would love it on a hand cream, but a very strong perfume-y scent right under my nose is a bit much.  It's overpowering, and not necessarily the perfume I would choose to wear to bed.

The cap is an interesting design, because it doesn't remove from the bottom but rather twists up and down to reveal a hidden pump.  The good thing about this is that I won't lose the cap or forget to put it back on.  I don't usually have a problem with this, but this design makes it impossible.  I can tell from the design, though, that there's going to be no way to get out the very last of the product when it's running low, because I can't remove the top and place it upside down over another container, or scrape out the sides of the bottle.  I know not everyone does things like this, but it really annoys me to have to just throw away a product when I know there's still some in there!  When the time comes maybe I'll find a way to pry off the top so I can get to the last 15-20% of the product.
summary: Lightly moisturizing, weird cap design, and overpowering scent

reviewText:
I rarely find an anti-aging product that doesn't cause me to breakout. This detox lotion has not caused any issues after a week of use. I noticed a difference the first night that I used it. In the morning my skin looked a little fresher. A week later, I haven't seen any more improvement than that. It is a nice lotion that has helped a little but nothing to justify the price. I looked well rested after my normal 8 hours of sleep. But after a 7 hour night of sleep, I looked like a zombie as usual. I think the bottle will last a while, you don't need to use much of this. There is no extra benefit if you use a lot.
To use, you just twist the top and the dispenser pops up. When done, turn it back and the dispenser is hidden again. It is kind of a neat feature.
I will keep using to finish the bottle but unless it works a miracle, I can't see spending $75 for just a little improvement.

The anti-aging skin care industry is full of luxury products claiming to restore skin using various botanical and biomolecular formulations.
This product sold me by having 10 French patents and its unique combination of Passionflower, Anchusa and Poppy.

When used as a night cream, the general benefit is to detoxify skin cells while you sleep.  The result is a revived complexion in the morning.

My wife is the primary user of this product.  She had very positive results from its use.  Her skin is noticeably smoother with a glowing complexion.
On the downside, she is sensitive to many products.  So far she has had no negative reactions to the product.

I am aware of the concern with animal testing of cosmetics and I think it is a horrid practice.  I did some research on Nuxe and found that they do not test their products or ingredients on animals during manufacture but they do engage in testing with the finished product when required by law (certain countries like China require this).

The scent is light and mostly unremarkable.  The box has multi-language descriptive and instructional text but the translation could be better.

Overall - this appears to have a positive affect on my wife's complexion and I have had positive results as well.  I would recommend it for night application with or without your normal moisturizer.  Do note that results will not be instantaneous...you will need to give it some time to work.

not exactly a confidence inspiring statement.

The box is printed in at least three languages. The first three ingredients are water, glycerin and safflower oil. Zoom in on a thumbnail picture on the left of the product page for a complete list of the ingredients.  Paraben free and non comedogenic, they say.

The bottle has a clever pop-up dispenser. On the other hand you cant see how much product is in the bottle. At this price you will probably want to eke out every drop.

It took about two pumps to cover my face. The lotion absorbs quickly and doesnt leave a greasy feel. It has a slightly medicinal fragrance.

The good news is my face didn't fall off. The bad news is I really couldn't tell any difference in my skin from using a regular moisturizer. Of course all skin is different and it might work great for someone else so Ill give it three stars for meh.

Edited to add: their statement...."(1) Use test conducted under dermatologically controlled conditions on 22 volunteers for 28 days twice-daily application"

  and a list of ingredients.

INGREDIENTS : AQUA/WATER, GLYCERIN, CARTHAMUS TINCTORIUS (SAFFLOWER) SEED OIL, HYDROXYETHYL ACRYLATE/SODIUM ACRYLOYLDIMETHYL TAURATE COPOLYMER, OCTYLDODECYL MYRISTATE, DIMETHICONE, ALBIZIA JULIBRISSIN BARK EXTRACT, C10-18 TRIGLYCERIDES, DICAPRYLYL CARBONATE, C14-22 ALCOHOLS, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, TOCOPHEROL, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE, LAUROYL LYSINE, PHENOXYETHANOL, SODIUM STEAROYL GLUTAMATE, DIMETHICONE CROSSPOLYMER, ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, DEHYDROACETIC ACID, ALLANTOIN, C12-20 ALKYL GLUCOSIDE, POLYSORBATE 60, SORBITAN ISOSTEARATE, HYDROLYZED CANDIDA SAITOANA EXTRACT, SODIUM GLUCONATE, SODIUM HYALURONATE, HYDROLYZED LUPINE PROTEIN, CITRIC ACID, PASSIFLORA INCARNATA EXTRACT, PAPAVER RHOEAS PETAL EXTRACT, BENZYL ALCOHOL, ANCHUSA ARVENSIS EXTRACT, LEPIDIUM MEYENII ROOT EXTRACT, SODIUM BENZOATE, CALENDULA OFFICINALIS FLOWER EXTRACT, THEOBROMA CACAO (COCOA) LEAF CELL EXTRACT, ARAUCARIA ANGUSTIFOLIA SEED EXTRACT, GERANIOL, ALPHA-ISOMETHYL IONONE [N2402/C].

Unlike a different Nuxe product I tried, this one has a pleasant fragrance that's not too strong. I also like how easy it is to dispense just a small amount.

I'm middle-aged and want to keep my skin looking young. This product does a super job of moisturizing and making my skin feel fresh and soft. I'm not sure about the claims since I haven't used the product for very long, but I do like it enough to continue using it daily. I will update with the results.
summary: Quality Moisturizing Product With Nice Fragrance

reviewText: The Proactiv Quick Fix Blemish Pen really does clear up acne and other facial marks.  It is portable and easy to use.  Just apply it to the target area and it dries quickly and acts quickly to clear the problem area.  This product neither smells bad nor stings.

Nice feeling lotion. It does somehow make your skin look more "rested" after sleeping - and this is after using it for less than a week.

I wish the container were larger though, this will run out quickly on my huge face.

Feels quite nice and smooth. Enjoyable!
People complain about the smell of this product, but that's just the smell. It actually works a lot better than your used-to Biore pore strippers.
summary: It actually works a lot better than your used-to Biore pore strippers

reviewText: These don't work near as well as the Biore strips. I really wanted to like them but they don't stick or seem to clear out pores near as well as other brands.

Sometimes it's best to just stick with what you know. I love biore strips. It's so fun to see all that gunk when you're done. I tried several asian alternatives including this product and none of them do as well as the old standby.
Doesn't work as well as the Biore ones. They do cost less though. Guess you get what you pay for in this case.
summary: Doesn't work as well as the Biore ones. They ...

reviewText:
I requested this for wife who happened to notice it on my queue. When it arrived I did all the unpacking and assembly for her just to score a few points. She worked on positioning the headset for a while until she got it exactly right for her. She cranked it up and let it run for the recommended twenty minutes. She said that it was not uncomfortable and she could sense a slight effect from the toner. After turning it off she has to wait twenty four hours for the next session.

This toner takes around twelve weeks to produce results so further updates will be made to this review when anything noteworthy occurs.

I own the FACEMASTER as well as all of the NuFACE products. I was looking for something that was hands free so I was excited to see this product. Unfortunately, it sits weird on my head and I end up having to hold it with one hand. This makes it no easier or better than the NuFACE! Honestly, I saw results immediately with my FACEMASTER, but its a hassle as you need two hands and a mirror. NuFACE is a little easier because you only need one hand and maybe a mirror. You can more easily maneuver the NuFACE so a mirror is not required. I haven't seen any miracle with this StriVectin as of yet but will keep using it even though it is quite uncomfortable on my head and needs to be held with one hand. NO- I do not have a weird shaped head!!! :)

OK - I have used this product for some time now and even though its not "hands free" like I had hoped, it is easier to use than NuFace and FaceMaster so I tend to use it at least five days per week! I can see visible lift to my "upper face" as in the eye area and upper cheek bones. So far, not much around the jaw line. Maybe they need to come out with another product that sits lower on the face to target the jawline? Overall I really like this thing and I would definitely recommend it!

10/2016 UPDATE The headset cracked! I contacted Strivectin and they offer a two year warranty and will send me a new one. YAY!

This is a review by my mother, transcribed by me:

I like this machine, though I haven't been using it for more than 3 weeks so its long-term effectiveness is an unknown.  It's easy to operate and although it feels strange at first (tingling and facial muscle movement), I found it wasn't uncomfortable or annoying.  The headset is narrow; it's possible my head is a little larger than the average woman but I found it a little tight.  The gel pads are sticky (be careful applying new pads to the headset so that they don't fall face down onto another surface -- they are difficult to pry off) and stay right where you place them.

The instruction manual is clear about where you're to place the headset but it could be clearer as to the initial settings, i.e. effectiveness, comfort, timing of exercises, etc.  The beginning setting I chose is 26 and increased it slightly every few days.  The display is easy to understand except for an error message which I found at the back of the manual and I appreciate the separate Left and Right controls for the two sides of the face.

I don't notice any difference thus far except a feeling of slight firmness in my upper cheeks.  So, it seems to be working.  A 20-minute regimen each day isn't a hardship and the headset fits over the back of the neck, so I can do other things while it's working.

I will update this review if I have anything more to add in the coming weeks.  I will need to buy more pads but thus far, I like this product!
summary: A mother's review: Seems to be working.

reviewText:
It was used on a smaller face during testing, and the user did not like how it puckered the face during use.  With prolonged use pulling the skin forward, it is likely to cause more wrinkles.  One has to pull it back with the hand during use, which is inconvenient.

If you have a medium to large face, it should be a good fit.  We did not experience significant changes after a couple of week of use, and have gone back to the neon tube d'arsenval machine which shows immediate results.

StriVectinLABS Facial Toner is a bit pricey for $200 plus tax via Amazon Prime. I've been using for around two weeks and have not seen any visible facial improvements. There are facial exercises one can do to keep your face and neck toned as you age. I would call this a fountain of youth item. The vibration is a relaxing feeling. It only comes with 6 pads. You can use the pads longer than they say. Make sure your face is clean before using. As long as pads stay sticky and you the feel the same current. StriVectinLABS Facial Toner Gel Pads cost 20 bucks for 6 via Amazon Prime Shipping. If I notice any truly noticeable changes, I will update. I still believe the cost is overpriced.

If you've got the money, this is worth a try, but don't expect miracles. In the world of beauty products price seems to go up faster than quality. The difference between the $20 brand and the $100 brand can be subtle. All that said, this is a high quality product. It absorbs well and doesn't leave an oil slick on your face. The scent is nothing to write home about, but it's subtle and dissipates fairly rapidly. Although I like the way my skin feels after using this, I can't say I see any noticeable difference. Your experience might be different.

All in all, worth trying if the price doesn't give you a heart attack.
summary: If you've got the bucks, try your luck

reviewText: I have used this 2 nights in a row so far, and noticed a difference after the first use.  The arctic winter air is causing my skin to dry, and this is really helping rehydrate it.  I also notice a reduction in the size of my pores.  My only complaint is that it is easy to get too much dispensed, which leaves your skin oily.  All in all a good product though.

I don't usually use face oils, but I love L'Occitane products and the Immortalle line, so I was anxious to try this. The fragrance is the only thing I do NOT like about the product: it's just a bit too intense even for my standards, and I am usually not bothered by fragrances. The scent is different from the other Immortalle products and is overly flowery. As for the actual product itself, it works great and I noticed an immediate softening/smoothness of the skin.
summary: Great product with too strong of a scent

reviewText:
Without a doubt, L'Occitane provides a luxury experience.  Whether it's the luxury experience that you want, is another matter.

The packaging is of course stunning.  It's a fairly low cost investment and definitely gives the end-user the feeling that they got their money's worth, so it's hardly a surprise that the box is elegantly designed and good quality, as is the bottle.  The bulb of the bottle is a smoked glass that feels quite solid in the hand and has an amber tone that reminded me of the bottles you might see on a 1930's dressing table.  Definitely running to the "classic" rather than the "contemporary."  The lid is very nicely constructed in brushed aluminum (or coated with metallic finish, possibly) and has a glass dropper with a push-button mechanism so that you can dip out a few drops at a time.  This works very nicely and I have no complaints, as I'd never want more than half a dropper-full at the most, and by the time that the bottle gets down past where the dropper will reach, I can just tip the remainder out into my hand.

The oil itself, according to the label, is sunflower-based, and contains a large number of florally-derived oils.  I'm not sure of the proportions; generally companies use the cheapest oil in 95% of the product and add in drops of the others (e.g. "argan oil" products that are mostly olive oil or mineral oil), but given the price and the pedigree I would not be surprised if more of the expensive oils made it into this product.

The smell is extremely strong.  It's a deep, rich floral and it lingers.  This could be a good thing, or not, depending on your preferences regarding a face smelling like an expensive bouquet.  My husband hated it.  I noticed the smell myself even after about an hour, which is unusual - I generally acclimate to a smell after 20 minutes or so.  However, I didn't hate the smell, and it actually grew on me after a bit.  Used it again and enjoyed the smell.

That being said, I personally would have preferred a lighter scent.  Or, possibly, a more singular scent like "rose" or "lilac" rather than the tremendous melange presented here.

In terms of moisturizing, it absolutely works.  A light oil is fantastic on the skin, this has been widely recognized since ancient Greece.  The trick is not to use too much, and to avoid areas that are broken out or rashy.  The oil actually sweeps away dirt and conditions the skin beautifully.

A note of caution - many people have plant allergies, and if you are unlucky enough to react to one of these essential oils, all the benefits in the world aren't going to compensate for the rash.  Secondly, there's no medical/health reason why flower oils are "better" than something hypoallergenic like mineral oil.  They're just more luxurious and they smell pleasant/overpowering depending on your perspective.
summary: Gorgeous packaging, smooth application, overpowering floral scent

reviewText:
Women of a certain age don't get the whole oil thing going on in Beautyville. Anyone over 40, even 35, was brought up to want to get rid of the excess oil on our faces that zitted us up. With some women - not all - the oil reservoirs start to dry up as we age. You'd think a good moisturizer would take care of that, but not always, which is why so many of us are always on the prowl for the next good product that works.

I bumped into L'occitane's Youth Oil in one of their stores, and the first thing I fell in love with is the smell. To me, it has this lemony herbal scent that is totally addictive. If you are scent-sensitive, AVOID this! (I adore scents of all kinds and the heavier, the better, so take that into consideration when judging whether my experience would be right for you.)

I use a wide variety of products, many of which are anti aging. The ones I use at night would conflict with this, so I use it in the morning. Understand, though, how an oil is to be used. After I wash my face, I put this on - just a few drops and pat it in. Then I go make coffee, get my clothes ready for work, etc. I come back, put on my moisturizer, then go drink coffee and have breakfast. Then when everything's all absorbed, I go to town on my makeup.

That's the secret: put this on a clean face, pat it in and let it get absorbed (takes a few minutes), THEN put on your moisturizer. This is not a substitute for a moisturizer! It's very lightweight, and generally speaking, you layer on face preparations in the order of how heavy they are (this goes before the moisturizer.)

I've been using it for over a month, and I love how it makes my skin look so much nicer, glowy and healthy. I love the bottle and the eyedropper, too. I mention that because it looks lovely on my dressing table, and that may be one more reason to add to the list of reasons for buying it. It is a very good oil, but IMHO, it's way overpriced.

I can see this in the $70 range, but topping $100? Noooooo! So why do I recommend it? Well, I really am that much in love with how it smells and how it makes my skin look. But the truth is that I probably could find something in the new range of skin oils that would do a similar job or a better one, and probably at a better price point.

But as I said, I love the way it smells. It'll be a good long while before i have to confront whether to replace it, because while this is pricey, it really does last forever.

So take my opinion for what it's worth. If you find anything better in the oil section, please let me know! I'm always on the lookout for something wonderful that will make my skin even better. (You may want to keep an eye on my reviews. I try just about everything, and I've reviewed a few things for women over 40 that worked for me.)
summary: If you don't know how to use this, try layering!

reviewText: This silky oil has become an invaluable part of my winter skin care routine completely eliminating my dry, flaky skin and reducing my fine lines.  Love how it plumps without making my sensitive skin break out.  Three small drops at night plus my normal moisturizer and I wake up with glowing, refreshed skin!  I tried to only use the oil, but found it wasn't moisturizing enough - at least during the winter.  The packaging is very luxe with a glass bottle and a push-pump cap/dropper that easily dispenses one drop at a time so you don't waste any product.  As I only need a few small drops a night, this bottle is going to last a long time.

First, the good: This product is non-irritating and is pleasant to apply. It has a pleasant smell, and I love the way a small dab smooths out the bleary-eyed, just-got-out-of-bed-crinkle between my brows. However, aside from spot treating between my eyes, I can't quite figure out a practical use for this elixir. It's too oily to wear all over, under my make-up. Because I have oily skin to begin with, even a drop or two of this product causes my make-up to slide off into oblivion, within an hour of application. And I can't use it before bed. It's so oily that it ruins my pillowcase (side sleeper, can't help it.) And even if I could iron that problem out, I still wouldn't wear it all over. Unfortunately, for me, it tends to promote breakouts (adult acne...wrinkles AND blemishes...what a curse!). Sigh. I was hoping this would be just the thing for my skin, but it's not. If you have oily or combination skin, stay away. This is a great product for clear, dry complexions.

I have recently tried a different oil moisturizing product which did not do well for me, so my thoughts were that the L'Occitane Divine Youth Oil would be another such product. Turns out I was completely wrong. The Youth Oil has a beautiful scent when you put it on and fades away over hours.

I followed the directions and put it on in the evening and after only one day, I could feel that my face felt softer to the touch. After a week, it feels really soft. I use only a drop or two an evening and at that rate, this bottle will last a long time. I thought it was rather expensive but when the price is broken out over at least three months (which is what I am currently estimating for my use), it won't be any more expensive than some of the moisturizing products that I already use from Clinique.

The bottle is lovely to look at and the dropper is easy to use. Just a drop or two into your hand and work into into your face using both hands - that's as simple as it can get. It only takes a minute or two to apply. I then rub the remaining oil into the backs of my hands - which are now feeling softer, too. I figure why waste even a tad of a drop?

This is a product that I will continue to use in the future and I recommend it to anyone with dry skin to help keep your skin as moist as possible.
summary: Lovely scent and makes my face will soft and smooth

reviewText:
Over the last month, I have used this lovely oil to try and "plump" and moisturize my getting-a little-older-type skin.
I have found that the Divine Youth Oil does indeed moisturize, smooth and soften my skin without causing any skin irritation.

The oil does not leave any sticky or any irritating residue to make your skin feel like it has a layer on top of it like other brands.  It really soaks in well and is a nice blend of oils, one of the best I have tried.
I have been putting it on the top side of my hands as well as the neck and face and it is wonderful.  After about two hours my skin is so soft that I find myself feeling it. I am amazed that the oil moisturizes without giving me any rash or pimples.  Many cheaper products will irritate my skin.  My skin looks smoother and more refreshed than without it.

There are a few things that have made me give it four stars instead of five:
It has a light scent of almost a Rose which makes me smell like I am wearing a light perfume. I have stopped putting it on in the morning because it doesn't blend well with my perfume.  The packaging claims that the skin will "appear plump and velvety, bursting with vitality" and it has a list of 5 claims that are based on only 32 women who used this for 1 month.  I think it goes a little overboard.  I really like it but it is not a miracle oil even though it is priced almost as one.  This is a large jar at 1 oz. and I do believe this will last quite a long while, even used everyday.

This made my skin feel amazing, though I do have some mixed feelings about it, mostly due to my already oily skin. In the past, I never would have considered putting additional oil on my face, but I heard such great things about this Divine Youth Oil that I decided to try it. It made my skin feel incredible! So silky and smooth. It really just automatically sinks into your skin and feels fabulous. I feel like it gave my skin a little extra glow during the day (I put it on at night) and while it definitely added a little shine, too, it was a glow-y shine that I didn't mind. While some are saying the scent is way too strong, I actually thought it was lovely and I'm usually pretty sensitive to strong smells.

After using it for about a week and a half, I did start to break out more than I usually do. However, I am pretty prone to breakouts, so I can't be certain it was due to the oil. I stopped using it for a couple weeks and my skin is pretty clear now- I'll likely jump back into using it, but will avoid my breakout prone areas. I will definitely report back after using for another extended time period!

I had the opportunity to try this product, and I was reluctant at first.  My skin has always tended towards oil--even now that I'm in my mid-40s, my face is often shiny by the end of the day, and I still experience occasional breakouts.  Given this, I rarely use any products with "oil" in the the name.  However, I thoroughly researched L'Occitane Divine Youth Oil, and I was amazed by the glowing reviews, including from those with oily and acne-prone skin.  I could find NO negative reviews of this product, which convinced me to give it a try.

I started using the Divine Youth Oil right after Christmas.  Upon application, it DOES have slight oily feel to it, but somehow, it vanished into my skin without leaving ANY greasy residue.  (Normally, I don't believe when products claim not to leave a greasy residue, as they always seem to, but this really didn't.)  When I used this product at night, I did find that some areas of my face would feel slightly oily in the morning.  For this reason, I limited my use of the Divine Youth Oil to only at night and stuck with lighter products for during the day.  The product has a fairly strong scent to it; I would describe it as akin to rosewater.  It didn't bother me, but some may find it irritating.

So, what about results?  I used this product daily for about a month.  I do think it left my face feeling nicely soft and supple after each use.  However, I don't believe that I saw any VISIBLE results.  If you look at my attached photos--the first taken just prior to when I started using the product, and the second two taken today--I don't think any changes are noticeable.  I was hoping to see a bit more, particularly around the eyes and mouth, where I concentrated my use of the product.  I know one month is not much time, but I think users who spend over one hundred dollars on this product are going to have fairly high expectations.

I am tempted to save this product until I am a little older (I'm 46 now), as maybe it would have a great effect on older skin.  On the positive side, it did not seem to make me break out, and I don't have anything bad to say about the Divine Youth Oil; I had just been hoping for more results.
summary: High quality product, but uncertain about results after one month of use.

reviewText:
I gave this to my partner as a Christmas gift.  She is very picky and only uses all natural beauty products (hair and skin) which are most often Organic.  What we put on our skin and hair gets absorbed into our bodies, so I totally understand why she wants only high quality natural products. She's also a health nut, like me, so she was sure to read this ingredient list to make sure everything was health-promoting and not drying or damaging to the skin.

This Divine Youth Oil has an ingredient list that is very impressive.  Although the box doesn't explain much, the L'Occitane website goes into great depth to describe the health promoting qualities and historical significance of their ingredients.  I highly recommend that you read it.  Nearly all of these ingredients are organic or wild harvested.  This means that no pesticides, fertilizers or other potentially harmful chemicals were used, and that the ingredients retain the biochemicals that nature has put into these items to give them their healing properties.  Often farm-raised plants lose the strength of their healing properties because of the sterile conditions and chemical additives in the soil.  There are reasons why these plants naturally grow in specific locations - so that the soil and environment nurture them optimally.

This Divine Youth Oil is primarily made from seed oils for their healthy fatty acids and protective qualities that hydrate the skin, feed the skin cells, and form a layer of oil to protect the cells from damage, and flower oils for their antioxidants, enzymes, and skin toning qualities.  There are no forms of alcohol which are common in beauty products and unnecessarily dry the skin while they clean, and no parabens which are cancer-causing and commonly found in beauty products.  So all in all, this is a first-class, top rate skin oil.

After a few days of nighttime use, I asked her what she thought.  She said that she only needed to use a small amount of oil (2-3 drops per cheek, 1 drop under each eye, 2 drops on forehead, 1 drop on chin, 3-4 drops on neck) and that it spread very well.  She did this each night after washing her face with MyChelle Fruit Enzyme Facial Cleanser.  The oil went on smooth and even.  The oil didn't stay on the skin leaving a film or residue; it was absorb and left the skin soft to full bodied to the touch.  Each day she noticed that her skin did stay soft and had that youthful feeling and "glow" that she likes.  Being that my partner has been at this beauty game so long, I trust that she notices even the smallest changes in her face and skin.  I think she's radiant all the time.

Would she buy this on her own at the $100 per 1 fl.oz. price?  If she had the spare money always on hand - yes.

I decided to post the ingredients here because they are not on Amazon's page.  I got these from the L'Occitane website.  I do recommend checking out their website.  The information on the herbs, plants and fruits they use is very interesting and well put together.

Ingredients are Caprylic/capric Triglyceride, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Octyldodecanol, Coco-caprylate/caprate, Squalane, Borago Officinalis Seed Oil*, Helichrysum Italicum Extract, Helichrysum Italicum Flower Oil*, Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil*, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil*, Rosa Moschata Seed Oil*, Myrtus Communis Oil*, Hippophae Rhamnoides Oil*, Camelina Sativa Seed Oil, Pelargonium Graveolens Flower Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Oil, Echium Plantagineum Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Parfum/Fragrance, Limonene, Linalool, Geraniol, Citral, Citronellol.
(*Ingredients from Organic Farming)

I like the LOccitane Divine Youth Oil very well.  A tiny bit goes a long way and leaves behind a soft, smooth feel, not oily at all.  In all honesty, though, I didn't find it made my complexion any better than my usual Clinique Dramatically Different moisturizer, of which I would get about 14 ounces for the price of 1 ounce of the Divine Youth Oil.  They both make my skin feel soft and moisturized, but neither product seems to have any permanent effect on my skins texture or wrinkles.  If you like the LOccitane line of products, I think youll find this one a worthy addition.

I have mixed feelings about this product. At first, it felt very strange to put oil on my face (especially since I had oily skin in my younger days), but it absorbs quickly and has a nice, exotic (almost spicy) scent. My skin does feel softer after using it for several days, and I did not have any problems with breakouts. However, this product is very expensive. On the plus side, there is quite a bit of the product, and you only need a tiny amount. I think you could probably get a year's daily use from the bottle, but I'm not sure how long the oil would last before it goes rancid. (I will update my review to let you know.) If you don't mind investing the money up front for a product that will last for a long time, this may be right for you. However, there are other products that will produce similar results that are available at a drugstore or discount store (Neutrogena, L'Oreal, etc.). This product is more of a luxury item and would make a nice gift.
summary: Not sure if it's worth the cost

reviewText: This is another great product from L'Occitane. It just sinks into my skin and makes it look better. I had not been treating my skin very well recently and it was beginning to show. It truly does feel like it is just melting in. It doesn't look or feel oily at all. I thought it might be heavy, but it isn't. My skin feels very soft and silky. I used it before I put on the L'Occitane cream moisturizer, a great combination.
summary: Makes my skin look and feel better. It feels as if it's just melting in, not oily or heavy at all. Skin feels soft and silky

reviewText:
I got this for the wife and since I'm blissfully oblivious to most makeup, I had to rely on her judgement. After 3 weeks, I didn't notice anything about her skin but she said it made it look better although I couldn't see anything. So I tried it myself for a week and didn't notice anything either. A drop or two on the face didn't seem to make me look or feel any different.

A lot of the reviews had mentioned the odor - I didn't detect much of an odor nor did the wife - there's a bit of one but it dissipates rather quickly. There's no lingering feel to the fingers when I applied it, so that's an added benefit.

Then there's the price at nearly $100. Certainly I won't begrudge you if you spend the money on this, but I can't see spending the money on something that doesn't seem to improve the skin. The wife's response at finding out the price, other than shock, was to say that her normal moisturizers do the same at a lot less cost. I don't see our household ordering another one of these. But ultimately if you like it and it makes you feel good, then I'm happy for you - but for us it was average at best.
summary: Quite expensive but luxurious with questionable benefits

reviewText:
I usually avoided oil skin products because I have naturally oily skin and tend to breakout, but this winter has been unusually harsh (even in the deep south) so I decided to give it a try. Well I was pleasantly surprised at how light and silky this LOccitane Divine Oil felt. It absorbed quickly into my skin and didn't leave any oily residue. It does have a very strong, astringent scent, and while the scent does dissipate after a few minutes it doesnt go away completely. If you are sensitive to smells, this product may give you some problems.

The instructions tell you to apply this oil first, so my new routine is to wash my face and then apply the oil. I let it dry/absorb completely before I finish with my normal nighttime moisturizers and eye cream (Clinique). I also found that I have to wash my hands at least twice before applying my other creams. If the Divine Oil gets anywhere near my eyes, my eyes start to water and itch. Once a little of the Divine Oil was on my fingertip and accidentally got transferred to my eye cream. As soon as I applied the cream to my eye area I knew something was wrong. I washed my face and eye immediately, but my eye felt swollen and itchy for 30 minutes after that. So be very, very careful with this Oil around your eyes.

Ive been using the Divine Oil for about a week now, and I do think it is making my skin softer (much softer than the Clinique moisturizer), but I haven't noticed any plumping of my skin or any radiance. But I will finish the whole bottle before I decide if the results are worth the price.
summary: Does make my skin softer but haven't noticed any plumping or radiance

reviewText: Though my skin tends to be dry, I was still hestitant to slather oil all over my face. It just seems counter-instinctual. But this light, 100% natural, oil absorbed quickly and felt great! A few drops of this luxurious product goes a long way. Pairs well with the L'Occitane Immortelle Precious Serum. My skin definitely seems softer and brighter.

I was worried about how I would tolerate this, since I am not a fan of 'in your face' fragrances, and a number of reviewers had mentioned that this product had a strong fragrance.  As it turned out, though I do not love the fragrance, I don't really mind it.  And I do think that this is a good moisturizer and wrinkle-softener, one that is more effective than the Eucerin Q-10 product that I generally use.

I would knock the review down by (at least) half a star because of the fragrance and the clumsy packaging.
summary: Good moisturizer.  I'd like it better if the fragrance were milder

reviewText:
I am not a tanner of any type...sun, chemical, spray, self. I am a pale human. I am attending a wedding and was trying to see if I could avoid wearing stockings, which I hate. I am not given to time consuming personal care regimes so this was out of my norm. I followed all of the directions and although I find this process quite tedious, it did work very well. With very careful application, my legs look uniformly tan. The product smells good and was not irritating in any way.

I am unlikely to use this regularly because of the time demands but I was pleased with the outcome.
summary: Instant tan....requires deliberate and careful application. Works though!

reviewText:
I wish I liked this deep tanner more. I have used many self-tanners over the years and I was looking forward to trying this one from XEN-TAN. This is an expensive, high-end product and I was expecting an experience at least on par with similar products Ive used by Lancome, Chanel, and Clarins.

This type of tanner combines two elements into the process. The first is a brown color stain that is mixed in with the tanning lotion. The second is the chemical DHA which causes the skin to change color, or tan. The first element is temporary and washes off, the second lasts about 5-7 days and wears off gradually.

I should start off by saying that I got a very nice, dark tan with this product. The color took about 5 hours to develop, but it was a very believable, attractive bronze color. It is perhaps darker than I would normally want, but it will fade in a day or two. Other tanners require three or more applications to get this deep a color, and this required only one.

My gripe is with the brown color stain. There are several reasons manufacturers add color to their tanning products. The first is that the color makes it easier to see that the lotion has been applied evenly and that there are no missed areas. The second is that the color provides an instant tan while the DHA takes time to develop. Products with this stain take longer to dry, but they do dry in about a half an hour and once dry, they don't stain your clothing or appear uneven.

Following directions, I used the Deluxe Tanning Mitt as suggested by the manufacturer. The mitt requires rinsing and drying prior to first use. I was very careful to exfoliate while in the shower, and after drying off, I applied a very light coat of Vaseline to my heels, knees, elbows, and cuticles. I rubbed the excess Vaseline into my fingertips. I then applied the tanning lotion to the Mitt and applied it to my body using circular motions. I started at my feet and worked up.

The cream is extremely dark brown. I have a light olive complexion and it was extremely easy to see the dark cream against my skin. Using the mitt made the application much easier and I was able to work a thin and even layer of tanner over my legs arms and chest. At the end, I applied what was left on the mitt to my face. I then stood still while it dried. It took forever to dry. Forever! More than an hour during a 65 degree day. After an hour and 10 minutes I couldn't stand still any longer, I put on a loose pair of shorts and a tank top. I had to get on with my life.

My fingertips were stained brown through the mitt. The Vaseline had done little to protect them. My heels two were stained brown. I tried to remove the stains with soap and a brush but with little effect. My heels and fingertips are brown. Washing out the mitt with soap and water made a brown soapy mess in my sink. Luckily, I was using a dark towel. Dont use light fabric with this product! Dont try to apply this with bare hands! The lotion stains everything it comes in contact with.

After three hours of very little physical activity, I looked down and saw that the product still had not set in places and the inside of my elbow and knees had lines of caked color. I now know why other reviewers mention needing to shower within 4 hours after using this stuff. Using a damp washcloth I gently wiped the inside of my elbows and knees. The dye came off easily leaving an obvious lighter area. I couldn't get the dye off my fingers and heels within 15 minutes of applying the tanner, but on the inside of my elbows and knees, the dye came right off after three hours! At the four hour mark I gave up and took a fast shower. The dye was too bizarrely mottled to leave on and the DHA had been on long enough to do its work.

If I use this tanner again, I am going to wear a thin rubber glove under the mitt.

There are many, many other tanners out there that perhaps don't provide such a deep a tan, but are far easier to apply and dry in less than 15 minutes.
summary: Very Deep Tan But Stain Unpleasant

reviewText:
Xen-Tan's products continue to amaze me. This tan lotion really does work - I used it on my legs, and that's probably the darkest they've been in my life (artificially or naturally)! It was easy to apply, and the color change was relatively quick. This would be good for someone who is more medium complected than I am, because the color - for me at least - was just too dark. And good for me, but bad for someone looking for a longevity, the tan didn't last the five days claimed. I was pretty much back to my normal uber fair skin by the third day.

Great product for a dark tan, particularly if you don't care if it lasts.
summary: Maybe a bit too dark for the very fair among us

reviewText:
The XEN-TAN products are some of the priciest on the market yet I'm not sure they deliver as promised. The Moroccan Tan Ultra is supposed to be one of their longest lasting self tanners yet my experience was disappointing.
Each XEN-TAN product is quite time consuming to use, both in the application and the drying time of the tanner. I probably wouldn't mind so much if the color truly lasted a long as the manufacturer claims but that has not been the case.
The color itself is one of the best in the XEN-TAN line but despite following directions carefully, it wore off in less than 48 hours.
When you factor in price, inconvenient application and less than expected color longevity, this is not for everyone.

Maybe because I have been experimenting with these Xen products for some time, but this one did not leave me looking nearly as orange-y as some others. Moreover, the scent is rarely appealing (seriously, when does that happen with tanners?) Now, I used the application mitten and got a really nice, clean, overall look. I think the mitten is well worth investing in. With Xen, it is pretty easy to build-up color ... and if you go a little to dark (or too "weird"), it wears down/off pretty quickly.

Yes, these are a little pricey, but the results are fairly nice. Give it a try!
summary: Not as Orange-y as Other Products!

reviewText:
XEN-TAN Moroccan Tan Ultra actually does an excellent job of simulating a natural sun tan. It mimics my natural sun tanned skin color very closely, great for extending my tan through the winter months. The color lasts a few days before it starts fading significantly, though it doesn't streak or leave any splotchy patches like some products do. Application is very easy and foolproof if you follow the provided instructions.

One thing to note is that I have mildly sensitive skin and I tend to get a little itchy from the drying effect of most of these sunless tanning products. This one hasn't caused any noticeable itching or irritation, but as with most things, your mileage may vary.

This stuff works really good, but you have to be really careful with it.

Start with the least amount of cream to cover the area you're applying it to and make sure that it is applied and rubbed in EVENLY and when it comes to ankles, feet, ,knees, do not apply there, but make sure to blend it down good or else you will see a definite line where the tan stops. Make sure you were a mit of some sort because this stuff stains your hands immediately and does not wash off even after heavy duty hand washing and several loads of dishes etc.  You will have brown or orange palms for the full 5 days. It does give a very natural look but you have to be super precise with it and make sure you do the tops of your hands - take a mit off and rub the lotion on that hand with your other hand that still has the mit on and then do the same for the other hand. Otherwise you will have a definite line at your wrist. It does last at least 5 days even just one application and as it wears off it is not blotchy or patchy at all - it is excellent in that regard.  It is a great product overall, but you just have to be super careful with it and precise.
This gives you a healthy looking tan all year long.  It does wash off easily.  It has a bit of a scent which isn't too strong.  It works, that's the main point.

I used different darknesses of the XenTan products when I tried them.  I pretty much knew by time I tried the second one though, that there was no way I was going to be able to stand somewhere for 4 hours.  Thats just not working.  It was probably for the best because the light tan that I ended up with was much more reasonable anyway.

This product went on really smoothly  using the mitt.  You really need the mitt to get it to go on correctly.

I had no orange issues.  That was amazing.

Reading the experiences of other reviewers on Amazon is almost always helpful. So when I applied this product, I used a mitt and rubbed it in well. I also applied very little cream at a time, so I got a thin, smooth layer that did not sit on top of my skin. The tint in the self-tanner was helpful for getting an even application. I applied so little that it was dry in fifteen minutes  You also need to know that I have naturally dry skin that just drinks up creams and lotions. I also do a weekly glycolic acid peel in hopes of removing skin discolorations and stimulating collagen, so this tanner doesn't ever go onto unprepared skin. My results were great. The process did not take a long time (again, that dry, thirsty skin). There was no streaking AT ALL, which is new to me. And I love the scent. I have not been able to tolerate the smell of other self-tanners except Xen-Tan products. The tanning chemical, dihydroxyacetone, which is in every self-tanner I've ever used, has always produced an overwhelmingly nauseating smell on my skin, but not Xen-Tan products, even though they also contain it. On my blue-white skin, this Moroccan Tan Ultra produced a wonderful tan color .
