It seemed to me that the color was just a bit warmer and richer than the tan I got from a different Xen-Tan product (the Dark Lotion Absolute Luxe) a few weeks ago. So I later applied them side by side on a hidden part of my body and found this is true. I prefer the Moroccan Tan Ultra color but that may be because I have no natural warmth to my skin tone without a tan -- and I never allow my skin to tan in the sun any more. I consistently use sunscreen every day because I'm outdoors for hours every day. If you already have a warm skin color, you may prefer the Dark Lotion Absolute Luxe, but in either case it's interesting that Xen-Tan has developed the technology to create different tones, neither of which run toward the orange of older faux tanners. I highly recommend this product but for myself will use it sparingly given the expense. The 8 ounce tube goes a long way and it needs to at this price!
summary: Best self-tanner I have ever used on my dry, white skin

reviewText: This is a great self-tanner. I was a bit scared to use it because I got it not realizing it was a darker tanning product, and I have VERY fair skin. Self-tanners for me are often a complete disaster, but it's a running joke around here that I will turn myself orange just to try to find the good and the bad ones. I've tried a LOT of them and this is definitely one of the best brands yet overall, and this product in particular is excellent. It smells a bit of vanilla, but it is not as strongly scented as their 'mousse' product. This one is a gel, and it is a dark brown out of the tube. They recommend that you use their self tanning mit, and I do too, it really is nice and gives good, even coverage. This does color the skin right as it goes on. It looks a bit greenish at first on me, but as I smoothed it on out, it began to turn into a darker tan color. After a few hours, I can tell that I am definitely getting the same sort of tan that I could see on application. No spots, no streaks, and NO orange. The bronze tan lasts (for me) about a week. When it fades, it fades evenly. On my nearly white skin this even looked very natural, though it gave me a tan that is about as dark as I can get in a tanning bed with several sessions. I do recommend getting the XEN-TAN Deluxe Tanning Mitt to go with it though. I used one and think it added to my results. Also, with the use of the glove and subsequent handwashing my palm didn't turn colors, it continued to look normal. Downside- Watch what you wear when using this. Be careful of where you sit, that you use a dark towel, and wear only dark clothing. If you put it on before bed, consider putting it on 3 hours before bedtime then showering, so you don't stain your bedclothes.
summary: Very natural, tan, without any orange, no streaks, no spotting, LOVE this self-tanner

reviewText: Best tanning product ever!  So non messy, the applicator smooths across your skin.  I used latex gloves under the mitt applicator just to be safe, but no need really it washes off easily.  No built up areas on heels or between toes.  I accidentally had to leave on for way over 3 hours but was not a problem.  Beautiful golden, non orange or red tan.  Completely natural looking and smooth, nothing uneven or streaky AT ALL. I cant wait to do the rest of my face and body.  I had to wait because I just had surgery on my wrist for a very atypical mole that could've become melanoma that had to be removed surgically.  Forever I will need to get checked every 6 months by a dermatologist.  My days in the hot sun are over this was a big scare.  Put your sun screen on everyday and stay out of the sun without protection while sun is over head!!

My daughter likes to change colors. Usually it's her hair but sometimes she likes to change her skin color from its normal Northern European ghostly hue. She says this went on easily and did not streak and it smells nice (it does - I checked). She was happy with the results and the dark color did not look orange. She goes to cosplay conventions and I guess mixing up the colors is perfect for that venue.
summary: Does produce a realistic temporary dark tan

reviewText:
This works o.k. for a fake tan, and does look like you've gotten some time in the sun, but it's a lot of work and time to apply. Mine came with a mitt for review purposes, but I understand that a mitt is not included when you buy the Xen-Tan. However, it wasn't all that easy to use and I think just using a plastic glove and a soft washcloth will do just as well.

I applied this thoroughly over my freshly showered bod using small circular motions as instructed in the directions. That took a while and I was working up a sweat just doing that, which caused me to have to re-apply in some spots. I couldn't do my back but I was able to smear enough on it so it was actually a good indicator of how much Xen-Tan stayed on after showering later on. I noticed I did look noticeably darker after applying the Xen-Tan. I wore loose clothing for the rest of the day and actually did not shower again until the next morning so I certainly left it on for the minimum 3 hours before showering.

When I got into the shower I saw the water run dark-ish down the drain and it had to be the Xen-Tan. I checked my back in the mirror and saw where some of the Xen-Tan had not washed off, but it was a lot lighter than when I initially applied it. I'm not really sure I'd want to spend $65.00 to work that hard, and not get much to show for it. I want to mention, that yesterday when I first applied the Xen-Tan, it felt sticky and I felt sticky for about an hour until it began to dry. Also, when I washed my hands any water that dribbled down my arms erased the Xen-Tan and I had to re-apply it. It doesn't tell you that water will erase the tan shortly after applying.  And be real careful with it on your feet because it will look like you just walked through red clay mud if you don't smear it around well.

XEN-TAN Moroccan Tan Ultra is better than its other self tanning lotion. The tan is actually not orange and worked pretty well. I was skeptical, but it was not bad. I used the mitt so my palms wouldn't stain (I highly recommend it), and it was pretty good. The color lasted for about a week, but took a little time to develop. It certainly does its job, and I like that it doesn't stay on for that long. I know that if I want to get a little more "glow" but can't get it the natural way, I can use XEN-TAN to get the job done.
summary: Good self-tanning lotion that last for about a week

reviewText:
This product has me baffled.  It's description reads great, so I really wanted to try it.  I sometimes do the spray on tan at the tanning salons and it can get fairly pricey if you do it regularly.  Therefore, if this product works as well as the spray on tans - it is definitely the way to go for the cost. This product came with the applicator buffing pad just for the vine reviewers.  Normally, that item is sold separately.  Although, if you do buy this product, I would strongly recommend purchasing the applicator as well.  I decided to just do my legs in case the product didn't look as good as advertised or turned out to be orange like some of the tanning products.  The applicator worked flawlessly for an even look and went on smoothly.  The tan looked really dark and great immediately. It didn't look orange at all.  I waited until I was sure the product was dry before putting clothes on as I didn't want the coloring on my clothes.  I waited at least 4 hrs until I showered  - longer than the directions state.

Now here is the tricky and disappointing part.  Most of the coloring washed right off in the shower.  Yep, just in a matter of minutes, I washed my tan away.  Maybe it takes longer with some skin types for it to develop and/or to absorb properly?  I am unsure.  I will try it again when I can work out a longer window before showering just to see if that corrects the issue.  Other than the tan washed off, it looked very natural while it was on.  I know some complained of the scent - I think the scent is just a preference.  Personally, I had no issue with the smell and it smelled better and not as strong as some of the sunburn prevention products and really no stronger and better than some of the spray on tans at the salons.  Marilyn
summary: Looked Dark and Very Natural, but Washed Right Off!

reviewText:
The application procedure for this lotion is like the other XEN-TAN lotion I have tried.  I can't imagine using this stuff without the enclosed mitt, which keeps the hand from turning a dark brown while applying this lotion to the skin.  A wet mitt helps spread the lotion more evenly and avoids any streaks.  It dries fast but the aroma lingers. The dark brown lotion quickly absorbs into the skin, but it's  not for a few hours before one sees the drastic color change.  Really be careful around the face and legs as that is where uneven streaks can show up if not applied properly.

The lotion smells like sweet Hawaiian suntan lotion.  After four days my "tan" had faded.
summary: Noticeable results in a few hours

reviewText:
This is very nice, effective self tanning gel.  It goes on easily and evenly and gives an instant color that gradually darkens over the course of a few hours.  One of my favorite qualities is the lack of the "odor" that many self tanners have as they work.  This has a nice scent that I would describe as a mild coconut, which I found pleasant while not being very noticeable or overpowering.

I find this "Moroccan Tan" to be just a little dark for me.  Even though I applied it quite sparingly, I feel it looks too dark, too brown, to be realistic on me.  I have a medium to light complexion and don't think I've ever looked like this with a natural tan, even before sunscreens were recommended.  I suggest trying the lighter XEN-TAN product initially for those with similar natural coloring, unless you really want to look like you're using fake tanner.  It IS NOT orangey, just too brown for me.

I used thin gloves to apply this and had no problems either with application or stained hands.  I suggest to go easy with it on your first application as it blends more easily, it dries faster, and you can always add more.  It just doesn't take that much to achieve a decent color.

I showered after about three hours and it's worn well.  It's lasted me most of a week with daily showers and hasn't looked blotchy or uneven.  I probably shouldn't subtract a star for the color as it is mostly personal need and preference.  I'd say four and a half stars just because of that, not the product quality.

Be sure to exfoliate well before using and the mitt is very helpful if you get it.  It's pricey but cheaper than a salon spray tan and should last at least a few applications.
summary: Great Product!  Personally a Bit Dark for Me

reviewText: My wife tried a similar product so I decided to try this one for myself. It gave a decent shade considering my skin is a little more dark complected than most. It was a little messy and was  somewhat difficult to evenly spread out on my body but the finished product looked great. I hope it stays this shade for a long time. I don't like sitting in the sun for a long time so this did the trick and several of my friends commented on it to me so I am happy.

I am a fair skinned older gal who lived in the sun in the 70's and 80's and don't dare get in it now so I wanted to try this.  I have tried other XEN-TAN products and I like this one the best because it seems more of a natural color to me.  The glove applicator is a necessity, especially if you are not familiar with using tanning products.  But, it's still a lot of work to use and to get it right.  It helped me to have someone with me to help with the backs of my legs and arms so it would be as even as possible. The end result reminded me of how I looked back in the day and yes, it does fade subtly and it looks nice while doing so.  But, to keep doing it - for me, no.  But, for someone who is out and about a lot and wears shorts and sleeveless tops most of the time, I'd say give this a try.
summary: natural looking color and not orange-y

reviewText: My wife likes self-tanning lotions, so she was excited to try the Moroccan Tan Ultra.  Although it did give her a dark looking tan, she didn't care for the way it worked or looked on her legs.  In her own words, "It works, but the consistency is very different to the lotions I've used in the past.  Since I had to use a mitten to spread it on, I found it difficult to spread it evenly.  Therefore, I ended up getting some tan-less splotches on my legs."  I asked if she could touch up the areas that were tan-less, but she was afraid she'd end-up with dark rings around those areas due to the layering of the new application.  I agreed with her and cannot recommend this product with confidence.

This is the strangest tanner Ive ever used. Its really nice in the color and scent but it is very high maintenance in application. The texture is more like a gel and its dark brown right out of the bottle. It kind of reminds of Hersheys chocolate syrup coming out. Its very scary to put something that dark on my fair skin. You definitely get some instant color when you apply it. It is nice to see where you're applying the tanner and to get some instant color but it was really hard to get it even. I had to go back over it with a tanning mitt to really buff it in.

You don't get that awful self tanning scent. The scent is actually really nice.

The color doesnt look as dark as it does right out of the bottle. It blends into a natural looking tan. The nice thing is that the color isn't orange, it has a more of cool tone dark brown shade than orange which is definitely more natural looking.
summary: Nice Toned Shade But Hard to Apply, Nice Scent

reviewText: I haven't used eyeliner in awhile just out of pure laziness, but when I saw this I figured it's time to revisit. Jillian Dempsey is known as being a really great makeup artist, so I was curious what she could do creating her own line. I loved that one end was eyeliner and the other was a smudger. I got the rich brown and it worked perfectly for me. It is indeed a "rich" brown - warm and chocolatey. It was easy to smudge and manipulate which I appreciated. No tugging and smooth application. I'd try this in black as well. Really nice eyeliner.

The first Jillian Dempsey pencil I received through the Amazon Vine program in 2014 lasted about two years.  It's the best khol product I have ever used.  It stays on all day, applies easily and gives the perfect smudged look.  I don't like sharp defined lines--instead, this is subtle and soft.  Best yet, it actually sharpens well.  I can't count the times I've whittled away pencils trying to achieve a point or finally getting one only to have it fall off.

Looking for the perfect khol liner?  This is it.  Even though Amazon says my review is not a verified purchase, it is--I initially received one for free but liked it so much after two years that I bought another.
summary: Sharpens Well, Looks Good And The Pencil Lasts A Long Time

reviewText:
I don't usually wear eye make-up but I really liked this product. I can just smudge it on and voila - eyes are done! I agree with the reviewers who said it makes a difference to use quality eye products. Like many people, I've used the low-end drugstore products, figuring it wouldn't matter. But it IS different.

Easy to apply and use. The color worked for me as well.

I received a brown eyeliner to review, not black, so I am not able to tell you how the black looks. The brown is a medium brown, not dark enough for me to use as eyeliner, but it is easy to apply and the sponge tip helps to spread it. It's a soft consistency, good for the classic kohl look -- that is, a soft, smudged line, not a sharply drawn line. It's an okay product if this is the look you want. I did also try it on my eyebrows, but it is too soft for that.

This liner gives a great, smudgy line. The attached smudging tool is not spongy as most are, but it's highly effective. The liner goes on dry and feels light. It's not designed to give a very precise line or to create the exaggerated cats-eye look, but for a more natural smokey eye.
summary: This liner gives a great, smudgy line

reviewText:
I admit that I'm a little stuck in a rut when it comes to my makeup.  I like to enhance my natural look without looking overly made up and never have had success with an acceptable "smokey" look.  That said, I do enjoy trying new products and was anxious to use this eyeliner.  I received the Rich Brown, rather than the claimed Jet Black one.

I normally use a dark brown eyeliner but thought this might be a little softer and natural appearing.  It does have a little more reddish tone to it than I really like.  The color painted on the wood pencil in the picture looks true to me.  Of course this can depend on your screen adjustment but it is a "warm" medium brown and not a dark brown.  It went on pretty smoothly and was a fine line when I first tried it.  As I've used it, the tip has naturally dulled and the line is thicker.  It's lasted well for the weeks that I've been using it so that I see as a good thing, considering the price.

It stays well and removes easily with coconut oil, my preferred makeup remover.  Soap and water have not taken it off completely in the shower.  On days when I've been outside in the wind and cold, it's faded a bit from tears but has remained until I removed it at night.

I've had no reaction since using it and like that it's plant based and not tested on animals.  It's a bit pricy but performs well.

Recommend!

With three women, teens and adult, in the house we go through make-up quickly. And it disappears, if you know what I mean. So I was excited to try this one.

This is a nice pencil. One side has the liner and the other side has a smudger for giving your eyes a smokey look. Use was easy as the eyeliner went on smoothly. Using the smudger was also easy once you figure out how to use it correctly. Here's a hint: not to much!

Since we care about trying to be organic and all natural about stuff we put in us and on us in our family I also like that several ingredients are organic and I didn't see the heavy chemicals I see in normal off the shelf stuff. A plus.

For my finally, we will be looking at this brand going forward.

As far as pencil liners go, the Jillian Dempsey Eyeliner is not bad. I think I've just determined I'm more of a liquid liner girl as pencil doesn't show up on me as well. I don't like a crazy dark, thick line, but I want it to be pronounced- my current favorite is Stila's Stay All Day Waterproof Liquid Eyeliner. This pencil definitely goes on a lot better than a lot of drugstore pencils I've found (it's also pricier), but it's still a little muted and more smudgy than I like. My eyelids are probably a bit oilier than most, but I found this pretty difficult to get on the top of my lid. I have been wearing it for when I want less of a dramatic look and I have to say that it definitely comes off my eyes a lot easier in the evening than my favorite liquid liner!
summary: Not Bad for a Pencil Eyeliner

reviewText:
I was offered this product free of charge in exchange for my honest review. The liner I am reviewing is the RICH BROWN.
The liner goes on very smooth, more like a soft, pen liner, than 1 pencil liner. It was creamy, yet still gave a nice, even line. With the added extra of a built in smudge tip on the opposite end, I was able to get a smoky look when I wanted to , or just blend it in for the right amount of color. I found it to only smear a tiny bit, but the smudge tip was able to even that out. It lasted all day at work without getting messy and removal was easy with oil free eye makeup remover. As for the color itself, it is a very dark brown shade, which is nice even with black mascara. Very good liner. I would use again,

This is an eyeliner that requires sharpening and like other eyeliners I've tried that need to be sharpened, I found that it does not go on as smoothly as gel liners.  Even in comparison to other pencils, it skips more and leaves messy gaps.  Also, the line it creates is very thin, so the smudger at the other end is definitely needed if you prefer a thicker line as I do. It is a good, dark black color that lasted for a few hours, but the application process was too lacking for me to choose Jillian Dempsey over other pencils like Clinique.
summary: there are better pencils out there

reviewText:
I usually use just plain pencil eyeliner because I don't want the line to get out of control, and then cover on top with a liquid pencil if it needs to last for a while.

I was worried that the Khol liner might smudge too much and make me look like a raccoon. However, I was pleasantly surprised that it glided on smoothly and stayed in place. It took a lot less pressure than a regular pencil liner. With a pencil sharpener, I can keep it to a nice thin line. The sharpener is not included, but it does come with a smudge tool on the other end.

And, as always, I like to keep the products that I use around my eyes natural - I wear contact lenses, so I don't want anything to irritate my eye.

My girlfriend is always excited to try new cosmetics. I gave her the Jillian Dempsey Natural Khol Eyeliner - Rich Brown, to try because I thought she might like it. This review is her experience with the product.

I had high hopes for the Jillian Dempsey Waterproof Kohl Eyeliner because it has three great features:

1. Waterproof
2. Not tested on animals
3. Plant-derived oil and wax based ingredients. No synthetic chemicals or preservatives.

The eyeliner color states rich brown, it's more of a reddish brown when applied. I prefer a neutral brown, not too cool or warm. I have blue eyes, brown hair and fair cool toned skin with pink under tones. The rich brown is too red, harsh and dark even with smudging it to soften the look.

The eyeliner is creamy upon application, however it seems to skip a bit. I will note that I don't have oily lids/skin and it's fall so the weather is cool.

I first applied the eyeliner to my upper lids and water line without my contacts in.  I didn't use the smudger tip to gauge the longevity of the eyeliner.

I checked the mirror 30 minutes later and the eyeliner had smeared and melted. I looked like a hot mess. I was glad to be home and not in public.

The smudge tip is a sponge and wipes the color off your eyes, it defeats the purpose. I use Rimmel Scandaleyes Khol waterproof eyeliner, which I love - no problems with raccoon eyes and it's inexpensive.

I really wanted to like this eyeliner but I can't recommend it because it doesn't live up to it's claim and is expensive.

** NOT RECOMMENDED! - 2 STARS **

This is definitely a quality eyeliner. So many eyeliners tug and pull at the eyelid, and are a struggle to use. This one glides on easily and smoothly with barely a touch. The color is vibrant, yet natural enough. The blending wand at the opposite end does a good job of controlled smearing for a smokier look. This eyeliner lasts all day, which is much longer than most pencils. This is a winner and well worth the cost!

I hadn't used eye liner in a long time, so I thought I'd give this Jillian Dempsey one a try. And I really like it! It goes on smoothly and has a sponge tip on one end, making it easy to get the smudged, smokey look. Great product!
summary: And I really like it! It goes on smoothly and has a ...

reviewText:
This liner goes on smooth and easily; for the smudged look, the little sponge end does a good job; has pretty good staying power; comes off fairly well with baby wipes and even better with baby oil; I think this liner pencil is a bit over priced. If I would've been shopping for an eye liner pencil, I would have passed right by this expensive one.
If price isn't an issue, this is a good eye liner pencil.
summary: Expensive liner pencil, but does the job.

reviewText: I really like this eyeliner.  I usually buy really dark brown eyeliner and this one is not as dark as I usually use but the shade is still dark enough for me.  The liner goes on smoothly and is creamy enough to go on easily, yet does not smear under your eyes.  The sponge tip is great too.  The only reason I am giving it four stars instead of five is that it needs a sharpener and isn't a twist up eyeliner.  I highly recommended this!

This eyeliner goes on smoothly and the blending end works very well to smooth out the lines.  I am pleasantly surprised how long wearing this liner is.  I applied this early in the day and later that evening checked myself before heading off to a football game and the lines were still just as bold and not smudged or running.
The blending tip works well, however it pulls a bit on the delicate under eye area which make me hesitant to use it, unless absolutely necessary to correct any mess-ups.

You can't beat the ingredients in this formula...it's oh so natural and has nothing remotely toxic in it. However, that plus seems to always come with a price. I have yet to find a natural formula that stays on all day. That said, my eyelids tend to get a little oily, so if you have drier skin on your eyelids, this eyeliner may have better staying power for you.

It glides on nicely and gives you a nice controlled line--from super skinny to thicker, and it smudges well too. The black is nicely pigmented and a good neutral black. However, I found that I had to reapply within a few hours. So I'm definitely going to have to use primer underneath this one, which I prefer not to do (the fewer the products for me, the better). But it's great to know this eyeliner is gentle and even good for my skin. It won't be my go-to, but it's definitely a quality natural eyeliner that's worth trying out if you care about ingredients.
summary: Great natural formula--but not exactly waterproof

reviewText: I love this eye liner! I have used the same drugstore eye liner for many years but this eye liner is my new favorite! It goes on smoothly and lasts all day. The blender is a nice touch and is nice for creating a nighttime smoky look. The jet black is a nice rich black color. I have sensitive skin but this eye liner did not bother my skin or eyes at all. It is worth the price!

My daughter is an amazing, self-taught make up artist.  Although she did spend six months at the Aveda school learning new techniques, this is a young woman who made it her business, from a very young age, to know everything about make up.  I thought I'd check out this product, and discuss her views.  First off, the box it arrived in was crushed.  With an item as pricey as this, presentation means something, although it hasn't affected this review.  While the colors were rich and deep, the color material was too malleable to create a straight line, which may be why there is a "smudger" attached (a recognition that you probably won't be able to get a straight line?).  It does not apply well over eyeshadow, but suffices for bottom eyeliner.  For this price, there are other brands that you can get at a high end make up store for a similar that can be used for multiple purposes and don't suffer from these problems.  The pencils did not arrive in time for me to use this Halloween, but next year .... Rocky Horror!
summary: My daughter is an amazing, self-taught make up artist

reviewText:
I have very sensitive skin, so I have to be careful what types of products I use, especially on my face.  This eye serum/lotion did not irritate my skin at all.  It has a nice subtle scent-it smells fresh with a touch of floral.  It comes out the consistency of a thin lotion and spreads on leaving a silky sheen and feel on the surface of the skin.  A little bit goes a long way-a pea-sized amount provided full coverage for both eye areas (under eyes, to the sides, and on the lids).

I noticed results within the first 2 days of using this.  I have dark circles with faint crows feet on the under/sides of my eyes.  I applied this first at night and when I woke up, the circles were more smooth and less dark by about a shade.  By the second day, the skin around my eyes, where the faint crows feet were, the skin looked fuller and you could barely see the lines.  The improvements continued for 3-5 days and have since plateaued at a nice place-firm skin around the eyes and very minimal circles.

I am not sure how long these results will last when I stop using this cream, but it really does work.  The reason I gave it 4/5 stars is the price-it is currently listed at $125 per 0.5 oz. container.  I do like it, however, I just can't see spending that kind of money regularly especially given this is only for the eyes, it's not designed to even be used on the the other parts of your face.

Overall, it works great, and in this case, it should b/c you may have to sell your first born child to purchase it regularly-however, this stuff will make you look so young no one would believe you've had kids anyway, so there you go ;)
summary: Works as promised, but a bit rich for my blood....

reviewText: This actually went terribly for me.  According to the ingredients list, I'm not allergic to any of the things included in the bottle, but when I put it on I immediately experienced a burning sensation.  Right after that my eyes swelled up so that it looked like I'd been punched in the face.  Itchy, painful and red!  I put a cold compress on my face and went to bed.  The next morning my lids were still super puffy and irritated, so I put some soothing cream on them and left them alone.  I'm not sure exactly what happened there, but it was a very bad experience.
summary: Not sure what went wrong, but ended up with 2 puffy eyes and massive irritation.

reviewText: I really like this eye cream. It is highly moisturizing and I just started using it and will come back to update this review in a few weeks.  A little goes a long way with this cream.  I was using Boots No. 7 eye cream which I am really happy with and is a fraction of the price.  I am hoping to see some great results from this cream and will update this review.

I wear glasses all day and then in the evening when I take them off I typically have a line and a bit of puffiness. After a few days of using the eye treatment at night and morning, I noticed a reduction in puffiness throughout the day in especially in the morning. It's very smooth and absorbs well into the skin, only need to use a tiny amount.

I am a senior gal and over the years have used MANY different eye treatments, mostly retail store Brand names.  You know, the ones where you pay a lot for the fancy packaging and a very small amount of product. i stopped doing that because so many new products were coming out that were easier to use and had healthier ingredients and less chemical 'stuff' that I never knew much about anyway.

I have been very fortunate with my skin around the eye area and have few wrinkles and lines, but I do have very dry skin and was a sun worshipper in the 70's and 80's so I am always looking for a good product.

VENeffect is quite remarkable.  It has little fragrance which is major to me and it is non-greasy.  It absorbs easily and very little product is needed.

I haven't been using it that long, but I do notice a bit of a change in the skin texture.  I think it will take some time to see if there are permanent changes and I will update at that time.  The price might keep me from buying it in the future even if it is doing great on my skin. And, the price is reasonable when compared to those retail department store big name brands I used to use and this is a nice sized bottle.  So far, this treatment is doing better for my skin than some of those did so I would definitely keep using it if possible.

Eye creams are generally too greasy, too smelly, or nothing but facial moisturizers in little tubes or tiny bottles.  They do SOMETHING, because you use them regularly and they hydrate/moisturize the skin in the eye area.

This product is clearly better than many of the other ones I have used.  It gets applause from me, first of all, because it is neither greasy nor smelly.  Will it make an extra-special difference? It's too soon to say; I think one would have to use the product consistently, morning and night, for months.

But I think it is worth trying.
summary: Neither smelly nor greasy, and richer than standard moisturizers.

reviewText:
When you use only ground up leprechauns and the tears of unicorns in a product, magical things happen. Amazon creates a new category called "luxury beauty" for your product. Women in the house fight over this mysterious little tube; you have to write a review for a product that will inevitably cost you money in the future. Make no mistake, I sincerely hope if you are not in the 1% that this product does not work for you. I am not in the 1% and this product did wonders for all the women in the household, and even this intrepid reviewer who tried it. This is why I'm certain this item will be ordered again. (Unless something cheaper comes along. fingers crossed.) As near as budget analysts can tell, this is the single most expensive item per oz I own save for gold jewelry that was bought before prices got so expensive.

In a few days this product has shown remarkable results. How long it will last once the bottle runs out is the only real question. Along with maybe when the results will plateau. Our previous favorites were Shiseido for results, and Olay regenerist for price. This product handily beats both--results wise anyway. It seems to slightly (in a good way) puff up the skin, probably by moisturizing it, causing some lines and dark circles to be decreased. It also firms up the skin under the eyes causing some of the drooping and more lines to disappear. This is also takes away the overly puffy look some peoples eyes can get with age or situations. Lastly and this is a point of major contention... multiple factions in the house are arguing that there is some sort of permanent color correction going on. What we can all agree on is that the skin is healthier and seems to blend in better with the skin around it, looking fuller and younger.

I try to take price into consideration when doing a review. But this is a sticky one. It definitely works at least twice as good as the product we were using previously that cost around $50. I'm not sure it works 10x better than the Olay, but it certainly is head and shoulders above it. Add into that everybody's skin is different based on all sorts of factors like age and type and oil and environment that its really a crap shoot. If you can easily afford it, I'd give it a try. If you can't, its probably not worth stretching the bank account for something that could be a gamble. I would love to know the actual cost breakdown of ingredients for this product specifically and other cosmetics in general (I'm looking at you Elf primer that comes in a straight up pretend package with the real product hidden in a tube within a fake white tube within what you think is the real clear tube!!!!) to know what the mark up is.
summary: Magic: takes years off your eyes and your 401k value

reviewText:
Does this work? Sure. Does it worth enough to justify the price? Maybe not ... I have a family history of "ravine eyes," and have been doing my best not to join their ranks with whatever means at my disposal. Moisturizing creams can be super expensive, or super cheap. They all make the same astounding promises, and they all fall short of the mark.

This VENeffect worked as well as brands that are a 1/3 of the price. It has some drawbacks as well; it takes a long time to soak in, and can easily get into your eyes. It is scentless as promised. But it also falls victim to it's own marketing. There are no "immediate" effects. You won't be stunned by the results. It will do what everything else that is similar.

I'll stick with my Olay.

A very nice texture, and it absorbs quickly, It feels very soothing around my old eyes. I don't think it will make me look 15 again, but I wouldn't want to go back there anyway. This is fragrance free, and doesn't sting my eyes.

What I like about this eye cream:
1. It does not hurt my eyes if some gets in them - which is great because I wear contacts.
2. A little goes a long long way
3. There's no scent

What could be better:
1. It does not absorb. I'll put it on when I wake up and go to work and notice it's still sitting on top of my skin at lunch time. It's hard to not rub my eyes.
2. If I push the pump all the way down, I get almost enough cream for my whole face. It only takes a little drop - or quick press to do both of my eyes.
3. I've been using this for 2 weeks. No change. I took a picture of my eye before to make sure I wasn't missing anything.
4. It did not soften, brighten or remove any puffiness.

The cream is in a nice dispenser and a little goes a long, long way. It glides on nice and I would love to give this stuff 5 stars. BUT... but... the whole purpose of it is to, and I quote, "Reduces the signs of aging, soothes, brightens, reduces puffiness and provides a more rested, youthful appearance." and, per the description, "This gentle and highly effective eye treatment moisturizer, powered by plant technology, minimizes the appearance of fine lines and crows feet for a younger-looking, brighter appearance."

It just doesn't do what it claims.
summary: Nice, but doesn't do what it claims

reviewText: It's a nice eye cream, goes on easily. A little goes a long way. Smells good. Will update if it actually erases crow's feet as it says. In any case, it's nice and light on. I'm not sure it's worth the money. Personally, I prefer Redermic C Eyes Anti-Wrinkle Firming Concentrate Eye Cream with Pure Vitamin C and Hyaluronic Acid, which is $44.99 on Amazon.
summary: Good, but not worth the money

reviewText: This is a very rich eye cream. It is much too greasy for me to use during the day under my makeup, so I've been using it at bedtime. I like that it's non-comedogenic! I'm acne-prone, so I have to be careful about what I use around my eyes, lest it rub off on my pillow and onto other parts of my face. I don't know why this is called fragrance-free, as it does have an obvious fragrance to it. I haven't seen any improvements to my eye area so yet, but I usually give treatments a good six-month's worth of daily use before a full evaluation. So far, it seems nice and keeps my skin moisturized at night. But at $125 for 0.5 ounces, I'm expecting miracles. If you're looking for something less expensive that actually removes wrinkles, try RoC Retinol Correxion Eye Cream, 0.5 Ounce. The first time I used it, I woke up to a visibly smoother undereye area. I was shocked! Obviously, wrinkles can't be repaired in 8 hours, but whatever it did, I liked it. I've been using it about a year and all my fine lines are GONE.

I have several issues with this product:

--The box claims that this product "immediately improves skin tone and elasticity" around the eye area.  In actuality, tiny wrinkles around my eyes were more evident after using this product.  And while I usually do not show puffiness around my eyes, puffiness under my eyes is sure evident after using this product.  I get much better "immediate" results from my less-than-twenty-dollars Neutrogena Healthy Skin Eye Cream.

--While this product is definitely fragrance-free, it also does not refresh or "brighten" as claimed.  In fact, this product makes me want to rub my eyes.  I get much better results from my very refreshing and, again, less-than-twenty-dollars, Joyal Beauty Super Brightening Vitamin C Eye Gel.

--I can only use this product at night.  Why?  It does not soak in very quickly at all.  The first few times I applied this in the morning, after waiting a half hour for it to soak in, I finally gave up on applying my usual light eye shadow and went without.  And as the first hours go by, it seems that moisture constantly accumulates in the outside corners of my eyes.  I end up constantly wiping the inside and outside corners of my eyes--and that is not a helpful/healthy thing to be doing.  So, now I only wear it at night.  Top main ingredients of this product are:  Water, glycerin, isoeicosane (an oil-free emollient), isononyl isononanoate (a synthetic emollient), wax, and even a few more in the same category....  The claimed beneficial ingredients come after that.....

--The pump is terrible:  It is tiny and very short, so my finger is always touching it as the lotion extrudes.  A full push down on the pump head results in way too much product.  A short push down is very hard to attain.  So, I end up with way too much or too little.  Time-wise, the pump is definitely not efficient.

I had high hopes for this, considering the price.  I will continue using it in the evening, right before bedtime.  Who knows what its benefits will be over an extended period of time?  Is it worth the wait?  Is it worth the price?  Is it worth giving it a try for the price?  I just don't know.  What I do know is that I am going to stick with my Nuetrogena Healthy Skin Eye Cream and my Joyal Beauty Super Brightening Vitamin C Eye Gel.
summary: Definitely no immediate results for me.  Takes more than an hour to soak in.

reviewText: This product works well for my mom (close to 70) - as attested not just by my amazon reviews, but also other online stores and even youtube videos. The lotion has minimal scent - almost fragrance free - and apparently feels and looks good around the eyes, by making the skin firmer. The downside is the price - it is quite steep even for a single bottle, but on occasions one can get a deal by combining this product with another one from VENeffect. It takes a few tries to see a difference - so a small sample might not be enough to make an impression. Nothing from the ingredient list: Vitamin E, Biotin, Antioxidants, Resveratrol, Dimethicone, Peptides, Aloe Vera seems to be a health issue. Since this product is sold in multiple Western European countries, there is the extra assurance that the product is safe according to both US and European standards.

This is a long-term result kind of product so hard to evaluate after short duration.  One thing that I didn't like though is that the liquid is oily and not pleasant to put on.  Some other competing products have a better feel when you apply it.  The feel matters a lot since if something is uncomfortable you're unlikely to put it on a frequent basis.  The scent was okay though, so thumbs up for that.  Didn't notice any reduction in wrinkles though again, can't expect that in such short time frame.
This lathers really nice and leaves you feel very clean!
Best smell on earth.. only thing that is wrong with it is a bar lasted me about 1 and 1/2 weeks. But the scent is worth it. It's also priced way too high.

This is a great bar of soap.  The exfoliates are ground very fine so they are not abrasive, but they are consistent throughout the bar.  The scent is a nice manly scent that's not overbearing.

But most of all: It cleans well.
Definitely good soap, I just wish the price was lower
Great lather. Nice amount of exfoliation (not too rough). I'm not displeased with the smell, I'm just not quite used to it. Four stars because it's an expensive product.
summary: Great lather. Nice amount of exfoliation (not too rough)

reviewText: Awesome product. fast shipping. Thank you!!!
summary: Awesome product. fast shipping. Thank you!!!

reviewText:
This spray advertising itself as good for pre and post shave. Sounds too good to be true right? Turns out, it isn't!

This feels great before you shave. I've noticed a sharp drop in redness along my neck since I started using it before shaving. Best part is, it works well as an aftershave too.

I've used this for quite a few shaves, both before and after, and have barely made a dent on the bottle. Great value. Can't go wrong. Such a wonderful smell.

Yes, I'm a woman.  But it seems like some of the best shaving products are marketed towards men.

This shave tonic is wonderfully moisturizing on just shaved legs.  The scent isn't overpowering and it's nicely neutral - not too masculine or feminine.  Just kind of minty and menthal-y.

No stinging and quite soothing.

I didn't notice any real benefit to using prior to shaving my legs, but as an after tonic, it's very, very nice.  So definitely not just for men. :)
summary: Psst...you can use it on legs, too. :)

reviewText: First of all, the directions on the bottle are in about two point type, but fortunately instructions were also in the Amazon description. But really, do we really need "instructions" on how to use this? The first time I used Baxter of California Shave Tonic, I decided to give this new tonic a "real test." Toward this end, I shaved using my Gillette Power Fusion ProGlide with a cartridge that was on its last shave. I sprayed half my face with this and lathered up both sides with my favorite shave cream, Cremo, using my trusty badger brush. The tonic has a light eucalyptus scent that didn't linger, and it felt cool going on. I didn't notice any real difference from one side to the other during or after the shave. Since I was using an end-of-life cartridge there was a small amount of dragging on both sides. As expected, it there was some irritation on both sides when I was done. I sprayed both sides with the Baxter spray. It is easy to spray without getting in my eyes, and a couple sprays per side give sufficient coverage. The spray was cooling and relieved the irritation. As before, the scent did not linger, which is the way I like it. I have been equally pleased on subsequent shaves when using this as an after shave tonic. I think I use less "aftershave" when I spray this tonic instead of "splashing on" the traditional liquid that I have been using for years. One thing I did notice was that it looks like it separates. After the bottle sat on the shelf for a few minutes there is a thin white layer on the top of the rest of the liquid. A quick shake re-incorporates it, but it's just an oddity I have never seen before. The Bottom Line Overall, I like this product. At the time of this writing, a 4 ounce bottle of Baxter of California Shave Tonic costs $18 here on Amazon, which, IMO, puts it in the "luxury shave" category. Despite its high price, however, I expect to buy another bottle when this bottle (provided on the house, courtesy of Vine) is gone, because, as the old commercial used to say, "Because I'm worth it."

I never really used anything after shaving but recently I have had some shaves at the local barber and they use a tonic and I always feel refreshed and my skin feels great.  So decided to try the Baxter tonic.  First of all I use numerous baxter products from their hair products, moisturizer and deodrant so trying the tonic is a no brainer.  After I shave splash a bit on to tighten up the skin and to help heal any nicks I got while shaving.  The smell is great and a little goes a long way.  Honestly I feel as great as I do after paying the barber $20 for a shave.

Refreshing! A alcohol based shave tonic that doesn't dry your skin like so many other alcohol based aftershaves do. With no perfumes, but with the scents of menthol, rosemary, eucalyptus, camphor and spearmint essential oils.

They suggest spraying it on a damp cold towel then applying or spraying directly. I didn't care much for either, so I sprayed on my hands and applied like my usual aftershave.

I really liked the feel- cool and bracing like "aftershaves' but moisturizing like shave balms.

Helps with razor burn, too!

This Badger Shave tonic is lightly astringent because the second ingredient is alcohol.  The effect on the skin is pleasant, but if you have dry skin, you may want an aftershave or tonic that has more oil or other emoillients or moisterizers in it.

As other reviewers have mentioned, the scent it overwhelmed in a bad way by the menthol, which is a harsh effect rather than being merely pleasantly minty.  It's mildly off-putting, but dissapates quickly.  The label says that there is rosemary, eucalyptus, camphor and spearmint as well, but I don't pick up any floral or warm spicy notes at all.  The fragrance needs to be better balanced.
summary: the scent is overwhelmed in a bad way by the menthol

reviewText: I tend to use Proraso which is an admittedly old brand but still one of the best in my humble opinion. However, I liked the ingredient list on this and thought I'd give it a try. The spray bottle is glass which I really appreciate - plastic simply feels cheap. The spray is light and misty which is superb; in fact, I like it a lot. Very light. The fragrance is a bit medicinal which is why I deducted a point...it's not overpowering but it's also more medicinal than fragrant. The feel is light and has a minimal zing to it...refreshing but subdued. Overall I like this but really wish the fragrance wasn't so vapor rub like.
summary: Nice but fragrance is a bit medicinal

reviewText:
This is smooth, soothing and very invigorating.  The scent is lovely.

This is a very high end product.  From the heavy glass bottle to the gentle formula that is unmistakable in it's quality, this product is perfect for the refined gentleman.

I really love this product and, even though, I'm a guy with a beard, this has become part of my every-other-day shaving routine (shaping and shaving the neck). It smells awesome--manly and herbacious--and provides a great cooling experience. And I notice a difference in how my skin my feels after just a few days--tighter and smoother. I use a lot of Baxter products (facial scrubs, shampoo, moisturizer) and have never been disappointed in the quality--which makes them a great value, despite the slightly premium price.

I am a wet shaver who uses a double-edge safety razor.  I have tried a number of different aftershave lotions, tonics, splashes, and balms.

This one didn't do it for me.

First off, there is no ingredient list on the Amazon page.  This product contains four different parabens.  Parabens are xenoestrogens, not exactly the sort of stuff a guy wants to have absorbing through his skin on a daily basis.

Second, the scent is medicinal and not that pleasant.  As someone else mentioned, it smells quite a bit like Mentholatum, probably because of the camphor component.

Third, I did not find this product as soothing as other splashes, lotions, or tonics I have tried from Proraso, Barrister and Mann, Chiseled Face, or  Pure Body Naturals, all of which are substantially less expensive and do not contain parabens.

In sum, you can do a lot better for the price and can avoid parabens at the same time.
summary: Contains parabens, more expensive than better-performing alternatives

reviewText: DH got his first bottle of Baxter of California Daily Protein Shampoo free and has been buying it ever since. Then he added the conditioner and Super Close Shave Formula to his regime. I expected he'd love the Shave Tonic when I accepted a bottle to review. Indeed, he tried it and was enamored with it, but it isn't a product that he will use and buy regularly. Specifically, he loves the scent and says it feels wonderful, but says it didn't work so great, or feel so different, that he'd stop using the Super Close Shave Formula. So, definitely liked, just not liked as much as his other Baxter grooming products.
summary: 2nd To Baxter's Super Close Shave Formula

reviewText: I am a fan of Baxter of California grooming products.  I've been using their products for several years now.  This tonic is pretty interesting.  I've not seen a product that doubles as both pre- and post-shave before.  I am using this primarily as a post-shave product and occasionally I just put it on my face.  I notice the minty smell primarily, but it fades rather quickly.  As an aftershave, it works very well.  I use it on my neck below my beard and have no irritation when I do.  Another quality Baxter product.

When I applied this I thought it smelled suspiciously like Seabreeze. I compared the bottles and they had a couple of I ingredients in common, they were not the same. However it is close enough that I would save myself 10 bucks or so and buy Seabreeze. They both close pores.

We are a Baxter family and love/use a ton of their products. The most soothing and non-irritating pre or post shave. The big problem for me is that despite the fragrance mix, it just comes out smelling like my arthritis topical. I was hoping the spearmint would be a top note but nothing can trump the camphor in this product. It's obnoxiously strong. I'll end up using this on my legs to keep the fragrance away from my nose. Overall a nice product with unfortunate fragrance outcome.
summary: Nice toner and aftershave but smells like my arthritis rub

reviewText: Excellent!
Great price on prime day

This Clarisonic head is pricey, but if you have a Clarisonic facial cleaner, you really don't have a choice once the original brush head has deteriorated.  I'm all too willing to pay the price because the cleansing system is so good.  This fits my Clarisonic FIT.  All I needed to do was to release the old one with a twist and install this one with a twist.

The Radiance is my favorite head because it's both soft and effective.  My face always feels soft and polished after I use it.

-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann
summary: Fits the FIT -- and All Other Clarisonic Facial Devices

reviewText: its a good thing all brushes fit on the SMART CLARISONIC, I thought this was the kind with the chip---NOT  it works anyway, i'll be more careful next time when ordering!!!
summary: Wish the description would tell which device the brushes are for----CLARISONIC

reviewText: i love it FOR the CLARISONIC IT FITS--------i wish they would SAY in the DESCRIPTION what device the BRUSH HEAD is for,  INSTEAD of SHOWING PICTURES!!!! (that one may not even notice--(-pictures)
summary: PLEASE PLEASE Change the Description of the Brushes--Tell what device they are for

reviewText:
Clarisonic has been a part of my skin care regime for ten years. I use it nightly to rid myself of my make-up, dirt and grime, and I have great looking skin for my age.

In order to keep my facial cleansing tool at its peak I replace the brush heads every three months to rvso.with this set of two replacement brush heads. Therecate several different brush heads, and I have tried them all.

Normal/Delicate/Sensitive: Classic, and PLUS models
Body: compatible with Clarisonic PLUS model only

I tried the Radiance Brush Head this past week, and like it immensely. It is specifically engineered with extra fine bristles to deliver a luxurious and highly-effective cleansing experience.  This unique  brush head helps to remove sebum and dullness. This brush head feels softer and more delicate on my skin, I do like the feeling. I do not see a great difference in my skin, but my skin does feel softer .

The Clarisonic Brush Heads are designed for a specific skin type or skin concern, and are designed to work at the precise frequency of our devices. They are made with super-soft, quick-drying super soft bristle, and each bristle is uniquely rounded on the end to provide a gentle and comfortable cleanse.

I found the Sonic Radiance brush head fully as effective in cleaning pores as the Deep Pore. It is softer so I have to keep reminding myself not to press harder. It cleans just fine when light pressure is used. I use a Clinique skin cleanser lotion with my Clarisonic. I have tried many cleansers, and they all work fine. It just depends upon your preference.

Recommended. prisrob 11-07-16

A lot of men's fragrances can be, to say the least,  a bit overpowering. Think huge clouds of musk wafting in the air the day after the guy has been in the neighborhood. Not so with Lacoste Live. For a man's fragrance, it's refreshingly light and citrusy.

There are some men's scents that women like to wear, and I can see that with Lacoste LIVE. It's not at all that it's feminine; it's just that it's such a nice, low key, natural fragrance that women might find it appealing as well. I certainly did - well, not on ME, but on my husband!

Not an inexpensive brand, but you're definitely getting what you pay for here: a large eau de cologne, and a smaller spare. Oh, and one other thing - great presentation! Box is nice, and the bottle packaging is definitely cool. This would make a great, classy gift, with little chance the male recipient wouldn't love it.
summary: Fresh citrusy scent that women find as appealing as men

reviewText:
LACOSTE LIVE FRAGRANCE GIFT SET FOR MEN

When I saw this one VINE I decided to treat my husband -- and here are his thoughts on this product - which, by the way, I think smells divine.

This gift set has a very pleasing scent that is pleasant, not too strong or over-powering.  I don't quite understand the fancy terms such as green leaves, aquatic notes, or smokey warmth of guaiac wood, but it just smells good, a very pleasant scent that seems to last once applied.

The packaging is in the style of a cube and that is unique and fits most decors.  These are two spray bottles; one is 100 ML, the other is 40 ML.

My husband is 63 years old and he says he is  fairly conservative [very] and he enjoys the scent of this product.  So do I !!  He's not sure about how well this cologne attracts women, and he doesn't think he will be able to quality that.  If you want a different yet pleasant fragrance, this would be a nice addition to your stable of colognes.  Me?  His wife?  I like it; it smells good on him!

Thanks.

I like the fragrance and was glad to receive both the large and small bottles in this gift set.  Citrus always smells clean and fresh and this Lacoste scent is not at all cloying unlike other men's colognes.  The packaging is a bit "too much" as I would have preferred more scent in the bottles and less cardboard for the package.  But, all in all, I like it.

This is a handsome gift set. It's a little odd that there are two bottles of the same product rather than an EDP and an aftershave or an EDP and a lotion. Still, the package is nice and the scent will appeal to anyone who enjoys citrus. There's a similarity to Obsession because of the strong citrus (lime) scent. I don't smell all the woodsy scents that are suggested, as they are a bit lost under the top note of lime.

My wife prodded me to get this - probably because I almost never use a fragrance. This is a familiar aroma that I am almost certain I've smelled sometime in the past. I am terrible at explaining aromas, but what I can say is, it definitely will not be confused with a woman's perfume. It is a good aroma, certainly not objectionable in the least.  I think this is probably aimed toward younger men going out on a date in the evening.

It came in an oversized box and I was uncertain what it was at first. I couldn't imagine it could take up so much space. Then after opening it up, it was apparent that it is a gift box set.  I don't know why they include a smaller bottle except maybe for a travel size.

I have previously reviewed an individual bottle for Lacoste LIVE and liked the scent very much.

This review is for the gift set. While the box for the gift set is colorful and attention-grabbing (though it did arrive damaged), it is also large and awkward. The box does not need to be this big and is an example of wasteful packaging.

There are two toilette spray bottles included (why not a talc or lotion, deodorant, or something other than a spray?), and I really believe a better box could have been designed to house them.

so far so good - only 4 stars due to the fact that every hair dresser will tell you that NOTHING will repair split ends!  I don't see too many split ends anymore so it seems to work though!  LOVE Oribe products!
Only need a small amount and apply to ends of hair. My sister also liked it and bought her one as a gift
summary: My sister also liked it and bought her one as a

reviewText: I have used what seems to be EVERY shampoo, conditioner, serum on the market from the cheap stuff you can buy at the local store to the exclusive expensive salon exclusives. When I first researched premium shampoos and products this came up on every search, and as always I was skeptical to purchase as I did not want it to go to the shampoo/conditioner/serum graveyard under my sink. I have paired this with the ORIBE Hair Care Shampoo for Beautiful Color, 8.5 fl. oz and ORIBE Hair Care Shampoo for Beautiful Color, 8.5 fl. oz. After washing I apply 3-4 pumps into my wet hair, a little goes a long way with this cream. I have extremely thick long hair with a ton of frizz. My hair is shiny, soft, and no split ends! Now my hair is so easy to manage and looks like I received a blowout every time I use it. My color has stayed in for 10 weeks while using this so far. I am so impressed with ORIBE products that I have thrown away everything under the sink! These products are WELL worth EVERY penny and even more! Excellent and a must try for anyone.
Great product, keeps my hair healthy

Awesome product.  Just like all other oribe products this one is also a winner.  Best used on wet hair.  Wash your hair , use on ends of hair.  Amazing results.  I get regular trims and use this along the way too.  Fantastic line !!!! Love oribe.
summary: Awesome product. Just like all other oribe products this ...

reviewText:
All the look, feel and performance of a precision designed, high quality product. It's hard to imagine any of these 3 tools could be made any better. The scissors close easy and smooth yet you can feel the blades just touching all the way up and down the length of the blades, making a nice, clean cut. The slightly curved scissor tips allow you to get into tight spots cut what you target. The nail file has a stiff blade with evenly dispersed metal "sand" with the perfect density of coarseness. Doesn't look like it will ever wear down. The tweezers are that rare find that seem to be able to grab even the smallest nub of hair and be able to firmly grip it as you pull it out. I don't know why it's included in what appears to be a nail grooming kit, but it's the one thing I needed most.

The black case is thick enough to last forever and has a nice, smooth black low cut felt lining. The black crystal badge is nothing special, but if it's a gift, I guess adds to the effect. Is it worth the cost? Well, they definitely are the best tools you can find, and if there's someone on your list that already has everything, and you can afford it, it might be a nice addition to their collection. I would say it's good as a travel kit, but I'm afraid some vigilant airport security guard might consider the tools a risk.
summary: Super high quality and prescion tools

reviewText:
This is how you make a necessity luxurious. Zwilling's elegant little leather case, encrusted with crystals, really shines in housing three beauty implements no woman can be without.

The tools are divinely made, well balanced and actually useful! Tweezers, which pluck individual hairs easily, a small nail file which solves the broken nail on the go dilemma, and my favorite, the manicure scissors. I have tons of manicure scissors of all different types, but none are as pristine as these. They fit nicely in the hand, but cut the toughest nail (they're also good for an irritating cuticle, not to cut, but to use one edge to scrape it off the nail face.)

What's amazing is how lightweight this all is. You can easily tuck this in your bag and never feel an extra ounce of weight. The case is truly lovely, a perfect housing for such well-made implements.

Granted this is a pricy set, but everything in it is pure quality. If money is no object, this would make a SUPERB stocking stuffer for the lady on your gift list. The holiday's are coming - there's no gift that weds practically and luxury as much as this!
summary: Practicality and luxury, wedded in a beautiful case of implements

reviewText: Henckels has been a producer of quality products for quite some time and this set is no exception. The steel used in this set is of utmost quality and appearance as well. This is a perfect set for travel considering its small size and the handy pouch. The scissors are sharp and work very nicely in trimming hair. The tweezers grasp unwanted hairs with authority and the nail file does well what nail files are supposed to do. All in all this is a top of the line quality set.

I'm not sure how I never realized there was a device like this until the last year.  Maybe they were only in nail salons, but I have been missing out on something extraordinary!  I also have the Amope (a similar device), and I truly didn't think I could like something better than the Amope, but I do prefer this callus remover with one exception.  This one has a combination type off/on switch, where you have to press down a safety button and then slide it up.  Turning it on was fairly easy, but turning it off was a challenge at first.  It doesn't slide down to turn off as easily as it slides up to turn on.  The Amope has a rotational off/on switch where you just twist on the handle and turn it on, and twist again to turn it off.  I greatly prefer the Amope on/off switch, but besides that one feature, I greatly prefer the the Silk'n callus remover. While the roller on this one seems much smaller than the one on the Amope, it is more effective.  It removed the dry skin on my heel quickly and painlessly.  This remover comes with two rollers, a coarse roller and a polish roller.  I think the Amope roller (it only has the one roller) is a cross between the two because while it also removes the dried skin, it does it slower.  The coarse roller on this remover is a beast!  It quickly removed the callused skin on my heels in a manner of a few seconds.  It's truly amazing.  It also comes with a brush to clean the device (the Amope didn't have a brush).  I also tried the polish roller, but I really didn't think it did anything and doubt I would use it again.  After about a month of use on the Amope, I did change the roller due to decreased performance, but I'm pleased to note in the Silk'n roller instruction guide it actually states "replace the roller.....depending upon the intensity of use, but generally after one year."  That would be great, as you wouldn't need to buy many refills.  Also, I noticed that this device is quieter when I used the coarse grinder compared to the Amope.  And one last really nice feature is it's size and shape.  This device is lighter in weight, slimmer in the handle, more ergonomic, and easier to hold in general, especially for smaller hands or hands with arthritis.  I'm a fan!
summary: Removes callused areas more quickly and quietly, and smaller and more ergonomic

reviewText: My favorite device of this type. ( I also have an emjoi). The device is easy to hold and pretty lightweight.  I like that it comes with rollers of 2 different degrees of coarseness. I cannot yet speak to how fast the rollers wear out, but I have used mine 2-3 times a week for a month and they are noticeably worn yet. There is a brush Included for cleaning, but you can pop the whole roller cartridge off and rinse it  under water for extra cleanliness. Batteries are included which is a nice surprise. Works so well, be sure to use it over a towel or paper or else you'll have foot callus dust all over.
summary: EXCELLENT FOR THE PRICE, SO GET RID OF THAT PUMICE STONE

reviewText:
I've owned this Silk'n Electronic File for less than one month and my feet look and feel better already.  I'm a guy but hey we have feet too and we wear flipflops.  Every couple of years my wife forces me to join her and my daughter for a mani/pedi and I always feel bad for the person that has to work on me (lots of deferred maintenance - hey I'm a guy).

In guy-speak - this thing is a belt sander for your feet.  It has two grits, coarse and fine, which come in the form of cartridge heads (kind of like changing out the blade on your Gillette-type razor).  So far I've stuck with the fine grit which has been all I need thus far.  Turn this belt-sander thing on and run it over any rough areas of your feet...basically it sandpapers off skin and you can actually see the sawdust (skin) floating up in the air.  Within 10 minutes both my feet were girly smooth.  On the cons side my 9-year old daughter also took a liking to this thing so now when I go to use it I can see her dead skin gunked up on the sander head so I have to give it a very good cleaning before I use it.

Other notables - includes the disposable batteries, easy operation (just turn it on and it starts spinning then turn it off), good build quality - appears durable.  My only gripe so far (besides my daughter using it) would be to have a bit more gender neutral color scheme (or maybe even some flames airbrushed on the handle if that's not too much to ask).

In summary, I like this thing and will continue to use it (when no one is looking).  The current price of $29 appears reasonable relative to the other competitive offerings I perused on Amazon.  Overall I rate it 5-STARS in consideration of price/value.  If there's any future notables with my product experience I'll add update comments to my review.
summary: This belt sander thing made my feet girly smooth

reviewText:
I can't tell you what great results I get from the Silk'n Electronic File. I get some serious callouses and it takes forever to file them off. I have tried various different manual files, the Ped Egg, a metal file and the Amope electronic foot file.

The Silk'n and the Amope beat manual filing easily. You can buff off callouses in a fraction of the time without tiring out your arm.

I would recommend the Silk'n file over the Amope due to the choice of a corse and a fine file roller. The Amope only has a corse file. For people with normal feet that would just like to maintain their pedicure at home, the fine file may be all they need. The 2 units seem to provide similar results using the corse file.

I have trouble buying shoes that fit so I end up with calluses. I was a little nervous about this device as I couldn't imagine an electronic gadget for my feet. But this one is great! It's like gentle pumice but it rubs on comfortably and really takes dry skin off, without hurting. Easier to use than pumice stones, too. Great product!

The batteries were included and they were easy to add. The compartment opened easily.  However, the batteries were wrapped really tightly in plastic! That was the hardest part of using the product.

I am an avid exerciser, so my feet have lots of calluses. I love treating myself to professional pedicures, but since they are rather pricey, I try to do it myself sometimes.

Why I like this product:

* It's very easy to use. The instructions are very clear and easy to understand. I am happy that I read them before trying this product. The key take away from the instructions was to not spend more than 2-3 seconds on a callus. I thought I would have to spend more time on them, but that isn't necessary.

* It works! After only a few uses, my feet are smoother.

* The product design. There are two rollers, one with a coarse texture to really get at those tough calluses and another roller with a finer texture to smooth the skin.

* It comes ready to use. Batteries are included with the product.

If you are looking for a way to pamper your feet, you will enjoy this product!
summary: Same results as with a professional pedicure

reviewText: The Silk'n Electronic Pedicure File and Callus remover didn't work quite as well at removing calluses as I thought it would, based on other reviews.  I think my problem is that I use too much thick lotion  daily (Gold Bond Shea Butter).  I didn't find it to take off calluses very well, and the roller was a mess.  This was using the coarse roller.  However, I found a perfect use for it for me.  I sometimes use one of the cheese grater type callus removers.  It leaves rough edges, and I never really filed my feet down after using it before.  That would leave rough edges eventually once it dried up.  I now use the grater callus remover and then use the Silk'n pedicure tool to smooth down the skin.  I also use the smoother roller on the edges of my fingers/cuticles to smooth them out after using cuticle nippers.  Therefore, I am quite happy with my Silk'n pedicure tool, even though I don't feel it works well enough for the intended purposes.

I used this last night for the first time after coming back from a rodeo. My feet were disgusting. In fact, they're disgusting a lot of the time because I hate wearing shoes. Pedicures usually do the trick, but I can't afford to get a pedicure a week.

This little device worked really well. There's not assembly. All you have to do is put in the included batteries and take the protective covering off and you're ready to roll. It felt really good on my feet. You can see the gross dry skin flaking off as you roll over your feet.

I used the course roller because my feet were so gross, but I imagine if I keep up with this, the fine one will do the trick.

When I was finished, my feet were truly soft and smooth.

The device is small so you can pack it to take on vacation, shove it in a drawer, put it in your purse (if you need to, I guess).

I think for what it does, it's worth the price. I mean, $25 a pop for a pedicure, or $30 for something you can use over and over to make your feet feel nice.

I really have nothing bad to say about this product. I highly recommend it for women who can't afford or are too busy to get routine pedicures.

Silk'n pedicure device is great to use right out of the package.  It has a roller bar that exfoliates the rough area of your feet.  Just place a towel or newspaper on the floor or sit with your feet over the bathtub and run the roller over the areas you want to smooth.  It is great to use on callouses and hopefully overtime they will smooth out.  Use between pedicures or instead of a professional pedicure.  This is far superior to pumice stones and ped eggs. Nice gift too!

I've had issues with a couple odd ball areas of my feet developing calluses over the last few years as I find myself going without shoes more often. Normally I have to soak my feet pretty good for a while and then just use a knife to scrape them down/off but this thing allows me to take care of them within a couple minutes that I start to notice they are bugging me.

The soak method works really good but it's nice to be able to get them in between soaks. A nice product at this time, hopefully it holds up well.

I really like this product.  It only takes a few seconds to snap together and you're ready to use.  Just glide it over your feet and the callouses just melt away.  Then change the head to the smoother and you soon have silky smooth feet.  I've used a pedi egg for years and what would take hours of work with that only takes minutes with the Silk'n.  The only drawback to the Silk'n is that where as the pedi egg catches all of the shavings, the Silk'n has no compartment so there is a huge mess.  Be prepared to file your feet over a towel or wastebasket.

So this is basically a gentle power-sander for your feet. I don't have many callouses on mine, but the two prominent ones I've had since I was a kid. This did a nice job of smoothing them out, and wasn't uncomfortable at all. The directions say to not apply pressure for more than 2-3 seconds at a time, but they're being cautious...if you have thicker callouses, you can sand away with a bit more gusto. I liked the two heads, the blue being the sander and the purple being the polisher (just a little finer grain); it says to use the latter after the other, but you can also use that one for other parts of your feet that might just be a little rough.

My only gripe is that cleaning the heads is kind of a pain with the useless brush they provide. A sterilized old toothbrush works much better. It says you probably won't have to buy replacement heads for a year with normal use, which makes this a definite value...but I could see how, if you don't clean the heads well enough, the build-up of residue will make the sander less effective and make the job take twice as long.

The Silk'n Electronic Pedicure File and Callus remover is a great solution to an annoying problem - foot calluses.  I had previously purchased a different product, the Perfect Pedi, which costs $10 more; I like this better.  The pluses to the Silk'n product include two different rollers - the turquoise one is tough for use on calluses and rough areas and the purple one one is a gentle finishing one that polishes and smooths. I like that you can treat this issue easily and safely at home yourself.  The refills suggested price for one of each is $19.95, but they are $16.95 on the Silk'n website

Even if you get pedicures regularly, this would still  be a handy product to have at home to prevent the build up of hard, uncomfortable, ugly calluses on your feet.

Tips:  Make sure your feet are totally dry before using it, and apply it very lightly; that's all the pressure needed to do the job.
summary: Great Solution to an Ugly Situation

reviewText:
I never get pedicures -- I just use a pumice stone at home -- and my feet have been getting a bit rough, so I was excited to try this out.  It works really well to smooth out rough areas and calluses!

This comes with two rollers:  a blue, coarser one for tougher calluses and a purple, finer-grained one for calluses that aren't as bad.  Since I have sensitive skin, I've only used the purple one -- but it works great to smooth out rough areas!  After using this twice this past week, my feet are softer than they've been since maybe I was ten.  :-)

I'd definitely recommend using this over your bathtub or in your shower.  I have a small shower stool, and sit there to do my feet since it gives off a lot of dead skin flakes.  (Using a towel under your feet would work too, of course, but you definitely want something to make clean-up easy.)

The best things about this are:

*  comes with the two rollers, so you can be as gentle or as tough as you'd like on your feet

*  the rollers are really easy to change out -- you simply depress a button and they pop off.

The reason I gave this four stars instead of five are:

*  there is no speed or pressure control; it would have been nice if you could use this on a gentler speed; I know that it probably needs to move at a minimum speed in order to work, but it does hurt a wee bit when using it

*  it would be nice if the rollers were easier to clean; the package comes with a little brush, but it doesn't remove all the debris off the rollers

Overall, I really like this!  It's the perfect device to use as we get head into sandal weather!
summary: This works incredibly well to smooth out rough feet!

reviewText: Ladies with cracked heels and callouses on the sides and tops of your toes, heads-up, this device can take them on!!  NOT A GIMMICK throw away.  It looks like it could never work and delicate looking but it is a dead skin eating monster!  Lay a towel under your foot while you work and you are going to be so surprised and what this removes and polishes your skin to a beautiful healthy look.  I have passed these type of callous removers by in the past thinking no way but the porous stone on the front does burr away your dead skin with little pressure.  I never felt any discomfort using this. This along with a foot rasp are all you'll need this summer to keep your pedicures beautiful.  No more old lady feet!!
summary: No more old lady feet!  Truly works on cracked heels and callouses!  LOVE IT!!

reviewText:
