This is an amazing little gadget! I have similar products advertised and in stores and was very interested in checking it out, so when I was offered an opportunity to review one for amazon vine at no cost, I jumped!

 I am on my feet all day at work and living in Florida, spend a lot of my free time barefoot. These are 2 very good reasons I wanted (and needed) this. Well, I was not disappointed! I want to say I was simply amazed at how FAST it worked. I saw instant results. Now,my fet were not really all that bad, but I did have some rough patches and very dry, cracked heels. Guess what? I DO  NOT ANYMORE!

This comes with 2 heads. One for really rough, coarse skin (blue) and another for softening and polishing (purple). I used the blue first all over my heels and on the pads of my feet. Wow. I just can't say enough how fast this works. I do recommend 2 things. First, I would place down a towel or cloth to "catch" all the dry skin that will flake off. It's a bit messy. Second, I would suggest using a foot cream- one specifically for feet, not a regular hand or body lotion- and use it right after. It will help with the softening.

Do not worry that this is something that will cause irritaion or any real discomfort with use. I know some of the advertised foot products look like they might be painful or make your feet sore after. Not The Silk'n.  It barely felt like I was doing anything and my feet were super soft and smooth after. Now I am ready for summer sandles and flip flops without worrying about my feet looking old and dry.

Along with the 2 heads, it also comes with the 2 AA batteries needed and a cleaning brush. I do wish it came with a storage case, but I am using an old makeup case I have.
summary: Say Hello to Softer, Smoother Feet

reviewText:
I have had others of these electronic callus remover devices before, and I have to say, the Silk'n is the best one Ive used.  It is the fastest and gave me the best results.

I walk several miles a day, and my feet show it, especially the dreadfully dry and cracked skin on my heels.

I was able to get very good results with one try with this device.  Granted, my feet at this point (early May) aren't as bad as they will be during the summer, but still, to be able to get them smooth with initial use is really amazing.

Be sure to put a lotion on your feet afterwards.  I use either Badger foot balm or Vaseline Intensive Repair lotion.  I use the device once a week and put the balm or lotion on my heels every night before I go to bed.

This device comes with two batteries, but I would recommend getting some rechargeable batteries when they wear out.

It comes with two rollers, a coarse and a fine.  I usually just use the coarse.  It does not hurt at all, but don't use it more than a few seconds in any spot as it will take off skin and you don't want to go deep.

According to the manual, the rollers should last about a year.  That is my only concern.  My other devices came with extra replacement rollers, and they did not last a year.  Its impossible for me to say at this point how long the rollers on the Silk'n device will last.  Not only does it not come with any replacement rollers, but you actually need to replace the entire top part  the rollers themselves are not removable.  Instead, the entire head removes (as you would do to switch between the coarse and the fine) and so the entire head must be replaced, not just the rollers.  I could not find any replacement heads for sale, so I assume that essentially, this is a toss-after-a-year product.

I am really impressed with this little gadget. I used it on a callus that I always have and it helped so much. I was afraid it would hurt but it didn't at all. And it just took a couple of minutes to make a big difference on my feet. This is a great little gadget to get your feet ready for summer weather.
summary: This is a great little gadget to get your feet ready for summer ...

reviewText:
I love this machine!  I always have rough skin on my heels and if I don't use a pumice bar everyday it looks gross.  I have tried all kinds of files, creams, vinegar, antifungal cream to no avail.  Enter this electronic item and I have had a breakthrough.  No rough skin and I have not needed the pumice at all.

Here's how I used it. There is a rough textured roller and a finer textured one.  The first time I used the rough one lightly and for just a few seconds all over my feet then switched to the finer textured one and did the same. They warn you in the directions not to use either one for more than a few seconds.  Any way, instant smoothness.  I used the fine one again the next night.  Now I use mostly the fine one about every other day for a quick touch up before my bath.

It's just great, my feet look and feel fantastic.

Dave's Wife:

I had never bought PCA on Amazon before, so I was a little worried..but the product was sealed, new, and legitimate. I am very happy and will be buying again when I run out. Thank you.

This deserves 5 stars for results (as I'm now using it at night) however it leaves the skin under my eyes shiny.  I wear rimless glasses & the shine is distracting, actually drawing attention to that area which is something I don't want to do.  I'm sticking with the Ideal Complex eye cream...which BTW is a light weight wonderful product as well.
Great scent.  Very light & refreshing.  Does not stay with you all day, have to refresh.  I would totally buy this product again

My absolutely favorite smells have to include light citrus smells. This perfume takes the cake over many by being light and refreshing. I can distinguish lemon, bergamot, currant and jasmine. The way the smells blend is absolutely beautiful. My only complaint is that the smell does not last longer than a couple of hours. I would expect it to at least linger a little longer, but it even disappears from clothes with wool in them. Wool is notorious for holding on to smells. I feel that if the chemical composition of this scent could be left unaltered while adding a component that would make the scent last, it would be an incredible perfume.
summary: My absolutely favorite smells have to include light citrus smells

reviewText: This is a nice and light refreshing scent.  It's described as citrus-flour, and I think that's accurate, but it's on the delicate side of things.  This doesn't hold all that long, but it's a unique fragrance that goes well for a lot of occasions.
summary: This is a nice and light refreshing scent

reviewText:
I consider myself a bit of a fragrance snob, and I was pleasantly surprised by this scent. Frequently, I find that the chemical compounds used to mimic white florals in fragrance are irritating, which is a telltale sign of a poor quality. Thankfully, I don't get irritation from this scent. In fact, I quite like it. It is neutral enough to wear to the office but unique enough to be recognized.

Although it appears to be marketed to women, I think a fragrance-daring gent could easily pull this off. The top citrus notes and middle floral notes are quite fleeting in my opinion. Not really a true floral scent, in my opinion, and on the order of D&G Light Blue but better.

I can recommend but would suggest trying before buying ... even if it is Meghan Markle's favorite scent.
summary: Neutral enough to wear to the office, Unique enough to be remembered

reviewText: Wife says: I got this product for review and to be fair was not sure what to expect. The perfume is to be sprayed on hair to get a desirable smell. I liked the smell a lot. My big concern, however, was the alcohol in the ingredient list, which may be an issue with people like me. Also, it is quite a pricey product, so need to be mindful of that.

Although Im not an avid perfume user, my favorite is Viva La Juicy La Fleur. As the name implies, La Fleur has sweet floral notes while Oribe Cte dAzur has floral grassy notes which evokes sophistication and maturity. Even with the grown-up feel of Oribe, Im surprised by their  modest looking packaging. While La Fleur has a glass crystal-like top, Oribe has an embossed black plastic top giving me that drug-store-like feel which is unfortunate.

This is A1 in my book as a gift item for your wife, girl friend, or daughter.  It's a pleasant scent, not to heavy.  It does fade away during the day.  However, it's a scent I much enjoy smelling on a lady friend, and so I do recommend it for ladies young and not so young alike.
summary: A thoughtful gift for the woman in your life

reviewText: This is a really unique fragrance.  I think that it is definitely appropriate for men and women.  It mixed with my body chemistry well, but I think that it is better to spray it on my clothes because it doesn't alter the fragrance and it lasts longer.  The only reason why I didn't give it five starts is because I found that it doesn't last very long.  This is one of the nicest fragrances that I have ever had and I would recommend for everyone to check it out.
I love this. It smells fresh and clean but isn't TOO aquatic or floral.  If you like jasmine you'll like this.  It's a very summery scent.

I'm super picky when it comes to floral perfumes, but this one? Hits it out of the park. Cote d'Azur is a deliciously beachy floral with strong hints of citrus and a really lovely, rich base of sandalwood and amber.

At first spritz, when the perfume is still wet, citrus is the strongest note; it smells like fresh lemon and orange peel. Immediately upon drydown, the florals take over. I mostly smell jasmine and tuberose. Underneath, though, is that nice, warm base of sandalwood and amber. The base isn't too strong, though it gets stronger the longer the perfume sits on my skin.

Throw is low to medium; my very scent sensitive husband just caught a light whiff of it as I walked past him. It's more of a private perfume rather than a perfume that lets everyone in the room know about it. On my skin, it lasted fairly well, though it did fade after a few hours. Applying the perfume over lotion helps with its staying power, though.

Overall, this is a gorgeous floral and one I plan on wearing all summer.

A Beautiful light fragrance that smells a little woodsy with lite citrus and floral undertone. The fragrance is light which is probably why some people don't believe it has any staying power but I noticed that the scent is still on my jacket from when I wore it a couple of days ago.  For me, the only downside is the price so I will probably just save it for special occasions.

I love it!  This unisex scent inspired by Oribe, the fashion hairstylist, has a sweet woodsy fragrance that is very sophisticated and perfect for any special occasion.  It was created by one of the oldest French fragrance houses, so it's of the highest quality.  I lightly sprayed it on my chest, back, and behind my ears.  I was very happy with the way it blended with my body's natural chemistry, since the fragrance lasted throughout the day without being overwhelming.  I also like the elegant packaging and bottle, which would make it perfect for an intimate gift giving.  I highly recommend it for anyone that likes quality fragrances.
This is a fabulous clean light fragrance that I love.  I didn't think I would love it as much as I do.  It's soft, leaves no residue and smells amazing.  I highly recommend it.

A beautiful bottle which is important to my wife as she keeps all her fanciest and classic perfumes in a display on her bedroom dresser.  She applied some the minute it came in the mail and we both loved the scent.  Our children all thought their mom smelled wonderful...a blessing as some of her perfumes do not meet with their approval.

At that moment, of applying the perfume we were completely happy and satisfied with the Oribe.  About 30 minutes later I asked if she had washed it off or what happened to the perfume.  It had been applied to her throat and behind the ears, and a touch on her wrists.  However, the scent was about gone in that short time.  She added a touch of the perfume in the same places and that wonderful scent was back.  Once again the effect lasted a very short time.  In less than an hour it was barely detectable.

For such an expensive product, the lifespan is way, way too short to be recommended.
summary: Great scent, great container, limited time of scent lasting.

reviewText: Smells exactly like... my orange scented oil diffuser. I don't know if that's a good thing or bad thing but I happen to like the smell of orange peels. This parfume is more reminiscent of air freshner than perfume.
summary: Smells exactly like... my orange scented oil diffuser.

reviewText: "ORIBE Cte d'Azur Esau de Parfum" is a unisex fragrance that when you choose to purchase this perfume, unfortunately, disappears as quickly as your hard-earned dollars did.  Based on its short "lifespan".  I would not recommend this fragrance since there are others available that are longer lasting and more friendly to your wallet.

As most reviewers of this product has already commented that while the scent is good it does not last very long. The bottle and packaging is very attractive as gift and the pump/spray works good in spraying the scent. It has a good scent resembling more of woodsy type and settles towards more floral / citrus notes which I liked but then within about 20-30 mins after applying it I could no longer smell it. For the asking price it is little too expensive especially knowing that it does not linger long enough where applied. I am sorry to rate this with 2 stars since the price is weighing in on it. I wish it lingered long enough to appreciate the nice smell.

At first spritz, the scent is a weak citrus that didn't really impress me.  It just didn't seem to have any depth, just a single, non-descript citrus note which I couldn't identify as lemon, lime, orange or grapefruit.  Immediately after spraying, I asked my husband, sitting 2 feet away, how he liked it and he said he couldn't smell anything at all.  After 30 minutes, the scent was completely undetectable even while inhaling deeply from my wrist.  Good thing I didn't really care for the scent in the first place.
summary: If you don't like the scent just wait 30 minutes

reviewText:
Edit March 2018:  I've changed my mind.  I like it now.  I think the problem was I got it in the fall and I was more in a spicy pumpkin mode.  It is spring now and this has a green tea springy vibe.  It's still to expensive.

This is extremely expensive for a fragrance that belongs in Bath & Body at the mall.  I was not impressed.  The smell is fruity, like apples; to me anyway.  It comes out strong and overbearing like the stuff at the mall.  Then in about an hour, it smells okay.  Then an hour after that, it is gone.

This perfume comes in a very pretty gold/black ombre presentation box. The bottle has a pleasing shape and is shaded from a smoky top to a crystal bottom. The bottle is nested in the velvet base of the box.

The atomizer top squirts more than sprays. Im not familiar with their hair products so I cant compare this with their scents. It has a citrus-y sandalwood scent to me.  It smells very masculine and I couldn't detect a floral scent at all, as middle notes. Of course, scent is a very personalized thing and everyones perception will be different especially as it will smell different when mixed with individual body chemistry.

The biggest downside is it lasts less than thirty minutes on me.
summary: INHALE FAST BEFORE IT GOES AWAY

reviewText:
This is billed as a unisex scent but my first impression was of a decidedly masculine cologne, which I found very appealing.  However as it dried down, the woodsy notes fell away and the sweet black currant, plum and amber dominated.  The final fragrance was almost identical to a Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum I recently tried.  Not bad, but a disappointment compared to that brisk and promising first impression.

In terms of lasting power and sillage (how much the scent permeates the air around the wearer), I'd say it's not as powerful as I'd hoped for such a costly fragrance.  After two hours, the scent lingers but is extremely mild.

The appeal of the aroma is a matter of personal preference so that would not necessarily have effected my rating, but I think the fragrance itself could be a bit more powerful considering the price-tag which knocks this down to a middling three stars.

This is one of those perfumes that causes headaches for me. Thank goodness the other reviewers weren't kidding when they said the scent doesn't last! I sprayed it on and within an hour the scent was completely gone.
This is a very unisex scent that misses the mark - it's too masculine for a woman to wear and too feminine for a man to wear.
I have no idea how Oribe thinks it's a good idea to charge $95 for this. This isn't worth the price by any means. It absolutely does NOT smell like their hair products.
summary: If you can't try this before buying pass on it.

reviewText: Nice fragrance but no lasting power.

Gelatin like mask.  It really keeps your skin super moist.  The pinkish gelatin is quickly absorbed and forms a protective layer.  Light tinkling sensation when applying.  Do not wear this in the day time as it might cause sun spots.  use only at night when you won't be exposed to sunlight.
summary: Gelatin like mask. It really keeps your skin super moist

reviewText:
This Erno Laszlo Hydra-Therapy Memory Sleep Mask comes in a 1.35 fl.oz. jar but it should last a long time.  You just use a scant amount and only twice a week.  I was originally afraid that it would be a gloppy mess that would ruin my pillow cases but the product absorbed into my skin almost immediately.

The liquid mask comes with a tiny utensil that you use to take a small amount out of the jar for use.  You won't be contaminating your product with bare finger tips.  This is absolutely, positively the BEST hydrating product Ive ever found.  As far as Im concerned it lives up to every claim.

My skin is softer and a bit plumper and its noticeable almost from the first.  It has caused no irritation or redness.  I cant even balk at the price point as you use so little of the product and only 2X per week.  Im very impressed.

This review is for the Erno Laszlo Hydra-Therapy Memory Sleep Mask.

This is an overnight treatment designed for moisturizing while you sleep.  The Amazon description could be improved.  The product's official website explains a lot more.

For example, the product base is a NASA inspired memory gel, not a cream.  The product contains prickly pear, green ginger and mugwort extracts which are used for their moisture retention properties.  Winged kelp extract has omega 3-6-9 and helps to boost skins collagen and elastin.  You use this product twice a week, not nightly.

The factors important to me are:  does it cause any irritation or reaction?  does it provide the benefits claimed on the packaging and would I add it to my normal beauty ritual?

To factor one, the product did not cause any skin reactions for me and I have sensitive skin.  I tried it over a 7 day period.  The only notable difference was a slightly oily nose and cheek area which may not be attributable to this product; I don't know.

It does moisturize skin and I think it is a good booster for regular day cream applications.  Whatever is put on your skin is being absorbed into your system, so it is possible this is also beneficial on a lower level.  My skin does feel softer and more hydrated after using this product.  One thing I don't like is the scent - I wish this was unscented.

The price point is high but I would add this to my regular beauty regimen.  I used it Sunday and Thursday and I feel like the product kept my skin hydrated in between.

OK this is an AMAZING mask.  I have tried a lot of hydrating masks, lotions, overnight creams and NOTHING has done what this has done for my skin!  The consistency is not like a lotion or cream it's "bouncy" gel cream that's pink.  There is a very, very light scent and it goes on very smooth.  Not heavy at all.  I have sensitive skin and had zero reactions, which is a big deal for me.  It's hard finding products that don't give me some sort of reaction.

Waking up the next morning my skin literally feels smooth, soft & glowy!  This stuff is so GREAT.  It's pricey, but wow, the product works!  I'll have to save up to keep this one around.  Would HIGHLY recommend!

I've used this creme a few times and have seen noticeable improvement in my skin's texture and color. Dry patches are moisturized and damaged areas have reduced color.

A tiny dab goes a long way, so even though the price is quite high, you'll have the creme for a long time.

I was worried that this would feel uncomfortable while sleeping. It doesn't. What is bothersome is the scent. It's perfumed and it's not my favorite. Having a smell you don't love slathered all over your face for the night is inescapable. That said, the benefits out weigh the cost in this case.

I would give this product 6 stars if I could.  I have used it several times now and each time I wake in the morning with my face feeling so moisturized and smooth.  Love it!  Dry skin is one of my biggest issues and I can honestly say that is NOT an issue while using this product.
I use it right before bed in hopes of getting the most moisturizing effect while I sleep.
Don't ever stop selling this one please!

4 stars for so far so good and well see after a couple of weeks.

I am taken aback at the price of Erno Laszlo products, and that would definitely give me great pause in purchasing them with my tight budget, so I will be back to update after using the product several weeks to see if I notice any significant enough results to warrant this price: that written, its difficult to know what a product is doing at a cellular level. What I consider when deciding on whether to purchase or repurchase a facial product is: Does it make me/my skin feel good? Am I happy using it? Does it feel luxe? Is there just something about it I love? And so far all of those are a yes to this product (except the price - ouch!)

The Hydra-Therapy Memory Sleep Mask comes packaged nicelyin a sturdy pretty little box. The product is in a heavy jar: white with black lid and lettering; nice enough looking if you want to set it on your bathroom counter.

The product itself is a light pink and the scent is a bit rose-like. I am NOT a rose personI don't care for rose-scented products at all; however, this Enron Laszlo rose scent is quite pretty and subtle and doesnt over-power and I find I do like it. The look & texture surprised me at firstits not a cream but almost looks gel-like with an oily look/feel to it. I was worried it would be too oily on my face, but once I smoothed it on, I was not disappointed, for it soaked right into my skin.

There is a tiny spatula to dip out the product. You can fit the spatula under the lid on top of the cover to the product so you don't lose it or have to find a place to set it.

This sleep mask feels amazing going on! And I have tried a LOT of beauty product so Im picky, especially when a product charges as much as this company does. But my skin felt incredibly soft after smoothing this on. Once it was absorbed, I kept touching my skinit was that softand the next morning my skin still felt super soft. As for how it looked, thats too early to tell so Ill need to keep using it.

You only are to use this twice a week, so the product will last a good whilejust a little is needed to cover your face, throat, chest, or if you want it really to last just use on your face. That makes the $90 price tag a little easier to bear if you look at how often you use it and how little you need. I try to look at ounces and how much product is there and then consider the costfor example, one of my creams is $25-30 but its in a much smaller amount and its for daily use, so how many of those will I buy compared to this Erno Laszlo? That written, Erno Laszlo products are still pricey.

Im excited to try this out for longer, and so far am encouraged even if just for the luxe feel of it, how soft it made my skin, and the quality ingredients used. There is still the problem that after this product is gone, could I justify $90 in my strict budget?for that, it better give me some obvious results after a couple weeks of twice-weekly use!
summary: Luxe feel, incredibly soft skin! So far, so good!

reviewText: When this first arrived, I was a little taken aback by the heft and weight of the inner jar that the mask comes in. It has a really high-end feel that makes this feel like the luxurious product that this is. The mask itself is really unique, and it's a pink gel that has an almost spongy texture to it. Included in the box is a small black spatula, which is a nice touch so you don't have to dip your fingers into this and contaminate the product. While it does leave your skin moist and hydrated, the cost of this isn't worth it, in my mind. I've used other sleep masks (I especially love this one by La Roche-Posay: La Roche-Posay Hydraphase Intense Hyaluronic Acid Face Mask, 1.69 Fl. Oz.) that work just as well for much less.
summary: It has a really high-end feel that makes this feel like the luxurious product that this is

reviewerName: Gina Pera, Adult ADHD Expert and Author
reviewText:
First I had to look up "Guaiac Wood," as this is apparently the "top note" in this fragrance.

Apparently, this is is a small tree, also known as guayacan, whose wood has been used for centuries by Native Americans in treating various ailments. Apparently, it adds a "smokey note" and has "phenolic notes."

What "phenolic notes" means, I had no idea. Phenols are found naturally in foods (apples, bananas, oranges, cocoa), but they are also byproducts of fires and other combustions (burning tobacco, etc.). Some phenols are endocrine disruptors; some aren't.  This site can explain all the terms used in the world of fragrance:

http://perfumeshrine.blogspot.com/2012/02/definition-terpenic-phenolic.html

Now, on to what I do know -- that is, my very subjective reaction to the scent.

I wouldn't know exactly which citrus describes the top note -- lemon, lime, grapefruit, keffir lime, or bits of all four, with a bit of licorice thrown in. But it strikes me as definitely citrusy as the "top note" with grassy mid notes and smokey/woody bottom notes. Somewhere there is enough "sea note" to remind me of Acqua di Gio.

It's a nice solid container -- a navy-blue glass cube, with the side and back panels overlaid with red, white, and blackwith a spray. (I think I'd prefer a non-spray; easier to control.)

Anyway, for the last 30 years or so, I've been unable to tolerate commercial fragrances. Even the "top quality." I get sneezy, my throat closes, eyes itch, etc.  With other types of allergies (such as to our biohazard of a pine tree) somewhat resolved in recent years, I thought I could give the green light to my husband to again try wearing a bit of cologne without making me sick.  (Some types of fragrances gave him headaches, too, and no one wears cologne where he works, in a science lab, so it's not like going without has been a big imposition.)

So, I sprayed a bit of this LIVE fragrance on my shirt, as a test. I love the scent; it's very fresh and evocative of the outdoorsif a forest and citrus grove were situated at the ocean.

I sprayed it yesterday, and the scent is still in evidence this morning. So, there is "staying power."

Unfortunately, it wasn't long before I started feeling the physical effects. Not rancorous sneezing or eye-watering but more subtle nose stuffiness and "tight" throat. Not everyone will have this reaction, so it's not fair to downgrade the cologne for that. Still, I wonder why I largely don't have this reaction to good essential oils but I do to commercial fragrances.
summary: Imagine a forest and an orange grove, at the ocean

reviewText:
The packaging alone makes a beautiful gift. The scent in manly with hints a spice (I smelled cloves and cinnamon) and it is long-lasting. A little spritz goes a long way. I took off a star because the scent of cloves is not one of my favorites - reminds me of either the dentist (my grandfather, a dentist, used oil of cloves to treat gum problems, etc. or a holiday ham).

The bottle is a cobalt blue square with white accents - very blue white and red. Lacoste has always beeen associated with sports and the scent is sporty and fresh.
summary: Sporty & fresh scent with a hint of cloves and cinnamon

reviewText:
Bit on the musky side for my liking.

Full disclosure: I have an unnatural love for Acqua di Gio. Its citrusy notes make me so happy. I love sandalwood, jasmine, and orange. A bit of spicy fragrance is cool too. It's why I've loved Gio for so long. When I saw that this fragrance is in the citrusy side, I was happy to give it a shot. Also, bear in mind that I don't wear fragrance every day, because I enjoy cooking, and you don't want anything to interfere with the smell of the food.

According to the marketing notes for L!ve, it's meant to hit you with lime at the forefront, and then bring out green notes of leaves in the background. That's fine by me. Guess what I didn't get? Lime. Leaves. What I did get is this overwhelming musky smell, which I dislike. Axe body spray grosses me out. I hate the stuff, and damn near every teenage boy I know bathes in the stuff.

L!ve has a strong musk to it. The musk overpowers the citrus, the leaves, and the liquorice that was promised. That said! It does have a sweetness to the edges of the scent which is rather nice. There's also a ground note of earthiness rather than freshness. Why is this good? It covers the smell of sweat rather handily. Other fragrances, that tend towards the lighter, more airy side tend to clash with the natural scent of the body, and will be jarring. If you're one of those types that sweats a lot, L!ve is your jam. It's got serious staying power. One spray (AND NO MORE) is enough to last throughout the work day, and leave a little bit of lingering fragrance at the end of the day. Don't do more than one spray, or you'll be consumed by the scent. It's better to have it be subtle than something that people can smell before you show up.

Bear in mind that this is eau de toilette, which means that it's not going to be as strong as an eau de parfum. Generally, it'd mean that you'd need to put more on to get the effect. Not the case here. The fragrance is strong, and has plenty of staying power.

Why did I not rate this lower? Because it does grow on you over time. Throughout the day, I noticed that it mellowed out from the harsh muskiness that I got when I first put it on. And, as a product goes, it's not a bad product. It just doesn't live up to the promises it makes.

LaCoste LIVE eau de toilette for men is made in the United Kingdom. It arrives in a unique blue square bottle and smacks of class  packaged to serve as a gift. It is not very strong and can pass for an expensive aftershave.

It is fine with me that cologne begins firmly but fades as the day progresses. That way it does not repel those who dislike them all together. This fragrance will do just that. It invites a smile from others as I walk by.
summary: LaCoste LIVE - it smacks of class

reviewText:
This is a very nice clean, masculine fragrance. Despite being female, I've long preferred male or unisex fragrances because those marketed to females are often too sweet and flowery.

This one reminds me of Benetton's Colors divided by Axe. Axe is still my favorite, but this is one that I don't mind using. It's a little strong at first, but becomes more subtle as the day goes on.

As someone who appreciates good design, I also like the bottle's design. I'm not in love with the red, white, and blue color scheme (would have preferred earth colors or monochrome), but the square bottle design is cool.

This cutely packaged, square bottle cologne has a very after-shave scent quality. It's not revolutionary and will smell familiar to most men, without being overwhelming like so many of today's body sprays. It's soapy and spicy and I actually really liked it. It had sort of a retro Old Spice-Zest Clean scent to it that doesn't scream HE'S WEARING COLOGNE! Just light, cool and fresh and, to my nose anyway, altogether pleasant.

At two squirts in the morning, I liked that I could smell it on him if I was within hugging distance even at the end of the day, but not from across the room. Definitely something I'd be happy to have my husband wearing regularly. He said he liked it to, and actually got a few compliments throughout the day and I've noticed he's used it several times since. (And he's not someone who usually wears cologne outside of "special occasions.")

The high quality exterior packaging -- a square box with ribbon handles -- and the chunky, square bottle also make this imminently suitable for gift-giving; there's even a snow-covered mountain motif that could make it a really nice Christmas stocking stuffer.

Love it, love it, love it. Once I do my hair stays until next shampoo. I have very long and heavy hair. Have been using it for over 6 months and every time I do, I receive numerous compliments. First couple of times I used  my hair got caught and took me minute to untangle.

Sold by Amazon and Fulfilled by Amazon is how I purchased this Pro Nano Miracurl. I am certain the Miracurl I received is real and not a knock off.  It is well made and worked just as it should. I did not have any tangling and the machine would stop and refuse to wrap my hair if I tried to put too much in at a time. I am thrilled with it. I was able to put in big beautiful curls that would last until the next day. The steam is a must for my hair to get the curls tight and to set well. The only issue I had was with the temperature because the highest setting was too much for my hair. I scorched my hair a bit, but that was my fault since I know I have fine over processed  hair. The alternating curl setting really makes the curls look natural. I got lots of compliments on my hair during the holidays.

I received a blue Miracurl Steamtech unit sold by Beauty In Style and fulfilled by Amazon. The unit I received had a flocked roller bar and no plastic ends. I watched you tube videos and set to work. I have below-the-shoulder thin, fine hair. I had a difficult time doing the back of my head so hubby took over. I used the steam feature. The unit worked as described and my hair was curled. I suffered minor burns to my scalp however because my husband held the unit too close. I could feel the burning but only toward the end of the countdown & by the time we responded my scalp was already burned. The soreness from the burns went away after several days. I read later that the unit should be positioned at a minimum of one inch away from the scalp. The unit beeped during the countdown and sent out a fast beep when the countdown elapsed as stated in the directions.

I researched this product on Babyliss's website, which redirects visitors to the miracurlpro website.  One photo depicts a plastic end on the roller with two raised (embossed) circles while another photo shows a plain (perhaps flocked) end (see screen captures). The image with the circles on the plastic end cap has red hair while the plain end cap has blonde hair. I do not know why there is a disparity in images of what an end cap should look like for an authentic Babyliss Miracurl product. Also, there is no mention or image of any other color except blue for this item as another reviewer stated.
summary: Not for me - fine, thin, long hair - takes forever to complete entire head - results are not worth the effort

reviewText:
*********UPDATE *********
So I've had this hair curler for 1.5 years now.  Honestly, after the first 3 weeks, I stopped using it.  Not because it was heavy.  Not because I was worried about damaging my hair. But because people told me my hair looked TERRIBLE!  The curls don't come out natural looking.  Yeah, they're curly, but there's a weird kink where your hair goes from straight-to-curly.  I wanted the entire length of hair to be curly so I used it as close as possible to my scalp as all the instructions/tutorials said.  It still leaves a weird straight area (about 1.5-2" from your scalp) and then this weird crinkly curl starts.  It's not a round big bouncy soft curl.  It's a tight, kinked, krinkly, uneven curl that looks lifeless.  I was so excited that a curl actually would *stay* in my hair...but the "curl" is so ugly that it's not worth it.

I'm sticking with hot rollers and big barrel curling irons from now on.  If anybody wants to buy this from me, I'll sell this to you cheap.  Only used for 3 weeks. So sad that I spent so much on something I used for 3 weeks. :(

I got mine and checked it against online tutorials teaching people how to decide if it's real or fake. I think mine is real. It works well but I realize that your hair has to be really dry for the curls to be actually curly. I had taken a shower and let my hair air dry for a day. I figured that was okay, but it's hot and humid right now and I noticed my "curls" (using the highest heat setting and the longest set time) were limp. I had to dry my hair with a blower dryer and then try again - then it worked quite well!

One thing I noticed is that the babyliss miracurl steamtech I got had a grey felt patch at the center of the curling mechanism (whereas online, it shows a plastic circle with concentric rings on it). I think the computer generated image online (even at the babyliss website) has the concentric circles whereas most people who have posted pics of their real babyliss (bought from verified sellers) have the grey felt. So just wanted to mention that in case people were worried.

I have stick straight Asian curl that got two perms over two weeks and still was straight afterwards. Seriously! I curled my hair about 4 hours ago and the curl is still there and looking great despite it being crazy humid and hot! This thing is awesome! (Though I really hope I'm not damaging my hair with the heat!)

reviewText: After doing lots of research I finally ordered this.  I was nervous that I would not get an authentic product but this is good and the real deal.  It comes with booklet, cleaner, and an extra steam cartilage.  I ordered the one with steam. I haven't used the steam feature and I don't think I need to. I wanted loose curls so I used the low setting and 8 seconds.  I sectioned my hair and when I came to front I switched from alternate setting to where it's away from my face. I had to use my hands and open curls up a bit and used some argon oil too.  Overall it's a great product and it does exactly what it says.  If you are good with curling rod then you don't need this.  My curls lasted for 3 days.  I only got my hair stuck in once and that's because I put too much hair and didn't comb and smooth it out first.  You should read instruction book and lots of u tube tutorials on this.  Happy curling

This beard oil is consistent with what I've come to expect from the company.  It has an excellent lime scent and keeps your facial hair soft.  I found it to help control dry skin on my face, too. reviewText: This is a very pleasant-smelling beard oil. I love the smell of lime (I'm a big Margarita fan) so this seems made for me. This Proraso oil is distinctly, yet subtly masculine. Highly recommended.

reviewText:
This is a review of Proraso Azur Lime Beard Oil.

I do not have a beard but use this as a shave oil. It works great. If you don't want to use it as a shave oil, it also works well as a pre-shave oil. Either way it has a really nice lime scent that has an old-school kind of scent like a traditional barber shop might leave you with after getting a shave.

I really like this oil. I wash and leave my face wet, then squirt about 10 drops of the oil into my hands and apply it to my face. Immediately begin shaving with my single blade shaver and re-wet my face with water if necessary. That's the secret to using this as a shave oil... don't use more oil, just splash your face with a little more water. It's a close shave and your left with a clean scent and the oil makes your skin smoother and conditioned. Great stuff!

reviewText:
Full disclosure. I don't currently have a beard. I do have skin and facial hair though, and this is a very soothing, pleasant smelling oil combo. It feels good going on and my wife likes the fragrance. Reading up on oils - all of the ones included are good for both skin and hair. I may grow some facial hair to fully test this, but as things stand now, it works well. I can see it being a boon to those with a goatee or full beard, but it also works as an after shaving soother or bed time application.

I sometimes think the whole beard fad was started for companies to make some money. While that isn't a bad thing, it is skewed by marketing. However, I feel this petite bottle is a little pricey for what you get.

~ Kort

reviewText: I like this beard oil, it softens and tames my beard and has a pleasant scent that isn't overpowering.  I also like that it doesn't make my beard feel greasy or weighed down. I only use about a dime size amount once a day so the bottle will last me a while.

I love the smell, it's like cedar, and eucalyptus, and a bit of citrusy lemon.  It's a exotic wood and freshness.  It is masculine, but appealing enough I'd consider it unisex.
The oils are very effective - sunflower, walnut, avocado, macadamia nut- and a bit of Vitamin E. These are classic oils that are so effective for keeping hair in good shape so that it doesn't break, is easier to tame, and has good shine.
The dropper is great for measuring out the small tiny amounts that a beard needs.  It only takes my son a couple of drops for his beard, which is full, but not long.  It adds a beautiful shine and helps the hair lay flat.  He likes it.  I like that it comes in a dark amber bottle, because he will grow a beard for a while then shave it- the amber bottle will keep the oils ready for use during the times he chooses not to have a beard.
If you find your beard looks oily, cut back on the amount you use, and apply it when the beard is wet, like right out of the shower or after washing your face.  In the right amounts, this oil will not make any hair look oily, only shiny and more smooth.
summary: Beautiful exotic wood smell, and nice oils, with Vitamin E - adds shine and smoothness, only takes a drop or two

reviewText: Great little product.  After a week of use, beard is softer and feels thicker with less knots. A great beard oil for anyone!

This beard oil gives a nice sheen to my beard. It lasts most of the day without drying out. It also makes the skin feel nice. I also appreciate the included dropper for easy application. I've dinged it one star because it has a slightly medicinal odor probably caused by the eucalyptus ingredient. Other than that I can whole heartedly recommend this oil.

Update October 2017:  Not changing my review or star rating but just adding that over a short time (1-2 mos.) the squeeze top of the dropper turned rock hard making it impossible to get any oil out without just removing the dropper and pouring the stuff in your hand.

reviewText: This oil effectively tames and softens facial hair. The dropper is convenient and a few drops more than suffice. The aroma is unique. There is a strong sweet musky tone as well as crisper notes of pine, cedar, menthol  an eucalyptus. It is masculine and vaguely medicinal but not unpleasant. Use judiciously because it can overwhelm and it does linger. Even though formulated with oils, it does not make hair look or feel greasy. It is a good product if somewhat strongly fragranced.

Awesome oil. It leaves my facial hair and skin feeling noticeably softer and soothed. It is neither greasy nor sticky, and smells great too. Sort of a masculine, musky and woodsy scent that tends to linger a bit but not obnoxious. I had never tried a beard oil before and I'm glad that I did. I'm really impressed. Definitely give it a try.

reviewText: My boyfriend loves it! I also love it! It totally softens his facial hair and also leaves a very soothing and sexy smell. He said it also made his skin softer, too.

reviewText: Like their shaving cream, this product is excellent--great smell, great feel, and great ease of use. All of that adds up to great value. I have made Proraso my regular shaving regimen (these days, that's just my neck and a little trimming) and plan on being a regular customer.

My beard feels amazing after using this beard oil. What more do you need to know?

Pros:

Goes on easily. Use the dropper to extract an amount, apply to a wet beard (right after a shower), and you're done.

I don't notice much of a smell. I see a lot of reviewers complaining, but all I get is a faint oily smell of musk and eucalyptus. I'm used to Nivea For Men's sensitive aftershave balm, which is very nonconfrontational so far as scents go, and I'd say the Nivea smells much more than this beard oil.

Cons:

None so far.

Overall, my beard feels wonderful. Get some.

Beard oils serve basically two purposes.

One is to soften, condition, smooth down errant hairs, and essentially tame your beard. They are imperative for larger beards, but they also work well to soften smaller beards and make them less scratchy.

The other is to smell nice, like a cologne for your beard. The normal smells are musky, outdoor, woodsy, manly scents, as you could probably guess. I have one that has a rum smell for those of you who want to smell more like a pirate. Or a homeless person. I guess there is a fine line there.

This one works well on both counts, though the smell is obviously very subjective. The price is very, very reasonable on this product, so trying it out won't cost you much. There is an eyedropper in the bottle, and a couple of drops is really all you need, even for larger beards. Members of ZZ Top will need more.

If you decide you like the smell, I recommend getting a trusted friend without a beard (you know, a woman) to give you their opinion on it as well. If you both like it, add it to your beard-taming arsenal. If not? Well, it wasn't too expensive. And the dog is pretty hairy...

Recommended.

Sean Logue, 2016

I had to regrow my beard in preparation for this conditioner. I usually only keep mine during the winter, but this was a good opportunity to try growing a tamer version in the summer. I have many other Proraso products and they're all very excellent; I expected to feel the same with this, and I was.

So my beard grew only about a little over an inch by the time I started using this. Usually my beard grows thick and curly in the summer, and this time it was thick and stubby with a little curl forming at the ends. I applied this as directed and was rushed by the pleasant smell. I usually let it sit for an hour before the results fully kick in, and do they ever. Even at the less-than-inch beard I have I can tell that my hairs are far softer and less churlish to the touch. I can finally rub my beard against my wife's face when going in for a smooch without being told it's scratchy. I might even let my beard continue to grow despite the crude Chicago summer weather.

Good stuff.  My beard has a definite tendency to get dry as does the skin underneath.  That can make for an itchy uncomfortable situation.  A few drops of this massaged into a damp beard and voila!  Beard stays much softer, skin is moisturized and it leaves a great woodsy fragrance behind for a bit.  This is a really good product.

My husband has been using Proraso's shaving cream for about four years and absolutely loves it, so I thought I'd pick up this beard oil for my younger brother, who has a thick, hipsterish beard.  He loves it!

Although the recommended amount to use is a dime-sized amount, that is a bit too much if you have finer hair.  His suggestion is to use a small amount, and then add more if you need it.

The dropper on this is also easy to use, and makes dispensing the product easy.

It does have a strong menthol scent to it, and it does linger all day.  Just be aware of that if you're sensitive to strong smells.

All of the oils in this are also so good for your skin and hair, and it creates a nice sheen.  It's another great Proraso product!
summary: Has a strong scent, but leaves your beard really soft

reviewText:
Confession: I wash my beard regularly. I scrub my skin, occasionally moisturize, and brush daily. So I was excited by the prospect of a beard oil tincture that promised to make my beard soft, smooth, and manageable. I would say by purported claims alone, the product is successful. My beard is tamer, softer, and looks better.

My issue is with the "side effects".  There are two.

1. Smell. The oil has a distinctive odor and it lingers all day. I've experimented with not applying to my moustache area but the smell persists, wafting up my nose. I thought I would get used to it, but it's kind of annoying and sickeningly sweet. Given its proximity to my nose, I was hoping for something a little more subtle. My advice is to use a single drop rather than a dime-sized amount.  Even then, the smell is powerful and persistent.

2. Flyaways. After a good brushing, my beard usually holds fast. After using the PBO I had a lot of stray hairs popping up in my field of vision. I thought it might be related to humidity or some other factor, but it's happened consistently now and I wonder if the oil somehow inspires my beard to take on a life of its own.

Take my comments with a grain of salt; I've got unruly curly hair (including a curly beard), and my sense of smell is perhaps more sensitive than others, or maybe you choose to wear a lot of fragrance that might mask or overpower the oil's scent. While it might work better for others, I'm on the fence about the pros and cons of this product.

fashion styles come and go, and trendy is a term applied to those who can generally ill afford to follow... but there are products that can be helpful, especially health and beauty products for men (who generally don't use much as a rule; and we're speaking of average men, not urban cowboys)

this is a men's product, made for men, and made to help men who wear facial hair proudly... even us aging men with beards and goatees can benefit from using this product - especially older men, whose skin tends to dry out more rapidly and who benefit from moisturizing - a concept rarely practiced at an early age unless afflicted with a dermatological condition

although labeled 'beard oil,' this product mainly benefits the skin beneath the beard (although it does help the hair and follicles)

the smell is manly, a cedar and 'cistus' (i think the Italian translator screwed up on the packaging text and really meant 'citrus') blend that can also supplant a light cologne or aftershave

while beard oil was commercially popular in the pre-Depression era in America, its time has come again - men are being men again, and wearing beards - this means your face and the skin under the beard on your face needs a bit more attention...

treat it right - use this beard oil - it's great stuff...

but Proraso - fix the typo on the packaging - and as a consumer, i'm glad to see that you sell this product with a safety seal - good job!
summary: Citrus, not 'cistus' but a great oil!

reviewText: I've used a variety of different beard oils, from small, locally produced ones, to national brand ones.  Most of them all work the same, and they all generally smell the same.
