When my hair is past my neck it needs help with volume because it doesn't matter what styling gel I use it flattens out to super straight.  but now that my hair is short, I wasn't sure how I was going to test out this brush.  I usually just blast it with a blow dryer for about 3 minutes and the slight wave and cowlicks are tamed.  Hairstyle achieved.

But I was surprised to find that even short hair like mine could benefit from this brush.  I used the brush on damp hair to creat a cute little hair flip.  The next day, I styled it against the part and then combed it back for maximum  volume to create a puffier, glamour look.

I wouldn't say the styling options are endless, the  longest part of my hair is about a 1/4 inch past my earlobe, so it's limited.  But I like how sleek and shiny my hair looks after using this brush, even if I haven't conditioned my hair for weeks it looks glossy and mirrorlike.

Also worth noting is the cord.  My last two styling brushes had wear on the cord, they broke down and had to be tossed out way earlier than I would like.  But this styling brush has a hardened cover over the first couple of inches of cord, right where the cord gets the most wear and tear.  Problem solved.  I think this styling brush, just based on the cord alone could last several years.

This FHI Thermal Styling Brush is basically like using a warm brush. It does not get hot enough to make your hair stay in the desired style. The wand says it goes up to 400 degrees but it doesn't get nearly that hot. Maybe wit ha ton of product this styling brush would work, but who wants to put that much stuff in their hair?

I do have straight hair, it's not overly thick. There is a bit of a learning curve to using it, as other reviewers have said. I also had my 13 yr old, who has very thick straight her, try to use it and she had the same complaints as I do. It just doesn't get hot enough to curl or add even much wave to our hair. At this price point, I expect better results.

Overall it's an excellent tool. It doesnt work so well on thicker hair but my hair is pretty fine and it makes it really easy to style my hair. The temperature controls are good and i like the little travel case it comes in and the auto shut off feature. It is a little awkward to use and i didn't get great results but with practice, and watching a lot of the tutorial videos, Im getting a lot better.

I don't like straightening irons as I feel they are too damaging to my hair.  This thermal brush works much better for straightening out the wave I have under my otherwise pin straight hair.  Basically for some reason, at the back of my head, closer towards my neck, the hair under my straight hair is wavy.  What this does is create a messy, poofy look for what would otherwise be hair very much like most Asian woman's.  My hair is also extremely long, so again, I don't want to damage it.  I use this on the low setting to get the wave out.  I don't use it all of the time, only when I want to look my best.  Overall I'm very happy with the results.

If you have fine hair, you know that even a professional layered cut can only help so much with giving your hair lift and body. For every inch of length below your shoulders, you're looking at extra time with product, a ventilated brush, and a blow dryer.

Ive never really been able to master that technique, and often find myself getting frustrated and pulling my hair back into a ponytail or French braid on hectic mornings. Every so often, I think about how much more body my hair has when its short, but I just don't want to give up the length.

Thats why I was so curious to try the Stylus. While watching videos showing the wand in use, I was reminded of those hybrid curling irons that had brush-type spikes that were popular but never really made my hair look good. But with this brush's wider, more oval shape, people using the Stylus were able to produce larger, more natural waves rather than the ringlets I remembered.

My major concerns were whether I would be able to get acceptable results on my own, how long they would last, and how much heat exposure my hair would have to take. The short answer is that after faithful practice, I am able to add volume and a gentle body wave to my hair, and that the wave lasts all day. With a tighter twist, I have been able to set curves at the ends that linger into the next day  with little or no  product!

The following information is really detailed, but this tool is a pretty big investment. I have tried to think of questions you might have, and to answer them and the questions I had before receiving the Stylus and while I was teaching myself how to use it.

TEMPERATURE: The Stylus has five heat settings, ranging from 250 to 400 degrees Fahrenheit. You choose what temperature to use based on how thick your strands of hair are and whether they're straight, wavy or curly. I practiced with 250 degrees but now that I am comfortable with the brush, I use the 285-degree setting. The temperature indicators are easy to read, and the wand heats up in less than 2 minutes. It seems to maintain a steady temperature during use. I unplug it when Im done, but it does have a one-hour auto-shutoff (I timed the unit several times, and it shut off reliably).

USAGE and TECHNIQUE: The styling brush comes with a small information booklet that includes instructions for building volume, making flips and waves, and smoothing your hair. While the steps are clearly explained, I found FHIs brief videos to be much more helpful, because I could see how to hold the brush, slowly pull it through a section of hair, and be sure to maintain enough tension on the section of hair. While my first couple of tries didn't look like the video results, I now can get similar body and wave.

Working with longer hair, the most challenging parts of using this brush are keeping the section of hair you are styling seated in the center of the bristles, and making sure that the hair wraps around the brush and into the grooves of the back without doubling up on itself when you pull the wand away from your scalp.

HAIR CARE: As mentioned, my hair stays fuller all day. I am not a fan of heavy leave-in product, but do apply a scant amount of Its a 10 leave-in mist with keratin after I am done with the Stylus. Note that the product packaging warns you to use this brush only on dry hair.  I have not had any issues with drying, brittleness, breakage or split ends, but my hair is not processed or treated.

The longest sections of my hair reach the middle of my back (almost 18 inches from crown to ends), so I had to practice for about a week before I got dependable results. But I am now able to work through sections of my hair and add volume near my scalp and gentle waves down the length of my hair pretty quickly. The key is to go slowly and keep steady tension on the section of hair you're working with  and then to give it a quick molding with your palm and leave it alone until it has fully cooled.

THE BRUSH. The Stylus itself is easy to hold.  You use the power button to turn it on and to choose the heat setting you want. The handle is rounded and has a grippy matte finish, so its easy to control. The swivel mount for the cord at the base of the handle is easy to keep away from your arm and hair. The electrical cord itself is thick and yet flexible, so it doesnt hang you up while you are working.

The brush area is 4 inches long by about 1-3/4 inches wide by about 1-1/2 inches thick. The base is roughly oval, rather than cylindrical. I found this a lot easier to work with than either my round heat brush or my memories of my old heated brush wand. The flexible part of the cord is about 8-1/2 feet long, not counting the reinforced swivel base or the plug.

STORAGE: The Stylus comes with a heat-resistant pouch. The main section is long enough to hold the brush, and has a fold-over lid that has a Velcro-type fastener. An outer pocket holds the coiled electrical cord, which has its own Velcro-type keeper loop that you wrap around the bundled cord.

VALUE: This unit is about the price of a midrange blow dryer, a styling brush, and either a midrange flatiron or curling iron combined. So while you cannot use it to dry your hair, it can be used to provide a similar variety of styles as those other tools. As noted, with practice I found it easier to use than those other tools, and got longer-lasting results, so I rate it as providing a similar value if you add up the prices of those other tools.

However, I am docking a star for the steep cost to customers who need to use the one-year warranty. That fee is currently about one-third the price of the unit, and covers handling and return postage (you also have to pay shipping and any tracking or insurance to send off the unit, and must call a toll-free line to request a return-authorization number).
summary: Solves the Length vs. Body Battle

reviewText:
I have very fine hair, but a lot of them. As such, my hair tends to be frizzy when not covered in some kind of smoothing lotion or or flat ironed. I have a small flat iron that I use on occasion to make my hair soft and shiny. A lot of the other time I simply slather on smoothing lotion or other product or choose to tie it up somehow.

I am not a hair expert and really don't enjoy spending too much time with styling products and devices. However, this one seemed very easy to use and I wasn't wrong. I started with freshly washed, dry hair. It is shoulder length. I pinned up half and put the brush temperature on 350. I took sections and brushed in an upward motion starting as close to the scalp as possible. In 10 minutes, my entire head was smoother and my hair more full looking. I used the brush to give a small curl at the bottoms and around my face.

This Styling Brush is easy to use. I plugged it in, pressed the button until I reached the desired temperature. I waited for the lights to stop flashing, which meant it was fully heated (it was approx. 2-3 minutes from cold to hot.) I also enjoy that it comes with a velcro wrap to keep the cord managed and a heat resistant storage pocket with closure for travel.

If you have coarse or very curly hair, I am not sure if this would be the appliance for you. It worked on my hair because each hair is very fine, although I have a lot. I also wouldn't recommend to anyone looking for tight curls or big defined curls. This is great for smoothing, light waves at the end of the hair and adding some volume from the roots.
summary: Great for quick touch ups and smoothing!

reviewText:
Having South Asian hair which is a bit thick and stubborn - the thermal styling brush came as a blessing.

Typical straightening technique which I have used for a long time is hair sprays (tend to give me headaches) and was using some styling oils a few years back.  All of these are messy, time consuming, but with this I can style my hair any way I want.

Few other things :
 * Never got my hair stuck in this even ones - very smooth gliding
 * Bit heavier than others that have used, but more versatile than a simple hair curler
 * Very well built and very safe

This styling brush is, I'm guessing, a much more effective tool in the hands of a professional stylist than in my hands, but with practice, I am handling it better for last-minute polishing of my hair. It's not a flat iron. It's more like a regular brush with heat to give you waves or curls, if you're starting with straight hair; volume, if your hair is flat or somewhat straighter hair, if you have curls you'd like to smooth. Be careful how you handle this tool, because it get hot.

I like that it's easy to regular the temperature. My advice is to start with the lower temperature, see if your hair responds, and only turn up the heat if necessary.

It's has temperature control with click and on and off control with plugging and unplugging the outlet cord. The heat resonates from black metal strips that are vertical and pointy brush is made of heat resistant plastic that provides protection against touching directly to skin or scalp. Within 30 seconds the styling brush was at 250F after turned on. The rear plastic guard and how the styling brush is constructed provided ample protection against surface it is going to rest on which I prefer it to be slightly damp towel to rest on. The styling brush has last strip of metal exposed and there is no plastic guard at the end which would advantage provide the smooth finish on the hair's end but it also leaves some heat element directly touching the scalp or face tissue. Heat at 250F is not strong enough to make a quick burn of skin but, at 400F for thicker curly hair to straighten out it would be something to watch out for. Definitely not a toy for a child to play with. Ethnic hair needs higher temperature to straighten with thermal hair styling brush, however, I advise slowly building up the temperature to prevent skin burning and never directly use it on a dry hair as it would singe the hair strands. Always use a thermal protection spray on the hair prior to using the thermal styling brush. Thermal brush works in theory that hair will be manageable when wet and hold a form with hair spray and thermal shaping of protein strands as it dries and when surface is flattened with thermal brush it retains this sheen of light as hair forms a flat surface that is part of styling. I never knew my studying cosmetology would come in handy on reviewing a thermal styling brush. Safety is very well thought-out and construction is well made. Design is good and safe for home and professional use. Most of the time, thermal wands is best when heat can be controlled easily and this provides easy to tell and control setting to keep the temperature for hair styling. If the temperature goes out of control, please replace it and recycle the electronics properly and stay away from completely soaked or wet hair and don't spray directly into the wand with any styling spray for hold. Only spritz of spray will hold most hair style. This styling brush has to wrap once entirely around the brush in order to prevent heat related burn to skin or scalp for styling. Don't use it on a short hair that is not long enough to wrap once around the brush.
summary: Good design and temperature control. Electric instead of heating coil based for easy styling of medium to long hair

reviewText:
I had low expectations. In fact, I balked at the price point for what it is. But, I stand wholly corrected. This is the be all end all hot tool for me. It handles my thick, yet fragile, hair with ease. I rarely have any tangles while using it and it's really sped up my morning routine. I used to hot roll, or brush everything into a pony tail. While I still love and need my hot rollers, this saves the day on days I need just a fast smoothing, or quick waves. The set is long lasting, and it hasn't left my hair dry or damaged.
I love the easy simple button operation, and that it heats up ridiculously fast. Seriously, this thing has changed my hair game for the better.
Highly 100% recommend. This is amazing.
summary: Hairy up and do your hair!

reviewText: Who needs a hairdresser when you have this 'magic' brush to do your hair!!  You can turn curs into straight if this is your style for the day...should you want curls, you get curls with this fantabulous thermal brush...it works very well on short hair and long hair to give you the perfect style you want for any give time.  Thick or thin hair you will soon learn the temperature need for the style you want...the brush/straightener is light and easy to handle..actually the handle is ergonomically structure for comfort.  My brush is black in color but it also comes in red.  Get your brush at the best price and fast shipping from AMAZON...mine came from AMAZON>
summary: FHI BRANDS Stylus Thermal Styling Brush

reviewText:
This thermal brush simply works......with a few caveats.

For most hair this brush will work and probably work great.  However, if you have really thick hair, your results may be not as good as those with thin hair might obtain.  This has been the experience in our household of three girls.  If you have thicker hair, I recommend allowing for more time to work with the brush. In our experience, the brush does provide volume and the volume seems to stay in place in most conditions.

The brush itself is constructed very well and comes very securely packed.  It includes a storage/travel pouch that is better than most.  Instructions are also included of course.  The brush heats very quickly and the settings are easy to use.
summary: For most hair this brush will work and probably work great. However

reviewText: I got this for my wife who has had a constant struggle with her curling rotating styler and minor (and not so minor) burns. I thought this styling brush would be more helpful for her and easier to use, so I took a shot. Well, it turns out she loves it. She said it is so easy for her and her hair does not get stuck....and......NO BURNS! That was a huge plus for her. She uses it exclusively now and I am a hero (since I got her "the burner" as she calls it). Her hair looks great and styled like she went to the salon. She reports that it does not dry her hair out either and is much easier to use.

At the outset, I suggest looking at the numerous videos on YouTube or at FHI's website (search for FHI Stylus or FHIBrands dot com) for pointers on how to use this styling brush.  This styling brush does a lot of things well, and some things not quite as well.  If you are looking for big waves and flattening or controlling small sections of hair, this tool is great.  If you are looking for a straightener for lots of hair or a curling iron to make tight curls, other tools will probably work better.  However, if you are looking for a single tool that will do just about everything except for small tight curls, this tool is the one to get.

For big waves and big curls, this device is great.  The brush is light and the temperature settings are easy to use.  The settings are approximate for each type of hair.  The easiest way to figure out the temperature to use is to start with a setting lower than you think you need, and see how well that temperature works.  Overheating hair is generally not a good idea, and can damage hair, so easing into a temperature setting from the low side is better than going past the optimal temperature.

The brush heats up quickly.  Most of the ceramic areas heater areas have bristles to minimize the chance of burning hands and fingers, but the edges of the brush can get warm.  I am always careful around heated styling tools, though the hottest areas on this brush are difficult to reach.

Use the brush on a section of hair at a time.  The size of the section matters and changes the ultimate effect.  Experiment with different size sections and different curling techniques (wrapping the hair clockwise or counterclockwise, wrapping hair around the brush completely vs. a sweeping brush stroke, etc.) to see how your hair reacts.  Also consider using a spray to help hold the curls.  You can use this styling brush as a straightener, but a dedicated straightener might be simpler to use, though the temperature control on this brush is better than many, and probably most straighteners.

This styling brush has lots of other features, including a no-slip handle, and textured edge areas to help slide through hair.  The brush powers off automatically after an hour for safety.  The brush comes with a thermal bag to permit transporting an iron shortly after use, so you can throw this brush in a suitcase without waiting for it to cool completely.

As a single all-purpose styling tool, this particular tool does most things well and easily replaces up to three different tools.  The tool is light weight and easy to handle.  The tool looks good too.  Though it would be unusual to impress friends with a styling tool, it might be possible with this one.

Enjoy!
summary: A good multi-purpose styling tool with lots of features

reviewText:
This is my new favorite for styling my short hair. The flat iron is a bit to maneuver for me, and since I have to get very close to my scalp (I have a short Mohawk, maybe 3-4 inches long), it is tricky to get the comb in to ensure the strands aren't in a mess when I get the iron on them, but I don't have much wiggle room for both the comb and the iron. Meanwhile, a hair dryer can only do so much for frizzy curly bits.

Enter this little gadget!

There are several heat settings, which is great, since thickness, texture, and desired style all affect how much you need. The grip is comfortable, and it is easy to use. I did burn myself a bit by touching the outside edges of the comb part a couple of times, but my face and head never got burned, so all in all, it was a win in that department. I was trying to straighten some spots, and it did pretty well. Not quite as effective as the iron or blow dryer, but less of a hassle. At the end of the day, I'm low-maintenance, so I got what I wanted.
summary: Versatile and easy to use--watch out for the edge

reviewText:
I am in love with this Thermal Styling Brush!

First thoughts - IT WAS SO EASY.

My hair is thick and it usually takes a good fifteen to thirty minutes to flatten, curl, tame my hair. It leans to the body/frizzy side of the spectrum, so I like to flatten it, if I'm going out for something special I will curl it.

I ran this baby through my hair and did some quick flips and tugs and I had hair with a bit of body, which was sleek but not flat to my head, which is what flat irons usually do to my hair.

Again my hair is thick, very thick actually, but fine. Worked fine for me. All I had to do was run it through my hair and turn it in a C for the ends to have a bit of curl.

Highly impressed and I'm set on NO MORE PONY-TAIL days!

I like this Thermal styling brush, but it doesn't get as hot as my straightener. Even when I put it on the highest setting, it still seemed like it wasn't hot enough to do my hair right. It is very light weight, and is very easy to use. It doesn't make my wrist hurt like other things I use, like my hair dryer. So there are some good points to this styling brush. It's quick and easy to use, but I was looking for more of a smooth finish to the bottom of my hair.

It curls my hair great, but I was looking for more of a salon look, and I didn't get that with my hair. I have thin frizzy hair, so I wanted to straighten it and curl the bottom. I watched several videos, so I know I was doing it right. I will keep this for the times that I want to add a little curl in my hair.

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText:
I like light, floral perfumes, and this one is both.  It also smells fruity just as much as floral to me,  My nose is not discerning enough to identify the predominant scent, but it is nice very pleasant.  For my nose, it is just a touch too "sweet" but my husband really likes it on me.

It doesn't last all day for me, but it also doesn't dissipate too soon.  I'd classify it as about medium as far as its lasting ability once it is sprayed on.  I use a spritz near my throat and one on my wrist, then rubbed to my other wrist, and that seems about right.  Hubby thinks I smell good and no one else has commented or complained.  I don't want a scent that warns people I'm entering a room before I get there!

The larger bottle is pretty and classy, and the spray worked well for me.  I love this particular set that comes with two purse-sized little spray bottles.  tiny enough for your purse, but even more important to me, small enough for my carry-on luggage when I fly.

This is a really nice scent especially for summer when I want something a bit lighter than I do in winter, but that is a matter of personal taste.

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText: This is a very pleasant, light scent that smells a little like a really clean beachy smell.  A spray or two is enough to last throughout the day- any more than that and it might be overpowering for the first couple of hours.  The smaller purse-sized sprays are convenient for bringing with you when the fragrance becomes too light.  The box that this particular product comes in is beautiful in itself and this makes a really nice Christmas present overall.  The bottles are even pretty!
summary: A great Christmas gift; pleasant, clean smell

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText: I ordered this for my wife, who generally doesn't like floral perfume.  I wasn't sure she would like this but thought if she didn't I would give to someone else.  So far she does like the perfume, which is a surprise.  I like the smell of the perfume and think it smells good on her.  I don't find the smell overpowering and so far she hasn't complained about a strong floral smell.  The whole package itself would make a very nice gift set.  The packaging is very nice, and it comes with one larger bottle (3.0 oz) and two purse size travel bottles.  The Burberry is not a cheap perfume but not many are and this particular brand and perfume I think are worth the price.  The smell is nice, and the packaging and bottles are of nice quality.
summary: Nice fragrance in an appealing package and bottle

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText:
This is a totally beautiful scent.

A lasting light fragrance that does not reek floral but feminine and classy.

I have enjoyed Burberry Brit for many years and this is another unique addition to their line of fragrances.

Whenever I wear either fragrance, I feel embraced in a subtle scent surrounding me.

This is also generating lovely compliments.
summary: Simply beautiful fragrance...and so worth the price!

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText:
Burberry Brit Rhythm Floral for Her is okay. I don't love the scent, and I love floral-scented perfumes and oils. It didn't last the whole day, that I noticed on myself, and no one I asked seemed to think I smelled awesome. If you are a fan of the scent, the large bottle and 2 small purse sprays will keep you happy.
I did like that all three bottles were spray delivery; however, the caps were impossible to remove and I nearly broke each one trying to open them. I twisted in both directions, pulled, pried, and generally got frustrated. I finally removed them, but for such an expensive product I would imagine a higher quality bottle, cap, and spray assembly.

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText: I was honestly skeptical when I ordered this fragrance because it is listed as floral scent.  I usually choose fragrances which are more fruity or spicy.  However, I was pleasantly surprised to find this more of a fresh fragrance with a slight fruity undertone.  I wore it today and got three compliments throughout the day.  I had a hair appointment at 4:00PM, and my stylist noticed I was wearing a different scent.  I was very impressed since I had applied the fragrance at about 9:00AM this morning, and she was still able to distinguish the scent at 4:00PM this afternoon.  Her comment was, "I like your new scent.  It smells fresh."  Since she smells many different people's fragrances throughout the day, her unsolicited "review" of this fragrance very well received.  I really believe this is a scent most people will like.  This particular set is nicely gift boxed and comes with one full-sized 3.0 ounce EDT spray and two .25 ounce EDT "purse sprays," which makes it great for gift-giving.  Personally, I am going to keep one "purse spray" in my handbag, and the other in my overnight bag where I always keep toiletries packed and ready for my next trip.
summary: A fresh fragrance with a slight fruity undertone.

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText: Burberry Brit Rhythm Floral is a light floral, fruity scent.  To me, the scent is more fruity than floral and reminds me a lot of Ralph Lauren's Blue (not sure if they still make that).  It is vibrant and light.  I am very sensitive to smell and it was not overpowering at all.  I did find myself sneezing a bit, so I would not recommend if scents tend to trigger your allergies.  This set includes the larger bottle plus two smaller sizes for your purse or gym bag.  I don't find that the scent lasts all day so it is nice to have a smaller bottle for a pick me up in the afternoon.  The box that it came in is very nice and it would make an impressive gift as well.  Overall I am very pleased with the scent.

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText:
Burberry Brit Rhythm Floral is now my favorite woman's scent. This eau de toilette is a sophisticated and complex fragrance that is playful and sensual at the same time. I have found other Burberry scents to be pretty powerful at first, but this one is not the same. It goes on and becomes sultry right away. It is a perfect scent for a night out or a date night! Actually, it's great any time. :)

The bottle is really cute, and the set comes with two rollerball tubes that she can keep in her purse. When she opened the case, I was surprised that her excitement was for the purse sprays. She said she loves them and they are her favorite....unfortunately, she thought they were rollerballs. HOWEVER, she tried it, and loved it. The fragrance lasts several hours....and you get a lot, so this will last and is sure to please. Great job, Burberry!

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText: The Burberry name is well known as a premium creator of great products and this is no exception. Brit Rhythm is a very tasteful, somewhat traditional scent that should appeal to many and men should enjoy smelling it on the women who wear it. I certainly love it. It is hard to describe(which is a good thing) but a bit floral and fresh. The price is not cheap but it is Burberry, after all, and you do get quite a bit of the stuff in this set. The box is also awesome. Any woman should love getting this!
summary: A great scent, just as we would expect from Burberry!

style.Style:: 3.0 oz EDT Spray + (2) 0.25 oz Purse Sprays

reviewText: This is one of the nicest scents I have run across in quite some time. It reminds me of Estee Launder's Beautiful, but it's not as strong and smells better. The bottle is a generous size, plus you get two purse sprayers. Keep one and give one to your mom or daughter. I believe this fragrance is good for all ages. It also comes in a beautiful gift box.

I am new to this product line. This is a very nice day cream with a lovely feel in the skin...not oily or greasy or tacky, just right. It has a pleasant scent and "sets" my skin perfectly whether I plan to wear are up or not.

If you have very dry skin I don't think this is quite the right product until you get your skin back to a baseline. This is more of a hydration maintenance product than emergency rehydration.

As price goes I think this squarely falls in the moderate range having seen day creams well into the 3 digit category. It is better than drug store creams and has a better than usual scent and feel to it. I'd definitely buy it again. The box has mostly Russian language directions and descriptions so use this as you would any day cream.
summary: Very nice mid weight, middle price range day cream. Fresh, appealing scent.

reviewText:
Vichy LiftActiv Supreme leaves your face feeling silky soft.  While the scent has a slight floral character, it's very subtle.  As a man, I'd feel totally comfortable using this product.

The cream is not too thick and not too thin or runny.  A little goes a long way.  It also has a gentle, cooling sensation and not the harshness of other products I've used.

They suggest that it minimizes fine lines and I'm candidly not sure that's true.  But it's a really fine facial cream and while it's not cheap, the price is lower than other high-grade facial creams that I've evaluated.  So it's a very solid product.  4 stars.
summary: Really a very fine quality moisturizing cream

reviewText:
I applied this to my face and neck. Since there are no directions on the package, I also used this on my eyelids. I usually do apply a moisturizer to my entire face unless it says to avoid the eye area. I really like this moisturizer. It has a clean fresh scent, goes on smoothly and did not leave my face tacky like some moisturizers I've tried before.

This product is made in France but most of the writing on the package appears to be in Russian. The one thing I don't like is that there are no directions for use on the package that I can see.

Overall, I really like this moisturizer and would definitely consider purchasing this.  NUXE from France is my favorite brand of moisturizer with Oil of Olay a close second. This is tie with Oil of Olay in my opinion.
summary: Left my face and neck feeling smooth and moisturized

reviewText: The texture is so smooth. Not water or greasy. This is a definite favorite

I did research before I purchased this line of products , but was enough to use for 2 days that i got very bad reaction on my face, burning, red swelling and I am in pain, I will never ever buy these products again
summary: but was enough to use for 2 days that i got very bad reaction on my face

reviewText:
I always make it clear that it is nearly impossible to verify benefits for anti-aging and various benefits in a short time frame.  So you have to rely on the list of ingredients as a guide and your own experience with a product. But as the list of ingredients lengthens and the print gets smaller and smaller it seems like it could be a full time job keeping up.

And this packaging doesn't make it any easier.  The print is virtually impossible to read and is condensed so tightly that it looks like a legal disclaimer.  Then combined with multiple languages on the same panel you'll need a Six Million Dollar Man eye to read it.
The jar itself is very attractive and is inline with a product of this price.

However, I will say that right away I liked this because it was thick on my hands but smoothed on and absorbed very easily by my skin.  It didn't feel heavy at all and wasn't an issue when I went out in the humid summer air.

It feels good and my face likes the effect.

Now as to its claims.  The primary claims is that it will help you look better deeper into the day.  I cant really vouch for that as I haven't noticed any differences later in the day.  But hadn't really been looking for them before using this.
I notice that it does not contain any Retinol which has been proven to reduce wrinkles and is commonly found in anti-aging blends.  So I am a little surprised I don't see it here.

Overall I am happy with the product and results (so far) but will likely go back to a preferred brand that contains Retinol A and that I have had success with in the past.

But that is just a personal preference. Aside from the packaging and the lack of Retinol I don't have any issues with recommending this as a daily moisturizer.
summary: A very nice product that moisturizes without being too heavy.

reviewText: Great daily moisturizer. Moisturizes without being greasy.  Doesn't lead to breakouts. I am not sure if I look younger, but my skin does feel better after several weeks of using it daily.  I'm less itchy.
summary: less itchy, cleaner feeling skin after a few weeks.

reviewText: I love the scent of this product, but I don't see any difference in my skin.  If I were younger, perhaps the results would have been better.  But there is no visible difference on my face after using this product for two weeks.
summary: I love the scent of this product

reviewText:
Overall this is a pretty good cream. It's not amazing and dramatic like some of Lancome's products are (for me), but it also is a fantastic moisturizer that does not cause break-outs, even on sensitive skin. (I'm over 40 now, but about 85% of moisturizers still make me break out.) The smell is faint and fades after a while... it's a subtle smell with just the tiniest chemical hint (I prefer using all-natural products, so I'm hyper-aware of chemical scents now; most people won't notice it), not pleasant but not annoying either.

This doesn't affect my rating, but I do appreciate that the lid is a mirror--makes it easy to double-check that you've rubbed the moisturizer in evenly.
summary: pretty good, about like most $40 night creams

reviewText:
My skin is always feeling dry from November to May. So now it a good time to apply moisturizer.

I love this product. No greasy feeling on my skin. After a few hours, my face does not look shiny or oily. I apply it once a day after shower. But I cannot claim my skin is feeling younger.

This moisturizer does an excellent job of moisturizing without adding any shine to your face,  the texture is very smooth and it is absorbed fairly quickly without a greasy or heavy feel.

Very nice scent.

It's not clear if it has made a difference in crow's feet and smile lines, but certainly doesn't hurt.

I've been trying this for about 2 weeks now. Never really used much lotion so I've got some wrinkles starting to come in but I'm blessed with some good genetics so I still look pretty young. Still, those laugh lines and forehead wrinkles are starting to leave permanent creases and I figured it can't hurt to try taking better care of my skin.

After 2 weeks I'm not seeing much difference as far as anti-aging, but I kind of expected that. What I have noticed is that, after I wash my face in the morning and put it on it does seem to hide/lessen some of the wrinkles and my skin does feel tighter. I can't tell if it's because I have a dry film of product on my face or if it's actually effecting my skin but it does seem to make a visual difference.

It does seem to last almost all day but one really interesting thing I've noticed is that during my workout, while I have this on, my sweat tastes very sweet. Almost like I just rubbed my face down with sugar. I don't know if that's a good thing or not. The skeptic in me starts screaming "Ha! You just rubbed a $40 placebo on your face!" the other half of me is thinking, "What's in this stuff? I wonder if maybe, sugar is good for your skin?"

As far as brightening my skin, well it does seem to create a more, matte shine, less oily or dry looking..

Either way I do see a difference when it's on, but not once I wash it off.
At this point (2 weeks in) I'm labeling it more of a moisturizing concealer than an anti-aging/firming cream.
I do like it though, hopefully it's helping my skin stay healthy and not just covering up the damage.
summary: Anti-aging? Not so much. But it does seem to conceal and moisturize.

reviewText: The wife really likes this. It moisturizes the whole day. Only a small amount is needed and sh said it spread easily. A very nice base for her makeup.
summary: Applies easily and lasts the whole day.

reviewText: I am always trying new anti aging lotions and creams and was excited to be able to try this Vichy cream.  I really like the density and texture of this cream.  It has a nice fragrance and for me, isn't too strong.  It absorbs pretty quick.  I will update this in about a month on how it is working for firming but so far I am happy with this cream.

This moisturizer is very nice. The texture is smooth--almost whipped, and slightly pearlescent. It goes one smoothly and absorbs seamlessly into my skin. This isn't like drug store creams. The scent is very light and floral...nothing obnoxious.  Does it remove wrinkles? Well, the jury is still out on that, I have only had it a few weeks. I can say that my skin ~feels~ very nice. Honestly, in this time I haven't noticed any real "lifting" or "erasing" properties. I did say it was pearlescent...which may diffuse the light in a way that makes your skin appear brighter and smoother. I am not saying it is glittery---I don't enjoy glitter or even frosty make-up (well I LIKE them, but they don't flatter my no-longer-20 skin!) I took a star away for this product sort of claiming it does more than any product really can (except maybe some prescription.)

Is it a nice cream? Definitely. Is it better than cheap stuff? The texture, absorption, and fragrance are. And time will tell if it does improve my skin more than the cheaper stuff. I probably would buy this again because it does go into my skin so nicely, but the price might make me use it carefully and trying not to waste it (like putting it on knowing I am going to shower in a few hours or when I know I will perspire it off shortly doing something.) Some people spend a lot on face creams and things, but I can be kinda cheap. While I enjoy good products, I feel guilty about spending too much. One amazing cream would be worth it...and hoping over time that this might be it. I will update in a few months if I see any serious results.
summary: Not sure any moisturizer is truly "anti" aging.

reviewText:
Ignore the marketing and what you have is a well balanced product.  The cream has a so-so fragrance, not bad, not good in my opinion.  The product goes on well due to thickness and definitely moisturizes.  Without question, a few days of sustained use made my face look a little better.  However, the nonsense of "illuminating" and deflecting shadows is absolute gibberish.  Not to mention the "Instant 3D Optical Correctors".  Come on folks.

Stay away from all the flowery, almost nonsensical, reviews.  It is a moisturizer that appears (feels) to out-perform low to mid-range products.

Im unfortunately a little late to the halt-the-aging skin thing, so my expectations of miracle creams reversing a process that is well underway are low.  That said, this pricey little jar of cream makes various appearance claims including immediate glow, end of day uplift instead of down-sag, and long-term improvement in wrinkle appearance and skin tone.  A troll through pubmed.gov (a compendium of medical literature) suggests there may be some scientific basis to support the less wrinkle more tone hype.

1. Immediate effects:  per the web-site blurb, were promised Liftactiv will mattify, blur, and illuminate.  Im no expert on mattificationnever heard of such a thing!, but it seems to me a lot of products deflect shadows and reflect light from cavernous pores and wrinkly rifts in an optical corrector sort of way.  Maybe more an optical illusion than correction, but hurray for that. I did not, however, appreciate any glow factor from my initial Liftactiv applications.
2. End of day effects:  Interesting claims of plumped skin, and features both younger and more rested in appearance.  This promise is apparently based on twice daily usage for a week, so Im not there but hoping to reach that days end rejuvenation and rested place despite the lack of evidence supporting the possibility.  The Vichy web-site cites cream ingredients caffeine and adenosine as their dayproof technology.  Topical or ingested caffeine protects rodents from sunburn and sun-related skin cancer formation but there are no human studies that support caffeine chemoprotection from damaging UV radiation. I found a single article from Korean researchers noting that 2% topical adenosine cream decreases fine wrinkles around the eyes by 12.1% when measured by a 3D Skin CycloScan. No mention is made of how much different those crows feet looked to the unassisted eye! Other articles cited on the web in favor of adenosine in skin care referred to beneficial actions of adenosine tri-phosphate (produced at the cellular level) but did not include studies that looked at skin outcomes after the topical use of adenosine.
3. Future firmer skin with fewer folds:  Botanically derived rhamnose and neohesperidin are the two Liftactiv ingredients listed to reduce the look of wrinkles over time.  Rhamnose is a complex sugar molecule which, as one ingredient in an almond gum-derived cream of various sugar chains, promoted wound healing in rats.  Microscopic inspection of the healed skin revealed increased collagen production.  Ointment containing rhamnose significantly accelerated tissue repair and inhibited inflammatory reaction of scalded skin.  And cultured human skin cells, growing old in a petri dish, were protected against the ravages of aging with rhamnose-containing solution poured into their environment.  As for neohesperidin, this is a known anti-oxidant from citrus fruit with anti-inflammatory action.  In one trial of topical application of a solution containing neohesperidin on the skin of brownish guinea pigs, the animals were delighted to find that they did not become even more brownish on exposure to UV radiation.

A lot of work went into the development of this Liftactiv cream, and indeed it is a nicely spreadable concoctiona little goes a long way.  It has a faint perfumey smell that I could live without, but fortunately, it doesnt linger.  If any of the benefits noted in rodents and guinea pigs translate out into fresher looking skin over time for me, I will probably continue to use it.
summary: Nice enough cream, but what's the science behind it?

reviewText:
I've been hearing a lot about the Korean ten-step beauty routine these days and, in an effort to maintain my skin, have been trying to expand on my fairly minimal skincare regimen in the past few years.  Lately, I've been alternating between two night creams - a high end brand, Le Metier de Beaute, and a drug store brand, L'Oreal Age Perfect.  Both are very emollient and attractively fragranced, leaving my skin feeling smooth and moisturized in the morning.

The Vichy LiftActive Supreme is right in between Le Metier and L'Oreal in terms of price so I was interested to see how it would compare.  I've been using it exclusively for a week and, so far, I really like it.  The cream itself is a bit thicker than the other two so I was able to use less, but it was also not quite as easy to smooth over my face and neck due to the dense texture.  The fragrance is lovely, but very strong.  It smells distinctly perfume-y going on and dries down to a lingering talc-like scent.  Personally, I like it very much but if you don't enjoy fragrance in your facial products, this is definitely not the moisturizer for you.  Most importantly, it improved the appearance of my skin tone and texture after a good night's sleep.  I think I might even go as far as to say it works better than both of my current standbys.  After seven days I can't vouch for any firming properties, but as a moisturizer, I give it high marks.  Good value for a mid-priced cream.

This moisturizer offers immediately visible results.  It has a creamy texture that is non-irritating, doesn't cause me to break out, and absorbs well leaving a somewhat matte finish to my skin. My skin is noticeably softer as long as I remember to use it.

It came with zero instructions so I didn't know whether it was a day cream or a night cream, and it ends up after looking online it should be applied twice a day. The only thing I don't like about this moisturizer is the very strong perfume scent and I am not even particularly sensitive to scents.  In my opinion, there is no reason to so strongly scent a product that is meant for the face.

Overall, it is a very nice cream if you don't mind the scent.
summary: Works well but is strongly perfumed

reviewText:
Vichy is an LOral brand so if you like their products its very likely you will like this moisturizer.

You are supposed to use it in the morning after cleansing your face. It has a very subtle scent and goes on like silk. It absorbs quickly with no greasy feel. It really does seem to tighten fine wrinkles as soon as you put it on and it leaves a matte finish which is a perfect base for make-up.

 There is a new ingredient I hadnt heard of, rhamnose. They say it has been tested in vivo and has been proven to have high efficacy.  I like it.

LiftActiv Supreme is a very nice anti-wrinkle cream for sensitive skin. The very first time I put it on, I could feel my skin tightening up. There weren't any instructions on the box or bottle, so I went back to the product page to see what it said there. Apparently you are supposed to put it on twice a day for 1 month and then check to see how your skin looks. I don't know if you should put it on the eyelids, because it didn't mention that. It is supposed to help tiny lines around your eyes, so it might be ok to put on your eyelids. The cream itself is very smooth and silky. However, it really stinks. The scent lasts a long time, and it burns my nose when I breathe it in. I won't continue to use it because of the horrible scent. If it were available in unscented, then I would use it, because I do think it will tighten your skin and reduce fine lines and wrinkles. Recommended if you can stand the smell.
summary: LiftActiv Supreme is a very nice anti-wrinkle cream for sensitive skin

reviewText: There is only one other face cream that I have ever tried that you could actually see results the first time I used it, and I have used a ton over the years. This Vichy gives results right away as well. I love that it is so light weight. There is no greasiness at all and it leaves no shine on your skin. My face looks and feels so smooth and hydrated. There is only very slight scent, so it shouldn't bother sensitive individuals. Lines and wrinkles look smoother, or plumped out and skin just looks youthful. It feels like a rich, thick cream, but as soon as you rub it in, it absorbs immediately, like a serum would. Very interesting and skin just looks so fresh and young... no other way to describe it. This one is a keeper and the price is very competitve.

Ingredients in this cream  are mainly dimethicone, stearic acid and water. Emollients/moisturizers work by forming an oily layer on the top of the skin that traps water in the skin. Petrolatum, lanolin, mineral oil and dimethicone are common emollients.
The label makes a point of saying it doesn't contain wax (paraben.)

Even a small quantity can spread very well on the face.  It left my face glowing - without any oil after effects.

The fragrance is very mild and just right
summary: Rich smooth feeling, adds a glow to the face

reviewText: This is a wonderful lotion! Smells yummy and not stickey, makes skin feel so soft!
Cant get enough of these. Its like I am in a rush to get it on me as fast as I can. A drink of water for my skin and hands. Nothing better.
summary: Its like I am in a rush to get it on ...

reviewText: As the others have said this lotion goes on smoothly, not greasy and leaves the skin smooth.  Also, there are great fragrances in this line of Avojuice.
summary: there are great fragrances in this line of Avojuice

reviewText: This is the best lotion for massages.  It never pills up, and a little goes a long way.  It absorbs into the skin, leaving it soft and lovely.  As far as I'm concerned, this is the best lotion on the market.  I'm never without several bottles, plus the scents are delicious.
Light weight body lotion; moisturizes very well.  Does have a strong coconut fragrance.

Best hand and massage lotion out there.  It never beads up, as some lotions tend to do.  It absorbs instantly, with no greasy feel.  I've used this brand for years!  Luscious scents too.  I will continue to order OPI Avojuice lotion!  Never stop carrying it Amazon, or I'll be heartbroken!  LOL!

I love the Avojuice products but the scent on this is not very nice! Smells okay in the container but if you have body wash or anything else on, the scent is very unpleasant! Don't know why but I'm going to end up tossing this one!!! Been too long since I purchased it to return it!! Be sure and check this out locally before you purchase and particularly, the large size!!! I will order another scent.

My mother loves Philosophy's body wash and I wind up getting them for Christmas for her. I'd never used the product before, but I like sandalwood/musky scents, so decided to try this. I now understand why the Amen shower gel is marketed to men, it definitely has a woodsy fragrance that is suited to men's grooming habits. I'm not saying women couldn't use this, but it has a smell of beachy and more dense flavors then the light and airy scents women are used to. Either way, I like it. I have sensitive skin and after using it for a week, my skin is soft, no irritations. I think this would be the perfect gift for a husband/boyfriend/SO.

We go through a lot of shower gel at home and at the gym. We tend to swap across genders so we are both going to use whatever comes in the house. I tried this first and felt is was top notch for dry skin. I felt clean but not stripped of moisture. It has a silky feel and lathers richly. For me, the huge drawback is the fragrance. It's got a throwback "middle age crazy" scent to it, so named because it reminds me of my father dating in the 1980s. The scent really lingers on the skin. If you are scent sensitive, this is not for you.

My husband tried it and hated the scent. He's not as tuned into the dry skin properties; he would just never use this again. So it will be mine and I will use it. If they made a scent free version (or a citrus scent) I would buy this in the future. I would not buy this in this fragrance. A generous 4 stars because it is really excellent for dry skin.
summary: Non-drying shower gel, very silky, strong fragrance. It's a love it or hate it thing.

reviewText:
In reviewing this Shower Gel, I'll admit that I am a soap bar guy.  I grew up with bars, never really got comfortable with gels.  I've tried but its never been my thing.  When you like soap bars, you need shampoo.  You can use the soap bar to shampoo hair but it leave the hair hydrophobic afterwards and then, once fully dry, its usually too dry and spindly.  You don't use soap for that, you use shampoo.
In the case of this gel, this is the first one that seems to be able to do double duty (soap AND shampoo) and do both jobs well.  It washes on and off easily, cleans thoroughly and smells great.  I have no idea what that smell is but its masculine and solid and if I smelled like that at the end of the day as well as the beginning I'd be happy.
All in all I like this Shower Gel very much and will be ordering more.
One final note: I am not going to pretend I understand the label. Its a reminder that there is a difference between a superstar and a hero and that we should be thankful that we have heroes. Amen.  Its also a little bit of a non sequitar.  And, by saying that, I am not disagreeing with their label. But it is a curious thing to put on a bottle of gel.
In summary, nice gel and shampoo, works and smells great.  If you are looking for a new gel, I liked this one very much!
summary: Review: Amen Men's Shower Gel from Philosophy for Men.  Exec Summary: Nice gel/shampoo!  Fragrant and light!

reviewText:
Amen men's shower gel has a pleasant but floral scent.  Even though it's a bit floral, it does have a masculine smell to me.

When you lather up in the shower, remember that a little bit goes a long way.  Also, don't be alarmed by how strong the smell is.  I find that about 60 minutes after I shower, the smell is mostly gone except for a mild hint.  You won't be overpowering your co-workers if you use this.  Instead, you'll just smell "fresh" when someone is standing very close to you.

I received this Amen Men's Shower Gel today so I was excited to give it a try in the shower after work.  The product arrives in a padded envelope with no additional packaging.  At this price point it ought to be packaged in an elegant presentation box.  There is an interesting philosophic statement about heroes printed on the label of the product that is definitely inspiring.

With use the gel is surprisingly soft.  It is so soft it feels like you are applying lotion. It lathers up just fine, though.  As another reviewer mentioned, a little goes a long way, and about a quarter sized dollop will be enough to wash your entire body.  This is about half as much as my usual body wash, so 16 oz. of philosophy will last like 32 oz. of other brands of body wash.  The scent is definitely not a citrus scent, which I think is very misleading in the product description.  It is an unusual scent that smells more like aged wood.  It reminds me somewhat of the old men's colognes from 30 years ago. It is not objectionable by any means, but you will be disappointed if you are expecting a citrus scent.  After showering the scent persists but lightly.  What I really like about this shower gel is that it makes your skin feel very smooth.  It rinses off easily and does not feel greasy.  Anyone with dry skin would be very happy with this gel.

Overall, this is a very nice shower gel that hydrates and moisturizes your skin very well.  It is an ideal product for anyone with dry skin.  It has a very unusual scent that does not linger for very long. My only criticism of this product, and the primary reason I docked it a star, is its insanely high price.  It is triple the price for a comparable amount of Cetaphil soap which is a moisturizing liquid soap commonly recommended by many dermatologists.  I do not think most people would spend this much for a bottle of shower gel.  But if you have very dry skin and like the scent you may find its higher price worthwhile.

Update 4/13/17:

After using this body was for 2 months now (same bottle - this soap is so concentrated it lasts seemingly forever) I decided to buy more as I really like it. If you go to the philosophy web site you will find they sell the same 16 oz. size for 2/3 the price Amazon charges. It's still quite expensive even at that lower price, but for one person a bottle will last for months with daily usage.
summary: ideal for those with dry skin; not a citrus scent; insanely expensive for a shower gel

reviewText: The first thing to know is that this product doesn't have what I would characterize as a "spicy citrus" fragrance, as advertised. It has a very pleasant mild scent, more woody than citrus.  Although this is marketed for men, I think it works well for both men and women, as the fragrance isn't overtly masculine or feminine. The texture is very silky and rinses cleanly; it is a pleasure to use. My husband loves being able to use one product as both shower gel and shampoo, and it works well for him, but I suspect most women would prefer to use this as a shower gel while continuing to use regular shampoo (I do).
summary: Smells great while keeping it simple

reviewText:
Im not a big fan of soap and prefer a shower gel. However, most of the shower gels out there for men have a strong, overpowering scent and leave a slight film. Ive used Old Spice gels for a long time and generally like them in spite of the weaknesses.

I enjoyed the chance to try out Philosophy for Men Amen shower gel. I actually really like it. First of all, the scent is spicy masculine (e.g. non-fruity), yet subtle. It doesnt overpower you like the Axe or Old Spice brands typically do. However, although its subtle overall, others will still notice your (nice) smell.

The texture is thick and it applies a lot like lotion. I have dry skin during the winter and its very helpful in keeping my skin hydrated. But, if you don't like your body wash feeling like lotion, its a downside.

I love the smell and how it keeps my dry skin at bay. Know what I don't like? The price. Its way, way too high for a shower gel. Heck, even cutting the price in half would be too much. But, if you have extra cash to burn, this is a really great shower gel.
summary: Love the Smell, But Oh the Price

reviewText: It looks like a lot of people feel about this product as I did.  It smells great and feels great in the hair and on the skin.  I feel like I am putting moisture in my skin while cleaning it.  That said, and although this is a generous size bottle, my husband said he would never pay that much for this product.  He likes it a lot but just said no way when I told him the price.  He's one that is willing to spend to pamper himself but he just didn't think the benefit justified the cost.  That's probably how a lot of men feel.  I've followed the Philosophy brand for years and know many people just love it.  Knowing this, I think a man would love to receive this as a gift from a special someone but wouldn't necessarily spend the money themselves to keep buying it.  So, I think this is a luxurious spa gift for the men in your lives but likely won't become a part of their regular routine unless you just keep buying it for them.
summary: Luxurious, Yet Pricey for Shower Gel

reviewText: Since I recently turned 50, I have been trying to be more regular with my skincare routine. I have been using anti-aging products for years, but it was usually just in the morning. Now, I have a regular morning and evening skincare routine that I have been following. I have been using this Erno Laszlo Radiance Emulsion at bedtime. It absorbs well, though I do give it about a minute before I apply anything else. It has a very light pleasant scent that's not artificial or perfumy. I don't have much in the way of dark spots yet, but I love that this serum also works to prevent future environmental damage. It isn't greasy or sticky. The pump works and makes for easy dispensing. It takes just one pump to cover my face. If I want to apply it to my neck and upper chest area, it takes two pumps. It does not leave my skin red or splotchy. I have somewhat sensitive skin and some products do leave a temporary redness. It also doesn't sting my eyes. I try to avoid the eye area when applying all creams and serums, but I do have to rub my eyes a lot and that does cause some products to get in my eyes. Overall, it's a nice addition to my evening routine.

Ive been using this product for a couple of weeks now and I don't notice any change at all. I cant imagine that a significant change could happen in another couple of weeks but Ill keep using it. The serum itself is perfectly fine, very light white lotion that absorbs fairly quickly. I use this in the evening only but Im sure it can be used in the morning as well. I do like Erno Laszlo products just not that impressed with this one.
So soft and gentle. Leaves my skin silky. Absorbs quickly. No fragrance. The bottle has a good amount of product, and a little goes a long way.

I love the Erno Laszlo Marble line, and this serum is no exception. Half a bottle later and I can already see a dramatic difference in all my dark spots and overall tone of my skin. Not only does it look more even, but also a lot smoother everywhere. Also happy to report that it mixes well with my usual moisturizer and doesn't pill the way many serums tend to. Very happy with this serum.

In the past I have used DHC cleansing oil, but I felt like I really needed to change things up, like if I use the same cleanser for too long my poor face dries out.  It might be in my head, but I do like change things up.  I like oil based cleaners, I have large pores, combination, super sensitive skin.  The oil based cleansers make my face feel pumped up and dewy, without over drying my face and oddly without clogging my pores.

A little bit goes a long way.  I like to rub the oil cleanser on first, then after I have worked the cleanser for awhile I like to add the water and create a little bit of lather and rinse off.  I don't like over perfumey cleansers, this has little to no scent.  It can clean your waterproof eye makeup off.  My skin did not have that painful dry feeling.  I almost forgot to put my nighttime moisturizer on.

This is really great stuff.  I like oil cleansers.  They are good for your face, the older your skin gets the more moisture it needs.  I would use this again.
summary: Wonderful for my face, large pores, combination skin, super sensitive.

reviewText: This cleansing oil disappointed me. For the price I was hoping to find something I would love, but it left my skin feeling oily like I had to double cleanse. Also I would get a film in my eyes from using it to take off my eye makeup. I stopped using it on my face and now I'm trying to use it up by cleaning my brushes with it.
summary: This cleansing oil disappointed me. For the price I was hoping to ...

reviewText: I received a sample of this in a L'Occitane sample bag. There was several products in there (All of which I loved), but this one took the cake. I've completely radicated face washes, like the Cetaphil face cleanser which I've been using for years, and replaced it entirely with this. My skin LOVES this. Since replacing my makeup wipes + face cleansers with this product, my skin has cleared up, I've had no breakouts, my skin tone is even and bright, no redness, no excessive oilyness, no dry patches, and my skin looks the best it's every looked. I usually wear a full face of make up (Foundation, concealer, mascara, etc.) and this removes all of my makeup with ease. L'Occitane is a great line, but this face oil takes the cake. It is a little pricey for an everyday face wash, but I feel you can never be too careful when it comes to your skin, especially your face. This product is worth every penny. One pump is all you need so this 6 ounce bottle will last you a very long time. Smells heavenly. Highly, highly recommend.
Nice product.

When I saw the product name I thought this was traditional oil cleansing where an oil or oil blend only is applied to a dry face to cleanse. This product is a combination of oils and manmade ingredients which is put onto wet skin. Upon combining with water it turns into a low suds emulsion cleansing solution. It is rinsed off with water then a layer of oil is left clinging to the skin which is a layer of moisturizer.

This has a mild scent which I cannot identify which surprised me as to me L'Occitane is known for very strong fragrance levels. I am fine with the scent as when I add a face lotion with SPF that has a scent and everything else I use is another layer of scent (facial lotions, body lotions, hair styling product, hair spray, anti-perspirant).

Although this was not what I assumed I like it very much. I have sensitive skin with rosacea (on prescription medication and an a food elimination plan). I rate this 5 stars = I Love It.
summary: Gentle Facial Cleanser with Mild Scent (Not Traditional Oil Cleansing)

reviewText:
This is a nice cleanser, especially for makeup removal.  It leaves the skin feeling nice and clean but not stripped of all moisture, and it doesn't make my oily skin break out.

Unfortunately, I don't like the synthetic floral scent of this cleanser and the scent is *way* too strong and unlike some other reviewers I did find it to linger sometimes.  If they used the same fragrance but cut the intensity of the scent down to about 25% of what it currently is I would probably give this 4 stars.  If it was fragrance free and slightly cheaper I would definitely give this 5 stars.
summary: Good cleanser hampered by overbearing fragrance

reviewText: I love the L'Occitane Shea Cleansing oil.  It is strong enough to remove my waterproof mascara, but it doesn't irritate my eyes.  I don't have to rub to get my makeup. Best of all this oil is water soluble so it washes off after you've wiped off the makeup leaving your skin moisturized and fresh feeling.  Smells good too.

This is an interesting product and I wanted to try it because the thought of using oil to clean/wash my face is foreign to me.  My face has tended to be oily most of my life so far but is not quite as bad in the last five years
.
I cringed the first time I put this on my face because I assumed it would make my skin break out with pimples or a rash.
I was wrong.
It hasn't bothered my skin nor caused any problems that are abnormal.

I am pleasantly surprised!  I apply the oil to my dry skin and then add a little water which make is lather up slightly.  I make sure that I rinse it well and my skin is clean and soft.  The oil does have a slight scent to it.  The first ingredient is sunflower seed oil and it contains 5% shea butter.

Although my face is seem softer, I have still been applying daily face and eye cream.  I don't believe that this is meant to be a moisturizer, just a wash and makeup remover. I like the handy pump dispenser.  Although this isn't my favorite wash, I will continue to use it and see if it makes any changes in my skin texture or look.

I will see how this product performs over then next few months and comment back if there are any changes.
summary: Strange Concept to me, but it works!

reviewText:
I've been intrigued with cleansing oils for awhile as they are touted as being able to thoroughly remove makeup without stripping or drying out the skin.  This cleansing oil does just that.  I used two pumps of the oil, rubbed my palms together to warm it up, and then massaged it into dry skin.  I then wet my hands with a little bit of warm water at a time and continued massaging my skin, adding more water until the oil was completely removed.  If you've never used cleansing oils before it's worth reading up on how to use them properly as the experience is a bit different than using a foaming cleanser (though it reminded me a lot of how I use my Glam Glow ThirstyCleanse).  It takes some time to fully see the effect of a product on your skin but so far, I'm enjoying the experience.  Having suffered from acne on and off since my teen years oil was a dirty word for me for a long time, but this product has made me realize it's about adding the right oils into my routine.  I do feel like my skin feels very clean after using this, but doesn't feel stripped, tight or dry like foaming cleansers often make my skin feel.  I think the only downside is it does mean your cleansing routine takes a little bit longer, especially if you are used to facial wipes or very quickly lathering and rinsing your face.  But I've found it's pretty relaxing and like a little luxurious treat at the end of the day.

I would definitely recommend this.
summary: Great for leaving skin thoroughly clean and soft

reviewText:
I generally love L'Occitane products, and for the most part, their Shea Cleaning Oil is great. As other reviewers say, it feels a little oily going on, but it cleans gently and any trace of oiliness disappears as your face dries. Overall it works well, leaving you feeling clean and without the dry or  harsh feeling you sometimes get with other products. A little goes a long way, so even though it's expensive, it lasts a long time.

About the only thing I don't like is that I feel the fragrance is a bit too strong, but if you like the fragrance, it's definitely worth a try.

I am really surprised to be writing anything less than a five star review from l'Occitaine.  But I am.  I have to say that the scent is just far, far too strong for me to use this product on my face, so I only used it the once and I was fairly desperate to get it off my face as soon as possible.  This product did seem to do a good job on my face, but I just can't bear the overwhelming smell first thing in the morning.  I usually use the L'Occitaine Precious Cleansing Foam and I love that product so much - it's perfect.

HOWEVER, I then used it to shave my legs and underarms, and it's absolutely heavenly for that purpose.  My legs, who have been dry and neglected, are silky smooth and lovely right now.  It's perfection as a shaving foam.
summary: The scent is strong with this one.

reviewText: Little odd to use oil to remove oil - and after initial use my face still feels oily, BUT it soon dries and leaves skin silky smooth. Love the smell and feel. Another winner from L'Occitane.

I got overzealous when I ordered this.  I love L'Occitane products, and failed to notice that this is oil.
Yes, it removes the makeup.  It also leaves behind an oily residue - but that doesn't stay oily for too long and then the skin feels pretty good.  For me, the fragrance is WAY too much for something you are going to put on your face.
summary: I'll stick with my cleansing wipes

reviewText: I have become a fan of cleansing oil despite being skeptical the first time I tried it. It is great for when your skin is dry or more "mature" so you don't want to use a cleanser that is too harsh. I am also generally a fan of the L'Occitane products. This oil does a good job of cleansing and feels very nice. My only complaint is that it is a bit more scented (it has a flowery perfumey scent) than I would prefer. The good news is that the scent does not linger so much that I could smell it all night, but I would still prefer less scent. If not for the scent, I would give this 5 stars. If you want a good cleansing oil but want less scent, I like Juice Beauty Stem Cellular Cleansing Oil, 4 fl. oz..
summary: Great cleanser but a little too perfumey

reviewText:
Dry, mature skin can suffer from wearing makeup every day, and removing the makeup with harsh cleansers just makes matters worse.

Enter L'Occitane Shea Cleansing Oil. This light, golden-colored oil is long-lasting, easy to use, and effectively removed my tinted moisturizer, concealer, and blush.

To use it, I wet my face and use one pump of the oil to cover and cleanse my face. Then I rinse thoroughly. All traces of my makeup are removed. (I don't use waterproof makeup, but the directions say the product will remove even waterproof makeup.)

The scent of the product is subtle and pleasant but does not linger when rinsed off. It contains 5% Shea oil, along with sunflower oil, but no "scary" chemicals.

After use, my face is almost smooth enough to skip moisturizer. (I don't skip it, but others might be able to.)

Even at the price of $22 for 6.7 fl. oz., this is worth trying. A bottle will last you quite a while (used once daily, as I do), and like me, you'll probably want to keep on using it.

This cleansing oil works surprisingly well.  After using it the first week my face does felt clean yet hydrated, not like other harsh soaps.  I did needed to rub a bit more or use extra oil to remove my eye make up but other than that is works great.  My lotions, foundations etc came off fairly easily and when I dried my face on my towel I don't see any make-up residue!
The only problem is that I have allergies.  At first I didn't mind the faint baby powder smell.  But I notice the more I use the product the more it is starting to bother me.  My eyes and nose feel a little irritated and now my skin is starting to feel uncomfortable.  My skin is clean but doesn't feel clean.  Because of this I stopped using it regularly and after use I wash it off thoroughly with warm water.  But even after that my skin is still soft.  I think due to my reaction I will have to discontinue use it soon.  Which is such a shame!  But for people who aren't really sensitive I think this is a great alternative to the other soaps on the market which are abrasive and strip your skin.  If this came in a fragrance free or another company had something of this quality which was hypoallergenic I would be purchasing it in a heart beat!
summary: After using it my face does feel clean yet hydrated, not like other harsh soaps.  But the faint fragrance is starting to bother

reviewText:
Like the other L'Occitane products I have tried, this cleansing oil is a winner!  You use it along with warm water, and it makes itself into a very effective, gentle and hardworking cleaning foam.  It feels just a little bit tingly going on, but you can also feel the nice hint of shea in it, which keeps it from making the skin dry at all.  My face feels totally clean and soft after using it.  I don't use a lot of make-up, but I put some on to take it off, some foundation, and it worked extremely well.  I might wear more foundation in the future, as I like to wear it, but other cleansers didn't always get it off completely, which I need, as I have rosacea.  If this has any scent, it's extremely mild, so no worries there.

I love the elegant look of this product too!  It can be left out in the bathroom as it just looks nice.  Highly recommended!
summary: Gives a wonderful clean without any dryness!

reviewText:
I have never used oils of any kind on my face so I was very curious about this.  I have always been taught that the idea was to keep oils OFF my face.  Oils clog pores--yes?  However, that was extremely short sighted.  I love how this Cleansing oil leaves my face feeling all soft and clean.

My skin feels amazing.  I know better than to touch, butits hard not to.

This is also an extremely effective makeup remover.  My only makeup is generally mascara which sometimes feels like shoe polish coming off.  This product removed mascara without scrubbing and rescrubbing.  That may cause me to wear makeup more often.  Maybe not.

I got this for my girlfriend to try because she loves the various Shea Butter hand creams that L'Occitane makes. Each year for Christmas I get her one of their sets with lots of different scents in it and she never seems to use anything else.

This seemed like a natural, but she was hesitant at first as it apparently has very little Shea Butter in it but she still thought it might be too oily as she doesn't have dry skin. However, she thinks it works just fine, cleans without drying her face, and she was pleased that it washes away easily and doesn't seem to leave any oil.
summary: My girlfriend thinks it's lovely despite have very little shea in it, and says it doesn't leave any oily feel

reviewText:
This oil and emulsifier based cleanser removes all traces of makeup and does not leave skin feeling stripped.  It is an impressive makeup remover.

I have issues with the aesthetics, though.  The first time I used it, I kept wondering when it would start to foam because it felt like I was still rubbing oil and water on my skin.  I finally opened my eyes and glanced in the mirror to find it was indeed foaming.  I can't feel it changing on my face or with my fingertips.  I've used it a good two weeks now, and that hasn't changed.  I know that after I add water, it will start foaming, but I can't tell when that happens.  It is impossible to rinse off unless I use a washcloth.  I can see the makeup is gone, but water beads up on my face.  I appreciate the softness, but I really don't like leaving cleanser on my face, so I scrape it off with a wash cloth.

Yesterday, I noticed the "Safe For" symbol on the back of the bottle.  This symbol looks like a jar, and has a number followed by the letter "M".  This symbol is not on all cosmetic and personal care consumables, but I find it more and more often.  Unfortunately, according to the "Safe For" symbol on this bottle, the cleanser is safe to use for a mere three months after opening.  I think the average consumer will wind up wasting a lot of product.  Exceptions would be multi-user households.

Like others, I have mixed feelings about this cleansing oil. I do like how it takes off my makeup. It helps break down my foundation so it comes off cleaner. What I'm so-so on is how my skin feels after using it. My skin tends to still feel pretty oily, although I'm not sure everyone will have the same result.

I'm wondering if the lingering oily feeling on my skin could be a result of what happens when one uses this cleanser with softened water. Some people mention they find it washes away cleanly, while others feel it leaves an oily residue. I'm wondering if those of us who feel their skin is still pretty oily after using it might be users who also have softened water.

I am still using this cleanser because I do like how well it takes off my color-stay foundation, but I also then rinse my face with a quick wash from a foam face cleanser I have as well. To take away the last bit of oily feeling left behind.
summary: Using with softened water might leave your skin feeling a bit more oily
