reviewText: I have somewhat sensitive skin, but this cleanser did not cause any irritation.  It has a nice, clean scent, that is not overpowering, but pleasant.  It left my T-zone clean and soft.  It says specifically that it is good on waterproof makeup and around eyes, but on my waterproof mascara, it did not take it all off.
summary: Good cleanser for my sensitive skin

reviewText: After a week of use, I'm not sure I can really tell a difference from my normal routine.  I would definitely not pay the current price of $22
summary: Didn't do much different than my normal routine.

reviewText:
I was quite skeptical about the claims that an oil based product could effectively cleanse my facial skin, but I have to admit that it really works well ! Just add a small squirt into the palm of the hand, add a little water, work gently into a lather, apply liberally to the face, then rinse off. It didn't sting my eyes at all, and washed away every bit of my waterproof mascara. To test how clean my skin was, I used some clarifying lotion on a cotton pad and found no trace of makeup on the pad. I found the scent a bit off-putting though - it smells like you're rubbing salad oil onto your face. Though I'm not a fan of overly perfumed products, it seems that in this case, a bit of added scent might have been helpful. The oil washes off easily, leaving no detectable residue, so I applied my usual moisturizer afterwards.

According to the label all contents are "natural origin ingredients", and the primary ingredient is sunflower seed oil.
summary: Yes You Can Clean Your Skin With an Oil - It Really Works !

reviewText: This is a non-foaming cleansing oil that works okay, but doesn't really take off mascara very easily, even non-waterproof mascara. I don't wear much makeup (a mineral foundation, some blush, a coat of mascara) and even after using this product like a wash (using my hands), some of my makeup remained and I had to use some on a cotton ball to get off the rest of it. It has an odd odor (perhaps the Shea oil) that I didn't particularly care for and it didn't leave my skin feeling clean. I have combination skin and I do enjoy a nice scrubbed face, so it might just be that this product and I are not a good fit. It would probably be nice for people with extremely sensitive or dry skin, but it sure didn't work for me.
It cuts through make-up or grease/oil leaving your skin feel smooth and clean. I would prefer if it didn't smell like baby powder though.
summary: Cuts through make-up and grease and oil.

reviewText:
This is a weird switch for me, having had oily skin most of my life and believing that more oil is bad.  Now that I'm older, my skin is drier, but even someone WITH oily skin may want to try this. It feels lovely.

I did an exfoliation first (my Sunday night thing) and then washed up with this.  Left it on a second an massaged it in.  Rinsed clean but with a lovely soft feeling.  After this I did my serum, night cream, and moisturizer.  I don't always do that series, as I usually fall into bed with my teeth brushed and not much else done to my face.  But on a good night I will take the time.  This was definitely a nice treat.

I liked especially that it didn't have an obnoxious overpowering scent (instead, no scent at all).  The bottle is large but a little will go a long way so it's worth it's price.

I did knock a star off because dispensing it was impossible with the pump. I had to get my glasses to read the tiny letters on the top and still couldn't figure out how the pump works so I just took the whole lid thing off and poured a bit in my hand.  Not cool.

For what it's worth, L'Occitane makes an Almond Shower Gel that is amazing.  Super soft too.
summary: Lovely feel and softness remains after rinsing.

reviewText:
Given the term "cleansing oil" I rather expected this to be a general facial cleanser, but that may just be my mistake. I didn't find it to work well as a general cleanser at all. Although it creates a nice, muted foam that has a laudable texture, it doesn't completely wash off. My skin decidedly felt far too oily after using this, unless I used a different cleanser/soap to wash it off.

That said, it did a pretty good job as just a makeup remover. I could easily see sticking this on your bathroom sink and pumping a little onto a cotton ball or pad at night to wipe off one's makeup with before washing your face. It did a good job of removing mascara, eyeshadow, etc. (though nothing I was wearing was waterproof, so I can't speak to that specifically). It's worth noting that it did not perform better than straight coconut oil in that respect, however, which is much cheaper.

I'm ambivalent about the scent. I usually like L'Occitane's scents, but this one didn't quite work for me. It's not obnoxious or overbearing, but there's something off about it. It seemed okay when I first opened it and gave a sniff, but I noticed when I went to use it at night that it didn't tend to agree with me as much. Just personal preference there, but I think the scent would be enough to dissuade me from picking it up again. It would be worth your while to try to find this in person somewhere and give it a sniff before you invest.
summary: Good Makeup Remover, Not So Much a Straight Cleanser

reviewText:
I was very excited to try this.  I've long wanted to try the Shu Uemura or Rodin facial cleansing oils, but they're just so darned expensive.  In recent years, the market seems to have been flooded with similar products at all price points but, with the exception of several free samples from the Japanese company DHC, I've still never bothered to pick one up.  I usually remove my eye make-up with Cetaphil and cleanse the rest of my face with an exfoliating product, so I've never felt the urge to stray from what works for me.  But since this was being offered as a free trial, I figured why not?

When it arrived, I immediately opened it and squirted a bit on my fingers.  My first impression was that it reminded me a bit of baby oil - the fragrance and consistency.  Very different than the DHC oil which was light and almost odorless.  Not off to a good start.  However, once activated with water the oil easily emulsified into a thin, slippery fluid and created a low grade lather that felt nice and rinsed easily.  My skin felt smooth, firm and moisturized afterward.  I was sold.

But the story doesn't end there.

After two days use, I noticed a number of clogged pores and two blemishes.  Now, I haven't had a blemish in years.  Years and years and years.  I honestly thought that any concern over zits was well behind me at this point, but I suppose I've just been using the right cosmetics and treatment products.  I tried the oil for one more night before finally calling it quits.  This seems like a high quality item and it may work for some, but I'm too old to be dealing with breakouts.

I have very dry hands and just spent 2 weeks in the drying southwest. This hand moisturizer is a life saver. It feels great and defends my hands against cracks and fissures. I've already ordered a back up tube.

I have had great luck with all of the Baxter of California products I have used; this is another winner.
summary: Another great product from Baxter; superb hand cream

reviewText: Like many reviewers of this product, I'm not male. But I still love this hand cream. It's thick, absorbs quickly with no sticky residue. The fact that it's fragrance free means it doesn't compete with my perfume. Just a little dab does wonders for my hands. Market to women too!

My wife found this hand cream to be an excellent product.  Her  hands are dry but not chapped or overly dry.  She has been using the product twice a day- morning and night.  It leaves her hands softer and smoother.  There is no odor and it does not leave her hands greasy or slimy.  The product seems to be absorbed quickly and it just improves the moisture in her hands.  WE recommend the product for anyone looking for a hand cream that moisturizes, has no odor and is non greasy.

I am very fussy about hand creams and lotions. They have to work, of course, but also to be pretty much non-toxic (many are decidedly not), and either have a completely fabulous and discreet scent that works with my high-end niche fragrance collection and/or essential oils or be scentless. I do not want to have a greasiness or tacky residue on my hands, and certainly not that dreaded "I am wearing plastic gloves" feeling. I am very happy to report that Baxter of California Hydro Salve Hand Cream actually works remarkably well and fulfills all my other requirements (except, perhaps, to be highly affordable). It's extremely thick, which is what I want from a hand salve, so I can work it into cuticles, elbows, and heels. It's different from wanting something to slather on my legs after I shave, and it delivers. Immediately, the hand cream dissolved into my skin, leaving a slight silky feeling for a few moments. Then.... voila! ... just nice, soft, hydrated, unscented skin. The only reason I can figure this is called a "men's" hand cream, is that it is scentless, and doesn't have a packaging attitude: it's a very simply designed tube and box, without that annoying "I am a girly bathroom design accessory" thing going on. The ingredients are really quite clean, no worries there, unless a tiny bit of trisodium EDTA upsets your apple cart (it's a common ingredient in toilet soaps made in the UK and Italy).
summary: Spectacular results from a clean, high quality and scentless product

reviewText: My hands are now silky smooth.  Living in Vegas my skin dries out and I frequently get callusus.  Using the Baxter Hand Cream keeps my hands nice and soft and there is no oily residue left behind.  The smell is very faint which is nice in a men's hand cream as you don't want an over powering scent.
summary: Really does good job keeping my hands soft.

reviewText:
My wife was going to use this hand cream, but reading the label she got a funny look on her face and shoved it at me. "I can't use this. It's says it's for men." I was skeptical, but sure enough, reading the label--this is a men's hand cream.

Well, I dutifully used it on my masculine hands, to make them smooth and shiny. It seems to do the trick. My white color computer keyboard abused hands aren't exactly rough, but whatever my manly requirements are for hand smoothness this cream meets them. I'm no expert, and not a regular hand cream user. I don't know that is enough to convince me to start, but maybe ...

The only problem is that my wife won't touch it because of the "men's label." I don't honestly know what spins this more towards men than any other hand cream. It doesn't have a particularly masculine scent. I suppose it is just marketing, but in this case it has backfired a little.

The cream is thick = a 1/4" bead is enough to thoroughly cover elbow and surrounding area or back of both hands.
It soaks in quickly and completely in about 5 seconds and works well to soften rough dry skin.

The cream provides/leaves a protective healing film of Shea butter on skin,
which is an excellent moisturizer and has exceptional healing properties.

The butter is noticeable by water beading up on back of hands.
Some folks may want to wash off palms. (requires soap)

Testing cream on only one elbow = upon which there are noticeable differences.
The Baxter elbow is tamed silky soft, and skin (briefly) very slightly cooler with lasting feeling of skin hydrated.

Not sure why Baxter hydro salve is targeted for men's grooming other than it's extra thick and contains zero fragrance,
but both genders of our family enjoy using the cream.

This cream is amazing. My hands have been drying a bit after using rubber gloves for extended periods of time on a home project. On top of that, I chopped Jalapenos for a salad and my cracked thumbs were in fire! Luckily, I received this cream on time. It has no odor, is snow-white, and does not feel greasy. It absorbed entirely in about 10 minutes and seem to heal my cracked hands very well. Excellent product!
summary: No odor, non-greasy, works well on cracked skin

reviewText: While this hand cream seems a bit expensive for the amount you get, etc., it is quite nice. I like really that it is unscented. It seems to last a while however as others have noted, if you wash your hands shortly after applying it, it will wash out and you can feel it doing so.
summary: A nice hand cream for men

reviewText: This is a nice, odorless hand cream but in all honestly, I could not tell a big difference from any other hand cream. My hands are in water on a daily basis and I use hand creams all the time. This cream feels nice, it is not sticky and does not leave a slippery feel on the hands, but after using it for a week, I could not tell a big difference on my cuticles and hands.
Light scent, very light. Also light lotion, could wear every day, ill report back after winter hits Pa. For now, its good lotion i can even use in summer.

I really liked Baxter of California Hydro Salve Hand Cream. It is a thick hand cream that didn't upset my eczema. Plus, the scent is pretty much nonexistent and the cream is very moisturizing.

My favorite part of the hand cream was how quickly it absorbed into my skin. Some hand creams sit on the surface of the skin for a long time, making it difficult to pick things up. Not this cream. This cream absorbed quickly and didn't leave my hands feeling greasy.

This is a wonderful hand cream. I would recommend it to anyone with dry, sensitive hands.

Ooops! I didn't realize this was a men's skin care line.  My husband set me straight though while I as going on and on about this fantastic hand cream I found.  I told him that explained why it didn't have any "scent" and he replied that generally speaking, men don't like their hands to smell like flowers.

Oh well, even if this hand cream is made for men I'm pretty sure that using it won't cause me to grow facial hair or my voice to drop an octave or two but it will keep my hands soft.  The best part is that even after I washed my hands, they still felt moisturized.  Especially the side of my palms, which are always dry and itchy and the back of my hands which also tend to feel dry, tight and flaky.  Those two areas are much softer.
summary: Made for men, but I love it too

reviewText:
I would describe this hand cream as thick but not creamy. It comes out thick from the tube, but applies onto the hands really easily.

It's odorless, which is a huge plus for me (and probably most other males?!)

I have calluses and rough patches from indoor rock climbing, and this works pretty well on smoothing them out.

I have had some pretty good success with Baxter of California products. This hand cream is no different. It comes nicely packaged, and the tube is easy to use. It's also easy to disperse the proper amount of hand cream. The hand cream itself feels a little weird at first, but it has no scent, goes on easily, and then disappears into the skin, so to speak, so that your hands don't feel greasy. So far, the hand cream has been working very well, and it seems like this will last quite awhile. So, while it seems fairly highly priced at $16, it's actually not too bad on a per-use cost. Overall, I really like this hand cream.

This is wonderful hand cream.  It has a great feel going on---not greasy or wet, but very good at making hands no longer dry feeling nontheless.  It's more like a paste than most hand creams I've tried---it comes out almost looking like toothpaste, but it has a much more smooth spread than that!  This is a product supposed to be made especially for men.  With 2 adult sons and a husband in the household, I was easily able to have men test it!  They liked it very much too, although I am not completely sure there is anything about it especially male, except for the non-feminine packaging.  But all sexes need hand cream at times, so it's a good product for all of us!
summary: Terrific hand cream, great feel going on---made for and liked by men, but I liked it a lot too!

reviewText:
This is certainly a heavy duty hand cream. My skin is horrible in hard water, so when I'm staying at hotels it can get to the point that my knuckles and heels will actually crack and bleed. It's times like those that I need a hand cream like this.

Pros:
-Gloriously unscented. I'm so tired of heavily scented hand creams- I don't want everyone around me being disgruntled by the scent of lotion wafting around.
-Works like a dream. I tossed some on my heels because I had excess from my hands, and I keep rubbing my feet together, they feel so soft.
-You don't need much. Like other Baxter products, a pea-sized amount will do for most people. They pack a lot of action into a small size.

Cons:
-Expensive. Although if you use a little at a time, this will definitely last.

Overall this is an amazing hand cream, and it's not just "for men" since it's unscented. Try some today.

I have to admit that I approached this hand cream with two opposite biases; having used other Baxter grooming products, I already expected it to work well, but conversely, I thought the price might deduct some points for being a tad excessive.  I'm very happy to admit that the first bias was correct and the second undeserved.  Because of it's rich consistency, I only need to apply a pea-sized dollop. It's readily absorbed and doesn't leave the skin feeling greasy as some petroleum based, less soluble products might.  Especially the back of my hands, which can appear paper-like when unmoisturized, felt immediately softer and plumper in appearance.  Due to the relatively small amount you need to use, I expect the tube to last longer than I initially imagined, making it a better value than I initially feared. As in most things, you do get what you pay for and a less ingredient rich cream would probably require using more of it more often, negating a bargain price. I tend to favor natural, unprocessed oils, like Tamanu Oil to soften my arms and hands and still use that before bed. But for during the day use, this has become my replacement product. Very effective, so well pleased.
summary: I only use a pea sized dollop so it's more cost effective then it initially appeared.

reviewText:
I was so happy when I found this hand cream from Baxter of California.  It's the first heavy duty hand cream I've found that is filled with ingredients that seem safe and healthy... and it actually works!  I'm in and out of salt water nearly daily so my skin ends up feeling drought-dry a lot.  I can rub a little of this cream onto my hands and it actually feels like the skin is drinking it up!  And even better, I don't have to worry about things slipping out of my greasy hands after I've used it.

The main reason that so many lotions leave your skin feeling greasy is that a lot of them are made with petroleum jelly.  Almost everything from the Body Shop, for instance, has petroleum jelly in it.  And, yes, petroleum jelly is made from crude oil and while I don't mind using it in my car engine I'm not so keen on putting it on my skin.  So I really appreciate the high quality ingredients Baxter's uses, like safflower oil, palm oil, aloe vera, chamomile, and green tea.  It's possible you could also use this as a salad dressing (but that's probably not a great idea!)  As a hand cream though, it works better than almost anything I've tried.

Although this lotion is designed for men, both my husband and I  love it. The lotion has absolutely no scent, which makes it a lotion we both can use. Lotion makes skin feel soft and moisturized,  but still natural.  Not slick or greasy.
summary: Love the fact it has absolutely no scent

reviewText: I have been using "Udderly Smooth" (unscented) as a hand and foot lotion for the ten years I've been in and out of chemotherapy.  I tried the Hydro Salve Hand Cream and was very pleasantly surprised at how well it compares.  First, it is unscented!  That is so important when changes in chemo often means changes in senses of smell & taste.  Next, it is quite thick and it absorbs and hydrates very well.

I'm not much of a tanner and the whole self tanning thing is new to me. My only goal is to make my legs a normal color and not frighteningly white. Just a light tan for yoga is my goal. While I normally just use disposable gloves, the optional mitt (sold separately) works very well to get even coverage.

This product goes on easily and evenly. I am not looking for a dark tan so I wash the product off at an hour. The product keeps developing into the next day. While on, the scent is not annoying but pleasantly light and fruity. The product rinses off easily in the shower. I end up with an even streak free light tan on my legs which is my goal. For me this is the most trouble free self tanner I've tried. If you are careful you can get the results you want.
summary: Easy to apply and control, not streaky. No harsh odors.

reviewText: This is a great self-tanning lotion. It has a nice consistency that goes on the skin smoothly. I have the XEN-TAN Deluxe Tanning Mitt which makes it easy to apply an even coat on the skin for a streak free application. It dries fairly quickly and leaves a nice color on the skin that doesn't stain clothing. I was initially worried that it would turn into an orangey or too dark a color that seems to be a common problem with many self-tanning lotion. I'm glad that it isn't the case. The resulting color is not too light nor too dark. It's a rather natural looking olive base color. It also has a pleasant, refreshing scent during the application. I'm really happy with it. The color doesn't begin to fade until the day 3 or day 4. So the weekly application is about right. Overall, I'm impressed with the result, a nice looking olive tan that I really like. Great product.
summary: Nice olive tan made simple; smells nice too

reviewText:
I'm still a relative newbie to self-tanning lotions, though I do love getting a sunless tan at a local salon so I'm pretty familiar with the type of results you achieve and how long it lasts.  This was also my second time trying a XEN-TAN product so this time, I was a little more comfortable with application and more familiar with the brand itself.

The big selling point for this tanning lotion is that it looks 'ultra natural.'  And having tried it, I have to agree.  In general I do think self-tanning products have improved a lot since I initially dabbled with them in my teens.  The results then were enough to scare me away FOR YEARS since the results were very orange and streaky.  The results of this product, to my eye, look much less orange and closer to a real tan.  I've actually been impressed with how close the color is to what I get when I go the higher end self-tanning salon in Chicago where the tanner is airbrushed on by a professional.  What I do prefer though about having it done there vs. with this product at home is that I generally opt for the clear solution that has no bronzer mixed in.  That means I don't have to worry about getting color on my clothes or furniture while I wait for the tan to set.  At home though I do think the added bronzer is necessary to help you keep track of where you've applied and where you haven't.  (If my experience with sunscreen is any indication I would probably miss spots otherwise.)  My solution to this has generally been to drape a blanket or towel over any furniture and to wear lose fitting clothes I can wash.  Thankfully I'm also going for a lighter tan so I generally only leave this on for an hour.

Of other things I appreciate, the smell is mild and totally pleasant.  And it's easy enough to apply this with a mitt, though I do get some help from my boyfriend for my back and other hard to reach places.

Overall I think this is great product and a perfect option if you want a natural looking sunless tan at home.
summary: Natural looking sunless tan at home

reviewText:
This product goes on easily when applied with a mitt that can be purchased separately that provide easy streak free application. Because I was testing this product, I applied it to one leg from thigh to ankle. There was an immediate change in color once my leg dried. As promised, this tanning product had a nice scent, did not come off on sheets or clothing, and provided a nice tan without being too extreme. The tan does fade slightly after a few days which recommends re-treatment once a week.
Since the color is neither orangey or too dark, I will probably use this on my face, neck, and arms for an overall tan. This is a nice and easy to use product and substantially better than other self-tanners I have used.

This self-tanner has a light fruity fragrance that is superior to most. The color intensifies over the ten hours following application. . I am very fair and applied this to my legs after exfoliating. I washed off after forty-five minutes. Initially, there was little difference but as the color developed there was a noticeable difference. I applied with a mitt (not included) and it was on a par with other products.  It does not stain clothing or bedding.  The end result was acceptable. Unlike many self tanners, this one contains olive tones instead of the awful orange. It was okay on my legs but I wouldn't use it on my face. The greenish tinge is flattering on my skin tone. My sister, who has a medium olive complexion, fared much better and loved the results. Neither of us experienced any unpleasant side effects. If you are looking for a tanner that leaves the orange out, this one is worth a try. 3.5 stars

What a great way for  me to touch up my tan. I like that I can add this to my natural tan. This is great when I want to touch up my legs and arms. This has a light scent.  Is perfect for that extra glow I like instead of being pale. Overall a good product for all over tans.

Like other Xen products, this one is okay (if not really overpriced). Nothing here distinguished this product from ones a fraction the price. The fragrance might be a little more pleasant, but outside of that, there is nothing particularly unique or effective about this tube.

Now, take it easy with this product. Use too much, and you are an unnatural color. So, it is MUCH better to begin conservatively (and check in with your friends as you use this ... they will tell you when you start to look weird ... at least, if they are pretty good friends, they will.)

This is okay. I wouldn't blow my allowance on it if I were a teen ... and I would not spend any genuinely hard-earned money on it either. Nonetheless, if you have a little extra cash, give this a try.

The XEN-TAN transformation ultra weekly tan is a bit different than most self tanners. You apply the lotion then depending on how dark you want your color, you wait anywhere from 45 minutes to three hours to let it develop before washing it off. This makes it the most complicated self tanner I have used and takes a real commitment to getting a decent result.
The end result was a nice, rich color but for me not worth the time consuming application process. The cost is also a deterrent even though this is a quality product. I would use this in anticipation of a special event but it's too much work to use as my regular self tanner. The quick drying time of the XEN-Tan mousse fits my lifestyle much better with comparable results.

I had mixed results with this product. I followed the directions exactly because I didn't want to end up with a blotchy skin tone. The mitt is very nice and does a good job helping to get this tanning lotion applied evenly. However, if you happen to have dry skin patches like I do, the tanning lotion gets stuck there and will not smooth out. Therefore, you have dark spots everywhere you have a dry skin patch.

It does spread nicely on smooth skin, and the mitt helps to blend it in nice and evenly if you're really careful about not putting on too much at a time. The color is nice. I was hoping it wouldn't be orange, because who wants to look like Donald Trump? It does not have an orange tint. The tanning looks quite natural as long as you do light applications at a time. This can stain your clothes if you're not careful. Especially white clothing. I would not wear white soon after application to be safe. And honestly, I think this stuff is way overpriced at $65.00.

All in all, it's probably good for younger women who don't have skin problems. If you have dry skin patches, this isn't a good idea.

This tan is easy to put on smoothly if you get one of the tanning mitts.  I thought it seemed silly to need one, but it goes on pretty smoothly and that matters when you are putting color on.

This was the first one of the tannins lotions that I used near my face and upper body.  The darker tans were funny but clearly not the right look.  Maybe earlier in the summer.

This color is a lot more appropriate to use during this time of the year.  I live in the north and people with tans just look funny.  We point at them and laugh.  Not really.  But most of them look like they are late to fly south.
summary: Light color is a big improvement

reviewText:
I love this brand of self tanner. It has a cooler tone to it than other brands that Ive tried so it is much less orange. The easiest way to apply it is with a tanning mitt. I like to apply it with a tanning mitt and then go back over my whole body once more with the mitt to make sure its all even. Tanning mitts can be purchased separately, I use the one sold by the same brand.

Besides the tone and coloring being so nice, it fades so evenly. I think that is such a stand out feature about this tanner. I don't get those unsightly, patchy spots. It just fades away evenly. It stays on for a good week and then I notice that Im just lighter again. No rough orange patches left like many other tanners.

There is also no stinky tanner smell.

3 standout features:
no orange shade
fades evenly
no stink

This is my least favorite of the XEN-TAN self tanners I have tried. It doesn't have the usual nasty faux tan smell, but I'm not crazy about the smell it does have. It is flowery and powdery in my estimation. Someone else may think it smells ok, but it's a scent that I like to avoid. The color was also somewhat darker than I prefer. I have used XEN-TAN dark tan creams and they have worked well for me, going on smoothly and subtly on my very light, white skin. But this one went on dark with a hint of orange. As I said, I'm very, very white, so someone with darker natural skin color may have an entirely different experience. I do think XEN-TAN makes the best self tanners available. I have been impressed with how different they are from even the St. Tropez and Clinique faux tanners that I used to like. My favorite XEN-TAN is the XEN-TAN Mousse Intense Weekly Tan, which has a wonderful vanilla scent, goes on ultra-smoothly, and gives a more subtle, buildable tan that lasts.
summary: A cut above other brands of self tanners, but not as good as some other XEN-TAN products

reviewText: This turned out to be a great product. I have used various self tanning products before and some were OK and some were not good at all, therefore I really had no true expectations. I was pleasantly surprised at this particular one. The lotion itself goes on smoothly. I will add, for review of this product we received the XEN-TAN Deluxe Tanning Mitt which is not normally included with the product purchase. I would however recommend purchasing and using the mitt to apply the product as it helps tremendously with applying it smoothly. The product went on easily and the smell is pleasant and very low key, unlike others that have an over whelming processing odor. Marilyn The tan did settle in naturally after a few hours and looks very real and natural. It has no orange fake tint to the coloring. Even after a few days, the tan still looks good. Also, the biggest pro is no coloring on my sheets or clothing. I can't boast enough about that as even the expensive spray on tans I've received have left coloring on my clothes and sheets. Overall assessment: The product works and does exactly what it claims! It looks as good as the tanning salon spray on's. It's not cheap, but spray on's at the tanning salons run approximately $20 - $25. Therefore, if you get at least 3 tans from this tube then you are probably ahead. No stains left behind on your sheets add even more value to this product and actually make it better than the spray on salon ones. I highly recommend this product and purchasing the XEN-TAN Deluxe Tanning Mitt that is sold separately.
summary: Best Self Tanning Product I've Tried So Far - Including at the Spray on Salons!

reviewText: The Transformation Ultra is a thick, creamy lotion with almost no unpleasant chemical odor that I find with some self-tanners. Instead, it had a cucumber melon scent. I found it a bit too sweet and strong, but far better than the smell of chemicals. The lotion is thick and easy to apply. However, it goes on sheer and does not provide an instant tan like some of the other XEN-TAN products, and I ended up missing a spot the first time I used it. I applied it with the XEN-TAN Deluxe Tanning Mitt. It is not necessary to use the mitt, but it did a nice job keeping my hands clean and was easy to rinse out. The mitt is sold separately and lasts through multiple applications. This tanner reaches full color after about 10 hours. It takes about an hour to dry and does not rub off until it is rinsed with water. I waited the full time before rinsing it off and the result was a deep, dark color tan which lasted almost a week. It faded naturally until the last few days when it became a little splotchy. I tried again, this time only leaving the tanner on for an hour before rinsing. The color was much nicer this time and more in line with my normal skin tone. And this time it faded evenly. I've tried many tanning products over the years with varying levels of success and find that XEN-TAN makes some of the best.

Xen-Tan is the best, and I love this Xen-Tan Transformation Ultra Weekly Tan. It smells pleasant (lightly fruity), it's easy to apply and produces natural and stunning results. This tanner is versatile and can produce a range of shades depending on how long you wait to rinse after application- just leave it on from 45 minutes to 3 hours and rinse depending on whether you want a light, medium or deeper tone. Color continues to develop for 10 hours. For my fair and untanned skin, at about one hour it's a perfect time to rinse. This tanner gives me a natural light to medium tone. This tanner has an olive undertone that seems perfect for my skin tone, and I love the natural healthy look this tanner gives my skin without any streaks. A mitt is recommended for an even application, though I apply this tanner with my hands and it still comes out even. The color lasts all week and fades evenly and gradually. I definitely recommend getting a Xen-Tan tanner. There are a number of awesome ones. This Transformation Ultra Weekly tanner works great, and I love that it provides the option of going for a lighter, medium or deeper tone depending on how long it's left on before rinsing. XEN-TAN Mousse Intense Weekly Tan, 4 fl. oz. was my favorite before trying this Transformation tanner as I really love its yummy vanilla scent, it's a leave on tanner that dries quickly and doesn't require rinsing and my fair skin consistently turns a natural looking golden tone every time. But it's a close call now that I've tried this tanner as they're both awesome, and I highly recommend this Xen-Tan Transformation Ultra Weekly Tan too.

I am one of those pale-skinned redheads who never tan, only burn and then burn more.  I have the WORST history with self-tanners.  The last time I wore one was summer before last.  We were traveling out of state to a dog show and all I took with me were capri pants to wear and when my friend saw the back of my calves, she said "what did you use to apply the stuff, one of those sponge cleaners for mini blinds?"  Apparently, it was a bit streaky.  And orange.  And generally uneven.  And darker around the ankle.  Sigh.

So the first thing you need to do is to buy the sponge glove that is offered for applying this product.  It is a very nice "mitten," with some substance to it and you can easily use it for several applications.  Important -- the glove needs to be rinsed off before first use to remove some sort of manufacturing process artifact and **then it needs to dry before you can use it.** And since the glove is not a flimsy throw-away, the drying takes a bit (I air-dried, unsure how it would last through the dryer).

Next, PLAN your application.  While some self-tanners require a lot of prep (loofah or other exfoliation, for example), this one recommends from 45 minutes to 3 hours of time between application and rinse off.  (It doesn't say what happens if you just don't rinse it off, and I'm not the right person to be going all rebel on it to find out, so let us know if you decide to experiment, okay?)  The product doesn't stay wet, so you can put on clothes and go do something in the interim, but you're going to have pretty strong self-tanner scent, so just plan your application time well.  Unless you are very good at yoga, you will also need someone to help you apply to your back.

The result is terrific.  It is very even, with no dark spots over knees and other spots where the color usually concentrates, even though I did nothing special for those areas.  Using the mitt, I was able to apply around the backs of my legs and even my traveling companion can't find fault with the self tan.  The color is great, NOT AT ALL ORANGE, but a very natural-looking toasted-honey on my pale Iowa legs.  Since I didn't have help, and because I plan to continue to spare the world any sight of my middle-aged midriff, I didn't apply to my torso.  However, I am impressed that the product, when applied to my "farmer's tan" arms and shoulders, seems to have evened out that abrupt change in color that occurs just below the armpit level.  So far, I've only applied the one "coat," but the instructions do indicate you can "build up" color over time.

If you've ever used self-tanner, you are familiar with the scent.  This product has a very light and pleasant version of it, but it is there, and, despite the rinse-off an hour and a half after initially applying the product and then a shower the next morning, I could still faintly smell that "baking" aroma the next day at work.  No one else commented on it, however, so it can't have been too bad...

I am SO glad to have this product on hand for occasions when I may want to transition to shorts or capris again in the future.
summary: Great self-tanner but don't expect to apply it "on impulse"!

reviewText: Great self tanner.  Goes on nicely when you use the tanning mitt with it.  It does not come with the mitt!  It helps to exfoliate before applying.  Gives a nice even "tan."  Not fake looking "orange" like so many others.  Good product.

This is a pretty good tanning cream. It is not orangey but is more of a natural olive colour. You can vary the depth of the tan by how long you leave it on  anywhere from 45 minutes to 3 hours, then you rinse it off and the tan further develops over the next 10 hours.
You really need the tanning mitt to have an even application.
The tan lasts for about a week and does look like a genuine suntan with the exception of on my elbows where it was blotchy. It does start to fade a bit as the week progresses.
Still it is a good sunless tanning product.

Key concerns with home-use tanning products are ease of application and natural results. On both fronts this product excels. Having applied the lotion with vinyl gloves and their sold separately application mitt, the mitt makes the task a bit easier but the color is obvious enough that it is no problem to apply evenly.

I have medium light skin and use products like this primarily so my pasty colored legs and arms have a more natural appearance. Applying once a week for 45 minutes to obtain a little color does not take much time and meets my needs. The color is realistic, rather than ghastly orange and the gradual fading looks organic. And, the scent is light and inoffensive. A product that does not disappoint.
summary: XEN-TAN Transformation Ultra Weekly Tan -- It Works

reviewText: This product gives me a nice color, and it smells better then most self tanners. It seems to wash off before a week is up, so I apply it every 3 or 4 days. I just used it for my legs and arms. It is pretty expensive for what it is. I usually use Suave Professionals Visible Glow Self-Tanning Body Lotion, Fair to Medium 7.5 oz, and I love it! The price is great, and the color lasts several days, if not a week. It doesn't rub off on clothes, like the Xen-tan does. However, the Suave has that self-tanner stink. So, the choice is yours!

The one thing about this formula that I like is the faint cucumber aroma.  Applying this is a bit different than some of the other XEN-TANs I have tried.  With this one, it's best to use it BEFORE taking a shower and let the lotion absorb for 45 minutes to a few hours before washing it off.  Also it's best to use a mitt or wear vinyl gloves before applying.  The tan that comes from this format is a natural-looking tan.  The longer you let it absorb, the darker the results.  There is a slight olive hue to this, so ghosts should not use this.
summary: Nice tan results, but follow directions!

reviewText: I am an avid user of sunless tanning products and have used them since they first became available. *This is one of the best, least smelly tanning products I have used. The two products that I typically use because they don't streak, have such a strong scent that my entire family knows when I put it on and my husband hates it. I am always so careful of when I can apply it, which is typically right before bed, after my husband is asleep! *This product, Xen-Tan, I can apply anytime! No one in the family notices because they can't smell it....love it! It has a very, very light scent. I did notice that after having it on for about 4-5 hours, there was a little scent, similar to my typical tanners but very light. It must be the product processing on the skin. I don't think you can get around this. I like using the tanning mittXEN-TAN Deluxe Tanning Mitt with the gel/lotion. I used it slightly damp, applied the clear gel to it and smoothed it onto my skin. I was a little nervous because there was no way to tell if I had applied it to an area, just had to remember. The first time, I had a little streaking problem but it wasn't anywhere that it could be seen. Note: if you are fair skinned, you are supposed to apply & wash off after 45 min so that the tan is not too dark(they also have a light/med tanning formulaXEN-TAN Transform Luxe Daily Tan, 8 fl. oz. this is cheaper as well) **Over-all, I am so pleased with the natural color tone. There is no orange tint to the tan, it really looks nice!** Also, I love that it doesn't turn my sheets and clothes brown after I put it on, like many do! I think my one and only drawback for this tanner is the price. If it was even in the 40 dollar zone, I think it would be flying off the shelves.

I have very fair skin and I left this on for 40 minutes and I got a natural looking light tan color that I am very pleased with.

I have tried several of the XEN-TAN products and each time using one it gets easier.  I have not had a problem with streaking or with the color rubbing off on clothing or bedding, but for the first hour after applying I wear a loose sleepshirt and throw a sheet over my recliner just in case.  So far, no problems.

I have learned to exfoliate prior to using any of the XEN-TAN products because it makes the application so much easier.

I think this is an excellent product with a pleasant fragrance that does not bother my respiratory issues.  It is easier to apply if using the mitt that is available separately or something similar.  At least it has been for me.

I have never been to a tanning salon and my days of being in the sun are long over, so this is a really nice way to look healthier!
summary: .works well on senior, light colored, freckled skin..

reviewText:
This is a wonderful sunless self-tanning gel that doesn't have the yucky scent that the less expensive ones do.  Xen-Tan's light cucumber melon scented gel is pleasant and leaves a medium to medium dark tan depending on your skin tone and how long you leave it on.

The first time I tried it I applied it with a plastic-gloved hand and the separately available mitt on the larger, smoother areas of my body (legs, arms, chest).  I just used the gloved hand for my face and it turned out nice and even thanks to the tinted color of the gel.  I left it on for about 3 hours as I wanted to see how dark I would get in this time.  After showering, I had a nice, even color that looked like I'd laid out, without the dkin cancer risk or the red burn!  It was a bit sticky for awhile after applying, about 45 minutes before I felt comfortable putting on loose fitting clothes but it was worth it.  It was hard to wait the rest of the time to see the results but it is the price you must pay, unfortunately, and it is a lot less annoying than the self-tanners with the weird odor.

My husband was surprised to see a suntanned me when he got home from work and thought I'd been outside all afternoon. Thank you Xen-Tan!

With Fall here and Winter on the way, it's nice to know I don't have to be pasty white, go on vacation, or wait until Spring to have a natural looking tan.  This is a bit pricey but not if compared to the cost of a spray tan and you can get at least 3 or 4 body tans from one tube, and more if you don't do your whole body. This is depending on your size, of course.

I had a nice, natural color for the week with daily showers.  I didn't have stained clothing or bedding.  Love it!
summary: Easy, Effective, and Smells Nice Too!

reviewText: This color is perfect for my daughter whose Black & East Indian
Great color. Great product. My nail tech was impressed with how nicely it went on. Its lasted too!
Beautiful color!

I love this color! It's a perfect neutral-like tone for most any skin color. I also looks great with a coat of Grapefruit Sparkle on top. I find it lasts about 2 weeks. The formula is a bit on the thicker side, but easy to deal with. I definitely recommend this color and product!
Love the color!

I adore this color. It's a great nude color that goes with anything. I wore this (and Safety Pin as an accent nail) for a wedding I was in, and it was chic and glam without being too 'loud'. Goes with anything; it's my go-to Shellac nude. Coverage is great, and it applies smooth.
good
Very pretty. Almost a creamy clay color. No glitter, sparkles, or pearl. Just a really lovely neutral.
Perfect nude color
I love this color from Shellac, it works for summer and it works for fall, very trendy!
Love this color

Color is lighter than  I thought. Good neutral.
Goes on well, cures well.

Before a day of skiing or snowshoeing I always put this on my face & neck.  It keeps my skin soft/protected from the cold weather.  It is not greasy and absorbs in to the skin.  You won't look shiny.  There is a fragrance that does last an hour or so on my skin so if you do not like fragranced lotion, you may want to look elsewhere.
summary: Super Moisturizing for the Face & Neck

reviewText: This moisturizer is amazing! During the winter my skin becomes very dry and flaky and a lot of moisturizers are greasy and I have using them. However, this one is not greasy at all but it's light and silky. It goes on smooth and leaves my skin so soft. I'm not afraid to use this anywhere I on my body as I know it won't leave it greasy and it will soak in leaving my skin glowing.
This is the first moisturiser to ever give me zits.
Great for very dry skin. In winter I have on my face very dry skin. This cream really helps a lot and it feels like a natural product.
All L'Occitane products are rich and improve skin moisture.
Feels good and absorbs well.
Love this product, so soothing & healing.  Great moisture!  Fast ship.

The description notes that this moisturizer is for dry skin, and it is absolutely correct. If you do not have dry skin (or seasonally problematic skin) you will likely find this moisturizer to be far too heavy for your needs. This moisturizer has the consistency of butter, it's more of a face butter than a face cream.  It has to be manipulated with the fingers to melt into the skin.  Once it does, though, the skin feels amazing.  My skin felt like velvet to the touch, and in my mind it was like I put a warm, soft blanket on my face.  For dry skin (especially dry skin troubled by winter weather) it was delightful.  I have combination skin that suffers in the winter.  I will use this as a winter moisturizer, but as it gets warmer I'm going to have to switch to something a bit lighter.  My only real complaint with this cream is the scent.  It smells strongly of baby powder.  I actually like my skin care to be scented, but I really don't care for this scent.  At the end of the day, this is a great cream.  My favorite L'Occitane moisturizer remains the Divine Creme Imortelle, but this cream is a great alternative at a really affordable price.
summary: Serious moisture for dry, chapped skin

reviewText:
This is a review of L'Occitane Shea Ultra Rich Comforting Cream. I was provided with a free sample for review.

My wife is a 50 year plus woman with normal to oily skin. This did not make her skin break out at all. It is not a heavy cream and is absorbed readily, leaving no greasy residue. It has a soft, light pleasant fragrance.

She applies it before bed, just a pea sized blob massaged into her face and neck. It's wonderful. She has used products costing twice as much that caused her skin to break out. This did not make her break out and was more effective than the more expensive products she has tried such as Lancome, Clinique and Estee Lauder.

She would definitely get this again
summary: A high quality moisturing cream ideal for face and neck

reviewText:
This is a great moisturizer with 25% Shea Butter. It is thick and creamy and smells pleasant. It goes on smoothly and soaks into my dry skin without a greasy feeling. It is a true luxury item with a luxury price tag. The jar is very small at only 1.7 ounces. It is not going to last me very long! That is the only reason that I did not give it 5 stars. At its current price, it is almost $19 per ounce.

I recommend this, but only if you can afford to fall in love with it!

I personally felt like the scent was a little bit overwhelming. It definitely has a highly floral fragrance which was a bit stronger than what I usually apply to my face. The Cream itself was very rich, but it didn't clog my pores at all. A little definitely goes a long way. I probably preferred it a bit more when it was rubbed on my neck than on my face.

I usually have very dry skin in the winter months, and this did a good job of hydrating it without making my skin feel greasy. If not for the strong scent, I would probably have given this cream 4-5 stars.
summary: Scent is a bit overwhelming, but it does a good job of hydrating the skin

reviewText:
First I have to say that I have ultra sensitive skin, with a few patches of hyper pigmentation and a very volatile disposition. My skin can be dry and flaky and then oily in areas. I was using La Mer for a while but really can't afford to plunk down my kids college savings on a face cream and that led me on a search for the product/s to help my dry/combination skin and my pocket. Make no mistake L'Occitane products are not cheap; they are high quality and one of the best brands currently in Europe, I bought some of their products in Switzerland and France. I'm using their Divine Youth Oil which is amazing as a rejuvenating serum, which led me to give this moisturizer a try. At first I was leery because it says that is Ultra Rich, but this cream is not greasy at all, it dissolves nicely into the skin, also feels silky and delicate. I could just spread this stuff on my face all day! Anyhow, it is very thick so usually I have a little plastic spoon to scoop out the cream. It smells wonderful and it doesn't irritate my skin, since it does tend to react to some fragrances in creams. Immediately your skin will feel nurtured and radiant, after two weeks you will see that it feels amazing.

I'm definitely a fan of L'Occitane and feel confident that I found the cream my skin needed!
This stuff is pretty thick, but it smooths out and soaks in nicely. Makes my skin feel good. Some have complained about the scent, but I found it subtle and pleasant.

The L'Occitane Shea comforting cream does feels good on the skin. It feels smooth and the addition of Shea butter gives your skin an instant feeling of rejuvenation. It is like just after treating your face an hour in a spa. The smell is not offensive neither; it also gives you a subtle aroma of Shea butter.

My take on the negative side is it is thick like a pomade so it is hard to spread on the face. It is not sticky, in fact it feels like you put powder once you have applied it thoroughly. You have to rub it on your skin or else you can see its white color on your face.

My first foray into L'Occitane was their soaps, which smell divine and keep my sensitive hands from getting raw and red in the dead of winter.  This winter has been brutal on skin and shea is a highly moisturizing ingredient which this cream features.

Upon opening the jar, the cream is so thick it feels like a luxe body butter.  It goes on smooth, and doesn't feel overly greasy.  I enjoyed the scent which feels clean, uplifting and especially appreciate the nourishing and hydrating feeling it leaves on hands, leaving my normally dry hands free of irritation or any redness during the super dry winter season.

Quantity is small, but because it is so rich, a little goes a long way.
Absorbs easily and not greasy.
Luxurious to apply.
Light fragrance reminds me of old fashioned baby lotion

Unfortunately this is yet another strongly-scented (think baby powder) L'Occitane lotion. Every so often I get one because I hear such good things about them. And they lotions themselves are really great. But I'm certainly not going to slather them on when the smell is so strong (and frankly unpleasant). I suppose there would be an uproar if they decided to change their "signature" scent - which I assume this must be, since it's been the same for all the products I've tried thus far. I wish they'd make an unscented version - I know shea butter tends to have an earthy scent that many people don't like, but this lotion is only 25% shea.

If you don't mind the smell, definitely give this a try. But steer clear if you're sensitive to strong perfume-y scents.

This review present two experiences for your consideration. I guess it shows how impressions of these products can vary.

My wife said it felt dry rather than creamy when applying, so much so that she felt she had to apply another moisturizer on top. There was also a noticeable smell which she didn't like at first - not unpleasant, just strong - but gradually became ok with her after a few hours.

I didn't notice the dry feel to the degree she mentioned. It's not as liquidy or creamy (or greasy) as some other moisturizer lotions but I didn't feel like I needed to apply another product on top. I've used "intensive care" moisturizers before which had a similar feel. I noted a slight sweetish odor similar to some beauty soaps or talcum powder, but to me it was unnoticeable within a few minutes. It may be that I use less than she does or I'm just insensitive:)

It seems to work but hard to say if it dies a much better job than others.

There you have it. Split the difference if you choose!

I love this cream and while the directions for uses suggest putting on face and neck however, I use for some dry spots on the back of my hands or even on a callus and it is very comforting.  Several reviewers have commented about the scent which to me smells like powder.  If I were using on my face I probably wouldn't like that but on my hands it actually smells quite nice and not too strong.  Friends eyes have been caught by the jar packaging style and I have let a couple try it.... everyone liked.
summary: Indulgent and recommended!  Good for gift idea.

reviewText:
If you're suffering from winter-dry skin that is flaky, tight, red, and/or slightly lined, this is the moisturizer for you.

The cream comes in a 1.7 oz. size, at a price of $32.00. If that seems expensive, consider that you will only need a very small (nickel-size or slightly larger) amount to cover your entire face. (Go for the slightly larger amount if you want to cover your neck.)

The jar itself is glass, and comes sealed with a foil tamper-proof seal. The jar is pretty enough to leave out on a vanity or bathroom counter. The scent of the cream (at least to me) was light, and pleasant. I could pick up the shea butter smell (familiar with it from other L'occitane products), as well as hints of lemon. A very soothing smell.

Besides smelling good, this cream does a wonderful job of smoothing the skin, and leaving a nice glow. Within two uses, some dry patches on my cheeks were gone, as was the dry, chapped skin on the backs of my hands! (I used the "extra" on my hands after applying it to my face and neck.) I use it strictly as a night cream, since it does NOT contain SPF. I have found that it absorbs well, and does not stain or rub off on pillowcases. (Also, because it is so thick and rich, I think it is a little heavy for a day cream --even if it did contain spf--, especially in the warmer months.)

Like many L'Occitane products, this one feels luxurious on the skin, and provides the benefits promised. I received this jar from the Amazon Vine program, but I've bought it before on my own (at Sephora), and will do so again. To me, it's worth the price.

One note: if you have oily or combination skin, you might want to try this ONLY on dry areas of your face. Otherwise, it might be too heavy for your skin type.
summary: Relief For Dry to Very Dry Skin

reviewText: Rich, creamy, and evenly absorbed, it leaves your skin moisturized without the slightest greasy feeling, pretty near a miracle during this rough Maine winter. The scent is mild and natural.
summary: Counteracts the drying effects of winter on delicate skin

reviewText: Super absorbent with a soothing and cooling effect. Smoothes skin and is true to its name as far as being comforting. Formula is thick and rich yet not at all oily or heavy. The formula contains Shea Butter which is rich in Omega 6's and Karitene, which help to moisturize. nourish and give extra protection throughout the day, The scent is even great, it's extremely subtle and not at all harsh, just a pleasant smell overall. It's the farthest thing from 'overwhelming'. I dislike anything with a strong scent so I was glad this didn't have that. Very light on the fragrance compared to other L'Occitane products.. Comes in a package made from recycled paper and in a beautiful jar. Would make a nice gift or a nice addition to your skin care regime and I'd definitely recommend this product.

The cream feels great. It really is hydrating and doesn't feel greasy. The only problem is the scent is way too strong. It smells like baby powder or something. It's overwhelming, especially for something used on the face. I don't know why it needed any scent at all. It's a bit too much for my taste.

I have tried several L'Occitane products and have really liked them.  This moisturizing cream is thick and has a slight powdery scent.  I've been using it on my neck and arms as they get very dry.  It is quickly absorbed and does not leave me feeling greasy.  For some reason, my arms and hands are very dry most of the time and this has soothed the itch and I see improvement.  My neck is showing fewer signs of aging as well.  I highly recommend this product and the other items (face wash, wrinkle serum) that I have tried.

This is an extremely effective cream if you have very, very dry skin. I am a huge fan of Shea when used on my very dry feet and hands. As for my divine face, it is dry but not nearly dry enough to use on me. It is very heavy and appears to not be easily absorbed into the skin. I applied it and there was still a slight layer of it resting on the skin's surface. As for the smell, it smells a lot like the Mitchum Powder Fresh Antiperspirant that I have used for year. Mitchum's scent dissipates quickly but this doesn't. I don't personally dislike the scent but I suspect those near me may end up hating it.
I would recommend this for severe dry skin and using it before bedtime. It will no doubt tame the dry factor without overpowering bystanders.
Update: I have changed my rating on this from 4* to 5* and this is why. I've been having an issue related to eczema. I had a horrible occurrence of facial eczema. While an OTC product helped reduce most of the swelling, redness, and severe dry skin subsequent trips to my dermatologist and prescription medication has done nothing for an issue on my eyelids and on my ears. The redness and dry skin has aged me by 10 years at least. I'm already shopping for a new doc, but decided to see if there was any product designed specifically for eyelids. I couldn't find the miracle cure, but I did find that in treating eyelids for this condition it required an ultra moisturizer. I tried this product. I used a minuscule amount on my eyelids and ears and reapplied multiple times for the last 24 hours. So far, the redness is gone as well as the dry flakey skin. I'm not itching and the rapid aging is disappearing. I'm going to continue using this and will update if there are any negative effects.
summary: Is A Little Greasy And Heavy, But Has A Surprising Benefit

reviewText:
For ultra dry skin, this L'Occitane Ultra Rich does the job.
While not crazy about the scent, when skin is needs more than most creams can offer, this will immediately make it feel better, and over a few days skin flakes and chapping are healing.
It has a 'warm' smell, odd way to describe it but it's true.
I don't this I'd use it in hot, humid weather, but dry skin usually isn't an issue in those climes.

This is a very thick cream that is extremely moisturizing.  It wasn't one of these creams that totally disappears into the skin: after applying, you could definitely feel there was something there, but I wouldn't call the feeling "oily."  It has a very light fresh scent to it that works for a woman or for a man.
summary: A thick, very moisturizing cream, with a light fresh scent

reviewText: Great lotion. Absorbs quickly without feeling oily. This particular lotion helps a great deal with peeling cuticles, which is a problem for me. Scent lingers, but is pleasant.
summary: Great lotion. Absorbs quickly without feeling oily

reviewText: Some reviewers claim this is not the original product, and, even though I have been using Crabtree and Evelyn for years, this is my introduction to this particular lotion and scent. I am very pleased with it...rich lotion that moisturizes without being greasy in the Crabtree and Evelyn tradition. The scent is light and flowery, which is what I want in selecting a lotion to use in warmer weather. I guess whether it is an "old lady scent" depends on your demographic! I happen to like what is frequently termed "Oriental" scents, and, while this is as far as one can get from that heavier, exotic formulation, this is a nice light change. The pump is a nice edition.
summary: I am very pleased with it

reviewText: This is a pretty large bottle, so it is a good value. Crabtree and Evelyn is one of the best lotions out there, and this one is no exception. It goes on easy and absorbs quick. It leaves your skin soft and touchable. I love this scent too, light and clean. I will definitely be back for more.
summary: Crabtree and Evelyn Summer Hill Body Lotion

reviewText: This lotion does a pretty good job of moisturizing - it absorbs quickly and doesn't feel greasy.  However the scent is not for me - it's a very floral per-fumy scent that makes me think 'old lady perfume'.  While the scent does fade a bit after a few minutes it does linger - I can still smell it faintly on my hands even a few hours later and after my hands being washed.
summary: Crabtree & Evelyn Summer Hill Body Lotion

reviewText:
I like Crabtree & Evelyn products but haven't used this body lotion before.

It initially has a strong (but pleasing) floral scent, goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly and does not feel sticky. The scent soon fades to a pleasant level that lasts for hours. Your skin feels soft and smooth.
summary: hydrating lotion with a nice floral scent that lingers for hours

reviewText: This blush is a very pretty color. I have fair skin and blush sometimes looks too dark on my skin. Not so with the Georgie blush. It gives me a glow, which is what I want. It's very creamy but not greasy. And I couldn't smell any fragrance. It's easy to apply with your fingers, makeup sponge or brush. It's perfect for a natural glow.

Blush has a nice natural color with a subtle shimmer. Creates natural looking color. Not obvious one is wearing blush. Goes on quite sheer. Flattering on medium skin tone. Goes on smoothly with a good dry feel. Easily blends.
summary: natural color with a subtle shimmer

reviewText: The Le Jardin Creme blush  went on very smoothly and left a dewy feeling on my cheeks. I used my fingers and easily blended it without the blush ending up looking unnatural or garish. Although it looks dark in the container, it goes on much lighter. The color stayed fresh for most of the day and came off easily with my facial wash.

I haven't used a cream blush in over a decade so it took some practice to get this right. I used it very sparingly to start because I wasn't sure how strong the color would be. It is actually quite subtle. It is a soft cream, you just rub it gently on your cheek bones and get a nice glow. It also has not caused me to break out which is what happened the last time I used a cream blush. Also A+ for being cruelly free.

I much prefer creme blushes to powder but they are harder to find. This one is excellent for several reasons. First, it has a nice creamy texture and goes on smoothly and evenly. The color is evenly distributed in the product so it was easy to apply using my fingertips. I have used other brands where I ended up with splotchy looking color but I didn't have that problem with this product.

The color is a darkish mauve with some subtle rose gold highlights. It is a neutral color, not too warm or too cool. I have very fair skin and it was easy to adjust the intensity because the color is sheer. I was able to make it darker by applying just a bit more. It spreads easily on both bare skin or over foundation. The color looks natural which is the most important thing to me. It lasts all day and if I want it darker at night I can just add a little more. I really like this product and will order more when this container runs out.
summary: Natural looking and very easy to apply

reviewText: As someone who tends to be light-handed with makeup, i was leery of trying this blush because I was afraid it would be too dark. But I loved the look the of the color for fall so I went ahead and tried it. I must say that I simply love this. It is easy to apply, you don't even know you're wearing it, and the color is light and natural and warm. It's just beautiful.
summary: But I loved the look the of the color for fall so ...

reviewText: I have been using cream blushes for years now because of how I can control where and how it is applied, much more so than powder blushes. Cream blushes can also be layered - either very light or deeper and richer. I love how this crme blush feels on my skin. It is easy to apply. With only one layer, it is a sheer, dusty rose but with additional layers, I achieved a warm rosy color which goes well with my skintone.  I use a BB sunscreen cream on my face in the morning - no foundation. I applied the blush to my satisfaction and did not touch up. Unfortunately, the blush was about 90% gone by the end of day. So this product does need to be applied again - hence I took off a star. Otherwise, I am very happy with the color, the texture, and the ease of application.
summary: Very happy with the color, texture and ease of application

reviewText:
I have pale skin with neutral undertones, leaning towards warm. (Foundations that look good on me tend to be called "natural" or "buff.") When I first saw this blush in rose gold, I thought it was going to be much too dark. Wrong! It's beautiful! Sheer and somewhat sophisticated, almost like a bronzer, but with a bit more color. (However, if you're looking for a bright pop of color, this shade is not for you.)

This is a cream, but it is not very slippery. Goes on easily with fingers.  Hasn't caused any breakouts on my acne-prone skin. My new favorite blush!

The only potential negative is the compact is very small. Some might find that off-putting for the $18 price.

This is a gorgeous creme blush. I have been using creme blush for several years now that powder tends to fade away after awhile. I wanted something that will brighten up my pale face and give me some color without looking garish. This blush does the trick wonderfully. I didn't need to apply a lot to give my face some semblance of color. It's going to be perfect for winter.

It is easy to apply. I use my fingers and it blends in real nicely. I usually wear foundation, so my skin is already smooth before I use this blush. I think it would work just as well on naked skin. It just has a creamy feel to it. The color looks darker in the case than on the skin. My skin doesn't break out like it would with other brands.

The price isn't too bad, especially if you like to buy upper end of make up. It is worth the extra dollars as it will last a long time since you really don't need to keep reapplying this blush like you do other things. It's a keeper.

For $18, this blush is priced more competitively than other brands, yet delivers similar quality.

That alone is all you need to buy this French blush.

I am fair skinned and wear very little make up , most make up itches. This goes on very smoothly sand does not titch, I am not aware I have it on. The color is very nice for my very white skin. It makes me feel like wearing more makeup on a regular basis.

If you like creme blushes, this one is a lovely one.  The color is natural and applies evenly as directed.  It may take a couple coats to look dark enough for some complexions, but I am fair, and one "finger" of color was plenty for my cheeks.  Nice.

I have naturally red skin around my cheeks and nose, so I don't often use blush. However, there are times (especially when I've applied foundation), where I want to add back just a hint of color without overdoing it. Georgie's blush is perfect for my needs. It goes on creamy smooth and sheer to start, with a hint of gold shimmer. Keep building it up and you get a more substantial color, but you have to work to get it on my skin tone (Hispanic, light beige). The shimmer and color last all day without needing to reapply, and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

I love this stuff.  The texture is perfect. A two year old could apply this blush and it will look good.  Easy to blend, not garish or difficult to work with.  So so nice once applied.  It's a true touch of color without streaking or annoying time needed to get the application correct.
summary: In love...wish all makeup was this foolproof

reviewText: This is a neutral and very light shade.  It's texture is extremely silky so it glides on easily.  Since I have fair skin I've been using it more as contor than as a blush.

I wore this crme blush the day after I received it and I love it.  It is very soft and light and applies smoothly.  The blush adds a sort of glow to the skin tone and the blush itself is sheer.  I have the Rose Gold which is perfect for my pale complexion.  The best way to apply the blush, in my opinion, is to just use your fingers.  Just be sure you wash your hands first.  Then lightly pat the blush onto your cheek, especially the apple of the cheek.  The shade may seem bright but, if you just keep patting it, the color will soften into a natural glow.  Super easy to apply and long lasting.  Definitely my new favorite and the only blush Ill be taking with me on my next trip.

I am very pale and I thought this color might be too dark. Not true!  I think it looks very nice, especially for evening wear. It creates a warm drama for me and I really like the color and consistency. I applied this with a make up sponge which gave me very smooth flawless color without streaks. I'd probably not use it for day wear but I have a lot of events coming up and this will be part of my front line makeup approach. It feels good, has decent staying power and goes well with my foundation. Very nice find, had not used this company's products before.
summary: Very pretty cream blush, worked well even for my pale complexion.

reviewText: I have very light skin (which never tans, even a little.  Because of this, I have to be careful with blushes.  Most of them make me look like a marionette doll (with bright red circles on my cheeks).  Not so with this creme blush.  It goes on much lighter than it looks in the compact, but that's perfect for me.  Just a little gives me a naturally blushed look.  A little more, and it highlights my cheeks perfectly.  It's almost impossible to get it wrong with this blush, even with my ultra light-colored skin.

This is a nice quality cream blush. The color is a very natural looking medium tawny pink. The texture is smooth and creamy.  I applied the blush to my cheeks with my finger tips and the color went on smoothly and evenly without dragging or streaking. Application was smoother when applied over a light coat of foundation, but it was fine when placed directly on bare (but moisturized) skin. The color lasted longer when applied over foundation, but this is to be expected.

I have a light olive complexion and I found this Rose Gold shade to be quite becoming. If you are familiar with Bobbi Brown Sand Pink and/or Tawny powder blush shades, Rose Gold falls somewhere in between.

I've tried a few Juicy perfumes now and I've generally liked them.  This one is no exception!

It is definitely fruity at first (the top notes are listed elsewhere as apple, pear, and pomelo), but that mellows out later on.  After a few hours, I am left mostly noticing a bit of musk and vanilla (two of the base notes).  Since my favorite fragrances are musky, I'm happy with this.  (The middle notes are several different florals.  I think they blend well with everything else but aren't super noticeable with my body chemistry.)  I have to say, it's rare that I like a perfume at all points in time, but I like the fruitiness at first and I also like the musky/vanilla scent later.  It's also rare for a fragrance description to match exactly what happens with my body chemistry, but here it does!

The scent lasts about half a day but then needs to be reapplied.  This is about average performance, for me, for similar types of products.

Please note: Check seller feedback carefully before making a purchase, because large bottles of designer fragrance are sometimes counterfeited.  (Good seller feedback is an indication that people are happy with the seller, and therefore also an indication that the product you receive is likely to be genuine.)  Also note that this is a flammable liquid and can only be shipped ground, so it will take longer to arrive and returns will probably not be accepted.  Please plan your orders accordingly.

In the end, I'm very happy with this fragrance and will definitely buy it again soon.

Gorgeous long lasting fragrance.
Just spray it on in the morning and it will last all day without being over-powering.

I like the smell of this perfume.  I find the scent very youthful.

Unfortunately, the plastic gold stars decoration on the bottle I received was wobbly making the bottle feel cheap.  It could be ok for a drug store brand perfume for under $20, but it is unacceptable for a $50+ bottle of perfume.
summary: Smells great, wobbly gold plastic stars cover

reviewText: It just did not work, despite the impressive packaging and attention to detail in the design and construction.

Of course this hurts. It's a laser. It feels like a bee sting and a rubber-band snapping on the skin. I've gone to a dermatologist for laser treatments and laser hair removal. This laser feels just like the doctors. It's easy to use. It's tricky to get the sensor contacting the skin properly. With practice it can be done. I've only used it a few times do I haven't noticed improvement yet.  I am frustrated because I cannot program this. The website they send you to is under construction. So I am just guessing how to use it. Once the website is fixed, I can get a personalized program custom made just for me. That might make a difference. I already own the Tria Laser.  I find the tree at easier to use because you continuously move it on the skin and the laser pulses as you move. This one you have to lift it completely off the skin each time in order for the laser to fire.  I will update my review after I have used it for at least six weeks.
Very confusing to get to operate.  Have to be an electrical genius; cannot get mine to work.  Sending back.  I would rather pay for immediate results if I am going to spend this much money.\
summary: Really think before buying this one

reviewText:
I really appreciate what they have done with the iluminage Skin Smoothing Laser - it brings a treatment formerly only available in a doctor's office into your home! My son and I had previously received hundreds of dollars of laser treatments for skin appearance in a dermatologist's office. With this device we can treat ourselves more often and without the inconvenience of going to the doctor.

Yes, there is a prick each time a pulse is delivered, just as I felt in the doctor's office. It really isn't that bad, esp. as I am motivated to improve my skin appearance. It feels very much like a mild static electricity zap. For my skin, I notice a little redness and tingling for a couple hours after each treatment, so I do it at night as recommended in the instructions.

After just a few treatments I am already noticing improvement, though the directions say it can take 4 weeks of daily use to see results. Although it is only recommended for rhytides (wrinkles), I noticed improvements both on minor scars as well as wrinkles.

The device is very stylish and easy to use. It is stored in the charger and has a rechargeable battery capable of delivering all the pulses you need in each treatment. To turn on, just hold down the power button for a few seconds - this is supposed to prevent children from accidentally using it. Then select the level (low or high) by tapping the power button and press the tip to your skin until the tip lights up and automatically delivers a pulse into the skin. It won't activate unless pressed against the skin, and I found it can be tricky at times to get it to activate. Wait until the light goes off and the tone ends (or it gives a warning alert and you have to redo that spot). Then just lift it from the skin and press on the next spot.
