The fabric, and I'm not familiar with how one washes copper infuses polyester nor any other qualities, feels strange. Almost like vinyl...

I'll update this review in a month or so and let you all know if this magical pillow does anything for my skin, but for now it gets 3 stars because if this doesn't noticeably change my skin, there are a lot better things I can spend $60.00 on.

I never thought about how a pillowcase can mess up the skin.  I do know that I wake up with bed face, creases on my face from my pillowcase and when I'm running late, I go out of the house with the creases very visable.  I've been using this for 3 days now and I don't have the creases on my face.  Not only that, I noticed my hair is not all crazy and knotted and this pillowcase feels cool on my face and head.  I really do see a difference in my skin in the morning.  It's smoother and I'm not sure if it's all in my head, but my skin feels softer too and more supple.  I never knew a pillowcase could change your skin.  I did hear about people sleeping on silk pillowcases but I never really paid attention.  I'm now a convert from my cotton pillowcases to pillowcase.  I think all women should sleep on this type of pillowcase.  My husband doesn't like to sleep on it but he did try it for about an hour and said it was smooth and silky.  I'm so happy with this product.
I like the feeling of the case.
great for sensitive skin and lather pretty good

The husband won't use anything else. He is a product snob and got addicted to this from one of his Birchbox subscriptions. Now we buy it all the time! Bonus: I use it on my legs too- Amazing! Oh and he has sensitive skin and this doesn't bother him AT ALL!

Great product!  Recently reverted back to a safety razor and had tried several different brands including the "Taylor of Old Bond Street" and Jack Black.  However, this product has provided the best results for me by far.  Furthermore, I use the accompanying Pre Shave Cream and together they are definitely my favorite.  These products are tried and tried for many generations - no gimmicks just high quality product in simple packaging.  Bravo!

Doesn't see a difference other than loading compared to the soap. Feels the same. I'll see how long it lasts. If it also close to the soap I might stick with the cream. Although, I use a boar brush and face lather and the soap seems to be better since it's in a bowl. I just don't like when it gets low and there's nothing in the middle and it's all on the side of the bowl.

Favorites shaving product though.

I can't decide if I like this or the green better.  This is an amazing product and I highly recommend it.  I prefer the tube to the tub as I find I can control the loading of the brush easier.

The scent is hard to describe but there are notes of lime and apple.  Very fresh and pleasant.  Whereas Proraso green's scent reminds me of Vick's vapor rub (in a good way), I'm not sure what this reminds me of, but it is a great scent.
summary: I can't decide if I like this or the green better

reviewText: I have been using Proraso Shaving Soap in a Bowl, Refreshing and Toning, 5.2 oz (150 ml) for years and swear by it as the best product for a close shave that doesnt irritate my skin. But, when I saw the Proraso Shaving Cream for Sensitive Skin, I decided to give it a go as an alternative for when I travel and don't want to carry both the plastic container the shaving soap comes in and my shaving brush. The shaving cream isn't the best fit for this because the tube is huge, but I am very pleased with the product. I have been trying to use the cream without a brush to see how well applying it without a brush works. I think that I am using much more of the product when I use wet fingers instead of a wet brush, but it does work. The shaving cream feels slightly greasy when applying it, but it washes off cleanly, leaving skin that feels moisturized. The shaving cream has a light scent which I barely notice. For shaving, the shaving cream works well. I can make smooth strokes using my safety razor to get a close shave and my skin does not feel irritated afterwards. This is particularly important on my neck where the skin can get irritated if I shave too close too often. Overall, a nice product, especially if you are looking for shaving cream for sensitive skin. Otherwise, I recommend the Proraso Shaving Soap which is more convenient to apply using a brush, has a nice scent and works well.
summary: Nice shaving cream for sensitive skin

reviewText:
Proraso Shaving Cream has long been available in the "Green" scent (menthol & eucalyptus) and has achieved renown as a good basic shaving cream, offering easy lather creation and lots of slickness. The deficits in that formula were few but significant: 1) menthol present (not everyone likes that chilly / irritating feeling), 2) limited post shave care (dry / sensitive skin will feel non-optimal after the shave unless you chuck a balm and / or moisturizer on also), 3) lack of cushion compared to tallow soap. (Kind of apples and oranges as the ProRaso cream is being compared to a soap but as long as you are using a brush, a soap is about as easy to lather as a cream, so why not expand the comparison? Non-brush users should stick with a cream, but they really should try a brush. Odds are you'll like it!)

The ProRaso sensitive formula (aka ProRaso "White") has long been a formula in the soap base, but is now offered as a cream, How does it compare to the original Green?

Much better post shave feel - skin is better soothed and moisturized. Many men with normal skin types will not need to use any added skin care products to have non-red adequately hydrated skin. Eggshell face types may still need extra care, especially during cold, dry weather, but even so, White Cream is much more effective than Green.

Lather creation is as easy as the original; a quarter sized dollop will give you a three pass shave, and the lather is easy and quick to work on the face or in a bowl. Slickness is much the same as Green, i.e. very good. Cushion, unfortunately, is also much the same, i.e. not as good as a tallow soap. If you only want a cream (i.e. don't like using a brush) and / or only want vegan products, this is about as good as you can get, but if you want a vegan soap, there are better options (e.g. Wholly Kaw) and if you don't mind using tallow, there are many better options (Tabac, Barrister & Mann, Mickey Lee, Mr. Fine, etc.)

The PR White cream works better than the soap - the soap sometimes dries out on the face during extended duration passes and got flaky. The cream has no such issues, and does everything the soap can plus more, so there is no real reason to stick with PR soap at all anymore, unless you want the extended shelf life. (Most creams start to break down in scent and / or performance after about 12-18 months of use.)

The one issue with the White is that the scent is a bit weak and medicinal. I like it better than Blue, but the Green and Red Proraso creams have better and stronger smells.

TLDR: better than the White Soap. Better than the original Green cream for post shave feel, same in terms of glide, lather creation ease, and (sadly) still has inferior cushion compared to other brands of soap. Still, if you want a cheap cream with good post shave, this is excellent.

So my shaving section of the bathroom is all about Proraso.  Ever since I discovered the old school way of shaving with a single blade safety razor, cream that you whip up in a cup with a beaver fur brush...I will never go back to the endless money pit of the main brand razors.

That being said, this sensitive skin cream is not my favorite.  I enjoy their classic scent much more than this one, and I can't say as though I noticed any additional protection from the sensitive skin cream vs. classic.

Still a great product, just not my favorite from theirs.

I have been using Proraso Beard oil for some time now so I thought I'd try the shaving cream. Its terrific. My razor glides through the whiskers and theres no burn or discomfort. I shave under my neck where my beard ends so its sensitive there. So long shave gels.....

Kind of a lighter, fresher version of high end shaving creams I have used. The cream uses more of a soap-based strategy versus a lubricant-based one. The consistency of the cream is thinner and is almost runny when you rub it between your hands and apply it to your face. A lubricant-based cream is thicker and requires more effort to apply to your skin, you can feel the lubrication as a layer between your skin and fingers, and when you shave it off, it tends to build up in between the blades of your razor. Another difference is how your skin feels afterwords. The soap-based cream washes off easier and leaves your face squeaky clean. A lubricant-based cream takes a little extra cleansing to get off, but leaves you with "baby soft" skin.

I am not saying one is better than the other. Both strategies work well and you get used to them with routine. I found the Proraso to be effective in preventing razor burn, but I think a lubricant-based cream has an edge there if you do nick yourself. I definitely like the refreshing fragrance of oatmeal and green tea. Make sure you keep the box if you want to read anything in English. Maybe it's to emphasize it is an Italian product, but the product appears to be the same product as found in Italy.
summary: A lighter, soapier version of a good shaving cream

reviewText: This shaving cream is very thick and rich, so much that when you first open it, its hard to squeeze out of the tube. It gets easier eventually though. Also, if you use it in the shower and the tube gets wet, its really slippery. The  cream really lubricates and hydrates allowing for a very nice and close shave. You skin feels soft after using it and it smells good. It clogs the razor pretty quickly so you need to do a lot of rinsing. To get it to lather up I put some in my palm and rub my hands together vigorously until it lathers. Its a bit pricey but most creams of this quality have a comparable price. It really is good stuff and you skin feels great afterwards but I docked it star due to the difficulty in dispensing it.

Shaving cream and razor blades seem to be a subjective experience.  The Proraso is good quality for the price, squeezes out of the tube in a nice thick bead, and lathers up well with the brush.  By the time I got to the end of the shave, the cream in the last areas had dried up somewhat, and didn't provide the same amount of glide.  The metallic tube, like old-school toothpaste, got rather dinged up in shipping, and I had a similar Italian brand in my travel kit recently punctured.  Plastic tubes ship and fly better.

I have the Proraso green label shaving cream, as well as the red in addition to this.  This is how they stack up:

The green is the baseline, general purpose shaving cream, and it is nice.  The menthol feeling is soothing.

The red is for thicker beard growth and is my favorite, the cream really works good for heavy growth and the sandalwood is a wonderfully enjoyable scent.

This white shaving cream is for sensative skin and for that purpose it works quite well.  It lathers easily and heavily and the additives (oatmeal and something else) do leave my skin feeling soft and moisturized.  Its a great shaving cream, and will be a noticable step up if you've only ever used Barbasol or any of the aerosol gel stuff they sell at a corner store.

I can say that about the other two types as well.  I like the red tube the best, but any Proraso shaving cream I've tried has been excellent!  Give it a shot, you may never look back!

I changed over from disposable razors to using a Edwin Jagger DE89Lbl Lined Detail Chrome Plated Double Edge Safety Razor, a Escali 100% Pure Badger Shaving Brush and a few different types of shaving cream. Proraso is the one I have stuck with. I do have a shave mug and hard soaps that are quite nice, however, I keep coming back to Proraso each time. I have tried 3 Proraso types and I like them all. I do owe a lot to the leisureguy shaving blog. I highly recommend it and he has a book here on Amazon: Leisureguy's Guide to Gourmet Shaving the Double-Edge Way. After reading either, I doubt you'll go back to shaving with disposables. After preparing my brush, I squeeze about 3/4" of shave cream on to it and whip up the later on my face. The lather is makes is excellent and it's fast. The smell is nice, kind of medicinal pine scent to my nose. It doesn't irritate my skin and my Derby blades glide nicely and give me a good shave. This tube is $10 at this writing and it's worth it. I get months from a tube ( I don't shave every day) as I need so little to get a good shave. Why I like Proraso Shaving Cream: Makes a a great lather quickly Doesn't irritate my skin Lasts a long time/Doesn't need a lot of product to work Good value Protects my skin and makes the razor glide nicely
summary: Excellent shaving cream; lasts forever and works incredibly well

reviewText:
Provides great lubrication for my Merkur long handle safety razor with Feather DE blade to glide smoothly, smells great, only a little is needed.  I apply an almond sized amount to my face and it is enough for the shave.  I just add water when needed.

I tried different versions of shaving creams, gels, foams, and brush applied soaps, and I eventually stuck with Creamo Cream.  I think this shaving cream from Proraso is as good, but, sadly, it is quite a bit pricier.  I also wish it had a bigger cap so I could stand it up vertically.

I use this shaving cream with my brush and double edge safety razor, and it works great.  Just a little bit of the cream with some water goes a long way for me, so I think this tube will last me for a long time.  I really enjoy the light scent, and it doesn't leave my face feeling dried out.  I'm not sure yet if it's more economical than my regular Proraso dry soap, but it would definitely consider buying it again.

I thought it was a little interesting that the product is from Italy, and the packaging is almost entirely in Italian.

I couldn't resist, being half Italian, checking out this brand. I'm happy to say my partial ancestry didn't let me down. This stuff glides on smooth, smells great, and gives me a clean shave, without nicks, every time. Highly recommended.

I gave the Proraso Shaving Cream, Sensitive Skin to my husband to try and he loved it!  He said the fragrance on first opening the tube was strong but that it quickly dissipated, leaving a mild pleasant smell.  The razor seemed to glide easily through the cream, giving a smooth shave and leaving a soft feeling to the skin on finishing.  This is the best cream he has ever used; much better than any other cream or foam and we will be buying this from  now on.

I've used a few different Proraso shaving creams in the tubes (they also sell some in tubs as well if you are interested).  I've previously used the green and red versions of this (I think there are 4 in all) and really enjoyed them.  The sensitive skin one does seem to be a better for me (I have a lot of issues on my neck, and if I'm not careful I'll get lots of bleeding there), and I really enjoy the scent.  The Prosaro scents really work for me, they are quite mixed in their fragrances and I never seem to get sick of them.
summary: I've previously used the green and red versions of this (I think there are 4 in all) and really enjoyed them. The sensitive skin

reviewText:
wow! a very nice change-up from my usual Arko Ivory Snow-smelling shave!

although Arko shave sticks are a bargain, this shave cream smells better and performs just as well as Nivea's shave cream (the tube type and the cream from Germany which is superior, not the American market Nivea shave cream, which is inferior)

like the Nivea, i put a large pea-sized squeeze of Proraso's cream onto my badge brush, which had been heated and wet in a hot shave mug... applied the cream, and it covered my face...

after a single-pass using my vintage Gillette adjustable with a made-in-the-USA Personna blade, my face felt nice and smooth!

there was a great fragrance and no dryness like with the Arko...

i may have to side with the Italians over the Turks on this one! this cream is a winner!
summary: Beats Nivea and Arko hands down!

reviewText:
I have been shaving with a double-edged razor for many years now.  If I have learned anything from this experience I have learned that a shaving soap can make a huge difference in the shaving experience.  Shaving with a double-edged razor can lead to a very clean shave but also significant skin irritation.  Up to now I have used various soaps with a brush, including Proraso, Baxter of California, Taylor of Old Bond Street, and Pre de Provence.  All work well, but you must apply them with a brush.  So I was curious to try this Proraso Shaving Cream, which can be aasily applied with your fingers, although a brush could be used if desired.

The product sent to me for review was amply sized in a carton containing no instructions printed in English (Proraso hails from Italy, so if you read Italian you're all set).  It was sent to me in a padded envelope, though, which resulted in my carton of soap being smashed.  Thankfully, the tube was not ruptured and still usable, and no soap was lost. If this is how this product will be shipped by Amazon I recommend ordering other items at the same time so it will be shipped in a more protective box.

I washed my face with hot water and left it wet.  I found a dime-sized drop of the shaving cream was ample to lather up my face, rubbing it on with my fingers.  I left it on my face for a few minutes to let it soften my beard well before starting to shave.  For this evaluation I used a Baxter of California double-edged razor with a Derby blade.  My face had several days of beard growth, so it was an added challenge for the soap.  I found the shave to be very smooth and easy, and there was no need to apply more soap despite multiple blade passes from different angles.  There was absolutely zero irritation, and the soap washed off easily and cleanly.  The scent is very mild and would not pose a conflict with any aftershave.

Overall, I am very impressed with this soap.  It is inexpensive and works equally well as soap applied with a brush for a close shave with no residual irritation.  It could certainly be used every day, but it would also be ideal shaving soap for travel use where taking a brush and soap mug along can be cumbersome.  I highlly recommend this product for anyone who appreciates shaving with a straight or double-edged razor.
summary: applies easily; close, comfortable shave with no irritation afterward

reviewText:
I quite liked the feel of this product on my skin and it does a good job of protecting from nicks during shaving, but I'm not a fan of the menthol scent so I am deducting one star.

While this product can be applied like one would shaving cream from a pressurized can, it is actually designed to be applied with a shaving brush.  Either way you won't get the kind of huge foam that is typical of shaving creams that come from pressurized cans, but it's still doing a good job of lubrication even though it doesn't produce a thick layer of foam.
summary: Good lubrication with "old school" menthol scent

reviewText:
My husband has been using the regular Proraso shaving cream for about five years, and, while it hasn't bothered his sensitive skin, he was still eager to try this new formulation since it promised to be even more gentle than the regular Proraso.  He loves it!

The instructions for this say to use it with a shaving brush, but he has always just rubbed it in with his fingers, and it creates a thick cream.  Even when he's gone a few days without shaving, this provides such a nice, close shave.  It's also a bit cleaner to use than foaming shaving cream, which tends to splatter a bit all over the sink.

Also, the tube lasts forever since you only need a small amount.

If you're sensitive to fragrances, this also has a light scent that dissipates as soon as you use it.

This is another really fabulous Proraso product!
summary: Great for sensitive skin, and leaves your skin feeling so soft

reviewText: I am going to use this as my travel cream.  It goes on nicely, I like the slight oatmeal aroma, and it gives me a nice, close shave.
This shaving cream works well, especially with a bristle brush. I typically prefer saving soap, but that is too cumbersome to travel with, making this tube a good option.
Color is ok. Would be great with a shimmer
Love this color wear it all the time. It works for all seasons depending on your mood. Color matches photo as expected. The quality of the polish is what you would expect from cnd.
I am not a fan of purples but this is a must have color!  Not purple and not quite blue.
summary: I am not a fan of purples but this is ...

reviewText:
Spray this on, go make your bed or relax for five minutes, and take a shower. Your legs will be smooth and soft.

The depilatory chemical is recognizable by its smell, but bliss has done a good job of making it as quiet as possible, and there is a fresh scent over it. I felt some tingling, but no irritation. Also no dripping or smearing or cuts, and it's way faster than an Epilady..

The package makes it clear that this not a substitute for your Brazilian wax, but for everyday smoothness, I'm completely convinced that this is the best option.

Meh, I didn't find the smell of the product to be that bad when I applied it. Perhaps I'm just not as sensitive as others are though -- it was definitely noticeable but nothing I couldn't live with.

The product burned a little on my skin when applying but did appear to get the job done. I'm only applying it to small areas at a time due to my skin being very sensitive but aside from the burning it's not too bad. I may stop for that reason alone though but I kind of expect some burning with a product intended to fuzz off hair.

Smells awful and didn't remove my hair completely. To be fair, I have very light hair on my arms and legs. I imagined I'd rub this stuff on, then after 5-10 minutes,  wipe it off and my legs would be silky smooth. Not the case for me. I had to shave anyway and it smells just as bad as I remember "Nair" from childhood and works the same too.

Review of: "'Bliss' Triple Oxygen Radiant Protection Serum, 1 fl. oz.:"

The serum product comes in a simple ergonomic tube that boasts: "This concentrated serum promotes healthy, younger looking skin with renewed vitality giving you a beautifully radiant and more youthful looking complexion while helping defend your skin against environmental aggressors, stress and premature signs of aging. Our luxurious yet lightweight formula evens skin tone, softens the look of fine, dry lines and wrinkles and promotes a luminous glow."

With that said, the serum is discharged from the tube with a pump action.  The product emerges as a creme with an orange tint and is scented citrus orange as well.  The serum results are given five stars by my wife.  She claims that the product does tighten the skin and provides a wrinkle diminishing and skin softening effect as well.  The one ounce does last for a long time as a mere drop of the product is enough for each application.  As has been pointed out the fact that the manufacturer lists the serum ingredients on the box, but the font is so small that it is not readable.  That is my only cause for concern.  Other than that it scores five stars for maintaining beauty.

This product arrived this afternoon. I eagerly removed it for the box and began to pump away ... totally excited to try this new serum. After many, many pumps, nothing happened. I took the top off and instantly noticed that the "straw" that connects to the pump was missing. This explains why no amount of pumping would result in any product. I found a pack of chopsticks in our junk drawer and gave the contents a little prod ... hoping to locate and reconnect that "straw" type device. There was nothing in the bottle except for the serum ... with no way to get it out. (It is so thick that my shaking it, tapping it, and even slamming it against my palm resulted in very little coming out).

From what I can deduce, the smell is REALLY nice, and it seems to have a lovely shimmer, but woe betide the person who gets a bottle similar to mine. Does it work? I have no idea. I cannot even get it out of the bottle. What a weird quality-control issue. If I can locate any way to get this out of the bottle without contaminating it, I will update this review.

My face looks less tired and more radiant now that I've added bliss Triple Oxygen Radiant Protection Serum to my routine.  I like this formula a lot.  It's a pretty peachy, shimmery color, which it may or may not impart on my actual skin.  It's hard to say.  It does plump up the fine lines I have, and I don't look so haggard by the end of the day, when I use this product, along with my moisturizer and makeup.  I like to think of it making the job easier that my makeup needs to do.  My skin is really sensitive, so I always worry about stinging or rashes or incidents of swelling eyes when I try a new product, but there was none of that trouble with this serum.

I love how soft my skin feels after using this. I've been applying a pump every morning for a week now and my face feels softer and looks more smooth. It has a hint of orange smell to it, which isn't too strong, but perfectly pleasant smell. The directions say to apply before putting on your daily moisturizer. This serum has no SPF protection, so it would be good if your moisturizer did. Like another reviewer stated, there are no ingredients listed on the product. I think any consumer would like to know how the product is achieving its results on your face. Though i have no idea if the lotion is simply filling in lines, or actually penetrating my skin for long term effects, i do see a positive result on my face.

Recently saw this at TJ Maxx for just under $20...

Another update: after using this for two weeks my skin feels super soft, but I started having an allergic reaction to it. I woke up with my face feeling a little tight and red. Didn't attribute it to this till it happened 3 days in a row. Once I stopped using it, I haven't had another reaction. Very strange, I think it took two weeks to properly absorb into my skin and for my body to realize it was allergic. The only known allergy i have is sulfa drugs...so this must contain sulfas or sulfates?
summary: soft and smooth skin...also allergic to it

reviewText: This product smells lovely and in general I like the bliss product line. However, I have not noticed any difference in my skin/reduction in fine lines after using for over a month. The glitter in the product is what I notice more than benefit or effect. For the price I will not be repurchasing.

I used bliss Triple Oxygen Radiant Protection Serum for about a week and while I didn't notice any visible results to my fine lines, I did start to experience breakouts. I have not tried the product again to confirm that the bliss serum was indeed the culprit of the sudden breakout but since discontinuing use of the product my skin has returned to normal. Perhaps I'm sensitive to one of the numerous ingredients this serum contains because II don't typically have problem skin.  I'm a little suspicious of whatever makes this serum look so orange and shimmery.  The serum has a faint orange fragrance, which is not unpleasant, and it felt okay when applied to my skin, but it practically glows when it's dispensed from the pump. I'm not sure why the manufacturer included all the color and shimmer because the product goes on as if it's translucent.  It may be a fabulous product for others but it did not work well for me.

During the winter my face usually looks and feels blah.  I'v tried several new products lately that have been helping with the dryness, texture and the uneven skin tone but my face still looks a little blase.  This serum has a pinkish peachy tint which instantly brightens my face.  The serum smells like fresh lemons and as a silky, non-sticky texture which sinks in almost instantly.  My face is looking a little brighter and plumper with a nice dewy finish.  I love the subtle glow because there's a fine line between dewy and oily/shiny and it's not pretty when you cross it.  Trust me, been there, done that.  And perhaps most importantly,  this product plays well with others so I can work it into my current beauty routine and layer it under other products without pilling.
summary: Soft glow with less visible fine lines, works for me

reviewText: I have tried several products over the last several years. They range from lower cost products, such as Neutrogena and high end products, such as Lancme.  I was anxious to try the Bliss Triple Oxygen! I have been using it for a few weeks now. It applies easy. It is light. It smells great. Once applied, your skin oils alive! Apply regular make up over this if you choose.  I can't seem to get over the price  point. It is most enjoyable and I have nothing negative to say about the product . I would like to see a lower price point.

As other reviewers have noted, this lightweight serum has a thick consistency and orange, shimmery appearance. I don't notice any shimmer or "glow" on my fair skin after application, and the orangesicle fragrance fades quickly. I allow the serum to soak in for 30-60 seconds before applying moisturizer and sunscreen (La Mer and Shiseido, respectively). At night, it goes after my toner (Algenist) and under my moisturizer.

After using about half the bottle (1-2 pumps per use), I haven't noticed any effect at all. The serums I've used in the past either add a little moisture, make the skin smoother, or give a little brightening and evenness to skin tone (or all three). This one does... exactly nothing. I can't even tell when I forget to apply it before my moisturizer. Maybe long-term benefits would include some of the nebulous claims of "healthy, younger looking skin with renewed vitality," but there's really no motivation to keep using it.

I also agree with another reviewer that the ingredients list should be prominently displayed on the product page, and that the purported benefits of the many, many ingredients made clear. Not only could those with sensitivities steer clear, but we'd be more educated about what we're applying to our skin and what combination of products would work best for us. I'll update this review if I notice any benefits after longer use, but I can't recommend it at this point.
summary: Does exactly nothing for my skin

reviewText:
When you put a drop of the bliss Triple Oxygen Radiant Protection Serum on your finger, you can see that the serum has a pinkish / orange tint.  The serum also has a bit of shimmer in it which reflects light.  The tint and shimmer are not obvious when you put it on your face, but I assume that both are meant to contribute to the luminous glow that the serum is meant to give your skin.

The instructions indicate that the serum is to be used in the morning and night followed by eye and face moisturizers.  But, after applying it in the morning, the instructions recommend also applying a sunscreen.  The additional moisturizers are needed because serums are meant to be light and fast absorbing to give a high concentration of active ingredients without petrolatum or mineral oils that keep water from evaporating.

The serum is light and goes onto skin easily, but rather than to be absorbed quickly, it leaves a reflective film on the skin. My fingers also feel slightly oily after applying the serum, but that feeling goes away immediately with hand washing.  The serum has a light, citrus fragrance which fades quickly after application.

As far as results are concerned, I don't think that using the serum twice a day has added a glow to my skin.  I have only been using it a few weeks and the claims of younger looking skin that Bliss makes are based on an eight week study.  At first, I had written that I was seeing no results at all.  But after continuing to use the product, what I have found is that my skin around my eyes feels smoother with less pronounced wrinkles.  This I take as a good result.

Overall, a descent serum to be used as part of a skin care regimen.  It does help to soften skin and smooth wrinkles to some extent.  But, this does take time and so don't expect instant results.
summary: Lightweight serum that has left my skin feeling somewhat smoother after several weeks of use.

reviewText:
So far, I'm really impressed with this serum.  It has a peachy tint to it that is somewhat "shimmery" but then blends into the skin flawlessly giving you a subtle "glow" but not in a shimmery way.  The ingredients are listed on the box, so if anyone is wondering what the orangy tone might be, it's most likely the Vitamin C, which is an excellent brightener for tired skin.

I recommend putting a nice face moisturizer on after use.  There is a slight stickiness, although it is very slight, it would make your skin feel "finished" once you apply a light moisturizer after applying the serum.  I have sensitive skin and so far I haven't had any problems with the ingredients, which is a huge plus because I've used product with Vitamin C in the past, and my skin was just far too sensitive for continued use.

I'm looking forward to a continued morning/night routine with the product and will post updates and/or rating change as I use the product for a longer period of time.

Bottom line: I would recommend, it's definitely a nice product and worth a try.
summary: Nice product, A definite pick me up for tired skin!

reviewText:
This serum is more like a thin cream than a watery serum. When I first opened the bottle, I had to pump it around 50 times to get it out of the container, I thought for a moment the pump was defective.

It has a pleasant scent and dries almost immediately.

This contains the form of Vitamin C which is called Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate, which is a fat soluble, stable form of C. Some researchers believe this form of Vitamin C has a greater affinity for skin because its fatty acid component aids penetration and protect the vitamin from rapid oxidation. This form of vitamin C has also been shown to stimulate healthy collagen production and reduce wrinkle depth....so give this some time - maybe 60 days or so - to see any improvements. Improvements don't happen overnight.

I love the glow this gives off and I use a little of it ON TOP of my moisturizer also. I rarely use foundation and this is all I need. The glow doesn't fade away either.

I have always liked bliss products and generally had good results with them. This one doesn't disappoint neither. This orange-tinted serum is easy to apply, goes on smoothly and dries quickly. It smells pleasant as well. I can't say it has made a difference in the appearance of fine lines or uneven tones. If it has, it would be marginally noticeable. That said, it does leave the skin feeling soft and smooth. The skin also seems to take on a more healthier glow. I usually follow up with a moisturizer to keep it soft and supple. Overall, this skin care product seems to help. I quite like it so far.

This serum is pleasant to apply, goes on smoothly and dries quickly.  It does not leave any stickiness and does not tighten my combination skin.  For me, it seems to smooth out the surface of my skin and leaves it very soft.  It provides a very nice base for my very lightweight moisturizer and equally lightweight foundation.

BUT, the company's general and somewhat ambiguous claims of its benefits, and the mystery surrounding the ingredients gives me pause.  At the time I write this review, the long list of ingredients is not shown on this product page.  And, what does "softens" fine and "dry" lines and wrinkles mean?  And is the "luminous glow" from the orange tint in the serum or from a useful ingredient?  And what ingredients in particular "even skin tone"?

It has an orange tint to it, that may give a slight "glow" to my skin.  I've tried some other serums that were surprisingly orange--almost neon orange--that tinted my skin an unnatural orange tint.  This is not that way.  This is a color that provides an almost mental pleasant experience, not visible on the skin.  The fragrance is a very pleasant orange, too.

I have a gripe with the ingredient list:  Bliss does not list it here on the product page.  I would like to see it here--in a decent size type face--so I can investigate the ingredients.  The ingredient list is on the box, in the smallest type imaginable.  I did get out my magnifying glass, thinking that I would look them up, list them in my review and tell you about them.  After a half hour, I've given up.  The list is long.  The ingredients are not familiar and not much info is available.  So, sorry.  I've given up.  I will say that I do NOT see any of my favorite serum ingredients:  Vitamin C, witch hazel, plant stem cells, hyaluronic acid.  There is yeast from black tea ferment, cranberry extract, some bark extracts and more.  I think the company should explain away some of the mystery of what is included in this serum.

Bottom line:  So far, so good with this serum.  I think it is worth a try, and it is a pleasure to apply.  So far, no bad effects like blemishes, tight skin, or stickiness.  Heck, it took almost two months to see the wonderful effects of simple witch hazel on the dark spots on my facial skin.  So I know that I need patience to see results with any serum.
summary: Why the secrecy of the ingredient list?

reviewText: I've always been a fan of bliss products- they're typically easy to apply and smell fantastic. The smell of this one is not my favorite, but aside from that, it's a great serum! Before moisturizing, apply a small amount of this product to your face to reduce the appearance of fine lines and uneven tones. I've even noticed that this can double as a primer- due to its peachy color and ability to lock in moisture. It absorbs quickly into your skin and has immediate (and noticeable) effects! My skin looks more dewy and fresh, almost luminescent. A must have for skin care.

This is neither a cleaner, nor a moisturizer.  Serums have a specialized use. This serum claims to soften fine lines and wrinkles, to even skin tone, and give a glow. Im at the age, mid 50s, where wrinkles are starting to pop out everywhere. This smells nice, slightly like oranges, goes on easy, nice and smooth, not greasy. For my skin, I can see immediate improvement in the evenness of the skin tone and an overall healthy look. My foundation has moisturizer in it, so I put Bliss Serum on and then my foundation. At night I use the Serum and then a moisturizer, not of this brand.  It seems like I am holding back more wrinkles, hard to say if its this serum, the moisturizer, or the cleaner, or the combination of all.  I do like what it does right away to my face, I've found myself wearing foundation less because of it.

Its a serum which is a relatively new term in cosmetics.  Wikipedia (Nov 2015) defines serum as a buzzword for lotion in the cosmetic market.  A few cosmetic sites say there is no formal definition, but cosmetic serums are rapidly absorbed and highly potent. They are the cousins of lotions and moisturizers. They typically focus on one of these areas: dry skin, aging, dark spots.  My concern because it does absorb into your skin so fast is with the ingredients of which I am not qualified to speak to and will watch for others opinions on this.
summary: Smooth, Easy, Smells Nice, Works Fast

reviewText: I love absolutely everything about this Bliss serum. The pump action is smooth,  the light color and even lighter fragrance of the cream is quickly absorbed and it feels wonderful.  I follow this with a moisturizer and during the day,  I also use sunscreen. This product is not a moisturizer,  it is a treatment that enhances the appearance with a little stimulated glow.

This has a peachy color and has a creamy consistency.  A little goes a long way.  I have combination skin, where I have both oily and dry areas, and the directions say to put it on before moisturizers.  I tried it without overnight.  My face felt a little tight at the beginning, but still this morning is still dry, even in the oily places.  Definitely you need to put a moisturizer over it.  Some time will have to pass before I can tell if it works or not.
summary: A little dab will do ya

reviewText: Scent is so personal.  On my husband I think this scent opens with a very clean aroma, as the evening wears on, it holds a more clean earthy scent.  I definitely enjoy this scent on him.  The bottle is quite pretty too, not as obnoxious as some male cologne bottles are.  There is a pleasant combination of light and heavy scents and all in all this cologne comes off smelling very clean and airy.
summary: Clean scent from beginning to end

reviewText: In one word, sexy. I put this on my husband and it smells great. It is a little musky, light, masculine but not too overpowering. Some of my husbands other sprays have an acrid smell and I've told him he can't use them. Like the aerosol lingers in the air and makes my eyes sting. But this is softer and doesn't bother me at all. The bottle is great with a crocheted outer wrap. It makes it look great sitting out on a dresser.

Our college man liked the scent but said it didn't hold up longer than an hour. The bottle is a nice design and looks 'sharp' on his bureau. I'll look into finding the scent in a more concentrated form.
summary: two thumbs up from the 20 year old

reviewText:
I feel that John Varvatos' Artisan Acqua is a great choice for date night. The spray has a very pleasant, outdoorsy aroma that I like. Most importantly, my wife likes the scent, too.

Some have commented that the scent doesn't last throughout the day; but at the relatively high price point I prefer to use Artisan Acqua at the end of the day, anyhow. The fresh, woodsy scent of John Varvatos works just fine over whatever might remain from the morning's spray. For me, the sensual scent I get with Artisan Acqua helps make the evening a little more memorable.

I highly recommend John Varvatos Artisan Acqua to everyone.
summary: Make the evening a little more memorable

reviewText: Very pleasant aroma, not too overwhelming. Fades within at least four hours, but that's okay, you don't want to smell like an overplayed person anyway.

Definite outdoors, woods scent.  Not bad at all.  I personally like it.

The bottle is a really neat addition to the whole package.  It is very sturdy and I like the cap for some reason.  It is actually made out of metal.

The scent once applied lasts for a while and it really isn't overpowering if you use it lightly.  It smells like the outdoors and like others have commented it does not smell floral at all which is something I like.

My wife likes it as well which is good enough for me.  She is pretty picky with some of these things and the fact that she likes it goes a long way in my book.

Shipping was quick and the spray was packed well.  No chance of it exploding in transit.

All in all a solid deal.
summary: Great spray at a good price.  Very happy

reviewText: Very nicely packaged if giving as a gift. Nice subtle cologne, does not come across as over powering, and lingers on with just the right tones, for a reasonable amount of time - will last your evening out. I do not like overly strong ones like Drakkar Noir. I used Davidoff cool water before this one, and this is equally good. My wife likes and so does my daughter on me.
summary: Very nicely packaged if giving as a gift

reviewText:
Vichy's thermale foaming cream wash has been an amazing gift to my dry, sensitive skin. Especially with cooler weather (and indoor heating), I have to be mindful of staying moisturized and hydrated.

This face cleanser is wonderful: it keeps my skin clean without drying. I've been very pleased and will continue to use it daily. For anyone balking at the price, the tube is BIG, and only a little amount is needed to cleanse thoroughly -- maybe a dime sized amount or so.

EDIT: After three weeks of continuous use, I'm STILL thrilled. This is a great face wash. Every second or third evening, I use it with a small motorized face brush (like a Clairsonic Mia) and have found my skin looking better and better. Usually I remove my eyemakeup and face makeup using remover + micellar water before cleansing with this foaming cream. Apply a solid moisturizer and you're good to go. I'll be a repeat customer in the future, for sure.
summary: A godsend for my dry, sensitive skin

reviewText:
Nice cleaning cream, made my skin feel softer, moisturized and refreshed.
(moisturizing feeling lasted for me about 1 hr)
After dampening skin, the cream guides smoothly over face.
Half a dime size amount is enough to cover my face, foams up in a few seconds.
Doesn't have any sensation while on skin.

This is a rich, thick, pearly looking cream with a mild, light fragrance, but no scent is left on skin.
It's easy to apply, works quickly as it foams and is quickly removed with a water without any greasy feeling.
Nice product for extra deep cleansing.

I didn't see 'foaming' and I don't know about 'hydrating' but I love this cleansing creme.  Why?  It leaves my face clean with no hint of residue .AND. my sensitive skin doesn't feel any dryer.

I should start by saying that I'm an older mom with sensitive skin -- sensitive to various chemicals and allergens and sensitive to being dry.  My skin can really feel miserable when it's dry.  I've been using this cream and it's delightful.  With other cleansers/soaps I feel like I need to rinse and rinse --not with this Vichy product.

It also leaves my skin feeling very clean without being any dryer than when I began.  This is marvelous.

Recommend.

I've used this for a while now and it really makes my face feel soft without being too oily or overdrying it -- a nice balance. There's no added scent to it, though it does have a light odor to it -- more natural smelling than anything (clay-like is the closest I can figure) however, it does not leave any scent behind on your skin. It foams up nicely so I feel like my skin is nice and clean. Very nice product.

Wow, I love this Vichy foaming cleansing cream. Vichy uses volcanic mineral water from France in this cleanser and other products. This cleanser is thick with a pearlized look and creamy texture, and it feels so silky and rich against my skin without being greasy. It glides so smoothly over my face and is a perfect foaming cleansing cream to use with my Clarisonic, or when I simply hand wash my face using a circular motion and rinse with water. I have skin that has dry areas (combination normal/dry skin), and Vichy cleans well while making my skin feel so soft and hydrated without any sticky or greasy residue. The Vichy site indicates this cleanser is for normal, oily or combination skin.*

This cleansing cream is also suitable for sensitive skin, and contains no parabens (a controversial preservative).  My skin is sensitive, and I've had no negative reaction at all.  Fragrance is listed as an ingredient, but the scent is really faint and doesn't trigger my sinus allergies. This is simply an awesome cleansing cream because it cleans well and also feels soothing and wonderful to my dry, sensitive skin. Also, despite being a luxury product Made in France, the price isn't sky high. I've tried lots of nice cleansers over the years, and this is among the very best. I highly recommend it.

1/27/2018: I have purchased this several times since posting my review as its really a great hydrating cleanser for my dry skin.
summary: Luxury Cleansing Cream That's Perfect For My Dry and Sensitive Skin- But Also Suits Other Skin Types

reviewText: Does not dry the skin as it cleanses, I tend to have oily patches around my face from chin, nose and fr3head,,and dry rest of my face.  Used this product twice a week, and left my face clean, and soft all over.  Pores were tighter around the nose, where blackheads often cumulate.  Did not sting when in use, which is simply apply to wet skin, and I used a face brush to massage it in.  Loved the after effects, and I used a very small amount for my face.
summary: Nice soft after effects, no sting.

reviewText:
I have "mature skin", so cleansers need to clean my skin without over drying it.  This one works beautifully.
The first thing I noticed as I dispensed the cream into my hand was the scent - light and very pleasant, slightly floral. I do not care for scented skin products usually, but the scent is so gentle that it felt more like aromatherapy than something perfumey.
The cream foams up a little and rinses easily.  My skin afterward feels clean, smooth, soft and NOT tight.
I've been using it each evening for several days now, along with the Vichy toner and my skin has been looking pretty darn good for a 59-year old.  This is a product I will happily continue to buy!

When I was in HS and the other girls were bemoaning their oily skin and pimples, I was using my grandma's moisturizer and Vaseline because my skin was so dry. My skin is still dry, some 30 years later, and coupled with the natural dryness I have hormonal issues and medical issues that made it even dryer.

Because of this dryness many cleansers (and toners, but that's another story) leave my skin dry and tight. I feel like I have a sunburn almost because it's so tight it has that same feel. The Vichy, however, did not leave my skin feeling tight and Sahara like.

A small amount washes my face, don't give it a good hard squeeze, just a gentle nudge for about a dime sized amount. The cream is very smooth and went over my face easily. I looked in the mirror and can't say it really foamed though. I don't care if it foams or not, but when something says foaming I sort of expect puffy foam like a mousse.

My face feels clean. I have no rashes or reds spots. My skin is sensitive too and this didn't cause any problems. This is a sensitive skin formula and says it's been allergy tested. It's also paraben free. It has an extremely light scent, not perfume heavy or fake scents, just sort of the soap scent even unscented products have, nothing strong or obnoxious, I can barely smell it.

Nice, non drying, for sensitive skin, very slight scent, recommended

I have normal skin with a slightly oily t-zone, and this cleanser works very well for me.  You need only a tiny amount  less than pea-sized  to work up a creamy lather on your face and neck.  It rinses easily and leaves my face with that squeaky-clean feeling that I love but without that tight, dry feeling that I can definitely do without.  The product has a very light, barely-there fragrance that I find pleasant (it doesnt linger once youve rinsed your face).  Ive experienced no redness, irritation, dryness or breakouts.

Theres nothing too impressive about the ingredient list  pretty much what you find in most mid-range cleansers.  Since you need to use so little of the product, the 4.2 oz. size should last quite a while.  I would consider purchasing this item again.
summary: Leaves my face feeling squeeky clean without drying out my skin

reviewText:
Vichy's Thermale Foaming Cleanser feels like a cream cleanser in that it's gentle on my skin and doesn't dry it out.  A pea-sized cleanser is sufficient for each use.  I haven't seen any significant changes in my skin's suppleness or softness but this Vichy cleanser is less expensive than the Japanese cleanser that I'd been using recently, so I'm happy to have this.

The scent is mild, what I noticed most about this Thermale Foaming Cream is its creamy texture and its ability to clean gently.  I have sensitive skin, but this worked well for me.
summary: Cream cleanser that is gentle on my skin

reviewText: I really like the way Vichy Purete Thermale Foaming Cream made my face feel. Its thick, like a lotion, but only takes a small amount to foam up and clean a damp face. It washed off my make up and left my skin clean. It has a very mild fragrance that doesnt linger. The best part is how soft and supple my face felt after washing. Ive found many cleansers will leave my face feeling tight or dry. That was not the case with this product though. Im very happy to continue using it.

kind of like what the combo shampoo and conditioner product does for your hair, this product does for your face. I have only been using it for a week now on my 50 year old Irish face. I have neither oily or dry skin (although it is dryer then it once was). I am not sure it will be for me - I think after a lifetime of cleaning and then using a cream the combo product makes me feel like I am not deep cleaning enough, but maybe I'll come to love it like I do my dish detergent "softens hands while you do the dishes". I will update when use the last bit.

I have used Neutrogena eye make-up remover for many years.  I use it on my eyes and face. Neuteogena still has the cheapest price.  If you want to upgrade, Vichy is as good as department store brands like Lancme, and costs about the same, or less on Amazon.

Vichy make up remover does its job. A lot of make-up came off on the cotton page I used to wipe the make-up remover on my face. It has a creamy consistency.  This make-up remover hydrates and is gentle on your face.  Even though Neutrogena works well to remove make-up and is the cheapest, it doesn't have the extra soothing ingredients like this one.  I use other products to hydrate my under eye area, but using a make-up remover like Vichy means I have more products working together to help my face.  Hydration is especially important in winter.  Due to my budget, I'm going to switch back and forth between the Neutrogena and this Vichy Eye Make up remover. I recommend both depending on your needs. I say paying more for this one is worth it if you want a remover that will be the most gentle and hydrating.
summary: Vichy is as good as department store brands like Lancme

reviewText:
Recommended for Normal to Dry skin.
Vichy Purete has a mild scent, a milky, lotion type texture & does a good job of taking my makeup off.
It doesn't  dry out my skin or leave it greasy.  My skin feels good after using it.
It works best for me if I rinse it off & blot my skin dry.  After cleansing, I apply moisturizer.
(When I wipe it off and don't rinse, I get a mild break out on my forehead.)
summary: Milky, lotion type texture, not oily. Works best for me if I rinse it off. Doesn't dry my skin nor leave it greasy. Mild scent

reviewText: It does not take my makeup off as well as a plain old baby wipe does! it will leave your face moisturized and clean, but it also has a floral scent that I can take or leave.

This cleansing milk has fit beautifully into my skincare routine. I always do a double cleanse, usually with oil as step one, the cleanser then comes in as step two - I buy some pretty expensive cleansers, so doing a pre-cleanse removes all my makeup so that my skin can get the maximum effectiveness of other cleansers. So, this cleansing milk has a creamy texture that has an oily slip to it when rubbed. I don't waste it on a cotton ball, but instead apply directly to my skin and massage it in, then I rinse it off and use my next cleanser. It does leave skin soft and smooth, but I wouldn't advise not rinsing this product off. Simply follow with a deeper cleanser, tone, use serum, and moisturize. So you can see it fit great into any beauty routine.
summary: cross between cream and oil, super nice

reviewText:
I've been using everything Vichy for years. Gel moisturizer, day cream, night cream, toner, and masks.  This was new for me. And frankly, I'm usually of the mindset that the cleanser doesn't really matter all that much.  I've been using Blissing Foaming Cleanser in the blue bottle, and it does fine.  I've also tried other brands.  But it's never been something that has made me go, "wow, great stuff!".

Until now. Yes, Vichy has surprised and delighted me again.  See, this doesn't feel like cleanser (or milk for that matter). It's thick like a soft cream. It stays on the skin and doesn't drip into the sink. It stays were you put it until you washcloth it off.  And that is somehow lovely. It feels like silk and I like the control that it isn't dripping into my eyes or on my shirt.  The smoothness is incredible. It doesn't exfoliate at all (and it doesn't promise too). Sometimes at the end of a very bad day, exfoliation feels like punishment. Yes, I'm fragile sometimes!

So this goes on, and I let it sit and (no joke, clean the area around my sink) then wash/rinse off. Then to the night or day cream I choose.  I feel pampered. I'm not a paid spokesperson.  In fact, I liked VIchy when they first came out as they sent me (I have no idea why...this was ten years ago) a small trial size set of their products and that struck me as nice and smart.  And of course, introduced me to a brand I would have never considered.

So I like this, everything about it. And this cleanser is cheaper than Bliss and Philosophy by far.  And, an important note is Vichy doesn't add icky fragrance to sting your eyes:  if you ever try Bliss' Makeup Melt Off, you'll know what stinging eyes feels like!

Very pleased to try this and am ordering MORE today so as not to be without.  In fact, now I've switched: I think the cleanser can be as important as the moisturizer. And if your moisturizer already pleases you, you could still use this.

Good stuff!  And it didn't make me break out as some cleansers that are too strong.

Another great quality Vichy product. I love all the products I've tried, but they're definitely pricey. The scent of this cleansing milk is a bit stronger than I'd prefer but it's not overly perfume-y. It does a great job removing my waterproof mascara. I use it as if it were a wash - on my whole face, then rinse with warm water. It leaves my face soft and not at all dried out, so if I forget my moisturizer my skin feels soft from using this product.

This is another product of Vichy that is really good.  It removes eye makeup with ease.  I use Maybelline's Waterproof Great Lash (the classic green and pink container) and that is extremely difficult to remove with regular cleanser.  This got it off without rubbing or repeated swipes.

It's creamy and it has some moisturizing. The reason for the star off is the scent.  I'm not sure if it is supposed to be fragrance free because the print is so small that I cannot read it.  But there is a scent but it is very faint but for those who are allergic or bothered by smells, may think twice about it.  I have been using the Vichy Micellar Water and that does the job just was well.
summary: Vichy Purete Thermale Cleansing Milk Balm

reviewText:
As I have gotten older, my skin has become drier, so I have to be more careful with what I put on my face.  I have yet to find an effective, yet gentle mascara remover.  That is, until this product.  It doesnt take much on a cotton ball to remove all of my mascara.

I also love using this to clean my face.  I don't like leaving it on, as the instructions state, so I gently rinse it off.  My face feels clean, but not dried out.

The scent is also very pleasant, which is nice.  There are so many products out there that are ruined by a strong, heavy and yucky scent.  Not so with this product.

I recommend this product as an effective eye makeup remover and also as a skin cleanser.
summary: A very pleasant way to remove makeup and clean your face

reviewText: This is pretty good cleaner, it cleanses my skin and leaves it feeling refreshed and moisturized. My skin sometimes reacts to cleansers but I have not experienced any reaction after using this cleanser. It seems like a good option but would not be my first pick because the price is kind of high for this small bottle.

The directions state to apply this with a cotton pad and you don't have to wash it off.  I, however, applied it with my hand on one side of my face, and it felt wonderful.  I did wash it off, and my skin incredibly soft.  I applied it on the other side of my face and did not wash it off, and this side too felt great.  This product is amazing and perfect for ageing skin.

This cleansing milk is the best I've used for removing waterproof mascara. One of the brands I use is great for thickening lashes but it goes on thick and has real staying power. That's great for all-day wear, but removing it can be a real chore. This product seems to dissolve it or melt it so I can wipe it off width cotton balls or a tissue. It takes a couple applications but it doesn't leave any traces of the mascara. With other products or soap and water, my lashes would look clean, but then the next morning I would see black smudges under my eyes. I don't see that with this.

Of course it also works well for removing foundation or lipstick and other makeup - the easy stuff. It has a mild scent that's hard to describe. It's pleasant and not overwhelming. It smells more like a soap or cleaner than a fragrance. It doesn't dry my skin. I usually rinse off what I don't wipe off with cotton or tissues, although it can be left on your face. I still apply a moisturizer before bed.
summary: Great for getting off tough mascara

reviewText: This is the most moisturizing and nourishing face cleaner I have had. It both takes off my mascara and leaves my skin soft. I really like this.

I wasn't expecting this makeup remover to have any scent at all, because the products description says that its Allergy-tested. Suitable for sensitive skin.. That being said, its does a great job removing all makeup, and it feels good on my skin. I have dry sensitive skin, and I didn't have any reaction after using this product. So, its all right for me to continue using it.

The scent is strong, but tolerable. And it probably will not matter for most of us, if like me, you wash your face after removing the makeup. In this case, I must do it because of the scent, I wouldnt sleep otherwise, because Im very sensitive to scents. During the day, I think I can handle it better, but that is when I apply makeup, not remove it. In all, is a good product, and I hope Vichy considers making a fragrance free version in the future.
summary: Its a good makeup remover with a strong scent

reviewText: this is for sensitive skin. I  used this to remove my makeup and works great. Nice clean smell, not greasy feeling and wipes off nicely.  Got black eyeliner off which is a great test for me.  I used this one with water. Says you can use it without but I have found I need to make sure all cleaners are off my skin due to drying and breaking out problems.  But works great and is a product I would use every day

So the instructions are a little unclear, and I wanted to take a chance to clarify. You do not rinse this. I guess you could wipe it off if you felt like it but you're supposed to just leave it on your skin, apparently.

This feels really soft and silky on your skin. I use it to take off my makeup like a cold cream and I do cleanse again after using it. It smells wonderful.
summary: I guess you could wipe it off if you felt like it but you're supposed to just leave it on ...

reviewText: If you get mascara that just won't wash off (I had a tube that wouldn't even come off with cleansing oil) this does the trick. It's fairly gentle. The instructions say you don't need to wash it off, but I wipe off with a wetted cotton afterwards as I don't want anything left on before I go to bed. Very nice makeup remover.

I used to never have to worry about washing off my makeup, but as I have aged, my skin has become more sensitive.  I also have age spots and uneven skin tone where I now wear foundation daily.  I have to remove foundation every evening, and my skin sometimes has a reaction to cleansers.

I have tried this makeup remover/cleanser both rinsing and not rinsing - not rinsing ends up causing me to break out and ends up drying my skin in spots.  I definitely recommend rinsing instead of leaving on the face.  I docked a star off my review because of this.

This cleanser also smells like a cleanser, which doesn't bother me because I actually want my face to be clean when I get done.  It works like it says it will, although in my opinion, the price seems a bit steep.
summary: I definitely recommend rinsing instead of leaving on the face

reviewText: The Cleansing Milk Balm is milder than the foaming cleanser that I've been using and I like using it during transitional weather.  I don't use much makeup but I've become more vigilant about putting SPF on several times a day.  I'm happy to find an effective and gentle cleanser.  While the directions state that no rinsing required, I prefer to rinse off the cleansing milk balm.
summary: Gentle cleanser that works well for transitional weather

reviewText: This make-up remover worked just fine. I was disappointed in the directions -- it's all well and good to have three languages on the label, but I wish they'd just told me whether to use this product on a dry or wet face. I tried it both ways, and using it without water worked better. It doesn't foam or increase in volume on the face; you just have to trust that it's doing its thing. The scent is odd, almost unscented but in an astringent sort of way. It won't become my favorite product -- that would be Creme Radiance Clarifying Cream-To-Foam Cleanser (which is used on damp skin) -- but I can't afford that product on a regular basis, so this is a good stand-in.
summary: Works fine, but not a favorite

reviewText: I was hoping that this cleansing milk balm would work for me. The positive points: Removed makeup and made my skin super soft. The negative points: This cleanser has a strong scent. It also made my skin burn and I had to rinse with water immediately. I don't have sensitive skin, but unfortunately this product caused a reaction. I think this is a good cleanser and wish it had worked for me. Hopefully it will work for you.

Very refreshing after washing your face especially at night before you apply night cream. Then in the morning it cleans up any residue left over from the night cream and cleanser. My face did not feel tight like some toners do after application and since you have no need to rinse off it allows a perfect canvas for make-up. Does not have a medicine smell either.

While this isn't anything necessarily groundbreaking in the world of face toners, there is a lot to love about this classic Vichy version. The scent is lovely, it reminds me of a sweet fruit. Nothing overwhelming, just a soft air of freshness about it. It doesn't make my face burn, which many toners do since I'm fairly sensitive. It removes any residual make up, dirt or grime, but my skin doesn't feel tight or dry.
I like the flip top, nothing to remove and only a small opening should I accidentally bump it over, so minimal chance for a large spill!
All in all for the price, this is a great everyday basic.

I've used a lot of facial products over the years but facial toner isn't typically one of them. When I was in college I used a toner which left me with a bad allergic reaction that sent me to a dermatologist. While I've used a Burt's Bees Toner with unenthusiastic results in recent years that has been it regarding my toner experience.
If you think the use of toner eliminates the need for washing your face, think again before using this product. Thoroughly wash and rinse your face first. Following directions apply this to a cotton pad and cover the face. It does a nice job and leaves the face somewhat tingly and fresh. I liked it though I cannot say I think it removed imbedded dirt or skin impurities or even excess make-up. I don't usually use a lot of make-up and I use a charcoal soap to clean my skin which takes care of all dirt very nicely. Regardless, I liked this toner if only for its tingly feeling and astringent properties. It did not leave my skin feeling dry nor did I have an allergic reaction to it. Overall it was a nice pampering product that left my skin feeling both fresh and clean. I'd recommend it for anyone who uses make-up daily and needs to thoroughly cleanse their skin.
This Purete toner is so refreshing on a clean face - the perfect finishing touch to your routine! You will like the effects.
summary: ... is so refreshing on a clean face - the perfect finishing touch to your routine

reviewText:
I have never really used toner before, mostly because I was never really sure what the purpose was.  This bottle tells me it is to remove makeup residue after cleansing.  That's a little troubling to think that cleanser alone isn't removing everything, but I thought it would be fun to give toner a chance.

It felt pretty good -- a little cool and refreshing but not too drying.  I put my evening moisturizer on right after I used this so I don't know how it would have felt without that.

I like this so far and will have to see whether I think toner adds enough to my daily routine to buy it after this bottle is empty.

As I love most things French, or made in France, I do think they make superior, quality products on the whole, I was very happy to be offered this Vichy Purete Thermale Perfecting Toner through Amazon's Vine Program.  I was not familiar with the Vichy line of products.

The bottle did not come sealed, but it does have a flip cap which has a soothing aquamarine color, as does the appearance of the toner bottle.

After cleansing my skin, I pored a little of the toner onto a cotton pad and wiped it over my face.  I liked the feeling so much that I did it twice.  The toner just leaves your skin feeling very refreshed. I like that this toner has no alcohol, which can be too drying to the skin.  It is also suitable for sensitive skin, which I also have.  It has no parabens and is only lightly scented with a nice refreshing scent.

If you really want your skin to feel refreshed, you might want to keep your toner in your refrigerator.  I especially do that in warmer weather.  It wakes my skin up in a good way!

I will be keeping my eyes open for other Vichy products.
This product performs exactly as advertised.  It does clean, but it is not harsh.  I noticed zero skin irritation but perfect clean.  I am quite impressed.
Hi! Love this toner work very well.
Vichy is the best for my skin!
Very nice toner for sensitive skin. Feels very gentle but effective at removing the last trace of makeup. Would definitely purchase again.
summary: Very nice toner for sensitive skin

reviewText: I have used other name brand toners in the past but stopped because they ended up being too drying for my skin.  When I found out that this brand does not contain alcohol, I decided to give it a chance.  I'm glad I did.  While there is a fragrance, I did not find it overwhelming.  Best of all, the product did not dry my skin nor did it cause my sensitive skin any other issues.  I like the way my skin feels tingly and fresh after using it - it somehow makes it feel cleaner than if I don't use it.
summary: Works well on my sensitive skin and doesn't cause my skin to feel too dry

reviewText: Vichy is a new line for me,  so I cannot compare the toner to their other products.  I can say that it is highly fragranced regardless of this being marketed as fine for sensitive skin.  The color of the liquid is a beautiful blue,  but I would prefer having no added colors to my skin care products.  The first few times I used this,  I did not like its effect on my skin but my taste must have changed since I now find it rather stimulating. I would suggest to those who do not care for scented skin care products that it is best to check this one out in person before ordering. It is even more flowery than the Lancome toner or eye make up remover.

This lightly floral scented toner is my new security blanket in my skincare routine.  Removing any residue I may have missed while cleansing and adding a little boost of hydration to my sensitive dry skin.  While I like to think my cleanser is completely effective, there are some nights where user error plays a factor.  On those nights I appreciate this quick, easy, and refreshing step before slapping on moisturizer and crawling into bed.  On other nights when I dedicate time to a careful skin routine, I still enjoy the addition of this perfecting toner.  I like how it feels on my face and how my skin feels softer afterwards.
summary: Refreshing addition to my skin care routine!

reviewText:
I like to use  toner as part of my evening skin care routine; it ensures that my cleanser has done its job and no traces of make-up have been left behind.  This toner is alcohol-free, non-drying and pleasant to use.  Theres a subtle fragrance  nothing overpowering  and it leaves my skin feeling soft.  There is no residual sticky feeling and Im able to apply my night cream within a minute or two.  Ive experienced no irritation, redness or breakouts.  My skin type is normal with a slightly oily t-zone and this product does not leave my skin with that tight, dry feeling.

While I like this product very much, Id pause before spending $18 (current price) on a toner.  Its not that I think the price is outrageous (it falls in the mid-range), but toner is just not one of those skin care items that Im likely to splurge on.  I have purchased alcohol-free toners for half this price and been happy with the results.  In the end it all depends on your beauty budget  its a nice product and if you're not on a tight budget then definitely give it a try.
Gentle &  non drying to my 59 year old, sensitive, dry face.

This is a very pleasant smelling product. It does say on the front of the bottle removes make-up residue and impurities which might lead one to believe you just use this to remove make-up. However on the back of the bottle it says to follow cleansing with this product to remove residue and impurities.

You apply with a cotton pad and do not need to rinse. It contains no alcohol, but does have castor oil.
It is made in France. For those that might be botheredit arrived with no seal or protective cover.
My face did feel toned and fresh after using this.

I have always used Neutrogena toner, (without alcohol).  This toner has a more powerful smell, and seems to be "nicer" to my skin.  A little goes a long way, and I imagine this will last me for months.

This leaves skin feeling clean and not dry.  We recently had to use theatrical makeup, which can be very harsh if your skin is stripped too far, but will not stick if there are any oils on your skin.  I chose this to use to do that extra cleansing before the application of spirit gum, latex, and makeup, and it was perfect!  The skin was in prime condition and the aforementioned remained steadfast for 12 hours!
summary: Great to prime skin before makeup--traditional makeup or theatrical

reviewText: Getting out of the shower we thought we were clean but not avoiding to the cotton ball after using this! It goes on and feels fresh and clean. It's not sticky. After it dried my face didn't feel tight - so it didn't dry out my skin. A slight clean smell, not alcohol smelling. I'm very happy with this!

I have not used toner in awhile.  I have "mature"skin and toner has often felt too drying for my skin. This is different.  It has a light, "barely there" scent and is easy to apply with a cotton ball.  The first time I used it  after cleansing my face in the evening I was surprised at how much make up residue was left.  The toner works well to remove residue and it seems to me that my skin was brighter-looking.  It is also a great quick "wake up" for my skin in the morning before I apply my make up.  And my skin is never dry or tight afterwards.
This is a product I will be happy to continue buying!

This is a nice product.  It is free from alcohol and parabens which is a real plus.  It has a nice cooling sensation when it goes on and the smell is clean and not overpowering.  While I like this product, my standard toner is witch hazel which works as well and is significantly less expensive
summary: This is a nice product. It is free from alcohol and parabens ...

reviewText:
I usually use Thayers Cucumber Witch Hazel as a toner because it smells wonderful and doesnt contain alcohol. I had just ran out of my Thayers so I decided to try the Vichy. Im so glad that I did. Its a great alcohol free toner.

Its smells fresh and clean and leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean. No burning or stinging. I remove my makeup with coconut oil then wash my face with a facial wash. Even after all that cleaning, this toner removes more traces of makeup. I use cotton pads soaked with the toner till the cotton pads are clean.

Great for sensitive skin
Contains no parabens
Contains no alcohol
summary: Leaves My Face Feeling Fresh and Clean

reviewText:
Both my wife and daughter give this cleanser/toner high marks for its ability to clean without drying out their face.  I'm told it cleans deep without having to really rub the face hard.

It does a great job of taking off makeup, while there are no noticeable changes to the "toning" aspect in its name.

I'll ding it one star for price...$18 seems awfully high to me...but hey, I'm a guy that used to use Noxema or Seabreeze so what do I know.
summary: Wife and daughter love it.  Seems high priced to me.

reviewText: My eyes are really sensitive and this toner causes me no irritation.  The smell is pleasant and it works well for removing make up and yuckiness.  I don't use mascara so don't know how it works on that.  The first time I used it I notice my skin got a bit red but the next morning no problem.. Also no problems after that.

4 1/2 stars
Gentle, non-greasy toner feels cool and soothing on your face.  It is to be used after cleaning your face with your regular facial cleaner.  The toner is supposed to remove excess make-up and deposits.  I did find on my cotton swab extra residue.  So it seems to be working.  I liked best that this toner didn't sting like other toners I've used and is great for people with extra sensitive skin.
summary: I liked best that this toner didn't sting like other toners I've used and is great for people with extra sensitive skin.

reviewText: This is... a very interesting product. The two creams have completely different effects: the peach side is mattifying, and the pink side adds a dewy sort of glow. I was a bit wary of the dewy side because it feels like lip gloss on your fingers when you touch the product. However, it goes on smoothly and doesn't feel like it's sitting on top of your skin or anything. It adds a nice flush that's not too dramatic, and it's a great highlighter for when you want a subtle sort of glow. The mattifying side didn't do as much for me, though, because my skin doesn't tend to get oily unless the weather is hot. It works all right as a pore minimizer, but I personally didn't find a lot of use for it. I can see it being great on oilier skin, though. On both sides, the color is very subtle, just a slight blush that worked quite well on my fair skin.

I'm fair, cool-toned. From the photos, I was afraid to try this, thinking it would be way too dark. It barely shows up on my skin. I have dry skin, and I NEVER have any oily shine breakthroughs during the course of my day. The matte I apply to places I want to minimize, and the dewy side I apply to areas I want to bring out more, like the tops of my cheekbones. I apply a tiny bit of the dewy side right above my eye brows (NOT the brow bone, the BROW) and it gives the illusion of my eyes being lifted.
