I really like this, but I wish it lasted all day. On me, I need to retouch every 3 to 4 hours. It seems to soak into my skin fast, or else it just goes away, I'm not sure.

Update 3/18 I don't use this as much as I thought I would.

This is so different than anything else I have ever used. Its a solid gel that acts like a powder. The matte effect works great. Instantly removing shine without looking dry like powder. The rose color is meant to highlight. I use it on the apple of my cheeks to highlight. It makes where ever you place it sort of glow and reflect light. Even though there is color it is really more translucent. Think hint of color. The compact is high shine black and well made. The compact clicks closed tightly. The mirror is large 2.25 inches square. The compact itself is just over 2.5 in. x 2.5 in. There are no worries of this coming open in my purse, but at the same time there is a large enough space for me to get my fingers in to open it.

The coloring on this product looks pretty dark in the picture but it does not go on that way at all.  For me, there was hardly any color t all.  This would be used by me to simply give my skin either a more matte tone or a more deewy finish.  That's how it goes on.  You can just use your fingers as per the instructions.  I am a medium tone and this just doesn't show up as color on me..  Don't use the photo as a guide for the coloring because that is not what you will get.  Use this more a a texture finisher.  If you have that expectation you won't be disappointed because it can give your complexion the tone you'd like it to have and can adjust using the two - matte or shiny.  I will note for my fellow scent sensitive friends out there, this does have a smell.  It's not too perfumey and is a nice smell, but I know there are many who can't have any type of fragrance on their face at all.
summary: A Skin Finisher - Looks "blushlike" in pic, but not like that at all

reviewText:
When I first saw this I was not optimistic. It looked far too dark for my pale complexion. I was wrong. The left side (called peach) is like a gel foundation which acts to smooth and cancel. The pink side (right) is a blush and highlighter. Both work in concert beautifully. I like the way my skin looks and feels. The finish is light not heavy.

Since this worked so well for me I wonder how it will perform for those with darker complexions. I just can't tell. I note there are not other shades available so perhaps this is universal for everyone. I am very pleased with the outcome.
summary: I was skeptical but am a believer now. Great results.

reviewText: I have very fair translucent skin. I honestly couldn't see any color or 'glow' on my face after using this product. The reason I gave it an ok rating is that it does feel very good around the eye area and moisturized well. I think this may work better on those with a darker skin tone and larger pores.
summary: The reason I gave it an ok rating is that it does feel very good around the eye area and moisturized well

reviewText:
This small compact has two colors: pink and peach.  The peach side is used in areas needing shine control or a matte finish.  The peach side will reduce the appearance of lines and pores.  The pink side is used to moisturize  skin.  The pink side leaves skin hydrated, supple and radiant.
You simply apply whichever effect is desired using your fingertips.

Neither color seems to really show up or tint your skin.  The product readily absorbs into your skin.

The peach side is mattifying and reduces shine.  The pink side is sort of like a gel and absorbs in - kind of leaves a gentle glow.

This formulation did not cause my skin to react in any way.

Overall, this is a good set to keep on hand.

My wife doesn't like an oil based make-up product. This is a mattifying gel product[peach] and a moisturizing product[pink]. The colors don't really mean much except to identify the matte versus the moisturizer. Despite the greasy feel my wife tried the product and it does work as advertised; just as the other reviewers have affirmed .
Yet despite doing the job; my wife just can't get past the greasy feel. So she has put the product away for the time being.
Still, the fact is that the products is as good as advertised.
summary: The Product Is A Good As Advertised.

reviewText:
I'm of two minds about this product- I really like the matte (peach) but I'm less enthusiastic about the dewy (pink) side.

The matte side I have been using on the areas next to my nose, where I have large pores and roseacea. It blurs the pores nicely, but barely has enough tint to deal with some of the roseacea. It goes on smooth and silky, and almost instantly feels dry. I like that, having very oily skin in that area. It doesn't last all day, but it has a nice compact and is easy enough to deal with in the middle of the day. I've used it on clean skin and also over oil free sunscreen; it doesn't seem to matter. It works fine either way. I have not tried it over makeup yet but I think it should work fine, because the foundation I use is also oil free (silicon base like the sunscreen).

The dewy side I've used on my cheekbones and above my eyes and I have to be really careful not to use too much, because it stays a little sticky if I use even a hair too much, and that drives me batty. Used very sparingly, though, it creates a nice, fresh, look.

Neither side has made me break out, and I break out if I put anything remotely oily on my skin.

I think this is a really nice product if you have break through in oily areas of your skin, because it's easy to carry and super easy to apply.
summary: Love the matte; dubious about the dewy

reviewText: I have very light skin, but I could not apply enough of this product to show.  It just didn't have any color to it.  I like very much that it is not tested on animals, it's in a nice case and packaged well.  I  applied about three coats, but it just doesn't work for me.
summary: I won't be trying this again.

reviewText:
This is not what we thought we were going to get, but it's OK.  We thought this was just blush but it is a different product.  This ended up being much more of a foundation product. We found it a little confusing for a few reasons.  First, expecting blush we were confused with the gel consistency of the Matte foundation. The instructions are very clear and we applied it by finger and it is a very subtle foundation that fills pours and removes shininess.

The pink side is another confusion.  It should be used to create a dewy effect.  We are not sure what that means, or if that is even something you would want. But even thought the Matte is a tan and the dewy side is a bright pink, both blended into fair skin tones rather well, leaving a nice non-shiny subtle skin tone.

It wasn't at all what we were expecting, but we like the subtle smoothing it leaves, and you can apply makeup over it.  I like that it keeps the natural beauty of my partner.

This is not foundation or blush or highlighter - it is a "finish" & "perfector" - kind of a hybrid of those cosmetics.  Although you can wear it alone it is also designed to be worn over foundation.  So you know how you want your T-zone to look very matte with no pores and not powdery/ashy?  But you want other parts of your face (cheek bone/brow bone) to look more dewy & "highlighted" without looking wet/sparkly/shiny/white?

Well, this little compact helps solve both of those problems.  One side goes over those too-shiny pore areas making them look flat but natural (the peach one) & mattifies oily skin.  And the other side adds just the right amount of dewiness/moisture without making you look goopy/greasy (the pink one) - genius.  It really does not cake up on your face if you reapply during the day as long as you apply lightly and not too often.

You apply with your fingers so make sure your hands/fingers are very clean before using. That is the one thing I'm not wild about because if I am out-&-about, I may not have immediate access to a sink to wash my hands.  But that is a minor complaint since I do not need to reapply often.

The founder of "Make" (2013), founded Mana Products, Inc. in 1975, which is a contract/private label cosmetic manufacturer/creator.  He has worked with many cosmetic companies including Nars so knows a thing or two about quality makeup.  10% of Make sales goes to the "We See Beauty" foundation (a 501(c)(3)) which is a non-profit that gives money to women-led, worker-owned co-op businesses.
summary: Kind of Revolutionary - This Is NOT Foundation or Blush or Highlighter

reviewText:
I admit, I was a little nervous about choosing this product due to the photo, but picked it when I read the other review that said it worked with her fair skin - I've very fair skin myself. The photo doesn't do it much justice, as the tan side is lighter than depicted, and the pink side a much rosier shade of pink.
The tan side is to help 'matte' your skin, especially if you've pores or areas that you want to 'blur'. Think of it as like a matte powder you put on over your makeup. One word of warning, don't use this if you do apply matte or setting powder first - I always use some after my foundation and then remembered I wanted to use this. >.< Yeah, it works well, but even though they say that you can put this on after your makeup, it's best to put it on after some sort of liquid foundation. For a 'gel', it is almost powdery and blends well, even with fair shades of skin and does help reduce pores and provide some camouflaging effects.
The pink side is what I'd consider more of a 'gel' makeup - it reminds me a lot of some products I bought from Korea that help produce a 'dewy' glow. The pink is like a pink lip gloss, it helps give a bit of sheen without much color, though not as tacky once you pat it on the points of your face you want some glow or highlights (parts of your cheeks, brow, bow of the lip, etc.). I know the 'dewy' effect is really popular right now so this is something that is fun to play with yet it doesn't go overboard too easily.
All of this comes in a sturdy case that will travel well and includes a mirror. It's a nice set that lets you experiment and cover some problem areas and I can see it working well for fair to medium skin tones at least.
summary: great for touch-ups and a little extra glow

reviewText:
MAKE Cosmetics Custom Finish Effects, Matte/Dew is a combination of products one of which is to cover and another that adds a layer of moisture all while giving a nice healthy pink tone that you can get to your exact shade. Very easy to apply and absorbs well into the skin. There is a slight fragrance but not anything overpowering. Application is suggested to be done with just your fingers but of course you can easily use any applicator you are comfortable with.

Easy to apply and looks and feels good on skin. Very nice case as well. Quality product. Very pleased with it.

I was a little worried about the coloring of this product, would it show up - happily no. Though each side is a different color, when used in a thin veil as directed, it absolutely doesn't show. The product on both sides is silky smooth, with pink side just giving a subtle healthy glow. I used this on bare skin and another day I used it over my makeup. You seriously can't see this product when on. I have dry skin, but some larger pores on my chin and nose. The peach colored  side, the mattifying side, did seem to camouflage mark larger pores for a smoother appearance, applied over makeup, it does the same thing and blends effortlessly. The pink side is lightly oily side, that gives your cheeks a healthy glow without adding color. Both sides are silky to the touch and apply silky smooth. I am really impressed with this product and will make it part of my daily routine.
easy to go on and seems to be doing what it says it will do

1/25/2018 I am starting to use this.  2/24/2018  I am still using this.  I keep it by my computer and this way I am more consistent with its usage.  It smells great like a sugar cookie.  I paint it onto the left hand and rub my nails together spreading it to the right hand.  A little goes a long way.  I am a nail bitter and this gives me incentive not to bite them.  If only I could lay off bitting my thumbs:-)
Love this product . When  I bought this product it was at a great price. Better than all the stars I've seen it in.
Because nails grow so slowly, it's hard to tell whether this is doing anything or not. I does make a nice cuticle oil, though.
summary: I does make a nice cuticle oil

reviewText: Really makes a difference and my cuticles are repaired!
Excellent product to use on nails.
This product is really helping my cuticles and stopping dryness on the sides of my finger.  Highly recommend it.
summary: CND Rescue RXx Daily Keratin Treatment

reviewText: Just had to add my vote to all the other reviews.  This really works.  And I too have found that it nearly completely "healed" a vertical split in one of my finger nails.  For years I had been polishing my nails and then had the bad habit of pulling the polish off the nail when it would start to chip.  Then I used nail products like Nail Tek that only seemed to make it worse.  Finally after forswearing all nail products for a while, I came to understand that even in their natural state the main problem was lack of moisture, not lack of hardness.  The first product I tried is Trind Nail Balsam, and that made a huge difference, used twice a day.  Then I came across this and have to say I think it is even more effective.  The Trind does moisturize the nails but the CND leaves a very light protective coating.  I continue to use both products as often during the day as I can.  My nails finally look healthy, better than I can every remember them looking.  I will never use polish on them again.
summary: Ner thought my nails could be this healthy again.

reviewText:
The smell of Josie Body Cream is pleasant. I have not encountered Josie Natori before so the perfume is new to me, but I don't mind it. The cream goes on well, dries quickly, and feels nice once it dries. The scent lingers a long time, and I would be careful before mixing this with another scented product; I would suspect they would compete with each other and the results could be stinky.

As has been noted in other reviews, this is in a large glass pot with a screw-on lid. Depending on how much you use, this could easily last a couple months. I hope so, as I can't imagine paying $60 for something every 30 days!

First, packaging. This container is so cute that when the lotion is all gone, I will def keep it and use it for something and place it where it will be seen. Major thumbs up.

Two, the smell. Amazing!!!! I can't pinpoint what it is. There's spice and a bit of musk and I think I detect something floral.

Three, the texture: a perfect cream. Goes on smooth, dries quickly, smells 12 hours later, and does not leave a greasy residue.

Four, allergies: I have sensitive skin and have not had any issues with this lotion. No rash, no nothing.

Very happy with this product and tempted to buy the perfume.

Josie By Josie Natori Body Cream, 6.8 oz.  I love the fragrance of this body cream. It is light, floral and very pleasant as well as long lasting. The jar is large and will last a long time for a little goes a long way. After using this product I noticed how nice my skin felt. The consistency is just right not greasy and not too heavy. The cost is $58.00 per jar.

I just received this cream and the first thing that struck me is the nice and elegant packaging. It looks good just sitting on the bathroom counter, of course that is not what counts but the rest didn't disappoint either. The cream is pink and very light, goes on smooth and leaves a wonderful floral scent that is just the right amount, not too subtle and not too overwhelming. My skin felt really soft and it is great that the jar is big because you'll want to put tho scream all over. This cream is also non-greasy so it absorbs well and you don't have to worry about having to let it soak in before getting dress. It is amazing after you shower, your skin will feel fabulous. Well, I have nothing negative to say about this cream, I recommend it and hope you indulge your skin and senses with it.
summary: Subtle, elegant and will leave your skin feeling like silk

reviewText:
The first thing you may notice about Josie Natori Body cream is the weight, 6.8 oz., and the large size of the jar. This will last a long time. The top of the jar has an interesting design: black and white squares with red flowers creeping up the side. The border of the lid is black and the jar is transparent, with the pale, powdery peach color of the cream, visible.

Natori body cream is light. Its absorbency time is average. It leaves the skin feeling soft and moisturized.

The scent lingers. For me, Natori has the unmistakable scent of menthol combined with other scents, perhaps a light baby powder, perhaps sandalwood, but for me, menthol was predominant.

Others have characterized the scent as exotic and sultry.
It reminded me of being a child with a cold when my mother rubbed a vapor rub on my chest.

The ingredient list on the black and white box is extensive.

UPDATE and ADVISEMENT: Scent was still strong after six hours with only a scant application. You may want to apply your usual scent more moderately as this body cream seems to act like a cream perfume. Some will love this, but some will not.
I felt it was important to include this information in my review.

Natori Body cream costs $58.00. Perhaps someone more sophisticated than me can tell me why.
summary: Lovely Looking. A lot of Product. Hint of Menthol?

reviewText: Prior to being offered this product, I was unfamiliar with the fragrance Josie by Josie Natori.  Since I can always use a good body cream, I decided to try it.  I absolutely LOVE the fragrance of this body cream!  It is just the perfect combination of a floral scent and something a bit more exotic; its a very sultry fragrance but not too heavy.  As a body cream, it left my skin not only smelling wonderful but also feeling wonderfully soft and smooth.  It is neither thick nor greasy, and it absorbs easily leaving behind only soft, beautifully smelling skin without any residue.  Josie by Josie Natori Body Cream comes in a large, substantial-feeling jar with an intriguing red floral cut-out design over a black and white geometric pattern and makes for a fabulous-looking accessory on my bathroom counter.
summary: LOVE the Fragrance of This Body Cream!

reviewText: Josie by Josie Natori body lotion....I've never heard of or tried this scent before but it has my attention now! Smells lovely, goes on smoothly and is long lasting (scent). Has a slightly musky/fruity scent. I use Vaseline intensive care lotion first and then this on top because it doesn't moisturize well but it smells GREAT!! I might want to order the perfume to March this scent!!
summary: Josie by Josie Natori body lotion

reviewText:
I don't see what the big deal is about this lotion. It really doesn't smell or feel any nicer than something that could be purchased at a drug store. The ingredients are also very basic and nothing to get excited about. The scent is mediocre at best. This is more of a perfumed lotion than a moisturizing one. I could look past that fact if this actually smelled good. It really does not.

I don't know what the whole "sparkling" thing in the description is supposed to mean. This is not a shimmering lotion. The price on this should really be $4.50 instead of $45.00. If you want to try some wonderful, but still affordable luxury skincare, go with L'occitane and Perlier.
summary: Not what I expect from a luxury product

reviewText:
At first I couldn't understand why a bottle of lotion would be almost $50. But then I realized that this is a perfume based lotion to layer the Josie scent. So let's talk about the lotion first. It is about average, sinks in, isn't too greasy and is good for moderate moisturizing. Onto the scent: it is strong but settles a little after awhile. It is a little musky with a hint of flowers. I tend to prefer a more 'fresh and light' scent but I have enjoyed the whiffs I get of this throughout the day.

If you like layering your scent and you like the Josie perfume, this will add to your experience.
summary: Nice for Layering the Perfume Scent

reviewText: Some of the reviews of this product are treating this like a lotion. While it *is* a lotion, its primarily a fragrance. If you are looking for something to help your ashy skin or your dry hands, keep looking. This is basically meant to be a perfume in lotion form. It is a light, floral scent that I would consider most appropriate for twenty and thirty-somethings. Its young and fresh without being childish. The lotion doesnt go on greasy and the fragrance is not overwhelming. It is the kind of quality fragrance you would expect from a brand like Josie Natori.

I am always a sucker for body lotion, particularly when the lotion leaves my arms and legs feeling hydrated with a fresh and appealing scent. Josie comes in an easily-squeezable and non-breakable bottle; it's easy to dispense the lotion. When it first arrived, I tested it on my hands to see how it would absorb. The scent was anything but subtle; I felt as if I were wearing perfume with a floral fragrance.  I waited a day and then tried it again, this time using it as intended, right after my morning shower.

The scent, when first applied, seems "perfumy" but quickly dissipates and becomes more subtle. The hydrating effect does not last very long at all, certainly not as much as some of the other body lotions I've enjoyed. All in all, the prices seems too high, unless you love the Josie Natori brand. Scent, of course, is highly subjective and it may well be that the scent is just not for me.

Josie by Josie Natori Body Lotion is a fairly thin consistency lotion that has a light fruity scent in the squeezable plastic bottle, and is dispensed through a euro-dropper type opening.  It spreads easy and absorbs quickly.

Due to the thinness of the lotion, I do not find it to be very moisturising, and the moisture it does supply is not long-lasting.  The fragrance, however, IS long-lasting, which is not a particularly good thing as I do not care for the scent when I wear it.  It develops an 'off' scent within five minutes of my applying the lotion.  However, my teen daughter can wear it and it smells very nice on her, slightly fruity and with a hint of vanilla and wood.  On me, it smells like cheap dollar store pear-scented lotion.  Not something I would buy for myself, but if you like the scent, it is a good layering option, especially if you do not really need it to moisturise.
summary: OK, not for truely dry skin

reviewText: When first sprayed, to me it is like fresh linen, floral and sweet, and a tiny bit of spice.  Then after an hour it changes character and becomes more subtle and has a powdery sensual fragrance.

It's a nice "every day wear" fragrance that won't leave your co-workers gagging for breath.
This fragrance is so light that within a few seconds of spraying it, I could hardly tell I was wearing any. I spritzed again on my wrist, and again, only a few (2-3) seconds later I could hardly tell it was there.

It has a very sweet fragrance that teminded me a tad of Mickarl Kors' Summer scent, but this is more flowery than Kors'.
  The bottle is very cool looking. The bottom half is real glass (as you would expect) with an acrylic top that matches.
  I am not familiar with Josie Natori at all. Never heard of the label before. Seems pretty good.
 .

Clothing designer Jose Natori has created a new fragrance called Josie. I am reviewing the 3.4oz  Eau de Parfum spray. The spray dispenser is appealing with its black and white geometric pattern and red highlights. The atomizer produces a fine but generous spray.

While this fragrance is advertised as a sensual floral scent, I thought it more of a musky scent. After 30 minutes or so, I smelled my wrist again and some of the musky scent that was initially present had dissipated, so it began to smell more floral, but the underlying musky scent remained. At first, I wondered if this was a unisex or mens cologne due to the musk.

Aside from Asian Pear in this fragrance, there is also Bergamot. I looked up Bergamot and was surprised to discover that it is derived from the Bergamot orange peel and is an ingredient in Earl Gray tea. Since designer Jose Natori is originally from the Philippines, it is fitting that her trademark scent contains the essence of the national flower of the Philippines, the Sampaguita (a.k.a. the Arabian jasmine). Freesia and Wild Orchid are also in this cologne.

I usually wear Marc Jacobs Daisy and Daisy Dream. I tend to prefer sweeter, flowery scents and I was not wild about this fragrance. My daughter, however, tried it and loved the scent. She wears a mens scented deodorant since the smell is appealing to her, so she selects fragrances that appeal to her senses rather than wearing ones that are touted to appeal to the opposite sex. She mentioned that the initial, primary musky scent was appealing to her.
summary: Sophisticated scent that my nose indicated was in the musky range, which gradually released hints of floral after a while

reviewText: Would make a great gift for perfume lovers or even someone who doesn't wear perfume that much. Presentation is great. Comes in a beautiful gift box with a geometric pattern on the front and sides. Bottle itself is also beautiful, is made of glass and the scent is nice. Bottle and amount of perfume inside it should last a long time considering you only need one or two sprays per use. Fragrance isn't too overpowering, it's a bit reminiscent  in packaging and scent to Liz Claiborne.  Has a bit of a musky smell, but in a pleasant way. A little will go a long way this one. I'd give it four to five stars.

This one gets a mixed review. My girlfriend loved it, and I didn't like it at all. Here are our takes on it.

Me: 2 stars
The scent is a little mature, overpoweringly sweet, heavy, and with a note of something plum or prune-like. Very floral, somewhat fruity (but not in a bright refreshing way so much as a stale, almost old wat), and far to feminine for me. I like crisp, invigorating scents with citrus, lemongrass, or more woody smells like patchouli and sandalwood. Masks are great, too. So if that's your taste, you will probably strongly dislike this perfume.

Hers: The scent has a long-lasting quality, though it is a bit on the sweet side. It has strength without being overwhelming, except perhaps the sweetness, and it feels expensive...but for the price, it's not quite worth it.
summary: Mixed review; mature, very sweet, floral and dully fruity

reviewText:
Update:
After having this for a few weeks, my wife has mentioned several times how much she loves the scent.
-------------------------------
Smell is a subjective thing but my wife and I both enjoy this scent.  It's very mild and does not overpower..  The scent easily lasts for several hours if you spray it into the air and then walk through it or spray it on your wrists and then rub them together.

The packaging is very attractive and makes this a splendid gift for a loved one.  The bottle and lid are unique and substantial.  It definitely makes an impression and lets you know you've got something special.
summary: mild scent, excellent packaging for gifts

reviewText:
I must admit that when I first received this and put it on, I was almost nauseated with how strong and overpowering the fragrance was. After a couple of weeks of wearing it everyday, however, I think I have to say that it has grown on me. I understand that every perfume reacts with the individual's own body chemistry and subtly or completely changes the notes in the scent, and I was totally surprised to find that I actually like this perfume quite a bit. Normally I wear only one perfume -- Ames Soeurs by Joya -- so I thought I'd branch out a bit and try something new just to change things up. When I first put this on I felt that the smell was more suited to what I term "old lady" gag. But after the scent dries and absorbed into my skin, it changed to a very pleasant aroma (at least to me). I find it very floral with a bit of a woodsy note and definitely this is a perfume that you find where a little goes a long way. Two spritzes with the pump at the neckline and done is enough and it lasts for quite awhile.
As a side note -- the lingering smell on my clothes is very pleasant because as it evaporates into its essence, the residual is quite a nice scent.

The packaging is very trendy and the perfume comes in glass with a plastic pull off top. The black, white and red accents are striking and sort of belie that this is definitely not so much a "fresh" scent as a heavier toned floral. Great for evenings out, or nights in. As with all fragrances, I suggest anyone who is interested try a sample over a period of time to see how your body chemistry reacts and changes the scent and to see if it suits you. The product description details the essences used to make the perfume.

As previously stated, although I initially wasn't too crazy about this perfume, I actually ended up liking it a lot and am glad I have it!
summary: Delightful floral that grows on you

reviewText: What struck me most about the scent is how sweet smelling it is, almost overwhelmingly so. There are floral undertones, not fruity. But the scent reminds me of older ladies. On the plus side, the scent definitely lasts and doesn't smell cheap. My mom enjoyed it.

Josie By Josie Natori Eau de Parfum, 3.4 fl oz.  This is a product that I had the pleasure and honor of trying out and reviewing.  It is one of the best products I've had the opportunity to test and rate.  The scent is so lovely.  It is hard to describe.  But with my limited ability to capture it's beauty, I will say it is sexy, sophisticated, elegant.  It's not fruity or sweet. (If it is, that part of it is subtle.)

I only spray on a very small amount, because too much perfume can (and probably will be) a disaster, and most everybody will be offended.  So unless someone says "no perfume because someone has allergies or because someone doesn't like it", then I only spray a very minute amount - only enough for it to make you have a scent of cleanness and elegance, rather than having a smell of mustiness.
summary: Josie By Josie Natori Eau de Parfum, 3.4 fl oz

reviewText: I like Josie Eau do Parfum.  The scent is nice, though a tad too strong for me.  After spritzing a very small amount behind my ears and cleavage, then crossing my wrists over cleavage, rubbing wrists together, I approached my husband to get his opinion.  He did not care for it.  Well, he won't be wearing it anyway!  LOL  (He prefers a much lighter floral fragrance on me, such as L' Air du Temps.)  Josie's fragrance is made up of a jasmine (sampaguito - national flower of Philippines), Asian pear, bergamot (also found in my favorite Earl Grey tea), freesia, and orchid, plus the usual other ingredients that are there to stabilize and keep it fresh.  This is a perfume that seems to be more for evening wear, than morning and during the day.  It's been about 5 hours since I applied it, and I can still catch a whiff on my wrists.  Rather pleasant, I think...so I would say let it linger a while before going out.  It is referred to, as being a vibrant mix of being confident, sexy, and delivering a spirited energy.  I guess I'm just a little to quiet and mellow, so I'll wear it occasionally with caution.
summary: Josie is a nice scent, but use small amount.

reviewText:
Overall, I like this eau de parfum, but am definitely not in the "love it" category.

There are many scents happening at the same time, which may appeal to some, and to which others may be adverse. It is not a light fragrance, and that said, my 17 year old daughter doesn't like it. As difficult as it is to describe a fragrance in words, especially given that it's all totally subjective, I would say that this fragrance is probaly one of those that women will immediately like or dislike as it's not one of those "beat around the bush" scents that you need to contemplate. It's definitely got musk, citrus, floral and tea notes happening, and I would honestly say that it's not a strong feminine fragrance (but does have a sweet finish) and has "shades" of more masculine scents. Like I said, a lot of different scents happening all at once, and a little goes a long way.

I do like it, but don't know if I'd actually pick it up and buy it for myself, as I have other fragrances that I really adore, and to add the fact that it's not a very inexpensive perfume. The bottle itself is unique, but very heavy and bulky.
summary: I quite like it, but think there will be lovers and haters of this fragrance, not too many who can take it or leave it.

reviewText:
I have not had much luck recently with commercial fragrances, as they all tend to smell the same with my body chemistry, sort of chemical like and cheap.  Since I tend to gravitate toward woodsy or floral type scents, I thought maybe a fragrance that claims to have a more fruit based scent (Asian pear in this case) would be different.  I was wrong.

Josie smells fine in the bottle, but when I apply to myself, I first get a strong alcohol smell-like I had spilled rubbing alcohol in the room.  Then the alcohol smell goes away, and I am left with a scent that is hard to describe.  It is not Asian pear, nor is it citrus, but more of a can of tropical fruit salad smell.  This fades quickly and is followed by a floral scent, like freesia and hyacinth mixed with Ivory soap.  On my skin, it smells absolutely nothing like the matching body lotion did-which is a good thing.

Not a terrible scent, and it did not give me a headache like Reveal by Calvin Klein, but it is not for me.  It does smell better on my clothing, curtains, and as an air freshener than it does on me.  It does not even smell nice on my daughter, on whom the body lotion smells wonderful.  Guess I will have to stick with perfume oils.

I like it and think it is best applied with a brush as it is more like a powdery substance.  Therefore I do not understand the ones complaining that it does not come with an applicator?  Most women would already have a nice makeup brush anyway.  I am fair toned with natural blonde hair and blue eyes.  I think the product applied with a brush in moderation works just fine even with my light tone. Marilyn.

I have fair skin, light brown hair with highlights and blue eyes.  I love the color of this.  If I put it on "just right" it looks natural.  There is no pad or brush included so I don't take it with me.  I generally use a fluffly brush and use the powder sparingly over my checks, forehead, I I tend to have hot flashes frequently and this disappears.  I would love to be able to re-apply it and am not willing to bring it with me along with a fluffy brush.

I wish it were less concenetrated and came with either a compact brush or a buff.  Then it would be much more useful to me.

I am not a huge makeup person. I have my list of things I use daily, SPF moisturizer, powder, brows, mascara, lip gloss... the end. To add something else for me is quite brazen. I thought I'd mix it up a little and add some glow to my summer routine.

I was worried about being too bronze, about looking fake from my neck up but I was totally wrong! I am pretty fair skinned and use a SPF 50 every day on my face. The color was needed.

I used a super soft, fluffy brush to add a bit to the top of my forehead, then the apples of my cheeks and up my cheekbones, a touch on my nose and on my chin. Voila! It looked slightly sun kissed and a bit shiny. I loved it!

This product seems silky and nice when applied. What I find nice about it is that the bronzing component isn't too overdone. A lot of bronzers are very metallic or pearly, and they overshoot sun-kissed and come off unnaturally shiny.

This bronzer is very easy to over apply, or for it not to go on evenly. If that happens, it doesn't just smooth out with a bit of powder like regular blush does. You have to wipe it off with a tissue and start over, which can be time consuming.

I'm not crazy about a lot of the ingredients in it, and for that reason won't likely continue using it. If you're vegan, this product isn't tested on animals, though it contains carmine.

Also, the compact doesn't come with an applicator, which is fine when I'm using it at home. However, to take it out with me and use it isn't an option, unless I want to haul around a brush, as well. That's the real deal-killer for me.

In all, Vincent Longo's products are very nice and generally worth the price.

It's worth noting that the reviews for this product seem to be addressing two different iterations of this product. The latest reviews are based on a mixed palette of shimmering and multi-shaded pressed powder. There is no split palette as earlier reviews indicate. The listing for this product really should have been split, because the one that was rated earlier is no longer.

I was instantly surprised by the immediate addition of bronze coloring on my fair skin.  I mixed the colors together and it went on a bit too heavy.  An applicator could be included with directions for mixing.  I will use it again but I will use less.  This product has an added benefit as it can be used on the body also, which is probably why it is so concentrated for better coverage.

The compact is rather cheap.  For this price point, the bronzer should be in a better quality case.
I was pleasantly surprised this was made in Italy (not China) and that it is hypoallergenic and cruelty free.

POSITIVES:

*Very silky feeling texture
*Blends in easily
*Does not feel drying
*Has a slight sheen but isn't loaded with sparklies
*Provides more coverage than expected for a bronzer
*Light scent in the container but smell disappears on skin
*Theres a handy mirror in the compact

NEGATIVES:

*Too moisturizing for oily skin
*Color (Copper Kiss  a warm rather than cool shade) does not work for my coloring+

This is not really a negative however an applicator is not included

+My skin is extremely fair with a ruddy undertone, light hair, green/blue eyes

It's a Jack Black product....what do you expect.  I read some reviews on the "new and improved" version but decided on this one.  As advertised it washes out easily and holds just fine.  Can't go wrong
Great

I switched to Jack Black's Wax Pomade after trying Clay Pomade. The Clay Pomade had a stronger hold but was extremely sticky and hard to apply.

Wax Pomade is an awesome product especially due to the addition of tea tree and sage leaf oils which are good for your scalp. The hold is fairly strong but flexible. If you need to re-style, simply use water and run a comb through your hair and you'll be good as new.

For comparison, I've used everything from American Crew, Paul Mitchell, Uppercut, Bumble & Bumble, and Kiehl's. Jack Black really blew away the competition with this one.

With the Jack Black wax pomade no one will know for sure if you used anything in your hair. It dries matte and leaves no clumpy residue to contend with. The fragrance is super light and not perfumey. Hold is firm but not too stiff.
summary: The fragrance is super light and not perfumey

reviewText:
Held my hair perfectly throughout the day and had a great smell that lasted just as long. I wished it came with more-that is my only complaint. I have tried several of these Jack Black products with varying degrees of success and this one did the job. I have straight hair and like to change it regularly so I need a good holding product and this did it.

Would give it a try!

I am using this for my goatee as I am bald (by choice) on top.  The product works very well with a great scent.  A little product is all that is needed unless you like the wetter look.  There is no greasy feel to the product at all and it works well out of the jar; rub into palms then distribute evenly through beard or goatee. The product also washes out very easily.

I had heard good things about the Jack Black brand so we wanted to try out some of their hair products. We have been trying out three different kinds of hair pomades (clay, wax, and gel), we didn't care for any of them.

Both my young boys have slightly wavy hair so I have to put something in their hair to keep it in place while they are at school all day. We use mousse, hair gel, etc. Weve been using different Jack Black pomades for the last few days.

The Wax Pomade states that it is good for beards and it probably is. We cant attest to that but this really does have a wax consistency so it probably would be great for beards, mustaches, or eyebrows.

For my boys, it worked ok. It was a little hard to get the wax out of the container and into their hair so for convenience, I don't like it.

The performance is ok but I don't like how it looks. By the time the boys come home from school, their hair looks dirty and greasy. Considering that a bottle of $4 mousse works great in their hair, we wasn't impressed with the Jack Black pomades.
summary: Made Their Hair Look Dirty and Greasy

reviewText: This wax pomade does a good job with very little little product. Rub into the palms and then distribute evenly through the hair. Comb and style in place. This product will keep everything in place and left my husband's silver hair looking shiny with out being stiff and hard to the touch. It also worked on his mustache as well giving him a nicely groomed appearance. This is a nice but somewhat pricey product, but it does go a long way.

My barber recommended Bona Fide Superior Hold Pomade for me when I switched to him from a salon. I've been using the BF for about six months now and really like it. The one thing which I have a love/hate relationship in regards to the BF is that it's water based. I love being able to rinse my head out under the faucet before bed without showering to get the product out. On the other hand, when participating in sports, if I forget to rinse my head first, I typically have it running down my face and it isn't the best tasting stuff on the planet. BF does give an excellent all day hold, my wavy hair tends to overcome it after a while though.

The barber I use, also has homemade petrolatum based products which is a heavier weight and does manage my hair better in regards to the wave. The downside of course is cleanup at the end of the day. When he gave me the sample, he suggested that I first use shampoo in my dry hair to break up the product, and then do a normal wet wash. This worked somewhat, but even then, there was some product left, so I never really liked using the petrolatum product.

The Jack Black product is also petrolatum based, which is the only reason I'm not a huge fan. I'm not going to ding the product for that reason, as it isn't fair, know what you're buying and the consequences of it. The hold of a petrolatum product is superior for my hair, and this product doesn't let you down. I will use this on occasion for the reasons mentioned in the homemade product. It may become my emergency supply, or used on days when I know I will be more active and sweating.

Of note, not on Amazon's page, this product is free of parabens, sulfates and phthalates.

I've tried many pomades since cutting my hair off. This particular wax pomade didn't cut it like some others I've tried. It didn't seem to hold my hair in place very well. It smells like wax too, which isn't that great. I put it on my husband's beard and it didn't do anything. The hairs were in the same places as before. Wouldn't recommend.

This is only my second ever time using Jack Black hair care products and so far I'm mightily impressed!

For a long-time user of American Crew Forming Cream it's been great to take a break from my tried and true brand and try something new. Jack Black's Wax Pomade features many of the things I like about my Crew cream and some things I like even better.

I used this product immediately after getting out of the shower while my hair's damp. My hair can be a bit of a pain to style depending on the length. I usually keep it short and neat but sometime it can be a month or so before making it back into the barber. So things I like with the Jack Black product...

(+) Application. This stuff really does feel like wax. The top layer in the container was a bit tough to penetrate but one you do and get a small dollop on your hands it's super easy to work into hair.

(+) Hold. Getting an all-day hold without helmet hair is a challenge for many products but the J.B. product does the job. Hair is soft to the tough but stays in place.

(+) Wet look. The wax pomade dries but maintains a 'wet-look' on hair. Think 1950's Mad-Men hair.

So I mentioned before a few additional things that I like about the product over American Crew. The biggest difference for me is how the product feels. My Crew Forming Cream can, especially during hot summer days, leave me feeling greasy. I also think that the Jack Black product is easier to wash away or at least leaves my hair feeling less greasy overall.

High marks here all around. This is definitely a product I recommend and something I plan on buying in the future.
summary: Compares Favorably to American Crew Hair Products

reviewText: Compared with Jack Black's Body-Building Hair Gel with Grapefruit and Ginger--which I obtained at the same time--this product is the hands-down winner, providing a stronger hold that I can restyle throughout the day without being concerned about tendrils of my short, fine hair separating and dangling onto my forehead.  While the pomade doesn't smell as good as the hair gel, it nevertheless has a similar, muted fragrance that improves over what other brand pomades have to offer in that department.  Although my favorite hair-holding products are those in the Layrite line, they don't have any particularly captivating fragrances like this one does.  I would definitely get this again.

Photo 1 = just had haircut and got out of the shower. Top of my hair/bangs are currently 4-inches on my way to a goal of 6 to 7-inches. Hair is wet.

Photo 2 = I stuck my finger into the product and pulled out a small scoop...probably a nickle sized glob. My hair has been towel dried a bit, so it isn't wet, but damp per the instructions on the container

Photo 3 = working it in and getting some lift

Photo 4 = After finger-combing it into the shape I took a fine-tooth comb and styled it a bit more since I'm older and my hair's thinner.

* This style will last me most of the day with me finger-combing back any strands that fall forward or to the side.

* This product is a 'flexible hold', meaning it is light to medium hold and over the course of the day my hair will start to flatten even with the product and/or if I drive with the windows down the wind will definitely mess everything up...but I can finger-comb it back into a satisfactory shape after the drive

* It does have a 'wet' look to it even though the container says 'natural shine'.

* It does NOT feel gross to finger-comb my hair throughout the day even with product in it

* Washes out easy enough...it may take two applications of shampoo, depending how much product I put in

* If I slept in it and get up the next morning and try and leave with out showering, adding more product does NOT help get it into a non-sleep hair shape. Either need to use a little water or just shampoo and start over.

* It has almost a medicinal scent to it, but the scent if very light. At least it doesn't smell feminine.

* Seems to have good ingredients, no propylene glycol or sodium laurel sulfate

OVERALL: While I'm still in my hair growing phase, I'm currently leaning to stronger hold products. But I can see how I'd use this once I get to my desired length. I also could choose to use a very small amount after showering and it would stop my hair from getting all frizzy, yet fall naturally if I didn't want to style, so having that option is good too.

Since guys can use different products for different hair occasions or the mood of the day, this is a worthy product to add to one's supply.

Hands down Jack Black is one of the best hair care product lines in the market. Wax Pomade by Jack Black is another fine example how well they know how to make a good product for men. The wax is firm, and looks all natural. In application, I find it easier on damp hair, rather than dry hair, and just layer it in a bit at a time, in the desired area like on the sides.  If you have dark brown or black hair, the result is enhanced shine that stays for a long time.  The hold isn't ultra firm, but it keeps the shape unless you get it wet.  It has very very light scent, almost unnoticeable after it's applied.  It does take some use to if you are used to using hair gel or foam.  This wax is way better than foam and may not replace the gel you are using.  It's great on mustaches.
summary: Hands down Jack Black is one of the best hair care product lines in the market

reviewText: This Jack Black wax pomade offers medium shine and flexible hold. It comes in a small canister which is ideal for travel. The product comes out easily, though it does stay sticky on your fingers after application. The scent is very subtle. Personally, I have thinning hair and this type of pomade is not very flattering on thin hair. I feel it would be better on thicker hair. If you have thinning hair, I highly recommend Jack Black Clay Pomade, 2.75 oz.
summary: Works well, but not ideal for thinning hair.

reviewText: Wax pomade is different than any hair product I've tried and it requires a little trial and error to get it right if you haven't used it before.  It's really hard to tell how much to apply, so go easy at first.  My best results have been with damp hair right after a shower.  I  just rub my fingertips on the wax (don't dig in or try to scoop it out)  and then through my hair.  The result is a nice, flexible, natural looking hold.  It doesn't really add any shine, nor does it take it away.  It does have a nice smell, but you won't really notice it because it takes so little to hold you hair in place.
summary: Just a little is all it takes

reviewText: While this seems a bit on the expensive side, it performs quite well; providing a nice shine but not too shiny, just right, with a medium to strong hold. They call it 'natural shine' which seems accurate. The wax in this makes your hair a bit shiny, although not super wet looking, just a bit more shine than without it. If you're looking for a more dry matte look, try the Jack Black Clay Pomade, 2.75 oz. instead. The scent is very mild, which I appreciate.
summary: Very nice pomade with just the right amount of shine

reviewText:
This one does what it says on the tin. I applied the normal amount for my hair, and was treated to a natural shine that held in place fairly well without being "crunchy" or overly stiff. Personally I prefer just a little more hold, as my regular product is Baxter of California's clay pomade and that can hold your hair in strong winds. For its part, this Jack Black pomade was enough that my hair was mostly untouched by some driving with the windows down, so it's a pretty solid hold.

Recommended. Good hold, doesn't look too greasy, and doesn't have any off smell.
Love the travel size. Smells good, have used this product for years, will continue to use.

As organic as you can get! Coola is non greasy and absorbs quickly so doesnt get into your eyes and sting when you perspire. The light cucumber scent is great, no smelly perfume or strong Pia Colada odour. My GF and I beach twice a year and we don't leave home without our Coola!

Coola has excellent products and if it wasn't so darn expensive I would give it five stars. I love the cucumber scent for the face sunscreen and how light it is, getting absorbed by the skin pretty much immediately.
Again, if it was a bit more affordable it would be 5 stars for me.
Love these excellent products and the perfect travel size and bag.

I really like these products. The sunscreens are both really nice (face and body). I am already all out of the body and will likely buy more from this brand. I also really liked the after sun lotion, and am very happy to have a lip balm with SPF. The balm isn't really moisturizing, so you can't likely use it as a day to day lip balm, but it's great for days when you'll be in the sun a lot.

The bag it comes in is also great for travel! Very cute and large.

I bought this set for a trip to Mexico and loved it! While I used a different sunscreen primarily, I used the lip balm with sunscreen and loved it - and never had chapped or burned lips the entire week! I also used the after-sun lotion and it helped immensely for the sunburn I acquired on the first day. And the bag it came in made a perfect wet bag for swimsuits! The face sunscreen's SPF is lower than another one I used during the day, but was perfect for layering under foundation (also with sunscreen) or for times of day when the sun wasn't as intense.

I haven't tried the spray sunscreen yet, but overall this is a fantastic set and I highly recommend it for travel!
This is a great peptide cream for everyday.  I love the way it makes my skin look and feel.

Very nice lightweight face cream for daily use.  I use all the Revision Skincare products and they seem to have a very positive effect on my skin.  I have noticed better texture, moisturized skin, and less fine lines and wrinkles.  My skin does not have a 60 year old look at all and I have to think that Revision products have played a big part of this.  My dermatologist recommended the Revision products and I am so glad I decided to purchase them.
Feels so smooth and silky

I ordered Revision DEJ Face Cream, not knowing whether it was a good choice as there were not too many reviews at the time.  I do like this product, but have learned that it needs to be applied fairly liberally to get the full benefit.  I have combination skin, and it keeps my face moisturized all day and night.  I will be reordering it when I run out.
summary: WILL REORDER REVISION D.E.J. FACE CREAM

reviewText: My favorite skin care product.  Revision rocks.
This is pretty expensive.  It is good, but not great.  I switched to Bliss Oxygen which is cheaper and seems to work better for dry skin.
Fine lines are decreasing, more suppleness. Thiis was recommended by a nurse practitioner who works in dermatology.

This is the same thickening shampoo that used to come in the blue bottle.  The only difference is that it now has a pump.  They also increased the size and raised the price on a per ounce basis (boo on you, Jack Black!).

In terms of performance though, this shampoo works great.  I have thinning hair and I'm very happy with the volume it provides.  The scent is nothing great, but it's mild and inoffensive.  This is something that women could use also.
summary: Great shampoo for adding volume to thin hair.

reviewText: Great
Excellent product
Great
I have fine hair. This does thicken it up.
It's Jack Black!!  Works well
Another win for Jack Black products, who have won me over with their overall quality. Lathers well and washes clean without your hair feeling "stripped" afterwards. Will be buying again.
summary: Another win for Jack Black products, who have won ...

reviewText: Works well, smells nice.

Love all the Jack Black products.
The Shampoo & Conditioner are great.
The only problem is when I fine something I like a lot, it either doesn't stay in stock or they stop making it.
Love it! It works well and you can not go wrong with Jack Black products.

Overall, a great smelling shampoo.

I've used a number of Jack Black products in the past, including shave creme, and this is right up there as a top notch product.

The Double Header has a very clean and fresh smell that obviously has some peppermint and sage in it.  It always wakes me right up in the morning.

The only negative aspect to the Double Header is the rather high price.  At $30, it's not a shampoo I'd recommend to everyone, but I do like it.

Branded for men, but this luxurious 2 in 1 works for male and female.  It is a thick, creamy white soap with just a light minty smell to it.  It lathers up really well and rinses fairly easily.  I left it in just a few minutes for the conditioners to work.  Even though it didn't seem like my hair felt soft and shiny when I rinsed, it did when it dried.  It was bouncy, shiny and smelled great! I did add a curl serum to my wet hair afterward, but my son added gel to his and we both thought our hair looked and smelled great.  If you can afford the price, it's a superb product.  Thank goodness it just takes a small dollop to do the work, making this product stretch for awhile. All natural and sulfate free; a superb product!
summary: Expensive product but works extremely well.

reviewText: This shampoo/conditioner combo from Jack Black works great: it smells great, smooth and light refreshingly clean with hints of peppermint, and cleans well, lathering less than some but still enough. It does actually leave my hair smooth and pretty tangle free (long hair), and honestly, I would buy it for daily use except for the price: it's a bit pricey for daily use, so for that reason, I will be using it for special occasion only and it gets 4 stars. If the price point goes down a bit in future, this product would be fantastic to use all the time, it's really good stuff. Bonus is the bottle comes with a little piece of plastic that keeps the pump from dispensing in transit (a nice touch on a higher end price product). Here, you're paying for the product, the fact that it works well and the name, and it IS a product I would recommend.
summary: Light, refreshingly clean with hints of peppermint, hair smooth - I liked it a lot!

reviewText:
Smells nice, works well, but wow that price.

Jack Black shampoos and conditioners tend to follow a theme, and this is no exception. Generally this product smells pleasant, and especially thanks to the shea butter included you get a very healthy feeling in your conditioned hair. It's quite pleasant, making this one of the better shampoo and conditioners I've used.

It is however also very expensive. As of writing this product retails for several times the price of "salon quality" shampoos and conditioners, so it's hard to justify the cost. I'm glad I'm doing this off a review sample because even though I absolutely love this product, I cannot possibly justifying this price. This bottle costs as much as a 3-month supply of Rogaine hair regrowth formula. That's just ridiculous.

We are longtime fans of Jack Black products. My husband has been a convert since I pushed the first sample on him and threw away his bar soap. He loves this product, as well. He normally uses the 3-1 on his hair. he likes that this has conditioner and he notices a shine to his hair that he did not have before. It has a nice smell, a very masculine, clean scent. This will be added to our rotation and will be the perfect present for my husband come holiday time.
summary: It has a nice smell, a very masculine

reviewText: Let's start with the ingredients.  I see one review here that raves about 100% natural ingredients that he/she can feel immediately when it hits the scalp. That is not true.... far from it, in fact.  Granted, the manufacturer makes no such claim, so I don't know where this reviewer comes up with this; I assume he can read since he was able to write a review.  Ingredients are listed in order of highest content to least.  Ingredient #1 is water-it almost always is.  After that, there are 8 compounds listed that would require and advanced degree in chemistry to read, much less understand.  Then we get to the Peppermint, more chems, shea butter and such.  Not a big deal.. just clarifying.  The shampoo/conditioner is good.  It doesn't lather as much as I'm used to, which is to be expected with a combo product, especially one sans the sulfates.  It has a pleasing, not overbearing scent and I do feel a slight tingle on my scalp after massaging it in, probably due to the peppermint.  It leaves my hair shiny as advertised; my hair is relatively short so tangles are never an issue.  It doesn't take much product to clean my hair, a couple of pumps is sufficient.  I do like this quite a bit, but it is very expensive.  I use Jack Black products religiously-shampoos, shaving products, lotions, etc... and I've never been disappointed with their performance.  I'll probably stick with their regular shampoo after this bottle is exhausted, mostly because of the price point.  If money is no object, I'll say go for it.  If you are price conscious, there are alternatives available for less than half of what you'll pay for this.
summary: Great product if you don't mind paying a premium for the name

reviewText:
Shampoo plus conditioner is an odd product.  It often has the effect of creamy shampoo, which is that it leaves hair more manageable (fewer tangles), but still a bit rough and dry compared to separate conditioner.  This one is an oddity for me, because it actually leaves my hair feeling more "moist."  If anything, it is a bit too heavy for my current hair length.  Still, I appreciate that the thick oily texture does result in something with more impact than a standard combination shampoo.  I suspect that whether you like it or not with depend on your hair texture and length.

What I expect to be more universally liked is the natural minty fragrance, which is excellent and not at all irritating.  The ingredients are certainly more premium than a typical shampoo.

So, while I don't think this is for everyone, if it suits your hair type, you'll probably love it.  It doesn't completely suit mine, but I still like it.

Very happy to see this shampoo and conditioner is sulfate free. It really makes a difference in your hair. It makes it much softer and is better for your hair overall. This 2 in 1 works very good to clean your hair and remove buildup from styling products, without stripping your hair or drying it out. Since it has built in conditioner, it helps with tangles and leaves your hair soft and manageable without the need for a separate bottle of conditioner. The scent is nice and not overpowering. It rinsed away easily and does not buildup on your hair. Adds some body too, which is always appreciated.

Any girl that has a Sephora obsession has tried a few Jack Black samples.
It's a high end line, with dozens of products touting botanical ingredients that offer real results.

Men love them because they aren't frou-frou and fussy, and we ALL like men that take care of themselves.

This stuff is downright delicious with a soft natural mint freshness. Not so much that you crave a peppermint patty,  just enough to feel refreshed.
Leaves hair soft and sexy.

I have used the following shampoos over the last 2 years, Anthony's, Baxter of California and Jack Black.  This is the first time I have tried the Jack Black Shampoo and Conditioner (previously used the shampoo and than a separate conditioner).  I feel that the normal Jack Black is my favorite of the 3 shampoos mentioned above but that this one is not in my opinion as good as using the normal shampoo and than the normal conditioner which I know from experience makes my hair feel squeaky clean.  This version merely makes my hair feel clean but not super clean that I get after I typically add conditioner.  It is easy to get sudsy and it washes out of my hair no problems and my normally dry hair does not feel as dry as it does after using the Anthony's brand.  I dislike the pump and wish they would go back to the old bottle (with that being said I also liked the blue bottles better than the new green that they switched over to for their product line).

In the end this is a good combo shampoo / conditioner but I feel you get better results by using a separate conditioner.

Jack Black Double Header Shampoo Plus Conditioner.  I love this shampoo/conditioner, as it feels as though it really made my hair clean, and it was easy to comb after I finished washing.  I also loved the smell.  It is sort of hard to explain, but it kind of reminded me of an "old timey" smell.  But the smell is not strong - just enough to sort of remind me of that wonderful old-timey smell.

I love old-timey smells (even though this is not that strong of a smell, just enough to know it's there).  That's one reason why I love going inside one of our natural stores; it has the smells and the feelings of "old-timey".

Because of the smell, the wonderful cleansing, and the manageability, I highly recommend this shampoo/conditioner.
summary: Jack Black Double Header Shampoo Plus Conditioner

reviewText: If I can give it 10 stars, I would.  I've never had a shampoo conditioner so good. The moment that thing hits your hair and scalp, you can feel it's 100% natural ingredients and not artificial.  The texture, the aroma, the way it cleans, is simply phenomenal. The pump came with a seal cap preventing leak during shipping. The pump doesn't over pump and it generally takes me 2 pumps to get the amount I need. This is also sold in Nordstrom at a higher price.  I love this.  After use, the scalp feels really clean and not heavy.  The hair is moisturized but not oily or tangled. Rich aroma with many of the ingredients' scents. You can smell natural coconut, kelp, etc.  But no strong artificial scent like candy or berry or citrus scents. It's not overpowering and not irritating to scalp or skin. It's very gentle to hair.  I am not sure about how well it keeps colors if you have color treatment. But I am definitely switching to Jack Black from generic brands from now on.
summary: I've never had a shampoo conditioner so good. The moment that thing hits your hair and ...

reviewText:
For that price you should be getting alot more than this. I am not saying the product is bad but I have tried much cheaper Mens shampoo and they  have done equal or better job than this. Smells nice and makes your hair smell great. Lather's great (the best part of this product) and has a rich mans smell(as it should at this price). It reminds me of the Polo scent which is good.

Decent product if you have the extra dollars to spare.

I'm a big fan of Jack Black products, though I'm a woman. They are made for men, but they are not so masculine in smell or anything that I can't just ADORE them. The Jack Black all purpose oil is the best hair product ever for me.
This comes in an attractive, easy to use pump bottle. Getting it ready to work is easy- there's just a small piece to remove and it's fully functional. The shampoo itself is fairly thick, and a pearly white. It smells like sage and mint. The affect is just a pure herbal scent. I think most people will find it fine for either sex.
It makes a nice luxurious lather and it rinses easily. At first I wasn't so sure it was going to be enough conditioning for me- my wet hair felt a bit 'rough' to me, but when my hair dried, it was soft, felt conditioned, and had lots of shine and volume. If I'd not been reviewing this, I might have went ahead and added some leave in conditioner or hair oil, but really, my hair did not need it. After it was dry, my hair did indeed feel and look like it had been both shampooed and conditioned.

It is not very smoothing though, so if that is an issue for you, you might add a bit of smoothing serum after washing. The scent after washing is subtle, but clean and herbal- it smells VERY natural and the fragrance is muted unless I just stick my nose in my hair.

I'm giving it a 5, because my hair feels just SO FULL and has so much volume, that I can't help but love this product. It really has helped get rid of the product buildup that was weighing my hair down.

It is expensive, and I probably won't be using it everyday, but it has a place in my product line up as a good clarifying shampoo for occasional use.
summary: Has a natural, herbal smell, and leaves my hair very full with tons of volume, great clarifier

reviewText: The scent of this conditioner definitely leans towards the peppermint and tea tree oil; I really don't get the basil scent at all. It has a creamy texture without the slickness of typical conditioners. On application it gives your scalp a very cool sensation, most likely from the peppermint oil, and that coolness lasts a while after rinsing. It is strong but not enough to tear my eyes. It did leave my hair smooth and shiny as advertised. The tube is pretty large and there's plenty of product inside; you don't need much to cover your whole head. I have a slight sunburn on my forehead and I was a concerned when the conditioner touched that area because I wasn't expecting such a cool 'rush'. But it did not sting and was OK.
summary: Gives a very 'cool' feeling to scalp

reviewText:
This is nice conditioner that has only a mild scent so you are not left with super-scented hair which is nice.

It seems to condition well however seems slightly expensive.

This is very nourishing, creamy conditioner. I used about the same amount as I normally do of my other (expensive) conditioner, and it was actually too much of this product: a little goes a long way. My hair, which is thick, naturally wavy, and tends to get dry and frizzy, is incredibly soft now and smooth, and best of all it's not big 80s hair like I'm always fighting.  It has conditioned and added a little weight to my hair so it falls into a nice style.  I was also very happy with the ingredients list, which is full of natural and organic ingredients, and nothing (that I know of) that will fade colored hair.  And it smells great! Sort of like rosemary and tea tree oil.  A fresh, clean scent which I think would work for men or women.  Great stuff!

I purchased for the first time and love it.  Just a little bit works. I will being purchasing this item again!
It really did make my hair feel nourished.
The shampoo is great the conditioner could be better.
summary: Love this line, but the conditioner produces only average results

reviewText: Great
This product makes the hair feel smooth. I really like the way it works!

I love the Jack Black line of hair products. I am very chemically sensitive and synthetic fragrances cause me to get a migraine. There are not many hair care products that I can use, but Jack Black makes good products that not only work well, but are made with healthier ingredients. Yay!

It's a line of products advertised for men, but their stuff works great on my hair. I smooths out my over-processed hair without weighing it down. This stuff is pretty great.

At first I was a little skeptical given the small amount for a pretty steep price, but I was impressed at how dense the conditioner is. You really can use a smaller amount than most conditioners for the same effect. It also seems to penetrate faster and better. Another win for the prestigious Jack Black line of products.
summary: ... a little skeptical given the small amount for a pretty steep price

reviewText: Hair is incredibly soft after using; smells nice.

The jack black conditioner is wonderful. My hair is so dry that I after I shampoo and rinse, it feels like straw in my hands. The Jack black was working as I was running my fingers through my hair, I could feel my hair soften and the texture become smoother right in the shower.

 I like that this is also a scalp conditioner with the tea tree oil. A lot of conditioners tell you to only put it on the ends of your hair, because it will weigh down around the scalp. The Jack Black is light and rinses out easily. Afterwards my hair was shiny and smooth, even the ends which desperately need a trim.
summary: Softens hair and treats scalp also

reviewText: This product does a great job of keeping this buzz-cut guy's scalp well-nourished and feeling smooth and not dry and flaky. It also does wonders for the stubble (something I didn't think was possible), leaving it soft and with a noticeable sheen. This is my first Jack Black product and I'm stoked to try more.

I'm a Jack Black fan. I have lots of their products on the shelf and use them all the time. Most of which I have purchased through Amazon but a few came free from Vine for evaluation. This product is one I got for evaluation and I tried it with their shampoo. The results were excellent on my thin hair. My wife tried it too and her hair is much thicker but the results were equally good. Lots of soft feeling tresses.

The scent is fresh and minty / herbal without being flowery - excuse the expression - it smells manly.

Why 4 and not 5 stars ? The recommendation to use a quarter-sized amount is too large. I tried a dime-sized / penny-sized amount (my wife says pea sized) and it worked just fine. Also, they say apply the conditioner first and leave it on while you wash. The problem with that is the product doesn't wash off easily. I feel a slippery film on my face, arms, etc. If you wash first and then rinse off the conditioner, you have to rewash to get all of the conditioner off. I checked with my wife - she says that happens to her too.

Does a great job on hair, smells minty, but is hard to rinse off
summary: Does a great job on hair, smells great, hard to rinse off

reviewText: When I opened the box this conditioner came in, my initial thought was, well that smells very minty.  Thankfully the scent is not very strong once you wash it out because I really would not want to smell like a candy shop all day.  The quarter sized amount (it comes out very fine, not the glob some other cheaper products do) is just enough to cover my hair.  It washes out easily and leaves my usually coarse and frizzy hair feeling soft and smooth even two days later.  And since you only need a quarter size of conditioner per shower, this 295mL bottle should last a while.

Feels super nice on my hair, and doesn't have the slick, oily residue that I get from most conditioners.

I almost didn't order this item because I thought it was from Jack Black the comedian. According to their website: "The name Jack Black, coined before the popularity of the comic actor, embodied the comfort and approachability of a good friend. And the packaging was designed to appeal to a masculine aesthetic."

This conditioner works really well, and it will replace my existing organic conditioner.

This is a good conditioner that smells nice & light. It's meant for men, but I have wavy hair with some grey hairs that are course. This definitely works a lot better than my previous conditioner (Pantene.)  I use Caprese shampoo for curly hair and this conditioner pairs well with it. My hair is thick, but I don't need to use a lot of this. This is more costly than drugstore brands, but if it takes care of my aging hair, it's worth it to me.
summary: Works better than what I was using before

reviewText:
This conditioner smells great: strong mint, with a hint of basil  very nice!  Out of the tube it is a semi-thick crème that is easy to distribute throughout a thick head of hair. Work it into your scalp for a nice conditioning massage. Leaves hair soft, and smelling awesome, without weighing it down or looking flat.

I especially like that there are no parabens, no fragrance or colorants, all ingredients are certified organic and has the Cruelty-Free Bunny symbol on the container.

Jack Black is an upscale men's brand.  I have purchased many products from this company for my husband.  The lip balm, the face moisturizers, and an after shave product by Jack Black are awesome.  We have not tried any Jack Black men's hair products until now.  My husband seems to love this hair moisturizer.  It's applied after you shampoo,  it's left in for a few moments and then it's simply rinsed out.  My husband says his scalp felt great and his hair felt shiny and healthy.  He is an every day shampoo kind of guy so he loves that this product is not at all drying!  It is perfect for him!

This has been very pleasant to use. Right out of the bottle the smell is very pleasant, leaning toward the basil leaf with an undertone of tea tree oil. It's not a masculine scent, just neutral, but pleasant. In use it applies like any really high-class hair conditioner, a little goes a long way and your hair feels wonderful after use. I have noticed that it does help my hair to lay down instead of going frizzy, which means when I use my pomade the finished look is that much better.

Highly recommended.

This provides a light hold and adds some texture and a bit of weight to your hair and no sticky feel. It has very little fragrance, which I appreciate.

I would say if you're looking for something with a mild hold, this texture cream is hard to beat.
summary: Great product for a light hold

reviewText: This is a great styler if you like some control and definition without the crunch or stiffness that gel gives. Nice for a soft "beiber" type style on top with some waves and height. Jack Black makes excellent products, so I am glad to see a  line of hair products. It doesn't make your hair sticky or greasy and the scent is very nice and fairly light.
summary: Definition and control without the crunch

reviewText:
I like Jack Black products a lot, and this one is no different.

I have longish, straightish to wavy hair, and this works great for me. I use it when my hair is dry, and it gives me a more finished, shiny look. My wife has curly hair, and she didn't like it as much as I did.

The earthy scent is pleasant and very subtle, and I really liked that the product left no residue.

This a high quality organic product in a cool tube.
It's a good product but it's not for me. I have blonde hair and using even a small amount it makes my hair look dirty. I see it working on darker thicker hair.
summary: Not for me but a good product

reviewText: I bought this for my husband and he loves it! He uses he thin hair shampoo too by JB and the facial washes too. I just bought him a 2nd tube of this a few days ago because he said he was getting low and didn't want to run out. Normally he doesn't come to me about stuff like this so I know he really likes it. He has medium texture dark straight short hair and his gives a little hold and shine.

I like this a lot. If you are looking for heavy hold then look at other products, but if you want nice manageable hair with a small amount of product this is very good. I like that it has a classy Jack Black clean smell, and you only need to apply a small amount (maybe a nickel size) dab into your palm to work into the hair. It holds up all day, and doesn't make your have all hard and full of junk. The price is a little high, but Jack Black products are simply very good and typically worth the extra.
This works really well at keeping your hair in place. It goes on very easily and you don't have to use a whole lot. Also like that it doesn't make your hair all stiff like other products.

I had not heard of Jack Black before, but I am a fan now. I have thin but frizzy hair, and the sleek finish texture cream tames the frizz without flattening my hair or making it look greasy.

The fragrance is light and pleasant, and disappears quickly so it doesn't clash with other scents.

The texture is creamy and rich and I didn't have to use much to get great results.

This one is one of the better(if not best) Jack Black product's I have tried so far. Has a great smell that lasts a long time and this one gives a slick nice wet look that I love. It also lasts through the whole day which is a big plus not having to worry about my hair getting flat over the course of the day.
