TIZO has none of those problems. None. It is silky and light. It melts into the skin like butter. With blending, it leaves no white cast. It feels moisturizing but breathable on the skin. I am so impressed and delighted. This is now my go to sunblock.

Its not often that I find a great new must have product.  But Tizo2 fits that description.

Since I have that pale thin skin that it is the bane of redheads, sunscreen is not an option for me.  Ive tried just about everything on the market, and none have felt as good on my face as the Tizo.

And, best of all, it works!  The active ingredients are 8% Titanium Dioxide and 3.8% Zinc Oxide.  Thats added to a light, unscented base that can double as foundation primer.

As with most sunscreens, it should be applied at least fifteen minutes before use and reapplied every two hours.  And it should be removed at before bed.

We used this yesterday at the pool for my and my son's faces, and I am happy to report we did not get sunburned! This sunscreen I think is meant to be used under makeup, but I used it at the pool as straight sunscreen and it worked perfectly. The lotion is very light and rubs in easily. While it does go on white it quickly rubs clearly into the skin with no tint or color. There is no scent, and it did not irritate my face nor my eight year old son's face. You need very little so the small bottle will last a while. This is so light on the skin I do see how you could put your makeup over this product. The best factor I found about this sunscreen is that since it is light it absorbs very quickly and you can get in the pool and it indeed seemed very waterproof as it never ran into my eyes and I did not burn. This is very expensive but it works so well I would highly recommend this sunscreen.
summary: Goes on so light and easy,.is water proof, and worked for my eight year old as well

reviewText: Goes on silky smooth and feels light on my face. There is little to no scent which is wonderful. You can wear this under make-up or by itself. I live in the desert southwest of the US so if I leave the house, I wear sunscreen. This is one of the best I've ever used. I'd say the only drawback is the price.
summary: There is little to no scent which is wonderful. You can wear this under make-up or by ...

reviewText: This goes on a little white but as you smooth it in, it disappears. This is one of the most comfortable facial sunscreens I have ever worn. It has a very silky/smooth feel & no scent. I had no sunburn on a very sunny day. I like this plain or with a drop of Dermablend Flawless Creator Pigment Drops mixed in. It makes my skin look excellent & Im getting really good protection from the sun at the same time. Dermablend Flawless Creator Pigment Drops Makeup 10n Liquid Foundation

The XEN-TAN Fresh Tanning Mousse comes with a mitt for application and has a pretty strong scent which is why i assume they call it Fresh.  It is not an offensive scent - a very sweet citrus smell to me.  Since after application you have to wait 3 hours to shower it takes some thought about when to schedule application.  I found that the best day for application was Sat morning before spending the day on the boat, in the sun etc.  I'd get up and shower- be sure to exfoliate- and apply the product.  By the time I was out the door and where I was going i was nice and tan.
While applying the product the mitt is essential. It's not only to protect your hands- it allows an even application.  Since it's not tinted during application be sure to go in circles and go lightly on the product use the 1st time.  avoid callused areas like the edges of your feet etc.  This product is by the a high performing self tanner that you'll be pleased with.
summary: ... comes with a mitt for application and has a pretty strong scent which is why i assume they call ...

reviewText:
The last self tanning product used was an orange streaky mess.
Being very careful to follow the instructions exactly really paid off.
It was used only on my legs, and after the buffing and waiting they are a natural color that isn't too dark.

Update to my previously unhappy review.
I added another "coat" and still nothing but 8 hours later I noticed my leg is tanned, so I am happy.  Although it takes awhile, it does work.  I guess the subtle is a good thing because you can add it in layers and it's not some shocking coverage all of a sudden.
*********************
I am fair skinned and I applied it to one leg only so that I could compare how dark it was.  I waited 3 hours per the instructions and NOTHING happened.  My leg looks just like the leg that didn't receive any mousse.  I read the other reviews and I notice a few say they saw "subtle" changes.  Hmmmm, well I wanted subtle and saw none.  Needless to say, I'm a bit disappointed.
summary: Takes time and a few coats of this stuff

reviewText: While I'm of the olive skin type and don't use tanning products (the sun does me naturally just fine) my wife is very, very fair skinned and couldn't wait to use this.  As stated, within 3 hours her normally pale fair skin and gained a slightly darker tone.  She was very pleased with the results and called it one of the most natural looking tans she has used...and she has used many.
summary: Great if you're fair skinned and looking for a little color.

reviewText: This self tanning mouse works really well!  So well in fact, you must be SURE not to get it on your palms because it is difficult to remove.  One use and I was a lovely shade of light brown.  The foam can be used quite sparingly and the bottle is large so it lasts a while.  I would recommend it to anyone looking for a real sun or tanning bed alternative.  Once I saw an age spot on my face I was done with the sun!

I have very fair skin. Tanning is not an option (who wants to take that risk?!). So, I rely on self-tanners to make me a little less translucent/glow-in-the-dark white in the summer months. Now, for me, this product didn't really provide that sun-kissed look I was seeking. The color was just ... off. I also found it difficult to use the product since the contents are clear; therefore, it was difficult to feel assured that the results would be consistent.

Now, as with all tanners, do exfoliate before using this. I like a sea-salt scrub ... but I know some people who like a sugar-scrub. Both have the same general results (but, for me, most sugar scrubs have a slick finish that conflicts with the tanning lotion). Exfoliating should prevent some of the dark patches that some folks are experiencing.

The scent is okay and the mitt is a really nice touch.

If I had to speculate, this might be better for those with a darker complexion. On those with fair skin, the results are a little strange.
summary: Maybe Not for Those with Very Fair Skin ...

reviewText:
I'm always on the hunt for a self tanner that won't make me look like the color of a candied yam. Xen-Tan applies nicely (but I also exfoliated my legs to within an inch of their paper white consistency.) The color development was...spotty. I followed directions, using their mitt, and I guess I screwed something up.

That wasn't even the biggest issue. A fairly good color seemed to develop at first, but several days later, it's like it gave up and died. The color was just...odd. Thank God I was wearing long pants, because my legs looked strange.

I did not try this on my face, wisely choosing to wait to see what the leg results were. This may work for you if you're darker than me (which isn't hard for most people to be.) For me, it means my search for the holy grail of self tanners goes on.
summary: An odd result on my paper-white legs.

reviewText:
This is a high quality tanner. It offers a pleasant smell and goes on without a greasy feel. The cream is a beige/khaki color. The resulting tan has a natural subtle appearance.

Although my skin is extremely sensitive, this cream does not cause me any irritation. There is a nice list of ingredients for the skin in here making this a double duty moisturizing cream.

So this self tanning foam is for people wanting to develop a " Olive" tan..  So I knew as when I am not in the sun a lot my skin is pretty fair..  I used the glove ( as recommended ) and the foam smelled great, I ensured I let dry about 15 minutes before dressing ( although it seemed to absorb right away which was nice ) . After about three hours I noticed a nice change in my legs, although it was a stranger tan that I have seen with other self tanners I believe this tanning mousse would be ideal for darker skin, versus my fair skin.  After four days it started to fade, I was easily able to buff out in the shower with a shower sponge.

My sister in law spends a lot of time in the sun with her children and has a nice base color- I let her borrow and she loved the color- It made her legs a very pretty olive, brassy brown.. So in conclusion this product is best suited for darker skin types. And although it states its OK to apply on face due to range of color I would be extremely cautious on applying to the face...
summary: Wouldn't Suggest for Fair Skin Tone..

reviewText:
If you like tanning products, then this is a good one.  If not, Xen-Tan won't make you change your  mind.

Pros:
-Easy to use
-Good tan (although not perfectly even)

Cons:
-a bit blotchy
-a bit greasy
-stains white cloth the first day

I had mixed results with this product. I followed the directions exactly because I didn't want to end up with a blotchy skin tone. The mitt is very nice and does a good job helping to get this tanning mousse applied evenly. However, if you happen to have dry skin patches like I do, the tanning mouse gets stuck there and will not smooth out. Therefore, you have dark spots everywhere you have a dry skin patch.

It does spread nicely on smooth skin, and the mitt does make it blend in nice and evenly if you're really careful about not putting on too much at a time. The color is nice. I was hoping it wouldn't be orange, because who wants to look like Donald Trump? It does not have an orange tint. The tanning looks quite natural as long as you do light applications at a time. This can stain your clothes if you're not careful. Especially white clothing. I would not wear white soon after application to be safe.

All in all, it's probably good for younger women who don't have skin problems. If you have dry skin patches, this isn't a good idea.
summary: Not bad if you're careful about application.

reviewText:
It was hard deciding between 3 and 4 stars-
I didn't like the scent and it made my elbows itch.

I love the mitt, and the browning effect. I have medium olive skin, and it did go brown instead of orange or bronze. This is truer to the color I turn when I get sun than other tanners. It absorbs very quickly and doesn't stain clothing.
summary: Some good, some bad, but I like the color a lot

reviewText: Did not care for the over all results of this product. The first thing I noticed was the smell which was quite pleasant so that was a good start. Application was fairly easy to apply to my skin so good there. But once it was all applied it did not give a nice brown tan look it was a more of a medium orange/tan which I did not like at all and as time went by it just got worse. I thought maybe I applied it wrong but I rechecked the instructions a few times and no it was not that. Maybe it was just my skin pigmentation and the product did not mix but either way it was a bust for me.

This brand of tanning lotion did not work for me.  The application was easy as all you really have to do is rub it in evenly, but the color was all wrong.  My skin turned out to be too orangy/brown.  It didn't look natural at all. I tried to apply it a second time thinking I had just used too much, but nope it wasn't my application. This lotion just has too much color in it for my skin.  It might look great on darker skin tones, but for med/light ones I would shy away.  The one positive I could find was that this one didn't smell horrible. Several other brands I have chosen smell really bad, but this one does have a nicer fragrance than most.

I have found that self tanners are totally subjective because everyones skin tone is different so this might work for you, just be careful is all I am saying.

Before we get into the review, I'll start with my disclaimer. I loathe the name "XEN-TAN." I can't tell you specifically WHY I have a negative association with it, but the tongue twister just doesn't sound appealing to me. Here is the definition that I looked up for "xen":
1
a :  guest :  foreigner <xenophobia>
b :  that which is not the host <xenograft>

2
a :  strange :  foreign <xenolith>
b :  not being the host <xenobiotic>

Weird, huh? Anyway, I think the creative geniuses behind the product probably thought xen meant Zen and mixed up big time.

BTW, Zen means: "An approach to religion, arising from Buddhism that seeks religious enlightenment by meditation in which there is no consciousness of self."

Think of Zen as "peaceful and relaxed."

Now that we got my opinion on the name straight, here's my evaluation of the product.
THUMBS UP:
1. If only reviewing the application mitt, I'd easily give it 5 stars. The texture, weight and the way it applies the product is unsurpassed.
2. Love the smell. I can't detect a hint of "grapefruit" as specified on the bottle, but the aroma is light, airy and natural.
3. Nice, foamy texture.
4. Easy to apply; use circular motions, as the manufacturers recommend, this way is the best way to apply the product for even absorption.
5. Absorbs lickety-split.
6. Feels light on the skin.
7. Doesn't stain clothes.
8. Though it didn't give me the results I sought (see THUMBS DOWN, 1 and 2 below), it worked better than other tanners I have tried without the dreadful streaking.

THUMBS DOWN:
1. Unfortunately, it didn't give me the tan I desired. At first, my legs and arms looked pretty good, but then I noticed after a couple of weeks of application, my arms started to look very uneven and were freckled in appearance. NO GOOD.
2. The product never worked on my face.

THE NITTY-GRITTY:
Perhaps XEN-TAN works better on people with darker skin. I am super fair and freckled. For me, this is not an advantageous beauty product. I should have figured as much when the name itself scared me off.
summary: XEN-TAN Fresh Tanning Mousse, not the results I wanted

reviewText: Although I have been wanting to try out a self tanner mousse, I was still a bit nervous when I first tried it out.  I prepared my skin by using exfoliating gloves for two days in the shower beforehand and keeping my skin moisturized. I also chose to just test it out on my legs first to make sure it gave me the results I wanted.  The tanning mitt works very well at applying evenly and I found that if I worked in small areas I could keep from missing any. I did one leg and then waited to compare the color before doing the other.  I immediately noticed the difference and it looked more natural than I had expected.  Because my arms, face and chest regularly get some sun I decided that I didn't need to try it there, but would be comfortable doing so in the fall.  Overall I like the color, ease of use and will consider buying it when this bottle runs out.

I mainly use tanning mousses to mitigate tan lines on my body. Having used several different tanning products over this years, I find the XEN-TAN fresh tanning mouse work a little better. It gives me a natural looking tan without any hint of an orangey tone that I sometimes get from other tanning products. Though it still makes skin blemishes stand out with a darker tone (I have yet to find a tanning product that doesn't). It is simple and easy to apply. A velour mitt is included with the product for my review. I don't believe it is included in the retail product but instead sold separately as Deluxe Tanning Mitt. I follow the instructions carefully, apply it with the mitt and let it air dry. It has a sweet scent that reminds me of cotton candy, which is nice when you wait for it to dry on your skin. The tan tends to be light, so re-application is needed for a darker tan. My only quibble is that it isn't tinted and you have to wait for the color to develop on your skin, so it is easy to miss a spot or two during application. All in all, this is a nice tanning mousse. It is easy to apply with their tanning mitt and the resulting tan doesn't look fake at all. It isn't perfect as I still get a streak here and there sometimes but it may have to do with my skin than anything else. I like it so far.
summary: Subtle tan and smells great too

reviewText:
Let it be known that I have never used an at home tanning product ever - so my expectations were pretty low.

This tanning mousse goes on easily, smells great, and - though it takes a few hours - leaves a nice, subtle, natural looking tan. I used it to help with my farmer tan lines I've got from wearing t-shirts outside so often, and it's blending it right together! Because the tan is subtle, it will take a few applications to completely blend the pale with the "real" tan lines, but it will definitely get the job done without leaving my skin orange or smelling funky.

Very impressed with the ease of use and the natural, subtle results of the product!

Update 10/5/15: I wanted to see how my "tan" would look as it fades and stopped Xen Tan temporarily. It looked natural as it faded, and I wasn't left with splotches of uneven color.

Xen-Tan really makes my face look like I've been out in the sun and got a tan. My skin tone is olive, but I'm super pale as I gave up tanning more than 20 years ago. I've used quality department store self-tanning products on occasion (usually before a vacation that involves sun and swimming), and they worked well, but Xen-Tan is definitely the best of all the brands I've tried. Unlike the other self-tanners, Xen-Tan has a yummy light vanilla scent that dissipates after a couple hours.

Xen-Tan is also easy to apply without getting streaks. I've applied it with bare hands (just wash your hands quickly to avoid staining), and I've also used disposable gloves. It looks and feels like a face cream (with a brownish tinge), and a dime-size portion is enough for my face, neck and chest. I basically apply it just how I apply my face cream, but at the end I smooth over the whole area to try and get even coverage. I avoid my eyelids and getting the product too close to my eyes.

As my Xen-Tan "tan" emerged the first time, I was surprised at how even the color was and that my face, neck and chest turned a nice golden brown tone with no hint of orange or streaks at all. I've since used my Clarisonic to wash my face and could see some color from the Xen-Tan show up on the brush, but my face still has a nice even color and glow. I've reapplied it again and will probably continue to use it every other day while the weather stays so hot. If you're looking for a self-tanner, I wouldn't hesitate to buy Xen-Tan. It's very easy to apply, smells great and looks so natural on my skin tone. Just don't apply Xen-Tan on a sick day from work as no one will ever believe you really stayed home sick!
summary: The Best Self-Tanner I've Used- Smells of Yummy Vanilla and My Skin Looks Golden Brown and Natural

reviewText:
This tanner can be applied with your fingers, tanning mitt or gloves. It is made specifically for your face. You are reminded to wash your hands afterwards and not to wash your face or go swimming for 3 hours.

It is never explained why it says daily use  if they feel you need to use it daily or if it will get darker if you keep reapplying it every day. For me, even though I did not was or go swimming  when I took a shower in the evening after this had been applied in the morning - it seemed to disappear. So it only appears to last for a day.

It might be an issue with how this combines with my natural skin tone, but there was a little more orange to it than I would have liked in the results. The application and all was nice, but the color wasn't quite right.
summary: but there was a little more orange to it than I would have liked in the results

reviewText:
I have the definition of porcelain skin. It is fairer than fair. Now, that's all well and good, but for the occasional gathering, I would like a little more "warmth." I was hoping this would give me that kiss of color that I need. But, instead it came out a little on the orange side ... which has been the same experience I have had with considerably less expensive products. Now, both the goods news and the bad news is that it was gone very quickly (under two days). This is good for me, but maybe bad for someone who wants a longer lasting product. (Now, this could also be a result of fairly aggressive skincare regimen). If anything, I might avoid using your Clarisonic while trying to develop some color.

For me, I think I am just too pale for these products to ever look normal. But, I think if you had medium skin, it might add depth.

As a long time user of St Tropez's self tanner for body as well as their tanner made for face, my standards are lofty.  XEN-TAN has a fabulous scent that does fade and doesn't have tell-tale self-tanner written all over it.  However, without the "guide color" or "instant tan" it can be a challenge to ensure you applied it uniformly on face, which can be a tad tricky.  The perk with the colorless formula is you can wear this tanner under your makeup or alone and go out without fear of looking a bit odd.  I noticed color developed within 4 hours or so, and seemed to work faster than my St Tropez tanner for face.  I loved that it was not greasy or tacky, which the St. Tropez does fall a little short in that regard.  Additional perk, the value -- for 80mL of product it's very reasonable.

However where this self-tanner loses points is as follows.  One, the tan was natural but not a very noticable difference in shade -- I'd say it's light medium in payoff but results could vary on how light or heavy you apply.  With facial skin that tends to go a little drier than rest of body it's safer to go light on application, as heavier seems to go more unnatural in tone.  Secondly, the wear on the tan seemed to be a faster fade than St. Tropez -- however this also can vary on how exfoliating your facial cleansing regimen is.  Lastly on slight negatives, I found a fresh set of blemishes this week after two applications, and time will tell if the XEN-TAN is the root cause.  The positives are strong, and will continue to give it a whirl and report back.
summary: no heavy odor, light-medium shade, can wear during daytime, develops quickly

reviewText: My daughter tried this and she liked the texture and smell of the lotion.  It did not leave streaks on her face.  Only two problems.  1) it is not a very natural tan color 2) you get residue coming off on towels for a while.

If you have very sensitive skin, pass this product by. I'm 52-years-old and this tanning cream caused my face to break out in acne.

I have an auto-immune disease that prevents me from being able to spend much time in the sun without covering up. I am as white as white can be, so I thought I would try this to give myself a little color. It does work. It gave me color, but after a day or two it leaned towards the orange side on me and I don't particularly want to look like Donald Trump. Luckily, I was able to wash most of it off by washing my face several times and then moisturizing.

If you don't have sensitive skin, and if, like Trump, you don't mind having a face that is orange, then this is for you. If not, embrace your whiteness as I plan to do.
summary: Not good for very sensitive skin.

reviewText: I didn't like this product much and it didn't bronze my face with a natural look. I was a bit wary of trying this product because of my past experience with self tanners and unfortunately this product didn't change my opinion of them.
summary: You might like this but I did not

reviewText:
I have several Xen-Tan products and they work very well.  This product is no exception.  This is lighter i color than the other products, but it is still easy to apply without streaks.

Their tanning mitt is highly recommended for application.  It is easy to use and washes out easily to be ready for the next application.  Using the mitt never looks "orange" or leaves streaks of color when I use it.

I love these products that give me some color without having to have the harmful effects of sunlight.  Five Stars!

This product works well for adding just a little color to the face. I wanted to try it because I do not like wearing make-up every day. With a medium light complexion, applied every few days it evens out my skin tone and acts like a subtle bronzer to provide a healthier glow.

Since I am not interested in a true tan, I just apply as it becomes apparent the last application has faded  which in my case is every three or four days. The cream has a pleasant vanilla scent which quickly evaporates. The recommended quantity needed to cover face and neck is a dime-size dollop and that is plenty. The tube should easily last a couple of months with my limited use.

I have greater control over the application just using my hands, but the product does stain so promptly wash hands with warm soapy water. I have not experienced any fake orange color and am over-all pleased with the result.

I have a fair complexion  & regularly use self-tanners. One  application of XEN-TAN this to my neck, decolletage & face leaves those areas with a natural looking, lightly tanned glow.  It slowly washes away during the week so sometimes I re-apply it, sometimes I don't.

It is advertised to get darker with daily application. I haven't tested that because one application is sufficient for me.

  I don't have any complaints & I like its light vanilla fragrance too.

If you apply with your hands, be sure to wash them carefully afterwards.
summary: One application gives my fair complexion a light, natural looking color .. Nice vanilla fragrance

reviewText:
I like this fragrance; however, I guess I am used to a more floral note and this scent reminds of fruity gum or candy.  Not obnoxious but fruitier than I expected.  I love Juicy fragrances and perhaps I put too much on so I will go lightly the next time.  The fragrance does last a long time so it can be used sparingly.  As we all know, fragrances smell different on different people and is subjective so give it a try.

The packaging and the bottle itself is really very attractive and I am sure I will be using it for a long time.

I can say your man will love it because I am a man and I love it!  I got this 'I am Juicy Couture' perfume for my wife, and she likes it.  We both agree it has a very sweet smell that has strong hints of vanilla (despite the fact that nowhere is vanilla mentioned in the product description) with a bit of peach and cotton candy in the mix.  Others have described it as light, but my wife said it is a strong fragrance in her opinion, and it lasts.  I actually like it better than my wife even - she enjoys it but I think the sweet aroma is extremely pleasing and it isn't floral at all (I don't care for floral perfumes and thankfully neither does the Mrs).  Four stars from my wife, five stars from me.  Which means it gets four stars.  My mama didn't raise no dummy!

Reviewing scents is not an easy endeavor.  Everyone is different when it comes to what scents they like or don't like.  I have always been very particular about scents and never wore perfume until fairly recently.  There are a few scents which I absolutely love, some I like and some that send me running in the other direction.  The "Juicy Couture I am Juicy couture Eau de Parfum" (wow!) is a scent I like.  I'm glad it isn't very strong and I have been able to wear it for several hours without wanting to wash it off.  It has a light, sweet-like fruity scent that is not overpowering.  Granted, I didn't douse myself in it, but gave the inside of my arms a light squirt each.

The bottle is pretty cool - almost garish but I like it.
summary: Juicy Couture I am Juicy couture Eau de Parfum

reviewText:
This is a popular product and I was glad for the opportunity to try it.  Beautiful bottle (1.7oz/50ml) with pump mist.  Very nice packaging.  Made in USA.  But, I was disappointed in the scent.  My wife likes it better than I do, but my findings . . .

Flowery (but not roses, perhaps the gardenia influence), sweet (candy-like),  fruity (citrus).  Not offensive, if worn lightly, but definitely not a fragrance that I would consider a "signature" scent or something that makes me want to get closer to it.  Certainly feminine, but it's more like what I would consider an "old lady " perfume (or, conversely, for a pre-teen girl to use on her Barbies).  A couple of other reviewers commented that it smells like baby powder.  I didn't find that at all at first, but maybe over time it finally settled in to a little baby powder-ish influence.  I think it would be more accurate to say that it settled into scent resembling my favorite gum . . . which solves the riddle of the curious name of this perfume.

Sorry, I really wanted to give this a more positive review, but it's just not for me.

This is a powdery perfume and not floral enough for my taste. It isn't obnoxious and I'm sure it is okay on others but for me, it's just not right.
I tend to wear lighter fragrances with a heavy floral scent. This reminds me a little of Angel.

I liked it but didn't love it. I was waiting for the raspberry and passion fruit notes but didn't get them. Perfume is very hard to judge and every woman's chemistry is different. As another reviewer mentioned she got a baby powder smell. I got a little of that but I don't agree that it doesn't last. I still smell it after quite some time. It's not overly heavy. I put it on before I ate which normally bothers me during a meal. But it did not interfere.

It's so important to try perfume out at a department store counter. For me I wished for a more citrusy note.
This perfume smells interesting to me. Doesn't smell like any other perfume I've smelled. Hints of cotton candy, pineapple and Christmas? Can't decide yet if I really like it or really don't.

I really like this fragrance, probably one of my favorites in the Juicy product line. I have 4 so far (Juicy Couture, Viva La Juicy, Viva La Juicy Noir and this new one, I Am Juicy Couture).  This new one smells a lot like the original Juicy Couture but with a heady bouquet of summer flowers and summer fruit (peaches,  I think).  While I liked the original, I like this one even more.  It just reminds me of Spring & Summer, outdoors in the warm fresh air when everything is blooming.  It's a much softer scent than Viva La Juicy, which seemed to have bright berry notes (reminded me of raspberries) and smelled a little sharper when first applied.

While I really like this perfume,  it may smell totally different on you.  I would suggest smelling a sample before taking the plunge.  After all, this isn't a cheap bottle of drugstore colonge.

I use this under foundation that has no SPF.  I don't notice a tint, actually, even before I put the foundation on.  However, SPF-wise, it works great!  I also add some to my neck area, as well.  I still have over half left a month or two later.  Definitely a very nice luxury skin-care item that's a good option versus drugstore brands.  I like it with foundation because it's so very light on my skin, and it doesn't feel greasy - it also hasn't messed up my makeup, either!  When I don't wear full makeup, I use this as a simple "grab and go" primer with just some lip liner.
summary: it works great! I also add some to my neck area

reviewText: This is a decent physical sunscreen. It applies evenly and has little odor. There are many claims with respect to the ingredients that are not independently tested. There are cheaper alternatives such as - Neutrogena Sheer Zinc Face Dry-Touch Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50, 2 Fl. Oz.
Coverage seems good but the product left my skin feeling oily. After using it for two days my face broke out so I stopped using it.

I absolutely love the feel of this product.  It has a very light feel to it, almost like silk.  I assume the 50+ SPF is accurate, so I can't rate that.  The only thing I downgraded it from a 5 star is that the color is almost non-existent.  I could see absolutely no difference on one side of my face from the other when applying it to just one side.  I was hoping it would have a little coverage to skin imperfections.  But it doesn't.  Maybe it wasn't intended to.  But I figured if there was color, it was supposed to have a purpose.

This cream feels great, smooth like satin or fine silk.  It's a little tan for me, but the tinted cream blends well on my sun-tanned arms. SPF +50  sounds good. I've not heard of applying CoQ10 to t he skin, and I'm not aware that this component will work as an antioxidant when used externally, but I assume the manufacturer has researched this method.

The price is a little more than most women I know would pay for such a product.

I used this on a recent 2 week vacation. I am very pale and burn badly. Sunscreen is a must. When I saw the color of this product I was concerned as it appeared way too dark. I was surprised that this was not the case once it was applied. It gave my skin only a bare hint of color.

I did not burn the entire 2 weeks of outdoor exposure. The product feels smooth and silky on my skin. I do feel it looks overly matte and chalky on me, even at the end of the day. However my intended use was for function and not appearance. I'd probably not use this for attending an outdoor wedding, for example. Overall, worked well for me.
summary: Excellent sun screen, blended well with my pale skin. Looked a little chalky on.

reviewText: This sunscreen offers really good protection, but for me in high heat/humidity it seems to sweat off a bit quicker than I'd like. The tint blends in with your skin although it can seem a bit dark in the tube if you're fair skinned. It doesn't streak though and doesn't end up looking like you have makeup on. It doesn't look too dark on the skin. It just blends in. It doesn't make me break out at all and that is a huge plus with such a high spf. In full sun all day with 10/10 uv rays, my face did not burn, so clearly it works as long as you apply it correctly and as often as you should. The color did sweat on to my white towel when laying my face on it, but washed out with bleach. So it doesn't stain like a foundation would.

Really impressed with how well it goes on and blends in. It applies on the skin like a primer, smooth and silky. It's not oily and doesn't feel like there's residue. It smooths out the skin. I expected to see some color or shading because the cream had a beige tint, but it really looks clear on my skin. In fact, it has the effect of blurring out the uneven color in my skin tone. I love the 50 SPF. This means I can wear it under foundation daily. I use it as a BB cream on days where I'm very casual and don't need to be wear make up. Great product so far. Pricey though.
summary: Very smooth and silky but pricey

reviewText:
I am very diligent about applying sunscreen.  I love using zinc oxide, since it seems to protect my face the best.  The problem with zinc oxide is that it normally is white and thick and it is hard to rub it in.

I just love this product.  Here's why:

* It has 16.2% zinc oxide.
* It is SPF 50 so I can feel comfortable using it in the summer months.
* It glides on so smoothly and instantly rubs into my skin.
* The additional ingredients, like botanicals and green tea extract, which can't help but be good for my skin.
* It is unscented.

I was a little bit nervous about the tinting, since everyones skin tone is different.  But it worked out just fine and looks very natural.

If you are looking for a nice sunscreen that can double as makeup, this product may just be for you.

Color was much darker coming out of the tube than I expected and yet, blended well into my skin. Smells nice and sun screen like but overall seemed like a great product to be using. I felt like I looked great on a day with high himidity and heat. Was safe from burns too
summary: Don't worry about the color- blends well

reviewText: This product has the highest SPF I've found in a tinted, BB type cream. It's a silicon base, and goes on totally dry feeling, and it stays that way almost all day (depends on how much sweating I do). Being a silicon, it's got a blurring effect and has enough pigment to be a darn good product for every day use with no foundation on top. I am assuming the antioxidants etc will provide the benefits advertised. The only problem I've had is that it's a little difficult to remove- it takes a couple of rounds of soap and water but when it comes, it does come off totally clean and fresh feeling, no residue. I used this today to sit outside for a couple of hours, facing upward (eclipse!) and have no sign of any sunburn, so it's doing the SPF job well!
summary: I love this product for daily use!

reviewText: Finally a sunscreen (SPF 50+) that does not make my skin, which is on the oily side, feel oilier.  Love the creamy texture and the way this product provides enough coverage to my minor skin flaws. The color is a good match to the makeup shade I normally wear (natural beige). 16.2% Zinc Oxide, this alone, definitely prevented me from getting a burn on my face after 4 hours by the pool on a sunny day. Will by again - love this product!

Very pleasant to use, this 1.6 ounce tube of tinted sunscreen offers 50 SPF broad spectrum protection from the suns rays. After a sunspot appeared on my forehead I became more diligent in selecting skin care products that include sun protection. The active ingredient is 16.2 percent zinc oxide which can make creams thick and hard to evenly apply but it is formulated so it blends well.

A medium beige tint is added but the depth of the pigment is light so rather than add noticeable color just lightly refines skin. Sunscreens normally must be reapplied depending upon length of time in the sun, so it may be wise to keep the product nearby during the day. Not waterproof, so perspiration or a dip in the water will necessitate reapplying.

The first inactive ingredient listed is ascorbic acid (Vitamin C), then Biotin and next green tea. The list reveals a number of additional botanicals and other items used to nourish and hydrate skin so this is more than a simple sunscreen.

Designed to be used on face and neck, the squeeze tube has a tiny opening to control product release, and there is a foil inner seal on the tube opening to ensure on arrival it is fresh and untouched. The fragrance is mild and herbal, dissipating quickly after being applied to skin.
summary: Replenix Ultimatte Perfection SPF 50 TInted Sunscreen

reviewText:
This UltiMATTE Perfection SPF 50+ sunscreen from Replenix is a tinted, physical sunscreen that evens out skin tone a little and provides oil absorption to boot.

I have oily, aging skin but I am trying to slow down the aging by wearing a sunscreen on my face, neck and hands. Most of them make my skin crazy oily after as little as 30 minutes but this one doesn't. It really does seem to absorb oil, just as Replenix claims.

The tint is enough to even out skin tone a little but it's not enough to hide scars or acne or melasma. It's a light tint.

While it is SPF 50+, it is not waterproof so plan on using a different sunscreen if your at the pool or the beach. It's a physical sunscreen, which means it uses minerals that sit on the skin and literally physically block the sun's rays from reaching your skin. In this case, it is 16.2% zinc oxide. It also has additional ingredients that address the signs of aging so it's more than just a sunscreen.

I really, really like this but it's just too expensive for me to use every day. However, I'm happy to have it for times when I am going to be in the sun in a group and don't want to go bare-faced. This gives just enough color to make my skin look less blotchy and and just nicer.
summary: Light tint that evens out skin tone a little

reviewText:
The active ingredient is 16.2% Zinc Oxide.

I like the scent of green tea.  While the fragrance is noticeable coming out of the tube, the scent dissipates in the skin.  The tinted silky cream then blends into your own skin tone for an even color without looking thick or caky.  This cream is not waterproof.  The price alone limits this cream to the face and neck.

To find the list of inactive ingredients, one must peel off the top layer of the tube to read Inactive: Ascorbic Acid, Biotin, Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Polyphenols, Centella Asiatica Extract, Ceramide 2, Cetyl PEG/PPG 10/1 Dimethicone, Cyclomethicone, Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Emblica Officinalis Fruit Extract, Glyceryl Isostearate, Iron Oxides, Lauryl PEG/PPG-18/18 Methicone, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Methyl Trimethicone, Neopentyl Glycol Diheptanoate, PEG-8 Methyl Triethoxysilane, Phospholipids, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Purified Water, Resveratrol, Silica, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Titanium Dioxide, Tocopheryl Acetate, Ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q-10).
summary: A very silky cream for face and neck

reviewText: This sunscreen product is prefection. It is creamy and spreads so easily. I think it may be the best one one that I have ever tried. I have had to have several places on my face frozen that were pre-skin cancer so I really need to use this every day, I love that it has Vitamin C and Co-Q10 in it too.
Love the naked line of polishes,  this is great starter set

Made my yellow nails look perfect. The Naked Manicure system is not going to be for everyone, and I don't suggest buying the full professional kit (which retails for $96 on Zoya's site) unless you're a salon owner. Most individuals are not going to use all of the different color perfectors because they're aimed at different issues and skin tones.

My suggestion is if you are often too embarrassed to let your nails go naked whether from staining, peeling, or just normal discoloration, then this is the system for you. The base, lavender, satin topcoat, tip perfector, and the colored perfector that best suits you would be my suggestion. If you need to have color on your nails all the time, this will likely be a pass. You might still enjoy the base and satin topcoat though.
Amazing. Lasts for 2 weeks and protects the nail while making you look manicured. I like that its classy looking and if you ding or chip it it is not noticeable.
summary: Amazing. Lasts for 2 weeks and protects the nail ...

reviewText: Love this product. I just got it in and used it right away. My nails look clean, solid, and flawless. I also purchased the lavender, and did one layer with the pink in this set. I also like that this set includes a booklet of how to layer the tints and what color you will get. In addition, this is a fast drying manicure, which is really great. I did it before I left for work, grabbed by bag and left. By the time I got to work (~ 20 minutes), it was fully dry - no smudging, etc.
Love this series! Dries fast. You can't tell that you have anything on your nails. Hides any imperfections! Love it!

This is the best system I have ever used. I have tried high end like Dior and Essie on the low end. This is hands down the best to do a clean looking manicure with high shine. I got all the colors and the glossy coat for use after the top coat included in this set. The whole thing is great and my nails are growing fSt strong and healthy. The price is great ! Get you one !
Got this for my picky, picky wife. Amazingly, she loves it and thanked me with a kiss.. Nice glow. Me too.

This highlighter is a must have for any makeup lover! The compact comes with a mirror but no applicator brush which is slightly annoying. So I used one of my own and it's glides on and blends like a dream. It has some sparkle to it so less is definitely more. It gives just the right sparkle with a bit of glow. Highly recommend
summary: The compact comes with a mirror but no applicator brush which is slightly annoying. So I used one of my own and ...

reviewText: Not happy with this - and it's the condition it arrived in that's the problem.  The highlighter was all broken up and it was impossible to put it back together in a cake so that it could be used with a brush or a sponge.  It was certainly packed well, in a double box with no signs of rough handling, so it must have been through something really wild to have arrived in this condition.  Too bad, because I was looking forward to seeing the effect.
This highlighter is subtle, easy to apply and comes in a lightweight casing. Worth a try.

Love this gentle highlighter.  You can add highlights as well as definition wherever you want to.  It's subtle enough to use every day.  Some days I highlight my cheekbones...some days brows...some days both.

Beautifully packaged in a small but substantial 3 1/2" round black plastic compact that closes firmly but opens easily, this rose gold highlighter is a real treat. Multi-tonal small chunks have been compressed together to create a finely-milled highlighter that includes creamy-gold, rose-gold, and beige-gold. Use your own brush or other applicator to pick up the powder and deposit it lightly wherever you want a glow.

The Patina color is surprisingly versatile and worked wonderfully on my cool, light-colored skin. I think it would work on all skin tones because it includes both warm and cool undertones. While I am older and must highlight sparingly, this product is so fine and smooth that someone with fewer wrinkles could use it lavishly. In fact, if you do a search online you will find photos of models with the highlighter generously applied over the entire face and neck. It's an effect I don't care for, but someone will. The more important quality for me is that the highlighter goes on lightly if I use a light hand and can be made more dramatic by applying more. There is never a glittery quality to the shine, which I greatly appreciate. If you like highlighters, I highly recommend this one!
summary: Super finely milled, easy to apply for a glow or a dramatic shine

reviewText: This does add some highlighting.  It goes on very easy without looking powdery or cakey.  It is a tad too shimmery for my taste, which isn't a look I want for the office/school.  I will use it on more special occasions.
summary: It goes on very easy without looking powdery or cakey

reviewText: This Vincent Longo La Bella Luce highlighter is great ! I love it ! It blends well with any complexion ,and gives your skin a wonderfully soft glow. It highlights any area you choose to use it. It is great now with your winter makeup pallet,and i can't wait to use it this summer. I would highly recommend it !!!

Very nice powder that provides light coverage with what can only be described as 'highlights'. Reduces the plaster face appearance so commonly encountered with most powders - instead, looks more natural and dimensional.

The VINCENT LONGO La Bella Luce Highlighter in Patina color is a finely milled highlighter in a multi-color, 'multi-tonal' palette that is more of a golden/bronze shade - some rose gold, some bronze, but nothing too dark. I'm usually a 'winter' color palette and fair skinned, and this went well with my coloring, to my surprise (I would have picked the 'flora' shade if I had my choice). Much like the name - patina - this gives a nice, not too bright highlighting, but something subtle if you want to get a little brightening effect for your 'high points' (cheekbones, forehead, bow of lips, nose, etc.) or all over your face. You can control the amount by how much you use. The black case is solid and closes well, but isn't too difficult to open, and I used my own brush (I don't know too many products like this that come with their own brush) to swirl around the highlighter and apply. It applied easily and I didn't notice any product fallout.

All and all, I'm very pleased with this highlighter - I've used Hourglass and Becca before, and think this is just as good as those brands. It will definitely help to brighten up your face.

Being an older lady I was concerned about this highlighter showing too much when it comes to the nooks and crannies, or what they're really called...wrinkles, on my face.  Well, that is not the case if applied with just a light dusting!  I'm happy to report that this Vincent Longo cosmetic product called La Bella Luce (translated: Beautiful Light or Glow) is fabulous!  I applied a very light dusting with one of my brushes, first on my cheeks, then all over my face to get the whole effect.  This was put on over my liquid makeup and powder blush and the look was perfection!  I swear, I looked younger with a lovely youthful glow!  The highlighter (color: Patina) is more of a beige/tan color, and I'm very fair, but it is exactly the perfect shade.  It went on smoothly and evenly and stayed all day.  I'm very pleased with this new addition to my collection of cosmetics.
summary: I swear I'm looking younger with this highlighter.  Hooray!

reviewText:
A little bit of this on my wife's cheekbones created the illusion of more brightness. I think it looks good lightly applied for a hint of shimmer. This counters the appearance of dark circles around the eyes.

The key to applying this powder highlighter has got to be moderation, for most people (a small percentage somehow can do something good with what would be excess for most). Just enough to combat a hint of fatigue seem right to me.
Love Davines products, especially this scent.  Happy to find it through Amazon!
summary: Happy to find Davines on Amazon!!!

reviewText:
I got a sample of this in a subscription box and decided I liked it well enough to buy it in full size.  I've been using it for a few days, along with the conditioner from the same product line, and I am really happy with it.

For reference, I have waist-length, Caucasian-textured, color-treated hair.  It is somewhat dry from frequent shampooing (I work out a lot, plus it is summer and hot where I live) and from the color-treatment.  It has a naturally-wavy texture and tends to pick up a lot of frizz due to local humidity.  I mostly look to conditioners, hair masks, and other treatments to handle frizz, and I look to shampoos to get my hair clean.

Honestly, I think this actually *is* helping with the frizz a little.  But more importantly, it does a good job of getting my hair clean.  I've been trying a lot of shampoos lately and this one has a good consistency/viscosity.  It is actually possible to distribute on my scalp (I usually only wash the roots, not the ends of my hair) and work up a decent lather without too much effort.  But it does also rinse out cleanly.

This has a scent similar to the conditioner from the same product line (I might describe it as warm, and possibly containing sandalwood and/or amber, but those are pure guesses on my part).  I happen to like the scent so that works for me.

Here are the ingredients since they are nearly impossible to read on the product page (wrapped around the side of the product bottle in the second picture):

Aqua/water/eau, Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate; Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate, Panthenol, Parfum/fragrance, Benzyl Alcohol, Sodium Methyl 2-sulfolaurate, Ppo-25-buteth-26, Acrylatesc10-30 Alkyl, Acrylate Crosspolymer, Phenethyl, Benzoate, Coco-glucoside, Glyceryl Oleate, Sodium Benzoate, Peg-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Glycol Distearate, Trisodium Ethylene Dame Disuccinate, Polyouaternium-7, Disodium 2-sulfolaurate, Amodime Thicone, sunflower Seed Oil, Guar Hydrokypropyltrmonium Chloride, C11-15 Parie Ph-7, Sodium Chloride, Glyceryl Stearate, Laureth-9, Trideoeth-12, Glycerin, Citronellol, Bixa Orellana Seed Extract, Geranol, Bexoc Acid

Update: I appear to have had an old ingredients list here, previously.  I have changed it to a more current one.  This contains some silicones but no sulfates.

The only thing I don't love is the bottle.  I prefer shampoo containers with the caps attached in some way.  It is easy to drop this one and of course you don't want to knock the bottle over, because then a lot of product would spill out.  However, the performance is so good that I will find a way to deal with the unattached cap.
summary: shampoo performs nicely and goes well with the conditioner from the same product line

reviewText: Totally love this Shampoo

Perfect shampoo with a nice fragrance that really makes your hair feel clean. I work at my roots mainly then use the left over suds for the ends. This pairs nicely with my davines nounou Pak. I wash my hair every other day.

Like them, don't love them. The Calming Lavender is my favorite of these 3. I am a lavender fan and use lavender essential oil in aromatherapy every day. Yes, I find it very calming. But the scent of the Calming Lavender in this bubble bath isn't calming, nor is it sufficiently intense to me. The Hydrating Hibiscus smells kind of like kool-aid or jell-o and isn't hydrating. It isn't offensive, but I'd never choose it. The Nourishing Milk and Honey is bland and as far as I can tell, it isn't Nourishing. That all sounds very critical, which is not what I mean to be. I do like these shower gels (I don't take baths, so I don't use them as bubble bath). They get me clean without stripping my skin. They are nicely packaged in their slim, 8 ounce, plastic bottles with convenient screw caps. They are cute. The colors are charming. They leave no residual fragrance on my skin. They don't make the shower floor slippery. They rinse quickly. BUT, they are not moisturizing. There is nothing in the ingredients list that distinguishes them from the competition. The one ingredient that really captures my attention is the Benzophenone-4. I can't understand why it was included in these gels. As Dermatitis journal stated, "Benzophenones are ultraviolet light filters that have been documented to cause a myriad of adverse cutaneous reactions, including contact and photocontact dermatitis, contact and photocontact urticaria, and anaphylaxis.... Benzophenones as a group have been named the American Contact Dermatitis Society's Allergen of the Year for 2014 to raise awareness of both allergy and photoallergy to these ubiquitous agents." There is no need for a UV filter in a shower gel, so why include it? I expected more from AHAVA.
summary: Cute, little, 8 ounce bottles of pleasant, but not outstanding, shower gels (with benzophenone!)

reviewText:
These smell pretty good and don't irritate sensitive skin.  The scent is also not so overpowering that my sinuses flair up.  After you use it, a slight (very slight) scent lingers on your skin.  I've found my skin to feel moisturized after bath - nice as it's been way too dry here lately.

If I had one issue, it was that it takes a lot of product to get any respectable bubbles.  I really want a bubble bath to be an indulgence - so much so that I'm a regular shopper at lush where I pay anywhere from 5 - 7 bucks for a single bath bomb.

This wasn't quite so luxurious, but it's very good for everyday baths.

Oh, and because it's so gentle, it's good for kids too - as long as they don't miss having copious bubbles!
summary: Gentle but where are all the bubbles?

reviewText: The scents are lovely and the company is responsible, with no animal testing and formulated for sensitive skin. The scents, milk and honey, hibiscus, and lavender are light and fresh. I used the product as a body wash/shower gel and it worked well in that capacity. I needed more than one ounce of liquid on my shower poof to create a decent lather but otherwise I was satisfied with the product. I encountered no skin reactions from the three bath/shower products and they were a pleasure to use.
summary: Dead Sea Essentials Bubble Bath/Shower Gel Trio

reviewText:
The best part of this is the smells which I liked as well as the rest of the family. I wish that it would have made more bubbles though-my daughter commented on this while using it. I don't take baths very much so I used it as a shower gel to see how it worked and I liked it-it got the job done.

Would use in the future!

While this bubble bath is not overly bubbly it did feel good on my skin which has been drying out lately due to the weather. I also have sensitive skin and react to perfumes and some chemicals to the point where my breathing can be effected.  This feels great on my skin and does not cause any reactions on my skin or effect my breathing in any way. I also use this as a shower gel because it feels so nice on my body.

This is great for a nice calming bubble bath. At my age bubbles are not a big thing. Relaxing in a hit tub of water which feels nice on my skin is all I want. It is also great as a shower gel.  If you are getting this for a child or adult who likes lots of bubbles they may want more bubbles.
summary: Feels Great But Could Have More Bubbles.

reviewText: I was expecting some really great bubble baths due to the price and all the Dead Sea marketing. Unfortunately,  this stuff is just not that great. The hibiscus smells like Jolly Rancher candy; the milk &  honey is pretty subtle; the lavender smells vaguely of it, but more like a generic purple smell.  Thr bubbles are  not plentiful and dissipate too soon.  And it certainly does not moisturize as it claims to. Check out the very long ingredients list.

I really enjoy this trio as a shower gel. The scents are unexpected and light, the bottles are small enough that they can be left in the shower without consuming too much room, and it even acts as a nice shave gel. These cleansers foam up nicely on the skin and rinse away effortlessly. They did not dry out my skin nor did they leave my skin overly perfumed.

I will return to these products over and over again. They are gentle and effective.

This would make a lovely gift for a friend or family member or a wonderful treat for yourself!

This is a good decent set of bubble bath. The scents are pretty mild so not to overwhelm you in a hot bath. The bubbles do not bubble up super well, and my skin was incredibly dry after using it. But, for bubble bath it was pretty good!
summary: Decent for bubble bath, not too many bubbles.

reviewText:
These are decent bubble bath & shower gel. As a shower gel, they produce moderate amount of lathers and clean well but I also have to use more than usual in order to cover my whole body. The scent is very nice. I like the lavender the best, which is the most intense out of the three, with the milk & honey the least intense. The fragrance is intense initially, but dissipates quickly and by the time I finish rinsing, it's all gone.

I don't do bubble both often but I tried it with the lavender bottle anyway. I followed the directions and put in the recommended amount. However, I was quickly disappointed by the results. It didn't produce many bubbles and they weren't long lasting neither. Half way through my bath, the bubbles mostly disappeared. The only saving grace was the nice lavender scent at the start of the bath.

I do like that it is paraben, phthalate and SLS free, and very well suited for sensitive skin, and that it is also made in USA.

Overall, I think they are best used as a show gel. If you like to infuse your senses with intense fragrance during a shower, this will work nicely. Keep in mind that the fragrance dissipates fairly quickly and quite a lot of the gel is necessary for a good shower. It cleans well and rinses off easily. That said, I don't think the retail price is worth it though.

This shower gel ( I don't take baths so the bubble bath thing is moot) comes in 3 very nice scents: honey, hibiscus and lavender. They are all lovely. As a shower gel, this works just fine, doesn't over-dry my skin. It is a bit skimpy on lather but that isn't a big deal for me. On that basis alone, I'd rate this product 4 stars.

Unfortunately the manufacturer really failed with container design. These bottles are a super skinny cylinder, far more narrow than appears in the photo. I routinely shower at the Y or at our company gym and you need to be able to prop up your products in a rail or small shelf. This bottle lacks any stability and always falls over. If put on the floor (since it will end up there), it is far too easy to knock over. A more stable design with a wider base would help. Also, this product has a detachable cap which is annoying and requires that you keep track of it. Having fished the cap out of the drain too many times, I have transferred this product to better containers. Any empty shampoo bottle from another product would be superior to these. 3 stars for poor performance of container.
summary: Decent shower gel, containers are a fail.

reviewText: This shower gel/bubble bath is okay, nothing special.  The scents are very mild and without much appeal.  They do leave the skin soft and smooth.

I really enjoyed all three fragrances, they are light and clean, and not overpowering.  I do wish the bubble bath would foam a bit more and result in more bubbles.  The bubble bath does leave my skin feeling great, however.  All in all a pretty good product.

These are absolutely lovely bubble baths/shower gels. I think the honey one is my least favorite, but the other two are just delightful. They are light yet fragrant, they don't leave a film, and they make the whole bathroom smell like an aromatherapy treatment!

As others have mentioned, these products have two things going for them: one, this company does not test on animals, which is wonderful; and two, they won't irritate sensitive skin.  As for that claim, my skin is super- (I'd even say ridiculously) sensitive, but after using all three of these multiple times, I didn't break out at all or suffer any kind of negative reaction.

Unfortunately, that's pretty much where the positives ended, in my experience, as they wound up being quite disappointing.  Upon opening the bottles, I was pleased with the scents, with the lavender being the most intense and the milk & honey being the lightest and warmest fragrance.  Those fragrances don't last long at all, which could be a positive or a negative depending on what you're looking for.  For me, I was expecting something that would impart a little bit of a lasting fragrance on my skin, but the scent rinsed away almost completely and the teeny tiny little bit that was left after stepping out of the shower dissipated extremely quickly.

If you're looking for something with a rich lather, these products won't deliver that.  I wing up having to use a good amount of product on my shower poof before I can get anything even remotely resembling a lather, and even then, it feels like that large amount of product still didn't even last long enough to cover my body, with the lather being negligible, at best.  (Note: I haven't had a chance to use them in a bubble bath, but given my experience, it doesn't surprise me at all that other reviewers say that the bubble situation these yield leaves a lot to be desired.)

As far as moisturization goes, well, there wasn't any.  I'm not exaggerating when I say that the minute I step out of the shower after using these, any patches of even remotely dry skin I have immediately being to itch, and the rest of my skin doesn't feel moisturized at all.

So these smell great in the bottles, don't irritate sensitive skin, and aren't tested on animals.  However, they don't actually fulfill their claims or do much of anything at all.  In fact, you could go to the drugstore and pick up any number of gels/washes and find things that smell good, lather well, impart a ton of moisture, and cost less than these.  The bottom line for me is that my expectations for these were high, but they were ultimately disappointing.

Out of the trio, my absolute favorite was the milk and honey.  It was absolutely heavenly.  I would buy a tanker truck of the stuff!  My next favorite was the lavender.  It had a lovely smell and lather.  My least favorite was the hibiscus.  I didn't really love the smell.  The bottles are a bit on the small size, they are not the usual club size barrels of product, so do set your expectations.  They lather well, especially if you have a jet tub or a bubbler.  I think, all things considered, that this would make a great gift for a teacher or the like.  Zero skin irritation and perfect for shaving, too.  All in all a very solid offering from AHAVA, the dead sea company.
summary: AHAVA ventures out into colors and fragrances

reviewText: This is a nice trio of Bubble Bath/Body Wash which makes a lovely gift. The scents are Hibiscus, Lavender and Milk and Honey. The Hibiscus is pretty heavily scented--a bit much for me--but the other two are just right. This product doesn't lather up quite as easily as traditional body wash and doesn't seem to contain as much moisturizer as my usual body wash, so it would not be my product of preference as a body wash, but it is fine as a bubble bath.

These are good smelling bubble baths which leave one's skin feeling good. They do not, however, make massive amounts of bubbles.  Considering their intended use by adults that is probably a reasonable trade off.
summary: Nice smelling bubble bath, but doesn't make huge amounts of bubbles

reviewText: My derma told me I need to wear this and she charges an arm and a leg.  If this is my new necessary evil, then I'm only willing to pay an arm.
summary: Use on face and neck only too expensive

reviewText: I love this product.  Here in the desert, you need to be certifiable if you don't use skin protection.  This glides on and does not leave your pores feeling clogged.  It does not smell and goes on easily under makeup.  It does not have a smell easily associated with advertising.  It will be happy used all summer. Mrs. Natchmo
summary: Get tough with your delicate face

reviewText:
At first I was a bit hesitant to use this product because I already found a morning SPF moisturizer that I really like. To my surprise, this is my new holy grail morning lotion. Also, I am a sucker for packaging and this one did not disappoint. The bottle is very sleek and it has a built-in pump. It contains 2.3 ounces, which is a good size.
Not only does it provide UVA/UVB/Infared and SPF 34 protection, it is also light-weight lotion and quickly absorbs quickly in the skin. It contains antioxidants and naicinamide, which helps rejuvenate and hydrate the skin. It is light-weight and doesnt leave a white cast on my face. It wears well underneath my foundation with no pilling on my skin.

I was hesitant to give this product only three stars because I believe SkinMedica is a great company and that they make quality products. However for me, this Total Defense Plus Sunscreen  was problematic.

I am a big fan of SkinMedicas TNS Essential Serum and used to use it years ago. I only stopped because it got too costly, so I was eager to give this a try.

This sunscreen feels great going on; its just the perfect texture and easily glides on your face. I was a happy camper the morning I put this on and went out and  took my dog out for a walk.

I wasn't a happy camper for long.  I was only outside with my dog for maybe 1/2 an hour and it was a fairly cloudy day, but by later on that afternoon my skin started itching and the telangiectasia on my face became very noticeable. I looked flushed for a while and had to put various anti-itch creams on to calm it down.

Because I wanted to make sure I hadnt done anything wrong or that maybe the sunscreen was reacting with something I had put on beforehand, I waited a week and applied a small part to my face and the same thing happened again.

So I know this isn't for me as much as I wish it was - because I do believe SkinMedica puts out such quality products.

This SkinMedica Total Defense Plus Repair Sunscreen might really be a boon to someone with less sensitive skin, which is why I hesitate to give it only 3 stars. At the same time, if you have skin like mine, its pretty useless. If you do give this a try, I highly recommend  you try it on a patch of skin before you slather it all over your face, like I did.
summary: Be sure to try this on a small patch of skin the first time you use it

reviewText: This Skinmedica Total Defense Plus Repair Sunscreen is very impressive because it provides 34 SPF while feeling like a very light lotion, which is a texture that seems to be hard to obtain with sunscreen products. This goes on smoothly and quickly like an expensive night cream, feels hydrating and absorbs rapidly. There is a normalized lightly moisturized feeling after you put this on, like you just washed your face and the moisture is still in your skin. Very impressive. There is no oily sensation, no waxy or greasy feel to this at all- just healthy feeling skin. I have older, dryer skin, and find that this balances my skin well.  My current sunscreen is a bit heavier and creamy feeling, and so i use a drier foundation to compensate. This Skinmedica gives me more choices with my foundations- I can wear moisturizing foundations using this Skinmedica, because it doesn't contribute to a a double dose of cream on my face. It feels "naked" on my clean face, which is perfect.
Nice, silky soft, non-greasy protection. Not sure about the repair qualities, but it is a good sunscreen.
summary: Good protection in a sleek package

reviewText:
This is quite a nice lotion, and it's smell-less and tasteless, so you can dab it on your lips. The dispenser is nice so you don't squirt too much.

I took issues with the marketing fluff: This is just a sunscreen. As a sunscreen, it's unremarkable, other than it's metallic bottle, and it's overall smoothness. Works nice on your face.

Note: it's misleading marketing to "protect against IR-A". IR-A -- or near Infrared wavelengths are beneficial to humans via the promotion of healing processes. Infrared protection is a marketing gimmick, and it's actually not helpful. While artificially-high IR exposure can be bad -- e.g. exposing your legs to a fire (for years), or the arms of bakers who go in and out of ovens, that's a different scenario from sun exposure. Near infrared, or IR-A, is a solution, not a problem. It does more good than bad for the skin, in that a process called photoprevention means that exposure to early morning IR-A wavelengths in sunlight can ready your skin for the coming mid-day deleterious UVR.

I love that this has the broad spectrum protection that was recommended by my dermatologist.  The product is a great consistency, has a nice smell, and is effective.  The repair/rejuvenating benefits are a nice bonus.  I managed to break the cap the first time I opened it  but I attempted to twist it off and it pulls instead.

This facial sunscreen works very well. It is very lightweight and nearly fragrance free. It goes on the skin smoothly and feels good. The part I like the most is that it gets absorbed almost immediately and doesn't make my skin oily, so it is easy to apply other skin care or makeup on top. Also, there is no sticky/tacky feeling or residues after application neither.

The sunscreen provides broad spectrum SPF 34 protection with a special blend of antioxidants to filter and absorb UVA, UVB and infrared-A rays from the sun while promoting natural repair. I like that it is lightly moisturizing and helps keep the skin hydrated. To me, it really feels like a sunscreen and moisturizer in one. It is an effective sunscreen and a light moisturizer, albeit on the expensive side. Easily one of the better facial sunscreen products that I've tried.
summary: Great sunscreen; easy to apply and non-greasy

reviewText: The cream goes on smoothly and blends in easily without feeling greasy.  This is my go to sun protection facial cream, others have caused my skin to break out.
summary: The cream goes on smoothly and blends in easily without feeling greasy

reviewText: This sunscreen is a good sun shield.  It is soft and gentle on skin and fortunately does not have a cloying odor nor does it leave any sticky residue.  It is absorbed nicely into the skin.  It has a high SPF and it does a good job of protecting skin from the sun.

I find that if I keep sunscreen handy--in my bag, the car, and by the front door, not just in the bathroom--I remember to use it more often. This is a handy size and attractive package. The sunscreen itself has no discernible odor, so you won't smell like a tropical cocktail. All in all, a good product.

For me, Skinmedica products are like medicine for my skin.  I have had melanoma, and skin care is extremely important to me.  The Total Defense Plus Repair is a great sunscreen which is also hydrating.  This product also soothes and nourishes mature skin, and helps it to keep looking younger and a little less crepey (when used consistently over time.)  When used in conjunction with other Skinmedica products, my fair, mature skin stays hydrated and more elastic.

Possibly the best sunscreen I've used. Nearly fragrance free (what little I do detect is pleasant).  Light in body and does not leave a feeling of a residue or greasiness, which is really important to me.  And is seems tom provide some facial moisturizing action.  Goes on invisible but sweating may reveal some whiteness.

This is a SPF 34 broad spectrum sunscreen, providing UV and infrared protection.  Contains antioxidants for skin protection and repair. Pricey, but a very high performance sunscreen that feels great.
summary: Possibly the best sunscreen I've used

reviewText: This may very well be my new go-to sunscreen. This lightweight, fragrance-free lotion goes on smoothly and feels good on my skin, absorbing right away without the greasiness, residue or lumpiness Ive experienced with other suntan lotions in the past. The active ingredients are octinoxate, octisalate and 8% zinc oxide, which are meant to protect skin against UVA and UVB rays and infrared-A.  The promise is that it offers antiaging repair and it will take time for me to be able to affirm that claim.  The lotion does need to be reapplied at least every two hours and at this price, its a true investment in your skin. If you can put aside the cost factor (and certainly these days, many people cant), its a very fine sunscreen.
summary: One of the best sunscreens under the sun for me

reviewText: It's no greasy at all
Love this shower oil. Makes my skin feel soft and moisturized.

I have itchy skin, from allergies, from bug bites, from scratchy clothes, from whatever. I have been using this for awhile and it really feels like its helping my skin build up tolerance to any outside forces that bother me.
summary: I have been using this for awhile and it really feels like its helping my skin build up tolerance to any ...

reviewText: Bioderma Shower Oil leaves my skin feeling soft and comfortable, but I still feel like I need to use a bar cleanser first and then use this as a moisturizing finish. I don't feel like it is sufficient to clean my underarms and other private areas.  It is a great shave lotion though and leaves my legs looking smooth and hydrated.  It doesn't make the shower floor slippy, which is amazing. It has a very low lather (no sulfates or parabens) and a mild, clean, scent.  The 33.8 oz is a large bottle that will last me a long time with daily use.
summary: Great way to moisturize in the shower

reviewText:
The winter is always harsh on my skin, and I decided to try this as part of my collection of products to treat my dry skin.  Definitely a oily feel, but did not leave an oily residual on the bath tube, and hence no slippery effect.  I didn't worry about slippery accidents.  It is not a soap, but plied after you have showered, and rinse.  Definitely, helped to,lock in some of the moisture, no oily afterlook on the skin, absorbs right into the skin.
One less star, as the rinse does wash off the impact, I rather wished it could be applied after shower with no rinse.
summary: Does not leave oily residual on bath tube/ shower floor.

reviewText: Very nice light scent.  Feels lovely on my skin.  I am very much enjoying this shower oil.  It seems a large size for the price, as well.

The BioDerma Atoderm shower oil is a product I really want to like. After all it purports to nourish the skin 39% more after a months worth of use. The consistency of the product is not oily like I thought it would be. Its more like any shower gel. BUT it does not produce much lather like your typical shower gel either if you simply use this directly in your skin. It does lather if you use it on a sponge or loofah. If you want to see immediate results for your dry skin, you will need to use the soap directly on your skin and you have to use quite a bit when compared to liquid soap or shower gels.
However, my skin does not feel dry after the shower. Ive used enough soaps (mass market as well as high-end artisanal soaps) to know what a cheaply made product would feel like on your skin. This shower oil is definitely not harsh on your skin nor does it strip the natural oils off your surface. I like the pleasant, mild scent - though Id rather they remove the parfum. There is no need for that at all. People will buy this to nourish their skin - so don't add fragrances just coz you have to.
The product makers state it can be used on faces of babies and children. I got some into my eye to test if it stings. It does. Not the harsh burning sensation of soaps, but this product still does sting. So use it on your kids if you must, but be aware to avoid getting this anywhere close to their eyes.
33 oz costs $20. But you will make quick work of the 33 oz. It will probably last for 33-35 days if you use it directly or double that time if you use it with a loofah. I will try it for 30 days - if it changes the way my skin feels then Id rate it 5 stars.
Right now it is only a 4 star product.

I've had good luck with Bioderma products in the past, so my expectations were pretty high for this. Unfortunately, something in it just doesn't do good things to or for my skin - it didn't seem to impart any moisture at all or otherwise help with dry skin, and every time that I've used it (and I've used it many times at this point, always hoping for a different result) I've gotten irritations on my skin (itchy places, redness, etc.). Plus - and this surprised me - the scent is quite strong/heavily perfumed.

Many other reviewers seem to like this product a lot, but while I wish that I had better things to say about it, it's just not something that works for me.
summary: No Benefits and Caused Skin Irritations

reviewText:
This review is for the Bioderma Atoderm Shower Oil

I have had dry skin issues forever, and showers every day only makes things worse.

This goes on easy and makes your skin feel so great. Cannot say enough good things about how silky my skin feels now.

The bottle is large and a good value. Bottle also has an upscale look so it doesn't look bad sitting around the shower and bath area.

It is also good for those with OCD who wash their hands constantly as a moisture replenisher.

Love this, had a flare up recently on my skin where everything scented and FAKE was causing me just unreal irritation. All my shower gels are scented and colored. This came up in VINE just in time as I'd been trying to stop the irritation with CeraVe and all that stuff, unsuccessfully. This shower oil is just what I needed!! It has a very light slip/very faint lather so it's not like you just rub oil on. Some people even use it as a facial cleansing oil but I haven't tried that yet.
