This oil goes a long way too, I thought the price was a little much at first as I thought I'd go through this oil fast...but after a couple of weeks I can hardly tell any is missing from the bottle. This is on subscribe and save for a VERY GOOD price and I'm sold. My skin doesn't feel dry and parched out of the shower, just feels normal (and then I put on the Bioderma Avo lotion......)  This is on my subscribe and save forever now. I can't tell you how many products from Lancome, CeraVe, Estee Lauder etc are being replaced by products from this brand. My face feels so calm now, no more redness and crusty dry flaking irritated skin (don't know what caused it only that I couldn't get it to stop)  I LOVE this brand.
summary: Soothing, moisturizing clean that doesn't irritate

reviewText: It has a weird smell during application that may bother smell-sensitive people, but it does not last. And it works as an all-day moisturizer. Using this in the shower keeps me from needing to also slather on lotion. It's really great for dry skin and will become a regular staple in the bathroom, especially during the winter months.
summary: Really good at moisturizing; strong smell at first

reviewText: I live in a dry climate and normally put oil on after my shower.  I started using this shower oil in the shower and LOVE how it works!  I put lotion on after my shower now and it really helps lock in moisture after using this oil in the shower.  If you use a wood stove or live in a dry climate, your skin will thank you for using this.  Highly recommended.

Bioderma shower oil is a thick oil that distributes easily over the body. It produces a small lather when applied with hands.  A little bit of the oil goes a long way and it replenishes my skin.  I enjoy the floral type of scent and it reminds me of spring, lilacs, and tropical flowers.  It is not irritating to my skin and is noticeably hydrating. It has a spa-like feel and feels wonderful to use. I have even used it on my face in the shower and I found it to be hydrating and protective.  It doesn't leave my skin greasy and I cannot feel a residue.  I do not notice a shine on my skin and I still apply lotion after my shower.  I am very happy with Bioderma Atoderm shower oil and would order again.  It does what it says it will do and the scent is beautiful.
summary: Bioderma Shower Oil has a wonderful texture and scent and is replenishing

reviewText: As a "Zesty" bar soap devotee I have been trying to switch to shower gel because it is better for dry skin but so far I have always reverted back to soap because I feel cleaner. I have used this shower oil on half of my body regularly for several days. 1. It lathers like soap. 2. After a tough sweaty workout I feel clean. 3. It is gentle enough for all body parts. 4. It is moisturizing but does not take the place of body lotion. 5. It is not good for application when you are out of the shower, it feels soapy. I actually got back in the shower to wash it off after applying to dry skin. (- one star) 6. It leaves no residue in the shower and does not create a slippery surface. 7. The bottle is large and heavy so is not conducive to travel unless you put it in a travel size bottle. 8. The pump works great. 9. The portion of my body that I used the shower oil on fared better with a softer feeling after several days of a side by side comparison.

According to the Bioderma website, this is good for:  babies, children, adults, face & body.  In other words, you can get a lot of use out of this.

You can use it in the shower or bath, or even after shower or bath, simply rubbing a bit into your skin.

The end result is soft and supple skin.

We've had extremely dry weather lately and my daughter finds that a small amount of this on itchy skin is very soothing.

Finally, it's a generously sized bottle.  Since you don't need a lot each time, it should last for ages!

I love the huge pump bottle for this amazing product.  The pump is easy to use and the product goes on smoothly. This oil is just what my skin needed.  After being trapped under all those layers of clothes all winter, it's itchy and in need of some serious moisturizer.  This does the trick in the shower and doesn't feel greasy or slimy. It imparts moisture to my skin and doesn't leave a film.  There can't actually be a person out there that can't benefit from using this.  My skin is thanking me for this.
summary: Your skin will feel great affter using this

reviewText:
Very nice to have this large dispenser of shower oil right in the shower with me.  Wow does it leave my skin softened and clean feeling.
I am accustomed to applying oil to my skin while it is still damp as I exit the shower.  This is a unique approach to oiling my skin while in the shower, and I like doing it that way.
Just don't wipe it ALL off when you get out of the shower.  I find the best result is to let some of the oil absorb naturally and then to towel dry lightly.  Do this especially in the winter months when you really need that moisturizing.
summary: Recommended highly to those of us with really dry skin....I think you'll enjoy this experience

reviewText: First let me start off by saying that I have extremely sensitive skin. I can't use anything too perfumed or harsh or I have a terrible reaction.  This is by far one of my favorite Shower Gel's so far.  It has a very light scent, similar to Mustella products if you are familiar with them.  It's smells clean with a subtle tone of baby powder.  But very subtle.  It's light, foams slightly and makes my skin feel, nourished, hydrated and smooth.  If you have dry or irritated skin, this is a winner!  Would highly recommend.

THIS is amazing stuff!!  I love it!!  My skin is normally very dry  ~ this year, after all this crazy cold, it's scaly, itchy, TERRIBLE, and I've tried so many products, soaps, etc...this is the BEST soap I've very used.  I was afraid it would be really oily, but I'm at the point I'm desperate, so I did not really care...I put a hair clip in to keep my hair off skin while I soaped up with this the first time.  To my utter amazement it goes on smooth, slick...and NOT at all greasy or oily, and rinses clean!!  Your skin feels smooth and silky, and with this and moisturizing with coconut oil after my shower, my skin is more hydrated than it's been in MONTHS.  It was getting little bumps on the back of my arms and back, so itchy...it's all gone now!!  My skin is healing!  This has a very light scent, is very non greasy, non oily...I've already put the shower gel in my cart as well.  This is worth the price for certain.  If you have skin issues you WANT TO TRY THIS!!
summary: If you have skin issues you WANT TO TRY THIS!!

reviewText: Wonderful. Very light, almost undetectable fragrance. Using this in the shower, after washing, really leavers skin feeling soft and smooth. No longer is my skin dry later in the day, the moisturizing effect lasts all day. Great idea. Wash, rinse, use Bioderma, rinse and pat skin dry. This will be a permanent fixture in the shower from now n.
summary: Effects last all day and such a light fragrance I would almost call it fragrance free.

reviewText:
I wish I discovered Atoderm about ten years ago, when middle-aged dry skin took over my entire body.  This shower oil is absolutely wonderful.  It soothes my skin itchiness and hydrates just as well as other skin calming, oil enriched brands that work but smell terrible.  Atoderm has a nice light fragrancenothing overpowering, just a clean smell.  I used to buy separate feminine washes for sensitive intimate areas, but Atoderm works without irritation there too.  Im so glad to have finally found a shower oil that meets all my cleansing needs and eradicates dry, itchy skin.  The removable clasp that prevents leakage  is especially appreciatedit fits around the pump area, making the bottle safe for travel.  This product might seem pricey, but most other calming soap oils come in 16 oz. bottlesthis one is twice the size at 33.80 oz.

Here is Atoderms ingredient list:  Water, glycerin, PEG-7 Glyceryl cocoate, Sodium cocoamphoacetate, Lauryl glucoside, Coco-glucoside, Glycerol oleate, citric acid, PEG-90 Glyceryl isostearate, fragrance, mannitol, polysorbate 20, xylitol, Laureth-2, Rhamnose, Niacinamide, Fructooligosaccharides, tocopherol, Hydrogenated palm glycerides, citrate, lecithin, ascorbyl palmitate.
summary: Wish I Had Found This Wonderful Product Years Ago

reviewText: Wonderfully moisturizing shower oil.  Skin retains softness without oil residue.  Great product without any perfume.

after I used it 3 weeks my skin has no improvement still dry
I don't think this product make a difference

While I like the coolness of the roll-on (it feels really good, especially in the summer), I don't like the uber-strong fragrance. It smells like something my mother might have used...in the '70s. Definitely an older lady smell that took over and made me regret putting it on my face.

I definitely need anti-aging products. I'm middle-aged and wouldn't mind decreasing wrinkles. But the fragrance will not go away.

I could be more enthusiastic about the product if it came unscented.
summary: Like that it's Roll-on...But NOT the scent

reviewText: A nice mask that helps to smooth the skin and reshape the facial contours. By leaving on for 10 minutes and then removing, skin is left feeling plumped and smoother. The mask is based on floral essences and has a lovely scent. Good stuff!  Recommended!

This roll-on mask by NUXE goes on smoothly and evenly and feels nice and cool. The directions are in French, but all you have to do is uncap it and twist the top to make the roller release the product. It's easy and closes again nicely. Leave it on for 10 minutes (I've left it all day by accident and it didn't hurt a thing) and rinse off. NUXE is the maker of NUXE Crme Frache de Beaut Enrichie 24HR Soothing and Moisturizing Rich Cream for Dry Skin, 1.7 oz., which is the best thing that's ever happened to my face. I'm very sensitive to fragrance and its light scent is of orange blossoms; I look forward to using it every morning. This anti-aging roll-on has a much stronger, sweeter smell that wears off fairly quickly and, more importantly, doesn't give me a headache -- virtually all man-made fragrances go straight for my sinuses. Though I wish it smelled like their Creme Fraiche, it is perfectly acceptable and smells more "natural" than any scented product I've used (excluding Creme Fraiche). As for plumping and reducing lines, I do feel some tightening and my skin does look better. But for the price, I think I'll stick to Eucerin Co-Q10 cream - it's fragrance free and much less expensive, and NUXE's Creme Fraiche. However, if you like floral scents, this is surprisingly nice.

I've got lots of wrinkles and baggy eyes, so that makes me a good test subject. There appears to be a lot more directions inside the box than on the outside but they're in French and I'm too lazy to use a translate app. The basics are easy to understand. Uncap, turn head so rolling applicator works, apply and wait at least 10 minutes. Then dab off. I generally leave it for 1/2 hour and wash off. Results: I can certainly notice my face tightening a little while the mask is on and for a couple of hours after. I think the wrinkles and bags are slightly reduced. It seems to be a rather temporary phenomenon but maybe after I use the whole tube it will stick? I suspect it is something you have to keep on applying. It might be useful before photo ops or events where you really want to look your best. Negatives: Although the package touts several natural ingredients, the mask also appears to contain a lot of chemicals that could be harmful... especially the fragrance, which can hide a world of sins. Frankly, I really don't like the smell... sneezing as I wear the mask again and type this review. I'm using in a well ventilated area with a fan blowing on me. That helps. I prefer Derma e Pycnogenol Gel with Vitamins C E & A 2oz (Set of 2). Results are a little slower but the gel is much more pleasant to use. The gel uses more natural ingredients and costs substantially less too.
summary: Not Sure Results Are Worth Unpleasant Smell

reviewText: Love the roll on mask. The cold metal applicator feels so good going on and it makes my skin feel great. Love this mask.

Ive been using a Nuxe Eye Cream for several months, and it has worked wonders on the dark circles under and wrinkles around my eyes, so I was anxious to try out this NUXE Anti-Aging Nuxuriance Roll-On Mask.  While I didn't notice the immediate results I noticed with the eye cream, over several uses, this mask has seemed to help my appearance.  My skin looks and feels firmer, and this mask seems to have calmed the reddish areas of my face.

This is a mask that you can either leave on for ten minutes or leave on all day or all night.  It rolls on and then massages in clear, and it doesnt make your face feel tight or dried out like other complexion masks tend to do.  It does have a strong perfume smell, which I personally like.  I especially like the roller, not only does it help in the application, but it feels so good and rejuvenating to give myself a little facial massage with it to work in the mask cream.

Overall, this is a nice moisturizing mask that over time seems to have improved my skins appearance and elasticity.  Since Im in my early forties and starting to notice the aging process, anything that helps me combat it is a plus in my book.

This arrived in a padded envelope. The box which it was packed in was a little smooshed, but the actual item was fine and suffered no damage.
This is a roll on tube and the product has a somewhat strong scent that was not unpleasant which reminded me a bit of the botanical products I have used in the past. I started with a freshly washed face and I applied the roll-on mask evenly. I allowed the mask to be fully absorbed for a full 10 minutes. Per instructions, excess mask should be removed after 10 minutes with a cotton pad or a cotton pad with some lotion applied to it.
I thought this product worked and plumped up my facial features while eliminating fine lines. However, I have used a couple of products that have done the same thing. I liked this product and method of application and will recommend it to others.

Ppop
L  ñnnmor a cotton pads soe

I love Nuxe products, and their NUXE Huile Prodigieuse Multi-Purpose Dry Oil, 1.6 fl. oz. is one of my all-time favorite beauty products, one that I've re-purchased and also given as gifts to friends. This new mask is such a nice treat, and each time I've used it, it has toned down the redness that my skin is prone to and made my skin really soft. The rolling wheel that you apply this with works smoothly, and helps distribute evenly across your face, neck, and decolletage. It's nice to not have to wash your hands again, too, after applying this! Long-term, I hope that the roller continues to work well, and that it doesn't become clogged up. I'll update my review if it does. I have sensitive skin that freaks out easily if a product is too harsh, but this is really gentle and soothing. I've actually been using it at night (which the instructions say you can do) as a sleeping mask, and I've pretty really impressed by how I wake up with an even complexion. I'm not sure if the science behind the saffron flower and bougainvillea cell is really legitimate (I tried looking this product up on Paula Begoun's Beautypedia site and googling it, and couldn't find any information about it), but what I do know is that the redness that I usually always have around my nose and mouth is gone after using this. It's an excellent product in my book!
summary: Helps tone down redness and softens the skin -- and works well on sensitive skin

reviewText: NUXE is a French brand. I buy and use several NUXE products (such as NUXE Contour des Yeux Prodigieux Anti-Fatigue Moisturizing Eye Cream, 0.5 fl. oz. which I love) but this one is not for me. This is a fragrant anti-aging mask. I just turned the cap to on and rolled on a thin film of clear "serum" on my face and neck, waited 10 minutes, and removed it. My face smelled great because the product is fragrant and my skin felt soft but not plump as specified. Personally, I prefer exfoliating masks to this type. I'm glad I got the opportunity to try this but it was not for me. One big negative is that it is hard to find the English instructions on the tube and box (both inside and out). The best instructions are on the inside of the box. If I were the type that preferred a super light mask that feels almost not there and has no exfoliating properties, then I would have rated this 4 stars.
summary: This is not a typical mask; it rolls on thin, is fragrant, & smoothing but I prefer exfoliating masks to this type

reviewText: This roll-on night mask has a pleasant, light floral fragrance. It squeezes out under the roller, so you can easily control the desired amount for application, and rolls on with the cool metal roller. My wife likes to refrigerate these products for an extra cool, soothing feeling. The box doesn't say anything recommending or not recommending refrigeration. The product absorbs very well, and has a very slight warming sensation, that doesn't last long. There is a slight residue feeling on your face after application--not a gross or dirty feeling, but you definitely will feel the desire to wash it clean in the morning. But your face and skin feels refreshed, and creases and lines in the face are visibly "plumped" or smoothed out, so you can tell that its hydrating the skin!

Review of: "NUXE Anti-Aging Nuxuriance Mask Roll-on, 1.6 fl. Oz."

The Paris, FR manufacturer claims that this product upon use works under these conditions: "Immediately, this roll-on mask with millions of bi-floral cells (active molecules from precious saffron flower encapsulated in a bougainvillea cell, with targeted and continuous action) works to smooth the skin and revive radiance. In just 28 days, the skin is re-plumped and firmer, it looks rested; the oval of the face seems reshaped. Use test conducted under dermatological supervision with 32 volunteers over 28 days."  The instructions further ask that the roll-on applicator be worked outward from the center of your face and neck and lower neckline. You leave the product on for 10 minutes and then remove any excess with a cotton pad.  So far my wife claims that he skin feels more plump after application thus any wrinkles disappear.  She is still working through the 28 day process to determine what effects, if any, remain.  So far it is a great product.  Five stars without reservation.
summary: It Works: Plumps Skin and Removes Wrinkles

reviewText:
After positive results with Nuxe Nuxellence Detox, I took Amazon's offer to provide a review of this product.

What interested me about this one was the "Saffron and Bougainvillea Bi-Floral Cells".  This seemed intriguing along with the claims about providing plumper skin which appears rested and firmer.

The product arrived in a bubble-bag which looked like it had been steamrolled.  The outer carton was flattened but the product was intact, thankfully.  This should have been shipped in a small box.

The odd thing about this product is that it has a roll-on applicator.  Instructions are basically to roll on working outward from the center of your face starting at the bottom of your face, neck and dcollet (i.e. lower neckline).  You leave the product on for 10 minutes and then remove any excess with a cotton pad.  Instructions are unclear if you should remove the product completely or only the excess.  I interpret it as only the excess.

My first question is "what are Bi Floral Cells"?  I did some armchair research and found that this is the result of encapsulating active molecules from the Saffron flower in Bougainvillea active cells.  It is entirely unclear to me how encapsulating a saffron flower cell in a Bougainvillea cell would lead to any beauty benefit, but I am not a molecular biologist.  Not sure why the cells would need to be combined versus just adding cells from each botanical?  I think the company could benefit from explaining why/how this works in much the same way that L'Occitane explains how their products work.

After trying this product for a week along with the Detox night cream, I can say that there is a visible result.  Skin does look rested and more firm.  Cheekbones are enhanced and skin seems brightened when using this in the morning after using the Detox product.

Overall - I was and still am skeptical of the bi-floral cell thing but I do see visible results and no break-outs.  The product does seem to have a beneficial effect.  I would recommend it.
summary: Roll on applicator - skin is firmer

reviewText:
This Nuxe luxuriance mask smells amazing. And the packaging is amazingly fun, it's got an on/off swivel top under neath the pull cap, and a easy spinning metal tip applicator. Unfortunately, that's about as far as my love goes.
It's not thick like a typical mask, but thin and more fluid like a serum. In fact it's so thin that after turning the tube off and using the cooling metal tip to massage the mask into my skin per the instructions I don't feel like I really have any mask left on, it's all been massaged into my skin. Which makes step 3, wiping with a cotton round feel unnecessary.
While my skin is soft after using, I wouldn't say it was more plump. And I wouldn't say it was softer than it was.
If this was a leave on serum underneath a moisturizer I might be more inclined to purchase with the really high price tag. But, since it's a mask, meant to be removed, it's too much for too little.
This is one Nuxe thats a miss for me.

Overall rating: a moisture rich gel that works exceptionally well as a night cream.  Four and a half stars.

Packaging: This bottle comes in a lovely metallic box that looks luxurious and also doesn't deceive the buyer about how much product they are getting.  I really hate getting a bottle of moisturizer or other face product that comes in a big box... full of little pieces of cardboard and stuffing and a bottle half the size.  This product fills its box, and the tube itself is quite nicely sized.  It fits well in the hand and is easy to maneuver.  The green is a beautiful,, saturated color and the metallic makes it look very attractive on the makeup tray.

Ease of use: The bottle has an interesting "roll on" feature, which means that when you receive it, the top is "locked" and you have to rotate the roller head (the entire cap of the tube with the roller embedded) around one half turn to allow product to come out.  You then gently depress the tube while rolling the tip on your face.  It takes one or two tries to get the hang of it (which is why I took off half a star from my review), but it's not difficult.  I would recommend turning the cap, doing one pass over your face, then locking the cap again and rolling of the remainder of the product on your neck or on areas that you want a little extra product on.  If you don't use the entire dose that you've squeezed out, it can collect in the cap and make a bit of a mess.

Product quality: The actual gel creme is lovely.  Note - it has a STRONG smell, but it is more like a classic perfume than a medicinal or unpleasant smell.  It's not even overly floral, despite the floral essences advertised on the bottle.  I love the scent, my husband describes it as "makeup-y" so your mileage may vary.  It definitely lingers.  I tried it on in the morning, and then again at night and both times I noticed the smell hours after I applied it.

The gel is substantial, not super thin - it's like a heavy moisturizer in texture, possibly a bit more slippery.  You do have to apply a sheer layer, as the directions say.  If you go too heavy, and it hasn't dried clear after a few minutes, it will ball up on your skin and you can peel it off or wipe it off with a washcloth.  After a few times of wearing it, I also used it in combination with my other Nuxe moisturizer (after a day at the pool, my skin was pretty dried out) and I had good results, very nice coverage and woke up with moisturized, fresh skin.

I'm not sure of whether it makes you skin "tighter" per se, but it definitely creates a moisture barrier and keeps me from drying out over night.  That alone is worth it for me, because I get some incredibly dry skin and I've been at a loss to frankenstein together my other moisturizers to get a super-moisturizer.  This takes care of it for me.
summary: Highly moisturizing, strong botanical smell, enjoyable to use

reviewText: This serum will give you immediate results. I have had sort of mixed experiences with this brand but this product really does improve skin texture after one use. Nuxe is a great French brand and known all over Europe. My biggest pet peeve with their products is that some of there scents are pretty strong but this one has a pleasant flowery smell that is not overwhelming. The tube has a top that opens with a turn so that it can be closed and locked and product doesn't spill. It has a metal roller in the top which dispenses the right amount of serum and works the product into the skin, I enjoy the coolness effect of the roller as it glides and massages my face. My skin has been a little stressed from the summer sun and this serum made it glow without making it greasy.
summary: Makes your skin glow, feels amazing

reviewText:
This really works for me.  It goes on like a lotion, and at first it looks shiny, like a lotion.  In about a minute, I start to notice that the skin is looking more matt, and in the next few, it's like my pores disappear where I apply it.  Now, I have fairly small pores anyway, so I've been using it where mine are the most noticeable and where my skin is the oilies- on my nose, chin, and that little triangle between my eyes and forehead.  I have great results.

I have used it with and without the Bioderma Sbium cleanser that is recommended it be used with.  It works either way for me, so this is a fine stand-alone product.  I have used other 'bur' products but they felt slick and silk, and like they had a ton of silicone in them.  This doesn't change the feel of my kin, and it works well under makeup.  This is my favorite pore minimizing product ever.  It does NOT leave my skin feeling dried out in the least, either.

It does need to be applied 2-3 times a day.  The tube is small enough to fit in any pure and it's fairly thin too, so it wouldn't take up much room in a makeup bag.

I can't say if it will work for people with pronounced poors, but on my small to average sized pores, it's very effective.
It doesn't have an odor.
summary: Leaves skin looking very matte "blurred' -non drying, not greasy or slick, makes small to average sized pores disappear

reviewText: This is my second purchase of this item! I love Bioderma products. I live by them. I can't get through any of my bookings without them. This is so great for Oily skin with a lightweight moisturizer under it. It does a great job of filling in those pore and keeping that oil from eating through your makeup. Most of the time, unless someone is extremely oily, I really don't have to touch up much. I will use this on combination skin types, as well, if they are pretty oily in the t-zone. I love this serum!

I use Retin A on my face at bedtime, wash it off in the morning, but have been plagued with oily, shiny skin now that the weather is warmer. I was eager to try this product!

The cream has a light scent and goes on thin. It takes a few minutes for the mattifying effect to appear. My skin stays matte for 4-5 hours. I don't get any breakouts from it, but I don't use it on my nose, where I can barely keep breakouts at bay anyway.

I haven't noticed any effect on pore size.

This does what it says it does. I have skin oily enough to lube your car with and this keeps it down for hours. I also have pretty big pores and this closes them to a manageable size. My wife tried it before her makeup and she was very happy with the results. All in all a great product.

I've been a fan of the Bioderma Micellar water for the longest time is I was excited to try this cream for oily skin and I was not disappointed. It does not go on oily and it is great for the summer months. My skin felt soft and I haven't had any issues with breakouts. It also made my skin feel more mat and my makeup went on smoother. Love it and highly recommend this brand!
summary: ... this cream for oily skin and I was not disappointed. It does not go on oily and it ...

reviewText: My teenage daughter has been using this cream for a couple of weeks. She has noticed a huge decrease in the amount of oil on her face in the t-zone area by the afternoon. She doesn't wear a lot of make up, so she comes by her shiny face naturally. The cream is gentle and doesn't annoy or irritate her skin. She hasn't noticed any difference in the size of her pores though. She hasn't had any unusual breakouts either.

I liked this product.
It provides light moisture but also leaves a natural and lightly matte finish.
Its no a super matte finish but more of a natural shine remover.
Did not last 8 hours for me.
Doesnt contain silicone so my make up did not pill and roll off.
I like to use it as a primer

In the winter, my skin is even and normal. In the summer months, I have a shiny, oily T-zone.

It comes out thin and occasionally watery. It absorbs quickly. When I first smoothed it on, I thought there must be some mistake. My skin was shinier than ever. But once it dried, my skin did look smooth and mattified. The effect doesnt last all day. My skin did look better than it would have without this moisturizer, but I could see the shininess coming back after about four hours.

4 STARS: Its lightweight and smells great. Its the perfect moisturizer for me for summer.

I use Bioderma Micellar Water and it's improved my complexion 100%. The MAT Control Cream is a welcome addition too. It's a very lightweight cream and it keeps my t-zone from being oily. It doesn't have a scent either. This brand has been a winner for me. Recommended
summary: Bioderma Changed My Complexion For The Better

reviewText: I got this for my teenage daughter, she has only acne prone skin and often has problems when her skin gets extra oily with her cosmetics. It has a lotion texture and a pleasant scent. I was really surprised with how well it worked on her skin as far as oil control. Without drying her out, her makeup was in place after a full day of school. As for her pores they did get smaller, but were still visible in some areas. Overall this was a real problem solver for her, and I'm happy she is happy and that her face is getting the moisture she needs especially with the drying effects of acne treatment.
summary: Kept face moisturized and makeup in place all day

reviewText:
This exfoliating body polish has been a nice treat for my wife and I to try out on our skin. I have been using it after shaves and find that my neck area feels better than when I just rely on some store brand aftershave. I never really exfoliate though so I'd imagine I'd get the same effect from other just normal exfoliators. Where this product really shines though is the anti aging aspects while my skin isn't in terrible condition it's comforting to know that it's being preemptively protected from such issues. I see it kind of like using whitening toothpaste when you have white teeth you don't really need it but it lessens the chance you'd end up getting stains in that case and helps minimize that crepe paper issue in this case.

It smells kind of nice it's not too overpowering but expect it to have some leftover smell it it afterwards. Some products come on with a smell but then disappear but I found I could still detect this a bit later. It feels nice on the skin and I have no complaints with any residue issues afterwards.

In terms of the claim about any skin types I have extremely sensitive skin which often will break out into eczema rashes if any products that aren't made for super sensitive skin are used on it... With this product my skin didn't do that. It's hit or miss really with skin products as even some perfume types won't necessarily trigger any rashes but I can say at least in my case my sensitive skin was fine. Make sure you try only a little at first if you want to be safe though and confirm. Hard to really just test out a product like this due to the price though.

I'd say it's probably too expensive for most users. The reason why I'm inclined to give it 4 stars is that it's intent it to erase crepe skin. If it was just an exfoliating body wash I'd probably see it as just way too expensive. It still feels a bit pricey but you pay for the results you're looking for I'd wager.
summary: Great exfoliator a bit pricey for just that use though

reviewText:
I really wanted to like this product more than I have. I'm a guy and I have a tendency to get reddish splotches on my face from shaving as I'm fair skinned. I also have dry skin on my forehead. So, I have been using this for a little over three weeks and while I definitely see a difference in my skin for the better (both the forehead and my reddish shaving area, I can't justify the cost of this product.

What I like is that this does reduce the redness over time and gets my forehead exfoliated. It does this without me having to put a creme on my face AFTER washing - this is part of the washing process. That means I don't perspire through the lotions or cremes that just sit on my skin, but are supposed to reduce the redness.

So that's it's biggest win for me.

However, there are other products out there that I have used over the years that do a similar job at a significantly smaller cost than Crepe Erase. Any exfoliant product is going to temporarily reduce wrinkles, because it's sloughing off dead skin, but as soon as your skin dries again, the wrinkles come back.

I prefer a product with a little more oomph than the beads in the product provide. Apricot scrubs or salt scrubs are a bit more abrasive but they are also super reasonably priced.

I just can't get past the price on this. I like it okay, but no way would I pay the retail cost of this
summary: Overly priced exfoliator - drug store versions are far cheaper and do essentially the same thing.

reviewText: Wife's review: "Really loved the product as its anti-aging effect was very quickly visible. I have used it regularly for two weeks at certain specific areas around face and neck, and the smoothness in the skin is very visible. It is smooth creamy texture and is a bit fluid-like. It expands very well and thus needs to be used in very small quantities. However, the price is very very expensive and I am sure that there are cheaper alternatives to get such good quality."

In the past I've used a scrub on my décolletage. This is the first time I've tried a body polish and it definitely feels more gentle. After I've applied and rinsed off Crepe Erase, my skin easily absorbs moisturizer. But will I pay upwards of $20 to buy another tube when this one is empty? I'm not sure. It's a little pricey, when compared to similar products on the shelf at Ulta for $7.99.

Currently, this product has two Amazon product pages. This one where the product costs over $70, and a second one where it cost $20--Crepe Erase Exfoliating Body Polish, Scrub Renews Radiance and Texture, 8 oz.. How strange. Personally, I would not pay either amount for this product, even though I like it, because it seems no different to me than your average exfoliating cream. It does do a good job exfoliating, although it makes my face feel a bit tight. Also, while I like the scent, it lingers too much on my face. If it actually makes crepey skin look better, I don't know, since I don't have that problem yet. The company Crepe Erase has a whole skin care system; so, if you really like this exfoliating body polish, you might check out their website to see what they suggest to use with it. I'll just use it until it's used up.

I like how this "polishes" my skin and makes it silky smooth. I'm not sure it actually erases that "crepe" skin gets as it loses elasticity but it definitely sloughs off the old skin and lets the new shine through. I was a little concerned about the beads they use to polish but the product info claims that they're "eco-safe" so I'm going to hope I'm not killing fishes and other critters by using this product.

If you worry that an "exfoliating" body polish will be like rubbing sandpaper on your skin,  you can relax. The texture is barely abrasive, and where the companion product, Intensive Body Repair Treatment, is quite thick, the body polish has a far thinner consistency. The scent, to my nose, is faint, and will not conflict with your favorite fragrance. The tube is nice and big but the price is sky high. Thus only 4 stars, not five. (I received this product from the Vine and on my own, look for products that cost about 80 less.)

The name of this product line, Crepe Erase, also strikes me as retro and unappealing. Rethink this, people.

I've been using this "body polish"  for a week or so and I can report that it does a fair job smoothing and moisturizing the skin.  I have mostly used it on my neck and decolletage, as well as my arms.  While I don't  have thin crepe-like skin, I did find this product to make a positive difference in the texture and hydration of my skin in these areas.  Everything feels softer and smoother.  I'm rather impressed by the difference, actually.  Every thing is much more touchable - softer - and yes, even polished.  I haven't experienced any redness or irritation from frequent use.

It's easy to dispense too much.  The formulation is on the thin side and you don't need a large amount to cover the areas I mentioned.  Since it's a rather costly investment, I would suggest experimenting with smaller amounts to find your ideal application.  The fragrance is a very pleasant citrus that doesn't linger.

It's almost beach season here in NWFL.  After a very short winter, I'm ready to get a pedicure and go out and enjoy the sunshine.  This smoothing polish is just the thing to wake up the skin on my legs and feet.  It doesn't take daily use to get results.  A few consecutive days of use jump started my skin and now a bit of maintenance once or twice a week is all I really need.
summary: An effective smoothing polish that doesn't irritate the skin or leave it feeling scrubbed.

reviewText:
The exfoliating polish contains little beads and is VERY runny--it literally just pours out of the tube like water. It's not very rough or "scrub-y" at all. I couldn't feel anything happening on my skin. After using in the shower, my skin felt very smooth, but I think it was due to it being mainly a moisturizing body wash, and not due to any exfoliating action.

This has a very strong fragrance.

There is no way that I'd pay the current $79 price!

The Crepe Erase Exfoliating Body Polish is a gentle exfoliator that will leave your skins feeling soft and smooth. My skin feels hydrated and polished. It has a mild scent and did a good job of removing dead skin. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because of the price. This would be way out of my budget.
summary: It has a mild scent and did a good job of removing dead skin

reviewText:
When I go out in the sun I don't tan I rash so I always wear a sunscreen. I have avoided sun damage because of that but not the soul-sucking, drying winter heat so my hide can use all the help it can get. They say it can also be used to prevent crepey skin. Youre supposed to use it with their intensive body repair.

The body polish is a very thin, lotion-y  product with scrubbing pearls in it. because it is so runny you can empty half the tube before you start scrubbing so I squirt some out in a wide mouth jar and dip a folded  washcloth into it for scrubbing.

 It has a very light citrus scent. No  parabens and not tested on animals.

The ingredients are:
Water (Aqua), Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Glycerin, Acrylates Copolymer, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Propylene Glycol, Cetyl Esters, Hydrated Silica, Peucedanum Graveolens (Dill) Extract, Pyrus Malus (Apple) Fruit Extract, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Wax (Cera), Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Butylene Glycol, Ursolic Acid, Citric Acid, Tetrasodium EDTA, Lactic Acid, Sodium PCA, Sodium Hydroxide, Sodium Chloride, Xanthan Gum, Phenoxyethanol, Chlorphenesin, Benzoic Acid, Sorbic Acid, Fragrance (Parfum).

I was surprised that it really did make a difference in my skin and I think I will continue to use it.

Very gentle and powerful exfoliator. I really like how it feels and my skin after using it.

It contains olive oil and silica beads for exfoliating. Please note the product itself is very thin and runny. First time using I flipped the bottle and When opened it, the gel just poured out.

Smells great!  The price point is ultra luxury. You can buy 10 good body scrubs for one of these bottles.
I love this product and it works well, but it is very expensive.  This would make a very special treat for a mom or grandma on Mother's Day or birthday.

I thought this product perhaps overstated its claims, but when I did a side-by-side test on two legs (treated one, didn't touch the other), it worked surprisingly well - the skin was more smooth, more hydrated, and less "old" looking (which is probably just a combination of the two former points). It went further than I expected--a quarter-sized amount was more than I needed for one leg--and it foamed up a bit as I was using it.

I was concerned that perhaps it had micro-beads (small plastic beads in the news for showing up in waterways), but it doesn't. If you wet the tiny "beads" you see and rub them hard enough, they disintegrate. I assume these are the "hydrated silica" mentioned on the ingredients list.

I'm a man with scaly dry skin and this exfoliating gel scrub worked wonderful and left me looking less lizard like. That being said, this has a Nordstrom type price and I shop at Big Lots. Great product but not in my budget.
summary: Great product if you can afford it

reviewText:
My wife reports: The first thing I want to stress, this is not a scrub-type body wash, but a shower gel with micro polishing pearls in it; the kind you have in face cleansers/washes. For me, who uses pretty rough scrubs regularly, this seemed too gentle. Also you end up using quite a bit of the product, because of the rather runny consistency, and low density of pearls. So if you want to feel the polishing effect on your skin you will take a handful of productfor my whole body I had to use 4 handfuls.  By using it every day, I expect it to last around 2 weeks or so.

It does lather very well, because of the second ingredient: Sodium Laureth Sulfate. This product has a very pleasant mild smell, and only stays on your skin for a short while. But it leaves your skin very pleasantly clean, and main thing it doesn't dry my skin out.

For myself I found that I will keep using it more as a shower gel than for it's polishing effect, which was way too gentle for me. By applying it onto my sponge, rather than directly to my skin, it should last longer. I do like it, but not as the main product in my cosmetic library :)

If you are looking for a very, very gentle skin polishing gel, than this is it!

This is the second Crepe Erase product that I've used, and, like the first one, I like this one a lot.

A spa employee once told me that the best thing a middle-aged woman can do for her skin is to exfoliate. Although this is pricey, this is a great product because I use such a small amount to get a large effect. This tube (8 oz.) will last a long, long time.

The scent is understated and pleasant, and the body polish feels great on my skin. It really is a treat to use.

This is a gentle exfoliator. Rating it 4 stars mainly because I didn't care for the aroma (somewhat strong) and I think it is way over priced. I am 60 years old and do not have crepe issues, but I do have aging skin and sagging issues. I have used this for two weeks now. I will state that my skin is a lot smoother than it was before I used it and it does appear to be more hydrated (considering I am in Florida, that is a strong plus). However, for the money, I could buy Ahave products for exfoliating and get the same or better results (and much less a cost). As I do not have major creping issues, I cannot say whether this products works (which may justify the cost), but for my needs it is an excellent exfoliator and I know I could do better price wise for same
summary: Nice exfoliator - overpriced for my needs

reviewText: OK, likely wouldn't purchase (there are less expensive options and better products). This is a thin, watery solution that is difficult to control, you end up using more than you want or need, as it gushes out. It may require frequent use to obtain optimal results? It's a very average product and I didn't find it impressive.

I am a senior gal in my 70's who spent most of the 60's thru 80's trying to get as darkly tanned as I could because the darker I got, the bluer my eyes looked and the different shades of blonde/beige hair looked so dramatic and Farrah Fawcett sexy - OMG! Would I have listened if someone had told me back then what would happen to my skin as it aged? No, I seriously doubt that I would have because I was too busy getting the tan lines even..........fast forward to 2016 and a 10X magnifying mirror is not my friend.  And, there is no magic tube of anything that will erase all the damage caused by sun and as the years progressed,  prescription medications, etc. I just want to look as healthy as I can without causing more damage and so many exfoliators on the market are just too strong, especially for someone fair-skinned like me with mild rosacea.

After reading other reviews on Crepe Erase I thought I would give it a try and I am so glad I did!  I live in a dry climate and I have very dry skin and sometimes I just don't take that good care of it so I have flaky skin as well, ugh.

I actually could SEE the difference on my arms and legs after using the Crepe Erase just one time.  Anything was an improvement, but this improvement was really noticeable and my skin felt so soft.  I mean, I was really happy with how I looked!  My skin was healthier to look at and it did not look as crepey as it did before.

The down side is the cost which is just not in my fixed income budget so I would not use it as often as I would like.  And, now I really want to try the facial product because that's where I see the damage the most.

I like this and would have given it 5 stars but for the cost.
summary: I like it and I do see a difference after using it

reviewText:
This product has a nice smell and applies on gently.  But it's supposed to exfoliate and make my skin softer after a winter in sweaters.  After several uses between me and my son, we didn't notice any changes.  I felt like using my loofah afterwards.  My son says it makes a good body wash.

Now for the price:  Holy moolah!  $47 bucks?  I double checked several times to see if quantity "1" included a four-pack.  No, it is only one and it is way overpriced.  If it was $8 at most, I would have given it four stars.
summary: That price cannot be right. Can it?

reviewText:
I don't like to admit it, but many years in the sun combined with a thyroid condition has not helped my skin. That's why the Crepe Erase caught my attention. Now that I've used it, I can't imagine not having it around when I need it!

Crepe Erase is a gentle exfoliator that really works. All I do is apply it to the skin, massage in, and rinse off. The dead skin is lifted off, revealing the more healthy and attractive skin underneath. Fantastic!

Of course, nothing can roll back the clock permanently but this works just fine for the moment. I'm finding it's something to always have on hand for those high-visibility situations (photos) where I want to make the best impression possible. I really can't ask for anything more than that.

I highly recommend Crepe Erase to everyone.
summary: A gentle exfoliator that really works

reviewText: Love this stuff more every day. Not harsh like other exfoliators and makes me feel clean and my skin very soft. Definitely recommend this and the facial exfoliator. Both great products for a great price. However, be clear on reasonable expectations.  Specifically, this scrub is not physically going to eliminate sagging skin.  That expectation is simply unreasonable.
Color glides on. Dark is perfect for crease and light for highlighting under brow.
summary: Dark is perfect for crease and light for highlighting under brow

reviewText: Coconuts and Cabanas- nice rich neutral colors that go on even and blend well. The case is nice and solid with a good weight that does not feel cheap.  I love the mirror size, too.  Some have commented on the lack of an applicator but I would not have used it anyway (I prefer a brush) so it did not bother me.  This was my first time using Julep and it was a good experience.  I usually prefer a more matte finish but otherwise a good solid choice.

I love the Julep eye shadow. The palate I tested contains two shades of brown. I felt like the color was exactly as expected from the picture. In addition, it is easy to apply if you use a brush and not an applicator. I use the eco tools brushes and felt they worked well with this eye shadow. The eye shadow creates a nice, muted look without being loud. I thought this was great if you are going for a natural look. I have brown eyes and these two shades really made my eyes look softer.

This is some of the nicest quality eye shadow that I've ever used. Unfortunately, it's not my favorite, mainly because the dark brown is a bit cooler color than I prefer, and the lighter, golden color would be better (for me) without the glitter/shimmer, although it isn't as pronounced once on as others that I've used.  The colors go on smoothly, blend well together with a brush, and last all day.

The compact set is good sized and the case includes a generous mirror.  It arrived with the shadows intact and they don't fall apart easily with use.  The colors are heavily pigmented so it doesn't take much to achieve the effect that you want.  I feel that these are high quality shadows and really worth the cost, if you find the right color.

I will continue to use these and experiment with them and others that I have.  I would recommend this brand from my experience due to the high quality and quantity that you receive.
Nice

I wear lots of brown clothing and eye makeup so these were perfectly complimentary shades.  It is easy to apply and feels fine when applied with no irritation of heaviness.  I was wearing it outside on a very, very hot day and the perspiration around my eyes caused me to wipe them quite often.  Reapplication was needed a couple of times.  I do not believe under ordinary conditions reapplication would be needed.
summary: Smooth, easy application and nice colors for me

reviewText: I love this! I wasn't sure if the shades would look good on me, as I have a medium fair skin tone. Usually golds don't do me any favors, but this looks great. It applies easily, I used an eye shadow brush to apply it. It doesn't come with a brush of it's own. This is the first Julep product I've used and I really like the quality. The case is nice and sturdy, too. I hate it when an makeup case breaks and the contents inside end up on the bottom of my makeup storage case. There are a lot of videos on YouTube that help with applying two colors together to look perfect.

Like velvet for eyes
Tawny, sultry, soft and smooth
Subtle yet striking

Purse-worthy compact
Handy mirror included
No applicator!?!

I gave Julep blush 5 stars, but the eyeshadow is lacking for me. I tend to wear neutral tones, so the colors coconuts/cabanas seemed like a good match. The eyeshadow comes in a sleek black case. The colors are gold and brown as pictured. Although I agree that the shadow feels like velvet, I was hoping for a more matte finish. The large pictures of the shadows look matte and other pictures look more frosted. I wish the description and photos were all accurate. So, nice eyeshadow, but a little too shiny for me.

This Julep eyeshadow in coconuts and cabanas was soft, smooth and applied without any chalky or patchiness. I love the shimmer, which adds dimension but doesn't sit in my creases. Pigment wise this set is nice, but on the lighter side. I don't mind, since with neutrals like this sometimes a sheer wash is easier to work with. That said, both colors built up nicely. There is a bit of dust/fallout in the compact, but not on my face, I just use a lighter hand when picking up the shadow with my brush.
I really like the compact. Though there is no applicator, the mirror is bigger than the average and the pans are a nice size. It feels like velvet rubber, and even after dropping it's been sturdy.
I usually think nail polish when I think Julep, but their line of color cosmetics is making me rethink that. High quality, and decent pricing.

This full coverage eye make up arrived, and is as pictured. The colors a pretty close to what is shown as well. They are not light shades, more of dark browns, even the lighter shade. Applied lightly it can be used for natural look, or apply heavier and it can be used for night. The only downfall is no brush. But if you're serious about makeup I'm sure you have many to use.
summary: The colors a pretty close to what is shown as well

reviewText:
So I'm having a difficult time finding anything to apply it.
I used a cheap sponge that comes from another brand and color of eyeshadow and it seemed to go on well even though I have very crepey eyelids but since it goes with another eyeshadow, I need one specifically for this color eyeshadow.  However I emailed the company to ask for a brush or applicator recommendation and they wouldn't recommend anything although they actually sell brushes, I found out later.

I don't live near malls or any beauty supply stores so buying makeup brushes can only be done online and sometimes I am lucky, and sometimes not.  If someone reads this and can give me a recommendation, I would appreciate it.  I love the color of the eyeshadow although it is shimmery but not enough that I can't wear it in the daytime.  The color seemed to make my eyes look less droopy, but I won't know until I get an appropriate applicator that is not mixed with another color.  One brush I used, was totally ineffective at picking up the color.

The colors are much more orange on me, after Smashbox 24 Hour Eyeshadow primer or swatched on my hand, than they look in the pan or on my screen--they look the same in person and on my Macbook Air, for the record. They are easy to apply smoothly, and did not flake, but the lighter shade is a very metallic gold that stays shiny in, to me, an unflattering way--obviously, of that's the look you are going for--I prefer a more blurred Hourglass Ambient look with less flat-out shine. The darker color has that blur quality more, but is far more copper on me than the soft toasted tan it looks in the pan. I think there's some copper shimmer? It's a bit more obvious than I was looking for, but does highlight my eye color.
For the record, I have a medium for a white person, neutral under-toned complexion with reddish overtones, dark ash brunette, with hazel eyes--the color of green olives with a coppery ring in the middle.
summary: much more orange than they appear, and the lighter shade is fairly metallic.

reviewText:
The Julep brand of cosmetics is new to me.  A little research revealed that they sell a full line of cosmetics, nail colors and skin care (including some enticing Korean-style cleansers), plus they offer a monthly subscription service.  The price and quality seem to be in line with some of the mid-range department store brands (MAC, Benefit, Urban Decay, Bare Escentuals).  The color combo (Coconut/Cabana) is very wearable and they complement each other well.  The lighter of the two is gold with a slight undertone of pink.  And the darker shade is a medium goldish brown - much lighter than I expected based on the photo.  Both are tastefully frosted.

I apply my eyeshadow with a short-bristled, square brush and it went on rather sheer.  I think if one were to apply it with a traditional applicator, it would definitely provide the "full-coverage" advertised, but I prefer a subtler look, so the sheer look was fine.  I applied the gold to my lid and the darker shade in the crease to give my eye depth.  Because there wasn't as much contrast between the two colors as I had anticipated, the effect was, again, extremely subtle.  But at my age, that's preferable.  And because neither shade is particularly dark, I think either would work nicely on the lid.

The texture was not quite as "creamy" as mineral based shadows, but wasn't dry either, so there are no worries of the eyeshadow flaking down onto your cheeks as you apply it.  Velvet is probably a fairly accurate characterization of the consistency and look.

Overall, a very nice product in two very wearable, every day shades that will work on almost any skin tone.

The Julep colors are beautiful!!!  It was easy to apply with a eye-shadow brush. It felt so good on my skin! I believe their claim to "Velvet Eye" would be appropriate for how it feels against your skin. I thoroughly loved it immediately! The colors of gold and copper bronze are so beautiful. All I can say is beautiful, beautiful! I will probably wear this shadow everyday for the remainder of this week. I am so pleased! And I highly recommend using the Julep "Feels Like Velvet Eye" full-coverage Eye Shadow. Love, love it!
summary: Eye Shadow that Feels Like Velvet Against Your Skin

reviewText:
I didn't realize what full coverage meant!  It means this is seriously pigmented! Just a dash on a brush is a lot and you need to blend and blend to work it in to your eyes to soften it. The result is nice, these colors are very natural. I pretty much only use the lighter one because even just in the crease, the darker one is darker on than it looks.

They do feel like velvet and are smooth and pretty.  They lasted all day, even when I forgot to wear my shadow primer.  My only qualm would be that they are so pigmented it's hard to apply without getting a few flecks of it on your face.  So I pick up a tiny bit and brush it in, but still have to go back and clean up a little on my cheek of shadow that falls off the brush. Not a huge deal, but it's so darkly pigmented that were I to miss it, it'd be a mess.  I have to use a Qtip with makeup remover as the color has staying power.

I like this product line and have tried it before.  I don't think I'd buy this in more intense colors, because I imagine they'd be that much harder to blend. As it is, these are natural for any skin tone.  Green or blue shadow in this product line? I can't imagine how you'd make that work.
summary: lots of pigment, almost too much

reviewText: This shadow duo is better than I expected! Mainly because of the photo ~ the colors are more rich and vibrant than in the photo, which I like. It glides on, as they said, in one stroke (with one of my own brushes; an applicator is not included). There's a nice shimmer, but not shiny/sparkly. It stays put and doesn't crease. I guess I have mature skin?? I'm 52. I think this particular color is great on medium/tan skin, so for me, this will be probably be a shadow that I wear only wear in the summer/early fall, but I'm not opposed to trying it during other times of the year to see how it looks. As others have said, it's packaged well, and is a good size (2.5 grams). I really like this duo and as they said, it truly feels "like velvet".

While often people think of Julep as a nail polish brand they've also been branching into makeup and skincare in the last couple of years. I've found the products to be hit or miss and when I originally heard about the launch of their Feels Like Velvet Eye Full-Coverage Eye Shadows through their Maven subscription box in May of 2015 I passed. At that point I already had their Julep Dial Up Your Glam Multidimensional Orbital Eyeshadow, Terra and wasn't wowed by it. And I had a lot of other eye shadows in palettes, singles, duos, etc. so the colors didn't seem unique enough to make a purchase. However, over time I did hear good things about the formulation on beauty boards I frequent. It was described as soft, blendable and long lasting. So I became curious and was excited when I finally got the chance to try this. Opening this up, the package reminded me a lot of other Julep products. It feels premium and substantial. Their packaging always seems to be a bit on the thick/heavy side to me. On the plus side it doesn't feel cheap, but on the negative side it does mean that the products can be a bit bulky and probably take up more space than they should, which isn't great if you travel. Looking at the colors in person, I thought they looked pretty true to what I expected based on the online photos. I know this seems like a given but I've had issues in the past with Julep products looking NOTHING like their marketing photos so I'm glad to see this one is pretty consistent. Coconuts & Cabanas comes with two eye shadow pans: chocolate shimmer & metallic antique gold. I'm not a huge matte eye shadow girl, so two more shimmery shades were fine by me. Both shades are warm neutrals and great for an everyday eye look. I used them by first applying eye cream and then my eye primer (I've been using Urban Decay's regularly). Because there really isn't a shade in this duo that works for an all over, base shade, I applied Urban Decay Foxy from my lid to my brow bone. I then washed my lid with Cabanas and worked Coconuts into the outer crease. I also find that Coconuts smudged into the lash line works well for a more natural eye liner. Paired with a dark black mascara I really liked this look. It works well with my neutral light/fair skin, blonde hair and gray-green eyes. I like that the colors are natural enough to be a good work look, but that shimmer brings attention to my eyes and adds some youthfulness. It works quite well with the more dewy makeup I tend to wear in the summer time. I really liked the formula on this. It does feel quite velvety on your lids, is easy to blend, and has buildable color. I also found I didn't get much fall out and thought that when used with the primer this does a good job of lasting throughout a workday. It also in no way irritates or bothers my eye or lids. Quality wise it seems to be on par with something like Urban Decay, Smashbox or Too Faced, which are regular go-to's for me for eye makeup. Overall I'm really liking this. I'm not yet convinced that Julep can do any product flawlessly, but this eye duo is good.
summary: Flattering shades in an easily blendable, well wearing formula

reviewText:
Coconut and Cabanas is a nice duo, overall. It comes in a very sturdy case, and is packaged smartly. There's no supehrfluous packaging. It doesn't come with an applicator, which is fine for me. If you want to take this on-the-go, you will have to BYO applicator.

The lid color goes on very smoothly, though it took me three swipes to get the depth that I wanted. The lighter shade is very light, though the darker shade is very dark. It seems like this set would have been better represented with a third shade, between the two.

Likewise, the color is shimmering, so it won't work well for a matte look.

In all, it's a nice duo, though it's very expensive for what it is. There's no way Id pay $40 for this set.

All right, this is going to be a weird review. I should have gotten the Julep Feels Like Velvet Eye Full-Coverage Eye shadow in Coconut and Cabanas. What I got was their pore reducing blush in petal pink. So yeah, I'm reviewing the wrong product, but I'm going with the link they sent me....

I'll say this, VERY nice packaging. You got a solid plastic case that closes well (so if you want to carry this in your purse, bag or for traveling) and it includes a mirror. The powder is very finely milled as well, and a little goes a long way. Great pigmentation, it's a very bright pink (and I'm pale), but it goes on sheer so you're not looking like a clown, it works well with buildability. Don't know about the pore thing, my pores are just fine, but it lays on top of the skin so no irritation. Judging from how well the blush is made, I'd say that the eye shadow is probably really good as well, with just as good packaging.

So, I'd hope that you don't get screwed with the product mix-up that I did. If I'd ordered and received the right product, I'd give this more stars, but....

My wife loves her eye shadow, and I ordered this for he to try out.  Here's her take:
The presentation was classy and professional, and she liked not having a poorly made applicator she'd never use thrown in.  The colors are prettier and ore vibrant in person with a bit of a sparkle in the browner tone.  The colors can be used for highlighting, sculpting, etc... depending on the look she's after, and the warmer brown is something she doesn't have from other products.

It glides on and lasts all day--removes well with remover but otherwise stays put.  All in all, she she's it as a complement to her MAC or Urban Decay eye shadow and is looking for more shades from Julep.

These are so silky. they slide on and if you feel your eyelid you can actually feel how silky they are. I've had zero problem with irritating my eyes in any way. I've use the light color on my lid blending it with a light coppery color I have from L'Oreal and that works out great, I've used the darker color in the crease of my eye and as an eyeliner. They last all day and are really my first experience with higher end eye shadows and I am now learning what I've been missing. They are super easy to work with, are true to color when applied, glide on and last all day. I'm going to order some of the other colors.

Pros:
Beautiful rich color
Glide on
Stay all day
Easy to blend

Cons:
No applicator (but I just used one of my assortment of makeup brushes)

It is boxed like they are giving you a gift with an inner and outer box, the compact itself is hefty, opens easily and has a large mirror. If the mirror were magnified that would be outstanding - but otherwise, it's perfect!

[...]
summary: Beautiful colors, beautiful compact, beautiful on!

reviewText: I have been a makeup artist for some time and as a result have had access to some of the best makeup there is out there from time to time. I have worked with high and low end products which thrill me and high and low end products which leave my wondering why they bothered. This eye shadow duo is one of those that was an unexpected surprise- a good one. WHAT IS COCONUTS AND CABANAS LIKE? This shadow duo turned out to be much nicer than I anticipated. The colors themselves are much nicer in person than the photo supplied with it online. The case is very classy looking. It snaps open nicely and shuts tightly as well. There is a mirror on the top lid which is large and a HUGE plus. The pans themselves are substantial in size, allowing for the brush to have great access to each color without overlapping to the other pan. The colors themselves are stunning. The light color is a beautiful rose gold color which has a slight shift to a champagne or lighter gold in certain light in certain directions. The dark color is a lovely gold brown color which is very beautiful and although you might think that you have a zillion like it if you have a substantial makeup collection, chances are you don't have one just like it. I was sure that I had this color, but in my entire collection, I could not find one exactly like it. It is a beautiful golden brown color. Most browns lean either cooler, or more reddish in hue. I have a very large eye shadow collection and I have to say, I did not find any matches in any of the palettes, individual shadows or MAC pigments. Believe me, if anyone would have one, I would. HOW DOES THIS SHADOW DUO PERFORM? One of my biggest beefs in recent years has been that the quality of eye shadow has not met performance expectations after years of velvety smooth and gorgeously pigmented eye shadows from companies over the years. Many newer shadows are not as nice as some of the better shadows I have used over the years. This duo is a beautiful duo, well matched. The colors are vibrant, but go well with many color combinations of hair and skin tone- mostly leaning toward the warmer side of the spectrum. The shadow applies smoothly and has a satin finish to it, although it borders on metallic for the light color. The durability seems to be excellent as I got an entire day of wear out of it using a shadow base (Too Faced Cosmetics, Shadow Insurance, 0.35 Ounce) Blendability is high and the two colors blend out well together for a smooth transition without looking muddy. You can sheer this out nicely for a glowy look or use it layered for a more intense color if you like. HOW WILL THIS PERFORM ON MATURE SKIN? I tend to prefer Viseart Eyeshadow Palette - Neutral Matte 01 for mature skin. (The price in that link is crazy and way above retail but at least you can see what I am referring to). This is okay if you don't have a lot of crepe creases on your lids. It could enhance those on some people. All in all, however, it is nicer than a lot of shadows I have used on mature skin. It should be used with a base, however. I would say it is worth a try in most cases. WHAT IS THIS SHADOW LIKE? The closest family of eye shadow that I can compare this duo to is the LORAC Unzipped Gold Shimmer and Matte Eye Shadow Palette. The two colors in this duo are in the same color family, although none are a perfect match, so you can use them together if you like. WHO MIGHT LIKE THIS EYE SHADOW DUO? If you have strawberry blonde, gold brown, golden blonde, or auburn hair, this duo would most likely look very pretty on you. Suntanned skin with highlights in hair from summer might push some people to be able to wear this easily in summer as well who might not normally be able to wear this warm of a palette the rest of the years. THE BOTTOM LINE This eye shadow duo is perfect for warm and bright warm palettes of people. If you are cooler but have a tan, it might also do well in the summer, even though the rest of the year it might not flatter as well. The two colors are great staples especially for summer, but even for the holidays if you happen to look good in them. They blend well with other shadows, especially above mentioned palettes. These shadows should be used with a primer and not on bare skin to avoid sensitive reactions. With satin finish and intense pigmentation, the larger pan of these shadows should last quite some time for lots of great use. They apply well with fingers, sponge applicators, or a brush and last through the day without having to re-apply.. I was pleasantly surprised by the nice quality of these shadows and give them five stars. I will update should anything change in my experience in the future.
summary: Makeup Artist's Perspective On A Great Palette For Warm Or Tanned People- A Pleasant Surprise

reviewText:
This is a review of the colorway "coconuts and cabanas". I'm not sure which is which so I'll refer to them as light and dark. This is a nicely packaged duo of eye color. I am white haired, blue eyed and pale with cool tones. The lighter color looks really nice on my lids, somewhat shimmery but very complete coverage. There is no applicator with this product so I use make up sponges.

The darker color is much darker than I had imagined. It was too dark for anything other than my brows. I used a q-tip and was able to nicely shade them in. I'd have no other use for a color this deep.

Overall, nice set and I like the lighter eye lid color. I prefer my make up to come with an applicator as that makes it easier to wrangle in my purse.
summary: Excellent lid coverage with a nice shimmer. No applicator.

reviewText:
I have this in the Coconuts/Cabanas color, and when it arrived, I was worried about how dark it would be.  It goes on much sheerer than expected, which I actually prefer.  Since the lighter color is still a bit too dark to use under my brow bone (I'm pretty fair, and wear MAC foundation in NW20, as a point of reference), I use a different highlighter color, and then use the two colors in this palette on my lid and crease.  I wish this had come in a trio with a lighter color to make things a bit easier, but it's no problem to add in a third color of my own.

I always wear either Urban Decay's Primer Potion or Tarte's eye primer, and this plays nicely with both of those.  It lasts all day when applied over primer, and is a pretty neutral color.  For more pop, I've also added a teal or green eyeliner, but you can tone this down by using black or brown eyeliner along with it.

I have a few Julep nail polishes, and hadn't realized that they had  branched into the world of cosmetics.  I'm impressed with the staying power and vibrancy of this palette.
summary: Goes on lighter than expected, but lasts all day

reviewText: This is a decent eyes shadow duo if you like a light color or a natural look.  The colors are very natural, however I like a more bright and bold color that makes my eyes stand out. Other than that if you are looking for a nice sepia, this would fit the bill!

This is a great little set of eyeshadows, in a velvet shimmery shades of brown. The darker brown is great for crease and lid and light brown gold works for highlights or even for all over lid color. The shades work for all skin tones and eye colors.

The texture is pigmented, creamy and smooth like higher end brands like Lorac, MAC or Urban Decay. If used with a eyeshadow primer they last almost all day without creasing or fallout. Since they're subtle Browns even if they lighten during the day they don't make my eyelids look streaky.

 I would have preferred matte finish like my Naked Palette but this works too and the case fits a party clutch. The mirror is nice for application. I just wish the set wasn't so expensive.
summary: Pigmented and velvety texture, a bit expensive.

reviewText: I honestly love these colors..perfect shade of brown for my green eyes and the coconut for under brows.  Haven't mixed them yet.  Are easy to apply with my little brush and I don't have "fallout" on my cheekbones after application..this stuff is creamy!  Haven't had any collection in my creases by the end of day and at night I wear even heavier without creases, so far.  I thought this is rather expensive..maybe I'm just cheap, sorry!

This is a beautiful light color. Goes on soft but has depth. It's hard to explain, it is a light gold and brown but they are easy to see the color. It stays on even after I tried wiping it off. They gold is very soft and it is shimmery without all the glitter and flaking that happens with other shadows.
Amazing product!

I've been a Lorac user for quite some time, and recently decided to try their matte eyeshadow.  The only negative is the pallette does not include an applicator brush, which it should.  The other almost negative - is the colors are extremely strong, so you only need to apply a tiny bit to get the look you need.
Highly pigmented. One of my favorite palettes. Goes on smooth and is easy to build.
Good

Lorac makes an excellent highlighter and bronzer kit.  The colors are great, the consistency is good, does not have any flakiness, color remains throughout the day.  I also like the brush that is included.  It is the perfect size for placing bronzer on the cheeks and highlighter.  The highlighter and bronzer colors are very good shades for all skin colors.  I am very happy with all the Lorac products.  I also have a couple of eye shadow palettes that I rotate on a daily basis.
Buy this!!! It's great and so easy to use. It also looks so natural. In love
summary: It's great and so easy to use

reviewText: I had high expectations of this set, but found the colors difficult to pick up on brushes and difficult to blend. Not the one for me.

I am now a lover of Lorac Cosmetics!!! The eye shadow that I normally use is cheap and drug store brands. The shadows don't stay all day or bleed with those. This doesn't have that effect, yet is still cheaper. I thought I was going to be very unhappy with this purchase because 1 shade was broken and I had to clean it up a little. This is why it didn't get 5 stars. But just the top layer was broken and I still use that shade everyday! This product made me a believer of the Lorac Cosmetics!

I had bought a cheaper contour palette and wasn't happy with it. I decided to splurge and get this and it's much better.

The colors are good, probably best for medium to darker skin tones. I'm very pale right now and I use the light contour shade and it is plenty dark and pigmented. I will probably use the other two shades in the summer.

I like that one of the highlighters is shimmery and the other 2 are matte.

The contour is very pigmented and does not take a lot of product to show up. When I use too much, it is hard to blend and ends up looking dirty. A little goes a long way, which is a good thing since it will last a long time.

The 2 matte highlight shades could be a tad more pigmented... I don't see much difference between the 2 colors.

Overall a good product!
Must have! A very versatile palette. The pigment on this is great. The formula of them very buttery, and blend out amazing. So many looks you can do with these shades.
This is my go to palette for smoky eyes. Super creamy and very pigmented so it should be built up slowly. Excellent quality, it travels well, LOVE IT!
summary: Super creamy and very pigmented so it should be built ...

reviewText: Love the colors

I love Oribe products (my favorite is the Dry Texturizing Spray), but the Cleansing Creme seems not to be for me.  I have shoulder-length, color-treated hair, so it appeared to be the perfect product but my hair felt greasy rather than moisturized.  It's ok to use on the ends, but I can't stand the greasy feeling if I use it all over.  It smells amazing though.
summary: too greasy for my long hair

reviewText:
The feeling this product gives my hair is on another level. I am in love with that.

I am not in love with the STRONG smell this has. It lasts through drying, through styling, and all day long. You better like it.

I'm not a fan of strong smells in my beauty products for this very reason, and especially if you dare to use two or more products that want to compete with each other on the smell front.

I'm a daily hair washer and I turn into a greasy mess if I wait for more than my allotted 24 hours between hair washings. This can stretch that a little bit, but only after I've been using it for several days in a row.

I use this only on the roots of my hair and work the rest out as far as I can. I have long hair so I always oil my tips after I wash & condition my hair.

This gives me the shiny and soft hair I'm always after. I have untreated hair with heat damage and this is a lifesaver for me.
summary: Strong scent, does wonders for your hair.

reviewText: I guess i read it wrong ----  said "cleansing" --- i thought this was shampoo.  it's more like a conditioner.  I love the other Oribe products, but very disappointed with this.  For conditioner, i like the "dark green tube".  I gave it 2 stars for being "vague" in the description.
