I have applied this with moisturizing and showering/exfoliating first and without it.  I find no difference.  The tanner is moisturizing but not overly so, so in hot weather it is not annoying.

HOW DOES IT APPEAR
I found that this takes over an hour to begin to show on me.  My coloring is medium fair skin right now, but I am lighter in the winter time.  I found that one application gives a decent very light realistic tan.  Waiting a day and applying again gives me a nicer light tan.  Using this every other day seems to work out well for me.  When not applying more than once, the tan begins to fade at about four days.

IS THERE SMELL?
There is a slight sunless tanner smell, but even in humid hot weather, it is barely noticeable which is a big thing for me in hot weather.

DOES IT WEAR OFF ON SHEETS?
There seems to be a slight wearing off on the sheets, but I am expecting it to wash out.  I will update if I find any problems in this area.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Having had two of the best sunless tanners ever found in the past, I was surprised when this one matched them in performance.  Very little smell and easy to apply without a mitt but using silicone gloves on each hand, I found this sunless tanner to look natural and not streak.  Wearing off in about four days or so with a single application, I get a nice light tan with natural fading and not patchy.  Having moisturizing nature makes me not miss my Alba Botanica sunless tanner which I have used a long time and love but can not find anymore.  The price is high, but performance is really good.  I can see this tube lasting a very long time.

I give this sunless tanner 5 stars.  I will update if I have anything else to report in the future.
summary: Replaces My Discontinued Favorite Sunless Tanner-I Have A Better Method Than Using A Mitt

reviewText:
This is by far my favorite product by Vita Liberata. I have fair skin and don't tan easily. Before using this, it was either TanTowels or Jergens Natural Glow for me. The Vita Liberata truly is FABULOUS just like the tube says. I'm very sensitive to odors and this has none, unlike every other self-tanner I've tried. No streaking, dries fast, almost fool-proof when applying. I use my hands and wash them afterwards. Makes you tan gradually as well as fading gradually. Very moisturizing, too.

While this is more expensive than the others I've used, you need so little it's very cost effective.

I have used lots of self tanners over the years and they all tend to give me a natural looking tan (thank god, the days of the Oompa Loompa are over). Some add scents to try and mask the "self tan smell" while others have developed technology to neutralize the smell.  But one thing that most self tanners haven't tackled yet, is dry skin.  Most tanners are not moisturizing and adding a secondary moisturizer, before or after the self tanner has been applied,  interferes with the tanning action.  This self tanner is white and goes on like a light weight body lotion.  I applied it early this morning and I just noticed that my arms and legs are not dry, flaky or itchy.

Now since I have been using self tanner since Spring, I can't attest to how many days it takes to develop a deep dark tan.  I usually use tanner once a day until it starts getting too dark then switch to every other day for awhile.  So, if you are just starting out,  use this once a day until you get as dark as you want then cut back until you determine how often to apply it to maintain your desired level of bronze.  Everyone's skin is different.  And don't forget the sunscreen!  I use a high SPF spray so as not to disturb the self tanning lotion.  Yeah, I know you're supposed to rub that stuff in to but I just spray it on very liberally until all my skin is wet, then I let it dry.
summary: Finally,  a self tanner that moisturizes too

reviewText: *Update* I put a lot of this product on my legs tonight after showering and walked aroudn for about 20 minutes without pants to make sure it was dried. I then put on jeans and it felt fine - but the stench from the product is bothersome. It is like every other tanning product I've tried. I am not sure why it seems so much stronger that when I've used it in the past - it could be that I applied more than I usually do, or because i applied and put jeans on vs a skirt or loose, lightweight, summer pants during past applications. Whatever the case, it's giving me a headache and is quite strong. I'm not removing a star because the product still works well, and is really no different from other products in having the tell tale self-tanning cream odor. Original post: This is the second product by this brand that I've tried thru Vine. The first was Vita Liberata Phenomenal 2-3 Week Tinted Tan Mousse, Medium, 4.22 fl. oz. This is almost as good. The Mousse had no scent; this has a mild scent but I'm not sure what it is. It is very faint and doesn't smell anything like the typical self-tanning products (from drug store version to high end version, they all have a tell tale scent.) After an hour or so, the scent seemed a bit stronger, but was still mild compared with the typical self tanner scent and certainly wasn't enough to make me self conscious. I tested on my forearms and hands, and after about 3-4 hours, my skin had a nice, fresh glow. The product itself is white, a mix between a rich, thick cream and a lotion that easily blends into the skin. It dries fairly quickly; the first application I used a bit too much on my right arm and it took longer to dry fully to the touch (around 30 min.) I was more careful with my left arm and used half the amount - about 1.5 dime size of product on the second arm. It blends easily, but no matter what product I use or how careful I am, I always have at least a few streaks. The streaks this time were on my fingers, which is always a hard area to cover to ensure you get the backs but not fronts of the fingers. The second application helped to easily cover up my streaks. All in all, I really like that this is easy to use with very minimal scent and it delivers a rich glow pretty quickly.
summary: The first was This is almost as good. The Mousse had no scent

reviewText:
Honestly, this is the best self tanner I've ever used, and I gave up after trying most brands! Having tried several other of the brands' self tanners, Vita Liberata has some OK products, but nothing I wanted to spend a small fortune on. This self tanner blew all of them out of the water!

I am fair skinned, and my legs are as white as paper. In the summer, I really want some color on them, but 'red' from a burn wasn't what I had in mind. That's why I go for self tanners, to give my legs some life. I've tried other tanners (including ones from this brand), and nothing worked as well or as easily as this.

It goes on clear, and the color develops gradually, without a hint of the dreaded oompa loompa orange that's the curse of too many self tanning products. It really looks like a tan, but it's light and natural. Very realistic! I also love that it lasts a good long while, and it fades gradually...like a tan!

Just remember to exfoliate well first, and don't apply any moisturizers for at least a day before you self tan. Trust me, you will love this!
summary: Probably THE best self tanner for my paper white legs I've ever used

reviewText:
Goes on clear, like a hand lotion.  Slight tingle but nothing major.  I did not use a bit and it didn't make a mess at all.  The scent is very subtle.  While I'm sure it's best to keep it away from your eyes, it didn't burn them.

The tan starts coming on pretty quickly.  It's almost like magic.  Not a fake looking tan either.

Only negatives I can think of is that the directions were pretty much non-existent on the tube that I received, and it's a touch pricy.  But it's an excellent product, very possibly one of the best.  5 stars.
summary: Probably the best self-tanner I've used.

reviewText: This is a creamy, gradual self tanning lotion. It softens and makes your skin look and feel moisturized, without feeling greasy.  I applied it over my tan and I thought my skin looked radiant and soft.  It does have a slight smell, but not anything like any other self tanner I've used before.  I did have to allow for just a little more time, than with their mousse, but I just stood in front of my fan and that helped to dry it.  It contains over 6 ounces of product, so a little more product than what the mousse holds for the same price, and it moisturizers your skin.  Here is what the manufacturer says: "A superbly hydrating lotion that applies clear for zero transfer onto clothing and then develops to a beautiful subtle glow that be deepened with daily use. Formulated with Aloe Vera & Shea Butter to soothe and moisturize."

Very good self tanner for being a white lotion. Usually I can miss some spots or have concentrated spots on the feet but not with this one.
Pros:
- no smell!
- a little goes long way,
- sun kissed look upon first application, not very dark but visible.
Cons:
- none, even price is ok.
summary: Great for fair and light skins.

reviewText: This is the second Vita Liberata self-tanner I've had the chance to try recently (the first was their Vita Liberata Phenomenal 2-3 Week Tinted Tan Mousse, Medium, 4.22 fl. oz.), and they really are the best self-tanners I've ever used. In the past, I've tried Jergens, Nivea, St. Tropez, Banana Boat, and Dave's. The color on each of those has varied, but this Vita Liberata one has left me with a consistent color that looks natural even on my fair skin. I did end up purchasing the VL mitt for six dollars to use with this and the mousse, and would really recommend doing to. The mitt helps keep the product off your hands (and thus avoid orange palms), and helps you apply it in a more even way. I had an Ulta brand mitt I used with previous products, but the VL is a bit thicker and softer. This does dry out your skin, so it's important to use a more moisturizing body wash in the shower and lotion. Although the VL products claim to not have the self-tanner smell, they definitely still do. I will say, though, that it's not as strong as other self-tanners. This really does give a natural, bronze glow!
summary: This brand makes wonderful self-tanners -- but they do still smell and I wish the price was less expensive!

reviewText: I have been wearing this for about 6 months now, and it is my daily go to. ADORE the color, LOVE how long it stays on, OBSESSED with the matte-ness of it, and it has such a pleasant smell when applied. I have bought this 3 times already in this shade alone. So good. :)

This is my absolute favorite matte liquid lipstick. I have the colors Loyal, Committed and Charming. Loyal is a bright true red, Committed is a dusty pinky nude shade with a sliiight coral undertone, and Charming is a deep mauve that can work for day or night.

The formula is soft and has almost a whipped like texture. Seriously, of all the Matte liquids I've tried, theBalm's Meet Matte has the best application. I never get those hard lines I get with other liquid mattes, and it's very easy to apply.

The colors are wearable, vibrant, and they are completely transfer proof after they dry. Not only are they transfer proof, they don't budge. You can eat and drink without anything moving. Although depending what you're eating (say a burger) the middle can fade a bit. The wear time is absolutely incredible. I rarely ever have to reapply when I'm wearing this lipstick.

Unlike most matte formulas I have tried, I find this to be the smoothest and the one that makes my lips look the least aged. I'm 33 and certain mattes really make my lips look much older than they are. Even with the bright red, I don't have any settling into the lines of my lips. This in of itself is a complete win in my book.

It's also the most comfortable matte liquid to wear, IMO. It's lightweight and doesn't feel like my lips are slathered in dry paint after it sets.

It doesn't taste like anything. They have a minty candy like scent that I find totally yummy. When you apply it you get a very subtle mint type of feeling that dissapates after it sets. I love it, some may not, and some may not notice it. The scent also dissipates after the lipstick sets.

Upon first inspection you may think the formula looks chunky, but it applies like a dream. It's kind of weird that is looks like it's chunky but it's not, not really.

I'd buy these again in a heartbeat. If you're looking for a high quality liquid matte with amazing staying power, amazing color payoff and pigmentation, that doesn't make your lips look like the Crypt Keeper...try this.

I've just come to accept the fact that all liquid lipsticks are super drying for me regardless of how much I exfoliate or moisturize. With that in mind, this product performs on par. It's drying but the color lasts for ages (it's a pain to remove), doesn't transfer (unless you're eating something oily) but looks stunning. My only real complaint is the doe-foot applicator. I never really have a problem with applicators like this but for some reason this one is really difficult to use. Either is comes out with a ton of product or next to none... Very weird. This issue is easily remedied by just using a lip brush but that would make touch-up throughout the day difficult (if touch-ups were needed)

These are by far the BEST liquid lipsticks.  I work 12 hours and I only touch up once after lunch.  Do not dry out much at all and they do dry slightly darker than when initially applied.  But this color is universally flattering, in my opinion.
Very good
Matte color isn't great

I purchased this in the color "Honest". It's a pink coral and is bright and lovely for spring and summer. It smells like minty chocolate (at least in my opinion) and goes on super smooth. It dries fast and lasts for a few hours. I tried eating and drinking and it did come off completely after eating. I don't expect any lip product to really last all day anyways so this didn't bother be. I also bought the lip gloss read my lips in "BAM" to wear over the top. Both are great!

For a long wear matte liquid lip color this is one of the best I've used. Color applies smoothly, very even, and is vibrant. Out of the four colors I've picked up I have not had any patchiness. And best, when completely dried down it looks velvety matte and not chalky.
I do find that it's drying, but no worse than any matte lipstick. It is long wearing, I get a little tacky and slight wear off but I think that's more the fact I continuously have a drink in hand, weather it be water or coffee and that lends to the lacking longevity for me.
The scent is amazing, kind of a sweet vanilla mint, not over powering and it does dissipate, but it's not bad when applying.
These are great to have in my vanity!

I really like the color it looks great on. Lasts a while, mine did not last as long as it says its suppose to but none of the long wear lip glosses and lipstick rarely ever do. But I did eat one meal and drank coffee.  But its still faintly there after about 7 hours. So you can be the judge on that. I included a pic after 7 hours.

Update-03/30/2015 After using for a week or so I stopped using it as it did dry out my lips over time. I even stopped using it for a while let my chapped lips return to normal and tried again thinking well it is winter so it could just be that. Nope within just a few days they were dried out again. Very disappointing because i really like the shade a lot.
summary: Like the color and the product lasts a while. But will dry out your lips.

reviewText: love he tone of red, is just a little messy you have to be careful when you apply it

The color is a bit more brown than I expected--but I like it. I found I need to use a brush--than the sponge tip to get a precise line. My reason for only giving it 3 stars is how drying it is. Image if you will having every bit of moisture drained from your lips--then drain another 8 oz--AND that's how my lips feel when I wear this. I've found if I layer a similar shade over it (In my case Makeup Forever)--I can tolerate it.
summary: Desert Dry--But the Color is Nice

reviewText:
This color is darker on me than I anticipated. However the color is very flattering. For a dark color it is easy to apply. The formulation is thick enough and thin enough to get a good line without a pencil. But I usually used a nude pencil anyways. In the pic I have no pencil on. I find this to be one of the best lip products I've ever used. I have an entire drawer full of lipsticks. And this is hands down the best matte formula I've used. Hoping they make more colors, particularly nudes.

Staying power is definitely strong. I work 12+ hours and I only touch up once in my shift (after I eat lunch). Lasts through drinking coffee and water but any greasy foods will remove it. After I ate I could have gotten away without a touch up because it was only worn off in the center and my lips were slightly stained there. I chose to touch up and it lasted the rest of my shift looking and feeling fabulous!

Absolutely the best formulation for matte lipstick I've tried. I love the wand, the color, the packaging, the smell, the staying power, the way it feels on my lips. It is dry but it dries SOFT not hard and it doesn't cause my lips to shrivel up. I love this. I haven't shut up about it for 3 weeks. I have a drawer full of lip products and this k my favorite!!

I'm a nurse and I work 12+ hours. I only touch up ONCE in my shift (after I eat lunch). Drinking coffee and water doesn't affect the wear.

I was expecting coral. But this is orange (on my skin tone). It is a pretty color but I usually mix in a nude lipstick to tone it down a bit. The color is subjective but the formulation is hands down the best I've ever tried. So long lasting, not drying, low transfer. Just phenomenal. Not many people are talking about these but they deserve more recognition. The only thing is there are 3-4 red shades and only 2 neutrals. Wish there were more nude shades!
summary: A bit more orange than I expected

reviewText: Love this shade. It is the perfect matte lipstick in a pink/nude shade for the office. It reminds me of the "brownie pink" shade from Bobbi Brown.
Nice long-lasting lip color! Slight mint flavor
Was hoping it would be a bit lighter, but it does apply easily..and is not gooey.

This system works pretty good.  The best thing is that its virtually painless, just feels slightly warm.  The applicator, when in contact with the skin, emits a bright white light which works the hair magic.  Quite easy to use once you get the hang of making sure its in contact with the skin.  When not in contact, the white light goes out, it does take some practice.  Unit is solid and well made.  I do have concerns about the long term effects of using this type of technology on the skin, its hardly a natural process.  That said, this system is well liked across the internet, thus if you need a permanent hair reduction system, this is a good place to start.

This hair removal system really does work to reduce the amount of body hair in the areas you treat.  What makes this system different than others I have tried is that it works for more skin tones and can also be used on some areas of the face.  The light does seem a bit stronger than the Remington iLight pro system I have used in the past so hopefully it will yield faster results. The one big downside to this setup is that it is significantly more costly.  Also worth noting is that a single cartridge replacement for this is $150 dollars whereas the iLight pro cartridge is only $20.  One of the other reviewers mentioned that this cartidge is good for over 100000 pulses witch is significantly more than the 1200 pulses that the Remington cartridge lasts for.  I will update this review as I see the results and can vouch for the cartridge lifespan.
summary: Expensive But Very Effective For Removing Hair

reviewText:
I have used this every 7-10 days for four months but have not noticed a huge difference.

First impressions were good. It feels solid.  I was disappointed when I read the instructions and it said to wax or otherwise rip the hair, roots and all, before using on most parts of the body (for the face and underarms you can shave). I only shave.

My hair is not particularly coarse, but my skin is very sensitive. I tested my skin by first trying it on low and checking back later and I had no problem, so I quickly went to high all over. I have mainly concentrated on underarms and my face. Although so far there has been no difference, there also has not been any negative reaction. No redness or any other problems. I have not experienced any pain during or after using.

I am writing this review after using the illuminage hair reduction system for a week. It is touted as proven to be effective in permanently reducing hair growth after just 3 months of treatment. I will finish the review in 3 months. I followed the directions and actually shaved my legs and underarms before the treatment. This is done so the system focuses on the hair follicles beneath the surface, rather than on present hair.  The treatment is very simple, you place the applicator on your skin so that the two silver contact bars are in contact with the skin. The applicator will emit a
bright white light as you move slowly over the skin. If there is no bright white light, the contact bars are not in contact with the skin. I admit the bright light was somewhat scary, but it does not make the skin warm, and is over in a second. Once I got use to it, I was able to glide the applicator over my legs, moving the applicator after each flash. I repeated the process two more times. Do not hold the applicator over one area of skin and flash multiple times. This may cause injury to the skin. The applicator is very safe, it will turn itself off if it is not in use for 30 seconds. You can also use the illuminate touch on your face, just follow the directions.
Three months later: I have use the iluminage Touch Permanent Hair Reduction for three months now and I am very pleased with the results. I have reduced shaving my arms and legs to every other week. I also use it for facial hair and that is every other week as well. The application does not take long and is well worth the time.

This product is well designed and easy to use. It is really not possible to tell at this point how effective it is at hair reduction as it is to be used for 7 weeks. After 3 weeks of use, there seems to be some hair reduction but it would be difficult for me to quantify how much. I also have light hair and light skin - the most difficult combination for laser hair removal - so it is possible that I won't see as much reduction as others might. I have had IPL treatments in med spas before rosacea and spider vein removal. In those cases, the pulse felt like a snap from a hot rubber band. There is no pain at all with this device, only warmth. I don't know if that is any indicator of its effectivity or not, only noting the difference between this and professional IPL treatments.

I have to admit that I had more and more trepidation as we got closer to trying this on me. And then even more as I could see the flashes through my hands over closed eyes. But there was no burning or noticeable reaction of any kind.

For me, I am targeting some rather thick back hair that my partner would also like to see gone, or at least controlled. This gives one small problem because I cannot reach the area by myself. So it has been a team effort. She aka been wearing the protective goggles and patiently applying the device.

As for results, it is mixed, for one I needed to shave the hair off per instructions so it is hard to truly tell how much thinner it is, but there does seem to be less after three weeks. So we have quite a ways to go. At this point I am happy that no damage appears to be done.

The device seems very solid, but the instructions are not always that clear. Will update as results come in.
summary: So far so good, at least some hair removal and no bad reaction

reviewText: The iLuminage Touch Permanent Hair Reduction machine is perfect if you are someone who consistently finds yourself getting waxed at the salon and maybe want to skip the hassle. I tested this product on my legs and underarms. What I did was showered and then completely dried myself off. After, I charged up the iLuminage. I used the lowest light setting. I also made sure to wear the eye protection goggles that come with it. I ran the iLuminage over each area that I wanted to reduce my hair just once. Do not run it over more than once or use a higher setting than necessary because you might hurt yourself or damage your skin. I accidentally went over a skin area twice and it definitely stung and I could feel it for the rest of the day. After completing, I repeated the process 7 days later. The process should be repeated for 7 weeks, but each session should be a week apart so that you do not hurt yourself. The iLuminage actually does work. My hair takes a bit longer to grow out between sessions and I notice that the amount growing has been steadily decreasing.

This is an interesting device for treating periorbital wrinkles or crown's feet around the eyes. It is easy to use and the treatment only takes 2 minutes a day.

The device is small and lightweight. It has a treatment tip that emits invisible laser radiation, an on/off button, and a multi-color light to indicate the device status. It has a non-replaceable Li-Ion battery and that can be fully charged within 2 hours. Charging is done via a standard mini-USB cable and a 5VDC 1A power adapter (both included). There are no user-replaceable parts as the device is designed to last for 3 years or more. It comes with a 1-year warranty.

The device is designed to use around the eyes where you can feel bone beneath the skin. That is, specifically, the area around the outer corner of the eye and below the eye. Never use it on the eye, eyelids or point the laser directly at the eye. You should read the manual in its entirety before using the device for the first time. The is a long list of warnings and precautions that you should know about.

The treatment procedure is simple and easy. Turn the device (the light will lit green),  place the laser treatment tip flat against the skin and glide it slowly in small circular motions, performing multiple passes throughout the treatment to cover the entire area. The device will lit up purple and vibrates when the laser is firing during treatment, so you will get a feedback that it is working. After 1 minute, it will turn itself off. Then repeat the procedure on the other eye. For post treatment care, the manufacturer recommends their Nourishing Eye Renewal Cream. I use my current eye cream and it seems to work just as good.

The laser may cause a stinging and uncomfortable sensation in the skin, as well as redness or swelling in some instances. I tried it on my forearm for the first time as suggested in the manual. It did sting a lot. It felt like a mild burn. It was uncomfortable enough to make me not want to continue. For the sake of a proper review, I continued the 2-minute treatment. My treated skin felt very tender and was a little red. I applied an eye cream to help soothe the skin. Next morning, the redness was gone and I felt better.

The manual recommends a daily treatment plan for 8 straight weeks (do not use it for more than 8 weeks). I'm 2 weeks into the treatment plan now and I can see a difference in the wrinkles. They are noticeably softer and less defined. It does appear that the treatment would actually work. The manual says the best results occur few weeks after the 8-week course. I'll have to revisit this after 8 weeks, but for now, so far so good.
summary: Easy 2-minute treatment but it literally stings

reviewText:
After using this for 15 days and trying to eliminate the crows-nest wrinkles around my eyes, here's my review:

PROS:
 Easy to use, if a little uncomfortable (the laser makes your skin feel tingly and sensitive)
 Short length of treatment: one minute, just before bedtime (recommended)
The light on the device tells you when to stop treatment  goes from green to purple then stops
 Wrinkles are less noticeable but still visible, but overall it seems to be working.  I will update this review after the recommended 8 weeks and let you know.

CONS:
 You have to be very careful using it around your eyes.  The instruction warn that the laser can cause problems with vision if held too close, like to the eyes or eyelids. Yikes!
 Dont use if pregnant  which is ok, since the device seems made for older, postmenopausal women
 It's not meant for people who have darker skin - according to the instructions, the laser can cause redness on dark skin.
 I can't use this if I've just had a botox treatment or any other professional cosmetic treatments", like skin peels, etc).  Unfortunately, the instructions are unclear about how long you should wait  I assume after the effects wear off?!
 Effects are meant to be TEMPORARY.  The instructions say you can only use it for 8 weeks straight (7 days a week), but it doesn't say anything about how long you can wait between treatments, or if the device is even reusable after 8 weeks.  If not, you're basically paying over $200 for a device that you can only use ONCE.
 The instructions are confusing.  The study they mention say that results were best after 8 weeks, with a slight decrease after 12 weeks, even though the device is not meant to be used after 8 weeks straight.  I assume it means the treatment keeps working even when you're stopped the nightly routine of using the laser, but it's unclear.
The Instructions recommend purchasing more Tria products, like tria priming cleanser and nourishing rye removal cream, to supplement this product.  I'm not surprised by this, but I used my own cleanser and cream, and it worked just as fine.

Overall, it seems to be working, but I'm disappointed that, despite the high price tag, it's apparently a disposable device - after 8 weeks, you're not supposed to be able to use it anymore.
summary: Seems to Work on My Crows-Feet - But Instructions Unclear and Confusing

reviewText: I feel like kind of a wimp here but this thing kind of hurt! Not terrible but a bit shock-y. Not as terrible as, say, childbirth or waxing but not the most comfortable sensation. On the plus side, it's so easy a trained monkey could use it. Press a button, rub in circles around your squinty eye lines and there  you go. Easy peasy. I don't know if it's really making much of a difference...I think this might take longer than a week or two to get some real, tangible results. Or not. Maybe my skin just rejects the laser and is happy with the way I'm aging. *shrugs*
summary: Easy to use, a little painful

reviewText:
I will update as I progress!
Initial review is  that the skin around my eyes for a little fresher? You can definitely feel it working as you're applying it to your skin. The first day was pretty painful actually. After that it's just been easier every single day to where you're wondering if it's still working. I am using is on one side of my face so that I can give the best reviews possible.

I tried this product for the first time, last night.  It's very simple to use: just depress the power button and a light comes on to signify that it is on.  Different light colors signify whether the device needs to be charged or that the laser is in contact with skin.  While the device is on, press the tip to your skin and after a few seconds it starts working.  The directions say to only use this around your eyes and to move it in circular motions.  Once the treatment starts, you must continue on the same eye until the machine stops on its own (about 1 min) then repeat on the skin around the other eye.

An earlier reviewer stated that he/she felt no discomfort.  For me, however, it feels like a mild electrical shock.  I have a high tolerance for pain but this is very uncomfortable and I almost decided to not go through with it.  I did follow through, deciding to try it once, at least.  When I was finished, my skin felt tender and was red and covered with bumps/welts.  I applied my usual eye cream, hoping the redness, etc. would subside by morning.

This morning, I see no sign of the redness/welts.  Everything is normal.  Now, the instructions did say redness and irritation could occur but I did not see anything about the discomfort during treatment.  Perhaps I did something wrong.  I will reread everything again before another attempt.  I had just come out of the shower.  I did dry my face and let it sit for a few min. before the treatment but my skin may have been too damp, still.  The tip did not "glide" very easily over my skin.

I will report back after further attempts.

This is the best smell that lasts for days!! I had my hair done a couple months ago and ended up asking my stylist the next day what products she used, because my hair still smelled good and was soft. She told me Davines Oi and I bought it  immediately. Like 4-5 different products too :)

I discovered this brand in a subscription box.  I tried a sample of this particular conditioner and it did good things for my hair -- enough so that I wanted a full-sized container to use, so I ordered one from Amazon.

For reference, I have waist-length, Caucasian-textured, color-treated hair.  It is naturally sort of wavy.  I shampoo every day (I work out a lot so I pretty much have to do this) and I air dry it, and I do not use any heat treatments.  I live in Georgia and it is summertime and humid and my hair is normally super frizzy.  (Because of the color treatment and frequent shampooing, my hair is somewhat dry, which surely contributes to the frizz.)

Anyway, I've only been using this for a few days and already, frizz is down by over 90%.  (I do also use a leave-in detangler.)  My hair is soft and shiny now, too.  This maybe weighs my hair down just a little, but my hair isn't fine and honestly, most of the volume I have had in the past is from frizz, so for me, this works.  It is easy to apply to my hair and it rinses out cleanly and without making the shower floor slippery.

This does have a scent that kind of stays with you.  I am not sure how I would describe it.  If this was a perfume, I'd describe it as a warm, slightly spicy scent, maybe with a hint of sandalwood and amber.  Not sure that's what's in here, but that's what I'm personally getting out of it.  As it happens, the scent works well for me.

This is very thick, hence the jar instead of a bottle.  This is actually thicker than most of the hair masks I have used.  I am thinking I will not need hair masks any longer if I continue to use this.

You can see the full ingredients list on the product page if you zoom in on the second image, but they are sideways and hard to read, so here is the list for you:

Aqua/water/eau, cetearyl alcohol, glycerin, cetrimonium chloride, cyclopentasiloxane, cetyl alcohol, behentrimonium methosulfate, behentrimonium chloride, panthenol, ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, phenylpropyldimethylsiloxysilicate, benzyl alcohol, parfum/fragrance, dimethicone, dimethiconol, citric acid, sodium benzoate, helianthus annuus seed oil/helianthus annuus (sunflower) seed oil, citronellol, bixa orellana seed extract.

This does have a few silicones in it, as well as a couple of natural oils.  They seem to have hit upon the perfect combination for my hair (both types of ingredients typically work well for me, and they are especially good in this combination).

Anyway, very happy with this.  It will probably be the conditioner I buy most of the time from here on out.
excellent

Davines is the best hair product that I have ever used on my hair.  They are out of Italy and a high quality product.  A little expensive, however I will continue to buy as I have not used over-the-counter hair or skincare in over 13-years and will not due to the ingredients.
summary: Davines is the best hair product that I have ever used on my ...

reviewText: Lovely scent and makes my hair so soft. I also love the way the packaging of this looks, however it's difficult to use in the shower.
summary: I also love the way the packaging of this looks

reviewText: Davines products are wonderful  This scent is my favorite.  The product does what it claims it will for my hair.  No tangles or knots to cause breakage after using this conditioner.  Love it.

reviewText: I'm surprised this mascara isn't more popular! I got a sample in my Birch Box and LOVED it! I've never spent more than $7 on mascara before, but I knew this was worth it. My number one frustration with makeup in the morning is my cheap mascara being too liquidy and sticking my lashes together to give me 6 this prongs instead of fluttery, full, separate lashes. This stuff is worth the price!

I really love this mascara it makes my lashes huge and I don't even have to curl them first! The only reason I won't give 5 stars is because after a while it does start to irritate my eyes. I do mean a while though like after 8ish hours or so. It's not really a big deal for like a regular work day but I wore this to Disney World and had to rub it off part of the way through. For an everyday use though I think it works great and makes your lashes really big.
4 stars because it melts so easily.  I feel like I am constantly having to wipe the black off under my eyes
summary: 4 stars because it melts so easily. I feel like I am constantly having to ...

reviewText:
This mascara is amazing.  When I first opened it I was initially put off because the brush was very wet and had a lot of product on it and my lashes clumped horribly after application.  But I cleaned off the brush with a lint-free cloth and all of my applications have been amazing since.  I did lose a bit of product due to cleaning the brush, but it isn't a huge deal as I rarely can get through a whole tube of mascara before it hits its expiration date or dries up anyhow.

What I love about this mascara is it seems to combine the best of a lengthening mascara and the best of a thickening mascara into one.  It both make my lashes look fuller and longer, but without making lashes stick together or become spidery.  I'm really impressed with how well it defines each lash whiles still giving additional volume.  I also like that it's not too obscene for a daytime look, but still makes my eyes pop with a more involved nighttime eye look.  It's nice to have a mascara that's versatile enough for both day and nighttime wear.

I also think it wears well.  I routinely wear this to my workout class after work and though I sweat a lot, my eye makeup still looks great.  I get a small amount of smudging under my eye, but it can easily be cleaned up and otherwise my lashes look fantastic without fading or flaking.

Love and would recommend!
summary: Best of a lengthening and thickening mascara in one

reviewText:
I change mascaras about once a month since I have a whole shoebox full of them.  This is the most recent one I grabbed.  And I am a big fan.

First off, I like the brush.  I felt like I was coating my eyelashes very well, but the shape prevented me from getting mascara all over my brow bone (this *is* a problem for poorly-shaped brushes).  So that was great.  (For reference, I generally only use mascara on my upper lashes.)

Second, it doesn't irritate my eyes.  I just got through with a Tarte mascara that became a little irritating after wearing it all day, so the lack of irritation is a relief.  (I have somewhat sensitive eyes and wear contact lenses.)  Also, for what it's worth, it lasts all day at the office for me.

Third, the appearance is quite nice.  I thought this thickened and lengthened my lashes nicely.  As with most mascaras, the name ("huge extreme") is hyperbole, but it did have a dramatic effect.  The color was a dark black, exactly what I'm looking for.

Fourth, it was not too hard to get off.  I am using Lancome Bi-Facil dual phase makeup remover right now and a bit of that on a cotton pad is all I need to remove this along with my eyeliner and eyeshadow.  If, after cleansing my face, there is a bit of mascara under my eyes, I use some micellar water on a cotton pad to take it off.  This is not such a problem with this mascara, but I've had to do so once or twice so I figured I would mention it.

Anyway, I'm happy with pretty much all aspects of the performance of this mascara.  If I didn't have about 60 others to go through, I would definitely buy this again.
summary: great appearance, nice applicator, non-irritating, easy to remove

reviewText:
TIZO Ultra Zinc Body & Face Sunscreen Non-Tinted SPF 40 Broad Spectrum is what I'm most comfortable putting on my face.  It's light and it quickly absorbs into the skin leaving a smooth and soft skin tone.  I used it on the beach this summer is loved it.

I recommend it!

Very effective face and body sunscreen. This is a Zinc based lotion that is very thick and must be worked in until the whiteness dissipates. It works for a long time and doesn't easily come off if you aren't in the water. I sweat a lot using it on my face. It's not really ideal for daily use under makeup. Tizo makes a very nice tinted sunscreen for the face (TIZO 3 Tinted Facial Mineral SPF40 Sunscreen , 1.75 oz that I suggest for daily wear.

When you get a sunscreen you really need to know if it provides the protection level that you need. I have a hard time getting that because I have sensitive skin. Tizo Ultra Body & Face Sunscreen protects my skin from the sun but doesn't adversely affect my allergies. Just what I've been looking for. Most highly recommend!

My go to facial sunscreen is made by Juice Beauty.  I was offered a chance to try TIZO and decided to give it a try.  While the Juice Beauty sunscreen is thick, the TIZO sunscreen is much runnier.  It's also more runny than the Babyganics sunscreen I used on my arms and legs.  That's not necessarily a bad thing since this product is easier to rub in than some of the thicker sunscreens.  I wore this sunscreen outside in Phoenix in August and did not get burned on my face.  I reapplied the sunscreen every two hours.  I tried to stay out of direct sunlight, but that's not always possible.  In the time I was in the sun though, my face didn't get burned.  This sunscreen didn't irritate my skin either.

While I like the TIZO sunscreen, I am going to stick with the Juice Beauty sunscreen.  The main reason being is that I can't find any information on whether TIZO products are tested on animals.  I know with the Juice Beauty products that they use ingredients that don't require animal testing and that their beauty line has been certified as cruelty-free.
summary: Good at protecting my skin in the harsh Phoenix summer

reviewText: This is waterproof sunscreen; ironically that's kind of why i don't like it. On the positive side, it's unscented, creamy, and the 40 SPF kept me from burning in triple digit weather. I hated that the sunscreen felt sticky on my hands. I kept wiping my hands on my towel, but it took awhile until it was gone. Works well but the sticky feel makes me choose other sunscreens.

This non tinted Tizo sunblock with an SPF 40 is excellent. Instead of being a chemical sunscreen, Tizo uses zinc oxide for a barrier sunscreen. Unlike many zinc oxide formulas, Tizo isn't really thick and blends quickly and easily into my skin without leaving my face white at all. Plus, it doesn't smell like sunscreen as there's no fragrance added. It's ideal too because it's a broad spectrum UVA/UVB sunscreen and water resistant. It's effective as I'm fair and have used it numerous times without getting color from direct sun exposure. Tizo doesn't feel too thick or greasy, and my skin absorbs it really well. It's just a bit heavier than my normal face cream, but it feels good to my dry skin and works well for me even when I wear makeup. I do get allergic reactions to some sunscreens but haven't had any irritation or issues with this one. I'm really pleased with this product. 5 stars.
summary: Effective Barrier Sunscreen That Absorbs Quickly Without Leaving White Residue, Feels Good And Is Fragrance Free

reviewText:
This review is for the TIZO Ultra Zinc Body and Face Sunscreen Non-Tinted SPF40, 3.5 ounce. Some of the TIZO sunscreen products get reviewed under the wrong product so I wanted to be clear what this is for.

This is the non-tinted sunscreen and is in the larger 3.5 ounce size (although that's not very big if you want to use this regularly over a large portion of your body.)

The lotion itself just feels terrific; it just glides on your body and makes your skin feel silky without feeling sticky like so many sunscreens. It's my favorite non-tinted sunscreen although it is pricey. It really does feel like it's moisturizing as well as protecting your skin from the sun.

If you like this product, I do recommend the TIZO tinted facial sunscreen (TIZO 3) and I use that a lot for my face instead of a B&B cream.

Recommended. Pricey, but a great product.
summary: A great sunscreen; will leave your skin feeling silky but not sticky

reviewText: This is a dream facial sunscreen that I also use on the back of my hands. Finally, a product I can use daily on my face. The product does not have a sunscreen odor and it goes on very smooth. I  skip using a Smashbox primer when using this product as it leaves my skin smooth enough for foundation application. There is no tint to this sunscreen. For over all body use it would be dreamy but expensive.

With red-headed children, you simply have to have good sunscreen or they are sunburned in mere minutes.  Sunscreens like TIZO with zinc oxide are the best that you can buy because the zinc oxide sits on top of the skin and forms a barrier against the sun's rays. Unlike a lot of high quality sunscreens, this one does not have an obnoxious smell and does not go on thick as glue.  You can easily and quickly rub TIZO into your skin without it feeling greasy.  It works great.

Yes, it is expensive, but I simply have to have something that can be used by my family every day.  The only negative I can see is that the instructions say to not expose it to "excessive heat and direct sun."  That means I can't just leave a tube in my car for emergencies.  I'm probably not supposed to do that with other sunscreens, but I don't remember being warned not to.

This is an excellent sunscreen that has the perfect SFP rating of 40 and goes on easy and smooth. It is very protective without feeling sticky. It is really one of the best sunscreens I have ever tried.

This TIZO Ultra Zinc is a really great facial (and body) sunscreen which works very well under my foundation, and as a moisturizing base after I wash in the morning. The TIZO feels creamy and moisturizing, but absorbs quickly and leaves my face feeling lightly dewy, but not greasy. For being a primarily Zinc vs. chemical sunscreen, this does not leave my face looking white and ghostly, nor does it interfere with the color or texture of my makeup. I really like the easy to apply texture and nearly invisible look. I always use some type of sunscreen under my foundation, and it's hard to find a product that protects yet doesn't make my face feel sticky or oily. And Zinc has always looked white. This sunscreen is a very good combination of the good features I am looking for in a facial sunscreen, and with the zinc-base I prefer.  This is a really good product that I'm pleased to use.
summary: Creamy, Moisturizing Zinc-based Sunscreen That Doesn't Leave You Ghostly Looking

reviewText:
My gold-standard test for sunscreens is to wear them while walking dogs in the super humid morning. If my sweat doesn't cause them to collect in the creases on my neck (yeah, ouch!), they must be staying in place. My favorite for my face is COTZ for Faces, which I believe is made my the same company as this, but it can be a bit too matte/dry-looking, and the titanium dioxide makes it look too obvious, too much like makeup for my neck and chest. This did not collect in my neck creases or eyelid creases, did not sting, and was invisible on my medium-toned white skin. It was dewy-looking--not greasy, rather than matte, which I find more appealing, especially on my drier-skinned neck. A win!
It's a bit thicker and more water-resistant than the Drunk Elephant Umbra lotion, which is also 20% zinc oxide, if you are curious. I think it's about the same degree of moisturizing.
summary: A great, dewy-looking sunscreen for sensitive skin and sweaty conditions, especially on neck and chest

reviewText:
Eternity is one of my favorite colognes for men and I was eager to try out the body spray as an alternative to the eau de toilette. The scent is lovely and does not start out as intense as the cologne but it lingers for hours on the skin. There is a sweetness to it but it is not overwhelming. Of course, as with any perfume, you should always try it on at a perfume counter before deciding whether to purchase it since the scent changes on the skin for each person.

I would probably prefer a roll on to a spray because I had  surprising amount of nasal irritation for a quick minute after using it. The ingredient list is fairly benign except for Isobutane and, of course, the vague proprietary 'fragrance' which tells you nothing about the ingredients at all.

Besides that, it is a lovely product and I really like that it isn't overpowering for the first 20 minutes after application like the cologne tends to be.

This deodorant smells so good! I tested it on my boyfriend. He has a job that involves a lot of moving around - so this isn't the sort of deodorant for that. Rather - this is more the type one would use on date night, when you're out to dinner and a movie. This won't combat sweat, but it will make the male in your life smell really good. I do wish that the scent would last a bit longer. If you have smelled the Eternity cologne before, that's how this deodorant smells, but it is a bit lighter in scent and does not quite last as long.

I got this for my son to use as a body spray. I don't really feel that deodorant sprays work, or maybe its just the sweaty men in my house need something more. I don't feel this would work as a heavy duty deodorant if you sweat a lot but for a body spray it works great. It smells just like Calvin Klein cologne and does seem to last throughout the day. Its not overwhelming but a nice manly scent. Perfect to spray for a pick me up or if you use an unscented deodorant.
summary: Works as a Great Body Spray

reviewText: I generally like the scent of most Calvin Klein fragrances so when I got the chance to try this Eternity Now deodorant it was a pleasant surprise.  The fragrance is very different from the classic Eternity scent, it almost has a lighter more modern aroma but still has that elegant undertone.  The Deodorant part of this spray is a bit on the weak side.  It will work for a few hours but don't expect this to take the place of a deodorant stick or true deodorant.  In my opinion this is more of a freshening  up deodorant that you can apply after a long day at work in preparation for a night or dinner out. It is similar to a lot of body sprays out there but it has a more refined (expensive) scent... of course it costs more too!!
summary: More of a Body Spray Than A Deodorant But Pricey For What You Get

reviewText: The scent is very masculine and spicy. One spray empowered the whole room for several minutes. It smells too strong to spray all over the body. It's a bit overpowering.

As a long time user of Axe body sprays, I was definitely intrigued when I saw Calvin Klein making a splash into the body deodorant marketplace that Ace has a death grip on. Eternity Now definitely has a stronger, more fragrant scent than the Axe sprays that for the most part are very light and pleasant before fading out scent wise throughout the day. The Eternity scent stays with you, mostly because he starting scent is so strong and pungent. If you like this smell, you will love the Eternity as it could almost be used as a cologne replacement as well, and in my opinion that is the niche market where this product has the opportunity to thrive. As a hybrid deodorant/cologne, this product goes from being one of the most expensive deodorants sprays on the market to being one of the cheaper designer-quality colognes. If you like pleasant, strong smelling colognes with rich undertones and you're looking to shave some money off your cologne spending, this product is worth trying out. But if you're sold on the cologne you wear that isn't overpowered by your current Axe body spray, take a pass on this offering because this spray will definitely overpower your cologne.

I got this for my husband. This is basically a designer version of Axe body spray. The bottle is bigger and contains a bit more product than Axe. Sleek can and comes with a cap to protect the nozzle. Aerosol fragrance can go on light or you can use a heavy hand. The fragrance lasts all day. Everything is as you would expect it to be.

If you are considering buying this, do so only if you already like the fragrance. If you are considering this because you like the original Eternity, know that this does not smell anything like the original Eternity. It's heavy on the patchouli, musk, and vanilla notes--reminiscent of chocolate or coffee and spices.

We liked everything about it except for the fragrance. But that is because I received this product to test and review. I was not familiar with the Eternity Now fragrance and was expecting it to be like the original Eternity fragrance (which we both like). Calvin Klein should have just named this fragrance a completely different name. Using the name Eternity is a bit misleading, IMO. If you like Eternity Now, you'll like this. But because I don't, I'm giving this product 4 stars.
summary: Nice Designer Version of Axe Body Spray--Just Don't Expect This To Smell Like Eternity

reviewText: Very refined scent, not flowery at all. And I like that this isn't overwhelming. It's a body spray, so it shouldn't be. A nice after-shower, after-gym light scent. Easy-to-use and subtle.

First off, Calvin Klein is a high quality name brand you can trust.  The packaging for this product is very nice, trim, and sleek.  Fits well on the bathroom shelf or in a drawer -- not too bulky.

It's VERY strong.  Very.  The expression "a little bit goes a long way" has never been truer than here.  However, with a body spray, you tend to want to use a little bit more because it's "all over" and not just a splash of cologne at pulse points.  This spray is certainly not something that should be used with a heavy hand...especially "all over."  Because of the strong fragrance of ginger, cedar wood, and patchouli, one could run the risk of putting too much on and causing people to run away from you.

Treat this like any other spray cologne you'd get from the store and not go heavy-handed on it like a "body spray."  If you use it sparingly, I think you'll be okay.
summary: More of a cologne than a body spray

reviewText:
The scent of this product is nice, but use care when you push on the button to use it. The product comes out in a pretty good sized spray, and it can be somewhat overwhelming. A little bit is all that's needed.

In the end, I think I would rather use cologne. This comes on strong but tapers off rather quickly. I prefer the more even scent of a good man's cologne. But for the right body chemistry, I could imagine this becoming a favorite.

Nice manly scent, not like a girly girl at all. Not too overpowering, unless you lay it thick like primer on an old Mustang coupe.

Seems to be strongest within the first 15 minutes or so. Then it becomes very subtle. Subtle to the point that she needs to be close, nuzzle close, to get a decent whiff of your manliness. Then she's all yours.
Really love the woody aroma and husky fragrance.  It smells quite exotic and masculine.  Only wish if the bottle was bigger.
summary: Really love the woody aroma and husky fragrance

reviewText:
Don't overly spray this or otherwise you will be leaving your aroma everywhere you go.  It is very overpowering if you spray too much, however used in small amounts the scent is just right.  It has a bold masculine musky aroma which is not sweet or light.

The scent will dissipate in time but it will linger on the body when you come in close proximity of it just like any body spray does.  My husband prefers using body sprays instead of colognes because it is faster and easier to use.  Also the cost of using body sprays is much cheaper than buying a bottle of cologne. and you still get the same results.

Use in fast quick sprays on wrist, chest, behind your ears - areas on your body the fragrance will last longer.  Dries quickly and remember spray too much.
summary: A little bit goes a long ways

reviewText:
This all-over spray sprays on clean and dries quickly, providing a low-key alternative to cologne. The packaging is attractive and practical for throwing in a gym bag.

Unfortunately, the scent comes across as very synthetic, rather than woodsy. Test the scent before you make an online investment.
summary: Nice Form of Scent, If You Like the Smell

reviewText:
This smells fantastic on my teenaged son, who sometimes reeks like a teenaged boy.  It does a good job of freshening him up when he's slightly stinky, but shower time is a couple of hours off.

The scent is really nice and fresh, and not overpowering.  It's a much better choice than the popular body spray for teenagers.

The one downside is that the scent doesn't seem to last very long.  My son will be keeping this in his gym bag.  He really likes it.
summary: great scent - not terribly long lasting

reviewText:
Calvin Klein's Eternity Now for Men Deodorant body spray sounded like it would be a nice, spicy, warm fragrance that would be lighter than the cologne.  It does have a lighter scent than a cologne would, but I cannot say that I appreciate it.

Upon application, it smells strongly of citrus-y ginger, with a hint of vanilla and woods.  It dries down on my skin to a synthetic citrus/ginger/artificial smell that I do not care for.  On fabric, it smells slightly better, but still synthetic.  In the air (as overspray) it smells fairly nice, if a little strong for an air freshener.

Fine if you do not mind synthetic fragrances, but for the price I expected better.
summary: Overly synthetic scent for my nose

reviewText:
This smells great on my husband. He does not like heavy cologne, or the Axe sprays, but this is perfect! It is lighter than cologne but WAY better than drugstore man sprays.

It has a spicy/citrusy vanilla hit but more masculine notes to balance it out and overall is spicier and more herbal than regular Eternity. It does not make your man smell like cookies, the vanilla is without the heavy sweetness of woman's fragrances and has lots of woodsy overtones.

This is the first body spray I have tried.  I used 2 short sprays across my chest.  It goes on with a string citrus smell, but that dries down quickly.  After that dry down I smell a pretty strong vanilla smell, combined with a spicy scent.  After a few minutes a spicy, artificial smell is left.  I honestly don't detect the smell after 5 minutes or so.  I could smell it slightly on my shirt after 10 hours of office work.

It's a nice scent, and was approved by the wife.  If anyone at work detected it they didn't say anything.

I love these body sprays. They are great for a mid day refresher or if you are going out at night and wanted to freshen up without taking another shower that day. I have used most of the Axe ones and liked them also. This one is not real strong but the scent lasts for several hours very similar to a men's cologne. I love Calvin Klein colognes and this is no exception.

A little costly but it does a great job.
Love this serum, it hydrates and plumps skin.  It is a tad sticky as most HA/B5 serums, but once you apply moisturizer it goes away. Great product and price.
summary: Excellent Serum to use after vitamin C and Retin A

reviewText: Appears to be the real deal

Eternity Now opens with a fresh, bright blossomy scent.  It reminded my wife of lemon verbena.  It dried down to a more sophisticated subtle blend of floral and oriental notes.  It does not last on her skin for more than a few hours, but after it dries down it is an inviting and warm romantic scent.  Well worth a go if you like florals and are looking for a perfume that would be suitable for an evening out.
summary: Nice dry down, sophisticated and inviting

reviewText:
This perfume spray offers a fruity floral scent that is not overpowering.  A little bit goes a long way and I can still smell the remnants of it in the morning (it smells light and refreshing).  If you like Calvin Kline scents - I think you'll also like this one.  Amazon also offers a better price than most department stores.

The 4 star rating rather than the 5 is simply due to comparison to my all-time favorite scent which is no longer on the market (Fendi).  Whereas I really like Eternity Now, it hasn't surpassed by favorite perfume and for that reason I view it as a 4 star - still a wonderful scent but not my all-time favorite.
summary: Subtle scent that lasts from morning until night

reviewText: I got this perfume for my wife and we both like the smell of it. Its fairly light and not at all overpowering. It has a fresh, floral scent. I highly recommend it.

My wife is very picky about what fragrances she wears as she's very self-consciencious about how she is perceived by others and scent plays a critical role in that regard.  Eternity Now by Calvin Klein mixes a great blend of mature rose scents but not overpowering or screaming old lady.  One gets a sense of maturity and youth when exposed to Eternity Now and that's a great blend for any woman over 18 but doesn't want to be mistaken for someone raiding grandma's perfume cabinet.

Truth be told, my lady has worn Eternity Now for every big event of the past few months from her recent job interview (she starts that new job today, BTW), and all photography shoots she works on.  She really loves it and I think any woman that wants a touch of youth and maturity will too!
summary: Youthful Maturity, an Excellent Blend that Doesn't Scream Vintage

reviewText:
I love this scent.  Scent information is really hard to portray in a review as a smell can be different for each person, but what I can share is this is my current "date night" perfume for when hubby and I go out somewhere nice.

The scent is more luxury and exotic floral scent to me (I don't really smell the fruity, and a little bit goes a long way.

The bottle is pretty and is a very nice size.  The bottle itself is a weighted glass with rounded corners.  It is very feminine with the pink toned perfume liquid. It comes inside a box that is sealed with an outer plastic wrap.
Floral and fruity smell that is not overpowering and that is great for the summer. My wife likes that it is pleasant and light scent for the day.
summary: Floral and fruity smell that is light and pleasant for the summer or any season

reviewText: I love this perfume! The reviews don't lie. It really is a lovely, floral sent that isn't overpowering. A lot of perfumes that I've used fade too quickly and don't leave a lasting smell until the end of the day, but this perfume really does a lovely job. It's just strong enough to be able to smell it, but no so strong that you get sick of it or leave a trail letting everybody know somebody with too much perfume just wafted in. I've always enjoyed Calvin Klein perfumes and this one is no exception. Considering how long these last, I think it's definitely worth the price!
summary: Long lasting but not over powering! Love it!

reviewText: To judge a perfume is such a subjective thing..but I can say what I think this smells like.  At first I got a fresh melon that seemed sporty.  After a while it melts into sweet floral.  Then after it mellowed, it was a really nice floral, toned down, with something heavier being smelled also.  It really does get better after wearing a while.  I have no idea what neroli smells like but peonies are super sweet fragrant and that and the peach blossoms could be the floral I'm picking up.  This really has a wonderful smell after it mellows..on me anyway, and I wear day or night.

I love the scent of Calvin Klein Eternity Now.  To me, it smells almost powdery with a light floral note on the end.  I've been getting lots of compliments on it.  I find that it is not overpowering at all yet it lasts all day.  I am very sensitive to scents and too much floral will have me sneezing all day - however, I have not sneezed once with this.  It is very light and clean.  Highly recommend.
summary: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eae de Parfum Spray

reviewText: Very strong at first, but then mellows out nicely. This Parfum Spray from Calvin Klein has a predominant floral scent that just smells like summer time. This is not my favorite from Calvin Klein for women, but he doesn't make any that aren't good if you are failure with his perfume line. Eternity for men is one of my favorites and this has just a hint of that scent as an undertone.
Very pleasant smell, CK has done a good job with this scent!  I like floral/fruity scents  for my wife and this one hits the spot.
summary: CK has done a good job with this scent

reviewText:
Calvin Klein has always been one of my few favorite brands for fragrance. I particularly like Eternity that came out many years ago. The floral scent is classic and long lasting. Now came Eternity Now and it doesn't disappoint.

Eternity Now has a light fruity and addictive floral scent. I initially found it a tad strong on the first spritz.  A somewhat sweet fruity note which subsequently opens up to a floral bouquet, and finally ends with a cashmere and musk. The scent is surprisingly long lasting. I could still smell a hint of the perfume at the end of the day.

The perfume comes in a hefty glass bottle with a beefy, silver and transparent acrylic top. Just one spray is enough to last the whole day. A little really goes a long way.
summary: A long-lasting, addictive floral perfume with a fruity first note

reviewText: This is really nice smelling perfume. Long lasting as well!  I spray in the morning and I can still smell that evening which doesn't happen with my skin type. Usually the perfume absorbs really fast but not this fragrance-  I have been exploring a lot more with fragrances and this is my new favorite scent! A little goes a long way as well !
Love CK fragrances.  This one is flowery and elegant.  It seems to last through the night.  Definitely a pleasing scent of you love flowers.

I have to give them credit for keeping this very light. It's a nice somewhat flowery scent that isn't overbearing. Definitely has the potential to make a nice gift. I also like that they didn't go too far overboard with the design of the bottle. It looks good in a confident way, rather than some of the really over-the-top bottles I've seen for perfume that left me wondering how much of the money was just going to cover the bottle and convince me it was something I wanted to look at on a dresser.
summary: It's a nice somewhat flowery scent that isn't overbearing

reviewText:
Since my husband is a big Calvin Klein user-Obsession, Nautica, Eternity for Men- I thought I would give this scent for women a try.
First, this is my first bottle of CK and I appreciate the fact that it is a pretty but not odd shaped bottle. The rectangular shape fits on my make-up counter without taking up too much space.
Second, the scent is a bit citrusy and floral but not over powering.  I don't like scents that smell like my Aunt Florida and/or scents you smell before Aunt Florida walks in the room.
I sprayed one short spray on each wrist and one on my collar bone and it lasted for hours. I asked my husband if he smelled it while sitting across the table-no- but he did smell it while we were both sitting in the car.  He did like it and said it wasn't "too" perfumey.  Nice scent

I think it's funny how everyone can experience the same perfume so differently! I really like it, the scent is clean and floral and I don't get any "musk" from it (which is good because I hate musk). I don't spray perfume on my skin, I prefer to spray it into the air in front of me and run through it. It makes my husband laugh, but that's how I keep from getting too much perfume on. I actually find that the scent doesn't last more than a couple of hours, so I find myself running through it again if we are going out in the evening.
summary: light scent for a young woman

reviewText:
Calvin Klein Eternity and Eternity Aqua are in my favorite perfumes collection. Aqua is perfect for summer time and Eternity Original is a classic that has stood the test of time.

Eternity Now is the latest in the Eternity collection. Like other Eternity fragrances it is on the softer side of fragrances but is quite long lasting unlike some other Calvin Klein fragrances like Reveal. It opens up with a floral and fruity bouquet and dries down to the seductive musk and cashmere. It is more flowery to my nose in the beginning and I can smell the peach blossom, although the top note is supposed to be Lychee. It's a nice floral which has a younger woman feel to it, but not too young.

The opening notes almost had me disliking the fragrance as it smelled too sweet but the drydown is nice. I am going to try it some more and give my final opinion. Here is a breakdown of the notes:
Top Notes - Lychee, Quince sorbet
Heart Notes - Peony, Peach blossom, Neroli
Base notes - Cashmere woods, Ambrox, Musk

Overall, I like this fragrance, I am going to use it a lot more in the summer as it smells more fresh and juicy to me - the spirit of Summer. However, it can be a mood booster on dark winter days.
summary: Floral and juicy, with a seductive dry down, light but long lasting.

reviewText: I tend to go for very feminine, floral fragrances and Lacoste Pour Elle Natural is in this zone.  It smells like a flower bouquet without trending too "old lady."  That said, I don't think it is the most complex or unusual smelling fragrance.  I don't detect the fruitier coconut or raspberry notes noted, mostly just floral.  I do like that the fragrance settles in well to my skin and mixes well with my natural scent, but over time I also find it smells a little one note.  Where as with some fragrances (Tokyo Milk Dark in particular) I find I smells something a little different every time I inhale.  This just smells...the same.  It's certainly wearable and inoffensive, but doesn't stand out.  I also think I prefer my previous go-to floral fragrance, Vera Wang Lovestruck, over this.  It's ok, but not a standout for me.
summary: Floral, but not unusual or complex

reviewText: When it first comes out of the bottle, the perfume smells strongly of alcohol and reminds me of cheap perfume, but then it gets subtler and you're left with a light, fresh scent. It's OK but kind of bland. It comes in a rather plain minty glass bottle with the Lacoste logo on it - an alligator patch. If I didn't know it was "for women" I would have sworn it was a bottle of cologne for a guy. Overall it's OK but the scent is not particularly interesting.
summary: Light, Fresh Scent - OK, But Nothing Special

reviewText:
Oddly, this doesn't particularly smell like rose, raspberry, or coconut, and the overall scent comes across as more floral (not so much rose as gardenia and others) and extremely sweet, rather than fruity, as many of the ingredients might suggest. If you like very sweet and floral, you might like this.

For my tastes, it is too sweet and heavy, not very light or fresh. But once again, for those who like heavy, strong florals with some fruity notes, this will work.
summary: Heavy, strong, sweet, more floral than fruity

reviewText: At first, I smelled this and thought, no way! It smells very old lady floral at first. But as it settled in, you can smell something sweet in it, which makes it more of a youthful smell. It ends up being a really nice fresh feminine scent. A little does go a long way, though. But definitely a nice fragrance.

Lacoste's Pour Elle perfume has a strong floral smell that reminds both my spouse and me of our grandmothers.  The fragrance is sweet and very feminine.  Obviously the smell of a fragrance is a very personal thing, mind you.  Therefore, if you love floral scents and prefer them strong, you will probably appreciate this perfume.  To me, however, it comes off as smelling a bit "cheap".

A little bit of it goes a long way.  One spritz lasts a few hours before it starts to dissipate.

The packaging and bottle are quite nice and will make a wonderful gift presentation.  A nice touch is the small alligator patch that is affixed to the glass bottle.

All in all... floral fragrance that feels "old".
summary: A bit too strong, and it reminds me of my grandmother.

reviewText:
I've really been enjoying this scent, and I find myself reaching for it more often than some perfumes I usually use (like Juicy Couture)  A friend of mine said she liked the scent, and every time she smells it, she comments on it and says it's "very distinctive."

While I agree that it has its own unique (and not too overpowering) scent it's hard to pin down exactly what it smells like. The scent is described as "rose, raspberry and coconut" but I swear I smelled vanilla. Also, I definitely smell flowers, but I don't really pick up on any raspberry. Some of my favorite perfumes are fruity, so that's a bit of a disappointment.

Nevertheless, this has become one of my current favorites for when I want a scent that's strong while not being too overwhelming.

This scent is very refreshing, clean, and reminiscent of the 90s hits such as Clinque Happy or the recent reboot of Calvin Klein's CK2. Millennials will like this scent, I think. It's a summery, day time scent with floral and citrus notes. An aquatic aspect as well. I would definitely expect it to be more of a young adult targeted scent. Not a very mature scent, very youthful.

The bottle is large and pretty, I love the color and the clear appearance. The classic Lacoste alligator adorns the front, just like on the shirts. It's a real embroidered applique!

My only criticism of this scent? It does not last long. At all. Like, I've had scents that didn't have great longevity before, but nothing like this. It fades very quickly. But the way some teenagers bathe themselves in scent...not sure that's a bad thing. It does last longer on clothing than skin (as usual). But the longevity, or lack thereof, is this scent's weakest aspect.
summary: Reminiscent of 90s hits Millennials love, lacks longevity.

reviewText:
I really like the sweet smell of this perfume. The description says that it is wild roses and raspberry enveloped in coconut. Some people say that they think it smells flowery. To me it smells more fruity. It doesn't smell like raspberry or coconut. To me, it smells more like a sweet citrus. My Husband said that he thinks it smells like "citrusy flowers". Regardless, we both like the smell. I read a comment that says it smells like grandmas. I don't think it does at all. I am 32 and I have worn it several days. I have asked the opinion of several others and none of my family or friends think it smells bad.

The bottle is really nice and it is a large size. It will certainly last me for years even with using it regularly. The perfume sprays out an appropriate amount and functions as expected. I do wish the perfume lasted a little longer. I feel like it fades a little fast. This isn't my favorite perfume that I own, but I do like it a lot and will use it regularly. I personally recommend it.

I love the scent of perfume, but I'm always scared to try new ones afraid that it will smell like an old lady or just plain stink.  I was initially worried about it smelling too "old ladyish".  It wasn't at all.  I love it.  It is a nice scent without being too overwhelming.  It seems to last pretty well through the day at work and church.  I'm really happy with it and would purchase it again.

I like the Lacoste Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette Spray, but scent is personal.

Im told by my psychologist husband that women tend to have more a more keen sense of smell than most men.  At least thats the case in our marriage.  I can locate the rose, raspberry, and coconut notes; he just smells floral.

Id like a bit less coconut if truth is told.  But I enjoy the light fragrance, though I do wish it were a bit less sweet.

This is a simple, unsophisticated scent.  Its not dramatic and fails to enter a room with bells and whistles.  Its soft, floral, and a bit sweet, and suitable for daytime wear.
summary: Soft, floral, and a bit sweet....

reviewText:
The description for the scent says rose and raspberry with a hint of coconut - maybe my olfactory senses aren't quite up to snuff because I really can't discern any of those notes. The "Natural" just smells like a generically sort of sweet, floral, scent to me. I can see people calling the sweet notes a rose, but it's like an artificial rose. The raspberry I can't find at all, but I tend to think of raspberries are more tart - and I can't find that sort of smell anywhere. The coconut I can sort of agree on, but more in a subtle sweetened coconut water sort of way, definitely not the meat.

I'd say that the scent goes on rather powerfully, but mellows very quickly. When outdoors, I could barely smell it after an hour in the sun - but that may be due to this being an eau de toilette instead of parfume. The closest scent I can say this reminds me of is probably Davidoff's Cool Water.
summary: A sweeter scent, goes on very strong, but mellows quickly

reviewText: I really like the light clean floral smell.  I normally feel that rose is a more "mature" scent, but this is light and fresh, I can detect a slight fruitiness in it but not really any coconut. I think this can easily be worn everyday. The bottle is a pretty teal color looks nice on the dresser as well.  Overall a nice product.

I think this is a really great scent for those who enjoy what I would classify as "clean" or "fresh" smells. It is quite potent and long-lasting....you definitely don't want to overdo the spritzing or you will regret it later.

There is something in this that seems to remind me of the Jennifer Aniston perfume in a good way. I like both.

A fun note for those who like to collect bottles: the alligator is actually stitched.

This is perhaps the nicest Lacoste fragrance I've sampled to date. The scent is light, fresh, floral, and slightly sweet. The sweetness tames down quite a bit after dry down, leaving a wonderful fragrance on the skin that lasts for hours, and stays close to the skin. This isn't one of those powerhouse fragrances you smell from across the room with one mist, nor should it be. This is a delicate, intimate fragrance to be enjoyed only by those you allow into your personal space. This fragrance is as suitable for the office as it is for evenings out.

My wife likes this Lacoste "Pour Elle Sparkling Eau".  She tells me the scent is a little strong but does fade over time.  The actual scent she likes and so do I - slightly flowery jasmine scent with a bit of spiciness.  Certainly not a generic scent - somewhat unique.

The actual bottle is also attractive/ elegant looking with high quality build and of course the cool Lacoste alligator on it.
