We have the 3 ounce bottle which is pretty large - at current price of $76 on Amazon it certainly appears reasonable price for a nice perfume and large size.  Tip:  I did see some lower sale prices on the 3 ounce bottle via google search (one sub-$50).  Tip2:  if you're not sure - get the smaller size bottle for less $$.  Overall 4-STAR rating from me in consideration of price/value.
summary: Certainly not a generic scent - somewhat unique...

reviewText: This is a slightly sweet and floral scent that I find very attractive but not overpowering. I do notice that it fades away pretty quickly and by the end of the day, there is no trace of it on my skin at all. For this reason, I decided to take a star off.

This scent is a very nice balance of floral with fruit undertones.  It is light but smells elegant and expensive.  The bottle is simple but still conveys a rich feel and even the "Lacoste" alligator is done in a subtle way.  The only real downside to this fragrance is that it really does not last more than a few hours.  It becomes extremely light by the end of the day so this is not something you can wear and expect to last even half a workday.  Overall this is a great scent but if it lasted longer it would be 5 stars.
summary: Very Nicely Balanced Floral Scent With Fruit Undertones But Does Not Last

reviewText: When I sprayed this Eau de Toilette on my wrists I could smell something very sweet and kind of nice.  I think this smells complicated and interesting. Different.  I thought of bubble gum right away.  It is fascinating to me that this has patchouli, jasmine and french macaroons.  No bubble gum, but I'm not so far off really am I?  I fel like this is very nice, and that I will enjoy wearing it.  This is fun. Since this is not perfume the smell only lasts a day, but it is a wonderful smell if you like slightly psicy sweet stuff.  I recommend this for girly girls.

This is a very subtle water based perfume that is perfect for going out but won't last more than a few hours.  The scent is is more flowery and less citrusy and we really like it.  The bottle is very aesthetically pleasing  and at first I thought the cloth Icoste was logo was a bit strange on a glass bottle but it's actually quite striking.  This would make a great gift for a younger wearer who is in to trendy things.

This sweet fruity scent is not overly strong.  It gives you a hint of fragrence without wafting someone who is standing in your vicinity.  I was wearing DKNY Delicious prior to this. That scent is a little too strong for me and more floral smelling. My husband bought it for me. This scent is something that I will not  grow tired of quickly because of the subtle smell. It does not last through the day, but few perfumes, in my experience,  do last for more than a few hours. Overall, I like this soft scent.

Really like this scent.  It's subtle and light while still having somewhat of a punch.  It reminds me as a less powerful Gucci Rush in the spice/essence of it, but at the same time it has a sweet flowery scent.  I think this would be a good day scent as well as an evening scent.  My daughter loves the smell and wearing it as well as my wife.  A solid all year round do almost anything scent.  The bottle is pretty cool as well, the signature Lacoste logo is the same appliqu style, but glued on the bottle.

I love the packaging with the pink tinted can't cologne and the green bodied and red mouthed alligator.  The clear yellowish/pink (it's actually pink but the gold toned pump underneath tints it yellow) snap on top is stylish as well as easy to take off and put back on.  It came packaged in a nice box covered in clear cellophane which makes it nice for gift giving.

Unfortunately I didn't love the scent.  There's nothing inherently wrong with and to be fair I'm overly sensitive to smell.  It reads to me as mostly floral and I'd describe it as bright and upbeat.  I think it would be a good daytime fragrance.  I put a very small amount on and it's lasting a long time.  The only reason I'm giving it three stars rather than four is because I don't love the scent.

UPDATE:  After wearing this scent for a few more days I like it better so I changed my three star rating to four stars.  I've noticed that some reviewers feel the scent fades quickly however that wasn't my experience.  Within an hour of first putting it on it tones down but it's still in the background just the way I most enjoy fragrances.  Others may not smell it distinctly unless they're very near you but you will sense it as a constant.

Buying a perfume for someone is always tricky, what might seem good to you might not work for the other person. This perfume though is of the subtle kind and has a very nice fruity/floral smell to it. It's not strong so that way it won't be an olfactory nuisance to anyone and wears off soon so you don't have to worry too much about it.

It comes in a simple package and the bottle is very nice. As you can imagine, it's for the ladies and the pink touch goes a long way to establish that. The smell also conveys the same and is the type that will be enjoyed by most ladies. It's a bit pricy for about 100 mL but overall you do get a quality product.

I've never purchased anything from Lacoste before, so this product was totally new to me.

Perfume is a totally personal thing, it can react differently on different people.  Unless it's a scent you are familiar with, it might be something you would want to smell in person, before purchasing it.  It might be a scent you like, or you may not like it, especially if you have allergies or asthma.  I have both.

I like the pretty pink color on both the bottle and the box.  The box is a little hard to read when I was trying to see where the product is made. because the print is white, so I kind of had to tilt it to read it.  This perfume is made in the UK

Now on to the scent, which to me is kind of hard to describe.  It's kind of spicy, sweet, and powdery.  One of the ingredients in the description is macaroons, which I find kind of odd in a description for a perfume.  It is the color of a pink macaroon tho.

The scent is kind of strong, at least to me, at first, but then the scent tames down.  It must be water based and not oil based, because the scent doesn't last more than a few hours.

It's an ok scent, it's not a perfume I would have purchased had I been able to smell it first.  There is nothing wrong with the scent, it's just not the kind of scent I prefer.  You may feel otherwise.  I tend to like clean, citrusy scents, more than flower scents, which to me can smell too sweet, which gives me a headache.

Like I said, scent is a very personal thing.

The Lacoste fragrance Sparkling is one of a trio of light scents that appear to be marketed towards younger women but I personally enjoy this simple layered fragrance which is neither cloying nor pungent. I first get citrus hints followed by vanilla and, unlike some people, I apply the scent but do not rub it into my skin. The bottle is about the same size and shape of another Lacoste fragrance for men that I have but the bottle color is a shade lighter than my Lacoste Pink bottle. As with any fragrance or cosmetic, I recommend testing in a brick and mortar store prior to purchasing online and oftentimes you are able to obtain a sample to try for a couple days. This is a very suitable sent for hot weather, moreso than a winter fragrance which I prefer to be less in the citrus family.

I've always been a fan of Lacoste fragrances. They are unique, often pleasantly trendy, stand out from the crowd, and offer a good variety of scents for both male and female customers. Reviewing a fragrance, however, is a challenging task because of the nature of the product. One's preference of any given fragrance over another is very subjective matter. The same product often wears/smells very differently on two individuals. Having said that...

My teenage daughter absolutely loved the sweet, flowery, playful fragrance of Lacoste L12.12. It stays consistent from the moment you spray it on and leaves a light, mellow trace. It does have noticeable plant/flower base with a light touch of powdery scent and candy. My wife however, didn't care of it. Personally, I prefer more pronounced fragrances with a touch of citrus. Overall, if you prefer this particular family of perfume/eau de toilette, you're most likely going to love it. You can't ever go wrong with Lacoste.

I do not wear perfume. I haven't since Clinique "Happy" came out back in the 90's . I make my own now, out of essential oils/coconut oil and I have been super happy with that for a decade. Lacoste Sparkling Eau de Toilette .....is a game changer. OH I remember Lacoste back in the 80's, my preppy older sister used to wear the clothing and I used to make fun of her. I thought I would maybe like this, because of its supposed scents: French Macaroons, Jasmine, Patchouli..Fruity. I actually really love it, and I love how it is not so strong that you regret even spraying it anywhere near you. You aren't supposed to smell like a whorehouse, you are supposed to have a subtle scent about you like a breeze over a flower garden.

My dad used to travel to France for business when I was little... and we would have new "alligator" polos every time! I was very pleased to see the new cloth/embroidered alligator on this beautiful bottle of perfume. The top is sturdy and the spray very misty. And the smell is wonderful. I am very pleased.

This is a good fragrance for a young woman or teenager.  It opens with a cotton candy scent that moves into apples, berries & spice.  The patchouli is just a backing note & keeps it from being completely sweet.  It stays fresh & sweet/clean smelling.

Longevity is short, lasting less than 3 hours on my skin.

It is a well made version of a young, sweet gourmand that I think many teens will like.

Its got a nice scent that really doesn't last too long. That's not a bad thing. I don't like overpowering and strong scents. Its got hints of Jasmine and Patchouli of which I love both. I would have given it a 5 star rating until I saw the retail price. It's not what I would have or like to pay for this. Its more of a casual scent.
summary: Lacoste L.12.12 Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette Spray

reviewText:
I love this, its just what I want in a perfume, light, floral, and fresh.  It's not too sweet or strong.

It does fade to a nice subtle beautiful scent thats still detectable six hours later.

The only perfume I regularly wore was Lovely by Sarah Jessica Parker of which this reminds me.  Id been searching for a new scent for a while, this maybe it.

I must have got a deal on Amazon when I bought a four pack of these: Black, Blue, Pink + Dark Pink.

i cannot recommend these enough. I am addicted to washing my face with these. These clothes with water alone remove ALL makeup. Even mascara. No more rubbing at the delicate skin under my eyes. Just a gentle swipe and off it comes.

I give whichever one I'm using a periodic swish in the sink with some Woolite + then just hang them to dry. Amazing. What a revelation using these clothes has been for me. I'll never go back to a regular washcloth on my face + neck.

It does take off a lot of the makeup but not nearly well enough to only use this.
I had a full face on when I used this. I decided I wanted to see how much it actually got off. I used a face wipe and there was still plenty of makeup left. I washed my face on top of that just to be on the safe side.
I use this when I have no wipes, which comes in handy. But I still always was my face after.

I was really excited to try this product because as soon as it came on the market, I thought it was the coolest thing ever. Unfortunately, it was a bit of a disappointment for me. It did remove a lot of my makeup, but a lot was also left behind and it didn't seem any different than using just a regular wet towel. Visit my blog at christinaschiccorner.com to read my more detailed review I posted about it.
no more maraca stains on my good bathroom towels.

Where else can you get a furry washcloth that will leave fuzz all over your face? Nope. Do not get this. You would do better with plain cotton muslin cloths you can buy on here in a 10-pack that are MUCH cheaper and way more effective. I hate this thing. The size is awkward, it doesn't get off mascara (of ANY type) or eyeliner, and despite washing it per the instructions, it fuzzed me all over my face. Blech. Save yo' money, honey.
Yes this worked, but you really have to pull and scrub at your skin. Which causes wrinkles. I set it aside and will only use it in a pinch if I run out of makeup remover.

Great product I love it! It's so soft on my face and I love the fact I can re use it and I am not using chemicals on my face which is great! I wear make up every day and this does take off my mascara eyeshadow  and concealer! I'm not sure how it works but it works!!
I rarely give 5 star reviews but my girlfriend won't shut up about this thing. She said its like magic. She couldn't be happier with it. This would be great as a stocking stuffer
good product
Love this..... I use it all week to remove my eye make up before washing it. No chemical is needed just use water.

It does clean but it rolls in your hand and is kind of awkward to use.  And I did not really feel my face was clean so I used a cleanser after.  However, I will use for times when I do not want to go full out and wash my face (i.e. late afternoon or late night).

So I was a bit skeptical at first. But one night I decided to put some makeup on my hand, I figured if I could get it off my hand with no problem than I could get it off my face with my problem. I was right. The makeup just came off my hand with a few swipes. Just add water.

Update 4/19/15: This past weekend I had a chance to use the makeup eraser again. I put my makeup on Friday evening around 6pm and didn't take it off until 4 am on Saturday. I was exhausted but my makeup melted off with the water and the eraser. My entire routine( makeup removal, face wash, night cream) took less than 5 minutes. Normally I would soak my face in oil to remove the Makeup and then wash it a few times to make sure all the oil and makeup was off. This thing is a life and time saver. Even my waterproof mascara came off. I use an electric skincare brush to wash my face and there was NO makeup on the brush. My skin felt amazing. $20 for a magic cloth to remove makeup...you can't beat that.

My teen daughter is very pleased with this product. She has seen definite improvement in less than a week. The Vichy Normaderm Beautifying Anti-Acne Care Treatment, 0.2 fl. oz. is not harsh and and it feels creamy and smooth. She applies it at bedtime and in the morning. If she is happy, mom is happy.
It is very drying, and that is the only difference I see in my skin texture since using this.
summary: Going back to my old brand

reviewText:
This product has a light scent to it.  It smells better than most acne lotions; it is slightly perfumed.
The packaging is great.  It has a pump dispenser that is very easy to use and it dispenses a perfect amount.
It feels more like moisturizer going on than acne cream.  It's more of a lotion than a cream, and it glides on, leaving skin feeling quite silky.  I'm sure it's the dimethicone in it, which always does feel nice, but which usually I prefer to avoid.  It is widely considered a very safe ingredient, but I find it can cause some rebound dryness, which, in a product like this, might be a good side effect for some.
The active ingredient is salicylic acid, 1.5% which is found in a lot of anti-acne products.  I do like that it has been doing a great job of keeping my skin from shining.  With the season change, my skin has been especially oily, and using this product, my skin has stayed looking healthy and fairly matte.  If you've used Smashbox's PhotoPrimer, it leaves skin looking and feeling similiar.
It says to use it 2-3 times a day.  After I applied it twice, without any makeup on, or other skincare products, I did get some piling.  It works much better to wash my face before each application.  The directions do say to do that, but I, being me, sometimes have to figure things out for myself.  With clean skin, there's no piling problem.
I've had a smattering of small tiny zits- like I sprayed something on my face that didn't quite agree with it?  After starting to use this, the area quit spreading, and in 3 days, it was completely cleared.

I'm rating this a 5, forgiving it for the dimethicone, because I love the way it makes my skin look - it really minimizes and blurs pores and gives skin such a nice matte look.  I've bought cosmetic products that have a similar effect, and they are priced much higher for a smaller amount, and don't have the acne fighting benefit.
summary: Minimizes and blurs pores, gives skin a nice matte look - but note it does have dimethicone and fragrance in it

reviewText:
The Vichy Normaderm Beautifying Anti-Acne Care Treatment lotion is fantastic. It started working immediately and I love the texture. My skin is responding to it in ways it hasn't with other anti-acne lotions. I also like the packaging: It comes with a pump that delivers just the right amount of product.

This lotion is a keeper!

This anti-acne lotion contains 1.5% salicylic acid.  As far as acne medicines go, that is no big deal. You can find it in all sorts of brands.  It's good for keeping mild acne at bay but will probably do nothing for more severe cases. What makes this a bit different is its moisturizing properties.

The lotion is very light, absorbs easily, and makes the skin soft without being greasy.  I would not have needed this when I was younger and gushing oil, but I like it now that I'm older (with acne) and my cheeks get drier.

I love the scent!  Kind of beachy.

This a nice moisturizing lotion with a non-drying moisturizer. This comes in a small bottle with an effective pump. The lotion is thin and bluish. It goes on very easily and has an immediate cooling effect. It is terrific as a base layer under foundation. There is a scent, sort of menthol. It does not linger.

Salicylic acid is an effective blemish fighter for me and this seems to work as well as any. The real plus here is the lotion which smooths and evens completion flaws. I like it quite a bit overall. The price point is a bit high for a product I could easily go through in a week or two. However I think it is effective and useful. I am a fan of Vichy products and this is another good one.
summary: Salicylic acid in a moisturizing base. Cooling.

reviewText: amazing product! cleared acne, left my skin smooth, not irritating at all, even my super sensitive skin!

I should have paid more attention before I ordered this. The key ingredient in this is salicylic acid, which I've never found to be particularly game-changing when it comes to my acne. And at only 1.5%, it's not a very strong salicylic acid either. The first ingredient is water, but the second is dimethicone. Dimethicone is a type of silicone, and creates a layer ontop of the skin that can fill and smooth the look of pores, wrinkles, etc. While this can be a desirable feature in a makeup primer, I find it odd to see in an acne treatment. I also don't really like that the format for delivering the salicylic acid is a "lotion". I already apply lotion with SPF on my face everyday, so I don't really want to layer several lotions on my oily/acne prone skin. If this had SPF in it, then I might consider making it my only lotion, however it does not, and not using SPF isn't an option. Overall, I think this is an "ok" product, but just not right for my particular skin needs. I find my acne tends to respond better to tea tree oil and sulfur products, such as Nelsons: Pure & Clear Acne Treatment Gel, 1 oz and Earth's Care Acne Spot Treatment, 0.97 Ounce
summary: It's alright, but not a keeper

reviewText:
After a little over 2 weeks of using this product morning and night, I haven't seen any benefits to my oily skin compared to using no products. So, it hasn't irritated my skin, but it hasn't helped with blemishes, either.

It does leave a smooth finish and works well as a primer under makeup. I like the fragrance although I generally avoid fragrance as a potential irritant.

I will look for products that do a better job keeping my skin clear. As a lightweight moisturizer or primer, this is ok but other products might be better suited.
summary: No help for oily skin, but had some benefits

reviewText: So far, so good with this product. We have been using it for about 2 weeks and it really has helped our complexions. My daughter is 13 and is starting to get slight acne in her oily zones, her forehead and cheeks. She uses this after she washes her face at night. It has decreased the amount of tiny bumps along her cheeks and hairline. Im hoping with continued use that it will clear her skin completely and prevent future bumps. Her skin reacts to different products and makeup and this product was gentle enough to cause no flare ups, reddening or itching. I also tried it on my cheeks where I ve been developing milkspots and my skin is also improving, I will continue to use this product as long as our skin continues to clear up.

I have used this for about a week now and I have seen some improvement in my complextion. I think with these products you have to try them over time to really get a good idea of how they will work in the long run. The bottle is very small but you do not need much to rub into your skin. Keep out of your eyes though. Goes on well and washes off just as well. It is a blue creamy light cream with a fresh scent. Active ingredient is salicylic acid 1.5% (hard to read without a magnifying glass). The directions are in very fine print.
summary: ACNE TREATMENT IN A BLUE FRESH CREAM

reviewText: Research indicates that salicylic acid is an optimal ingredient for an acne face wash, and you can find similar products without looking too hard. What sets Vichy apart is the added hydrating effect -- nothing like suffering with dry skin on top of the acne -- and an inoffensive fragrance. It's too soon to see whether regular use will produce lasting results, and this is a product designed for mild acne, but so far I prefer it to the Paula product. Minus one star for price, but if it does the job in the long term, it's worth every cent.
summary: Effective wash with a clean scent

reviewText: I had been using proactiv moisturizer and spot treatment to control my mild HRT triggered acne but I was still plagued by recuring breakouts in the same  2 areas along with red marks that lingered long after the bumps had healed.  So, I decided to give this a try since I have been pleased with other products by this brand.  After 2 days the red marks were noticeably lighter and now after about a week, they are gone.  I haven't seen any dryness, flakes or irritation.  I was amazed that this one product did a better job than the two proactiv products I've been using for months.
summary: Fantastic for my HRT related acne

reviewText:
For context, I've struggled with acne on and off since my teens.  Thanks to two or rounds of accutane I am mostly clear, but get the occasional cystic acne breakout on my face (1-2 at a time).  Because of that I've always struggled with what to use because so many over the counter products seem too harsh to justify with only the occasional (but still very painful) breakouts.  Putting this on I like how light weight it felt and how quickly it absorbed into my skin.  I'm very picky about how products feel on my skin and hate anything that leaves my skin feeling sticky or as if there is a residue hanging around on top, but I didn't notice that here.  That said, it's DEFINITELY drying.  After a couple of weeks of using this I noticed my skin felt dryer than it otherwise would have were this not in my routine.  I've tried to balance it out by using other skincare products for hydration like face oils (sound like they wouldn't be well suited for acne-prone skin but I've had great results) and hydrating masks.  I've also been using prescription topicals for acne on and off for years so I understand most products for acne-prone skin also lead to some dryness.  All that is fine but the biggest reason I won't be using this again is I just don't see many noticeable benefits for my skin.  I suspect in general my skin may not respond to salicylic acid and it's no different with this product.  My advice would be if you've tried other salicylic acid-based products before and haven't seen results this one may not be any different for you either since it is the active ingredient.

If you're someone who responds well to salicylic acid I do think this is a good product as it seems less drying than other salicylic acid-based products, but if it generally doesn't work for you, I'd take a pass
summary: Feels nice on skin, but didn't notice results

reviewText: I really wanted to like this product, but at the end of the day I couldn't use it. While it wasn't harsh as some similar ones are, something about putting it on and then following up with my regular moisturizer caused the combination of the two to pill together. Every time I touched my face I always came away with a roll of white stuff. Yuck!

I've tried other similar products where the main ingredient is Salicylic acid, this Vichy Normaderm Beautifying anti-acne care 24 hour Hydrating Lotion Salicylic Acid Acne Treatment contains 1.5 % Salicylic Acid, but unlike other similar products this smells fresh and is not too harsh to your skin.  It goes on easily and feels light on your skin.

You are supposed to wash your face thoroughly before applying a thin layer one to three times daily.  Iam only using this once per day, because products with salicylic acid can irritate your skin.

I like this product because it doesn't leave your skin feeling dried out.  I only get the occasional blemish, more as the weather gets warmer my skin seems to get more oilier, versus in the colder weather where my skin tends to get drier, so I need to use different skincare depending on the weather/season.

This will work great to keep acne at bay, or when I get the occasional blemish.  This product is suitable for sensitive skin.  Like other Vichy products, this one too is made in France.
summary: Not As Harsh As Similar Products

reviewText: I have yet to find a Vichy product I don't love, and this anti-acne lotion is no exception. It does not dry out my skin as many acne medicines have, but instead leaves it smooth and moisturised. I live the fact the bottle has a pump, giving you more control over how much to use. And the scent is wonderful - very clean and fresh. Vichy products may be a bit higher than others, but I always get a high quality beauty product that works exactly as it claims.

I've always had fairly clear skin, but I do get an occasional pimple or a rash of blackheads. This light and silky lotion goes n easily and contains 1.5% salicylic acid. This is fairly typical of most acne medications and will zap the offensive stuff both quickly and efficiently. The real gift here is the lotion base which is applied to clean and dry skin. It absorbs quickly and reminds me of a liquid silk. It moisturizes and replenishes the skin and gives it a luminous quality and also seems to tighten the skin.
This zaps the heck out of the bad stuff while leaving the skin looking softer, tighter, and radiant. This is an extremely good product with nothing  but positive end results that make me look better.
summary: Great For Aging Skin Prone To Outbreaks

reviewText: This goes on smoothly and hasn't irritated my sensitive skin. It does work toward keeping the the acne at bay - I break out less. As expected, it is drying but there is also a moisturizing agent in there so it isn't completely dried out.  1.5%  salicylic acid is a good amount - not too much and not too harsh.

Vichy is a great brand. I have tried body lotion by them and love their products. They have quality items.

I am in my 40s but severe with breakouts, or used to. My dermatologist has me on a prescribed medication I sleep in called Aczone. Since then my face is clear! During the day I use oil free lotion and also an astringent with 2% salicylic acid. Vichy has 1.5% which is still great. It might be too strong for some; sensitive skin usually can handle about .5%. I decided to use this as a make up base and it has been great! After washing my face, I still use an astringent then use this lotion. After it dries I apply a thin coat of foundation and loose powder. I have no shine and my face does not break out.

I think you need to know if you can handle salicylic acid prior to trying this. I am allergic to Benzoyl Peroxide and can only use salicylic acid. If you use it am it works for you, I highly suggest trying this lotion as a make up base.
summary: Great as a make up base...

reviewText: Vichy Normaderm Beautifying Anti-Acne Care.  Vichy is a brand that I love, as I have had experience with another one of their products.  This cream works well.  It is light - not heavy and overpowering.  Highly recommended.

I suppose the salicylic acid is the ingredient that fights acne but whatever else they have added makes it special.

The lotion is very lightly scented and absorbs almost instantly.  It leaves a smooth matte finish and makes an excellent make-up base.  I have had no problem with drying or irritation.

Dont use while you're using another acne product. Paraben free, made in France.

 The expiration date on mine is 09/17.

For the past few weeks I have used Vichy Normaderm Beautifying Anti-Acne Care every morning after washing with my normal facial cleanser. I've substituted Vichy for my usual routine of day cream and moisturizer. I love how smoothly Vichy goes on. It makes my skin feels silky smooth and is a fabulous base for my foundation. It has successfully controlled shine even though I regularly have oily areas.

Though I don't usually have major acne, I occasionally experience an outbreak. Since using Vichy Normaderm, I haven't broken out at all. I'm very pleased with the product and will probably buy it again in the future.
summary: Skin Feels Silky Smooth and Clear

reviewText: The anti-acne ingredient in Vichy Normaderm Beautifying lotion is 1.5% salicylic acid. I generally use a product with 2% concentration, so I didn't expect this lotion to be so drying. My skin began flaking and peeling after one use - and that's not all that unusual with a new anti-acne lotion, but even spacing out applications, after more than a week it's not any better. I'm going back to my higher concentration, but somehow gentler, regular product.

Like many other acne control preparations,  this is a salicylic acid-based product.  In that regard, I would judge it to be no better and no worse than other acne control products.....though this one is a lot more expensive.

What--arguably--makes this product better than its rivals is that it has some nice overall toning effects: after using it only a few times, I can attest that skin looks brighter, and feels smoother.  Because it is a lotion and not a cream, it also doesn't feel thick and icky on your face.

UPDATE: with longer/continued use, both the acne control and toning effects of this lotion are EVEN BETTER.  (Moved rating to 5 stars....)
summary: In addition to acne control (because of its salicylic acid content), this has some nice overall toning effects. SEE UPDATE

reviewText: This palette is VERY pigmented. The "Pro Basic" shades are for building up a smokey eye and the "Pixelated Color" shades are to add a bit of pop at the corner of the eyes. The pixelated colors are not intended to be use all over the eyelid, and they would look absolutely awful if you tried to do it. I like how pigmented the colors are, but I'm really put off by the fact that the pixelated colors have black mixed in, which makes them really muddy. I get that this is to help them blend with your eyeliner, but I'd rather mix them myself to get that effect. You can't really see how muddy the colors are in pictures, because the light makes the glittery colors stand out. In person, it is very noticeable.
summary: Okay, but the colors are muddy

reviewText: I love eye shadow, but I tend to prefer a more natural look.  When this pixelated color eye shadow palette arrived, I was a little concerned.  The pro basics shades seemed great, but the pixelated colors all looked a bit too garish in person for my taste.  However, with some blending and using the pixelated color as more of an accent to the pro basics, the overall effect was quite nice.  Ive only been brave enough to try the copper shade of pixelated color, but I think the two shades of gray could also work well.  Im not sure Ill ever be brave enough to try the shades of purple.  Im in forties, so Im fairly certain sparkly purple eye shadow would look ridiculous on me and not at all flattering.  The quality of this eye shadow is very nice; it goes exactly where you want it to go without any flaking off to unwanted spaces.
Pretty much for the teenagers who want wicked sparkle eyes or to reflect oncoming traffic lights into the night so they don't get hit.  WOW.  Might be able to use it up for Halloween.

You know when you see older women on tv with shimmering eye shadows that highlight every sag and wrinkle? And your like, "Use matte shadow! That shimmer looks terrible!" Well, this is that shadow.

It comes in a pretty black cardboard box and the shadows are bulbous mogals. There are the 'pro basics' and the 'pixelated color'. The pro basics definitely reflect more light than I'd like (*Not Matte*) and the pixelated colors are super sparkled.

Don't recommend for anyone over 35-40.

This palette is amazing because of it's versatility.
By lightly using the neutral 'Pro Basics' pans you get a shimmer that can be played down, or just use a small dab of the very lightest one in the inner and outer corners of your eyes to brighten and make them look bigger.
Those looks are certainly appropriate for day wear.
When you feel like having fun, layer on the glitter metalic colors for some serious hi def glam.
And even those, if lightly applied, give the look of freshly fallen snow. Each tiny bit of glitter sparkles as you move, a mesmerizing look.

Here's what is not so great...that glitter tends to travel. A primer is a must here. And after application, the two purples have that grey muddiness that purple shadow often has.

Still, this is such a fun palette to play with and get creative. Palettes are a terrific way to try lots of colors at a much lower cost than single pans or even quads. You might not love them all, but there are always a few that make it worth the price.
For me, the copper with a dab of the lightest one in my inner corner is gorgeous, and worth the price of the collection.

I would classify this color palette as on the bold side.  It is advertised as pixilated.  It definitely leans toward dark/sparkly.

Out of the box I took an immediate dislike to the product.  It arrived in its black Japonesque box, but there were no plastic seals at all.  No shrink-wrap, no plastic over the makeup, no plastic overlay, etc.  I have to knock it down 2 stars just because of that.

There also is nothing at all in the way of an applicator.  Now, for decent/better makeup that is not uncommon, but just a note to anyone who is buying this expecting an included applicator.

In total, there 10 colors, totaling 16.4 grams.

The color palette itself is varied as far as color options.  There are four Pro Basic colors and four Pixelated (sparkly) colors:
 Medium flesh tone
 Lighter flesh tone
 Cocoa flesh tone
 Black
 Pixelated silver
 Plxelated turquoise
 Plxelated lavender
 Pixelated gray
 Plxelated bronze
 Pixelated purple

Obviously the pixilated colors have a good deal of sheen/glitter properties to them.  The Pro Basic colors are more matte, but have some shimmer to them.  They go on nicely and are excellent for transition between colors.

If you like a more prominent, bold shadow look, you probably will like working with the pixilated colors.  This is definitely more of a weekend kit than a business/work day eye shadow set.

The colors all apply nicely, but like anything strong or bold, less is more and a little goes a long way.  I see the pixilated shades as more accent colors than the base.

This is a decent set, but I could see younger people or those who go bold preferring it over someone looking for a more subtle look.  Probably a 4 start product, but eye shadow with no plastic seal?  2 stars.
summary: Decent Makeup - On The Bold Side - Questionable Packaging

reviewText: This is a very nice set.  the colors are a great variety, the shimmery ones really pop.  This is high pigment eye color, a little goes a long way.  I really like this paette because it offers a variety, so it could be an essential palette.  folds up really nice and is very well protected for traveling as well.  I think this is a great product.

This brand makes very high quality eyeshadows that go on smooth. The four "pro basics" colors in this palette (a matte nude, a shimmer nude, matte brown, and matte black) are easy to use, easy to blend, all great for my skin tone - I will definitely use these a lot for everyday looks.
The "pixelated" colors make good accents. The green color is actually green glitter in a black powder base. Same for the purples. When you put them on they look mostly black, but with sparkle. Makes them work well for smudging into your eyeliner. The bronze appears to have brown base and the silvers seems to have gray base, a little hard to tell.

Full disclosure:  Ive been in a makeup rut for literally years, where I wore black eye shadow almost exclusively; the most I ever deviated from that was a little white/silver on the brow bone and maybe the lid from time to time.  Its only in the last two years or so that Ive begun using an actual color on my lid, and accenting with black in the crease.  When I do go for color, I tend to prefer darker ones, and I normally stick with purples, greys, and greens. And yes, I am a huge fan of Urban Decay.

That said, I was so thrilled with how these shadows from Japonesque looked when they arrived.  I had thought they looked nice online, but I wasn't prepared to fall in love with this set as much as I have.

The set contains four Pro Basics colors:  two pale nudes, a cocoa nude, and a black.  Then there are the six Pixelated colors: two very different purples (one leans more toward blue, the other toward red), a silver, a grey, a green, and a bronze.  Neither the photo on the Japonesque site nor the photos on Amazon do any of them justice.  But trust me when I say that the colors are simply divine. The pixelated colors are really vibrant, both in the case and on the skin.  The Pro Basic colors are a bit more subdued, but the two paler colors have a light shimmer and the cocoa and black are both matte.

Ive used all of the colors except the cocoa; brown eye shadow is not a good look for me. I did use a bit of Urban Decays Primer Potion with them, which worked very well.  For each look I paired either one of the pale nude colors or one of the pixelated colors on the lid with the soft black in the crease and outer corner, finishing with black eye liner and mascara  basically my normal look. I was very happy with the way all of the colors looked using them this way (though I will admit, the black in the crease probably does tone them down a bit). Even the bronze  which I was really hesitant to use  looked great (very autumnal).

I didn't notice a lot of fallout on my face when using these, though you will see some excess powder in the case (especially with the black).  That actually surprised me, since they just looked like theyd be grainy.  I used both brushes and sponge applicators (depending on where I was applying and how much coverage I wanted).  I didn't have any trouble blending the black into the crease and the coverage and opacity of all of the colors was great. The shadows have all held up well through a full day of work, which is a neat trick considering I have the oiliest skin ever.  I haven't had any irritation at all from the pixelated colors, and I am a contact lens wearer. They were also easy to remove with my regular cold cream and a warm, wet face cloth.

The set does not include applicators nor a brush. Im not sure if thats a plus or a minus though, since with few exceptions the applicators and brushes included in makeup sets tend to be low quality. Except for the UD ones Ive gotten, I tend the just chuck them.

The Amazon price is $38 for the palette, which contains 16.4 grams of eye shadow. Compare that to Urban Decays new Vice 4 palette, which costs $60 for about 16 grams, or one of their Naked palettes which is about 13 grams of makeup for $54.  I personally think this is the better deal for the quality and color payoff you get and given that I adore and will use all of the colors in the set except one  I cant say that about a lot of palettes, even Urban Decay ones.

Every great product has a wow moment - the pixelated eye shadows surprised me by the beautiful sparkly results and easy soft application of the eye shadow.  There's a bit of sparkle in the shadows, and it really works.  The colors are also great for my eyes - blue on very pale white skin.  No freckles, but I get blushed easily. I buy Lancome, so already know to invest in a good brand, but this was hands above my usual go to shadows.

One note - it does not come with a brush.  It's not a concern at all if you already own a good one - but a good brush on it's own will set you back $25-30.

I also wear contacts during the day, and I was not bothered by the eye shadows or the sparkly pieces.
summary: a wow moment with this unique eye shadow

reviewText: Housed inside an extremely sleek packaging set are 10 different eye shadow colors to try out. There are four pro colors that are more basic in style and six pixelated colors that are more colorful and glittery. To an older crowd more content with the standards, this set might not be very useful as the six pixelated colors are definitely a lot more loud than the 4 pro colors. Some reviewers have blended the colors together to mitigate the loudness of the pixelated colors, and that is definitely a good route to go if you're just looking to apply some nice looking eye shadow without drawing too much attention to yourself. As for the quality of the eye shadow, it goes on very nicely and looks great once applied. The price is on the higher side and I fear this product may have a hard time reaching a broad audience due to the majority of the colors in this palette being the louder pixelated styles. That being said, this is high quality eye shadow that looks and it will definitely satisfy the consumer who is looking to be noticed.

As soon as I opened this box I realized that these colors are what older teens and young women like to wear, accenting their eyes on the corners with some sparkly eye shadow.  The colors are bright but the powder is long-lasting.

This is definitely something for the younger, partying crowd.

My husband has worn the original Eternity from Calvin Klein for many years, and we both enjoy it.  This is a new twist on an old favorite with a light musky scent and a masculine freshscented  aftershave.  Its all we expected as a follow up to the original sexy scent.

I love Calvin Klein fragrances. I also love the clothes line. I own several coats and sweaters by CK and they are high quality and look great. I also use several products from the fragrance line. I used regular Eternity for a long time, now with this new version I am back to it again.

The smell is nice and clean. No musky overtones. A great mix of citrus and some wood scents that combine to make a scent that is pleasant but still masculine. I have gotten SEVERAL compliments on it and have been asked what cologne I was wearing. This new version of Eternity is truly an excellent fragrance.

It is also not over powering. Of course like with any new scent, you apply a minimum amount to gauge how strong it is. I found it very easy to get the correct amount for wearing. I really like this product. Very pleased. Highly recommended.

Any review of a product of this type will intrinsically be subjective.  Nevertheless, the Eternity line has always been a favorite.  The scent is not overpowering and masculine without that musk or woods scent.  It definitely is not long lasting by any measure and seems to evaporate very quickly.  It feels good on the face after shaving and is definitely soothing.

Eternity for Men is one of my favorite fragrances for men. It's clean, it's fresh and subtly masculine. This new version called Eternity Now plays on that original fragrance but makes it a little more oriental and floral. The woodsy notes are downplayed. This fragrance contains notes of bitter ginger, coconut water, star anise, star fruit, cedar, patchouli, Moroccan cedar, tonka bean and Madagascar vanilla. The coconut dominates, followed by vanilla and star fruit.

In my opinion, Eternity Now aftershave is for the man who is not afraid to explore his more sensitive side. The fragrance is very mild and not very long lasting, so it is great for work. It's perfect for the summer, but also good in winter to remind you of those blue skies and sunny summer days.
summary: Clean and fresh fragrance, does not last very long.

reviewText: I have the women's version of this cologne and I love it.  This men's version is delightful.  The problem is how to describe a scent.  Ok...it's light, refreshing, perhaps a tad woodsy...and it has a light scent that lingers.  It's a young and beautifully vibrant scent!  I would buy this in the future.  My husband smells amazing with this one!  It's masculine without being cloying and overdone!

Yes, the other reviewers who gave this five stars are exactly right: this is good stuff!  My wife really liked it, and I do too.  It isn't too strong, but the scent lingers just perfect.  Exactly what I want in a men's fragrance!  Highly recommended!
summary: One Of The Best I've Smelled!

reviewText:
The Calvin Klein Eternity Now Aftershave is a wonderful aftershave to gift to the special guy in your life.  I got this for my husband and both he and I really enjoy the scent.  The scent is a more clean and crisp scent vs a musky scent.  The aftershave comes in an attractive squarish bottle, and the sprayer sends out the aftershave in a nicely diffused mist.  Because it's an aftershave, the scent is not nearly as strong as a cologne, and the scent does "wear out" much faster.

For those who are unsure of the difference between cologne and aftershave:  Colognes have fixers and are meant to stick around on the skin, so the scent is formulated to last longer.  On the other hand, aftershaves are used to clean small knicks/disinfect/tone skin after a shave.  Balms are also scented an designed to moisturize skin as well after a shave.  You can use aftershave as a cologne, but do NOT use cologne as an aftershave!

Overall, the husband was very pleased with this after shave.  It scent is fresh and masculine, it's not overpowering, and makes his skin feel great after a shave.  However, like all scents, I would definitely check and see if you like the smell at your local department store before committing to purchase a full bottle.
summary: Light Fresh Masculine Scent, Works Perfectly as After Shave

reviewText:
I let my wife rate this since she is the one that will smell it the most.  She loves the smell of this and the fact that it lasts for a while.

This is one of the only after shaves where I would get a smell of it once in a while.  Most of the ones I have had never linger enough for me to smell it again.  The fragrance is good without being too flowery (more masculine, not feminine).

Highly recommended (by my wife)!

I have use CK in the past and have always liked the scent.  The product line has alway produced subtle scents and this aftershave is no different.  The smell is not overpowering is used sparingly.

My 18 year old son likes it.  I passed it around to my seniors in my economics class and both the young men and women for the most part liked the smell.  My wife likes it as well.  You have young people and older people liking this item.  This says a lot to the care CK takes in producing a product.

Solid all around  and a big thumbs up.  I would buy this again.
summary: Great product, great scent, another hit by the CK brand.

reviewText:
I love this scent on my husband. It's not too overwhelming and fits perfectly to him. He tends to wear Sandalwood and Citrus scents and the notes of this after shave are just perfectly blended.

If you're an Clavin Klein fan and looking for an update to Eternity, you'll love this.
summary: Another great scent from Clavin Klein

reviewText: Spicy ginger, coconut water and anise are the top notes in this after shave spray that also has middle notes of crisp starfruit, cedarleaf, and patchouli. The scents adding depth are a mixture of cedarwood, tonka bean and madagascar vanilla linger that add the base notes and if I layer it with the eau de cologne it adds staying power.
summary: Clean fruity crisp scent that is addicting

reviewText: NIce smelling, not overpowering aftershave.  The fragrence will be familiar to anyone who has used this product in the last decade, but with the addition of a slight musky smell.  The smell does last longer than I thought it would, but I got no complaints from the girlfriend as she really enjoyed the smell.  Little expensive, but not over the top for a fragence of this quality.  For Calvin Klein fans you will not be disappointed with this selection.
summary: Eternity - Not Quite It Does Last Longer Than One Would Think

reviewText:
There is no anti-perspirant in this product and that must be noted. Most importantly it kept smell almost non existent which is great. Also had a great smell to it that lasted throughout the day. Easy glide on does a great job. Only problem is price which is high considering what you get.

Still-does its job just like Calvin Klein usually does.

There are so many studies that say the stuff in the antiperspirants really are not good for you so we try to use them as little as possible. ...
This is a cool to the skin, lightly scented gel deodorant. It is NOT an antiperspirant! Some people have remarked that they still get damp when using this... well you will with any deodorant! It stops odor without an overpowering scent that broadcasts to others all day long. I really liked that it is not overpowering. You really can't smell it unless you are very close to the person wearing it. I got this for my 22 year old son and he really likes it, I , (mom) however personally LOVE the scent and am going to get one for me !
I know there are times when you NEED an antiperspirant but it is nice to give your body a rest from the antiperspirants when you have light days that you know you won't be exerting yourself much where a deodorant will do for a change.
summary: Light VERY pleasant scented gel deodorant not overpowering but light & fresh smelling. I got this for my son but I want one also

reviewText:
Calvin Klein always makes the best sensual scents, whether they are for women or men. His Eternity and Obsession scents are favorites in our home, because they are not overwhelming but carry their lighter sensual aromas through the day.

This Calvin Klein Eternity Now Deodorant Stick is the same as his colognes and perfumes, the scent carries it's sensual aroma lightly through a work day. When you first apply this clear deodorant stick, the citrus scents of spicy ginger, coconut, starfruit and star anise stand out. But after a short time, the more sensual scents of cedarleaf, patchouli, cedarwood, tonka bean and vanilla take over. In the 1960's, cedarwood, patchouli and tonka bean were the scents that gave the headiness sensuality to many of the top selling perfumes and colognes and adding these scents to this deodorant stick does the same.

This Eternity Now Deodorant Stick will give you all day protection if you are not doing physical work that you really need an antiperspirant for. It does not contain any irritating alcohol in it either. It's an average 4 STAR deodorant with a 5 STAR citrusy-sensual fragrance that stays light throughout the day, making it a 4 1/2 STAR deodorant stick.
summary: Very Masculine With It's Citrus & Sensual Scent

reviewText: After putting it on for the first time, my girlfriend looked at me and said, "mmm, thats manly!". The smell is definitely a masculine musk stye fragrance. It says "no alcohol" which is good, it won't dry my skin out. Feels The packaging is nice as expected from such a brand as Calvin Klein. I would recommend this to anyone already using the Calvin Klein Eternity Now line of fragrance.
summary: Elegant deodorant for men that is nice addition to the cologne.

reviewText:
I usually use clinical strength anti-antiperspirant, so I was skeptical about this product.  I was pleasantly surprised that it did work pretty well.  It comes in a thicker than usual container, the cap is a little annoying, you have to screw the product down to affix the top.  A small complaint, but back to the performance.  I used it for work, a desk job, and didn't detect any foul odors, like I generally would with regular strength deodorant.  The scent of the deodorant itself is very faint, pretty much immediately.  I could barely detect the scent after a day at work.

The deodorant is pricey, but it's high quality.

Calvin Klein Eternity Now Deodorant has a pleasant scent that I love my husband wearing. It keeps him smelling fresh through a variety of activities. Since it is alcohol free, it is comfortable to wear and doesn't discolor his clothing.

This scent has a nice smell to it - it's not too strong like some men's cologne might be. It is a nice calming smell.

You just roll it on and it takes away the stinkiness. After a few hours of wearing it and having worked outside, it was still there. I just had to get right up to his pits in order to smell it. But the nice thing is that it kept him dry and it smells great.

I did take off one star because i don't remember any other deoderants that are $20. I'm thinking it's because of the name that it has to be $20 but still it's a nice treat for when you want a good smelling husband.
summary: Good deodorant - nice smelling and seems to last for us

reviewText: My husband likes the aroma of this Deodorant, and I love the way it smells on him.  Keep in mind this is a deodorant, not antiperspirant, so it won't stop perspiration, but it does effectively keep the sweaty odors away.

My husband was quite pleased with this deodorant. He is not someone who works in an office but he does like to wear a dab of fragrance when he goes out, ( he actually found one that doesn't set off my sensitivities,) and always tends to buy deodorant with a scent. I thought this would be nice for him to try.  What he does do for a living is repair machines in a food factory. Even though he is about at retirement age, he has a physically demanding job.

This does not have an overwhelming scent, which I am grateful for, because I am sensitive to fragrance carriers. It is light and pleasant and so far has not given me a blasting headache, so I think I'm safe. Also, the fragrance fades fairly quickly which makes me happy. He enjoys this fragrance and has had no issues with it not being strong enough a deodorant. It works quite well for him, even at work.

I would say that this is a win, win in this house. He was happy as could be at getting a fancy new deodorant, and it doesn't seem to contain the carriers that bother me. Will we purchase this agin? Possibly, as a gift. Perhaps even for my 3 sons.
summary: He likes it, He really likes it!

reviewText:
I generally use an anti-perspirant with no scent. I've found gel-types can cause some itch and rash. This deodorant, while not an anti-perspirant, has a nice fragrance, and dries completely, leaving no stickiness or rash. I really like it, and my spouse approves. I can smell the vanilla, spice and citrus in this deodorant. There are other subtle fragrances, but the effect is a masculine scent that lasts a few hours, and not all day. It's Fall, and the cooler weather is probably an easy test for the effectiveness of deodorants. Still, a few swipes of this stick seems to last all day (and night). Nice stuff, and it's made in Monaco, so it must be good :)

Update: 7/6/16 I use this deodorant every day. It goes on easy and I like the fragrance which gradually fades. Wife likes it too. No staining on my shirts and it does prevent odor through a day of workouts and warm weather.

I never suspected that they actually 'made' things in Monaco but, apparently they do and this men's deodorant stick comes straight out of Monaco, actually made there. And I can see how a prince, but not a princess, would want to wear it. And I can definitely see myself wearing it when out on a date or, more realistically for me, at a social function.

I am allergic to most fragrances but, to my surprise, I found myself tolerating this one quite well. The smell is subtle, not pungent, and yet pleasant in a manly way and, thanks to 'no alcohol', there shouldn't be much skin irritation. The high price is absolutely warranted in my view because of a significantly better quality product than the less expensive but much more 'strident' items one normally finds in a normal store.

First impression of Eternity Now deodorant was good enough, it was nice scent, a clear stick that goes on clear.  The stick is circular and after using it I realize while others are oblong shaped because those I can do one wipe up and down to get enough coverage, but with this circular shape I felt like I had to swipe four or five time to get complete coverage.  Then I tried this on a Sunday and but by the fourth quarter of the football game I noticed the scent starting to fade which is not good for a big brand name deodorant when some cheap general store bought brand usually last until bedtime.  I guess this is fine to put on before a dinner party (it would probably go well with some Calvin Klein cologne too) but it is not very good if you are putting in a long days work, or even a lazy Sunday in front of the television.
summary: Decent Scent; Not Very Long Lasting

reviewText: The scent is nice but not lasting and needs a second application after any major workout.

I am disappointed. This body lotion was supposed to smell like lychees and peonies but I don;t smell them at all. Maybe there is too much musk for me. My smelling ability has diminished over the years but my husband's had not. He announced his dislike for the smell as soon as he came into the room! He hates perfumes so if you love perfumes, you may like this a lot. The only way that I can smell it is by holding my arm up to my nose and then it hits me. It smell like the elevator, Someone in our apartment wears this smell.

Going bask to the lotion itself, it does moisturize so i will use it on and off., A little bit goes very far so that is good.

I think would prefer a lotion with no scent than this one.

This is a really lovely body lotion. It has a lovely scent that is fruity/floral without being overwhelming or too florid. It imparts a good amount of moisture without being greasy but restores moisture to normal levels as the season changes and skin begins to dry. I have used this on my legs, arms, hands, shoulders, and even neck and face. It is a great formulation that will take me into fall and winter and beyond.
It is pricey by my standards, but also a real treat.
summary: The Scent Is Just A Preview

reviewText: This body lotion goes on smooth and silky, and the sweet scent of flowers drifts from your skin.  It smells bright and cheery and happy.  I just put a few dabs of the lotion on my arms and the scent stayed with me for hours.  But I do think you could easily apply too much of this lotion and end up smelling like a perfume bottle.  For a body lotion this product has a lot of scent, so a little goes a long way.  If you are not a big fan of perfume, this is a good alternative.  You get hint of perfume, but nothing overpowering.
summary: A little goes a long way

reviewText:
Calvin Klein ETERNITY NOW body lotion smells great! Goes on smoothly to moisturize and fragrance the skin. This lotion has a light pleasant scent that smells gentle bit fruity. Has a peony/Corey's scent. I like it, works for day or night wear.
5/5 stars.
summary: Calvin Klein ETERNITY NOW body lotion

reviewText:
This item was given to me for my review.
Mmmm, nice lotion. Calvin Klein Eternity Now has a floral/musk scent that is soft and not over powering, but still very grown up. The lotion absorbs quickly, and a little goes a long way. I have found that it lasts a long time and is a very good lotion for the summer, since body heat does not appear to make it morph into anything unpleasant, like some lotions I have tried in the past. Hubby seems to like the smell, as well, so bonus. I am not sure who the ad campaign is targeting, but to me this is neither a young scent nor one for the older crowd. Rather, I find it to be clean, soft and fresh and perfect for blue jeans or a little black dress.

"The thrill...the promise..." the hype of this product is crazy!...maybe that is why it's SO pricy!  All and all it's a smooth lotion to apply...a bit this, but it  has a nice floral aroma. It definitely softens your skin and the scent will stay with you for most all day...so it's kinda like a "twofer" with being a body lotion and cologne rolled into one.  I deduct a star for the price.
Strong fragrance.  Probably too strong for some occasions.  It leaves skin smooth without a greasy residue.  Very nice product with the great scent of Eternity Now.  This will last a long time.
summary: Very nice product with the great scent of Eternity Now

reviewText: This is a very nice body lotion.  The scent is quite light, which is good because it's also a little baby-powdery.  It leaves my skin feeling silky soft.  I don't wear Calvin Klein fragrance (I wear Flower Bomb) and I don't think this clashes with my regular perfume.

This is definitely an upscale product, modeled after a perfume and retailing for significantly more than your average lotion. What are you paying for? Mainly the brand, and secondarily, the perfume. If you care about brands and like this perfume, then this product is for you. The scent is mildly floral, feminine, and soft, and fans of Eternity will enjoy this.

As for the lotion, it is fairly standard in that it moisturizers and absorbs into skin very well. There's no greasy finish, and your skin will definitely feel soft.
summary: Just like the perfume; nice moisturizing & absorption

reviewText: I got this as a gift for my wife and she loves it. Actually we both really like it. She had been using a lotion that had a scent that I was not very fond of. This Calvin Klein Eternity Now Body Lotion has a very pleasant scent (I guessed that I would like it since I use and like the Eternity for men cologne. It is feminine but not overly so (mildly floral and sweet) with a touch of musk. It seems creamy and rich without being oily. She says that it "goes on and absorbs well, feels nice". It is probably a bit pricey for what it is.

Yes, Calvin Klein is a long established name in high end cosmetics and clothing.  I admit that I actually like this product.  This lotion gently glides onto your skin and has a very pleasant floral aroma.  I  have a sensitive nose, so overpowering fragrances can make me ill.  Fortunately that was not what I experienced with this lotion.  It doubles as a skin softening agent and a perfume as the scent will stay with you for the majority of the day.  Just remember - a little dab will do you.

Calvin Klein Eternity Now Body Lotion goes on smoothly, and left my skin feeling soft.  I put it on my poor dry feet, and it is a great moisturizer.  6.7 ounces is a good size tube that will last for a long time.  The fragrance is strong, and I don't know which of the ingredients gives it such a strong scent, but it is a bit too strong for me.

Like a lot of CK colognes, this one is superbly packaged in a glass piece that is designed to be aesthetically pleasing. It will sit well on any bathroom counter/cabinet shelf. The cologne itself is strong but not overpowering. A little goes a long way. Good fragrance, good product.
summary: Like a lot of CK colognes

reviewText: This is nice. Not the best but still really nice smelling. Makes men smell nice.

This fragrance is attractively packaged and small enough to easily throw into a gym bag or backpack. What immediately struck me about the scent was something I liken to coconut oil; a tad 'tropical', but not overpowering and somewhat fresh. Both my husband and I found it to be a nice daytime scent that became slightly sweeter the longer it was worn. Over time I also picked up hits of patchouli, but again, not overpowering.

I guess the greatest compliment I could give this scent would be that if the women's equivalent smells like this one - I'd buy it. Eternity Now would be a fragrance that should appeal to all ages of men who like a fresh, warm, sweet scent without being too 'in your face' about it. The scent retained its character throughout the day, and was very complimentary to the wearer as it didn't scream "I've got cologne on!", but rather whispered "Come closer to find out more."

Definitely a scent I'd recommend as a gift. Really nice!

--------------------------------------------

NOTE: the description on Amazon: "...captivates with the unexpected freshness of spicy ginger, coconut water, and star anise...with notes of crisp starfruit, cedarleaf, and patchouli. A bold masculine signature of exotic moroccan cedarwood, tonka bean and madagascar vanilla linger with vibrant sensuality."

Just got this in as I thought I would see if it would be something hubby would like and all I know is I love it.  It's light and just right for a man.  I'm very picky about what I get him usually and this was just a whim since I was offered it to review but it really surprised me with how nice it smells. Just a little bit goes a long way without knocking you out with the strength.  I have a sensitive sniffer and I don't like heavy strong fragrances and this is not one of them.  I also miss him wearing aftershave in the winter months since he only shaves from April to the first of October.  Now I will have me a handsome smelling honey all year round.  I highly recommend this for all ladies that like their men to smell like a bit of heaven.

I've been buying CK colognes ever since i can remember. This one sounded nice with the woodsy and vanilla along with many other notes. Colognes smell different on everyone and for me this one smells more sweet when I wear it. I would have liked it to be a bit more masculine but in my opinion most of the CK stuff has that unisex style of smell. But this one leans more towards sweet and vanilla and not so much the cedar/pachouli.

Its super expensive too which was kind of a bummer. I have the 1fl oz and its tiny. However one quick spray lasts all day, its very potent. Don't over spray or you'll choke from the strength of it.

This for me is more of a crisp light summer scent so i'll keep it for those months.
summary: More on the sweet and vanilla notes

reviewText:
I really enjoy wearing many of the new complex masculine fragrances - particularly as the weather turns colder.  I'm not talking about something that could be mistaken for a "unisex" scent, but rather colognes with heavy base notes of cedar, resin, leather and tobacco. If you are familiar with the original classic Eternity line (for both men and women), you can probably figure out that I was never a huge fan.  Even in warm weather I tend to avoid those beachy, "ozone" scents.  That said, I was intrigued that the description of Calvin Klein's Eternity Now for Men included Moroccan cedarwood so I thought I'd give it a go.

Unfortunately, it disappoints.  This is a very sweet, almost tropical, fragrance, with strong coconut and vanilla at the front.  If I did not know this was formulated specifically for men, I would categorize it as unisex.  I can't say I detected any woody notes either.  And, much like the classic Eternity scents,  it lacks the staying power of other high end fragrances and by the middle of the day, the spot I'd applied it at my wrists smelled only vaguely talc-like.

Overall, it's not a bad scent and I intend to put it aside for summer when it will be more appropriate.  But if you're looking for a heady, masculine scent - this is definitely not it.

Calvin Klein's Eternity Now cologne has a pleasant scent, comes in a substantial bottle, and lasts a long time.

The Eternity Now is boxed in a simple cardboard box with a reinforced liner to protect the glass bottle.  The bottle itself is a chunky piece of glass with a simple and masculine design.  The whole presentation is very elegant and refined.

Eternity Now's fragrance is subtle and pleasant.  It has an earthly and slightly sweet scent.  It's not overly masculine, or smelling like a "lumberjack's shed", but it doesn't need to be.  It perfect for most occasions.

It has great staying power too.  I sprayed one spritz on myself, and it was still noticeable 6 hours later.  A little goes a long way.

I had no issues with rashes, itching, or skin irritation of any kind.

All in all... a wonderful cologne.
summary: A nice fragrance with good staying power.

reviewText: This is a very strong fragrance and you need to apply very little  amount. The fragrance is pleasant, but it does not last very long. Probably about 6 hours and after that you don't smell anything.
summary: A Little Dab Will Go a Long Way

reviewText: Obviously fragrances are a matter of taste, but here's why I like this: it isn't overpowering--with a normal application of a spritz or two, you can smell that you are wearing it, and someone who comes nice and close to you can tell. You do not make the whole room have watery eyes, like some fragrances (and body sprays--the worst offenders). This smells nice and clean to me, and is less cloying, but similar to Atelier Cologne's Mandarine Glaciale---minus the strong tangerine smell of the latter. It smells expensive--not like cheap musk or overpoweringly of vanilla--more of a subtle vanilla dry down, with clean woods smell!

As a quality goes, this one is a good quality one. A single spray will stay with you the full day, even though it doesn't assault as strongly as it did when you started. On clothes, it's got one scent, but on skin it's a slightly different one. These are all things you expect from a perfume or cologne that's made well.

As far as the smell is concerned, this isn't my favourite by Calvin Klein. The one I love most from CK is CK One. It's timeless, and distinctive, and seems to smell slightly different on each person who wears it. This one has an undertone of baby powder on it. While that does lend to the "clean" part of the scent, it's not something that I'd wear all by itself. If I spray this on, I'll be adding some sandalwood oil to myself, so that I don't remind people of diaper changes.
summary: this one is a good quality one

reviewText:
I don't wear cologne very often as I have very sensitive eyes and the alcohol dries them out pretty easily.  As such, I have to be judicious in which colognes I wear, as well as how often.

I won't compare this to the original Eternity because, frankly, I've never tried it.  I know it's popular, but even though Eternity Now shares a name with the original, it should probably be judged on its own merits.

Honestly, I really, really like this scent.  It's much sweeter than colognes I've used in the past.  To me I smell a lot of warm vanilla.  It could be its just how it reacts to my skin, but I quite like it.  I enjoy musky and citrus scents, but I'm a bit new to sweeter scents.  But, as I said, I really like it.

It's hard to write a review on cologne because it reacts differently to different skin types.  All I know is that it smells good on me and, bringing it back around to my opening sentence, its a scent I can very easily see myself wearing so long as my eyes allow me.  Which is saying a lot, frankly.
Love this
These highlighters are very pigmented and they come in a compact that is the perfect size for your purse. My wife has really loved using this product and says nothing but good things about it.
Excellent product and the colors are amazing
Nice

I don't know how I missed ever getting any of theBalm's luminizers, but it just never happened, and there was always another luminizer (like Hourglass's Ambient Lighting palette) that I coveted more. I had racked enough points at Birchbox and decided to take the plunge when they offered this trio.

I kept expecting disco ball, but I couldn't have been more wrong. Don't get me wrong, though: this is definitely more glittery than the Ambient Lighting palette, but the truth is that they are simply different. I've been warned off theBalm's lighting effects as simply being too too for a woman over 40. Some things you just gotta do for yourself, and unless you are as wrinkly as Miss Haversham, I see no reason why you couldn't enjoy these luminizers if you keep a light hand. They're simply lovely!

The effect is more intense than Hourglass, but with the aforesaid light hand and a fan brush, you can get a simply pretty look. They work great for fair-skinned girls like me, but I'd venture to say darker-complected ladies could make good use of these as well.

I essentially got them free for Birchbox points, but I like them so much, I'd have bought them anyway. If you're not a kidlette any longer but crave some sparkle, and you don't want to shell out for the Hourglass line, I can give these luminizers a hearty endorsement.
summary: Works for the over 40s who crave some sparkle (and don't want to shell out for Hourglass)

reviewText:
I have really sensitive skin so I am very careful when using new products.  I really like that this product is not like other exfoliators and facial scrubs because it doesn't use abrasive cleansers.

Using this product didn't feel like you are using an exfoliator.  It was very gentle, I didn't realize I was cleaning my face. Very surprising how smooth my skin feels.

Who would have ever thought that rice milk could be such a great cleanser.  Add in some Hyaluronic Acid & Vitamin E and you have renewed skin ready for the day!
summary: Great cleanser that makes your skin feel fantastic!

reviewText: I tried it cautiously on my cheek at first because my skin is sensitive. It dried immediately and rolled off in a way that looked and felt cleaner (despite having already washed my face). Comparing both cheeks' skin, the one with the dermasuri was clearly softer. Brighter? Maybe so. The skin overall did look cleaner, fresher and felt smoother after gentle exfoliation with this. I liked it.
summary: Gently exfoliates. Skin feels softer and cleaner.

reviewText: This is a very inexpensive and effective product. Though I've decided it's not for me, I'm surprised by the reviews that say it doesn't work. I'm guessing they are used to feeling beads like in microderm abrasion products. It worked TOO MUCH for my sensitive skin! You wet your skin. Put a small amount on your face - it feels like a serum, which surprised me. Rub it all around until stuff sloughs off. Rinse. Easy enough. For those of you who remember Pretty Hands and Feet, it's SO MUCH like that, except for your face. I use a lot of quality skin care. This is by far less expensive than similar products. For some of you, it may be perfect. Here's why it doesn't work for me: - As I mentioned, it's a bit too heavy duty. I have extremely sensitive skin and have to be very careful about the products I use. After, my skin felt so soft and smooth, but it was blotchier and a bit irritated. If I was new to exfoliating, I would think this was a normal reaction to beginning use. However, I exfoliate twice a week and use a Clarisonic, so I know that's not the case. - The little clumps that slough off can be hard to keep out of your hair. Between the rubbing and the rinsing, I couldn't keep this out of my hairline, even with a shower cap. I'd recommend it for pre-shampoo. This just doesn't really work for my skin care routine - I usually do my face at a different time than I shower. So if those concerns aren't relevant to you, you would probably love it. However, if you are like me and want to keep looking, I recommend the Aveda clay mask (been using it for years, very gentle) as a lower cost option. For a splurge, Bliss' microderm option can't be beaten. AVEDA Botanical Kinetics deep cleansing masque mask 4.2oz/125ml bliss Micro Magic Microdermabrasion Treatment | Gently Exfoliates with Volcanic Pumice, Soothing Aloe, & Refreshing Peppermint | Tightens Pores & Smoothens and Brightens Skin | 3 oz
summary: Inexpensive and effective, but not right for me...

reviewText:
This sounds very nice and the packaging looks elegant, but I had a really difficult time with it...

It stuck to my face and I could barely get it off. I used it in the morning before work and had to scrub like mad with a washcloth. I could still feel it on my face when I took my evening shower. After I scrubbed my face trying to get it off, my face burned. Not a good experience for me.

I love this type of facial cleanser - I have tried a few other brands that work like this. It is a gel like texture and you massage your face and it gently exfoliates your skin while balling up and taking the dead skin with it and it falls into the sink or your hand. It says to use 1-3 times a week I typically use it on Saturday and Wednesday evenings. I have combination skin with some slight rosacea on my cheeks and chin - this did not irritate it. They also offer a full refund if it doesn't work out for you - which is pretty bold in this day and age. This is comparable to the BOSCIA Exfoliating Peel Gel which is a great product and offers similar results. I do like the rice milk better because it did leave my skin feeling softer and more moisturized over the Boscia brand.
I really like this!! It leaves my face so smooth! It works really well & feels so good to remove dead skin. Great ingredients & high quality product.

This is an amazing product.  The first time I used it I was amazed at everything that came off in little rolls, and it is easy to use.  My skin looked like it was glowing after using it.  I did it two days in a row before carefully reading the directions, which state to use it 1 to 3 times a week.  The second day it didn't take off nearly as much, probably because I had used it just the day before.

Oh yay! This is the best exfoliator I have EVER used for my eczema-prone skin! I have used other exfoliators for sensitive skin, some costing as much as $200. They have all been too harsh and made my eczema flare up. Not this!  It's wonderful - even on areas where I'm having a flare up, I can use it, it will remove the flakes of the flare and then NOT irritate the sensitive area! I'm so relieved to have found this - it's so nice to be able to exfoliate without worry!

I have to confess, when I first put it on my skin and it started balling up immediately, I kinda flipped out, thinking that anything that was reacting that quickly could NOT be gentle. But I kept very gently rubbing it around, and then rinsed. It left my skin SO soft and it just feels so much cleaner!  Love it!
