First a detox mask...then a resurfacing " peel"...and last a nourishing and brightening "treat".  All of the components  are clearly labeled and easy to do.  The key ingredients for me are glycolic acid for smoothing, calendula flowers for healing...witch hazel for calming and glycerin for hydration.  These components all lead to a more toned and brightened skin.  Plus you get to do it again when you feel the need for it!  I loved this little power packed treatment!

This is a nice enough facial product. I'm an older woman though, and it didn't do anything miraculous for me. My daughter used the other one (we had a facial night at home which was fun). She liked the product better than I, but she's 25 and anything makes her skin look great. My skin did feel better.. but as much as this product cost, it would be worth it to add a bit more and go for a salon facial.

Bliss triple oxygen to the rescue facial in a box is really easy to use and good for your skin. I am sixty and it made my skin feel much softer and brighter. I haven't had a facial in years and I don't intend to go that long in between facials again. This will be my go to .I really love how my skin looks.

The Bliss Triple Oxygen to the Rescue Facial in a Box is a brilliant idea- great for travel or to try out Bliss's Triple-Oxygen system before committing to full-size products.  You get TWO "official" uses out of this kit, so with the price and shipping, you figure it's about $10 per full facial use.  It's pricey for a 2-use set, but still less than going to the spa (although going to the spa is about the experience and relaxation more than just the products).  Also, you get a few more uses out of the mask and treat components.

I have really sensitive skin, so I was a little worried that the products in this kit would irritate my skin, but they do not.  The mask is really cool- it makes little bubbles on your face.  It feels like sticking your face in a fizzy drink.  The "peel" pads are gentle, and the "treat" serum gives the skin a subtle glowiness.  Very much needed in the dry, dull winter!

There are 2 facials per box, so it's a really inexpensive way to get a home facial.  I have to say, I thought the treatments were a little bit harsh, and I was going to give fewer stars than five.  But I did the treatment last thing before bed, and when I woke up, my skin looked AMAZING.  I'm 49 and have pretty decent skin, but it tends to be dry, especially in winter.  This was great!!
summary: Doesn't feel gentle while using it, but results are great!

reviewText:
Excellent product for brightening my skin and reducing redness.  I have oily skin (so no wrinkles!) and tend towards redness.  This calmed my skin right down with the first application.  It's a nice treat, well priced and the suggestion is to use it three times a week.  It felt like a treat to be able to do a facial that actually works in such an economical way.  The steps were very easy to follow too.

Though the insert explains the products you need to read the print on the actual packages to use this correctly.

This is a sampler type product.  You get a foamy mask, a, alpha hydroxy wipe (the peel), and a vitamin C moisturizer.  The foamy mask can be used many times, there was quite a bit there for a sample size.  I found the wipe was so saturated that it could be used 2 or 3 times if you closed the package tightly.  There also seemed to be enough moisturizer in each of the two packages for at least two uses.  I didn't really see any benefit from the mask.  The moisturizer was nice.  What I loved, and will purchase separately, was the peel.  The peel is fantastic!  I could see improved clarity by the second use (I used every other day) and after 5 uses big improvement in clarity of skin.  This is a nice stocking stuffer present or a good way to sample the three products which can all be purchased separately.
summary: Fun sample set and good way to try the products

reviewText:
With enough for two 3 step facials, this kit is easy to use and gives skin quite a boost.
I confess that I already love the bliss brand, especially the hand products.
Rescue Facial in a Box is perfect for those days when you only have time and energy for a fast and no nonsense  treatment.
Leaves your face feeling very soft.

I have really sensitive skin and I breakout when I use most products so I have to use products through trial and error.  This facial in a box was great for my skin.  I didn't have any breakouts and my face felt wonderful after I used this product.  It would be great to take with you on a trip because it is portable and quick to use.

bliss's Triple Oxygen to the Rescue Facial in a Box is a sample kit of three products.

First is the foaming face mask-a thick, rich, citrus smelling gel that foams when it mixes with water and is applied to the face.  It is a strange looking reaction, reminiscent of what happens when the scrubbing bubbles hit the shower wall.  It did seem to get my face clean, and the smell was great.

Second is the little pad thing with the peel solution on it.  This is sticky feeling, with a neutral scent, that feels really gross on the skin.  It also takes a long time to dry, and did not seem to do anything to improve my skin.  The instructions say to use an SPF of at least 15 after using.

Last is the little packet of day cream.  This is a thick cream, with a lovely scent.  It did a good job of moisturizing my face and neck, but it does not appear to contain an SPF, so you will still need to use a sunscreen.

The cream is a four star, the mask is a four star, and the peel thing is a one star, for a combined rating of 3 stars.  It is an expensive little kit.

A simple 3 step "facial' that cool, cleans and refreshens.

Not much in the box, 2 treatments, starting with a small bottle of "mask' that one applies after wetting down the face.  It has a nice smell, slightly fruity, that you rinse off after 5 minutes.  Step 2, open the little peel pack, a moist pad, that one wipes over the face and allows to dry.  The skin feels clean, dry and slightly tight; moreover, if you have any nicks or scratches on your face, you'll sense a slight sting.  Step 3 is a moisturizing cream with vitamin c that one massages on face and neck- again, a pleasant, mildly fruity smell.

Ovearall, a nice, relaxing experience, but I don't know if it makes me look any different, espeically after just 2 treatments.  My face feels cleaner.  Perhaps, get your significant other to do it for you or do the applications together simultaneously while watcing a romcom moive.

Left my face feeling refreshed after step one, sticky after step two, and grimy after step three. Ling term effects will be hard to determine because I do not intend to continue using it due to the yucky feeling left on my face.
summary: Left my face feeling refreshed after step one, sticky ...

reviewText:
This is a pocket-size, two-time-only-use, all-in-one at home facial kit, that starts with a gentle foaming mask, in a small jar, and also includes four small, foil packets; two "peel" pads and, finally, two small packets of extra emollient moisturizer.

The foaming mask felt nice on my skin. You rub it on as it foams up and then leave it set for five minutes before rinsing off. I did mine while in a bath and it left my skin feeling bright and firm, but not tight or dry. I did notice though that I used more than half the bottle in my single use, making it doubtful I'll get another full mask out of it. Still, it was also much less messy, and faster, than a mud mask.

Next, you use the glycolic peel scrub, which is contained in a small cotton gauze round. These are reminiscent, for me, of the Ponds pads I used years ago, and they have the same slightly Witch Hazel-like smell. They leave your skin feeling a little sticky -- you're not directed to rinse afterwards, but I did -- but they're very mild, and not at all harsh, which is what I think when I hear the word "peel." Finally, you finish with the Vitamin C day cream, which is very rich and thick. If you're very conservative, you could probably get two uses out of the small packet, simply because it is rich, but I used my little bit extra on my dcollet.

All in all, this is basically a Bliss sample set, which might make a nice stocking stuffer, but is pretty pricey for a two-time use item. I'm not sure the products really even came close to replicating a true spa facial ... Frankly, I'm not even sure they worked in tandem all that well, and I certainly didn't notice any difference, from my single use, than I would from my usual, weekly mud-mask followed by a Clarisonic scrub.

Overall, I liked the foaming mask best, and might look to buy it again, but neither of the other two products impressed, and I admit I balk at paying high prices for a what are basically sample sizes, no matter how nicely they are packaged.
summary: Quite Pricey for a Two-Use Item

reviewText: The first impression is very "Wow, this box seems tiny to actually have enough to actually do anything..." but it turns out that it's only meant to hold enough for a couple of rounds of use, and it does that well. My skin is feeling good so far, and now that I know it works I like the idea that I could toss it into a bag very easily to take it on a trip, or keep a couple extra boxes around without having to worry about it much!
summary: My skin is feeling good so far

reviewText:
I have to say that even though the packaging is not very attractive, the actual treatment is totally worth a try and five star.

fairly simple and just three steps, it really doesn't require much at all as far as preparation, timing, and additional tools.

This is a perfect kit for taking with you on vacation, even if it's a three day weekend getaway.

 And of course, after using it and following the directions on the box, using enough for just two applications, my skin felt much smoother.
summary: It's worth a try, suggest to take it with you on vacation

reviewText:
True to it's word - this is indeed a 3-step facial conveniently packaged in a little box. What you're getting is a .34 ounce pump bottle of the foaming mask solution, 2x individually sealed glycolic resurfacing pads and 2x packets of Vitamin C day cream. While the kit is intended to provide 2 complete facials I'm able to squeeze 4 complete treatments out of it as the glycolic pads can be cut in half and still cover the entirety of my face/neck and each pack of the C cream can be used for 2 separate applications. With the foaming mask a little goes a very long way and I estimate that I could very likely get 8-10 applications out of it.

Like with all bliss products formulation is very high quality, pleasantly scented and I've experienced no irritation while reaping all the rewards of rejuvenated and glowing skin. A very convenient kit perfectly suited for travel or as a sampler set to experiment with quality bliss products.
summary: A great sampler set perfectly suited for travel

reviewText:
My skin is dry and somewhat irritated in spots with a reddish hue.  The small bumps that were evident when touching my face weren't noticeable just looking in a mirror.

The mask:  Rub it into your face until it lathers.  Leave it on for 5 min and rinse it off.  Made my skin feel dryer and tighter.  No indication if, like with other mask products, you should keep away from the soft area under your eyes.  You get 1 small bottle that youll be able to use for a lot more than the 2 applications.

The peel:  Not sure why its called a peel.  Its applied via a moist pad and it tingles for a few minutes.  Watch out though if you have any irritated skin as instead of a tingle, youll feel a burn.  You leave this on overnight.  My skin looked pretty red the next morning.  You get 2 of these in a foil-like packet.

The day cream:  You get 2 of these in a foil-light packet.  Dip your finger in and apply all over your face.

My face was still pretty red afterward and I wasn't thinking happy thoughts about these products.  But later in the day I realized that my skin felt smoother.  Those small bumps were less evident and my skin just felt better.

Would I purchase this kit again?  Perhaps.  But its not something Id use every week.  Is it the combination of the three that made a difference or is it more just one of the items that were so effective?  I wish I knew.
It softened my hands and made them look more youthful for an hour or so BUT so would using any good hand lotion with latex gloves. The "straps" on the gloves kept slipping loose, too.
summary: Works as well as any hand lotion with latex gloves.

reviewText: I have used hand masks in the past and some of them sting if you have cuts or torn cuticles but this one didn't.  The gloves have 2 layers, an outer plastic layer and a fiber-ish inner layer.  The first glove was easy to put on but I had trouble with the second glove getting the fiber-ish layer to open up.  If you've ever had trouble getting a produce bag at the grocery store to open then you know what I'm talking about.  Once I managed to get both gloves on, I massaged my hands for about 10 minutes then removed the gloves.  My hands were soft, not sticky, and didn't require any rinsing.  I applied the mask before bed and when I woke up my hands were still soft.  I would definitely use again.
summary: Once you get them on, they work great

reviewText:
Most reviewers are pretty critical about this hand mask.
They have good reasons.
It's expensive for a SINGLE use hand mask.
That's right: you're paying $10 for one disposable treatment.
You can justify it by saying that a similar treatment in a spa might cost 2-5 times more.

1. You must tear mask at the seam.
2. Wear the gloves
3. Secure the straps
4. Add the massage oil
5. Wear 10-20 minutes or longer for intense treatment.
6. Throw everything away.
7. Don't wash away the residue. Let it work its way in.

Karuna should price the single-use a bit more aggressively to encourage people to try it.
If they like it, they can get a 4 or 5 pack option.

Just don't expect miracles on a single-use product.

While this did indeed have moisturizing properties and left my hands feeling quite nice I felt that the delivery was a bit of an over kill with the ill-fitting and uncomfortable plastic gloves. I also felt that there was a great deal of waste with oil/lotion left behind in the gloves and that this product would be better served in a bottle or tube like any other lotion rather than try to be trendy and needlessly cost more.

This Age-Defying + Hand Mask from Karuna really did make my hands feel soft and smooth but not really any softer or smoother than when I cover my hands in a good, moisturizing cream and then put on vinyl gloves and let it work for 20 minutes.

You get one set of gloves - enough for one treatment. Just put your hands in the gloves and tape the attached wrist strap around your wrist, massage your hands through the gloves and then wait 20 minutes before removing and tossing the gloves. Notice that there is an inner pair of fabric-like gloves so be sure to put your hands inside the inner pair of gloves. It's a somewhat oily cream so you will need to rinse your hands after removing the gloves.

My hands definitely look and feel smoother and younger and well hydrated after using this hand mask but again, no more so than when I do it myself at home with my own hand cream and gloves. I put the cream on my hand and then slip on a pair of thin, cotton gloves and then pull on latex gloves over that and wait. While this is very convenient (I don't have to wash gloves afterward) and the cream is of high quality, it's just too expensive for my budget.
summary: Not really any softer or smoother than when I DIY this

reviewText:
I have been having a tough summer so far.  My allergies mainly manifest with intensely itchy and irritated skin.  Secondly, it's dry and my skin is already dry and tight feeling but this balm is actually working.  I had my doubts, honestly, I am suspicious as hell, but this is actually helping.  It has even helped with the godawful eyebrow itching that has been plaguing my every waking moment since springtime showed up with it's attendant hangers-on; pollen and mold.

I'm using this on my hands too and so far, not skin peeling and the itching feeling that was so intense I thought the irritants must be under the skin of my palm has mostly faded away.

Also, and this will be my last also, there is no smell!  I mean it, no fragrance at all.  Nothing to slice into my nostrils like a Star Trek brain burrowing bug to give me a headache, nausea and a mountain meadow odor that will not fade no matter how much I want it to.

With my fragrance sensitivity a lot of otherwise good moisturizing products are forbidden to me.

I really can't say enough positive things about this lotion.
summary: Stopped my skin from flaking away into red rash-y-ness.

reviewText: This is a good lotion if you have any sensitivity or allergic reaction to strong scents. This lotion is completely scentless. So that's a plus. However, I didn't like that it's not a very good absorbing lotion. I put it on, rubbed my hands together and about a minute later, my hands felt really greasy, like the lotion was sitting on top of my skin. I didn't like that at all. It eventually feel better but I didn't like how long it took before I didn't feel greasy.

I have very dry skin, and it winter, it itches and cracks if it's not moisturized regularly. While this lotion is too expensive for me to use year-round, it's wonderful in winter to soothe my itchy arms and legs and heal my cracked hands. I didn't find it sticky, as some reviewers did, but I'm usually negligent about my skin until it's gotten so dry I can't ignore the itching, so maybe with drier skin it absorbs more readily. I've found colloidal oatmeal products to be tacky though soothing, and this doesn't fall into that camp. One thing I really like about this product is that it won't irritate my skin if I've let it get so dry that it's sensitive. There are other dry skin products I use that are great with regular use, but irritate my skin if I've let it get too dry. This just soaks in and stops the itch.

Aside from excessive dryness and the accompanying sensitivity, I don't have any chronic skin conditions. This seems to be targeted more toward more serious skin issues, where the added expense would be more worthwhile year-round. For simple dryness, it makes more sense to use a cheaper product (i.e., whatever reasonably creamy lotion is on sale); but for winter itch, it's top notch and worth the price.

It's a reasonably large bottle with a solid pump, and I like that fact that it tapers down for efficiency.
summary: Great for winter itch. Not sticky for me (but my skin is quite dry).

reviewText: Wow, this is really effective on allergic dermatitis and some psoriasis issues. It calms the itching almost immediately and provides a long time of relief. It absorbs easily and doesn't leave the skin feeling too greasy.
summary: Great product - helped allergic rash and psorasis

reviewText: I've been using this the last few days since I've had eczema and dry skin on my hands. This definitely seems to work as well if not better than a standard moisturizing lotion. Keeps my skin hydrated and no itchy feeling.
summary: This definitely seems to work as well if not better than a standard moisturizing lotion

reviewText: Fragrance-free which is really great and feels nice and soothing on your skin, but this stuff takes forever to absorb.  An hour after I applied it my skin was still sticky.

This intensive baume has been tried out in my household on dry skin, eczema, and cellulitis with varying degrees of success. It has a lotion texture that feels thicker and more balm like when applied to the skin. It doesnt absorb very well, but instead creates a bit of a barrier on top of the skin and it takes awhile before not feeling greasy or sticky. It has no fragrance which is nice, not even an ingredient scent. As for soothing the itch, it worked well on eczema and did provide a small amount of relief on healing cellulitis. However it didn't seem to stop the itch of dry skin. It does work to heal and hydrate, especially on eczema there is a quick noticeable improvement to the condition of the skin. Honestly if it weren't for the residue I would use this daily, unfortunately I will only continue to use this for eczema to avoid the greasy feeling. I do feel this is a good product for skin conditions, however if the issue is just daily dry skin it is better to choose a lotion that absorbs more cleanly.
summary: Worked well for eczema, but doesn't fully absorb

reviewText:
I sometimes have an allergic reaction to one of the key medications I have to take.  Bioderma helped calm the crazed need to itch all over my body but especially my arms and face.  It acted quickly and though I still felt the impulse to itch at times a reapplication of this lotion mostly relieved that over time.

The lotion is scentless and works quick.  Its of average consistency and works into your skin fast.  It has a plastic stopper which removes easily the first when you first open the pump style nozzle.  The stopper prevents leakage during shipping.  This is a large bottle at 16.7 fl. oz.

The winter brings dry skin, and this product, Bioderma Atoderm Intensive Balm, is a very nice balm that stops any itching. My hands are quite dory, and this balm worked very well.

I do not have any particular dry skin issues except for aging and seasonal changes. I have used this balm on my feet after a nice soak, and the skin on my feet have become p,iable @n$ #oft. I can say the same for my hands. I would suspect that for anyone with a dermatitis, this balm would be lovely and quite helpful.

Recommended. prisrob 04-24-18

Wow.  I love this product and it is perfect if you have severe dry skin as I do.  I lack moisture in my body because of an illness and my skin is often dehydrated and it looks and feels it.  I also have chemical sensitivities and very sensitive skin.  I absolutely love, love, love that this truly has no fragrance.  I cannot abide by scented products on my body.  It's like they just penetrate my nose when they even have a touch of scent.  I could smell absolutely nothing on this balm.  My skin felt so good after I put this on.  It's heavy although very smooth.  I can still feel it on my skin the day after I put it on and my skin feels plump and moist.  This is a product I will continue to use and if you have extremely sensitive and extremely dry skin. this is a product you should try.
summary: Truly Unscented and Wonderful for Extremely Sensitive Dry Skin

reviewText: I would be extremely impressed by this if not for how sticky it remains even long after applying. I have a mast cell disorder so tend to get dermatitis and itchy skin from all types of things ranging from doing a bit of gardening to chemicals, sitting in the sun or even overly dry temperatures. In short - I itch a lot. Worse, I've spent a small fortune on skin products that often end up irritating even more due to harsh fragrance or some odd chemical. I have prescription heavy duty topical steroids but repeated use can actually make things worse so when possible, I attempt to go with something a bit less powerful. This has basically no fragrance added so gets high marks on that. It feels so so when it comes to soothing. I tested on dry skin - not really noticeable. I tested on itches - it was average. What really made this a no-go for me is the stickiness that remained even an hour later. I had to wash it off which defeats the purpose. Nice big bottle for a good price makes this worth a try but it doesn't dry well.

This is a pleasant, white-colored, scent-free balm that feels nice on the skin. It's in a sizable bottle (16.7 Fl) and is easy to squeeze out thanks to the pump. The texture is oily, but does absorb easily. My main issue with this balm was that, while it didn't irritate my sensitive skin, it didn't help me with the intense itching of my foot.

I have been using this for a week now on my eczema which covers both of my hands and palms and I can attest that the relief is there. No scent, when applied it is similar to sunscreen in that a layer is definitely detected as it actually absorbs slowly into the skin. It stings a bit at first but this is better than itching and even when I felt a "Layer" on my skin it was not sticky or greasy like other so-called heavy duty moisturizers or eczema lotions I have tried before, and yes the dry scales are healing and going away somewhat which is so much better than nothing.

Reading the bottle I see this is normally used in hospitals and clinics, based on how abrasive soaps and cleaners are there this product makes total sense.
summary: The relief is immediate and the lotion does deliver on it's promise to moisturize and kill the itch

reviewText: I'm crushing on this new to me mascara!!  I have long lashes, but they are fairly light and not the thickest, so I really like to amp them up and get the vavoom from my mascara.  I actually usually use 2 types ~~  Big Fatty for my base and build and It for the final layer.  AND I typically have to use waterproof because very seldom is it that my eyes don't water from the mascara.  I was kind of skeptical about this La Roche-Posay Respectissime Mascara, Extensions, but thought what the heck why not try it?  I LOVE this mascara!!  It has a smaller, thin wand, so again I was doubtful but it doesn't take much to build up, extend and darker your lashes to where they look AMAZING!!  As good as what I was using 2 mascaras to get ~ and my eyes haven't watered the least little bit.  I'm truly sold on this!!  And the cost is right in line with what I was already paying, times 2, so I think they've got a convert here.  I put it on when I do my make up for the day, and I work nights, so for a good 13 hours it looks amazing!!  I just remove with mascara remover and no issues!!  LOVE IT!!
summary: I'm crushing on this new to me mascara!!

reviewText: Whether or not you like a particular brand of mascara is dependent on what you want from the product.  Some mascara are designed to produce major thickening or volume.  If that's what you're looking for, this product is probably not going to make you happy.  But if you want color and length without any clumps you will probably really like this mascara, as I do.  The reason I gave it four stars instead of five is price.  The La Roche Posay Respectissime mascara costs about $25.  The L'Oreal Telescopic Mascara costs about $8.  I had been using the L'Oreal and am happy with it -- it goes on easily, separates, darkens, and does not clump.  Does not irritate my eyes.  When I had a chance to compare it to the La Roche Posay I was very interested to see if there were differences.  The brushes are a little different.  The L'Oreal brush is thinner and the little projections are more rigid than the La Roche Posay, which seems more like a conventional mascara brush.  The ingredient list is similar if not identical with water and wax being the main components of both. The two products go on similarly and look about the same.  The LaRoche Posay might be just a tad smoother or more silky but if there is a difference, it is a small one.  I like both products very much and if I were doing a controlled blind test I am not sure I would be able to tell them apart.  So I would say the  L'Oreal is a good dupe for this at about a third of the price.
summary: Love this but cannot see much difference from the less expensive L'Oreal Telescopic

reviewText: I have very sensitive eyes, with mascara being the worst offender. I normally use a Physician's Formula organic mascara which thankfully doesn't cause my eyes to burn and turn red, and adds a lot of drama. (Physicians Formula Organic Wear 100% Natural Origin Mascara, Black Organics, 0.26 Ounce ) The only reason I don't totally love it is it runs instantly on contact with water--so no crying or getting caught in the rain! Anyway, I think this mascara is similar. It adds volume and length, flakes minimally, and doesn't cause irritation. Removes easily with soap and water. It's fine, but since it costs so much more than the Physician's Formula, I'll stick to that one instead.

It's a nice mascara. The brush is oddly shaped but surprisingly convenient and fits the shape of lashes well in a direct swipe. The mascara itself leaves them not clumped and soft, and pretty well defined. I'd say it's nice both for everyday use and on a night out. I probably like it even better than its waterproof counterpart which I tried as well, because this one is easier to take off in the evening. For a full tube at $25, it might be a little pricey, but seems worth it.

As a long-time buyer of off-the-shelf-at-the-drugstore mascara, I have to admit I was intrigued by what an $18 tube of mascara would offer that the drugstore brands did not.  I wasn't really expecting anything special, but I have to say that I was wrong.  This mascara goes on beautifully smooth, looks great, but fairly natural, and makes my already long lashes look even longer and just bolder enough for an everyday look.  My only hesitation with this mascara is that is not waterproof, so I'm hesitant to wear it out to a movie or a night at the theater where I might end up shedding a tear -- but for everyday wear, or just a really basic application to feel awake and alert with a dash of lipstick, it's great.  It has a somewhat strong smell... I can't quite imagine why, but it is not unpleasant - somehow it makes me feel like I've gotten fancy.  I definitely will be glad to have this as time goes on and will likely repurchase in the future.
summary: Better than your average drugstore mascara, but not waterproof

reviewText: The thin, narrow wand allows the mascara to coat each eyelash without an excessive application of product. However, over time, the product builds up on the wand and it isn't scraped off sufficiently when you pull the wand out of the tube. So you end up with clumping on the lashes. To address this problem, I wipe the wand on a tissue to remove the excess product. I have also rinsed the wand a few times under hot running water. These extra steps shouldn't be necessary and are wasting a rather expensive product. Nevertheless, I like the appearance of my lashes when using this mascara, and it doesn't bleed too much under my eyes throughout the day. It also comes off easily at night with the use of a single eye makeup remover pad.
summary: Creates Nicely Separated Eyelashes and Washes Off Easily At The End of the Day

reviewText:
This made my sensitive eyes itch and water and turn red. I washed it off and my eyes immediately felt better. However, the next morning I had puffy, red lids.

Also, looks nice but you get spider eyes if you apply one stroke too many.

On the good side, it washed off easily.
This mascara works great, my wife can't really tell much if a difference from other mascaras (aside from a chemical smell). But, it stays on all day and makes her lashes look bolder and longer.
summary: This mascara works great, my wife can't really tell much if a ...

reviewText: Looks great and applies very easily.  Applied once and it lasted the rest of the day.

This mascara is easy to apply, coats the entire lash with one stroke and separates the lashes nicely. There's no need for several coats or careful build-up to get the effect you want. It provides excellent lash definition without the "anime eyes" effect. It looks nice throughout the day without the need for a lot of reapplication, but comes off easily with mascara remover. The brush is skinny and easy to maneuver for edge or lower lashes.
summary: lengthens and defines lashes with one stroke

reviewText: As for the mascara application and appearance, this is fine, nothing spectacular.  It goes on smooth with a nice darkening of the lashes.  I wouldn't say it necessarily makes them look longer, it isn't thick enough to really achieve that.  My main problem is that it is not water, or even sweat proof.  The slightest big of moisture around your eyes and you look like Alice Cooper.  I made the mistake of wearing this to hot yoga and it leaked all down my face.  I understand it isn't a waterproof mascara but it shouldn't run like that.  So if you are going to do anything where you might sweat a little, don't wear this.  On the upside to that, it didn't irritate my eyes when it ran into them!

As far as sensitivity goes, this is a 5 star product. I have very sparse lashes, but my eyes also get irritated by makeup, so it's great for that. But it's not the best mascara I have for long thick lashes. I think it's great for normal days when I only use mascara and don't apply any other eye makeup. Because my eyelashes are sparse and very light, it gives a little pop, like I have eyelashes.

When I wear eye makeup, I prefer some of the Maybelline line of big lashes.

I hadn't used this brand mascara before, but it was a fabulous addition to my makeup collection. It was immediately striking without clumping. It was also long lasting throughout the day without having to re-apply. This is a perfect product for everyday use.

Was not impressed by this. It did lengthen, but added 0 volume. A little volume would be ok, but this was 0. Hey thats just how this product is right? Well yes so normally I would say just wasn't our cup of tea. But it also dried out very fast and clumped incredibly badly. The clumping seemed to happen independent of how much or little was put on. Everyday for 4 days and counting we tried it we had at least some clumping we had to deal with. So it just was not a hit for us. It did make the lashes look long and beautiful when it was working. Ie before it dried out and for the few minutes it wasn't clumping. We tried it both with curling the eyelashes and without. Just couldn't get it solved. (These were used on hispanic eyelashes for somebody who has dark hair and straight lashes and usually goes for added volume just for context.)

I like this La Roche-Posay mascara but am not in love with it. Here is my honest opinion of pros and cons:

Pros: It separates my lashes without clumping, it looks very natural, washes off easily, does not flake, good for sensitive eyes

Cons: It does not make my lashes appear thicker, curly or longer (which is highly desirable for me), pricey

Overall, this mascara is good for people who want a natural look and have sensitive eyes. I like this mascara but don't love it because I prefer mascaras that give me volume for my sparse fine eyelashes.

Is is probably the third product I've tried fro La Roche-Posay and I'm impressed with what they produce.  This mascara is a true black.  It goes on easily and dries quickly so it's easy to apply a second coat and you'll most likely want at least two coats because it doesn't go on thick in fact that's probably what helps prevent clumping because this is the first mascara I've used where there's zero clumping.  It also wipes off cleanly if some goes astray which I do more than a little.  When applying my first coat I got a smudge in the corner of my eye.  Because this is such an often occurrence I dint even attempt to get it off immediately, I waited until I'd applied it to both eyes and then used a cotton ball to take it off and to my surprise it disappeared completely on my first try!  It stays on all day without any under eye flaking and washes completely off with soap and water.  I just wish it wasn't so expensive but over all the added price is probably warranted.
summary: True Black, No Clumping, Stays on All Day, Washes Off Cleanly

reviewerName: Leah Maines, best-selling, award-winning author, actor, and editor
reviewText: I have very sensitive eyes.  Most mascaras end up under my eye because I find myself rubbing my eyes during the day--because f allergies.  It wasn't until recently that I figured out I was actually having a reaction to the mascara.  This mascara did not bother my eyes at all.  I did not end up with black under eyes from rubbing.  The mascara did not flake, and did not irritate my skin.  It gives an attractive natural look.  I'm hoping they make this in a fuller look too.
summary: Good natural look for sensitive eyes

reviewText:
I love the idea of a dermatologist developed mascara. For someone with sensitive eyes/skin, this would be great! However, I was not as impressed with the overall effect of the mascara. I put it up against Urban Decay's Perversion mascara which is $22 versus La Roche-Posay's $25. I have very fair lashes that are long but slightly sparse.

The La Roche-Posay mascara has a thinner brush wand and seems like it would comb through lashes better. It does on the first pass but if you try to build the mascara with subsequent passes, you'll start clumping quickly. I need better coverage so one pass doesn't suffice. And once the mascara started to clump, I used my lash comb to separate and wound up clumping even worse. The mascara seems to be very sticky and dries quickly.

On the other hand, Urban Decay's Perversion has a bushy brush and a lot more bristles. This keeps the mascara from clumping despite several passes with the brush. The formula is more creamy and takes a little longer to dry but it much more manageable. I can build the mascara to the coverage I need.

So, for my use, the La Roche-Posay doesn't cut it. It's a decent mascara but I like something with which I can get better coverage.

This is a cool and powerful gadget that does all the face scrubbing for you.
I've been using it for a couple of days now and my skin is noticeably softer, and a lot smoother.
It *started* working on the blackheads but I can't say they are completely gone. There is definitely a visible effect, and I think I will get some results applying a pore-minimizing creme after. Just don't expect to completely eliminate blackheads with this device alone.

The brush has 4 speeds and has preset programs for your face and body. The preset speed for your cheeks for example is different from the one for your chin, and the brush tells you when you need to move from one are to the next.
The package includes a face cleanser and a body scrub but you can of course use your own cosmetics.

It takes forever to charge the brush the first time but then the battery lasts quite a while.
I just wish it came with a stand like the charging station for your phone.
Instead it comes with a USB cable and a wall charger - I still managed to balance the brush on the charger.
The charger also has a little magnet that attaches to the brush - nice touch!

This is the big daddy Clarisonic.  I bought a Mia a couple years ago & it still works great  its much smaller so I travel with that one.  You have to buy these from authorized dealers.  There are a lot of fakes being sold online.  You need to see Ships From & Sold By Amazon if you are buying here.  These are made in the USA.

This took at least 18 hours to charge the first time.  Dont plan to use it right out of the box.  It is pre-programmed to spin at different rates depending on face, body & feet.  You can override this & use it as you like.  It comes with 2 brushes; one for your face & one for your body.  Read the instruction manual  youll have plenty of time while you wait for it to charge the first time :)

It cleans & exfoliates really well.  I like these devices very much but I also like my non electric/natural bristle face brush by Bass.  I go back and forth.

Make sure you keep the brush clean & let it air dry between using.  These brushes can become a Petri dish of bacteria if you don't rinse & dry them.

This can be charged by USB and includes a wall mount AC adapter so you can plug it in to an outlet.  The charger is 100-240 Volts so it can be used worldwide if you have a country adapter.

I have been using Clarisonic facial cleansing brushes for years. This is the top of the line Smart Profile model. The Clarisonic leaves my skin feeling smooth, fresh and glowing. The Smart Profile includes a "turbo" button for deep cleaning and rough skin, It boasts 4 speeds and includes an adjustable T-Timer (this beeps when it's time to move on to a different skin zone). This unit is designed to be used (with different brush heads) all over the body.

This package includes 2 brush heads (face and body), the Smart Profile unit, USB Charger and directions.

There are fake Clarisonic units on the market. And some of them look good visually though they don't tend to work well or last. I did due diligence on this one checking all the signs and this is a genuine unit. When you purchase a Clarisonic avoid to good to be true offers and work with an authorized dealer to make sure you are getting the real thing. Amazon is an authorized dealer.  If you plan to purchase from Amazon, purchase directly through them.

The one drawback to this unit is there is no stand for it. There used to be one but apparently they had issues with it. I do think they should make a stand for it. It is more hygienic.

Overall, this is a fabulous tool for glowing skin!

The solid feel and the power of the "Clarisonic Smart Profile Advanced Face and Body Cleansing Brush" are impressive.  The cleansing brush is comfortable to hold, but it is heavier than many others that are sold.  Including the brush head, the complete unit weighs about 8 5/8 oz.  A plastic cover protects the brush head when you are not using the unit.  However, even though it has ventilation holes, I found that after 16 hours the brush was not completely dry.  I would recommend leaving the plastic cover off the cleansing brush unless you are traveling or throw it into a drawer after use.  Controls for the cleansing brush are located on the handle; they are positioned well and you will not accidentally turn the brush off when using it.

Even more impressive are the four different speed choices, the cleansing function and the various use options available.  The charger fastens to the front of the brush handle using a magnet; this helps keep the charger smaller in size and makes it easier to pack for travel.  This cleansing brush charges fully in 24-hours; the green indicator light has a solid glow when the brush is completely charged.  The three-year warranty, when purchased from an authorized dealer like Amazon and not a marketplace seller, is a real plus since most cleansing brushes have a one-year warranty.

The "Clarisonic Smart Profile Advanced Face and Body Cleansing Brush Holiday Gift Set, White" has been on my Amazon "Wishlist" for several months.  I balked at paying nearly $300 for it and was pleased to see Amazon had reduced the price to about $145 briefly, allowing me to purchase it without feeling guilty.  This is a five-star product - and, if you can catch it on sale, a five-star price!
summary: Solid Feel, Excellent Cleansing Action, Different Use Options, and Three-Year Warranty Make This a Winner ...

reviewText:
Back in the 80's, I had a similiar motorized skin brush. It was great while it lasted. Now that  I am middle aged with sensitive, oily, perimenopausal with occasional acne skin I thought I should try one again. Would this really help my skin look better, I wondered?.

The box arrived very quickly. This unit has a magnetic charging station with usb and an electric adapter as well, which is nice  It comes with a face brush, body brush, cleansing lotion and a polishing lotion. Charging it was easy, the instructions say to let it charge for a full 24 hours.
I've used the pre-programmed facial and body cleaning cycles. The face brush is very soft, I wasn't sure it would DO anything when I first used it but I was proven wrong. I wish the face program was shorter for the forehead and longer on the cheeks, but that's a personal preference. My skin does look better after just a week of using it. The clogged pores on my nose are much clearer and smaller and my skin looks a bit healthier.

The body brush is ok but I'm not overly excited about it. I wish it were larger and had a bit more power to it. I had a bit of trouble getting the heads off while in the shower, but I supposed they need to be that tight so water doesn't get to the interior. The cleansing/polishing lotions that come with it are really great. My skin is super sensitive and these didn't dry me out or make me red. I would buy them on their own if available.

Overall, I'd recommend this as an excellent skin care tool!

This is a powerful and awesome beauty accessory that does your facial deep cleansing for you.

I've been using it for a couple of weeks now and my skin is noticeably softer, and a lot smoother.
I have noticed that my pores aren't as large and my skin now has that "glow" that people talk about.

The Smart Profile Model includes a mode for deep cleansing.
It has four speeds and includes an adjustable timer that beeps when it's time to move on to a different skin zone (It follows a t-zone pattern)
You get a facial and body brush head in the Smart Profile package.

It does take 24 hours to charge the brush the first time, but, once the battery is fully charged it last quite a while.

The only negative i see is that it doesn't have a charging stand, which would make charging easier and the storage of the unit more sanitary.

The cleansing system comes neatly packaged with two cleansing brushes, cleanser, skin buffer and charger. Switch out the brushes and after cleansing your face, you can scrub thicker skin i.e. Feet, elbows, knees.
The facial cleanser works well but my skin was left very dry. A good follow up moisturizer is a must.
Overall, it gives a thorough clean but is too drying for daily use.
summary: Cleanses well but left my skin quite dry.

reviewText:
I'm a longtime Clarisonic user.  Prior to receiving this, I already owned a Clarisonic Mia 2 and a Clarisonic Opal, both of which I love and use regularly.  Because of my past experience, I know first hand how well my skin responds to their devices and how fantastic their customer service is (part of my Opal charger stopped working during the warranty period and they exchanged it for a new one without hassle).  And I was excited to receive this device because knowing how beneficial Clarisonic had been for my face, I was excited to see what it could do for my body.

This particular Clarisonic model is awesome for a few reasons. One, it can be used on both the face and body making it more versatile.  Two, when you use a smart-enabled brush head it adjusts its speed, power and timing.  Yet, it also has four speeds that can be used with the original brush heads (i.e. acne, sensitive, deep pore, etc.) so it  gives you lots of options.

I will admit I still prefer my Mia 2 for my face since it is a little lighter and less bulky than the Clarisonic Smart Profile, but LOVE this for my body.  I'm prone to body acne so getting a thorough cleanse is essential.  This does a good job of keeping my body acne managed, with the bonus of also exfoliating my skin so it feels soft and healthy.  I LOVE using this with the Refining Skin Polish on my legs before shaving because it makes my legs extra soft.  And beyond the benefit of having thoroughly cleansed skin it gives my skin a nice little massage, which I enjoy.

My only nit is I really, really wish this came with an attachment to make it easier to reach back between your shoulder blades.  I have pretty flexible shoulders, but I still find it challenging to reach that area.  It looks like a separate attachment was sold for this purpose in the past, but has since been discontinued by Clarisonic.

Still, I love this device.  I still think if you're planning to use it primarily to clean your face that the Mia 2 is a slightly better option (less bulky, lighter weight), but do very much love the versatility of being able to use this on both my face and body.

Would recommend!

I am in love with this!  I have always wanted a facial cleansing system like this one.  I have seen many different brands all with varied brushes and cleaning systems.  All of them seem to have similar claims of miraculously turning your skin from blah to fabulous.  I am a middle aged woman with sensitive skin that has several issues from black heads, white heads, dark spots, dryness and wrinkles.  Clearly if this system can do something to improve skin, then it will show up on me.

Set up was very easy.  The charging cable connects magnetically to the unit, so you just set it up against it and it automatically starts to charge.  I think that it would be nice if it had some sort of stand to keep it on.  I just don't care for having it just laying on my sink.

When I first used this I was excited, but I didn't expect miracles.  I used the pre-programmed facial cleaning cycle.  It was fast, so I almost didn't think that it would have worked.  It is exactly what you need.  My skin showed a dramatic change after just a few days.  The black heads, white heads and spots all started to disappear.  My face feels softer and looks clearer.  The brush clears your pores much better than a wash cloth.  The cleanser is also good on my sensitive skin.  You also only have to use a very small amount of the cleanser to clean your entire face.

I love the body brush just as much!  I was shocked at how good it feels and how well it exfoliates your skin.  The turbo feature was excellent for a deep massaging clean.  I have very dry skin and after using this on my body I no longer have dry or rough patches anywhere.  Even my feet are no longer flaky and they have always been a problem area for me.  I just cleanse with this and put coconut oil all over like I used to and my skin is super soft and thoroughly hydrated.

I would recommend this to anyone looking for an excellent sonic clean.  The fact that this one can also be used all over makes it better than the ones that I have seen that are just for the face.

There is no doubt this Clarisonic is expensive but it definitely works.  Overall, I really liked using this product.  After I used it I tried my regular exfoliate (The Cure from Japan) - instead of globs of dead cells hardly anything came off my face.  Very impressive.
First off, I like that it is completely water proof so you can use in the shower.  (NOTE:  the cord is NOT water proof) The handle is charged by attaching a magnetic like curved strip that plugs into an USB or regular outlet and it clips to the handle, so there is no opening on the handle. However, the problem with a handle that is self contained is how long is its lifespan?  Since it can't be opened you can't add or replace new batteries.  The internal battery can also be a hassle if you forget to recharge it since it can take a while to recharge.  But it does have a battery life indicator which is helpful to tell you how much juice is left.
The pack also includes 2 brush heads one for the body and the other for the face.  Both are soft and plush on the skin- the problem is you will need to buy more.  It would be nice it they were sold in multi packs for a discounted price!
This Clarisonic also has a helpful timer so you can do each zone of your face equally.  I admit I liked the massage it gives and wanted to do more cycles per zone.  This is good for preventing you from over exfoliating yourself!  You can also go manual and switch modes if you prefer, too.  This model has speed options that can increase 'illumination.'  Not sure if that actually works.
The kit also includes 2 cleaners.  A gel cleaner and skin polish.  Both are very mild.  The company states you can use other cleaners but not to use any with exfoliates that not are perfectly round like those that have nut shells as this will scrape your face.  Another thing about the use of the brush is that it should not be shared since bacteria etc. can transfer.  I am currently using it with my sister but we have our separate brush heads.
Although there are several negatives I really felt the Clarisonic worked so well on my face and body that the positives outweighed the issues of concern.  Since I often feel my make up removers aren't doing all that they are supposed to this extra insurance gives me piece of mind and feels a little like a fancy spa treatment.  Definitely something to spoil yourselves with.
summary: Gives me piece of mind and feels a little like a fancy spa treatment.  Definitely something to spoil yourselves with.

reviewText:
I have used another facial cleaning brush with minimal results. I wondered if the Clarisonic would do better so ordered this one to try. It comes with a facial brush and a body brush, trial sized tubes of gel cleanser and refining skin polish. It utilizes both a manual and a smart four-speed system for programmed cleaning of forehead, nose, chin and cheeks. Each area is cleaned for 20 seconds, and then a speed change signals you to move on to the next area. The body cleanse is timed for three minutes, almost enough time to use the brush on ones body.

The unit is waterproof and comes with a charging cord and magnet that attaches to the handle of the brush (not to be attached when using near water).

Ive been using the facial brush for a few days and can attest that it does a very good job of cleansing the skin and shrinking the pores. Already my skin feels softer. Time will tell if wrinkles become less visible, but I am hopeful. I haven't had the device long enough to give a more detailed review, but so far, I am more than pleased with both the performance and quality of the Smart Profile Sonic Facial Cleansing System.
summary: Does a far better job than a washcloth.

reviewText: I LOVE this product, my skin is looking so much better since I began using it. Lines are reduced, pores clearer, skin looks younger, woot! I got a great deal on it for Cyber Monday, so glad I snapped it up! I don't use the body/pedi brushes much, but have had good experiences with both.
summary: Wish I had bought one sooner

reviewText:
Okay, now I get the hype around Clarisonic brushes.  I have a cheaper, knockoff type facial brush that I got, but it never really made a difference in my skin's appearance or texture.  This brush is amazing!  It has a 60 second "smart mode" that cleans your face wonderfully (20 seconds deep cleaning on forehead, 20 seconds deep cleaning on nose and chin, 10 seconds each cheek).  This is quick and done..and your face is so super soft.  It comes with it's own gel cleaner.  You can use the manual mode if you want more control over the time on each part of the face.

Now for the equally exciting part...it comes with a bigger brush head that you can use on your body in the shower!  It also comes with it's own cleaner, and rather than a gel, it is slightly gritty to exfoliate more.  The body "smart mode" is 3 minutes long and that is about enough time to do most of my body, i might go thru the cycle again if I am really working one area.  It has made such a difference to my skin, it is has never been so soft before, and I exfoliate with scrub cleaners on a regular basis.  It isn't so abrasive that I can't use it every day, so I use it as much as I can.  And obviously, the brush is waterproof, but do not submerge in water.

It also has a turbo function that I like to use on my feet, knees and elbows.  This just seems to speed it up a bit, but nothing drastic.  It charges with a cool little magnetic clip that attaches to the front.  The first charge is 24 hours but I have not run it all the way down again to have to charge it that long again.  The brush heads are easy to remove when you leave the plastic caps on, you just simply press down and turn.  The plastic caps have holes in them so i let the brush dry with them on, no issues with this so far.

Per the manual other Clarisonic brush heads will fit this brush, they just won't have the smart features and you will have to do the speeds manually.  It also says it will notify you when it is time to replace the brush heads.  From what I have seen, the cost for replacements are crazy expensive and if my skin continues to be this soft, it will definitely be worth it!  Overall I am very pleased, more so than I expected to be!

So before using this, the only face brush I had used was the Conair Power Facial Cleanser. There is a huge difference in price so I was curious about whether or not the quality was enough that I'd care. Right of the bat, there's an obvious difference in quality. This Clarisonic is rechargeable while the Conair one is battery operated. This brush comes with a face and a body brush while the Conair one comes with a face brush and a sponge which I never used so I can't tell you how useful it is. This has multiple settings and the default setting beeps telling you when to move to the next section of skin while the Conair one just rotates one way or the other. I have sensitive skin but am not diagnosed with any skin conditions. I do get dry skin patches easily. Because of that I didn't use the included sample creams as I wanted to be testing this device with cleansers that I know don't upset my skin to be sure that any issues were with the device and not the products. What I found was that it cleans well but if you have really sensitive skin this device might not be for you. Most of my skin was fine with using this. A few more sensitive areas did have light red splotchiness after use. Not for long but enough for me to decide to be cautious using this on days when my skin is extra sensitive. The brushes on this device are definitely a high quality product when compared to the cheaper Conair brush that I have. They feel just firm enough to exfoliate but gentle enough that you're not afraid to use them on your skin. The Conair felt similar at first but softened up a bit too much within the first few uses while this brush holds it's original condition longer. These use technology to tell you when you should replace them while the Conair brush = you're on your own. I've never personally seen the replacements for the Conair brush and unlike their more expensive brushes there is no link for parts on the official product page while the replacement brushes for this Clarisonic brush are readily available. This brush takes at least 24 hours to fully charge when you first get it and the manual does recommend letting it fully charge before its first use. The charger is magnetic and connects to the lower front section of the brush. The power cable is a USB cable and comes with an adapter so you can plug it into the wall. I really don't have anything bad to say about this product except for the price. It should be noted that this is one of the pricier at home face brushes. Would I, personally, buy it knowing what I know after using it? I wouldn't. It's an excellent product but I don't wear makeup except for once every few years. This device is overkill for someone like me. I'm not into sports. Sure, your skin is going to feel clean. But if you're not outside getting dirty a lot or if you're not wearing a lot of makeup, I really think that a more inexpensive brush with less bells and whistles will do the job just as well. Especially given that that replacement heads for this device can cost as much or more as some of the lower end brush systems. For someone who is really rough on their skin and needs more cleaning power and has some money to spend, this may be an option. It does accept all of the brushes that the company currently sells while some of the more inexpensive Clarisonic devices are not compatible with all of the brushes -- so if you know you have uses for all of the brushes or if you will share the device with people who have different brush needs (don't share brushes) it might be worth it. But for me, while a nice device, it's a bit much.
summary: Awesome device but overkill for me...

reviewText:
My daughter, a cosmetology student in her late teens, is very meticulous about her complexion.  She has wanted to try a brush cleansing system, so I was pleased when this Clarisonic Smart Profile, 4-Speed Sonic Facial Cleansing Brush System showed up in my Vine selection.  This particular system has additional settings over the other Clarisonic brush systems, including deep cleanse and body smoothing, and offers 11x better cleansing over washing with hands alone.

My daughter has been using this brush system for over a week now and absolutely loves it.  Her skin is healthier looking; her complexion is now pimple-free and the dry flakey skin on her outer cheek area has disappeared.  Note that she has continued to use her regular face cleansers (vs the Clarisonic cleanser).

The main disadvantage of this system is its price.  In addition to the initial cost of the system, it is recommended to replace the brushes every three months because the bristles become less effective over time.  In addition, the Clarisonic gel cleanser and skin polish are kind of expensive should you choose to use their products.  Besides the cost, one other negative is that the set does not come with a stand, which would be nice to have.

Had this not been available to us free of charge, we would have most likely purchased a less expensive brush system.  However, my daughter has been very impressed with the results and would recommend it.

I have had a Clarisonic Mia for a year and I have really liked it. It was recommended to me by a friend and by my brother in law's wife, so I thought I'd give it a shot. It's expensive, but it's been really wonderful.

I realized that I was neglecting to change the brush at the rate you are supposed to (it happened sporadically). It's important to change the brushes as they can build up bacteria which they will then spread around on your face when you wash.

I was very excited to have the opportunity to use the Smart Profile purely because of the brush changing reminder, but this one is SO much more. It is timed for the different parts of your face, so you'll start it on your forehead for 20 seconds, it will buzz and you'll change to your chin for 20 seconds and then it buzzes and turns down the intensity for your cheeks (10 seconds each). I find this feature extremely handy.

I also used the body brush. The Smart Profile knows which brush is on, so it doesn't time itself for the body. You can use it on the normal level or you can switch it turbo for some extra exfoliation.

It came with a sample of body scrub and a cleaner. I have very sensitive skin which reacts badly to changes in skin care products, so I didn't try the cleaner, but I did try the body scrub and it was nice, but you'd be fine with any exfoliating or non-exfoliating body scrub.

While this is a pricey product, if you like your current Clairsonic product, you will really love the extra features on this one.

Although I'm in the target age group for this product, I was disappointed to find it too greasy for me to use. During the day it made my skin look oily and unwashed, and at night, it just felt uncomfortable, even though I only applied it to the drier parts of my face.

This is a little bottle of product, but since you only pump out smaller amounts, it will probably last for a while. There is a subtle fragrance, but it's not unpleasant.  I intend to use this on the backs of my hands and other non-face areas, and see if there are any skin improvements.

I have been looking for the right products that could reduce the appearance of crow's feet and laugh lines in my aging skin. I have tried Collagen and Retinol based skin care products. While they seem to help a bit, I wanted something better and more effective. When I heard good things about Cindy Crawford's Meaningful Beauty line of products, I decided to give it a try.

The Ultra Lifting and Filling Treatment seemed like a promising anti-aging serum at first. A couple of pumps from the bottle went a long way. It went on silkily and left my skin feeling soft and smooth. That was until the next morning when I woke up to breakouts. There were several red blotches as well. Needless to say, I wasn't thrilled at all.

I don't know if it is too harsh or my skin is too sensitive. It seems to irritate my skin more than improving it. At any rate, this product is not for me.

I used this lifting cream based on the directions and it didn't seem to work very well for me.  It stays sticky for a really long time, so you have to wait at least 1/2 hour before applying foundation over it.  It is hot and humid where I live and perhaps that is why.  The last time I used it, I put it on the fine lines under my eyes and around my mouth after I put my makeup on and that worked better for me.  I saw a bit of an improvement but not enough to justify the price.

First let me say I got this through Amazon Vine and would not have purchased this normally. And I would still absolutely not spend $72 on this.

Overall, it's a decent product. As others have pointed out, there is no ingredient list on the bottle, which is kind of annoying. The bottle itself, though, is very pretty. The pump works well, and does give good control over how much product you dispense. A little goes a long way, too.

The product feels very smooth, almost slick, but doesn't leave a greasy feel on your hands or face after applying. It soaks in very quickly. The scent is almost non-existent (which I like very much). I've had no adverse reactions to this at all, but neither have I been impressed. It's just okay. I have liked other, much less expensive products more.
summary: Very nice bottle, but the product inside is just okay

reviewText: Kind of a silly name for a product, but since I can't do Botox I'm always trying new things for  skin management. The results from this were ok-not any better or worse than your average store bought cream. Nothing that's going to make anyone look like Cindy Crawford from back in the day. All any of us can do is try.
summary: Meaningful Beauty Ultra Lifting and Filling Treatment, 1 fl. oz

reviewText:
These temporarily filled in some faint lines by ultra hydrating some of the skin under the eyes and on the forehead.  It was easy to apply and didn't go on greasy.  It seemed to have a couple hours of face-life in 80 degree dry heat.  A little went a long way but the bottle probably wouldn't be enough for everyday use for a full month.

I couldn't find any actual ingredient list for this product so I probably wouldn't use it again.

I'm nearly 50 with dry, sensitive skin. I think this is more a temporary line filler than a product that would produce any worthwhile cumulative effects. After using this twice, I had more milia pop up, probably due to the large amount of dimethicone (a silicone) in this product that would explain the ability of it to temporarily fill the lines/wrinkles. Milia are hard white bumps that form underneath the skin's surface, not to be confused with whiteheads.

I normally don't care for fragrance, but this has a pleasant, very light fruity scent, and the treatment spread easily on my face without much tugging. However, no matter how little I used, it was sticky and made my face shiny. I noticed absolutely no lifting effect.

If you have an event where you want to temporarily fill the wrinkles, this product may be for you, although there are probably cheaper alternatives.

This appears to be yet another product with a celebrity name that costs more than many products but doesn't deliver meaningful results.  I haven't really been able to notice any difference in the appearance of my face using this product, but it does feel extremely silky going on in a way that other products haven't felt on my skin. I'll probably use it if I run out of other products just to keep my skin treated and because it feels nice, but I certainly wouldn't purchase it.

reviewerName: Keleigh Crigler Hadley, author of Revenge Inc.
reviewText:
I have tried several products with blurring technology. Loreal and Garnier both have products that not only blur but matte the skin as well.

I was very disappointed in the blurring ability with Meaningful Beauty. I didn't expect much in the Lifting and Filling area because I don't have any fine lines or wrinkles, but I do have large, oily pores around my nose. I had hoped that this product would reduce the appearance of my pores and reduce the shine, but it did neither.

Granted the package says that it does some things instantly, and other things over time, so perhaps in time I will see a difference.

I was hesitant to try this product due to the reviews of it causing breakouts and blotchiness but I gave it a go. Happily I did not break out but I did not see results either. It made the fine lines under my eyes stand out more. It felt greasy and sticky. I don't like the smell either. I do not wear foundation and this product just made my skin look shiny. I did like the packaging. The pump is nice. But it is not something I would purchase.

This actually worked.  I couldn't be more surprised.

WHAT IT DID
---------------------
What the Lifting and Filling fluid did was reduce small lines.  It doesn't work on anything major like those creases above the nose or around the mouth.  It does diminish those tiny lines.

TOUCH AND FEEL
----------------------------
I did NOT like the feel of this on my face.  It is sticky and you'll have to wear make-up over it or you will look exceedingly 'dewy' as we say in the South.  Since I'm a mom who goes with minimal make-up this means that I'll be breaking this out only for special occasions.

I also want to note that I have very-very sensitive skin and this fluid did not irritate my skin.

SUMMARY
Much to my amazement this Guthy Renker product worked to reduce the appearance of small lines.  Because it leaves you looking glossy it's not a product that I would use on a daily basis because I don't wear much in the way of makeup.  I would use it though on special occasions like family photo shoots or parties. I would not pay a ridiculous price for it.

My skin is easily irritated and I had no problem with this product.  If you're sensitive like me do test it out first on the inside of your wrist and elbow.

I am 54 and don't have a lot of deep wrinkles yet--thanks genetics. I do however have a stubborn groove between my eyes from years of furrowing too had during exams, meetings and stressful situations. I have tried fillers before to little avail. I currently use L'Occitane serum at night which seems to help a bit. I decided to try this product during the day as recommended to see if it did indeed, fill in that line. I have mixed results. It looks a bit less deep, but it's still visible, especially later in the day. The product takes awhile to dry (especially if it's humid) and then sometimes flakes later in the day as well. I started putting some under my eyes and it really felt great and gave a little sheen-glow to that area. I have translucent skin, very fair and this product did not irritate me in anyway. While I like the product, I think the price is very steep for the results. I do think it will last a long time however because a little goes a long way.
summary: Some Results but no Magic Potion

reviewText:
I think the best possibility of this treatment working is if you have a basis of good genes.  This does smooth out some imperfections, but it is sticky and more than that very expensive for any results that you might get. It is an impossibility that your skin will begin to look like Cindy Crawfords unless your genes are aimed in that direction.

The directions say 1 or 2 pumps, massage into your face and neck in the morning and let dry then follow up with the rest of the Meaningful beauty system. Personally it feels uncomfortable to have this on my skin during the day and my makeup does not look as good.  The advertised glow seems to come from the fact you have this gel like substance on your face, not from a skin improvement.

This didn't work for me.

It produced puffiness, which is really not the sort of wrinkle minimizing I hoped for, or want.

I also have several red blotches, which are taking (at least) a few days to fade.  It's not a lovely look.

Am I allergic to the product?  I don't think so.  On the other hand, there were unpleasant sensitizing effects each time I tried the product, and they did not mitigate at all the next time I used the product.  I may try again when my skin is completely back to normal--and the pollen count is very low.

But I may well not.  For me, this has proved to be more of a skin irritant than a skin improvement.
summary: This produced puffiness and red blotches.  Whether it's just too harsh or my skin is hypersensitive, I can't say.

reviewText: An easy to apply silky feeling lotion.  According to the product label this Ultra Lifting and Filling Treatment contains blurring agents designed to help conceal imperfections, giving your skin a beautiful soft-focus glow.  To be honest I didn't notice that my skin has a beautiful soft focus glow.  I did notice a bit of tingling after I put it on.  It claims to give your skin a youthful appearance but I haven't noticed any change although that may change after using the product on a regular basis.
summary: no noticeable changes in my skin

reviewText: Can't give a long term review because after one use, I have decided I will not be using more of it. I have sensitive dry skin. I had tried this brand's serum and figured why not? I don't have many signs of wrinkles yet but do have a few old acne scars, so a "filling" cream is something I'm willing to try even if that sounds like an unbelievable claim -- even if it benefits my skin in any way, it'd be worth trying. I'd only try one other product that claimed to have any filling benefit (L'Oréal Paris Revitalift Volume Filler Daily Volumizing Moisturizer, 1.7 Ounce) and it was at least a good moisturizer. This filler, however, not only didn't have any "filler" benefit but also left my skin angry. At first it did feel like there was something to it... Run my hand over my face and it felt pretty smooth. Felt tight. That's always a good feature from anything you're putting on your face. Within minutes it felt dry and itchy. May be for some people but for me? Something in it is not agreeing with my skin. Any benefit that it might offer isn't worth the reaction I had to it. There's no ingredient list on the bottle, so I searched them out... not sure what is bothering my skin, but something is. Did not have this reaction with their serum so it's definitely something in this product and not necessarily in all of their product line. Water (Aqua), Glycerin, Isopentyldiol, Dimethicone, Cucumis Melo (Melon) Fruit Extract, Orchid Leaf/Root/Stem Extract, Methylglucoside Phosphate, Copper Lysinate/Prolinate, Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Stearyl Alcohol, Phytosterols, Glyceryl Stearate, Polyglyceryl-10 Myristate, Tocopherol, Behenyl Alcohol, Batyl Alcohol, Polyacrylamide, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, C13-14 Isoparaffin, Laureth-7, Sodium Hydroxide, Phenoxyethanol, Fragrance (Parfum).

Utterly overpriced. I am so glad I never caved in to one of those informercials over the past several years. The serum is fairly light and sticky, and once it dries it's supposed to smooth over your skin. I suppose it does this job fairly well, for the day, but it's not permanent and it's certainly not worth its cost. There are many other products, including the Vitamin C serum from Body Shop, that do the same thing for less than half the price.  The scent is very light and didn't bother me, and I am very sensitive to fragrance. And, it didn't irritate my skin, although it feels very tingly when you first put it on until it dries.
summary: I am so glad I never caved in to one of those informercials ...

reviewText: This stuff is expensive.  There I said it.. it is amazing that they can charge this much for just 1 oz of product.  As for the product itself,  it goes on a bit greasy and definitely seems to have a positive effect.  The blurring effect that the product description mentions is subtle and does help with minor imperfections.  I cannot say if the effects are long term but for the few hours that this stays on your skin there is indeed a difference. If this product were cheaper or came in a larger quantity it would be excellent.  But at its current level it is too expensive and too small to say it is a 5 star product.
summary: Works But Too Expensive For Such A Small Quantity

reviewText:
I've seen the infomercials-my expectations were low but I was delighted!
The serum smelled nice, light smooth texture and quirky absorbed. Leaving skin smooth and dewy.
I have used this for a few weeks and already see and feel improvement.
summary: Able to see results right away

reviewText:
One to two pumps is all you need for full coverage of your face and neck. This potion is very smooth and silky going on, and covers very well.  Almost like it's skimming along the surface of your skin more so than being absorbed by it, although after a bit of time it seems to be 'in' the skin. It has a pleasant scent, but does leave a slightly sticky residue on your hands and face. (Very noticeable as flakes on the skin if too much product is used.)

The product's website details this product in the following way:

"This powerful, dual-action anti-aging serum helps visibly lift skin and acts as a non-invasive line filler to help temporarily smooth out the look of fine lines and wrinkles. It contains a rare, exclusive orchid extract which comes from the Emerald Coast of France and is designed to enhance natural production of healthy collagen and elastin in the skin."

It's part of a skin care line that if used regularly promises amazing results. Unfortunately I don't have the entire line to try out, but this 'filler' - used to temporarily smooth fine lines and wrinkles - is a good product from my brief usage of it. It does add a moisturized layer to the skin; especially around the eyes, that gives the skin a plumper appearance.  Used underneath my mineral make-up, I noticed a subtle, positive difference.

I do get a slight blotchy redness right after applying it, and some very minor tingling.  This does disappear rather quickly though. I think using less is actually better and it may not be necessary to smooth it all over your face as much as the areas around your neck, mouth and eyes.

This product is expensive by comparison to other products I've used and I look forward to giving it at least 30 days to work its magic. Ideally I would use it for 3 months, but I'm not sure there's that much product in this 1 fl oz bottle.  I'll definitely update this review the longer I use the product to let Amazon shoppers know my experience with it over an extended period of time.

--------------------------------------

UPDATE:  7/18/16 - After a month of consistent use I can say this product works very well to make my whole face and neck feel moisturized.  My skin seems plumper - more elastisity - and does seem to make the appearance of fine lines (especially around my eyes) significantly less noticable.

This stuff is really remarkable in the sense that it takes one pump (very small amount) to get full coverage.  My 49 year old skin is generally fairly dry so I was afraid this product would be sucked in never to be seen again.  Much to my delight it went on silky smooth, with no oily residue.

The inital red, blotchy skin reaction I got when I used it went away within a week of use. Maybe my skin got used to it?  Really smooth applicaiton with no tingling after two weeks of use.

On the downside, it's not ideal with mineral make-up.  What generally had a matte appearance became more 'oily' looking.
