reviewText:
I have the Clarisonic Mia FIT and I freaking love that thing.  I was off and on about the Mia 2 but with the FIT I have seen a huge improvement in my skin.  The only thing I was lacking was a variety of heads.  I had the pink head it came with but I've been realizing I need to change it up sometimes for a better/deeper clean.  In comes the brush wardrobe which really completes the MIA for me.

In it you'll find 4 different heads:  the pink one (which comes with the cleansers) for your "basic" clean, the black one which is for sensitive skin, the blue one which is for deep pore cleansing and my personal new favorite, the cashmere one for a luxurious feeling clean.  I know, it sounds weird, just go with it.  When you try it you'll feel the same.  It's great to use in the morning!

Now you can easily swap your heads out for the kind of clean you feel you need that day instead of changing up whenever it's time for a new head like I used to do.

Overall I'm very pleased with these brush heads and I think most clarisonic users will be too!
summary: Awesome complement to the Mia system!

reviewText: Brushes are amazing. I rotate them different days and my skin looks and feels amazing because they get the job done.

I love my Clarisonic and this Brush Head set solves a lot of problems.

Like most people, my skin isn't exactly the same every day.  Sometimes it's more sensitive - maybe I spent the day before in the blistering sun.  Or it's been too dry out.  Or maybe it just needs a deeper cleaning.

This set gives you different brush heads so you can choose one based on what your skin needs that day!

As usual, the brush heads are easy to install and remove, they work extremely well, and clean easily.

And they make my skin look wonderful.

I used to think of my Clarisonic as a luxury - now I think of it as a necessity!

I just discovered Clarisonic, or at least I just finally decided to take the plunge and get one.  These are amazing. These brushes take care of cleansing your skin whether you want a deep cleanse or if you have sensitive skin.  Once you have these fundamental brushes, you'll also probably want the one that blends your makeup foundation.  I love that one too.
summary: My new Clarisonic loves having a variety of brushes. These in this set go from sensitive skin cleansing to deep cleaning.

reviewText:
I find the deep pore and radiance brushes are the ones I actually use but I like all four brushes. The key for me is to not press hard on my face. These brush heads certainly exfoliate the skin although I personally don't think they make acne scars go away, could be wrong about that though.

One of the biggest lessons to learn about using the Clarisonic is to replace the brush heads on time. Instructions say once every three months, I'm sure there are reasons why the timing may vary but it's important to at least take them off to clean the device before it gets moldy.

The brushes are good and necessary if one uses the device often.

The "Clarisonic Summer Wardrobe Brush Head" collection consists of four very useful brushes.  Including the Cashmere Cleanse, an extremely soft-bristles brush; the Radiance Brush Head, a shorter bristled, but also soft brush; the Deep Pore Brush Head, a sturdier bristle and my favorite of the four; and the Sensitive Brush Head, another soft bristled brush.  This collection purportedly has something for everyone.  In my opinion and with the exception of the bristle length and the colored ring, there is little difference between the three soft-bristled brushes.  The Deep Pore Brush Head is not very different from the standard brush head that is included when you purchase your Clarisonic.

I love my Clarisonic; my skin has never looked better.  I like this collection of brushes because it is more economical than purchasing the brushes separately, but I do not love that there is little difference between the soft brushes.
summary: A More Economical Way to Get Four Brush Heads; Little Difference Other Than Bristle Length & Color Between the Soft Brushes ...

reviewText: I'm using this set with my Mia fit clarisonic. The radiance has been my go to everyday brush for awhile but it's nice to try out some different ones. The sensitive is a new favorite, it cleans deeply without being too rough on my skin. The cashmere brush is unique. I wasn't sure how well it would work since it's so very soft but I'm pleasently surprised by it. It certainly doesn't exfoliate or deep clean but it's wonderfully gentle for days when my skin is broken out or just extra sensitive and I want to use my clarisonic but I don't want anything too harsh. The deep pore brush is ok but I'm saving it for occasional use. It's just a bit too rough for my skin but my skin is on the sensitive side so I'm not surprised by that. It does work great on my husbands skin. It even clears out blackheads although it does leave his skin red so it's not something he would use frequently.

I've been a loyal Clarisonic user for 3 1/2 years now starting first with the Mia 2 and then transitioning to the Mia Fit (for travel) and Smart Profile.  As someone who struggled with cystic acne for a long time I very much appreciate something that helps keep my skin clean and that gives me the added bonus of making cleaning feel a bit more indulgent and spa-like.

Over the years, I've figured out which brushes I like the most (Sensitive, Acne, and Cashmere are my favorite), but this set is great for variety or for someone who is just starting out and figuring out what brush heads they like.  It lets you try out different types to see how they work with your skin or (as I like to do) switch it up for slightly different sensations.  I also think this is a good assortment of brush heads that genuinely feel different on the skin so it isn't as if you are getting 4 of the same brush with different marketing.  I also appreciate that the value is better here vs. buying the brushes individually, which is much appreciated if you use your Clarisonic regularly.  I also thought they came nicely packed making this suitable for a gift for someone who has a Clarisonic (or a nice add on if you are gifting someone a Clarisonic).  I originally received my first Clarisonic as a gift and experimented on my own to find the brush heads I liked, but would have very much appreciated this as a gift.

Would recommend
summary: Great assortment of popular Clarisonic brush heads

reviewText: If you love clarisonic like I do then you know have a fresh clean brush is essential.  These brushes are great and offer 4 different kind of cleanses. The deep cleanse brush and the cashmere brush are my favorite.  This is an awesome kit and definitely worth the investment.

reviewText: Excellent and genuine, just as it says.

I am not sure I am going to do these brushes justice with my review. I always had my doubts about the clarisonic brush and its cleaning capabilities. However, I got these brushes and decided to take the plunge and purchased a Mia Fit from my local sephora with a 20% off coupon. There are four brushes which I will outline below with what they are, what they do and how I feel about them.

Cashmere Cleanse Luxe Brush - cleanse while increasing hydration in the skin - I am honestly surprised that this brush did make my skin feel more moisturized and less dry and flaky.

Radiance Brush - Refresh Dull Skin to reveal softer, smoother, more radiant-looking skin - This was a soft but a bit more firm then then sensitive brush head. My skin felt clean and soft after using this brush.

Deep Pore Brush - Helps minimize the appearance of pores - I use this one on Sunday's when I do a hair mask and other longer beauty things. The bristles are soft but much more firm then other brushes. This one is a bit more rough on my skin and that is why others may be able to use it more often.

Sensitive Brush - Cleanse Gently yet effectively, for all skin types - This brush works great for everyday use - sometimes twice a day due to workouts, swimming and other outdoor "dirty" activities when I feel like I need to clean my face.

This is a great set and once my brushes start to wear out, I will buy this set again to replace them.
summary: Great set of brushes to keep your skin looking amazing!

reviewText: Fabulous set that addresses all of my skin needs. I mix up the brush heads depending on what kind of cleanse I need and my skin is always so soft afterwards. I have slightly sensitive skin that gets red easily so the softer brushes are perfect. These last a long time if you keep them clean and dry in between uses. Highly recommend clarisonic for anyone!!
summary: I have slightly sensitive skin that gets red easily so the softer brushes are perfect

reviewText:
This is an awesome set of authentic replacement brushes for any Clarisonic. The Sensitive brush has been my "go to" brush I used exclusively with a Clarisonic Pro for about nine years with great results. It's comfortable to my sensitive skin and has resulted in noticeably brighter and cleaner skin than hand washing or using other cleansing gadgets. My dry skin absorbs my serums and creams better, so my skin stays more hydrated, more comfortable and my fine lines are minimized. My skin texture is definitely smoother and softer and regular use has visibly improved my overall skin quality.

I splurged on a Mia FIT about seven months ago (my Pro handle doesn't hold a charge as long as it use to), and it came with the Radiance brush. So I've used Radiance awhile now, and to me it feels similar to the Sensitive brush. They both seem to use the same soft bristles, except Radiance also has those softer bristles in the center. It also feels slightly more plush with denser and slightly longer bristles than the Sensitive brush. Radiance feels good on my sensitive skin and is an excellent everyday brush that gives me the same results as the Sensitive brush.

I've also used the Deep Pore brush regularly (but not daily) over the past five months or so to focus on pores by my nose. The bristles are also quite soft, but do feel a little firmer and more stimulating than the Radiance and Sensitive brushes. Some may enjoy it as an everyday brush, though I prefer the other brushes for everyday use. I do, however, like it as a complement to another brush to use a few times a week as it does seem to help lift gunk from my problem pores.

The big surprise in this set is the Cashmere brush. I hadn't tried it until recently, and I absolutely love it. It combines shorter and taller uber soft bristles and has a noticeably different feel than the other brushes in this set. I find myself gravitating to using it more than the others as it's so plush and comforting to my dry, sensitive skin and feels so enjoyable and luxurious. Plus, it does a fabulous job getting my skin clean and preparing it for my serums and creams. I'm in my 50's with dry, sensitive skin, and it's perfect for my skin type and may be my new favorite. This is an excellent set with four different, high quality Clarisonic brushes. 5 stars.

8/30/2017: The spring and summer sets on this page contain the identical four brushes. The only difference is the packaging.
summary: No Duds In This Assortment Of Authentic Clarisonic Brush Heads And That Cashmere Brush Is Really Special

They are color coded, so you know which is which, even after you open the package and mix them all up.  Overall, great addition or refill to my Clarisonic exfoliation unit.

I love my clarisonic and I've been using their products for a number of years now. This pack is a great deal. Around here, we use the colored more to determine whose brush head it is rather than for the purpose. I've tried all the brush heads and the deep pore, sensitive and radiance all felt the same. They all cleaned my face just fine and I love the smooth after feel. The luxe brush (cashmere) has longer softer bristles.  I've tried other luxe brushes as well and prefer them. Between the luxe brushes though, I really can't feel the difference. Close your eyes when using the luxe brushes as they splatter more, but the luxe brushes are also better at getting around the crevices of your face - like where nostril meets cheek. Using these once a week keeps my skin super smooth.

To make my brushes last longer, I take them off when I'm finished and let them and the clarisonic dry completely before using again. It keeps the clarisonic from getting mold under the brush too.

I have been using a form of the Clarisonic face brush system on and off for many years. My most recent is the Mia. I say I have been using it on and off because sometimes I have found it irrriating for my skin, and also because I have heard various "experts" claim that these type facial cleaning systems with their brushes can actually make pores larger.

Saying that, I have still used them on many occasions and do believe they can really get your skin clean and slough off dead skin. What's tricky is finding the brush type and texture that is going to be the best for you.

That's what makes this brush head pack so great - it's got 4 different heads that you can try. Personally, I loved the cashmere one which for me felt like I had finally found the one that was the softest and that I felt was right for my skin. Other people - those younger or with different skin types - will hopefully find their ideal brush in one of the other three or may feel that they want a different brush head to use at different times.

It's true this is a little costly and you may only end up wanting to use one or two of the brushes, but it's a good way to really see what brush you like best and if you have tried the Clarisonic cleaning system before and found it lacking or irritating for your skin, you may find that you've been using the wrong brush and this may make encourage you to use this more often.
summary: A great way to figure out which brush head is ideal for you

reviewText:
I have had my Clarisonic brush since they first came out and at the same time bought one for each of my daughters.  They love that brush just as much as I do.

This box of brush heads will be great, even though the cost is a little pricey; about $20 a piece.  But I figure it' worth it if it keeps my face looking the way it does.  One of these brushes is softer than the others and I actually like the stiftest one the best.  Over time I am sure I shall be using all of them.  I am a very old senior citizen and my face has almost no wrinkles....either great genes or good brushes.....maybe both.
summary: A little costlier than some but you pay for what you get.  Here you are getting the best.

reviewText: This is an excellent gift pack with assorted brush heads. You receive a cashmere luxe, radiance, deep pore, and sensitive. Packaged in a nice box if you want to give for a gift. Great value as well at $81. Retail is $111. I've been using my clarisonic face brush for many years and has kept my skin in top condition.
summary: Great value for replacement clarisonic brushes!

reviewText: Per the wife: This 4 pack is fantastic for your Clarisonic. I have a Smart Profile, but these also fit my older model Clarisonic. The pack has something for everyone and all skin types. I like to rotate them depending on my needs. By way of example, I use Hydroquinone or Retina-A about three months on and two months off.  During the time I am using those products, my skin is peeling and cannot handle the deep pore brush (the strongest cleansing) or even the radiance (next strongest) so I can only use the sensitive or Cashmere Luxe, which are both very gentle.  During the off time when I am not using strong peeling or retinol agents, I need the deep pore cleanser daily to reduce my pore size. I really love the set. It is perfect. There is nothing to supplement your beauty routine like the Clarisonic and these brush heads are such a treat. They are extremely easy to switch out, and they should be replaced every three months, so don't ever be without again!
summary: Fantastic Brush Heads - Change them with the needs of your skin

reviewText: This set is a great idea - it is a one year supply of brushes (you are supposed to change Clairsonic brushes every 3 months) that allows you to try out four different kinds of brush heads.  It also includes a Cashmere brush head which is a bit more expensive than the average brush head so it is a good value.  I of course am using that first because I think some Clairsonic brushes are a bit harsh.  This is really a great way to try a bunch out and I would definitely buy this if you are new to Clairsonic or even if you aren't and want to try something new.

I love the Clarisonic facial cleansing system, and the brush heads are a large part of it.  This set of four provides a good introduction to the different kinds and is especially useful if you don't yet know which brush you prefer.  The only brush I hadn't tried before receiving this assortment was the cashmere; its bristles are about twice as long as the regular and are incredibly soft.  I almost hated putting soap on the cashmere head to use for the first time.  This set also includes a Sensitive Skin, Radiance, and Deep Pore Cleansing heads.  My favorite and go-to brush is the Radiance, but Clarisonic makes it so easy to change from one to another that I use the Deep Pore one once a week.  Even though I have sensitive skin, I feel that that head is unnecessary, although maybe I would if I were younger.  Of course, the cashmere one is also unnecessary, but it feels so luxurious that it's worth trying at least through one brush head.

This would make a great gift set, particularly as a companion to one of Clarisonics devices.  Yes, the brush heads are expensive -- the whole system is -- but it makes sense to buy them in a pack like this that offers a little savings rather than buying them individually.

-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann
summary: A Set Perfect For a Gift or Trying Out Your Clarisonic Options

reviewText:
I've used the Clarisonic heads for a few years now, and always appreciate finding them in mixed sets like this one. This set works well for trying different heads to see which you like for which applications, and introduced me to the Cashmere head, which I hadn't run across before. (It's basically got really long bristles that are very soft. I'm not sure where the "increases hydration" claim comes from, since I've noticed no effect like that.) The heads fit my Mia just as expected, and the plastic cover stays in place to protect the brush.

I have to say - I don't notice that much difference among the different types of heads, with the exception of the Cashmere. There's a little variation in the stiffness of the brushes, but I don't notice that my skin responds differently based on which brush I use. I suppose that makes these sets more useful, so you can test this for yourself before investing in mult-packs of each brush.

The packaging is nice for a gift, but too oversized for storage. I thought, as another reviewer noted, that the plastic covers had been downgraded, since they weren't attached to the heads in the box. Not true! After fiddling with them a little, I found that the covers DO attach to the heads as normal, you just have to press and twist. No idea why they're not attached in the box, which seems silly. I compared them to covers from a set I bought last year, and they seem the same in every regard.
summary: A good set to test different brushes

reviewText: Each of these four brushes graduate in their firmness it's the softest one feeling silky soft in fact all of them have soft outer bristles.  The inner two bristles become imcreasingly firm.  The brushes are color coded from white to a deep brown or black.  The other two are tan and turquoise.  All the bruuhs have a container with large holes to allow the brushes t,dry between uses.  There is a decisive click when you put the brush in its case so you know its secure.
summary: Graduated in Firmness, Color Coded, Each Has its Own Snap Shut Case

reviewText:
My teenage daughter is very meticulous about her complexion. She has been using the Clarisonic Smart Profile Brush System for over half a year and absolutely loves it.  Her skin is healthier looking; her complexion is now pimple-free and the dry flakey skin on her outer cheek area has disappeared.  The only drawback is the price:  the initial cost of the system itself and the replacement brushes.  This four-piece value set is a more economical way to purchase these brushes than to purchase them individually.  This special edition Wardrobe set consists of the following brush heads:  Sensitive, Deep Pore (my daughters favorite), Radiance and LUXE Cashmere Cleanse.

Note:  Although these brushes are not Smart brushes, they can be used on the Smart Profile system, but the system will not signal when it is time to change the brush.  That is not a big concern, especially considering the difference in price.

Would recommend this set.
summary: Economical way to purchase these brush heads

reviewText:
This 4 pack represents replacements for me of 3 and one new one I had not tried before. I've had my MIA 1 for a year and I really love the impact on the texture of my skin. These are genuine replacement heads that are easy to put in and take off. I rotate the heads based upon my skin needs (WI winter, etc).

This is the first time I've had the cashmere head. I really like it for my face and neck. It is super soft yet effective at debridement and cleaning. I don't think it would be possible to make a softer brush head that is still effective.

I was a skeptic but I am now a big fan of this system. I like this 4 pack in particular since you get to try out different heads for your skin type. Very pleased.
summary: Great way to try out different heads.

reviewText: Right when I got these, my Clarisonic stopped working. Just died. Won't charge, will not work. I was excited about my new brush heads and they come lovely in a pretty pack...but I can't use them! I'm heartbroken. I will have to give them away or something. I've only had my Clarisonic sine Christmas, so I'm really peeved about it. I don't think I'll buy another Clarisonic because of this. I know this isn't about the brush heads, but I guess the Clarisonic brand in general. But, again, it's a pretty pack and will make a good gift if I knew someone with a Clarisonic spin brush.
Great four pack of replacement heads for Clairsonic. These are definitely name brand not knock off. They fit perfectly. Great quality at a reasonable price. You get what you pay for.
Does not chip for days. Easy to apply,

I bought this a while back, but finally had a need to use when I botched my pedicure. I was using a beautiful deep blue with iridescent flecks, actually kind of hard to apply, and couldn't get a smooth finish. It doesn't help that I have ridges in my nails either. Anyway, I let it cure overnight, and then used the KUR this evening. They now look flawless! Very pleased and will be keeping this in my polish bin as long as they make it!
summary: I was using a beautiful deep blue with iridescent flecks

reviewText: This  product  is great but very pricey. Minus the $20 price tag I give it a 5 star but i would  personally  never pay this much for a nail polish. It gives a great shine to your  manicure and dries extremely  fast. I has to be used with regular polish, not gel because  it will  bunch up the gel. It is not  intended  for that use. The durability  is great, lasts several days before chipping.
summary: Quick dry top coat. Great shine. Very pricey.

reviewText:
I'd used this Kur topcoat on one hand and just did regular polish on the other for a day, just to compare how much of a difference the topcoat makes. The topcoat looked much better. The nails are glossy, polished, and even look better than my last salon manicure.

I also like that the topcoat is low maintenance and dries quickly as well as protects my nails.
summary: Dries quickly and looks glossy and polished

reviewText: I love this product. I can honestly say it's the best top coat I have ever used. My nails are thin and were always breaking. I put a light color of polish on first and let them dry for about an hour and then used this. The results were amazing. Like salon quality amazing and I was able to open a can of soda without breaking any. Just be sure you don't layer it too thick and let all coats dry completely, otherwise knicks will show up in the finish. Definitely recommend if you want to get great nails at home.
Goes on smooth, is clear and has a great shine to it. The picture looks deceiving b/c it is a black bottle but it is a clear top coat.  Dries relatively quickly.  I really like it.

This thing is pricey but it is so worth it!!!
My nails were a total mess and I honestly don't have the time to do my nails at home regularly, and I can't afford to spend lots of money every week or two retouching and doing gel nails. So I decided to try this.

First, I painted my nails with a very light pink nail polish from a different and very cheap brand. I let it dry for about 30 minutes (just air dry) and then aplied one coat of the gel polish. This is clear and won't alter your color. As soon as you apply it you can't believe your eyes. It's like magic.

I had beautiful nails done at home by myself in less than an hour.
Just make sure you have plenty of time to let them air dry. I sitted on my couch while zipping a glass of wine and watched a movie and let them dry. I was surprised and happy about my "done at home manicure" .

The final results look amazing in person. The pictures don't show how it actually looks like.  But here are some pic for you to see.

When it comes to my nails I am very low maintenance, so I am okay spending a bit more on the one or two items I may use. I keep them trimmed very short and only use a clear coat, so this top coat was a good choice. It goes on very smooth and clean, has a great gloss and didn't chip or come off easily for me. I will say that I work at a desk and I am not very active with my hands other than typing, so I found that I could reapply every 5-6 days with good results. If I was one to actually paint my nails a color, I would definitely try some something from LondonTown, but unfortunately with my nails as short as they are clear or a light nude color is all I'm comfortable wearing. Overall for the quality and use I will get out of it, I easily recommend this even if it is a bit pricey.
summary: Makes my nails look good without a trip to the salon.

reviewText:
THE BEST GEL TOP COAT EVER! I have been using now for over a month and I only have to repaint my nails once a week due to how this top coat really keeps my nail polish on and chip free! The first week I was totally impressed but thought it could be the higher end nail polish I used as that does make a difference. The second week I used a cheaper Sally Hansen product that in the past only lasts about 2-4 days and I got 8 days of use before my ends started to tear and chip.

I have used two more times and each week I am so impressed. No more gel manicures for me as my nails grow really fast with the Biotin supplements I take and I was only getting 14 days max with a salon gel manicure ( and a $30 price tag every time ).  I have gotten 10 days out of one application and it's important that if your nails do get ragged at the end it doesn't hurt to file the ends of your nails every other day gently. But no chips, so impressed this is my must have product and I have been using a base coat ( Ipsy ) and I always buff my nails before applying and two coats of color, than the Gel Top Coat  in the last six weeks of trial LOVE IT~
summary: 7-10 Days Wear with this AWESOME Gel Top Coat!

reviewText:
I got this to help me extend the life of my gel manicures. I tend to get a little peeling about a week in and wanted to see if this helped.

Well, it does. I have had my gel manicure almost two weeks with no chipping or peeling. This topcoat does not require a gel lamp to set. The smell is a little stronger than normal polish but it is not overpowering.

The bottle is a little smaller than a normal bottle of nail polish. The finish on the top helps you grip it better. The brush is your standard nail brush.

in all, I recommend you use this about a week into your gel manicure to preserve it just a little longer.
summary: The finish on the top helps you grip it better. The brush is your standard nail brush

reviewText:
This is a great non UV gel coat that actually provides a great strong top coat that doesn't chip! I am down on my hands and knees playing with my kids inside and outside daily. A regular manicure only lasts two days before chips start happening but with this London town our gel genius top coat I got about 10 full days before chips started happening! I also used this on my toenails on top of a clear baseboards to help my tonsils from chipping as I seem to always have toys and such falling on my bare feet and it did help with broken nails because it is so strong!

I did not experience any yellowing or any issues at all.
summary: Great non UV gel top coat!

reviewText: Genius is exactly what this is!  This is the first non-uv light gel top polish that has kept my nails from chipping that I have tried.  I have been wearing it almost a week and my nails still look great, only  just a little wear around the edges.  I am so hard on my nails that a normal nail polish top coat start chipping in about 24 hours.  The polish is glossy and only slightly dulls over the week, which is to be expected.  It goes on smooth and is pretty cold on your nails, surprisingly.  It is only cold for less than a minute and it dries pretty fast, overall I am very pleased with this.  Worth the money.
summary: One week later and still going strong and chip free!

reviewText: With these new nail products promising a long-lasting manicure, you really don't have to go to the salon anymore! I applied the top coat (which is clear) to my existing plum-colored nails and it kept it from chipping for a week. My only caveat is the price - you could buy the Sally Hansen Miracle Gel top coat for half that price and it will do almost as good a job. The main difference is the drying time - Londontown Gel dries much faster than Sally Hensen and it gives my nails a nice gloss. So if you don't mind paying a little extra, the Londontown Gel is faster and looks a little nicer.
summary: Dries Faster Than Sally Hansen Miracle Gel, Though Pricey

reviewText:
I've been on the search for a holy grail top coat to do salon-quality manicures at home.  For many years I had used Seche Vite, which gave a glass-like shine and dried within 5 minutes, a big plus for those of us who can't seem to sit still when we do our nails.  Many top coats say they dry fast but you find out it leaves the dreaded "sheet marks" from when you sleep.  Not with LONDONTOWN Kur Gel Genius Top Coat.

I gave this top coat a try after polishing my nails with an Essie nail polish.  I let my nail polish dry for about 20 minutes prior to applying this top coat.  I let the topcoat sit on my nails for another 20 minutes (couldn't find this on directions) and it seemed to be completely set and fully dry by then.  I applied the top coat on Wednesday night and still going strong on Saturday AM -- no chips, looks shiny and feels like a quality gel manicure.

I will update as I continue to wear this polish for longer on the durability of the top coat.  My main issue with the Seche Vite was that it was prone to peeling, and if a little bit chipped, the whole nail easily came off in one piece, polish + top coat and all.  It made it tough to maintain when this could happen less than a day after applying the Seche Vite.  So far, after 3 days all the nails are in tact with the LONDONTOWN Kur Gel Genius top coat, making this one a staple in my collection to continue using for future at home manis.  Additionally, the scent of this product is minimal -- all around this is an excellent choice for a top coat.
summary: durable, good shine & not strong odor

reviewText: I chip nail polish - a lot.  This lasted for almost a week before the dryness of my skin made the edges start to lift. That is good for me.  I often am picking at it by the next day.  That is no fault of polish, but my point is - this is light-weight and seems to be strong.  for lack of a better term.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText: I'm not a huge fan of putting just any old sunscreen on my face, so when I tried Obagi Sun Shield Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Sunscreen, I was a bit skeptical not only because it's sunscreen, but it's tinted as well. I'm pleased with the results. It didn't have any negative effects on my skin and the tint was just enough to give my face a nice even look. It protected the way I like and I didn't get a sunburn - something that I have to watch. I'm quite pleased with the overall performance of Obagi Sun Shield Sunscreen, but am a bit hesitant to buy it again because of price. It performs about the same as Neutrogena did for me, but the only difference was the tint - something I can do without.
summary: Works well and has a nice subtle tint.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Cool Sunscreen

reviewText:
I liked this tinted sunblock on arms and legs, where the mild color was helpful in disguising minor skin imperfections. However, the tint is strong enough on my fair skin that I have to be extremely careful to rub it in far beyond what I would normally do with sunblock so that the medium beige tone does not appear streaky or settle into any uneven spots on my skin.

Overall, given that the coloration was a little dark for my blonde, blue-eyed self, I probably would not purchase again, especially given the price. I think I prefer the Japanese blue-bottle Biore, which sinks in immediately and provides good coverage. I can use that one on face and body.
summary: Tint was a little too beige for my fair skin.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Cool Sunscreen

reviewText: I like this more than the regular untinted product.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText: The WARM color is  beige !! Not at all like the picture on the package !! 51 $ for that really doesnt worst it ,,,, not for tan skins

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Cool Sunscreen

reviewText: I love this hypoallergenic tinted sunscreen! It's lightweight enough to where I don't feel as if I've caked on gloppy sunscreen like with other brands, and still does its job as well as any other spf50.  I rarely wear makeup (having nothing to do with preferring the natural look but more not having the time) so having tinted sunscreen gives me an easy way to apply sunscreen while also evening out my skin tone like a foundation would.  Two birds! This non-oily broad spectrum defense is something I can apply every 2 hours without concern of blocking my pores, leaving a shiny slick to my skin, or getting a sunburn.  This is a purse essential!

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText: I liked this sunscreen and it does a good job.  As a vine reviewer I received it at no cost but I marked it down because I consider it's price too be excessive.
summary: Nice Product but Oh That Price!

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText: The Oblagi sun shield with tint is rated at spf 50 providing excellent coverage for your sunbathing needs.  The addition of tint covers and blends evenly with most skin tones and does a good job that you may consider going makeup free for the day.  The product is very thin which is a good thing as it provides plenty of coverage without having to use to much.  The non greasy feel allows you to enjoy your day in the sun without feeling oily and uncomfortable.  The product itself is wonderful, but easily the most expensive that I have ever used.  For a large family this may not last more then several days especially after reapplying throughout the day.  To make the product last, you may consider only using this only for your face while using something less expensive for the rest of your body (or your family )  If cost is no object then this is certainly over if the most effective and useful sunscreens in the market.
summary: Excellent, fine textured sunscreen w tint that blends well with or without makeup giving a nice even tone while protecting your

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText:
If you don't already use tinted sunscreen, allow yourself some time to practice with it so you get a smooth, even coat with enough coverage to protect your skin without looking caked on.

This Obagi sunscreen applies pretty evenly, and doesn't move too much when you perspire. I am sensitive to scent, and found that after a couple of days of wearing this product, I wasn't noticing the scent as much.

As mentioned, it stayed in place when I was active and perspiring, and yet washed off at home pretty easily. It did not seem to clog my pores, and did not make my skin feel itchy. It has been reliable for me when I want to look somewhat polished and yet natural  as if all I am wearing is sunscreen, not foundation.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText:
The wife and I just returned from a week-long stay at a beach resort and during that time my wife made extensive use of this Obagi Sun Shield Tint SPF 50 Sunscreen.

So a little setup first; my wife describes herself as pasty-white and the description isn't too far off. It's not because she's an indoors loving recluse but more related to her family lineage. Prior to our vacation she'd been visiting her favorite spa to spray-tan and get a little color. During our vacation, she used the Obagi Tint Sunscreen to essentially touch up her spray-tan and keep a nice bronze color.

She loves this sunscreen so much that she talked me into trying it and I can see why she's a fan. This sunscreen offers excellent protection (SPF 50) and both she and I did not burn at all. The sunscreen goes on very easily and is a less viscous than some of the other sunscreen's we brought along and regularly use. Since this product goes on so easily you'll get a nice amount of coverage per dollop of sunscreen. The tinting effect is very nice as well and goes on evenly thanks in large part to how easy the sunscreen rubs onto the skin.

I normally avoid products that offer tinting because I'm paranoid about getting the tint on my clothes. The Obagi sunscreen does a great job staying put once dry. The resort we visited featured white linens and bed sheets and we didn't get any of the tint on any of those items. Naturally you'll want to use some caution when using this sunscreen for the first time. I'd apply it and wash my hands immediately and then let the sunscreen dry fully before putting on clothes.

This is definitely a product my wife and I will buy and a great, easy way to get a little bit of color without having to tan. Recommended!
summary: Add a Little Bronze Color the Easy Way

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Cool Sunscreen

reviewText: One little dab spreads out easily, no wasting of product here. This being used on porcelain skin tone, left some coloring marks in areas where it wasn't overly blended. If it left no marks, I would have given it 5 stars.
summary: One little dab spreads out easily, no wasting of product here

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText: I like this sunscreen because it kind of evens out my skin tone and protects my skin.  I was worried about it burning my skin like most products tend to do but I have not noticed any burning with this.  Good amount of product seems like it will last awhile.
summary: Protects and evens my skin color.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Cool Sunscreen

reviewText: First time using an Obagi product, and it didn't disappoint. Really liked the tint color to the lotion; it absorbed nicely into the skin leaving no greasy residue. Protected my skin for the several hours we were outside at a soccer game. Protects from UVA and UVB rays. The directions say "use a water resistant sunscreen if swimming or sweating" which leads me to believe this is not waterproof! Fragrance free. Four stars because of the price point and not waterproof.
summary: Quality sunscreen on the pricey side.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Cool Sunscreen

reviewText: As I get older, I become a lot more concerned with wearing sunscreen, especially on my face.  Obagi Sun Shield Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Cool Sunscreen is a tinted sunscreen that seems to work quite well with my skin.  I have sensitive skin and am prone to breakouts, but this sunscreen did not aggravate my skin at all.  It does feel a tiny bit greasy, but it blends really well with my skin tone and works perfectly with a little pressed powder over it to create a more finished look.  Overall, I am quite pleased with the quality of this sunscreen.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText: I sure wish this product had been available during my outdoor working life as a mail carrier, &various other jobs.  It's not all that greasy, and it certainly protects.  If you spend lots of time in the sun, you need this.  Trust me.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

reviewText: This obagi sun shield spf 50 warm is awesome !I have sun damage from years ago and This sun shield gives me piece of mind that my skin is protected from further damage. It also  blends well with my skin tone. I came from the baby oil and hit the beach generation (I know) now I'm paying the price .Anyway this is  a really great product and I would highly recommend it!

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Cool Sunscreen

reviewText:
I really hate the scent of sunscreen so Im glad to get my sunscreen in beauty products since the scent seems to be less sunscreen-scented. This one is advertised as fragrance free but it is not unscented, it is lightly scented for a sunscreen but it is still there.

It is a light, sheer coverage makeup so it works as a casual, everyday wear product. It comes in different tints for either cool or warm skin tones. I did find it a little greasy feeling and slightly tacky feeling. It does make my skin look shiny.

style.Style:: Tint Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Warm Sunscreen

It is a light, sheer coverage makeup so it works as a casual, everyday wear product. It comes in different tints for either cool or warm skin tones. I did find it a little greasy feeling and slightly tacky feeling. It does make my skin look shiny.
