reviewText: Tex Texture Paste is a proprietary pomade of Vaughn Acord, a famed stylist. Tex Texture Paste's clay base gives long lasting control. It has beeswax that provides a moisturising effect. Together, the paste is used to maintain style and impart volume. This is one of those a little goes a long way products. Start with almost dry hair, just the slightest bit damp. Put only a little product on with fingertips, working down from the tips of the hair to the bottom without getting it on the scalp. I initially applied too much which left DHs hair looking greasy and slightly wet. Because it's clay versus water base, it took more than one shampoo to remove all that I'd accidently applied. With his hair finally clean again, we worked together, using a minimal amount. It successfully worked great in his short hair to plump it up into a messy bedhead look that lasted an entire afternoon and evening. For most men, this probably isn't a daily use product; however, when one needs a pomade to create and heavily control a style (weddings, parties, date nights, etc), it would be hard to find anything better.
summary: Strong Hold To Tame And Control Even The Wildest Of Hair

reviewText:
I didn't realize that V76 by Vaughn Tex Texture Paste was designed for men until AFTER I received the jar of texture paste and re-read the Amazon description online. Im a hair fanatic with fine hair and anything that might give me texture, I impulsively order, typically missing some important details in the description--like this product is specifically designed for men. Im not sure what the difference is between male-females hair types, except for maybe with this particular product, the scent is distinct, not bad or necessarily good, but distinct. I think the strong fragrance is more pleasing to men than women. To me, the aroma is interesting and certainly lingersnot in a bad-good way, but in a way that you have to think twice what the distinctthere goes that word againsmell is.

Anyway, the product goes on easily; looks good in appearance and feels good to the touch. As far as giving my hair texture goes, 50-50its okay. Not great it doesnt come close to matching many of my other terrific products, but it's not awful. Ill continue to use it, but its not the product I reach for firstsecond or even third for that matterits much further down the list, not on the way bottom though.

Seems like a good basic paste .. it comes in a small jar and a little goes a long way for control. Of course you absolutely must use this with wet hair or the results are less than ideal. All in all, it has a pleasing smell and strong hold. I didn't find any significant difference over other AXE products ...
summary: Fine, nothing to rave about, works good

reviewText: This texture paste is really nice. It has a decent hold, but it really does add some texture. I can't get much product to keep my hair in place all day long, so you may have more success with that than me, but it did as well as most other products I've tried. Overall, this does the job and I'm very pleased with it.
Very thick hair paste, lets you mold and style the hair easily. It smells great too!
summary: lets you mold and style the hair easily. It smells great too

reviewText: I have tried a couple of these for my son that has very thin hair, but likes it long, just not in his eyes.  So many have been clumpy.  This is easy to manage, not too greasy, but not clumpy.  Winner!
summary: Winner! Not clumpy, not too greasy. Holds hair in place.

reviewText: I have a plethora of hair products under my sink from trying to find 'the one' product that works great on my hair.  I have fine, medium length hair that I wear in an undercut type style.  Many of the products I've tried leave my hair looking and feeling greasy.  Others just weigh it down so much that it just falls.  This Vaughn V76 texture paste is awesome.  I work some of this through my hair when it's damp then blow dry.  It gives my hair great volume and hold with just a bit of hair spray.  Unfortunately, the price is ridiculous for this small amount.  Other than that, this stuff is perfect.
summary: Works great, but a bit pricey

reviewText: This V76 Tex is a really good product. I'm a gal w medium length layered hair, and I started using a lot of men's hair products when my hair was short- I'm particularly fond of these texture pastes that prevent flyaways and give your hair a more manageable feel- your hair stays better where you want it. V76 is natural looking since it's not shiny or oily or slick or crispy on your hair. I often use Sebastian's texurizing products, like their Matte Putty, and this is very similar. I don't love the smell of this so much- a bit like a plastic barbie once it's on my head (smells better in the jar), but it's mild enough to not be unpleasant. This has no fiber in it, so you can't sculpt your hair too much- just mainly gives you a look and feel like you've not washed your hair in a day, but without the oily part from your scalp-looks very smooth and not puffy. V76 is also water soluble and not sticky, so i add a little bit of it- like a fingertip amt. to water in my hands, and run it through the ends of my hair- or just add some directly when my hair's still wet out of the shower.
summary: Decent Texturizer that Looks Very Natural

reviewText: V76 Vaughn Tex Texture Paste is kind of a mixed bag.  It works really well in providing texture but other than that it comes with some drawbacks.  As others have mentioned, it does have a strange smell that really lasts more in your hands than in your hair.  In addition, there isn't enough moisture in this product and the effect is twofold.  First, it doesn't spread well and you have to use a pretty sizable amount each application even with relatively short hair.  Second, it kind of dries my hair our over the course of the day.  I think I will use this for evenings out but not as part of a morning routine.
summary: Needs some refinements and more moisture.

reviewText:
Never heard of this product or even seen it before, but when I saw that it was a "paste" I thought I would try it on my natural hair
for twists and possibly to lock. I wasn't too concerned about the smell, which I can't say that it smells like caramel, but it isn't unpleasant and it doesn't irritate my boyfriend so that's a plus (because my other hair products do something to his nose, he claims) I like the texture, the smell and it seems to be holding well, my twists have been up for 3 days now. Not to greasy, didn't have to use a lot and didn't even have to wet my hair.
summary: First Time User...I May Be Hooked

reviewText: This paste is marketed for men but I tried it and liked the performance very much. The scent is subtle and pleasing. It does a great job of texturizing my hair. Mine is on the short side and I'm always looking for products to give a bit of lift and define waves. This does the job very nicely. And hair stays in place without it being 'crunchy.' It stays soft and stylable.

There are a lot of things to like about V76.  Strong hold that lasts most of the day, messy look without looking greasy, application to dry and damp hair, and it washes off easily.

However, one big downside is its overpowering vanilla scent which lasted at least 4-6 hours at least before it diminished.  Those who are sensitive to strong fragrances may want to look elsewhere.  The V76 isn't a compelling enough product to make me switch allegiances from my usual Cibu Sticky Rice.

This is a TINY (1.7 oz) jar of texture paste. It has sort of a woodsy smell--definitely on the masculine side. It seems like it would be greasy, but it's actually pretty matte and allows good sculpting of the hair without any crunchiness.

Smells nice, great hold, not crunchy or greasy.
Five stars.

I had no idea that this soap was for men until I came to write a review.  Believe me,...you do not have to be a man to enjoy this soap!

All I can say is WOW!  I am a real soap snob,  and this is some great soap.
The description talks about detoxing clay,  and maybe that's why it's super slippery.  Granted all soap is slippery,...but this soap is especially slippery.  My experience of using this soap in the shower was nothing short of spa like.  It smells so good and feels absolutely luxurious on the skin.  I used it on my face too,  and it was gentle and did not dry my skin out.

I will not hesitate to purchase again for myself,  a woman.  A set would make a great gift for a man.

I'm a woman, and I still love this soap.  (It reminds me of the old Irish Spring commercials, "Made for a man . . . but I like it, too.")  It has a somewhat slippery feel to it, thanks to the clay, that washes off cleanly and without drying.  The scent is the pleasing balance of spice and herbs.  It looks like a cooler version of an elastic artist's eraser with streaks.  It meaures 3.25" x 2" x 1.25" -- an average-size bar.

-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann

My husband loves this soap. i got him started with buying his own soap when he voiced dislike for our feminine scented products. I started him with Jack Black products and he also likes Clinique and Ahava. This bar soap he says is most similar to Ahava. It is a clay soap so it gives you a very deep clean. It is lightly scented, but the scent fades quickly. which I like. He likes how clean he feels and he also uses it on his face since it does not dry the skin out. This would be  aperfect gift for your hubby or boyfriend.
summary: i got him started with buying his own soap when he voiced dislike for our feminine scented products

reviewText: Smells wonderfully of lavender.  Sometimes such scented bars of soap come in a tiny size but this is a full sized bar.  I wouldn't call it moisturizing nor is it in any way drying but it easily rinses free of your skin.  The smell isn't chemically and to me that's the key to the detoxing in the name because the smell is so refreshing.  It's expensive however which is the only reason I deducted a star and I had to force myself to do that.
summary: Refreshing Lavender Scent, Rinses Clean, Expensive

reviewText:
I have very sensitive skin (Eczema) and this works pretty well.

I didn't immediately realize this was marketed towards men when I received it, but it still works well for me. I would definitely say that this soap can be gender neutral :) It smells good, and it is a generous size. It also lathers pretty well.

It does seem a bit pricey for one bar of soap, but the price is not too far off from other comparable speciality soaps.

I didn't even consider the fact that this is advertised as a "mens" soap when I selected it and started using it.  That was about 2 weeks ago and so far I am really liking it. The scent is clean and some might think a bit "manly", but it doesn't linger on my skin so it's of no concern. The only reason I would say that it is geared towards Men would be because of the size, as it's a bit big for me to comfortably hold in my hand when wet in the shower. I solved that by cutting it in half which made it much easier to manage. A few things I have noticed; my skin is softer and although not necessarily more hydrated, it definitely isn't any drier. Overall I do feel like I'm "treating" myself to something special by using this product and will continue to use it.  And if I'm being honest, I just may buy another bar because the price isn't so much that it's not affordable, especially for how long it appears it will last.
summary: I'm not a Man and I like this soap.

reviewText:
The V76 soap bar is wonderful.  The size is similar to a traditional bar of soap, so don't worry that this is a small "boutique" sized bar of soap.  The soap has a wonderful citrus scent when using it, and it's not overpowering or flowery.  The scent will work well for both sexes.

In use it provides a rich lather without having to use much product.  It rinses cleanly and easily and leaves behind no residue.  I have dry and sensitive skin and I noticed no issues.

All in all... a great bar of soap.
summary: Lathers nicely, smells great, cleans well.

reviewText: I've been using this soap for over a week and I noticed right away that my skin isn't as dry as it had been. For years I've been using liquid soaps and I wasn't sure about changing, but I really like this Vaughn Detox Bar Soap. There is hardly any fragrance which is a plus for me with my allergies. Another bonus is that it hasn't gotten mushy the way many soap bars do, so I'd definitely recommend this for men and women.

I like the scent, it smells refreshing - slightly citrusy and herbal, maybe lemon verbena. The scent is a little masculine, but I'm female and I like it too. I also like that the smell doesn't linger; smells nice while you're in the shower, but it won't compete with your perfume/cologne.

The bar is pretty big and it is rectangular, not contoured like other brands. It barely fits in my soap dish and is a little hard to hold.
Especially since it feels more slippery than other soaps (I think because of the clay).
But it lathers pretty well and rinses clean.

A very nice soap with a pleasant scent. The smell is slightly sweet with a hint of ginger and maybe a bit of citrus. The bar feels good on the skin and lathers well. The scent does not overpower and does fade relatively quickly - it does not feel like you're wearing a cologne. I can't really speak to the detoxing abilities but the clay does make it feel a bit softer on the skin and it does not dry out the skin as much.
summary: A very nice soap bar with a mildly sweet scent - does not overpower

reviewText:
This was a really nice surprise.

The unrelenting heat has taken a toll on my skin.  I have tried a lot of things: lotions, creams, oils, arm-covering sleeves, etc.  Some have helped a little, for a little while.  But I haven't been able to kick back the redness, dryness, itching, and general discomfort for very long.

Enter this soap.  It's not magic:  I am not utterly transformed by it.  But...it truly helps.  And every day I use it, it helps more.

The best thing that could happen would be seasonal temperatures (no...high 80s in November are not seasonal temperatures).  But this soap is really helping a lot.  I recommend it.
summary: Great soap.  Actual relief of some of the symptoms of contact dermatitis

reviewText:
This is a great soap, but personally I cannot believe the price.
I have to admit it is the best soap I have used. The scent is rather masculine. I have used it after working in the yard and never had that much residue floating down the drain. Even when I haven't been working and am dirty there is a lot of residue coming off of me, so it seems to be a lot of detoxifying going on.

Smells good, cleans well, and doesn't leave your skin feeling over dry. I noticed my skin looked a bit better after a few days of using it.

I do like the smell, and it has a rich thick lather.
summary: Good smelling, good cleaning bar for your whole body

reviewText: I have to admit, usually soap is soap for me.  If it smells OK and cleans, it's good enough.  But this soap is honestly much better than average soap.  First, it is a bigger bar.  Second, it feels richer.  Third, it smells better (something like lemon and another scent I can't quite identify).  Anyway, I can tell a big difference between this soap and the cheap stuff you get at the local -mart.  Recommended!

According to the package, this soap is made with detoxifying mineral clay and oats.  All I know is, I love the feel, the smell, the everything.  It feels smooth and good.  I love the smoothness of the feel.  And I feel so good and clean after having used the soap.  I love this soap and I highly recommend it.  It is wonderful.

I like this soap more than my husband does.  He thinks it smells too "girly."  I think it smells like citrus, and it does create a nice lather and feels good on the skin.  Once the skin's dry you don't even smell it on your skin anyway.

My only shock is the price.  Seriously, fourteen bucks for a 5-ounce bar of soap?  Thus I knocked off a star.
summary: Great aroma and lather, but overpriced!

reviewText: In 1980something, I visited the former Soviet Union and lodged at hotels for two weeks, traveling great distances. I brought back several small slices of gray soap because they were long lasting, non drying and had a scent that grew on me. This dense bar of V76 detox soap reminds me of those hotel supplied mini bars, having a similar scent and suds in the shower. It is marketed to men but it's really gender neutral, rather sporty.
summary: Gluten free and vegan bar with clay

reviewText: I like this soap it is one that leaves you feeling fresh and clean without a lot of mixtures that you don't need.  It has a pretty good smell but not over whelming which is good.  It leaves your body feeling fresh and clean but not overdone as some soaps do. Its a very useful product.

This soap has a nice milky/creamy lather. It leaves you feeling so fresh and clean without drying out your skin at all. It doesn't leave you with that weird feeling on your skin like normal bar soap does. The scent is a light lemon verbena, so it isn't necessarily a feminine nor masculine scent... its rather neutral and just very fresh. This one is a keeper. I had never heard of or tried this brand before, but I will look into other products now. It seems to be very good quality and the fact that it doesn't have the mile long ingredient list is a huge plus.

I really like the V76 Vaughn Molding Paste, and here is why.  I opened the jar easily and the paste is almost without a smell, which I like. Don't want too many competing smells. I then took about a dime sized dab and rubbed it on my palms. I wanted to move my bangs over to a side part and keep them up off my forehead and over.  This paste worked really well for that without looking like glue.  The key to using this paste is to use very little because a little goes a long way.  I have used other molding pastes and they are too heavy and build up is a big problem. I do not think that is an issue with this V76 and I also use a clarifying shampoo once a week to get all of the hair products that I use ( sprays, detangles, etc.) out and can start fresh. I think this product will last me for a pretty good while. Glad I tried it.
summary: A little goes a long way.

reviewText: The product holds nice and rinses out easily.  No overwhelming perfumed odor which I appreciated.  The price at 21 bucks is a dollar more than what I usually use and contains. .3 oz less than the Baxter product I have been loyal to for the past few years.  So for me I will stay with Baxter unless the price would drop by 25%.

A little bit of this goes a long way. I have very thick, wavy hair that is often difficult to tame.  About a dime size of this worked into my damp hair at the roots and another dime size amount worked in from middle to tips and that's all I needed (my hair is about 3" past my shoulders in length).  Then I blow-dried it and my hair was much smoother. I didn't get all the little flyaways in my part and my tips didn't frizz out. This stuff is a bit pricey, but it does work and gave me smoother hair. However, I do usually get 2-3 days out of a single wash, but with this stuff, my hair was noticeably greaser the second day, so I only got 1-2 days out of a wash while using it.

I've been using similar products for years and the first thing I noticed was the jar is smaller than most others in this price range.  My usual go to was 4.2 oz and this is only 1.7 which is small for $20.  That being said, for the length of my hair (fairly short) I only need to use a pea size amount so it should still get some mileage out of this jar.  I rub it between my hands and apply to my hair while still wet and then blow dry it as I style.  I usually go back with just a tad extra and spot style a few places.  It rinses out easily with shampoo and doesn't seem to leave any residue.  Overall if you are a fan of Vaughn and the celebs hair his products have ended up in and don't mind the small size, you won't be disappointed, it does offer a good texture and hold.  Minus one star though for the small quantity size.
The best.

This was a nice find. This molding paste looks thick in the jar, but it's actually kind of a whipped light texture. I know it's for men with the earthy mild scent. But it works on women's hair too. It gave my hair some body.

This stuff works pretty well, although I would have liked a little more hold over a longer duration. Still, for performance, it did nicely enough, and it outperformed some of the current items I have tried out. It also does not take a lot to work; the sizing that is normally presented is about the size of a dime, and I found that this works with this stuff. That is good compared to a lot of products, where you sometimes feel like you would have to bathe in it to get it to hold. It also does not have that weird, sticky feel to it, and the stuff smells fine.

I've used this molding paste for my hair. I am a woman with short hair and was looking for a product to keep my hair in place, as it falls a lot because my hair is thick. I anticipated it being more pasty, as in thicker. It somewhat keeps my hair in place, but I need another product on top of this to keep my coif from moving too much.
summary: I've used this molding paste for my hair. I ...

reviewText: You'll experiment, of course, but in our experience (two users, different ages), it doesn't take very much. The hold is good and not stiff or chalky. It lasts. Washing it out is not a problem. There's not much scent and what there is isn't unpleasant. All in all, we were pleased.
summary: Good molding paste that holds without being sticky or chalky

reviewText: One of the first things I noticed about this paste is it doesn't smell bad.  This is always important because who wants to put smelly stuff in their hair.  The next thing is a little goes a long way.  It works well and holds hair like it says.  I have thin hair so I can attest to this only.  Thicker hair outcomes are unknown.  My only gripe is what you get for what you put out.  This is a solid product.  If you want to give it a shot go for it.  I'd you are on the edge I would try something else.

Once upon a time, I used a somewhat similar molding paste called PureHair Watercress.  Unfortunately, that product was discontinued, and I've been searching for a replacement for some time.  V76 by Vaughn Molding Paste seems like a great replacement, as it performs similarly or better than PureHair.

The nice thing about this molding paste is its balance.  It's not too heavy, not too light.  Offers terrific body without flattening or weighing your hair down.  Can work great for all lengths of hair (mine is on the short side).

Really a fine product.  Nice light scent too.

I was provided a sample for evaluation purposes, but there's a good chance I'll continue buying it once I'm out of the stuff.  5 stars.
summary: Possible replacement for my discontinued PureHair Watercress

reviewText: A nice, solid hair product for my arsenal. This molding paste goes on lightly, but provides a strong hold. It works well with my wavy hair, maintaining my style without looking plastered on. Its subtle and has a subtle scent to match. Reasonably priced for quality molding paste.

I've used a couple V76 by Vaughn products and i REALLY like their texture paste.  The molding paste has a little firmer hold, but the satin finish just makes my hair look a little too greasy unfortunately.  Scent is identical to the texture paste.  If you have fine hair, the texture paste would be a better choice for you.  Like their other offerings, this is a pretty high price point for 1.7 ounces.
summary: good hold, satin finish is too much for fine hair

reviewText:
Holds really well - use less than you think you need!

Creamy like a forming cream, holds much tougher, stiff feel.  No dandruff or anything else.

The first thing I noticed about the product was the scent.  It totally brings back childhood memories of being at the barber shop.  The paste itself, has a smooth, thick texture until you work it with your fingers, then it becomes very pliable.  Once the product has dried, it does a good job maintaining its hold without that hard, crusty texture common with cheaper gels.  The product has not irritated my skin and did not make my hair feel itchy.  I have relatively short hair that I style, and this product was able to provide some good volume and control, even with the random strands that like to break away.  Compared to my favorite product Gatsby hair wax it comes pretty close in performance.  Overall, its a nice product that has a great scent and predictable control.
summary: Nice Hair Product w a Great Scent and Predicatable Control.

reviewText:
V76 by Vaughn Molding Paste is a great molding/hold paste. Great for men and women alike who enjoy a more define, sharper image to their look. It works great on any type of hair, thick, curly, straight. And it comes in a small 1.7 container that is perfect to take on the go/travel and is enough that it will last months without having to purchase an extra.

This is a great styling paste and would make a great accessory to your hair game.

I have short curly hair and this Molding Paste really kept my hair looking just the way I placed it in the morning after my shower and shampoo all day. It has a very faint scent and is a white cream. A little goes a long way.
summary: A little goes a long way to keeping your hair in shape

reviewText:
So far I'm quite impressed with this hair product.

My go to brand is American crew for molding paste, but this one seems to work just as well, but doesn't require as much product.  I would easily  recommend this product.
summary: feels great and smells good too

reviewText: Excellent molding paste.  Has great hold without being sticky.  The smell is a bit masculine which would be expected for a product made with men in mind.  It doesn't flake off at the end of the day either.  Nice!

Wonderful Scent and Soft Hold.  This zoomed to my top 3 list in pomades.  It's different; it actually softens my
hair like a conditioner and the next day, just re-wet the hair to reactivate it.  Leaves hair soft and well as a good hold.
The scent is to die for.  The biggest testimony of a product is whether you'll buy it again.  I'll buy this again.

Let's just start with the fragrance: heavenly! Usually, I tease my boyfriend for spending too much time in the mirror ... but when he's using this pomade, I know why! Because it just smells delicious! And the look is polished perfection.

A guy with a traditional "men's haircut" will not have to use a great deal of this pomade to achieve maximum effect. And, obviously, control is key here. It does have that quintessential "shiny" look. So, if you use a calculated amount, it will look chic and not greasy. So, you may want to take it for a test-spin before that big date or event.

The look is gorgeous, the smell is so tasty ... and the little container is just charming!

Everything about this product is well thought-out. And, yes, I know is seems expensive, but unless you are using WAY TOO MUCH, it is going to last you a really long time.

Buy this without hesitation! Awesome!

It's 2 ounces of product in a small but heavy glass jar but since a small dab is really all you need you can expect plenty of use out of this one. Product is listed as medium hold and that sounds about right - its easy to set and reactivate throughout the day with some strokes of the comb and dabs of water. The product provides a decent finish with a healthy, natural looking gloss of sorts. The product itself is water soluble so for a pomade product it washes out reasonably well with your standard shampoos. Fragrance is listed as 'sweet tobacco' and it does have an earthy, masculine aroma with sweet notes punctuated throughout - indeed it does smell great and that's one of the more enjoyable aspects of putting this product on for day to day use.
summary: Small dab goes a long way

reviewText:
I have graduated from gels, to creams so thought I give this pomade a try.
I have very fine hair so I have to be very conscious of what product I use and how much I put in.  Too much of anything and my hair looks like its a matted down mess.  Too little and i have an uncontrollable fly-away mess.

My stylist had recently started using a pomade on my hair and I like the way it turned out so I wanted to try for myself.
First off I really like the scent of this product but it is very strong.  Literally so strong that it is all I smell all day.  Good thing I like it but not sure about everyone else I come into contact with each day feels.

This is much thicker than a cream or gel so if you haven't used pomade before start small.
Its best to apply to dry or nearly dry hair.  When its wet my hair looks sort of flat once it dries.
I simply glide a small coating on my fingers and rub them together to get some heat in it and to smooth it out them simply run my fingers through my hair.
I notice it doesn't go on nearly as evenly as my less thick Redkin pomade, so I often have to hit certain spots again to get it even.
I like how this product holds my hair all day.  Other products seem to give up at some point. This definitely has more endurance.

I still haven't perfected the best way to apply this so that it is consistent day to day.  It seems like some days are just right withe others I put in too little.  Its very thick and sticky so the natural tendency is to use too little.

Its been a good introduction to this type of pomade and I am generally happy with the results.
The strong smell is still a question as is my ability to apply it consistently. But otherwise I like it.
summary: Works well with a very strong scent.

reviewText:
This pomade is wonderful. I have thinning hair that gets oily easily. This stuff is easy to work into the hair, and adds a long lasting hold and shine without weighing it down. More importantly for me, it doesn't leave my hair oily looking like many styling products do by the end of the day. The stuff itself is thick like honey but not sticky. A small dab goes a long way.

It comes in a heavy glass jar with a tin lid. The scent is strong straight from the jar, sort of masculine and sweet. However, after you've applied it to the hair, the scent is very pleasant and not overpowering at all. It is easily the best styling product I have used in a long time. A little expensive but well worth it.

I am not a man; I have very fine waist length hair. Years ago I was complaining to a stylist that I can't get any loft near my crown. My hair hangs flat against my head. She suggested using a pomade near the crown. I started using Semisumo and have been ever since.

This works very well in the same way; judiciously applied to dry hair near my scalp, it gives my hair a structural lift that lasts all day. I love the consistency and the smoothness. I had a very difficult time reading the ingredients list ( couldn't find anything on the website) but after I peeled the sticker off and put it on a white sheet of paper, I found the scent just listed as fragrance. So it's a shot in the dark but I don't smell tobacco at all in this scent. It feels pretty grounded like vetiver and ylang ylang, maybe patchouli. Anyway, I like it a lot and it is not like I'm walking around wearing Old Spice.

This works fantastically for my purposes. I don't think the 21st amendment ( for which this company is named) is our crowning achievement....for that I'd go to the 19th.

This pomade feels great and is perfect for the slicked back look. A little goes a long way. Any product left on the hands rinses away easily plus this washes out of my hair fine. This leaves the hair very shiny, so if you are looking for something more matte, check out the other Man Made hair products. My only minor complaint about this product is that the scent is pretty strong. That being said, it is a great scent. I bet Bowser wishes he had this product back in the day.

Pomade has an incredible hold life and applies easily. Don't be scared of the price because this will last you a long time. Easily style your hair to hold where you want it to. The pomade has a clean fresh smell that lasts all day.

I have the body wash/shampoo/conditioner from the same company.  The same tobacco smell. My wife loves it! It's a different texture than most gels.  Not too heavy and not really sticky.  It feel and looks like a blend of petroleum jelly and waxy stuff, yet it's water soluble.

I love the jar ideas. You can take it to work or to the gym with out it messing up other things in your bag.

This very thick golden Man Made Pomade is literally, the balm for your hair!  It smells amazing.  I rubbed some between my palms and worked it into my son's hair for about 20 seconds and we could do any look he wanted.  I did the tossled, just off the beach, windswept hair PERFECTLY and that is the look I love on my kid.  He saw it and immediately out came the brush and slick back it was.  Oh well.  This pomade can make every style happen, easily.  LOVE the smell!  Can't wait to see what else this company makes.

This is a very nice pomade that smells nice and gives great hold to my short-ish hair. I apply is after showering to damp hair, but sometimes I use it when my hair is dry. Both yield excellent results.

A little goes a long way and this jar should last a long time, as I use a small amount rubbed in my hands each time. It gives great hold and will hold all day. I also use Bumble and Bumble's Sumotech, which is also excellent but this holds stringer for longer at a lower cost.  It has a good smelling scent (tobacco and leather) to it, but its good, so I don't mind.

My other common pomades are Tip Top and Bonda Fide. I prefer water based over the Petrolatum products because they're much easier to clean out of your hair. My barber told me to use shampoo first when using Petrolatum ones, before you even wet your hair, rinse, then wash again. Too much work, and even then I didn't feel like it all came out. Further, I try to wash my hair every other day.

This pomade product is definitely pretty heavily fragranced. It's a very manly scent however. I kind of like the smell of the product, an hour after putting it on, the smell is still faintly there for the wearer, which means for someones nose it hasn't adapted to, I'm sure it's much more noticeable.

The hold is superior. I can go a full day in the humid warmth of the summer and it's still got hold left.

I feel like the jar is very packed full and heavy for the volume of the jar. It's much smaller than a Tip Top container, and slightly larger than the Bona Fide. As new, I'd say the weight of all three products is about the same, which I found kind of interesting.

I'll definitely be adding this into my rotation.

I haven't had a pomade that has a strong smell. It smells robust but with a sweet burnt.

It is easy to rub between the fingers for styling. Holds well with some water.

The hold on this is great, and it is indeed very shiny! It makes hair easy to style for short looks, and works for relatively sculptural stuff if you finish with some spray; it also resists humidity well, which is a great plus.

Downside? If you like fresh clean scents or traditionally masculine scents, this isn't it. It is VERY sweet and heavy. I hate it. Some might like it. Personal preferences, you know? But if you like citrusy, musky, or clean scents like rain, ocean, linen, etc, and dislike very sweet stuff, you'll be with me on this one.
summary: Great hold and shine; overpowering sweet smell

reviewText: Of all the Pomades I've tried, this one for now is unfortunately my least favorite.  This stuff has a really strong scent and is so thick and heavy, it's like putting honey in your hair.  Not to mention the ridiculous price of $24 for 2 ounces?

I think this hair stuff smells like honey, not tobacco. It is the consistency of honey. It gets a little slimy if your hair is wet. But the hold and shine are spot on. Not a crunchy hold like hair gel. Just a medium hold and high shine.

Thiis pomade is amazing!! You only need a little. I've put it on my edges and it holds amazing. I also used on my daughters hair and her edges are laid down. We both have African American natural hair. Highly recommend

This pomade came right in time as I had just finished cutting my husband's hair.  He likes it on the short side and has been using styling gel for years to get his hair to lay like he wants it too.  At first he was a little hesitant to try the pomade saying it was too thick and it smelled sweet, but after he used some he seemed to be quite satisfied with the look he obtained.  He said it was nice to be able to leave a few finger comb trails through his hair.  The only thing he wasn't too fond of was the scent.  I like it however.  I've always loved the smell of pipe tobacco and this pomade smells like a mixture of pipe tobacco and honey.  It is thick and a tiny bit disconcerting at first because of the thickness, but you don't need much and it does a good job of keeping hair where you want it and nicely so.

This would be a perfect product for my fine, none-too-thick hair that gets poufy in the front and flat at the back crown, except...
It smells amazing, like honey, but not too strong. It has a gel/grease sort of texture, but not sticky at all. A dab did not make my hair greasy, or my husband's, which is super short--it just gave it nice style. No flaking.
However, my gray and white hair wants to pick up yellow color on the porous ends, and this has caramel color. I wondered why it was a nice honey color, and squinted and found out why. Nope. If it were clear, I'd be all over this. My husband, who has more dispersed gray will enjoy it.
summary: Caramel color may discolor your light colored hair.

reviewText: I learned about this product line recently while working on a movie with a mostly-male cast. These products made the hair and makeup trailer smell like heaven, so I immediately ordered the pomade and shower gel for my husband. The scent is reminiscent of honey and my grandfather's pipe...just what a man should smell like. He loves the shine it leaves on his hair and beard, I love that his hair looked groomed but still feels soft. Whenever he uses it, not only women, but grown men will stop him and ask what it is so they can order it for themselves. And the shipping is always super fast! Love love love!!!
summary: How a Real Man should smell

reviewText:
The fragrance here is so yummy that I considered stealing this from my boyfriend's side of the cabinet just to smell it on occasion. And, the look on my boyfriend is a playful messiness without the sheen/shininess one might find in comparable products. What I really like is how it is not rigid ...  I can still put my hands in his hair and tousle it a bit.

This is his favorite hair product ... he uses it daily. And after month, there is still plenty left in this cute little jar. In his opinion (and in mine), this easily worth the price for the look, the fragrance, and the overall longevity.

We will buy this again and again! So very highly recommended!

Unfortunately, this wasn't a favorite for the following reasons:

- Compared to similar pastes/water based waxes, this paste did not give the flexible hold expected.  Hair remains flexible but the style didn't hold up for very long.
- The scent is strong, so you really must enjoy it, and did doesn't fade away even hours later.
- If you have dark hair, you need to blend it really really well or the white product shows up.  By the time it is rubbed and blended and rubbed and blended, the style is a mess and needs to be redone.

I would only recommend this for people with lighter hair who want minimal hold and love the scent.  It is low shine product which is a plus!
summary: If you have dark hair, be careful...

reviewText:
I try to live a very healthy life.  I try to only put on my body what I'd also put in my mouth.  Meaning that I won't shower with or apply onto my body unsafe toxic ingredients.  This basically eliminates 99.9% sold in stores and online.  Finding hair styling products is tough.

I originally got this Man Made Paste because the Amazon description said "Contains: Macadamia Glycerides, Hydrolyzed Quinoa".  I searched the internet and no where could I find an actual ingredient list.  I took a chance and got it, going off of what I thought was the simple list of ingredients that Amazon posted.

When I got the actual Paste, I found the actual ingredients to be a long list of processed chemicals that I would never put on or in my body. I posted here a photo of the ingredients so that discriminating shoppers can see what is inside this hair Paste.
summary: Not the clean list of ingredients that we are led to think

reviewText:
Was looking for a new hair paste when Amazon recommended the Man Made Paste... so glad I tried it out. I love the smell, and you don't have to use much for it to really hold and smell great. I've gotten so many compliments. Generally before trying the Paste I was alternating between different Axe and Old Spice pastes. This 2oz bottle is going to last awhile because you're really not using much. It lasts all day, and when I say ALL day I mean it. I put this on in the morning getting ready for a wedding I was in and never rechecked (and had been partying quite hard later that evening...) my hair still looked good when I got home after the reception.

So this is much more expensive than the stuff I usually buy, but I have to say it is definitely worth the price. It lasts much longer, works much better and smells great. Going to be purchasing!!

This is the second 18.21 hair product I have reviewed and I do like this paste.  I have fine hair and most 'matte finish' products either weigh it down or make it look very greasy.  This paste has a satin finish and medium hold as it advertises.  The scent is great, but a little stronger than most men's hair products.  I don't mind it, but some people might.  I have found that applying this in conjunction with a clay or wax first tends to give me more volume and hold.  The product I received is identical to the one pictured on Amazon and the performance lives up to the item description.  I try to provide candid, honest feedback for all products I review so other Amazon consumers can make better informed decisions when purchasing these products.  If you feel this review was helpful, please be sure to click the Yes button at the end of my review, thanks!  I am required to disclose that I "received this product at a discount in exchange for an honest and unbiased review".  This in no way influences my opinion or review of this item.

STAR RATINGS: Each product is tested and reviewed for a sufficient period of time to provide an accurate review.

1 Star: This product is complete garbage.  There is something wrong with it or is grossly misrepresented in the item description.  It does not live up to the claims advertised or is of extremely low quality craftsmanship or materials. I would not recommend a product with this rating to friends or family.

2 Stars: This is a very poor product.  It has flaws, mistakes in the product details or description.  It does not live up to the claims advertised or normal customer expectations. I would not recommend a product with this rating to friends or family.

3 Stars: This item largely meets the product description as advertised but is not something I would purchase again.  Overall the product meets the minimum standard of quality and/or price, but lacks real appeal.  I might recommend a product with this rating to friends or family.

4 Stars: This is a good product. This item has met all my expectations based on the item description.  The design is sound, quality and craftsmanship are good.  The item performs as it should and meets the objective of its intended use. I would recommend a product with this rating to family and friends.  I rate most products at 4 stars.

5 stars: This is an amazing product.  It is well thought out, designed and produced.  A truly exceptional product worth every dollar of the price tag.  It exceeds all expectations based on the item description.  This item exceeds most consumer standards and expectations.  I would recommend a product with this rating to anyone.
summary: As advertised, medium hold and satin finsh

reviewText:
I've tried the pomade, clay and this paste of this line. They all have the same grounded warm scent. I don't find it as much tobacco as I do vetiver and ylang ylang. Regardless of what the fragrance actually is, I like the scent and it is pleasant to be around.

This paste has a smooth consistency and is easy to work into my fingers for placement near my crown, I have waist length fine hair that is very flat on my head. I got a bit of lift from the paste and it does last all day. I really like that it does not get stiff and brittle.

For firmer hold I recommend the clay. However for day to day use this is an excellent product. Personal preference on product texture will win the day with this as to variety chosen. I have been mostly using the pomade and clay but this works well too.
summary: Very useful for medium hold, easy to get to the exact spot I need it. Smooth texture.

reviewText:
This stuff is fantastic. I have thinning hair that gets oily easily. This stuff is easy to work into the hair, and adds a long lasting hold and texture without weighing it down. More importantly for me, it doesn't leave my hair oily looking like many styling products do by the end of the day. The paste itself is thick and non-greasy. A small dab goes a long way.

It comes in a heavy glass jar with a tin lid. The scent is wonderful. Masculine and very sweet. It smells strong from the jar but not overpowering after you've applied it to the hair. It is easily the best styling product I have used in a long time. A little expensive but well worth it.

When you sniff it straight from the jar it smells like cheap cologne but once you put a smidgeon on your hair the fragrance is more subtle and pleasant, with that minty smell of other bath products. More importantly it doesn't leave your hair feeling too stiff or sticky, like other products I've used. If you use it sparingly, it gives your hair a light hold and a nice shine. My only qualm is the packaging - it's easy to mistake this "paste" for the real thing and I'm afraid that if I leave it on the shelf where a child might see it, she will mistake it for an Elmer's Glue product and ruin the stuff. I get the "manly" packaging (no-nonsense, kind of hipsterish in celebrating the basics) but it feels gimmicky to me and I wish the package would more clearly state what it's meant to be used for (instead of just saying "PASTE" why not add a second line saying "HAIR POMADE"?). Otherwise, this is a quality product.
summary: Good Product But Packaging Could Be Mistaken For Craft Paste

reviewText:
Before we begin...this is a hair product.  That is NOT clear anywhere in the packaging or most of the product descriptions out there.  Its basically a hair gel, though its consistency and description of 'paste' is accurate.

Its actually a terrific product.  The paste applies smoothly, simply.  I usually wet my hands first and a 'lil dab'll do ya' happens. A little goes a pretty good way (most of my hair in a couple of drops of the paste but a little more than minimal is needed to go a full day.  It IS capable of going a full day and with my hair, that's saying something.

A lot of comments have been made, pro and con about the smell of the paste.  I am a smoker and I'm not sure I could tell you what tobacco really smells like.  But after I sniffed at the paste...that's just what it smells like.  Its pleasant and nice and the odor permeates without overpowering.  I really like it.

The pricepoint for the 'paste' seems high (around $24 today) but the paste does a very good job and it is likely worth it to spend a few more pennies everyday to get the hold, look and smell that you want.

All in all, this is a very good product. Remember three things: it is a hair product (which you CAN'T tell by looking at the jar, it works really well and the smell is pleasant.  All in all, strong recommend!

Update 07/24/2017  - This particular hair product has become my son's favorite.  We have re ordered it multiple times since the initial order.  Again, a strong recommend, seconded by a happy teenage consumer.
summary: Review: Man Made Paste Exec Summary: Once you figure out what its for, its great.

reviewText: I got this for my 12 year old son who has formerly been a bit too much of a gel fan.  I am happy to say that this paste doesn't make hair rock hard or shiny, though I have had to coach him in the appropriate amount to use compared to gel.  The smell is very nice- earthy, tobacco smell, which might be a bit much for his age, but smells better than the typical pre-teen Axe overkill.  If my husband wore his hair long enough to style, I would be happy for his hair to smell like this!
summary: Wonderful smell, better look than gel

reviewText: My husband loves the smell and feel of this product.  He says it has a light vanilla smell and he loves the way it holds his hair.  He most likes using it on a non wash hair day.  It provides the hold he needs without having to go through the trouble of washing his hair every day!  This is the kind of product that makes a day in my husband's world less stressful.

I have worked with hair products on men for quite some time.  I have cut and styled hair and helped teach how to maintain styles for men.  Having products to recommend is always a plus, especially if it is effective and easy to use, which most men appreciate.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This paste is a rather odd product.  The jar has no instructions on it at all, so you are left to experiment on your own.  The appearance is simple and appealing for men.  The product inside is almost like rubbery.  It is not the kind of cream you can just run your finger over, you have to press your finger into it and hope you don't get too much on.  It is hard to gauge how much you will get on your finger, because it is so congealed.  The fragrance is going to be a deal breaker for some men, however. It is similar to Ojon but much more intense and not quite as natural smelling either.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
It depends on what type of hair you have as to how this will perform.  On short hair, it performs well, but you have to be careful not to use too much. On medium length hair, it gives that tousled look that is so popular among men.  It seems to last most of the day.  On long hair, not so much.  It seems a bit much for longer hair.

Another factor is hair coarseness and thickness.  This is not made for fine hair.  It is not made for very straight floppy hair either.  It is more for hair that has a wave to it, is medium to coarse, and already has some body.  That is, unless you are going for the pieced almost greasy look, then this will work on poker straight hair, especially with highlights.  It does have a satin finish, and does dry down to an almost dry feel, although too much will cross that line and weigh down certain hair.

THE FRAGRANCE
At first I loved this fragrance in the jar.  It really is a nice smell.  When used on the hair, however, it is very overwhelming.  I found that although I liked it in the jar, it seemed to multiply in intensity on the hair, and it does not fade quickly either.  I found myself getting a headache after being around it on my hair, and my husband and son's hair.  I could not wait to get rid of it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This paste has potential to be good stuff.  It does a good job on certain hair types and styles, and holds them well.  The fragrance is too strong once it is applied to the hair.  It is like someone dumped a bottle of cheap cologne on the hair.  Although performance is good, the fragrance is just too high intensity.  If they toned it down some, it could actually be attractive.  As it is now, it is almost repulsive after wearing it a while.

Two stars from me just due to the overbearing smell.
summary: Loved The Smell In The Jar, On The Head It Became A Problem

reviewText: This works well but still keeps a soft feel to the hair.  It has a  strong men's cologne smell though.

I usually use Baxter pomade, (20 bucks vs this which is 24) and whille I do like this product a lot for how it holds my hair as others have noted the heavily perfumed  "paste" is OVERwhelhming.  I personally do not have a problem its initial smell, but it is just way to strong and if you are going out and combine this product with any cologne, you are asking your date to put up with a lot - and that is before she sees you naked lol.

It does do as advertised, but it just too perfumed to use for my tastes.  If you like the odor you will love the product, but for me I will stick with Baxter's line of products.

If any one from Paste is reading this and you have a similiar product that is unscented send me a bottle and I am sure I would love it.

Excellent aroma, like a nice vanilla cream, type thing.  The texture in the container is definitelyspringingI think is the best way to describe it.  So you have to dig it out.  But once you have it on your hands, it is very easy to work into the hair.  I agree with the description of a medium hold.  The product describes a Satin shine.  I would say more of a matter for me.  But my hair rarely gets shiny without pomade of a gel.  But otherwise a nice little product with a great aroma that last for a good half of the day.  Makes me want to try their other products.

The smell. The smell pretty much overwhelmed everything. I could smell it all day at work, and even after during my workout. I couldn't wait to shower. When I put it on in the morning, it didn't really bother me and I thought it'd dissipate quickly. It stuck around. There are quite a few reviews on here that don't seem to mind it, so please do take my review with a grain of salt.

Outside of the smell, this product works really well. I need to find out if they make a scentless version of this, because I really did like the way it worked. It held my hair in place very well without needing too much of it.

Overall, if you like the smell, this is a great product. It made me nauseous so I can't really use it. I'd love it if it had no scent.

I like to sport a surfer-style do (even though I no longer live near Orange County, where I grew up). I've have found that Man Made Paste helps me get the look I want.  I believe that anyone who wants to gain more control over their hair style should give this excellent product a try.

I towel-dry my hair and apply the paste. I can work it in and get a tossled look.  The paste helps lock in waves and curls in my hair, all day long.  My wife really likes the look!

I suppose the paste works just fine for guys with shorter hair, as well.  The bottom line is that Man Made Paste provides control over whatever you want to do with your hair.

I highly recommend Man Made Paste to everyone.
summary: Helps me get the look I want

reviewText: This "18.21 Man Made" (?) hair styling paste is functional and pleasant as a pomade or hair product, but so intensely scented with a rather unpleasant patchouli-tobacco accord that I can't use it regularly. Texturally it's a thick, very dry-feeling lanolin and clay-based paste, with a lot of titanium white visible when you spread it into hands and hair -- in heavy application this might be a problem, visually, but it smells so strongly I couldn't tolerate  a heavy application anyhow. It applies nicely once softened -- needing significant body heat to do so -- and works okay, if not at all high-hold, as a hair styling addition. But the scent is like bathing your head in Kouros -- I felt I had a cloud of aggressive cheap cologne following me around for the whole day. Can't recommend it for anyone but the Axe-teenager crowd, due to the way-too-strong scent.
summary: Way too strongly scented for a hair product

reviewText: This "Paste" smells a lot like sweet pipe tobacco so it's on the manly side.  It holds a woman's short hair in place too but you will smell the tobacco scent everywhere you go.  I just got my hair cut nice and short and since hubs is at work right now I thought I'd give it a try.  It definitely will hold your hair in place with a minimal amount, but I sure can smell it.  I like the scent of pipe tobacco but after a while I may have to wash it out.  Hubs tried out the 18.21 Pomade yesterday and it smells a lot like this paste.  So, either one will hold your hair pretty much all day but the scents are rather strong.

Smells great and works awesome. Yes, it is thick, but is is a paste. Typically we rub in between our fingers and style according with only a dab, and re apply as needed. We found out that it can clump if not rubbed into the hair well enough.

My boyfriend prefers to be a pretty low fuss guy when it comes to his hair, but also has thick wavy hair that can become unruly without product and some attention to styling.  For context his hair is longer and wavy on top and shorter on the sides.  This works for him.  He uses about a dime-sized amount and runs it through his hair when it's damp.  It helps keep hair in place and have a more polished look without looking overly shiny or stiff.  I personally like that we both agree on the scent.  A lot of men's styling products smell WAY too musky and strong to me.  This is instead a really pleasant, gender-neutral scent.  Mostly to me it smells like bourbon or vanilla, but without being cloyingly sweet.  I also think the packaging on this is really nice.  It's hard to tell from the picture but the look of it is very premium and substantial and consistent with its price tag.  Would recommend.
summary: My boyfriend likes this to give his wavy thick hair a polished look without excessive shine

reviewText:
This is a good hairspray!  I think it's great they make one targeted toward men, and it's a good quality.  My best guy friend uses it, and he really likes it.  It has a good scent to it, it doesn't smell girly or anything.

Overall, I was happy with it and I'd recommend it.

Eeek. While the hold is great, the odor is overpowering. Given that it is a strong smokey/tobacco scent this will not be acceptable in a professional environment or even in an environment where one is working with the general population. I guess it smells like someone's elderly grandfather ... maybe something of faux wood paneled den with yellowing copies of This Old House/Popular Mechanics stacked in the corners. Nothing about this appealing so we tossed it after one trial run.

I guess if you work in career where tobacco scent is not a liability, and (for some reason) you find that scent appealing, this could be for you? Outside of trust-fund hipster babies, I cannot fathom for whom this is an appropriate, sexy option.

This is a medium-hold hairspray with a distinctly masculine and somewhat artificial fragrance of tobacco with sweet spice and perhaps a little musk.  It is more reminiscent of the mens smoking lounge than a barbershop.  The scent lasts quite a while, so be careful choosing other fragrances to use with this hairspray.

The spray holds well even in humid conditions and doesnt flake.

The 10 oz. can has an old-fashioned look and the nozzle doesnt clog easily.

Obviously the scent will be up to individual tastes, but in general the hair spray portion of this product worked well. With a light spray, the hold was loosely firm with still a bit of play. When brushed, the hair still held the styled shape relatively well, but there were quite a few stragglers. If you used a heavy spray, you would suffer from 'crispy hair,' and I did see some hair spray flakes after a while.

The scent, I'm not sure I would call 'sweet tobacco,' but rather a generic sweet with overtones of licorice. Being a pipe tobacco fan, I can't really say that I've smelled specific tobacco that was similar, but I can sort of see how you might infer that a tobacco shop in general might smell somewhat like this scent. When sprayed lightly, the smell was not overpowering and could be worn in conjunction with a cologne or other scent. When used heavily, it does stand out and lasts quite a few hours.
summary: A decent hold, the scent mildly sweet and not overpowering if used for light hold

reviewText:
I would consider this product as a hair spray and cologne all in one. It has a very unique, masculine scent that is very unlike that of Old Spice, Axe, etc. I can't really put my finger on it. It's sort of spicy, sweet and manly at the same time. You either love it or hate it (I like it). The scent lingers like a cologne for a long time and I can easily catch the hint of it after an hour.

As a hair spray, it has a light hold to it. It sprays a fine mist and holds the hair without being stiff, crunchy or tacky. Very nice and natural looking.

I really like this product. I wouldn't use it everyday though since I don't like to wear a cologne smell all the time. That said, it is great for the special occasions when I want to look good and smell nice. It's pricey but worth it for the scent alone (for me).
summary: Light-hold hair spray with a nice cologne scent

reviewText: When I was a young girl, I spent time in Tennessee where you could smell fresh, sweet tobacco growing all over the state. It's nothing like smoked tobacco. The smell is very pleasant. Rather fresh and clean. This spray is strikingly similar to the fresh tobacco plants. The smell is fresh and light. The spray is pretty high intensity. You have to hold it a decent distance from your head, and the spray has a generously wide fan. We only had to hold the button a couple of seconds to get a full coat. And for testing, I tried it on my own hair to see how it worked for shoulder-length hair. It's great. The hold was light to medium but not stiff. It also added amazing shine. Really surprised by how much we ended up liking this.
Husband really likes the scent..no 'hairspray" smell.  This doesn't get tacky and turn his hair into a helmet after spraying!

This product is like a combination of hair spray and cologne in one. So you're really going to have to like the scent of it or you won't like the hair spray. Even a tiny spritz of this will have you smelling like you put on cologne.

The fragrance is mildly spicy and nothing at all like the water/splash/cool/whatever scents you get with Axe or Old Spice hair products. It's different, and unlike any other scent I can think of. It has a more mature, less teenage smell to it. And the fragrance lasts. An hour later you will still catch whiffs of it.

The hairspray goes on in a broad fine mist. It has a light hold to it. It won't make your hair rock hard but will tame frizzies and smooth some. Still plenty of natural movement.

I had wondered if a hairspray could be so nice that it's worth the premium price. I think it is. This isn't your every day AquaNet, Axe, Paul Mitchell or Bed Head hair spray. This reminds me of something a barber would finish off a fresh hair cut with. A luxury hair product rather than a styling staple found in the bathroom cabinet.
summary: Like a cross between hair spray and cologne

reviewText:
This hair spray has a very strong smell. Even with two small sprays, the smell lasted for hours. It smells like a strong perfume a grandmother would wear that would overpower everyone.
I really did not detect a tobacco smell.
The hold is not as good as my wifes regular pump hairspray either.

My husband and son have been using this hairspray. They both like it. It works well and doesn't have a feminine scent. They both say the hold is good but not crunchy which they like. The scent is a like it or leave it sort of a thing. I think it smells nice but it lingers which I'm not crazy about. It's one thing to smell the smokiness in the bathroom but it's something else to smell it on and off all day. It doesn't seem to bother the ones wearing it, I think they just get used to the scent and ignore it but for those who aren't used to it after a few minutes of wear it's not the best scent to be around. A definite plus to this scent is that it does not seem to attract insects. Around here there's still bugs out in the evenings and this stuff, unlike womens products, doesn't bring mosquitos buzzing around your head.
summary: non fruity scent keeps bugs away

reviewText:
This hairspray reeks terribly of cheap cologne scent.  I don't think I'll be attracting any women with it either. It's terribly overpowering. So bad I had to actually jump back into the shower to wash it off. I only used two short sprays and it stunk up the entire bathroom.

I've had functionally bad hairspray but I would gladly use those over this one.  I would not use this hairspray under ANY condition given the unbearable scent. It would be such a huge turn off and I suspect it will most certainly irritate anyone within a whiff of.

I have never used a hairspray that smelled this strong, easily twice as strong as AXE body spray.

Okay, as a male past the mid-century mark, I can honestly say that I've never bought hair spray nor actually used it. Gel yes, hair spray...no. However, I was intrigued enough by the tobacco scent that I couldn't resist...and admittedly, I really like it. The fragrance is very light - it absolutely reminds me of that light lingering fragrance surrounding my grandfather who did indeed, smoke a pipe and/or cigar. Not so obvious that it hits others unless they are quite close - it won't interfere with your normal fragrance. Takes very little (well, for me...I have little hair at this age). Very cool product!

This hairspray is awesome! The can looks good, the scent is amazing and the hold is great - not too stiff or crunchy. My 22 year old son wanted this, but he is going to have a hard time prying it away from my 14 yr old daughter!!!

Got this for my hubby.  Maybe now he will stay out of mine.
I like the smell.  Doesn't smell "perfumey".
Highly recommended.
Between haircuts my husband's hair gets a little too long and I'm sure this is when he'll
use it, to give him some style.
summary: This ought to keep him out of my hair spray now.....LOL

reviewText:
This smells absolutely amazing -- a sweet, smoky blend of vanilla, tobacco, and honey.  But the scent of the hairspray is somewhat subtle; it certainly won't take over the room or command a lot of attention.  It is noticeable, but fleeting.  If you really want to smell good all day long, go for the 18.21 Man Made Sweet Spirits cologne.

As a hairspray, it seems to work fine.  The packaging purports to look like a vintage beer can.  It holds a little over 10 ounces, about the size of a can of shaving cream, and sports an odd plastic cap that looks like tire tread, that doesn't speak luxury to me.  But the packaging is not what makes this product -- it is the incredible scent.  This is a little pricey for hairspray, but a relatively inexpensive way to add luxury fragrance to your day.

Seriously, I love the smell of this hairspray. It's fantastic. I know the fragrance is called Sweet Tobacco but it definitely doesn't smell like cigarettes. To me, it smells like Old Spice cologne with good pipe tobacco. Clearly scent is a subjective thing so your mileage may vary but I love this stuff.

It comes in a very masculine looking can, which may or may not matter to you. However, even the most manly man won't mind having this out on his bathroom counter.

The hairspray itself is what I would call a light hold. Spray it once and your hair won't be stiff and it will be held in place for the day in indoor conditions. You'll need to spray it again and maybe even 3 times to get the kind of hold that will stand up to windy conditions and even then, this won't give you unmovable helmet hair. Since my guys prefer a light hold, this is great for them. And all of the men in my family really like the smell.

I suppose a woman could also use it but the scent is decidedly masculine. I'm focusing on the scent because that is really the only reason to pay this much for a can of hairspray. This is more than 4 times the price of the brand we normally use so it's not something my guys will use on a daily basis. But for date night or a big event? Think of it as cologne that keeps your hair looking good.
The smell alone is worth the purchase!  My husband has short hair so he's not too picky on his hairspray- he usually just buys cheap store brands so this was a welcome treat.  Great hold!
summary: Great stocking stuffer for your guy!

reviewText:
Ohhh it's serene... people feel it and let me know. This excellent aromatic tobacco scent has given me access to something new or maybe it was always there.

That's all there is to it I think. It's a hairspray with a winning aromatic smell that is tremendously rewarding in terms of attracting female attention that hopefully my wife finds harmless.

Monopolistic competition.  Make no doubt about it, you are paying not merely for hairspray but also a confidence boost to your egos.  This product plays upon a perceived lifestyle, one that exudes confidence and masculinity.  Beyond the marketing, it is hairspray that works well in conjunction with a stronger gel or wax.  By itself, the spray will not maintain your awesome do.  Part of the allure is the extremely strong sweet tobacco scent which may be confused with musk, but after 20 minutes the odor does dissipate.  You will either love it or find it repulsive.  Personally, I'm not a fan of the scent, especially considering how it will quickly block out all your other senses.  If you want to be the center of attention, this will certainly help.  Whether its positive attention or not.  The product is priced higher then competitive brands normally geared towards women, but given the small market of hair spray products for men, this will probably sell well.
summary: DISCLAIMER: "Coolness In A Can", Individual Results Will Vary.

reviewText: This is a small but extremely solid and heavy glass jar containing 2 ounces of clay styling product. For most guys just a small amount of clay is needed so don't fret at the quantity as a single jar should last a couple of months even with near daily application. The clay product starts off a bit hard and clumpy once you scoop it out but after working it a bit in the palms of your hands and fingers it'll smooth itself out and apply itself fairly easily to your strands. The product has a flat, matte finish that doesn't give off a moisturized or oily finish. It's a very natural look and provides a nice level of hold that seems effortless to the casual observer. Product works best for guys with short to medium hair that wants a bit of lasting hold in a manner that looks unfussy and natural. The product is pleasantly sweetened reminiscent of a cherry-flavored convenience store cigarillo (this is a good thing).
summary: Good for short to medium hair for those who prefer a bit of lasting hold that looks unfussy and natural

reviewText:
The first thing one notices is the elegant jar. This is the type of product you deliberately leave on your vanity. Then, when you remove the lid, you are instantly drawn to the subtle but appealing aroma. One swipe of the product leads to gorgeously tamed and thick-looking hair. It does not require a tremendous amount of time to achieve a polished, contemporary look. What a boon!

Everything about this product is perfection. LOVE IT!
summary: Love the look, the smell ... EVERYTHING!

reviewText: My husband uses this so my review is based on me trying it in my hair, his hair and the feel in my hand. I found that you really need to rub it in your hand so that it goes in evenly and does not leave any small globs in your hair. Also, if your hair is very slightly moist it does seem to go in and hold a bit better as well. It is very easy to get out of the jar and did not leave a lot of residue on my hands - I did still have to wash my hands after. I found the smell of the CLAY to be great but a bit overpowering and lingering through my house wherever my husband went before work. The finished effect was a matte non wet look that when messed up you could easily put back into place without the hair looking as though it had a ton of product in it.
summary: Very strong smell but works very well!

reviewText:
After years of going with a buzz cut, my teenage son started growing his hair out for a more trendy look. He's got about 6 months of length now and with each trip to the barber he's been shaping his hair a little more into the look he wants. He started out taming his thick hair with a pomade, but his hair is at a point where it needs a little more than that.

As his hair has gotten longer he has had it has a hard time controlling it with a pomade, so he tried out this clay instead. It has a much firmer hold than the pomade he was using and it goes into his hair nicely for him once he's worked well it into his hands.

Someone else mentioned applying this when you're hair is almost totally dry but not quite. That's exactly how it's worked best for him as well. After he's showered he drys his hair and then applies a bit of this. It holds his hair so well and he's able to shape his hair rather than just reduce the frizz. It has a completely matte finish, so you get the firm hold with out the shine like you get with a gel.

The smell is good. It's different than the typical Axe or Old Spice hair products so if you prefer those types of scents, this is a bit different. But my son likes this one so it works for us!
summary: Great hold with a matte finish

reviewText: This is a great smelling product that provides a nice, firm hold while keeping your hair looking natural/dry.  It just takes a little bit to provide the control I need.  I dig out maybe a dime size dollop with my fingers and rub it together between my palms (they'll need to be damp) and work it into my hair.  From there, you can comb as I do, or run your fingers through your hair, as my sons do, and you're pretty well set for the day.  Nice product.

I realize these are men's products but I am a woman. I have waist length very fine hair that is completely flat. A stylist told me to use men's hair pomades near the crown. It works very well at giving my hair some loft. I also have an annoying cowlick that this product can defeat.

I've tried this brand's pomade and that works great. I was looking for a slightly firmer hold. This clay product works better for me than anything I have tried. A finger full, warmed up in my hands and raked through my crown, gives my hair lift all day. I don't characterize the scent as tobacco but rather ( to my nose) a very grounded vetiver, ylang ylang type fragrance. I like it a lot and find it very distinctive and warm. If you need control, I've not tried anything better than this clay treatment.
summary: You need firm hold? Look no further. Love this stuff.

reviewText: Clay is a hair molding paste that works great with short hair for quick no hassle styling.  There are no directions included, but I discovered that for my straight hair, it works best to brush my hair into place after washing and pat-drying it with a towel.  Then, I moisten my hands, pick a small dollop of Clay, rub-it in my hands, and spread it around my hair.  Finally, I brush my hair back into place, and I'm done!  (I don't like to put it on with dry hands, because when I did, it didn't spread properly, and I ended up with little clumps of it on my hair.)  Clay holds my hair all day, even when I'm in and out of the workplace, and it looks natural. (Not a wet look like gels.)  Plus, it's made in the USA, so it makes me feel good about helping our country's workforce!  For its natural long lasting hold, I give it 5 stars.

I requested this to try and get my husband to stop using mousse for this thinning hair, and use something modern and manly. First off, this has a great scent, (Sweet Tobacco) but it is a strong one. If you do not like heavy scents or wear a signature scent, this may get on your nerves. Man Made makes great hair products. I use the pomade to slick back my thick hair. Like the pomade, this does have a bit of a sticky feel when using it but easily rinses off with warm water. The product does not get crunchy or weird like lesser products can. Unlike the pomade, this feels a bit drier, (well, it is a clay) and leaves a matte finish which is preferable to many who do not want a wet or "greaser" look. This helps the hair stay in place, for the most part, but some may want to additionally use the Man Made hairspray for extra hold.  I would recommend this for those with short thinning or wispy hair. If you have longer thick, dense hair, go with the pomade (shiny finish) or paste (satin finish).

This product costs a bit more than drugstore fodder, but it comes in a nice glass jar, is good quality and a little bit goes a long way.

I think I just ordered the wrong product, but I'll tell you my experience.  The scent is super strong.  I could smell it all day.  It's not a bad scent, just strong.  I have short/medium hair and it is perfectly straight and flat.  I thought that if I applied this to my roots it would uplift my hair and keep it from looking so flat.  That didn't work.  It made my hair feel gummy and matted and actually weighted my hair down.

Again - not the fault of the product.  I think I just ordered the wrong item.

I have been searching for a matte finish clay/paste/wax that will actually give my fine hair some volume and hold.  This 18.21 Man Made Clay almost does the trick.  The finish is great, it literally looks like you have nothing in your hair. So they get a 10/10 for that.  I even tried using a lot of it and it still just looked like my hair was dry with no product.  Where this fell a bit short for me was in the hold department.  As soon as I pointed the hair dryer at this stuff it's like it wasn't even there.  Which is unfortunate because I like the scent and the matte finish.  It just didn't do it for my hair type.  If you have short, coarse or thick hair this will probably work well for you however.  The product I received is identical to the one pictured on Amazon.  I try to provide candid and unbiased reviews for all products I review so other Amazon consumers can make better informed decisions when purchasing these products.
summary: Great matte finish, didn't hold well

reviewText:
This stuff is amazing. I have thinning hair that gets oily easily. This stuff is easy to work into the hair, and adds a long lasting hold and texture without weighing it down. More importantly for me, it doesn't leave my hair greasy looking like many styling products that make my hair more oily looking by the end of the day. It is matte, waxy looking but non-greasy. A dime size of it goes a long way.

It comes in a heavy glass jar with a tin lid. The scent is wonderful. Masculine but very sweet. Strong but not overpowering though. It is easily the best styling product I have used in a long time. A little expensive but I would highly recommend it.

The hold on this is pretty solid and has a nice matte finish, which is particularly useful for the deliberately messy/effortless look. You can style hair in a number of ways without adding too much weight or thinning it out like gel can (because you get these skinny little clusters instead of fluffier sections). It makes hair easy to style for short looks, and it works for relatively sculptural stuff if you finish with some spray; it also resists humidity well and can be reworked even with days of accumulation. Just wet a bit and blow dry (or if you have cooperative hair, just wet a little).
