reviewText: like the product however shampoo is shampoo  that's how I feel..

I have the kind of hair that looks like a disaster area in the mornings, and requires brushing and fussing to look like anything. This pomade was a bit stiff for my purposes, but had great hold without having the brittleness that I've found with some other products. I used it for nights out and parties; it gave that sort of look to my locks that wasn't everyday.

This stuff is a lot more touchable than other pomades I've used, but still not quite ideal, so I'm cutting a star. Still, I strongly recommend this.

I really like this Baxter of California Slick Pomade. I've been using and like American Crew Fiber. Slick Pomade has a similar smell and hold when compared to American Crew Fiber. The only really difference I've noticed is the color and texture. Fiber is a white paste that dries clear when in your hair. Slick Pomade however is more clear and little more gel like than a paste.

Baxter of California Slick Pomade doesn't leave a sticky feeling residue in my hair like some gels I've used in the past. My only problem with this pomade is the cost it's $5 more than American Crew and you only get 2 oz verse the 3 oz in the Fiber container.
summary: Great product I wish it was a little cheaper.

reviewText: I am not a major pomade user, but I have used a couple of other brands and I do not see how this product warrants the price.  It isn't bad.  It provides a medium hold without a heavy fragrance.  It's okay for men and women it all depends on the style that you are going for.  I like to wear my hair in sleek ponytails and up dos sometimes, so extra control really helps.  The problem is that the pomade leaves a slightly sticky residue without the shine, so your hair can look dirty if you are not careful.  The other brands that I have used have come close and one even exceeds the performance of the Baxter brand, so I wouldn't recommend that anyone splurge on something so average.

I normally us styling gel and my favorite so far has been Pinaud Clubman Styling Hair Gel, Original - 16 Oz. After trying this Baxter of California Slick Pomade, I might end up using this for the future because it doesn't just give me the styling but also gives my hair a little silky shine, not too much as to look strange, but just enough to look healthy. It also have a very light scent that produces a clean sensation, lifting up your morning spirit making you ready for the day.

I have the BoC dry pomade already so was expecting good results from this.  This slick pomade does just what it advertises.  It holds well without feeling bulky or sticky and gives your hair that wet sheen look.  Really great pomade, I'm a fan.
Provides adequate texture for short to medium long hair. Works on hispanic and asian hair too. Works best after shower than greasy hair. Gives hair style ready slick to comb or hand shape styling.
Always a great product!

I was excited to try the Hampton Sun Face Cream because I suffer from dry skin on my t-zone.  I usually use regular lotion on my face and it just doesn't seem to help.  I used this face cream for a little over a week and decided to try something else that was half the price so I would have a basis for comparison, as I have never used face cream before.

The Hampton Sun cream works quite well, but I did notice that I have to use more than the other product I tried.  Since I have to use more of the cream in order to help with my dry skin, the texture of my face ends up feeling like I'm wearing a heavy amount of makeup.  I have never used much makeup so the texture was rather uncomfortable.  After switching between the two products I decided to experiment and use a thinner layer of the Hampton Sun and then a thin layer of the other product.  With the two thin layers, my face has been silky soft and I have not been plagued with dry flaky skin.

My recommendation is that if you have extremely dry skin, pairing a thin layer of this product with another product may be the best possible option.  Play around with various combinations and you may end up with a dream combination.  I rate this product 3 stars because it works best with another product rather than as a stand-alone.

Good Luck!
summary: Worked better for me with another product.

reviewText: I don't have a particular brand of moisturizer that I love and use daily. I have bought quite a few that have been effective. I look for something that is light and has an SPF of 15-25. I like this particular Hampton Sun moisturizer but I'm not quite sure why it's priced so high. It is not a miracle cream by any means. It goes on nice and smooth and feels light on my skin. That said, I've tried about a dozen cheaper products that do the same thing. The amount you get doesn't even justify the cost. By the end of the day my face has an oily feel to it, which is attributed to my naturally oily skin, so I know this doesn't help against that. But I haven't tried a moisturizer that has yet to help in that regard anyway. There is hardly a scent to it which is ideal and the pump is nice and works well. I have been using it for about 4 weeks now and while there have been no negative side effects, there isn't anything special happening either. For this price, I think there should be. In the future I will be going back to my Aveeno. It's much cheaper and does the exact same thing.

Very silky and light, excellent moisturizer.  Odorless.  I would not recommend wearing this out in the sun thought... SPF 15 is just a light protection.  I'm very fair skinned, and would not wear anything out below 50.  I think this is more perfect for dry winter months.. then hot humid summers.
summary: Light and moisturizing, some sun protection

reviewText: This is a smooth and somewhat light cream that provides adequate enough moisturizing if I use about a few quarter sized dollops and really rub it in to the dry areas. I would not agree with the super hydrating label though, as my skin feels dry again by the end of the day. I would say while providing decent enough moisturizing, it is probably does not provide enough for it's price point.

The sunscreen in this Hampton cream really works. I was in full sunshine this past weekend wearing the SPF 15 cream on my face, but I forgot to put any sunscreen on my shoulders and neck. The next day my face was normal, but I had a sunburn on my shoulders and neck. Next time I will just use more of the Hampton cream on my neck and not worry about it!

I do prefer to put this cream on directly after a shower because I think it spreads in better with the slight  amount of moisture & humidity after a shower. When I put it on my skin dry I find it a bit more difficult to get rubbed in. Overall I like the texture of the cream, not too heavy or too light, and a little seems to go a long way.
I use this every night before bed with the Super Smile toothpaste. I am complimented on my smile. My dentist wants to know who I'm cheating on him.
summary: No need for whitening at the dentist.

reviewText: This is a great "nude" shade, although it runs a little "lavender."  Looks great on toes.

Love the color. Has a bit of a brown undertone to it, but it goes well with most grays.

Essie is a thicker polish, some of the darker colors will need 2 coats, but 2 coats is always best for a glossy finish. I type a lot and do hand work so it's nice to have a great color that lasts at least a week before looking like I've put my nails in the wood chipper!
Perfect color for the holidays!
This is a pretty muted purple/pink with an iridescent purple running through it. It has great dimension and the wear time is exceptional - however you will need at least 3 coats for it to be opaque.
summary: This is a pretty muted purple/pink with an iridescent purple running through it

reviewText: Essie Cartel blue is a deep, rich navy blue. It's perfect for any time of the year.
Quality of the polish is fine however the color is much darker than the image suggest and does not really look green at all.
summary: Quality of the polish is fine however the color is much darker than the image ...

reviewText: Pretty color, but not as opaque as I'd hoped. Even with 3 coats, the white of my nails is visible.
summary: Pretty color, but not as opaque as I'd hoped

reviewText: Love this color and love Essie products.  I have long natural nails and Essie is my favorite reasonably priced polish for natural nails.
Love this color.
This is gray, not gray green, just gray. Not as described or pictured. Not eligible for return. Buyer beware.

I haven't noticed any change in my skin, so I wonder if it actually does anything?  Love to see some results, but not seeing them after weeks of use.  I could think of a better way to spend my money, candidly.  2 stars because I question whether it does anything.
I've heard great things about Strivectin over the years, so my experience might be atypical. I've been using it for over  three weeks an neither I nor my husband has seen any difference in my skin.

I'm not sure about this serum.  It does make my skin feel tighter and makes the fine lines less noticeable (for a short time), but it also dries out my skin.  I guess the drying is what produces the tightening, but I'm a little leery about putting something on my face that is going to dry it out.
summary: Dries out my skin  not sure if I like that

reviewText: This definitely worked to tighten my skin.  It also didn't cause any irritation.  The active ingredient is niacin which is popular in skin care products, sort of the "it" ingredient of the moment.  Since this is a serum I followed up with a rich moisturizer and sunscreen and the combination worked well.  I did like the other niacin infused product I reviewed earlier better but this does get the job done too.

My wife loves this stuff; I hate it just because now I have to buy more when she runs out, and its not cheap. I must say it does make a difference, and you don't have to wait months to see the effect. Your face will look firmer right away, and that translates into fewer and smaller wrinkles. I wake up in the morning and I have a 70 year old walking around next to me, after she finishes with this stuff shes back to 45, which is good, because shes not quite 60 yet. Maybe its not quite that dramatic, but you get the idea. It really works; I am honest when I say Ill be buying more, so that alone says something. To top it off, she is very sensitive to chemicals and even odors around her eyes, and this doesnt bother her at all.
summary: If the bottle lasted a lifetime it would be perfect. It really makes a difference

reviewText: I've been trying real hard to see if this tightening face serum really works as advertised but so far I can barely tell if any tightening at all is occurring.  It's been a little over one week of continuous usage, and I can detect only minor changes.  That part about giving your face it's youthful  contour is a load.  And what I did notice didn't last very long.  I don't have a lot of wrinkles, but at 60, I have a few that I would like to see decreased.  I always get a little hopeful when I get the opportunity to review these types of products, but usually I find they don't work very well.  I'll continue with this product until gone and report back if I finally see a positive, noticeable improvement.

I really cant tell a difference.  No one has said to me I look ten years younger.  I don't have a lot of wrinkles to begin with but I don't feel like I see much difference.  Its easy to apply and didn't cause any allergic reactions.  It feels light when applying and doesnt have any smell that is bothersome.  Maybe it is working and I wasn't wrinkly enough in the beginning for anyone to notice but I can barely see a difference.  I cant say it works, but I cant say that it doesnt.

Very effective serum provided that you're using it as 1-step in a multi-stage nightly skin care routine. I use this product as the third step after washing the face (with cleanser), toning and then this StriVectin TL Serum followed by a moisturizer/exfoliant combo. Serum application is an often over-looked stepped in the process but an important one to get the max benefit from your moisturizer and ensuing restoration over the course of your slumber. This product arrives in a white plastic pump bottle that dispenses the white and lightly scented lotion. You're getting 1.7 ounces of cream but a few small dabs are all you need so this bottle should last several months even with nightly use.
summary: Effective component to your skin care routine

reviewText:
I first tried it inside the house at night and it had a nice feel to it. Light and fresh, but not really cooling per say. The shimmer was not too intense, but that was only under the bathroom lighting.

Outside in the daylight is an entire story, I put it on my forearm and with the light hitting it, it was full blown glitter and shimmer. I don't know if I could ever wear this on a casual day to "highlight" my tan. I don't have much a tan anyways, but this would definitely make me seem like I doused myself with glitter rather than highlight any tan of mine. It does not seem to have cooling properties either or none that I could feel. It's similar to misting yourself with water on a hot day. It's certainly does not have a cooling effect like the coolness of toothpaste on the skin for example.

A bottle of overpriced glitter liquid? In my book yes and I would see no reason to buy it. I'll probably just use the rest of the bottle to reenact some Twilight scenes for my amusement. It's kinda interesting to see yourself in the mirror sparkle, but it does not serve it's original purpose of cooling or highlighting any tan. Unless they mean highlight yourself with sparkles.

I've used the Hampton Sun Serious Shimmer Cooling Spray Pearl a couple of times now after using the Hampton Sun tanning gel. It has a nice smell and a LOT of shimmer/sparkle. Being in my mid 40's I'm not really interested in walking around looking like I'm sparkling. The first thing i thought of when I saw this on my skin is that everybody would think I was a vampire because my skin sparkles in the sun. This would probably be much better for somebody younger. I really didn't notice a cooling effect nor did I think it made my tan look any better, but then again that may be because I didn't really like the sparkle effect.
summary: Nice if you want to look like a vampire from Twilight.

reviewerName: Leah Maines, best-selling, award-winning author, actor, and editor
reviewText: Hampton Sun Serious Shimmer Cooling Spray is an excellent cooling spray, and it makes my skin look fantastic.  It adds a multi-color shimmer that looks very subtle.  It also helped ease my sunburn.  The only problem I had with this product was that the bottle is too small.  I used most of it up during a week of Florida vacation.  If the bottle were larger, I would rate this product five stars.
Love this product...very good for hair needed constant moisture

I'm normally a fan of the more solid concealers in stick or pot form since I can get heavy controlled coverage with those to hide the deep dark circles I've been getting under my eyes for the last year or two.  This was the first liquid concealer I've tried in a very long time that didn't become virtually translucent after patting it onto the spots I'm trying to hide.  It stayed nice and opaque and even after dabbing my liquid foundation over it, kept a nice bright base.  I was really pleasantly surprised by the results and since it is so smooth and creamy, I don't worry as much about tugging at that delicate under eye area to get coverage.
summary: Heavy - just the way I like it.

reviewText:
I am getting into the stage of life that they call being "a woman of a certain age," which is a nice way of saying I'm no longer young and dewy skinned. Because I have left acne long behind, I primarily use concealer under my eyes to conceal the dark circles.  This is a nice concealer but I think it is better for younger skin than mine.

It has a nice applicator -- you turn the bottom section to push up the concealer through some tiny holes in a sponge tip and then dab that where you want the concealer to go.  I suppose you could also use the sponge to even it out on your face but I prefer my fingertips for that.

I used the medium and the color is not super dark but was dark enough that I didn't look like a raccoon with it on.

It dries into a matte-like finish, which is my issue with it -- it emphasized the wrinkles in my under-eye area more than I liked.  I usually use a cream concealer that stays creamy and doesn't settle into the wrinkles as much.  This is why I think it is better for younger skin than mine.
summary: Great for younger skin than mine

reviewText:
I was quietly optimistic about these new serums. The directions were easy to follow:

Apply S-1 & S-2 twice daily, Apply S-3 only once (bedtime)
  Wash & dry face/ neck area
Apply approximately 5 drops of each, tapping/massaging the serum into the skin.
  Starting with *S-1 (Nourisher) features superfruit stemcells, moisturizes the skin, aids absorption
  Step two: apply *S-2 (Smoother) contains peptides targeting fine lines and wrinkles.
  Evening:  apply *S-3 (Lifter) contains Hyaluronic Acid and Vitamin C, to plump and brighten.

I put my regiment on hold and used these products as directed. Facial toning, smoothing, brightening and tightening are real concerns. We all want to rejuvenate our face...if not turn the clock back - slowing it down would be nice.

After using these serums for one month -
The Lifter. *S-3 was my favorite. My skin felt tighter and it was brighter. I had a subtle glow again. Using the three tiny bottles took some getting used too. This regiment took about 6 minutes longer than my usual. The serums were pleasant enough ...no foul odors or stickiness. The tiny dropper could be a problem for some. I would think NuFace could repackage these serums so that reading, grasping and dispensing are easier. Last, the price - I think it is high. Based on my use it averages out to $15 a week. Considering the results were no more effective than the product I have been using, I see no reason to change.

If you're considering a new product I definitely recommend this "starter set." It will give you ample time to evaluate your individual results, before investing in the larger, even more expensive bottles.

This set up introductory oils is a three-step process. You do three steps in the morning and two at night. I did this consistently for a month, and still have approximately half of each little bottle left. I have been a 20+ year Mary Kay user, but as I hit my early 40s, I want to make sure I'm doing as much as I can to support my skin. The idea of using oils to do that is appealing. I can't say that I saw dramatic differences in my skin, but I like the way that my skin stayed hydrated and it didn't take more than a few drops of this product to cover  my face. A couple more drops for my neck.
summary: but I like the way that my skin stayed hydrated and it ...

reviewText: great

As a user of the NuFace Trinity electric current facial toning device, I was excited to try their new serums. Included in this set are 3 sample sizes of 3 different serums. Be warned- they are tiny at .25oz each! S1 is the 'Nourisher' designed to moisturize skin and help it absorb the other serums. It features superfruit stemcells. S2 is the 'Smoother' which contains peptides designed to smooth out fine lines and wrinkles. S3 is the 'Lifter' which uses Vitamin C and Hyaluronic acid to brighten skin and plump it up.

Use: Directions state that you should massage 5 drops of each serum into your face and neck after washing your face. S1 and S2 are supposed to be used twice a day while S3 is used once a day. Personally, I found the products made my skin too oily for makeup application if I used S1 and S2 in the morning so I only used S1-3 at night before going to bed.

Effectiveness: The serums feel wonderful on your skin. It felt very nourished during use and even in the morning after washing my face. My skin seemed more moisturized within a few days of use. When I received the serums, I stopped my former regimen of moisturizer and Vitamin C.  The results from those products (brightened skin and smoothed fine lines) were maintained with the use of NuFace serums. My skin did gain a slightly dewy quality which it did not have before.

Downside: The price of these serums is very high compared to generic products with similar ingredients and the same results. I did not see a difference between these serums and my normal regimen of moisturizer containing hyaluronic acid and Vitamin C serum. (Which has a price point of about $25 and lasts 5 months). For this reason, I suspect that S3 is the one that really delivers results since it has almost the same ingredients as my former regimen. I used the serums nightly for close to a month and used about 1/2 of each bottle. This puts the monthly cost at about $37. To purchase the serums individually you are looking at between $70-88 for 1oz.

My skin is soft and supple after I use this treatment. It helps to smooth out my skin tone and I find myself reaching for it on a nightly basis because I can see the results and difference it has made after only a couple of months. I will continue to buy this product.

I got this fragrance for my wife and found it decent but unexciting.  I think it smells a lot like soap.  Not deodorant soap mind you, but one of those fancy little soaps you aren't supposed to use or the wife gets mad at you.  It is fruity and flowery with just a hint of baby powder.  Certainly not offensive, but also not particularly sensual or romantic, at least not for me.  Other reviewers have said it is good for summer; I can understand that but think it would be just fine any time.  I would say it is medium-body, certainly not heavy and maybe a little on the lighter side.

It's half-life is about 4 hours or so; in other words, I can still smell it on her after a full day, but it's only about 1/4th as strong.

I would say it tends older, i.e. 30s and up.  My teen daughter characterized it as "musty flowers" and while she thought it was okay, it wasn't something she found special or would wear regularly.

Overall I would say this is a good, basic scent that is just fine but nothing special or head-turning.  If that's what you want, it could be perfect for you.  If you want something a little spicy or musky or daring, this is probably not the one.

I am not an expert on fragrance--not by a long shot. But I do know what I like (light and floral) and dislike (heavy, musky, or super sweet). This Eau Sensuelle has a nice floral scent that lasts on my skin for about three hours. I don't have a distinguishing enough nose to be able to tell you what all the notes are--I mainly get "floral"--but other reviewers have done a great job of that. It is pretty strong and could quickly become overpowering, so I'd definitely recommend using only a small amount!

I haven't worn perfume or Eau de Toilette since the 80s when I was enamoured with Oscar (de la Rente). So many people are allergic to scents these days so I stopped wearing scents at work.

That said when I read that this a light scent and fruity I wanted to try it. I like the Bodyshop body washes and sprays so thought this would be right for me.

Pros:
Pretty decorative modern looking bottle
Light scent with fruity scent

Cons:
None yet

I don't know how to describe it exactly. Scents are different on every woman and different on different days.

I would recommend trying it on somewhere if one has never worn it. It isn't exactly  inexpensive and risky if one doesn't know how it interacts with ones chemistry.

4 stars because I like it but don't love it.
summary: Light, fruity pretty Eau de Toilette

reviewText:
This is a lighter, fruitier fragrance with slight overtones of jasmine and spice mingled in with the citrus notes. Even when initially applied, it isn't cloying or overpowering. It is delicate enough so that even if you find perfumes to be initially overwhelming, you probably won't have that problem with Rochas Eau Sensuelle.

Upon application the citrus notes predominate. This lends the fragrance an appealing freshness that is subtle enough so that as it begins to mature on the skin and the floral elements come to the fore, it retains its appeal even as the aroma becomes more complex. The various elements of the fragrance don't clash as they are released on the skin, an unfortunate attribute which can give lesser perfumes a slightly unpleasant bitterness which I find off-putting. There is a pleasant and attractive balance of fragrances that is revealed over the 4-6 hours of a single application's efficacy.

The Rochas Eau Sensuelle is a subtle and delicate blend of citrus, floral and spice elements which make this an appealing fragrance.
summary: A delicate blend of citrus, floral and spice elements that is fresh and appealing

reviewText:
I liked the smell very much. Its soft, sweet, and warm. I don't notice it for very long but then I don't tend to use very muchjust a spray behind the ears and on the wrists. By the end of the day, its subtle but still smells very good.

5 STARS: My favorite fragrance at the moment is Jadore. I think this fragrance is similar in its sensuality. Its not a sharp or aggressive smell. I love it.

I've been reading other reviews, and I can't do anything like that.  I am nowhere near sophisticated enough to detect individual scents, undertones, bases or whatever.

What I can say is that the scent is pretty strong initially, enough that I thought this was something I wouldn't wear.  After about 30 minutes, though, it fades enough to be a nice, subtle fragrance, and I really like that.  What I've noticed is that I can still smell it after five or so hours.  Faint, pleasant, and it makes me feel pampered a bit.

Other reviews can tell you a whole lot about the actual scent.
summary: I'm not an expert on perfumes

reviewText:
As pretty much anyone knows, evaluating a particular fragrance is entirely subjective and personal.  With that in mind, I quite like Rochas Eau Sensuelle and find it pleasantly fruity/floral with an appealing hint of spice to counteract and balance the sweetness.  The bouquet which is comprised of Rochas' signature white flowers plus mango and a smattering of dried fruit, is neither overwhelming nor cloying but as fresh and clean as a warm spring day.  And while its complexity certainly makes a statement, it's not so heavy that it can't be worn during the day as long as you take care not to apply it too lavishly.

To avoid over-application when using a spray bottle, rather than spraying it on myself directly, I prefer the old trick of lightly spritzing the air  and then walking into the cloud of fragrance.  I've never gone wrong with this technique.  You derive the subtle benefit of the lovely scent without stopping people in their tracks.

I've been using this Juice Beauty Blemish Clearing Mask for about one month and it has helped make my facial skin look improved.  Directions say apply mask twice per week - in reality I've been applying 1-2 times per week but still helps.

I have slightly oily skin and prone to occasional spot acne.  Using this Juice clearing mask makes my skin look a bit less oily and it does reduce acne for me.  The mask goes on smooth and easy, it feels light, and easy to remove.  Juice uses certified organic products (per their label) and the ingredients do feel high quality.

In summary, not all facial skin products I have used have produced good results for me - this Juice Blemish clearing mask has produced positive results for me and I'll continue to use it based upon that.  At current price of $22, i think it's worth it for the results I'm getting so far.  Overall, I rate 5 STARS in consideration of price/value.

Love the clean and refreshing feeling of the mask that I experienced while applying.  I did a spot application on cheek with a group of annoying blemishes.  The next day my skin looked improved and by the following day I barely saw any blemishes on my cheek.
Extra bonus for the easy to use tube that dispenses just a small amount, and especially enjoy knowing it is made from natural ingredients and certified as organic.  Within 10 minutes it dries and isn't itchy or too tingly while on.

Now for the slight negative, when I went to apply a full face of mask, the tube's orifice for dispensing product is quite small.  So this means you will need to squeeze the tube hard to see just a little product come out, maybe 7 or 8 times to get just enough for a light application of mask.  Either tube material needs to be softer, or make the orifice diameter larger, as this detracts from an otherwise pleasant mask!
summary: Love the clean and energizing tingle of the mask that ...

reviewText: Best treatment
nice stem cell product
Awesome!!! Thanks!!
silky skin, soaks in, wonderfully soft luxurious scent.

I cannot stand filing out these surveys and comments, but, I do love this product, both as a moisturizer and as a conductor for the Nuface device.  I am starting to see some muscle memory kicking in and firmness in the face.  Hopefully this review will suffice and I will not have to respond to questionnaires after every purchase.  I will procure this product again.
Okay, so this stuff works, but I am not exaggerating when I say that they smell like pee. 100% like pee. Confirmed with others. Too much uric acid probably, because this stuff is pee.
Works well to keep the hairline and temples neat.
It does good.

I have this one and temple peach. I am quite impressed with these they really brighten my face. They're only slightly different. I sort of use it as a bronzer bc I'm very fair and the color is sheer and very natural so it has a sort of effect of making you look healthy less ashen as I tend to get. I've never seen a product that you can use quite like that. If you use a lot it will work as blush too. I think it's good all over
I really love this blush.  Great pigment...goes on smoothly and stays on without smudging.  I would definitely use more products in this line.  The color was rich but blended well.  Very very pleased

I have pale skin, and this color looks very intense and not very natural even when I very lightly apply it.  It doesn't come with a brush.  Be careful - when you do go to use a brush on it, you barely touch the blush and it starts shedding off like crazy.  This wastes a lot of (very expensive!) product.  It is also a matte finish.  My personal taste is to have a dewy, natural finish to my blush so I'm not a huge fan of this product.  Hope this helps!

This powder goes on smooth. It doesn't look caked on or settle into fine lines like other matte powders tend to do. The multi color blend seems to give it a more natural look on the skin which is exactly what I'm looking for in a foundation.

This is the second product by the brand that I have tried. I am a big fan of the lip gloss palette that I have of theirs (such a nice size!), and this compact is nicely packaged as well. The clasp to open and close is flush which means that there is less chance that this will open in your purse by accident. It includes a powder puff applicator as well (if I am hope, I instead use a finishing powder brush). I like the blend of colors and it applies very finely and adds the perfect final touch to your makeup. It can definitely be used for quick touch-ups too, but I wouldn't use this as the only face product. All in all, I am quite pleased with it - most of my experience with finishing powders have been in a looser powder form, so this did take a little bit of getting used to, but overall, I am quite pleased!

Well, it feels nice, not too heavy going on. The color because it is speckled was a little difficult to know that you're getting the right one. I am gernally a lighter medium shade. As it turns out Beige No. 3 when applied is a tad darker than you would expect. Also, a faint peachy orange tint to it. But over all a good brand.
summary: I would recommend brand with a heads up on shade description.

reviewText: This is a great powder. Unfortunately, the Beige 3 was too dark for my light skin. I really like the way it goes on and the way it looks. I have very sensitive skin as well and this didn't cause any problem at all after leaving it on all day. that's always a plus for me. I like this so much that I plan on buying the fair #1 which I think would be closer to my skin tone. I would say this is for a medium light skin tone, but not a light skin tone.
summary: I like it, but need a lighter color.

reviewText:
This is a really gorgeous pressed powder.  I love the variations in color, which give the skin a more luminous, multi-dimensional look.  I especially love how it makes the skin look lit from within, without being sparkly or glittery.  It also wears well throughout the day.  Unfortunately though the color was not right for me.  Beige No. 3 is described as being 'light to medium,' which is generally where my skin falls, but it was noticeably too dark for me.  Unfortunately the Light 2 looks too light for my skin so I think the five shades offer may not provide a wide enough range to find the one that works for me.

It's a shame because I really do like this powder.  It's wonderfully build-able.  It feels lightweight and silky.  It doesn't make my sensitive skin itch or redden.  It's just not the right shade.

It's lovely powder but at this point I'd highly recommend trying it on in person before purchasing.

This is the second Vincent Longo product I've tried, and I'm impressed with it.  While the color I chose ended up being too dark for me, it provides nice coverage and helps cut down on shine.

The included puff isn't that great, which is a shame since this is the type of product that you want to keep in your purse or bag for touch-ups.

The color is interesting since it has a mix of tones in it, which makes it look natural on your skin.

The texture is a bit chalkier than I like, and, because of that, it tends to cling to my dry patches.  If your skin is smooth, though, this should work well for you.  My personal fave is still MAC's blot powder, but this powder works well overall.
summary: Provides nice coverage and helps cut down shine

reviewText: I purchased this and the cream Vichy roll-on deodorants to compare the two. While this one is easier to apply (it has a roller ball which the cream version doesnt) and dries faster, this made me break out in a rash which the other didnt. When I first chose this product to review, I didn't realize that it came with such a hefty price tag!  Upon arrival of the small leather zippered case, I was immediately impressed.  The leather zippered pouch is manufactured from genuine supple rich grain leather.  The moment you open the box, the heavenly aroma of quality leather hits your nose.  After my excitement from the leather subsided, I kept my fingers crossed that the contents would be just as impressive.

The five included tools while impressive, are not as equally so.  J.A. Henckels has always been a quality maker of kitchenware, mostly knives, cutlery and flatware.  I have had their flatware for a bit over two years.  This set is run through the dishwasher twice a day daily and it still holds it's shine and edges.  I would come to expect the same of this grooming set that is geared toward the individual that not only enjoys the finer things but DEMANDS them.

INCLUDED in the kit are the:

Zippered leather case

Satin finish stainless steel pointed tweezers

Satin finish stainless steel nose and ear hair scissors

Satin finish stainless steel nail clippers

Satin finish stainless steel cuticle pusher/nail cleaner

Satin finish stainless steels sapphire nail file

All items are of exceptional quality and should last with proper care; an individual's lifetime.  The tweezers are one of the best as well as the nail file.  Now there is a minor disappointment and that stems from the actual price.  At this cost, I would have loved to see a straight edge blade and even a ear/nose hair trimmer included.  If the company needed to keep cost down then they could have done away with the cuticle pusher, as a majority of men wouldn't have missed it.  The nail clipper had me stumped for a few minutes at first, until I realized how to 'assemble' to make it functional.  Once it was assembled, the blades were sharp and precise while not over-cutting which I tend to do rather often.

Highly recommend if you need a higher end gift for that discerning male or even female in your life!  I did deduct one star because it would have been a show stopper with an included straight edge and ear/nose hair trimmer that I originally suggested.  Understand that this product does not seem to actually cost the amount that your are paying.  If a clueless individual opens the gift, they will think that it is nice but not understand that it was over the two-hundred dollar mark.  They will assume that it was closer to ninety dollars.  Understand your audience and this should make a wonderful heirloom-quality gift.
summary: MADE IN GERMANY, ITALY, INDIA, VIETNAM & CHINA

reviewText: I'm still a little bit confused about this product and exactly what void this fills in my makeup arsenal.  I had originally thought it would allow me to remove those annoying mascara blobs that happen every time I sneeze right after putting on a fresh coat, or to fix an overly heavy wingtip lash line, or to straighten out a lopsided lip line.  While this does technically do all those things, it's not a miracle worker and worked no better than a dampened makeup sponge. The product was nice and luxurious, but I'm not sure that I'd call it essential by any stretch of the imagination.

I don't have very steady hands, so makeup application is often a problem for me.  especially around the eye area.  I don't like to take a lot of time to apply tiny little amounts when i am in a hurry, so I can easily get a heavy look when I was just going for a more daytime natural look.  My daughter also loves this for cleaning up mistakes because she is into makeup application and has tried other less effective products.  It does live up to its claims and it uses no harsh chemicals, so i will continue to use this product.

The actual remover is fine, and has been easy to remove makeup with, but the tips are cumbersome and only so much better than Q-tips. I don't feel I'd be buying replacements for the tips.

The remover works well without smudging much, but even smudges are easy to remove.

For the price, however, I'm not sure I'd be ordering it again.

reviewText:
A friend of mine has been trying to find a "Make-up Fixit" product for over a year.  Apparently, she used this type of product in the past and can no longer find it.  When I saw the Vincent Longo Olive Oil Fix Tip Makeup Remover, I immediately ordered it.  I have used other Vincent Longo Make-up (the lip stain is great) and also am a fan of olive oil based make-up removers.  So, I thought that even if this product didn't work well for touch-ups, I could use if for night time make-up removal.
  I was impressed with how well the product worked on all types of make-up mistakes, but especially impressed by the way it worked to remove mascara without smudging any other eye make-up.  I have been a q-tip and water user in the past with mixed results (usually removing too much make-up), but no more.  This does a much better job and the wands are extremely portable due to their small size.  The 4 and 1/2" box (great for travel) contains a 3 and 1/2" bottle (7.5ml) of liquid make-up remover with a wand attached to the cap.  It also contains 12 extra 3 and 1/2" wands.  I apply the oil with the attached wand and remove the oil and make-up "mistake" with a dry wand.
  I like this product very much and recommend it to anyone who wants to remover just a small amount of make-up without having to re-do everything.  I use it at home, and have also taken it my purse for "on the go" touch-ups.  My friend is also quite impressed, but sadly, she will have to get her own:)

The packaging and presentation is nice. Set comes with 12 sleek looking black sticks wrapped into a small package along with a small container of an olive-oil like product along with a story about Vincent in it along with his credentials. Looked pretty stylish and polished to me. I liked the presentation despite it not being very practical or useful.

This is quite pricey for a small tube of a product with olive oil in it just to do 'touch-ups'. Whether this is a gimmick, I'm not sure- but it worked ok but then again why do you need this to fix your make up or do a touch up? I'm sure I can think of other ways to do it that aren't as expensive. An Interesting idea but I wouldn't say it's a requirement to have this to do touch ups. I'm torn between 'it's ok' and I like it, middle of the road. Not a bad idea, would make a cute gift, just overpriced I'd say.

I wanted to love this product!  I love olive oil and the thought of using a natural product opposed to other make-up removers with additives really bloated this product to be something greater in my mind than it actually was.

First off the packaging is horrendous.  You receive this tiny package which can mistakenly be thrown away.  The wand is not removable/replaceable which is pretty disgusting to say the least.  The other applicators cannot be continuously re-used and are the equivalent of cheap cotton swabs.  The actual olive oil that you receive is such a small amount compared to the excessive price, and it has additives.  It is not completely natural.

The actual product can correct smudges from my liquid eyeliner but I can also do that with my Dermologica make-up remover and cotton swabs that are disposable!  This is nothing special.  If necessary you can bring it with you to keep in your purse but not at this price.  It is just too expensive for what it actually is.  I found that it would also leave a shiny sticky film which would need to be dried and cleaned if I wanted to reapply my liner.

Do not recommend for use in your bathroom.  Your current product is doing the same thing.  I do not see how re-using a dirty wand would be all right.  Not worth it; look elsewhere.
Gave it as a gift for a friend recovering from surgery. Its really lovely.

Overall, it doesn't look like the fine lines are disappearing, but it also doesn't look like there are other ones popping up. reviewText: Okay, first the good. This cream does not make me break out. Which is no small thing, mind you. L'occitane Divine Youth, Strivectin, you name it...after two weeks of use, they brings on the blemishes. But this Liftlab cream is extremely light and non-greasy, and...no pimples. It absorbs very quickly, too. So kudos for that. However, I haven't noticed overly dramatic results, even with the lines on my face, and since this is a non-retinol cream, it's not doing anything to even out tone, so I'm wondering if maybe I should forgo this, and go back to my old standby, a drug store cream. As you can tell, I'm still on the fence. There are some great things about this cream, but I'm still waiting to see the results.

The consistency of this product is very interesting.  It is very viscous - kind of like a combination of cream and petroleum jelly. It is difficult to get it to fully absorb into the skin - I had better luck when my face was just a little bit damp.  It's kind of a light green color - and the smell is pleasant - a little bit of "essence of plant".

I mostly use it at night as it doesn't contain any sunscreen - which I wear every day.

When I use the cream - I do notice that my skin plumps up a bit and that some finer lines are less noticeable - but I haven't seen any dramatic differences.  I've been using it for a few weeks now and am still looking for a change I really notice.  At this price point - I think I expected more "wow" factor - but it is only cream, however, and not plastic surgery.

Still - I like the product and will continue using it - though I can't say that a next purchase is a sure thing.

This LiftLab Moisturizer Cream is quite expensive for most people. If price is an issue for you, you might try buying their travel set first which sells for $60 and has a number of their products included. So far she has not seen tremendous results as far as wrinkles, but the cream is very moisturizing and she can tell a difference in that area.

reviewText:
A while ago I received the sample pack that included small bottles of the Agave Healing Oil shampoo, conditioner and oil treatment.  I really loved the conditioner and bought it again, but separately, not the set.

The first time I used this, someone commented on how wonderful my hair looked and asked if I had just had a trim or done something else new.  Another person present said she was thinking the same thing.  So I had to buy more.

Its not cheap, and the 8-ounce bottle seems very skimpy.  Most conditioners I purchase come in a 13 to 18 ounce bottle for the smaller size, and about 35 ounces in the larger size.  So theres not a lot in an 8-ounce bottle.  So I don't use this all the time, usually about every second or third time I wash my hair.

FYI, for reference, I have extremely fine ash-blonde hair, hip length, straight.  This conditioner makes my hair look very sleek.  I do not usually use a shampoo, just lots of water and a conditioner.  I do not use the oil treatment (leave in) as it left too much scent on my hair, and I cannot stand any scents.

I just purchased another bottle of the conditioner in the largest size.
excellent
This smells great! I love how light and not overpowering it is. Love it!

Surprisingly, I love this ffloral combination. It's a very pretty girly light scent. I received lots of compliments when wearing this.
I think that some don't realize just because you don't smell  your perfume after a while, doesn't mean that others can't. At times i will have forgotten what I was wearing when someone will ask or say oh you smell good. I had one man compliment me at least 3 times while I was talking to him!
I was really surprised to get in my car the next day and smell just a  hint of it. So keep that in mind. I did get more compliments from the Juicy Couture Gold, but I love them both.

Floral and fruity

This fragrance has summery floral and bright fruity notes complemented by lingering hints of vanilla and sandalwood.  It is assertive, but not aggressive or overwhelming.

It would be perfect for summer evenings in Florida, but as the decorations on the bottle might suggest, it is a distinctively youthful and sweet scent, much more suggestive of Miami Beach than West Palm Beach.

reviewText: This perfume is a pretty floral scent that is light and fresh. I think it smells great, and so do my teenage daughters. My older teen has been careful to tell me what a "young" fragrance it is, and I'm old enough to understand that she'd love for my bottle to migrate to her room. This won't be happening, though. The bottle will stay in my room where I can enjoy the lovely bottle and both girls will have equal access (until one kidnaps it and I have to perform a rescue mission). The only downside is that the fragrance isn't the longest lasting I've used -- it was gone after about five hours.  Plenty of time for a date, but if you're looking for something to last all day, understand you will need to reapply this scent or perhaps apply it in layers (lotion and perfume, for example).

This is a sweet gourmand, white floral.  It opens with a dose of sweet red berries, honeysuckle & caramel.  It's not sickly sweet but definitely sweet.  Background notes of jasmine, gardenia & orange brighten it & keep it from being just a fruity, sweet-bomb of goo.  The bottom notes of hyacinth & sandalwood give it some sophistication.  It's playful & sweet without being cloying.  If you like white flowers & sweet gourmand notes, you may like this fragrance.

The sillage is almost arm length.  But don't overspray - this has a tendency to be too much if you pile it on & it's not really going to last any longer.  You are better off just reapplying another spritz or two when it fades.  I believe it was designed to be worn as a close-up/intimate fragrance.

The lasting power is average - this disappears within 3 hours on my skin.  It is an EDT so that is not unexpected.
summary: Sweet White Floral With Gourmand Notes

reviewText:
We were a little surprised to find such a conservatively understated floral scent in such a jazzed up container. Juicy Couture sounds youthfully edgy, and the scent is rather mildly floral.  It's a decent scent, but I found it almost generic.  Especially when juxtaposed to such a glitzy bottle.  It almost seems like an entry level perfume for tweens.

But I don't want to knock it, just show my surprise for it's seemingly understated fragrance.  It is a decent floral perfume.

Beautiful, soft, sexy and playful - love it!  (reviewed by my wife, I don't use perfume much ;-)
