For me, it will be fingertips as I am less likely to misplace those.  For my skin tone, it is an all-day color that is very neutral.
summary: Cream blush is back again - better than ever

reviewText: I like this much more than I thought I would.  Initially, the scent is very sweet, but that diminishes and becomes more complex after a minute or two.  A little goes a long way, and it does last through the day.  Bottle is done oddly (top is loose and I wonder if it will stay on), but is eye-catching.

Hollywood Royal has that mystical combination of sweet and woodsy that makes my heart skip a beat when a woman wearing it walks by.  The lingering scent is not at all pungent or offensive, despite having some floral notes.  The "flowers" are the more modern sort, like white lillies smelled through a window rather than a potpurri satchel.

Why four stars?  The bottle looks like it is straight out of a kid's playset, with a plastic star cover perfect for Barbie's dream house.  I like the fun concept, but the execution might detract from using it as a gift.  Still, the scent is so good that I don't think it matters much.

Juicy Couture Hollywood is a nice, fresh fragrance, not too heavy and a little flirty. I think it would appeal to younger people. The bottle itself held promise but totally under delivered. The painted plastic decoration arrived cracked and with very rough edges. It does not look nice in person, more of a child's fake perfume bottle for dress up. The bottle itself is glass and heavy, they should have just gone with an elaborate top and left the rest plain. The perfume is worth it, the bottle ruins it. If you can find the same scent in regular packaging, I'd suggest that over this.

Nice packaging on the box. Pull the bottle out and it looks elegant, but the stars that wrap around the bottle is like a collar and are plastic and they move, so it comes off a little cheap. The smell at first, you may want to shake it, but it has a strong alcohol odor. But spray on the skin and it has a different tone. Let it sit for a little and it picks up a sweet smell that is pleasing. Juicy Couture fans will want to snatch this up. But the unassuming consumer may feel this is average or better than average smell.
summary: A sweet scent in a somewhat cheap package.

reviewText:
I feel like Goldilocks with the samples of Juicy Couture I've been given to try--one is too faint; one is too strong... This one has a very powerful, almost masculine, aftershave presence when first applied.  It does dry down to a lovely floral/herb cloud that lasts a very long time, but there's definitely a learning curve to how much to apply.  Less is certainly more!

When you get it right, Hollywood Royal is a wonderful fragrance--the kind you'll get compliments on!
Love this palette!! First product I used from LORAC and since then I have been hooked.
summary: The Cause of My LORAC Addiction

reviewText:
I haven't used powder in years.  I have terribly dry, sometimes reddish irritated skin and a dry powder seems like the exact opposite of what i need to put on my face.

But, I like to give new things a try and the spf 29 really lured me in.

My first impression was that the powder would be too dark for my pale freckle prone skin.  The dark powder that was ground was a match for the suntan colored knee highs my sweet grandma Florence used to wear, but I was hopeful that the ivory powder mixed with it would magically blend in with my skin.

It went one better, the color not only blended it seemed to even out some of the pinky freckly bits of my face.

My skin is sensitive, so the first time I used it was right before a shower, I wanted to make sure it didn't have fragrance in it, it doesn't and that it wouldn't make me itchy, it didn't.

The next time was for a real day on the go, I wore it to the bowling alley for a day with the kiddos, my friend and I sipped sodas while our kids bowled and ate fries and chicken strips.  The bowling alley we go to is old, their only form of air conditioning is ceiling fans and so the uncomfortably warm, fried food scented air became positively sweltering as the afternoon moved on.  For the first part of the day the powder was light and comfortable, but once I started to sweat it felt a bit itchy.

So  don't think I'll wear this to hot places.  But since I live in the Pacific Northwest, this means this should be good for most of the year.

As others have noted, the powder comes with a micro foliation tool, in other words a makeup brush.

The product says it minimizes aging, I didn't notice that effect, just light skin evening coverage.  All in all a nice product at a not so nice price.
summary: Lovely addition to my makeup kit

reviewText: This mineral foundation has an 29 spf. I feel like it does last all day, but it is definitely light coverage. I like it better paired with a tinted BB cream or another type of liquid foundation. It claims to be an anti-wrinkle treatment duo and on the box claims 83% saw a reduced appearance of lines & wrinkles. I wish I was part of that 83% but in my opinion I saw no change in fine lines. It also says 77% saw a reduction in the appearance of under eye puffiness. Again, I didn't notice any difference. The mineral wear compact has no mirror, which I really would've liked, but anyway when you grind it and mix the 2 powders, be careful to really tap the brush over the compact before applying.  If you don't it falls on your shirt and can be quite messy. While I do think the grinding effect is pretty cool, I don't like that you have no idea when you are running low because you can't tell how deep the foundation is in the compact. All in all I do like it as a mineral wear powdered foundation it did lack results for any anti wrinkle claims so in my opinion I have tried others and do not feel this warrants the hefty price. I do have to say I love the brush and how it works to apply the foundation evenly. It also never loss any of the brush hairs. However, I don't really see how this is a micro-exfoliation tool. It seems so soft that it really wouldn't be effective to exfoliate.

I don't normally use foundation as I feel it's too heavy and appears obvious. This product is so light as to be pretty much invisible. It has a matte finish and eliminates shine, while minimizing  skin flaws. It is very natural looking - I don't think anyone can tell you are wearing it - but it makes a great foundation for make-up. I also like the fact that it isn't just loose powder, which can get messy and spill. There is a a sort of grater top to it, and in order to use it, one has to turn the top to grind a small portion for immediate use. The brush that came with it is perfect for the purpose and feels delightful on the skin. My skin also felt very soft after using it.
summary: Never used foundation before - I will now

reviewText:
This seems like a nice product. I rarely use makeup because my skin is very sensitive so I cannot compare this to similar products. The foundation did not cause an allergic reaction, so that much is a plus.

There is a facial masque in the kit. I used it and it made my skin feel tight and very slightly irritated. I did not notice a difference in my appearance.

I don't really care for the compact. I have trouble turning the grinding mechanism and it seems like a nuisance to have to do that. But the product itself seems to be very good. The included brush is nice. I have no idea what makes the kit expensive, but as I said, I am not a regular user of makeup and I am not impressed by brand names.

My first time trying out Scott-Vincent Borba brand, which is featured on HSN, where you can see clips featuring the makeup artist behind the brand.  The packaging is beautiful, with much care and attention to details, explaining how to use.

I find the brush very soft and designed well for application of the powder.  The compact contains an inner piece you twist to grind just the amount of powder you need for your application.  I found the first time using that I had a bit more of the treatment than the makeup and my initial thoughts after applying was that I had a much lighter tone than my own.  Within a few minutes the powder matched up to my complexion and the look was smooth, bright and I felt like it was very natural.  I only wish there was a shade between the light and medium, as I found the light a little too light for me, especially as summer approaches.  I am a big fan of liquid foundation but would use this product when I feel like changing it up, especially in the warmer weather when a liquid base feels too heavy.

I found the powder did not irritate my skin, which can be slightly sensitive and can get a bit flushed -- no redness after using or breakouts.  Application with the included brush is easy and I can see this brush being excellent for bronzer as well.  The benefit of a dosage of skincare to your foundation with a high SPF (29) is a pleasant combo and I recommend for anyone looking for sun protection in a natural foundation.

Update: I've been playing around with this product and find it gives a beautiful finish over my usual liquid foundation.  It beautifully tones down the shine from liquid base, without being too matte or chalky.  It photographs well and I find I just need a light touch, so this compact should last quite some time used this way.
summary: Easy application, soft brush, natural looking powder plus treatment

reviewText:
I'm a fan of some mineral powder products, others not so much. Some seem to get into the lines of your face and just sit there, emphasizing age. Others (mainly eye shadows and blushes) do a pretty good job of lightly sitting on the skin, adding color without emphasizing the lines. Scott-Vincent's ended up being one of the later. Trying it as foundation was no good for me. The white powder added when you turn the dial (boy that took me a while to figure out) makes it too light for my complexion and trying to scoop up the darker powder without the white powder was just too much of a hassle. So, I mixed up the two colors and tried it as a finishing powder. This seemed to work fairly well. The powder went on smoothly, but at times the white powder left my face splotchy with white puffs, even when I mixed it well in the compact.  It think they should redo the powder colors so one is just a light cream color and not white.

Overall the powder performed well, lasting as long as my usual $10 mineral finishing powder, so no complaints there. I only put it on once in the morning. I have dry skin, so my face doesn't require reapplying of powder since there is no shine and it doesn't wear away. I didn't notice my skin looking anymore youthful and unlined than usual, but I didn't use it as a foundation, so that might of made a difference. I didn't use the mask, either there wasn't one in my package or I missed it and threw it away. I wouldn't have used it anyway. It just seems plain silly and reminds me of a creepy skin mask from Silence of the Lambs. The brush is really nice and soft, two thumbs up for the brush. It is rather small and narrow, giving you more control I suppose. Overall this was a nice foundation/finishing powder, but the price, ouch. I'm on a teacher's salary. This was fun to try, but paying almost $80 for foundation just isn't going to happen in my household. Hello L'Oreal and Mary Kay foundations, good to see again.

As expected! I rarely buy cosmetics like this for myself so I was happy to try.  I won't say my under-eye bags disappeared, but they were much less noticeable. People kept saying, "You look really good today!"

Easy to apply, lasted all day and was fine with my skin (which is not especially sensitive).  I work at home but I'll be using it when I go out to meetings and social events. Good stuff.
Works as expected. Goes on smooth. Stays all day. Would have given 5 stars if price was a bit lower.
summary: Works well, but price is high

reviewText:
This was an easy to apply concealer, and a little goes a fairly long way - don't overdo. I've been testing it for about a week, with or without foundation and/or powder. It does cover a fair amount of my facial redness and age spots, but not so heavy I feel weighted down and greasy. My skin gets a bit dry when any type of makeup is applied, and I had better results if I applied this immediately after applying moisturizer instead of waiting a couple of minutes for that to set in. It doesn't cover everything, but every little bit helps with me.

It isn't a miracle worker by any means, but it does help.

OK, so a little of this concealer goes a long way. I barely dip one corner of the brush and am able to lighly conceal the rosacea covering my nose. This is a light concealer, so is not going to achieve100% coverage on scars or deep pigment discolorations. The concealer go on lightly and effortlessly. The brush is a perfect shape and allows the user to get in the tight spaces between the eyes and beside the nose. The concealer has a decent longevity, If you apply a good layer of powder over the concealer. The concealer will last through the day, but it needs the powder to set it. The concealer does a good job not clogging up the lines created by those wrinkles. I had no issue in caking around my crows feet. Overall, a great product that I would recommend.

I don't understand the reviews saying this is messy or gets all over everything. The one I received "Anti-Fatigue Invisible..." is a cream, not a powder. It wasn't chalky and I didn't need a brush (and one wouldn't have worked). It's fine for a sponge applicator or with a fingertip (if you don't have long nails, the jar's only about 1 1/2" in diameter. It smooths on easily, blended in with my light skin). It covered blemishes well, dark circles not as well, but wouldn't be too bad if they weren't very dark. It had a nice finish to it and stayed on throughout the day. I didn't see much difference in covering fine lines. The light one is definitely for fair skin but didn't give "raccoon eyes"--it blended nicely.. My only question is if the results justified the cost. If you don't need too much help, it might. It was far better in consistency and coverage than what I use now, but for me, it didn't work miracles with the dark circles, and that would have been what justified the cost for me. If you don't have -too- heavy dark circles, though, and even out blemishes/skin tone, I think it would be pretty good and worth a try if you can afford it.

Given that I am a token male in my family (well, I have a son, but he has a family of his own), I gave this concealer to the fairer (and significantly cuter) family members to test.  The verdict was that this concealer had a great color and conceals minor blemishes well.  I heard that both ladies that tried it liked the way it went on to their faces, and how other makeup could be used on top of the concealer.

While this concealer is a bit expensive, it is relatively reasonably priced as compared to many concealers you buy in makeup sections of high end department stores, and you get a relatively large amount of concealer.  I admit that "large amount" for me is like a gallon.  Apparently, makeup manufacturers believe in the theory that less is...well, less.  Or about the amount that you can use before the concealer dries out beyond the ability to use it.

Okay, so the color is fine, it applies well, it conceals minor blemishes with a smooth finish, and you get a goodly quantity.  It seems like this concealer is a good value and works for most people!

Enjoy!
summary: Covers Minor Blemishes Well, Looks Good, and You Get a Lot

reviewText: I don't use concealer very often but now when I do it will be this one.  It goes on smoothly and blends perfectly.  I tried using it both with my finger and a brush and I think I got a much better result using a stiff brush.  The mouth of the pot is not very big so it's easier to get the product out of it using a brush.  This is definitely my go to concealer.
summary: goes on smooth and blends perfectly.

reviewText: A very light scent which I enjoy, not overpowering at all.  It's so light, in fact, that it doesn't last very long at all which may be a good thing depending on your view of fragrance and how strongly you want it to present itself.  I do not like the bottle cap design, the second time I removed the top, the chrome spray cover came off and leaked everywhere.  Other than that I would recommend this for guys who want a light, fresh scent that won't clear a room.
Not too heavy a scent, this is more light and refreshing than other heavy woodsy scents.  Hard to describe this one, but I enjoy the fact that Burberry Brit Splash is not overbearing.

I absolutely LOVE Burberry Brit Splash, Eau de Toilette! It is a perfect blend of sporty and mature-ish scent and is not overpowering. You don't have to use much at all, and yet, the fragrance will last all day, even after a night of dancing and stuff. The best is my wife loves it (her new favorite, she said)....It is clean, fresh, and still subtle, and as my wife says, "sexy." Fragrances are so subjective, and often depend on skin type, etc. My skin is usually dry and not oily. I also find that I always need to let a cologne (or EdT) kind of settle in before I pass judgement because things change for me after just a few minutes.

This is a big bottle, and unlike some there Burberry products, this spray is easy to modulate so you don't get a huge spray. The only negative I can think of is that the cap is very tight a little difficult to remove, and because the bottle is so smooth, it sometimes feels like I might drop the bottle or fling something as I am pulling it off. Still, it looks nice. You see the Burberry design, but doesn't look stuffy.
summary: Sporty, fresh fragrance that is not overpowering

reviewText:
I really like this Burberry Brit Splash.

It is not too "metro" like a lot of men's scents that I have tried lately. It has a nice mild woodsy undertone that assures you it's for a man, yet still has a bit of floral/herbal sweetness in there. I find it a nice balance with a classic appeal.

It is very subtle. Maybe a little bit too subtle? This is subjective and some may like this. It seems to fade quickly as the day goes on and may need to be reapplied. For me in fact, I can hardly sense it after just a few hours, unless I use it very generously.

"Brit Splash is a bright aquatic fragrance, refreshing and invigorating. The modern scent features crisp rosemary, a watery accord and moss."

Elegant bottle with the Burberry plaid design styles on the glass.

NOTE: I don't know why my pics are repeated multiple time. I deleted a few times but it doesn't help. It must be a glitch.

Interesting unisex perfume. I liked the sandal wood smell and so does my wife. There are several undertones of fragrance like floral and cedar-like or some woody smell.

This is a scent that is distinctively different and can be a conversation starter in an informal setting.

Highly recommended by me and my wife. :)
summary: Distinctively unique scent that can be a great conversation starter

reviewText: This is a beautiful floral fragrance that doesn't have much, if any sweetness to it, making it great for warm weather wear without fear of it becoming cloying. The fragrance has an excellent longevity, easily lasting from dawn to dusk without fading into nothing. The initial application can feel a little strong, but it dries down nicely within 10 to 15 minutes. Even after washing clothing, hints of the fragrance can still be detected in areas where it touched the skin during wear.

Initially very potent and definitely unisex scent.  I found it to be one of those scents that is ok to wear very lightly and not to impress the opposite sex.  When I first tested it, I sprayed it on my sons shirt, it lasted most of the day but the initial spray was overpowering which lasted for about 30 minutes.  After that, either my nose was desensitized or it started to tone down a little.  Since my nose is not trained to pick out the subtle hints, I honestly won't try to say if it was floral or if it was fruity etc.  All I will say is that once it tones down, it is a pleasant smell.  Sorry but not my first pick for a scent and I would likely not purchase it in the future.
summary: After the initial spray tones down, it is pleasant but not for attracting a potential significant other

reviewText:
This was an interesting scent to try, as it can be smelled several times and different notes keep coming to the fore.

The initial spritz does smell strongly of alcohol.  Once that dissipate, that's when the spicy, very woodsy notes start to show up.  This is touted as being a unisex fragrance, but I would say that at this stage, the scent is fairly intensely masculine.  After some time has passed - usually a matter of a couple of hours or so - that woodsy smell starts to fade, and what remains is a slightly less intense floral aroma that retains a hint of the spiciness.  At this point, the scent becomes more feminine in nature.

The (changing) scent isn't bad, per se, at any time, but it is on the strong side; so much so that it tends to give me headaches, as I am someone who is generally sensitive to really strong fragrances.  This one turned out to be more intense than I expected.

Again (aside from the headaches), the fragrance isn't what I'd call bad, but I also can't say that this is one for which I'll be reaching with any kind of regularity.  Moreover, while it could appeal at different times to those looking for a masculine or feminine scent, I would caution users that the scent's change is pretty noticeable, so while those on the hunt for more manly scents might enjoy it initially, they might not be so pleased as the day wears on.  Similarly, those looking for a sophisticated, womanly scent (though not one that could ever be called girly or delicate) might not be overly happy with it when it's first used, but after waiting for some time, they could like the end product.

All in all, it's a difficult product to review, because it's something that could easily wind up appealing to different people at different times, given how it changes the longer it's worn.  It's strong, but not unpleasant, and I can definitely say that I've never smelled or encountered a fragrance quite like this before.  I can't say that I think it's worth the price for which it's being sold, but for all those who are in the market for a scent that's really different, you might like this.

Raw Spirit Eau de Parfum, Desert Blush comes in a nice bottle which is enclosed in a rose color sleeve enclosed in a white color cardboard box and the bottle sits inside in a crafted cutout exclusively for the protection of the bottle. The bottle is glass and the spray mechanisms are plastic. This does look like a product that can be gifted as it has nice presentation to it. So how does it smell? This one starts out with a strong scent that you might have experienced once you enter the ladies Macy's perfume department which is primarily alcohol based. After couple of minutes when the alcohol has dried out the smell starts to change and become primarily floral scent a mixture of sandalwood sweet flowers and feels fresh. IMHO the scent is overwhelming at first but slowly fades away to more fresh flowery smell. I have used Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men and while this is an unisex product which is suitable for both men and women this one smells better than ETERNITY for men. This one needs to be applied in very small quantity and it does linger for more than 24 hrs after initial application and does smell nicer than ETERNITY when compared. The only quibble I have is the spray nozzle does seem little too basic black plastic when compared with rest of the product. This is a luxury scent product and has a very Rich sophisticated, floral scent! does smell nice. Four stars!

Has a strong scent of alcohol when first sprayed, which within moments mellows to a woodsy scent. The smell is more complex than cedar.  It bears no resemblance to the smell of cedar-scented closet hangers.  My husband, who is allergic to cedar, did not sneeze when smelling this perfume.  Soon after that,  the floral undertones shine through, comingling with the woodsy smell.  I really like this scent, it is very unique and versatile, being both fresh and slightly musky and somewhat flowery but not overly sweet.  It's suitable for a day at the office, or a day spent outdoors, or even an evening out.  A lot of perfumes smell like they are made for either a teen girl or a grandmother, but this is a sophisticated yet sexy and down-to-earth blend.  Really a nice combination.  For reference, my other favorite perfume is  Katy Perry's Killer Queen. This perfume is described as being unisex, and I can see that.  It is not overly masculine or feminine.  One downside is that the scent does not last very long.

There is some controversy regarding the harvesting of sandalwood, including the wild harvested Australian sandalwood contained in this product.  If you are particularly interested in environmental issues, a bit of research is suggested.  The company, Nomad Two Worlds, was founded by famed photographer Russell James, with the goal of helping indigenous people through a self-supported company rather than a charity.  The company puts an emphasis on being socially and environmentally responsible and donates 10% of their profits to their charitable donation arm, also called Nomad Two Worlds, as well as an undisclosed amount of their proceeds to Australian indigenous agricultural projects, and are also aligned with the Clinton Global Initiative.  (This information about the company's background came from a 2013 Forbes article on Russell James, so may not be up to date.  The company's website contains no financials, including no references to what percentage of their profits are donated.)

This product is made in the USA. It is nicely packaged in a heavy off-white cardboard box with cutout insert for the bottle and the emblem in gold on the box cover.  The box has a rose-colored sleeve around it that is made of heavy paper.  The sleeve also has gold writing and emblem that looks like the label on the bottle.  The label on the bottle itself is made of thick, high-quality, glossy paper.  The lid and spray mechanism are black plastic.

When I spray this perfume on it has a very spicy scent.  You can really smell the cedar, sandalwood, and the musk base.  Especially the cedar.  It reminds me of camping in the deep, damp woods or the smell of freshly cut cedar planks.  Very out-doorsy.  In the first 30 minutes of spraying this perfume I could detect no hint of a floral tones, but after a while the spiciness starts to mellow and you get a hint of flowers.  After about 2 hours the spicy scent fades into the background and the floral tones become prominent.  And the floral tones are unique and interesting.  Like no flower I have ever smelled before.

So if you like spicy scents with just a hint of floral this is a unique and interesting option; but if you like a purely floral fragrance, this might not be the perfect choice.
summary: Starts out very spicy with lots of cedar scent, but mellows to a unique floral fragrance

reviewText:
I struggle to find scents I like. This one had me with one sniff.

It is a little woodsy with hints of lemon, but I was surprised that it was so delicate considering it was a unisex scent. I can actually see either my husband or I wearing it and both being able to pull it off, which is not common. It is not a delicate floral, if that is what you are looking for. Since I tend to like heavier, spicier scents, I was really pleased with this- it is woodsy, but not too strong. I don't usually wear perfume either, so a more subtle scent was appreciated. I got a lot of compliments, and I will definitely buy this again once I run out!

I have issues with some perfumes so am always on the lookout for one that I can wear.  I have learned that I have the most trouble with heavy floral perfumes so like to try unisex fragrances.

I was hoping that the bergamot would give this a more citrus-y smell but that note is fleeting at best.  I never really noticed any citrus at all.  I also thought the amberwood and musk would be more dominant but the scent that lasts the longest for me is the grassy scent of the vetiver.  If I had to describe this scent, it would be that it smells green and maybe a little herbal or grassy (but not like freshly mowed grass -- more herbal grass).

Because everyone's personal chemistry affects how scent will react and because words don't always convey smell very well, I would not buy this without finding someplace to get a trial size or to try it in person.

The bottle is classic and elegant looking and I thought the scent lasted a fair amount of time.  For me, I wish the citrus notes were more dominant.  It was OK but herbal/grassy isn't quite what I was looking for in a scent.  It is definitely not for someone looking for a girly flowery scent.  This might work well for guys who like to wear scent as well as women who want something different than the usual florals or citrus.
summary: Longest notes are green and grassy

reviewText: I was excited to order this, but my nickname for this "Citadelle" cologne is now "Citronella."  Something seemed not-quite-right when I put it on, and I put my finger on it after I lived with it for a few minutes--it is extraordinarily reminiscent of bug repellent.  It has that bright, citrus-y, and somewhat yucky conglomeration of scent that does not make for a great scent. I went into this with an open mind; figuring if I didn't like it for myself I could enjoy it on my husband, but honestly I don't think it works for men or women; it's just not an attractive scent.  I do love a variety of colognes and perfumes, and I have a collection of about 40 different designer brands, but this one does not make the cut.

I love this earthy, grounding and deeply sensual perfume.  I've never had the pleasure to smell Vetiver, but LOVE Bergamot and Cedarwood, so I thought I would at least like the scent.  I was so happy when on first (tiny) spray, I instantly loved it.
I smell the musk quite a bit and yet to really smell the pear and nutmeg, but I'm not really a perfume connoisseur, so this would be typical for me.
I spray just a tiny bit on my stomach and it lasts all day for me. I definitely enjoy the scent come thru when I'm least expecting it.  It makes me smile and think of strength and resistance.  I can't explain it better than that.  I feel strong and able just a bit more when the scent hits my nose.
 I don't do well with very strong scents so this works best for me if I use just a tiny spray under my clothes as it is quite strong.  I highly recommend only using a small spray whether or not you can handle scents because it is highly concentrated and will make anyone's eyes water if wearing to much.
Overall, I think this is a quality product, magnificent scent and the fact that a portion of the proceeds help Haitian Agricultural projects make this a must purchase item for yourself and for your friends and lover.  Definitely a scent for either man or woman.
summary: deeply sensual scent for man or woman

reviewText: I was very excited to get this parfum.  It smells very nice.  It's powerful and only takes a tiny bit to be enough.  It is billed as unisex and I can totally see how it would be very attractive on a man.  In fact perhaps more so than on a woman.  I will be wearing it often to see how people react.

This Citadelle by Raw Spirit is a wonderful scent unlike anything else I have tried in the past.  My first impression was that it was a light, powdery scent that was not in any way fruity or flowery (which is a good thing).  Beyond the initial hint of baby powder, there is a rich earthiness that I really enjoy.  It's hard to put the scent into words, but truly powerful smells often trigger sense memories and that is exactly what I experienced here.  It instantly and powerfully took me back to an Alaskan cruise I took nearly a decade ago, specifically the cool, woodsy scent I recall from the deck as we navigated a narrow channel surrounded by trees and water.  It may seem strange to recall a specific memory like that, but that is what instantly came to mind when I tried this out.  What a wonderful scent to rekindle that very pleasant memory from my past.  If you enjoy smelling things like a forest in the afternoon, fresh rainfall, and cool mist, this would be a scent you would likely enjoy.

Citadelle comes double boxed, and the tall thin bottle is beautifully simple and fragile.  I will treasure this one-fluid-ounce bottle and use it on special occasions.  It is listed as unisex, and I suppose that is true.  The initial light powdery scent, however, may strike some as effeminate though the more powerful and lingering woodsy/smoky scent lingers and it does have some masculinity to it.  Overall, I am thrilled with this and would easily recommend for those willing to make a special purchase for quality and - hopefully - some pleasant scent memories.
summary: Woodsy and exquisite, for me a powerful scent memory trigger

reviewText:
What a pleasant surprise...having had no idea whether this scent would work for me. I took a chance, and am so glad I did. This is the sort of scent I adore....with green & woodsy notes, rather than a face full of florals! I feel as if I'm in a forest after a light rain. Heaven!

The top note is certainly a bit fruity, sweet, and powdery. I also get grassy undertones. There's a distinct "greenness" that opens up this fragrance. It then settles into a smoky, spicy scent where the nutmeg is detectable as the sweetness fades. Citadelle then settles into it's primary basenote, a heady VETIVER dry down. That's where this fragrance really shines. The vetiver base lasts and lasts. Silage (longevity) for me is about 4 hours, which is very good for me....I find that most perfume doesn't last a long time on me unless it's cloying. But if you're looking for a scent that lasts all day, this isn't it. It's a LIGHT fragrance, very wearable for work, not heavy and does not "project".

One of my all time favorite perfumes is Sycomore by Chanel. It's very expensive, a scent I've saved only for special occasions. Citadelle reminds me of a lighter version of Sycomore, in many ways more wearable because it has less of a dark/heavy feeling about it. This is a scent that can be worn year round, rather than just saving it for Fall/Winter months. If you love Vetiver & tree/green smelling perfumes, you'll enjoy Citadelle. It's certainly more affordable than Chanel, or Encre Noir by Lalique and the lightness of it will win over those who feel that those scents are a bit too heavy and overbearing.

Unisex? Yes! My husband likes this scent very much. This fragrance is in no way too girly. No floral notes anywhere! But he'll have to get his own bottle....this one is MINE and I'm not giving it up. My new favorite is now Citadelle by Raw Spirit and I plan on wearing it often. Highly recommended for Vetiver lovers, you won't be disappointed. 5 stars.

I love the box, it has a sleeve that is sparkly greyish silver with gold writing and a gold symbol on it, then in a heavy white cardboard box with just the gold symbol  on it. The bottle itself is basic, exactly as shown. It is very strong, which normally I do like a fragrance to be strong and long lasting so it has that going for it. My mom tried it and was wearing my jacket and I could still smell it two days later.  However, I had several people ask me if it was men's cologne. I don't like it for me, personally I also think it smells like men's cologne. It seems like a strong woodsy scent.

First, I can definitely see why they list this perfume as a unisex version. Although I feel it leans masculine, it would be an appropriate scent and gift for both men and women. It comes nicely boxed in a 7" box that shimmers, a gold chandelier-like ink blot shape embossed in gold above the block text, "RAW SPIRIT", and the scent name "bijou - vert." It's attractively boxed.

The bottle inside is a simple one, about 4" tall and very square with a black cap and same ink blot style label. It is 1 fluid ounce filled with a complex fragrance. It is a musky, green, earthy scent. It's definitely bright! Not much floral there, no fruit except for a hint of grapefruit in those layers. It's spicy and woodsy. That said, I read another reviewer say it reminds them of a 70s Avon fragrance. OUCH! That's a low blow to Raw Spirit...if only there weren't some truth to it!

Yes, I have to agree, there is something a bit Avon grandma about this fragrance. There is even an aspect of it that reminds me of my Tinkerbell perfume from when I was a child in the 80s & 90s! So I already wasn't too big of a fan before I read that, although I definitely appreciate the craftsmanship of this fragrance. I can also see why it would REALLY appeal to a lot of people. I'm not a scent snob, just because I don't like it doesn't mean YOU won't. It's a pleasant enough scent, the longevity is decent, and complex enough to make it interesting. But it's not for me. Due to it's PRICE (!) too, I would definitely recommend testing this one out in person before purchasing.

If it helps the reader, my typical favorite scents in perfumes are: jasmine, vanilla, tobacco, musks, nutty scents, anise, and cedarwood.
summary: Try it before you buy it, not for everyone

reviewText: When I opened the package and removed the lid to sniff this parfum it didn't smell too bad. As soon as I sprayed it on  my wrist I wished I hadn't. It reminds me of a bad Avon fragrance from the 70s. I tried to wash it off but it's a long lasting parfum and won't wash off. I find it repulsive. Unless you can get to a store that carries this and sample it I wouldn't recommend buying it.

Smells quite masculine. Can't really smell much of floral scents, like mandarin, lotus flower or grapefruit. Unlike this Raw Spirit fragrance, with Jo Malone, those scents can be easily picked up. This Raw Spirit fragrance also smells very strong. A tiny spray in the air and the entire room is permeated. I don't use it on myself because it's not as unisex as some that I've used in the past. So, I use it as a room spray. It makes the room smell fresh and pleasant.

I love the scent of this perfume!  My wife isn't quite as wild about it as I am, but she will wear it to please her loving' hubby...I hope.  Her preference is for perfumes such as Red or sometimes Chanel.  It is going to get tried tonight for a dinner date for the two of us!

The packaging is attractive as is the bottle of perfume itself.

This scent starts out sharp and green -- vetiver is a major component -- but then warms to a spicy, peppery scent with undertones of exotic woods.  It's a pretty scent, but not a flowery one, both fresh and sophisticated.

The bottle is attractive and it comes in a really beautiful presentation box, so it will make a nice gift.

It's also a plus for me that part of the profit is devoted to supporting sustainable agriculture in Haiti, so you can feel positive about your choice whether it's a romantic present or an indulgence for yourself.

If this Raw Spirit fragrance bears any resemblance to the island of Haiti (as suggested in the product description) I should visit soon  I love it. And as has been stated famously about one particular product Raw Spirit may not be easy to describe but youll surely love it when you smell it.

About an hour before the start of the Super Bowl last evening I showered and stepped out for a quick trip to the supermarket (less than two blocks away) to pick up some of the usual stuff that go with watching the game. It was quite filled with shoppers. I sprayed on Raw and hoped someone would notice. Sure enough a couple was tempted to start a conversation that became an exuberant description of my smell. The lady guessed its a French product; her man said German.

I ordered Raw Spirit for my lady but I am going to keep it for myself. Its unisex after all.
summary: Raw Spirit Perfume - yes, it's one a man can share

reviewText:
I love this.  So does my wife. Truly. 1.0 fl oz (30 ml) in an attractive heavy square glass bottle with a spray head.  Marketed as "unisex" and I easily agree.  Nicely presented in a 2 layer box with outer sleeve.  Now, the scent . . .

My very,very first impression was that it reminded me of the Asian after shaves my dad wore . . . Jade East, or Hai Karate (young people will not know those once popular names).  After settling in the scent mellowed and deepened.  Certainly a presence of citrus (contains grapefruit essence), but underlying fragrances of spices (contains black pepper) and woods (contains cedar wood and patchouli).  I put a little on my wrist, which I keep checking as I type this.  Just heavenly!  And the scent is not wearing off, implying use of high quality base oils.  This "Raw Spirit Bijou Vert (green jewel)" will join my short list of favorite perfume/colognes.

I already mentioned, "unisex".  Yes, that applies here.  I asked my wife to describe it - she replied, "Definitely not flowery, maybe some citrus".  I think I did well in my description above.  As a man, I'd be pleased to wear this on dressy occasions.  I may not get the chance, as my wife seems to have taken it over -- she just loves it.

A perfume/cologne is of course a matter of preference, but I would expect few disappointments here.

My skin feels clean and smooth after just once use. I tried it with both makeup and without. The makeup came off with just once use, and when I tried it on makeup-free skin, I could actually see the dirt that came up on the cotton ball.  Also it didn't irritate my very sensitive skin. Very very happy with this product and plan to order more.

I picked this product up for my teenage daughter to use. She has used it for a few weeks now and here are her thoughts:

I regularly use this product
One thing that I find a little surprising is that it is extremely watery, which means that you must use a little bit of the remover on a cotton pad in order to remove the makeup.
Does not leave my skin overly oily after use, although I always wash my face afterwards just to make sure it is all gone.
I usually prefer lotion-like makeup removers but this product works very well and comes in a huge quantity.
summary: Works well but must be applied using cotton pad due to its watery consistency

reviewText: It cleanses well with a cotton ball. The water has very faint pleasant smell that does not linger. It does not seem to irritate my skin after prolonged use. The bottle is huge and would last forever. You don't need to rinse it after use, but it leaves some residue on the skin. I really like to use it in the evening before going to bed.

I have sensitive skin - to the point where if I add lotion or wash with anything but water and a washrag then I break out with acne.  Micellar water works perfect for my skin - I don't break out when cleaning my face at night!  Regular would have been too harsh for me.

I pump a couple squirts into my hand and apply in circular motions to my face.  After cleaning my face, I rinse with a washrag!  Perfect!
summary: Micellar water works perfect for my skin - I don't break out when ...

reviewText:
My teen daughter and I use this and it's very good.  I don't wear a lot of makeup but teen girl does and she uses it as a second rinse.

I use it to leave my face with a nice clean feeling before bed and I love that it doesn't dry out my old mom skin.  It's very very gentle and doesn't aggravate acne nor my dry, super sensitive skin.  I have allergies and product sensitivities and I've not had any problems.

The best part is the size and the fact that it's a pump.  Teen girl tends to overdue it and go through products like crazy.  The pump has acted to help her get the right amount on her cotton pads and this size is lasting very well.

I love Laura Geller products - I had previously used a different spackle from her but I am really enjoying this oil control primer during times of the month when my face is a little greasier.  This provides a smooth foundation before putting on my balance and brighten also from Laura Geller.  This helps to make more pores look a little smaller and really helps control shine.  I like the feel of it on my face as well.
summary: I love Laura Geller products - I had previously used a ...

reviewText: I am so picky about my primers---my skin is extremely sensitive and it seems that a number of popular ingredients used in primers lead to breakouts for me.  This is such an awesome primer.  Feels great going on, helps extend the life of my makeup, and doesn't case any skin issues for me.  I even love to use this without foundation over top.  It creates a beautiful "blurred" finish.  I had a bad experience with some Laura Geller makeup years ago and was hesitant to try anything else but this is fabulous.
summary: Feels great, does not cause irritation or breakouts

reviewText: Love this body lotion/serum. My skin is looking softer and firmer and I really like the fragrance. Will continue to buy this.

I absolutely hate everything about this mask. The squeeze bottle that it comes in is much larger than the small amount of product that you actually receive. I was fighting to squeeze it out ON THE FIRST TRY after opening the sealed bottle. I finally squeezed a decent amount out and it smelled awful. Very chemically.

I spread it around my forehead and the burning started immediately.  I thought maybe it was just like a cooling menthol burn and it would die down, but it didn't. It burned my face to the point of being super uncomfortable and removing it within minutes of putting it on. My face is NOT sensitive. I have literally tried thousands of skin care and makeup products as I do a lot of reviews. This is only the second product to ever cause irritation with my skin. What is worse is that it burned for an hour after removing.

Maybe it has something I am allergic too? I've never found any allergies before and have none as far as I know. Even if this odd burning was unique to me, the product stinks and is poorly packaged. I am not willing to go through pain to see if it might help some acne. I threw it into the trash. I do not recommend this mask.
summary: This mask is in the trash where it belongs. Warning: may burn

reviewText: My wife doesn't have the drastic acne she first had when she arrived in the USA from Philippines, but she still uses various masks to help prevent when she feels them coming.  She liked this product and said she would buy more, but the price was too high for two thin applications.  Her battle has been long and hard and requires constant attention, keeping her face clean, mask weekly and using copaiba oil on anything trying to come up in spite of the masks.  I think the copaiba oil is worth it's weight in gold, but this formula must be also, judging from its price.
summary: good product, but expensive and small amount

reviewText: Acne mask to help clear up those trouble spots. It does work, its 2% salicylic acid. You apply the mask to trouble spots or whole face if needed and let sit for 5-10 min and then rinse. My skin did start to peel after a few uses so be very careful when going into the sun. I had to minus a star only because of the price point, you can get2%  salicylic acid in many products that also work for a fraction of the price. If cost isn't an issue for you then this product is a good choice.

I have been using this mask two times a week to combat adult acne and I feel like it's making a difference. I have very oily skin with random breakouts and some annoying cystic acne on my chin that never wants to go away. I'm seeing a reduction in breakouts. It's not completely gone but I'd say at least 75% cleared up and it's actually helping some with the chin cystic acne. It tingles a little bit when I put a thin layer on but I wouldn't call it painful. My skin does peel a little bit the day after use but that's easily fixed with some oil free facial moisturizer. Since my skin is so oily and I live in a very hot weather area, I am liking how it's drying my face some so I'm not so oily and shiny all the time. The tube is small but if you are careful to not glob it on, it can easily last over a month.
summary: Helps with adult acne and super oily face

reviewText:
This medicated acne mask is better as a spot treatment for me that applying to the full face. It has a whole list of ingredients and many of them seem to be plant based but it's still fairly granular and harsh on my skin and made it red and itchy in parts that are not oily. The menthol-like ingredient in it almost burned off my skin as it seemed too harsh. My eyes always get red and itchy with shampoos that have tea tree oil or peppermint for cooling the scalp, so I washed it off as soon as I realized it had some menthol type ingredient in it. However, it did help with an acne spot when I applied to the oily part near my nose that had a zit.

I cannot use this product as I am allergic to something in it, but I am giving it 3 stars as it seems to have a lot of natural ingredients and might work well for acne for some people. I did not like the granular nature of this product, it seemed more like a scrub than a mask, but that's probably because my skin is more sensitive to scrubs.
summary: Granular texture, not for sensitive skin. Better as a spot treatment.

reviewText: This seemed to be less than helpful. It didn't clear up the skin, but seemed to make it worse. That may differ from person to person, of course.
summary: Didn't work for me because it made skin break out more rather than less

reviewText: I still get some adult acne (when will it end?) and salicylic acid seems to really help me. I'm using a new skincare line so finding that glycolic acid works too. So far I've used this mask as a spot treatment and it has cleared up a few spots quickly. There is other ingredients listed that take out the redness too. The texture is kind of grainy. All I know is that I'll continue to order this product. It really works great! Recommended.

I don't have facial acne but get severe cystic outbreaks on my shoulders and upper back from bra straps. I have a deep boxcar scar and am trying to avoid any more. This seems to work well when applied overnight and showered off in the morning. I wear a white t-shirt and sleep on white linens to avoid ruining any sleepwear or bedding.

Id say this is not a casual topical but serious treatment for significant acne. I do t have a ton of sensation in the places I use this but it does burn a bit. When I began using this I felt a cyst erupting and afterwards it simply went away. Used with care it is one more tool to fight scarring acne.
summary: Works pretty well for body acne too.

reviewText: This stuff is great.  It's an all coverage powder foundation that contains SPF.  Would have been nice if it came with an applicator.  It does not.  Perhaps your're supposed to use your fingers, but I do not like dipping fingers into makeup and spreading germs.  I used a sponge applicator and a brush applicator that I already owned. I found that this stuff works best with a brush.  But that was just my preference.  The coverage it provides is very good.  I was able to use this only and skip the liquid foundation.  This is nice here in Florida where it is humid and hot and liquid foundations smear and cake off.

This product was nothing special for me and it certainly isn't the Anti-Wrinkle Treatment miracle!  I think the powder form seems to almost accentuate the wrinkles!  It also claims that it is foundation, well it isn't in my book!  Foundation for me covers blemishes or sun spots...not this stuff!  It is also difficult to apply as it comes with no brush.  I'm not a make-up girl...I've never had formal lessons on colors or make-up trends, but this is just an extra expense with no outcome to show for it.  Another negative is that it is so messy!  I used a brush to apply this and by the time I was done, it was all over the counter!

All in all, it is just another Anti-Fatigue, Anti-Wrinkle treatment that promises results, but fails to deliver.

I like this powder/foundation a lot. I find that it is a bit darker than I expected, but I guess maybe I used too much of the darker color. I have fairly light skin, so this may not be an exact match. It stays on well and I don't have to reapply throughout the day. It does not cause any irritation. I like the way the product is encased in the compact, but you twist the top to dispense only what you need. This seems like the amount in the compact will last for a while, and I would buy this if it weren't quite so expensive.
summary: Great powder/foundation, but a little dark for my light complexion...

reviewText: I was surprised this was not greasy at all and soaked in really well. Going to buy the full size!
Fun color!
Great color
Not what I was expecting, but a lovely shade of purple.

I have really thick black hair on my legs and have to shave daily. I used this after waiting several days in between shaves. It worked well. The hair took about an extra day to start showing.

I used Nair and the like before and found this to be more mild and less aggravating to my sensitive skin. Always test on a small patch first!
summary: I used Nair and the like before and found this to be more mild and ...

reviewText: This product is not for sensitive skin. I have fair sensitive legs that I get waxed because it's easier and lasts longer than shaving daily. When I used this bliss hair removal on my legs it caused a painful, itchy breakout but removed a majority of my leg hair. Similar or better than when I get my legs waxed. The smell was similar to other hair removal products, which is one of my pet peeves as I hate getting "whiffs" of the smell. However, I could overlook the smell if my legs didn't ache after application. I will continue to get my legs waxed - less painful (for me).

This product worked pretty well. It got most of the hair off where I was trying to remove it. Didn't leave me super soft, but it was nice enough. Didn't make me breakout or anything like that. I've only used it once, so far, but it's nice enough. I'm pretty impressed, since I was worried that it wouldn't work at all! I would use it again and if it keeps working will, I will be keeping it in stock in my bathroom.

I've been using this serum morning and evening for about a month now. I'm in my 30's with combination skin, some fine lines, acne prone skin, and some skin tone discoloration. I can't say this serum has really done anything to improve that situation. The serum is tinted a light pink color with some shimmer to deflect light. As such, when you put it on it does make your skin artificially appear nicer, but I'm not sure that I want that feature in a serum. The product description for this serum is very vague, only providing two sentences with broad claims that it will make your skin better in general. I like it when a product discusses the ingredients and what their individual benefits are. This serum does have a very, very extensive ingredient list, but one that I found confusing and not particularly "natural". I tend to gravitate more towards products with simple, mostly natural ingredients. In the end, this product is just "ok", and as such I'll keep looking. On a positive note, it didn't cause me to break out.

This serum has a lovely consistency that isn't too greasy or too watery, and when the pump is working (as mine is), you have complete control over how much product you dispense. This shimmering, pink serum makes my skin feel very soft and hydrated. It goes on slightly tacky, but the tackiness fades quickly, and I'm able to apply a moisturizer soon after. I haven't used it long enough or consistently enough to comment on my skin's "radiance." But the price alone would prevent me from buying this product again.

I looked up the ingredients, and most of them are benign or have little or no toxicology data available. The worst offenders are the fragrances: limonene (score of 6 on the Skin Deep database), citral (score of 7), and fragrance (parfum) (score of 8). Why ruin a decent product with synthetic, toxic fragrances?

With its Triple Oxygen Radiant Protection Serum, Bliss promises "revitalized skin function, even skin tone, softened lines and wrinkles, supercharged natural defenses, and a healthy glow!"

Whew!  That's a lot of miracle to pack into one little .9 ounce bottle. I have been using this product twice per day for 28 days and I can honestly say my lines and wrinkles have not softened and my skin doesn't feel supercharged (that just sounds painful).

The bottle I received had a faulty pump.  No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get it to work.  I have to unscrew the cap each time I use it.  No big deal, but for $50 I would expect the bottle to work.

The serum feels lightweight, goes on evenly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy or tight. But that's about it.  My skin glows a little right after applying it, but no erasing of wrinkles.  It smells good though.  I guess that's something.

** The bliss website lists this for $58.  I would never spend that for this product, nor would I recommend it to a friend.
summary: It smells good though. I guess that's something

reviewText: Very nice serum. It goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin silky smooth!

Beautifully packaged, so that the antioxidants and phytochemicals will remain fresh and effective to the last drop. The ingredients list shows 58 separate components in this unusually complex formula. I looked up all of them and found some intriguing information. No wonder Im seeing results! The most interesting to me are the following eight ingredients:

Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate, a stable form of vitamin C. There is evidence it is one of the most effective forms of C and that it assists in collagen production as well as reducing the depth of existing wrinkles.

Sodium Hyaluronate, a form of hyaluronic acid known to be even more bioavailable.

Rhizophora Mangle Bark Extract, an antimicrobial that assists in wound healing. Proven effective through clinical studies.

Euterpe Oleracea Fruit Extract, a polyphenol rich extract also shown through clinical studies to assist in healing.

Punica Granatum Extract, an antioxidant derived from pomegranate and considered one of the best.

Vaccinium Macrocarpon (Cranberry) Fruit Extract, an excellent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory, rich in proanthocyanidins.

Tetrahydrobisdemethoxydiferuloylmethane, a synthetic antioxidant derived from curcumin/turmeric.

Saccharomyces/Xylinum/Black Tea Ferment, an anti-aging, smoothing ingredient that adds radiance.

The silky, pinkish-gold opalescent serum adds temporary radiance as well, but the longer-lasting radiance is more important to me. The serum has a light, citrus fragrance I like a lot. On my very dry skin it absorbs quickly leaving a surface that feels smoother, but almost like nothing has been applied. Once Ive added a layer of moisturizer and sunscreen, there isn't even a hint of the mica or the pink-gold color. Over the course of a month of daily use, my skin appears to be just the slightest bit less wrinkled and definitely refined. I think over time that I will see real improvement, but I am not unrealistic about the speed of skin texture change. Ill update my review after a few months. To me, this serum is expensive, so getting real improvement is essential or I will not repurchase. The following is the full list of ingredients, which was not shown on the product description page at the time of my review.

INGREDIENTS: Water (Aqua, Eau), Dimethicone, Pentylene Glycol, Saccharomyces/Xylinum/Black Tea Ferment, Polysorbate 60, Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate, Vaccinium Macrocarpon (Cranberry) Fruit Extract, Rhizophora Mangle Bark Extract, Euterpe Oleracea Fruit Extract, Punica Granatum Extract, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Extract, Lepidium Sativum Sprout Extract, Allium Sativum (Garlic) Bulb Extract, Hexapeptide-2, Tripeptide-1, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Synthetic Sapphire, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Tocopherol, Lecithin, Hydrolyzed Soy Protein, Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, Squalane, Decarboxy Carnosine HCL, Tetrahydrodiferuloylmethane, Perfluorodimethylcyclohexane, Tetrahydrodemethoxydiferuloylmethane, Tetrahydrobisdemethoxydiferuloylmethane, Perfluorohexane, Glucose, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Perfluoroperhydrophenanthrene, Perfluorodecalin (oxygen-carrying chemical that assists in hyperoxygenation), Caprylyl Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Ethylbisiminomethylguaiacol Manganese Chloride, Cyclodextrin, Dimethiconol, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Xanthan Gum, Carrageenan, Sodium Potassium Aluminum Silicate, Silica, Butylene Glycol, Mica, Fragrance (Parfum), Disodium EDTA, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Tin Oxide, Phenoxyethanol, Chlorphenesin, Citral, Limonene, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxide (CI 77491).
summary: INGREDIENTS LIST! It's working for me

reviewText: This serum is expensive. But it makes my combination skin feel youthful and soft. It has a nice scent, it non greasy or heavy, and is gentle to my hormonal adult acne prone skin. Bliss products are quality and they don't test on animals. The packaging is simple and they don't advertise heavily so I feel like I am paying for a high quality product and see results to reflect that. I will continue to you this.

This men's fragrance is nice and light. A hint of floral. Perfect for spring and summer. The box is not extraordinary however the bottle is nice. Draped in jute rope. Reminiscent of a warm summer day. The scent lasts a long time without being overpowering. Very nice

I find this to be a complex citrus forward scent.  It isn't particularly strong, in fact it's pretty light - perhaps this is purely intentional, but it is way too polite for me.  I say this because I really love the scent itself and would be quite enamored with it in a stronger version.  As expected the longevity of the scent was commensurate with it's lightness as it did not last me an entire day and was, in fact, hard to determine.  If this scent could keep  it's fragrance profile, only ramped up in strength,  it would be a knock-out fragrance.  Even in it's present state of lightness it's far more complex than the old 4711 German aftershave which may have it's place even if it's somewhat less refined.  Acqua, as far as scent is concerned, is much better.
summary: Very Nice Light Scent..Too LIght For Me.

reviewText: I have sensitive skin and am always looking for cleansers that can work well for me.  I thought that this one as a cream cleanser might work out.  It turns out that I was right  it cleanses well and doesn't dry my face out.  I use very little, really just a small dab.  This is a fairly expensive cleanser but given I use so little, the cost equals out over time.  I will certainly be adding this to the cleansers that I alternate.  I don't like using the same product over and over again as it seems that I can become re-active to products that I use too much.
summary: Cleans without drying my sensitive skin

reviewText: As a milk balm, I like this product a significant amount, however it is called in this product title a make up remover, which it definitely is not.  Although it is not effective as a make up remover, it is effective as a cleansing balm.
summary: Cleansing balm, not a make up remover

reviewText: It is light, very gentle and effective in removing makeup without leaving any kind of residue that could irritate my skin. I can skip putting moisturizer on after using it because my skin does not feel dry after it. It has very non obtrusive smell. My skin is very sensitive and tends to react to a lot of products, but not to this one.
summary: It is light, very gentle and effective in removing ...

reviewText: This is a really nice makeup remover. I only use it on my eyes, but it gets every bit of stubborn waterproof mascara off, gently.  It's hydrating, so it doesn't dry out the delicate eye area. It's made for use on the entire face, but I use special products for my acne-prone, oily skin. I think someone with normal to dry skin would really like using it to remove all of their makeup.

My girlfriend noted that this removes make up, including waterproof mascara, easily while simultaneously being soothing and comfortable without any need for rinsing or using moisturizer afterward. It has a clean fresh scent, leaving her skin naturally soft. Since she has sensitive skin, she noted there is no irritation or redness, which is sometimes present with harsh make up removers and similar products.
summary: Removes makeup effectively. Excellent for sensitive skin. Fresh scent and no need to rinse.

reviewText: incredible . so soft.

I love this! I had to look up online how to use it. You use your fingers to put the peach side on the places you want your skin to look matte. For me this means my forehead, nose, and chin. Then you use the pink side to put on the parts of your face that you want to glow, like your cheeks. I put this on with my fingers over my makeup, and had great results. In still tinkering with it to find the perfect places to put each one. I'm not sure if this will work with dark skin or not. I have light-medium skin. I'm really happy with this!

So this is not what is considered a "blush" product as far as consistency. Its a gel formula best applied with your fingers and just gives the perfect splash of light color, more of a highlighter  There is two ways that I apply. For a natural look I apply over my foundation ( or natural )  and I first apply the pink and then the peach color for a very light splash of color on my cheeks or areas I want to highlight.

The other way is to apply as above and then apply your blush and/or bronzer over. It really gives my blush and bronzer more lasting power. It gives my products some added glow and either way you apply it just keep in mind it's a very light consistency and really is a nice product! You can also apply to your lips and the mirror in the compact is perfect!

I'm a woman of a "certain age" with pretty good skin, a little dry though. I keep my makeup simple using a mineral powder and some powder blush. I decided to give the matte finish a try. It feels creamy when picking it up on your fingers but has more of a powder feeling to it,  it's interesting. That being said I really didn't feel my face looked better or worse after applying it...and for 27.00, I'd like to see some improvement! Seriously, I didn't see where the matte or the dewy side did anything noticeable...maybe this product is really meant for the young twenty+ crowd. That is why I gave it 3 stars vs. 2 stars as it might be great on younger skin....but I sure can not recommend this to the "retired" crowd.

Upon trying the first time I noticed that the compact doesn't specify which color is for matte and which is  for dewy. I had to go back and look at the instructions. It turns out to not matter as neither one had any effect on my skin either way. Seriously, I could tell no difference. Neither the texture or the color of my skin was affected in any way. Curiously ineffective. Too bad the execution is poor as the idea is interesting.

This product appears to be targeted for those who apply a lot of different make-up products to get that perfect look.  I'm a great deal more minimalistic when it comes to applying make-up and I honestly am not seeing a difference when using this.
summary: Not for the minimal make-up consumer

reviewText:
What a strange makeup.  Unlike every other product I've used this compact is about less, not more.  It is extremely translucent and I seriously doubt that color is going to be a problem for most light shaded women.

When I first used it I was like, 'What the Heck', there's nothing here.  But I was wrong.  Upon putting up my specks I saw something that was pretty cool and that was that it glossed over flaws in my skin but not the way a foundation does.  It sort of fills in for large pores and obscures discolorations from the sun.

SUMMARY
I like where this makeup is heading.  It's an intriguing idea but it needs to work a little better for me to purchase it.

WHAT I DON'T LIKE is that you have to use your fingers.  Yuck.  I'm a mom.  If you're a mom you know where my fingers have been. I don't want to contaminate my makeup like that.  Also, I don't like how shear it is.  I'm a person who wears very little makeup, even when dressed up; and this is too light for me.

WHAT I DO LIKE is the minimalist nature of this Make pairing.  It's cool how it works, I just wish it had a little bit more color.

Honestly, I didn't see any difference when using this makeup. It was easy enough to apply and felt smooth going on, but it didn't make my face noticeably more matte or dewy. My face is neither super oily or dry, so maybe that is why.

I'm an avid makeup lover with a pretty substantial arsenal of products (though by no means an expert at application), yet I will admit it took me a little while to wrap my head around what this product was intended to do.  But when I grasped it, I was very excited to receive it.  Essentially it gives you the ability to customize the finish of your face making it more matte in areas where you want to tone down the shine and more dewy where you want to give your skin some glow.  For me this is awesome because my face is mostly dry so I can use all the glow I can get, but I still tend to get a bit more shine than I would like on my forehead.  Essentially you get the best of both worlds - a single product that helps you address both dry and dull skin in one compact.

To apply this I first applied my foundation primer and foundation and concealer underneath eyes and to blemishes.  I then used my fingers to lightly apply the matte product to the shiny areas of my forehead.  For the dew product, I applied it everywhere I would apply a highlighter, for me that means the tops of my cheeks, the bridge of my nose, and along my brows.  I've then been swiping on a finishing powder afterwards to set everything before continuing on with the rest of my face routine.

Using this compact this way, I've been very happy with the results.  It does a nice job of mitigating the shine on my forehead but more importantly for me, the dew side gives me little pops of glow where I need it most so my skin looks healthier and more well rested.  It's no substitute for a good skincare routine with proper hydrating (which I've been trying hard to optimize over time) but it's still a nice improvement.  It's also a nice product for people who want to emphasize certain parts of their face but who don't like the shimmer that comes with some highlighters.

Some other reviewers have mentioned concerns with applying this with their fingers.  I'm used to doing this with cream blushes so this application technique personally doesn't bother me, but I'm also experimenting with using the same brush I use with my cream contour products.  The results seem to still be good though I personally like applying this type of product with my fingers.

Overall I think this is a neat product and has been very handy in my makeup arsenal.

This Make brand Cosmetics Custom Finish Effects palette has a matte finish and a dewy finish.  The mirrored compact comes with a side of each and you have to apply these finishes with your fingers.  I can see this makeup becoming very dirty from fingers, just saying.

So I already have pretty nice skin.  It's not oily but I do wear a light dusting of powder every day, so I thought I'd love the matte finish.  It actually comes off on your finger as a bit of cream, a very lightweight cream, and turns into powder immediately. I applied it to my face over and over again, and nothing.

So I tried the dewy finish skin perfector. It's a light pink and has a bit of a light oily feel to it.  It is supposed to give you that dewy look.  I applied it to my face over and over.  I tried different areas of my face.  I tried it on my nose. Nothing.  Seriously, nothing noticeable.

I rubbed them on my hand, side by side and could barely see the dewy finish product.  There's a tad of shimmer there.  The matte side has no difference and the dewy side has just the slightest shine to it.  Seriously not worth much to me.

Yes, I like the compact and yes, I like the way the product feels as it disappears into my skin.  I also like the old fashioned cosmetic aroma that the product has, but I can't tell much of a visual difference on my skin.  I can feel the product if I rub my skin hard with my hand, but for as much as I put on, it's not surprising.

I'm going to mess around with this stuff and see if an epiphany comes to me after a few days.  If I get compliments on my skin that I just can't see, I'll update this review.  Again, it feels nice, smells nice, and everything, but I just don't see enough of a difference to make it worth the price.

Maybe a photograph could pick up the glow.  My face smells like a bandage now.  I don't even like the smell anymore.
summary: Noticed Very Little, If Any, Difference

reviewText: Sorry this product did not help my nail problem. Others find it helpful.

The jar of this cream is huge!  There is no doubt that this will last a while, which might explain the high price tag. You don't need much of the cream as too much of the cream makes the scent overwhelming. The overwhelming scent was a bit much for me as I don't usually wear strong smelling lotions or creams. The scent lasted the entire day and made my skin feel smooth.

This is a very exotic smelling body cream, me and my 6 year old daughter are in love with it. The cream has the right consistency, very easy to apply, keeps body moisturized, not at all sticky, and absorbs completely into the skin.

My family is so much into fragrances, always buys new perfumes, scented body lotions, mists, sprays etc. and I got to say that this new fragrance is a keeper.

I love round containers, they are quite convenient, and gives me the feeling of luxury.

The body cream comes in a very nice size, would last me long time, would definitely recommend to all the scent loving girls out there.

I was initially a bit hesitant to try this body cream since it is scented and I am sometime sensitive to strong perfumes but I decided to give it a try. I am glad I did. This cream is a medium weight product that smooths on nicely, absorbs into the skin and moisturizes well. I find the scent of the cream more pleasing when applied to the skin. Upon opening the jar, the cream smelled rather harsh,- perfumed flowers and baby powder. I was pleasantly surprised when I applied the cream, the scent was nuianced, I could detect notes of sandalwood and spice in addition to the floral tones. I found the scent to be pleasing but not overpowering and was happy to note that I had no adverse reaction to the perfume in the lotion. The lotion also keeps your skin nice and smooth throughout the day and the light perfume continues for several hours after applicaton. I definately would be hesitant to mix other perfumes with this lotion.

My only quibble with this lotion is the price point. It is on the expensive side and I am on the fence about whether it is worth the investment to me, so I am withholding one star.
summary: A lovely floral/sandalwood/spice scented body cream that moisturizes well

reviewText: This is a wonderful body cream, it is indeed a very sensual. I don't care for strong overwhelming smells so I am very happy it is not overpowering. My skin is a bit on the dry side and it leaves me feeling very soft and smooth. I especially enjoying rubbing a bit on my hands before bed so I keep it on my night stand where it doubles as a home security weapon the jar is HEAVY lol. This comes in a beautiful glass jar and a wonderful pretty box that would make gift wrapping unnecessary if you ever purchase this as a gift for some one. Its a bit pricey and depending on how you use it it may not last as long...in the end a little goes long way and it feels and smells divine very light and floral!

I'm always a little apprehensive buying a "smelly" item on line. The description can sound awesome, then when your product arrives it smells so bad the dog won't even go near it!
NOT TRUE with this body cream!! It smells so good!! I put a little bit on my arms when I opened it and that was plenty! Both my husband and my daughter love the smell. I'm not good at describing scents so read the company's description. And just know it smells good! My daughter and hubby said it smells "sexy"!  A little goes a long way. Not only does it smell good, it makes my skin feel so soft! It doesn't leave a greasy feel, nor does it  make your skin "sweat". With this body cream there is no need for perfume. The scent is strong enough on its own.
summary: A very nice smelling/feeling body cream.

reviewText:
When I opened this cream and took a whiff I was intoxicated.  It smells so fantastic and the scent is long lasting.  The cream is luxurious without being overly heavy.  It absorbs nicely and leaves my skin soft and perfectly scented.  There is no need to wear perfume if you are wearing this lotion.  I know that scent is a very personal choice and I tend to like scents that have more low notes than high notes.  This is floral and sensual at the same time.  I personally smell jasmine and sandalwood, which I love.

The packaging is equally as impressive; a thick glass jar that was boxed beautifully.  It would make an impressive gift.  Overall, I think this lotion is fabulous.  The price per ounce seems a bit high but sometimes it's nice to treat yourself to a high quality product and this lotion certainly delivers in that department..

When I first used this body creme, I was really impressed by how nicely it went on and how smooth it made my skin feel.  And then I was even more pleased to see how long it lasts.  I could see a difference immediately, and the difference lasts.  No oily or greasy feel, just nice, soft skin, hour after hour.

I was a bit apprehensive about the scent before I opened it.  Some scented cremes can be overwhelming or not very pleasant.  This didn't smell too strong when I opened the jar, but it does have a very fresh and long lasting scent on my skin.  Layering it with the Josie perfume would be lovely.  The fragrance is a bit floral, not overly spicy, and especially nice for the warmer months when I don't want something heavy or heady.

The jar it comes in is heavy with a cute lid - a floral and geometric design in red and black on white that looks great on counters or dressing tables.

This is a luxury item and is priced as such, although not as expensive as some.  It's not your average Vaseline Intensive Care type of lotion.  However, if your budget can manage a higher end skin creme, this one is a great one to choose.

The Josie by Josie Natori body cream is certainly an indulgent purchase (though I received it for purpose of a review). The first thing I noticed was how heavy it was - you receive a black and white decorated box, and inside is a heavy, clear jar with a black and white lid decorated with flowers. There's a nice amount of cream here, and considering that you don't have to put a lot on to both moisturize or to have the benefit of the 'Josie' perfume, it's going to last you a long time.
