As I said, the body cream is pretty decent - it's not as good as some lotions, but it absorbs well and it should work great in the warmer months - you might want to add another lotion if you've really dry skin/areas or during winter months. Now for the scent.
Looking up the Josie fragrance, its notes contains the following (and keep in mind that perfume reacts differently for everyone):
Top Notes: crisp Asian pear and bergamot and luscious dewy leaves
Mid Notes: sampaguita, freesia and wild orchid
Base Notes: sandalwood, white musk and patchouli
I definitely pick up the sandalwood, musk and patchouli in this one, a bit of the orchid and bergamot. And this LASTS. It lingers on the skin for hours, and in my bathroom as well after I open the jar and use it. If you're looking for a body cream that can take the place of a perfume or if you use Josie perfume, this is good. If you plan on using your favorite perfume as well, then you might have a problem (and why I'm removing a star, since I've a ton of perfume that I love wearing each day based on my mood).
So if you're looking for a very strong scented body cream as a moisturizer and a main perfume, this is a good one.
summary: Nice body cream, very strong scent

reviewText: After I read other comments here, I decided to try this out as more of a perfume that comes in lotion form. As long as you are using it like that and not to replace your current lotion, I think it does a good job. It isn't really thick enough to use as a regular lotion, especially if you have dry skin like I do. But as a perfume, it isn't too strong and leaves a nice smell throughout the day. I would say the scent is done within 4 hours or so though.

I have been Natori customer for a while, although I must admit that all of my purchases for this brand were limited to their intimates products.  Their clothing line is fine quality and I was intrigued to try their body lotion.  I must say that lotion comes in elegantly designed bottle and it is easy to use (no extra squeezing of the bottle needed, also lotion is the right texture too - not too watery or too reach).  However, I find scent to bee too flowery and sweet.  It is OK for young women, but more mature customers may find it a little too girlish.  I use it only on the weekends when it is time to go to bed or after I take shower after my workout and do not plan to go out in public.  So in a way this lotion has become my house-bound body moisturizing solution -- until is all used up.  And after that, I do not think I will be using it again.

This is a nice fragrance lotion to put on before going out to a party or dinner.  I have very dry skin, and  use lotions for that issue, but this is not one I would use for that purpose.  Josie should be used primarily for fragrance, not to help with dry skin.  It's a thinner product than I'm used to using, but it went on nicely and soaked right in.  The scent is strong and lasted quite some time. I got many compliments throughout the evening.

It leaves your skin nice and soft. I like the smell but it is a little overpowering when you first put it on. It actually smells better after it's worn off a little. It's a very nice smell though. It is a fairly good size bottle and will last me a while since I only am using it on my face, neck and hands. They are certainly feeling softer after only using it for a couple of weeks.
summary: Makes your skin feel soft and silky...

reviewText: Lovely light floral scent.  Luxurious, moisterizing, and long lasting.  The packaging is exquisite.  Highly recommended.

Features & pros:-
1) It has a fragrance of fresh flowers and perfume is of Josie Eau de.
2) The lotion container is easy to squeeze and use.

Cons:-
1) Since it is of thin texture it does not absorb to the skin well.
2) It does not moisturize the skin completely.
3) It may not suit skin types that are extremely dry.
4) It is very expensive for the price.
summary: Does not solve the purpose for which its made..

reviewText: The lotion has strong smell, and the smell stays there for many hours. It is very easy to spread over the skin, it is pleasant to touch, it's not sticky or greasy, and it absorbs well. You do not need much because it is so easy to spread.. The skin feels smooth and silky afterward, but my skin wasn't dry to begin with. I like that the smell stays for so long, but it is not overpowering.
summary: nice perfumed lotion, smell lasts for a long time

reviewText: I have used several body lotions over the years; St Ives, Lubriderm, Jergens, Vaseline, Johnsons and a few other brands. All of them vary slightly in terms of moisturizing the skin and the fragrance. This lotion is very moisturizing and the fragrance lasts longer than I expected. My wife and I have very dry skin and this lotion felt great. In addition to providing moisture, it reduces skin-dryness. The quality of the lotion is good but this is certainly a high-end product!
summary: High-end body lotion that has great fragrance

reviewText:
This scent is pretty powerful and perhaps it's my age, but I prefer stronger fragrances less and less, on me and on others.  If you aren't careful, this scent can take over a room, and this is that way.

It is described a citrus scent and that's what it smelled like and least initially.  Scents are different on each person, of course, but this has a lighter, not fuller, scent to me..

A little goes a long way, lasting all day and filling into clothing.  It's travel sized, as well, so there's that.  Overall, if you are fond of Josie Natori products especially, I recommend this.

A nice fragrance but a lot more earthy than I had expected; I didn't get any notes of asian pear or bergamot (I loveeee earl grey, so I was hopeful) on my skin.  Alas, it may simply be my body chemistry not playing nice.

While I enjoy this fragrance and personally, I don't find it too strong, it's simply not something I'd wear regularly.  It's definitely a woman of a certain age type of fragrance; not young but also not my mother or grandmother's perfume...  it's a little "serious".  I feel most comfortable wearing this in the office on days where I'm dressed to impressed for an important board meeting or conference.

Beautiful bottle and good longevity.  Try this one out first if you can before purchasing if possible.
summary: Lovely bottle but not an everyday fragrance

reviewText:
Im going to have to go against the grain here.  I didn't care for this perfume.  The bottle design screamed out 1980s drug store perfume (think Electric Youth from Debbie Gibson).  When the perfume first went on, I found it to have too strong of a musk smell with just a hint of floral.

I realize that perfume is different for different people, but I didn't have the experience of other reviewers who said the musk scent faded and the floral smell stuck around.  I found that very quickly all scent was gone.  For me, this perfume just didn't have staying power at all.  I even put on what I considered a lot of it (4-5 sprays) and it was gone in no time.

I did give it two stars simply because the price is good and the quantity is great for perfume.  If it works for you, its a great deal.

How do you review a scent? This is such a subjective thing, but my wife likes it and that's what's important. On first spray I thought it was too strong but it faded into a very pretty perfume. It doesn't smell new and chic, it smells elegant and refined. To me the smell is at contrast with the packaging. The zebra print and bright red makes me think it will have sharp, maybe citrus smells, but instead the smells are floral, fruity, with a soft edge. And I feel that's so subjective that I don't want to knock it for that opinion. I think it's fancy, sensual, feminine--more exotic than exciting.

I do think the packaging is really nice and perfect for gifting. The black and white "zebra stripes" on the outside of the box are embosses. Then when you open it there is a cherry red cardboard that envelopes the perfume bottle. The bottle and the lid are both glass. The zebra print is right on the glass as well as the Josie Natori logo. The button pump is a little darker--maybe a metallic ruby red? Even thought the pump button has a metallic look, it feels like plastic. The bottom of the bottle says "MADE IN U.S.A." which is a always nice to see. The perfume bottle has a nice heft to it.

Overall the wife likes it, and I think it smells good on her. I don't think she'll be wearing it daily but rather save it for a special time where she dresses up.
summary: Something you save for special nights

reviewText: Love it!  Great scent and smells wonderful on my wife!!!

I stick to floral scents like Joy or Chanel No. 5 and occassionally wear Happy by Clinique, my all time fav was Rive Gauche by YSL and I haven't found a new perfume I really like until this one!  I love the floral undertones mixed with earthiness.  Like all perfumes, this one will smell completely different on another, but it works well for me.  Bonus points for the unique packaging.  The cube looks almost like lucite and the red atomizer running down the center looks amazing with the black and white graphic on one side.  Definitely a plus to displaying this scent.

Since fragrance preference is subjective and highly personal, it's a difficult product to review. Based on the description that mentions citrus and floral notes, I was excited about trying Josie by Josie Natori. I tend toward light fragrances - mostly one-note florals. While I enjoy musk tones on others, I don't care for them in my own fragrance choices.

I find Josie to be too heavy, musky and cloying. It smells "old lady" sweet to me and even though I may be an old lady, I don't want to smell like one. ;-) It does become less cloying after an hour or so and it isn't what I would call unpleasant. It's just too much for my taste.

However, to illustrate how highly personal fragrance preferences are, my daughter and one son adore this scent! Both of them have raved about how fabulous I smell when wearing this. Go figure.

I would say that if you enjoy long-lasting scents that are complex, musky and have sweet floral and citrus notes, you may love Josie. If you prefer lighter, one-note scents that aren't musky, this probably isn't the scent for you. But you never know - try some at a fragrance counter!

As a side note, the bottle is interesting and unique with a vaguely Asian feel in black, white and red. It's beautifully boxed and makes a statement on your dressing table.
summary: Fragrance is a very personal thing

reviewText: This is a decent bronzer that will give the user a quick healthy glow.  I have a fair complexion that  turns relatively dark after time in the sun and this shade is a good match for my skin tone right now in late July.  The powder does not flair any allergies or cause blemishes or other problems for me at least.  The compact itself is quite cheap  and composed of fairly flimsy plastic though it does have a serviceable mirror.  I do wish it had some kind of included applicator that could be stored conveniently in the compact especially as this item has a price tag of over thirty dollars.

My skin colour is not very dark, just sort of a beige; so I would expect a bronzer to add some colour. The product says for face and body and it really adds no bronze tone at all anywhere.

The case is hard to open, but does have a nice round mirror in it. There is no applicator. I used my brush and it went on well, except it blended in so much that it had no effect at all. The price seems high for what you get in this product as compared to the ordinary brand name drug store varieties.

First, the compact is very large -- you can grab a big brush and use the bronzer for shoulders and neckline comfortably. There's also a mirror, which is becoming a rarity. You really do need a brush, though, so this isn't something to tuck in your purse for a touch up.

The powder is very fine, with a bit of shimmer, and applies evenly. The feel is silky, and it's light enough that you won't feel it all day. You can wear it over bare skin for a natural, sunkissed look or add it to your make up kit for summer. There's a nice range of colors, so everyone should be able to find the perfect shade.
summary: the compact is very large -- you can grab a big brush and use the bronzer for shoulders and neckline comfortably. There's also a

reviewText: Perfect travel or gym set. All of the great Coola products that I use daily, in a nice size. The bag is actually bigger than I thought - there is room for the product shown, plus you could add in face wash, eye shadow, lip stick, deod, nail file, etc. I have lots of little things added in the bag for my travel.
Great product! Used for several years. Like the results.

This is not just for men. I am a woman with long, curly hair and I love this product. It kind of reminds me of VO5 hairdressing, but this product is much thicker and waxier. It does not liquify in your hands when you rub them together (like the VO5 does), so it is a bit harder to distribute to your hair.
Nevertheless, it does a great job of smoothing down flyaways and giving a nice subtle shine to my hair. I only use just a touch so it really doesnt weigh down my hair or make it greasy.
fair

As with any pomade, a little goes a long way. Just the tiniest dab is all you need - rub in the palms of your hands and then run through your hair. It gives some control and definition with a subtle shine. If you use too much, it will be heavy on the hair and a bit greasy looking/feeling. The scent seems to only last a minute or two after applying, which really isn't a bad thing at all.

Im kind of surprised that they call this gel.  Its quite hard.  It has a translucent look.  ITs not the easiest thing to get out of the container.  I typically use Aveda, which is a real gel.  But I must say that this product actually works quite well.  My hair also stays soft, even though the product keeps it in the direction that I put it.  So I like that part a lot.  At the current price, its quite expensive. .  but. . . it takes very little so it will last and last.  In the past Ive used butch wax which is a bit similar, but MUCH for challenging to use.  This product is FAR better.
summary: Bit surprised it's called "gel". .  .But it works really well. . . Keeps your hair soft

reviewText: This leave in conditioner is extremely thick, the texture coats my hair like a lotion. It doesn't weigh my hair down and tames my fly aways. The smell is pleasant and I keep reaching for it after every shower. It's a keeper!

I don't normally use conditioner but this conditioner is great. It not only smells amazing but it makes my hair feel instantly soft and smooth. It rinses clean from my hair and leaves it feeling great. My hair is usually dry but not after using this conditioner just once. I have started using it at least twice a week and my hair has become so much more beautiful, soft, and just more healthier. Great stuff, for sure.

I love this moisture cream! I use straight out of the shower and it really helps my hair with detangling and less frizz and more control compared to when I don't use.  I recently went on a two week vacation and didn't bring with me and noticed a difference with my hair styling regime.  My hair is much more manageable when using and a little goes a long way!

I use two small pumps with some hair oil and work into my hair straight after washing before placing the towel on my hair. In about 10 minutes when I am ready to comb through my hair is super soft and although with thin hair some products will weigh my hair down like this, this product doesn't. My hair still is super body-full and I love this product.

I've never had so many compliments on my hair since using this cream, so it must be good stuff.

My hair is curly, but thin. It still gets awful frizzy without a bit of help, though. At first, I used too much of this cream, and my hair looked flat and oily. It doesn't take much at all, which means the bottle will last awhile. Once I figured out the right amount to use, I feel like my curls are more defined, with less frizz.

The scent is pleasant, and I didn't find it overwhelming. I'm incredibly sensitive to strong scents, but this one hasn't bothered me at all.

Overall, I really love this conditioner!
Too drying
summary: It simply does not help bleached dried hair

reviewText: I purchased this at Nordstrom as part of a complete foot care regimen.  I live in the desert and I wear heels for work every day.  My feet are dry and callused.  After using Gehwol Swiss foot file, I used the Gehwol Soft Crme.  This lotion is amazing, my feet immediately felt motorized and softer.  I even used it on my legs.  The crme is definitely less expensive on Amazon than at Nordstrom.  I definitely recommend this to rid yourself of dry cracked feet.  You won't regret it.

I purchased this at Nordstrom as part of a complete foot care regimen.  I live in the desert and I wear heels for work every day.  My feet are dry and callused.  After using Gehwol Swiss foot file, I used the Gehwol Soft Crme.  This lotion is amazing, my feet immediately felt motorized and softer.  I even used it on my legs.  The crme is definitely less expensive on Amazon than at Nordstrom.  I definitely recommend this to rid yourself of dry cracked feet.  You won't regret it.

I tried this before purchasing Biotone foot lotion, and I was so disappointed in this. I had received a sample and I thought it worked well enough that I purchased the full size.
It didn't do much for my feet. It was better than nothing, but it wasn't anything to rave about either.
in 1 week start some results.

This works very well if you have medium to dark hair. You will feel a very mild warm sensation that is over almost before you can think about it. Of course it will take a while to eradicate hair over any substantial area this way, but for simple touch ups, this is great.

However, if you are a natural blond or even a light ginger, this may not work for you at all, so be aware of that.
summary: Great! If you have darker hair....

reviewText: THE BEST! Natural color, not too much shimmer, applies wet or dry.

I haven't used a bronzer in many years because I felt that it made me look somewhat brassy and was sort of awkward on my skin tone. I have fair to olive skin, brown hair and eyes.  Considering my complexion it gives me a natural glow without looking orange. So, I think that impression was mostly in my head.

I was a little hesitant at first because I had seen some of the reviews about it looking orange or being too shimmery. However, once I put it on, it looked like I had a soft, natural tan. I liked it from day one. So it works well for me and is not too orange or brassy. Id describe it as warm and gold/copper tone.

A little goes a long way. One thing I love most about it is that the staying power is great. I've not had a problem with smudging, smearing, etc. like Ive had with other bronzers and some makeup. Ive used it for 30 days and it barely looks like I have used any.  I could see this lasting me for more than a year.

Over the last 30 days Ive not had any reactions or breakouts so I should be good for the remainder of the package.

The package is very cool looking and handy to carry but is difficult to open at times. Not fun when you are trying to reapply while out and about.  It comes with a brush but I prefer my own most of the time. I use the one included when I am traveling inside. The brush is well shaped to apply and contour. But prefer one easier to handle unless I am traveling.

Overall I would recommend the product.
summary: A good way to get back into bronzers.

reviewText: So, I really like this bronzer. It is packaged really nicely, with the brush fitting into the bottom compartment. The bronzer applies nicely and blends very well. I just wish I got a darker color. This one is exactly the same color as my skin, making it a better finishing powder. It is matte, with no shine, which I like. I'm over all the shine. This is an excellent product that I will try in a darker shade, while I use this over my concealer.

This is a beautiful shade for fair skin, no hint of orange or dullness, just a warm glow. Most bronzers are a little deeper than this, but if you are light-complected, it's nice to have an option that isn't too dark for your color. I appreciate the lack of shimmer or glitter particles, which makes this suitable for daytime and even the office, since it's a subtle bronze. If you're already tan, or have a skin tone beyond medium, I'd recommend a different product. This is definitely for fairer tones.

It applies smoothly and blends well. The packaging is bulky, so this isn't one you'll throw into a small bag, and may not want this for travel. That's my only complaint.
summary: Beautiful shade for light skin tones

reviewText: I got this in shade 2, pale green, to counteract the ruddiness I have around my nose and mouth.  I keep this in my purse for midday touchups as needed; the pencil format makes it very portable and application is easy with my fingertips. It does help neutralize redness, but it's not thick/opaque enough to cover severe discolorations like a fresh pimple or whatnot,  But for its portability and ability to do what it claims to do, I give this 5 stars.

First, what I like about this product: it is soft and causes no drag. There's nothing worse than a hard product that feels like its tugging at your skin. Likewise, it distributes evenly and easily. Now for the downside, I didn't really seem to cover much of anything. And, once I layered  foundation over it, I really couldn't see that anything was different from my usual routine. Maybe its very subtle ... but I'm probably not willing to invest extra time in my morning routine for something that I'm unsure if it has any effect at all.

So, kudos to Japonesque for the ease of use and the lovely packaging ... I think if it were slightly more effective, it would be receiving somewhat better ratings. (Wait for a redesign!)
summary: Great Idea, Maybe Not So Great in Reality ...

reviewText: This works okay, but it doesn't really last long. I find that it is too light to really cover very well, and it's consistency is too thin to to get good coverage. It is a very pale lavender color which is supposed to neutralize redness. I would recommend putting it on under your normal foundation because it does give your skin a lavender cast. I found that I had to very often reapply throughout the day to keep things hidden. There are much better concealers out there.
summary: Works okay. Not the best concealer I've used.

reviewText: I use the red correcting crayon in this brand and it works fairly well.  This crayon looks like, well crayon, on my light olive complexion.  It may be that it is not for everyone but I wish that there was some guidance as to which skin tones this works with.  It comes across very light against my skin and it is embarrassingly noticeable.
summary: Not for very fair olive complexions

reviewText: I love Mustela baby products in general, and these wipes are definitely one of my favorites. Although they might not seem sturdy, I have cleaned the biggest diaper messes with no problem. I love taking them on the go with me and using them for whatever I need. Sometimes that may be wiping a dirty mouth or a runny nose and these do the trick! My daughter loves them as asks for her bear wipes if I happen to pull out a different brand of wipes. She always looks for the bear on the product to make sure they are her favorite wipes. I loved discovering the Mustela baby products and highly recommend them for parents looking for more natural baby products!

The particular wipes that I received are indeed scented, and somewhat strongly scented at that. I am not one that is weary about scents, though, so I used up the pack. I am comparing these Mustela wipes to two other wipes I've purchased repeatedly: Pampers Sensitive (I have them on subscribe & save) and Water Wipes.

These are much thinner than Pampers Sensitive wipes, and marginally thinner than Water Wipes. For messy diaper changes, I double up the "first pass wipe" when I'm using these and Water Wipes. So they are not "extra thick", as mentioned in the description. They do a good job otherwise and are non-irritating to my child's skin. They are not super saturated--actually kind of on the dry side--and thus I use more than I would with my Pampers Sensitive wipes. These are also 8 bucks a pack, which is significantly more expensive than any other wipes I've used. I know Mustela is somewhat of a luxury skincare brand--and I LOVE most of their products (the Stelatopia line has been a lifesaver for my child)--but these wipes are sort of a miss for me. Because of their price-point, and how thin and dry they are compared to Pampers Sensitive wipes, I wouldn't recommend them.

I have to say I was sadly disappointed when I received these. I thought they were going to be way different because I like Mustela products. I opened them up and the scent was very strong and I didn't find it pleasant. It says they are delicately fragranced or maybe I have an extra strong sense of smell but I was quite worried to use them on my kids as we use unscented and cucumber wipes. Having a girl I don't think you should wipe them with any scents so I did not use them on her, just my son. So as I was pulling one out I was also surprised to feel that these really aren't thick at all, they are very thin and quite flimsy. I had to use quite a few to completely wipe my son clean from a #2. They did wipe fine but I also don't fee like they were very moist but I think that's because it's so thin it can't hold much moisture. I will not be buying these wipes in the future. I have purchased wipes just like these at discount retailers when I was in a pinch.
summary: I have to say I was sadly disappointed when I received these

reviewText: For me personally, these are indistinguishable from the fragrance free baby wipes that I get in a sixpack for just a few dollars more. I really didn't see what made these special or luxurious, because the cloth, the solution, everything really just seemed indistinguishable. The other baby wipes I use don't dry out my child's skin, and I get unscented ones, so they don't leave an unpleasant fragrance or anything. This also wasn't packaged for traveling, so I ended up kind of unsure as to what distinguished these wipes from just the regular old wipes but I always get. I don't think I would spend extra money for them, but they are a perfectly fine product with nothing wrong with them.
summary: Indistinguishable from the regular fragrance free wipes I usually get, only more expensive

reviewText: These luxurious wipes are made in france and this review is for the fragranced single pack version. I have many mustela products and have used them for my toddler when he was a newborn and I am using them now for my 5 month old (for the past 5 months). This is my first time using the wipes though and though I normally love the products from them, I am in two minds regarding this product. The scent is the usual mustela scent , which does not bother me though it might come off as being very strong to some people. However for some reason this product's scent seems extra strong or something. I can smell it even when the pack is closed.  I only use this in place of the no rinse solution (which along with the foaming newborn shampoo is my favorite product) after cleaning up a poopy diaper. The wipes seem thinner and smaller than what i am used to( I will have to recheck this and edit my review if it is inaccurate) but they do clean very well.

These are fantastic wipes for "bird bathes" for baby.  We use these when we don't have time or ability to give the baby a full bath.  They are lightly scented and leave the skin feeling soft and refreshed.  They are not too wet and usually two wipes will do an entire baby (results may vary depending on size of baby).  They have not caused any skin irritation on our baby.

If you hold the wipe in your hand for a few seconds before use, it will be warm enough that it isn't as "refreshing" to the baby.
summary: Great for Baby-Cleanups and Bird Bathes

reviewText:
These are sturdy wipes.  They aren't thick but they don't tear easy.  No skin irritation on face or booty.  They are fragrance free and don't have an odd smell as some other fragrance-free wipes do.  Love that they have natural ingredients.

It should clarify if the wipes are biodegradable on the package. I'm not sure if I can flush these or not.
summary: These are sturdy wipes. They aren't thick but they don't tear ...

reviewText: This is a great set and a new fave brand of my husband's. I got him started on products for men with Jack Black's line and he has since tried a few other brands, always going back. This he really liked and has already purchased the deodorant, again. He LOVES the deodorant. He sweats a lot and is very picky with deodorant but this left him feeling fresh all day. Mind you, it is still winter, so we'll see how well it holds up once summer hits. He also likes the clay pomade. He uses just a bit to keep his very short hair slicked to the front. The moisturizer he did not care for, but I have yet to find one that he does like. He is not a moisturizing type of guy except for rubbing lotion on his elbows. Lol. So, I did not lower the rating for the moisturizer as it just seems to be a preference of my husband's to not use it. It is fragrance free and contains no oil so it might work well for other men. All in all, this is a great set for gift giving and this is an excellent brand for men, which we will continue purchasing from.
summary: This is a great set and a new fave brand of my husband's

reviewText:
I like BoC products although they tend to be on the pricey side.  Also the glass packaging which they typically use is a nice touch.

Lotion: not greasy, doesn't stay on too long (good for a frequent washer like myself), but nothing earth shattering

Deodorant: might be the highlight of the kit for me.  I like that it's aluminum and paraben free.

Pomade: I like that it's also paraben free, and doesn't give a greasy look or texture.

The kit is a good gift if the recipient is already well-acquainted with BoC products.  Otherwise, the items can be found elsewhere for cheaper.
summary: A little pricey, but good quality products

reviewText:
This kit is a wonderful introduction to the Baxter California line of products for men. The company has an eye to safety and the products have ingredient lists that make me very happy.

The deodorant : is aluminum and paraben free. It has a light scent that I liked. It smells clean and fresh. I haven't seen any stains on clothing and it is probably my favorite item in this kit. This is a deodorant though, so if you like antiperspirants, this will not be strong enough for you.

The Clay pomade : Again, a paraben free product, this is mostly beeswax and clay. Ideal for holding a style in place for a long time and for a slicked back look. Not some thing that will see much use but I did try it out and it goes on smoothly and has a matte finish. If you've got thinning hair you do not want the shiny look! It has a light scent that was not my favorite but it is very faint and fades quickly.

The moisturizer : is my least favorite out of the kit. It leaves a greasy film and has a lot of ingredients that I stay away from. It is definitely not Paraben free!

Bottom line : This is an ok item since the quality of the moisturizer really makes it less of a value buy. The headliner for this kit is the deodorant! That is something I will be buying in the future. The moisturizer is not worth the price and the pomade is very specific to each person.

If you know someone who is already a fan of Baxter, this kit would make a good gift but I wouldn't expect too much from the moisturizer.
summary: The great, the good and the not so good.

reviewText:
Baxters has become my new favorite line of products after being an American Crew and Redken guy for the last 10 years.
Normally I buy the Hard Water Pomade but I'm actually really liking this clay.

The clay has a different smell, a bit more "piney" or herbal smelling, and isn't really good at going on dry if you have fine hair but if you add I few drops of water and warm it up it goes on easy and has great hold.

The lotion is awesome, hardly any fragrance, and leaves my face feeling good all day. Not too greasy or anything either.

The deodorant is the only part of this kit I don't like, and only because of the smell. It's not a feminine smell at all which is good, it's more of a natural herbal kinda smell, but it's really strong. Really, don't bother wearing cologne with this stuff.
But beyond the smel it did a great job of keeping me from stinking and unlike a lot of other deodorants it didn't give me a rash. Apparently i have sensitive armpits and most stuff makes me break out. Wore this 3 days in a row and had no issues.
So if you like the smell (which I do) and don't mind how strong it is (which I do) then this is a great deodorant.

Overall I'd say it would make a nice gift for a guy looking to step up from Speed Stick, Suave hair gel and Jergens. Quality products all around.
summary: Great products, deodorant is a bit strong for me.

reviewText:
This is a perfect gift for the well-groomed man. The deodorant has a gentle (but weirdly unrecognizable) scent. And, while my boyfriend is frequently allergic to just about everything, this Baxter product did not provoke the slightest reaction. Moreover, the moisturizer has no recognizable  scent and caused zero negative skin reactions. In fact, his skin felt softer and more touchable than ever. Now, the pomade was met with a big "no." He said that it "wasn't for him." I can see that ... it does seem to be a somewhat polarizing product. I wonder if a facial cleanser would have been a choice for this collection?

Do know that this kit did not arrive as shown. It showed up in a clear plastic baggie. Weird. Still, we did not mind since it was ordered for everyday use by my better-half.

It seems that the deodorant and moisturizer will become a staple. (I see that they are already in our cart ... separately.) I would say that before you invest in this set, to consider the person for whom you are buying. Make sure that all components make good sense. (Because the kit is awfully expensive to toss any unwanted element in the rubbish bin).

This is a nice set with the basics beyond shaving products and accessories. The hair pomade is probably the best part. It holds well and isn't greasy or too sticky. The moisturizer is more gel than cream and absorbs into the skin with a minimalistic, fresh scent that  leaves room for using aftershave without clashing. The deodorant has a very pleasant masculine scent that makes me think of pine, herbs and a hint of cedar in a clear stick. As a gift I found the packaging a ixed bag. The moisturizer box is well-designed but the colors of the products don't match really and I find the labeling cheap looking -- alot like labels you'd print off a home color printer. I get not going too frilly for men but I think for the price I'd see a higher quality package I'd feel good about giving.
summary: Overall good products, pleasant to use

reviewText: I have used Baxter Moisturizer for years and really like the light and non-oily feel on my face.  I keep it in my gym bag for a post workout shower moisture for midday.  The deodorant and pomade are new to me and I like them both.  The deodorant has a fresh clean smell unlike any other and it was non-irritating and lasted the day.  The Clay Pomade is a firm hold but doesn't leave any shiny film or greasy look.  And buying the kit rather than separates is almost like getting the deodorant for free

Baxter of California is my go-to product for skin and personal care. The quality of this stuff really justifies the price. This item would make a perfect holiday gift for the man in your life (or the men, no judgment here). Whatever ingredients they use, it feels great on the skin and has little to no aroma (if there's any at all, it's simple, clean, and masculine).

This is really nice shower oil. This is a great way to moisturize while taking a shower. This fresh scented oil. Feels great in a or shower. This does not irritate your sinuses.you use about a quarter on your skin and repeat. You will have a great feeling when exiting out of the shower.

This is definitely something different. It's a fairly thick oil with shimmering gold microbeads in it that turn to a foam once it gets wet in the shower. I'm sorry to say I only used this once. I had no problems with it on my skin. I have sensitive skin so it's good that it didn't cause any skin issues.

The problem I did have with it is that the fragrance is extremely overpowering. So much so that I was actually sick by the time I got out of the shower. Now, I do have a sensitivity to certain fragrances and to any fragrance that is so strong it permeates my nostrils and never wants to leave.

It does lather well and I did like the way my skin felt after using it. It would be fine for anyone who doesn't have a problem with fragrances. But if you have a sensitive schnoz, you might want to pass this one by.

Wow. If you have sensitivities/allergies to fragrance, this might not be the product for you. Likewise, this smells super feminine to me, so it might not be the first choice of most men. The product itself was okay ... but no better than comparable drugstore versions (maybe just a little more perfumed). I guess it's okay if you are seeking a little extra punch of scent.

My wife was very impressed with this lipstick.  She was happy with the color as it was very bold yet not too 'out there' (from my uninformed opinion she has darker skin and it looked very good on her).  Its a pinkish red that she thinks would look good on a wide range of skin tones.

She tells me that it had a very smooth application and was moisturizing, and lasted a good length of time.  She believes that for best results you should use it with primer and lip liner.

Even though its pricey she thinks its worth it, and is one of the better lipsticks she's used.

Beautiful color!  It's actually a bit on the natural side of red, too.  Very nice.  The angled design of the tip makes for easy application and it felt nice and smooth as it went on and it didn't dry my lips out.  I didn't need a lip gloss as a top coat, and that's a rare thing for me.  The staying power is excellent.  After drinking a beverage I still had a nice red color to my lips.  I did a reapplication after eating a meal but there was surprisingly enough still some color on a good four hours after applying.  This lipstick is odor and tasteless and I quite appreciate that.  It did not bleed nor feather.  This is most definitely a quality lipstick and I'd highly recommend it to anyone wanting the perfect red.

The color is exactly as described. Maraschino Cherry is a true red. I wore it alone and also toned it down with a frosted gloss I had. The color looked great both ways. My review is based on the Make lipstick alone. Red can be a difficult color because it shows when it feathers to the small lines around lips, this lipstick did not bleed but did feather a bit. I applied it in the morning and it looked fine after I drank a beverage. After eating a meal I still had lip stain but for a polished look reapplication was necessary. I like the feel of the lipstick, it is not sticky and it is moisturizing.  I have clear lip gloss or lipstick on my lips at all times because my lips are very dry, I did not need to apply a moisturizing gloss in addition to the lipstick. This is a premium lipstick and I am satisfied with the product.

MAKE Cosmetics Silk Cream Lipstick Maraschino Cherry is a very good product. The color is very nice, not too flashy but still bright enough to compliment. It goes on very smooth and stays on, only needing a touch up sometimes, depending on if you ate or other factors like that.

The cream texture does leave your lips feeling not dry. It has a pleasant texture. Application is easy due to the shape of the the stick itself. Also benefit is the product is hypo allergenic, so should not cause irritation unless you have an allergy to a specific ingredient it is composed of.

Very good product. High recommendation.

This stuff is amazing! I received a sample from Birchbox and wanted to purchase the full size but they can't keep it in stock! Luckily I found it here. It's super gentle on your eyes, but removes every last trace of makeup. I'll be using this for as long as they continue to make it.

I wear some serious make-up...as in waterproof, long lasting and layered. I need a make up remover that is just as serious. MAKE is the ultimate bad arse true to every claim remover.

Just a little goes a long way. Shake it up, apply to cotton ball or makeup remover wipes and gently on face, the oil loosens the make up. Keep wiping ...nicely not all angry...and coila...your face is clean.

The real miracle here, is that this product removes my lip stains like a boss. I wear the dark long lasting stubborn lip stains, and they never come off this good.

It leaves behind a nice scent, and moisturizes your face and lips.

Beautiful and easy to apply, this little beauty just adds a touch of color to your skin. I have  medium toned skin and this worked just right for me. Takes a few tries the first time you use it to get the product to come out, and you have to reapply it a few times, but otherwise it is a great little *extra* for my makeup routine when I want to add something special.

I decided to get this product as an introduction to make-up for my 12 year old. It is very easy to apply, with just the tap of a button, the make-up appears on the brush. It flows smoothly and effortlessly onto the cheek and blends in quickly. The brush did not stay stiff once the product was on it. I decided to try it too, so I could write this review from my own experience as well.

Though it offers a little brightening, I honestly don't see much of a difference or much shimmer on my face when wearing the skin illuminator. I was hoping for more of an impact. I don't wear foundation or blush, as I really don't like the feel of face make-up, so I was hoping this product would give me a little extra without the heaviness I find with traditional blushes, etc. The good news is, once applied, I did not feel it at all. The bad news is that it is really hard to tell when it has been applied. This was true for both my daughter and myself.
summary: Not a lot of shimmer or glimmer

reviewText: This highlighter adds a bit of subtle gorgeousness to my skin.  The color is a warm pink apricot that blends perfectly with my fair complexion.  I was worried it would be too dark, but it is very sheer.  The pearlescent quality adds a pretty glow without being over the top sparkly.  I like to use it to highlight my cheekbones and eyelids, but I've also used it as an all over face enhancer/foundation substitute and it looks very pretty.
summary: Adds beautiful, subtle glow to my skin

reviewText: This is a quick little tool to add some quick radiance to the face.  The color I received is more peach than apricot which was a bit of a disappointment but it is still a usable tool.  The applicator is very easy to use and this can be used either over makeup or on a bare face.
summary: Quick Way To Freshen Face And Add Color

reviewText: excellent product, I love it, it's just what I needed

This scent is pretty powerful and perhaps it's my age, but I prefer stronger fragrances less and less, on me and on others.  If you aren't careful, this scent can take over a room, and this is that way.

It is described a citrus scent and that's what it smelled like and least initially.  Scents are different on each person, of course, but this has a lighter, not fuller, scent to me..

A little goes a long way, lasting all day and filling into clothing.  It's travel sized, as well, so there's that.  Overall, if you are fond of Josie Natori products especially, I recommend this.

A nice fragrance but a lot more earthy than I had expected; I didn't get any notes of asian pear or bergamot (I loveeee earl grey, so I was hopeful) on my skin.  Alas, it may simply be my body chemistry not playing nice.

While I enjoy this fragrance and personally, I don't find it too strong, it's simply not something I'd wear regularly.  It's definitely a woman of a certain age type of fragrance; not young but also not my mother or grandmother's perfume...  it's a little "serious".  I feel most comfortable wearing this in the office on days where I'm dressed to impressed for an important board meeting or conference.

Beautiful bottle and good longevity.  Try this one out first if you can before purchasing if possible.
summary: Lovely bottle but not an everyday fragrance

reviewText:
Im going to have to go against the grain here.  I didn't care for this perfume.  The bottle design screamed out 1980s drug store perfume (think Electric Youth from Debbie Gibson).  When the perfume first went on, I found it to have too strong of a musk smell with just a hint of floral.

I realize that perfume is different for different people, but I didn't have the experience of other reviewers who said the musk scent faded and the floral smell stuck around.  I found that very quickly all scent was gone.  For me, this perfume just didn't have staying power at all.  I even put on what I considered a lot of it (4-5 sprays) and it was gone in no time.

I did give it two stars simply because the price is good and the quantity is great for perfume.  If it works for you, its a great deal.

How do you review a scent? This is such a subjective thing, but my wife likes it and that's what's important. On first spray I thought it was too strong but it faded into a very pretty perfume. It doesn't smell new and chic, it smells elegant and refined. To me the smell is at contrast with the packaging. The zebra print and bright red makes me think it will have sharp, maybe citrus smells, but instead the smells are floral, fruity, with a soft edge. And I feel that's so subjective that I don't want to knock it for that opinion. I think it's fancy, sensual, feminine--more exotic than exciting.

I do think the packaging is really nice and perfect for gifting. The black and white "zebra stripes" on the outside of the box are embosses. Then when you open it there is a cherry red cardboard that envelopes the perfume bottle. The bottle and the lid are both glass. The zebra print is right on the glass as well as the Josie Natori logo. The button pump is a little darker--maybe a metallic ruby red? Even thought the pump button has a metallic look, it feels like plastic. The bottom of the bottle says "MADE IN U.S.A." which is a always nice to see. The perfume bottle has a nice heft to it.

Overall the wife likes it, and I think it smells good on her. I don't think she'll be wearing it daily but rather save it for a special time where she dresses up.
summary: Something you save for special nights

reviewText: Love it!  Great scent and smells wonderful on my wife!!!

Since fragrance preference is subjective and highly personal, it's a difficult product to review. Based on the description that mentions citrus and floral notes, I was excited about trying Josie by Josie Natori. I tend toward light fragrances - mostly one-note florals. While I enjoy musk tones on others, I don't care for them in my own fragrance choices.

I find Josie to be too heavy, musky and cloying. It smells "old lady" sweet to me and even though I may be an old lady, I don't want to smell like one. ;-) It does become less cloying after an hour or so and it isn't what I would call unpleasant. It's just too much for my taste.

However, to illustrate how highly personal fragrance preferences are, my daughter and one son adore this scent! Both of them have raved about how fabulous I smell when wearing this. Go figure.

I would say that if you enjoy long-lasting scents that are complex, musky and have sweet floral and citrus notes, you may love Josie. If you prefer lighter, one-note scents that aren't musky, this probably isn't the scent for you. But you never know - try some at a fragrance counter!

As a side note, the bottle is interesting and unique with a vaguely Asian feel in black, white and red. It's beautifully boxed and makes a statement on your dressing table.
summary: Fragrance is a very personal thing

reviewText:
Update:
After having this for a few weeks, my wife has mentioned several times how much she loves the scent.
-------------------------------
Smell is a subjective thing but my wife and I both enjoy this scent.  It's very mild and does not overpower..  The scent easily lasts for several hours if you spray it into the air and then walk through it or spray it on your wrists and then rub them together.

The packaging is very attractive and makes this a splendid gift for a loved one.  The bottle and lid are unique and substantial.  It definitely makes an impression and lets you know you've got something special.
summary: mild scent, excellent packaging for gifts

reviewText: My hair is fine and my scalp is dry which necessitates regular deep conditioning.  I liked the aroma of this conditioner and how silky my hair was after using it.  Although it is for coarser hair than mine, it didn't weigh down my hair.  The negatives are that it didn't impart much shininess to my hair.  I also find that it is much more expensive than other brands of conditioners that provide a better finish to my hair.
summary: Pretty good conditioner but not my go-to.

reviewText: This conditioner smells great and is useful for helping tame my hair when it gets too long. It is though a little expensive considering how small the bottle is, so someone one with even onger hair that needs a lot of conditioner may want to keep looking.

This is a good conditioner that has a nice, mild scent. It leaves my hair soft enough. Unfortunately I don't have anything special to say about it - it's nice and works fine but it doesn't stand out in any particular way compared to other decent quality conditioners I've used. I got this as a sample for review so didn't pay money for it, but I am surprised at the cost. To me it doesn't feel or work differently from other less expensive conditioners I've used.
summary: Good condition though nothing extraordinary or unusual

reviewText: Great!  I no longer have to go to the nail salon.  Thanks!
summary: Great! I no longer have to go to the ...

reviewText: This is the best makeup cleaner that I have ever used!  I have sensitive skin, so I have to be very careful about what kind of skin products that I can use.  This is the first time that I have tried any kind of a gel cleanser and it works great.  My daughter and I both used it and loved it.  She applies lots of makeup from primer to sealing spray, so she has to use a good makeup remover to get it all off without scrubbing.  I like to use waterproof makeup products and it still removed all of it without any problems.  It has a very light fragrance that doesn't bother you and goes away quickly.  My skin was very soft and smooth after using this without applying any moisturizer.  I love the pump because it makes it very easy to administer.  I still like to rinse my face after using this.  I would recommend this to anyone looking for a top quality makeup remover.

Simply wet your face apply the cleaner and then pat dry, it seemed a little odd not to rise this off and I used it about 3 times a week with no adverse reactions but I felt like my face was getting dry
Keep in mind how your skin reacts to products before you buy

I keep trying micellar water products in the hope that I'll like them, and I keep ending up disappointed. Everyone (including in the reviews here on Amazon) raves about it, but this couldn't even take off my non-waterproof eyeliner.

The instructions on the bottle are extremely vague:  "Apply to a wet face. No rinsing." I'm not a big fan of makeup removers that you don't need to rinse off because it seems counterintuitive to me. You're trying to get all that residue off of your face, and what better way to do that than with a rinse? Even if I use a wet wipe to remove my makeup, 9 times out of 10 I'll wash my face afterward to get the leftover residue off. So I ended up experimenting a bit with this one: I tried rinsing, but that didn't seem to help with the actual makeup removal. I tried wiping with a soft washcloth and with cotton pads, and I still had to really go at my eye makeup to get it off. And even if I used a cloth or cotton with the micellar water gel, if I used toner afterward, I could still see makeup coming off on the cotton pad.

I really like La Roche-Posay products and I really want to like micellar water products, but... this just didn't do it for me. I still had to use a separate eye makeup remover on non waterproof makeup; using this on waterproof liner and mascara just made me look like a panda.
summary: Just doesn't remove eye makeup well enough

reviewText:
Very subtle, light scent -- "seaberry" doesn't smell too much like berries, just lightly fruity.  I honestly don't really smell it after my hair is dry, so it definitely doesn't clash with perfume or any other scents.

The conditioning is a very good level for my very fine hair.  I have blonde hair, and anything too heavy also makes it seem dirty or appear to have buildup or oil faster -- that isn't a problem with this conditioner.  If my hair is especially tangly or dry (such as after swimming or a very windy day, I may mix it up and use a heavier conditioner (like Pantene Smooth n' Sleek), but the Obliphica is awesome for everyday use.  It is very rich and thick as compared to other conditioners, it is definitely not watered down.  It is easy to spread just on the areas you want it, if you prefer to target your conditioner more towards the ends of your hair.

The bottle is compact, which actually makes it nice for carrying along on a trip or to the gym...it also has a shorter, perfectly round, squat shape, which makes it not topple over and hit my foot (a pet peeve!).  The pump works very well, only problem is that it may take slightly longer if you use a lot of conditioner -- not because it clogs, just because it "rises" after a pump relatively slowly.  Although, usually the ones that rise up quickly end up with large air pockets inside the bottle, so they're not much faster in the long run.

Overall, a very nice, rich feeling conditioner that makes my hair soft and well conditioned, but not weighed down.  Not an overly fruity scent, but clean and light.
Great!  I no longer have to go to the nail salon.  Thanks!
summary: Great! I no longer have to go to the ...

reviewText: Great price and I love having it shipped to me.
Works great!  Better than the original top coat.
Good , hard to stay committed

I have been using this product with its sister product "clear" for about 6 months and it does seem to have made a slight difference in the tone and texture of my skin.  Wrinkles seem smoother and redness/dark spots seem not as bad BUT...i was really hoping for more of a change after 6 months.  The cream goes on smooth and didn't cause any issues with my skin having allergies to it.  Overall I was pleased but hoped for more of difference at this price point.  I had another similarly priced cream that make more of a difference.
summary: Work slowly but not as much as hoped

reviewText: I wanted to use this to brighten my skin a little, but this stuff burned my sensitive skin and I couldn't use it.
summary: I wanted to use this to brighten my skin a ...

reviewText: I ordered the color Candid. Very light but easy to blend. As a fair skinned, blue eyed blonde I needed a subtle color. However next time I would choose a more pigmented option.
Perfect application!  Smooth, blended well, and provided stunning results.  The concealer offered complete coverage without feeling caked on.

I find this product interesting as it contains two products in a single tube form, with a tinted moisturizer in the squeeze tube and a concealer cream inside the flip-top cap. The shade is just about right for my medium complexion.

The moisturizer has a creamy lotion-like consistency and is easy to apply. It gets absorbed well and feels lightweight on the skin. The SPF20 is a plus to me. The concealer appears to be a tad heavy and creamy. It spreads smoothly on the skin and does a pretty good of concealing slight imperfections on the skin. Though at times it feels somewhat thick and cakey, especially wearing it for the whole day.

The flip-top cap has a 1" circular mirror in it. I find it rather hard to use since it's small and recessed in the cap.

Overall, it is a good product. I have better moisturizers and concealers at home but this combo serves my needs when I just need something for the day that is easy to use and convenient to carry in the purse.
summary: Quality moisturizer and concealer in one product

reviewText: I have had a lot of success wearing this product.  By the picture it looked like it would be too dark but it is perfect.  i apply while my moisturizer is still moist on my face and I do not apply a lot of the product.  I found it to be sheer yet complimentary.  It was very comfortable to wear.
summary: By the picture it looked like it would be too dark but it is perfect

reviewText:
I am a 38 year old Caucasian with dry up normal skin. I have a light skin tone but tan well in the summer. The #4 shade was a close match for my tanned skin.
I liked the feel of the tinted moisturizer. It applied well and blended in nicely.  The added spf protection is an added bonus.
The concealer I did not like. It was too heavy and felt like I had a lot more make up in one area than another.
The combo just did not work well for me.
I did like the packaging of the concealer being on the cap with a mirror. However I also wonder if you Would throw the concealer away when tinted moisturizer is gone or keep an empty bottle to keep the concealer on. You could keep it separate but the way I sparingly use concealer it would last me a while.
summary: Tinted moisturizer is great - concealer I'm not a fan of

reviewText: Love this concealer/foundation! Beautiful results leaving me looking and feeling ultra feminine. I give this five stars and a big thumbs up!

I have very fair skin, so the medium was a bit dark for my complexion. That being said, this is a very nice product and i would like to try it in a lighter color.

It is a very luxurious feeling cream and has a pleasant and subtle vanilla scent. There was no streaking and though a bit dark for me, it looks natural. I do use self-tanners and this is the best feeling and looking face tanner I've used so far. It's obviously high quality and I had no adverse effects while using it.  I will definitely be purchasing a lighter color to try it out. Recommended

This product is effective for both men and women.  However, for me, I end up with orangy skin rather than tan skin.  It does wash off easily, probably too easily for people who want a longer listing tan.  So it's okay, but just that.

I have olive skin and was hoping to achieve a little evening out of my skin tone. I also like my summer tan (I use sunblock bit when you are olive skinned it still tans a bit) to last a bit longer. This is easy enough to apply and has a pleasant, non lingering scent.
I am careful to even it out and wash my hands right away. It looks ok and works with my skin tone. I am not one to use it everyday so I probably don't get the full effect. It does wash off a bit and you definitely need to wash your face at night before putting it on a pillow.
summary: Looks Good With My Olive Skin Tone

reviewText: I've used this product a total of four times over 5 weeks and I'm still undecided as to whether I actually like it.  I do enjoy having a little color to my face without the harmful effects of the Sun and while this does give me a little bit of a glow that's not too orange, it's not exactly natural either.  Application is easy and the color is gradual which is nice. Overall I will most likely continue to use this bottle until gone, but for the price and results I don't know that I would buy a bottle to replace it.
summary: Gives an almost natural glow to your face

reviewText:
This is a pretty good tanner for your face.  Upon initial application, it feels light and has a pleasant scent.  It goes on easy and readily, and I didn't have a problem with it feeling gunky or anything.

I usually apply it under makeup.  I didn't have a problem with it ever looking orange or anything, and I do have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate it at all.

The only thing I didn't like was that a few hours after application, it has that same unpleasant aroma that ever tanner has.  I assume it's just the component that gives it its tanning ability, but I would prefer if it were masked a little better.

Overall though, it's nice, not streaky, it didn't stain my hands.  (Sometimes even after washing, it'll still leave stains and get under the nail beds.)  I really like it, and I'd definitely recommend it.

This is a decent self tanner that won't harm your skin but may give it a bit of an orange shade for awhile.  I am not talking the infamous orange of QT from years ago but a little orange. Aside from the slight orange tone it leaves skin quite natural looking., This stuff has a very nice vanilla fragrance.  Remember you can'r get your face wet until three hours after applying.

I have a fair complexion, and I'm generally fine with it. Occasionally, though, a slight tan would be nice. My problem is that if I go in the sun, no matter what I do, I burn. So I slather on the sunscreen and realize I'm never going to be a golden girl.

Xen-Tan is an interesting product. It goes on easily, and it really does create the illusion of a tan. But from the few times I have gotten any kind of tan (usually from when my burned skin gave up the ghost and resigned itself to tanning), I don't recall there ever being any orange cast to it. Let me be clear: I don't look like a popsicle with Xen-Tan. The orangey thing is light, but it is noticeable.

If you're OK with that, this may be the way to go for a good faux tan. I'm sure most people aren't as picky as I am with this sort of thing. For the average person, the tan is fairly realistic.
summary: Probably good for most people; on me, it pulls orangey

reviewText:
I applied this after my normal moisturizing routine in the morning and I was surprised that it gave me a really nice color and I didn't need to apply my normal foundation.  I applied some highlighter and my face looked really nice and the color held until night when I washed my face and the color seemed to go away as well as the evidence on my makeup remover wipes.

I didn't have any negative effects on my skin, its a nice product.  It's more like a foundation though although all the color didn't leave at night, and the color did build each day to a nice color overall.  I did notice on the fifth day some blotches near my hair line and I didn't like that so I decided not to continue using daily, just as needed.  Overall for me its a nice foundation and gives my face a nice light tan color but a little pricey to continue using all the time...
summary: Worked like a nice foundation with my skin tone/type!

reviewText: This is a beautiful perfume! I've been getting compliments for weeks wearing this scent.  It's not overpowering but subtle. It has a nice refreshing scent, a bit floral, fruity and musky.  I think it's a sensuous scent that just makes you feel good wearing it.  The bottle is the diamond on my vanity. The top just glitters with it's facets and gold, and the glass vessel just lets light shine through it.  I would definitely purchase this perfume, the price point is excellent as the scent lasts all day. A little goes a long way and I just love it!
summary: Scent lasts all day and is very sassy and sultry!

reviewText: Perfumes are hard to review since everyone's preferences are different.  I am sure everyone has sat next to someone with an overpowering perfume and thought "too much".  I don't think anyone will find this overpowering, but it is a very sweet scent.  This product does have lasting power.  I put some on in the morning, and could still notice it when I went to be and laid my arm near my face.  It is not my favorite, but since everyone's body chemistry is different you may love it.

Recently, my parents came to visit me.  It was Moms birthday and I gave her a 0.60 pound bottle of I am Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum Spray from Juicy Couture.  She prefers eau de toilette over perfume and eau de parfum.  There is a difference.  Perfume has the highest concentration of perfume essences, eau de parfum has the second, and eau de toilette has the third.  Perfume is longer lasting.  However, women choose according to the fragrances interaction to their skin and the climate in which they live.  Normally, Mom purchases Chloe Eau de Toilette Spray for herself.  She has delicate skin that is sensitive to high concentrations of perfume essences.

  The I am Juicy Couture came well packaged in an attractive cardboard box that was easy to open.  We saved the box in order to protect the bottle when Mom traveled back home.  It was easy to put the bottle back inside the box and reseal it.  The bottle is extremely gorgeous and elegant.  It would look great sitting on any womans vanity.  Most importantly, its scent is very flowery and feminine.  It lasted surprisingly long for an eau de parfum.  Mom sprayed some on her neck when we went shopping at Greenbrier Mall on a Sunday afternoon.  About four hours later, when we returned to my condo, I could still detect it.  For fun, when we were meandering through Sears, I sprayed some designer fragrances on my wrists.  They had vanished by the time I returned home.

  Mom was very pleased with her gift of I am Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum Spray from Juicy Couture.  It does smell sweet and flowery and juicylike a piece of juicy fruit, such as an overripe peach basking beneath the Georgia sun.  Before leaving to go home to Tennessee, Mom laughed and said to me, You write in your review that I went to the mall and the old men threw down their canes and threw aside their walkers and went after me when they smelled that Juicy Couture.  Well that didn't happen.  However, Mom has been wearing this eau de parfum for nearly two weeks now and her delicate skin hasn't experienced any adverse side effectsno hives, no rashes and no itching.  I highly recommend the I am Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum Spray from Juicy Couture.  It would make a wonderful present on any occasion.
summary: I am Juicy Couture is a Sweet, Feminine Eau de Parfum Spray Inside an Elegant Bottle; it is Suitable for a Queens Boudoir!

reviewText: I am almost out of my tube now and am planning to purchase. I love this sunscreen because it gives my skin a little life, a little tint, so it gives me that "no makeup" look. It does slightly even out the skintone, but doesn't have a lot of coverage. When I first tried it I thought it looked way too dark/orange, but it is so sheer that it just gives a nice tint. Don't be afraid of it. It's kind of like a bronzing base, but I struggle to even label it that because it sounds too severe. It feels very smooth and silicone-y, as most "mattifying" products do. I feel it keeps my skin matte enough, but being matte all day isn't really a concern of mine. I've never become greasy looking while wearing this so I suppose it does work. It just looks like skin. All while having amazing spf 50+. And the tube has lasted me forever. If you're looking for a tinted sunscreen that gives your skin a sunkissed pick me up, look no further. I love it and would heartily recommend it to a friend looking for a tinted sunscreen. Unless they were extremely fair, I would recommend it to them. I have a light medium skin tone with warm undertones.

I never used to use sunblock on a regular basis, but since I'm getting older, I'm trying to take better care of my face. This has the slightest tint to it, not even really noticeable. That's fine though, because I use it for a sunblock/primer application. The resveratrol in it is a great antioxidant for your skin. I've noticed that this also doesn't sting when I start to sweat. Plays nice with makeup. The price tag is a bit hefty, but a little goes a long way, and it IS the only face you'll get.
summary: Doesn't sting, wears well under makeup

reviewText: I live in a very hot climate (Hawaii) so it's hard not to look shiny all the time and most sunscreens make it worse.  This matte makeup is excellent at minimizing the shine while looking very natural (I find some matte makeup make my skin look kind of plastic.)  It manages to add spf50 without making it heavy which works well in warm weather.  This Replenix ticks all the boxes for me!

This is a gorgeous highlighter. I ordered the Patina color. The bronze color mixed in with the golden highlight helps to make sure that the highlighter blends well with your skin while still highlighting the desired areas gorgeously. I really like this for highlighting my cheeks. I also like to highlight the area above my lips in the center and the inner part of my eyes. This product works for that too. I just use a small brush like an eyeshadow brush to apply it there.

This highlighter is huge and will last for a really long time. The Vincent Longo brand seems to be a great brand. The highlighter seems to be really well made. It is a little pricey at $32 per highlighter. I will say that I like a different highlighter better for my smaller areas and I could just use that one on my cheeks. Therefore, I probably would not buy this one again. I am happy to have it though. If you are looking for a new highlighter, I would recommend trying it.

i don't use makeup that often but when i do this completed my look. soft but smooth to apply and you only need a little bit to give your skin that extra glow to just make you feel sexy and ready for a night out!

I was a little unsure of this powder from the picture on Amazon because the pattern reminded me a bit of dog kibble or some weird skin disease, but I'm glad I ordered it because the picture doesn't do it justice.  The pattern on the highlighter I received was much more pleasing to look at in person than the featured photo here.  It really doesn't do it justice.

My winter skin can look a bit flat and dull so I've been sweeping it on the apples of my cheeks, the bridge of my nose, and along the tops of my lips with a fluffy powder brush.  It gives the perfect amount of glow to my neutral-toned light/medium skin.  It's just enough to make my skin look healthy and awake, but not so much that it looks glittery or unnatural.

I also like that it wears well throughout the day.  I apply a bit of setting spray afterwards (Urban Decay) and it still looks great hours later, even after a workout.

Would recommend.

I'm a big fan of Vincent Longo products and this one is definitely a favorite. I love the fact that it is buildable so you can choose how much highlight to apply. I definitely recommend using a fan brush because it gives the best finish. I'm only giving it 4 stars because I think it's a little too pricey.
summary: ... Vincent Longo products and this one is definitely a favorite. I love the fact that it is buildable ...

reviewText:
A little bit of highlighter goes A LONG WAY - so basically you'll be using this pallet for the rest of your life.

This goes on well, is CLEARLY present (so go easy), and adds a little bit of subtle brightness to your face.

This does not come with a brush or applicator of any kind, so I used a small brush I had from one of my sets. You could definitely use your ring finger too for blending, though.

This is such a lovely highlighter!  As you can see from the attached photo, it has multiple colors in it, and creates a lovely, soft glow.  I'm slightly obsessed with highlighters and have quite a few in my collection, and this one reminds me the most of Jaclyn Hill's Becca  Champagne Pop highlighter.

I'm fair and cool-toned (I wear MAC foundation in NW20), and this adds a nice warmth to my skin.  It also doesn't cake up or feel chalky on my skin, which is important since I'm in my mid-40's and worry about powders settling into my fine lines.

I'm really impressed with this!
excellent

yes, this sunscreen is expensive. But, for a high quality product that actually does what I need it to -- it is amazing! The sunscreen kept me protected and my face did not look greasy after applying.

I've been using the Japanese Aqua Biore sunscreen for my face recently because the texture is so light and unobtrusive, but since that's only a chemical sunscreen, and I am often out in the field working and unable to reapply every 2 hours on the dot, I appreciate the added mineral protection from this product.

This is a moisturizing sunscreen and seems thick enough I would only use a really light moisturizer underneath it. It doesn't smell rancid as so many sunscreen creams to do me, and it goes on nicely and sinks in well without too oily of a feel. You can feel it is there but it is not as heavy as Neutrogena for example.

I really like this overall, but of course given the higher end price tag I would stick to using this on the face and neck/ chest and not on the rest of the body.

The Skinmedica Total Defense Sunscreen works well with my wifes facial skin. Some of the face lotions with screen out there makes her face dry, this does not. She said it applies easily and does not have any scent which she prefers.

When it comes to protecting your skin in the summer, using the right sunscreen with UVA/UVB protection is of the uptmost importance. However, if thats all it has, it won't be enough. Your sunscreen also needs to protect skin from infrared-A (aka IRA) rays as well, and heres why. Besides the sun, these rays can also come from less-obvious places. When you blow-dry your hair, or even get a gel manicure, your skin is exposed to them. IRA rays travel even deeper into skin than UVA and UVB rays, causing free radicals that further accelerate skin aging. What you're left with are fine lines and wrinkles no matter how much sunscreen you're putting on.  With all that said, we now understand why we need sunscreen. Sunscreen is now the new skincare standard.  We must use sunscreen to fight aging.  In paricular, we must use a sunscreen with infrared protection.  I have been using Goop sunscreen in SPF 40 and find it amazing.  It is clear, weightless, scentless and oil free.  I have never had a breakout using it.  It always goes on smooth and I never have to worry about my foundation applied on top, balling or pilling or just making a general mess of my face.  With the Skinmedica, I had the same results.  It however is not clear, nor scentless and I did have a few break outs when first using it.  The price of the Skinmedica is $57.80.  The price of the Goop is $28.00.  So the question is, why would I buy a product that works the same, has no other benefits over the other, has less SPF and costs quite a bit more?  The answer is simple.  I will continue to buy the Goop.
summary: Way too pricey for a sunscreen!

reviewText: This is the kind of sun screen that I prefer. You apply it under your makeup and then if you are going to be out in direct sunlight, you reapply it every two hours.  The ingredients are typical for Skinmedica products, very excellent ones that are healthy for your skin.  I like it very much.
summary: Excellent ingredients and practical to apply under makeup, reapply every 2 hours if you are in direct sunlight. Excellent!

reviewText: We went to a swim party last week and my wife too this along to give it the first go.  She said it goes on smoothly, smells good, she didn't get any sunburn... all the things you're looking for... no heavy white coating on her face.  She wore minimal makeup on top of the sunscreen, but didn't mention that, I just saw it.  She did say it made her face slippery when she got wet, but no complaints about that.  Overall she gave it an A.
summary: Good product for my wife's face

reviewText:
First off, if you're looking for standard sunscreen, look elsewhere.  This is definitely not your everyday, average sunscreen.  If you're looking for something to wear daily to protect your face and you have the cash for a higher end product, than this might be for you.

I hate putting on sunscreen every day as I feel like it always makes my face oily.  This definitely fixes that problem, as it doesn't leave a residue like most standard sunscreen, yet still offers 34 SPF protection.  I'm very fussy about fragrances and found this one to truly be almost fragrance free and not at all offensive if you're sensitive.  It's light enough to be worn under foundation if you regularly use that.  Overall, its a nice product, if you're not put off by the price
Great for dry skin works really well and smells great

I love this shower oil.  It feels SO creamy and rich and does a good job of cleaning skin without stripping moisture or irritating.  It also has a nice, unisex smell so both my fianc and I have one bottle of body wash we can agree on.  And because it's so rich a little goes a long way and we've been using this one bottle for a few months even though it's summer and we shower very regularly.

I've been using this product the last 3 months and have not seen any change in my skin.  Like another reviewer mentioned, instructions weren't clear on the product so I went online looking for more information.  I was not a big fan of the texture of the product on my skin but did like the feel of my face after it was removed.  I was hopeful for results but have not seen any change.  Back to Rodan and Fields products for me.
summary: Hopeful, but no change after using for months

reviewText: This is the second time I am trying a product from this company and I feel like directions are one thing that are never clear. You look on the box, in the box, on the website and I feel like one is always a little different from the other. It feels good going on and is easy to apply. You twist the top and apply from the center of your face in outward strokes, after it's applied you close the applicator and massage your face in zigzag motions carefully paying attention to problem spots. Leave on for 10 minutes and wipe excess with cotton pad or cotton pad soaked in toner. I always used a toner, I didn't feel like a dry cotton pad would've did the trick to remove the product. It smells good, it leaves your face feeling soft, and as I'm always hopeful to try a new product that offers great results, I just can't say I notice my skin any plumper. It is rather expensive, so I can't say I will be giving it another try. I will continue using the rest of it. The tube will last more than a month. Sorry to say I'm just not a fan.
summary: Haven't noticed much of a difference in my skin!!!

reviewText:
NUXE ANTI-AGING NUXURIANCE MASK ROLL-ON, 1.6 FL OZ is a unique way to apply a mask. One that I wish was incorporated in other mask products. Its easy to apply, feels light, and is clear. Its easy to remove and leaves your skin soft and glowing.
Product Description
Immediately (1), this roll-on mask with millions of bi-floral cells (active molecules from precious saffron flower encapsulated in a bougainvillea cell, with targeted and continuous action) works to smooth the skin and revive radiance.
