In just 28 days (), the skin is re-plumped and firmer, it looks rested; (1)the oval of the face seems reshaped. (1): use test conducted under dermatological supervision with 32 volunteers over 28 days.

I love the applicator on this. It allows the lotion to be rolled on easily and evenly, without wasted amounts. You roll on the lotion, wait 10 minutes and wipe off with damp cotton. The 10 minutes the lotion was on was comfortable - neither tightening nor making my skin greasy. When I wiped it off, my skin was left soft and smooth. I don't know if my skin looked plumper or younger, but it certainly felt that way. A very nice mask.
summary: Love the applicator and leaves skin soft

reviewText:
Nuxe is a brand I got introduced to in a Sephora skin care kit a few years ago. Their quality is on the middling side of high-end skin care, which is to say they are good, but IMHO, probably not worth the price they charge.  I have never been so overwhelmed by their products as to purchase them full size, but if I received a sample, I'd probably use it if a favorite moisturizer, serum, or other skin care product was unavailable.

That being said, this mask was one of the more unusual ones I've seen in any line. I'm surprised that no one has thought of it sooner. The delivery system is nifty. A turn of the top and you roll on the proper portion of the gel-like mask to take care of your skin for the evening. It has a strong perfumey scent that I like; be warned if you're allergic to strong scent, this will put you in the ER!

I use Retin A, glycolic acid, and Vitamin C on a daily basis, as well as a Clarisonic, and various scrubs and exfoliators, so my skin is about as good as it gets, product-wise. I'm in the age bracket, though, where I'm always interested in any product that will tighten up my epidermis, so this mask was of particular interest.

I haven't used it quite a month, but so far, I can say I notice a minimal lifting effect. Let's put it this way: it's so minimal, I'm apparently the only one who has noticed it (my husband looked at me as if I had two heads when I asked him if he saw a huge change in my skin.) Now I'm not against a product that only gives a small reward, if it's one YOU notice and works for you. I daresay if you have crepier skin than me, or if you haven't gone whole hog with anti-aging skin care as I have, you might experience a bigger oomph.

I'm going to stick with my Retin A/glycolic acid/Vitamin C regimen, because as far as I'm researched and in my own experience, these are the products that really work. (I mean REALLY work, as in scientifically proven.) FWIW, they're also cheaper.
summary: It's OK, particularly if you aren't already invested in a good skin care regimen

reviewText: I received this as a sample to test, but after trying it once I will not be using it again.  The smell is light but persistent - it smells vaguely of rotting fruit and once you've wiped the mask off per the instructions, the smell remains.  I had to wash my face twice before I could get the smell off my skin.  It also left my skin feeling greasy but washing it helped with that, too.  It may work wonders on my skin, but I'll never know because now that I've gotten the smell and the greasy feeling off my skin I will not be trying it again!
summary: Between the odor and the greasy feel, I'm not impressed...

reviewText: I don't see any change in my skin.  Nor has anyone commented on any change.  It smells wonderful, but it doesn't seem to make any difference whether I use it or not.
summary: It smells wonderful, but it doesn't seem to make any difference ...

reviewText: I love the application of this mask. It definitely seems more like a serum, but I really like the cooling effect and feel of the roller. It does pill off if you apply too much and I don't see the point of "wiping it off with a cotton round". I just do a light application and leave it to sink in. It's not working wonders but I'll keep using it to see the lasting effect.

It does plump the skin and make it look nicer at least until it is washed off. It is a thin type of product, almost like a serum that absorbs quickly. It doesn't pill or feel tacky on the skin. I don't like the scent, it isn't overpowering and it does fade over time but upon application it smells perfume like and I don't like perfume on any product that is close to my nose. I don't like it, I prefer no scent or a light natural scent. Most of the info is in another language which would be OK if the English were easier to see. I couldn't find instructions for this unless I missed it in the jumble of languages. It does make my skin feel soft and supple but to me it doesn't seem like it is doing anything when it is rinsed off or washed off. The plumping for me only lasted a few hours.

I had to shake and massage the tube to get the ingredients to combine and not be runny but once the consistency was right, the cream was terrific. It doesn't make my skin feel tight the way some oily skin moisturizers do.  The finish is soft and supple and worked well as a base for make up or on its own.
summary: Matte finish is soft and supple

reviewText:
Sbium MAT Control is a moisturizing product that keeps your skin hydrated for up to eight hours. It really works well, goes on just like an ordinary lotion, but works so much better. It conceals by closing up your pores. Look younger while moisturizing!

Recommended to reapply 2-3 times each day for best results. Works great for any season!

Summary:
(1) Paraben free
(2) Hypoallergenic
(3) Scented formula
(4) Non-comedogenic

Brand Story
BIODERMA has acquired unique expertise by placing biology at the service of dermatology.

I generally love bioderma products, but found this one irritated my skin just a bit.

I found the consistency of the cream very nice - it smoothed in well - and the light scent was pleasant.

Unfortunately, I just didn't like the way it stung my skin a bit.

Big fan of their other products, but this one just didn't work well for me.

I cannot even begin to tell you what this product has done for me! I use this right after I shower, it soaks in very quickly and leaves my skin matte soft. I use it as a primer for my make up and it does exactly that. My make up goes right on top, and it STAYS matte for most of the day. It also has been great for my skin, which is really sensitive to any low quality skin products.
summary: It also has been great for my skin

reviewText: I have combo skin with an oily T-zone, and this serum helps keep my shine at bay.  It did, however, irritate my sensitive skin a bit, as it seems to have for other reviewers.  If I use a small amount, it seems to be alright, but I will most likely give this away since I worry about a reaction to it.

The stuff that I use to prevent razor bumps on my chin really dries out my normally oily skin, and this Bioderma cream works great for me.  It works great as a moisturizer on my face and it leaves a really nice matte feeling.  I don't feel greasy or oily after applying it.
Great pigment, sheer but not invisible, generous pan size, really love this.  Going back for different shades.

The pallet it self is great. And there is no say about its quality, LORAC it just perfect in pigmentation. I must say my favorite color in the pallet is burgundy. Its really hard to find that shade, I love it, the other colors Are also great but even if they weren't I would still buy this pallet just for the burgundy, thats how great it is.
This works great in between shampoos and keeps my hair supple. I love this product!

Other than being quite pricey this is a really nice product.  It's designed as a cleanser, which I take to mean a shampoo + conditioner type of product (but not really your basic all in one).  This does a really good job of cleaning your hair while also still leaving it nice and conditioned.  The smell is also really nice (ORIBE also has a couple of fragrances).
summary: Other than being quite pricey this is a really nice product. It's designed as a cleanser

reviewText:
This is a fantastic set to try out. I was more than a bit skeptical about the Incredi-peel pads. I've used other OTC Glycolic Acid peels and they've all been AWFUL. Seriously they were just about as strong as water and they did nothing.  However, these pads really work!!!! I have very sensitive skin, so there was a bit of very mild stinging (nothing like prior TCA peels I've had at the dermatologist). My skin felt noticably smoother afterwards! This is powerful stuff but not scary. The instructions advise you not to go out in the sun after using it just like the dermatologist does.

The Triple Oxygen +C Energizing Cream which is described as: A lightweight gel-cream that hydrates, brightens, and instantly revives dull, stressed skin. It smells like baby aspirin and goes on like buttah!!! It instantly gets absorbed and makes my skin feel like velvet. No redness, no burning, no gloopy skin feel. I LOVE this too and will order more.

Lastly the Foaming Face Wash, which isn't my favorite.  My skin felt very dry after using it but the Triple Oxygen +C cream fixed it right away. Not so sure I'd use it again but I wanted to try them all for a week.

Over all, love these products and so does my super sensitive skin!

Great product! I would buy again. I really liked the "that's incredi-peel". I could tell a difference in the fine lines on my face and felt my skin was firmer overall. This product did make face red and dry. I tend to be more sensitive than the average person, so I just used the peels once a week. I still feel like I got a great result and spacing the use out really helped my sensitive skin. I would give the peels 5 stars. The other included products worked as advertised, but didn't feel like anything special to me.

his kit contains 3 products. A cleanser, a peel, and a moisturizer.
The cleanser is supposed to be a foaming cleanser, but it did not foam at all. No matter, foaming is probably just a gimmicky feature anyway. I do like the cleanser. It has a very fine exfoliant in it that you can just barely feel, but nothing harsh like you would find in a scrub. It cleanses well and rinses well.
There are 5 peels that are individually sealed in little packets. The instructions say to use it each night. But, like I said, there are only 5. I found that if you put it back in the packet and fold over the packet and seal it well, it will stay wet and usable a few times. When I used the peel, I felt a little tingling on my skin that lasted a few minutes.
The final product is the vitamin C day cream. I did not like the smell of this cream. It has a strong lemony scent that reminds me of furniture polish. I kept using this cream daily anyway. It works well has a moisturizer. It is not too heavy or greasy. Unfortunately, this cream does not contain a sunscreen so I still have to apply my sunscreen on top of it.
summary: nice set, but I don't like the strong lemony scent

reviewText: I do suffer from occasional breakouts, and Im at the stage where Im starting to notice fine lines. One skin care regimen to rule them all sounds like a great plan, but it fell a bit short for me. I have mildly sensitive skin, and while Ive used peels before, *this* peel is definitely not for me. It lit my skin up like a Christmas tree. The irritation also made my skin break out in a mild rash, so skip this step for sure if your skin is in any way problem prone. The Face Wash and Day Cream both worked well for me, but it does reduce the value of the kit when you're only able to use 2/3 of it. Keep in mind and buy separately if youd like to err on the side of being cautious.

I ordered this product from the Vine program because  I am one of those people who have acne and wrinkles...aarrggghhh!  I have breakouts during "that-time-of-the-month" and I thought that it would be good to try this product because it included a cleanser, light moisturizer and the glycolic-acid pads.
On the first evening that I used the pads, I noticed a stinging and tightening sensation on my face.  The next morning I noticed that there seemed to be a slight irritation on my forehead and cheeks.  The next evening, I cut the pads in half and I used only half of the pad for my entire face and the backs of my hands.  That seemed to cut the irritation down and I also noticed a decrease in the size of the pimples on my lower jawline.  The backs of my hands also looked smoother after five or so days.
I will have to give another update after finishing the entire bottle of cleanser, but after one week of using the entire system, my skin is a bit clearer and I even have smoother looking hands.
summary: Smoother looking skin on face and backs of hands

reviewText:
Ok let me start by saying that I was very unhappy when my package arrived. GRRRRR! There is nothing like having 1/2 a bottle of face wash oozing all over the package. But the face wash comes without a lid inside a box and that is exactly what happened. The entire box was sudsy and I had to wrestle with the packaging to pull things out and it was a big sticky mess - not to mention the leakage took away 1/2 of the cleanser.

Despite feeling like throwing out the entire messy package, I pulled out everything and wiped it off. That night I started with the incredi-peel and I have to say I was just amazed by how much nicer my skin felt the next morning and it even looked smoother in the mirror. This continued on for several nights till I ended up ordering a box of the peel pads!

All is forgiven with the lousy packaging. I love this product and it seems to work wonders. There are only 5 pads in this kit but I can't wait to see how my skin looks after a few weeks as it looked so smooth after just the few applications. I also cut each pad in half to make them last longer.

Overall, I have to give this product 5 stars just because I am so impressed with the results despite the not so great packaging.

Great value in this Bliss 'bright' face kit.  This facial kit includes a 6.7 fl oz foaming face wash, 5 incredi-peel glycolic acid resurfacing pads and a 1.7oz jar of vitamin C day cream.  I find the foaming face wash, combined with my clarisonic to adequately remove my makeup.  My skin feels soft and refreshed after use.  I have not used the glycolic acid pads because of a prescription cream I use; I was advised not to combine the two.  I apply the vitamin C cream in the morning under my foundation and it absorbs quickly into the skin.  If you price out the items individually, you will discover the value of this set!  It comes in a nice box for gift giving.

This Bliss Brightening Kit works very well. I am finding that the cleanser though gentle is a bit drying as is the peel pads but the included Vitamin C Cream works to sooth the dryness. The cleanser and the cream are full sized products but there are only 5 peel pads in the kit. The peel pads are very well saturated and I've used one peel pad per week. I use a quarter of it and then fold it up and put it back into the pack and it keeps nicely until my next application.

This product reduces pores, refines fine wrinkles and cleanses and moisturizes wonderfully. I am more used to using a face cleanser that has some exfoliating but when I use a loofa sponge, this cleanser, while drying, works great for me.

All in all, this is a great kit for more mature skin.

I loved the cleaner and day cream.  The scent is light and lovely.  The cleaner does not leave my skin tight and washes away nicely.  The day cream is light and does not leave a film (love that) but I mostly use creams at night except on cold, windy or hot days.  The peel has 5 uses only and stings; so this is my least favorite.  I do love the way my skin feels and looks after using the whole system.
Highly recommend despite the price.
summary: I love the way my face feels and looks after using this 3 part system

reviewText:
Diptyque, L'Artisan Parfumeur, and Dayna Decker candles are all in regular rotation in my home. If you are a candle snob, this one's on par with the rest of them in terms of fragrance composition, sillage, and quality. I'd classify Xochimilco as a clean, green, not-too-sweet, fruity-floral. If you're a Baies fan, this scent falls within that family.

But who is Ovando? Well, She's one of the top floral designers in NYC known for artistic, sculptural, flower arrangements. I live right by the Ovando boutique and it's total antithesis of a "florist" -- more like an art gallery: Walk into the dark, black, mysterious parlor to see breathtakingly curved whorls of blooms and stems like abstract paintings. Minimalist yet lush, Ovando creations are a staple at high-profile events around the city for that reason--just do a quick Google image search. I'm so glad to see Ovando extend her brand into fragrance products. No other major floral designer has done that since Robert Isabell, whose perfumes are still highly regarded, though discontinued.

Beautifully boxed, this candle makes a great housewarming gift to someone who appreciates high-end candles or is into flowers/floral design.

Priced to compete with other luxury candles, this is not for the person who's into Bath & Body Works' or Yankee Candles; they may not appreciate it at first. But if you want open their world into the beautiful world of luxury candles, it's a great starting point.

If you love Diptique candles, you'll love this Ovando candle, which is in the same price bracket as Diptique, DL, Barclay and other premium candles.
The scent is fresh and intoxicating, and the minimalist look is chic and on-trend. Clean burning.

The real test will be after it is nearly gone. The true test is if it will remain as fragrant, the way Diptique will. If it does, I think I have a new candle brand in the house!

This candle adds a touch of sophistication. Packaged in a black presentation box with  mustard accents, it features a candle encased in black glass. The spare styling makes it an ideal unisex gift and should blend with most decors. The lush floral scent is accented with a bight of lemon and the tang of mint. It is rich and strong without being overpowering. The spare styling and tantalizing fragrance makes this an ideal gift for either sex. The candle's burn time is approximately 55 hours (although it shouldn't be burned for more than four hours at a time) permitting ample opportunity to enjoy the illumination and perfumed atmosphere.

This is a lovely gift candle, and should be, since it is rather expensive. You won't want this for a daily burner, but to impress someone with a one-time gift, it's quite nice.

Pros:
- Very attractively packaged in black, with everything set perfectly in its place.
- It smells VERY strong. You can smell it across the room even when unlit.
- Lasted quite a while so far, with minimal sputtering or other problems. It's quite a nice candle.

Cons:
- It smells VERY strong. If you're sensitive to smells or perfume, do NOT buy this.

Wonderful packaging - perfect for gift giving!  The box it comes in is so nice you wouldn't even have to wrap it up before giving it to someone!  The matte black cylinder is very modern and the OVANDO name is subtly written in a pleasant font.  Upon opening the box, the fragrance is pleasing but not overwhelming.  I like a good candle that permeates a wonderful fragrance even before lighting it and this does do that but not like my favorite candle, Capri Blue, from Anthropologie.  Even after lighting the candle, it still doesn't put off a noticeable fragrance.  Nice packaging but not worth the price tag.
summary: Nice packaging but needs more obvious fragrance!

reviewText: High end luxe candles are a thing now.  I have received a few as hostess gifts and also give as gifts for those not quite so personal people in my life.  This Ovando candle is one of the BEST, hands down.  If you are looking for FRAGRANCE that is OFF-THE-CHARTS.  Burn this for a few hours and any party will smell delicious.  It's simply fantastic and will last about a month.
summary: Best Fragrance Candle out There - WORTH IT

reviewText: I liked the candle but the fragrance is not as strong as I would have liked it to be and more citrus than floral or even fresh like linen or ocean. It is in a very plain holder (charcoal) with a clear plastic lid which will go with most modern decor but would have to be dressed up a bit if you tend to like more ornate. Comes in a really nice box for gift giving. I gave it 4 stars because it really was not anything special and the scent tended to smell a bit more like a citronella. I would not purchase it again because of my unique preference. Box says it will burn for 55 hours but not to burn for more than 2 hours at a time.

Unlike my other candles, the Ovando candle fills the whole room with its scent. The scent is hard to describe, but I like it a lot. It isn't heavy or overpowering. It's light and smells kind of fruity to me.

The candle itself is medium-sized and looks nice, but I wish that it didn't have the brand's name on it. It's not a sticker that can be removed. It is also waaaay overpriced at $60. There is absolutely no reason it should be that expensive. It also is not supposed to be lit for more than two hours at a time which I thought was strange.

I gave it a four-star rating because I do like it, and it smells great, but I knocked a star off for the price and my other quibbles.

Foremost, this is one of the only self-tanning products that has such a mild smell (thank goodness) and leaves skin bronzed instead of "orange-y." For these reasons alone, the price is 100% justifiable! Likewise, the size and amount of product is fairly impressive and will last quite a while (if one just uses it for a touch of color on one's legs).

This is one of the best (if not THE best) product of its kind. I would not hesitate to purchase this in the future.

This self tanner is pretty good and gives a nice color but it was a little too light for me. I usually use fake bake which is a lot cheaper and it comes with its own mitten. I really like the fact that it's foam and not liquid because I feel like it applies easier.
summary: This self tanner is pretty good and gives a nice color but it was ...

reviewText:
This is a sunscreen that has no scent and feels very natural on the skin, not heavy or sticky or filmy. You apply it and forget that is even there.

It seems like it absorbs very well on the skin.

You need to reapply every two hours, after 40 minutes of swimming or sweating and immediately after towel drying.

It washes off easily with no residue.

It's very effective when reapplied as needed and if you appreciate a natural feeling sunscreen, this is the perfect sunscreen for you.
This sunscreen did its job when I was away on vacation.  Im quite happy with it

I use cologne daily and usually match my cologne with a deodorant with same scent / brand.  Figured I would give the Calvin Klein spray a try.  To me it was a bit stronger than I liked and I seemed to be catching the scent throughout the day.  I think for younger users who are just starting out on trying to smell good this is a far better product than axe but for my taste I think I will pass.
summary: A bit strong for my taste.

reviewerName: BUCK WINTHROP, Author of Ocean Drive-A Novel
reviewText: The air in Southern California is DRY. And, hence, that makes for dry skin. Lotions and creams sometimes are just not enough. Replenix Pure Hydration Hyaluronic Acid is powerhouse product binding water to your skin for round the clock moisture and hydration. In the evening, I use a Topix Glycolix 20% pad (Makers of this product) after cleansing to remove any remaining dirt and dead skin. Then, with wet hands, apply 2-3 drops of the serum in the palms of my hands and massage into my face and neck for several minutes till it is all covered and absorbed. It hydrates immediately and all night long. You can definitely see a difference after just one use, and, greater improvement with continued use. One bottle, if used this way last two months so it is a great value. Topix is an outstanding company of superior products. Many of which pair well or stack with others. You would expect to pay double for triple for a lesser product in a dermatologist or plastic surgeon's office. For sure, a part of my daily grooming routine.
I love this product.. makes my derma pen glide ... I can use it with micro-needling or by itself it does a great job .

This is a wonderfully formulate hyaluronic acid serum, which is absorbed fast into the skin, helps with hydration overnight and makes skin look plum in the morning. Since I only had a sample, I cannot tell much more about the long term results. I don't regret buying the sample (I used the credit for another cosmetic product), I definitely started liking this brand by trying their samples. I compare this to the Paula Choice Hyaluronic booster, which per oz still comes to a similar price; but I would buy the Paula Choice one which is 0.5oz; I prefer to get boosters in smaller sizes, since I take a lot time to finish them and I prefer to have smaller quantities to have a `fresh` product on hand.
summary: Great hyaluronic acid serum, but quite expensive

reviewText: This fragrance is a little too heavy for me, despite being described as "light." For a point of reference, I typically wear the Tory Burch perfume (which is super light!) and I also used to be obsessed with Lacoste's Touch of Pink. However, I did find that while this one seems too heavy right out of the bottle, it's not the kind of perfume that completely inundates you for the whole day and definitely seems lighter once you've been wearing it for a little bit. I sadly didn't get a lot of coconut out of this fragrance and not too much rose or raspberry either. I think with that description, I was expecting something very summery and this feels like a deeper more fall or wintery fragrance to me. I'll definitely still wear it, but will probably stick to other fragrances as my go tos!
summary: Heavier than I expected, but not overwhelming

reviewText:
Smells very good. has a light scent which is not too strong or overpowering.
Can be used daily. I love it!
summary: Smells very good. has a light scent which is not too ...

reviewText:
This Lacoste perfume has a fun light floral scent that carries well but does not linger.  The description is "Wild rose and raspberry enveloped in a detectable coconut".  The rose is the strongest aspect of this fragrance, amounting to maybe 70-80% of the aroma.  The raspberry does not stand alone or overshadow the rose, instead it mildly alters a solitary rose fragrance.  Don't expect to smell flowers and fruit, instead experience a more playful rose.  The cocount is very, very light - not anywhere near your sun tan lotion strength.  I apply organic coconut oil to my skin as a moisturizer and the smell of the oil (which is already very light and not at all at perfume levels) is greater than the coconut in this perfume.  Rest assured you won't smell like Coppertone or Hawaiian Tropic sunblock.

I dislike strong perfumes and colognes that are so bold that they linger long after someone has left the area.  To me a scent should stay on the person and offer a gentle greeting to those in conversation or standing side by side.  The power of this perfume is just that.
summary: Impressive alteration of traditional rose.  More fun that only flowers.  Greets softly (like a rose should) without lingering

reviewText: This Lacoste perfume has a fun, floral youthful scent. I liked how sweet and fresh it smells when you first apply it. However, in order to make the scent last longer, you have to be strategic in your application. I sprayed onto my pressure points and did not rub the pressure points like my wrists together. I also used unscented lotion and sprayed onto myself after putting on the lotion. In all, I felt like this scent was inoffensive. I also brought it into work and because I work with mainly women, my coworkers asked to have a few spritzes of the perfume. So, for me this was a great smell to wear, but results may vary especially as scents are very individual and depend upon your body chemistry.

I really like this perfume. It is feminine without being overly floral. My husband said it smelled almost unisex to him. If you ever smelled Escada's Magnatisim before it was discontinued,  it is a lighter version of that. While it lasts, it has a hint of fruit and vanillaish(made up word) musk scent. It is so light that it evaporates to nothing within an hour or two. I still love the smell, but I wish it would last longer.

I love to discover new scents, hence why I hound Ross's and TJ Maxx for their discounted perfumes. I had never tried Lacoste before, so I took the plunge, even though it said it had "coconut" and if there is one scent I've grown to hate, it's coconut.

But seriously, this perfume is a fantastic "day to day" perfume! It's light and subtle, a perfect balance between sweet and floral. I don't smell coconut at all, which is absolutely perfect!

This is definitely not a super strong perfume, but really, that's good because those strong perfumes tend to get rather noxious (and make me nauseous) over time.

I really like the packaging - very efficient with little waste. Same with the bottle - while I do love my decorative bottles, I appreciate streamlined ones that fit into cabinets better.

Overall, I do like the scent; I find it very light and refreshing, more floral though than coconut. If that sounds like something you want, head to your perfume counter and check it out!

Brought to you by:
*C.S. Light*
summary: Nice light scent for daily wear

reviewText: I love perfume.  I'm the type of girl that buys sample sets and wears a different one everyday.  I don't usually get full sized bottles until I absolutely love them, but when this popped up on Vine, I jumped at the chance.  Now I'm a little disappointed.  This is something that I would maybe wear every once in awhile, but it'll take me years to go through the entire bottle.  I honestly have been thinking about giving it to one of my teenager students because I think they would enjoy it more.  I usually love the mix of flower and fruit.  I like sweet scents and have been currently obsessed with Prada's Candy for exactly that reason.  This is much lighter than almost anything I have word lately and has now lasting power.  By mid-morning, I couldn't smell it at all anymore and no one commented upon it.  I usually get a few students that ask me what scent I was wearing that day, but it was like this disappeared.  I couldn't smell the coconut at all and the rose was more of a generic floral scent than a clear rose.  I guess this is to keep it from going too far into the very specific rose water smell that a lot of rose perfumes go towards.  Regardless, it leaves this without a distinction and without any lasting impact.
summary: Could have been better, maybe for a younger audience

reviewText: Wasn't familiar with the brand, but pleasantly surprised.  As others have noted the eye shadow material is a little powdery.  The neutral colors looked very good.  The glittery colors are a bit *too* glittery and only a very slight application of it is needed to achieve a full effect.  Would consider this brand again.
summary: Wasn't familiar with the brand, but pleasantly surprised.

reviewText:
I love the elegant packaging and the magnetized case that is smooth to the touch and looks pretty sitting on my counter.
There is no applicator but I have my own eye shadow brush I prefer so this wasn't a problem. The shadows go on smooth and are a powdery consistency and using a primer is recommended. In the picture on the website the colors are quite muted and they are MUCH brighter in person and very glittery or pixelated as the description says. There are four matte very usable every day colors in more of a nude palette and then there are six shimmery, sparkling shades with lots of glitter in them. Several of the colors are somewhat similar - the two nude shades are nearly identical and with the shimmery shades there are two nearly identical purples. The coppery shade is gorgeous and the only one I will wear out of the house as the other shades are too bright for office wear and you could use them for a night out to go bolder. I would recommend this for a makeup junkie who loves experimenting with color as it is a gorgeous compact to have.
summary: Shimmery and much bolder than the picture depicts. Some are not for day wear but the nude tones are very pretty

reviewText:
This is very good makeup. It's not great makeup, but it has a large palette with many varieties, and most would enjoy it.

Pros:
- Like the more tame colors. They spread easily, and work pretty well.
- It's a bit powdery, so not as good as better makeup. For the price, however, it is very competitive.

Cons:
- The sparkly ones are a bit too sparkly. If you're 21 and going out - they'd be a better fit than for a career woman.

Overall, good, but not as good as Urban Decay.

I love eyeshadow. I love playing with different colors, with going 'natural' one day with the nude palettes out there, smokey another (nude, grey or dark), or having fun with various colors - pinks, blues, greens and purples. There are so  many amazing colors and brands out there and I love trying them all. This Japonesque pixelated color eye shadow palette is a bit of a mixed bag (no pun intended).
First, the eye shadow is decent, but it's rather powdery - not creamy or a touch of gel to it like some other palettes I have that are around this price point but maybe a little more. You will need a primer of some sort, either for eye shadow or to set your make up to keep this from going all over the place, and a decent brush to apply it. As with other Japonesque eye shadow, yes, it's buildable - use a little and you get a light color and add more for intensity. That or use some water (especially with the black) to really make it pop or for a liner effect.
What prevents this from being a four or five star review? The colors. You have four matte, more of a nude palette and then six of a shimmery, opal-style palette. The problem I have with this is that several of the colors are very similar - the two highlights on the nude side are almost the same, one is just a little lighter. You don't have much to work with other than the two highlighter shades and the brown in fact, unless you want to go really dark with the black for a smokey look or as a liner. On the shimmer/pixelated side, you have two very identical purples, one again is a touch more amethyst than the other, cooler shade, and two greys, one more taupe than the other. For ten colors, they could have put something a little different in here to punch up the variety, such as a pink, a true gold and so forth to make this more versatile for the money and handier if you're going to take it on the go.
Also, since the shadow is so powdery, one of the shadows is already crumbling (the matte brown) - it arrived chipped. This makes me concerned about using this as a 'to go' shadow set, and one of the best things about a palette is being able to pack them and take them with me when I travel or need to put on make-up somewhere else.
So, while I like Japonesque make-up and find them as a nice mid-range option, I think you could buy a better eye shadow palette by finding other brands on sale (Urban Decay, Tarte, Kat Von D, etc) that will offer you more of a color range. Unless you really like these particular colors and a more powdery style of eye shadow.
summary: not much of a color selection in this rather powdery palette

reviewText:
I will be the first to admit that I've always used less expensive makeup. Okay, so cheap makeup. I don't wear makeup every day, in fact as a photographer I usually only put it on if I'm shooting a wedding or if my husband takes me out on a date (which is definitely rare!!), so I generally go for pretty cheap makeup. I never saw a reason to spend money on high quality makeup, so I honestly thought when I got this eye shadow palette that I wouldn't see much of a difference between the cheap makeup I purchase and this kit.

I was wrong. I was so, so wrong.

Firstly, it comes in a beautiful, heavy case - you can definitely tell that it's all there. Secondly, the minute I put my makeup brush to the eye shadow I could tell the difference. It was so silky and smooth and came away from the cake of makeup beautifully. I applied it and again could tell the difference because it is so, so light. Not that the color is light, but it FEELS like when it's on your eye! My daughter and I had an absolute blast trying all of the colors in various combinations, and it seems to stay on very well! The good news, though, is that it also washes off with just soap and water.

The sparkly colors don't go on overly sparkly, but do add a little bit of shine to your eye. They blend together absolutely amazingly on the eye as well - I'm very, very happy with this kit and now I realize that I'll have to spend a little more on my makeup if I want to get the same results that I'm getting from this!
summary: I Usually Buy Cheap Makeup - No Longer!!

reviewText: My son thinks this after shave has a nice smell, masculine but not overbearing. He said that it felt cool and refreshing at first, but he felt it dried his skin a little. His girlfriend likes how it smells, so he will continue to use it.
summary: Calvin Klein Eternity Now After Shave Spray for Men, 3.4 fl. oz.

reviewText: Calvin Klein has managed to create a fragrance whose complexity, depth and longevity have made it my favorite men's fragrance. Other reviewers discuss its freshness, its clean aroma and its crispness, which are all valid observations. But what struck me the very first time I sprayed it on after shaving was its aromatic depth and complexity. It has spice and wood overtones at first but these soon deepen into a cinnamon/musk/cedar aroma that is very appealing. The aroma lingers for quite some time without losing much of its early intensity. I also found this after shave spray exceptionally bracing and soothing on the skin, something that is often overlooked in discussing the merits of high quality after shaves. With an appealing aroma that lasts for several hours and its soothing freshness on the skin, Calvin Klein has created an excellent after shave spray in Eternity Now.
summary: Intensely aromatic and very soothing on the skin, a superb after shave spray from Calvin Klein

reviewText: The Calvin Klein Eternity is a new favorite in our house. It has a clean, fresh and masculine smell and though it feels strong when you just put it on, the aftershave smell fades away faster than a Cologne. My husband has sensitive skin and some aftershaves have irritated his skin in the past so he is always weary to try new ones but this one was not irritating to his skin at all. Love this and would definitely repurchase.
summary: The Calvin Klein Eternity is a new favorite in our house

reviewText:
This is one nice deodorant stick.  I normally wear anti-perspirant, so I don't wear it that often, but it provides a nice scent.  The Eternity Now scent is really nice, and if you're getting this deodorant I imagine you know what it smells like already.  The deodorant is a bit different, maybe a bit more subdued, a nice compliment anyways.

The container itself is quite fancy.  The top screws on/off, you raise the circular deodorant stick up with a turn knob on the bottom.  The plastic exterior feels thick and solid.
summary: This is one nice deodorant stick

reviewText:
I have the Eternity Now perfume and wanted the lotion to match it. I am used to using more of a serum type perfume body lotion. This is thicker, more like a cream. It is still lotion but is on the thicker side.

Texture aside, the thing I was not impressed with, it does not last long on your skin. I applied it once dry out of the shower and within two hours you could not smell it at all. I have never had perfume lotion that wore out so quickly.

I love the scent but cant recommend it since it does not last long enough.
summary: Thicker than I like and does not last long...

reviewText:
Calvin Klein Eternity Now Body Lotion smells like pure bliss to me. Such a light sweet smelling scent that really compliments my scent profile. Not overly strong and the scent stays with me throughout the day. Has a scent profile of lychee,peonies,peach blossoms and neroli petals all wrapped by a soft cashmere veil, sensual ambrox and precious musk for a warm, intimate aura. Now that might seem like a lot of scents all in one bottle, but they blend beautifully together.
I tend to have really dry skin on my hands so I am always looking for scented lotions that not only smell good but moisturize and that is what
Calvin Klein Eternity Now Body Lotion does for me.
The price is a little high for me, but for the quality and how nice it smells... I am sold.

I've been wearing Calvin Klein's Obsession for many years. I usually wear Obsession but have tried Eternity and Euphoria and liked those as well.  I've only used the Obsession body lotion, which I received in a gift set, so I was curious to see if I would like the Eternity Now lotion as much.

The lotion goes on smoothly and gives a light scent that lasts a surprising amount of time. I can see wearing this to work without irritating coworkers with an overwhelming scent. If you are using this because of dry skin, you might need to use something specifically for dry skin. This is more to make your skin feel silky and smooth while giving off a pleasant scent. For instance, the bottom of my feet are very rough, this is not something I would expect to fix that.

The biggest drawback is the price. (currently $43.00) I didn't like it anywhere near enough to pay so much over a less expensive scented body lotion.
summary: I usually wear Obsession but have tried Eternity and Euphoria and liked those as well

reviewText:
I didn't love the scent, but it is nice and pleasant. The lotion feels thick and creamy as it goes on, and did a good job of keeping my legs moisturized all day despite the dry weather. The product is a good size - not tiny like a lot of lotion containers seem to be getting these days.

Also excellent was that when I ran the first half of the ingredient list through EWG's Skin Deep, everything came out either yellow or green - nothing toxic, nasty or highly allergenic. Yay! I'm pleased with this product and would buy again.

This lotion has a lovely scent!  I am not an expert on scents, so I can't speak to whether it includes all the subtle different ones the description mentions, but I can say it smells very good---a smell I would call with my amateur nose a calming kind of floral.  It comes in a big tube---I can never quite picture how much of something I'm going to get based on the size listed, but this is what I'd call a large tube of lotion.

I've used it now after a bath and for a hand lotion.  It worked well for both, leaving my skin feeling smooth.  The scent lingers just a little, which is what I want.  It's not perfume, but it's nice to have a little bit of scent around to just feel a bit luxurious.  This falls into the category of an everyday type indulgence.  The tube is big enough so I can use this each day for a month or two, and feel a little special every time I do!
summary: Lovely subtle scent, and enough lotion for a little everyday treat!

reviewText: I much prefer the scent of Eternity Now versus Eternity - it's lighter, fresher, and not as overpowering. The lotion is not overly thick and not too thin or insubstantial in consistency. For me, I soon as I put it on my skin, perhaps because of my body's chemical reaction, it smelled overwhelmingly like detergent. It stayed like that for most of the morning. However, by the end of the day, it smelled perfect - just like the perfume. The scent does stay on for a very long time, even until the next morning. Perhaps others will have a different experience than I, as it is dependent upon what other products one uses and body chemistry.
summary: Scent lasted on my skin for a very long time

reviewText:
Calvin Klein has a wide range of scents, some more heavy and  sophisticated, some more light and simple. This one is in between . It is hard to describe a scent, it is very subjective. I can say it does not remind me of the original Eternity scent at all.

The lotion is a bit disappointing. Nothing special , it is thin verging on runny rather than a thick cream  . It is not fast absorbing and feels tacky until fully absorbed. Aside from the fragrance this is just a basic moisturizer, and I'd expect better at this price and from this brand.

I ordered this for my husband to try because he likes wearing different men's colognes and aftershave fragrances. He said he likes this scent, which is crisp and fresh, smelling of tropical fruits, maybe some lemon, wood scents and patchouli. But he thinks it's a little overwhelming unless he uses just a tiny amount. It does have a staying power. I could still smell it in the evening after he applied it in the morning. I think he may have just sprayed on too much the first time. I think it smells nice and has a definite masculine fragrance.

The packaging and bottle are simple and attractive. It's the kind of fragrance that would be nice to give as a gift. It's a little pricey but I believe 1 ounce of this will truly go a long way, even if it turns out to be a favorite that is worn often.

I have used Calvin Klein Eternity for some years. I have found the scent to be compelling, with a very fresh, clean aspect.

Eternity Now for Men is an update, refreshing the product line, initially introduced in 1989. Calvin Klein notes that Eternity Now is "an oriental fougre with ginger, coconut water, star anise, starfruit, cedar, patchouli, tonka bean and vanilla."

The result is excellent. It has an even fresher, cleaner aspect than before. I see that some Amazon reviewers are not happy with the update. So there may be some disagreement among those of us who've long liked the Eternity line.

Will you like it? Fragrances are a very personal thing. Eternity Now is high-quality and priced accordingly. I would suggest trying it at a department store and seeing for yourself.
summary: An Excellent Refresh, Update of a Classic Scent for Men

reviewText: Our 20 year old college man attending school in Florida liked the scent, it has a tropical vibe and he said it didn't make him feel like he was wearing his grandfather's cologne. Only comment was that it went on strong and was totally gone in 6-8 hours.

I ordered this product for my teenage daughter. She is constantly in a battle with her skin and is always wanting to try new things. She tried this exfoliating mask quite a few times until it ran out. She said that she liked it and would use it again, but she didn't love it. She is ready to try other products, again, until she finds one that she loves. She did comment on how fresh it made her skin feel after using it.
summary: My daughter liked it but didn't love it.

reviewText:
This stuff is scary effective. I put it on my lower cheeks  to my jawline, where I have some minor KP bumps, and within a few seconds I'm rubbing off big rolls of dead skin. It's disgusting, and satisfying. I do this once a week.

I have KP which occasionally gets to my lower cheeks near the jawline, and when I use this, I can actually remove the little keratin plugs causing the KP bump. I have never had an exfoliant this powerful.

But gracious, use with caution. If you have any tiny little hairs on your face, you'll get dead skin bits stuck on them and have to very carefully clean your face after. I'd also suggest not using it too often. I used it twice in one week once, and caused a lot of irritation on my skin (and got next to no benefit the second time because there was not much dead skin left for it to exfoliate).
summary: GREAT for Keratosis pilaris on face.

reviewText: PHYTO products have been saving my over-processed hair for years! If you're looking to improve the density and luster of your hair, look no further! While it is pricy, the results are immediately (perhaps on a superficial level) noticable and my hair feels much more thick and has incredible shine to it. After using this in it's entirety, the strength and quality of my hair has dramatically improved. Even my hair stylist noticed! If you can budget this product, I highly recommend it!
summary: Noticeably thicker hair after each use!

reviewText: This product claims to increase hair abundance. I could use that. Unfortunately, it didn't work for me. While I didn't expect it to regrow my hair, I did expect it help not thin because of the claim that it would help attachment. I didn't notice any difference, and neither did my wife or kids. I was looking and looking hard for ANY sign of extra retention, and no change.

I was about to buy rogaine when I was offered the PHYTO to try. I have had hair loss in the past, due to some medical conditions, but those are under control and the new thinning seems to be related to changes due to aging. Thus, I decided to try the phyto first. I apply it like close to the scalp and then rub it in, once must be very careful or it will be a greasy clumpy mess. Running late from work with a shoe in one hand, wand of mascara in the other, and trying to dump this on your scalp is not the way to go, patience and a bit of time are required.

After using this I didn't notice anything other than about the second week it started irritating my scalp and flakiness and itching began. Now, in addition to my hair falling out, I had flakes. I'm going to let my scalp recover completely and try something else

the Phyto is packaged in one use vials which are convenient and I don't have to guess at the amount.
summary: didn't work for me, might for you

reviewText:
Very interesting product.  It arrives in an attractive box (almost gift quality).  Inside are small capped vials intended to provide one application.  There is also a "dropper" that screws onto the bottle (with cap removed) to dab your scalp with the "liquid".  Similar to dying your hair/roots.

The enclosed instructions are woefully incomplete.  Basically says, "make three straight lines down your scalp" (and massage in).  Three lines?  Where...side-to-side?  front-to-back?  There are youtubes available, but I wasn't in the mood to sit through a video when I just wanted to test the product.  So I focused on the areas of where my hair is thinning the most and then randomly dabbed, massaged in, added my usual small amount of gel & leave-in conditioner and partially blow-dried.

If I use too much in one area, the combination of my hair and the liquid leaves my hair feeling somewhat clumped and like it's dirty (my fault).  If I'm patient, it absorbs well.  My hair did "feel" like it was more full upon drying (though that isn't part of its claim).

Recommended to use three times to freshly washed damp hair (and then dry as usual) per week.

I'm skeptical these days, but after two weeks (9 applications), something DOES FEEL different.  I know that isn't scientific and vague, but I'm still curious to see the results after a month's use.  (and I will update then)

Where I can definitely feel a difference is when I condition (after shampoo) and rinse out the conditioner, I have nowhere near the hair in my hands than before using this product.  The claim is that it anchors the hair to the follicle ~ and to that note, I do have far less hair loss after conditioning/rinsing.

Recommended is 3 months use and if my results continue in this positive direction, I feel encouraged to purchase two more sets at their pricey amount.  My hair, with age and thyroid issues, has thinned a lot over the past few years and I'd love to slow that down (or stop it).  Interesting product.

Like other reviewers have noted, my package arrived in the beautiful package, but the bottles were all tossed about inside. Thankfully none were damaged, but the manufacturer might want to find a different way to secure these small bottles for less messy delivery. Perhaps a deeper 'well' to hold them more securely? That said, this product smells great and absorbs without any sticky gel-like feeling on the scalp. There is an eyedropper to screw into each bottle at time of application. Note: at first it was taking a longer time than I'd prefer to get all the stuff out, but then I squeezed on the dropper itself and got the liquid out quicker, but your mileage may vary.

How is it working on my very fine, thinning hair? After three weeks, there's nothing dramatic (that one receding spot still recedes), but at the same time I'm noticing less hair coming out after a comb through and/or when I pull off my hair band, so there is that, but in my frugal world I haven't had strong enough results that I'd pop $95 for a month's supply to get the experiment going. Your mileage may vary.

This is truly a single pass straightener.  I have fairly thin hair and used it on the low setting, which is still pretty hot at 260 degrees, and was very happy with the results.  Most straighteners make my hair look super thin and this does the opposite.  It actually seems to give it a little more volume.  It heats up super fast and has a perfect sized little heat resistant pad to set it in while heating up, which I liked.  You can't put a lot of hair in this one because it is micro, but that's okay with me.  I knew that it is a micro wand before I got it.  I feel I'm actually doing a better job this way, anyway, by doing smaller sections of my hair at one time.  I would highly recommend this straightener to anyone!
summary: The best straightener I've ever had!  I love it!

reviewText:
The look of this straightener is really sleek and chic. It is easy to plug in and comes with nice clips to section your hair. You plug it in and it gets to the right temperature within seconds.

Now my hair has just a slight wave - not too bad but can be stubborn to keep a certain shape. I was told I had the most stubborn hair when I was having my hair done for a wedding. So I tried this. I felt the plates were pretty thin and I had to actually go through a few passes for it to be straight - to the point that I need it. It felt like it did an OK job but if you have really frizzy or curly hair, it might not work and definitely would need many passes. In fact, even at a higher setting, it really didn't seem that hot.
summary: Decent hair straightener but have had much better

reviewText: I'm impressed with how light weight and therefore easy to use this curler is.  It creates the gentle waves which are currently so popular.  It takes close to five minutes to fully heat up.

A great way to sample all the Baxter pomades, or even get containers for travel use.  There are 4 included, 3 that are firm hold, and one light hold.  Of the 3 firm holds they are shiny and matte and natural holds.  The two creams are the natural finish (and they are more typical pomade texture).  The clay pomade (matte finish, firm hold) is thicker, and doesn't even smooth out as much as the thicker creams do when you rub them on your hands.  The hard water pomade is blue and translucent, it's thick but still goes in easily.

I enjoyed all 4 of these, and they are quite small, so you'll probably want to migrate to the full size versions when you get your favorite ones.  My son (5 years old) also enjoys trying the different ones, although he mostly does it based on color (he goes for the blue one a lot).
summary: A great way to sample all the Baxter pomades

reviewText:
Pomade is a hair styling product that gives a stronger, longer lasting hold than other traditional gels and sprays. Baxters of California is a well-known, trusted company known for quality pomade.

Because pomade can comes in different varieties and is kind of pricey, Baxters has offered a sampler set with their clay (firm hold/matte finish), cream (light hold/natural finish), hard water (firm hold/shine finish), and hard cream (firm hold/natural finish) varieties.

This gives users of Baxters pomade the chance to try a new type or mix and match various varieties for an ideal look without buying an entire container. Its also great to let new users choose which one to purchase. Also, the sizes are convenient for travel if you need to maximize space on a trip.

If you want to know more about using pomade in general you can visit visit Baxters how to videos here:[...]
The only downside is that you pay more per ounce for this set than buying the regular sized containers ($28.00 for about two ounces vs. $20.00 for two ounces).

I gave it 5 stars because its a cool gift idea, perfect to try out their different varieties, and good for travel. And, the pomade is high quality and works.

Also, if you know you want to use pomade often, spending a little more for this set will allow you to try out the varieties and pick the one you like. This will save you from wasting money in the long run. But, if price is your concern, you might want to read up on the different varieties (basic description above in this review) and then pick one based on your research.
summary: Ideal for Gifts or to Sample Various Pomades

reviewText:
Baxter makes a good product. This pomade mixer kit is an interesting endeavor, as it offers you the option of mixing and matching four different pomades to style your hair in a unique way. This is really super if you have found that the pre-packaged pomades are "too" something for you. By mixing them, you can customize the results you want to get.
There is enough variety in the Mixer Kit that you can get a really good feel for what you might like. In fact, you might decide that colder days require a bit more of something or night time requires a bit more/less...it's really all up to you.
I think this is a really neat option to have available to customers.
I don't know that it will be something that everyone will want to attempt, but for those who want a little variety, this would be great!
summary: Great option for people who want to customize their hair pomades!

reviewText: This kit is a great way to try several of Baxter's pomades, and it also makes for an attractive gift.  I like the texture and color of each pomade, with my favorite probably bring the hard cream.  Quality stuff.  They each had a pleasant scent (nothing that lingered or was too aggressive), and the scent was different for each product.  I was a little wary of the Hard Water because it's teal-colored in the container and a little glittery/sparkly, but in hair it just looks shiny.
This smells nice and does make my hair shiny. A little guess a long way. I have dinner hair and have to be careful or it looks oily/dirty and weighed down. It smells nice.

This does leave my hair shiny and is lighter than many other defrizzing products that I have used in the past. It doesn't work as well as some other products I've used. Also, I tend to like these a lot for the scent, but this smells a bit synthetic to me.
summary: I tend to like these a lot for the scent

reviewText: This shine mist is a nice, small size that adds some nice shine to your hair! Though I am not exactly sure what a seaberry is supposed to smell like, this one has a nice and refreshing scent that is pleasant but not overpowering. I have fine, thin hair, so I am careful with adding sprays because it can weigh my hair down too much and make it too flat. This is lightweight spray, which is great! I actually use it the most when my hair is pulled back in a pony tail  but make sure to wait until it has dried before re-doing a pony tail because it does leave a residue on your hand otherwise! I find that it does make hair shinier and helps keep any minor flyaways in place! I don't use this every day, but I do like it on the days that I do use it!

My wife tried this recently: I love using shine products on the hair and I was looking forward to giving this product a try.  It does make the hair nice and shiny, but there is a rather strong fragrance. It smells like the classic argan oil aroma, though argan oil wasn't mentioned in the product information.  The folliwng ingredients were listed: Cyclopentasiloxane, Dimethicone, Phenyl Trimethicone, Hippophae Rhamonoides (Sea Buckthorn) Oil, Dimethiconol, Fragrance.  So it appears as though the company added the argan oil fragrance without the actual benefit of argan oil.  It sprays a really fine mist of shine oil that disperses well throughout the hair for great results.  Good result, but odd that they would intentionally make the product smell like argan oil but not include it in the product  especially for the price.
summary: Will make your hair SHINE but is quite fragranced

reviewText: Obliphica Professioanl Seaberry Shine Mist gives hair a nice light shine. I have previously tried oil based products that you rub into your hair. Those have weighed down my hair. This is a light spray mist that doesn't. I have thin hair, so I use most products very sparingly. It is made to be a UV protectant that helps your hair color last longer. I had colored my hair for twenty years and had decided the other year to give my hair a break from coloring. So I can't speak to the spray helping color last longer. I do like that it is a UV protectant. It is also alcohol free, which I like. The scent is strong. I like it, it reminds me of a floral beachy scent. Scent is personal and this scent may not be for everyone.

I think the bottle I got must have had a defect. I can't imagine anyone would use it based on how it sprayed for me. It would come out in little clumps, as opposed to misting, and that was after quite a bit of pumping. I tried it out on my children's hair because of this. It left oily circles in their hair. I tried brushing it through a bit, but wasn't overly successful with that. Those spots were shiny, if that's what you're after. Based on my experiments with their hair, I wouldn't recommend this for thin/fine hair(like mine).

My daughter has extremely thick, curly and frizzy hair.  Other daughter has straight but thick hair, while my own is wavy and very thin.  After styling the frizzy thick hair, I sprayed and found that her hair did shine which really attracted attention to the overall style.  My hair is just too thin for the product so it tends to weigh it down if I overspray.  My other daugher's hair can handle the mist but she needs to shower after use as her hair tends to be oil prone.

What drew me to this shine mist was the fact that it did not include alcohol!  My daughter's hair has been drying out over the years because of the massive amounts of alcohol in most of the products.  Unfortunately, the only products that tend to work are the ones that include alcohol.  The bottle tends to leak so it is always greasy/oily to touch.  Her hair sucks up the oil and hungrily asks for more.  While using with her other products, this shine mist does take away from the frizz and adds a beautiful shine.  I can only spritz twice before it weighs my hair down.  Everyone's mileage will vary depending on their type of hair at the end of the day.  The scent is a pleasant but rather strong one at first.  My asthmatic daughter does get triggered by the scent.  For this reason I cannot recommend to those that have breathing issues or affected by strong scents.

Recommend but I believe that the price is exhorbitant for what you are actually receiving, which is an oil.  There is a high shine with use but do not recommend for thin hair.  This product would be best for thick, curly and thirsty hair.

I have super fine, super straight hair that always has fly-aways and when I try to use something to control them, it just weighs my hair down and makes it look flat and a bit greasy. This styling cream manages to control the previously uncontrollable wisps of hair while still allowing me to retain some volume and a natural, straight look. I love it! I also love that it isn't highly scented because I am very sensitive to smells and any hair product that is strongly scented usually goes straight into the trash.
summary: perfect for my super fine hair

reviewText:
I tested this and a friend tested it, just to give you two perspectives.

My hair is very fine, and it's natural state is curls. Sometimes I do want to go straight and sleek though and that's where this product comes in. I used a half pump of the thick cream and spread it evenly through my damp hair and then styled, and for me, the frizz and flyaways I usually get stayed away. The formula did not weigh my hair down or feel greasy, and I like the fresh scent.

My friend has a harder time with hair product. She has medium thickness hair that is prone to static and is more noticeably "frizzy" especially on the top of her head. She used this product on her damp hair and then blew it dry and still had a moderate degree of frizz (though it did control the frizz better than most, she admitted).

So, basically, your milage may vary. It worked well for me, not so well for my friend. So try it, but perhaps don't hope for a miracle if your hair is especially difficult.
summary: Worked better for me than for my friend

reviewText:
I'm surprised by how much I liked this. I'm not big on hair products, I hate feeling like it's being weighed down and I have little patience for trying out a million things to tame my frizz. I really liked this one though. It doesn't stink, the bottle looks nice and doesn't take up much space, but most important it leaves my hair looking and feeling nice. I primarily use it for my braids. I tend to put my hair in a french braid, I use this to tame my baby hairs and the bits of hair that usually want to stick out in my braid (I have layered hair).

A lot of products can help tame baby hair, but this one does it without making my hair stiff and crunchy. Best of all, when I remove my braid my hair is shiny and curly, doesn't explode into a ball of more frizz. I got this from Vine but I'll likely be buying more.
summary: I'm surprised by how much I liked this. I'm not big on hair products

reviewText: It's very thick and smells okay - not too perfumy but also not very scented. it is okay for styling but like other hair products, can weigh your hair down.

I am not a big fan of this cream. I have short hair which tends to get a bit out of control and stray hairs will decide to go their own direction. This cream did not help keep them in place at all. I saw no difference after using this cream and I used half a pump then increased to a full pump; still had hair going every which way, just as though there was nothing on it. The cream did make my hair feel a bit softer, but at the expense of a fairly strong perfume odor. I am also not a big fan or hair products adding scents, you end up with the shampoo, hair cream, body wash and perfume all competing with each other, and nobody wins; least of all the wearer. If you're looking for something to help keep your hair in place or make it more manageable there are better options.
summary: Did not help control my hair at all, has perfume scent.

reviewText:
The Seaberry styling cream smells really nice. My hair is shoulder-length and somewhat fine, and I use a partial pump when my hair is wet. Doing so does turn out a nice effect. I let my hair air-dry, and it seems to help with flyaways, and when I wear my hair down it keeps it in a manageable style all day.

5 stars!

That being said, I like to wash my hair every other day, but when I use this styling cream after washing my hair in the morning, it feels greasy the next morning. Just be aware.
summary: I like it, but a bit greasy

reviewText:
In conjunction with the Obliphica Professional Expect Perfection Volume & Body Seaberry Collection, I got the styling cream as an additional measure against frizz.

I have fine blond hair which sometimes gets a mind of its own.  I've been using the Obliphica Seaberry collection for several weeks with positive results.  The styling cream is that last touch that provides a smooth style and eliminates flyaway hair.

The scent is exotic, complex, pleasing and difficult to pinpoint.  The product goes on nicely and doesn't weigh hair down like some argan oil products.  I only use a strong pump per day.  My hair doesn't get oily or sticky after using this product and it stays in place all day as I work.

I would recommend this styling product in conjunction with the other offerings in the Seaberry Collection line.  They tend to work hand-in-hand to give you great looking and smelling hair.

I've had better results with mud masks. It did tingle nicely and I felt fairly clean faced afterwards, but I didn't notice anything that made me want to use it again or suggest it to other people...

It is very easy to use, so perhaps it works better with other skin times than mine? (My skin is mostly even but with a slightly greasy T zone)

My wife is 30 and her job is very hard on her hands, because she runs a crew of cleaning personnel.  She is into chemicals, harsh detergents and, well, you know what cleaning people do.  She uses a pair of these about twice a week before bedtime for a half hour.  Her issue is, of course, how to keep up with her social media when she has slippery gloves on (humor).  She feels like this helps her a little better than simple lotion at bed time, so she likes the idea and her hands definitely are softer and never cracked anymore.

Not sure I saw a huge difference with this time.  I liked it, but it wasn't that muck of an improvement.  Slightly expensive and wasteful compared to some at home treatments I have done using gloves and balm.  not sure I would buy this item again.

Karuna masks are always fantastic-- and this hand mask was no exception. Not only did this treatment leave my hands feeling incredibly soft and smooth, the material of the gloves allowed for me to text and use touchscreen devices during the period of time which I wore it. It softened my cuticles enough to make giving myself a manicure after simple and easy.

Does this treatment work any better than putting a disposable glove on top of hands lathered in an expensive cream-- I'm not sure.  But I'm not here for a DIY moment, I'm here for a luxurious experience-- a treat.
summary: Perfect for those 'treat yo' self' moments.

reviewerName: Leah Maines, best-selling, award-winning author, actor, and editor
reviewText:
The hand mask is basically my grandmothers bedtime routine of putting lotion on her hands and then a pair of gloves over your hands then sleeping with the gloves on.  You wake up to refreshed hands.  The Karuna hand mask is applied to dry hands.  You place your hands in thin prelotioned plastic gloves (similar to the ones in hair dye boxes but thinner), and leave them on for 20 minutes or so.  You don't have to sleep with the gloves on.  When you remove them the hands are more hydrated.  Im not really sure if they are any more hydrated than if I applied lotion to my hands without gloves.
This is a fun thing to do with my daughters but it is pricey.  They are totally into face masks, so hands masks were also a must for them. However, I personally prefer buying some hand lotion at that price.  It lasts much longer than one time.  If there were more than one mask in the Karuna pack, I would have been happier.

This are a bit of a puzzle, I think.  My poor, battered hands definitely need some TLC.  I cant actually do all the things I want to do in the garden or with potted plants if I wear gloves.  And having no dishwasher isn't hand-friendly.

But, while I like the idea of these, the execution is poor:  they are hard to use, and they don't produce better results than conscientious use of a good lotion or cream, and occasional overnight treatment with white cotton gloves.  Since they are one-use only, an heavily over-packaged, they also add appreciably to the stuff one must throw away.  And they cost a lot.  I cant see why anyone would be eager to add these to their beauty regimen.
summary: The execution is poor.  They are hard to use, & don't produce better results than regular use of lotion.

reviewText: I was a little disappointed in the fact there wasn't as much lotion in the thumbs. My thumb knuckles get really dry and that's the place I need this stuff. Didn't seem like an even amount all in the fingers either. Smelled really good! My hands felt good afterwards. Something I would certainly consider buying though I'm not sure I would buy this brand. I'd like to shop around.

I'm a gardener, I always have my hands in water around the house, I'm a quilter and use pins and scissors. So, my hands are kind of a wreck. I try to take care of them and sometimes pamper them with cream and cotton gloves covered with latex gloves. I was happy to try this hand mask, which is basically the same thing as my cotton gloves/latex gloves/cream routine, but with a higher end hydrating cream. You put your hand in the inner fabric gloves that come with this kit, secure the tapes at the wrists and wait. Twenty minutes later, you peel off the gloves and throw them away.

Results: well, my hands felt utterly soft and hydrated, but for $9.50 a pop, I think I'll keep doing this myself.  If there had been maybe 10 of these things, I might change my mind, but $9.50 for one application?

Nope.

This is a thumbs up from everyone in the family. The balm is not like the cream which absorbs better but that's like a barrier to keep the skin hydrated. This is great for my wife and daughter who has slight eczema and there has been a reduction of itchiness or redness when they use this product for their dry skin.

My skin gets very dry in the winter time and on and off throughout the year. The worst areas are my feet and my elbows. I try to keep them hydrated.  I hate the feel of greasy or oily lotions. I was hoping that this lotion would be thick and hydrating, but not greasy. Unfortunately, it feels very greasy to me. It is hydrating. I can tolerate it on my feet, but not anywhere else. I have to wash my hands shortly after applying because I hate the feel of greasy palms. While it does hydrate my feet, it doesn't leave them feeling as satisfied as a thick body butter would.

Overall, it works. The lotion is nothing special and feels oily/ greasy on my skin. I will use it until it's gone (alternating with a much more hydrating body butter or lotion). I will not buy it again and I would not recommend it. There are better products out there for dry skin.

Whatever active ingredients in this didn't work on stopping the itch and didn't make any noticeable difference in helping clear up chronic eczema.  Also, this lotion is water-based.  While it doesn't feel as heavy and absorbs quickly, water-based lotions and creams do not create a barrier or keep in moisture as well as oil-based ones, which is important for dry skin.  Therefore, while a water-based lotion might feel good right after it has been applied, after the water evaporates your skin will feel as dry as ever.
summary: didn't stop itching and the water-based formulation isn't ideal for dry skin

reviewText: I have skin that often breaks out into rashes, itchy places, hives because I am very sensitive to perfumes, dyes, insects, plants, grass, republicans, etc. This intensive balm , which contains an anti-itching agent will soothe any irritated skin.
summary: I have skin that often breaks out into rashes, ...

reviewText: I've been using this for a few moths now and it is holding up very well with weekly use. The bristles are perfect for my fair skin, soft enough that it doesn't aggravate me, but tough enough to get a good face scrub in. Have not tested the waterproof part out, but it states it can be used in the shower to help save time.

Durable and well made. Indeed waterproof, using in the shower to save time. Purchased additional replacement heads, but haven't needed to change one yet. Easy to use, great results immediately, sensitive skin not adversely affected. Great inexpensive facial! Great product! Would recommend and buy again.
summary: Your source to clean beautiful skin!

reviewText: I didn't really see any impact on my eyes from this product. I used it as directed, for numbers months. Now it's collecting dust.

reviewerName: Keleigh Crigler Hadley, author of Revenge Inc.
reviewText: I used it once or twice. Didn't see much of a change. It was weird to use and not convenient to have to plug in to charge. I watched a Youtube video to see how it works but although they glowed about the product, it did not live up to the hype.

This eye massager is a unique product, I have started incorporating it into my daily routine. I would suggest reading the instructions fully before using this product. To unlock the device, hold the + and - buttons down together for 3 seconds.  If you use eye serum, apply it before you use the massager. There is a detailed display in the quick start guide about how to apply the massager. The massager is made of a silicone like material that feels nice and soft against the skin. You can adjust the intensity of the pulsing to suit yourself. The massage itself feels great, you just move the massager along under the eye and along the brow bone for 30 seconds per eye. Be careful not to apply to the eye lid or eye ball. I can tell a reduction in under eye puffiness and dark circles after about a week of use.  Made in China.  If you do a search, youll find a video online as well, which may be helpful for you to get started.
summary: It's unique.  .. and I like it. .  .I've added it to my daily routine

reviewText: I am not sure what true firm is. I can tell you shea butter and vitamin E you can buy for pennies. This had better work for what they're charging or it is absolute fraud
This product hydrates well. There is something unit that makes my eyes itchy even though it is not applied to eye area
summary: May not be for sensitive skin

reviewText: I first saw this in my dermatologist's office. I am a mom to two kids under two and I am in my late 30s - I need all the help I can get to reduce my under eye wrinkles and facial lines. This product works and does a great job plumping my skin and making my face bright and **LOOK** well rested, as trust, I am not well rested. While this is an investment, my face is worth it. LOVE

Absolutely amazing! Even my Esthetician noticed the difference! It feels so incredibly luxurious, creamy and nourishing to my face and neck. Not too light and not too heavy. In a recent hospital stay I had three employees ask to confirm my birthdate. When the third one asked about it, I said is there a problem? The doctor said I looked 15 years younger than what's on file! Made my day!

This Youth intensive cream comes  beautifully packaged in a blue metallic box with the tiny silver spoon. The cream has a light lemony fragrance and is easy to apply. It absorbs quickly and feels wonderful on my skin. I apply it over my face and neck. I've used it for about 30 days. I wish there was some magic cream or potion that could remove wrinkles and make me look 20, or even 10 years younger. I've tried a lot of different brands through the Vine program. But the best this or any cream seems to be able to do is soften and moisturize, which minimizes the look of wrinkles. I think this product does a better job of that than most. Is it worth the high price tag? The product goes a long way. It doesn't take much to cover my face and neck. And it makes my skin feel good all day or all night without having to reapply it. The jar will probably last a few months. There are a lot of anti-aging creams out there and most aren't as nice as this.
