Ive more or less given up on reducing wrinkles.  Ive never found a product that really seems to have much effect on them.  However, Ive found that using a good lotion makes a big difference to my skins texture, and the Tizo PM Restore really works in this regard.

It has the oddest texture Ive ever experienced in a face lotionit kind of looks like really thick honey.  However, it applies very smoothly and does not feel heavy at all.  My skin was already improved by the next morning, perhaps because the moisture was held in.  After a couple weeks, the texture was very noticeably improved.  My often-sensitive skin had no bad reaction to this at all.

The only thing I really don't like about this is the packaging.  It looks cool and works well, but it makes it impossible to tell how much product is left.  Theres only an ounce in the bottle to begin with, and Id really like to know how much I have left before I have to reorder.

Wife's review- I'm probably more critical of skin care products because I've used so many & rarely do they do what they promise. I have sun damage, hyperpigmented acne scars & fine lines. I didn't see much improvement after a month of using PM Restore. It does feel nice when applied. It is a soft gel consistency. I have used prescription strength retinoids and it does not preform as well, though it claims to.

I like the results I get from using Retinol, but I have very sensitive skin, and I often feel like I have a perpetual sunburn when I use Retinol.  Tizo claims to deliver all the results of Retinol with "little to no" irritation.  And it's true.  With other Retinols, I have to make sure my skin is completely dry before I apply it- as in waiting 20 minutes after I wash my face at night, in order to minimize irritation.  Because I don't wash my face until bedtime, and am unlikely to change that part of my routine, I would wash my face, pat it dry, and hope for the best.  I can apply this Tizo to not-completely-dry skin, and I experience very, very little irritation.

Results-wise, after a little over a month of using Tizo Photoceutical PM Restore, my skin is super-soft, looks smoother and better-toned, and my pores appear smaller.  And the vertical line between my eyebrows I've been working on by avidly scowling for years is less pronounced!

I think this is a must-have product for anyone who wants the benefits of Retinol without the irritation!

This skin restorer does leave your skin soft. It does get rid of some skin that remains over a patch on my face. It does not leave my face puffy. You do need to keep it away from your eyes, but you can carefully put it on the crows feet under them.
My one problem is that despite its good work it is quite expensive. However if you try other products and this is what works  which for some is what the retinol complex is good for then the purchase price would be worth it. The serum is thick and not runny so a little does go a long way.
Using this. Not seeing a difference.
This is a wonderful day cream--so creamy, yet light, not heavy or greasy at all. I feel it improved my skin softness and tone--just ordered a new bottle--totally recommend.
summary: Really like this day cream-light, not greasy

reviewText: The first time I applied this serum, I dispensed too much and it felt thick and goopy on my skin.  The next morning I used about half that amount with much better results.  It does leave a matte finish  (great during summer when products described as "dewy" or "luminous" make me look sweaty and oily) but doesn't make my skin feel dry.  While this is called a serum it feels like a primer, but since I don't wear a lot of makeup, I can't comment on how it performs under makeup.  What I can say is, that applying sunscreen on top messes up the matte finish and leaves me looking shiny but I'm not sure if applying sunscreen underneath interferes with the absorption of the skin nourishing ingredients.  Would have been a lot easier if they just put sunscreen in the product.  It does make my skin feel super soft, even when I don't use it everyday, but I'm thinking of putting this away till Fall/Winter when I'm not sweating and reapplying high SPF sunscreen all day.  I mean why waste it.

This cream, intended for use in the mornings, is a "rejuvenation" cream, or basically, a firming cream. It comes out in a super easy to use pump (one pump is well-sized for single use, so no problems with pumping too much product). It's yellow in color and effectively odorless.

I've been using this for several weeks now, and there are aspects of it I like and aspects I don't like. What I like: it absolutely is firming. I've noticed an impact from this product, and I'm pleased. I've also been using it under my tinted moisturizer, and it doesn't feel super heavy. What I don't like: while it goes on fairly matte, it leaves a slight tactile sensation, like there's some sort of residue on my skin, all day. There's no forgetting to wash it off at the end of the day! Still, it doesn't look greasy and I think I'm the only one who notices.
summary: It comes out in a super easy to use pump (one pump is well-sized for ...

reviewText: I absolutely LOVE how this feels on my cleansed skin! Even though it says it's an AM Day Cream,I prefer to use it at night.  I use two pumps over my entire face and neck, smoothing it into my skin for a minute until it totally absorbs.  My skin feels wonderfully smooth. I really think the product has improved the texture of my skin.  I also really like the delivery system of this cream:  it's measured, prevents oxidizing, and is sanitary.  And thankfully it doesn't contain any parabens,  It is pricey, but I expect it to last quite a long time.  I hope to try the tinted mineral sunscreen next.
summary: I use this at night and LOVE the effect on my skin.

reviewText: This cream cones in an easy to expense pump. It was unlike many creams that I've used before. There was no oily or greasy feel when applying or after application. My face was left feeling soft and light, almost like nothing was on it. It does not really have a scent to it. I have continued to notice extremely soft and firmer skin with repeated use.

I've been using this for over a week and I'm thinking it may need more time? I think  it's a decent it's not good moisturizing serum however I'm not noticing a huge difference in my skin. It really may take more time. I will say I like the delivery system you get just the right amount and it goes on very smoothly. It's not oily, greasy, or drying. I'm just not sure if it's any better than some of the other products  i've used, like philosophy, Josie Maren are L'Oreal.
summary: I think it's a decent it's not good moisturizing serum however I'm not noticing a huge difference ...

reviewText: Per the wife: I actually love this, but like some others have indicated, it is more of a thick serum/cream, rather than a cream or a serum. I really like the consistency. I like to use it both day and night.  When I use it at night, I add a night cream on top of it because I like a heavier night cream, but I am not sure that is even necessary.  I am very familiar with Tizo products, and have used their sunscreen and tinted sunscreen for years after being advised to purchase it by my dermatologist. I was really excited to try this new product. Peptides are the current best way to reduce and plump fine lines. Many products claim to have peptides, but they only put a small amount into the product, thus defeating the whole purpose.  This is loaded with peptides. It dries relatively quickly. Really nice product. I will buy it again.

This is a thick serum that take a minute or so to fully abosrb. The first few times that I used it, there was a slight tingling sensation, but I no longer felt this after using if for 3 or 4 days. I feel like it does a make a difference to the appearance of my skin. There also seems to be an improved feeling of my skin texture. So far, I am quite satisfied with this Tizo cream and plan to continue using it daily.
summary: I feel like it does a make a difference to the appearance ...

reviewText: I like this cream, but I'm more inclined to use it at night. It's a bit thick for day use, and feels oily-plasticky. It makes my skin tingle, which might be the ingredients nourishing the skin (niacinamide, Vit C and Vit E), or it might just be strong and causing slight irritation. I have no idea what most of the ingredients are. It's a bit expensive for my budget, so I'd have to see major results to make the investment. So far, results aren't any better than with cheaper AHA creams. I'll update if I see any difference later.

For context, I'm a 34-year-old woman with dry, acne prone skin and a skincare junkie.  I'm meticulous about my skincare routine and especially sunblock usage, but still like to take preventative steps for aging as well as the faint fine lines I already have.  I've tried a lot of different skincare brands from drugstore to high end, but this was my first time trying the H20+ Brand.

The purpose of this night cream is to reduce the appearance of dark spots and help brighten the skin.  I was especially excited to see that it contains Vitamin C because my skin has responded to Vitamin C really well in the past with products like Ole Henriksen Truth Serum.

The first thing I noticed about this cream is how unique the packaging is. I love that though the cream is in a jar it has a built in pump that dispenses just the right amount of cream for your face.  This is genius because exposing the active ingredients in creams to air can lessen their effectiveness so I like that this seems to have a tight seal so the cream stays as potent as possible.

Rubbing it into my skin I was surprised at how light it is.  I've become accustomed to using richer creams so this was much, much thinner than I expected.  But accordingly, it rubs into your skin really easily and doesn't feel heavy or greasy on the skin.  I was a little worried that because it is thinner than I am used to my skin might feel tight or parched in the morning, but I was pleasantly surprised.  When using this with an essence, serum, and facial oil it does seem to be enough moisture for my skin, even in the dry winter months.

So far I really like this.  My skin has been looking and feeling great even though it is incredibly dry here and I haven't had any adverse reactions.  No breakouts.  No redness.  No itchiness.  All good!

Would recommend!

I'm a 46-year old woman with dry skin. I moisturize morning and night, and occasionally use anti-aging products like retinol, though my skin is too sensitive for daily use. I find my skin looks pretty good with consistent moisturizing and really haggard without. I usually only wear mascara and lipstick and just use water and a washcloth (or micellar wipes on the road) as my cleansing routine.

Love how fresh my skin looks in the morning with this product! It's lovely, light and quick absorbing, and my skin looks much fresher when I wake up than with other moisturizers I've tried. Kind of reminds me of the Laneige water mask.

The product also has great packaging. the top lid pops off and underneath is a second screw-on lid (I made the mistake of unscrewing it initially) with a flat, slightly concave surface and little silicone pump/plug with a tiny hole in the center. When you press it, a pea-side dollop of product appears. The advantage of this over your typical pumps is that you can apply it in steps--apply to on side of your face, a third to the other, and the last bit to your neck--without fumbling with the whole thing in one of your hands. If for some reason you get too much, you can put the cover back on and use it next time. Then, when the pump isn't effectively drawing more product, you can always unscew the lid and get the last little bit. I HATE getting cheated out of product by traditional upright pumps, though I like the hygiene. This offers the best of a pump and a jar.

Caveat: while this does make my morning skin look much nicer, it doesn't seem to have any lasting anti-aging effects. But if you want to look all fresh and hydrated in the morning, this did the trick for me.
summary: Beautifully hydrating, and wonderful stay-clean jar pump (that doesn't cheat you out of product)

reviewText: I have tried other products from this company and really like them. What I liked about this cream is that it goes on smooth with a non-greasy feel. In addition, it stays on all night. I put this on right away washing my face for the evening. You only need a little bit to go all over your face. So, it makes the purchase worth it as it can last a long time. Plus, I did notice that my skin felt softer in the morning and I had a bit of a glow as well. As if my skin was healthier.
Love it.  Just wish it came it bigger tube.  It expensive and you don't get much.

I really like the Tizo sunscreens, but this one, despite being the most expensive, is not my favorite. I just don't love the way it feels going on. There's something... overly slick? ... about it. I still use it anyway on occasion. It's tinted, but it's not any kind of foundation; the tint just prevents that weird white undertone you sometimes get with zinc sunscreen. I use it under whatever makeup I'm using. I have to say it does seem to moisturize my skin, and it certainly keeps me from burning, which is the most important thing. As far as other anti-aging effects, I'm not sure whether this does anything in that regard. However, keeping the sun off your face is the most potent anti-aging action you can take, so I'm gonna say this stuff does at least most of what it claims to do.
summary: Not sure what else it's doing, but it's definitely an excellent sunscreen

reviewText: I used this on a recent trip across the country instead of taking two glass bottles of my more expensive usual moisturizer with spf and my concealer. It worked well. But it is very drying and thick. Its not something I would use at home or for a very big occasion when I was going to be photographed a lot. For traveling it was ace because of its size and container and that it can do double duty.

This product doesn't really say what it is. The listing here on Amazon says it's a primer but all the tube says is AM replenish. I found that it worked well as a primer, moisturizer and a sunscreen. The SPF is 40, which I appreciated. Usually facial moisturizers are only SPF 15. The product was tinted coming out of the tube but once I rubbed it in, it seemed to leave only the slightest hint of a tint on my skin. That was good because I am super pale and the tint coming out of the tube would have been too dark for me. My only real complaint is that the writing on the tube is so small that I literally could not read it.

I'm not sure whether it is the ceramicides or the zinc oxide (likely the latter), but I didn't like how this felt on my skin.  I'd use this on a day when I was going to be out in the yard all day working because I think zinc oxide lasts longer than the chemical sun screens, but I wore it to work and really hated how my skin felt all day so I wouldn't do that again.
summary: Hated how it felt on my face

reviewText:
I like to use moisturizers and sunscreens that have a tint. This product has tint, covers your skin very nicely and is also a sunscreen. a huge minus is that it is not waterproof and I found myself reapplying it a few times during the day while I was outside on a sunny day.

I would like to give it a 5 star but the price is too much for the amount in the tube.

This lotion works great and if you can afford it, go for it, you will not regret it.
summary: Works great as a moisturizer and sunscreen

reviewText: I wouldn't be able to afford this if not asked to review it, so I've deducted a star for the price. That said, if I -could- afford it, I would definitely purchase it. I liked the way it felt on my skin and the light color blended well and left a nice finish. I took "primer" to mean it was sunscreen you could use under foundation (like most) but agree with someone who said the packaging strives to cover too much. It has ceramicides--accounting in part for the cost--and is intended to firm skin and give it a more youthful appearance. For me, it felt good and provided a good level of sun protection. It also was liked by family members who normally refuse to wear sunscreen. They lied this one. I did, too, it's just a bit too high in cost.
summary: Nice skin care product and sunscreen if you don't mind the price

reviewText: Did nothing

I love the Oribe bright blonde radiance spray. I've been using it twice a week for about 8 weeks and I didn't have brassiness between colors. I know some complained about dryness, but I didn't have that experience. I highly recommend this for use between colors.
I love all of the Elemis products.
